At this point, the Emperor narrowed his eyes. "There happens to be a vacancy in the Ministry of War at the rank of Langzhong, which is equivalent to your current rank."

In this dynasty, civil officials were valued over military ones. Although Zhao Xuanyou commanded a military region, apart from being the heir of the Marquis of Jingyuan, he was only a fifth-rank general.

A Langzhong in the Ministry of War was also fifth-rank, so it was indeed equivalent.

"Your subject thanks..."

"There's no need to thank me. Although you are a fifth-rank military officer, your meritorious service is outstanding. Serving as a fifth-rank official in the capital would be a waste of your talents." The Emperor pondered for a moment. "There is a vacancy for a military advisor in the Secretariat. That would be a more suitable position for you."

A military advisor in the Secretariat was a fourth-rank official. This was not only staying in the capital but also a promotion.

Zhao Xuanyou declined, "Your subject has never served as a civil official. Being granted the position of Langzhong is already a great imperial favor."

The Emperor smiled, "You may not have served as a civil official, but you are no worse than any civil official in the court. Alright, accept my decree and withdraw."

"Your subject obeys the decree and thanks Your Majesty."

Zhao Xuanyou respectfully withdrew. With the Emperor's decree, a young eunuch led him to the Imperial Household Department to receive his reward.

At the Imperial Household Department, since the Emperor had said to let Zhao Xuanyou choose for himself, the eunuch in charge, following the decree, brought out all the bolts for Zhao Xuanyou to choose from.

Zhao Xuanyou had never paid much attention to fabrics. He first picked two bolts of steady colors for his grandmother. The remaining three were all brightly colored, and just as he was about to leave, a sharp and arrogant voice suddenly came from behind him.

"There are only twenty bolts of floral satin in total. Who are you to take so many?"

---

chapters.title: The First Clue
chapters.content:
"The slaves greet Princess Yi'an." The eunuchs of the Imperial Household Department knelt in unison.

So it was Princess Yi'an who had arrived.

Zhao Xuanyou turned around and cupped his hands in greeting, "Your subject Zhao Xuanyou greets Princess Yi'an."

"Zhao Xuanyou?" Princess Yi'an frowned slightly upon hearing his introduction.

She had just turned seventeen last month. She had an oval face, willow-leaf eyebrows, and was originally quite charming. However, she was naturally noble and spoiled by the Emperor and Empress, which made her often look at others with disdain.

"Yes." Zhao Xuanyou replied calmly.

"This name does sound familiar."

Seeing that she couldn't recall, a young eunuch beside her timely reminded, "This is the heir of the Marquis of Jingyuan, Lord Zhao, whom His Majesty appointed today as a military advisor in the Secretariat."

"Marquis of Jingyuan?" Princess Yi'an's eyes suddenly lit up. "Oh, you are Cui Yichu's... beloved husband?"

"Yichu is indeed my wife."

Princess Yi'an instantly took a strong interest in him and looked him up and down carefully.

Seeing his tall figure, handsome appearance, deep and profound eyes, and noble demeanor, Princess Yi'an felt a pang of jealousy. "Do you know that Cui Yichu used to be my study companion?"

"I do."

When Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu got married last year, Princess Yi'an had sent a congratulatory gift, and her servants had come to inform Zhao Xuanyou.

However, he had thought that since his wife had been a study companion to the Princess, their relationship must be close. But judging by the Princess's tone, she seemed to dislike his wife, and even held some hostility towards her.

He recalled what Ye Moqing had told him about the unfavorable rumors regarding his wife in the palace.

Many thoughts crossed his mind, but his expression remained calm as he respectfully replied, "Yes."

"Your Highness," the eunuch of the Imperial Household Department said, "His Majesty has generously rewarded the Heir, and he is currently receiving his reward."

"So that's why someone was taking so many bolts of floral satin. It turns out it was by Father Emperor's order," Princess Yi'an finally averted her gaze and walked forward to examine the five bolts of floral satin Zhao Xuanyou had chosen.

First were the lotus green and autumn fragrance for Lady Ye, then the water green, goose yellow, and apricot red for Cui Yichu.

Princess Yi'an smiled, "Are these three bolts all for Cui Yichu?"

"Yes."

"It's rare for Father Emperor to bestow a reward, yet the Heir doesn't keep a single bolt for himself. He truly dotes on his wife."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression was indifferent, "Your Highness overpraises me."

Princess Yi'an could see his mood but didn't mind. She continued, "Mother Empress also bestowed a bolt upon me today. I had my eye on the goose yellow, but the last bolt was taken by you."

"Feel free, Your Highness."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's cold and decisive tone, Princess Yi'an's eyes filled with more amusement. "Thank you, Heir, for your generosity. I see that the stone green satin is also quite good. The Heir should take it back to make a new set of clothes for himself."

"Thank you, Your Highness. Your subject takes his leave."

Zhao Xuanyou spoke briefly, bowed, and took his leave. The eunuch beside him quickly gathered the five bolts of satin and escorted him out of the palace.

Watching his retreating figure, Princess Yi'an curled her lip and let out a soft scoff.

The palace maid beside her quickly picked up the bolt of goose yellow satin she wanted and softly said, "Your Highness, we can return to the palace now."

As they walked out of the Imperial Household Department, they could still see Zhao Xuanyou's figure in the distance.

The palace maid said, "I didn't expect this Heir to be much stronger than the young masters of other noble families in the capital."

"Isn't that right? I originally thought Cui Yichu had no other choice but to marry an older, coarse military man. Who would have thought he would be such a person?"

Princess Yi'an was a proud daughter of heaven, accustomed to looking down on everyone. But upon meeting Zhao Xuanyou, even she couldn't help but feel a stir.

He was elegant and otherworldly, both literate and martial, neither servile nor overbearing, with a remarkable demeanor. Moreover, he was highly favored by the Emperor. Upon returning to the capital, he was not only promoted but also assigned to the Secretariat, a crucial government office, clearly indicating the Emperor's intention to entrust him with important tasks.

She had not yet been betrothed because she had never found a suitable candidate.

If she had known earlier that the heir of the Marquis of Jingyuan was such a person...

"What a lucky break for that wretch."

The palace maid saw that she was angry and softly said, "She has indeed struck gold. The heir of the Marquis of Jingyuan is the one who has suffered a great misfortune."

Princess Yi'an helplessly nodded, then glared at the palace maid and disdainfully said, "Mother said not to mention this matter again. Be careful with your head."

"The slave understands."

---

The carriage rumbled along, and Zhao Xuanyou leaned against the window, looking at the streets outside, his mind restless.

Initially, when he heard from Ye Moqing that there were unfavorable rumors about Cui Yichu in the palace, he hadn't taken it to heart.

Cui Yichu was beautiful and noble, so it was natural that she would attract gossip.

But she had been a study companion to Princess Yi'an in the palace. Even if there were rumors, Princess Yi'an should be the one who understood her best. Why would she show such disdain towards her?

His wife was usually cold and distant, but at night, when she let down all her guards, she was gentle and lovable. Anyone would like her.

Princess Yi'an had known her for many years, so how could she not know her true character?

That day, Ye Moqing's exact words were that the Empress disliked Cui Yichu, not only preventing her from marrying into the imperial family but also stopping her from continuing as the Princess's study companion.

At the time, he had thought it must be groundless, but after speaking with Princess Yi'an, given the Princess's attitude towards Cui Yichu, it was clear that the rumors were not baseless.

What on earth had happened... to make his wife seen as a thorn in the eyes of the Empress and the Princess?

Zhao Xuanyou had never hesitated on the battlefield, but now he was at a loss.

He wanted to return home and ask Cui Yichu for clarification, but he felt that doing so because of others' attitudes might harm their marital relationship.

Recalling the affectionate moments they shared in the embroidered tent, Zhao Xuanyou ultimately couldn't bear to do so.

After much deliberation, he finally suppressed this thought.

This chapter is not yet complete. Please click on the next page to continue reading the following exciting content!

The carriage stopped in front of the Marquis's residence. Before he could enter, he saw Manager Song hurrying over.

"What's the matter?"

"Just now, someone from the official office came. They said that Mama Zhou died in prison."

Died?

Mama Zhou had embezzled a large amount of silver, but her crime wasn't punishable by death.

"How did she die?"

Manager Song hesitated for a moment before softly saying, "Earlier, someone from the Xingguo Duke's residence went to visit her in prison. The magistrate, considering that the Duke's residence is the Heir's in-law, recorded Mama Zhou's death as suicide out of guilt."

Zhao Xuanyou immediately recalled her advising him to silence Mama Zhou last night.

"Did the Madam send someone out this morning?"

"Cui Rong went to Liu Fang Hall early in the morning and then left the residence in a carriage."

Cui Rong was Cui Yichu's personal maid and had her own carriage. Normally, she ran errands for Cui Yichu without needing the Marquis's residence's permission. However, the stables and gatehouse belonged to the front courtyard, so Manager Song could still notice Cui Rong's movements.

Had she ordered the Duke's residence to take action?

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes turned cold.

Perhaps his wife truly had many things he didn't know about.

He said nothing, got back into the carriage, and ordered the coachman to head to the Anning Marquis's residence.

Ye Moqing was very sociable. Seeing Zhao Xuanyou arrive, he didn't notice his expression and called a few more friends.

Because Zhao Xuanyou had been promoted to a fourth-rank official in the capital and assigned to the Secretariat, Ye Moqing celebrated with him by renting a decorated boat to tour the lake, inviting the most famous singing girls in the capital to perform. The wine flowed freely, and the atmosphere was lively.

Zhao Xuanyou sat among the flowers, his mind elsewhere the entire time.

The singing girls' voices were melodious, but he didn't catch a single lyric, only continuously drinking.

Ye Moqing initially didn't notice, but when he saw the wine pot empty in a short time, he realized Zhao Xuanyou was acting strangely.

Under the pretense of sobering up, Ye Moqing led Zhao Xuanyou to the stern of the boat.

"Brother, what's going on? You've been drinking silently all evening." Ye Moqing asked in confusion. "His Majesty promoted you to a military advisor in the Secretariat today. It's a huge joyous occasion. Why do you look so troubled?"

Zhao Xuanyou had an excellent capacity for alcohol. Even after drinking a lot, the night breeze quickly sobered him up.

Seeing that no one had followed them, he said heavily, "How much do you know about my wife?"

chapters.title: Frivolous Conduct
chapters.content:
"Huh?" That day, when Ye Mo Juan saw Zhao Xuanyou defending Cui Yichu so fiercely, he realized that their marriage was harmonious. He had already made up his mind not to speak ill of Cui Yichu in front of Zhao Xuanyou.

After returning to the Anning Marquis's residence, he even told his third sister that his sister-in-law was an extremely good person. In the future, if they heard any more idle gossip, they should scold those gossips.

"What happened now?"

Zhao Xuanyou exhaled heavily. "Today, even in the palace, I heard rumors about my wife."

"Huh?" Ye Mo Juan was stunned. Someone dared to speak ill of Zhao Xuanyou's wife in front of him? "People from the palace? In front of you?"

Zhao Xuanyou gave a bitter smile and lowered his voice. "It was Princess Yi'an. Although she didn't say anything, I could tell that she dislikes my wife very much."

"So that's it." Ye Mo Juan scratched his face.

"Do you know why?"

Ye Mo Juan shook his head. "My third sister is currently a companion reader for Princess Yining. Last time, when you asked where the rumors came from, she also heard it from Princess Yining."

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened.

If it were just Princess Yi'an, it might be because Cui Yichu had somehow offended her. But now Princess Yining was saying the same thing, which showed that Cui Yichu was indeed disliked by the Empress.

When Zhao Xuanyou had an audience with the Emperor today, the Emperor did not mention anything about his marriage, nor did he show any displeasure. It seemed that only the Empress and a few princesses knew about this matter.

He shouldn't have cared at all, but thinking about how last night she had personally promised to spare Zhou Mama's life, and this morning she had sent Cui Rong back to the Duke's residence, and before noon, Zhou Mama had lost her life.

He thought that between them as husband and wife, they were honest and open with each other, with nothing hidden.

But in her heart, only the Xingguo Duke's residence was worth relying on.

Looking at the pleasure boats on the lake, one after another, filled with music and dance, Zhao Xuanyou felt an emptiness in his heart.

"Did Princess Yining say why?"

"No." Ye Mo Juan saw that Zhao Xuanyou had changed his attitude tonight and was particularly concerned about this matter. After thinking for a moment, he disclosed everything he knew. "I'm just repeating what my third sister said."

"Mmm."

"The princess said that my sister-in-law is frivolous in her conduct and not a person worth associating with."

As soon as Ye Mo Juan finished speaking, he clearly felt Zhao Xuanyou's grip on the railing tighten.

He knew Zhao Xuanyou was angry and advised, "My sister-in-law must have done something in the past when she was in the palace that displeased the Empress and the princesses. But as the saying goes, serving the ruler is like serving a tiger. It's not necessarily my sister-in-law's fault if she offended them. Since you know my sister-in-law's character, you don't need to pay attention to these things."

Did he know her character?

If it were yesterday, Zhao Xuanyou would have been certain and would not have been shaken by Princess Yi'an's attitude.

But after experiencing Zhou Mama's death, he had doubts.

A cold wind blew across the lake, sweeping away the effects of the alcohol on Zhao Xuanyou.

"It's getting late. I should return to the residence."

"That's good. It's almost curfew time. Let's go together."

Ye Mo Juan ordered the boatman to dock the pleasure boat by the shore, and everyone went home in their respective carriages.

When he returned to the Marquis's residence, it was already late at night. Zhao Xuanyou did not go to Liu Fang Hall but instead rested in Honghui Hall.

A moment after the lights were extinguished in Honghui Hall, a maid hurried into Liu Fang Hall and reported to Cui Yichu, "Madam, the Heir has already returned to the residence. Tonight, he is resting in Honghui Hall."

"Is that so?" Cui Yichu's eyes showed some surprise.

Since Zhao Xuanyou had returned to the capital, he had spent every night in Liu Fang Hall.

Previously, there was one time when he returned late, and the maids said she had already gone to bed, but he still groped his way in.

Why tonight...

Seeing Cui Yichu's worried expression, Baozhu softly advised, "In any case, Madam doesn't plan to have Yu Wan attend to you tonight. It's better that the Heir rests in Honghui Hall."

Cui Yichu slightly shook her head.

Her mother had already instructed her that since Zhao Xuanyou had seen Yu Wan, she must not let Yu Wan serve him again.

Last night was too late to arrange, but tonight she had prepared an excuse.

She had intended to wait for him to come and then, under the pretense of catching a slight cold, ask to rest in the side room. But now, Zhao Xuanyou had not come.

Baopeng brought the calming soup forward. "Madam, don't overthink it. Please rest early."

"Ever since Zhou Mama was taken away," Cui Yichu said, covering her chest and sighing softly, "my heart has been in suspense, feeling that something is not right."

"Zhou Mama was the one who accompanied Madam to marry into the Marquis's residence. She managed the inner residence for Madam. Now that she is gone, Madam has lost her right-hand woman and is simply unaccustomed."

Cui Yichu sighed. "You know that I wanted to save her, but the Heir pressed so urgently. If the yamen had interrogated her, it would have definitely caused trouble for the Duke's residence."

"It was unavoidable for the Duke and Madam."

Baozhu and Baopeng did not like Zhou Mama. After all, with Zhou Mama around, the two senior maids were always suppressed.

But with the hare dead, the fox mourns. As servants, they knew that Zhou Mama had been silenced by the Duke's residence in prison and could not help but feel a pang of sympathy.

Zhou Mama was an old servant of the Duke's residence. She had served for so many years and ended up like this. If one day they met with misfortune, their fate would not be better than Zhou Mama's.

Cui Yichu was sharp-eyed and quick-eared. Looking at the expressions of the two maids, she more or less guessed their thoughts.

She was naturally disdainful of such thoughts.

Servants were originally tools for the masters to use. Living for the master and dying for the master were natural and justified.

However, she had just lost Zhou Mama and needed Baopeng and Baozhu to loyally serve her even more.

"Isn't it unavoidable? Who knew the Heir would treat me like this... Now that Zhou Mama is gone, her family will be taken care of by the Duke's residence. My father is currently at the yamen trying to save her. Once she is out of trouble, we will give some money to let her continue running the restaurant."

"His Lordship truly has a compassionate heart."

"If Zhou Mama knew this in the afterlife, she could rest in peace."

Listening to the two senior maids, Cui Yichu raised her delicate eyebrows slightly and nodded. "The Heir is now dissatisfied with me. It seems that it is indeed time to promote someone in the residence."

"Does Madam mean Yu Wan?" Baopeng asked anxiously. She disliked Yu Wan, that vixen, the most. If she were really promoted, wouldn't her status surpass her own?

Cui Yichu shot her a glance.

Baozhu, however, understood Cui Yichu's intentions. "It's not her turn. The Phoenix Tang sent by Prince Ping's residence has not been arranged yet."

"How does Madam plan to arrange Phoenix Tang?"

"What else can be done? Elevate her to the status of a concubine."

Phoenix Tang was a person sent by the Prince's residence. Elevating her to a concubine would be giving face to the Prince.

Zhao Xuanyou had inexplicably become dissatisfied with her. Letting Phoenix Tang come out to divert his attention would be good.

After all, she was just a dancer. No matter how much trouble she caused, she could not surpass her.

Baozhu thought for a moment. "Phoenix Tang is easy to handle, but Yu Wan goes to Honghui Hall every day under the pretense of tending flowers. Madam, you must be on guard against this."

Previously, they had been focused on the matter of Zhou Mama being taken by the Heir, but apart from this, Yu Wan going to Honghui Hall was also a major issue.

No matter how Baozhu thought about it, she felt that Yu Wan had done it intentionally.

Hearing this, Cui Yichu's expression remained indifferent. "She is originally a cheap slut. It's natural for her to try to seduce the Heir. Moreover, with the position of a concubine that I promised her, she dares to act so boldly."

Baopeng's eyes lit up, and she looked eagerly at Cui Yichu. "Madam, then should we immediately..."

---

chapters.title: The Heir Needs People
chapters.content:
Baopeng believed that Yu Wan had already committed a grave offense against Cui Yichu and was doomed to die.

But before she could finish her sentence, she was met with a light, dismissive glance from Cui Yichu. Her heart panicked. Could it be that Madam still did not intend to kill Yu Wan?

"In my opinion, this incident with Zhou Mama is also Yu Wan's fault." Baopeng continued, unwilling to give up. "Madam usually never leaves the residence, but coincidentally, as soon as Madam stepped out, Yu Wan went to Honghui Hall. Zhou Mama was worried that this slut would try to seduce the Heir, so she followed her there."

Seeing that Cui Yichu was unmoved, Baopeng added, "If Madam had been in the residence, she would have stopped the Heir and prevented him from sending Zhou Mama to the authorities."

That was true.

If it had just been driving her out of the residence, Zhou Mama could have returned to the Duke's residence to work. It wouldn't have come to losing her life.

The night wind rustled the bamboo curtains by the window, and the moonlight that filtered in was particularly hazy.

Cui Yichu's expression was unreadable as she slowly spoke, "That makes sense."

Baopeng hastily advised, "Since Madam has made a decision, why not act quickly? At this moment, take advantage of the night to have someone tie up Yu Wan, give her twenty strokes of the board, and throw her into a brothel. Her face is still worth some money."

As soon as she finished speaking, she clearly felt that Cui Yichu's eyes had grown colder. She realized she had misspoken.

Yu Wan bore some resemblance to Cui Yichu. Stepping on Yu Wan's face was equivalent to insulting Cui Yichu.

"There's no rush." Baozhu, however, did not agree. "The Heir's actions are somewhat unpredictable lately. Yu Wan has shown her face to the Heir and is even working in Honghui Hall. If we rashly kill her, it will surely alert the Heir."

"Killing Yu Wan is not urgent. I have my own arrangements."

Today, Cui Rong had brought back her mother's instructions from the Duke's residence, which was also to tell her not to act recklessly.

Zhao Xuanyou had a position in the military and would not stay in the capital for long. She could let that little vixen Yu Wan strut around for a few days. Once Zhao Xuanyou left the capital, she would immediately deal with her.

With Zhao Xuanyou gone, the Old Dowager would not be able to control her.

"I'll go to sleep first, Baozhu."

"Slave is here."

"Tomorrow morning, go to Honghui Hall and invite the Heir to come for breakfast."

"Yes."

"Baopeng, go to the kitchen early tomorrow and instruct them to prepare a lavish meal. Add a few dishes with a northwestern flavor."

"Yes."

Soon, the lights and candles in Liu Fang Hall were extinguished. In the side room, Yu Wan also lay down.

She had thought that Cui Yichu would not let her get close to Zhao Xuanyou tonight, but she had not expected that Zhao Xuanyou would not come to Liu Fang Hall tonight.

For Yu Wan, this was good news. It indicated that Zhao Xuanyou's attitude toward Cui Yichu had softened.

She slept peacefully until dawn.

The next morning, after finishing her toilet, Yu Wan headed to the flower room. As soon as she reached the courtyard gate, she ran into Baozhu, who had a gloomy face.

"Sister Baozhu."

Baozhu glanced at her and walked straight toward the main house, seemingly in a hurry to report something to Cui Yichu.

Yu Wan quickly made her way to the flower room, picked a pot of blooming jasmine, and carried the flowers toward Honghui Hall.

Having come several times, the guards at the gate were familiar with her. Because she was pretty and clever, they were happy to exchange a few pleasantries with her.

Yu Wan entered the courtyard and saw the kitchen staff coming out with empty trays, indicating that Zhao Xuanyou was having breakfast.

Previously, he had eaten in Liu Fang Hall. Baozhu's expression was so poor, perhaps she had encountered a setback with Zhao Xuanyou.

Yu Wan did not go into the house. Instead, she busied herself in the courtyard, tending to the flowers and plants. She trimmed the overgrown branches and gently wiped the dust off the leaves with a handkerchief.

While she was busy, Yuan Qing's voice suddenly came from behind her.

"Why are you here so early?"

Yu Wan turned around and smiled at him. "The matters of Honghui Hall are naturally of the utmost importance. The managing mama hasn't assigned me any other tasks, so coming early allows me to do a more thorough job."

Of course, this was just an excuse. Jasmine was not a delicate flower and did not require such meticulous care.

Coming to Honghui Hall early was simply because she was worried that Zhao Xuanyou might go out again and she would miss seeing him.

Yuan Qing said, "I only asked you one question, and you've said so much."

Yu Wan had indeed said too much. Fortunately, Yuan Qing was not a suspicious person and did not think that Yu Wan was hiding her true intentions.

"If you think I talk too much, then I won't say anything." Yu Wan turned back to continue wiping the leaves.

"Don't be angry. I have good news for you."

"What good news?" Yu Wan was not particularly interested.

Yuan Qing smiled and said, "His Highness the Heir was granted the position of a military advisor by the Emperor today. In the future, there will be more work at Honghui Hall. This place will definitely need to add more maids. If you're willing, I can ask Manager Song to arrange for you to come and work here."

Zhao Xuanyou had only brought twenty guards and two attendants with him when he returned to the capital this time. If he were to stay long-term, Honghui Hall would indeed need more maids.

Yu Wan was beautiful, intelligent, efficient in her work, and pleasant to talk to. Naturally, Yuan Qing was happy to have her come to Honghui Hall.

"Has the Heir been appointed as an official in the capital?" Yu Wan had not expected that when she had earnestly pleaded with Zhao Xuanyou in the embroidered tent to stay, he had agreed so casually, yet he had truly accomplished it.

This was great. If he stayed in the capital, Cui Yichu would not be able to do as she pleased in the residence.

"You seem very happy?"

"His Highness the Heir is kind. Working at Honghui Hall will certainly be better than elsewhere," Yu Wan smiled. "However, my happiness is not just for myself. His Highness staying in the capital, I wonder how happy Madam will be when she hears this news."

Yes, at this moment, Liu Fang Hall should have already heard the news of Zhao Xuanyou becoming an official in the capital.

Cui Yichu's expression... must be quite something.

Yu Wan entered the courtyard and saw that the furnishings and decorations in the room had some years to them. Although they were not as exquisite and luxurious as those in Liu Fang Hall, each piece had a certain texture and was antique and grand.

Zhao Xuanyou had already finished his meal. The table was set with empty bowls and plates. The dishes on the table looked neat and untouched, as if no one had touched them. Moreover, they all looked like dishes that Cui Yichu liked.

There was ham and egg drop soup, pan-fried yellow croaker, poached chicken shreds, and stir-fried bamboo shoots. Only the steamer baskets with meat buns and dumplings seemed to have been specially added for Zhao Xuanyou.

Yuan Qing brought clean bowls and plates and whispered, "The person in charge of the kitchen is Madam's dowry maid. His Highness is not used to these dishes and hasn't touched them. He separately ordered a bowl of meat noodle soup."

Zhao Xuanyou had been leading troops in the north for many years and had long adapted to the food there. He was not used to the refined dishes of the capital.

Previously, in Liu Fang Hall, he had only enjoyed eating with Cui Yichu.

Yu Wan picked up her chopsticks and chose a bun to eat. "Since it's a reward from His Highness, how could I be picky?"

The bun was filled with wild mushrooms and pork. The rich aroma of the pork and the fresh fragrance of the wild mushrooms blended together, making it exceptionally fresh and delicious.

"Does Liu Fang Hall often bestow dishes?" Yuan Qing asked curiously.

"I'm not one of the close attendants to Madam, so I don't often receive dishes."

Cui Yichu had a very small appetite, and there were always leftovers from her meals. She would indeed bestow them upon the servants, but only to Baozhu, Baopeng, and the accompanying servants. It never reached Yu Wan.

Thinking about this, when Cui Yichu had once bestowed food upon all the servants in the residence, it was to set up the situation for her to take the aphrodisiac and the trap. Unfortunately, she had not seen through it at the time.

Seeing Yu Wan slightly lost in thought, Yuan Qing said, "Actually, the good news I wanted to tell you earlier is not just about the bestowed dishes."

"What other good news is there?" Yu Wan regained her composure, her eyebrows twitching.

Yuan Qing smiled and said, "The Emperor has appointed His Highness the Heir to the position of a military advisor. In the future, there will be more work at Honghui Hall. This place will definitely need to add more maids. If you're willing, I can ask Manager Song to arrange for you to come and work here."

Zhao Xuanyou had only brought twenty guards and two attendants with him when he returned to the capital this time. If he were to stay long-term, Honghui Hall would indeed need more maids.

Yu Wan was beautiful, intelligent, efficient in her work, and pleasant to talk to. Naturally, Yuan Qing was happy to have her come to Honghui Hall.

"Has the Heir been appointed as an official in the capital?" Yu Wan had not expected that when she had earnestly pleaded with Zhao Xuanyou in the embroidered tent to stay, he had agreed so casually, yet he had truly accomplished it.

This was great. If he stayed in the capital, Cui Yichu would not be able to do as she pleased in the residence.

"You seem very happy?"

"His Highness the Heir is kind. Working at Honghui Hall will certainly be better than elsewhere," Yu Wan smiled. "However, my happiness is not just for myself. His Highness staying in the capital, I wonder how happy Madam will be when she hears this news."

chapters.title: The Magpie Brings Joy
chapters.content:
"Yuan Qing." Zhao Xuanyou's voice came from inside the house.

Yuan Qing quickly put down his chopsticks, gesturing for Yu Wan to continue eating, and hurried into the house.

"Master." Yuan Qing entered the room and saw another attendant, Yuan Qi, standing beside Zhao Xuanyou. "Are you going out?"

Yuan Qi was a native servant of the Jingyuan Marquis' mansion, a year older than Zhao Xuanyou. He was steady in his work and often ran errands for Zhao Xuanyou outside.

Seeing him at Honghui Hall, it seemed the young master was about to go out again.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

After the emperor had kept him in the capital yesterday, he had received many banquet invitations this morning. Most of them Zhao Xuanyou could ignore, but he could not refuse the kind invitations from the two prime ministers of the Secretariat.

Yuan Qing had followed Zhao Xuanyou on the frontier and was not very familiar with the official circles of the capital, so he usually did not accompany him on outings.

Now, seeing Zhao Xuanyou call him in, he knew there was more to be said. He respectfully asked, "Master, do you have any instructions?"

"I have been assigned to stay in the capital. The mistress probably does not know yet. Go to Liu Fang Hall and inform her."

If it had been before yesterday, Zhao Xuanyou would have personally told the mistress such joyful news. Now, he was sending Yuan Qing to deliver the message, showing the distance between them.

Before Yuan Qing could respond, Zhao Xuanyou continued, "Take the brocade I brought from the palace yesterday to the mistress. One bolt of water-green and one bolt of apricot-red."

"Yes."

Yuan Qing was about to leave to fetch the items from the storeroom when Zhao Xuanyou suddenly remembered the faint sound of conversation he had heard. He shot Yuan Qing a sideways glance. "Who were you eating with in the side room just now?"

"I saw there was still a lot of food left on the table. Yu Wan hadn't had breakfast either, so I let her join me."

Recalling that graceful figure, Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently, "You sure know how to use my things to curry favor."

"If Yu Wan and I don't eat, it will just go to the kitchen staff when we take it back." Yuan Qing scratched his head. Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's relaxed expression, he gathered his courage and said, "Master, I think Yu Wan is quite diligent. She takes good care of the flowers in the garden. If Honghui Hall needs more people in the future, can she come?"

If it were someone else saying this to Zhao Xuanyou, he would think they were overreaching.

But Yuan Qing was someone Zhao Xuanyou had saved from the battlefield.

Years ago, Yuan Qing's village had been massacred by the enemy. Yuan Qing had been hidden in a cellar by his sister. To protect him, his sister had not moved even as she lay dying, until the soldiers moved her body and discovered the cellar entrance.

His sister had been only fifteen or sixteen when she died, about the same age as Yu Wan. Zhao Xuanyou understood why Yuan Qing was so kind to Yu Wan.

"This is a matter for Steward Song to worry about. Don't make decisions on your own."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou left with Yuan Qi.

Yuan Qing returned to the side room and saw that Yu Wan had already gone to work in the courtyard. The remaining bowls and chopsticks on the table had been tidied up and stacked in one place.

Yu Wan was indeed like his sister; efficient and diligent.

Yuan Qing went to the back courtyard and saw Yu Wan collecting her tools. He smiled and asked, "Sister Yu Wan, why did you eat so quickly?"

"If you weren't here, I'm not part of Honghui Hall. If others see me eating and drinking alone here, they might take me for a thief."

"Now it's not, but soon it will be."

Hearing this, Yu Wan's eyes flickered. She thought of how Yuan Qing had mentioned that Honghui Hall would be adding some maids, but there had been no definite news before. Now it sounded certain. Could it be that he had spoken to Zhao Xuanyou?

If she could truly become a maid of Honghui Hall, not only would she see Zhao Xuanyou every day, but she would also no longer have to live in fear under Cui Yi's control.

"Did you ask the young master?"

"Mmm."

"Won't the young master be displeased if you ask like that?"

"Why would the young master be displeased?" Yuan Qing did not understand.

"How can a servant influence the master's thoughts?" Yu Wan saw that he did not understand the intricacies of the inner quarters and explained helplessly, "If I were to request to serve at Honghui Hall in front of the young master's wife, both of us would have been beaten by now."

"Good thing I don't serve the young master's wife."

Seeing that he was completely unaware of the danger, Yu Wan had to be more explicit. "The matter of me coming to Honghui Hall is not settled yet. You must not spread it around. If others find out, they will definitely interfere."

If Cui Yi found out, she would surely obstruct it.

As the mistress in charge of the household, assigning maids was just a matter of a word from her.

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou still had feelings for her and would not humiliate the mistress for the sake of a maid.

"Not even Steward Song?"

"Steward Song can be told, but no one else, especially not the people from Liu Fang Hall. Understood?"

Yuan Qing indeed did not understand the ways of survival in the inner quarters, but he understood Yu Wan's words.

"Do you think the mistress won't let you work at Honghui Hall?"

Yu Wan raised her delicate eyebrows but did not respond.

Although she wanted to escape Cui Yi's clutches as soon as possible, there were too many uncertainties in this matter. If she celebrated prematurely, she might end up even more disappointed.

"Don't worry, I won't say anything reckless." Seeing her sad expression, Yuan Qing knew she did not dare to speak ill of the mistress. He changed the subject. "I'm going to Liu Fang Hall now. If you have nothing to do, help me carry some things."

Yu Wan looked up. "Going to Liu Fang Hall for what?"

"Yesterday, the palace bestowed some things. The master asked me to deliver them to the mistress."

Yu Wan scoffed inwardly. So he still had feelings for Cui Yi. But on the surface, she still smiled. "Then I'll help you carry them."

Yu Wan picked up the bolt of water-green brocade, and Yuan Qing picked up the bolt of apricot-red brocade. Together, they walked toward Liu Fang Hall.

After Mama Zhou's incident, Cui Yi had not yet promoted anyone new. She had let Baozhu take Mama Cui's place to manage the various parts of the rear mansion for her.

When Yu Wan and Yuan Qing entered Liu Fang Hall, only Baopeng was attending inside.

Cui Yi was wearing a thin honey-colored blouse with a jadeite Xiang skirt, looking luxurious in every detail, though each piece was extremely expensive.

She was annoyed that Zhao Xuanyou had not come for breakfast, and she had not even taken a sip of the tea Baopeng had served.

Seeing Yuan Qing appear, Cui Yi first felt a moment of joy, then, seeing Yu Wan behind him, a flicker of displeasure flashed in her eyes. She felt that Yu Wan was like a stubborn plaster, clinging to Honghui Hall, and she would tear her off sooner or later.

"Has the young master gone out?" Cui Yi regained her composure and asked indifferently.

"Yes. Early this morning, the two prime ministers of the Secretariat invited the young master to their residences for a chat. After breakfast, the young master left. Before leaving, he specifically instructed me to bring these things to the mistress."

Cui Yi noticed the bolts of brocade in their hands.

Coming from a ducal family and frequently entering the palace, she recognized them at a glance as tribute floral brocade.

Floral brocade was precious, even the palace concubines would fight over it.

"Were these bestowed by the palace yesterday?"

"Yes," Yuan Qing held the brocade forward and handed it to Baopeng. "His Majesty was very pleased with the young master and bestowed five bolts of floral brocade. Two bolts went to the Old Madame's place, and two bolts here for the mistress."

"Did the young master keep only one bolt?" The floral brocade was made from the finest silk, with intricate patterns like flowing clouds and water. Even without embroidery, it was extremely beautiful when made into clothing.

Yuan Qing knew the young master cared deeply for the mistress. Although he did not know why they were on bad terms, he still wanted to help his master. So he said, "I heard Yuan Qi say that the master originally did not want to keep any, but yesterday at the Imperial Household Department, he encountered Princess Yi'an. The master gave away one bolt. Because there were no suitable colors left, he kept one bolt for himself."

He had said this to please Cui Yi, but he did not expect Cui Yi to be stunned for a moment.

Yu Wan was just handing the brocade to Baopeng. Being close, she naturally noticed Cui Yi's sudden change in expression.

Why did Cui Yi react so strongly to the princess's name? Could it be that the princess knew of her disgraceful deeds?

Yuan Qing thought he had said the wrong thing. He did not dare to speak of the brocade anymore. He just wanted to finish his errand quickly and return to Honghui Hall. So he continued, "Mistress, the young master sent me here not only to deliver these two bolts of brocade but also to tell you some good news. His Majesty has issued a decree appointing the young master to a position in the Secretariat. From now on, he can stay in the capital permanently."

Cui Yi suddenly stood up, her sleeve knocking over the teacup beside her. It crashed to the ground with a "bang," shattering into pieces.

---

chapters.title: The Poisonous Plot to Silence
chapters.content:
Yu Wan put down the brocade and lowered her head as much as possible, afraid that others would notice her smile.

"Mistress, are you alright?" Baopeng quickly helped Cui Yi sit down and called for maids to come in and clean the floor. She forced a smile and said, "It's a great joy that the young master can stay in the capital from now on."

Hearing these words, Cui Yi gradually regained her senses.

Yuan Qing was still in front of her; she could not lose her composure.

But... how could Zhao Xuanyou stay in the capital? Wasn't he supposed to return to the frontier soon?

"Someone, come and clean this up." Baopeng saw the situation and started shouting. Soon, maids from the courtyard entered with brooms and quickly cleaned up the mess on the floor.

Cui Yi finally calmed down a bit. She looked at Yuan Qing and nodded. "It is indeed a great joy that the young master can stay in the capital. Tonight, we must prepare a feast to celebrate. Yuan Qing."

"Mistress, please give your orders."

"When the young master returns, tell him that dinner will be served at Wangyue Pavilion tonight. I will invite the Old Madame to join us."

"Understood." Yuan Qing said this, cupped his hands to Cui Yi, and retreated.

Yu Wan was about to leave with him when Cui Yi called out to her.

"Yu Wan, you've been quite busy this early morning."

"Mistress, if you have any orders, please instruct this servant."

Cui Yi sneered. "You've buried yourself in Honghui Hall. How dare I give you orders?"

Yu Wan found her words amusing.

Initially, when she was sent to serve Zhao Xuanyou, Cui Yi had repeatedly said she would elevate her to the status of a concubine. Now, she was no longer pretending.

Yu Wan put on a wronged look and lowered her head without speaking.

Baopeng knew that Cui Yi would not kill Yu Wan for the time being, but she hated her deeply. Seeing her pretentious and affected manner, she wished she could go up and tear her apart.

"You dare to go to Honghui Hall to seduce the young master. Even Mama Zhou lost to you. You're really something!"

"What is Sister Baopeng talking about? I only tend to the flowers and plants at Honghui Hall. I already told the mistress about Mama Zhou's matter that day." Yu Wan said this and then pretended to wipe her tears, looking aggrieved. "Moreover, the mistress has already agreed to my status as a concubine. What's wrong with me tending to the flowers for the young master?"

No matter how she was scolded for seducing Zhao Xuanyou, why had Cui Yi initially sent her to serve him while keeping her so close?

"The mistress may have agreed, but she never said when. Are you trying to force the mistress to elevate you to a concubine by rushing to the young master's side?"

Yu Wan looked at Cui Yi with tears in her eyes. "This servant would not dare. Every time I go to Honghui Hall, I only work in the courtyard and do not dare to speak to the young master."

Her eyes were beautiful, and when she cried, they looked even more watery, which inexplicably annoyed Cui Yi.

"Since you're busy with Honghui Hall's affairs, you don't need to live in Liu Fang Hall anymore. Go back to the flower room."

"Yes."

Yu Wan felt a mix of joy and worry.

Moving out of Liu Fang Hall meant she would no longer be under Cui Yi's constant surveillance. However, returning to the flower room meant she would have to share a bunk with six or seven other maids, making it difficult to hide her money and contraceptive medicine.

After Yu Wan left the room, Cui Yi's expression suddenly darkened.

Although Baopeng was not as clever as Baozhu, she had served Cui Yi for many years.

"Look at her crying so falsely. Mistress, Yu Wan must be eliminated as soon as possible. She cannot be allowed to stay. Especially now that the young master will be staying in the capital permanently."

"Why?" Cui Yi's eyes were dark and unclear.

Baopeng said, "Mistress, think about it. Previously, we came up with this plan to make Yu Wan pregnant as soon as possible. While the young master was away, the mistress could fake a pregnancy and give birth. But now that the young master is staying in the capital as an official, this plan will no longer work."

That was true.

Zhao Xuanyou was sharp-eared and sharp-eyed, with exceptional intelligence. In less than half a month since his return, he had dealt with Mama Zhou with lightning speed.

If he stayed in the Marquis' mansion, how could Cui Yi's fake pregnancy possibly be hidden from him?

Cui Yi suddenly realized this. She had been worried about how to deal with Zhao Xuanyou at night but had not considered this aspect.

"Yu Wan is restless. Now that she has shown her face at Honghui Hall, if the mistress does not question her, she keeps talking about being elevated to a concubine. If this drags on, she will definitely expose everything to the young master."

Yu Wan was indeed a huge hidden danger.

She should have been dealt with when she first went to Honghui Hall, but Cui Yi had not expected Zhao Xuanyou to take action against Mama Zhou, which made her afraid to act recklessly.

Her mother had also said that Yu Wan could not be kept, but told her not to act within the Marquis' mansion.

However, Cui Yi truly did not want to wait any longer.

"Mistress, all places have been inspected, and there are no problems," Baozhu entered and saw the serious expressions of the mistress and servant. She asked, "What happened?"

Baopeng then told her about Zhao Xuanyou staying in the capital and the urgent need to deal with Yu Wan.

Baozhu thought for a moment and agreed that Yu Wan needed to be dealt with.

"Two days ago, the kitchen mentioned a rat problem. Steward Song sent someone to deliver rat poison. The kitchen is not far from Liu Fang Hall. If they spread the poison there, it would make sense to do the same here at Liu Fang Hall."

Hearing this, Cui Yi's eyes immediately lit up.

Finally, the time had come to get rid of Yu Wan. Baopeng, like a fighting cock, was full of fighting spirit. "It's still your idea. Yu Wan is just packing her things to roll back to the flower room. I'll go to the kitchen to get the poison."

"Don't go yourself. The kitchen is crowded. Send a little maid to get it." Cui Yi quickly made up her mind and winked at Baozhu. "You go and keep Yu Wan occupied. Don't let her run away."

Although it was not appropriate for Yu Wan to die in Liu Fang Hall, Zhao Xuanyou was watching her now. If they were to poison Yu Wan in the flower room, someone else would surely notice.

Liu Fang Hall was filled with her people inside and out. She could erase all traces. Even if Zhao Xuanyou suspected something, he would not be able to search Liu Fang Hall.

The chapter is not yet finished. Please click on the next page to continue reading the following exciting content!

As long as Yu Wan was dead, there would be no witness.

Zhao Xuanyou had sent tribute floral brocade this morning, showing that he still had feelings for her.

She must remove this hidden danger before he found out that the person she favored was Yu Wan.

Baopeng then sent someone to the kitchen to fetch the rat poison. Soon, the poison was brought over. Baozhu mixed the poison with water and dipped each piece of the red bean chestnut cake on the table into it.

"Don't dip too much, or she might notice the taste," Baopeng said. "The kitchen staff said this rat poison is potent. A little bit is enough to kill."

Baozhu sniffed it. "It doesn't smell like anything. She probably won't taste it."

The red bean chestnut cake was very sweet and rich. Mixing a little something into it should go unnoticed.

After watching the poison soak into the cake, Baozhu picked up the plate and went to the side room. Baopeng took the poisoned water and sprinkled it around the courtyard.

In the side room, Yu Wan had just sorted out her clothes. She only had two or three outfits. The rest were nightclothes given by Cui Yi, which she folded separately and placed aside.

Seeing Baozhu enter, Yu Wan looked at her uneasily. "Sister Baozhu, does the mistress have any more instructions?"

"I heard that the mistress wants you to return to the flower room. I asked about it specially. After you left for Liu Fang Hall, the flower room filled your vacancy. There's no place for you there now. Stay in Liu Fang Hall for another day. Tomorrow, when there's space, you can go back."

"Thank you, Sister Baozhu, for thinking so carefully on my behalf."

"The mistress said that you have been diligent in your duties and have served the young master well. Even if you have no merits, you have worked hard. This plate of chestnut cakes was just sent from the kitchen. Eat them while they're hot."

chapters.title: The Porcelain Vase is Fragile
chapters.content:
Baozhu was the head maid of Liu Fang Hall and the most trusted person by Lady Cui Yichu, the wife of the heir. She was undeniably prominent in the Marquis's mansion.

Even the flower room maids, who were of equal status to Yu Yuan, found it difficult to exchange a word with Baozhu.

Yet, Baozhu treated Yu Yuan with kindness.

The first time, she had persuaded Yu Yuan to drink the fruit wine bestowed by Lady Cui Yichu. That night, Yu Yuan had been drugged with an aphrodisiac and carried to Zhao Xuanyou’s bed.

This time, Baozhu brought her the red bean chestnut cakes that Lady Cui Yichu had bestowed, urging her to eat them while they were hot.

Who knew where they would take her after she ate the chestnut cakes?

To the mass grave outside the city?

"Did the lady really bestow this?" Yu Yuan, flattered, accepted it with both hands. "Earlier, when the lady questioned me, I thought she was angry with me and wouldn’t use me anymore."

"Just the other day, Mother Zhou got into trouble, so the lady was in a bad mood. As servants, we naturally have to endure some temper. But the lady is clear-headed and knows that Mother Zhou’s matter isn’t your fault, so she rewarded you with good things."

"Thank you, sister, for conveying my gratitude to the lady."

"You’ve almost finished tidying up. Aren’t you going to eat?"

"Alright, I’ll go fetch a basin of water. Sister, you can wash your hands and try some together?"

Seeing Baozhu urging her to eat the cakes, Yu Yuan invited her to share. As soon as the words left her mouth, she indeed saw Baozhu’s eyes flicker.

"I often attend to the lady, so I’ve had these often. You should keep them."

Yu Yuan smiled. "I’ve just finished tidying up the clothes. Since you won’t eat, I won’t wash my hands either. I’ll clean the bedsheets and quilts first."

Baozhu, of course, hoped she would eat the cakes quickly. But now, with Manager Song’s people watching closely, forcing her to eat would cause a commotion, which wouldn’t be good.

Of course, Yu Yuan had to die today. She wouldn’t be allowed to escape.

"Are these all the nightclothes the lady bestowed upon you?" Baozhu said, stepping forward to pick up the pile of nightclothes. "I’ll take them to be washed first."

These were fabrics that only Lady Cui Yichu could use. After Yu Yuan died, these nightclothes must not be discovered by anyone.

As for the rouge and powder in the vanity case, they could be left here to frame Yu Yuan for theft.

After Baozhu left and closed the door, she instructed a young maid outside to guard Yu Yuan tightly, not allowing her to leave the side room.

Best case scenario, Yu Yuan would obediently eat the cakes and die quietly inside.

If she didn’t eat... they would deal with her at night.

In the past, such dirty deeds were handled by Mother Zhou. Now, it fell to her.

Yu Yuan watched Baozhu leave through the crack in the door, then saw the young maid sitting not far away, embroidering.

Although she had made her judgment, when she turned and saw the plate of still-steaming red bean chestnut cakes, she still took out a silver needle to test for poison.

The silver needle pierced the cake, and after a moment, when it was taken out, the tip had turned black.

It was indeed the lady’s "kindness."

Things were developing faster than Yu Yuan had anticipated. With Zhao Xuanyou staying in the capital for an extended period, whether Yu Yuan was pregnant or not, Lady Cui Yichu’s plan to fake a pregnancy and give birth would fall through.

Zhao Xuanyou was sharp-eared and sharp-eyed; he couldn’t be fooled by a fake pregnancy.

So, after her miscalculation, Lady Cui Yichu decided to silence Yu Yuan, removing this piece that could expose her secret.

Yu Yuan silently stared at the plate of chestnut cakes and began tidying the side room again.

In the meantime, Baozhu sent someone to deliver a meal to her. Seeing that she hadn’t eaten the chestnut cakes, she asked again.

Yu Yuan yawned and said she was sleepy. She accepted the food box, pretending to want to take a nap first, and directly lay down on the bed.

This nap lasted until nightfall.

Lady Cui Yichu intended to kill her tonight. It was a life-and-death struggle.

Zhao Xuanyou had left the mansion early in the morning and would only return for dinner. Only when he was in the mansion would Yu Yuan have a glimmer of hope.

Yu Yuan used the silver needle to check the food in the box, and sure enough, it was all poisoned. Lady Cui Yichu was really worried about not being able to poison her to death!

After some thought, Yu Yuan first hid two pieces of chestnut cake on her body. Then, thinking again, she hid some of the dishes from the food box in the thermos.

Yu Yuan waited quietly for a while, peering through the crack in the door at the sky. When it was completely dark, Yu Yuan took out a piece of clothing from the wardrobe.

From the first day of her rebirth, she knew that Lady Cui Yichu could strike at her at any time.

A mere maid, even with memories from her past life, might not be able to outmaneuver the wife of the heir.

So, she had prepared early. At worst, she would take Lady Cui Yichu down with her.

Every night, she secretly poured lamp oil onto this piece of clothing, a little each night. Over time, the clothing had taken on a strong smell of lamp oil.

In addition, under the bed were dry branches and leaves she had secretly collected from the flower room; all highly flammable.

Yu Yuan placed the clothing on the bed, then turned around and peeked through the crack in the door again. The maid was still guarding her from a distance, very dutifully.

It was still a clear night, though the moonlight was a bit chilly.

Yu Yuan took a deep breath, turned around, picked up the oil lamp from the table, and smashed it onto the bed.

The flame on the lamp wick immediately ignited the clothing on the bed, followed by the sheets and quilts, and soon the entire bed was engulfed in flames.

Watching the flames grow stronger, it was clear that a bucket or two of water wouldn’t be enough to extinguish them.

She felt footsteps approaching the side room, and soon there was a voice asking, "Yu Yuan, why is your room so bright?"

Yu Yuan did not answer. She picked up a piece of chestnut cake from the table, opened the door of the side room, and rushed out, then shouted loudly.

"Fire! Fire! Liu Fang Hall is on fire!"

A fire was a major emergency. Even though the maid outside was ordered to guard Yu Yuan, she couldn’t help but join Yu Yuan in shouting for help, immediately alerting everyone in Liu Fang Hall. The maids and servants in the courtyard first took water to douse the fire, and soon Manager Song arrived with the family guards.

In a large household like the Marquis’s, there was already a set of strategies for dealing with fires. Large water vats were prepared outside the courtyard, and the guards used buckets to fetch water. With more than a dozen people working together, they finally managed to extinguish the fire.

However, the arson wasn’t meant to burn anyone to death. Instead...

Hidden among the maids, Yu Yuan looked up and saw Zhao Xuanyou striding towards Liu Fang Hall.

A fire was a major event. In addition to putting out the fire, the servants had immediately gone to Wang Yue Xuan to report to the master. Zhao Xuanyou immediately rushed over. With his long legs, he walked swiftly and arrived before anyone else.

He had already changed into casual clothes, standing tall and steady with deep, profound eyes.

A general who had seen life and death on the battlefield would, of course, not be alarmed by a fire.

Seeing him appear, Yu Yuan let out a sigh of relief.

All her strategies and plans hinged on Zhao Xuanyou alone.

She raised her hand and took a bite of the chestnut cake, then immediately spat it into a nearby flower bush.

"How is the fire?"

Manager Song hurriedly replied, "Your Highness, the fire has been extinguished."

Zhao Xuanyou asked again, "Where did the fire start?"

"It started in a side room in the back courtyard. That side room is already destroyed, and the adjacent one was also affected."

Lady Cui Yichu, leading Baozhu, hurried over. Hearing this, she was immediately startled.

The side rooms in Liu Fang Hall were for the head maids to live in. Baozhu and Baochuan both attended to Lady Cui Yichu, so the only one still in the back courtyard’s side room was Yu Yuan.

What did she have to do with this fire?

Had she burned to death? That would be the end of it.

"Are there any casualties?" Lady Cui Yichu asked anxiously.

Manager Song cupped his hands towards her. "In response to the lady, the guards went in to check. There are no casualties, but the cause of the fire hasn’t been determined yet."

"I know." Yu Yuan stepped out from the crowd, holding a half-eaten chestnut cake in her hand, and struggled to walk forward.

At this moment, she was wearing a plain white dress, her hair hanging loose, her face pale without a trace of blood, and her beautiful eyes filled with tears. She looked like a fragile porcelain vase, on the verge of shattering to the ground.

---

chapters.title: Carried Away in Public
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou’s brow twitched, and his gaze deepened immeasurably as all his attention fell on Yu Yuan.

In the hazy moonlight, Yu Yuan, who was gradually approaching, suddenly looked up at him and softly called, "Your Highness..."

If her disheveled appearance was merely familiar, these two softly spoken words were like thunder in Zhao Xuanyou’s ears.

This soft, gentle call; he had heard it countless times in the embroidered tent, high and low, singing softly. It was impossible to mistake.

He didn’t yet understand what had happened, but... even if he found it incredible, he still stepped forward to support Yu Yuan.

"Yu Yuan, what’s wrong with you?"

Yu Yuan wasn’t pretending.

Her stomach was in agony, as if her intestines had been tied in a knot. She was in so much pain she wanted to die.

She had thought that since she hadn’t eaten the poisoned chestnut cake, only her teeth had touched it, she wouldn’t be in serious trouble. Who knew the poison was so potent that it would react so violently?

She wouldn’t die here, would she? No, even if she died, she would take someone down with her.

"Help..." Yu Yuan endured the pain, looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, and tried to say something, but she couldn’t get the words out.

She looked at him with sorrow, trembling as she raised the hand holding the chestnut cake. Before she could bring it to Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes, the intense pain in her stomach made her faint.

"Yu Yuan!" Zhao Xuanyou’s brows knitted together as he watched her body soften and fall to the ground. He reached out and caught her.

Dead?!

The moment Yu Yuan fell, Lady Cui Yichu felt an incomparable sense of relief. The long-suppressed anger finally found an outlet.

No matter how much trouble Yu Yuan had caused, as long as she was dead, it was all over.

But in the next moment, seeing Zhao Xuanyou catch Yu Yuan, her heart sank like falling into an icy abyss.

Zhao Xuanyou... had really taken notice of Yu Yuan?

"Lady." Seeing her change in complexion, Baozhu quickly steadied her and whispered in her ear, "We don’t know if Yu Yuan is truly dead yet."

Lady Cui Yichu immediately regained her composure and stepped forward with concern. "What’s wrong with Yu Yuan? Manager Song, quickly have someone take Yu Yuan back to Liu Fang Hall and call the mansion’s physician immediately."

"Yes." This arrangement didn’t seem problematic, so Manager Song immediately called for guards to carry her.

But Zhao Xuanyou still held Yu Yuan.

He didn’t let go, so no one dared to approach and help.

Everyone stared in shock at the scene before them. The noble heir actually protected a lowly flower room maid.

This scene was truly thought-provoking.

A servant standing farther away whispered, "No wonder the heir had her manage the flowers at Honghui Hall. It turns out he fancies her."

"That girl does have a fox-like charm. Men do like that type."

"But doesn’t the heir only like the lady? The sounds coming from Liu Fang Hall at night are louder than a cat’s meows."

"Shh, don’t talk. Look at the lady’s expression. Do you want to die?"

Lady Cui Yichu tightly clutched her handkerchief, trying her best to remain calm.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at the unconscious Yu Yuan, recalling how her lips had moved twice just now, as if she was saying: Help me...

"Your Highness, saving her is urgent. Let them take Yu Yuan to Liu Fang Hall first." Lady Cui Yichu advised.

"Liu Fang Hall just had a fire. You still need to clean up the aftermath. Manager Song," Zhao Xuanyou ignored her suggestion and quickly made a decision, "call the mansion’s physician to Honghui Hall."

There was something suspicious in Liu Fang Hall. He couldn’t take Yu Yuan there.

"Yes." A life was at stake, so Manager Song didn’t dare to delay and hurried off to find the physician.

"Yuan Qing."

"Here."

"Pick up the thing on the ground."

After saying this, Zhao Xuanyou horizontally lifted Yu Yuan into his arms.

In that instant, he clearly felt her figure. If her appearance and voice were just guesses, then at this moment, he confirmed that the woman in his arms was indeed the person who had embraced him in the nights of the past.

Why?

Countless questions filled Zhao Xuanyou’s mind. His sharp, profound gaze fell on Lady Cui Yichu’s face, seeing only panic and evasion.

Amid the shocked gazes of Lady Cui Yichu and the servants, Zhao Xuanyou carried Yu Yuan and left directly.

But Baozhu’s eyes were fixed on Yuan Qing.

Yuan Qing bent down and carefully picked up the half piece of chestnut cake that had slipped from Yu Yuan’s hand, then quickly ran after Zhao Xuanyou’s retreating figure.

Baozhu’s heart turned to ash.

The heir actually valued Yu Yuan so much?

The highly poisoned chestnut cake was the one she had brought to Yu Yuan. Now the cake was in the heir’s hands... What to do? What should she do?

She thought of Mother Zhou’s fate.

Would she die even more miserably than Mother Zhou?

Just a moment ago, it was a clear night, but suddenly, dark clouds gathered.

By the time Zhao Xuanyou carried Yu Yuan into Honghui Hall, raindrops were already pattering down behind them.

He carried Yu Yuan inside and placed her on his own bed.

The inner room was dimly lit with only one lamp.

But it was in this dim light that Zhao Xuanyou felt an increasing sense of familiarity and certainty as he looked at the unconscious woman before him.

No wonder, from the first time he saw Yu Yuan, he had a strange feeling in his heart.

"Master, the physician is here." Manager Song led the physician in hastily.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t say a word, just nodded by the bed.

"Your Highness." The physician bowed to him, put down his medicine case, and stepped forward.

Manager Song ordered someone to light a few more lamps in the room, making it much brighter.

On the bed, Yu Yuan’s eyes were tightly closed, her delicate brows furrowed, and her usually rosy lips were now slightly purple.

He reached out to take Yu Yuan’s pulse. After a moment, he respectfully said to Zhao Xuanyou, "Your Highness, this young lady has been poisoned."

"Is there still a chance to save her?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a deep voice.

"Judging by her pulse, there is no immediate life-threatening danger. However, we don’t know what kind of poison she ingested. If we knew, administering the antidote should save her."

Zhao Xuanyou’s brows furrowed. Before he could speak, Yuan Qing, who had been listening, understood. He held up the half piece of cake that Yu Yuan had been holding. "This is what Sister Yu Yuan had in her hand. It should be the poison."

"Good, as long as the substance is here, I can examine it." The physician’s face showed delight as he took the half piece of cake to the side.

First, he tested it with a silver needle, then smelled the temperature, and finally used the silver needle to poke out some of the cake to dissolve in water.

Manager Song stood behind Zhao Xuanyou and saw him staring intently at Yu Yuan. He whispered, "That half piece of chestnut cake is likely the work of Aunt Yu from the kitchen."

Fearful that Zhao Xuanyou might not know who Aunt Yu was, Manager Song continued, "Aunt Yu came with the lady from the Duke’s mansion. She is very skilled, and the pastries she makes are delicious. Each piece has a pattern on it."

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou had been standing the whole time, Yuan Qing went to the side and brought over a chair.

Not long after he sat down, the physician came over.

"Did you find out?" Yuan Qing asked anxiously.

The physician looked at Zhao Xuanyou and respectfully said, "This poison is not uncommon. It’s the rat poison used in various mansions in the capital to kill rats. Normally, if someone ate half a piece, they would likely be dead. But this young lady is fortunate; it seems she only had a little, so there’s still a chance to save her."

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze didn’t waver. "Go ahead."

"Yes."

The physician quickly wrote a prescription for the antidote and handed it to the servants to prepare the medicine.

By the time the medicine was finally ready, it was almost the Zi hour (around midnight).

Manager Song, being considerate, called a maid to feed her the medicine.

After drinking the bowl of medicine, Yu Yuan’s expression seemed to relax a little.

Zhao Xuanyou silently watched her, waiting for her to wake up and tell him the whole truth.

chapters.title: No Mercy
chapters.content:
Unlike the orderly Honghui Hall, the Liu Fang Pavilion was in complete chaos.

The side room had caught fire, and the maids in the courtyard were scrambling to clean up the mess. Then, a sudden downpour drenched everyone, leaving them in disarray.

Inside the main house, Cui Yichu clenched her fists, listening to the sound of rain outside. Her mind was filled with the scene of Zhao Xuanyou carrying Yu Wan away.

He must have found out!

He must know that Yu Wan was the one who had been with him at night!

All her careful planning had gone to waste! Not only that, but she had also paved the way for that wretched girl Yu Wan, sending her straight into Honghui Hall.

What was going on?

Her plan had been flawless. Where had she gone wrong?

"Madame, what should we do?" Baozhu, usually the most composed of her maids, was now at her wit's end. "Madame, please save your servant."

"Madame is already worried enough. Why are you adding to the noise?" Baochuan, who had been overshadowed by Baozhu lately, retorted. The two had once been on good terms, but now Baochuan seemed to take pleasure in Baozhu's distress.

Baozhu knew she was in a life-or-death situation, but she ignored the warning and knelt before Cui Yichu. "Madame, Young Master's servant Yuan Qing has taken the chestnut cake that Yu Wan ate. Once it's examined, they'll find the poison in the cake, and the trail will lead to the kitchen... and to Liu Fang Pavilion."

"So what if it leads here?" Baochuan said, her voice trailing off as she finally understood Baozhu's concern.

Yu Wan's poisoning was one thing, but the poisoned chestnut cake was another.

If it were just the poisoning, whether Yu Wan lived or died, no one would know how it happened. They could claim she had foolishly eaten rat poison.

But the half-eaten chestnut cake had been taken by the Young Master. He would realize the cake was tampered with; someone had deliberately poisoned Yu Wan.

If the investigation traced back to Liu Fang Pavilion...

Although Baochuan always tried to outdo Baozhu, she still had some sisterly affection and didn't want to see Baozhu die. Gritting her teeth, she said, "It's fine. At worst, we can blame a lowly maid."

Seeing that Cui Yichu was still distracted and hadn't heard their conversation, Baochuan quickly helped her sit down. "Madame, don't worry. Maybe Yu Wan will die tonight. That rat poison is potent; just a little bit can kill a nest of rats. She won't survive."

Cui Yichu shook her head and sneered. "She'll live. I underestimated her."

Baochuan was taken aback. She looked at Baozhu, who seemed completely drained, and shook her arm. "It's not time to give up yet. Let's think of a way."

Wanting to remind Cui Yichu, Baochuan said, "Madame has lost Zhou Mama. Now only we two remain. We must help Madame come up with a plan."

Hearing this, Baozhu regained some composure.

At this moment, her survival depended entirely on Cui Yichu. If Cui Yichu could weather this storm, she would have a better chance of living.

"Yu Wan is indeed cunning. She took the chestnut cake to the Young Master tonight. It couldn't have been a coincidence. She must have known the cake was poisoned all along. She delayed eating it just to let the Young Master see her get poisoned."

"It's all your fault!" Cui Yichu suddenly flew into a rage and slapped Baozhu hard. "If you had put the poison in earlier, none of this would have happened!"

The slap was fierce, and Baozhu's mouth immediately started bleeding. Baochuan was also startled.

When Baozhu had prepared the poison, Cui Yichu had been sitting nearby, watching and instructing them to do it discreetly.

Now that things had gone wrong, all the blame was placed on the maid.

Baozhu covered her face and dared not make a sound.

"Madame, please calm down," Baochuan steadied herself. "It's we servants who are stupid and incompetent. But since it's already happened, we must find a way to deal with it."

"How to deal with it? That wretched Yu Wan has already gone to the Young Master. She will certainly reveal everything."

Baozhu endured the pain in her cheek and said, "Yu Wan doesn't know Madame's entire plan. Even if she talks, she won't be able to say much."

"So what do you suggest we do?"

After losing Zhou Mama, Baozhu was the most useful person Cui Yichu had left. Though she had struck her hard just now, she still relied on Baozhu for ideas.

"Yu Wan only knows that Madame ordered her to serve you at night. Even if she doesn't die, she can only tell the Young Master this one thing."

"The Young Master will definitely come to question me."

Baozhu said, "Madame's health has always been poor. Just say you were worried about inadequate service, so you intentionally promoted Yu Wan."

"Promote her? You mean, elevate her to the status of a concubine?" Before Baozhu could answer, Cui Yichu understood.

Zhao Xuanyou had carried Yu Wan away in full view of everyone, clearly indicating his affection for her.

"Yu Wan's aim is the position of a concubine. As long as we give it to her, she probably won't cause trouble."

"How do you know she won't cause trouble?"

Half of Baozhu's face was swollen, and her voice sounded strange. "Tomorrow morning, Madame can go to Honghui Hall. If Yu Wan is still alive, declare in front of her that you intend to elevate her to a concubine. With her cunning, she will likely accept the offer. After all, one poisoned chestnut cake cannot shake Madame's position."

"It seems we have no other choice."

Baochuan was unhappy. "This really lets that wretched girl off too easily!"

Earlier, she had been happy at the thought of Yu Wan dying a gruesome death. But in just one night, Yu Wan was about to become a respected concubine.

"It's just a concubine. Madame can deal with her later."

"Mmm."

Cui Yichu closed her eyes, deeply regretting not heeding her mother's advice.

Her mother had warned her not to act within the mansion.

She had underestimated her enemy. Fortunately, the loss wasn't too great. A mere concubine was nothing to worry about.

"Madame, we still need to figure out how to explain the chestnut cake. If the Young Master investigates thoroughly, several maids in the courtyard saw me take the chestnut cake into Yu Wan's side room."

"Everyone in the courtyard is on our side. What is there to fear?" Cui Yichu slightly massaged her temples. "Didn't you have someone watching Yu Wan? Take care of it while it's still night."

Hearing the word "take care of," Baozhu and Baochuan understood.

The maids in the courtyard were all part of Cui Yichu's dowry from the Duke's mansion. They were originally Cui Yichu's favored maids, and under normal circumstances, she wouldn't easily dispose of them.

But now, having lost Zhou Mama, she couldn't afford to lose Baozhu, her right-hand woman. She had to sacrifice the pawns to protect the chariot.

"Yes. Madame should rest early."

Though she said this, Cui Yichu tossed and turned all night.

As soon as dawn broke, she couldn't wait to dress herself carefully and, leading Baochuan, headed to Honghui Hall.

"Madame." The guards at the courtyard gate all bowed to Cui Yichu.

Cui Yichu was about to enter when they stopped her.

"You dare stop me?"

As the Young Master's wife, she had never been stopped by anyone in the Marquis's mansion.

The guards exchanged glances, also finding the situation difficult.

"Madame, please calm down. We are only following orders."

Following orders?

Cui Yichu was stunned. Had Zhao Xuanyou ordered them to stop her?

What had Yu Wan told him in Honghui Hall?

---

chapters.title: The One Who Stayed
chapters.content:
Inside Honghui Hall, Yuan Qing approached Zhao Xuanyou and said, "Master, Madame has arrived."

Zhao Xuanyou had just gotten up not long ago and was leisurely eating his breakfast; a bowl of spring onion noodles, accompanied by four small dishes: stir-fried pork, seasoned tofu, bamboo shoot with shrimp, and fried small fish.

He put down his chopsticks and asked in a deep voice, "Has she woken up?"

Yuan Qing knew he was asking about Yu Wan and quickly replied, "She woke up once an hour ago, asked for water. The maid fed her medicine as per the physician's instructions, and she has been sleeping since then."

Although she was still asleep, it seemed she was out of danger.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou remained composed, Yuan Qing whispered, "What about Madame?"

"Tell her I just finished breakfast and am about to read. Ask her to come for lunch at noon."

"Yes," Yuan Qing thought for a moment and added, "This morning, the Old Dowager sent Yang Mama to deliver a message. Since Liu Fang Pavilion caught fire, Madame should not stay there and should choose another courtyard to live in."

The Marquis's mansion had few people and ample space. Besides the late Marchioness's residence, Jushui Study, there were three other spacious courtyards.

"Relay the Dowager's message as well. If she wants to move, let her choose any place she likes."

Yuan Qing acknowledged and left. Zhao Xuanyou, having finished most of his meal, walked toward the inner room.

Honghui Hall was spacious, with three rooms in the main house, front and back courtyards, and side rooms on both sides.

Due to the urgency last night, Zhao Xuanyou had placed Yu Wan on his own bed and had not moved her since, sleeping in the study instead.

Yu Wan lay quietly there, her brows relaxed and her expression serene, clearly in a deep sleep.

Zhao Xuanyou gazed at her intently for a moment, then ordered the maids to watch her carefully before turning into the study to review official documents.

A few days ago, at the Prime Minister's residence, they had discussed his upcoming assignment to the Secretariat. Zhao Xuanyou knew that being a capital official was entirely different from leading troops in battle, so he humbly sought advice from the Prime Minister.

Although his official rank was not high, his status as the heir of the Pacifying Marquis meant the Prime Minister treated him with kindness, promising to send someone to deliver the relevant documents for his review in advance.

That very morning, someone from the Secretariat had delivered the documents.

After Yuan Qing served tea, Zhao Xuanyou began to focus on reading the documents.

When he finished reviewing the stack of papers in front of him, he glanced up and saw Yuan Qing standing at the door, staring at him.

Normally, Zhao Xuanyou disliked being disturbed while reading, but today was different. He could roughly guess why Yuan Qing was standing there. In a deep voice, he asked, "What is it?"

"Master, Yu Wan has woken up."

"I see."

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou remained calm, Yuan Qing thought he might consider her presence presumptuous and was about to quietly retreat when she saw Zhao Xuanyou throw down the document in his hand and stand up to walk out.

Yuan Qing quickly stepped aside and followed Zhao Xuanyou into the inner room.

At this moment, Yu Wan was being helped up by a maid and was leaning against the bed, drinking water. Hearing the footsteps, she looked up and saw Zhao Xuanyou.

He was wearing a green brocade robe, with a jade hairpiece securing his hair, a simple yet elegant home attire that made him look refined and handsome, like a scholar.

"Young Master," she softly called out.

After her ordeal, her face was extremely pale, her lips almost bloodless, but the pair of autumn-water-like eyes beneath her dark brows stood out strikingly.

Zhao Xuanyou walked forward, and Yuan Qing brought over a chair.

He sat quietly, waiting for the maid to finish feeding Yu Wan water before waving his hand.

"All of you, leave."

Once all the servants had withdrawn, Zhao Xuanyou said, "Speak. What happened?"

Had this moment finally arrived?

Yu Wan felt no great joy in her heart.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze was not gentle. It was clear that, compared to reminiscing about their past intimacy, he found being deceived far harder to bear.

Fortunately, before risking her life last night, Yu Wan had already thought of a countermeasure.

She let out a soft sigh. "This servant has too many disgraceful things in her past. I don’t know what the Young Master wishes to hear, nor where to begin."

Her expression was pitiful, but Zhao Xuanyou remained unmoved. Lifting his chin, he said, "Then start from the day I returned to the mansion."

Yu Wan lowered her gaze and softly said, "Before the Young Master returned, this servant had always worked in the flower room without any mistakes. On the day the Young Master returned, Madame was overjoyed and rewarded all the servants with food and drink. I had intended to eat and drink with the other girls from the flower room, but someone from Liu Fang Pavilion suddenly came, asking me to deliver some night-blooming jasmine. After I delivered the flowers, it was Madame's maid, Baozhu, who received them. She said I had a good eye for picking nice flowers and wanted to reward me with the fruit wine that Madame had given her."

"And then?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"Baozhu urged me to drink several cups in a row. After that, I became groggy."
