"You didn't know anything after that?"

Yu Wan looked up, her beautiful eyes reflecting Zhao Xuanyou's face. She helplessly bit her lip. "Actually, it wasn't that I knew nothing. It's just that I couldn't move or see clearly who was in front of me at the time. When I became fully conscious again, Zhou Mama and Baochuan were in front of me, scolding me for being shameless and climbing onto the Young Master's bed."

For the first time, Zhao Xuanyou's previously calm expression showed a hint of emotion.

He had known that Yu Wan had been intimate with him, but he truly hadn't expected that the person from the very beginning had been Yu Wan.

Sensing his complex gaze, Yu Wan lowered her head even further.

What was Zhao Xuanyou thinking?

From his expression, it didn't seem like he was reminiscing about those nights of passion. Instead, there was more anger, ridicule, and restraint.

The person who had stirred his emotions was Cui Yichu.

Yu Wan didn't feel particularly distressed.

In Zhao Xuanyou's heart, Cui Yichu was his wife. The person who had shared those nights of intimacy with him was also his wife.

As for Yu Wan, she was just a maid who happened to resemble his wife.

How could he be angry on her behalf?

It was still far from the time to bring down Cui Yichu...

"If they said you climbed into my bed, why didn't they punish you?" Zhao Xuanyou suddenly asked.

"Zhou Mama and Baochuan took me to Madame. Madame said that her health was poor, and she had originally intended to elevate a concubine to serve the Young Master. But since the Young Master rarely returned to the capital, she was afraid the Young Master would be disappointed, so she had me disguise my voice and wear Madame's nightclothes to take her place in serving the Young Master."

"So, it was all you?"

"Yes, it was me."

Zhao Xuanyou did not doubt that Yu Wan was lying.

Liu Fang Pavilion was filled with Cui Yichu's dowry servants. Yu Wan, a mere flower room maid, didn't even have the qualifications to enter the main house. How could she have climbed into his bed?

Moreover, how could Cui Yichu have tolerated Yu Wan serving him at night?

Only Cui Yichu had the power to arrange all this. Only she, as the Young Master's wife, could have accomplished it.

But why would she do such a thing?

Zhao Xuanyou recalled his wedding night with Cui Yichu.

The brocade curtains were fragrant, the red candles flickered, and when he lifted the bridal veil, he had indeed had many expectations. But those had been quickly shattered by her expression and words.

This time, when he returned to the capital, he had no particular expectations, but his wife had given him a surprise.

Indeed, it was a huge "surprise."

chapters.title: Where Lies the True Heart
chapters.content:
"What about the poisoned chestnut cake?" After a long silence, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly asked, "Who gave it to you?"

He had already learned what he wanted to know about last night's events. The rest, he needed to ask Cui Yichu.

Yu Ying replied, "Like the fruit wine last time, it was Baozhu who gave it to me."

Baozhu was Cui Yichu’s senior maid. Whether it was the fruit wine or the chestnut cake, it was naturally Cui Yichu who had instructed her to deliver it to Yu Ying.

Recalling how he had silenced Zhou Mama last time, Zhao Xuanyou was not surprised that Cui Yichu wanted to get rid of Yu Ying.

"Did you know the chestnut cake was poisoned?"

Yu Ying gave a bitter smile. "Actually, thinking back, ever since the madam learned that the Young Master had met me, her attitude toward me changed. Yesterday, Baozhu brought the chestnut cake over. Though I may be foolish, I remembered the fruit wine from last time. Baozhu is the madam’s senior maid; let alone the junior maids, even the stewards of each courtyard have to fawn over her. For no reason at all, she brought me a chestnut cake. I knew something was wrong, so I left it there and didn’t dare eat it."

"How did you end up eating it?"

"The sky grew darker and darker. I wanted to go out, but the maid guarding outside stopped me. She even scolded me for not eating the chestnut cake, saying I was wasting the madam’s kindness and being disrespectful. The more she pressed me, the more I suspected the cake was poisoned. I just wanted to escape, but I couldn’t."

"Did you two have a struggle in the side room?"

Yu Ying nodded.

She didn’t know if Cui Yichu would be able to protect Baozhu this time.

But she knew that the little maid who had helped Baozhu block her yesterday would definitely not survive this time.

She couldn’t admit that she had long prepared for arson, shifting all the blame onto that little maid would be best.

"Your Lordship, please understand. She rushed over and stuffed the chestnut cake into my mouth. I could only clench my teeth and fight her for it. That was when I accidentally knocked over the candle stand. The side room caught fire, and the courtyard fell into chaos. Only then did I get the chance to run out."

As Yu Ying spoke, she stole glances at Zhao Xuanyou’s expression.

But his gaze was too deep, making it hard to discern his emotions.

"Later, when I saw Your Lordship arriving, I knew that the only one in this mansion who could uphold justice was you. Unfortunately, before I could report to you, the poison took effect. That poison was too potent; I almost lost my life just from my lips touching it."

A sharp glint flickered in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes.

"You should be grateful you only got a little on your lips. Otherwise, you wouldn’t have survived last night."

Since Cui Yichu had already decided to kill her, Yu Ying had no choice but to gamble with her life for a chance to survive.

Even now that she had passed this crisis, she couldn’t help but feel lingering fear.

She suddenly looked up at Zhao Xuanyou. "I beg Your Lordship to save my life."

Seeing the faint glimmer of tears in Yu Ying’s eyes, Zhao Xuanyou’s cold and stern expression softened slightly.

"How do you want me to save you?"

"I want to stay and serve in Honghui Hall." As if afraid Zhao Xuanyou would misunderstand, Yu Ying hastily added, "I’m not asking for anything extravagant. As long as I can stay in Honghui Hall, even sweeping the floors would be fine."

Zhao Xuanyou neither agreed nor disagreed. He stood up and walked straight out of the inner room.

Before he even entered the study, Yuan Qing approached and said, "Young Master, the madam has sent someone to deliver a message. She says she has prepared a feast at Liu Fang Pavilion with all your favorite dishes and invites you to dine there."

After reading official documents for half the day, Zhao Xuanyou was indeed hungry.

But Liu Fang Pavilion... For some reason, just thinking of that place made him feel nauseous, completely ruining his appetite.

"Not going. If she wants to see me, she can come to Honghui Hall now. Prepare a meal."

"Yes."

Yuan Qing respectfully withdrew and conveyed the message. Soon, the kitchen quickly served lunch.

Compared to the exquisite and refined dishes made by Aunt Yu, the old chef of the Marquis's mansion had a much plainer style, but it was what Zhao Xuanyou had grown up eating.

Just as he had taken a few bites, Yuan Qing led Cui Yichu in.

"Master, the madam is here."

Zhao Xuanyou responded with a soft "mm," and Yuan Qing tactfully exited.

Cui Yichu walked slowly into the veranda, watching Zhao Xuanyou, who was focused on his meal. She could only clench her fingers tightly.

She had arrived, and he didn’t even lift his head?

Before entering Honghui Hall, she had specifically asked Yuan Qing and learned that Yu Ying had already woken up.

Zhao Xuanyou’s attitude toward her must be because that wretched Yu Ying had spoken ill of her first!

That wretched girl... How could she be so hard to kill? Even rat poison couldn’t finish her off?

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly looked up, catching Cui Yichu in a fit of rage. He actually let out a light laugh.

"Why is the madam so angry?"

Cui Yichu’s heart pounded wildly. She hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to suddenly look up. For a moment, heat flushed to her face, but her palms grew cold with sweat from nervousness.

"Your Lordship misunderstands. I just don’t know why you are angry with me? You wouldn’t even see me this morning."

Zhao Xuanyou put down his chopsticks. "Madam, please sit and talk."

Cui Yichu nodded, struggling to maintain her smile.

Ever since the fire at Liu Fang Pavilion last night, everything had gone against her plans, and she was truly at a loss.

"Early this morning, when the madam came over, I was reading official documents sent by the Secretariat. I’ve always disliked being disturbed while working."

"I understand." Cui Yichu picked up the tea on the table and took a sip. "Just now, when I came in, Yuan Qing said Yu Ying had already woken up."

Zhao Xuanyou responded with a soft "mm," but said no more.

What Cui Yichu was most anxious about right now was what Yu Ying had told Zhao Xuanyou. His sparse words were torture to her.

"It was her side room that caught fire yesterday. Did she say anything?"

"She said a lot, not just about the fire."

"A lot?" Cui Yichu’s expression turned rigid and cold. Her words came out stiffly, completely lacking her usual grace. "What did she say?"

Zhao Xuanyou gave a cold smile, facing the nervous Cui Yichu with calm detachment.

"Yu Ying said that from the day I returned to the mansion, the person who shared my bed in Liu Fang Pavilion was her."

Although she had anticipated this, when Zhao Xuanyou personally said these words, Cui Yichu’s mind still went blank.

She clenched her hands tightly, her palms soaked with sweat, and even her forehead broke out in a cold sweat.

Zhao Xuanyou had never doubted Yu Ying’s words, but seeing Cui Yichu’s reaction, he suddenly found the whole situation utterly absurd.

Before today, he had actually harbored the intention to spend his life with the woman before him.

What a joke.

He exhaled sharply, and when he looked at Cui Yichu again, his gaze had grown much sharper.

"Yu Ying said that the first time, Baozhu persuaded her to drink a lot of fruit wine. Yesterday, when she was poisoned, it was again Baozhu who brought her the chestnut cake. Madam, do you know why this is?"

"This..." Cui Yichu had completely lost her composure. After stammering for a moment, she could only stubbornly insist, "I really didn’t know about this. The first time? When was the first time?"

"The first time between the madam and me was naturally the day I returned to the mansion." Zhao Xuanyou patiently said slowly, "Madam, can you clearly tell me, that night, who was the person in the bed. Yu Ying or you?"

---

chapters.title: Pressing Questions
chapters.content:
Even though she had mentally prepared herself, upon hearing Zhao Xuanyou’s seemingly casual question, Cui Yichu still instinctively recoiled, her eyes filled with fear.

She came from a good family, had a beautiful appearance, and had entered the imperial palace since childhood. Apart from carefully attending to the emperor and empress, there were few people or things she feared.

But now, sitting in the veranda and facing Zhao Xuanyou, she felt as if she were sitting on pins and needles, with thorns pressing against her back.

The carefully prepared excuses died on her lips under Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze.

After countless thoughts tangled and tore through her mind, Cui Yichu spoke in a trembling voice, "It was Yu Ying."

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze was extremely indifferent as he looked at Cui Yichu’s posture, so different from her usual noble and elegant demeanor.

"So, Madam is unwilling to be my wife? If being married to me is so unbearable, there is a way out. You can leave the Marquis’s mansion today."

"No!"

The moment these three words left her mouth, Cui Yichu instinctively stood up. Tears welled in her eyes, and the fear and shame born of humiliation and regret made her face flush red, then pale, then a sickly mix of both, looking utterly wretched.

The turn of events was far beyond her expectations. He wanted her to leave the mansion today?

Had it really come to the point of divorce?

Seeing no warmth in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes, the color drained from Cui Yichu’s face bit by bit.

It was as if a sharp sword was pressing against her throat, about to pierce her flesh.

She had no other options left. She could only walk up to Zhao Xuanyou, take a step back, and slowly kneel down on both knees.

"I did not refuse to serve the Young Master. It was just that my body was unwell, and I had no choice."

Zhao Xuanyou sat upright in his chair, his gaze coldly observing the delicate beauty before him.

The face that had been so captivating under the red candles on their wedding night now filled him with nothing but disgust.

"Madam, why must you kneel before me? Doing so only dishonors the reputation of the Xingguo Duke’s family."

In the past, what Cui Yichu had been most proud of was her status as the legitimate daughter of the Xingguo Duke’s family.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou’s sarcasm, Cui Yichu knelt on the cold, hard ground but did not dare to retort.

The Xingguo Duke and his wife had always doted on her. With them as her backing, she had never thought she would be at a disadvantage in the Marquis’s mansion.

But now, she had no choice but to kneel.

If she did not lower her head, Zhao Xuanyou would not let this matter go just for the sake of her parents’ faces.

No matter how noble the Duke’s family was, Zhao Xuanyou was not afraid.

He held real power and imperial favor. In the imperial court, he walked with swagger, and even the two prime ministers treated him as an honored guest.

Moreover, she was in the wrong.

She carried too many secrets. If this matter were exposed, the hidden undercurrents that her parents had suppressed in the past would resurface, leading to her ruin and a dishonorable death.

Cui Yichu, tears streaming down her face, said, "Though the Xingguo Duke’s mansion is my maternal home, now that I am married to the Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion, I am a member of this household. I beg the Young Master, for the sake of our marriage, to listen to my explanation."

Marriage?

Zhao Xuanyou, who had been calm, couldn’t help but let out a light laugh upon hearing these words.

"Can you and I be considered husband and wife?"

"Of course," At this point, Cui Yichu had no other choice. She reached out and grabbed Zhao Xuanyou’s robe, pleading earnestly, "The Young Master and I have bowed to heaven and earth and drunk the wedding wine. In my heart, I am to be with the Young Master for a lifetime."

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, maintaining his superior posture.

Seeing that he did not mention sending her away from the Marquis’s mansion again, Cui Yichu calmed down slightly and slowly recounted the explanation she had pondered over all night.

"The Young Master does not know, but my body is not well. I have a congenital yin deficiency, and the doctor said it would be very difficult for me to conceive. So I thought of having Yu Ying serve the Young Master first. If she could bear a child, I would raise it as my own, allowing me to have a place in the Marquis’s mansion."

In high-ranking families, if the main wife could not have children, it was common to adopt a child from a concubine.

But this did not explain why they had never consummated their marriage.

Cui Yichu raised her hand and wiped the tears from her cheeks, still looking up at him.

This gesture was usually charming, but Zhao Xuanyou was not moved in the slightest.

She had no choice but to continue, "The Young Master does not know, but I have been taking the prescription regulated by the Duke’s mansion’s doctor. The ingredients in that prescription are very rare. My parents went to great lengths to gather them for me. The doctor also said that I could not serve my husband until I recovered. I truly admire the Young Master and did not want him to know of my inadequacies. I had no choice but to resort to this."

"If you were truly ill, why didn’t you tell me the truth?"

"If the Young Master does not believe me, you can have the mansion’s doctor examine me now."

"No need."

"Your Lordship," Cui Yichu begged desperately, "there is already a rift between you and me. If the mansion’s doctor does not examine me today, I will have no peaceful days ahead. Your Lordship, I beg you, for the sake of our marriage vows, let the doctor come in and see for himself."

Zhao Xuanyou indeed had doubts. He glanced at Cui Yichu and called Yuan Qing in.

"Master." Yuan Qing approached the veranda and was startled to see Cui Yichu, tears streaming down her face, kneeling before Zhao Xuanyou.

He still did not know what Yu Ying had told Zhao Xuanyou. Suddenly seeing this scene, he was naturally shocked.

Master cared so much for the madam, so how... Could Yu Ying’s poisoning be related to the madam?

Yuan Qing pondered in his heart and stepped forward respectfully, "What are your orders?"

"Bring the mansion’s doctor here. Have him examine the madam."

"Yes."

Yuan Qing bowed and withdrew. Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Cui Yichu, who was still kneeling on the ground, and then stood up and went straight to the study.

Cui Yichu had not expected Zhao Xuanyou to leave just like that, but she dared not stop him or stand up.

In the past, even in the palace, she had never been punished by kneeling. Now, as the Young Master’s wife, she had suffered such humiliation.

All of this was because of that wretched Yu Ying.

After a while, Yuan Qing returned to the veranda and saw that Cui Yichu was still kneeling. He went forward to help her up.

"Madam, the doctor has arrived. Please come out for the examination."

Cui Yichu looked up, "Where is the Young Master?"

"He is reading the documents sent by the Secretariat. There are too many, and he wants to finish them before going to the office." Yuan Qing was still respectful to her.

Cui Yichu, used to a life of luxury, had been kneeling in the veranda for a while, and her knees could no longer bear it. She had to rely on Yuan Qing to support her as she stood up.

The mansion’s doctor was waiting in the main hall with his medicine box, but there was no sign of Zhao Xuanyou.

He didn’t want to see her?

Cui Yichu almost ground her teeth to dust but could only swallow her tears.

After sitting down, she extended her wrist, allowing the doctor to take her pulse.

After the doctor finished, he merely bowed respectfully to her. Cui Yichu looked at him, confused. "How is my body?"

Before the doctor could speak, Yuan Qing interjected, "Madam, have you decided which courtyard to move to?"

Although Liu Fang Pavilion had only lost a side room, repairs would require workers coming in and out, and as a woman, Cui Yichu naturally needed to move temporarily.

"I’ll go to Tingyu Pavilion then."

Tingyu Pavilion was closer to Honghui Hall.

Zhao Xuanyou was in a bad mood, and she needed to try to win him over to ease their marital tensions.

As for other matters, she couldn’t attend to them now and could only discuss them with her parents when she returned to the Duke’s mansion.

"Madam has had a busy morning and must be tired. Please go to Tingyu Pavilion to rest. Master said that if there is anything, he will send for Madam."

Send for her to come to Honghui Hall?

In the past few days, he had always rushed to Liu Fang Pavilion no matter when he returned.

Cui Yichu closed her eyes in despair, dragging her numb legs as she listlessly walked out of Honghui Hall.

chapters.title: The Position of a Concubine
chapters.content:
After waiting for Cui Yichu to leave Honghui Hall, Yuan Qing led the court physician into the study.

Zhao Xuanyou put down his documents and said in a deep voice, "How is her health?"

The court physician looked troubled and hesitated to speak.

"If you cannot treat her, I will find someone else." Zhao Xuanyou's tone was cold, devoid of any warmth.

"Please calm down, Young Master," the court physician quickly cupped his hands towards him and sighed, "Madam's pulse is weak and floating, indicating an imbalance of yin and yang, with excess yin-cold evil in her body. I'm afraid..."

"She cannot conceive?"

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou say these four words, the court physician secretly heaved a sigh of relief. "This old man is not skilled in gynecology, only knowing some common regulatory prescriptions. I'm afraid they will be of little use to Madam."

"It's fine." Zhao Xuanyou had called the court physician to resolve his doubts. "In your opinion, is her condition due to congenital deficiency or an illness she contracted later?"

"This..." The court physician pondered for a moment, not daring to make a reckless conclusion. "Madam's condition is severe, but whether it's congenital or acquired, this old man cannot say. Perhaps a master of gynecology could tell."

The Jingyuan Marquis' residence was a military family, and the court physician had served the old Marquis for many years, treating injuries and illnesses, but he was indeed not skilled in gynecology.

Zhao Xuanyou did not press further and asked another question, "Go see Yu Wan before you leave."

"Yes." The court physician bowed and retreated.

Yuan Qing looked at Zhao Xuanyou's expression, unable to tell what he was thinking.

If Madam could not bear children, the Young Master should be upset. But why did he make Madam kneel in the side room earlier?

Was Madam pleading guilty for not being able to bear children?

But Yuan Qing vaguely felt that Madam kneeling to the Young Master was related to Yu Wan and did not dare to advise rashly.

After a long silence, Yuan Qing said, "Madam said that while Liu Fang Hall is being renovated, she will temporarily stay in Tingyu Pavilion."

Zhao Xuanyou neither agreed nor disagreed.

After some thought, Yuan Qing added, "This time, Yu Wan was poisoned in front of everyone. Manager Song wants to know how Young Master wishes to handle it. Should he investigate thoroughly, or...?"

The fire in Yu Wan's side room, and Yu Wan being poisoned; this series of incidents were clearly all related to Yu Wan.

She was a maid in the flower room, but she lived in Liu Fang Hall and managed the flowers and plants in Honghui Hall. It was truly unclear who should handle this matter.

Moreover, last night, the Young Master had carried Yu Wan into Honghui Hall in front of Madam and all the servants, even placing her on his own bed.

Yu Wan's status was so special that Manager Song did not dare to act presumptuously and had to ask Zhao Xuanyou for instructions.

Zhao Xuanyou said, "The fire started in Liu Fang Hall, and the poisoning happened in Liu Fang Hall. Furthermore, Yu Wan said that it was Baozhu who gave her the poisoned chestnut cake. Let Manager Song ask Madam how to handle it."

"Yes." After some thought, Yuan Qing asked again, "Yu Wan has already woken up. Should she continue resting there?"

Yu Wan was just a maid; it was against the rules for her to rest on Zhao Xuanyou's bed.

"Let Manager Song ask Madam about that as well."

Ask Madam?

Yuan Qing was even more confused. Wasn't the Young Master still angry with Madam? Why was he asking Madam about everything now?

Though he grumbled internally, Yuan Qing responded and left, quickly relaying Zhao Xuanyou's words to Manager Song.

Seeing Manager Song's knowing look, Yuan Qing could not help but ask, "Do you know why the Young Master is doing this?"

"What's there to not understand?"

"What do you understand?"

"You foolish boy," Manager Song saw Yuan Qing's confusion and immediately began to tease, "Wait until Madam has handled the matter. Then you'll understand the Young Master's intentions."

How to handle it, the Young Master's words were clear. Madam was a clever person and would likely understand with just a hint.

Manager Song hurried away, and Yuan Qing scratched his head before returning to the room.

It was time for lunch, and a maid had just brought food for Yu Wan.

One meat dish, one vegetable dish, and a soup.

It was worse than the masters' meals but better than the senior maids'.

Yu Wan had been tormented by poison all night, and now that she was awake, she was truly hungry. After finishing the food in one go, she looked up and saw the maid staring at her. After wiping her mouth with a handkerchief, she asked uneasily, "Should I not be eating on the Young Master's bed?"

"Yuan Qing said to let you rest here peacefully. When there's a proper place for you, you'll be moved."

Yuan Qing's words naturally reflected Zhao Xuanyou's intentions.

Although Yu Wan's memory was blurred after being poisoned last night, her last memory was collapsing into Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

Since he had placed her in his room, it seemed he was not entirely heartless.

Yu Wan slightly relaxed. The big gamble from last night had finally paid off.

Her pale face showed a hint of a smile as she asked the young maid, "What's your name? Where were you working before?"

"In response to Sister, my name is Yingxue. I was in the front courtyard, assisting Mama Yang with tea and water."

The front courtyard and the rear mansion of the Marquis' residence were distinctly separate, so it was no wonder Yu Wan had never seen Yingxue before.

Last night, Zhao Xuanyou had someone come to feed Yu Wan medicine. Manager Song had naturally selected a trustworthy tea and water maid from the front courtyard.

"Thank you for taking care of me."

"Sister is too polite. I am only following orders." Yingxue looked a couple of years younger than Yu Wan, but she spoke and acted very maturely. It seemed she was a native of the Marquis' residence, having been taught by her parents since she was little.

Yingxue cleared the dishes and brought the prepared medicine to Yu Wan.

"This detoxifying medicine is very bitter. Sister should rinse her mouth with clear water after drinking it."

"It's fine."

Yu Wan had already consumed poison; she was not afraid of bitter medicine.

After drinking it all in one go, Yu Wan lay down again.

When she woke up again, Yingxue bowed to her. "Congratulations, Sister."

"What is there to be happy about?"

Yingxue came forward to help her sit up. Since there was no one else in the room, she spoke loudly, "Just now, Manager Song delivered a message saying that Madam has elevated Sister to be the Young Master's concubine. From now on, you will live in Honghui Hall. Isn't that a great joy?"

Zhao Xuanyou's concubine?

After two lifetimes, the position of concubine that Cui Yichu had promised her with his own mouth had finally been granted.

Yu Wan did not feel particularly elated.

Becoming Zhao Xuanyou's concubine only temporarily secured her life. To truly be free from worry, she would have to wait until the day Cui Yichu died.

Being a concubine was only the first step in her revenge.

"Why does Sister seem unhappy?" Yingxue asked.

Yu Wan smiled faintly, "I am happy, but having just been poisoned, I still feel some lingering fear."

"Sister can rest assured. The person who harmed Sister has already been found out by Madam."

Found out?

Had Cui Yichu been willing to deal with Baozhu?

"Who put the poison in the chestnut cake?"

Yingxue did not know the details about the poisoned chestnut cake, only who had been punished.

"The Yu Qi from Liu Fang Hall was jealous of Sister being favored by the Young Master and Madam, so she poisoned the chestnut cake. Yesterday, she was constantly guarding the door of Sister's side room, watching like a tiger. Many people who entered and exited Liu Fang Hall saw her."

Yu Qi was indeed the maid who had blocked Yu Wan in her room yesterday under orders.

A dead rabbit, a cooked hound.

Since the task had not been accomplished, a small pawn like Yu Qi would naturally be pushed out by Cui Yichu to take the blame.

"How did Madam punish her?"

"Madam did not even get to punish her. When Yu Qi found out that Sister had not been poisoned to death, she committed suicide in her room, using the same rat poison she had used to try to kill Sister."

It was indeed a case of killing the witness.

Yu Qi had helped Cui Yichu harm her, but Yu Wan understood that both Yu Qi and herself were nothing more than insignificant lives in Cui Yichu's eyes.

Yu Wan did not feel any satisfaction.

"Besides Yu Qi, are others not involved? Was no one else punished?"

She had clearly identified Baozhu in front of Zhao Xuanyou. Could it be that Zhao Xuanyou still harbored deep feelings for Cui Yichu and indulged her in covering up for her subordinates?

---

chapters.title: Good News
chapters.content:
"Madam's maid, Baozhu, was also punished." Yingxue said.

Yu Wan's brow twitched slightly. She asked, feigning ignorance, "Why was she punished?"

Between Baozhu and Bao Chan, Baozhu was smarter, more agile, and more composed, with a mind not much less than Mama Zhou's.

If Baozhu were removed, dealing with Cui Yichu would be much easier.

"Baozhu is the senior maid of Liu Fang Hall. The junior maid had harbored harmful intentions, so it was naturally due to her poor supervision. Furthermore, yesterday, Madam rewarded Sister with chestnut cakes, which Baozhu was supposed to deliver to Sister personally. With such a major incident as poisoning, she cannot shirk her responsibility."

Was that all?

All the blame was pushed onto Yu Qi, and Baozhu was naturally spared.

Yu Wan said indifferently, "In that case, my poisoning truly cannot be blamed on Sister Baozhu."

"Such a major incident as poisoning occurred in the residence. Madam was very angry and ordered Baozhu to be given ten board strikes. I heard that the strikes were very heavy, and afterwards, there was not even a sound of crying."

Ten board strikes were indeed severe, but they would not endanger Baozhu's life. With Cui Yichu's protection, Baozhu would recover after resting in bed for a few months.

Yu Wan wanted to bring down Cui Yichu, but even removing Baozhu was this difficult.

Yu Wan could not describe what she was feeling. The image of Zhao Xuanyou's cold and handsome face appeared before her eyes.

Disappointment?

Could she blame him? Yu Wan smirked at herself.

From the beginning, she and Zhao Xuanyou had been forced into an awkward situation. They had shared intimacy before even knowing each other. Now... even though they had met, there was no affection to speak of.

Last night, he had brought her back to Honghui Hall for treatment, which was already considerate given their past nights together.

Not to mention that she had been saved, but even if she had truly died from the poison, he would not have done anything to Cui Yichu.

She understood all this, so why did she still feel disappointed?

Perhaps in her heart, she had always believed that Zhao Xuanyou was not like Cui Yichu, a noble who disregarded human life. He would distinguish right from wrong and stand on her side.

Yu Wan sighed. In the end, it was she who had thought too much. Whether Zhao Xuanyou was good or bad, how would she know?

Yingxue saw her complex expression and felt at a loss.

However, Yingxue had been well taught by her parents and was good at reading the room. She noticed that Yu Wan seemed somewhat disheartened.

Indeed, Baozhu's negligence had almost cost Yu Wan her life.

"Sister should not overthink it. It's most important to recover your health. Since Madam has decided on the punishment, the matter cannot be changed. You should look ahead," Yingxue smiled and consoled her, then mentioned another important matter. "This time, Madam not only promoted Sister but also promoted others to serve the Young Master."

Was it the young lady Feng Tang from the Prince's residence?

Earlier, Zhao Xuanyou had agreed to take a concubine, but Cui Yichu had been dragging her feet.

"The young lady from the Prince's residence has been elevated to a concubine." Yingxue paused and lowered her voice. "In addition, another concubine has been elevated."

Another concubine?

This was unexpected for Yu Wan.

Given Cui Yichu's temper, elevating Feng Tang was to give face to Prince Ping. Elevating herself was out of necessity. How could she bear to elevate more people?

"Who is it? Is it someone from Liu Fang Hall?"

Bao Chan seemed quite envious of Zhao Xuanyou. Could it be her?

If she was truly elevated to a concubine, it would be extremely beneficial for Yu Wan.

Yingxue shook her head. "Not one of Madam's personal maids. The day before yesterday, the Ministry of Rites sent five official servant girls. Manager Song taught them the rules of the Marquis' residence for a few days, and today they were brought to Madam for inspection. Madam found their appearances proper and their conduct appropriate. Since Honghui Hall was short-staffed, she originally intended to select two to work, but one of them stood out, so Madam decided on the spot to elevate her to a concubine."

"So that's how it is."

There was already a rift between Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu. By sending the official servant girls over, Cui Yichu wanted to prove that she would not place her own people around Zhao Xuanyou.

As for elevating one to a concubine, it was probably purely to make things difficult for Yu Wan.

Yu Wan was determined to take revenge on Cui Yichu. Currently, Cui Yichu's family dominated the Marquis' residence, but Yu Wan felt that the more people in the residence, the better.

As her mother had taught her since she was young, the muddier the water in the river, the easier it was to catch fish.

Of course, as Yingxue had said, the more women around Zhao Xuanyou, the more disputes there would be.

She did not consider others as enemies, but others might see her as a thorn in their side. She would have to be more careful in the future.

"Thank you for the reminder. I will just do my own duty."

"Yes." Yingxue saw her smile and did not find it strange.

Earlier, when talking about Baozhu's light punishment, it was clear that Yu Wan was unhappy. Now, with the arrival of a strong rival, she seemed indifferent.

The two of them were not very familiar with each other, so Yingxue stopped there and did not say more. She carried the medicine bowl and retreated.

Yu Wan's body still ached from the residual poison.

With no time to think, she soon fell into a deep sleep.

She slept for a long time, and in between, she felt Yingxue come in to feed her medicine several times. However, her eyelids were so heavy that she could not open them.

When Yu Wan finally woke up again, it was three days later.

"Congratulations, Sister. This morning, the court physician came to see you and said that there is no longer any residual poison in your body."

"Really?" Yu Wan did indeed feel much clearer.

Yingxue smiled and said, "There's another piece of good news for you."

"What good news?"

"Your residence has been decided. It will be Xiaoyue Pavilion, right next to Honghui Hall."

Xiaoyue Pavilion had a beautiful name, but it was not actually a separate courtyard. It was a small connecting veranda-like cross courtyard between the Marquis' residence storage and another courtyard.

Because it was curved like a crescent moon, the people in the Marquis' residence simply called it Xiaoyue Pavilion.

Although the house was not square, it had windows. Only the respected servants in the residence could live there. Formerly, Mama Zhou had been allocated one room.

It was indeed much better than the side room she had lived in before.

"I should not be living here. I'll pack up and move over now."

Yingxue whispered, "Since Sister is awake, you should first go thank the Young Master. I'll help Sister pack."

Even though Zhao Xuanyou's handling of Baozhu had disappointed her, by all rights, he had saved her life and allowed her to recover in the main room of Honghui Hall.

Yu Wan had been in a deep sleep for these past few days. This matter had likely spread throughout the Marquis' residence. From now on, no one would dare to bully her again.

"You're right. I should go thank him first. But has the Young Master not gone to the yamen for duty yet?"

"I don't know about the yamen."

Yu Wan sat up, and Yingxue brought over a set of clean clothes and some hairpins and rings. They looked more exquisite than the usual maid's attire, likely given according to the status of a concubine.

After changing her clothes and arranging her hair in a simple bun, Yu Wan exited the inner room.

At this time, Zhao Xuanyou should be in the study.

But Yuan Qing had said before that he did not like to be disturbed while reading. If she went directly...

It would be better to have Yuan Qing announce her first.

She stood in the middle of the room for a moment, not seeing Yuan Qing come in. Thinking it would be better to go back to the inner room to pack her things, she suddenly heard a deep and rich voice from behind her.

"You're awake."

chapters.title: Borrowing a Knife to Kill
chapters.content:
Yu Ying knew it was him and turned to greet him with a bow.

"Your Highness."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded, his gaze steady on her.

"Your Highness's life-saving grace is something this servant will never forget." These words came from her heart. Yu Ying was just a poor maid with no one to rely on. The only way she could seek revenge was by using Zhao Xuanyou.

"It is the duty of the Marquis's mansion to handle matters where someone has poisoned you, as you are a member of the household."

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's indifferent tone, Yu Ying respectfully replied, "Yes."

"In the future, Manager Song will give you your instructions."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou walked straight into the courtyard.

His tone was the same as before, clearly not treating her differently just because she had become a concubine.

Could it be that he had no intention of touching her at all?

Previously, when Zhao Xuanyou had mistaken her for Cui Yichu, he had said he did not want to take concubines. This time, Cui Yichu had sent so many women to his side all at once; he probably wasn't happy about it.

This was both good and bad.

If he wasn't a womanizer, then as the only woman in the Marquis's mansion who had attended to him, she would naturally hold a special place in his heart.

But if he wasn't a womanizer, it wouldn't be easy for her to use her beauty to gain his favor.

Without gaining a higher position, how could she talk about revenge?

Well, there was no use in rushing.

Yu Ying returned to the inner room, where Yingxue had already packed her things.

This was Zhao Xuanyou's bedroom, and she didn't have many belongings here; just the medicine pills left by the mansion's physician, her dirty clothes, and the small clay stove and medicine pot Yingxue had used to brew medicine for her.

The bedsheets and quilt she had slept on were also taken down and placed to the side, but as they were Zhao Xuanyou's bedding, other servants would come to collect them.

"I'll escort you to Xiaoyue Pavilion, Sister." Yingxue helped carry the things, warmly saying, "In the future, if Sister is too busy, you can ask me to help brew medicine."

In the future...

Yu Ying didn't know what the future held; she could only take it one step at a time.

"That would be too much trouble. I already owe you a favor."

"You're too polite, Sister."

Xiaoyue Pavilion was very close to Honghui Hall, and the two of them arrived in a moment while chatting.

Yu Ying was assigned the central room, which was the same one Mama Zhou had lived in before.

Yingxue said, "This is the largest room in Xiaoyue Pavilion, and the view outside the window is beautiful."

The scenery was indeed nice; outside the window was a clump of Xiangfei bamboo.

Pushing open the window, a warm breeze rustled the bamboo leaves, making a soft sound, as if she were in the wilderness. For a moment, Yu Ying was transported back to her childhood, digging bamboo shoots in the bamboo forest with her mother.

Recalling the past, she naturally thought of her seriously ill mother, and her eyes cooled slightly.

There was no time to be sentimental. She had to pull herself together and rise in status as soon as possible to earn money to hire a doctor for her mother.

There was no tea in the room, so Yu Ying thanked Yingxue again and saw her out.

Not long after, someone came to deliver a message that the Madam was calling for her at Tingyu Pavilion.

With the sudden addition of a concubine and two maids to the Marquis's mansion, Cui Yichu, as the mistress, naturally had to give them a talking-to.

Yu Ying did not delay and followed the maid who delivered the message to Tingyu Pavilion.

Tingyu Pavilion was adjacent to the large garden of the inner mansion, so the small courtyard was also lush with flowers and trees. Built by the water, the scenery was better than in other courtyards of the Marquis's mansion.

However, because the garden was large, the house was inevitably smaller and could not compare to the spacious and grand Liu Fang Pavilion.

As soon as she entered Tingyu Pavilion, she saw Cui Yichu sitting on a cool chair on the veranda, looking somewhat gloomy.

After Yu Ying was poisoned, Cui Yichu's days had not been good either. Compared to Yu Ying's sickly appearance, Cui Yichu looked even worse.

Behind her stood only Baochuan, looking somewhat lonely.

When Baochuan saw Yu Ying approaching, she clenched her fingers tightly.

Ever since Yu Ying was sent to the Prince's bed, Baochuan had been jealous of her. But she had comforted herself with the thought that Yu Ying was just a pawn of the Madam, and the Madam would never truly elevate her.

Who would have thought that Yu Ying would actually climb up, becoming the Prince's maid, even surpassing her.

Looking at Yu Ying's new clothes and the jade hairpin in her hair, Baochuan's eyes were almost burning with envy.

"Madam." Yu Ying walked to the steps and bowed to Cui Yichu.

Cui Yichu's mood was no better than Baochuan's.

Yu Ying was the maid she had personally chosen to bear a child for her. She looked like her, and through her, she could have the child she desired.

But now, this tool had caught Zhao Xuanyou's eye.

Cui Yichu had fallen out of favor, while her substitute had gained it.

This was simply... a complete reversal of fortune.

"Has the poison in your body been completely resolved?" Cui Yichu suppressed the anger in her heart, but she couldn't manage a smile. Her expression was stiff and cold as she asked with feigned concern.

Yu Ying understood her feelings well, so her smile was especially sincere.

"Thank you for your concern, Madam. The mansion's physician said that the poison in this servant's body has been completely resolved."

"That's good." These three words were said by Cui Yichu through gritted teeth. "These days, you've worked hard for me, and I've kept my promise by elevating you to be the Prince's maid."

What a promise kept!

Yu Ying still smiled pleasantly and bowed respectfully to her again. "This servant will always remember Madam's great kindness. Without Madam's promotion, this servant would never have had today's glory."

Seeing her so obedient, Cui Yichu nodded. "Those who tried to harm you are either dead or punished. Let the past be the past, and there's no need to bring it up again in the future. Especially in front of the Prince, do you understand?"

This was a warning to Yu Ying to keep her mouth shut.

Yu Ying hurriedly said in alarm, "Madam misunderstands. That day, it was the Prince who guessed that this servant had attended to him at night. This servant couldn't hide it any longer, so I confessed. I would never betray Madam; please understand, Madam."

"Betrayal or loyalty, I only want you to never bring it up again and to quietly do your duties as a maid."

"This servant understands. In the future, this servant will definitely behave properly."

Cui Yichu nodded, and finally, a hint of a smile appeared on her face.

Of course, she didn't believe a single word of this.

The night of the fire at Liu Fang Pavilion had been chaotic, and the incident had happened suddenly. At the time, she hadn't thought too much.

But over the past few days, as she calmed down and reflected, she couldn't help but notice too many coincidences.

For example, the side room, as a maid's quarters, had very few belongings. How did the fire spread so quickly?

Another example: the chestnut cake had been given to Yu Ying a whole day earlier. How did she just happen to eat it when the fire broke out?

The more she thought about it, the more terrified she became.

There were so many people in the Marquis's mansion. How did she just happen to have a poison attack when Zhao Xuanyou arrived, and even collapse in his arms?

And the most important piece of evidence, half of the chestnut cake, had just happened to fall in front of Zhao Xuanyou.

One coincidence was possible, but not every single one.

At this moment, Cui Yichu finally realized that her previous assumption that Yu Ying was greedy and stupid had been a huge mistake.

Yu Ying was indeed greedy, always dreaming of rising in status, but she was not stupid. Instead, she was cunning and scheming.

She wanted to get rid of Yu Ying, but she wouldn't use simple and crude methods again.

This time, she would borrow a knife to kill.

The maid guarding the courtyard gate announced loudly, "Madam, Concubine Feng and Sister Yue have arrived."

Cui Yichu's eyes flashed.

Her knife had arrived.

---

chapters.title: Dividing His Favor
chapters.content:
Yu Ying also turned to look, and saw two women walking towards them one after the other.

Leading the way was Feng Tang, whom she had seen at Honghui Hall before. She was wearing a purple dress with a blue brocade sash around her waist. She was slender and graceful, her gaze fixed on Cui Yichu on the veranda as she curtsied.

Following behind Feng Tang was an unfamiliar face.

The woman had a face like a fresh lychee, with elegant features. As she walked, her chin was slightly raised, her demeanor not at all inferior to Cui Yichu's.

If one didn't know she was a newly elevated maid, one might mistake her for a noble lady visiting the Marquis's mansion.

"Madam."

After they had all greeted her, Cui Yichu slightly raised her eyebrows and gently fanned herself with her round fan.

"You will all be serving the Prince in the future. You must live harmoniously in the mansion. The reason I called you here today is to have you meet each other first."

"Yu Ying greets the two sisters." Yu Ying spoke first.

As soon as Feng Tang saw her, she remembered their previous encounter at Honghui Hall, when Yu Ying had been just a maid in the flower room.

The fire at Liu Fang Pavilion had been a major event, and even Feng Tang, who lived in a secluded part of the mansion, had heard about how Zhao Xuanyou had carried Yu Ying back to Honghui Hall in full view of everyone.

Thinking of Zhao Xuanyou's coldness towards herself, and then looking at Yu Ying, she felt a sudden sense of obstruction in her heart.

This maid must have seduced Zhao Xuanyou while working in the flower room.

She couldn't even do her job properly, and was so flirtatious; it was truly disgusting.

Feng Tang, after all, had already been elevated to a concubine and came from a princely mansion. She considered herself of high status and showed no warmth towards Yu Ying, merely nodding slightly.

Yu Ying was not offended and turned to the unfamiliar woman, smiling gently. "May I ask the young lady's name?"

The woman was slightly shorter than Feng Tang, but her features were even more beautiful. Her arched eyebrows, like distant mountains, seemed to be slightly furrowed, and the corners of her eyes and eyebrows carried an indescribable sorrow, making her appear pitiful.

"Huaiyue greets the two sisters."

Huaiyue?

This name didn't follow the usual naming conventions of the Marquis's mansion.

Judging by Huaiyue's demeanor, she was refined and dignified, suggesting she came from a good background. Perhaps someone in her family had committed a crime, leading to her being taken by the Ministry of Rites and reduced to an official servant.

Compared to her earlier gritted-teeth conversation with Yu Ying, Cui Yichu's expression was now much calmer. She looked at Huaiyue and said warmly, "In the future, you two will both work in Honghui Hall. You must not compete for favor; instead, support each other and work together to serve the Prince."

"Yes."

Cui Yichu pretended to think for a moment, then said, "Huaiyue is skilled in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting. She will manage the Prince's daily needs inside the house. Yu Ying is knowledgeable about flowers, so from now on, the courtyard of Honghui Hall will be under your care."

At first glance, there seemed to be no issue with these words, but a discerning person would sense the subtle implications.

Yu Ying and Huaiyue were both maids, but Huaiyue would attend to Zhao Xuanyou's daily needs, allowing her free access to Honghui Hall, while Yu Ying would only be allowed outside, continuing to tend to the flowers and plants.

Different duties represented different circumstances.

Huaiyue would see Zhao Xuanyou from morning to night, serving him as he dressed, ate, drank tea, and even bathed. Yu Ying, on the other hand, might not see Zhao Xuanyou at all in a day.

Cui Yichu's intentions were obvious to everyone.

"Do you have any objections?"

"None." Yu Ying and Huaiyue both respectfully replied.

Cui Yichu looked at Yu Ying, her eyes narrowing slightly. She felt that Yu Ying's excessive obedience must hide something. As she fanned herself, she saw Yu Ying smiling at her respectfully.

"Madam, how many maids will there be in Liu Fang Pavilion in the future?"

Cui Yichu raised her chin and continued, "Liu Fang Pavilion is the Prince's study. He reads and handles official business there, so it cannot be too crowded with people. Apart from you and Huaiyue, another official servant, Ziyan, will also go to Liu Fang Pavilion to assist you both."

Ziyan, like Huaiyue, was an official servant, so the two were likely already acquainted.

At this point, Yu Ying fully understood Cui Yichu's scheme.

Huaiyue would work inside, while she worked outside in the courtyard. With Ziyan assisting Huaiyue, she would find it difficult to set foot inside Honghui Hall in the future.

"There is one thing this servant is unsure whether to mention to Madam."

So this vixen was going to cause trouble!

Cui Yichu cursed silently.

Although she and Yu Ying had not openly fallen out, after the fire and poisoning incidents, Yu Ying's ambition and cunning had been fully revealed. From now on, she would not hide her schemes and would bring them up directly.

"What is there to mention or not," Baochuan, seeing Yu Ying speaking, immediately snapped, "Madam is giving instructions. Just listen. Don't think that just because you've entered Honghui Hall, you can put on airs. Compared to Madam, what is a mere maid like you?"

Yu Ying quickly bowed to Cui Yichu.

"This servant does not mean to be disrespectful to Madam. It's just that earlier, Madam said that Honghui Hall is a place of great importance where the Prince handles official business. This servant thinks that is indeed the case. Normally, only Yuan Qing and Yuan Zao are allowed inside, and even the guards at the door are those who have followed the Prince for many years. This servant tending to the flowers and doing rough work in the courtyard is fine, but if both Huaiyue and Ziyan enter the house to serve the Prince, it might not be appropriate."

Baochuan was about to scold her again, but she saw that Cui Yichu's angry expression had already faded, and she had lightly raised her round fan, so she had to lower her head and stand to the side.

What Yu Ying said was indeed a concern for Cui Yichu.

Honghui Hall was Zhao Xuanyou's territory. Now that there was a rift between them, Cui Yichu did not dare to place her own maids in Honghui Hall.

Zhao Xuanyou's affection for Yu Ying was undeniable. Every night he had spent guarding the veranda of Liu Fang Pavilion had been a nightmare for Cui Yichu.

She couldn't allow Yu Ying to monopolize his favor; she had to send someone to Honghui Hall to divert Zhao Xuanyou's affection away from Yu Ying.

Huaiyue was an official servant sent by the Ministry of Rites. Although she was an old acquaintance of Cui Yichu, she was not truly under her control.

She was beautiful and pitiful. If she could serve Zhao Xuanyou up close for a long time, he would surely not be able to resist and would neglect that little vixen Yu Ying.

Worried that Yu Ying was full of tricks, adding an assistant for Huaiyue would be more secure.

But thoughts were just thoughts. Originally, only Yuan Qing and Yuan Zao had served Zhao Xuanyou closely. Suddenly adding two outsiders might backfire, causing him to drive them all out.

"Do you have a better idea?" Cui Yichu had this concern, so she suppressed her anger and had to ask Yu Ying with a pleasant expression.

Yu Ying said, "A few days ago, while I was recovering, the Prince had Yingxue from the front courtyard's tea room take care of me. Yingxue is a native servant of the Marquis's mansion and has been tending to tea in the front courtyard. She would be the best choice to help at Honghui Hall."

Cui Yichu didn't have much impression of Yingxue, but she had to admit that Yu Ying's idea was indeed more appropriate.

Whether it was Old Lady Ye or Zhao Xuanyou, they both cared for the old servants of the Marquis's mansion.

If new maids were added to Honghui Hall without any native servants, it would inevitably cause controversy.

With Yingxue and Huaiyue serving together, even if Zhao Xuanyou initially disliked it, he probably wouldn't send them away.

But in front of so many people, she couldn't let Yu Ying have her way.

chapters.title: Quarreling Over Favor
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu quickly had an idea.

"What you said makes sense. Huaiyue is new here, and with Yingxue assisting her, things will go more smoothly. Here's what we'll do: Huaiyue and Yingxue will work inside, and you take Ziyan to manage the courtyard."

"Yes."

Yu Wan only wanted to get Yingxue into Honghui Hall. Now that her goal was achieved, she naturally had nothing more to say.

Yingxue wanted to get close to her. As a house-born servant, Yingxue was familiar with every room and corner of the Marquis's mansion.

As long as she could enter the main house of Honghui Hall to serve, it would also provide convenience for Yu Wan.

"You've just recovered from illness, so there's no need to stay here any longer. Go back to your room to rest and regain your strength. You can start your duties tomorrow."

"Thank you, Madam."

Yu Wan glanced at the three women in the courtyard and understood that Cui Yichu intentionally wanted to make her the target of public criticism.

Although she felt a bit helpless, she was not afraid.

If she wasn't even afraid of Cui Yichu, why would she fear a concubine and a servant?

After bowing respectfully, Yu Wan left Tingyu Pavilion.

Cui Yichu gently shook her fan and smiled helplessly at Feng Tang and Huaiyue. "Back when she worked in the flower room, not to mention me, even Baochuan was treated with respect by her. Now that she has gained the Young Master's favor, even I can't control her anymore."

Feng Tang thought of Yu Wan's charming smile just now and felt a surge of anger.

Since entering the Marquis's mansion, she hadn't even seen Zhao Xuanyou's face.

Although the cakes she sent were accepted, she was told not to send any more.

Previously, she heard that the Young Master and his wife were deeply in love. Although she felt disappointed, she had nothing to say.

But who would have thought that a servant from the flower room would gain the Young Master's favor? And in front of everyone in the Marquis's mansion, he carried her into Honghui Hall to recover from her illness. It was truly unacceptable.

If a servant from the flower room could do it, why couldn't she?

Feng Tang angrily said, "Yu Wan is too disrespectful. How dare she speak to Madam like that? If a palace maid in the Prince's mansion dared to be disrespectful to the Princess, she would at least be slapped ten times."

Seeing Feng Tang burning with jealousy, Cui Yichu was satisfied.

Yu Wan was a vixen, a cunning one at that. She had suffered at Yu Wan's hands, and she didn't believe Feng Tang and Huaiyue could deal with Yu Wan.

She didn't need them to deal with Yu Wan either.

As long as the two of them quarreled with Yu Wan over favor, and let everyone in the Marquis's mansion know about their discord, Cui Yichu could fish in troubled waters and kill Yu Wan, letting them take the blame.

"My health is not good. If someone can serve the Young Master well, I am happy." Cui Yichu sighed. "However, it's not good for only one person to be favored. It would be best if all of you could gain the Young Master's affection and soon bear children for the Marquis's mansion."

"Yes."

"Standing here for so long, you must be tired. Go back to your room and rest." Cui Yichu stopped there, seeing that Feng Tang's mind had been stirred, she dismissed her. Then she gave Huaiyue a look and led her into the house.

---

Yu Wan returned to Xiaoyue Pavilion and saw an unfamiliar woman coming and going next door. After inquiring, she learned it was Ziyan.

Because Huaiyue was called to Tingyu Pavilion, Ziyan helped bring Huaiyue's luggage over.

She looked slightly older than Yu Wan and Huaiyue, with a slender figure and an oval face. Although her appearance was not bad, it was still a bit inferior to Huaiyue's.

"So you are Ziyan. Just now, Madam said that from now on, you will help me manage the courtyard of Honghui Hall."

"Manage the courtyard?" Ziyan was somewhat surprised. Obviously, she had known she would follow Huaiyue to work inside, but after a moment of daze, she came back to her senses. "Are you Yu Wan?"

Yu Wan nodded.

Ziyan bowed to her. "I don't understand flower arrangements. In the future, please give me more guidance, Yu Wan."

"I was sick a few days ago. Madam allowed me to start my duties tomorrow. If you have nothing to do, go and wipe the leaves of the flowers and plants in the courtyard this afternoon. It hasn't rained for the past two days, so there might be dust."

"I understand." Ziyan responded and left.

Yu Wan looked at the room next door. She and Huaiyue were neighbors, and the days ahead would be lively.

Just as she was about to enter, she caught a glimpse of Yingxue walking over.

"Yu Wan, sister." Yingxue called out sweetly.

"Let's talk inside." Yu Wan pulled Yingxue into the room. Seeing there was no water on the table, Yingxue took the kettle and went out to fetch some.

After sitting down, Yu Wan poured her a cup of tea. "Thank you for your trouble."

"You've just recovered from a serious illness. I should do more." Yingxue smiled. "I came to find you because I heard something from my adoptive mother."

"Your adoptive mother is?"

Yingxue explained, "The Yang Mama who guards the side gate is an old sister of my mother, so I recognize her as my adoptive mother. Just now, when I went to find my mother, she happened to mention something related to you, sister. I was afraid you would be anxious, so I came over to let you know."

"What is so urgent?" Hearing this, Yu Wan was naturally curious but had no clue.

"A few days ago, a young man claimed to be your fellow villager and came looking for you. Because you were sick, my adoptive mother sent him away. He came again today."

It was Chen Da Niu.

Previously, Yu Wan had asked him to come every five days to see her, but because of the poisoning and coma, she had forgotten about it.

"Where is he?" Yu Wan asked.

"He said he was your fellow villager, but without proof, he was sent away again."

Chen Da Niu didn't have much money left. It was likely he would come again.

Thinking of her mother's illness, the matter of seducing Zhao Xuanyou became urgent again.

After a moment of thought, Yu Wan took out a string of coins and handed them to Yingxue.

"What is this for, sister?"

"He is indeed my fellow villager. My mother is sick, and he has been helping to take care of her. I am not convenient to see him now. Please ask Yang Mama to give him this money and ask him to take good care of my mother."

Currently, Yu Wan had nothing that required Chen Da Niu's help. Having Yang Mama give him the money would not draw attention.

After some days, when it was Yu Wan's day off, she would go out of the mansion to visit her mother.

Yingxue took the money pouch and nodded. "If he doesn't come in the next few days, I will return the money to you, sister."

"Thank you." The house-born servants in the Marquis's mansion were deeply connected. Most of them were married, so having Yingxue as a helper was indeed an advantage. Thus, Yu Wan said, "There is something I have taken the liberty to decide for you."

"Ah?" Yingxue looked at Yu Wan in confusion. "What is it?"

"Just now, when I went to Tingyu Pavilion to pay respects to Madam, she mentioned adding more maids to Honghui Hall. I thought you are good at serving tea and have worked in the front courtyard, which is reliable. So I recommended you to Madam to work in Honghui Hall."

"Really?" Yingxue was overjoyed. "Did Madam agree?"

Yu Wan nodded.

"Thank you, sister! Thank you, sister! From now on, I can work with you, which is really great."

Although Yingxue's family had served the Marquis's mansion for generations, her biological father worked in the stables, and her biological mother helped in the kitchen. She had only gotten a job in the tea room.

Being able to work in Honghui Hall was a significant step up in status.

Looking at Yingxue's joyful expression, Yu Wan said, "We won't be working in the same place. Madam wants me to continue taking care of the flowers and plants. In the future, you will serve the Young Master's daily needs with another servant."

Another servant?

Yingxue was intelligent and immediately understood that Cui Yichu intended to suppress Yu Wan.

Thinking that she would be serving inside while Yu Wan was left outside, she couldn't help but feel wronged for her.

"Everyone knows that the Young Master likes you, sister. How can Madam do this..."

Yu Wan held Yingxue's hand and looked into her eyes, softly saying, "Even if she drives me out of the main house, it's fine. I still have you. You can help me, right?"

---

chapters.title: Sleepless Night
chapters.content:
Facing Yu Wan's eyes, which were as rippling as a spring, Yingxue was slightly startled.

Although Yingxue was a house-born servant, her parents were honest and simple, not good at socializing, and worked in the corners of the Marquis's mansion. She herself had always been doing odd jobs in the tea room.

She knew her place. With her appearance and temperament, it was impossible for her to gain the Young Master's favor. Being a steady maid was her path.

Yu Wan was beautiful with a good temperament, which was why she could gain the Young Master's affection.

Now that she could get to know Yu Wan, it was her opportunity.

In the future, if Yu Wan could advance further, Yingxue would also have a place in the Marquis's mansion.

Thinking of this, Yingxue also held Yu Wan's hand and seriously said, "If there is anything I can do for you, sister, just let me know."

"Thank you, sister."

Since her rebirth, Yu Wan had been weak and alone, and every step in the Marquis's mansion had been difficult.

Now, with Chen Da Niu outside and Yingxue inside, she finally didn't look so pitiful.

"What do you need me to do, sister?"

"You don't need to do anything. Just work hard in Honghui Hall."

Yu Wan had her own plans.

When Zhao Xuanyou was with her, he was passionate, but Yu Wan felt that he was not a lustful man. In fact, he valued boundaries in his interactions with others.

Previously, he was close to Yu Wan because he thought she was his wife.

He was willing to be intimate with his wife and willing to solve problems for her. Even so, he always maintained a respectful distance from the Marquis of Xingguo's mansion.

On Yu Wan's side, after the truth was revealed, Zhao Xuanyou's attitude became ambiguous.

People in the mansion said that Yu Wan had bewitched him, which was why he carried her into Honghui Hall in front of everyone.

Yu Wan, however, believed that it was because Cui Yichu was present that he had done so.

He did it intentionally for Cui Yichu to see.

Therefore, there was no need to worry about quarreling over favor.

Even if Huaiyue was a beauty, before Zhao Xuanyou completely gave up on Cui Yichu, he had no mind to appreciate her beauty. Huaiyue had no chance at all.

As for Yu Wan herself, it was Cui Yichu who personally sent her to Zhao Xuanyou's bed, making her his only woman.

Now, what needed to be done was to make Zhao Xuanyou think more about those tender and passionate nights.

"Do I not need to help you watch out for Huaiyue?" Yingxue asked softly.

"There's no need to pay attention to her. You've just gotten a new job. The most important thing is to let the master know that you can handle this job."

Yu Wan had won over Yingxue for the connections her family had among the servants in the Marquis's mansion, not for quarreling over favor.

"Okay, I understand."

The two sat by the window and talked for a while. Soon, someone came to inform Yingxue that Steward Song had something for her. Knowing it was about working in Honghui Hall, Yingxue hurriedly left with the person.

Yu Wan stayed alone in the room for a while.

It was good to have a window in the room. Looking at the Xiangfei bamboo swaying in the wind, the view was lush and green. Occasionally, sunlight would shine through the gaps in the bamboo leaves, dazzling her eyes.

As she was daydreaming, someone came to inform her to go to the storeroom to collect her things.

Yu Wan was officially promoted to a servant with a monthly salary of two taels of silver, two new sets of clothes, and some cosmetics, jewelry, and earrings that even senior maids didn't have.

Because her previous room had been burned down and she had just moved to Xiaoyue Pavilion, Steward Song had specially arranged for the storeroom to provide brand new bedsheets, quilts, and other daily necessities.

This was a great help.

To save money for her mother's treatment, Yu Wan had to spend her money carefully. If the mansion could provide more things, she would spend less.

---

Zhao Xuanyou had a rare desire to take a nap after his meal.

Life in the capital was much more leisurely than on the frontier. Every day, he had to practice martial arts and read, but there was still a lot of free time, which he could only spend by sleeping.

Although he lay down, he still couldn't fall asleep, so he sat up.

Looking at the empty bed, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but let out a cold snort.

On the frontier, sleeping and eating were necessary for survival, and he found no pleasure in them.

But now it was different.

After experiencing such extreme pleasure, how could he want to sleep alone?

The person accompanying him was not his legally wedded wife, but; Yu Wan.

Zhao Xuanyou felt inexplicably irritated. He got up and went into the study, randomly picked up a document, and read. As he read, his mood gradually calmed down.

The sun gradually set in the west. After finishing the stack of documents in front of him, Zhao Xuanyou wanted to get up and move his muscles. Out of the corner of his eye, he caught a glimpse of a figure outside the window.

Was it her?

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly stood up and walked to the window. The woman wiping the leaves in the courtyard heard the sound behind her, turned around, saw Zhao Xuanyou standing by the window, and quickly bowed to him.

It wasn't her.

Zhao Xuanyou said nothing and turned to walk back into the room.

"Young Master." Yuan Qing saw him come out and hurried forward.

"Is there something?"

After Zhao Xuanyou took his seat, Yuan Qing poured him a cup of tea and respectfully said, "Previously, it was mentioned that more people would be added to Honghui Hall. Today, Madam has decided on the candidates. They are waiting under the corridor right now."

Cui Yichu was the mistress of the Marquis's mansion, and arranging maids was her responsibility.

"Who did she choose?"

Yuan Qing said, "An official servant, Huaiyue, and the maid who took care of Yu Wan the other day, Yingxue."

Zhao Xuanyou knew about the official servants sent by the Ministry of Rites.

Official servants were usually families of convicted officials. They were good-looking, literate, and artistic. Apart from being sent to the imperial palace, some were also allocated to high-ranking families in the capital.

This time, to curry favor with Zhao Xuanyou, the Ministry of Rites had allocated five of them to him.

Of course, Zhao Xuanyou would not allow Cui Yichu to fill Honghui Hall with her own people. One official servant and one house-born servant were appropriate.

"Young Master, today Madam officially promoted Feng Tang to be a concubine. Also, from now on, Huaiyue and Yu Wan are both your servants."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a cold laugh.

Was she trying to choke him by sending so many people at once?

"Where are they?"

"They are waiting under the corridor right now. The Young Master can take a look first. Madam said that if the Young Master doesn't like them, she will send better candidates."

"And the one in the courtyard?"

Yuan Qing was stunned for a moment before remembering the one helping Yu Wan in the courtyard. He quickly said, "The one managing the flowers and plants in the courtyard is also an official servant, I think her name is Ziyan."

She manages the flowers and plants?

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's pensive expression, Yuan Qing added, "Madam's intention is for Ziyan and Yu Wan to manage the courtyard of Honghui Hall together."

She really disliked Yu Wan, not even wanting to pretend otherwise.

Zhao Xuanyou said nothing more, indifferently, "Bring them in to see."

After all, the senior maids would be working inside the house. They couldn't be stupid or unpleasant to look at.

"Yes." Yuan Qing responded and left, leading Huaiyue and Yingxue, who had been waiting under the corridor for a long time, into the room.

Compared to their previous simple appearance, the two were now dressed exquisitely.

After Cui Yichu gave her instructions, Steward Song immediately made arrangements.

Huaiyue and Yingxue would be the senior maids of Honghui Hall. According to the Marquis's mansion's standards for food, clothing, and daily necessities, even ordinary young ladies from other families couldn't compare.

Both wore light green tunics and white pleated skirts, standing like small trees in front of Zhao Xuanyou, and bowed to him together.

"Slaves greet the Young Master."

Zhao Xuanyou took a sip of tea, looked up, and his gaze suddenly stopped.

The woman in front of him had a slender figure, graceful and delicate. Especially with her eyebrows knitted like spring mountains and eyes containing autumn water, she was truly charming and moving; it was none other than Huaiyue.

Feeling Zhao Xuanyou's gaze on her, Huaiyue also looked at him, bowing gracefully.

"Huaiyue greets the Young Master."

---

chapters.title: White Moonlight
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched, and his gaze swept over Yingxue again. He said indifferently, "Since Madam has sent you two to Honghui Hall, do as she said. My study is off-limits, and for everything else, listen to Yuan Qing."

"Yes." Huaiyue and Yingxue responded respectfully.

Yuan Qing glanced at Zhao Xuanyou's expression and saw that he seemed to be deep in thought. It seemed there was nothing more to say to the two maids, so he said, "You may leave."

As the maids turned to leave, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly called out, "Huaiyue."

Huaiyue paused in her steps, turned around, and looked back at Zhao Xuanyou, gazing at him steadily.

Zhao Xuanyou gave Yuan Qing a look, and Yuan Qing understood, silently leading Yingxue out of the room.

When they reached the corridor, Yingxue finally couldn't help but ask, "Is this the first time the Young Master has seen her?"

chapters.title: Chapter 46
chapters.content:
"It's our first meeting." These official maids had just been brought back from the Ministry of Rites.

"I haven't seen her before. As for the Young Master..."

Yingxue didn't dare to continue. Having just entered Honghui Hall, she didn't dare to recklessly comment on the master and cause trouble.

But the situation seemed a bit dire. Could it be that the Young Master had fallen for Huaiyue's beauty at first sight?

Yingxue couldn't help but worry for Yuhan.

Huaiyue was exceptionally beautiful, and with the mistress's support, she was to serve the Young Master in the main house. Yuhan's path ahead would be difficult.

---

The doors and windows of Honghui Hall were all open, and even inside, a cool breeze was blowing.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Huaiyue before him, his brows slightly furrowed.

This was certainly not the first time he had seen Zhuang Huaiyue.

The Zhuang family was a prominent family in Jiangnan. Zhuang Huaiyue's father had achieved success at a young age. Twenty years ago, he had been the second-place scholar chosen by the late emperor. It was then that the old Marquis had met him, and the two families had since maintained close ties.

Though Magistrate Zhuang held a second-rank position, he had not lost his youthful spirit. Early last year, he had been deceived by a villain and implicated in a major case, leading to his imprisonment and exile to a distant land. His family's women were all reduced to official maids.

Recalling that the old Marquis and Magistrate Zhuang were old friends, Zhao Xuanyou, upon learning that the Ministry of Rites was sending people over, had specifically instructed Manager Song to bring Magistrate Zhuang's youngest daughter to the Marquis's residence and arrange a light duty for her.

Unexpectedly, Zhuang Huaiyue had been sent to Honghui Hall and even granted the status of a concubine.

Zhao Xuanyou did not remember her given name, so when he heard the name Huaiyue, he hadn't thought much of it.

How had she chosen Zhuang Huaiyue?

"Do you know my wife?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Zhuang Huaiyue lowered her eyes. "Before my family fell, I had appreciated flowers with the mistress a couple of times."

So, they did know each other.

After a moment of thought, Zhao Xuanyou said, "My father and Magistrate Zhuang are old acquaintances. It was my idea to bring you to the Marquis's residence. I can arrange a lighter duty for you."

Zhuang Huaiyue looked at Zhao Xuanyou's proud and cold demeanor, her brows twitched slightly.

After a moment of silence, she lightly bit her lower lip and softly asked, "Does the Young Master not want me to work in Honghui Hall?"

Zhao Xuanyou, hearing her words, narrowed his eyes and glanced at Zhuang Huaiyue again.

He didn't have much of a relationship with Magistrate Zhuang. Out of respect for the old Marquis, he had taken Zhuang Huaiyue from the Ministry of Rites, thus fulfilling his obligation.

In his view, a young lady like Zhuang Huaiyue should be given a light duty, and after a few years, when a general amnesty was declared, he could help remove her slave status and arrange a marriage for her. That would be the best arrangement.

However, facing Zhuang Huaiyue's eyes, which were as clear as autumn water and full of affection, Zhao Xuanyou understood.

He was cold, but not a block of wood. He could understand Zhuang Huaiyue's intentions.

Originally, he thought that Zhuang Huaiyue becoming his concubine was Madam Cui Yi's insistent arrangement, and he had intended to help her escape this predicament.

But now it seemed, she was willing?

"It doesn't matter where you work," Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

Zhuang Huaiyue's eyes lit up with joy. "Does the Young Master agree to let me stay by your side?"

"Stay for now. The Marquis's residence has its rules. If you make a mistake, everything will be handled according to the rules."

"Thank you, Young Master. I understand. I will serve diligently."

Zhuang Huaiyue's face, which had been filled with worry, finally showed a slight smile.

Her red lips slightly curved, her fair face full of charm, truly a beauty to behold.

Unfortunately, Zhao Xuanyou didn't appreciate this beauty at all. He stood up and went straight to the study.

Zhuang Huaiyue watched his retreating figure, a hint of disappointment in her heart.

She was very proud of her beauty.

Before her family's downfall, many noble sons had come to propose marriage. But in her heart, she only thought of Zhao Xuanyou.

She didn't like the foppish young masters of the capital. She liked men like Zhao Xuanyou, tall and dignified, both literary and martial.

Zhao Xuanyou had not been betrothed, and she had always harbored hopes, even asking her parents to wait until the Marquis of Jingyuan returned to the capital to discuss the idea of marriage.

Unfortunately, before the Marquis of Jingyuan returned, her family had fallen into dis grace. Her father was imprisoned, and the women of the family were sent to the Ministry of Rites as maids.

Her heart had almost died, but unexpectedly, she was sent to the Marquis of Jingyuan's residence.

Madam Cui Yichu had met her before, and though they didn't have much of a relationship, Cui Yichu had recognized her immediately. She said that Zhao Xuanyou was short of attendants and wanted to promote her to a concubine.

Zhuang Huaiyue's heart, which had turned to ashes, slowly came back to life.

Even if she couldn't be Zhao Xuanyou's wife, as long as she could stay by his side, her life would not be in vain.

---

Yuhan slept quite peacefully that night. In the early morning, after getting ready, she went to Honghui Hall.

As soon as she entered Honghui Hall, she saw Zhao Xuanyou practicing swordplay in the courtyard.

The sword's edge cut through the wind, and even from a distance, Yuhan could feel the killing intent.

She wouldn't try to seduce Zhao Xuanyou at this moment, not when he was wielding a sword.

She wondered if he had seen her...

Yuhan sighed and, from a distance, bowed to him before walking around to the side.

At this moment, Ziyan had not arrived yet. Yuhan walked alone in the back courtyard and saw several jasmine plants that had passed their blooming season. She moved them all out.

After busying herself for a while, when she returned to the front courtyard, Zhao Xuanyou was already gone.

He must have gone to have breakfast.

It was really annoying to guess like this. If she were working inside the house, she wouldn't have to worry about not seeing Zhao Xuanyou.

Cui Yichu was indeed cunning.

Yuhan was pondering how to see Zhao Xuanyou again when she heard a voice behind her say, "Sister."

She turned around and saw Yingxue.

As the saying goes, people rely on their clothing. Yingxue, dressed in the attire of a senior maid and with a new hairstyle, looked much more charming.

Yuhan's eyes curved into a smile. "You look very pretty in this outfit."

"Don't tease me. You are the real beauty." Yingxue said, embarrassed.

Seeing that Yingxue had come to the courtyard, Yuhan asked curiously, "The Young Master should be having his meal. Aren't you supposed to be serving inside? Why did you come out?"

Yingxue's expression suddenly became a bit subtle.

"The Young Master is indeed having his meal. Huaiyue is serving him, so I'm not needed."

Yuhan detected the underlying meaning in her words. Thinking of Huaiyue's weak and self-important demeanor at Tingyu Pavilion yesterday, she felt a bit strange.

"Is she serving the Young Master very attentively?"

---

chapters.title: Ingratiation
chapters.content:
