"Isn't she?" Recalling how Huaiyue seemed to want to stick to Zhao Xuanyou, Yingxue whispered, "She's been in Honghui Hall for less than a day, and she's already taken over all the tasks of serving the Young Master up close, leaving me to tend the stove, wipe the tables, and tidy the wardrobe."

Both were senior maids in Honghui Hall, but Huaiyue was a concubine, so her status was naturally higher than Yingxue's. It was not out of line for her to order Yingxue around.

Yuhan comforted her, "The mistress favors her and wants her to manage the affairs of the house. Don't argue with her. Just do whatever she asks you to do."

"I won't cause any trouble in Honghui Hall. I'm only telling you, sister."

Yuhan was thinking about other things.

After a moment of hesitation, she asked the question that truly concerned her.

"Last night, did she...?"

She had witnessed Zhao Xuanyou's fierce demeanor in bed. At his age, full of vigor, and having just returned from the barren frontier, coupled with his extraordinary...

With a beautiful woman like Huaiyue, delicate and alluring, always by his side and eager to ingratiate herself, could he resist?

In fact, he didn't need to resist. Huaiyue was, after all, a concubine.

"No, she wanted to, but the Young Master didn't even let her help him change his clothes. He sent her out of the room before the lights were out."

So that was it.

Yesterday, when they met, she saw that Huaiyue didn't look like a servant at all. She carried herself like a young lady from an official family. Yuhan had thought she would rely on her status, but she hadn't expected her to be so eager to get close to Zhao Xuanyou.

Fortunately, Zhao Xuanyou's reaction was within Yuhan's expectations.

He was not a man who was easily swayed.

Seeing Yuhan lost in thought, Yingxue looked around to make sure no one was nearby and lowered her voice, "Later, I'll go to Xiaoyue Pavilion to find you, sister. There are some things I can't talk about here."

Yuhan nodded, and the two went their separate ways to attend to their duties.

Before long, Ziyan arrived. Yuhan briefly taught her how to care for the plants, especially the jasmine, which was nearing the end of its blooming season. She needed to keep an eye on it daily, and any wilting flowers should be quickly replaced with new ones from the greenhouse.

"Is the courtyard only going to have jasmine?" Ziyan asked. "It's the height of summer, and flowers are in full bloom everywhere else. Honghui Hall looks a bit monotonous."

Yuhan was about to say that Zhao Xuanyou didn't like too many colors in the garden when Ziyan said, "This morning, Huaiyue went to the greenhouse and picked many flower branches to arrange in vases."

It seemed that she had only come now because she had been helping Huaiyue earlier.

"Really? What did she pick?"

"There was platycodon, crape myrtle, and hibiscus. They're all in full bloom."

Honestly, these flowers were indeed in season, and their blossoms were not too large or gaudy. It was clear that Huaiyue had put thought into her choices.

Yuhan pursed her lips. "I can't interfere with Miss Huaiyue's work. Honghui Hall will stay as it is. You take these wilting jasmine plants back to the greenhouse and pick some better ones to replace them."

"Yes."

Ziyan reluctantly nodded, said no more, and silently went to work.

Yuhan bit her lip thoughtfully.

Huaiyue was by Zhao Xuanyou's side from morning to night, while she couldn't even enter the room to serve him.

Even if Huaiyue didn't yet understand Zhao Xuanyou's temperament and preferences, after a few days of serving him, she would. Over time, Yuhan's slight advantage would mean nothing.

She truly regretted not seizing the opportunity to enter the room at Tingyu Pavilion yesterday. Perhaps Madam Cui Yichu would have agreed.

Alas, it was useless to dwell on the past.

Thinking of what Ziyan had said about the many fresh flowers arranged in vases inside, Yuhan imagined the room must be filled with a strong fragrance. Given Zhao Xuanyou's habits, he would surely open the windows for ventilation.

A thought struck Yuhan, and she left Honghui Hall, heading straight for the greenhouse.

Due to her status, the greenhouse manager was warm and cordial when he saw her.

Yuhan selected a few pots of purple bamboo and had Ziyan put down the jasmine, pushing the purple bamboo back to Honghui Hall.

It was clear that Ziyan had aligned herself with Huaiyue. Since Huaiyue could order Yingxue around, she could certainly order Ziyan around as well.

Upon arriving outside Zhao Xuanyou's study, Yuhan glanced inside and saw him engrossed in reading documents, paying no attention to her.

She simply instructed Ziyan to move the original jasmine plants aside and place the newly selected purple bamboo in their stead.

After finishing these tasks, she sent Ziyan to look after the jasmine flowers and set to work with a pair of scissors.

As Zhao Xuanyou drank his tea, he noticed Yuhan standing outside the window trimming bamboo leaves. His gaze was drawn to her and couldn't look away.

After sleeping for several days, she appeared a bit thinner. The thin summer dress she wore seemed quite loose on her, with the sleeves and skirt hem swaying gently in the wind, like rippling water.

It was also in the breeze that the good figure hidden under her loose clothing was revealed.

Zhao Xuanyou had held and embraced her before, so he knew well her soft, slender waist and graceful figure.

Those nights spent with her... were indeed unforgettable.

An image involuntarily appeared in his mind.

She had been cornered against the wall by him. Overwhelmed by his teasing, she had no strength left and could only sit weakly against the wall, allowing him to have his way with her.

The canopy had been too dark for Zhao Xuanyou to see her face clearly at the time.

But her eyes had been clear and bright, filled with tears that made them glisten darkly. Just that gaze had seemed pitiful, making him want to tease her even more.

"Young Master." Yuhan turned around unconsciously and "just happened" to see Zhao Xuanyou standing by the window.

She seemed genuinely surprised to see him there, looking somewhat at a loss, and the scissors in her hand fell to the ground.

Zhao Xuanyou silently watched her bend down to pick up the scissors, then saw her look up at him with reddened eyes, seemingly aggrieved.

Compared to Cui Yichu, the jewelry she wore was cheap. The jade hairpin in her hair had no luster, looking not the least bit polished, and the embroidery on her skirt was simple, just a single layer of lilies.

But these inexpensive items, when worn by her, seemed to become remarkably pleasing to the eye.

"Did this servant disturb the Young Master?" Yuhan asked carefully, holding the scissors.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze remained fixed on Yuhan.

He was no fool. In fact, there were few people in the world smarter than Zhao Xuanyou.

He, of course, knew the reason why Yuhan, in the spacious Honghui Hall, had chosen to trim leaves right outside his window.

Just like Huaiyue, who was eagerly trying to ingratiate herself with him, Yuhan had come for him.

He couldn't explain why, but seeing Huaiyue trying to get close to him, wanting to serve him in his most intimate moments, filled Zhao Xuanyou with disgust. He even wanted Yuan Qing to throw out all the flowers she had arranged in the room.

But Yuhan...

Even though he knew she was scheming in front of him, he didn't mind. The cheap ornaments she wore looked very nice, and the bamboo she had placed there was pleasing to the eye.

"What is this plant?" Zhao Xuanyou asked indifferently, looking at the purple bamboo behind her.

Seeing that he was looking at the purple bamboo, Yuhan lowered her eyes. "This is purple bamboo."

"Better to live without meat than without bamboo," Zhao Xuanyou nodded. "Planting some bamboo in the courtyard is indeed better than jasmine."

So he really didn't like flowers.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's interest in bamboo, she looked up at him, her gaze meeting his directly.

"The Marquis's residence has planted many bamboos in various places. Besides purple bamboo, there are also Xiangfei bamboo, phoenix tail bamboo, green-skinned bamboo, and more. However, some are too tall and not suitable for planting in Honghui Hall. If the Young Master likes, this servant can cut some branches to arrange in vases."

Cut bamboo branches for vases?

That was indeed more elegant than the flowers in the room.

"Alright."

chapters.title: Probing and Tempting
chapters.content:
With those two words, Zhao Xuanyou’s figure flickered and disappeared from the window.

Yu Ying had achieved her goal, so she gave up on those few purple bamboos and searched the Marquis's mansion for suitable bamboo branches. After picking and choosing, she only broke off one branch and took it back to Xiaoyue Pavilion, soaking it in a water basin.

After a whole day of busy work, Yu Ying was hungry, so she had the kitchen add a sweet potato to her dinner.

When a through-room maid had an advantage, she no longer had to eat with the other maids, and could pick and choose from the kitchen to take back to her room to eat alone.

Just as she was peeling the sweet potato, someone knocked on the door.

"Sister Yu Ying."

"The door isn’t locked, come in."

Yingxue pushed the door open and entered. Seeing the meal on Yu Ying’s table, she smiled, "Sister, you’re still eating?"

"Have you eaten? If not, join me."

"The Young Master rewarded us with dishes, so I already ate at Honghui Hall."

Seeing Yingxue’s bright smile, Yu Ying knew that Zhao Xuanyou must have rewarded her with many good dishes.

"You seem to enjoy working at Honghui Hall."

"His Lordship is kind to the servants and not harsh or picky. Working under him is indeed much more comfortable than in the tea and water room. Look, Sister, see if you like these things."

Yingxue placed a large oiled paper package on the table as she spoke.

Opening it, there were various pastries inside.

"Did His Lordship reward you with these too?"

"No." Yingxue laughed, "My mother knows that I was able to enter Honghui Hall thanks to Sister’s recommendation. Today, she went out of the mansion on business, and when she passed by Guifang Zhai, she bought these pastries and snacks, and told me to thank Sister properly."

"It was just a small favor, no need to be so polite." Yu Ying had recommended Yingxue to make things easier for herself, but she hadn’t expected Yingxue’s family to be so grateful. She felt rather guilty.

But Yingxue took everything out of the oiled paper package and placed it on the table.

"This is hawthorn cake, this is pine pollen cake, these are mixed fruit cakes, and this package is their most famous lotus root powder. From now on, Sister can have a bowl of it every day. It’s very nourishing."

"You’re all too kind. I’ll accept this time, but don’t buy any more in the future."

"Okay. If Sister doesn’t like sweets, just tell me what you’d like to eat or buy in the future," Yingxue said with a hint of pride. "My parents often go out on business, so whatever you want to buy, just say the word."

Since it was inconvenient for her to meet Chen Da Niu often, if Yingxue’s parents could help her buy things outside in the future, it would indeed be a great convenience.

"You came to find me just to talk about this?"

Hearing Yu Ying’s words, Yingxue slightly restrained her smile and softly said, "Not just for this. I heard some things about Huaiyue and wanted to give Sister a heads-up first."

Huaiyue’s matters?

Yu Ying was indeed curious.

"She used to be a young lady from a noble family, right? Did she have any connections with the Marquis's mansion?"

"That’s right."

Yingxue saw that Yu Ying had guessed correctly right away, and secretly admired her in her heart. She was both clever and beautiful; her future prospects were probably limitless.

At the very least, she would definitely be better than that Concubine Feng.

"Huaiyue’s real name is Zhuang Huaiyue. Her biological father was once a second-rank official, but later he committed a crime, and the women of the family were sent to serve as official maids. I heard that it was His Lordship who specifically asked for her, so the Ministry of Rites sent her here."

Zhao Xuanyou specifically asked for her?

Yu Ying lightly took a bite of the sweet potato. The two of them wouldn’t have some old feelings between them, would they? That would be troublesome.

"Who did you hear this from?"

"It was Yuan Yi who said it."

Yuan Yi?

Yu Ying hadn’t spent much time in Honghui Hall, so she was somewhat familiar with Yuan Qing, but she hadn’t met Zhao Xuanyou’s other long-time attendant, Yuan Yi.

"Do you know him?"

Yingxue nodded, "He’s like me; his parents are both slaves of the Marquis’s mansion. Before, my brother and he were both book boys for His Lordship."

Speaking of this, Yingxue showed a somewhat embarrassed expression, "It’s just that my brother was too stupid. After following His Lordship for a few months, he was sent back. Yuan Yi is clever, so he’s stayed by His Lordship’s side to work. Yuan Yi said that the Madam probably knows about this matter, which is why she promoted Huaiyue to a through-room maid."

Yesterday, when Huaiyue appeared, Yu Ying had this doubt in her mind.

Clearly, Zhao Xuanyou had already been angered by Cui Yichu, so why was she still stuffing women into Honghui Hall besides Feng Kang and herself?

Yu Ying had thought that she really wasn’t afraid of Zhao Xuanyou turning against her.

So it turned out to be to please Zhao Xuanyou.

"Yingxue, you’ve also been at Honghui Hall for a day. In your opinion, does His Lordship seem close to Huaiyue?"

Yingxue shook her head.

"Huaiyue volunteers for everything, but whenever His Lordship has something, he orders Yuan Qing and Yuan Yi. He never lets her get involved in personal matters. Originally, it should be my turn to be on duty now, but she saw that Yuan Qing and Yuan Yi went to eat dinner, so she sent me away too. Right now, it’s just her and His Lordship in Honghui Hall. I don’t know if she’ll do something shameful."

"If she’s His Lordship’s through-room maid, wanting to serve him isn’t shameful."

Yingxue realized she had misspoken and quickly said, "Sister, I didn’t mean that."

"No need to explain, I understand." Yu Ying smiled.

She really wasn’t angry; on the contrary, she was in a good mood.

Yuan Qing was already on good terms with her in Honghui Hall, and with Yingxue joining, it was like adding wings to a tiger. Unexpectedly, Yingxue was also very familiar with Yuan Yi, so they could speak without restraint.

The situation in Honghui Hall had suddenly become favorable to her, but she couldn’t let her guard down.

"Yingxue, in the future, when you’re in front of His Lordship, don’t get too close to Yuan Yi, understand?"

Yingxue seemed to understand but not quite, "Sister means..."

"Just don’t let people see that you and Yuan Yi are very familiar."

"Okay, I’ll remember." Yingxue said, standing up, "I should go back to Honghui Hall. If Huaiyue wants to do something, I can’t let her succeed."

---

In Honghui Hall, the lights in the corridor and the room were gradually lit.

After dinner, Zhao Xuanyou sat by the window alone, studying the chessboard in an ancient book.

Leaning against the window to admire the moon, sipping tea, and playing chess, how leisurely it was.

Zhuang Huaiyue replaced the lukewarm tea with fresh, but instead of leaving with the tray, she just stared at the man on the soft couch.

Zhao Xuanyou wore a green robe, his hair tied up with a jade crown, making his face look even more like jade, and his bone structure refined and elegant.

Compared to his usual dignified and cold demeanor, he now looked particularly lazy; seemingly much more approachable.

Since she had become his through-room maid, if she couldn’t truly become his woman, Zhuang Huaiyue really couldn’t accept it.

"His Lordship, let me massage your shoulders." Zhuang Huaiyue said softly.

Zhao Xuanyou raised his eyebrows and glanced at her, then looked back at the chessboard.

"No need."

Zhuang Huaiyue was unwilling to give up and whispered, "Then let me rub your legs?"

She sounded pitiful, her tone full of humility.

Zhao Xuanyou was at a crucial point in his chess game. Seeing Zhuang Huaiyue standing there refusing to leave, he impatiently hummed, "Mmm."

Zhuang Huaiyue was overjoyed to hear this hum, her face flushing.

She put down the tray, looked at Zhao Xuanyou, who was focused on the chessboard, and suddenly made up her mind. She raised her hand and pulled her collar forcefully to the side.

chapters.title: Spring Scenery Revealed
chapters.content:
The moon was like a hook, and the night was deep.

Zhuang Huaiyue was from a noble family, and such vulgar methods of seducing a man were originally beyond her.

But the words Cui Yichu had used to persuade her yesterday still echoed in her ears.

Yes, her father had been exiled, her family had fallen, and she, as an official maid, was no different from other slaves.

Cui Yichu had kindly promoted her to a through-room maid and sent her to Zhao Xuanyou’s side as a senior maid, sparing her a lot of hard labor.

The past glory had vanished into smoke. She had to plan for her own future.

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou was the man she admired.

Whether it was his status or his appearance, he was one in a million, a dragon among men.

Being able to be his through-room maid was the only good thing that had happened to her since her family was confiscated.

Cui Yichu said she was in poor health and didn’t want to see a little vixen like Yu Ying bewitch Zhao Xuanyou, so she wanted to promote her.

If she could bear a son for Zhao Xuanyou, she would be able to secure her position in the Marquis’s mansion in the future. Her life would then be one of wealth, honor, and freedom from want.

Even more, Zhao Xuanyou was currently in high favor with the Emperor. If he was willing to say a few good words to the Emperor for her father, perhaps he could even help clear her father’s name and restore him to office.

No matter what, Zhuang Huaiyue pinned all her hopes on Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhuang Huaiyue slightly lowered her head, catching a glimpse of the fair skin revealed by her collar. She took a deep breath and made up her mind to walk towards Zhao Xuanyou.

She knelt beside the soft couch and raised her hand to massage his legs.

The wind outside kept blowing, and Zhuang Huaiyue’s collar had been pulled open. The night wind rushed in, making her feel a little cold.

She let out a soft "hiss" and looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, her eyes full of expectation.

From where she knelt, she could just see Zhao Xuanyou’s profile and the moon outside the window.

Tonight was a waning moon, the moonlight outside was bright, and Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes were lowered, casually looking at the chessboard. His expression was exceptionally relaxed, and his handsome appearance was so captivating that she couldn’t look away.

She wanted Zhao Xuanyou, not just for other reasons, but simply because he was Zhao Xuanyou.

A blush of spring feelings spread across her fair cheeks, and her eyes shimmered like spring water, full of tender affection.

Zhuang Huaiyue felt a little dry-mouthed and unconsciously straightened her chest.

If Zhao Xuanyou looked at her now, he would see the suddenly revealed spring scenery.

Unfortunately, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t even glance at her, and steadily placed a black chess piece down.

Zhuang Huaiyue felt a little disheartened and lowered her eyes, but she wasn’t willing to give up just yet.

"His Lordship." She softly called.

Zhao Xuanyou still didn’t look at her, only hummed in response.

Although it was just a perfunctory response, Zhuang Huaiyue’s heart was pounding.

The moonlight was so beautiful, and she wanted to express her feelings to Zhao Xuanyou.

"I first came to the Marquis of Jingyuan’s mansion when I was twelve years old. My parents took me to celebrate the Old Dowager’s birthday."

Zhao Xuanyou picked up a white chess piece, pondering left and right, and placed it next to the black piece he had just played.

Zhuang Huaiyue’s heart surged, and she continued to immerse herself in her memories.

"The Old Dowager was kind and gentle. She asked me how old I was. After I told her, she said it was a pity I was a little too young, otherwise such a beautiful little girl would definitely be a good match for her grandson."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyebrows twitched slightly, but he still didn’t speak.

"At that time, I was indeed young and didn’t understand what marriage meant. Later, when I saw His Lordship, I regretted that my mother hadn’t arranged a marriage alliance with the Old Dowager that day..."

Back then, her father was still a second-rank official. Although the family background was slightly inferior to that of the Marquis’s mansion, it wasn’t considered an overreach.

Zhao Xuanyou had no interest in her past at all, "If there’s nothing else, you may withdraw."

Hearing the coldness in his voice, Zhuang Huaiyue bit her lip, and her eyes turned slightly red.

"I just want to say... I truly want to serve His Lordship. His Lordship probably doesn’t know, but when Sister Cui persuaded me to come and serve him, I was so happy in my heart. I felt that the heavens finally favored me for once."

Zhao Xuanyou’s always calm expression finally showed a slight change at this moment.

"How did she persuade you?"

Zhuang Huaiyue was slightly taken aback, not expecting Zhao Xuanyou to pursue this matter.

Zhao Xuanyou’s voice naturally carried a deterrent force, and he was also the man she admired. When he asked, Zhuang Huaiyue naturally told the truth.

"Madam said that she was in poor health and couldn’t serve His Lordship. There aren’t many decent women in this mansion. Feng Kang is a brainless dancer, and Yu Ying is a flirtatious maid. She said..."

"Finish."

"Madam said that I come from a good family, have a good appearance, and am knowledgeable and courteous. It would be most suitable for me to stay by His Lordship’s side. If I could bear children for His Lordship in the future, she would be willing to raise them as her own."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a cold laugh.

As expected of his good wife. From the day they got married, she wouldn’t let him touch her, but she kept sending one woman after another to his bed, playing him like a puppet.

Zhuang Huaiyue looked at Zhao Xuanyou’s curved lips and cautiously asked, "What does His Lordship think?"

"His Lordship?" Not getting a response from Zhao Xuanyou, Zhuang Huaiyue tentatively called out again.

No one had taught her how to seduce a man. At this point, she really didn’t want to give up.

She had already expressed her feelings to Zhao Xuanyou. Since he kept her by his side, he must be willing to accept her.

What she was doing now was just to make this happen a little sooner.

Zhuang Huaiyue’s ears turned red, but her eyes became even more alluring. She stopped rubbing his legs and lightly placed her hand on Zhao Xuanyou’s leg, her slender fingers caressing the expensive fabric.

After all, she was from a noble family. Having come this far, Zhuang Huaiyue didn’t dare to look up at Zhao Xuanyou anymore.

He should be looking at her now, right?

She didn’t know what kind of expression he had.

Since Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t made a sound, Zhuang Huaiyue vaguely felt that he must like her this way.

Everyone praised her for her beautiful appearance, saying she had the beauty to make fish sink and geese fall. He couldn’t possibly not notice.

It didn’t matter if she couldn’t marry Zhao Xuanyou. As long as she could be his woman, as long as she could bear children for him.

"His Lordship..." Zhuang Huaiyue’s heart surged, and she pressed her body against Zhao Xuanyou, rubbing her softness against him. She whispered, "Please, show me your favor..."

Before she could finish her sentence, a strong force suddenly struck her shoulder, painful as if a sharp sword had pierced her bone.

Zhuang Huaiyue was very light, and her whole body flew backward with this force.

"Ah…" She fell to the ground and cried out in pain.

This was accompanied by a crisp "click"; it was a black chess piece.

Zhuang Huaiyue’s shoulder hurt as if it were about to split open, and tears quickly filled her eyes.

She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, only to see his cold and stern expression. His gaze was deep and unfathomable, like a sharp sword, or the fierce fangs of a wild beast, instantly tearing her to pieces.

"I... I truly admire His Lordship." Zhuang Huaiyue’s tears couldn’t stop falling, not knowing if it was because of the pain in her shoulder or the pain in her heart.

"Master!" The scream was too loud, and Yuan Qing, Yuan Yi, and Yingxue had just reached the courtyard. Hearing the sound, they all rushed in together.

The scene before them was truly shocking.

Zhao Xuanyou sat on the soft couch with a dark expression, as if he wanted to eat someone alive.

Yuan Yi and Yuan Qing had seen Zhao Xuanyou like this before... This was the expression he wore when wielding a sword and slaughtering on the battlefield.

Then they looked at Zhuang Huaiyue, who was lying diagonally on the ground. Her shoulder was half-exposed, her collar was wide open, and most of her alluring scenery was revealed.

chapters.title: A Maiden's Spring Feelings
chapters.content:
Seeing this scene, the three of them understood immediately; Huaiyue was seducing the Prince.

However, Huaiyue was a concubine, and though not officially recognized, she had been acknowledged in the mansion. This situation could be considered a "boudoir amusement."

Just as they were about to shrink their necks and retreat, they heard Zhao Xuanyou coldly say, "Take her away."

"Yes." Sensing the anger in his tone, Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhan immediately complied.

But neither of them dared to approach Huaiyue in her current state.

So much exposed skin... one should not look at what is improper.

It was Yingxue who came to her senses first. She walked forward with her head lowered and rearranged the clothing that Huaiyue had torn open.

Huaiyue allowed Yingxue to adjust her clothes, completely indifferent to her own embarrassment. She only stared at Zhao Xuanyou through her tears.

Under Zhao Xuanyou’s icy gaze, she felt as if thousands of needles were piercing her body.

"Prince, what I said just now..."

Zhao Xuanyou glared fiercely at Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhan. The two didn’t dare delay and quickly stepped forward, lifting the still sobbing Huaiyue from either side and dragging her out to the corridor.

Yingxue was about to bow and leave when she noticed a black chess piece on the floor.

Thinking that Zhao Xuanyou was pondering the chess game, she bent down to pick it up, wiped off the dust with her sleeve, and respectfully placed it back beside the chessboard.

"Make a fresh pot of tea."

The tea on the table had been brought in by Huaiyue earlier, and just looking at it made him sick.

Yingxue quickly cleared away the teapot and cups. After taking a few steps, she heard Zhao Xuanyou say, "From now on, that woman is not allowed in here."

"Yes."

Yingxue respectfully agreed, then quickly brought in a fresh pot of tea for Zhao Xuanyou, along with two plates of tea snacks.

Seeing that his expression was as calm and indifferent as usual, clearly unaffected by what had just happened, Yingxue silently withdrew.

In the corridor, Huaiyue was weeping. Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhan looked at her, unsure of how to comfort her.

"Why... why won't the Prince even look at me... How can he be so heartless..."

Huaiyue cried extremely sorrowfully.

Every word she had said to Zhao Xuanyou earlier had come from the heart. She had never expected that Zhao Xuanyou would remain completely unmoved.

She truly couldn't believe it, feeling both lost and desperate.

"I even went that far, yet the Prince still doesn't care?"

Why... why...

With her beauty and the friendship between their families, this shouldn't be happening.

"Huaiyue, calm down a bit." Seeing her cry uncontrollably, Yuan Qing dryly advised.

He was naturally simple and kind-hearted. Seeing her cry so painfully, he couldn't help but feel some sympathy.

By the rules, he and Yuan Zhan should have thrown Huaiyue out of Honghui Hall immediately. But with her clothes disheveled and hair in disarray, if they really threw her out of the courtyard in such a state, she would never be able to hold her head up in the Marquis's mansion again.

"You should go back to your room and rest for a while. We can talk about this tomorrow." Yuan Zhan also advised.

Having followed Zhao Xuanyou for many years, they both understood his temper well.

Just expelling Huaiyue from the study was probably already out of consideration for her father's sake.

If Huaiyue continued to cry, and annoyed him further, the consequences would be far more severe.

Just as they were unsure how to persuade her, they saw Yingxue walking out. Yuan Qing quickly said, "Yingxue, you take Huaiyue back."

Recalling the efforts Huaiyue had made to seduce the Prince, Yingxue felt a touch of disgust at her current state and didn’t want to help.

"The Prince said that from now on, you are not allowed to enter the room to serve."

Huaiyue, who was wiping her tears, suddenly looked up upon hearing this.

"Don't upset her anymore, quickly take her away." Yuan Qing said.

"How am I upsetting her?" Yingxue didn't think she was in the wrong. She pouted and said, "It was her actions that angered the Prince. She was the one who made the Prince banish her. What does it have to do with me?"

"Still, you didn't have to say it like that."

"Am I not supposed to repeat the Prince's words? Can't she handle it? Sister Huaiyue, wake up. Right now, the Prince is just angry, but you can still stay in Honghui Hall to work. If you remain stubborn and continue to cry, make a scene, or even threaten to hang yourself, the Prince might get so angry that he banishes you from the Marquis's mansion with a single word! By then, you won't even have a place to cry."

Banished from the Marquis's mansion?

Recalling the time she was detained by the Ministry of Rites, when the officials had withheld her food and clothing and made unwanted advances, Huaiyue couldn't help but shiver.

Yuan Qing scratched his head. Yingxue's words were harsh, but they made sense.

The Prince wasn't as soft-hearted as him. If she truly angered him, it would be a dead end.

"Huaiyue, you..."

"I understand, I'll go back to my room now."

Huaiyue finally came to her senses after hearing Yingxue's cold words.

She couldn't leave the Marquis's mansion. She absolutely couldn't be banished.

She endured the sharp pain in her shoulder and tried to stand up. Seeing her struggle, Yingxue finally softened and gave her a hand.

"Can you still walk?"

"My feet are fine, it's just my shoulder..."

Yuan Qing had seen the chess piece on the floor earlier and naturally knew it was the Prince's doing. He said, "You should quickly go back and get some medicine for external injuries. Otherwise, your shoulder will be ruined."

Zhao Xuanyou's martial arts were unparalleled. Even though it was just a small chess piece he had thrown, it was enough to severely injure a delicate woman like Huaiyue.

"Thank you both." A hint of gratitude appeared in Huaiyue's panicked and confused eyes.

The night wind was chilly, and the moonlight was faint.

Huaiyue finally calmed down.

Years of admiration, a maiden's spring feelings, were shattered in one night.

She finally realized that even though she had admired Zhao Xuanyou for many years, even though she had once tossed and turned for him, in Zhao Xuanyou's heart, she was nothing.

Everything deep and affectionate was just her one-sided wishful thinking.

She dragged her painful shoulder and slowly walked out of Honghui Hall.

Watching her departing figure, Yuan Qing sighed and turned to Yingxue, asking, "The Prince didn't say to banish her from Honghui Hall, right?"

"No, the Prince just doesn't want her to serve inside anymore."

"Huaiyue was too reckless," Yuan Zhan said, somewhat puzzled. "The Prince's wife has already elevated her to a concubine. Why is she in such a hurry?"

"She seems to really like the Prince." Yingxue murmured.

Ever since arriving at Honghui Hall, Yingxue had noticed that Huaiyue was overly attentive to the Prince.

Wherever the Prince went, she followed. Even when the Prince entered the study, she would wait outside, ready to serve at any moment.

Previously, Yingxue had thought she was scheming to seduce the Prince, but after seeing Huaiyue collapse so pitifully on the floor yet still gazing at the Prince with infatuation, Yingxue realized she wasn't pretending; she genuinely liked him.

Yuan Qing laughed upon hearing this, "Our Prince is a dragon among men. There are plenty of women who like him."

Yingxue turned her head and asked, "Yuan Zhan, you've followed the Prince for so many years. Did he and Huaiyue really have no past connection?"

Huaiyue's infatuation and reckless actions suggested deep feelings, which could explain her loss of composure.

Something must have happened between them when they were children, right?

"Shh!" Yuan Zhan quickly silenced her, "How would I know about that? Also, stop asking about the Prince's affairs, or else..."

Yingxue stuck out her tongue to indicate she understood.

She silently sighed for Huaiyue but then perked up.

With Huaiyue now banished from the main house, wouldn't Yu Wan be able to serve inside?

---

chapters.title: Sending Secret Signals
chapters.content:
Yu Wan did not sleep well that night.

There were intermittent sobs outside, mournful like a cat’s wails, which kept her awake.

Finally, after enduring until dawn, she washed her face with cold water and felt a bit more alert.

The bamboo branches she had picked the day before had soaked in the water basin all night. The leaves looked fresh and vibrant. Yu Wan took out the bamboo branches and carefully dried them before heading to Honghui Hall.

The Marquis's mansion had overlapping verandas and winding corridors. Yu Wan wore a thin, water-green summer shirt with an apricot-colored ruqun skirt.

These were the clothes she had received from the storeroom the day before. The fabric was much lighter and more breathable than before, and the skirt swayed as she moved.

As Yu Wan made her way swaying into Honghui Hall, she saw Zhao Xuanyou coming out of the house.

Today was different from usual.

Zhao Xuanyou was wearing a precious fourth-rank official robe. The embroidered clouds and wild geese on the robe were intricate and exquisite. His tall and straight figure stood on the steps like a towering pine.

His expression was as cold and stern as ever, like a mountain peak shrouded in mist; unapproachable and unfathomable.

"Prince." Yu Wan stopped and, holding the bamboo branches, curtsied to him.

He was tall and long-legged, and in a few strides, he was in front of Yu Wan. He glanced at the lush green bamboo branches in her hands and nodded, saying, "You chose well."

He praised the bamboo branches, but his gaze was on Yu Wan, whose smile was gentle and charming.

Yu Wan was dressed neatly and elegantly, her eyes sparkling with a lively glow.

Her clear, bright eyes met Zhao Xuanyou’s without hesitation, exuding a captivating charm.

Zhao Xuanyou slightly lifted his chin, his gaze dark and inscrutable. The faint scent from her body reached his nose.

Upon closer reflection, the two of them were already the most familiar people in the world to each other. Meeting in broad daylight, they couldn't help but recall those nights that made their faces hot and hearts race.

"If the Prince likes them, this servant will pick more."

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm" and strode away quickly, leading Yuan Zhan out of Honghui Hall.

Watching his departing figure, Yu Wan wondered if he would start his official duties at the Secretariat from today.

If he wasn't home, she feared that Cui Yi would start causing trouble again.

Yu Wan raised her eyebrows slightly, a light smile playing on her lips. She took small, delicate steps toward the corridor.

As she glanced into the room, Yuan Qing approached and familiarly called out, "Sister Yu Wan."

Yu Wan held up the bamboo branches, "The Prince just said these are very good. You quickly find a more elegant vase to put them in."

Seeing that Yu Wan was standing at the threshold without entering, Yuan Qing smiled and said, "You go find it yourself. Why are you ordering me around?"

"How is this ordering you around?" Yu Wan said helplessly. "I'm not one of the servants inside. Hurry up and take them. I still have to go to the courtyard to work."

"If not you, then who is?"

At Yuan Qing’s counterquestion, Yu Wan was taken aback and was about to ask further when Yingxue, hearing the voices, came out of the house.

"Congratulations, Sister. From now on, we can work together."

With that, she took Yu Wan’s hand and pulled her over the threshold.

"Really? Are you not joking?" Yu Wan was pulled into the main house and looked at them doubtfully. "Is this the Prince's intention?"

"Of course. In Honghui Hall, apart from the Prince, no one else's word counts."

Seeing that Yingxue spoke with such certainty, Yu Wan finally believed it. But she still had doubts. "Won't there be too many people serving inside the room then?"

Yingxue recalled what happened last night. In front of Yuan Qing, she couldn't speak directly to Yu Wan, so she vaguely said, "Last night, Huaiyue made a mistake. The Prince punished her by banning her from entering the room to serve. Sister will be the one serving inside."

Huaiyue made a mistake?

Those mournful sobs last night must have been from Huaiyue. She lived next door to Yu Wan, so only her cries could be heard.

"Sister Yu Wan, let's go pick a vase." Yingxue pulled Yu Wan toward the side room where there was a display shelf with many exquisite vases.

As the two of them huddled together, Yuan Qing went off to do his own tasks.

After Yuan Qing left the room, Yingxue whispered, "Sister, you don't know this, but last night, Huaiyue took advantage of Honghui Hall being empty and indeed tried to seduce the Prince. The Prince was furious and immediately said she was not allowed in the room anymore."

"Are you sure he was angry because of the seduction?"

Yingxue nodded firmly, "Sister, trust me, it must be."

How could it not be seduction when Huaiyue had undressed like that?

However, thinking that Huaiyue genuinely liked the Prince, Yingxue couldn't bring herself to hate her.

Seeing Yu Wan lost in thought, Yingxue asked, "Is something wrong?"

Yu Wan shook her head. "No, it's just that she acted so hastily... isn't it a bit too rushed?"

Although Yu Wan didn't want Huaiyue to gain Zhao Xuanyou's affection, with Huaiyue's beauty and talent, given time, Zhao Xuanyou might develop feelings for her.

Why did she try to seduce Zhao Xuanyou on the second day at Honghui Hall?

She seemed well-read, so how could she be so foolish?

Yingxue seemed to guess Yu Wan's thoughts and whispered, "Huaiyue cried very sadly. She said she truly admires the Prince."

True admiration? Unable to control her emotions? That made sense.

No matter what, Huaiyue's actions not only harmed herself but also greatly helped Yu Wan.

She pointed to a plain white porcelain vase on the display shelf and ordered Yingxue, "Use that vase."

---

chapters.title: She is Playing with Him
chapters.content:
"You said what?" Cui Yi suddenly stood up, staring at the little maid in shock. "Who died?"

"Sister Baozhu."

Baopeng was momentarily flustered. "Don't talk nonsense. Baozhu may be delicate, but she only received ten board strikes. How could she die from that?"

That day, after Baozhu was beaten, Cui Yi had ordered her to be taken to a secluded part of the mansion to recover and had assigned someone to take care of her, but she hadn't called for a doctor.

In the Marquis's mansion, the punishment of board strikes was standardized.

Five strikes were considered a light punishment, and one would recover in a couple of days.

Ten strikes were a bit heavier, and it would take at least ten days to half a month to recover.

Twenty strikes would require months of bed rest.

If one received thirty strikes, they would be left with a permanent injury and might never recover.

"How could she die from just ten strikes?" Baozhu and Baopeng had entered the Duke's mansion around the same time and had always worked by Cui Yi's side. Although they occasionally quarreled, their relationship was generally good, and they supported each other in times of need.

When Zhou Mama died, Baopeng hadn't felt much, as Zhou Mama had been the National Duke's wife's person.

But now that Baozhu was dead... Baopeng suddenly felt a sense of shared sorrow, like a rabbit mourning a fox.

The little maid cried and said, "When Sister Baozhu was carried out that day, she was already in bad shape. This servant told Sister Baopeng to call for a doctor, but Sister Baopeng said it wasn't necessary!"

Baopeng, who was already upset, heard the little maid blaming her and immediately slapped her across the face. "What nonsense are you talking about? How was I supposed to know she couldn't even handle ten strikes? Those people hit her too hard!"

"Enough! Get out, all of you!" Cui Yi suddenly roared in a fit of rage.

She had always prided herself on being the legitimate daughter of the Duke's mansion and the mistress of the Marquis's mansion, keeping her emotions in check. Even Baopeng, who had served her for many years, had only seen her lose her composure twice.

The first time was when she was scolded by the Empress in the palace.

chapters.title: was when she learned from the imperial physician that she would never be able to conceive... and now this...
chapters.content:
A chill ran down Baochuan’s spine. She tugged at the little maid and retreated, closing the door behind her.

Loud crashes echoed from inside the room as objects were smashed. Baochuan chased all the servants out of the courtyard and stood guard at the gate herself.

Cui Yichu’s face was dark as he smashed every golden tripod and jade artifact within sight, turning the room upside down. Then, exhausted, he collapsed into a chair.

Just now, the maids had been chattering, and she suddenly realized she had made a fatal mistake.

When she married into the Marquis’s mansion, her parents, worried she would be powerless there, had selected twenty capable personal maids from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion to accompany her.

Cui Yichu trusted these people, and upon arriving at the Marquis’s mansion, he assigned them to various managerial positions in the inner quarters.

As the mistress of the household, no one dared question her arrangements.

But by assigning her own people, she naturally replaced the old servants of the Marquis’s mansion.

The Marquis’s mansion had many hereditary servants, and their families were all interconnected. Though they dared not speak out, they secretly resented her and the people from the Duke’s mansion.

When Zhao Xuanyou found an excuse to attack her personal maids, these long-suppressed hereditary servants could no longer hold back.

If they hadn’t already hated Mama Zhou, how could they have gathered evidence and witnesses so quickly to build an ironclad case in just a few days?

If they hadn’t already hated Baozhu, how could ten strikes of the board have killed her?

The executioner was under the command of Manager Song from the front courtyard; whether each strike was light or heavy was entirely up to them.

But what truly enraged Cui Yichu was not the deaths of Mama Zhou and Baozhu.

What he hated was that Yu Wan had seen through what he had failed to realize.

That day, when she arranged for the maids to enter Honghui Hall, Yu Wan had warned her not to exclude all the hereditary servants.

How infuriating! How infuriating!

That lowly wench Yu Wan; not only did she look like her, but she had also won Zhao Xuanyou’s favor. And now, was she even smarter than her?

“Ah…”

Cui Yichu let out a shattered scream, exerting all his strength to knock over the incense burner in the room.

---

Today was Zhao Xuanyou’s first day at the Secretariat as an official.

He was a fourth-rank military advisor, which was not a significant position in the high-ranking Secretariat. But as the heir of the Jingyuan Marquis, with a hereditary second-rank title in his family, no one dared to take him lightly.

During the morning court session, the emperor had specially called him forward to offer a few words of encouragement.

Upon returning to the Secretariat, he had intended to focus on his duties, but many colleagues came to greet and congratulate him, inviting him to feasts.

Since it was his first day, Zhao Xuanyou did not refuse. He accepted the invitations and only left the restaurant late at night.

The Marquis’s carriage had been waiting for him in the alley.

Zhao Xuanyou lifted the curtain and boarded, suddenly sensing someone hiding inside.

With lightning speed, he struck, lifting the person up by the throat.

“It’s me! Brother, it’s me! Ye Moqian!” Ye Moqian choked out, clutching at his neck.

“What are you doing hiding here?” Zhao Xuanyou impatiently released his grip and sat on the other side of the carriage, ordering the coachman to return to the mansion.

What else could he be doing? Hiding here to give Zhao Xuanyou a surprise...

Unfortunately, there was no surprise; only a great fright.

Ye Moqian, having narrowly escaped death, was still trembling as he rubbed his throat.

Once his emotions settled, Ye Moqian slowly said, “Elder brother has just started his new position. I came to congratulate you, didn’t I?”

“Is this how you congratulate someone?”

“I really do have something to tell you,” Ye Moqian said, seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s indifference. “Last time, didn’t you ask about your wife’s past? Today, I encountered something that might be related, so I wanted to tell you right away. If you don’t want to hear it, I’ll leave.”

Related to Cui Yichu?

To be honest, after the poisoning incident involving Yu Wan, Zhao Xuanyou had been deeply disappointed in Cui Yichu. Combined with what Zhuang Huaiyue had said yesterday, that Cui Yichu had instigated her to seduce him, his last bit of fondness for her had vanished.

But Cui Yichu had too many secrets.

The empress and princesses in the palace spoke of her as if she were taboo. She had deceived everyone in the Marquis’s mansion, pulling so many tricks, and absolutely refused to consummate the marriage with him.

Zhao Xuanyou could not tolerate such deception. He wanted to know the reason.

“Speak.”

Facing Zhao Xuanyou’s deep, abyss-like gaze, Ye Moqian dared not tease any longer.

“Today, I ran into the third young master of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, your wife’s third elder brother, at a tavern. He was drinking and chatting with someone, and in the conversation, he actually mentioned your assignment to stay in the capital.”

“Hmm?”

“I normally wouldn’t eavesdrop, but when he mentioned your name, I couldn’t help but listen.”

“Get to the point.”

“That young Master Cui was actually asking who arranged for you to stay in the capital. I found it strange, if you stay in the capital, his sister won’t have to be alone, so why would he be unhappy...”

Ye Moqian’s rambling words silently opened a door in Zhao Xuanyou’s mind, making him realize something important that he had overlooked.

The Cui family did not want him to stay in the capital.

To hide Cui Yichu’s secret, they had Yu Wan act as a substitute to serve him, so of course, it would be best if he did not stay in the capital for long.

Then, the one who had begged him to stay in the capital was; Yu Wan.

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze darkened.

And it was Yu Wan who had kept Fen Tang, removed Mama Zhou, and arranged for him to stay in the capital.

He, Zhao Xuanyou; heir of the Jingyuan Marquis, commander of the Minglian Guards, and advisor to the Secretariat. Had been manipulated by a mere woman?

---

chapters.title: Night Intrusion
chapters.content:
Yu Wan had been so busy today that she barely had time to catch her breath.

In the past, when she worked in the flower room, she had done all the heavy labor, always assuming that serving the masters as a senior maid would be leisurely. Now that she was the senior maid of Honghui Hall, she realized how endlessly tedious the household chores were.

Bedsheets, quilts, nightclothes, and hairpins; everything had to be neatly folded and arranged.

Tea sets, bedding, polishing, and organizing; there were countless tasks, far more exhausting than tending to flowers in the courtyard.

After lunch, Yu Wan felt a dull ache in her lower abdomen; her monthly cycle had arrived.

Though physically uncomfortable, she felt more at ease mentally.

At this moment, she absolutely could not become pregnant. Cui Yichu already saw her as a great threat and had already tried to kill her once.

If she became pregnant, Cui Yichu would stop at nothing to harm her.

Of course, that was only one reason.

There were so many women in the Marquis’s mansion, whether it was Fen Tang or Huaiyue, they all harbored deep feelings for Zhao Xuanyou.

She had to stay by Zhao Xuanyou’s side and firmly grasp his favor.

Yu Wan endured the waves of fatigue and continued her tasks. As dusk fell, Yingxue hurried over.

Seeing her solemn expression, Yu Wan asked, “What happened?”

“Baozhu is dead,” Yingxue said in a low voice.

Dead?

Yu Wan froze for a moment, her expression subtly shifting before she calmly asked, “How did she die?”

“After she was struck with the board that day, she was carried away to recover. At the time, I heard people say her injuries were severe, and I even told you about it, Sister.”

Yu Wan remembered this.

At the time, she had been dissatisfied with Zhao Xuanyou’s leniency in the poisoning incident. Yingxue had said Baozhu was seriously injured, and Yu Wan had assumed Yingxue was just comforting her.

She hadn’t expected that those ten strikes would actually take Baozhu’s life.

“Ten strikes killed her? Was she that frail?”

Hearing Yu Wan’s doubt, Yingxue looked around. Seeing Yuan Qing busy with something else in the distance, she lowered her voice. “Baozhu was the mistress’s senior maid. In the past, she had flaunted her power in the mansion, and many people had long been displeased with her.”

“So someone took the opportunity to exact revenge?”

Yingxue nodded, then lowered her voice further to tell Yu Wan something else.

One of the people who had struck Baozhu often drank with Yingxue’s father. The other day, in his drunken state, he had said that Baozhu had taken his wife’s lucrative position, and now he had finally gotten his revenge.

Cui Yichu was a wicked person, and the personal maids she had brought to the Marquis’s mansion had been tyrannical for a long time, earning the hatred of the mansion’s hereditary servants.

That made sense.

With Zhao Xuanyou’s status, if he had wanted Baozhu dead, he wouldn’t have needed to go through such trouble.

Yingxue said indignantly, “Baozhu ordered Yu Xi to poison you, Sister. Now that both of them are dead, it’s karma.”

“Yes.”

Though Yu Wan said this, she didn’t feel it was true justice.

In her past life, she had been smothered to death by those three wicked maids after giving birth. Baozhu’s death was far too lenient for her.

However, Baozhu, Baochuan, and Mama Zhou were just Cui Yichu’s accomplices. When the time came for Cui Yichu, the true culprit, to die, Yu Wan would ensure she did not die easily.

“Sister, are you still unhappy?” Yingxue asked, somewhat puzzled.

“No, it’s just that when you mentioned your parents, I thought of my mother.”

This was the first time Yingxue had heard her mention her mother. She asked with concern, “Does Sister have family outside the mansion? I thought... Sister was sold into the mansion because her family had met with disaster.”

“Yes, we did meet with disaster. My mother is very ill. Ordinary physicians can’t treat her; we need to invite a famous doctor.”

“That serious?”

“Yingxue, I have an impertinent request. Can you help me?”

“Sister, just say it.”

“Three years ago, my mother fell off a cliff and has been in a coma ever since. I need you to go home and help me find a skilled acupuncturist in the capital.”

“Acupuncture? I’ll remember that. When I go home, I’ll ask around. My father often moves about the capital and has many friends. We’ll definitely find someone.”

Hearing this, Yu Wan looked at Yingxue with gratitude.

Cui Yichu was ruthless, and Yu Wan was constantly struggling to survive. She had no chance to go out and seek medical help.

If Yingxue could find a skilled acupuncturist, Chen Da Niu could take her mother directly to see the doctor.

Time was running out; her mother’s illness could not be delayed any longer.

“Thank you.”

“Don’t mention it. Sister has helped me so much; I’ve been wanting to repay you.”

“What are you talking about so lively?” Yuan Qing finished his tasks and came over to chat, his face full of mystery. “Do you know the big news in the mansion?”

“What big news?” Yingxue guessed what he was going to say and replied nonchalantly, “Isn’t it just that the wicked Baozhu is dead?”

“Oh, so you already know. But the one who harmed Yu Wan was Yu Xi. Baozhu was just careless. Why call her wicked?”

Yingxue gave him a helpless look, then exchanged a glance with Yu Wan and teased, “Careless? I didn’t know you were so naive. How did you manage to stay by the young master’s side?”

Yu Wan pondered these words.

Perhaps it was because Yuan Qing was simple-minded that Zhao Xuanyou kept him by his side.

“If the young master says so, then it must be true,” Yuan Qing said righteously. “Oh, by the way, you two should finish your work and go rest early. The young master is dining out tonight and won’t be eating at the mansion.”

Normally, Yu Wan and Yingxue would have to prepare the meal, but since he wasn’t eating at the mansion, it saved them the trouble.

Yu Wan had her period and felt extremely tired. Since she didn’t have to work, she returned to Xiaoyue Pavilion.

She was usually healthy, and her periods were not painful; just made her sleepier and more sensitive to the cold.

After eating a little, she took a cotton quilt from the cabinet and covered herself before going to sleep.

Curled up under the blanket, she gradually warmed up. Drowsiness overwhelmed her, and she quickly fell asleep.

Yu Wan slept very deeply.

In her dream, she returned to the estate where she had been confined during her pregnancy in her past life.

The estate was property of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, with fertile fields and a small stream; it was a beautiful place.

But the old woman assigned to care for her never allowed her to leave the house. She was locked inside all day, and aside from that woman, she could only exchange a few words with the occasional visiting physician.

After ten dark, endless months of pregnancy, Yu Wan gave birth to a son.

She had thought her suffering was over, but to her surprise, Mama Zhou and others arrived... Wait, why was Cui Yichu there too?

Before Yu Wan could react, Cui Yichu stretched out her claw-like hand and viciously gripped her throat... Help...

In extreme terror, Yu Wan suddenly awoke.

She thought waking from the nightmare would be the end, but the next moment, she was stunned.

A tall figure stood in the darkness. She recognized the outline of those shoulders all too well.

She could hardly believe it.

How could he be in Xiaoyue Pavilion?

She rubbed her eyes, and when she looked again, he took a step forward.

By the faint moonlight filtering through the window, Yu Wan finally saw his face.

Zhao Xuanyou stood in the darkness, yet his features seemed clear and serene, his skin as fair as jade.

His usual demeanor was cold and hard, but the dim surroundings softened these sharp edges, highlighting his strikingly handsome features instead.

His long eyebrows, clear eyes, high nose bridge, and thin lips…

Apart from his status and power, his appearance alone was enough to captivate most women. It was no wonder that even when Zhuang Huaiyue was still a noble lady, she had secretly admired him for many years.

But he shouldn’t be here.

chapters.title: Soiling the Clothes
chapters.content:
Yu Yuan suspected she was still in a dream, so she gently pinched her finger and felt a sharp pain.

So it was real?

Zhao Xuanyou had really appeared at her bedside?

"Shizi?" Sensing Zhao Xuanyou's gloomy gaze, Yu Yuan tentatively called out, sitting up from the bed and pulling the quilt up to her shoulders, still wrapping herself tightly.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with a cold "mm," glancing at her with a blank expression.

What had happened?

Clearly, when they met at Honghui Hall that morning, there had been a hint of ambiguous affection in his eyes. How had it turned into this?

Yu Yuan's unease grew. Her nightgown hung loosely on her, and she hadn't fastened the side ties before sleeping. If she lifted the quilt to get up, it would be indecent.

Zhao Xuanyou clearly wasn't here for pleasure.

If he thought she was trying to seduce him, the consequences might be worse than what had happened to Zhuang Huaiyue yesterday when she had rashly teased him.

Zhuang Huaiyue was the daughter of an old friend; he had saved her face. Yu Yuan had nothing.

"Shizi, why have you come so late at night? What are your orders?" Seeing that he wasn't speaking, Yu Yuan had to harden her resolve and speak.

Zhao Xuanyou sat directly at the edge of her bed, turning to look at her.

"Earlier, you said that from the night I returned to the residence, you were the one who stayed with me all night, correct?"

His tone was chilling, making Yu Yuan's heart race.

Had he come to settle scores?

What scores? When she had told him this before, hadn't he said nothing?

"Yes, from the time the lights were extinguished until Baozhu came to call in the morning, it was this servant who was with Shizi."

"Then," Zhao Xuanyou said with a cold look, his voice low, "the person who stayed up talking with me every night was you?"

Stay calm, she had to stay calm.

She had managed to stay at Honghui Hall; she couldn't be driven out for saying the wrong thing.

"Yes... this servant..." Since her rebirth, Yu Yuan had faced everything with composure, but now she stammered.

She suddenly remembered the words she had said to Yingxue and Yuan Qing that afternoon.

That's right, Zhao Xuanyou disliked cunning people. Yuan Qing was simple-minded, so even though he didn't understand social niceties, Zhao Xuanyou was still willing to keep him as his personal attendant.

Since Zhao Xuanyou had already suspected her, if she denied everything, it would only make him angrier.

Yu Yuan took a deep breath, and her wildly beating heart calmed slightly.

"The person who talked to Shizi at night has always been this servant."

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes, reaching out to pinch Yu Yuan's chin, slowly saying, "Was it your idea to keep Feng Tang?"

"Yes."

"Was it your idea to deal with Zhou Mama?"

"Yes."

"And to make me stay in the capital?"

"That too."

"How dare you!"

As soon as he finished speaking, Zhao Xuanyou's fingers suddenly tightened, and Yu Yuan clearly felt a pain in her chin.

She didn't doubt that if he wanted to, he could crush her chin in an instant.

It hurt, so much,

Tears quickly filled Yu Yuan's eyes, and she struggled to call out, "Shizi."

He held her chin, staring at her face, his tone growing heavier: "You, a mere maid, have such audacity. How dare you toy with me."

"This servant is just a servant. I have no audacity, nor the ability to toy with Shizi."

"Hm?" Zhao Xuanyou sneered.

His fingertip pressed against the softest part of Yu Yuan's neck, making it difficult for her to speak.

"Last time you said you were manipulated by Cui Shi, but can you still say that now?"

Everything she had asked him to do wasn't what Cui Yichu wanted.

She had been using him all along!

Yu Yuan's breathing became more difficult, and tears streamed down her face. At this life-and-death moment, she gathered her strength and sobbed, "This servant did act presumptuously, but everything I did was just to survive! Does Shizi think that even seeking survival is a crime in your eyes?"

Survival?

Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched slightly, his gaze fixed on Yu Yuan.

She was very beautiful, especially her lovely almond-shaped eyes, which were usually full of tender affection and warmth.

Now, all the tenderness in her eyes had turned into indignation, pain, sorrow, and unwillingness.

She was resisting...

After a long silence, the killing intent in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes gradually faded.

He loosened his grip, watching Yu Yuan cover her neck and gasp for air, her face covered in tears.

"Did you know she wanted to kill you?"

Yu Yuan shook her head, realizing she had passed the most difficult hurdle. After surviving the disaster, her emotions calmed down.

She didn't wipe her tears, just looked up at Zhao Xuanyou.

"At that time, this servant didn't know if Madam had the intention to kill me. But Madam said she would only promote me to a concubine after I became pregnant. I just thought, if Shizi left the capital quickly, wouldn't that mean I couldn't become a concubine?"

She had indeed wanted to keep Zhao Xuanyou, and it wasn't a lie.

"What about Zhou Mama? What was that about?"

"Zhou Mama has always disliked me, constantly calling me a little slut and a little vixen. I was afraid that if she kept saying such things to Madam, Madam would change her mind, and the matter of making me a concubine would also fall through." Yu Yuan sniffed, lowering her eyelids. "Shizi was willing to talk to this servant, so I had the idea. I thought if I could get rid of Zhou Mama, it would be good. I never expected she would end up dead."

Whether it was Zhou Mama or Baozhu, the final outcome wasn't something Yu Yuan could control.

"How did you know I would drive her away?" Zhao Xuanyou suddenly lowered his voice. "Did you think I favored you?"

"This servant wouldn't dare." Yu Yuan buried her face lower, and because he leaned closer, she carefully shifted a bit to the side. "This servant was acting on Madam's behalf. Shizi favors Madam, not this servant."

Her answer was humble. Zhao Xuanyou's deep eyes showed no sign of whether he was pleased or angry.

After a moment, he coldly said, "If it wasn't because I thought I favored you, why didn't you get up to greet me when I entered this room?"

Yu Yuan tightly clutched the quilt in her hands. "This servant... this servant was very tired tonight and didn't fasten my nightgown before sleeping. I didn't dare to get up to greet Shizi."

Was that so?

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly reached out and yanked Yu Yuan's quilt away.

Indeed, the side tie of her nightgown was undone, and the entire garment hung loosely on her.

Yu Yuan instinctively tried to cover herself, but it only added a touch of alluring charm, like a beauty half-hidden behind a pipa.

Zhao Xuanyou's Adam's apple moved, and some memories surfaced in his mind.

He grabbed her arm and pulled her into his embrace.

Yu Yuan let out a soft exclamation. By the time she reacted, she was already sitting in Zhao Xuanyou's lap.

"Shizi."

Yu Yuan was caught off guard.

This night had been full of ups and downs, with too many events.

Just a moment ago, Zhao Xuanyou had been pinching her chin as if he wanted to strangle her, and now he had pulled her into his embrace.

This man... was truly unpredictable.

Yu Yuan was wondering how to respond when she suddenly felt a dull pain in her lower abdomen.

Oh no!

Yu Yuan realized something was wrong and tried to get up, but the man's strength was too great, holding her firmly in place.

"What are you moving for?"

Yu Yuan's face turned crimson. Even if she was extremely shy, at this point, she had to tell the truth.

"This servant started her monthly cycle today. Just now... I might have soiled Shizi's clothes."

---

chapters.title: Fear of Cold, Love of Warmth
chapters.content:
In the summer, clothes were thin, and Zhao Xuanyou was no exception.

As Yu Yuan spoke, he felt something wet on his leg.

His expression became complex.

Although he wasn't a fastidious young master from the capital, he had always valued cleanliness. Coming into contact with blood was indeed uncomfortable.

But the person in his arms was curled up slightly, warm and soft, and her breath easily fell on his neck, making it hard for him to let go.

Moreover, her nightgown was unfastened, and a glance downward revealed an enticing sight.

Yu Yuan was also extremely embarrassed.

Through the two thin layers of clothing, they could feel each other's body heat.

It was a time when she feared the cold and craved warmth. Nestled in such a warm embrace, it felt like holding a large stove in the depths of winter, and she didn't want to let go.

Feeling another stir in her lower abdomen, she finally came to her senses. She placed her hands on his shoulders and stood up, quickly fastening her side tie.

"Please forgive this servant, Shizi."

After staying in the dark room for a long time, her eyes had adapted to the darkness.

Zhao Xuanyou, sitting at the edge of the bed, clearly saw the bloodstains on Yu Yuan's nightgown.

"Are you alright?"

"Thank you for your concern, Shizi. This servant is fine. But your clothes..."

"It's fine." Zhao Xuanyou looked at her standing there weakly with her head lowered, and a ripple of emotion passed through his deep eyes. "In the future, be careful in what you do. Do not play tricks again, or I will not let you off lightly."

Was he letting her off this time?

"Yes." Yu Yuan's heart rejoiced, and she obediently replied, "This servant remembers. I will never dare to deceive Shizi again."

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm," glanced at her once more, then suddenly stood up and strode out.

After he had walked far away, Yu Yuan closed the door and let out a long sigh, feeling even more tired.

Zhao Xuanyou's thoughts were far more thorough than she had imagined. One wrong word tonight might have been her downfall.

But then again, his intelligence was a good thing for her.

Yu Yuan had indeed used him, but she hadn't harmed him. Cui Yichu, on the other hand, had firmly placed a green hat on his head. When the truth was revealed in the future, how furious would he be?

It was also at this moment that Yu Yuan realized she didn't need to personally investigate Cui Yichu's secrets. Once Zhao Xuanyou became suspicious, he would definitely investigate thoroughly, even if it meant digging up the ancestral graves of the Xingguo Duke's residence.

Although she had been frightened tonight, the plan for revenge had taken a big step forward invisibly.

Yu Yuan took a breath and laid many sheets of grass paper on the bed.

There weren't many bedsheets and quilts in her room to replace, so she could only pad it for now.

She poured herself a cup of hot water, and as her stomach warmed up, she lay down again.

---

When Zhao Xuanyou returned to Honghui Hall, it was already past the Zi hour (midnight).

Honghui Hall was lit with lamps inside and out. Seeing him return, Yuan Qing hurried out. Noticing the bloodstains on his clothes, he was startled.

"Master, were there assassins?"

Assassins?

That thing had indeed come suddenly.

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow but said nothing, changing his clothes and lying down.

The next morning, after breakfast, Zhao Xuanyou changed into his official robes and was about to go to the yamen for duty.

As he walked along the corridor, he saw Yingxue boiling water. A few steps further, Ziyan was teaching Huaiyue how to wipe leaves.

Just as he was about to leave Honghui Hall, he finally couldn't help but ask, "Where is Yu Yuan?"

Yuan Zhen, caught off guard by the question, paused for a moment before replying, "Yu Yuan isn't on duty this morning. She'll come later."

Previously, Zhao Xuanyou had ordered that he didn't need senior maids to attend to his dressing and daily routines. Therefore, the schedule for Yu Yuan and Yingxue at Honghui Hall was relaxed; they took turns coming in the mornings and didn't have to stay up at night.

Zhao Xuanyou neither agreed nor disagreed, striding out with powerful steps.

After he had walked far away, Huaiyue put down the cloth in her hand, her eyes revealing sorrow.

Ziyan advised, "Everything has its order. Shizi currently favors Yu Yuan, and he is at the height of his interest. Don't be too anxious."

Huaiyue shook her head, looking as if she was about to cry.

"Waiting won't help. Shizi has no interest in me at all." The ruthless look in his eyes that day in the room was something Huaiyue would never forget.

Indeed, she and Zhao Xuanyou were not meeting for the first time. If Zhao Xuanyou had truly been attracted to her beauty, he would have sent someone to propose marriage before the Zhuang family was confiscated.

Ziyan, like her, was from the family of an offending official and thus shared the same plight.

Hearing this, she could only advise, "In any case, compared to the other sisters we met at the Ministry of Rites, we are already much better off. The Hou residence is upright and honorable. If we do our duties well, preserve our chastity, and wait for a general amnesty, perhaps we can still marry and live a normal life."

What Ziyan said made sense.

But Huaiyue's heartbreak wasn't for wealth and honor.

She had admired Zhao Xuanyou for many years. Now that her sincere heart had been crushed, she was truly deeply hurt.

But Zhao Xuanyou was so heartless; what could she do?

Not long after, Yu Yuan also arrived at Honghui Hall. Huaiyue stopped her work and looked at her, but Yu Yuan kept her eyes forward and went straight into the house.

Before she saw Yingxue, she noticed Yuan Qing collecting Zhao Xuanyou's dirty clothes from the previous day, which were still stained with blood.

Yu Yuan turned her face away, and Yuan Qing, thinking she was scared, laughed, "It seems Master encountered a petty thief yesterday. He dealt with it in a few moves, but unfortunately soiled his clothes. This fabric is cloud brocade; I don't know if it can be washed clean."

"Soaking it in water for a while should help clean it."

"Who knows? Let the laundry people think of a way."

After Yuan Qing left with the clothes, Yu Yuan couldn't help but smile at the thought of the "petty thief."

Yingxue had just finished wiping the antique shelf and was coming out with a basin to change the water. Seeing Yu Yuan smiling to herself, she quickly asked, "What happy event happened? Sister is so happy."

"Just heard a joke from Yuan Qing."

"Oh, it's a joke. I also have good news to tell Sister. You'll probably laugh even more when you hear it."

Yu Yuan remembered the matter she had asked Yingxue to look into yesterday and quickly took the water basin from her hands.

"Did you find a doctor skilled in acupuncture?"

Yingxue nodded. "My father said there are several famous clinics in the capital, but when it comes to acupuncture, it has to be Physician Feng from Huichun Hall."

"Huichun Hall, Physician Feng. I'll remember that."

"However, Physician Feng's consultation fee is very high. I heard it's five taels per visit. Does Sister have enough money?"

Previously, she had received an advance on her monthly allowance as a concubine from Cui Yichu, along with some reward money. But she had spent some when she went out last time. Although she had just received this month's concubine allowance, adding it up wasn't enough for five taels. She would have to wait until next month's allowance to have enough.

Seeing Yu Yuan frown, Yingxue guessed that she was a bit short on funds.

Coming back to her senses, Yu Yuan quickly said, "I have enough. Don't worry about me."

Yingxue had already helped her a lot; she couldn't trouble her for everything.

"If that's the case, if Sister needs anything, be sure to tell me."

Yingxue's family had served the Jingyuan Hou residence for generations and had some financial means. But Yingxue had parents above her, as well as elder brothers, sisters-in-law, and younger brothers. The family's money didn't reach her. Most of the monthly allowance she had just received as a senior maid had been taken by her mother, who said she would save it for her dowry.

If Yu Yuan needed something, Yingxue would have to get it from her mother.

After discussing this matter, the two went back to their respective tasks. By the time they had a moment to rest, it was already evening.

Yu Yuan sat down on the corridor to take a brief rest. As she drank the hot water Yingxue handed her, she finally had a chance to catch her breath. Just then, she saw Zhao Xuanyou's tall and straight figure appear at the courtyard gate.

chapters.title: Changing Clothes
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou returned a little earlier today than yesterday.

As a new official taking office, he was currently in high favor with the Emperor. Many people sought to ingratiate themselves with him, and after finishing his official duties, he had social engagements until nightfall. However, today he had declined the evening banquet and insisted on returning to the Marquis's residence.

"Young Master." The servants in the courtyard and along the corridor all put down their tasks and bowed to him.

His gaze passed over the people in the courtyard and settled steadily on Yuhuan.

Today, she was dressed a little more brightly than usual, wearing a rose-red top with a moon-white long skirt. Though there were no embroidered flowers, it looked particularly charming on her.

Her hair was styled simply, with a single jade hairpin holding up a low bun.

This casual attire, paired with her beautiful face, was perfectly balanced, each enhancing the other.

When Yuhuan saw him, a smile immediately appeared in her eyes.

Seeing her joyful expression, Zhao Xuanyou withdrew his gaze and went straight into the house.

"Prepare dinner."

As soon as he spoke, Yuan Qing came forward from the side, "Master, the Old Madam sent someone this afternoon to say that you should have dinner at Leshou Hall tonight."

"At this hour, has Grandmother not eaten yet?"

Yuan Qing looked troubled, "I don't know about that. It sounds like there's something to discuss."

"Let me change clothes first."

As Zhao Xuanyou spoke, his gaze drifted toward Yuhuan.

Yuan Qing didn't notice anything at first, but after Yingxue tugged at his sleeve, he finally realized and followed Yingxue out.

He wanted her to attend to him while changing clothes?

Yuhuan's heart stirred slightly. She went to the inner room to fetch his casual clothes, and seeing that he had already stood up, she put down the clothes and began to untie the sash at his waist.

In her two lifetimes combined, she had never helped him change clothes before, and now she couldn't seem to undo the sash.

Yuhuan, flustered, made a mistake and swung her hand, hitting his waist.

"Master, this servant..."

"Clumsy."

Though it was a reprimand, his tone was not harsh.

"Please forgive this servant, Master." Yuhuan lowered her head, looking pitiful as she apologized.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't say anything more, pressing his lips together to suppress a smile.

He moved Yuhuan's hands aside and untied the sash himself, tossing it to the side.

"Forget it. You'll get better with practice."

Did he want her to attend to him in the future?

Recalling the ambiguous atmosphere between them last night, Yuhuan wasn't particularly surprised.

She didn't dare to be distracted. Quickly, she helped him remove his official robes, put on his casual clothes, and then tied the sash.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou was about to leave, Yuhuan stepped forward and said, "Earlier, when the people from Leshou Hall came to deliver the message, they said that both this servant and Huaiyue should go as well."

Grandmother wanted to see Yuhuan?

Zhao Xuanyou frowned.

Grandmother spent her days chanting scriptures and copying sutras. She had long since stopped involving herself in the affairs of the Marquis's residence. Why would she want to see Yuhuan?

Could it be that Cui Yichu had gone to Grandmother to complain?

"Let's go."

Yuhuan clearly saw Zhao Xuanyou's expression darken, but since she hadn't done anything to offend Old Madam Ye, she simply followed Zhao Xuanyou to Leshou Hall.

---

Old Madam Ye had been chanting Buddhist scriptures every day since she started her devotions, rising and retiring early like a nun.

Normally, at this hour, she would have already gone to bed. But today... she glanced at the several women sitting in Leshou Hall and couldn't help but sigh softly.

In the past, she had always hoped that the Marquis's residence would be lively with more people. But now, with so many women suddenly added, it had brought so much trouble. It would have been better to keep things quiet.

"Old Madam, the Young Master is here." A servant came forward to announce.

Old Madam Ye nodded slightly.

"Serve dinner."

By now, it was completely dark. The servants, carrying lanterns, led Zhao Xuanyou inside, and soon they entered Leshou Hall.

"Grandmother."

"Young Master." The others in Leshou Hall all bowed to him.

Yuhuan had chosen a deep cyan casual robe for Zhao Xuanyou. Though it was for leisure wear, the collar and placket were intricately embroidered, exuding a dignified and noble aura.

Following behind Zhao Xuanyou, Yuhuan and Huaiyue bowed to Old Madam Ye.

"You've been busy with your duties. It's already dark when you return home."

"My colleagues are mostly unfamiliar to me, so I have more social engagements than usual." Zhao Xuanyou explained.

Old Madam Ye nodded slightly. After waiting for him to take a seat beside her, she patted his shoulder. "I'm not blaming you. You must work hard in the Secretariat to live up to His Majesty's expectations."

"Yes."

Zhao Xuanyou's arrival caused a subtle change in the expressions of everyone in Leshou Hall.

The first to be affected was Cui Yichu, who was sitting next to Old Madam Ye.

Today, she was dressed plainly, and her gaze toward Zhao Xuanyou was filled with nothing but guilt.

After the ugly incident of making Yuhuan her stand-in was exposed, Zhao Xuanyou had ignored her completely, communicating only through servants, neither speaking to her nor meeting her.

Next was Fenghuang, who was sitting beside Cui Yichu.

Unlike Cui Yichu, from the beginning, she had been someone Zhao Xuanyou did not want.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou leading the two beautiful concubines, Yuhuan and Huaiyue, with their graceful figures, into the hall, Fenghuang's face was filled with envy.

Being a concubine was so unrewarding. It was better to be a servant concubine, at least she could stay by Zhao Xuanyou's side every day, seeing him at every moment.

As for the other unfamiliar young woman, ever since Zhao Xuanyou entered Leshou Hall, she had been staring at him without blinking.

When Zhao Xuanyou's gaze finally fell on her, her cheeks turned slightly red, and she called out, "Cousin."

"Jirou? When did you arrive in the capital?"

These days, so many things had happened in the Marquis's residence that Zhao Xuanyou had completely forgotten about the previous agreement to take his maternal cousin, Feng Jirou, as a favored concubine.

She had actually come uninvited.

Feng Jirou lowered her head and softly replied, "I arrived today."

"Why didn't you inform me in advance? If you were coming to the Marquis's residence, I would have sent someone to pick you up."

Feng Jirou lowered her head even further upon hearing this.
