The Marquis's residence had taken too long to respond, making her parents anxious. They had forced a distant relative to bring her to the capital, hoping to pressure the Marquis's residence into accepting her.

Feng Jirou had been educated since she was young and knew proper etiquette.

Although she was willing to be Zhao Xuanyou's concubine, she understood that it was improper for an unmarried young lady to visit unannounced.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's question, she was so ashamed that she couldn't utter a single word.

Old Madam Ye noticed her embarrassment and gave Zhao Xuanyou a look. "We're all family. There's no need for so much formality in coming and going."

Zhao Xuanyou felt somewhat helpless and explained, "I was just worried that my cousin might encounter danger traveling to the capital alone."

He truly didn't mean to embarrass Feng Jirou.

Feng Jirou was his cousin, a relative of his mother. He had always treated the Feng family kindly.

"Fortunately, a relative was coming to the capital for business, so I traveled with his merchant ship. The journey was quite smooth."

"In that case." Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly.

As they spoke, the maids came forward with dishes, quickly filling the table.

Old Madam Ye knew that Zhao Xuanyou had been busy all day at the office and must be hungry, so she didn't rush into conversation. Instead, she smiled and said, "Since everyone is here, and we're all family, there's no need for formalities. Let's eat."

"Yes."

Everyone picked up their chopsticks.

Huaiyue and Yuhuan, being servant concubines, didn't have the status to sit. They could only stand by to serve food. Huaiyue took her place behind Old Madam Ye and Zhao Xuanyou, while Yuhuan stood beside Fenghuang and Feng Jirou.

The atmosphere in Leshou Hall appeared harmonious, but beneath the surface, undercurrents swirled.

Just half a month ago, when Zhao Xuanyou had first returned to the capital, there had been only one madam in the residence, Cui Yichu.

In just over half a month, the number of women in his life had grown enough to fill a table. It was hard for the Marquis's residence not to be lively.

Yuhuan, lost in thought, served food to her cousin Feng Jirou. Coincidentally, her gaze met Zhao Xuanyou's across the table.

---

chapters.title: Rivalry in Beauty
chapters.content:
Their eyes met for a moment before Yuhuan lowered her gaze and continued serving food to the masters.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze followed the movement of her chopsticks, watching as she first picked up a piece of hand-torn chicken for Fenghuang, then a piece of tofu ball for Feng Jirou.

For some reason, the hand-torn chicken and tofu balls seemed to look much more delicious.

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened as he picked up the fruit wine on the table and took a sip.

All the women in the room were paying attention to Zhao Xuanyou. When his gaze met Yuhuan's, everyone noticed.

Cui Yichu's eyes were filled with mockery. Fenghuang felt even more distressed. Feng Jirou, being new, didn't understand the situation but vaguely sensed that her cousin seemed to care about that servant concubine.

Following Zhao Xuanyou's gaze, her eyes firmly fixed on Yuhuan's graceful face and figure.

Indeed... she was very beautiful.

"Cough." Old Madam Ye cleared her throat, breaking the awkwardness in the room. She looked at Zhao Xuanyou, "This is the plum wine my maids brewed themselves. It has a light flavor. Are you used to drinking it?"

When Zhao Xuanyou was in the northwest, he often drank the local strong liquor. This plum wine tasted almost like tea to him.

He had always been filial, and since Old Madam Ye asked, he naturally replied, "It's fragrant and refreshing. Our family's things are naturally better than those outside."

Old Madam Ye smiled in satisfaction, "Since you like it, I'll have someone send a few jars to Honghui Hall later."

"Thank you, Grandmother."

After a long silence, Cui Yichu finally stood up, using a spoon to scoop a piece of crab meat tofu, and placed it in Zhao Xuanyou's bowl.

"Crab is rare at this time of year. Young Master, try some fresh food."

Zhao Xuanyou silently ate it, giving her some face.

Cui Yichu rubbed her fingers together, her heart stirring. The Young Master wasn't completely indifferent to her.

Encouraged, she brought up the topic of Feng Jirou. With distinguished guests arriving, it was natural to arrange a good courtyard to entertain her properly.

She was indeed clever.

Feng Jirou was supposed to be Zhao Xuanyou's concubine, but her status was different. She was Zhao Xuanyou's cousin, a relative of his late mother, someone whom the late madam had entrusted to his care. Naturally, she was different from Fenghuang, a favored concubine. It was necessary to choose an auspicious day for a proper ceremony.

Old Madam Ye praised her arrangements repeatedly, while Zhao Xuanyou remained silent.

Seeing that he wasn't engaging, Cui Yichu tactfully stopped.

Fenghuang had never received even a word from Zhao Xuanyou. Even if she wanted to speak to him, she didn't know where to begin.

Today, she had dressed quite alluringly, standing out next to the plainly dressed Cui Yichu.

But she had no choice. She hoped that Zhao Xuanyou would glance at her more, and perhaps, if he was in the mood, he might call her to Honghui Hall to attend to him that night.

Feng Jirou had come uninvited, which was improper. She was even more reserved.

Thus, although there were many women in Leshou Hall, they only stirred hidden currents, and no one dared to make trouble.

After finishing the meal in harmony, Old Madam Ye ordered the bowls and chopsticks to be cleared away. New dishes of desserts and chilled pear soup to aid digestion were brought in.

"At my age, I can't eat too much at night. It's easy to get indigestion," she said, looking at Huaiyue and Yuhuan, her gaze lingering on the two of them. "You two have been busy serving. You haven't had dinner yet. Try some desserts first."

"Thank you, Old Madam." Huaiyue and Yuhuan each took a piece of dessert.

"Yesterday, I heard that Xuanyou has added someone to his household. Today, I specifically called you over to have a look."

Old Madam Ye looked at the two young girls before her. One was delicate and slender, the other graceful and shapely. They had a certain charm, like the contrast between a plump swan and a slender swallow.

"Yichu thinks highly of you, so she let you serve Xuanyou. From now on, you must dedicate yourselves to your duties. If you can bear a son or a daughter for the Marquis's residence, I will reward you myself."

Old Madam Ye had one son and two daughters.

Zhao Xuanyou's two aunts: one had followed her husband to a distant province for his official post, and the other had died in childbirth ten years ago. After the Marquis inherited the title, his three younger half-brothers had left the residence to establish their own households.

The Marquis and his original wife had a loving and harmonious relationship, but she had been frail. She had difficulty bearing children, and after finally giving birth to Zhao Xuanyou, she passed away early. Now, the Marquis was living with a concubine in the south to recover from his injuries, leaving the vast Marquis's residence feeling empty.

Old Madam Ye was getting older and increasingly longed for the days when her descendants would fill the halls. After hearing that Cui Yichu's health was poor, she hoped that the concubines could soon bear children for the Marquis's residence.

The larger the family, the more it needed descendants to inherit it.

Today, she had called Yuhuan and Huaiyue to see their appearances and temperaments.

Now that she had seen them, she was quite satisfied.

Huaiyue, needless to say, was the daughter of an official family. If her family hadn't fallen into disrepute, she would have been a suitable match even as Zhao Xuanyou's official wife.

Yuhuan, on the other hand, was the first time Old Madam Ye had seen her. She was even more beautiful than Huaiyue, which explained why Xuanyou insisted on keeping her by his side.

For a servant concubine, there was no need to hold her to the same standards as an official wife. As long as she was beautiful, obedient, and could make Zhao Xuanyou happy, that was enough.

Moreover... Old Madam Ye narrowed her eyes, examining Yuhuan's figure.

In the capital, noblewomen often prized a delicate and weak appearance, but Yuhuan had a graceful figure and a radiant complexion. She looked like she would be good at bearing children, which made her a perfect match for Zhao Xuanyou.

Yuhuan ate some dessert and stood to the side, feeling uneasy under Old Madam Ye's constant gaze.

Fortunately, the old madam didn't say anything to her. Instead, she said, "The Marquis's residence has many people now. You are all young, and I, this old woman, don't want to restrict you with too many rules. There's no need to come and report to me every day. However, without rules, there can be no order. In all matters concerning the inner residence, you must listen to Yichu. Do not act on your own. If someone relies on favor to act spoiled and causes trouble, I will not let them off lightly. Do you understand?"

These words were not only directed at the two servant concubines but also at Fenghuang and Feng Jirou, and even at Zhao Xuanyou.

"We understand."

"Alright, it's getting late. You should all go back and rest. Xuanyou, you will escort me back to my room."

Old Madam Ye, supported by Zhao Xuanyou, stood up. Everyone else also stood and bowed to her.

The grandmother and grandson went around the screen and entered the inner room. Old Madam Ye pulled Zhao Xuanyou to sit on a soft couch. After the servant came in to report that everyone else had left, she finally looked at Zhao Xuanyou.

"Did Grandmother call me in to scold me?"

Old Madam Ye said reproachfully, "You are the Young Master, a secretary in the Secretariat. How could an old woman like me dare to scold you?"

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the calming soup from the table, scooped half a spoonful, and respectfully fed it to her.

"Grandmother's teachings, this grandson does not dare to ignore."

Old Madam Ye drank the calming soup and looked at Zhao Xuanyou, sighing softly. "You, poor child, lost your mother when you were just over ten years old. Then you had to lead the Mingdi Guard for your father. What storms haven't you weathered over the years? Indeed, there's little I can teach you."

"But?" Zhao Xuanyou asked, sensing the implication.

Hearing this retort, Old Madam Ye couldn't help but smile, tapping Zhao Xuanyou's head lightly.

"You want to take concubines, and I don't object. But you've only been back for less than a month, and suddenly you've added so many women. That's a bit too fast."

Listening to his grandmother's words, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but feel a headache coming on.

"Does Grandmother think I wanted to keep so many women?"

"You didn't want to?"

"Fenghuang was a gift from Prince Ping. It wouldn't be good to refuse. Cousin Jirou was arranged by my mother. I can't reject her either. As for Huaiyue, she was thrust upon me out of nowhere."

Zhao Xuanyou looked somewhat agitated. Old Madam Ye believed what he said was true.

But she was an old hand at these matters and immediately noticed what was amiss.

"So, the only one you want is Yuhuan?"

chapters.title: Another Night Intrusion
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou had not expected the old lady to be so perceptive, and he could only manage a helpless smile.

To be honest, Yu Wan was not his choice either.

Ever since he returned to the capital, all he wanted was to live peacefully with Cui Yichu. Who could have known that Cui Yichu would pull so many tricks, even arranging for Yu Wan to share his bed in her place all this time.

His relationship with Yu Wan could only be described as a twist of fate.

The inner quarters had been thrown into chaos by Cui Yichu, but at least being with Yu Wan didn’t frustrate him as much.

"Yu Wan... was also chosen for me by Madam. It wasn’t my intention to keep her."

"Sigh, Yichu has it hard too," Zhao Xuanyou had informed Old Lady Ye about Cui Yichu’s difficulty in conceiving, and as a woman herself, Old Lady Ye felt considerable sympathy for Cui Yichu. "For a woman, being unable to bear children is a heartbreaking matter. She is a sensible person, which is why she resorted to such measures. Xuanyou, you are husband and wife; you must support each other."

Husband and wife?

Zhao Xuanyou scoffed inwardly.

If Cui Yichu truly considered him her husband, she should have been honest with him.

Naturally, he would have supported her in return.

But what did Cui Yichu do? On their wedding night, she slept in a separate room. While he was away from the capital, she found a maid who resembled her and, in the darkness, let him... consummate with the maid to deceive him.

At this point, Zhao Xuanyou had almost figured out Cui Yichu’s plan.

If Yu Wan became pregnant and gave birth successfully, the child would likely be placed by Cui Yichu’s side, claimed as her own.

In her eyes, he was not a husband at all; just a tool to secure her position as the mistress of the Marquis’s residence.

Old Lady Ye watched as Zhao Xuanyou’s expression gradually darkened, and she sighed again. "Xuanyou, as a married couple, you must not be so heartless."

"Grandmother, rest assured. I know my limits." Zhao Xuanyou suppressed his thoughts and respectfully replied.

"Forget it. I’m not saying you’re at fault. It’s all my doing," Old Lady Ye sighed. "When your father took a wife, I arranged a frail daughter-in-law for him. Now that it’s your turn to marry, in my eagerness for a grandson, I didn’t investigate properly and found you a wife who cannot bear children."

"Grandmother, such things cannot be known just by asking around. How can you blame yourself?" Seeing his grandmother blame herself so, Zhao Xuanyou had to say against his true feelings, "Madam is the most beautiful woman in the capital, of noble birth, literate, and graceful. I am very happy to have married her."

"Really?"

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

Recalling how, when Zhao Xuanyou had first returned to the capital, the couple had come to pay their respects to her every day, Old Lady Ye believed him to some extent.

"Then why are you at odds with her?"

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow. "Did she say that?"

Old Lady Ye, seeing his attitude, became anxious. "Does she need to say it? You carried a maid back to your room in broad daylight. Isn’t that a slap in her face?"

On the night Yu Wan was poisoned, Zhao Xuanyou had indeed taken her back to Honghui Hall with some intention of humiliating Cui Yichu, but... that wasn’t the only reason...

"Xuanyou, I’ve been through this. Yichu is just putting on a brave front. She arranged for concubines and chamber maids for you, but believe me, her heart aches every time she does so. She is your lawful wife; you cannot forget the old for the new."

"I do not want so many new people."

Old Lady Ye frowned. "You don’t want Jirou? It’s true you have enough women around you, but Jirou was chosen by your mother and is your cousin. It wouldn’t be right to go back on your word."

Zhao Xuanyou had originally planned as such.

But seeing Feng Jirou’s embarrassed and distressed expression today, his resolve had wavered somewhat.

Perhaps his cousin herself was unwilling to be a concubine.

"About Huaiyue, have you taken her into your household?" Old Lady Ye suddenly asked.

Zhao Xuanyou shook his head. Hearing her question, his eyes flickered. "Does Grandmother have a plan for her?"

"Minister Zhuang and our family are old acquaintances. By reason, we should help his daughter as much as we can. If you like Huaiyue, there’s no harm, but if you don’t, don’t delay her either."

With the Marquis residence’s status, if there was a chance for a general amnesty, it wouldn’t be difficult to add Huaiyue to the Ministry of Rites’ pardon list.

Once her slave status was removed, a dowry could be arranged, and a good family found for her, without betraying past ties.

"This matter may have to trouble Grandmother."

Old Lady Ye saw that he truly did not want her, so she nodded. "Starting tomorrow, send her to Leshou Hall. The maids and servants here are illiterate; she can come and read scriptures with me, discuss Buddhist teachings."

Although Old Lady Ye hoped the Marquis residence would soon have descendants, she did not want Zhao Xuanyou to be a man obsessed with women.

Having two or three women who truly cared for him was enough.

"Very well." Zhao Xuanyou had no interest in Huaiyue at all. If Old Lady Ye was willing to take her in, that would be the best outcome for her.

As for Feng Jirou, he would think of a way later.

After talking for so long, Zhao Xuanyou saw that his grandmother was tired, so he stood up to take his leave.

Finally, Old Lady Ye instructed him to give Cui Yichu enough respect. In the past, some noble families who favored concubines over their wives ended up with family discord, ruining their fortune.

Zhao Xuanyou naturally agreed to all of this.

When he left Leshou Hall, the moon was already high in the sky.

Returning to Honghui Hall, Yuan Qing had already prepared hot water and a towel for him.

His eyes darkened slightly. "Only you?"

Yuan Qing was confused by the question. "Master, who else should be here?"

Yuan Ben had accompanied Master to the yamen today, so it was Yuan Qing’s turn to serve at night.

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression was grim as he sat down and said in a low voice, "I told Yu Wan this morning. From now on, the task of helping me change clothes is hers."

Yu Wan? Helping Master change clothes?

Although Yuan Qing hadn’t quite figured it out yet, he had long sensed that Master treated Yu Wan differently.

He quickly said, "Yu Wan has prepared Master’s nightclothes. She should be back at Xiaoyue Pavilion by now. Should I call her over?"

"No need."

After washing up, Zhao Xuanyou dismissed Yuan Qing.

He walked into the inner chamber and saw the neatly folded nightclothes on the bed. A faint, almost imperceptible smile crossed his eyes.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the nightclothes, intending to change, but suddenly hesitated, his mind torn. After a moment, he threw the nightclothes back onto the bed.

He quickly left Honghui Hall. Yuan Qing, who was waiting outside the corridor, was startled.

"Master, it’s so late..."

"Don’t follow me."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou swiftly left Honghui Hall and strode toward Xiaoyue Pavilion. Before long, he was standing at Yu Wan’s door.

Under the quiet moonlight, he pushed the door open and entered the room.

Yu Wan had been very tired these past two days and had gone to bed as soon as she returned to her room.

She was curled up on her side in the bed, her silky black hair cascading over the pillow, her expression peaceful as she slept soundly.

Zhao Xuanyou watched her for a moment, then slowly reached out and pulled at her blanket.

Because the door was open, the night wind blew in, and as he pulled back Yu Wan’s blanket, the cold air rushed into her bed.

Feeling the chill in her sleep, Yu Wan instinctively shrank back.

Forget it, she was having her period... What was he doing...

In the end, Zhao Xuanyou covered her with the blanket again.

Just as he was about to pull his hand back, Yu Wan, still asleep, grabbed his hand.

---

chapters.title: The Bed is Occupied!
chapters.content:
Her fingers were slender, but her grip was strong.

Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat surprised, but he did not pull his hand away. Instead, he let her hold it and sat down by her bed.

Yu Wan was fast asleep. The blanket had been pulled by him, exposing half of her shoulder. Instinctively, she sought warmth.

After a moment, Yu Wan, still asleep, grew bolder. She tightened her grip on Zhao Xuanyou’s hand and even pressed her face against the back of his hand.

The warm breath on his hand made his heart race.

Cui Yichu was so calculating and had never intended to live a good life with him from the beginning.

Yu Wan was beautiful and clever, always courteous and respectful to him. There was no need to force a harmonious marriage and make life difficult for himself.

Keeping Yu Wan by his side was both pleasing to the eye and comforting to the body and mind.

Zhao Xuanyou’s Adam’s apple bobbed.

He was well aware that the nights he had spent with Yu Wan had indeed made him... unable to stop.

The room was dimly lit, and the woman on the bed breathed evenly. She was a tender, within-reach paradise for him.

Zhao Xuanyou simply undressed and lay down beside Yu Wan.

The bed in the servants’ room was narrow. As soon as he lay down, Yu Wan was pushed all the way to the wall.

The wall was indeed cold and hard. Feeling the chill, Yu Wan pressed closer to him.

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression was somewhat conflicted.

Catching the faint scent of the woman, his breathing became rapid.

But it was that time of the month for her. No matter how uncomfortable Zhao Xuanyou was, he had to endure it.

Rationally, the best thing to do was to leave immediately. But even though he couldn’t touch her, he was unwilling to leave this soft, fragrant body.

As they lay close together, Zhao Xuanyou struggled internally for a while before finally placing his hand on Yu Wan’s waist.

Yu Wan did not sleep very well that night.

It was warm, but something around her felt off.

Her bed was indeed narrow, but it was enough for her. However, that night, she felt as if she was sleeping between two walls, so cramped that she couldn’t lie flat.

Her waist also felt heavy, as if something weighty was placed on it.

She had many dreams that night.

First, it was a cold winter night. She shivered from the cold, wrapping herself tightly in the quilt. Then, she entered a small, warm room with a large stove, finally driving away the chill.

When dawn broke, Yu Wan finally woke up from her dreams.

Morning light streamed in through the window lattice. As soon as she opened her eyes, she saw the gray-white wall in front of her, her nose almost touching it.

She instinctively tried to move back; only to find another wall behind her, a warm one.

Yu Wan was confused for a moment before realizing she was enclosed in a man’s arms, her head resting on one of his arms. In her groggy state, she felt the weight on her waist; it was his other hand.

Glancing at the pale jade ring on his finger, Yu Wan felt somewhat helpless.

Why did this man always like to come over in the middle of the night?

The servants’ rooms in the Marquis’s residence had no bolts, which made it convenient for him to come and go as he pleased.

Yu Wan, squeezed in this narrow space, couldn’t move. She tried to shift back a couple of times but couldn’t budge an inch. Just as she was wondering what to do, the man behind her spoke.

"Awake?"

His voice sounded muffled and deep, as if he hadn’t fully woken up yet. Yu Wan didn’t dare move and only softly replied, "Yes."

He responded with an "mm," and indeed fell back asleep.

This time, however, unlike during the night, he finally shifted outward a bit, creating some space. Just as Yu Wan was about to get up, he lifted her shoulder and turned her over.

Yu Wan changed direction and nestled in his arms, her forehead pressing against his chin, gentle and intimate.

Through the thin fabric, she could feel the warmth of the man’s chest, which gave her a strange sensation.

In her past life, whenever she was with Zhao Xuanyou, she had been drugged. Every time she woke up, all that remained was embarrassment and exhaustion; there was truly no pleasure to speak of.

In this life, she had the chance to truly interact with him and discovered a different side of him.

Actually, he wasn’t always rough; he could be quite gentle.

Yu Wan’s drowsiness returned, and she fell asleep against this warm "stove."

"Yu Wan jiejie, Yu Wan jiejie!"

A rapid knocking sound came from outside the door; it was Yingxue.

The two people on the bed were startled awake by the knocking. They exchanged a glance, both knowing that the current scene was not suitable for others to witness.

"Yingxue, is that you?" Yu Wan quickly responded.

"It’s me. I was so scared. It’s good that you’re alright, jiejie."

"What happened?"

"I came to check on you," Yingxue genuinely cared for Yu Wan. "You didn’t seem well yesterday, and you’re late to Honghui Hall today. I was afraid something happened."

Indeed, because Zhao Xuanyou had been here, Yu Wan had missed her duty time.

Recalling the previous attempt on her life, Yingxue was worried and had come to Xiaoyue Pavilion to check on her.

"Thank you. Please go tell Yuan Qing that I’ll be there soon."

"No rush. The Young Master seems to have gone out early this morning. He’s not at Honghui Hall right now. Yuan Qing and I are both free. I just came to see you, not to hurry you."

Yu Wan, of course, knew she hadn’t delayed her duties; this master had been lying in her bed all night.

She looked at Zhao Xuanyou with some exasperation, and he was also looking at her.

Their eyes met, and an inexplicable sense of shame, as if they were having an affair, arose between them.

"I’m not dressed yet, so I won’t invite you in for tea."

"Alright, I’ll leave first."

Yingxue, hearing this, didn’t think much of it and turned to leave.

Yu Wan turned her head and saw that Zhao Xuanyou still had no intention of getting up. She had to remind him, "Young Master, this servant needs to attend to her duties."

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her rosy cheeks and raised an eyebrow indifferently. "I’m here. Where are you going to attend to your duties?"

That was true. Yu Wan had spent the whole night squeezed by him, which was far more tiring than working at Honghui Hall.

Her beautiful eyebrows twitched as she retorted playfully, "But nighttime isn’t when this servant is on duty. This servant has worked an extra night shift. Shouldn’t the Young Master let this servant rest a bit?"

Zhao Xuanyou, hearing her talk back, looked even more at ease.

"Want to rest?"

"This servant doesn’t dare."

He finally sat up. Yu Wan tried to sit up as well, but as soon as she moved, her neck hurt, and she couldn’t help but let out a small cry.

"What’s wrong?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yu Wan felt a mix of emotions. "I think I slept wrong and strained my neck."

The bed was already narrow, and Zhao Xuanyou had taken over most of it like a cuckoo in a magpie’s nest, pushing Yu Wan against the wall all night. It was no wonder her neck was suffering.

And it wasn’t just her neck; her shoulders, knees, and waist all ached.

"Slept wrong?" Zhao Xuanyou didn’t say much. He directly reached out and pressed a few points on the back of her neck.

Yu Wan yelped as he massaged her, but after the kneading, her neck did feel a bit better.

"Does the Young Master also know how to give shoulder massages? Thank you, Young Master."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a faint smile. With his status, how could he possibly give someone a shoulder massage?

It was just that years of martial arts practice had made him familiar with the body’s pressure points, so he had tried pressing a few for her.

Seeing that Yu Wan’s neck was a little better, and noticing her fists lightly rubbing her shoulders, it seemed she was sore all over from being squeezed last night.

"Rest for a couple of days. No need to go to Honghui Hall."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou got up and began straightening his clothes in the room.

Yu Wan watched him open the door and leave, then reached up to rub her cheek.

Not having to go to Honghui Hall was good, but... would he come sneaking over again at night?

chapters.title: Reluctant to Leave
chapters.content:
"Master." Yuan Qing was talking to Ziyan in the courtyard when he caught a glimpse of Zhao Xuanyou returning. He hurried over to greet him.

Why were Master’s clothes so wrinkled? Had he slept in them last night?

Last night, Zhao Xuanyou had left in a foul mood, so Yuan Qing hadn’t dared to say much and had simply followed him into the main house.

"Master, shall we prepare a meal?" Yingxue, carrying tea, approached and poured him a cup of Wuyi rock tea.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the teacup and responded with a hum.

Yingxue quickly went out to make the arrangements.

Considering the time, the heir would have to leave for the yamen in the time it takes for an incense stick to burn. He couldn’t afford to delay.

Zhao Xuanyou looked up at Yuan Qing, who understood his meaning and asked, "Does Master have any other orders?"

"Yu Wan has been unwell these past few days. Excuse her from her duties."

Yuan Qing was taken aback, his mind filled with confusion, but he didn’t dare to ask further. He could only respond blankly, "Yes."

Seeing him look like a dull-witted fool, Zhao Xuanyou shot him a sidelong glance. "Go to the storeroom and pick a hairpin with good craftsmanship."

The one she was wearing was far too shabby. It was an eyesore.

"Yes." Yuan Qing finally came to his senses.

But Master didn’t look like he had just returned from outside the mansion.

Early in the morning, and now he was excusing Yu Wan from her duties and sending someone to fetch a hairpin from the storeroom. Could it be... that Master had spent last night with Yu Wan?

Had Master been at Xiaoyue Pavilion last night?

The thought struck Yuan Qing, but he quickly dismissed it as unlikely.

Why would Master, for no good reason, make Yu Wan stay the night at Honghui Hall instead of Xiaoyue Pavilion? That place wasn’t exactly reputable.

After turning it over in his mind, Yuan Qing only felt a headache coming on and decided to stop thinking about it.

The kitchen had already prepared breakfast for Zhao Xuanyou early that morning, and Yingxue soon brought it in.

It was still the lamb noodle soup he loved, paired with flaky meat pies and a few small dishes.

Though he hadn’t succeeded last night, it had still been pleasant.

In a good mood, Zhao Xuanyou even exchanged a few more words with his colleagues at the yamen than usual.

As noon approached, a messenger arrived from the palace, saying the Emperor had summoned him to the imperial study.

Not daring to delay, he rushed to the palace without even eating lunch.

Inside the imperial study, the auspicious beast incense burner slowly released its fragrance.

The Emperor, having just finished his lunch, was sitting behind his desk, leisurely sipping a bowl of cooling loquat soup.

"Your subject Zhao Xuanyou pays respects to Your Majesty. May you live ten thousand years, ten thousand times ten thousand years."

"Rise." The Emperor, after more than twenty years on the throne, had long since honed his demeanor to be inscrutable, showing no hint of joy or anger. "Have you had lunch?"

Zhao Xuanyou answered truthfully, "The Ministry of Personnel has not yet reached the time for lunch."

The lunch hours for the various ministries were fixed, and the meals varied by rank. The rules were strict, and everything was done in order.

"In that case, you can have some here in the imperial study later."

"I dare not. May I ask why Your Majesty has summoned this humble subject?"

The Emperor studied his expression, paused, and a faint smile appeared on his face. "I am very pleased that you have stayed in the capital. However, you still hold the position of Commander of the Mingmi Guard. A commander cannot be away from his post for too long; the Mingmi Guard always needs someone to manage it."

Zhao Xuanyou’s heart stirred.

Was the Emperor making a move on the Mingmi Guard?

The Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion traced its roots back to the imperial family, both sharing the Zhao surname.

Over a hundred years ago, during a time of great chaos, Zhao Xuanyou’s ancestor and Emperor Taizong were cousins. They rose up together, subdued the warlords in the turbulent times, and seized the throne.

Emperor Taizong’s brothers were all enfeoffed as princes, while their branch received the hereditary title of Jingyuan Marquis and command of the Mingmi Guard.

For over a hundred years, the Mingmi Guard had always been commanded by descendants of the Jingyuan Marquis.

Now, by keeping him in the capital, was the Emperor trying to take away the military power of the Mingmi Guard?

Without a moment’s hesitation, Zhao Xuanyou cupped his hands in a gesture of respect. "Your Majesty is wise. The Mingmi Guard indeed cannot be without a commander for long."

The imperial study was thick with the scent of dragon’s saliva incense. The Emperor narrowed his eyes, examining Zhao Xuanyou.

After a moment, he burst into laughter. "You have misunderstood my intentions. Of course, the commander of the Mingmi Guard is still you. I was referring to something else."

"This subject is dull-witted. May I ask what Your Majesty means?"

The Emperor stood up and paced back and forth behind his desk, speaking slowly. "My sons are all mediocre. They have been in the court for some years now, and it’s about time they gain some experience in the military."

So it was about the princes.

The Emperor had seven sons and three daughters.

The first prince had died at the age of three. The second prince, Zhao Zun, born of the empress, had been crowned prince at the age of twelve. The third prince, Zhao Huan, was the Prince of Ping. The fourth prince had died at seven. The fifth prince, Zhao Lin, was the Prince of Jing. The sixth prince, Zhao Yu, and the seventh prince, Zhao Qi, had not yet been enfeoffed.

Originally, with the empress’s position secured, the court had been stable. But two years ago, Prince Zhao Zun had mishandled two important tasks, earning a public rebuke from the Emperor. Since then, petitions regarding the heir had been pouring in.

Many officials believed Zhao Zun was too mediocre to bear the responsibility of the heir.

The matter of establishing an heir was treacherous, and Zhao Xuanyou had no intention of wading into those murky waters.

"This subject still does not fully understand Your Majesty’s meaning."

"I want to choose one of my sons to serve as the deputy commander of the Mingmi Guard, to gain military experience for a few years. Since you are the commander of the Mingmi Guard, it is most appropriate to ask your opinion."

Choosing a deputy commander had nothing to do with the crown prince.

Zhao Xuanyou felt slightly relieved and declined, "This subject has only recently returned to the capital. Apart from drinking with Prince Ping a few times, I am not familiar with the other princes. I truly do not know how to recommend one."

This was the truth. His interactions with Prince Ping were due to their childhood training together, not out of any intention to form connections.

"Do you think Prince Ping would be suitable?"

Zhao Xuanyou detected the Emperor’s probing tone. After a moment’s thought, he respectfully replied, "I recall that two years ago, Prince Ping inspected the troops in the northwest and should be familiar with the Mingmi Guard. However, since Your Majesty wishes to provide military experience, in this subject’s humble opinion, it would be more appropriate to send the sixth and seventh princes to the northwest."

"Can they handle the Mingmi Guard at their age?"

Zhao Xuanyou solemnly replied, "Your Majesty is wise. The world is at peace, and the people live in tranquility. There is no war in the northwest. The Mingmi Guard is loyal to Your Majesty. No matter which prince is sent to the Mingmi Guard, they will do their utmost to assist and help the prince understand military affairs."

The Emperor nodded slightly, quite satisfied with his words, and his demeanor unconsciously became more amiable.

"You speak reason. I will consider it further. Xiaoluzi."

"Your servant is here." The young eunuch waiting outside the study hurried in.

The Emperor said, "Take Xuanyou to eat. Let him try the imperial kitchen’s cooking."

"Yes. Lord Zhao, this way, please."

"Your subject thanks Your Majesty for your grace." Xiaoluzi respectfully led Zhao Xuanyou out. The Emperor watched Zhao Xuanyou’s tall and imposing figure as he left, and let out a soft sigh.

Zhao Xuanyou was both literate and martial, with measured actions. He possessed the dignity and decisiveness of a military officer, as well as the refined demeanor of a scholar. He was truly a dragon among men.

If any of his sons could match Zhao Xuanyou in bearing and ability, he wouldn’t have to worry so much every day.

As Zhao Xuanyou followed Xiaoluzi out of the imperial study, his mind began to calculate.

The Emperor today didn’t seem to truly want to send any prince to the Mingmi Guard. Every word had been a test for him.

Could there be some task he was being assigned?

Zhao Xuanyou had a vague feeling that he might be promoted, but he also had concerns.

At this juncture, he didn’t want to leave the capital.

---

chapters.title: But He Likes Her
chapters.content:
"Is Young Lady Huaiyue here?" Xing Mama, from Leshou Hall, stood at the door of Honghui Hall and asked.

Yu Wan was sitting on the veranda watching the stove. Hearing this, she stood up and said, "Huaiyue and Ziyan are in the back courtyard. Mama, what’s the matter?"

After Zhao Xuanyou left that morning, Yu Wan had also come to Honghui Hall after breakfast.

She wasn’t so frail that she had to stay alone in Xiaoyue Pavilion. Since Yingxue and the others wouldn’t let her do any work, she sat on the veranda to help watch the stove and boil water.

"How convenient that you’re here too." Xing Mama asked.

"Does the Old Lady have any orders for this servant?"

Xing Mama smiled. "It’s not an order. The young master returned too late last night, and the Old Lady fell asleep, so she forgot to reward you. She just sent me to bring it over."

With that, Xing Mama handed Yu Wan an embroidered brocade pouch.

Yu Wan took the pouch and felt its weight. It was quite heavy.

She figured the Old Lady hadn’t intended to reward her last night, but since her performance had pleased the Old Lady, she had sent someone to deliver the reward today.

She was in need of money, so this was a timely help.

Yu Wan held the pouch, overjoyed. "Thank Mama for conveying this servant’s gratitude to the Old Lady."

Seeing Yu Wan’s sincerity, Xing Mama nodded slightly. "I will certainly pass it on."

Yu Wan didn’t dare to show her eagerness for money. She tucked the pouch into her sleeve and smiled. "Mama, please wait a moment. I’ll go call Huaiyue to receive the reward."

"It’s not for her," Xing Mama said.

Yu Wan was surprised. "Is this reward only for me?"

Xing Mama replied, "Our Old Lady doesn’t reward just anyone. Whoever does their job well gets the reward."

Job well done? Where did that come from?

Recalling how Old Lady Ye had mentioned "bearing children" several times the day before, Yu Wan felt helpless.

This Old Lady, like Cui Yichu, seemed to have taken a fancy to her "perfectly suitable for men" appearance.

Too bad, they were going to be disappointed.

Yu Wan smiled. "I’m just clumsy. The Old Lady is too kind."

"Old Lady says that Young Lady Huaiyue will serve in Leshou Hall from now on. I came to fetch her. If she has any tasks at hand, you can assign someone else to take over."

Old Lady Ye was taking Huaiyue to Leshou Hall?

Putting herself in Huaiyue’s shoes, Yu Wan would certainly be willing, but as for Huaiyue herself... that was unknown.

"Wait a moment. I’ll go call her."

Honghui Hall was Zhao Xuanyou’s study, not a place where others could enter freely.

Without his permission, no one from outside the courtyard could enter, even if they were sent by the Old Lady. So Xing Mama could only wait outside the courtyard.

In the back courtyard, thick shade provided relief from the heat.

Huaiyue and Ziyan were sitting on a bench under a tree, whispering to each other.

"Are you two done with your work?" Yu Wan approached.

The two women, thinking she had come to check on them, stood up.

Ziyan explained, "The flowers and plants in the courtyard are all blooming well today. There’s nothing to replace, so we took a moment to sit and chat."

"The courtyard is managed by you two. I don’t interfere." Yu Wan knew they had misunderstood, but she didn’t explain further. Instead, she said, "Someone from Leshou Hall is looking for Huaiyue."

"For me?"

After thinking for a moment, Yu Wan told the truth, to prevent Huaiyue from losing her composure in front of Xing Mama.

"That Mama said Old Lady ordered Young Lady Huaiyue to serve in Leshou Hall from now on."

Sure enough, Huaiyue was stunned.

"Me, go to Leshou Hall?"

"Yes. The person is waiting at the door of Honghui Hall."

Seeing Huaiyue’s incredulous expression, it was clear she couldn’t accept it.

"Go, go to Leshou Hall..."

Just yesterday, Old Lady Ye had been in Leshou Hall instructing them, as concubines, to serve the heir diligently and bear children for the marquis’s family. How could she now be sending Huaiyue to Leshou Hall?

If she went to Leshou Hall, she might not see Zhao Xuanyou more than a few times a month in the future.

"That’s what the Mama said. Why don’t you go ask her?"

"No need to ask."

Recalling Zhao Xuanyou’s ruthless demeanor that day, Huaiyue understood that sending her to Leshou Hall must be Zhao Xuanyou’s idea.

Ziyan tried to console her. "Actually, Leshou Hall is a good place. Everyone in the mansion says the Old Lady is the kindest. If I had a choice, I’d want to serve in Leshou Hall too."

How could others understand her feelings for Zhao Xuanyou?

Huaiyue gave a bitter smile. "When I have time in the future, I’ll come to Xiaoyue Pavilion to talk with you."

Ziyan nodded and watched as Huaiyue followed Yu Wan toward the front courtyard.

When Xing Mama saw Huaiyue, she repeated the Old Lady’s instructions. This time, Huaiyue didn’t say anything more and obediently followed Xing Mama.

But after taking only a few steps, she turned back to look at Honghui Hall.

Honghui Hall was the most majestic place in the marquis’s mansion and the most envied by the women.

For the past two days, as a concubine to Zhao Xuanyou, Huaiyue had thought her childhood dreams were finally coming true.

Unfortunately, this dream had begun suddenly and ended even more abruptly.

She glanced at Yu Wan, who stood on the veranda, dressed in fine clothes with a calm expression, and felt a pang of bitterness.

Perhaps Yu Wan was inferior to her in countless ways, but Zhao Xuanyou happened to like her.

What could she do?

Huaiyue took a deep breath and silently followed Xing Mama away.

"Huaiyue was looking at me so strangely just now. What was that about?" Yingxue, having heard the commotion in the courtyard, came out with a feather duster. She had just caught sight of the scene.

"Let her be. We won’t be working together anymore anyway."

Yu Wan didn’t mind at all. She had the brocade pouch from Xing Mama in her sleeve; heavy, the Old Lady’s reward must be quite generous.

She had finally found a skilled acupuncturist, and she naturally wanted to take her mother for treatment as soon as possible.

She was just short on money, and now the Old Lady had provided.

Thinking about it, the Old Lady was more generous than that man Zhao Xuanyou, and she didn’t even have to work hard to serve him.

"My head feels a bit dizzy. I want to go back to Xiaoyue Pavilion."

Yingxue said, "I told you not to overdo it. Go back to your room and rest."

After saying this, Yingxue also felt a bit puzzled. Yu Wan hadn’t even told her that she was unwell, so how did Master know? And why had he given her leave?

But Yu Wan was already walking quickly out of Honghui Hall, so it was too late to ask.

---

As Zhao Xuanyou walked toward Honghui Hall, he suddenly caught sight of a graceful figure ahead.

He narrowed his eyes and looked over. The figure was walking very quickly, almost jogging out of Honghui Hall, and seemed to be skipping as she went.

"Master, that looks like Yu Wan." Yuan Cuo saw him stop and also glanced in that direction.

Yu Wan’s figure was quite outstanding, and even a distant glance was enough to recognize her.

"Should we call out to her?"

Zhao Xuanyou shot him a glance, and Yuan Cuo didn’t dare to speak further.

Just as he was about to continue forward, someone quickly ran up to Zhao Xuanyou.

"This servant Baochuan greets Master." Baochuan blushed as she curtsied to Zhao Xuanyou.

Seeing that she was one of Cui Yichu’s people, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened.

To have intercepted him outside Honghui Hall, she must have been waiting here for him for a long time.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s apparent displeasure and clear reluctance to engage, Baochuan had to harden her resolve and continue. "Master, the day after tomorrow is Madam’s birthday. She would like to invite Master to Lingyu Pavilion for dinner."

chapters.title: The Couch is Too Small
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou, of course, did not want to go.

But just yesterday, he had promised his grandmother to give Cui Yichu the respect she deserved. To avoid disappointing his grandmother, he had to at least make a show of it.

"I understand."

His words were cold, but Baochuan, upon hearing these three words, felt as if she had been granted a great pardon. Overjoyed, she bowed to Zhao Xuanyou once more.

Nowadays, Cui Yichu often threw tantrums because of Yu Ying's favor. If she failed to invite the young master, she would face a scolding at best, or a beating at worst.

"The mistress will be delighted to know that the young master is coming."

Seeing that Baochuan was still standing there, Yuan Zhen quickly waved her off, signaling her not to block the way.

Baochuan came to her senses and hastily stepped aside with a bow.

Zhao Xuanyou strode back to Honghui Hall, changed his clothes, and had some tea. Then, he glanced at Yuan Qing. "Where are the things I asked you to find?"

Yuan Qing reacted quickly this time. "Master, please wait a moment."

He dared not neglect his master's orders. As soon as Zhao Xuanyou left that morning, he had gone to the storeroom to look for the items.

Soon, he entered the study carrying a tray.

"Master, I don't understand jade. I really can't tell which one has better quality."

The jade hairpins stored in the Marquis's mansion were naturally all of high quality. Zhao Xuanyou gave them a cursory glance and confirmed that they were indeed excellent.

He nodded. "Take them to Xiaoyue Pavilion."

Xiaoyue Pavilion?

Yuan Qing rolled his eyes. "Are you giving them to Yu Ying?"

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in acknowledgment and picked up a book from the bookshelf, flipping through it.

Yuan Qing was about to leave when he heard Zhao Xuanyou say, "Send two sets of nightclothes over as well."

Nightclothes?

Yuan Qing suddenly realized that his master had indeed stayed at Xiaoyue Pavilion last night.

But the order was too brief. Yuan Qing was confused and tentatively asked, "Are we sending Master's nightclothes, or are we bestowing nightclothes upon Yu Ying?"

Zhao Xuanyou looked up at him, his face dark and terrifying.

Yuan Qing was afraid, but he had always been straightforward. If he didn't understand, he had to ask again. "Sending Master's nightclothes?"

"Get out." Zhao Xuanyou's voice carried a hint of anger.

Fortunately, Yuan Qing finally understood before his master lost his temper. He grabbed the jade hairpins and rushed out.

He went into the room, took a set of nightclothes, and wrapped the jade hairpins.

Yingxue passed by and curiously asked, "Who are those for?"

"Mind your own business." Yuan Qing dared not provoke Zhao Xuanyou any further. Yingxue pouted and went to attend to other matters.

When Yuan Qing delivered the items to Xiaoyue Pavilion, Yu Ying was in the middle of counting the gifts bestowed by the Old Dowager.

A jade bracelet of good quality, a small gold lock, and an exquisitely embroidered handkerchief.

Setting aside the handkerchief, both the bracelet and the gold lock were substantial in weight. If pawned, they would fetch a considerable sum.

"Yu Ying." Yuan Qing knocked on the door. Yu Ying quickly pulled a quilt to cover the items on the bed before rushing to open the door.

Seeing that Yuan Qing was holding something, Yu Ying asked curiously, "Why are you here?"

"You'll see for yourself." Yuan Qing handed her the nightclothes and the brocade box before turning around and leaving.

Yu Ying was bewildered. She hugged the items and went inside.

The nightclothes were soft and fine. Without even opening them, she knew they belonged to Zhao Xuanyou.

Was he coming again tonight?

Yu Ying felt a headache coming on.

Originally, she had been eager to serve him, to seduce him. His favor was a tremendous stroke of luck for her.

But at this moment, she was in the middle of her monthly cycle and couldn't do anything with him...

Moreover, why did he like to stay at Xiaoyue Pavilion so much?

If he truly wanted to hold her while sleeping, wouldn't it be better for them to sleep together at Honghui Hall?

Last night, she had been squeezed into a corner against the wall, and her bones still ached from it.

If she had to endure another night like that...

Although displeased, Yu Ying had no way to stop him.

She sulkily placed the nightclothes aside and opened the brocade box next to them. Seeing the five jade hairpins inside, her gloomy mood instantly lifted.

Yu Ying didn't know how to appraise jade, but these five hairpins were clearly of the highest quality. The white ones were lustrous, the green ones were vivid, as if they were all glistening with moisture.

If she pawned these jade hairpins, even one would be enough to cover her mother's medical expenses.

Within a single day, both the Old Dowager and Zhao Xuanyou had bestowed gifts upon her. Yu Ying's circumstances had drastically improved.

Counting the days, Chen Da Niu would come to the Marquis's mansion to find her tomorrow. After much deliberation, Yu Ying decided to pawn one of the jade hairpins.

Zhao Xuanyou had given her five at once. If she only pawned one, it probably wouldn't be noticed.

Yu Ying sat happily on the couch, trying to pick one with relatively lower quality. Unfortunately, she didn't understand jade well, or perhaps all these jade hairpins were of such high quality that she couldn't tell which was better or worse.

Before she knew it, the moon was high in the sky. When Zhao Xuanyou silently pushed the door open and entered, he saw Yu Ying gazing fondly at the jade hairpins, unable to let go.

"Do you like them?"

The sudden voice startled Yu Ying.

She turned around and saw him. Hastily, she gathered the precious items back into the brocade box.

"Master."

Yu Ying got off the couch and respectfully greeted him with a bow.

Zhao Xuanyou walked up to her, used a finger to open the brocade box, and saw not only the jade hairpins but also the gold lock and bracelet inside. He raised an eyebrow and asked, "When did you get all these things?"

"Except for the hairpins, the rest were bestowed by the Old Dowager."

"The Old Dowager rewarded you?" Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat surprised. "Today? Why?"

Yesterday, his grandmother had only prepared a meeting gift for Feng Jirou.

Yu Ying said, "Xing Mama from Leshou Hall said that the Old Dowager thought I had done a good job. To be honest, I don't know the reason either."

Zhao Xuanyou understood a few things.

At his grandmother's age, she no longer had any expectations of titles or power for her descendants. Her only wish was for more children and grandchildren.

Among the group of women standing in Leshou Hall yesterday, the one most likely to bear children for the Marquis's family was Yu Ying.

Since Cui Yichu couldn't have children, the old lady hoped that Yu Ying would have good news soon.

"You don't know?" Zhao Xuanyou's voice suddenly became hoarse.

Yu Ying, hearing this, understood immediately.

She lowered her head, not daring to look at Zhao Xuanyou.

"This servant truly does not know."

"Then you should think carefully about what duties you are supposed to perform, and how to perform them well."

Yu Ying was momentarily speechless.

This was the first time she had heard him say something so shameless.

She could only say helplessly, "This servant has been feeling unwell these past few days."

This was not an excuse, but a fact.

Zhao Xuanyou let out a light "hmphed," reached out to close the brocade box on her couch, and with a slight push, sent it to the edge of the couch. He then turned and sat down on the couch.

Yu Ying watched as the brocade box nearly fell to the ground. She panicked for the gold and jade inside, quickly grabbed the box, and placed it on the table.

She turned around and saw him sitting on the couch, clearly intending to stay. For the sake of her own neck, she still asked, "Master, are you staying at Xiaoyue Pavilion tonight?"

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened. "You don't want me to?"

"I wouldn't dare," Yu Ying said with difficulty. "It's just that my room is really too small, and I'm afraid..."

Zhao Xuanyou simply moved further onto the couch, tilted his chin up, and slowly asked, "Afraid of what?"

Yu Ying rolled her eyes in her mind.

There's no room for you, you big oaf.

---

chapters.title: Whispering Close
chapters.content:
Yu Ying cursed in her mind, but her smile remained gentle.

"The young master is tall and large. I'm afraid this bed is too small for you and won't be comfortable."

She spoke considerately, purely for Zhao Xuanyou's sake.

But the man clearly did not intend to appreciate it. He remained motionless on the couch, gazing at her leisurely.

"It's fine."

Yu Ying maintained her smile and, holding the nightclothes Yuan Qing had brought, attended to him as he changed.

He had already washed up at Honghui Hall. As he opened his clothes, revealing his solid, muscular chest, Yu Ying couldn't help but stare.

She and Zhao Xuanyou had long been intimate, even sharing a bed at night, but she had never appreciated his body like this before.

His face, tanned from years of leading troops, was not as fair as the young masters in the capital who powdered their faces, but his skin had a superior texture, like the finest mutton-fat jade hairpin; rich and lustrous.

As her fingers touched his chest, she felt the solid muscles beneath, as if they held immense power.

Seeing Yu Ying staring at his body in a daze, the man felt a sense of pride.

But today, knowing she was indisposed, it was not the time to tease her.

If he aroused his own desires, he would be the one suffering.

Zhao Xuanyou gently moved her hand aside and, without her help, put on his nightclothes.

Yu Ying came to her senses and saw that he was about to lie down. She quickly said, "Master, wait a moment."

"What now?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yu Ying took a stack of coarse paper from the cabinet and placed it on the side against the wall.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly. "Do women have to go through such trouble every month?"

Yu Ying blinked.

If she were a noble lady like Cui Yichu, of course, she wouldn't have to go through such trouble.

Nightclothes, bedsheets, once soiled, servants would take them away to wash.

If Yu Ying's bedsheets or quilt got stained, she would have to wash them herself.

"It is indeed a bit troublesome. This servant really doesn't want to wash the bedsheets every day." Yu Ying looked at him pitifully. "So, it's not that I don't want to keep Master here. It's just that the bed is small, and I'm afraid of soiling Master's clothes."

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent.

He had already come; there was no reason to leave over such a small matter.

He raised his hand and patted the thin quilt. Yu Ying fell silent and obediently climbed onto the bed, lying on the inner side as she had the previous night.

If he were to lie flat, she would have to lie on her side.

Since both of them were awake, if she lay on her side with her back to him, she might displease him again.

Seeing Yu Ying curled up in the corner against the wall, Zhao Xuanyou inexplicably felt a flicker of desire.

He forcibly suppressed the flame in his heart, blew out the candle, and lay down beside her.

The candle was out, but neither of them felt the least bit sleepy.

After all, they were so close. Yu Ying's chest pressed against his shoulder, and with every breath she took, she could blow into his ear.

Feeling the warm breath drifting into his ear, Zhao Xuanyou struggled to maintain his composure.

He simply turned onto his side as well. The two of them faced each other. In the moonlight filtering through the window, he saw her beautiful almond-shaped eyes, glistening like a spring pool, so clear they could reflect his face.

He reached out and smoothed her hair that had fallen down, intending to pull his hand back, but he couldn't resist lingering on her cheek.

She was naturally beautiful, without a single flaw.

Over the past year in the Marquis's mansion, Cui Yichu had intended for her to be a stand-in and, fearing that a country girl like her might be exposed by Zhao Xuanyou due to her rough hands and feet, had always sent her the finest creams and ointments to care for her skin.

After a year of meticulous care, Yu Ying's skin was as well-nourished as that of a high-born lady.

Zhao Xuanyou's fingertip glided across her cheek, as if touching a freshly peeled hard-boiled egg.

Seeing that he was getting aroused, Yu Ying feared that if he lost control, she would be the one to suffer. Helpless, she had to speak up.

"Master has to go to the government office tomorrow. You should rest."

He responded with an "mm," and Yu Ying let out a breath of relief. But in the next moment, a dark figure pressed down on her.

"Ah…"

Yu Ying instinctively let out a shriek, but her mouth was immediately covered.

Being kissed so passionately by him, Yu Ying's emotions were indeed complex.

She felt a mix of shyness, longing, and, above all, fear.

Had he truly lost control of himself?

"Master..." Yu Ying's voice squeezed out from the gap between their lips, soft and faint, like a mosquito's buzz. "This servant truly cannot..."

Her head felt a bit dizzy, and her body felt weak, as if she had turned into a puddle of water.

But she had to think of herself.

Her previous life had been too short; in this life, she needed to live longer.

"Master!" Yu Ying finally gathered some strength and suddenly cupped his face, pushing him away a little.

This separation finally brought Zhao Xuanyou back to his senses.

He sat up, and the thin quilt covering them slid to the floor.

The moonlight outside was hazy. Zhao Xuanyou's nightclothes were half-open, revealing his solid, muscular chest. His loose, ink-black hair draped over his shoulders and chest.

The pale moonlight enveloped him, adding a touch of allure to his usually steady and dignified demeanor.

Yu Ying certainly didn't want to disappoint him.

Both for her revenge and out of a woman's instincts.

But today was truly not the day.

She glanced at his pants and saw that he was struggling to restrain himself.

Yu Ying tilted her face up and lightly kissed his chin.

"Master, rest assured. This servant has a way."

"A way?" Zhao Xuanyou savored the light kiss she had given him, his deep eyes shimmering.

Yu Ying smiled, pushed him to lie down, and reached out with her slender fingers to cover his eyes.

---

Before dawn, Zhao Xuanyou left Xiaoyue Pavilion.

As soon as he was gone, Yu Ying finally had the chance to catch up on her sleep.

Serving him at night was no easy task, and resting during the day was her due.

She actually had another dream early in the morning.

In the dream, she had returned to the village where she had been confined during her pregnancy in her past life. But this time, she was not alone; she was with Zhao Xuanyou.

It was the third month of spring, with fine rain like silk and misty smoke. Zhao Xuanyou walked beside her, and when they passed a peach tree, he even picked the best peach blossom for her.

Yu Ying placed the peach blossom in her hair and led Zhao Xuanyou to the room where she had lived.

The old woman who used to guard the door was gone, and the room was empty. Yu Ying wanted to tell Zhao Xuanyou about her past life's experiences, but he had disappeared.

Where had he gone?

Yu Ying's heart inexplicably began to panic.

Just as she was about to go out and look for him, the room door was kicked open!

Yu Ying on the couch jolted awake, her eyes snapping open.

She turned her head and saw two unfamiliar old women glaring at her menacingly.

"Who are you?" Yu Ying pulled the quilt and sat up from the couch.

The two old women looked at her with ill intent. One of them stepped forward, yanked the thin quilt from Yu Ying's hands, and said with a fake smile, "The sun is almost shining on your butt, and you're still asleep, girl."

Were they sent by Cui Yichu?

For no reason at all, why would Cui Yichu come for her?

Unless she wanted to take the opportunity while Zhao Xuanyou was away to kill her?

Yu Ying did her best to calm herself down.

"I'm not on duty today. Besides, you're not from Honghui Hall. What gives you the right to meddle in my affairs?"

"We can't meddle, but there are those who can. Yu Ying, come with us."

The two old women, without further ado, pulled Yu Ying off the couch.

chapters.title: "Stealing a Man"
chapters.content:
"Wait!" Yu Wan's nightgown was loose and disheveled, revealing glimpses of skin.

If she were dragged outside like this and seen by the servants, she would never be able to stay in the Marquis's mansion.

She had been working since she was little and was not weak or easily bullied.

With her mind set, she forcefully broke free from the two servant women's grip, retreated to the side of the room, and quickly tidied her clothes.

The two servant women were thrown to the ground by her and immediately cried out in pain, "Aiyo!"

"Unless you explain who you are, I won't go with you!" Yu Wan reacted extremely quickly. After putting on her clothes, she grabbed a pair of scissors from the cabinet.

"What's going on?" The person outside heard the commotion inside and stepped in.

Yu Wan looked over and saw that the newcomer was actually Madam Xing, who had delivered rewards to her yesterday.

Was the Old Lady trying to capture her?

No wonder the two servant women looked unfamiliar to her; they weren't Cui Yichu's people.

"Madam Xing, what is this about?"

"Put down the scissors," Madam Xing said, seeing her react so strongly. "The Old Lady has summoned you to speak with her."

Because Madam Xing had appeared, Yu Wan did not suspect that it was the Old Lady who was looking for her.

But the two servant women had barged in aggressively, clearly intending to take her to task.

Yu Wan genuinely did not know what she had done to deserve such a grand summoning from the Old Lady.

"If the Old Lady has summoned me to answer, please allow me to change my clothes and tidy up a bit."

"The Old Lady is waiting, so don't delay too long," Madam Xing nodded, then pulled the two servant women up from the ground and led her to stand outside the room.

Yu Wan was completely confused, but she knew that the Old Lady was a person who upheld the Marquis's family values, so she was not worried.

After quickly combing her hair and changing clothes, Yu Wan went out and followed Madam Xing to Honghui Hall.

Madam Xing walked in front, Yu Wan followed behind, and the two servant women walked on either side of Yu Wan. Anyone who saw them would know they were taking Yu Wan to be interrogated.

And so, they walked all the way to Leshou Hall under everyone's gaze.

In the main hall, the Old Lady was seated in the central position of honor, with Cui Yichu sitting beside her. Next to her was Feng Tang, and as for Zhuang Huaiyue, she was standing in attendance beside the Old Lady.

Seeing this setup of a joint trial, Yu Wan understood that she had likely been framed again.

Seeing that Cui Yichu was calm and composed with a hint of a smile in her eyes, she guessed it was her doing.

"Old Lady, Yu Wan is here."

The Old Lady looked at Yu Wan with a dark expression, her eyes filled with both fury and disappointment.

She had just rewarded her yesterday, but today such a scandal had come to light.

"Yu Wan, I'll give you a chance to explain yourself, so you don't have to wait for Xuanyou to return and deal with you."

"Old Lady," Yu Wan bowed respectfully to the Old Lady. "This servant was woken up by Madam Xing early this morning and truly does not know what has happened, so I don't know where to begin."

Feng Tang looked at Yu Wan's dark eye circles, her disheveled appearance from lack of sleep, and couldn't help but sneer. "Woken up early? I, as a concubine, woke up early, had breakfast, paid my respects to the Madam, and then to the Old Lady. What do you mean, a mere servant, saying you were woken up early?"

"Yu Wan is now a member of Honghui Hall. If the Heir does not pursue the matter, it's not wrong for her to sleep a little longer," Cui Yichu said softly.

"Madam is truly too lenient, which is why these servants are getting out of hand."

Yu Wan had no time to pay attention to Feng Tang.

Since Cui Yichu was pretending to be kind, the only one who could decide her fate in this room was the Old Lady.

She respectfully said, "This servant has not been feeling well these past two days. The Heir, in his kindness, allowed this servant to rest in the room without neglecting my duties."

Yu Wan was telling the truth, but the phrase "the Heir's kindness" was indeed grating to the ears of the women in the room.

"Hmph!" Feng Tang looked at her with disdain. "After doing such a shameful thing, you still have the face to mention the Heir?"

A shameful thing?

Yu Wan was getting more and more confused.

She looked at the Old Lady, whose face was as dark as water, but her eyes were similar to Feng Tang's, as if they wanted to devour her.

"Enough, since you're playing dumb, then we'll ask one thing at a time. Madam Xing."

"Here."

"You ask."

"Yes." Madam Xing was the most capable person by the Old Lady's side. She used to be the Old Lady's personal maid, and with the Old Lady's permission, Madam Xing turned to Yu Wan. "You haven't been to Honghui Hall to serve these past two days?"

"I went yesterday, helped Yingxue and Yuan Qing with some chores, but I arrived late and left early. Today, I was planning to go after waking up." Yu Wan told the truth.

Madam Xing said, "Have you been staying at Xiaoyue Pavilion these past two nights?"

"Yes."

What did it matter where she stayed?

Yu Wan was full of doubts but could only answer one question at a time.

"Huaiyue."

Madam Xing suddenly turned to Huaiyue. Huaiyue stepped forward from beside the Old Lady, glanced at Yu Wan with a cold look, and bowed to the Old Lady.

"You live next door to Yu Wan's room. Tell me, did you hear a man's voice coming from her room last night?"

Huaiyue?

A man's voice?

Yu Wan suddenly realized and felt like crying and laughing at the same time.

Yesterday, she had indeed made a lot of noise to help Zhao Xuanyou, and it turned out Huaiyue had heard it... This was really... So today's big drama was set up by Huaiyue.

It was all Zhao Xuanyou's fault.

He, the culprit, wasn't here, but she was being accused of being a wanton woman.

Seeing Yu Wan's relaxed expression, Huaiyue also felt a surge of anger.

Having gained Zhao Xuanyou's favor, she even dared to steal a man?

"Not only last night, but also yesterday morning when I woke up, I heard a man's voice talking in her room. I was suspicious but didn't confirm it. Last night, however, I heard it clearly."

Cui Yichu had been watching Yu Wan's expression. Seeing her suddenly relax and look confident, she suddenly thought of something.

But thinking of that possibility, Cui Yichu couldn't help but feel a pang of hatred.

Shameless...

Madam Xing nodded, signaling Huaiyue to step back, then called another woman forward.

This woman was the manager of the storeroom. Since Xiaoyue Pavilion was next to the storeroom, she was also given a room, though it was a bit farther from Yu Wan's.

"Zhao Quan's wife, Huaiyue said she heard a man's voice coming from Yu Wan's room for two consecutive nights. Did you hear it?"

"I didn't hear it the night before last, but last night..."

"Last night, what? Speak quickly."

Zhao Quan's wife glanced at Yu Wan and also showed some disdain. "It was the sound of... that kind of thing."

The Old Lady suddenly angered, "If you all heard it, why didn't you catch them in the act?"

"Old Lady, please calm down. I did hear it last night, but I didn't know where it was coming from. I was also half-asleep and thought it was a dream. In the morning, I met Miss Huaiyue, and we talked about it. Only then did we confirm it wasn't an illusion, but a real sound."

Yu Wan felt more and more wronged.

It was clearly Zhao Xuanyou who came to her room, and it was Zhao Xuanyou's voice. Such a huge accusation of stealing a man was placed on her.

Huaiyue blushed and said, "I didn't know what that sound was... so I went to confirm it in the morning."

She was an inexperienced young girl. Although the sound was a bit strange, she couldn't be sure.

Madam Xing said, "There was indeed that smell in Yu Wan's room. I checked it myself. The mat was lined with grass paper, all soiled."

"Enough, no need to ask further," the Old Lady angrily turned to Yu Wan. "After doing such a shameful thing, what do you have to say for yourself?"

---

chapters.title: The Scapegoat
chapters.content:
With so many people standing in Leshou Hall, under the gaze of everyone, Yu Wan considered for a moment and respectfully said to the Old Lady, "There is a reason for this matter. Please, Old Lady, dismiss the others so that this servant may explain in detail."

Zhao Xuanyou was a man who cared about face. If she were to reveal in public that he had been coming to Xiaoyue Pavilion night after night, he would surely be furious.

Even though it was Huaiyue who started this, in the end, she might be the one held accountable.

As a servant, enduring some hardship for her master was only right.

The Old Lady frowned upon hearing this. Feng Tang, seeing that the Old Lady was silent, thought she might have softened towards Yu Wan and angrily said, "Shut up! Who do you think you are? And who do you think is sitting here? A mere servant dares to ask others to leave. You really have no manners."

Cui Yichu silently sipped her tea, her eyes coldly watching from her seat, not saying a word.

Compared to her anger towards Yu Wan, at this moment, she despised Zhuang Huaiyue even more.

She had originally hoped that Zhuang Huaiyue, with her beauty and intelligence, could suppress Yu Wan's influence when sent to Zhao Xuanyou's side. Who knew she would be so stupid?

She wanted to deal with Yu Wan but couldn't even report the matter correctly, actually bringing it to the Old Lady's attention.

The Old Lady was a principled person and would surely give Yu Wan a chance to speak.

If Zhuang Huaiyue had reported to Cui Yichu early in the morning, she would have immediately sent someone to silence Yu Wan and dispose of her.

Even if it alarmed the Old Lady, with Zhao Quan's wife and Zhuang Huaiyue as witnesses, she would never protect Yu Wan.

By the time Zhao Xuanyou returned to the mansion, the situation would be settled, and no matter how angry he was, he couldn't punish everyone in the mansion.

How foolish... to waste such a good opportunity!

Yu Wan saw that the Old Lady was silent, so she looked at Madam Xing beside her. "Please, Madam Xing, convey this for me."

Madam Xing looked at the Old Lady, waiting for her nod before walking over to Yu Wan.

Yu Wan leaned close to Madam Xing's ear and whispered a sentence. The people in Leshou Hall clearly saw a flicker of surprise in Madam Xing's otherwise calm eyes.

Madam Xing quickly composed herself and walked briskly to the Old Lady's side, whispering what Yu Wan had said to the Old Lady.

The Old Lady's expression was exceptionally rich.

She looked up at Yu Wan, her eyes filled with disbelief.

Yu Wan lowered her gaze and said nothing.

After a moment, the Old Lady slowly stood up from her chair and said to Yu Wan, "Come in to explain."

"Yes." At this point, Yu Wan finally let out a sigh of relief, and her tense expression relaxed.

The others in Leshou Hall watched the scene. Although they were still confused, they all understood that Yu Wan had resolved the immediate crisis.

Under everyone's strange gazes, Yu Wan followed the Old Lady into the inner room.

Although Leshou Hall was somewhat remote, it was very spacious.

The Old Lady lived alone in this large courtyard, which had a special room for worshipping Buddha and copying sutras, as well as a special room for tea and rest.

Yu Wan followed her into the tea room. Inside, there was a low table with a cushion on either side.

The room had large windows on three sides. At the moment, the windows were open with gauze curtains, offering a view of the green shade in the courtyard, which was particularly pleasing to the eye.

"Speak. What exactly happened?" The Old Lady sat on the cushion, looking at Yu Wan with a composed expression.

Such a big commotion had to be clarified.

"In response to the Old Lady, the person who stayed at Xiaoyue Pavilion these past two nights was indeed the Heir."

The Old Lady displeasedly said, "Why would he, in good health, not sleep in Honghui Hall and instead go to Xiaoyue Pavilion to crowd in? You are his concubine, and serving him in Honghui Hall is proper. Do you two need to sneak around?"

The rooms in Xiaoyue Pavilion were the best servant quarters in the Marquis's mansion, but they were still just individual rooms with a window, incomparable to the places where the masters lived.

The Old Lady truly couldn't imagine how Zhao Xuanyou, with his tall figure, could sleep on that narrow bed.

Moreover, there was also Yu Wan?

Yu Wan pinched her fingers, feeling a bit wronged.

Although she had passed this obstacle today, in the Old Lady's eyes, it was certainly she who had lured Zhao Xuanyou to Xiaoyue Pavilion.

"He allowed me to rest, but then he came over himself?" the Old Lady asked again.

Yu Wan didn't dare to say more.

If she continued, it would sound like she was blaming Zhao Xuanyou. Given the Old Lady's affection for her grandson, whatever she said would be wrong.

After a moment of silence, the Old Lady looked at Yu Wan and sighed. "If you've had your period, you mustn't act recklessly. Even though you're a servant, you don't need to do such things."

Seeing that the Old Lady had misunderstood again, Yu Wan hurriedly said, "The Heir came to Xiaoyue Pavilion only to rest. He joked around with this servant for a while. Perhaps the people next door heard it, but we didn't do anything."

"If you didn't do anything, how could others have heard it?" The Old Lady said, becoming a bit angry again. Seeing Yu Wan lowering her head, she softened her heart. "Forget it. This matter isn't your fault. It's just that I heard what Zhao Quan's wife and Huaiyue said and got angry, so I sent people to bring you here. If I had known it would be like this, I should have let Madam Xing ask a few questions first."

Now that she had calmed down to think, how could Yu Wan have stolen a man?

She had already gained Xuanyou's favor. Was there any man in the Marquis's mansion worth her stealing?

"How do we handle such a big commotion?"

Yu Wan said, "When I was called over, the others didn't know why I was coming to Leshou Hall. Maybe we can come up with some excuse to gloss over it."

Madam Xing, hearing Yu Wan say this, had an idea. "Since it was caused by Zhao Quan's wife and Huaiyue, we can just say they heard wrong. There's no need to cover it up."

"That's good. Just say it was a mistake," the Old Lady nodded. "You go handle it. Also, inform the others in Leshou Hall. Since they are all family, it should be easy to manage."

Cui Yichu and Feng Tang were masters and naturally wouldn't go around spreading rumors. Zhao Quan's wife was an old servant of the Marquis's mansion and understood the rules. As for Huaiyue, she would be admonished separately later.

"Yes." Madam Xing respectfully retreated, leaving the Old Lady and Yu Wan sitting in the tea room.

The Old Lady looked at Yu Wan. Her hair and clothes were neat, but it was clear they had been hastily arranged.

Having practiced Buddhism for many years, she was originally a kind-hearted and soft-hearted person. She didn't think Yu Wan had seduced Zhao Xuanyou into misbehaving.

Of course, she didn't blame Zhao Xuanyou either.

This child had left the capital at the age of ten to take over the old Marquis's position. Over the years, he had been surrounded by old men.

Peers his age, even if they weren't married with multiple wives and concubines, would have a few childhood sweethearts or close female friends. But he had only taken a wife at the age of twenty.

"Were you dragged out by them today?"

The two servant women who had barged in were fierce, but after all, they were people from Leshou Hall. Yu Wan couldn't pursue the matter out of respect for the Old Lady.

She simply said, "When Madam Xing came, this servant was indeed still asleep. After they woke me up, they told me to quickly change and come to answer."

"Consider today's matter as if it never happened. In the future, just do as you have been. You are the Heir's concubine, and others cannot criticize you."

"This servant understands."

The Old Lady looked at her obedient appearance and slightly nodded. After thinking for a moment, she added, "There is a brocade box in the cabinet. Bring it to me."

chapters.title: Move Closer
chapters.content:
Yu Ying carried over a brocade box and placed it on the low table.

"Open it."

Yu Ying opened the brocade box. Inside were a dozen or so golden melon seeds, dazzling enough to blind the eye.

She had seen melon seeds before, but never golden ones.

The Hou residence was wealthy and luxurious, so this box of golden melon seeds was likely just a decoration in the tea room of the Old Dowager.

"Take a few," said Old Dowager Ye. "I'm rewarding you."

"This... this servant does not dare." Yu Ying was desperate for money and wished she could take the whole box, but she had to decline. "This servant acted improperly and caused such trouble for the Old Dowager. I do not dare accept the reward."

"You did act improperly, but the fault does not lie with you," Old Dowager Ye said slowly. "Yu Ying, you kept your composure and did not recklessly reveal Xuanyou outside. You did well. As his grandmother, I am rewarding you on his behalf. Take them."

"But this is all within my duties. Besides, I didn't speak out to preserve my own reputation."

"Take them quickly."

At this point, if Yu Ying refused again, it would be excessive. She smiled respectfully, reached out, and picked up one seed.

It was small, but surprisingly heavy.

"You girl, there's no need to be so cautious around me."

But Yu Ying did not dare take more.

How could she not be cautious?

In her past life, she had not been cautious enough and ended up dead!

Seeing that she did not move, Old Dowager Ye reached into the brocade box, grabbed a handful, and placed them on the table. "Take them all. I have plenty of these trinkets. They're just sitting here useless."

At a glance, there were at least a dozen or so on the table.

Yu Ying said, "Then this servant will take a few more."

She did not dare to be greedy. From the handful Old Dowager Ye had taken, she picked out five or six seeds.

"This servant thanks the Old Dowager for her generosity."

Compared to the ornate but impractical jade hairpins bestowed by Zhao Xuanyou, these golden melon seeds were a true relief for Yu Ying's urgent needs.

They were real gold, which could be used as money directly.

With them, she could invite a renowned acupuncturist to treat her mother...
