"This small reward is nothing," Old Dowager Ye said with a smile, looking at Yu Ying. "If you can bear a child for Xuanyou, I will give you this entire box of golden melon seeds."

A child?

Yu Ying said, "This servant does not know if she has such fortune."

In Old Dowager Ye's eyes, of course she did.

Yu Ying had a plump and graceful figure, clearly a woman well-suited for childbearing.

To be honest, Old Dowager Ye's fondness for Cui Yichu had waned significantly after learning she could not bear children.

A wife should be virtuous, but the most important thing was to continue the family line.

What good was a hen that couldn't lay eggs, no matter how beautiful, noble, or dignified?

The Jingyuan Hou residence had a small population, which ultimately was because Xuanyou's mother had difficulty bearing children.

The deceased was gone, and Old Dowager Ye did not want to speak ill of her, but she could not let Zhao Xuanyou follow in his father's footsteps.

The Jingyuan Hou residence must prosper with many descendants.

Thinking about it, Zhao Xuanyou going to Xiaoyue Pavilion to find Yu Ying was not a bad thing.

Old Dowager Ye was truly afraid that he would be completely focused on the court and military affairs, with no interest in women.

Now it seemed he not only had an interest in women, but a strong one at that.

This was a good thing, and it made her look more favorably upon Yu Ying.

The Jingyuan Hou residence was a military household, and Old Dowager Ye, following the family's style, rewarded and punished clearly.

"From now on, you don't need to live in Xiaoyue Pavilion," she decided after a moment. "I remember there is a side room next to Xuanyou's study, filled with his father's books. Later, I will have someone move the books to the storeroom. You can set up a bed there. Being closer to Xuanyou will make it more convenient for you to attend to him at night."

Move to Honghui Hall?

Yu Ying quite liked her room in Xiaoyue Pavilion, but being able to live next to Zhao Xuanyou's study and face him day and night would surely infuriate Cui Yichu.

Thinking of this, it was a great thing.

"This servant understands."

"Alas, after all this commotion, I haven't even started copying the scriptures for today."

"This servant does not dare disturb the Old Dowager's rest. I will take my leave."

Old Dowager Ye waved her hand. "Go. Rest more if you are not feeling well."

"Yes."

Yu Ying collected the remaining golden melon seeds on the table, put the brocade box back in its place, and then walked out.

Most of the people who had gathered to interrogate her had already left. Only Zhuang Huaiyue was still standing there, listening to Mama Xing with her head lowered.

Seeing Yu Ying come out, Mama Xing asked, "Is Yu Ying leaving?"

"Yes. The Old Dowager said she needs to copy scriptures, so I did not dare disturb her."

"Today's events have been most offensive." Earlier, Mama Xing had also believed Yu Ying was indeed stealing a man and had allowed those two servants to humiliate her. Now, of course, she had to apologize.

Yu Ying naturally would not pursue the matter. The Old Dowager had bestowed so many golden melon seeds upon her; she could afford to be magnanimous.

"It was all this servant's fault for following orders. I blame no one."

Yu Ying finished speaking and glanced at Zhuang Huaiyue out of the corner of her eye. Seeing her face flushed as she looked at her, Yu Ying did not want to pay her any mind and walked straight out of Honghui Hall.

After all this commotion, she was both hungry and thirsty.

As soon as she returned to Xiaoyue Pavilion, Yingxue hurriedly came forward, concerned. "I heard that Sister was taken away by people from Leshou Hall. I was so scared. What happened?"

"It was nothing, just a misunderstanding."

"As long as Sister is fine."

Yu Ying had been dragged out of her room by Mama Xing, and by now, the whole residence knew about it. Was it really just a misunderstanding?

"Thank you for always thinking of me. I'm starving."

Learning that Yu Ying had not eaten breakfast, Yingxue went to the kitchen to find food for her.

Yu Ying pushed open the door and returned to her room. Seeing the mess on the couch, she felt a headache coming on.

No wonder Mama Xing and the others had such bad expressions towards her. It was so filthy; who wouldn't be suspicious?

Fortunately, she had padded it with coarse paper beforehand.

She quickly tidied up the bed, washed her face, re-combed her hair into a bun, and inserted the jade hairpin given by Zhao Xuanyou.

Before long, Yingxue returned with a food box.

There was a plate of white rice cakes, a plate of pickled melon, and a bowl of mung bean porridge.

As she was eating, Manager Song arrived and congratulated Yu Ying, saying that people had already been sent to clean the side room in Honghui Hall. It was expected that she could move in by the afternoon.

Even though Yu Ying was reluctant to leave Xiaoyue Pavilion, she had to move.

Fortunately, she did not have many belongings, and with Yingxue's help, everything was packed and ready before lunchtime.

In the afternoon, she arrived at Honghui Hall, and the side room had just been cleaned.

Yuan Qing knew about Zhao Xuanyou's nocturnal activities. Hearing that Yu Ying had been taken to Leshou Hall, he smiled when he saw her. It was Yingxue who helped move her things and led her to the side room.

This side room was actually smaller than the one in Xiaoyue Pavilion, but the bed and cabinets inside were exquisitely made, as if crafted specifically for this room.

After a busy half-day, Yu Ying was indeed tired. After a simple tidying up, she lay down in her new home.

As she dozed off, she vaguely felt someone had joined her on the bed.

She knew who it was but felt helpless.

She had just been humiliated because of him, and now, as soon as he returned, he was squeezing in beside her again.

Yu Ying opened her eyes and met Zhao Xuanyou's dark, ambiguous gaze, which seemed to hold a hint of a smile.

"I heard you were arrested today?"

---

chapters.title: Feeling Sorry for Her
chapters.content:
The two of them were lying so close together that, although fully clothed, it felt as if they were not.

In broad daylight, Yu Ying did not want to make any noise.

The Old Dowager liked her and was generous with rewards. Yu Ying wanted to be an obedient and sensible concubine to continue receiving her generosity.

She moved back slightly and said pitifully, "Does the Young Master still mock this servant?"

This was not an act.

Early in the morning, she had been cursed at and dragged out of her room, causing a commotion throughout the residence. If it weren't for those golden melon seeds, Yu Ying could have cried.

His eyes darkened slightly. "What exactly happened?"

"Last night's noise was heard by others in Xiaoyue Pavilion. This morning, they went to Leshou Hall to report, saying that this servant was stealing a man."

"Grandmother actually believed it?" Zhao Xuanyou sneered.

Yu Ying was serving him now. Who else could she be stealing? How could Grandmother believe their nonsense and make such a big scene to arrest her?

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's silence, Yu Ying roughly guessed what he was thinking.

It was illogical for her to steal a man, but was it logical for him, the Young Master, to sleep in a servant's room in Xiaoyue Pavilion every night?

Of course, Yu Ying would not argue with him. She simply said, "Huaiyue and Zhao Quan's family all said so. The Old Dowager must have believed them a little."

"What did you say in Leshou Hall?"

"This servant reported the truth to the Old Dowager alone in the tea room. The Old Dowager understood and said they had misheard, so the matter was settled."

Quite clever.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at the jade hairpin in Yu Ying's hair, its green luster dripping. He reached out and lightly tapped it. It was indeed much better than the inferior jade hairpins she had worn before.

Seeing that he was not speaking, she knew he did not mind.

After all, the person arrested was not him, and others' idle talk would not reach him.

Yu Ying changed the subject with a smile. "Why did the Young Master return so early today?"

"I have a drinking appointment tonight. I came back to change clothes first."

"Then... this servant will help the Young Master change."

It seemed someone had specifically instructed it. The bed placed in the side room by Manager Song was not the narrow, long bed from Xiaoyue Pavilion; it was wide enough for two people.

But as he pressed against her side, it still felt heavy.

He heard Yu Ying's intention to send him away. Normally, he would not be pleased with this little servant arranging him so.

But thinking that she had just been taken to Leshou Hall for questioning and was physically weak during her period, Zhao Xuanyou had no reason to be angry.

On the contrary, watching her rack her brains to coax him into leaving, and recalling how she had been exhausted to the point of her hands going soft last night, Zhao Xuanyou was even in a good mood.

"Lie down."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou finally let go and got up.

Since the matter of catching an adulterer had been stirred up in the residence, Zhao Xuanyou decided to pay a visit to Leshou Hall to have a proper talk with his grandmother.

But... looking at Yu Ying's soft and delicate figure lying weakly on the bed, Zhao Xuanyou could not help but give her a light pinch.

Yu Ying instinctively moved to protect her chest, but it was too late.

"The Young Master should go change quickly. Don't delay your outing."

Listening to her slightly aggrieved complaint, Zhao Xuanyou smiled and left the side room. He saw that Yuan Qing had already hung the casual clothes he was going to change into on the rack.

Yu Ying's side room was connected to his bedroom, separated only by a screen. It was indeed convenient.

Grandmother had been thoughtful.

Zhao Xuanyou removed his official robes and changed into his casual clothes before heading to Leshou Hall.

Inside Leshou Hall, Old Dowager Ye had just woken up from her nap. When Mama Xing told her that Zhao Xuanyou had arrived, she had him brought in directly.

Old Dowager Ye sat up from the bed and put on her clothes but did not get up.

Mama Xing brought a chair for Zhao Xuanyou and respectfully retreated, allowing the grandmother and grandson to talk in private.

"Did you come to settle accounts with this old woman?" Old Dowager Ye knew Zhao Xuanyou was filial, but seeing him return to the residence and come straight to Leshou Hall, she could not help but tease him.

Zhao Xuanyou smiled. "This grandson came to apologize to Grandmother."

"What have you done wrong?"

Faced with his grandmother's questioning, Zhao Xuanyou felt somewhat embarrassed and could not help but raise his hand to cover his thin lips, coughing lightly.

He finally understood why Yu Ying had been so eager to push him away earlier.

He felt a little flustered just from his grandmother's teasing question. How much more so for Yu Ying, who had been taken from Xiaoyue Pavilion to Leshou Hall for questioning?

Thinking of her red-eyed, pitiful appearance, Zhao Xuanyou rarely felt a pang of cruelty in himself.

"It was this grandson's fault for acting improperly, almost causing the servants to laugh."

Old Dowager Ye had not blamed Yu Ying, so naturally, she did not blame him. Hearing this, she laughed. "You've been in the military too long. You're used to doing things your own way. I'm too lazy to scold you. Don't do it again in the future."

"Yes, this grandson understands."

"Since you like Yu Ying and need someone by your side, I see that she is clever and obedient. I might as well let her live in Honghui Hall from now on to make it convenient for her to serve you."

"Grandmother is always so thoughtful."

Zhao Xuanyou did not need many servants for many things. Previously, Yuan Qing and Yuan Zao's help had been enough. But now that he was back in the capital, following local customs and having a maidservant attend to him was indeed a different experience.

Old Dowager Ye looked at Zhao Xuanyou and remembered something. "Tomorrow is Yichu's birthday. She doesn't want a big celebration, so I originally thought to prepare one for her, but she declined. So I prepared a gift for her."

Zhao Xuanyou understood. Grandmother was reminding him to give Cui Yichu the proper respect.

"I have already agreed with her to return tomorrow for a meal at Tingyu Pavilion."

"Xuanyou, don't blame Grandmother for being long-winded."

Zhao Xuanyou guessed what Grandmother wanted to say, but in front of her, he always had patience.

"Grandmother, please speak."

"Regardless of whether Yichu can bear children for you, she is already your wife. You are the master of the Hou residence, and she is the mistress. Yu Ying, no matter how good she is, is still just a servant girl. You may like Yu Ying, and I may like Yu Ying. Liking her and rewarding her with more things is fine, but you must never let her overshadow Yichu in this residence."

"This grandson understands."

Did he really understand?

Looking at Zhao Xuanyou's eyes, Old Dowager Ye sighed softly in her heart.

To be honest, she did not quite understand Zhao Xuanyou. When he had first returned to the residence, he had been as close as one person with Cui Yichu. How had it been so short a time before he became close with Yu Ying?

From what she knew of Zhao Xuanyou, he did not seem like such a flirtatious person.

However, her grandson was already grown and married. She could not lecture him on whom he should or should not like. She could only advise him from the perspective of maintaining peace in the household.

The balance within the inner residence was profound, yet simple.

Ever since the night of the water incident when Zhao Xuanyou had carried Yu Ying back to Honghui Hall, the scales within the Hou residence had completely tipped in Yu Ying's favor.

Originally, Old Dowager Ye should have reprimanded Yu Ying, but she had learned from the residence physician that Cui Yichu could not bear children.

For the sake of having a grandson, Old Dowager Ye had to rely on Yu Ying. But it would not be good if Zhao Xuanyou only liked Yu Ying. If the legitimate wife was out of favor, the household would lack stability, and chaos could easily arise.

In simple terms, whoever Zhao Xuanyou spent the night with held the influence.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's vague response, Old Dowager Ye had to make her words clearer and gave him an ultimatum.

"Tomorrow night, after you go to Tingyu Pavilion, don't just eat and leave. Stay and rest there for the night."

chapters.title: A Playful Tug
chapters.content:
When Yu Yuan saw Zhao Xuanyou again, it was nearly the Hai hour.

As soon as Zhao Xuanyou entered the room, Yuan Qing withdrew.

He called out twice for tea, but no one came. Yu Yuan heard his temper rising and emerged from the side room.

Moving to Honghui Hall had brought her closer to him, but also closer to trouble.

Even though today was supposed to be a day off for her, she still had to attend to him.

"Master, it's already this late; no more tea. This servant will have someone prepare a sobering soup."

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes at her. Before she could go give the order, he swept her into his arms with a long reach.

"Do you think I'm drunk?"

He reeked of alcohol, clearly having drunk a lot, but when Yu Yuan met his gaze, she saw his eyes were clear; he wasn't drunk at all.

Yu Yuan softly replied, "This servant misspoke. Master has a great capacity for drink. How could you be drunk?"

Pleased with her answer, he pulled her even closer, unable to resist planting a kiss on her cheek.

Feeling his restless hands, Yu Yuan said, "This servant should help Master change clothes first."

Zhao Xuanyou’s mood soured at her words. He wanted to be angry, but then remembered her condition.

Yet he still couldn’t let it go, and in the end, he yanked off her belt.

"Master, this servant…"

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes burned with desire, refusing to back down. "It’s just a belt. It’s only the two of us here anyway."

Only the two of us?

Yu Yuan pondered his words, sensing something was off.

If it was just the two of them, why did he undo her belt?

Did he want her to be completely bare in this room?

Yu Yuan was willing to seduce and please him, but not to that extent.

Seeing his smug expression, a rebellious spark ignited in her. She reached out and tugged at his belt, pulling his shoulder bare.

"Hmph." Seeing Yu Yuan show her claws, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t get angry; instead, he laughed.

Yu Yuan had always greeted him with smiles and attentive service, but he had always known she wasn’t truly docile. Deep down, she was stubborn and defiant.

If others dared to poison, she dared to set fires.

He had only taken her belt, yet she retaliated by not only undoing his belt but also baring his shoulder.

But... in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes, he was still the one who came out ahead.

Yu Yuan’s counterattack only added to the allure.

"Now... isn’t it my turn?" Zhao Xuanyou said with a half-smile, extending a finger to hook her apricot-colored dress.

Yu Yuan knew when to stop. She lowered her gaze and meekly rearranged his clothes, sweetly smiling as she said, "This servant was wrong. Since Master doesn’t want sobering soup, this servant will prepare tea."

"Cold tea." Zhao Xuanyou finally let her go.

He had drunk strong liquor that evening, and now his throat was slightly parched; he wanted cold tea to quench his thirst.

"Yes."

Watching her belt lie on the floor, Yu Yuan smiled as she stood, holding her dress with both hands.

The summer dress was thin, if she didn’t hold it, the undershirt beneath would be exposed.

Yu Yuan quickly returned to the side room, tied a new belt around her waist, and then went to the outer room to bring him tea.

Zhao Xuanyou took the tea and, seeing her belted again, narrowed his eyes slightly. "So afraid of me?"

"This servant isn’t afraid of Master, it’s just…"

"Just what?"

Feeling his gaze sweeping over her, his expression clearly cooling, Yu Yuan had no choice but to explain softly, "When a woman is in her time, her body is weaker than usual. This servant is afraid of catching a chill if she undresses."

His angry look was somewhat terrifying. Yu Yuan feared his anger and didn’t want to upset him, so she did her best to soothe him.

This reason... Zhao Xuanyou could barely accept.

After he finished his tea, Yu Yuan went out to fetch water for him to wash up.

Pushing open the door to the corridor, she saw Yuan Qing and Yingxue sitting by the stove whispering. Furious, she urged them to hurry inside and attend to him.

Only then did the two quickly enter; one carrying a washbasin, the other a foot basin.

Yu Yuan didn’t want to go in. She sat in Yingxue’s previous spot to catch her breath.

After a while, Yingxue came out and secretly slipped something into Yu Yuan’s hand.

Yu Yuan looked down; it was the belt Zhao Xuanyou had torn off earlier.

"Thank you." There was nothing to explain about such a thing.

Yingxue blushed and whispered, "Elder sister, go inside quickly. Master has changed into his sleeping clothes but hasn’t lain down; he must be waiting for you."

A man in high spirits; Yu Yuan truly had nowhere to hide.

She tucked the belt away and walked toward the room. Before entering the inner chamber, she heard Yuan Qing reporting something to Zhao Xuanyou from behind the screen.

She hadn’t meant to eavesdrop and was about to leave when she was called.

"Come in."

Yu Yuan had no choice but to enter.

Zhao Xuanyou sat on the couch in a dark green sleeping robe, his black hair cascading down to his waist. Without his usual dignified demeanor, he looked even more strikingly handsome.

Seeing Yu Yuan, he beckoned her over and pointed to his shoulder.

Yu Yuan approached, kneeling beside the couch to massage his shoulders.

Yuan Qing, seeing Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, continued his report: "There are also six gold items and six jade items, thirty-six in total. Master, is that enough?"

"For a tenth birthday, that should be sufficient. Send them over first thing tomorrow."

"Yes."

Yuan Qing didn’t dare glance at the couch, quickly bowing his head and slipping out.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head, glancing at the woman beside him.

"Strong hands."

His muscles were firm; ordinary women couldn’t massage him properly, but her strength was just right.

"Master has forgotten; this servant used to do rough work, so of course her hands are strong."

Zhao Xuanyou lightly hummed in acknowledgment, then suddenly grabbed her hand.

Her fingers were slender and fair, quite beautiful.

But upon closer inspection, the skin on her index finger was slightly tougher, with a thin callus on the pad; hands that had done hard work.

Yet Zhao Xuanyou didn’t mind at all.

He practiced martial arts year-round, his hands calloused from gripping weapons. Feeling Yu Yuan’s hands, he instead found them familiar, holding them affectionately.

"Does Master have another engagement tomorrow evening?" Yu Yuan asked with a smile.

"Tomorrow evening... no engagements."

He didn’t want to see Cui Yichu, but he had promised to return for her birthday, so he had to decline other banquets.

Moreover, his grandmother had given a strict order for him to stay overnight at Tingyu Pavilion.

Yu Yuan said, "Just now, I heard Yuan Qing mention preparing gifts. I thought Master was going to another family’s banquet tomorrow evening."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes narrowed slightly.

Normally, he didn’t need to inform Yu Yuan of his plans.

But since the topic had come up, he was curious to see her reaction upon learning he was going to see Cui Yichu.

He feigned nonchalance. "Tomorrow is Madam’s birthday. Those gifts are for her."

Cui Yichu’s birthday?

That would be her twentieth, then.

A major milestone; no wonder Zhao Xuanyou had prepared so many gifts. Just from what she’d heard, there were six gold and six jade items.

On such an auspicious day, Yu Yuan... should also present a grand gift.

---

chapters.title: Soiled Three Times
chapters.content:
Yu Yuan was lost in thought, unconsciously easing her grip.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her distracted expression, his eyebrow twitching slightly as he asked indifferently, "What are you thinking about?"

"Nothing." Yu Yuan snapped back to reality, softly replying, "This servant was just wondering, since it’s a major tenth birthday, Madam should celebrate grandly. Why is it so quiet?"

In truth, Cui Yichu had deliberately arranged it this way.

With no male heirs in the marquis’s residence, and both the marquis and the master away, only the old matriarch and the young mistress remained at home. Too much socializing would invite gossip.

Thus, apart from occasional visits from relatives, they usually refrained from hosting banquets.

Two months ago, Cui Yichu had thrown an extravagant birthday feast for Lady Ye to demonstrate filial piety. Now, for her own birthday, she claimed it was inappropriate to be extravagant, earning praise from Lady Ye for her frugality.

Originally, she hadn’t known Zhao Xuanyou would return to the capital at this time. Inviting guests now would seem rushed, so a simple family dinner would suffice.

"She doesn’t want a big celebration. Grandmother will arrange a table for her at noon, and in the evening, I’ll accompany her for a meal at Tingyu Pavilion."

"Madam has always lived in seclusion; she does prefer quiet over noise."

Once Zhao Xuanyou went to Tingyu Pavilion tomorrow, Cui Yichu would surely seize the opportunity to mend their relationship.

Yu Yuan couldn’t let her have it so easy.

A faint smile tugged at Yu Yuan’s lips as she looked at Zhao Xuanyou. "Since Master is going to Madam’s tomorrow, you should rest early tonight to be well-prepared."

Before Zhao Xuanyou could respond, Yu Yuan stepped off the couch, and he reached out, grabbing her sleeve.

"Where are you going?"

"To let Master rest well. This servant will return to the side room tonight."

"Does it matter?" Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes, his voice deepening. "Isn’t there enough room here for you?"

Yu Yuan’s cheeks flushed. She timidly glanced at Zhao Xuanyou. "This servant’s... time is not yet over. I’m afraid of soiling Master’s couch."

"How long must I wait?" Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened, clearly displeased.

"Until tomorrow. The day after should be fine." Yu Yuan counted on her fingers.

Her monthly cycle usually lasted three or four days. Today was already the last heavy day, if there was nothing tomorrow, the day after would indeed be clean.

"The day after?" Zhao Xuanyou emphasized, his tone heavy.

Clearly, if Yu Yuan tried to evade him again the day after, he wouldn’t listen.

"Mm." Yu Yuan smiled, pausing before tilting her head thoughtfully. "This servant is truly too embarrassed to soil Master’s clothes again. Counting them... it’s happened three times already."

Three times?

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t mind much.

Yu Yuan, however, counted seriously: "The night before last, and yesterday a little... and then..."

She drew out her words, subtly watching Zhao Xuanyou’s reaction.

"The night Master first returned to the capital."

Zhao Xuanyou let out an "oh."

As she reached the crucial point, Yu Yuan’s heart raced; afraid of saying too much and revealing her intent, yet afraid of saying too little and him not understanding.

She smiled. "That night, I was half-asleep. When Master got up, I was still sleeping. After waking, I saw myself... quite soiled. I assumed Master was the same."

The night he first returned to the capital?

That was their first time together. They had indeed gone to the side room for a thorough wash afterward.

Yu Yuan cautiously observed Zhao Xuanyou’s expression, wondering if he had caught the implication.

Thinking of Cui Yichu’s birthday tomorrow, Yu Yuan’s gift had to be delivered.

She steeled herself and made her words even clearer.

"At the time, this servant was quite puzzled."

"Puzzled about what?"

"Master and Madam have been married for a year. Madam had this servant serve Master in her place, and this servant... bled. Wouldn’t Master find that strange?"

With the words laid out so plainly, how could Zhao Xuanyou, as clever as he was, fail to see the oddity in Cui Yichu’s behavior?

Clearly, she had sent Yu Yuan to take her place in bed, even letting Yu Yuan bleed on her couch.

And that wedding night blood... had Yu Yuan bled for her as well?

Then what was Cui Yichu planning to do?

When she eventually shared a bed with Zhao Xuanyou herself, what would happen if she bled again?

Unless... she knew she wouldn’t bleed.

Something in Zhao Xuanyou’s mind collapsed with a crash.

Yu Yuan sat beside him, watching the light in his eyes dim little by little, until a ruthless glint appeared.

"Master?" Yu Yuan feigned ignorance, calling out softly. When he remained silent, she decided to retreat, whispering, "This servant will extinguish the candles."

She quietly stood, blew out the candle by the couch, and in the darkness, slipped away to the side room.

Lying on the couch, Yu Yuan couldn’t sleep at all. She listened carefully for any movement outside, but all she heard was the rustling of bamboo leaves in the night wind.

Today, she had taken a risk by bringing up Cui Yichu’s shameful secret in front of Zhao Xuanyou. Once he came to his senses, he would surely realize her provocation.

So what?

Before he came for her, he would certainly go to Cui Yichu first to settle the score.

Tomorrow’s intimate birthday dinner at Tingyu Pavilion would likely be quite lively.

The next morning, when Yu Yuan woke, Zhao Xuanyou was already practicing martial arts in the courtyard.

Even though he had taken up a civil post in the capital, he insisted on daily training.

Yu Yuan stood on the veranda, watching him silently.

In the morning light, the man moved with powerful, fluid motions, his robes billowing. He exuded an aura of overwhelming might, unmatched in vigor.

Yu Yuan had never seen him wield a sword in battle, but she knew that with him present, the enemy would be intimidated, and the tide of war would turn in their favor.

After about the time it takes to burn a stick of incense, Zhao Xuanyou finally finished his routine.

Seeing the sweat on his brow, Yu Yuan hurried over with a towel.

He took it and wiped his forehead. Yu Yuan said, "Yuan Qing has prepared warm water."

"Mm." Zhao Xuanyou replied, then glanced at Yu Yuan. "Don’t you have anything to do in the morning? Why are you standing there like a post?"

His tone was no different from usual.

Had he not understood her hints yesterday? Or did he simply not care?

Was there any man who wouldn’t care about being cuckolded?

Doubt gnawed at her, but Yu Yuan didn’t dare bring it up again.

Noticing the playful tone in his voice, she smiled back. "This servant wasn’t standing like a post. I was waiting to attend to Master. Yuan Qing is preparing the water, Yingxue is preparing the meal, and this servant is on standby."

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled, tossing the towel back to her before heading inside to wash up.

The morning passed like any other. Zhao Xuanyou had breakfast, then left for the yamen, returning only at the Shenshi hour (around 3-5 PM).

After changing into casual clothes, he sat in the study reviewing documents. As dinnertime approached, Baochuan came to invite him to Tingyu Pavilion, and he followed.

Upon entering Tingyu Pavilion, he saw the courtyard adorned with vibrant flowers; roses and wisteria in full bloom.

Baochuan led him through the moon gate, straight to the back courtyard. Here, a circle of purple bamboo lined the walls, with not a single flower in sight, arranged with exceptional elegance.

Cui Yichu wore a light purple dress embroidered with irises, her hair piled high in an elaborate bun, adorned with golden hairpins.

Upon seeing Zhao Xuanyou, she stood up, her face lit with joy.

Long pearl earrings dangled from her ears, swaying gently with her movements, accentuating her graceful neck and fair collarbone.

"Master," she said, "you’ve arrived."

chapters.title: Rekindling the Wedding Night
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu was the renowned number one beauty of the capital. With such meticulous adornment, she appeared even more elegant and captivating than she had on her wedding night the previous year.

Yet, when Zhao Xuanyou saw her breathtaking beauty, not a hint of admiration flickered in his eyes.

"Mmm," he replied indifferently, his expression unchanging.

In the backyard, a rosewood round table was set with four cold dishes, four fruit platters, and a single jade wine pot.

Cui Yichu had gone to great lengths with her appearance, but Zhao Xuanyou didn't spare her a single glance. A wave of disappointment washed over her.

However, the birthday banquet hadn't started yet; the main event was still to come. She took a deep breath and forced a smile back onto her face.

"Young Master, please."

She gracefully stepped forward, personally pulling out the chair for Zhao Xuanyou. Only after he was seated did she sit beside him.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou had no intention of speaking, Cui Yichu turned to Baochuan and instructed, "Serve the hot dishes."

"Yes."

An outsider's perspective is clearer. Though Baochuan wasn't quick-witted, even she could see the coldness in Zhao Xuanyou's demeanor. She couldn't help but feel a pang of anxiety for her mistress.

But her mistress had been planning for tonight for a long time; there was no turning back now, whether it succeeded or not.

Cook Yu had long been prepared. At Baochuan's command, the green-clad maidservants entered in a line, quickly setting a table full of steaming delicacies.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up his chopsticks and began eating without a word, showing no intention of offering birthday greetings or small talk.

Seeing this, Cui Yichu had no choice but to pick up her own chopsticks and serve him food.

She gently told him the name and origin of each dish, but he simply ate, completely ignoring her words.

When Zhao Xuanyou had eaten his fill, Cui Yichu lifted the jade wine pot to pour him a drink.

"Master, this is the lychee wine I brewed myself. Try it."

Lychees were precious; transporting them from Lingnan to the capital was no easy feat. Even the concubines in the palace found them rare.

It was a testament to the wealth and small size of the Jingyuan Marquis's household that they not only had lychees to eat daily but also enough to brew into wine.

"Not bad."

As the wine flowed from the jade pot, a sweet fragrance of lychee filled the air.

Zhao Xuanyou lifted the cup and drank it in one go.

Seeing his silent resistance, Cui Yichu had no choice but to say, "Master, I loved the gift you sent this morning."

"Good that you liked it." Zhao Xuanyou's reply was brief.

Cui Yichu reached out a slender finger to touch the golden hairpin in her hair. "I couldn't resist wearing it tonight. Does Master think it looks good?"

Zhao Xuanyou looked up. It was a golden filigree egret and lotus hairpin.

The goldsmith's craftsmanship was exquisite, creating a lifelike scene of an egret lingering among lotus flowers. As she touched it, the pin swayed gently, vivid and true to life.

The hairpin was indeed beautiful.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't speak, merely giving a slight nod.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou had no intention of engaging with her, Cui Yichu, with her usual proud temperament, would normally refuse to fawn over him, let alone subject herself to his cold shoulder.

Who was she?

She was the legitimate daughter of a ducal family, the mistress of the Marquis's household, a companion reader to the princess, the number one beauty of the capital.

She, Cui Yichu, had been the center of attention since birth. Men had always courted her; she had never had to lower herself to seek their favor.

But what could she do?

If she didn't try to win Zhao Xuanyou back, that wretched Yu Wan would climb higher and higher, and one day, she would step on her head.

"Thank you for your gift, Master. From now on, I will wear it every day. To show my gratitude, I toast you." Cui Yichu refilled Zhao Xuanyou's cup and poured one for herself.

She raised her cup to Zhao Xuanyou. After a moment's hesitation, he picked up his own.

"Master." Cui Yichu lightly clinked her cup against his. The two jade cups emitted a crisp "clink," pleasing to the ear.

She drank her cup in one go, while Zhao Xuanyou took a sip before placing it back on the table.

She watched but didn't dare to urge him.

"It seems Master doesn't like lychee wine," Cui Yichu said with a flattering smile, ordering Baochuan to bring over some top-quality bamboo leaf green liquor instead.

This time, Zhao Xuanyou drank all the wine she poured for him.

The two sat in the backyard in heavy silence.

Cui Yichu tried her best to find something to say, but no matter what she brought up, Zhao Xuanyou dismissed her with a word or two.

Helpless, they could only drink cup after cup.

After a pot of bamboo leaf green liquor, a flush appeared on both their faces.

The moon gradually climbed to the center of the sky, the bright moon and cool breeze filling the courtyard with a sweet fragrance.

It was at this moment that Cui Yichu felt Zhao Xuanyou no longer seemed as cold and distant as before.

"Master, it's getting late, and a wind has picked up outside. Shall we go inside and continue our conversation?"

"Alright."

Zhao Xuanyou replied with a hoarse voice, his gaze sweeping over her. Indeed, it seemed more blurred than before.

Under such a gaze, Cui Yichu's heart suddenly began to race.

In the first eighteen years of her life, her every thought had been of another man. After all those hopes were shattered, she was forced to marry Zhao Xuanyou under her parents' arrangement.

In the days leading up to the wedding, she had felt as if she were living in hell.

But the moment she saw Zhao Xuanyou, she suddenly felt at peace, with not a trace of regret for the past.

Zhao Xuanyou was truly a dragon among men, a son of heaven.

She had taken a fancy to him and was willing to be his wife.

If only that wretched Yu Wan hadn't interfered... Tonight was her chance; she had to win Zhao Xuanyou's heart back.

He was already half-drunk; the things she had prepared should be able to deceive him.

Cui Yichu tucked a loose strand of hair behind her ear, smiled softly, and called out "Master" in a gentle voice. She took his hand and led him into the house.

Zhao Xuanyou seemed genuinely drunk, allowing her to guide him inside.

Baochuan followed behind them. As soon as they entered the room, she closed the door and shooed all the maidservants out of the courtyard.

Only a dim candle flickered inside.

Cui Yichu helped Zhao Xuanyou into the inner room, and they sat down together on the edge of the bed.

The candlelight flickered, merging their shadows into one.

Cui Yichu reached out to touch something placed at the edge of the bed; a white porcelain bottle containing a small amount of human blood.

This had been specially sent to her by her mother.

During her wedding, her mother had suggested she prepare some human blood to pass off as her own virgin blood. But at that time, she had been too proud, dissatisfied with Zhao Xuanyou as her husband. She considered herself to have married beneath her station, believing he was unworthy of her. She had scoffed at her mother's suggestion, refusing to consider it.

But when she saw Zhao Xuanyou in the bridal chamber, she wavered. She regretted it, wishing she could immediately become his woman.

Tonight, she would correct that mistake.

Cui Yichu withdrew her hand and turned to Zhao Xuanyou.

"Master, let's change clothes."

She spoke softly and reached for his belt.

But the moment her hand touched his narrow waist, it was firmly gripped.

She looked up in pain, meeting Zhao Xuanyou's cold eyes.

His expression was clear, with not a trace of drunkenness.

He looked at Cui Yichu, his gaze dark and fierce, like a wild beast about to tear her to pieces.

---

chapters.title: Slut
chapters.content:
In an instant, Cui Yichu's face lost all its color.

"Mas…"

She moved her lips, trying to force a smile, but facing Zhao Xuanyou's cold, emotionless gaze, she simply couldn't.

She wasn't stupid.

Just now, in the backyard while drinking, he had clearly looked at her with that blurred gaze, just like on their wedding night when he lifted her veil.

She had thought they had returned to that moment.

But now, his expression was clear, his eyes cold and sharp. It was evident he had been feigning drunkenness.

Why...

Before Cui Yichu could think it through, the hand he was gripping felt as if it were about to break.

Having always lived a life of luxury, she had never endured such pain. Tears immediately welled up in her eyes.

But her tears elicited not a shred of pity from Zhao Xuanyou.

"Please... please let go." Cui Yichu choked out.

"Hmph," Zhao Xuanyou coldly laughed, releasing her hand.

He hadn't intentionally increased his strength, but with his current cold and hardened heart, he hadn't held back. The delicate Cui Yichu was pushed to the ground by the force.

The golden filigree egret and lotus hairpin slid from her hair to the floor with a clear sound.

Cui Yichu looked up at him, her face streaked with tears. "Why is Master angry? I only wanted to help you change clothes."

"Change clothes?" A mocking glint appeared in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes. "Just change clothes?"

"Master is my husband. Even if I had other thoughts, was that wrong?"

Zhao Xuanyou sat on the bed, narrowing his eyes as he looked at Cui Yichu. "I'll ask you one thing. If you can explain it clearly, we can let bygones be bygones."

"What is it?" Cui Yichu's expression tightened, as if she saw a glimmer of hope. "As long as you ask, I will tell you everything, without hiding anything."

"Good." Zhao Xuanyou stared at her deeply, then reached for the edge of the bed where Cui Yichu had secretly touched earlier. From under the bedding, he pulled out a small white porcelain bottle hidden there.

The moment the porcelain bottle appeared, Cui Yichu felt a desperate sense of doom, knowing she could no longer keep up the pretense. Her entire body began to tremble uncontrollably.

Zhao Xuanyou acted as if he hadn't noticed her distress. He gently shook the bottle and continued, "What is this? Can Madame tell me?"

Cui Yichu bit her lip tightly, unable to utter a word.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced down at her from his lofty position, opened the bottle, and a sweet, metallic scent wafted out.

He was a general who had emerged from mountains of corpses and seas of blood; he was accustomed to this smell.

In the past, on the battlefield, the scent of an enemy's blood would excite him. But now, holding this bottle of human blood, he couldn't help but feel disgusted.

He recorked the bottle and looked at Cui Yichu with revulsion.

"If Madame can't answer, then I'll have to ask my father-in-law and mother-in-law."

"No!" Cui Yichu blurted out. "It has nothing to do with my parents. Everything... everything is my fault. Master, I beg you, don't ask them."

"Beg me?" Zhao Xuanyou let out a cold snort. "The Xingguo Duke's household has been playing me like a puppet. Now you beg me? Isn't it a little late?"

"How does Master want to deal with me?" Mentioning the Xingguo Duke's household, Cui Yichu's emotions calmed slightly. "I leave it entirely to your discretion."

Her last shred of dignity had been brutally torn away by Zhao Xuanyou. As far as she was concerned, there was nothing left to lose.

"Deal with you? Why? What crime have you committed?" Zhao Xuanyou slowly countered. "Is it a crime to hide a bottle under the bed? Should I punish you for that?"

These sarcastic words cut into Cui Yichu's heart like knives.

Cui Yichu finally realized that today, he hadn't just been pretending to be drunk. He had agreed to come and eat with her for the sole purpose of this moment.

She barely maintained her composure. "If Master doesn't blame me, then please rest."

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her expression and suddenly burst into laughter.

"How can I rest? According to Madame's plan, shouldn't you be here to help me change clothes, then act like a cheap courtesan to seduce me? Or perhaps you had your cook add bull penis and deer antler to the food today, waiting for me to get aroused so you could just spread your legs?"

Cui Yichu listened to his cold, venomous insults, her eyes wide with disbelief.

She silently cursed herself for not having dealt with Yu Wan sooner, which had led to so many hidden troubles.

One mistake led to another, and now, Zhao Xuanyou hated her to the core...

"Of course, the most important part of your plan is this porcelain bottle in my hand. You wanted to wait until after I touched you, then, under the cover of darkness, pour this blood on the bed. Why?"

Why...

Why...

"Because you, Cui Yichu, were already a slut before marrying into the Jingyuan Marquis's household, weren't you?"

The words "slut" struck like a blade, ruthlessly piercing Cui Yichu's heart, tearing apart all her dignity, nobility, and face.

This was the most embarrassing moment of Cui Yichu's life.

Of course, it wasn't the only one.

The last time she had suffered such humiliation was in the palace.

It was the Winter Solstice. When she was taken by the matron of the Kunning Palace to the Empress, the Empress had looked at her with the same gaze, her tone calmer than Zhao Xuanyou's but her words just as venomous.

This had happened only two years ago, but to Cui Yichu, it felt like a lifetime ago.

She couldn't remember exactly what the Empress had said. Or perhaps, after marrying Zhao Xuanyou, she had deliberately tried to forget everything that happened in the palace.

She was now the Young Master's wife of the Jingyuan Marquis's household. She still maintained her noble status and luxurious life, completely severing ties with the Cui Yichu who had been humiliated and despised by the Empress.

Unfortunately, Zhao Xuanyou's icy words dragged that distant memory back, merging the two Cui Yichus together, leaving her shattered and bleeding.

"No... no... I'm not a slut... I am... I am the daughter of the Xingguo Duke..."

Hearing her incoherent words, Zhao Xuanyou felt not the slightest bit of relief.

The Cui Yichu his grandmother had described in her letter was a heavenly proud daughter of the ducal family, with a face like a blossoming flower, a heart as pure as an orchid, and a beauty that all the talented scholars of the capital vied to marry.

Such a great beauty willing to marry him had filled Zhao Xuanyou, as a man, with both joy and pride.

Based on the few words in the letter, he had imagined the grace and charm of his future wife.

Even before returning to the capital, he had endlessly imagined the blissful life he would have after marriage.

He would love and cherish her as his father did his mother, even more so. He would protect her, spend his life with her, and make her the most envied woman in the capital.

Unfortunately, it was all destroyed.

This marriage had been a conspiracy of the Xingguo Duke's household from the very beginning.

His grandmother, himself, and the Jingyuan Marquis's household; all were mere pawns in someone else's game.

Zhao Xuanyou's hands clenched into tight fists. If there were a stone in his palm, it would have been crushed to dust by now.

"I'll ask you one last time. Who was that man?"

chapters.title: Passing the Long Night
chapters.content:
Cui Yichu was visibly shaken by the words, the shock and disbelief on her face even greater than when Zhao Xuanyou had exposed her loss of chastity.

She stared at Zhao Xuanyou, her face ashen.

"I can't say."

"Can't say?" Zhao Xuanyou restrained his emotions, his gaze toward Cui Yichu filled with disgust. "If you won't speak, then forget it. I said I would only ask once."

Zhao Xuanyou stood up and turned to leave.

Cui Yichu grabbed his robe. "Prince, whether you believe me or not, from the day I married you, I have been willing to be your wife."

Zhao Xuanyou, upon hearing this, did not get angry but instead laughed coldly. "Is that so? Then why didn't you consummate the marriage with me that night?"

"I..." Cui Yichu opened her mouth but couldn't utter a single word.

Zhao Xuanyou finished her sentence for her.

"Because before our wedding, you always harbored fantasies, thinking that your lover would come to snatch you away. That's why on our wedding night, you weren't prepared with this porcelain bottle."

At this, Cui Yichu finally laughed.

After losing her chastity and being expelled from the royal palace, she had spent every day hoping that the man would come forward and speak up.

With his status, if he had only opened his mouth, he could have at least secured a position for her as a concubine.

But he didn't.

In his heart, she was nothing more than a plaything.

Cui Yichu's eyes turned red, and her emotions finally erupted.

"Lover? How dare you call him a lover? Zhao Xuanyou, there are people in this world you cannot afford to offend!"

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her wild and hysterical state, and instead of anger, he laughed. "Perhaps. But those I cannot afford to offend are certainly not you, nor the Xingguo Duke's mansion."

"You want to deal with the Xingguo Duke's mansion? You're just the heir of a marquis' mansion; you can't even touch the Xingguo Duke's mansion!"

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Cui Yichu, feeling both hatred and pity for the woman before him.

Even when she was struggling to save herself, she was still concerned about her maiden family.

"I can offer you a way out now. You are the granddaughter-in-law chosen by my grandmother. She is in poor health and cannot bear shocks, so I will not expose your ugly deeds in front of her for the time being. Starting tomorrow, you will devote yourself to Buddhism, stay indoors all day, and copy scriptures. As long as my grandmother is alive, I will keep your position as the main wife."

After saying this, Zhao Xuanyou resolutely turned to leave.

He could probably guess who Cui Yichu's lover was.

At first glance, he might seem untouchable, but it was not certain that he couldn't provoke Zhao Xuanyou.

"No! Zhao Xuanyou! You stop right there!" Watching his mercilessly departing back, Cui Yichu screamed hysterically.

Her shrill cries alarmed the maids and servants in the courtyard.

Zhao Xuanyou stood under the corridor, and when Baochuan and the others met his icy gaze, they dared not speak, nor did they dare to enter the room to check the situation.

"How many people are there in Tingyu Pavilion?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Baochuan glanced at the white porcelain bottle in his hand, realizing that Cui Yichu's trick had been exposed and her situation was hopeless. She could only answer trembling, "Ten maids and six servants."

"From now on, only you need to stay here to serve."

"Slave... slave alone? But the mistress..." Baochuan forced herself to swallow the rest of her words.

The prince had already discovered that the mistress was not a virgin, and the fact that he hadn't dragged her to the pond to drown was already a leniency.

"Yes, I obey."

From the room behind, the sound of Cui Yichu smashing things could be heard. Zhao Xuanyou's expression remained unchanged as he ordered someone to call for Manager Song.

"Except for Baochuan, send everyone from Tingyu Pavilion to the estate, the farther the better."

Manager Song didn't know what had happened, but as a loyal servant, he immediately followed the master's orders and led the guards to take away the maids and servants from Tingyu Pavilion.

The sound of smashing continued inside the room. Zhao Xuanyou glanced at the trembling Baochuan and coldly said, "Make her quiet down. If you can't do it, you won't stay in the marquis' mansion tomorrow either."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou quickly left Tingyu Pavilion.

It was a clear night, and Zhao Xuanyou walked back to Honghui Hall under the moonlight, but his mood was not relaxed at all.

He knew he had lost his composure.

He had intended to handle the matter coldly and indifferently, but when the time came, he was so angry that he couldn't help but say those harsh and vicious words to Cui Yichu.

She was not even worthy of his anger!

"Master, you're back." Yuan Qing saw him return and was somewhat surprised.

Zhao Xuanyou had not informed anyone of what he was going to do tonight. After all, being a cuckold was not something worth letting others know.

Except...

His eyes darkened, and he quickly entered the room.

Yuan Qing, knowing better, did not follow but closed the door behind him.

In the side room, the lights had already been extinguished. Yu Wan was lying on the couch but had not a trace of sleep.

When an additional presence entered the room, she keenly sensed it and sat up from the couch.

"Prince?"

The shadowy figure in the darkness did not speak.

"Why have you returned?" Yu Wan asked again.

"Aren't you aware that I would return?" Zhao Xuanyou countered.

Yu Wan knew in her heart that after settling the score with Cui Yichu, he had come to her to demand an explanation.

Thinking that Cui Yichu might be going crazy at this moment, Yu Wan's mood was not bad even if she was interrogated by him.

She got off the couch and bowed to him.

"This slave has indeed been hoping for Master to return soon."

As soon as she opened her mouth, he indeed began to question her: "When did you find out?"

"Slave..." Yu Wan's words had not yet fallen, when he suddenly pulled her into his arms with a long sweep of his arm.

At the moment they embraced tightly, Yu Wan understood why he had made this move.

Through the thin summer shirt, she felt that Zhao Xuanyou's body was very hot. He was strong and certainly not ill.

Feeling that he was desperately restraining something, Yu Wan asked, "Did Mistress give you medicine, Master?"

"No." Zhao Xuanyou answered firmly.

"Then did she feed you bull's penis again?"

Zhao Xuanyou did not make a sound, only enduring the heat, he held Yu Wan even tighter.

Hearing her teasing, he pinched her waist: "You haven't answered my question yet."

He truly could not tolerate any ambiguity and had to clarify everything.

Yu Wan said, "On the second day after Master returned to the capital, this slave began to suspect, but didn't dare to believe. Later, many things happened that confirmed it bit by bit."

"Hmm?" Zhao Xuanyou's breathing seemed to grow heavier, "Explain more clearly."

Yu Wan knew he was suffering, so she reached out to hold him and explained in a low voice, "This slave did not deceive Master. That morning... the first morning this slave accompanied Master, Master got up before this slave. Baochuan took this slave to the adjacent room to wash. At that time, this slave's body was covered in fallen red. I assumed Master's body was the same. Later, when Mistress asked this slave to replace her in serving Master, this slave found it very strange. Mistress and Master were already married, and this slave had served Master and lost her innocence. Wouldn't Master find it strange?"

The rest of the words were left unspoken.

Yu Wan was just a flower room maid, and her life was in Cui Yichu's hands. How could she dare to speak of these things to others?

Later, when Cui Yichu tried to kill her, she entered Honghui Hall and under his protection, she dared to mention this to him.

"I see."

Zhao Xuanyou reached out and picked her up, walking straight toward the couch.

"Master, this slave still..." Yu Wan reminded him softly.

"I know."

The man ruthlessly interrupted Yu Wan's voice, or rather, silenced her.

The night was still long, and it had to be passed somehow.

---

chapters.title: Satisfied
chapters.content:
Yu Wan groped to help him, but he stopped her.

"Don't move." He said in a low voice.

As he spoke, he also let go of her.

In the darkness, she felt a hand untie the thin strap around her neck.

At this point, she couldn't resist, so Yu Wan had no choice but to let him do as he pleased. Besides, her menstrual flow had already ended today, so it shouldn't cause much harm to her body.

The jade crown on his head touched Yu Wan's chin. Afraid of injuring herself, she took off the jade crown with effort and undid his hair bun.

He allowed her to handle his hair.

At this moment of greed, he wildly wanted to devour everything.

The moonlight was beautiful, and the spring scenery was also excellent.

The jade crown in Yu Wan's hand fell to the ground with a clatter. Her head was dizzy, and she felt as if her soul was about to be consumed.

---

The morning light was faint, and Yuan Qing stood at the door, hesitating.

It was already the time for Master to practice martial arts every day, but Master had not come out, and he didn't know whether to go in and remind him.

"Yuan Qing, what are you standing here for?" Yingxue stepped up the steps and asked with a smile.

"It's time for Master to practice martial arts." Yuan Qing said.

"Didn't Master go to Tingyu Pavilion yesterday? What's the use of waiting here? Why not send someone to Tingyu Pavilion."

Yuan Qing turned his head and put his hands on his hips helplessly, "Master came back last night."

"Master rested in Honghui Hall?" Yingxue immediately understood.

Yu Wan had moved to Honghui Hall, so if Master hadn't gotten up, he must be with Yu Wan.

"Then let's wait. Maybe Master wants to sleep a little longer today. Just keep an eye on the time and don't miss going to the yamen for duty."

That was the only thing they could do.

Yuan Qing still sat back under the corridor to boil water, preparing for Zhao Xuanyou to get up and use water at any time. Yingxue went to instruct the kitchen to prepare breakfast.

After finishing all this, and waiting for a while longer, Zhao Xuanyou still hadn't gotten up.

As it was about to be too late, Yuan Qing had no choice but to step forward and knock on the door.

However, there was no response from inside. He pushed the door open and entered, calling out "Master" a few times. After going around the screen, he saw that Zhao Xuanyou's bed was neat and tidy, with no signs of having been slept in at all.

Was Master in the side room?

Probably. Previously, when Yu Wan was staying in Xiao Yue Guan, Master had followed her there. Now that they were both in Honghui Hall, it was even more likely.

At the entrance of the side room, Yuan Qing did not dare to push the door open. He called out "Yu Wan" a few times through the door.

This time, there was finally a response from inside.

"What's the matter?" It was Yu Wan who answered.

Yuan Qing felt a bit embarrassed. "If Master doesn't get up soon, he'll be late for going to the yamen. I trouble Yu Wan jiejie... to remind Master."

"Understood."

After hearing Yuan Qing's footsteps leave, Yu Wan glanced at the man beside her.

The man was lying on his side on the couch, idly rolling Yu Wan's green and blue embroidered lotus flower stomach wrapper into a strip.

He looked composed, like a fierce tiger in a cave that had just feasted on its prey, looking at its spoils with a satisfied expression.

He had been awake for a while but was simply lingering here, unwilling to leave.

"Master," Yu Wan removed his hand from her body, her voice soft, "It's time to get up. If you don't get up now, you'll be late for the yamen."

In the Ministry of Personnel, there were many high-ranking officials, and being late would be very conspicuous.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm," lingered for a moment longer, and then finally sat up from the couch.

As he reached the door, he suddenly turned his head back, seemingly asking casually, "It should be okay tonight, right?"

Yu Wan hadn't expected him to ask this at this moment. She blushed and, under his persistent gaze, could only respond with an "mm."

Zhao Xuanyou, having received the confirmation he wanted, quickly left.

He was used to taking care of himself in the military and did not call for anyone to serve him. He quickly changed his clothes and tidied his hair. When he walked to the corridor, Yuan Qing had just brought water over. After washing his hands and face, he ordered Yuan Tan to bring breakfast to take with him as he left.

Meat pies and steamed buns could be eaten in the carriage without any problem.

Yingxue watched in astonishment and couldn't help but mutter to Yuan Qing, "Master got up so quickly. No wonder he dared to sleep in."

"That's from his training in the military. Think about it, in urgent military situations, sometimes things happen in the middle of the night, and he has to go out immediately. The commander of the Ming Ding Guard can't go out looking disheveled."

"That's true."

Seeing that Master had left, Yingxue thought of Yu Wan and took water into the room.

Yu Wan had indeed sat up, draped in a nightgown, and was looking down at something.

Hearing footsteps, she alertly raised her head and fastened her collar.

"It's me, sister."

Seeing that it was Yingxue, she breathed a sigh of relief. "Has Master left?"

Yingxue closed the side room door behind her and walked to the edge of the couch. "Yes. Breakfast is packed in a food box, and Master had Yuan Tan take it and leave. There's plenty of breakfast, so if sister is up now, she can eat some. It's still hot."

"Mm." Yu Wan was indeed hungry, but she was worried about other things. "Yingxue, can you help me find some anti-inflammatory ointment?"

"Ah?" Yingxue was taken aback. "Is sister injured?"

Yu Wan was very embarrassed, but compared to going out to find the ointment herself, it was better to ask Yingxue.

She hardened her head and said, "It's not an injury, just some discomfort on my body."

Yingxue, after all, was inexperienced in such matters and took a moment to react. Seeing Yu Wan's flushed cheeks and very embarrassed look, she guessed it was related to Master and did not ask further, just nodded.

"Sister, please wait. I'll go find some. Earlier, Yuan Qing said there was top-quality trauma medicine in Honghui Hall. I'll ask him if he can give me some." With that, she ran out.

Yu Wan sighed helplessly.

She didn't know how to describe Zhao Xuanyou as good.

Yesterday, when she said her body was inconvenient, he listened and didn't even touch her underwear.

But while the underwear was left alone, the areas he could touch suffered.

When Yu Wan got up in the morning, she felt a slight pain in her chest. Upon closer inspection, it was red and swollen.

It was no wonder. That was the most tender skin, yet...

"Sister, I've found the ointment." Yingxue excitedly entered with two jars. "Yuan Qing said these are top-grade external medicines, guaranteed to heal injuries with effective treatment."

"Thank you."

"Do you need my help?"

"No need." Yu Wan was too embarrassed to ask someone to help apply the medicine, or even to let someone see. Taking the jars, she said, "You go take care of your tasks first. I'll come out to work later."

"Serving Master is the top priority. Sister doesn't need to rush. I can handle the chores outside." Yingxue glanced at the bedding and sheets and added, "If sister has anything to wash, gather it up later, and I'll take it to the laundry."

"Thank you."

Moving to Honghui Hall did have its benefits. At least she didn't have to wash her own clothes and bedding, especially since they were all soiled by Zhao Xuanyou.

The porcelain jar felt heavy in her hand. She opened both jars: one contained a green ointment, and the other a light brown paste.

She didn't know which one was better, so she smelled both and chose the one with a fresher scent. She carefully applied it to the slightly painful area and indeed felt a cooling sensation, which was much more comfortable.

Upon closer inspection, there were also some red marks on her waist and arms. Although they didn't hurt, they had left traces.

After applying the medicine to all the affected areas, Yu Wan's resentment toward Cui Yichu deepened.

For no good reason, she had to prepare deer antler and bull's penis for Zhao Xuanyou, stirring up his desires, and as a result, all of it was directed at her, making her whole body uncomfortable.

Truly despicable...

chapters.title: Close Combat
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou left in a hurry that morning, so the lavish breakfast Yingxue had prepared ended up benefiting Yu Ying.

In addition to his usual favorites, noodle soup and meat pies, there were two types of steamed buns, two side dishes, and two desserts. It was truly a feast.

Yu Ying was enjoying her meal in the warm pavilion when Yingxue suddenly entered.

"Can you still eat more? Try this shiitake and pork bun," Yu Ying said with a smile.

"Not today, but I’ll remember. In the future, I’ll eat less before coming to Honghui Hall and enjoy good food with you, sister."

"It’s not every day we get such a treat."

Most of the time, Zhao Xuanyou woke up early and would sit here to eat slowly before leaving.

"Sister, your fellow townsman is here again."

Chen Da Niu?

Yu Ying’s delicate eyebrows lifted, and she quickly asked Yingxue, "Is he at the side gate?"

"Yes, he’s waiting at the side gate. My foster mother knows he’s your fellow townsman, so as soon as she saw him, she sent a little maid to Honghui Hall to inform you."

"Thank you."

Yu Ying stood up as she spoke.

"Aren’t you going to finish eating, sister?"

"No."

She quickly returned to the side room, counted the silver and gold melon seeds she had saved up, put a gold melon seed and some silver into a pouch, and hurried toward the side gate.

She ran all the way, breaking into a light sweat.

As soon as the gatekeeper saw her, she came forward, addressing her as "young lady" repeatedly, and led her aside.

It turned out she hadn’t made Chen Da Niu wait outside the mansion but had brought a stool for him to sit in a small room near the corner gate.

Now, Yu Ying was the head maid of Honghui Hall and Zhao Xuanyou’s intimate maid, so she was highly respected in the mansion. Many things were done for her without her even asking.

"Brother Da Niu." As soon as Yu Ying entered, she asked urgently, "How is my mother?"

Chen Da Niu stared at her in surprise when he saw her.

Previously, when he had seen Yu Ying, she had been dressed very plainly, no different from maids in other mansions.

But today, she entered radiant and elegant, her entire demeanor almost comparable to that of noble ladies.

"Yu Ying, you... seem to be doing well these days."

"Yes," Yu Ying nodded. "I am now the head maid by the heir’s side, so my food, clothing, and daily needs are much better. How is my mother?"

Earlier, when Chen Da Niu arrived at the side gate and mentioned Yu Ying’s name, the guards and servants there had been very warm to him, unlike the arrogant attitude they had shown before.

Chen Da Niu had guessed that Yu Ying must be doing well in the marquis’s mansion.

"She’s fine... just the same as before." Chen Da Niu said, lowering his head somewhat guiltily and speaking in a hushed voice. "Previously, you asked me to find a way to work at the Duke of Xingguo’s mansion to gather information, but I’ve been there several times and couldn’t find any work, let alone gather news."

Zhao Xuanyou already knew about Cui Yichu’s premarital loss of chastity and had even fallen out with her over it. There was no need to investigate further.

"It’s fine. You don’t need to worry about this anymore. Just take my mother to see a doctor."

"Do you have money now?" As soon as the words left his mouth, Chen Da Niu realized it was a foolish question.

Given how well Yu Ying was dressed, she must have money.

"I’ve heard that Physician Xu of Huichun Hall is a renowned acupuncturist. I’ll trouble you to take my mother to Huichun Hall for treatment."

"Physician Xu of Huichun Hall, I’ll remember that."

Yu Ying nodded and handed Chen Da Niu the prepared pouch. "Physician Xu is a famous doctor, and his consultation fees are high. Take this. If it’s not enough, come back to the marquis’s mansion to find me."

Seeing how the servants of the marquis’s mansion treated him, Yu Ying thought that in the future, whenever Chen Da Niu came to the door, they would surely inform her at Honghui Hall, making things much more convenient.

"Alright, I understand. I’ll go to Huichun Hall to check the situation first."

---

As soon as the morning court session ended, the emperor ordered Zhao Xuanyou to follow him to the imperial study.

Recalling the emperor’s various probes last time, Zhao Xuanyou guessed that this time, he was going to be given a task.

Entering the imperial study, Zhao Xuanyou stood respectfully to the side.

The emperor slowly walked to the desk, sat down, and a eunuch served him fragrant tea.

"This is newly tribute Lu’an melon seed tea. Try some."

Since the emperor had spoken, the eunuch quickly brought a cup for Zhao Xuanyou as well.

Zhao Xuanyou took a respectful sip and said in a deep voice, "It’s rich but not bitter, fragrant but not astringent. It’s indeed good tea."

"Good tea also needs someone to appreciate it," the emperor said with a nod of approval. "It’s rare to find someone who understands tea. Take a pack back to your mansion later."

"Your subject thanks His Majesty for his generous grace."

The emperor set down his teacup and looked at Zhao Xuanyou quietly for a moment before saying slowly, "I have decided to appoint the Fifth Prince as the deputy commander of the Mingchuan Guard. What do you think?"

Zhao Xuanyou was not surprised by the emperor’s decision.

Prince Jing, Zhao Lin, was sixteen years old and the fifth in line.

The crown prince Zhao Zun and Prince Ping Zhao Huan were not suitable, and the Sixth and Seventh Princes were too young to be sent to the frontier for training. Only Prince Jing was suitable.

"Your Majesty is wise."

The emperor nodded and picked up a memorial from the desk to read.

Seeing the emperor ignoring him, Zhao Xuanyou did not change his expression at all. He still held his teacup and stood respectfully to the side.

The window in the imperial study was open, and a cool breeze stirred the brocade curtains, carrying some of the dragon’s saliva incense out.

It was not until the emperor finished reading three memorials that he slowly raised his head and ordered the eunuch to take away his teacup.

"Are you adapting well to the Ministry of Personnel?"

To be honest, Zhao Xuanyou had been used to being a commander in the army, where his word was law and orders were absolute. Suddenly becoming a civil official in the capital, surrounded by many people of higher rank, was indeed a bit uncomfortable.

Zhao Xuanyou did not lie. He honestly replied, "Your subject enjoys staying in the capital, but after being a military officer for so long, switching to a civil position is indeed still a bit difficult to adjust to."

The emperor nodded slightly.

He had long known from military reports that Zhao Xuanyou was decisive and meticulous in battle. Now that he had returned to the capital, he had also learned that Zhao Xuanyou was measured in his actions and both literate and martial, which made him even more appreciative.

"Earlier, the imperial guard commander mentioned that your martial arts are unparalleled, surpassing even the palace guards. Over the past few days, I’ve been thinking that assigning you as a staff officer in the Ministry of Personnel is a bit of a waste of your talent."

Zhao Xuanyou did not respond, only listening respectfully.

"I just haven’t decided where to place you yet. In a few days, I plan to go to Lichuan to escape the summer heat. You will accompany me then."

The Lichuan Summer Palace was the royal summer retreat. The emperor had been taking his concubines and children there every year for two or three months.

The emperor wanted him to accompany him?

Having been away from the capital for many years, Zhao Xuanyou was not familiar with the royal family members except for Prince Ping. Of course, since he had decided to stay in the capital, he would inevitably have to deal with them in the future.

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes flickered slightly, and he respectfully bowed to the emperor. "Your subject obeys the decree."

As soon as he finished speaking, a eunuch came forward and said, "Your Majesty, the Crown Prince has come to pay his respects."

The emperor’s expression darkened noticeably. "I am still reviewing memorials. Have him wait."

After a pause, the emperor said, "Escort Xuanyou out. Give him a pound of Lu’an melon seed tea."

"Your subject thanks His Majesty for his generous grace."

"Yes."

Zhao Xuanyou followed the eunuch out of the imperial study. Before he even walked down the steps, he saw Crown Prince Zhao Zun, dressed in a red gauze robe, standing in front of the imperial study.

---

chapters.title: Watching His Misfortune
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou was not unfamiliar with Crown Prince Zhao Zun.

When he was young and his parents were still alive, as the heir of a marquis, he often entered and exited the palace, accompanying the imperial princes.

But the crown prince did not play with them.

Zhao Xuanyou had understood from a young age that the crown prince was different from the other princes. He was the son of the empress, and after the early death of the eldest son, he became the eldest legitimate son, destined to inherit the throne.

Not to mention someone like Zhao Xuanyou, a descendant of the imperial clan, even Prince Ping and the others treated the crown prince with great respect and did not dare to offend him.

Yesterday, Cui Yichu had refused to reveal who her lover was, but Zhao Xuanyou had a good idea.

Cui Yichu was proud of her status and beauty, and her pride was extremely high. Ordinary people were beneath her notice.

The only person in the world who could make her go so far as to lose her chastity before marriage was likely the one standing before him now.

He wondered what expression the crown prince had worn when he learned that Cui Yichu was marrying him.

For a moment, as their eyes met, Zhao Xuanyou felt as if a storm was surging in his chest.

But it was only for a moment.

His expression did not change, and he calmly walked down the steps. As he passed the crown prince, he bowed to him.

"Your subject Zhao Xuanyou greets His Highness, the Crown Prince."

The crown prince had been silently waiting for the emperor’s summons. Hearing this name, he turned to look at him.

Cui Yichu and he had known each other since childhood. She was beautiful, and he had always been kind to her. They had long since developed feelings for each other.

Unfortunately, the empress had other plans for his marriage, which led to all the troubles that followed.

When he learned that Cui Yichu was getting married, the crown prince was not completely unmoved. However, due to the empress’s imposing presence, he had never revealed his feelings.

He had already obtained Cui Yichu, but as the crown prince, even if he did not want her, no ordinary person was worthy of having her.

Watching Zhao Xuanyou bow respectfully to him, the crown prince’s expression was complicated.

To be honest, Zhao Xuanyou was a man who held military power, was both literate and martial, and was favored by the emperor. If he could be brought under his command, it would certainly be a great asset. Unfortunately... it was troublesome.

"It’s been a long time."

If Zhao Xuanyou had been seventy to eighty percent certain before, after meeting the crown prince’s gaze, he was almost certain that the person who had been involved with Cui Yichu before her marriage was indeed Crown Prince Zhao Zun.

In his arrogant eyes, there was disdain, ridicule, and schadenfreude; the look one gives a loser.

"Zhao Qingjia, you may rise."

"Thank you, Your Highness."

The eunuch following Zhao Xuanyou spoke at the right moment: "Your Highness, the Crown Prince, His Majesty is currently reviewing memorials. Please wait here for a moment."

"Reviewing memorials?" The crown prince’s calm voice suddenly rose, clearly suppressing his anger.

Zhao Xuanyou had just come out of the imperial study. If he could enter, how could the crown prince not?

However, although the crown prince was displeased, he did not dare to cause a scene here. "Thank you for your trouble, Eunuch Chen. I will wait a little longer."

The eunuch handed Zhao Xuanyou the Lu’an melon seed tea bestowed by the emperor and called a young eunuch to escort him out of the palace.

After Zhao Xuanyou had walked far away, the crown prince, with a dark face, asked, "Has the emperor been summoning him often lately?"

The eunuch respectfully replied, "This servant is not very clear, but today His Majesty did have a pleasant conversation with Lord Zhao. Look, he even bestowed tea upon him."

With that, he bowed to the crown prince and returned to the imperial study.

---

After leaving the palace, Zhao Xuanyou was waiting for the marquis’s carriage when a luxurious, canopied carriage stopped in front of him.

The driver said, "Heir, our prince invites you."

It was Prince Ping’s carriage.

Zhao Xuanyou jumped into the carriage, lifted the curtain, and indeed saw Prince Ping sitting inside.

"Your subject greets Your Highness."

"No need for formalities. Sit down and talk."

"Yes." Zhao Xuanyou sat down next to Prince Ping. "What a coincidence to meet Your Highness here."

Prince Ping ordered the coachman to go to Mingyue Tower and then turned to Zhao Xuanyou casually. "Today, several theater troupes are competing at Mingyue Tower. I have reserved a private box. I was feeling lonely sitting alone, but fortunately, I ran into you."

Mingyue Tower was the most famous restaurant in the capital, with flying bridges and ornate railings, rich and magnificent.

It was a place where one could eat, drink, watch plays, and listen to stories. The women who accompanied the diners in song and dance were all stunning beauties. Nobles, scholars, and poets from all over the world were willing to visit Mingyue Tower.

He just hadn’t expected Prince Ping to be a regular there.

"Mingyue Tower is famous throughout the world. To be honest, your subject has never been there."

"Is that true?"

"Absolutely. Your subject has embarrassed himself in front of Your Highness."

Prince Ping laughed. "You’ve been on the frontier for a long time, so it’s normal that you haven’t been there. Later, I’ll have the top courtesan pour you a few extra cups."

As they spoke, Prince Ping glanced at the packaged Lu’an melon seed tea in Zhao Xuanyou’s hand. "Oh, you brought something out of the palace?"

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. "His Majesty bestowed a cup of tea upon your subject. It was excellent, and with His Majesty’s great generosity, he also bestowed some tea leaves upon your subject."

"Father Emperor loves Lu’an melon seed tea the most. There are not many people in the palace who can get tea from him."

"Your subject is honored."

Prince Ping said, "Previously, you said you wanted to stay in the capital. I even went to some trouble for that. I didn’t expect Father Emperor to appreciate you so much. I heard that last time you took several bolts of silk from the Imperial Household Department, which even made Princess Yi’an envious."

Hearing Prince Ping mention Princess Yi’an, Zhao Xuanyou’s heart stirred.

Princess Yi’an knew about Cui Yichu’s past scandal. Did Prince Ping know as well?

Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly, hesitated for a moment, and then asked, "The last time your subject met the princess, she expressed much dissatisfaction with my wife. Your subject takes the liberty to ask, did something unpleasant happen between the princess and my wife in the palace?"

"They shouldn’t have any conflict," Prince Ping said without hesitation. "It’s just that..."

"Your Highness, please enlighten your subject."

Prince Ping curled his lips, pondered for a moment, and then slowly said, "Although Princess Yi’an is not the empress’s daughter, she is very good at pleasing the empress and has won the empress’s favor. It’s probably because she knew that your wife could never become the crown princess that she distanced herself."

As he said these words, Prince Ping’s expression was calm, not feigned.

It seemed that the empress and the crown prince had tightly sealed the news back then. Even people in the palace did not know the details.

"Did my wife once have a chance to become the crown princess?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"Of course. Her background, appearance, and talents were all far superior to the current crown princess." Prince Ping remembered that at the time, the emperor had seemed more inclined toward Cui Yichu, but there was no need to say this to Zhao Xuanyou.

"The current crown princess..." Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly. "If I recall correctly, she is the empress’s niece and the crown prince’s cousin."

"Yes. You’ve been on the frontier for a long time, so you may not be familiar with the empress’s ways. She likes to keep things within the family, so she decided on the crown princess long ago. She just found an excuse to eliminate the other candidates. It’s all in the past. Don’t take it to heart."

"Thank you for informing your subject, Your Highness. It’s just that when your subject met the crown prince, he seemed to have some opinions about your subject, so your subject took the liberty to ask for Your Highness’s guidance."

"Oh?" Hearing that the crown prince had opinions about Zhao Xuanyou, Prince Ping’s expression shifted slightly. He looked at Zhao Xuanyou and sighed softly. "I treat you as one of my own, so I speak frankly. In the future, you don’t need to be so distant with me."

Zhao Xuanyou, of course, understood the implication in Prince Ping’s words.
