He gave a slight smile, looked up at Prince Ping, and said in a low voice, "Wouldn’t it be better for your subject not to be one of Your Highness’s own?"

Prince Ping heard this and was slightly stunned for a moment. Then, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he was overjoyed.

"Xuanyou, do you mean..."

He did not finish his sentence, but Zhao Xuanyou did not give him a chance to continue.

"Your subject is incompetent and may not be of much help to Your Highness. But please rest assured, Your Highness, your subject will never be your enemy."

chapters.title: Morning Stirrings
chapters.content:
The Mingyue Tower was indeed lively tonight, with the four major troupes competing in their performances, each showcasing their most prized skills.

Prince Ping watched with great enthusiasm, only reluctantly leaving his private box when the curfew hour arrived.

"Xuanyou, I see you are also a connoisseur of opera. Since we share this interest, let us come again another day."

"Yes."

After the tipsy Prince Ping had boarded his carriage, Zhao Xuanyou's expression darkened, and he ordered his own carriage to return to the Marquis's residence.

"You've returned, my lord."

As the hour approached midnight, Yuan Qing finally saw Zhao Xuanyou step into Honghui Hall and hurried to greet him.

Today, he had encountered the Crown Prince and heard many things from Prince Ping. Thinking about the matters he would have to face in the future, his heart felt heavy.

As he ascended the steps, Yu Yuan came out of the house to welcome him. In the heat of summer, her clothes were light, and the night breeze in the courtyard made her skirt flutter like an immortal's.

Upon seeing Zhao Xuanyou, her eyebrows curved into a smile, her eyes sparkling with joy, her radiant smile both dazzling and charmingly innocent.

Faced with such a smile, Zhao Xuanyou's mood lightened slightly, and he gave a soft "mm" in response.

Yu Yuan quickly fetched clean nightclothes and attended to him, helping him change and wash up with fluid, seamless movements.

When she was about to extinguish the candle and withdraw, Zhao Xuanyou stopped her.

"My lord, you must be tired today. Rest early; you have to go to the yamen tomorrow."

"Tired?" Zhao Xuanyou gave a cold laugh, encircling her waist and pulling her close. "You have something to say?"

Yu Yuan felt a bit helpless.

It was clear he had been drinking and enjoying himself outside until late at night. She was genuinely worried about him and wanted him to rest well.

Seeing that he wouldn't let her go, Yu Yuan advised, "When my lord returned just now, there was the smell of alcohol and powder on you. After entertaining women outside all evening, you must be exhausted. Now that you're finally home, you should rest early."

"Hmph."

This little girl dared to look down on him.

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled softly and, with a slight pull, dragged her onto the couch.

Caught off guard, Yu Yuan tumbled into his arms.

However, contrary to her expectations, Zhao Xuanyou did not act as urgently as he had the previous night. He simply held her quietly.

"Do you have something on your mind, my lord?"

Yu Yuan knew the answer but asked anyway.

As the heir of a marquis and a favored subject of the emperor, he had everything he could wish for.

Who else but Cui Yichu could trouble him so much?

Rumors had spread throughout the marquis's residence that last night, during the birthday banquet for the marchioness, she had a quarrel with the heir, and the heir had flown into a great rage. Now, all of the marchioness's maids had been sent to the estate by Steward Song, leaving only Baochuan in the Tingyu Pavilion.

To the other servants in the marquis's residence, this was already a severe punishment for Cui Yichu.

To Yu Yuan, it was nothing more than a slap on the wrist.

Being confined was nothing; it hadn't harmed Cui Yichu in the slightest. She was still the respected and glorious marchioness.

"Who doesn't have troubles in this world?"

"Mmm," Yu Yuan thought carefully, "His Majesty?"

Zhao Xuanyou had just entered the palace today. From what he had seen, both His Majesty and His Highness had plenty of troubles.

Thinking this, he seemed a little less troubled.

She was always good at comforting people.

Suddenly, Zhao Xuanyou turned his head and gently placed a kiss on Yu Yuan's forehead.

Feeling the warmth of his thin lips, Yu Yuan sighed softly in her heart.

Earlier that day, she had silently resented Zhao Xuanyou for a long time, blaming him for not being ruthless enough and for still having lingering feelings for Cui Yichu. Now, seeing him in this state, she calmed down.

Cui Yichu was the beloved daughter of the Duke of Xingguo. Dealing with her indeed involved many complexities.

Not to mention her lover and the Duke of Xingguo's residence, there were also people in the marquis's residence who cared for her.

So Yu Yuan spoke up: "My lord."

"Hmm?"

"Today, the Old Dowager sent someone to Honghui Hall several times, probably to ask you something."

"I know."

Zhao Xuanyou wasn't physically tired, just mentally exhausted.

He had always been this way, if he was going to do something, he would see it through to the end.

Today, he had decided to deal with those who had harmed him and mocked him, and he would do so thoroughly, ensuring they had no place to bury their bodies.

That was his intention, but those people were powerful and influential, so it wouldn't be easy.

Until he figured out a way, he couldn't focus on anything else.

Yu Yuan could see that tonight, he had no amorous intentions; he was just troubled.

She wanted to return to her side room, but the man held her tightly.

Helpless, she could only rest her head on his arm and fall into a deep sleep.

---

Early in the morning, a few bird calls broke the silence of Honghui Hall.

Yingxue carried a basket of embroidery samples up the steps and saw Yuan Qing standing at the door with a pale face.

"What's wrong with you? Did something happen?" Yingxue asked strangely.

Yuan Qing heard the voice and turned to stare at Yingxue, stammering and unable to speak.

Yingxue felt something was off. Looking at Yuan Qing, who seemed dumbfounded, she couldn't get any answers.

"Has the heir not gotten up yet?"

"Don't go in!" Yuan Qing suddenly spoke, pulling Yingxue's hand.

Caught off guard, Yingxue dropped all the embroidery samples in her hand.

"Hey, what are you doing?" Yingxue was a bit helpless and squatted down to pick up the items. "Hurry up and go call the heir to get up, or he won't be able to have breakfast again."

"We can't go call him." Yuan Qing said, blushing.

Looking at Yuan Qing's embarrassed expression, Yingxue asked, "What happened?"

Yuan Zhen was at the bottom of the steps organizing Zhao Xuanyou's morning practice items. Hearing this, he teased, "I told you earlier, now the lord is not living alone. Don't barge into his room without thinking, or you might see something you shouldn't. Be careful the lord gouges out your eyes."

"Ah? What did you see?" Yingxue asked subconsciously.

Yuan Qing's face turned red: "I can't tell you."

Honestly, Yuan Qing hadn't seen anything.

He had called out to the lord several times at the door without getting a response, so he went inside.

Before he even rounded the screen, he saw the top of the bed canopy rhythmically shaking through the gap above the screen. Then he heard Yu Yuan speak weakly, and the lord responded with great vigor.

That sentence was simply... too... too... Simple-minded as Yuan Qing was, he couldn't believe that was something the lord could say.

"I'm not going in anymore, I won't go in again in the future." Yuan Qing was anxious and looked at Yingxue. "You're a maid, so from now on, the task of calling the lord to get up is yours."

Looking at Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing's expressive faces, Yingxue could more or less guess the scene inside.

But... wasn't it morning? Wasn't that kind of thing usually done at night?

Yingxue was unmarried and couldn't understand this at all.

"That's right," Yuan Zhen understood Yuan Qing's trouble and came over to help. "Now that Yu Yuan is living in the room, it's inconvenient for me and Yuan Qing to go in. From now on, let's just follow the rules of the madam's courtyard. Both at night and in the morning, it will be you maids who go in to attend."

That was indeed the rule in the inner chambers.

Yingxue didn't refuse. "I understand. It's not early anymore; the lord should get up. I'll go in and remind him."

She pushed the door and carefully entered the room.

As soon as she walked to the screen, she looked up and immediately understood what Yuan Qing had seen.

chapters.title: The Struggle to Get Out of Bed
chapters.content:
Yingxue was caught between advancing and retreating.

Thinking of shouting loudly behind the screen and then leaving, she heard Yu Yuan's voice, which sounded like she was crying.

Yingxue's face turned red, and she quickly ran out.

Under the corridor, Yuan Qing saw her run out just like he had and couldn't help but laugh.

"Just now you were questioning me? Did you remind the lord?"

Yingxue was in a difficult position: "In that situation, how could I remind him?"

Even if she had reminded him, could the lord have heard? And Yu Yuan was even more out of it, seemingly in a daze...

Yuan Qing laughed: "Yuan Zhen, now you're the only one left. Go in and think of a solution."

"No way," Yuan Zhen firmly refused. "You're trying to set me up. I'm not going."

"But what if the lord wakes up late?" Yuan Qing persistently tried to pull him into this.

Yuan Zhen, however, didn't fall for it: "I've followed the lord for so many years. When have you ever seen him delay his official duties? He must have it under control."

"Hopefully."

"You two quickly prepare the lord's food box. I'll go outside and check if the carriage has arrived."

While the three of them were coming up with random ideas, the main character, Zhao Xuanyou, had already sat up from the couch.

His nightclothes had been thrown aside as soon as he got up. He picked up his inner garment, quickly put it on, got up, and put on the outer robe hanging nearby, then tied his belt.

He dressed extremely quickly, as if well-trained, and in the blink of an eye, he was fully dressed.

Just as he was about to leave, he turned back to look at Yu Yuan, who was still asleep on the couch.

She lay weakly on the pillow, her eyes misty, her face flushed, and her breathing light.

A seductive little kitten.

Zhao Xuanyou's thin lips slightly hooked, and his gaze darkened again.

Meeting his dark, ambiguous gaze, Yu Yuan's face turned even redder, and she shyly turned her head away.

Seeing her avoiding him, Zhao Xuanyou sat back on the couch, forcibly turned her over, and reached out to hold her small, delicate face.

"My lord, the servants are urging so urgently. You should go out."

Both of them had heard Yuan Qing and Yingxue come in earlier; they just hadn't had time to respond.

"Driving me away?"

Zhao Xuanyou, unhurried, lightly brushed her red lips with his calloused fingers. They were moist and tender, inexplicably alluring.

"In my room, who dares to drive me away? They're afraid you won't have time to eat."

Yu Yuan gently persuaded him and tried to push his hand away.

He was a martial artist, and his reactions were extremely fast. He avoided her hand and instead moved downward.

"Don't!" Yu Yuan shrank back, covering her chest. "I just applied medicine yesterday."

"Why apply medicine?" Zhao Xuanyou asked, confused.

Yu Yuan gave him a resentful look, her face completely red, and said embarrassedly, "It was swollen."

Knowing the reason, Zhao Xuanyou was in high spirits. He let her go and left contentedly.

Yu Yuan still slept for a while before getting up.

He had left in a hurry, and the rich breakfast prepared by the kitchen was enjoyed by Yu Yuan alone.

Looking at the extra bowl of yam and chicken congee compared to yesterday, Yu Yuan asked Yingxue, "Did you specially ask the kitchen to prepare this?"

Zhao Xuanyou didn't like congee, so the kitchen usually didn't send congee to Honghui Hall.

"It wasn't me. It was Sister Qin from the kitchen who asked me what you like to eat, so she could prepare it and send it to Honghui Hall in the future." Yingxue said, then took a plate of mixed fruit cakes from the food box. "It's not just congee; even pastries are sent over."

Sister Qin was in charge of cooking in the marquis's main kitchen. When Zhao Xuanyou wasn't around, she was responsible for the Old Dowager's meals. Now she was also in charge of Honghui Hall.

"So kind?"

Yingxue smiled: "Sister, you are now the favorite in the marquis's residence. They all want to curry favor with you. Sending some food is nothing. It's good that I have the luck to know you early."

"It's me who is lucky to have known you early."

Recommending Yingxue to work in Honghui Hall was a natural decision.

Apart from anything else, just the fact that Yingxue had helped inquire about the doctor had been a great help to Yu Yuan.

In the future, if her mother was cured, she would still have to give Yingxue a big gift.

The two laughed and ate some food together before starting work.

There weren't many servants in Honghui Hall, but the work was no less than elsewhere.

Even when Zhao Xuanyou wasn't around, the servants didn't get much leisure time.

After finishing breakfast, Yu Yuan began to tidy up the bed. She no longer had to do the washing herself, but Zhao Xuanyou's bedroom wasn't just anyone's place to enter.

Nothing had happened last night, but this morning, when he wanted to get up, he suddenly got energetic.

The bedsheet was so dirty that it naturally had to be changed. Yu Yuan rolled up the dirty bedsheet and put it aside. Just then, Yingxue came in with a newly sun-dried bedsheet.

With the strong sun these days, the sun-dried bedsheets and quilts all carried a pleasant smell of sunlight.

The two worked together to make the bed. Yingxue, holding the bedsheet and quilt, asked again, "Sister, do you have any dirty clothes? I'll take them all to be washed."

"Yes, there are a few pieces. I'll go with you to take them."

After this flurry of activity, it was soon time for lunch. At this time, the kitchen would send meals according to the servants' portions, but as a senior maid, she could also have a dish with meat and a vegetarian dish.

With only three maids left in Honghui Hall, and Ziyan being alone, Yu Yuan invited her to eat together under the corridor.

She and Ziyan had no grudges against each other. Since they both worked in Honghui Hall, they saw each other often, and it was better to get along harmoniously.

After these few days, Ziyan also knew the character of Yu Yuan and Yingxue. Since they were taking the initiative to be friendly, she was naturally happy and asked Yu Yuan for a lot of advice on taking care of flowers and plants.

In the afternoon, after finishing the work in the courtyard, Ziyan also helped them.

The embroidery samples and silk fabric that Yingxue had prepared in the morning were intended for making a few new pairs of socks for Zhao Xuanyou.

Yu Yuan had never learned needlework and couldn't help much. However, Ziyan was good at embroidery and patiently taught Yu Yuan how to use a needle.

When Zhao Xuanyou returned to Honghui Hall, he saw this harmonious scene in the courtyard.

Under the setting sun, Yu Yuan's skin looked flawless, smooth like white porcelain, her fragrant cheeks like snow, incredibly eye-catching.

"My lord." Seeing him return, the three maids stopped their work and stood up to greet him.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm" and went straight into the house to change clothes, then headed directly to Leshou Hall.

Yesterday, the Old Dowager had sent for him several times, probably knowing about Cui Yichu's situation and urgently wanting to ask him about it.

He had returned too late, and early in the morning, he had to go to the yamen. Now that he was back, he naturally went as quickly as possible to avoid worrying his grandmother.

As soon as he entered Leshou Hall, Zhao Xuanyou met his grandmother's reproachful gaze.

"Xuanyou, what on earth is going on?"

"Nothing serious, Grandmother. Have some tea to calm down."

The Old Dowager Leaf angrily said, "Nothing serious? Today, I sent Mama Xing to Tingyu Pavilion to have a look, and the people guarding the door actually refused to let her in! Xuanyou, you are husband and wife, not superior and subordinate in a military camp. Even if you quarrel, there's no reason to lock her up!"

chapters.title: The Decision to Divorce
chapters.content:
"You…"

Madame Ye was so infuriated by his words that she raised her hand to strike him.

Zhao Xuanyou did not dodge, tilting his chin up at her with a smile, as if inviting her to hit him.

"Bratty boy!"

Though she cursed him, Madame Ye ultimately couldn’t bring herself to strike him. Instead, she tapped his forehead lightly, just as she had when scolding him as a child.

"What in the world is going on? Don’t think you can evade me today. I may be old, but I’m not senile yet."

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the teapot, poured a cup of tea, and presented it to Madame Ye.

"Have some tea to calm down."

"Hmph." Madame Ye refused to drink his tea.

Zhao Xuanyou had returned from the yamen without a drop of water or food, and now he was thirsty. He downed the tea in one gulp and then picked up the pastries from the table to eat.

Seeing his carefree demeanor, Madame Ye felt both angry and heartbroken.

"Xuanyou, you’ve always been methodical in your actions. Why are you acting so out of character this time?"

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, continuing to eat the osmanthus cake in his hand.

It was a bit too sweet, but it filled his stomach well.

Madame Ye pondered for a moment, then glared at him. "Is it that Yu Wan whispering pillow talk to you? I had no objections to her serving you since Yichu couldn’t bear children, but no matter how much you favor her, you can’t elevate a concubine above your wife! That’s something only the lowest of families would do."

"It has nothing to do with Yu Wan."

Madame Ye, seeing Zhao Xuanyou finally speak, said, "Truly nothing to do with her? You didn’t say a word when I scolded you just now, but the moment I mention Yu Wan, you speak up."

"It has nothing to do with Yu Wan, or anyone else. Cui Yichu brought this upon herself."

"Brought this upon herself?"

Hearing those four words, Madame Ye realized the matter was more serious than she thought.

Seeing the coldness in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes, she trusted her own grandson more. She sighed and asked, "Did she do something wrong?"

"Mm."

"What could she have done to make you this angry?" Madame Ye advised, "As the old saying goes, 'Gold cannot be pure, and man cannot be perfect.' Everyone has moments of confusion. Since you’re married, you should be more tolerant."

"Grandmother, there are things in this world that cannot be tolerated."

"What exactly did she do?" Madame Ye pressed, seeing Zhao Xuanyou silently eating his pastries. She called for Stewardess Xing to bring some hot dishes and rice.

The kitchen fire in the marquis’s residence was never extinguished before the master returned.

Soon, a table of dinner was served. Though the portions were smaller than usual, there was still chicken, duck, fish, and meat.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up his bowl to eat, while Madame Ye sat beside him, deep in thought.

Recalling the incidents that had occurred in the residence, she gradually pieced things together.

"Could it be that the things Zhou Mama did were at her instruction?"

Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t investigated, but he knew Cui Yichu must have been aware of Zhou Mama embezzling the marquis’s silver.

But that wasn’t what truly bothered him.

"Yichu is quite considerate of her natal family, but she hasn’t been in the marquis’s residence for long. Give her some time."

Zhao Xuanyou could tell that his grandmother had made up her mind to mediate.

The old lady was sharp-eyed and clear-headed; he couldn’t deceive her.

"It’s not that."

"Then what could it be?" Madame Ye had taken this long to think of Zhou Mama, and now Zhao Xuanyou denied it. She grew impatient. "The greatest faults a wife can commit are the Seven Grounds for Divorce. Since it’s not theft, it’s not disrespect to parents-in-law either. Yichu has been very respectful to me. She doesn’t gossip or slander, and she even helped you take concubines and find chamber maids without jealousy. She has no serious illness, and you’ve said you don’t mind her barrenness. Could it possibly be... adultery?"

Madame Ye had spoken casually, but the moment the word "adultery" left her lips, she clearly saw Zhao Xuanyou’s pupils flicker.

She was startled. "Yichu committed adultery? That can’t be. When you weren’t in the capital, she never left the residence, only occasionally visiting her natal family. She didn’t even hold a coming-of-age banquet for her twentieth birthday when you weren’t home. How could she have committed adultery?"

At this point, Zhao Xuanyou knew he couldn’t hide it any longer. "After marriage, she indeed never did."

Madame Ye’s eyes widened, her mouth hanging open in shock for a long time.

After a while, she muttered, "How is that possible? She’s a noble lady from a ducal family... how is that possible?"

Madame Ye thought for a while but couldn’t make sense of it.

"Don’t leave me hanging like this. Are you trying to give me a heart attack?" Without waiting for Zhao Xuanyou to speak, Madame Ye suddenly slammed the table. "What kind of scandal haven’t I heard in this capital? I’ve eaten more salt than you’ve eaten rice. Speak up! It won’t kill me!"

Seeing that Madame Ye’s expression was anxious but her voice steady, Zhao Xuanyou hesitated for a moment before slowly saying, "Cui Yichu was not a virgin when she married into the marquis’s residence. On our wedding night, she claimed she was unwell and did not consummate the marriage with me."

Madame Ye knew about this. When she had asked about the unstained handkerchief, Cui Yichu had said she was having her monthly cycle, and Madame Ye hadn’t thought much of it.

"You only discovered this after returning to the capital this time? But didn’t you stay in her Flowing Fragrance Pavilion every night after you came back?"

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. "I did stay in Flowing Fragrance Pavilion, but the one who spent the night with me wasn’t her."

Not her?

Madame Ye was momentarily stunned.

A face as radiant as spring blossoms and as delicate as autumn moonlight suddenly appeared in her mind. That face was not only charming but also bore a resemblance to Cui Yichu.

"Is it Yu Wan?"

Though anxious, Madame Ye was indeed clever and quickly pieced together the mystery.

"So you never actually shared a bed with her?"

Zhao Xuanyou shook his head. "Yu Wan was a virgin. She bled the first time."

At this point, Madame Ye fully understood the plan. Her gaze grew complex. "Originally, you wouldn’t have stayed in the capital for long before returning to Mingxian Guard. Once you left, she would have dealt with Yu Wan, and by the time you returned, everything would have been seamless."

"Grandmother is wise. I underestimated you. I thought you would faint from anger upon hearing this news!"

"Hmph, you little brat," Madame Ye said, her heart truly chilled by the truth. But with Zhao Xuanyou joking beside her, her emotions stabilized. "Did you confront her that night in Listening to Rain Pavilion?"

"Yes."

Madame Ye asked, "Since you confronted her directly, did she admit who her past lover was?"

"No, but I know."

"Who is it?"

"Grandmother knows her. She frequently enters and exits the palace and has always aimed for the best possible marriage. It’s good that you know now, Grandmother. In the future, keeping her confined in the residence will at least bring some peace."

"We cannot keep her confined in the residence," Madame Ye suddenly said.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned. "Does Grandmother think I should forgive her for what she’s done?"

"Xuanyou, you’re being foolish. This involves the palace. We cannot handle it this way."

"What does Grandmother mean?"

Madame Ye’s expression turned solemn. "Divorce her! We must divorce her!"

---

chapters.title: A Moment of Obsession
chapters.content:
Madame Ye’s words surprised Zhao Xuanyou somewhat.

"Xuanyou, if this matter didn’t involve that person from the Eastern Palace, I might hesitate. But since she is connected to him, we absolutely cannot keep her in the Marquis of Jingyuan’s residence," Madame Ye said earnestly. "Our family, though of the imperial clan, is still a subject. We’ve survived this long by being prudent and avoiding trouble. Now, though there are many criticisms of his abilities inside and outside the court, we don’t know what the future holds. But he is still in the Eastern Palace, and we must not provoke him."

At the mention of Crown Prince Zhao Zun, Zhao Xuanyou recalled his haughty and cold gaze, and he clenched his fists.

Madame Ye, seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s restrained and suppressed expression, felt even more guilty. She pounded her chest hard a few times.

"In the end, it’s this old woman’s fault for being stupid. I didn’t investigate properly before arranging the marriage, and I brought such a woman into our family."

"Grandmother!"

Zhao Xuanyou frowned and supported her. What he least wanted was for his grandmother to worry and grieve over this. Seeing her regret so deeply that she pounded her chest, he hated those people even more and silently vowed to return today’s humiliation a hundredfold.

But in Leshou Hall, he didn’t dare show any of this to avoid worrying his grandmother.

He respectfully persuaded her, "You shouldn’t trouble yourself over these matters, Grandmother. It’s not your fault; it’s the fault of those who schemed against us. Grandmother, do you remember who first mentioned Cui Yichu to you?"

Madame Ye, upon hearing this, thought carefully. "It was an old friend of mine, the Old Madame of Chengguo Duke’s residence. She came to visit me and mentioned that you hadn’t been betrothed yet, so she brought up a suitable candidate from Xingguo Duke’s family. Sigh, I did some inquiries too. They said her beauty and demeanor were outstanding, the best among the noble ladies in the capital. It was just that her marriage was delayed because she had intended to marry into the imperial family. I invited them to the marquis’s residence for tea, and seeing that the girl was indeed exceptional and a good match for you, I hastily settled the marriage."

The Old Madame of Chengguo Duke’s residence had indeed been acquainted with Madame Ye for many years, and their friendship was deep. She wouldn’t have intentionally harmed them.

Thinking that even Prince Ping didn’t know the truth, the Old Madame Yu must have been kept in the dark as well.

"Grandmother, I understand now. Let’s not dwell on the past. As long as you are in good health, I don’t care about anything else."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou’s comforting words, Madame Ye felt both heartbroken and touched. She patted the back of Zhao Xuanyou’s hand. "Do you truly not mind?"

A wife’s pre-marital adultery was a great humiliation.

Zhao Xuanyou curved his lips into a smile. "I said it before: I only care about you, Grandmother. As for her... hmph, she’s not worthy."

Before the confrontation at the birthday banquet, he had indeed resented her, so he had lost his composure in rage and said many things to deliberately humiliate her.

But after leaving Listening to Rain Pavilion, he suddenly calmed down.

Such a filthy and vicious woman. Was she even worth his anger?

"Good. You’re truly the child I raised. You handle things decisively," Madame Ye took a deep breath. "She’s not worthy of my pity either. Hurry and divorce her. Write the divorce letter tonight when you return, and send her out of the residence tomorrow."

Seeing that his grandmother had regained her composure, Zhao Xuanyou finally felt at ease. "Grandmother, don’t worry about this. I will handle it as soon as possible."

"The sooner, the better," Madame Ye said with clarity. "Since I was the one who brought her into this family, when we drive her out, it will be under my name. We’ll say she was disrespectful to her elders. The Xingguo Duke’s family, with their guilty conscience, should accept this. If they insist on making trouble, we won’t be polite either."

Cui Yichu’s adultery was a fact, but since it involved the Eastern Palace, they must never mention it. Using the charge of disrespect was the safest approach.

The Xingguo Duke and his wife had known about their daughter’s loss of chastity yet still married her into the marquis’s residence, concealing it with all their might. It was truly despicable.

If they knew their place, it would be fine. But if they dared to cause trouble, the Marquis of Jingyuan’s residence had nothing to fear.

"I understand, Grandmother. Please rest and take care of your health. Leave these matters to me."

"Sigh," Madame Ye was truly heartbroken and exhausted. Looking at Zhao Xuanyou, she slowly said, "You’ve grown up. You can manage the marquis’s household, and I am greatly comforted."

"Let’s not talk about this anymore. Grandmother, what sutra have you been copying recently? I’d like to read some scriptures to calm my mind."

He called for Stewardess Xing to help Madame Ye change and wash up. Once she was lying on the couch, he took a copied scroll of the Earth Store Bodhisattva’s Fundamental Vows Sutra and sat by her side, reciting it.

The profound and mystical teachings of the sutra were indeed calming.

As she listened, Madame Ye’s emotions gradually settled.

But after learning such a huge matter tonight, how could she easily fall asleep? She listened quietly to the sutra, occasionally discussing a few lines with Zhao Xuanyou, until the Zi hour (midnight) before she finally closed her eyes.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at his sleeping grandmother and let out a soft sigh.

The one most deeply hurt by Cui Yichu’s adultery was his grandmother. It was truly infuriating.

He set down the sutra and instructed Stewardess Xing to prepare calming soup for the old madame over the next few days. Only then did he head toward Honghui Hall.

The night was deep, and the bright moon hung high in the sky.

The marquis’s residence had prospered for a hundred years, with tall, lush trees lining the paths, their canopies like umbrellas. Occasionally, the calls of birds could be heard.

After reciting the sutra for so long, Zhao Xuanyou felt a lightness, as if experiencing the tranquility of "The idle man lets the osmanthus flowers fall, the quiet night reveals the empty spring mountain."

He strolled back to Honghui Hall, where only Yuan Qing was dozing off in the corridor waiting for him.

Yuan Qing had been training in martial arts with him and was quite observant. Hearing the footsteps, he opened his eyes, rubbing them as he came forward.

"Master, you returned so late. Did you go out again?"

Zhao Xuanyou said, "I stayed and talked with Grandmother a bit longer."

"Is the old madame in good spirits?"

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze darkened. He would rather his grandmother never have such spirits again.

Cui Yichu’s matter had to be resolved quickly so that his grandmother could be free from worry.

Yuan Qing, seeing his dark expression, realized he had said the wrong thing but didn’t know how to make amends. He quickly brought water for him to wash his feet.

As Zhao Xuanyou was washing his feet, he suddenly remembered something. "Did you deliver the item I asked you to send to the Xingguo Duke’s residence?"

"Ah?" Yuan Qing was stunned for a moment before coming to his senses. "Master, do you mean that bottle? Steward Song sent someone to deliver it yesterday."

They had received the bottle yesterday, and yet there was still no response today. They were certainly good at keeping their composure.

It seemed the Xingguo Duke’s reputation for doting on his daughter was just talk.

Zhao Xuanyou dried his feet and sent Yuan Qing away.

Walking past the mountain and water gilded screen, he saw the empty bed and narrowed his eyes, knowing she had gone to sleep in the side room.

He didn’t know whether to call her cautious or cowardly; he hadn’t said she couldn’t sleep here.

Zhao Xuanyou blew out the candle and felt his way to the side room in the dark.

The door was slightly ajar. He walked over to the bed in a few steps and sat down. Yu Wan was already fast asleep.

Zhao Xuanyou, enticed by her softness and warmth, soon lay down beside her.

The side room had only a small window, and it was pitch black, making it impossible to see clearly. He could only grope around and lift her foot.

Yu Wan finally woke up, coquettishly scolding, "Heir."

They say a single thought can lead to enlightenment or damnation. After reading sutras all evening, his mind had been calm and detached, yet a single touch from her made him completely fall.

In the end, he had no Buddhist affinity; he was destined to linger in the mortal world.

chapters.title: Heatstroke
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou got up quite early that day. Following his old habit, he practiced swordplay for half an hour before sitting in the warm pavilion to have breakfast.

As he was about to leave, Yingxue secretly whispered to Yuxuan with a smile, "Why is the young master up so early today?"

"You stinking girl! How dare you mock me!" Yuxuan, teased by her, rushed over to tickle her, and the two rolled around in a playful fight.

After the joke, they sat in the courtyard and started sewing.

Before it was time for lunch, someone suddenly barged in front of the Honghui Hall.

"Where is Zhao Xuanyou? Tell him to come out!"

The guard at the door blocked him, and the people in the courtyard also looked up at the commotion.

"Who is it? How dare they cause trouble at Honghui Hall?" Yingxue couldn't help but mutter.

"Anyone allowed into the Marquis's mansion must be someone of status."

"But no matter how high their status, they shouldn't let the young master's enemy in."

Yuxuan didn't know what was going on either; she just quietly watched.

The intruder was a young man in brocade robes and a jade belt. With a thin figure and delicate features, unlike Zhao Xuanyou's natural authority, even when angry, there was still a hint of refinement in his eyes and brows.

But at first glance, Yuxuan saw that he bore some resemblance to Cui Yichu.

Was he from the Xingguo Duke's mansion?

She had long heard that Cui Yichu was the apple of the Xingguo Duke's eye. It had only been two days since she was confined in the Marquis's mansion, and now someone from her family had come to seek justice for her.

Yuxuan felt an inexplicable envy.

She put down her needlework and walked to the courtyard gate. "This young master, the young master is currently at the yamen for duty and has not returned. Please go to the front courtyard to wait with some tea."

"He's really not here?" The other party, originally furious, had his expression soften slightly upon hearing Yuxuan's patient words. "If he's not here, then Yichu must be. Take me to see her quickly!"

So it was indeed someone from Cui Yichu's maternal family. Judging by his age, he was probably her brother.

Yuxuan's expression remained unchanged. "Please forgive me, young master. I am just a maidservant of Honghui Hall, not one who serves the madam. Since you have come to visit, please wait in the tea room. If the madam is willing to see you, she will certainly send someone to invite you."

"Don't try to fool me! I've already waited in the tea room for more than an hour! What have you done to Yichu?"

"Second Young Master, Second Young Master," Manager Song hurried over with people from behind. Seeing the young master shouting at Yuxuan, he quickly stepped in front of him. "I have already sent someone to inform the madam. It's just that she is unwell today and doesn't want to see guests."

"I don't believe it!" That Second Young Cui, originally fair-skinned, now had a flushed face. He grabbed Manager Song's collar. "Yichu would never refuse to see me. What have you done to Yichu? Explain yourselves!"

"The madam is truly ill."

"Hmph, you dogs, not a single truthful word from your mouths. One moment you say Zhao Xuanyou isn't in the mansion, the next you say Yichu is sick. Is he not in the mansion? Then I'll just sit here and wait."

With that, he truly disregarded the dust on the ground and sat right in the center of the courtyard gate.

Manager Song looked at this unreasonable young master and didn't know how to handle him for a moment.

Early in the morning, when the master left, he had specifically instructed that all matters concerning Cui Yichu in the mansion were not to be reported to Leshou Hall. Everything would wait for his return to decide.

If they tied the man up and threw him out, it would surely alarm the old madam.

Since he was willing to sit on the ground and wait, as long as he could wait quietly, let him be.

"Second Young Master, if you don't believe my words, just wait here."

Manager Song gave a signal, and two servants stood beside Second Young Master Cui.

"Who is he? Why is he sitting there blocking the door?" Yuan Qing came out of the house at this moment and saw the scene, feeling a bit angry.

Yuxuan said, "He seems to be a relative from the madam's maternal family. He says he's waiting to see the young master. Manager Song allowed him to sit there. Let's not bother with him; we should do what we need to do."

With that, she beckoned Yingxue to sit back at the stone table to make socks.

"Huh?" Yuan Qing was confused.

Judging by the young master's clothes, he looked like the madam's brother. Was he the young master's brother-in-law? How could such a noble guest be made to sit on the ground and wait by Manager Song?

What on earth had happened between the madam and the young master?

First, the madam's personal servants were sent away, then the madam wanted to seclude herself to copy scriptures, and then there was that strange little bottle. Now, a young master from the duke's mansion had come and was sitting at the courtyard gate. It was all too strange.

"This is a big problem!" Yuan Qing, full of questions, couldn't find Yuan Xi, so she ran to sit next to Yuxuan and Yingxue.

Yingxue also found Young Master Cui strange and lowered her voice, "Why is that man speaking so fiercely? It feels like he's here to cause trouble for the young master."

"He probably knows about the madam secluding herself to copy scriptures."

"Oh, no wonder. He was just saying he wanted to see the madam."

Yuan Qing understood. Since the young master had confined the madam, he naturally wouldn't let her see her maternal family.

Just as she was about to speak, she caught a glimpse of Yuxuan, who was silent.

"Sister Yuxuan, you don't know something, do you?"

Yuan Qing said this, and Yingxue also looked at her with burning eyes.

As someone close to the young master, she must know the inside story.

"I know a little more than you, but not much more."

This was the truth. Yuxuan really didn't know what Zhao Xuanyou intended to do.

Yesterday, Zhao Xuanyou had stayed in Leshou Hall for a long time before returning. He must have had a long conversation with the old madam, and the two of them must have come up with some plan.

Yuxuan didn't want to be questioned by the two of them, so she simply stopped talking and focused on making socks.

The needlework wasn't as difficult as she thought. Purple Smoke had taught her yesterday, and today she could try it herself. It was a bit rough, but it was usable.

It was the height of summer, and the heat was stifling. Even sitting in the shade, Yuxuan and Yingxue were covered in a thin layer of sweat.

Thinking of going inside to get a fan, she glanced out of the corner of her eye and saw the man sitting at the door with a red face and ears.

The courtyard gate was wide open, and there wasn't a single tree around. Sitting there in the direct sunlight, he was likely to get heatstroke.

After a moment's thought, Yuxuan went to pour a cup of water.

She walked to the courtyard gate and handed the tea to the man.

"It's too hot. Have some tea, young master."

The man looked at Yuxuan and didn't take the tea, only slightly frowning. "Are you one of Zhao Xuanyou's servants?"

"Mm." Yuxuan nodded.

"Why do you look a bit like Yichu?"

Yuxuan gave a cold laugh. Wasn't it because she looked like Cui Yichu that she had been bought to be a surrogate maid...

"Please don't say that, young master. The madam does not like me, and she especially doesn't like that I resemble her."

He was taken aback but wasn't surprised by Yuxuan's words.

"Yichu has never suffered any grievances since she was a child. She thinks she's the best, so she's inevitably a bit too proud, but her heart is good."

The first few sentences might have made sense, but the last one was something Yuxuan had verified with her life.

Hearing this, Yuxuan realized that this young master probably didn't know about Cui Yichu's loss of chastity before marriage. He had truly come to the Marquis's mansion in righteous indignation to seek justice for Cui Yichu.

Yuxuan didn't feel like wasting her breath anymore. He took the tea from the tray himself and drank it in one go.

"I haven't asked for your name yet. Thank you for the water. I am Cui Zaiting. If you ever need my help in the future, feel free to come to the Xingguo Duke's mansion to find me."

Cui Zaiting?

The people from the Xingguo Duke's mansion might not be much, but their names were indeed pleasant to hear.

Yuxuan's expression remained indifferent. "There's no need for courtesy, young master. Please put the cup back."

"Oh." Cui Zaiting tried to put the cup back in its original place but placed it on the edge of the tray instead. The cup rolled off and fell to the ground.

Yuxuan reached out to pick it up, and so did he. Their hands touched.

Just at this moment, Yuxuan caught a glimpse of a dark shadow approaching rapidly from afar, appearing right in front of them.

---

chapters.title: Jealousy Erupts
chapters.content:
Before she could lift her head, Yuxuan saw Cui Zaiting being grabbed by the collar, lifted, and thrown aside by someone.

She let out a soft exclamation and looked up to see Zhao Xuanyou, his face filled with rage, his eyes as cold as ice and snow.

Cui Zaiting, being a scholar, was thrown aside by Zhao Xuanyou, and his chest and back ached from the fall.

However, he gritted his teeth and endured the pain, refusing to cry out loudly. Seeing that the newcomer was Zhao Xuanyou, he stood up despite the pain, unwilling to lose face in front of him.

Covering his chest, he said intermittently, "Zhao Xuanyou, you... you finally came back! I... I was just looking for you to settle the score."

Zhao Xuanyou didn't bother with him at all. He only looked at Yuxuan. "Are you alright?"

Yuxuan was, of course, fine. She had only been picking up the cup. Why was he so angry? Was it directed at Cui Zaiting or at her?

Could it be that he thought she had been holding hands with Cui Zaiting?

She softly replied, "This servant is fine. The teacup fell to the ground, and I was just about to pick it up."

With that, Yuxuan picked up the cup that had fallen to the ground.

It wasn't broken, but it had a chip. It couldn't be used in Honghui Hall anymore.

Because of her explanation, Zhao Xuanyou's expression softened slightly. However, he still didn't look at Cui Zaiting with any kindness.

"Master Cui, you barged in and caused a commotion. What is the purpose of your visit?"

Yuxuan, holding the tray and the teacup, was a bit surprised by his cold reaction.

By not allowing Cui Zaiting to sit down and talk, it seemed he was prepared to break ties with the Xingguo Duke's mansion.

She suspected that Manager Song was also aware of this, which was why he had let Cui Zaiting sit on the ground in the sun.

She wanted to listen to their conversation and wasn't in a hurry to go inside, so she silently took a step back behind Zhao Xuanyou.

"I want to see Yichu. Take me to her." Cui Zaiting wasn't stupid. He knew that no one in the Marquis's mansion would tell him the truth.

Right now, he just wanted to confirm Cui Yichu's safety as soon as possible.

Zhao Xuanyou asked, "Did the servants pass on your message?"

"They did. They said Yichu is ill and refuses to see me, but I don't believe it."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression returned to calmness, and there was even a hint of a smile between his brows. "If she refuses to see you, what does it have to do with me?"

Cui Zaiting's lips trembled upon hearing this, filled with both anger and confusion. "Zhao Xuanyou, Yichu is your wife. How can you be so indifferent? If you don't care about her, then I will take her away with me today."

Upon hearing this, Zhao Xuanyou confirmed that Cui Zaiting knew nothing about Cui Yichu's scandal.

Probably, after Zhao Xuanyou sent the porcelain bottle to the Xingguo Duke's mansion, Cui Zaiting had heard some fragments from the Xingguo Duke and his wife and had rushed over in a hurry to seek justice for her.

Zhao Xuanyou coldly retorted, "Who are you? On what grounds do you take her away?"

"I am her brother. Of course, I can manage her affairs." Cui Zaiting answered with righteous indignation.

"Cui Yichu's parents are still alive, and the young master is her elder brother by the same mother. Anyone can come to the Marquis's mansion to claim her, but it's not your turn, you, a son by a concubine."

Cui Zaiting's face turned pale upon hearing this. However, he wasn't angry about the humiliation he had suffered but realized that Zhao Xuanyou had finally confirmed that something had happened between him and Cui Yichu.

There was a hidden anger in his eyes, and his fists were tightly clenched under his sleeves.

"Zhao Xuanyou, explain yourself clearly. What exactly happened?"

Zhao Xuanyou naturally saw his clenched fists and gritted teeth, but he was Zhao Xuanyou, the one who feared the least was someone wanting to fight him.

He looked at Cui Zaiting and couldn't help but give a light laugh.

After years of wading through blood on the battlefield, even his enemies would be terrified at the mention of his name. It had been a long time since someone had shown such a fierce expression in front of him.

He said casually, "The Xingguo Duke and his wife know best about this matter. Why ask me? However, since you have come, you might as well take a message back for me."

Cui Zaiting recalled that early this morning, when he went to his father's study, he and the Duke's wife were indeed arguing loudly. It was during their loud argument that he heard Cui Yichu's name.

However, when he entered, they fell silent and refused to speak no matter how he asked. Fearful that something had happened to Cui Yichu, he had rushed to the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion to confirm.

"What message do you want me to take?"

Zhao Xuanyou said, "Tell them to quickly figure out how to apologize to the Marquis's mansion. Once they have thought it through, they can come to the Marquis's mansion to take her away. I will divorce her myself."

"What did you say?" Cui Zaiting looked at Zhao Xuanyou in shock, unable to believe his ears. "What apology? What divorce?"

Zhao Xuanyou said no more and walked straight into Honghui Hall.

Cui Zaiting tried to chase after him but was stopped by the guards at the door.

These guards had been trained by Zhao Xuanyou for many years and were highly skilled in martial arts. They quickly restrained him firmly.

"Let go of me! Let go of me!"

Seeing him making such a commotion, Yuxuan stepped forward and advised, "Master Cui, the young master's words were very clear. All the rights and wrongs can be clarified when you return home. You need not worry about the madam. The Marquis's mansion is a reasonable family and will not mistreat the madam."

She wanted to tear Cui Yichu into pieces, but she knew very well that Zhao Xuanyou wouldn't, and neither would Old Madam Ye.

Cui Zaiting, originally emotional and full of resentment, finally calmed down upon hearing Yuxuan's words.

He looked at Yuxuan and asked softly, "Do you know what happened?"

Yuxuan shook her head.

"Yichu wouldn't do anything wrong." He muttered.

In fact, he had also realized that if Yichu had not been in the wrong, how could his father and the Duke's wife have argued so loudly in the study?

Manager Song hurried over and saw Cui Zaiting, dumbfounded, being restrained by the guards. He coughed twice. "Second Young Master, I will arrange a sedan chair to send you back home."

The two servants next to him, without any further ado, took Cui Zaiting away and half-supported, half-carried him out of the mansion.

Yuxuan carried the tray back into the house. Zhao Xuanyou was drinking tea. Seeing this, he said, "He's not a guest of the mansion. Why offer him tea?"

"It wasn't tea, just a cup of water." Seeing his sulking face, Yuxuan put the tray aside, walked up to him, and said, "Why did you return so early today, my lord?"

Zhao Xuanyou neither confirmed nor denied, his gaze dark and unclear.

What else could it be? As soon as Cui Zaiting arrived, Manager Song had sent someone to the Secretariat to inform him.

Afraid of alarming the old madam, he had even skipped lunch at the office and rushed back.

Yuxuan truly didn't understand what he was angry about, so she could only say, "This servant will first attend to you in changing clothes. Yingxue has already gone to the kitchen to have them prepare."

Normally, Zhao Xuanyou didn't eat at home, so this sudden return required additional arrangements.

Zhao Xuanyou usually changed his own clothes, but hearing her say this, he nodded and went into the inner room, standing there to let her serve him.

Yuxuan was quite familiar with these tasks by now. She quickly helped him take off his official robes and put on a light, breathable casual outfit.

Compared to the hazy allure of the night, Yuxuan in the daylight appeared bright and graceful.

Her eyes were calm, and as she adjusted his belt, she lowered her gaze, her long lashes trembling slightly, which was truly charming and captivating.

chapters.title: Do You Care About Him?
chapters.content:
He gazed at her quietly until she finished adjusting his belt and sleeves and looked up, still reluctant to look away.

A sweet fragrance wafted from her, and his eyes gradually darkened.

"What kind of sachet are you wearing?"

"I don’t use sachets," Yu Wan replied. Lord Zhao Xuanyou disliked strong scents, so no incense was burned in Honghui Hall, and the servants did not wear sachets either.

As soon as she finished speaking, Yu Wan remembered something. "It must be the laundry maids who scented my clothes for me."

Lady Ye and Madame Cui Yi both enjoyed fragrances, so the laundry room would additionally scent the cleaned clothes with incense.

Yingxue had said that Yu Wan was now the undisputed favorite in the household, and many things would be taken care of without her needing to ask.

When her clothes were sent to the laundry, it went without saying that someone would scent them.

"I’ll tell them not to do that in the future..."

"This scent is quite pleasant." Zhao Xuanyou said, unable to resist taking another breath.

The faint sweet fragrance carried a hint of her own scent.

Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t help but reach out and wrap his arms around her slender waist.

Yu Wan knew what he was thinking, and her face flushed crimson.

It was one thing at night, but this was broad daylight. She softly urged, "The kitchen should have everything prepared. My lord, please go to the warm pavilion to dine."

Zhao Xuanyou did not speak. Instead, he pulled her even closer.

Lowering his head, his forehead pressed against hers.

They were so close that their breaths intertwined.

Yu Wan was thinking of how to refuse when she heard his deep voice ask, "Are you hungry?"

What could she say?

It was nearly time for lunch, and Yu Wan was indeed hungry. Since he had returned to eat, today’s meal would surely be abundant.

But his tone was ambiguous; clearly, he wasn’t asking about food.

Yu Wan truly did not want to answer, to let him have his way.

So she tilted her head up, her eyes filled with a soft, aggrieved look, and replied, "This servant is not hungry. My lord, please go to the warm pavilion."

Hearing her displeasure, Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes flashed with the scene he had witnessed earlier; Yu Wan crouching beside Cui Zaiting, their hands overlapping.

He coldly huffed, gripping her chin, and gave her no chance to refuse as he directly carried her to the bed.

---

When Yingxue led the kitchen staff to serve the dishes, she saw the door tightly closed and felt a moment of confusion.

Just now, when she saw the young master return, afraid of delaying his meal, she had hurried to the kitchen to make arrangements.

Although lunch was also prepared, the Old Madame usually ate lightly, with little meat, and the dishes prepared were not to the young master’s taste. So, Madame Qin immediately started cooking a few hot stir-fried dishes.

After all that effort, why was the door closed?

Yingxue looked at Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhi under the corridor with a belly full of doubts.

Yuan Qing had a strange expression and refused to speak. Yuan Zhi smiled and said, "Wait a bit."

"Alright, it’s hot anyway, the food won’t get cold."

Yuan Zhi thought for a moment, then coughed twice. "Take it back to the kitchen to keep warm. The young master had a lot to do this morning and is tired, so he’s taking a nap first. We’ll serve it when he wakes up."

At the mention of waking up, Yingxue suddenly understood.

The young master really couldn’t bear to be apart from Sister Yu Wan, not even during the day.

However, while the people in Honghui Hall knew about this, those outside the courtyard must not. She quickly turned around and instructed the kitchen staff to return first.

"Tell Madame Qin to stew a meat soup for the young master to nourish him."

As expected, Yuan Zhi was right. When someone was called from inside the room, it was already half an hour later.

Yingxue had specifically asked her mother yesterday about how to attend to such situations, and now it came in handy.

She hurriedly carried a basin of water inside and wrung a towel to wipe the young master’s face and hands as he sat at the edge of the bed.

It was the middle of the day, and Zhao Xuanyou had worked up a sweat. Simply wiping his hands and face wouldn’t do, so he had Yuan Qing fetch several buckets of water to the adjacent room for a bath.

With only Yu Wan left on the bed, Yingxue was no longer so nervous.

"Sister Yu Wan, let me help you wipe your back."

Since they were both women, there was nothing to be embarrassed about.

By the time Yu Wan had cleaned up and came out, Zhao Xuanyou was already seated in the warm pavilion, having his meal.

Yuan Zhi had just come out of the warm pavilion and smiled, "Miss Yu Wan, the young master asks you to attend him at the meal."

Attend him at the meal?

Yu Wan rolled her eyes internally.

With her waist aching and legs weak, after serving him for so long, she still had to attend to his meal?

"I understand, I’ll go right now."

Yu Wan grumbled internally as she entered the warm pavilion. Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her and, seeing the displeasure in her eyes, felt a slight sense of satisfaction.

"Sit down."

At least he had some conscience.

Yu Wan did as she was told, but she didn’t dare to be too bold. She first picked up a pair of chopsticks to serve him food.

Madame Qin, having returned to her position as the head of the Hou Mansion’s kitchen, was indeed very dedicated.

On the table, besides the dishes prepared for Old Madame Ye; such as chestnut chicken soup, pickled vegetable bamboo shoots, and steamed fish slices; she had also made sweet and sour pork slices and fried golden prawns for Zhao Xuanyou. There was also a steamed goose, which was probably prepared for his dinner but brought out early.

Yu Wan, knowing Zhao Xuanyou’s preferences, picked a goose leg for him and added a few golden prawns.

Zhao Xuanyou could see that her arms were weak, and in a rare moment of kindness, he said, "Eat yourself."

This was exactly what Yu Wan wanted, but she was the most obedient and gentle. After serving him a bowl of chicken soup, she picked up her chopsticks and began to eat.

They had already missed the usual mealtime, and after he had pulled her into that exhausting activity, Yu Wan was starving.

From then on, she no longer bothered to serve him and ate to her heart’s content.

By the time Yingxue led the servants to enter and clear the dishes, most of the bowls and plates on the table were empty.

After the maids had cleared the dishes and left, Yu Wan got up and made him a cup of Pu’er tea to aid digestion.

Zhao Xuanyou took a sip of tea and softly asked, "Before I returned, did that Cui Zaiting say anything else?"

"Not anything special. He just wanted to see Madame, to find out what had happened in the Hou Mansion. Manager Song didn’t tell him anything."

Zhao Xuanyou sneered coldly, "The Cui family has the audacity to ask me."

Recalling Cui Zaiting’s behavior that day, Yu Wan had no particular fondness for him, but she could sense that he was not the same kind of person as Cui Yichu.

"Does the young master know that Mr. Cui well?"

"Not well."

The first-generation Duke of Xingguo was a strategist, while the Hou Mansion of Jingyuan was a military family. The two families had originally been on different paths and had no prior interactions.

Zhao Xuanyou had only met the Duke of Xingguo and his heir a few times before. He had first seen Cui Zaiting during his wedding to Cui Yichu.

Speaking of which, Zhao Xuanyou recalled that when he went to the Duke’s mansion to fetch his bride, the Cui family men had blocked the door, and Cui Zaiting had repeatedly made things difficult for him, posing many obscure literary questions. Fortunately, the Hou Mansion had an extensive library, and he had studied widely, so he was able to resolve them one by one.

"Why would I know a bookworm like him?"

"A bookworm?" Yu Wan couldn’t help but admire Zhao Xuanyou’s insight in judging people. She had thought long and hard about how to describe Cui Zaiting’s demeanor but couldn’t find the right words. She hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to sum it up so simply. "That Mr. Cui does indeed have a somewhat bookish air. He’s not like Madame."

"He is the illegitimate son of the Duke of Xingguo. When he was very young, he was sent to a mountain academy to study."

"Oh?"

That was somewhat strange. If he had left the capital so early, how could he have such a deep sibling bond with Cui Yichu?

Seeing Yu Wan frowning in thought, Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t help but feel a stir in his heart.

"Do you care about him?"

---

chapters.title: Double Standards for Her
chapters.content:
Did she care?

Yu Wan did care about Cui Zaiting to some extent, but not out of curiosity about him as a person. Rather, she was curious about the family relationships within the Duke of Xingguo’s mansion.

Cui Zaiting genuinely cared about his sister, Cui Yichu. But for someone like Cui Yichu, was there anyone who truly cared for her?

But judging by Zhao Xuanyou’s expression, he clearly didn’t want to know the answer.

She curved her lips into a smile. "This servant doesn’t care about him. I just heard before about the Duke of Xingguo’s reputation for doting on his daughter. Even though Cui Zaiting has been away from the capital for years, he still knows the news. The Duke and his wife must know as well. Why haven’t they come to inquire in person? Instead, it’s this somewhat naive second young master who has come."

"Face, of course."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a cold humph. Naturally, he understood why the Duke and his wife could remain so composed.

They hadn’t felt any guilt when they had schemed against him before. Now that he knew the truth, they suddenly cared about face.

Today, he had deliberately sent Cui Zaiting back to deliver a message, precisely because of his naive nature.

This bookworm would definitely deliver his words back home and force the Duke and his wife to come to the Hou Mansion to handle this matter.

With his grandmother having calmly accepted the situation, Zhao Xuanyou now had no reservations. He only wanted to quickly resolve the issue of Cui Yichu, this tumor.

He truly did not want that woman to continue holding the title of his wife for even a day longer.

"Cui Zaiting seems a bit foolish. Since he knows the young master intends to divorce his wife, he will surely urge the Duke of Xingguo to handle this matter. I wonder how many days it will take for them to come."

Listening to Yu Wan’s words, Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her.

She appeared obedient and gentle, but in reality, she was intelligent and quick-witted, understanding with just a hint.

"They will probably delay for another two or three days."

Feeling Zhao Xuanyou’s scrutinizing gaze, Yu Wan lowered her eyes and softly said, "I see," before falling silent.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up his tea and took a sip.

To be honest, Zhao Xuanyou did not like scheming women.

It wasn’t that he preferred stupidity.

He hoped that the woman who would accompany him for life would be kind and simple, with no need for probing, guessing, calculation, or manipulation between them.

So why was he more tolerant of Yu Wan?

Perhaps because she was just a concubine. Being with her only required pleasure, with no need for any other considerations.

Zhao Xuanyou set down his tea cup and suddenly leaned over, familiarly embracing her.

---

As Zhao Xuanyou had expected, three days after Cui Zaiting’s departure, the Duke and Duchess of Xingguo arrived at the door.

After listening to Manager Song’s report, Zhao Xuanyou deliberately reviewed a few more scrolls of documents before having someone invite them into Honghui Hall to talk.

The Duke of Xingguo’s mansion was prosperous with many people, and the entourage that came to the Hou Mansion was grand. Besides the Duke and Duchess, all four of their sons were present, filling up half of Honghui Hall.

Although there were many of them, Zhao Xuanyou was not afraid of their numbers.

Yuan Zhi and Yu Wan remained in the room to attend, standing on either side of Zhao Xuanyou. They were both aware of the situation.

Zhao Xuanyou did not rise to greet the Cui family. Instead, he got straight to the point. "My request, I assume your second young master has already conveyed it?"

"Zhao Xuanyou, don’t be too excessive!" The third young master of the Cui family, seeing that Zhao Xuanyou did not put his parents in his eyes at all, neither offering a seat nor serving tea, could not bear it any longer. "These are your father-in-law and mother-in-law standing here!"

"Do they still think it’s a secret?" Zhao Xuanyou sneered. "Since they claim to be my father-in-law and mother-in-law, then everyone here is family. Let’s be frank. How do my father-in-law and mother-in-law plan to handle the matter of Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity before marriage?"

"You!" Madame Tao of the Cui family clenched her fists, her expression changing abruptly.

Years ago, when Cui Yichu’s incident occurred, she and the Duke of Xingguo had personally handled it with their trusted aides, ensuring that not a whisper of the news leaked out.

This time, the truth had come to light, and they had only informed the heir of the Duke of Xingguo. The other three brothers, including Cui Zaiting, were unaware.

Now, Zhao Xuanyou had exposed Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity before marriage. Even if they managed to take her back, she would have no place to stand in the family.

"How is that possible?" Cui Zaiting shouted. "Yichu usually only likes to read and write. Apart from entering the palace to accompany the princess in her studies, she rarely goes out. How could she have lost her chastity before marriage?"

"Whether it’s true or not, you shouldn’t ask me. You should ask your parents." Zhao Xuanyou struck at their hearts, sneering. "Of course, I warned you earlier; you’re just an illegitimate son. They won’t tell you anything."

"Enough, Xuanyou." The Duke of Xingguo finally spoke.

He was around forty years old. Although there were some fine lines on his face, his features suggested that he had been a handsome man in his youth. The Cui family’s children were all good-looking, each resembling him.

"Duke of Xingguo, what instructions do you have?" Zhao Xuanyou was no longer willing to acknowledge him as his father-in-law. If it weren’t for Cui Yichu still being in the mansion, he wouldn’t have allowed these people to set foot in the Jingyuan Hou Mansion again.

The Duke of Xingguo first looked at his three sons who were unaware of the situation and said in a low voice, "There are reasons for this. I will explain in detail when we return home."

Facing Zhao Xuanyou’s mocking gaze, the Duke of Xingguo managed to remain composed.

Things had developed to this point. Even if Zhao Xuanyou had no human or physical evidence, denial was impossible.

Since Zhao Xuanyou had confirmed Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity, she could no longer remain in the Hou Mansion.

He could only do his best to suppress the matter, keeping it within the Jingyuan Hou Mansion; or rather, within this Honghui Hall.

He had called them here today to humiliate them.

After all, most of the people in this room were surnamed Cui. Enduring this one day’s humiliation would be enough.

"Young Master, what do you intend to do?" The Duke of Xingguo forced himself to remain calm.

"My requirements, didn’t Cui Zaiting make them clear? First, I want a divorce. Second, you must sincerely compensate me to appease my anger."

Upon hearing this, Madame Tao angrily retorted, "You want a divorce, and you still want to appease your anger? How?"

Before Zhao Xuanyou could respond, Old Madame Ye appeared at the entrance of Honghui Hall.

"Hmph, Madame Cui’s words are indeed strange. You married a woman who had lost her chastity into the Jingyuan Hou Mansion to be its mistress. Do you think a mere divorce is enough? How did you deceive the Old Madame of the Chengguo Duke’s Mansion into coming to persuade me? Did she know about Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity? If you don’t explain clearly today, I will personally go to the Chengguo Duke’s Mansion to ask."

Old Madame Ye’s words were powerful, directly countering Madame Tao’s unreasonable outburst, and there was a hint of threat in her tone.

If the Duke of Xingguo’s Mansion did not show sincerity in compensation, the entire capital would soon know about Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity.

"Grandmother." Zhao Xuanyou had instructed Manager Song not to disturb Old Madame Ye, but she had arrived so quickly, which meant she must have made arrangements.

After all, the old servants in the mansion were all promoted by her.

Madame Tao, hearing Old Madame Ye’s words, showed no fear. Instead, she turned the tables and threatened, "Yichu’s matter involves the palace. If the Jingyuan Hou Mansion spreads this, it may backfire on you."

Old Madame Ye came from the Anning Marquis’s Mansion and had been the mistress of the Jingyuan Hou Mansion for decades. She had seen countless upheavals in the court and political storms. How could she be intimidated by the mere mention of the "palace"? Hearing such words only made her laugh.

"The Hou Mansion only knows that Cui Yichu lost her chastity before marriage. As for whether the person involved is from the palace, I know nothing, and Xuanyou knows nothing! If one day rumors about palace nobles spread, the Duke of Xingguo’s Mansion will die before the Jingyuan Hou Mansion does!"

chapters.title: Kneel and Apologize
chapters.content:
The Tao family had not expected that Lady Ye, despite her advanced age, would still be so sharp and formidable. Their expressions changed, and they were left speechless.

The Duke of Xingguo still forced himself to remain calm and respectfully greeted Lady Ye. "Old Madam, it has been a long time. I hope you have been in good health?"

"Very well indeed. If it weren't for your deliberate schemes against my grandson and your humiliation of the Marquis's mansion, this old woman could have lived a few more years."

Zhao Xuanyou understood that Lady Ye was engaging in a verbal sparring with them, but he also knew that his grandmother had been deeply troubled by this matter, unable to sleep for many nights, and her resentment towards them had grown increasingly intense.

"On the day at the Tinghui Mansion, you said that Xuanyou would either divorce his wife or apologize. Do you still stand by those words?"

"Of course. I am not the kind of person who breaks promises or speaks sweetly while harboring ill intentions."

The Duke of Xingguo knew that Zhao Xuanyou was angry, and every word he spoke was an insult to them. But in this matter, they were indeed in the wrong, and no matter what Zhao Xuanyou wanted to do, they had to comply.

"Prince, we have come to your door today to sincerely apologize. However, regarding the divorce..."

Zhao Xuanyou raised his chin and narrowed his eyes. "Can it be changed to a peaceful separation?"

The Duke of Xingguo quickly said, "I would never let you suffer a loss."

"Is that so?" Zhao Xuanyou's eyes suddenly turned cold.

A general who was decisive on the battlefield, once revealing his killing intent, was not something ordinary people could handle.

Even though the Duke of Xingguo tried his best to remain calm, the color drained from his face at this moment.

Cui Zaizhou, the heir of the Duke of Xingguo, who had been silent all this time, finally spoke: "Back then, you gave a generous betrothal gift to marry Yichi. We will return all these gifts in full. Yichi's dowry was also quite substantial, and all of it can remain in the Marquis's mansion. The marriage back then was a moment of confusion on the part of my parents and Yichi. Whatever compensation you require, we are willing to provide, as long as you allow Yichi to live and return home through a peaceful separation."

Yu Wan's eyes flickered slightly, and she was somewhat surprised.

She had only interacted with Cui Yichi from the Duke of Xingguo's family. In her view, a family that could raise such a vicious daughter must be a den of filth. But her brother seemed to be a reasonable person?

Perhaps it was a case of knowing the face but not the heart.

Upon hearing this, Lady Ye also looked at Zhao Xuanyou.

Cui Yichi's pre-marital loss of chastity was a grave sin, but she had already married into the Marquis's mansion. If this matter were to spread, not only would she be unable to show her face, but Zhao Xuanyou would also become a laughingstock.

The threats made to the Tao family earlier were just threats. The Jingyuan Marquis's mansion would never spread this matter.

The conditions proposed by Cui Zaizhou were indeed good.

Zhao Xuanyou had given a generous betrothal gift back then, but as the beloved daughter of the Duke of Xingguo, Cui Yichi's dowry was indeed very rich.

If Zhao Xuanyou were to divorce his wife, the high-ranking families would gossip endlessly, and who knows what rumors might surface. But if it were a peaceful separation, it would be much more acceptable in the eyes of others, without so much prying.

However, this was Xuanyou's matter, and she did not want to overstep her bounds by making the decision for him. She simply looked at him inquiringly, letting him decide for himself.

Feeling Lady Ye's gaze, Zhao Xuanyou knew that his grandmother thought it was time to stop.

But how could a mere dowry compensate for his anger?

Cui Zaiting saw that his brother had somewhat moved Lady Ye, and also persuaded: "Yichi has indeed made a great mistake. Whatever you want to do to her is fine, we only ask that the Marquis's mansion gives her a chance to live."

"Whatever I want to do is fine?" Zhao Xuanyou asked coldly.

The Duke of Xingguo and Madame Tao exchanged glances, Cui Zaizhou also frowned, but Cui Zaiting urgently agreed: "Yes, as long as you agree to a peaceful separation, we will comply with any request."

Yu Wan also looked at Zhao Xuanyou at this moment.

As far as she could see, the Marquis's mansion was very wealthy, and Zhao Xuanyou did not care about money at all.

The condition proposed by Cui Zaizhou might be very tempting to others, but Zhao Xuanyou would not be swayed.

But what would he do?

If he wanted to kill Cui Yichi, he would have done so long ago. He just wanted a divorce.

Under the gaze of everyone in the room, Zhao Xuanyou slowly said: "In ancient times, there was Lian Po carrying thorns to apologize. Since you have no thorns, then kneel and apologize."

"You are being insolent!" Madame Tao was shocked upon hearing this.

The Duke of Xingguo was a hereditary first-class duke, and she was a first-rank imperial concubine. Even when entering the palace, they only bowed to the emperor and empress.

How could Zhao Xuanyou, a mere fourth-rank official and a marquis's heir, ask them to kneel and apologize?

The Duke of Xingguo did not speak, but his face turned pale, clearly enraged by Zhao Xuanyou's proposal.

Lady Ye also looked at Zhao Xuanyou in surprise but did not say anything.

The three young masters of the Cui family were stunned, their eyes wide open.

Kneel and apologize? Yu Wan's eyes flickered. This was indeed something Zhao Xuanyou would do.

After a deathly silence in the room, Cui Zaiting spoke first: "Zhao Xuanyou, I can kneel and apologize on behalf of Yichi, but my parents are of a higher generation than you. If you make them kneel to you, it might shorten your own lifespan!"

"Cursing me to have a shorter lifespan, is that an apology or a threat?" Zhao Xuanyou said. Since the day he sent the white porcelain bottle to the Duke of Xingguo's mansion, he had already torn off all pretense with them and would not leave any room for maneuver. "If you don't agree, it's fine. After all, it's just a dowry. I don't care about it at all."

"Indeed, just write the divorce letter," Lady Ye also hated the people of the Duke of Xingguo's family. However, she also felt that making the Duke and his wife kneel to Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat inappropriate.

She didn't care about the dowry either. It was better to divorce quickly and find some peace.

But Zhao Xuanyou said, "I don't want to write a divorce letter either. Now that I am staying in the capital, the marquis's mansion in the border area will have no master. I plan to send someone tomorrow to escort Madame there to live. As for whether she can arrive safely, I don't know."

"You, Zhao Xuanyou!"

This was a complete threat!

Cui Zaiting, upon hearing this, knelt down with red eyes: "Zhao Xuanyou, I beg you to let Yichi go! Please spare her life! The Duke of Xingguo's family has wronged you. I will take the blame!"

He spoke sincerely, but Zhao Xuanyou's expression remained cold and unmoved.

From the moment the Duke of Xingguo and his wife decided to marry Cui Yichi into the Marquis's mansion, they had not considered leaving any face for Zhao Xuanyou.

They came to apologize today not because they genuinely felt guilty, but for the sake of the Duke of Xingguo's family's face and honor.

At this point, the heir Cui Zaizhou hesitated for a moment and then knelt down as well.

As the eldest legitimate son of the Duke of Xingguo, his kneeling caused the other two to follow suit.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze was fixed only on the Duke of Xingguo and his wife.

Seeing that he was still not satisfied, Cui Zaizhou clenched his fists and said, "Can you really accept the greetings from my parents?"

Zhao Xuanyou raised his chin, coldly folded his arms, and looked down with a superior attitude.

"Whether you perform the ritual or not is your business. Whether I can accept it or not is my business. You don't need to worry about it."

---

chapters.title: What is Humiliation
chapters.content:
The third young master of the Cui family could not help but say, "You want us to kneel and apologize. We have all knelt and apologized. At this point, are you still not satisfied?"

"Every debt has its debtor," Zhao Xuanyou said slowly, his eyes cold. "Whoever set me up and made me marry Cui Yichi, that person should kneel and apologize."

Looking at the three Cui brothers kneeling on the ground, he sneered, "I didn't ask you to kneel. You insisted on kneeling to me. How could I stop you?"

Yu Wan stood to the side, unable to suppress a smile.

This man was truly cunning. Usually, he did not speak much, but he was surprisingly eloquent.

"Zhao Xuanyou!" The third young master of the Cui family was momentarily speechless with anger. After a while, he suddenly stood up. "Are you playing with us?"

As he spoke, he reached out and pulled up Cui Zaizhou and Cui Zaiting beside him.

"Don't kneel anymore. He never intended to let her go!"

"I haven't agreed to anything," Zhao Xuanyou said coldly. "I only told you that the main culprit kneeling and apologizing is the only way to appease my anger. Whether you kneel or not is up to you."

"Prince, everything is negotiable. Why must you humiliate my parents?" Cui Zaiting said.

"Humiliate? You're talking to me about humiliation?" Zhao Xuanyou laughed instead of getting angry. "When your family concealed Cui Yichi's loss of chastity and married her to me, did you ever consider what kind of humiliation I would suffer?"

With these few words, Zhao Xuanyou left Cui Zaiting speechless.

"Hmph. In my view, the humiliation you have suffered today is not even a tenth of mine."

When Cui Yichi was married into the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion, it was all planned by the Duke of Xingguo. The mansion was filled with so many servants that they caused chaos in the Marquis's mansion. Even on Cui Yichi's birthday, they were still helping her scheme against him.

If he were alone, he would have wanted to eliminate all of them.

"Fine, I will apologize to you!" Under heavy pressure, Madame Tao finally yielded. She gritted her teeth so hard that her lips lost all color.

"Mother!" Cui Zaizhou hurriedly tried to stop her.

Madame Tao looked at her son and patted his shoulder, signaling him to step back.

She said bitterly, "We have come this far. If we leave now, all the previous suffering would have been in vain."

She bent her knees, her eyes devoid of any vitality, and with a thud, she knelt on the ground.

Everyone in the room, except Zhao Xuanyou, showed surprise on their faces. Even Lady Ye was somewhat taken aback.

The Cui family had indeed conspired against them, but Zhao Xuanyou was a junior. For him to ask the Duke of Xingguo and his wife to kneel and apologize was truly against all norms.

Even if this matter were taken to court, the dowry and betrothal gifts could be reclaimed, and Cui Yichi might end up in a pig cage, but it would never come to the point where the Duke of Xingguo and his wife would have to kneel and apologize.

The Duke of Xingguo was a first-class duke and a generation senior to Zhao Xuanyou. Kneeling was truly a violation of ethics.

"You said you wanted the main culprit to kneel and apologize. I am the main culprit. I was the one who found out that you were nearing twenty and still unmarried. I was the one who went to the old madam of the Chengguo Duke's mansion to ask her to arrange the match. The Cui family and your marquis's mansion had no prior connection. I originally tried it on a whim, but it progressed surprisingly smoothly. Lady Ye took a liking to Yichi as soon as she saw her. It was when your family's matchmaker came to the door that the Duke found out about this matter. He was unwilling, Yichi was unwilling, but I did my best to make it happen."

Cui Yichi?
