Zhao Xuanyou recalled the scene from his wedding night.

He had lifted the bridal veil with anticipation, and the bride sitting at the edge of the bed had an expression similar to Madame Tao's now; completely indifferent, as if she had given up on everything.

It was only when they drank the wedding wine that her gaze towards him softened slightly.

Zhao Xuanyou could never forget her initial expression.

Even though Cui Yichi had been gentle in every way since then, this matter had become a shadow in his heart.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou did not speak and seemed lost in thought, Madame Tao continued: "As for the porcelain bottle you sent back, it was also arranged by me."

"Did the Duke of Xingguo not know?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in return.

The porcelain bottle contained human blood, not chicken or duck blood. How could Madame Tao, a woman of the inner quarters, prepare fresh human blood?

The heir Cui Zaizhou heard Zhao Xuanyou's suspicion and stood up.

"That porcelain bottle was prepared by me. I just didn't know what my mother was going to use it for."

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes flashed, and a cold, thin smile appeared on his lips: "So, Madame Tao alone managed to play the Marquis's mansion like a fiddle?"

Cui Zaizhou said, "It is the Duke of Xingguo's family that has wronged you. My mother was the mastermind, and she has knelt and apologized as you requested. If you think she, as a mere woman, is not significant enough, my three brothers have all knelt to you. I am the heir of the Duke's mansion. I have knelt and apologized. Am I not enough to represent the Duke of Xingguo's family?"

Zhao Xuanyou frowned and remained silent.

Lady Ye looked at his expression and sighed softly in her heart.

Back then, she had taken a liking to Cui Yichi not only because of her good looks and family background but also because of her gentle and refined demeanor.

Xuanyou's marriage had been undecided for a long time. Most of the unmarried girls in the high-ranking families of the capital were four or five years younger than him, with unsettled characters, and it would be difficult for them to settle down in the capital to manage his household.

Cui Yichi had been an unexpectedly suitable match.

It was because of her own momentary oversight that she had been deceived, leading to such a situation.

She usually practiced Buddhism and always believed in showing mercy. But if she advised Xuanyou to forgive them, who would help Xuanyou?

He was afraid of worrying her and swallowed all the bitterness himself.

"Prince, everything that has happened today is the fault of my Duke of Xingguo's family. I hope you can forgive us." The Duke of Xingguo, who had been silent for a long time, finally spoke. He cupped his hands and bowed deeply to Zhao Xuanyou. "Yichi's dowry need not be returned. The betrothal gifts sent by the Marquis's mansion will be returned double."

Zhao Xuanyou had given a generous betrothal gift back then. If the Duke of Xingguo's family could not take back the dowry and had to return double the betrothal gifts, it would indeed be a crippling blow to them.

Noticing the reluctance in her grandmother's expression, Zhao Xuanyou also decided to let the matter rest for now.

"In that case, write the separation agreement today. After signing and sealing, you can take Cui Yichi away."

"Good!" The Duke of Xingguo did not hesitate. He reached out to help up Madame Tao, who was kneeling on the ground.

Madame Tao had lived a life of luxury for decades and had rarely knelt for so long. Her legs were weak, and she could barely stand straight, leaning heavily on her son.

Even though the Duke of Xingguo had not knelt, with his wife and son kneeling to Zhao Xuanyou, the Duke of Xingguo's family would forever be unable to hold their heads high in front of the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion.

But regardless, Zhao Xuanyou had not divorced his wife and had agreed to a peaceful separation with Cui Yichi. The Duke of Xingguo's family could still maintain a foothold in the capital, and the young masters and ladies of the family could still marry normally.

The silver they had to compensate was indeed a lot, but with so many properties under the Duke's family, they could earn it back in a few years.

Zhao Xuanyou said, "Yu Wan, prepare pen and ink for the Duke."

"Yes."

Yu Wan went to the study to fetch a set of writing brushes, ink, paper, and inkstone, and placed them on the table in the main room.

"Your Grace, please."

The Duke of Xingguo walked forward with a solemn expression. However, when he took the brush from Yu Wan's hand, he was slightly stunned upon seeing her appearance.

chapters.title: The Tide Turns
chapters.content:
Sensing Lord Xingguo’s scrutiny, Yu Wan also found it strange. She raised her brush slightly and gently reminded him, "Lord?"

Lord Xingguo withdrew his gaze, took the brush, and began writing the divorce agreement.

He was a man of literary talent and skilled in calligraphy, so he finished quickly, making two copies.

It stated that the Xingguo Duke’s mansion would not take back the dowry and would return double the betrothal gifts within a month. From then on, both parties would part ways and be free to remarry.

Lord Xingguo signed and sealed it first, then had Yu Wan deliver it to Zhao Xuanyou.

He glanced at the divorce agreement, his sword-like brows tightening.

The joy and anticipation he had felt when writing the marriage contract were now replaced by disgust and revulsion.

To avoid delaying the three letters and six rites, he had rushed back to the capital from the military, going without sleep for three days and nights.

All the cherished respect had turned into a ridiculous joke of being fooled and schemed against.

His hand hidden in his sleeve suddenly clenched into a fist!

"Prince Heir said we could take Yichu away today," Cui Zaizhou reminded.

Zhao Xuanyou shot him a sharp, cold glance. "Rest assured, I am even more eager to sweep her out the door than you are."

At this moment, there was not the slightest concealment of his repulsed emotions in his words.

Cui Zaiting, however, frowned upon hearing this. He cupped his hands towards Zhao Xuanyou. "Prince Heir, since the divorce agreement has been signed, you and Yichu are no longer related. From now on, you should still be mindful of your words!"

"You can rest easy. Since the divorce agreement is signed, the grievances between the two families are clear. Yu Wan, go to Tingyu Pavilion and bring Cui over here." Old Lady Ye had not interfered with Zhao Xuanyou’s handling of the matter, but seeing his anger, she finally spoke to ease the tension.

She felt sorry for Zhao Xuanyou, but she knew that a clean break was better than prolonged pain. The matter of Cui Yichu’s loss of chastity involved the Crown Prince, so it was indeed not suitable to spread, nor could it be spread.

One should look forward. With Zhao Xuanyou’s influence at court, remarrying would not be difficult.

After sending away this jinx, he could marry a virtuous wife and live a stable life.

"Yes." Yu Wan respectfully agreed and walked out.

Yingxue and Yuan Qing had been standing in the corridor, vaguely hearing the voices inside; words like "divorce" and "kneeling," but not clearly.

Seeing Yu Wan come out, they hurried forward. "What happened?"

"Prince Heir ordered me to go to Tingyu Pavilion and bring..." She had intended to say "Madam," but remembering the signed divorce agreement, Yu Wan changed her words. "...bring Lady Cui over."

Lady Cui?

Yingxue immediately understood, but Yuan Qing was still confused.

"I’ll go with you, sister." Yingxue said, "The people in Tingyu Pavilion are not easy to deal with."

"Alright."

Seeing the two of them walking out, Yuan Qing quickly caught up.

"I’ll go help too."

Yu Wan shook her head. "With only Yuan Yan attending here at Honghui Hall, it won’t do. You should stay here. But, ask two guards to come with us."

Being able to divorce was a result of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion’s people kneeling and compensating, but Cui Yichu had a high opinion of herself and might not be satisfied.

She had long harbored murderous intent towards Yu Wan. If she saw Yu Wan at Tingyu Pavilion, she might cause a scene where both would perish.

In her past life, she had died due to Cui Yichu’s schemes; in this life, she had to be cautious.

Having not stayed long at Honghui Hall, Yu Wan was only familiar with the guards by face and did not know their names, so it was not appropriate for her to give orders.

Yuan Qing, however, was different. It was suitable for him to speak.

"Duan Cheng, Yu Peng, you two follow Sister Yu Wan to Honghui Hall."

"Yes." The guards responded promptly and immediately followed behind Yu Wan and Yingxue.

After walking a distance, Yu Wan stopped and said to the guards, "When we get to Tingyu Pavilion, if Lady Cui comes out peacefully, that’s fine. But if she does anything extreme, please restrain her."

"Lady Cui?" They were still unaware of what had happened at Honghui Hall and looked at Yu Wan in surprise.

Yu Wan calmly explained, "Just now, Prince Heir and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion signed the divorce agreement. From now on, Lady Cui has no connection with the Marquis’s mansion. The Xingguo Duke’s mansion will take her away today. We need to deliver her intact to Honghui Hall. You know Lady Cui’s temper. If something goes wrong, it will delay Prince Heir’s important matters."

The news of Cui Yichu being confined to Tingyu Pavilion had spread throughout the Marquis’s mansion these past few days, so the two guards were also aware.

Hearing Yu Wan say that they had divorced, they were indeed surprised but not shocked.

"In that case, Miss, rest assured. When we get to Tingyu Pavilion, we will be careful."

"Thank you."

After giving special instructions, Yu Wan finally felt at ease.

When they arrived at Tingyu Pavilion, the gatekeeper, seeing Yu Wan leading the way and the guards following, stood up and asked, "What are your orders?"

"Prince Heir ordered us to bring Lady Cui to Honghui Hall."

The gatekeeper was overjoyed upon hearing this and muttered, "Finally, something is being done. She’s been restless all day. If she’s locked up any longer, I think Tingyu Pavilion will be wrecked beyond repair."

Yu Wan had heard a little about this.

After being confined, Cui Yichu had been smashing things every day and occasionally cursing Zhao Xuanyou, forcing Steward Song to have people gag her mouth with cloth to quiet her down, leaving her to vent her anger on the flowers and plants.

As they spoke, the gatekeeper opened the courtyard door.

Tingyu Pavilion was a quiet place in the Marquis’s mansion, and the courtyard was always lush with flowers. But as they entered, the entire courtyard was filled with overturned flowerpots and uprooted flowers and plants.

The plants, separated from the soil, were all withered.

Yu Wan, having worked in the flower room for a long time, felt a sudden heaviness in her heart seeing Cui Yichu so wastefully destroying the flowers and plants.

Yingxue saw her expression and took the lead towards the house.

"Lady Cui, come out. Prince Heir requests your presence."

There was no response from inside the house. Instead, a person hurriedly ran out; it was Baochuan, who had been serving Cui Yichu at Tingyu Pavilion.

She stood on the veranda, her gaze passing over Yingxue and falling directly on Yu Wan.

"How come it’s you?" she said.

Yu Wan shifted her gaze from the mess of flowers and plants to Baochuan and calmly said, "Where is Lady Cui? Call her out."

Baochuan had been confined for several days and was as listless as a frostbitten eggplant. But at the sight of Yu Wan, she suddenly perked up.

"Yu Wan, what is your status? What is Madam’s status? How dare you speak so wildly?"

At this point, Yu Wan had no intention of wasting words with her. She turned to the guards behind her. "Go inside and bring Lady Cui out."

"Yes."

Since the divorce was finalized, she was no longer the Prince Heir’s wife but an uninvited guest lingering in the Marquis’s mansion. There was no need to observe the strict separation of men and women.

As soon as she finished speaking, the two guards quickly walked towards the house.

Baochuan was horrified. "What are you doing? Don’t be rude! Madam is resting."

She tried to rush inside, but Yingxue reached out to stop her.

Baochuan struggled with all her might. The gatekeeper, recognizing Yingxue and being very perceptive, quickly came forward to help, and together they firmly restrained Baochuan.

The guards, having followed Zhao Xuanyou into battle, were far more capable than ordinary servants. In a short while, they carried Cui Yichu out of the house.

Baochuan had not been lying; Cui Yichu was indeed resting.

She had been cursing and smashing things day and night in Tingyu Pavilion, living in a state of constant upheaval; wailing in the middle of the night and sleeping during the day.

At this moment, she had been pulled out of her sleep, her hair disheveled, wearing only a thin nightgown.

Seeing this scene, Yu Wan felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity.

Back then, when she had been dragged from the bed by Madame Xing, Cui Yichu had been sitting in Leshou Hall, coldly watching as a bystander.

How quickly the tides had turned. In less than a month, Cui Yichu was being dragged from her bed, while Yu Wan had become the one watching the spectacle.

---

chapters.title: The Dowry Stays
chapters.content:
"Madam!" Baochuan, seeing her in such disarray, couldn’t help but burst into tears.

Watching their deep bond as mistress and servant, Yu Wan felt a coldness in her heart.

They looked like humans with human emotions, but when they had used and killed her, why had they shown no humanity at all?

"Take her away." Yu Wan said indifferently.

Feeling the sudden increase in the grip on her arm, Cui Yichu winced, the last remnants of her drowsiness vanishing.

"Yu Wan!"

Seeing Yu Wan standing in Tingyu Pavilion, giving orders, Cui Yichu was furious. She glared at her with bloodshot eyes, as if she wanted to swallow her alive.

Unfortunately, she was firmly held by two strong guards and couldn’t move at all.

"You shameless woman, how dare you treat me like this?"

Yu Wan scoffed, "Feel ashamed? Being dragged out of bed by a man is indeed shameful. But you are a worldly person who has done even more shameful things. What is there to fear?"

"What are you talking about?" Cui Yichu was enraged, but her palms were sweating from guilt.

Her shameful past had been cleaned up by her parents, and the only person in the Marquis’s mansion who knew about it was Zhao Xuanyou.

Could Zhao Xuanyou have told Yu Wan?

Yu Wan slowly approached her and lowered her voice. "I’m saying that all the disgraceful things you’ve done have been exposed. Your three brothers, upon learning of them, were so ashamed that they are currently kneeling in Honghui Hall with your mother, apologizing to Prince Heir."

"You’re lying! How could my mother possibly..." Cui Yichu’s face turned ashen, her angry eyes fixed on Yu Wan, but her words trembled and she couldn’t continue.

Baochuan, however, was clearer-headed at this moment. She quickly said, "Madam, don’t worry. Lord Duke and the others have come to rescue you. From now on, you won’t have to endure this place. This is a good thing."

A good thing?

If the truth was exposed, Zhao Xuanyou would certainly not tolerate her. Staying in the Marquis’s mansion would be a dead end. If she returned home... everyone there would know her secrets... How could she face them in the future?

Cui Yichu’s face was a mix of green and white as she stared blankly at Yu Wan, her eyes fixed unblinkingly.

Yu Wan met her gaze without flinching, showing no fear.

"Yingxue, go inside and get some clothes for Lady Cui. After all, she is being expelled from the Marquis’s mansion. It would look bad if she is too disheveled."

As she spoke, Yu Wan finally understood why Cui Yichu always spoke lightly and casually before. It wasn’t due to her upbringing or virtue, but the power that her status and honor had given her.

So, that was the mindset of someone in a superior position.

"Alright." Yingxue responded and quickly entered the house.

Ever since Yu Wan mentioned that her family was kneeling and begging Zhao Xuanyou for mercy, Cui Yichu had been like a soul taken by ghosts, standing there dumbfounded.

Yingxue took a honey-colored blouse and an apricot-red skirt from the wardrobe and put them directly over her nightgown.

That apricot-red skirt had been given to Cui Yichu by Zhao Xuanyou from the palace not long ago. She had received two bolts of fabric and immediately ordered clothes to be made, but had never worn them. She hadn’t expected the first time she wore it would be today.

Seeing Cui Yichu’s disheveled hair, Yingxue also took a gold hairpin and roughly tied her hair into a bun.

Even with her pale face and red eyes, at first glance, one couldn’t say she had been mistreated by the Marquis’s mansion.

After all, the Marquis’s mansion had not mistreated her.

During her time at Tingyu Pavilion, apart from not being allowed to leave, she had been well fed and cared for every day. The servants guarding the door had also been scolded by her repeatedly, yet no one dared to treat her as anything less than the Prince Heir’s wife.

"That’s about it. Take her over."

As soon as Yu Wan finished speaking, the two guards escorted Cui Yichu towards Tingyu Pavilion.

Before they could even leave the courtyard, Baochuan behind them said, "I am Madam’s personal maid. Prince Heir ordered me to take care of Madam. Wherever Madam goes, I go. Let me go!"

Yu Wan suddenly turned around. "Don’t let her go."

"Yu Wan! It was Prince Heir’s order. Do you dare to disobey?"

"The Marquis’s mansion and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion have already discussed it clearly. The Duke’s mansion can take Lady Cui away today, but all the dowry must stay in the Marquis’s mansion, including you."

Baochuan, upon hearing this, was overwhelmed with rage and despair. She stared blankly at Yu Wan, not daring to utter a single word of rebuttal.

In that instant, shock, doubt, and trembling filled her mind.

That Yu Wan, that shabby flower room maid, that tool for surrogate pregnancy they had manipulated and schemed against. How had she become the winner?

Madame Zhou was dead, Baozhu was dead, Madam had been driven out of the Marquis’s mansion, and she had been left behind in the Marquis’s mansion. What kind of fate awaited her now?

Baochuan suddenly felt lightheaded, her legs gave way, and she collapsed to the side.

---

As they neared Honghui Hall, Yu Wan had one of the guards let go and had Yingxue take over to support Cui Yichu’s other side.

Cui Yichu, her heart as dead as ashes, said coldly, "Why don’t you dare to support me? Are you that afraid of me?"

"Yes," Yu Wan didn’t take offense and smiled. "I’m afraid of your bad luck."

"You shameless woman, you’re just relying on your looks to temporarily bewitch Zhao Xuanyou. With your background, do you think Zhao Xuanyou can elevate you?"

Yu Wan had never expected Zhao Xuanyou’s favor to last long.

In fact, as long as she could bring down Cui Yichu, even if Zhao Xuanyou abandoned her today, she wouldn’t care.

Cui Yichu’s words couldn’t hurt her in the slightest.

They were blood enemies. At this point, Cui Yichu still tried to hurt her with words, but Yu Wan could only tighten her grip on Cui Yichu’s fatal weakness.

"You were driven out of the Marquis’s mansion. Was it because I bewitched Prince Heir, or because you are a dissolute and shameless woman? I know the truth, you know the truth, and the people of the Marquis’s mansion and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion know it even better."

Yu Wan’s voice was neither too loud nor too soft, just enough for Yingxue and the guards to hear.

Several sharp gazes fell on Cui Yichu, causing her to immediately shut her mouth.

Soon, they entered Honghui Hall. Before Yu Wan could report inside, Cui Yichu’s three brothers came out in single file, running all the way to the courtyard.

"Yichu, why do you look so terrible?" Cui Zaizhou asked with concern.

Cui Zaiting saw the guards tightly restraining Cui Yichu and looked displeased. "Yichu is no longer part of your Marquis’s mansion. Do not be rude. Release her at once!"

Faced with the concern of her relatives, Cui Yichu felt as if her whole body was being pricked by needles.

Lord Xingguo and Madame Tao also came out of the house. As soon as they saw Cui Yichu, Madame Tao immediately burst into tears and quickly ran to her, crying, "It’s alright now. You’ve divorced Zhao Xuanyou. From now on, you can just go home and live your life."

Divorced?

Cui Yichu looked up at her mother, somewhat unbelieving.

Earlier, when Yu Wan had made that display, she had always thought she was being abandoned, but it turned out to be a divorce by mutual consent?

She couldn’t help but doubt Yu Wan’s words.

"Earlier, that shameless woman said you knelt to Zhao Xuanyou. Was she deliberately lying to me?"

Madame Tao hadn’t expected Cui Yichu to know about this. Remembering the humiliation she had suffered today, she couldn’t bear to repeat it and could only glare at Yu Wan with resentment.

Zhao Xuanyou, supporting Old Lady Ye, also came out of the house and happened to hear Cui Yichu’s words.

His gaze was filled with disgust, and his words were sparse. "She’s asking a question. Why don’t you answer?"

chapters.title: A Dying Struggle
chapters.content:
If Cui Yichu had still harbored doubts, Zhao Xuanyou’s words confirmed what Yu Wan had said.

Her family, her mother. Had they really knelt before Zhao Xuanyou and begged for mercy?!

Was it because of this that he had agreed to write the divorce letter?

The anger in Cui Yichu’s chest swelled, nearly bursting.

Born into a noble household, pampered and cherished, what she took the most pride in was her status as the legitimate daughter of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. Relying on her parents’ affection, she had always been unrestrained and arrogant.

Even when the Empress had suppressed her in the past, preventing her from marrying into the royal family, her parents had no choice but to yield.

That was the Empress, the mistress of the harem, the queen of a thousand phoenixes.

But Zhao Xuanyou before her was merely a fourth-rank court official. How dare her family kneel before him?!

The pride and honor she had always cherished had been so easily trampled upon by Zhao Xuanyou.

Perhaps emboldened by the presence of her family comforting her, Cui Yichu suddenly found her courage. She lifted her noble head once more and furious rebuked, “Zhao Xuanyou! I’m not afraid of you! If you want to kill me, then kill me! Let me tell you, you’re not worthy of touching me! If it weren’t for my misfortune, how could a man like you ever marry…”

Before she could finish, the Duke of Xingguo rushed down the steps and slapped her hard across the face.

“Father…”

Cui Yichu looked at her own father in disbelief. From childhood to now, her father had doted on her the most. Even if it was something belonging to her brothers, if she wanted it, her father would always give it to her.

Yet now, in front of everyone, he had struck her?

The Duke of Xingguo’s face was dark with fury. “Are you not ashamed enough?! You’ve disgraced the Xingguo Duke’s mansion’s century-old reputation! Shut her mouth!”

Tao Shi’s hands trembled slightly, but she hardened her heart and stuffed a handkerchief into Cui Yichu’s mouth.

The three young masters of the Cui family also hesitated, but they understood that if they let Cui Yichu continue her outburst, Zhao Xuanyou would never allow them to take her away today.

“Young Master, Yichu is ill and speaking madness. I must take her back to the mansion for treatment immediately. Please order the guards to release her.”

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, but Old Madam Ye finally lost her temper.

Earlier, it was she who had advised Zhao Xuanyou to show mercy and let the Xingguo Duke’s mansion off lightly.

But now, hearing Cui Yichu’s heartfelt words, she realized that this wicked woman had no remorse or guilt. She truly deserved to die!

“Duke of Xingguo, although Xuanyou has written the divorce letter today, I hope you understand that Cui Yichu has violated the Seven Grounds for Divorce. As a wife, she was unvirtuous; as a daughter-in-law, she was unfilial. The Marquis’s mansion originally intended to divorce her, but because we are a family of virtue, we agreed to a peaceful separation instead. If there is any other gossip in the capital regarding this divorce, even if this old woman never leaves the house, I will not let it rest!”

The Duke of Xingguo heard the warning in Old Madam Ye’s words.

She was telling them that from now on, they must not spread rumors among the noble families of the capital. They must acknowledge in the aristocratic circles that the fault of the divorce lay with Cui Yichu.

Originally, they had fought for a peaceful divorce to calm the situation and allow the Duke’s mansion to weather this crisis.

But who could have expected Cui Yichu to shout those things at Zhao Xuanyou…?

The Duke of Xingguo closed his eyes wearily. “Old Madam, rest assured. It was her fault. There will be no other rumors in the capital.”

“Get out.” Zhao Xuanyou said.

If it had been before, Cui Zaiting and the others would have certainly rebuked him. But now, having seen Cui Yichu’s true nature, they all understood that Zhao Xuanyou saying just this one word was already the height of restraint.

The guards finally released Cui Yichu, and Tao Shi and Cui Zaizhou half-dragged, half-pulled her away.

Cui Zaiting followed for a few steps before turning back to Honghui Hall.

“Old Madam, Young Master, I was unaware of the situation. I thought you were treating Yichu poorly… which is why I said those offensive words. I hope you can forgive me.”

Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t be bothered to respond. Old Madam Ye sighed instead.

“Go. I only hope that from now on, you will keep to yourselves and never cross paths with us again!”

Cui Zaiting’s face showed shame. He cupped his hands in a bow to them before hurriedly leaving.

After such a grand spectacle in Honghui Hall, it finally quieted down.

“Grandmother, I’ll escort you back to Leshou Hall.”

Old Madam Ye was already advanced in years. After watching the commotion from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion for so long, she was utterly exhausted and could barely continue walking without Zhao Xuanyou’s support.

Seeing his grandmother’s haggard appearance, Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes sharpened with anger.

He and Cui Yichu would indeed never cross paths again, but he and Zhao Zun, and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. This was far from over!

“Yingxue, go to the kitchen and check if lunch is ready.” Once the two of them had walked far enough away, Yu Wan said to Yingxue, “After such a big event today, tell Qin Sao to prepare a few more elaborate dishes.”

“Will the Young Master be dining in Leshou Hall?”

Yu Wan shook her head. “Old Madam looks very tired. She will probably close her eyes to rest as soon as she returns to Leshou Hall. She won’t keep the Young Master for a meal.”

“Alright, I’ll go check.”

After Yingxue left, Yu Wan went to the warm pavilion to set the table. Yuan Qing entered with a sullen expression. “What exactly did the mistress do wrong? Why would she say those things?”

To say that the Young Master wasn’t worthy of marrying her was one thing, but to say that a man like the Young Master wasn’t worthy of touching her. Did that mean the Young Master had never touched her?

Seeing Yuan Qing’s troubled look, Yu Wan softly said, “I’ll only say this once, so don’t think too much about it. Cui Yichu violated the Seven Grounds for Divorce. As for which one, you can figure it out yourself. The Young Master has been more than lenient with her.”

The Seven Grounds?

Yuan Qing was ignorant about matters of love between men and women, but he knew of the Seven Grounds for Divorce. Comparing them with Cui Yichu’s words, he quickly understood.

“You mean…?”

Yu Wan had finished setting the table. She examined it for a moment before calmly saying, “I didn’t say anything. Go change this set of bowls and chopsticks. The light blue ones usually look elegant and refined, but today they seem a bit gloomy. Change them to something more festive.”

“Alright, there’s still the set of longevity peach dishes and bowls from Old Madam’s birthday celebration. I’ll go fetch them.”

With Yuan Qing’s help, the table was quickly reset, and it did look more festive.

She then went to the adjacent room to find an elegant window screen and was in the middle of changing it when she heard footsteps behind her.

“What are you doing?”

Hearing that deep, rich voice, Yu Wan didn’t turn around immediately. Instead, she continued to hang the curtain on her tiptoes.

“The previous bamboo curtain has been up for a long time. This servant is replacing it with a gauze curtain to give this warm pavilion a fresh look.”

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled softly and walked up behind her.

He was tall, and with a casual lift of his hand, he helped her hang the gauze curtain.

The curtain was embroidered with delicate lotus flowers, graceful and elegant, truly a fresh sight.

“You’ve gone to a lot of trouble.” Zhao Xuanyou was satisfied. His large hand casually wrapped around her waist.

Yu Wan softly reminded him, “My lord, it’s time to eat.”

“Mmm, let’s eat.”

He said this, but he made no move to sit down or do anything else. He simply stood there, quietly holding her.

It seemed he didn’t want to do anything; he just wanted to say something.

“Heard you locked up that Baopeng.”

---

chapters.title: He Lost Face
chapters.content:
The news certainly spread quickly.

With the Xingguo Duke’s mansion arriving in force to demand her back, did he still have the mind to concern himself with such trivial matters?

Who told him?

Yingxue wouldn’t have. Was it one of the guards or the gatekeeping matron?

Yu Wan responded calmly, “The lord ordered this servant to bring Cui Shi to Honghui Hall. He didn’t mention Baopeng. The other attending servants from the Duke’s mansion were sent to the estate. This servant assumed Baopeng would be sent there as well.”

She was only following orders.

“She could have been sent anywhere. I remember the maids in Liu Fang Pavilion often bullied you, especially this Baopeng. Don’t you want revenge?”

Of course she wanted revenge, but Yu Wan would never admit it.

“Baopeng has bullied many people before, not just me.”

Zhao Xuanyou drawled, “She’s yours to handle now. Consider it a reward.”

A reward?

All the attending servants from the Duke’s mansion had been sent far away. Cui Yichu had been taken back. Only Baopeng remained, a last arrow from a spent bow; there was nothing left to gain from her. This reward wasn’t worth accepting.

Yu Wan smiled gently. “This servant is just a servant. What can I do with a person? I can’t even afford to keep her alive. If the lord truly wants to reward me, perhaps something else would be better?”

Zhao Xuanyou continued to hold her from behind. Listening to her words, a smile tugged at the corner of his lips.

“You want a monetary reward?”

“Would that be possible?” Since he had brought it up, Yu Wan naturally took the opportunity.

Zhao Xuanyou, however, said, “What would you do with so much money? Didn’t Old Madam just reward you with a handful of golden melon seeds the other day?”

Who would refuse more money?

But to say she had taken a handful of golden melon seeds? That was an injustice. Yu Wan had to clear her name.

“The Young Master misunderstands. Old Madam did bring out a box of golden melon seeds, but this servant only took a few.”

“Those golden melon seeds are made of pure gold. Even one could be exchanged for a considerable sum.”

Yu Wan huffed softly. “The Young Master simply doesn’t want to give any. This servant dares not accept.”

As she spoke, she turned to face him. It was then that Yu Wan noticed his furrowed brows.

“The Young Master has been busy for so long. Aren’t you hungry? You should eat.”

“With so many people inside and outside watching my humiliation, how can I eat?”

Yu Wan blinked, tilting her face up to look at him. “The people from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion all knelt and apologized to you. It was them making a fool of themselves, not you.”

The bright summer sunlight filtered through the gauze window, casting a thin layer of gold over Yu Wan’s face, making her fair skin and beautiful features even more radiant.

“You didn’t laugh at me?” Zhao Xuanyou asked.

So that was what he was concerned about.

The truth about Cui Yichu’s pre-marital loss of chastity was originally known only to Yu Wan and Yuan Qi. But with Cui Yichu shouting so loudly in the courtyard, Yingxue and Yuan Qing had heard it, as had the guards at the door. Even Ziyan, who was trimming flowers in the back courtyard, might have heard.

He felt he had lost face in front of the servants.

“Does the lord mean that this servant would laugh at you?” Yu Wan’s lips slightly pursed as she let out a soft laugh. “For the lord to think that is the real joke. The lord is a noble Young Master, while this servant signed a contract of servitude, living day to day without knowing what tomorrow holds. If the lord doesn’t laugh at this servant, how could this servant dare to laugh at the lord?”

As she spoke, she placed her hand on his shoulder and gently adjusted his collar.

“Later, this servant will speak to Yuan Qi. The lord’s divorce from Cui Shi is because she violated the Seven Grounds for Divorce, showed disrespect to Old Madam, and allowed her wicked servants to steal from the Marquis’s mansion. That Zhou Mama was convicted in the official court; it’s not a baseless accusation.”

Zhao Xuanyou slightly narrowed his eyes and reached out to pinch her chin.

He had to admit, Yu Wan was clever. Having her by his side truly helped ease many of his burdens.

“Seems I have no choice but to reward you.”

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered as an idea occurred to her. She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou.

Seeing the hope in her eyes, Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow. “Changed your mind about the money?”

“My lord knows everything.” Yu Wan smiled softly, her voice gentle. “This servant’s mother has been unwell. This servant would like to request two days’ leave to visit her.”

“Your mother?” Zhao Xuanyou frowned. He had always assumed that a servant like Yu Wan, bought from outside, was either sold by her family or had no one left.

Yu Wan explained, “This servant was originally a peasant girl. My mother fell from a mountain while gathering herbs and has been in a coma ever since. To save her, I sold all my family’s possessions and, in the end, had to sell myself into servitude. Now that this servant has a little money, I want to hire a good doctor in the capital to treat her.”

“You work in the Marquis’s mansion. How does she live alone in the capital?”

The early passing of the Marquis of Jingyuan’s wife had always been a regret in Zhao Xuanyou’s heart.

Seeing that he was asking about her mother, Yu Wan did not hide the truth. “Yunshui Nunnery has a charity hall. My mother has been staying there. Kind nuns take care of her, and a fellow townsman who works at the docks also helps.”

As expected, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression softened slightly at her words, but he did not immediately agree as Yu Wan had hoped.

“You want two full days off?”

So that was what he was thinking about… Yu Wan nearly choked.

“I’ll take my mother to see a doctor during the day and return to the mansion at night.”

As soon as she finished speaking, Zhao Xuanyou realized she understood his intentions. A playful glint appeared in his eyes.

“Then take two days off. I am indeed hungry. Have them serve the meal.”

Zhao Xuanyou released her and turned to sit down. But as soon as he saw the longevity peach pattern on the dishes, he frowned. “Why did you change to these?”

“This servant thought today should be more festive. There wasn’t time to go to the storeroom, and the only festive porcelain in Honghui Hall is the set from Old Madam’s birthday. My lord, please make do with these for now. I’ll go to the storeroom later to find others.”

“No need to change. This set is fine.”

Zhao Xuanyou had not been in the capital for Old Madam Ye’s birthday this year. Seeing this set of dishes brought back memories.

Next year, when his grandmother celebrated her birthday, he should be able to be in the capital to show his filial piety.

The kitchen had long been prepared. As soon as Yu Wan gave the word, a large table was quickly filled with dishes. The menu was quite lavish: steamed crab meat lion’s head, Dongpo pork knuckle, sweet and sour carp, and other elaborate dishes were placed in the center, accompanied by refreshing side dishes like Sanmei tofu, milk soup with pu vegetables, and stir-fried bamboo shoots.

Yu Wan had intended to stand to the side and serve Zhao Xuanyou, but he was generous and pulled her down to sit with him.

He was already used to serving himself and eating whatever he wanted.

“Thank you, Young Master.”

Yu Wan did not refuse. She picked up her bowl and began to eat with him.

After dealing with the Xingguo Duke’s mansion for so long, they were indeed hungry. Faced with a table full of delicacies, not to mention Zhao Xuanyou, even Yu Wan ate two bowls of rice and a large piece of pork knuckle.

After eating the rich dishes, she had some bamboo shoots to cleanse her palate.

The afternoon sunlight warmed the pavilion. Even after their bellies were full, the lingering flavors made them wish for more.

“It was so good. The pork knuckle, the crab meat lion’s head. Oh, the bamboo shoots were the best! Qin Sao mixed in some pickled bamboo shoots. The sourness was so appetizing.”

Zhao Xuanyou watched her satisfied expression, and a hint of emotion flickered in his deep eyes.

Eating together like this was indeed more enjoyable than eating alone.

He just hadn’t expected that the feeling he had once hoped to find with Cui Yichu would instead be found with Yu Wan.

chapters.title: Did You Divorce?
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou kept his word and gave Yu Wan a day off the next day.

The sky was clear and bright, lifting her spirits.

In her side room, Yu Wan took stock of the bundles she would bring out, then checked the things she had acquired recently. She had nearly three taels of silver, five jade hairpins, and six gold melon seeds.

The jade hairpins were gifts from Zhao Xuanyou. He was meticulous, so she shouldn’t pawn them unless absolutely necessary.

After packing the silver, Yu Wan took two gold melon seeds and hid them in her waistband for emergencies.

Chen Da Niu had grown up with her in the village since childhood and was fairly reliable.

But last time, she had given him a considerable amount of silver. If he got greedy and ran off with the money, it wasn’t impossible. She had to leave the mansion to confirm.

Moreover, Yu Wan hadn’t left the mansion in a long time. She wanted to see her mother and, more importantly, accompany her mother to see the doctor and hear what the doctor had to say.

If Doctor Feng from the Huichun Hall couldn’t cure her mother, she would have no other options.

"You’re carrying so many bundles. What are you doing? Aren’t you going shopping? Why are you bringing things out?" Yuan Qing had just finished breakfast when she bumped into Yu Wan leaving with a large bundle. She asked in surprise.

The nearby Xiang Xue, who was knitting socks, said, "Sister Yu Wan is going to visit her mother, not going out for fun."

"Oh." Yuan Qing didn’t know about Yu Wan’s mother being ill and immediately scratched her head in embarrassment.

Yu Wan smiled. "I’ll go shopping too. When I return tonight, I’ll bring you some trendy snacks from the capital."

"I don’t want snacks. The gatekeeper mentioned the other day that the Beggar’s Chicken from Taihe Tower is especially delicious. If you have time, buy one for me. I’ll pay you."

Seeing Yu Wan’s relaxed demeanor, Xiang Xue added, "Sister, if you go to Taihe Tower, there’s a pastry shop next to it. Help me buy two taels of hawthorn candy. Ziyan has done so much embroidery for me; I need to thank her."

"Don’t worry, I’ve noted it all down."

Since Yu Wan had agreed to help, Yuan Qing returned the favor by taking the large bundle from her hands and escorting her out of the marquis’s mansion.

Without the master’s explicit instructions, Yu Wan couldn’t use the marquis’s carriage this time.

She hired a donkey cart herself and took her things to Yunshui Convent.

When the nun saw Yu Wan, she took her to the meditation room where her mother stayed. Chen Da Niu wasn’t there at the moment; only her mother was.

"Mother, I’ve come to see you." At the sight of her mother’s pale face, tears immediately welled up in Yu Wan’s eyes.

In this new life, the two most important things were revenge and saving her mother.

Cui Yichu was still alive, so her revenge wasn’t complete yet. But she could plan it slowly and carefully. However, she knew nothing about medicine or treatment. Apart from raising money to hire doctors, she truly didn’t know what else to do.

"Mother, please, you must pull through. Don’t leave me all alone."

Yu Wan held her mother’s bony hands, tears streaming down her face.

The nun pushed the door open with a tray of tea. Seeing Yu Wan crying so sadly, she gently advised, "Donor, there’s no need to be so heartbroken. Yesterday, Donor Chen brought a doctor here to see your mother. He even performed acupuncture and prescribed medicine. I think she can be cured."

"A doctor came to see her yesterday?" Yu Wan wiped her tears and asked joyfully.

"Yes. The doctor spoke with Donor Chen for a long time. If there were no hope, I don’t think they would have talked for so long."

"Thank you, Master." Yu Wan quickly pressed her palms together in gratitude.

"Have some tea. It’s almost time; Donor Chen will be here soon."

"Alright."

Hearing the nun’s words, Yu Wan perked up again.

She went out to fetch hot water, carefully wiped her mother’s body, washed her hair, and changed her into fresh clothes.

These bedsheets, quilts, and clothes were all secretly bought by Xiang Xue at Yu Wan’s request while she was in the marquis’s mansion. Though they weren’t expensive, she had cleaned and sun-dried them all, and they still carried the scent of sunlight.

After the change, Yu Wan opened the window of the meditation room, letting the warm breeze from outside flow in.

Her mother had been bedridden for years, unable to move, and with the need to take medicine, the room’s odor was actually quite unpleasant.

The nuns had many people to care for and couldn’t clean the room frequently. Chen Da Niu wasn’t suitable for such tasks either.

After some thought, Yu Wan asked the nun about hiring a local woman to help with the chores and care. She immediately gave the woman a deposit and explained all the tasks required.

"Yu Wan, you’re here?" Chen Da Niu looked at Yu Wan in surprise and joy.

"Yes, the master gave me a day off, so I came to see Mother. This Auntie Wang can take care of Mother from now on. You’ll have it easier."

Hearing that Yu Wan had hired someone else, Chen Da Niu immediately panicked. "Do you think I’m not doing a good job?"

"Of course not. This isn’t the place to talk. Let’s go inside the meditation room."

Once inside, Yu Wan explained her plans.

"My mother is a woman after all. Some tasks are more convenient for Auntie Wang to handle. But since she’s an outsider, I don’t fully trust her. I’ll still need you to come by every day to supervise. Make sure she washes Mother, turns her over, and helps her move her limbs a little."

Chen Da Niu let out a soft "hmm" in surprise. "Why do you sound just like Doctor Feng?"

Yu Wan had previously taken her mother to see several doctors. Though they all said the illness was incurable, she had learned how to care for a bedridden patient.

Before, she had been too busy making a living and didn’t have the money to be particular about these things.

"Brother Chen, what did Doctor Feng say about my mother’s condition?"

"He said it can be treated. He’ll come every ten days to perform acupuncture. But he’s not sure when she’ll wake up. If we’re lucky, the stagnant blood might clear after three to five sessions. If we’re unlucky, it might take three to five years. Yu Wan, Doctor Feng’s consultation fee is five taels each time. If it takes three to five years..."

"It’s fine. I have a plan for the money. If you’re short, just come to the marquis’s mansion and find me."

The gold melon seeds given by the old madam could be pawned in an emergency. Combined with her saved monthly allowance, it should be enough for her mother’s treatment for this month.

In truth, the jade hairpins Zhao Xuanyou gave her were quite valuable; each one could be pawned for at least ten taels of silver. If her mother couldn’t be cured in three to five sessions, she would have to pawn them.

If he was unhappy, she would find another way to make him happy.

It would be great if her mother woke up in three to five sessions, but even if it took three to five years, she wasn’t afraid. As long as her mother could wake up, she could wait.

---

Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t even finished his shift when an inner attendant came to the Secretariat to summon him to the palace.

As soon as he stood up, his colleagues around him all revealed envious glances.

Apart from the two prime ministers, who else could enter the palace as frequently as Zhao Xuanyou?

Zhao Xuanyou remained composed and followed the inner attendant into the palace.

However, today the inner attendant didn’t take him to the Imperial Study but to the Qingfeng Pavilion beside Taiye Lake.

The clear waters of Taiye Lake rippled gently, and the breeze stirred the flowers and grasses on the shore, exuding a refined and elegant charm.

The emperor, dressed in a bright yellow casual robe, sat alone in the Qingfeng Pavilion, facing a chessboard.

"Your subject Zhao Xuanyou greets Your Majesty. May you live ten thousand years, ten thousand times ten thousand years."

"Xuanyou, come here." The emperor still looked at the chessboard, his voice kind.

Zhao Xuanyou bowed and walked to the emperor’s side, silently observing the chessboard.

It seemed to be an ancient residual game. He hadn’t expected the emperor to share the same hobby as him.

"Do you see anything? Where should I place this black piece?"

"Your subject is dull-witted." He didn’t show off in front of the emperor.

The emperor pondered for a while but still couldn’t figure it out. He sighed and reluctantly dropped the chess piece.

He ordered an inner attendant to bring a stool for Zhao Xuanyou and bestowed tea upon him. Then, he suddenly spoke.

"I heard you divorced? What’s going on?"

chapters.title: Missing Her
chapters.content:
It was the height of summer, when rotting grass turned to fireflies and heavy rains fell frequently.

Just a moment ago, the sky outside had been clear and sunny, but now thick, dark clouds had gathered over Taiye Lake. After a few thunderous rumbles, rain began to pour down.

"Yes, Your subject has divorced Cui."

"Last time I asked, you two seemed quite harmonious."

"Your subject’s family matters are not worth troubling Your Majesty over."

"Oh? The more you don’t say, the more curious I become."

"Your subject had been away from the capital for a long time and was unaware that Cui had been on bad terms with my grandmother for a long time. Recently, I learned she had been disrespectful to my grandmother. I tried to persuade her, but to no avail. So I had to divorce her."

"Such a thing happened? It’s for the best that you divorced her." The emperor stood up and walked to the window, watching countless raindrops fall onto the surface of Taiye Lake, creating ripples. "I’m quite envious of you."

Zhao Xuanyou stood up and went to the emperor’s side, sensing there was more to his words but not daring to speculate.

"Your subject is humbled."

The emperor looked at him and chuckled. "If you dislike someone, you can just sign a divorce paper and send them away. Isn’t that worth envying?"

Only a legal wife required a divorce document... The emperor’s words pointed to the empress.

Zhao Xuanyou considered for a moment before respectfully replying, "Your Majesty’s worries are beyond your subject’s understanding."

"You may not understand my troubles, but can you share my burdens?"

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly knelt down, cupping his hands. "Sharing the ruler’s burdens is the duty of a subject. Under the heavens, your subject is loyal only to Your Majesty."

The emperor turned his head and looked down at him, narrowing his eyes.

"Are you not loyal to Prince Ping? You two have always been close."

"Prince Ping has shown your subject much favor, for which I am grateful. But your subject is not his retainer."

The emperor’s expression remained calm. He didn’t say anything else and indifferently stated, "Get up. Keep me company while I watch the rain."

Zhao Xuanyou stood behind the emperor.

The surface of Taiye Lake was vast, and the raindrops falling on it were both pleasing to the ear and awe-inspiring.

"Three days from now, I will travel to Lichuan. Originally, I thought you would bring your family, but since you’re divorced, you can bring whoever you like."

"Your subject thanks Your Majesty for your grace."

Zhao Xuanyou accompanied the emperor in the Qingfeng Pavilion for a long time until the clouds dispersed and the rain stopped before leaving the palace.

The emperor had tested him several times, and their conversations had grown deeper each time. Today, he finally mentioned the empress. It seemed he trusted him more and more.

However, Zhao Xuanyou had been away from the capital for a long time and wasn’t familiar with the palace’s situation. He still couldn’t let his guard down during this trip to Lichuan.

After leaving the palace, Zhao Xuanyou went straight back to his mansion. As soon as his carriage arrived at the gate of the marquis’s mansion, it was stopped by someone.

When he lifted the curtain, he saw it was Ye Moqian.

It seemed the news of his divorce from Cui Yichu had not only reached the palace but also spread throughout the entire capital.

Seeing Ye Moqian’s curious expression, Zhao Xuanyou felt somewhat helpless. "Come in and drink with me."

"Alright." Ye Moqian nodded repeatedly. "I brought two bottles of Liu Guang Brew from Mingyue Tower. Just have the kitchen cook a few dishes to go with the wine."

As soon as they entered Honghui Hall, Ye Moqian looked around at the furnishings and sighed. "It’s only been over ten days since I was last here, but the room has become much more refined."

Has it?

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression remained calm as he looked around. He noticed that the room had indeed changed. The position of the vases, the style of the curtains, and the placement of the antiques were all different.

Honghui Hall had been uninhabited before, its decor cold and desolate. Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t paid much attention to it, but thinking about it, it was because of Yu Wan that the place now had a touch of warmth.

"Where is Yu Wan?" Zhao Xuanyou suddenly asked.

Yuan Qing replied, "Yu Wan had the day off today. She hasn’t returned to the mansion yet."

She hasn’t returned yet. Who knows what she’s doing outside? Visiting her mother shouldn’t take this long.

Zhao Xuanyou led Ye Moqian to the backyard, and soon, small dishes were served.

Ye Moqian indeed asked about the divorce.

Zhao Xuanyou then recounted how Cui Yichu had been disrespectful to his grandmother.

Previously, Zhao Xuanyou had asked Ye Moqian about Cui Yichu many times. In Ye Moqian’s eyes, this was just an excuse, but since Zhao Xuanyou didn’t elaborate, he didn’t press further.

"You have many friends in the capital, and your connections are wide. If anyone asks you about it, just tell them that."

Ye Moqian understood. "Don’t worry. Within three days, everyone in the capital will know that Cui Yichu was disrespectful to the old madam. But, Brother, will the Xingguo Duke’s mansion comply?"

"Hmph. That marriage was a trap set by their family against the marquis’s mansion," Zhao Xuanyou sneered. "Originally, I wanted to divorce her, but they begged me repeatedly, so I agreed to a mutual divorce instead. Do you think they’ll comply?"

At this point, Ye Moqian understood.

Princess Yinings had been telling the truth when she said Cui Yichu had been "frivolous" before marriage, and Zhao Xuanyou had caught evidence of it.

"A great man need not worry about finding a wife. Next time you marry, countless families will want to form a connection with you. Brother, I’ll drink to that."

After clinking glasses with him, Zhao Xuanyou picked up his chopsticks and looked at the stir-fried bamboo shoots on the table. He remembered that Yu Wan loved this dish, saying it was sour and refreshing, a great appetizer.

A strange irritation rose in his heart. This woman was too wild.

It was almost dark, and she still hadn’t returned to the mansion. Wasn’t she afraid of encountering robbers on the road?

---

Yu Wan had originally planned to buy Beggar’s Chicken and hawthorn candy from Taihe Tower and then return to the mansion. However, she arrived too late, and the hawthorn candy at the shop was already sold out. After asking the shopkeeper, she rushed to another nearby pastry shop.

Just as she was having the candy weighed, a voice suddenly came from behind her.

"Miss Yu Wan, is that you?"

She turned around and saw Cui Zaiting. A hint of vigilance flashed across her face.

Being alone and encountering someone from the Cui family was not a good thing. Who knew what they were planning?

"Master Cui." Yu Wan called out reservedly.

The Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion were still at odds, so she didn’t need to show respect to Cui Zaiting.

Cui Zaiting looked somewhat haggard, a stark contrast to his previous self-assured demeanor in the marquis’s mansion.

He looked at Yu Wan, his expression stiff, as if he wanted to say something but hesitated.

The shopkeeper enthusiastically lifted the oil-paper package. "Miss, your two taels of hawthorn candy are ready. And here are two taels of orange peel candy."

Since she couldn’t buy the candy from the shop Xiang Xue wanted, Yu Wan decided to buy an extra type for her.

Yu Wan took the candy and turned around, only to find Cui Zaiting still standing there.

She decided to ignore him and walked past him.

After taking a few steps, Cui Zaiting called out emotionally, "Miss Yu Wan, please wait. Hear me out. I came out today specifically to find you. I didn’t expect to meet you here. It must be heaven’s will for me to repay my debt sooner."

He wanted to repay a debt?

Yu Wan thought for a moment before remembering that she had once given Cui Zaiting a cup of water, and he had repeatedly said he wanted to repay that kindness.

What was he up to now?

"It was just a cup of water, Master Cui. There’s no need to take it to heart. I’m in a hurry to return to the mansion, so I won’t chat with you."

Cui Zaiting suddenly said, "Don’t you care about your mother?"

Why would he suddenly bring up her mother?

How did he even know about her mother?

Yu Wan turned her head abruptly and stared at Cui Zaiting. "What do you mean? What’s wrong with my mother? Are you saying... are you saying that Cui Yichu is going to harm my mother?"

chapters.title: Visiting His Wife
chapters.content:
Cui Zaiting's eyes were turbulent, and his fingers trembled uncontrollably.

After Cui Yichu and Li returned to the mansion, the Duke of Xingguo was still furious. He locked her in the ancestral hall as punishment, forbidding her from eating during the day and allowing only a bowl of porridge at night. Anyone who dared to bring her food would be punished according to the family rules.

An hour ago, the Duke of Xingguo left to socialize. Worried that Cui Yichu might be starving, Cui Zaiting brought some snacks and went to the ancestral hall to see her.

To his surprise, the guards at the entrance of the ancestral hall were gone. As he entered the courtyard, he heard Cui Yichu's sharp voice.

"Mother, I have come to this! It's all thanks to that wretched woman, Yu Wan. Her own mother is currently recovering from illness at Yunshui Nunnery. You must send someone to finish her off to vent my anger!"

He truly did not want to believe that the sister who had always encouraged him to study, to write poetry, and even helped him publish his poetry collection could say such words.

He was the son of a concubine, and everyone in the duke's mansion looked down on him. Even the Duke of Xingguo refused to speak to him much. Only Yichu treated him like a brother. He didn't care about anyone else in the Duke of Xingguo's mansion, but he cared deeply for this sister.

Yet, this sister had utterly shocked him.

Clearly, her divorce from Zhao Xuanyou was because she had lost her chastity before marriage. How could she blame Yu Wan for that?

Even if Yu Wan was somehow involved, how could she ask her stepmother to kill Yu Wan's sick mother?

Cui Zaiting stumbled out of the mansion, his mind blank.

He didn't know how to face all this, but instinctively, he wanted to save someone after hearing what Cui Yichu and her mother had said.

He had intended to go to the Hou mansion but unexpectedly encountered Yu Wan here.

This was fate. Without hesitation, his emotions gradually calmed, and his chest no longer heaved, though his eyes remained turbulent.

"Yu Wan, you must quickly move your mother to another place. They know she is at Yunshui Nunnery and will make a move against her."

"Thank you..." Yu Wan struggled to steady her mind.

She wasn't sure if Cui Zaiting meant well or ill, but he was right.

Cui Yichu did know where her mother was. Given the Cui family's methods, they were very likely to take action against her mother. She had to move her mother as soon as possible.

Tomorrow? No... she couldn't wait until tomorrow. She had to do it today.

Her mother had finally found a glimmer of hope for survival. She absolutely could not take any risks.

Yu Wan couldn't be bothered to say more to Cui Zaiting. She picked up her things and left in a hurry.

When she returned to Yunshui Nunnery, Aunt Wang was just closing the door of the meditation room, preparing to leave. Seeing Yu Wan's panicked expression, she asked with concern, "Miss, has something happened?"

"Where is my mother?"

"Same as before."

Yu Wan pushed open the door and entered. Seeing her mother lying on the bed, breathing evenly, she finally let out a sigh of relief.

"Aunt Wang, your home is nearby. Do you know anyone who is renting out a house?" Yu Wan's money had to be saved for her mother's acupuncture treatment. She couldn't afford to rent a courtyard, so she could only look for a room first.

Aunt Wang thought for a moment. "There are a few families renting out rooms, but... Miss, are you planning to live there yourself, or..."

"I want to rent it for my mother."

"That might not work." Aunt Wang looked troubled. "Your mother is too ill. Even if we deceive the landlord into renting it, once they see your mother being carried in like this, they will definitely kick you out immediately."

Landlords were superstitious about such things.

If someone died in the house, it would be considered a haunted house, and whether renting or selling in the future, the price would be heavily discounted.

Yu Wan clenched her fists but felt helpless.

"Aunt Wang, my husband will be home soon. I still need to go back and cook. I'll take my leave now."

"Alright."

Aunt Wang left quickly. Yu Wan thought about going out to ask around, but she didn't dare to leave her mother's side, fearing that if she left, someone might take the opportunity to harm her.

After some thought, she called a nun over and asked if there were any empty meditation rooms nearby, saying that some friends wanted to come over.

After the nun left, Yu Wan quietly lifted her mother from the bed and moved her to the farthest empty room.

Even if the Cui family people came to take action, they wouldn't likely search room by room. They would definitely ask around first.

By secretly changing rooms, they wouldn't be able to find their target immediately.

She would endure tonight, and tomorrow when Chen Da Niu arrived, she would immediately take her mother away. Even if they had to stay at Chen Da Niu's place temporarily, it would be fine.

Yu Wan hid in the dark room, clutching a pair of scissors, not daring to speak or move.

She listened as the outside gradually grew quiet, knowing that night had deepened.

She forced herself to stay awake, but as time passed, her eyelids grew heavier. Just as she was about to fall asleep, the door of the meditation room creaked.

Yu Wan jolted awake, tightening her grip on the scissors.

Seeing a shadow appear at the door, she hesitated not for a moment. She lunged from the wall, stabbing the scissors fiercely toward the person's neck.

She was physically stronger than most women, but the assassins sent by the Cui family would certainly know martial arts.

She had only one chance. She had to kill him with this strike!

As the scissors approached the person's neck, the figure let out a soft "mm."

The surroundings were too quiet, and his voice sounded particularly clear.

Was it Zhao Xuanyou?!

Yu Wan's heart trembled, but her movement couldn't be stopped. She wanted to cry out, but due to extreme tension, her throat couldn't make a sound.

At that moment, the shadow lightly swayed and moved behind Yu Wan.

Yu Wan's entire body lunged toward the door, but he let out a soft laugh, caught her slender waist, and pulled her back.

Everything happened so fast that Yu Wan couldn't react. The scissors in her hand clattered to the floor.

"Quite bold, daring to assassinate me."

Yu Wan panted heavily, her heart almost leaping out of her chest, and tears welled up in her eyes.

It wasn't out of fear, but because everything had happened too quickly. Her mind and body were out of sync.

In that moment, it was the first time in both her lives that she had personally tried to kill someone.

The feeling was too strange.

It had rained in the afternoon, and now the sky was clear, the moon like a jade plate, casting a soft glow everywhere.

The door was left open, and the moonlight spilled in, illuminating everything in the room.

Looking at her eyes filled with moisture, Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes. "You tried to kill me, and now you're crying?"

"Who said I was trying to kill you?" Yu Wan covered her chest, took a few deep breaths, barely calming her emotions, and reproached, "It's the middle of the night. I thought some villain had come, so I took the scissors to defend myself. But Lord, why are you at the nunnery at this hour?"

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze was hazy, and his brows twitched. "I only allowed you to stay out during the day. Who told you to hide in a nunnery in the middle of the night?"

"I wasn't hiding."

"Not hiding? Then why haven't you returned to the Hou mansion at night? Your mother isn't even staying in this meditation room. What exactly happened?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Listening to Zhao Xuanyou's questioning, Yu Wan suddenly thought of something. She looked up, her lashes, still wet with tears, trembling slightly.

"Lord, did you come to Yunshui Nunnery specifically to look for me because I hadn't returned?"

---

chapters.title: He Was Angry
chapters.content:
Yu Wan's voice was soft and warm. Hearing her words, Zhao Xuanyou subconsciously raised his eyes, trying to look fiercer.

"Are you answering my question? Why didn't you return all night?"

Seeing that he wasn't answering her, Yu Wan met his seemingly cold gaze, tilted her head up, and obediently replied, "This servant originally intended to return early, but something came up on the way, so I had to stay and guard my mother at Yunshui Nunnery."

"What came up?"

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou ask about this, Yu Wan felt a sense of relief in her heart.

Her current situation was quite difficult.

She had at most a few dozen taels of silver in her possession, all of which had to be saved for her mother's medical treatment and acupuncture. She usually couldn't leave the Hou mansion, and outside, only Chen Da Niu was there to help. She had no means to confront the Duchess of Xingguo and Cui Yichu.

If Zhao Xuanyou was willing to help...

Yu Wan had considered asking him for help. She knew that at night, when he held her, he was one way, but during the day, when he put on his clothes, he was another.

A noble heir like him had an imposing manner that could not be violated.

If she went to ask him for help, he would only think she was overstepping her bounds. The last person he saw as overstepping was Zhuang Huaiyue, and she didn't want to follow in Zhuang Huaiyue's footsteps.

Tonight, Zhao Xuanyou had come looking for her on his own, and now he was taking the initiative to ask. This was indeed a good opportunity to speak up.

"This evening, when this servant was buying things near Taihe Tower, I encountered Cui Zaiting."

"What did he do to you?"

Yu Wan turned her face away, her gaze falling on a small tree in the courtyard. She raised her hand to wipe away the tears at the corner of her eyes.

"He didn't do anything to me. He just told me that when he was at the duke's mansion, he overheard the Duchess and Cui Yichu talking. Cui Yichu knows that my mother is staying at Yunshui Nunnery and wants the Duchess to finish her off to vent her anger."

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her worried and lost expression, his gaze darkening slightly. He said in a deep voice, "The words of the Cui family cannot be trusted."

"I don't believe Cui Zaiting either. But Cui Yichu does know that my mother is recovering at Yunshui Nunnery. Back then... when she asked me to conceal my identity and serve you, Lord, she promised to help me invite famous doctors to save my mother. She does hate me. Since I am by your side, Lord, and she cannot take revenge on me, she will definitely take it out on my family."

Zhao Xuanyou's Adam's apple rolled, and there was no ripple in his eyes. He simply reached out and hugged Yu Wan.

"So you hid here with a pair of scissors?"

"It's not just that." Yu Wan pouted, dissatisfied. "I wanted to move my mother to another place for treatment, but when I asked around, no one was willing to rent a room to someone so ill. I can't take her far by myself. I thought I would endure one night at Yunshui Nunnery, and when my fellow townsman comes tomorrow, we could figure something out together."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly.

Staying at Yunshui Nunnery but secretly moving to an empty room.

This method might not fool him, but it was enough to deal with ordinary thugs.

As for her ambush from the dark, if the first person to enter hadn't been him, they might have been injured.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, Yu Wan's heart began to race.

It seemed he really wouldn't easily help. She couldn't urge him, so she had to retreat strategically.

"It's so late. Lord, please return to the mansion to rest. Once I have settled my mother tomorrow, I will immediately return to serve you."

"Where can your mother stay besides Yunshui Nunnery with her condition?"

Yu Wan said softly, "If we can't find a place in the capital, we'll have to go to the outskirts."

Land in the capital was expensive, and even the shabbiest houses had tenants. Landlords could be picky about their tenants. In the outskirts, with a little more money, people might not be so superstitious.

Yu Wan's gaze was open and clear.

If Zhao Xuanyou was unwilling to help, this was indeed her plan.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at the thin woman lying quietly on the bed and slowly said, "Isn't she still seeking medical treatment in the city? Will the doctors go to the outskirts for consultations?"

"We can't worry about that for now." Yu Wan said helplessly, "We'll take it one step at a time. If it doesn't work out, we'll come back into the city when it's time for treatment."

"Let's go." Zhao Xuanyou took her hand and strode out.

"Lord," Yu Wan called out softly, secretly curling the corners of her lips.

Although he didn't say anything, Yu Wan knew he was going to handle this matter.

As they left the meditation room, Yuan Xuan and a guard were standing not far away. Zhao Xuanyou ordered, "Go inside and carefully carry the patient out."

"Yes." Yuan Xuan complied.

Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Wan out of Yunshui Nunnery. Outside, a carriage from the Jingyuan Hou mansion was waiting.

"Get in."

Yu Wan didn't know where he was taking her. After some thought, she turned to the nun who had followed them and said, "Please trouble you to tell Aunt Wang that there has been a change in my family circumstances, and I no longer need her help. This is today's wages; please give it to her."

"The donor can rest assured. I will deliver it in full." The nun took the money and asked, "It's so late. Are you leaving?"

"There's been a family emergency, and we have to go," Yu Wan said in a low voice. "Tomorrow, when my fellow townsman comes, tell him to find me at the Hou mansion. He knows where."

"Alright."

After saying this, Yuan Xuan and the guard carried Yu Wan's mother out and carefully placed her in the carriage.

Yu Wan followed and got into the carriage. When the coachman flicked the whip, the carriage started moving.

She sat next to Zhao Xuanyou, cautiously observing his expression. She didn't know where he was taking her mother and didn't dare to speak recklessly.

Before long, the carriage stopped.

Yu Wan helped her mother out of the carriage and found herself in a small alley. Next to them was a large house with lights on.

Yuan Xuan went forward and knocked on the door. Soon, someone opened it and warmly welcomed them inside.

Yu Wan then realized they had arrived at the backyard of a inn.

She didn't catch what Yuan Xuan said to the innkeeper, but soon the innkeeper led them to a superior room on the second floor of the inn.

After her mother was settled, Yu Wan carefully asked Yuan Xuan, "Where is this place?"

"Taoran Inn."

"Is it the Hou mansion's property?"

Yuan Xuan nodded. "It is a property left to the heir by the late Hou Madam. The innkeeper is also one of our own. Your mother can safely stay here for treatment without any problems."

Yu Wan thought of how Chen Da Niu had been living in a cramped room at the dock with others. The superior room had two rooms inside and out. If he could move in, it would be convenient for taking care of her mother.

"Are you familiar with the innkeeper?"

"What's the matter?"

"I have a fellow townsman who has been helping to take care of my mother. Since this superior room is spacious, could you ask the innkeeper to add an extra bed outside so he can stay here as well?"

"No problem. When we go out later, I'll help you ask. Let's go."

"Go?" Yu Wan had no intention of leaving.

"You're not going?" Yuan Xuan blurted out.

"What's the problem?"

Yuan Xuan scratched his head in difficulty. "The heir has come all the way to find you. If you don't return to the mansion..."

He spoke tactfully. Earlier, at Honghui Hall, the heir had asked several times if Yu Wan had returned. His questions had even prompted Young Master Ye to repeatedly ask who Yu Wan was, to have the heir so concerned.

The heir had gone to Yunshui Nunnery and taken the trouble to arrange for Yu Wan's mother to stay at Taoran Inn. If Yu Wan didn't return, Yuan Xuan didn't dare to imagine how dark the heir's face would be.

chapters.title: An Unexpected Kiss
chapters.content:
"Before, this lord did not know why you had not returned, but now that I do, I won’t say anything."

Easy for him to say. If it had been any other servant from the mansion who went missing, he wouldn’t have come out in the middle of the night to search.

Yuan Qi muttered to herself, hesitating for a moment before daring to face Zhao Xuanyou’s dark expression.

She forced a smile. "Yuan, what do you think about this: His Lordship has already arranged for your mother to stay at the Taoran Inn to recover. You go and thank him yourself, and tell him you won’t be returning to the Marquis’s mansion tonight."

This...

Seeing Yuan Qi’s difficult expression, Yu Yuan finally nodded.

They left through the back courtyard again. The Marquis’s carriage was quietly parked in the dark alley.

Yu Yuan got into the carriage alone. Zhao Xuanyou was inside, resting with his eyes half-closed.

"Is everything settled?"

"Yes. The innkeeper has arranged for this servant’s mother to stay in the best room. Many thanks, Young Master."

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in acknowledgment and opened his eyes, his gaze firmly fixed on Yu Yuan.

"Just a thank you?"

Yu Yuan blinked slightly, then revealed a flattering smile. "What else does His Lordship want?"

Gazing at the soft, delicate curve of her lips, Zhao Xuanyou’s mind wandered.

"Obedience."

At first glance, there was nothing wrong with these words.

It was only natural for a master to demand obedience from a servant. But Yu Yuan immediately understood the hidden meaning.

Recently, Zhao Xuanyou had stopped reviewing official documents and instead focused on studying the patterns of the "Fire Avoidance Diagram." A few days ago, he had wanted Yu Yuan to try it out, but she had refused in a coy voice. He hadn’t said anything at the time, but he had been thinking about it ever since.

He had done her such a great favor tonight. Yu Yuan should repay him, but... she couldn’t easily promise too much.

Yu Yuan cleverly replied, "Alright, this servant will obey His Lordship next time."

"Only next time?" Zhao Xuanyou coughed lightly.

"Only once." Yu Yuan’s face was filled with a relaxed smile as she quickly changed the subject. "My mother can’t be left alone, so I still can’t return to the Marquis’s mansion tonight. I know this is against the rules, but I’ll return to the mansion to serve tomorrow morning."

As soon as she finished speaking, it was clear that Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened.

Yu Yuan pretended not to notice his displeasure. She leaned close to him, planted a heavy kiss on his cheek, then whispered in his ear, "My lord, this servant will take her leave now."

With that, she quickly turned and jumped out of the carriage.

The kiss came too suddenly. Zhao Xuanyou, usually sharp and alert, only realized what had happened after Yu Yuan had already disappeared.

The warmth of her lips still lingered on his cheek.

He and Yu Yuan had been intimate many times before, but he never expected that tonight’s kiss would leave such a lingering aftertaste.

He slowly raised his hand, extending a finger to touch the cheek she had just kissed. He truly regretted letting her escape.

After a moment of silence, Zhao Xuanyou let out a light laugh and ordered the coachman to drive back to the mansion.

---

The best room at the Taoran Inn was spacious and clean.

Yu Yuan quickly tidied up the things she had brought, then lay down beside her mother to sleep.

Having lost her father at a young age, her mother had raised her alone. During the more than ten years they lived in the village, Yu Yuan had fallen asleep next to her mother every night.

Those days had been poor but warm.

Recalling the past, tears welled up in Yu Yuan’s eyes.

She wrapped her arms around her mother’s shoulders and softly said, "Mother, please wake up soon. Your daughter misses you so much. Your daughter’s life is a little better now than before. But your daughter is struggling in the Marquis’s mansion. The bad people there are both clever and powerful, and sometimes your daughter is truly afraid. Your daughter really hopes you will wake up soon so we can return to the village and live a peaceful life again."

Yu Yuan had indeed had an exhausting day. After saying these words, she fell into a deep sleep.

Because she fell asleep so quickly, she didn’t notice at all that her mother’s fingers had twitched a few times.

---

Early the next morning, Yu Yuan opened the windows of the room to let the sunlight in.

The sickness clinging to her mother was too heavy; more sunlight would be good for her.

Since she was a distinguished guest sent by the Marquis’s mansion, the inn’s servant had already delivered breakfast to the room.

Yu Yuan first fed her mother some millet congee before eating herself.

She went downstairs and saw the innkeeper busy behind the counter. After some thought, she went over to greet him.

"Miss Yu Yuan." The innkeeper, having learned from Yuan Qi that she was someone valued by the Young Master, treated her with great courtesy.

Yu Yuan didn’t put on airs, but as a mere servant girl, she had to borrow Zhao Xuanyou’s influence to throw her weight around a bit. She said she worked in Honghui Hall, which was why Zhao Xuanyou had specially arranged for her mother to recover here.

After boasting a little, Yu Yuan revealed her true purpose to the innkeeper: "Please, do not reveal my mother’s identity to anyone."

"Miss, rest assured. I understand. Apart from me, no one in the inn knows your identity."

Yu Yuan nodded.

The power of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion was vast. The Taoran Inn was Zhao Xuanyou’s property, so most people there should be trustworthy. But there was no such thing as an airtight secret; the more people who knew, the higher the chance of the news leaking out.

"Yuan Qi said yesterday that another bed needs to be placed in the outer room, but there are no extra beds available right now. It won’t be installed until the afternoon. It’s not urgent, right?"

"Not urgent."

As soon as Yu Yuan finished speaking, she saw Chen Da Niu entering from outside, being stopped by the servant at the inn’s entrance.

She quickly went forward, led Chen Da Niu inside, and had him exchange greetings with the innkeeper before taking him upstairs to the best room.

"You came really quickly. I thought you wouldn’t arrive until at least noon."

Chen Da Niu embarrassedly said, "I don’t know why, but I was restless all night. As soon as I woke up this morning, I went to Yunshui Nunnery to see Aunt Shen. The nun said you had left, and told me to look for you at the Marquis’s mansion. Then, Miss Yingsue at the mansion told me to come here."

Yu Yuan hadn’t dared to tell the nuns at Yunshui Nunnery about moving to the Taoran Inn, so she had to ask Yuan Qi to have Yingsue pass along the message. Fortunately, everything had gone smoothly.

Looking at the spacious, bright, and elegantly furnished room, Chen Da Niu marveled, "This room must cost at least one tael of silver per night."

Yu Yuan wasn’t sure either.

"For now, we should save money for Aunt Shen’s treatment. Don’t spend money like this."

"You don’t need to worry about money. The innkeeper is a friend of mine. He won’t charge anything. I’ve already told him that another bed will be added to the outer room, and you can stay here."

"Can I move in too?" Chen Da Niu was overjoyed.

The place he rented at the dock was in very poor condition; drafty and leaky, with several people crammed into one room.

Yu Yuan nodded. "There are enemies targeting me now, so you need to stay here."

"I understand. I’ll be careful."

Chen Da Niu was a steady and honest man. After receiving Yu Yuan’s wages, he was willing to work hard.

"Big Brother Niu, I’ll leave now. If there’s anything in the future, you can still come to the Marquis’s mansion to find me."

"Alright."

Yu Yuan turned her head and glanced at her mother on the bed, suppressing her tears as she left the Taoran Inn.
