She hurried to the Taihe Restaurant, but it was still too early; the Beggar’s Chicken wasn’t ready yet. However, the pastry shop next door had everything available.

She bought the hawthorn candy that Yingsue wanted and half a jin of lard cakes for Yuan Qing.

Fully loaded, she returned to the Marquis’s mansion. As she approached, a sudden sense of unease washed over her.

She had easily dismissed Zhao Xuanyou last night, but today might not go so smoothly.

---

chapters.title: Misplaced Affection
chapters.content:
Honghui Hall was quiet.

Yu Yuan entered the courtyard but didn’t see anyone. She climbed the steps and called out for Yuan Qing twice, but no one answered.

She first returned to the side room, changed into clean clothes, and when she came out again, she heard laughter from the back courtyard.

It turned out that Ziyan and Yingsue were there embroidering handkerchiefs.

Yu Yuan carried the pastries over. "Yingsue, I’ve bought the hawthorn candy you wanted."

"Thank you, Sister." Yingsue happily took the hawthorn candy and turned to hand some to Ziyan. "Thanks to your help, I was finally able to finish the Young Master’s socks. Consider this candy a token of my gratitude."

"I’ve never tried the pastries in the capital before." Ziyan sighed emotionally, taking a piece of hawthorn candy and tasting it. "It’s delicious, sour and sweet. You should try some too."

Yu Yuan and Yingsue didn’t stand on ceremony and each took a piece to eat.

Since they had grown more familiar with each other, they asked a few more questions.

Ziyan was not from the capital. Her father had been a county magistrate, but later, when a dike in the county collapsed, the Ministry of Works arrested several people and implicated her father, who was then dismissed and investigated. After their family was confiscated, she became an official servant.

Yu Yuan couldn’t say she sympathized with Ziyan’s situation, but she could certainly empathize.

A seemingly stable life was actually very fragile; the slightest change could turn everything upside down.

If her mother had not made that mistake back then, perhaps they would still be living peacefully in that village.

The day passed relatively leisurely. As dusk approached, Yu Yuan and Yingsue began preparing Zhao Xuanyou’s dinner. As they walked into the courtyard, they saw Yuan Qing leading Feng Tang inside.

"Lady Feng." Yu Yuan and Yingsue greeted her with a curtsy.

The last time Yu Yuan had been misunderstood in Leshou Hall, Feng Tang had been the one who scolded her the most.

Now that Yu Yuan was thriving by Zhao Xuanyou’s side, Feng Tang’s feelings were mixed. She barely nodded at Yu Yuan before walking straight into the house.

After leaving Honghui Hall, Yingsue couldn’t help but ask, "Why did Lady Feng come over?"

Yu Yuan had personally seen Yuan Qing tell Feng Tang that without Zhao Xuanyou’s orders, she was not allowed near Honghui Hall. Now that Yuan Qing was leading Feng Tang inside, it was clear that this was Zhao Xuanyou’s intention.

"She is the Young Master’s concubine. It’s only natural for her to come and serve in Honghui Hall."

"But, Sister..."

Yu Yuan had never expected to have Zhao Xuanyou all to herself. The fact that he had allowed her mother to stay at the Taoran Inn was already a huge favor.

Moreover, Yu Yuan had no standing to compete for his affection.

He had no official wife, and Concubine Feng Tang was his rightful woman.

"Don’t worry about me."

"I just think men are really strange." Yingsue sighed softly. "Yesterday, Sister, you didn’t come back all night, and the Young Master asked about you many times. In the end, he even went out to look for you. But today, he actually called Lady Feng over."

Yu Yuan had no expectations, so naturally, she had no disappointment.

But at this moment, she couldn’t say she was particularly happy either.

She lived in the side room next to Zhao Xuanyou’s bedroom. If Feng Tang was to serve him tonight, wouldn’t she have to listen to them all night? With Zhao Xuanyou’s stamina, how could she possibly sleep peacefully?

The two of them went to the kitchen to discuss the menu with Aunt Qin, then returned to Honghui Hall. Feng Tang was sitting alone in the room waiting.

There was a cup of tea beside her, presumably poured by Yuan Qing, but the cup looked somewhat lonely.

Yu Yuan went to the nearby cabinet, took out two plates of tea snacks, and placed them next to Feng Tang.

"Lady Feng, please have some."

Feng Tang looked up at her, her gaze extremely complex.

Cui Yi had already divorced Zhao Xuanyou. By rights, she was the woman with the highest status by Zhao Xuanyou’s side. Yet, her relationship with Zhao Xuanyou was as pure as water.

Yu Yuan, though a servant girl, attended to Zhao Xuanyou night and day, managing everything in Honghui Hall.

Even as a concubine, she didn’t dare to cause any trouble for Yu Yuan in Honghui Hall.

"Put it down." Feng Tang said indifferently.

Yu Yuan didn’t want to talk to her much either, so she went straight to the warm pavilion.

Previously, for the sake of celebration, they had used peach-shaped dishes in the warm pavilion, but those couldn’t be used all the time.

Today, she had specially gone to the storeroom to find a set of light blue-green porcelain bowls. The glaze was as smooth and warm as jade, and the color looked very soft.

Just as she finished setting the table, she heard Yingsue outside say, "The Young Master is back."

Yu Yuan returned to the inner room just in time to see Feng Tang greeting Zhao Xuanyou.

"Concubine greets the Young Master."

"No need for formalities."

Zhao Xuanyou’s attitude toward Feng Tang seemed much gentler than before. It looked like they would be intimate tonight. She wondered if she would still be able to return to the Xiaoyue Pavilion to spend the night.

Yu Yuan was lost in thought and didn’t notice Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze shifting to her.

"Master, should we serve dinner now?" Yingsue asked.

"Serve it."

Zhao Xuanyou and Feng Tang walked past Yu Yuan toward the warm pavilion.

Yu Yuan came to her senses and followed them in, pouring tea for both of them.

"Where did you find this set of bowls and dishes?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yu Yuan replied, "This servant doesn’t know their origin. I found them in the storeroom and thought they were pretty, so I took them out to use."

He nodded without saying more.

Soon, Yingsue led the servants in to serve the dishes.

Since it was an ordinary day, apart from two main dishes, crystal pork trotter and eight-treasure duck, the rest were home-style dishes. However, today there was also fresh lotus seed soup and stir-fried lotus root slices.

Zhao Xuanyou took the main seat, and Feng Tang sat beside him.

Once all the dishes were served, Yu Yuan picked up the serving chopsticks to serve Zhao Xuanyou. Just as she picked up a piece of eight-treasure duck, Feng Tang said, "It’s rare that I get to dine with the Young Master. Let me serve him."

Zhao Xuanyou neither agreed nor disagreed. Yu Yuan cupped the serving chopsticks with both hands and presented them to Feng Tang.

Feng Tang took the chopsticks and eagerly began serving Zhao Xuanyou.

Prince Ping was a man of refined tastes who loved feasts. Feng Tang had spent two years in the Prince’s mansion, so her manners were elegant, and her conversation was appropriate.

She ladled lotus seed soup for Zhao Xuanyou and served him lotus root, then began singing a lotus-picking folk song from the south. The atmosphere in the warm pavilion suddenly changed.

Yu Yuan stood respectfully to the side, feeling a pang of sympathy for Feng Tang.

The lotus-picking song was quite elegant, and Feng Tang had a pleasant voice. However, to sing the lotus-picking song, she had added more vegetarian dishes for Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou was different from the pampered young masters. Having spent a long time on the border and practiced martial arts for years, he preferred large portions of meat and hearty drinks. He only lightly sampled the delicacies like bamboo shoots and lotus roots that the nobles of the capital highly praised.

But if she pointed this out now, she feared Feng Tang would hold a grudge. It was better to stay quiet.

Sure enough, after Feng Tang finished singing two songs, Zhao Xuanyou stopped waiting for her to serve him. He helped himself to a large piece of duck leg and ate it with relish.

Seeing how much he enjoyed it, Feng Tang finally understood his culinary preferences. She quickly picked up her chopsticks and served him a piece of the tender braised pork trotter.

Before she could place it in Zhao Xuanyou’s bowl, he said, "No need to serve me. Eat your own meal."

She held the piece of pork trotter in the air for a moment before placing it in her own bowl.

The warm pavilion, which had been lively and refined moments ago, suddenly fell silent.

Zhao Xuanyou quickly finished his meal. Feng Tang, feeling disheartened, forced herself to eat a few bites before putting down her chopsticks.

After drinking tea, Zhao Xuanyou slowly said, "I called you here today because there’s something I need to tell you."

"Concubine is all ears."

"In two days, I will accompany His Majesty to the Luochuan Summer Palace."

Feng Tang, having spent a long time in the Prince’s mansion, knew that the Emperor took a portion of the royal family and officials to the Luochuan Summer Palace every year to escape the summer heat for two or three months. Last year, Prince Ping had brought his concubines and two wives there.

Her heart filled with joy.

The Young Master had called her to Honghui Hall for a good reason. Since he had divorced the Cui family, the only family he could bring would be hers.

chapters.title: Yu Zhen's Spring Outing
chapters.content:
Yu Wan was equally surprised upon hearing this.

Zhao Xuanyou was going to the Lichuan Imperial Palace?

She had heard that the palace had taken a full fifteen years to build, and the emperor was very fond of it. After its completion, he visited every year to escape the summer heat.

Lichuan was far from the capital; it would take two days by carriage to get there. If Zhao Xuanyou accompanied the emperor, it would likely be one or two months before he returned.

No wonder he had called Feng Tang over; he must be taking her with him.

That would be for the best.

With the old matriarch out of the way and both Zhao Xuanyou and Feng Tang away from the capital, Yu Wan could have the household servants secretly help her slip out more often to visit her mother. She still hoped to meet Physician Feng in person to discuss her mother’s condition.

Lost in thought, Yu Wan’s gaze inadvertently met Zhao Xuanyou’s across the room.

She quickly offered him a smile, but it was too forced, and after smiling, she hastily lowered her head.

“Since there is no mistress in the marquis’s residence now, I’ve decided that from now on, you will be in charge of managing the inner courtyard. If there’s anything you don’t understand, ask Steward Song.”

“Yes, my lord. I wouldn’t dare act on my own; I will consult Steward Song on all matters.”

Though this wasn’t the answer Feng Tang had hoped for, being put in charge of the household was still a cause for joy.

At the very least, Zhao Xuanyou had acknowledged her as his woman.

“I won’t be at the marquis’s residence for some time. Remember to go to Leshou Hall every day to pay your respects to Grandmother and read scriptures to her.”

“Ah?” If the earlier news had been a pleasant surprise, this was a blow to the head.

He wasn’t taking her to the Lichuan Imperial Palace?

He had called her here just to have her help manage the household?

“Worldly Son.”

“Hmm?” Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow.

“I…” She wanted to request to go to the Lichuan Imperial Palace to serve him, but under Zhao Xuanyou’s unfathomable gaze, she couldn’t help but feel intimidated.

Once he made a decision, she couldn’t change it.

If she begged, she might end up like Zhuang Huaiyue, making things worse.

Today, upon learning that Zhao Xuanyou had summoned her to Honghui Hall, she had taken extra care with her appearance. The pearl hairpin in her bun swayed gently, and two ruby earrings, vivid as drops of blood, hung from her ears. But she hadn’t seen even a flicker of admiration in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes.

Not only that, he hadn’t even glanced at her.

Yu Wan was exceptionally beautiful; she couldn’t compare. Yu Wan had bewitching charm; she couldn’t compare to that either.

So be it.

Managing the household and showing filial piety to the old matriarch were the duties of a wife. If she did well, over time, the worldly son would understand her character. There was plenty of time ahead.

Having made up her mind, Feng Tang replied gently, “My lord, rest assured. I will take good care of the old matriarch and spend more time with her in Leshou Hall.”

“It’s getting late. Go back.”

With the earlier conversation, Feng Tang naturally didn’t dare hope to stay the night in Honghui Hall.

She said no more, bowing respectfully before retreating.

Left alone in the warm chamber with Yu Wan, Zhao Xuanyou noticed her lost in thought. “What are you spacing out about over there?”

“I wasn’t spacing out,” Yu Wan snapped back to reality, smiling as she stepped forward to clear the dishes. “My lord and Concubine Feng were discussing important matters. How could I dare interrupt?”

“Then what were you so absentmindedly thinking about?”

He had caught her daydreaming several times today. Almost every time, she had been lost in thought, except for the one time their eyes had met.

Was she really that distracted?

Yu Wan had no choice but to say, “Just some trivial worries. They’re minor things; my lord need not concern himself.”

“Hmph.” Zhao Xuanyou gave a cold laugh. “For example, that fellow from your hometown is a young man, and you didn’t think to report that to me?”

Ah?

Was he talking about Chen Da Niu?

Yu Wan blinked, realizing that someone from the Taoran Inn must have informed him. Unsure of Zhao Xuanyou’s expression, she cautiously replied, “But I never said my fellow townsman was a woman.”

“Your mother is so ill. How could you have a young man taking care of her?”

Yu Wan felt a hint of helplessness.

She wasn’t him; she couldn’t just find whoever she wanted to help.

But he kept pressing, so Yu Wan had to tell the truth. “Brother Chen is my neighbor from the village. He’s been working at the docks in the capital. Before, when my mother was at Yunshui Nunnery, the nuns took care of her, and Brother Chen only needed to check in occasionally. This time, when we moved out of Yunshui Nunnery in a hurry, I couldn’t find anyone else to help. We’ll figure something else out once things settle down.”

Yu Wan’s words were reasonable, but Zhao Xuanyou found them extremely unpleasant.

Perhaps it was the phrase “Brother Chen” that bothered him.

The servants had said the man was about his age and quite handsome. For him to help Yu Wan and her mother so devotedly, he must have ulterior motives; she just couldn’t see it.

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyebrows furrowed deeply.

“What’s the difficulty in finding someone? I’ve already arranged for a matron to take care of your mother. As for your Brother Chen, I’ve had him moved to another room.”

Yu Wan was startled by Zhao Xuanyou’s words.

He had arranged for a matron to care for her mother and even moved Chen Da Niu out?

To be honest, having Chen Da Niu and her mother in the same room was indeed improper, but her mother’s life was at stake, and Yu Wan had no other choice.

But she hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to be so considerate.

“My lord, you’ve been too kind to me.”

Zhao Xuanyou lifted his chin, arrogantly saying, “So how will you repay me?”

Repay him again…

Yu Wan rolled her eyes at him in her mind, then smiled and walked behind him, giving him a shoulder massage.

“I’ll help my lord relax a bit.”

Zhao Xuanyou knew she was stalling. His voice immediately deepened. “Playing dumb?”

From the moment he started questioning her about Chen Da Niu, Yu Wan could tell he was displeased. Now, with his every word hinting at something, and her deliberately avoiding the topic, he was likely getting annoyed.

“I’m not playing dumb. I’m seriously thinking about how to repay you, my lord.”

“Go to the study and bring me that book on the desk.”

Yu Wan was confused but did as she was told.

The desk, usually piled with official documents, indeed had a book on it; one that looked brand new.

Upon closer inspection, the cover featured neat, delicate calligraphy: The Spring Outing of Yu Zhen. It looked like a storybook.

Opening to the first page, it told of Yang Guifei being exiled from the palace after a quarrel with Emperor Xuanzong.

On the second page, Yu Zhen returned to her maiden home only to be callously driven out, left to wander the streets alone and helpless.

On the third page, Yu Zhen encountered a scholar who took her in, showing her warmth and kindness, and gradually, affection blossomed between them.

On the fourth page, the two of them were in the study…

Yu Wan finally realized what kind of book this was. Her face flushed slightly, and just as she was about to close it, Zhao Xuanyou appeared behind her; she hadn’t noticed when he had approached.

No wonder he had insisted she fetch the book from the study.

Now, standing behind her, he had her cornered against the desk. Wasn’t this exactly like the scene on the fourth page?

“My lord, let’s talk about this later,” Yu Wan pleaded softly.

Zhao Xuanyou ignored her, tugging at her sash.

“My lord,” Yu Wan called out softly, “don’t.”

Zhao Xuanyou loved the sound of her soft voice, but he wasn’t about to indulge her.

He frowned slightly, mimicking the scene from the book as he lifted Yu Wan and placed her on the edge of the desk.

Yu Wan struggled in vain, her face burning as she leaned against his shoulder.

---

chapters.title: Following to the Imperial Palace
chapters.content:
Morning light spilled into the room, illuminating the two people still wrapped in each other’s arms as they slept.

Zhao Xuanyou had actually been awake for a while.

He was used to practicing his sword in the morning. No matter how late he went to bed, he would wake up at the usual time.

But he didn’t want to get up.

The woman beside him was sleeping peacefully with her head resting on his arm. If he moved, he would wake her.

She had indeed been exhausted last night and needed more rest.

Recalling the events of the previous night, Zhao Xuanyou’s lips curled slightly. He had wanted her to be more obedient, and last night, she had been.

He lowered his head and kissed her cheek.

The stubble on his chin pricked her delicate skin, causing her to frown in her sleep. She turned over, her back to him.

But away from his embrace, she felt a chill and curled up into a ball.

She looked even more like a sleepy cat.

Zhao Xuanyou had originally intended to get up and practice his sword, but his gaze remained fixed on her smooth, jade-like neck.

He couldn’t resist kissing her again.

His movements stirred Yu Wan, dispelling much of her drowsiness. Half-asleep, she felt the cold intensify.

An hour ago, he had already removed her undershirt, and now it seemed he had lifted it again.

Yu Wan was fully awake now, gasping at the cold, but there was nothing she could do about it.

Hurry up and go to the Lichuan Imperial Palace so she could at least get some sleep!

---

Yu Wan’s hope was utterly shattered an hour later.

She was serving Zhao Xuanyou breakfast in the warm chamber. After eating, the man leisurely sat there sipping tea.

“It’s already this late. Aren’t you going to the Ministry of Personnel, my lord?” Yu Wan asked curiously.

“I’m not.”

“Because you’re going to the Lichuan Imperial Palace?”

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement.

Other royal relatives had known about the trip for a while, but he only had two days to prepare. Officials, being considerate, had excused him from court duties for these two days.

“Then I’ll go make the arrangements.”

Zhao Xuanyou said, “Have Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhi handle the packing. You go to the storeroom and pick out some clothes and jewelry. Even if you’re just a maid, you must pay attention to your appearance in the imperial palace.”

“Ah?” Yu Wan blinked. “Does my lord mean for me to go to the imperial palace as well?”

“Otherwise, who will attend to me?” Zhao Xuanyou watched her expression, slowly drawing out his words. “What? Unwilling?”

“How could I be unwilling? The Lichuan Imperial Palace is a royal residence; ordinary people can’t even dream of seeing it. To go with you, my lord, and see the world, is a great fortune for me.”

Yu Wan’s smile was genuine, her expression impossible to feign.

Physician Feng was currently treating her mother. If she were to pick the items, staying in the capital would be better, as Zhao Xuanyou wouldn’t be around, and she could slip out more often to visit her mother.

But Zhao Xuanyou taking her to the Lichuan Imperial Palace wasn’t a bad thing either.

And now, he was letting her pick clothes and jewelry from the storeroom. The marquis’s residence was wealthy, and everything in the storeroom was of high quality. Even if she only took the lesser items, they would still be valuable at a pawnshop.

The money for her mother’s acupuncture treatments was almost enough, but her mother had been in a coma for so long and was now painfully thin; almost unrecognizable. Saving more money would allow her to buy more tonics for her mother in the future.

Looking further ahead, she would eventually need to buy a house to settle down.

The more money, the better.

With this in mind, Yu Wan’s eyes shimmered with charm, her smile growing even more alluring.

“My lord, how much can I take from the storeroom?”

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes, studying her.

To be honest, aside from the few jade hairpins he had given her, Yu Wan had almost nothing worthy of his attention.

Even the clothes she had received after being elevated to a concubine were only slightly better than those of the other servants.

“The emperor will likely stay in Lichuan for at least two months,” Zhao Xuanyou said. Based on what he had seen at the Qingfeng Pavilion last time, the emperor might even stay for three months. “Have Steward Song help you pick. He knows what’s appropriate.”

“Thank you, my lord.”

Yuan Zhi and Yuan Qing were used to traveling with Zhao Xuanyou, so packing was something they could handle without his personal supervision.

After finishing his tea, he got up to pay his respects to the old matriarch.

At Leshou Hall, Feng Tang was keeping the old matriarch company. Upon seeing Zhao Xuanyou arrive, she quickly stood up and curtsied.

“Worldly Son.”

Seeing Feng Tang’s dedication, Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod and sat beside the old matriarch, smiling at her. “Grandmother, you look well today.”

After the farce at Xingguo Duke’s residence, the old matriarch’s spirits had been poor, and it had taken several days of rest to recover.

“The girl Feng Tang kept me company and talked some sense into me. She’s right; we should always look forward. There’s no point in being angry over past people and events.”

“That’s true.”

The old matriarch patted Zhao Xuanyou’s shoulder. “You’re leaving the capital?”

“Yes, in two days.”

“Will Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhi be going with you?” the old matriarch asked.

“And Yu Wan.”

Feng Tang’s fingers tightened in her sleeve. As expected, the worldly son was taking Yu Wan with him.

Fortunately, she had already spoken to the old matriarch about this; otherwise, she might not be able to keep Yu Wan in check in the future.

The old matriarch said, “In past years, the officials who accompanied the emperor to the imperial palace often brought their families. If you were still unmarried, bringing a maid wouldn’t be out of line.”

Zhao Xuanyou merely nodded, saying nothing, his gaze drifting toward Feng Tang.

Feng Tang, ever perceptive, took the hint and stood up. “My lord asked me to help manage the household, but I’m at a loss. I was just about to pay my respects to Grandmother and then consult Steward Song.”

“Go ahead.”

Once Feng Tang had left, the old matriarch said, “You came today because you have something to discuss? Coincidentally, I also wanted to talk to you.”

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. “The emperor spoke to me at length at the Qingfeng Pavilion. I have some questions, but since these matters are of great importance, I didn’t dare ask anyone else. I can only seek Grandmother’s guidance. What did you want to discuss?”

At the mention of the emperor, the old matriarch exchanged a glance with Madam Xing, who understood and led the maids out of the room, closing the door behind them.

“Matters of the palace are of great consequence. Let’s set that aside for now. I’ll speak of the trivial matters first.”

“Grandmother, please go ahead.”

The old matriarch took his hand and patted the back of it. “Earlier, the府 medical official said that Lady Cui was infertile. At the time, I only felt sorry for her and didn’t think much of it, so I had Feng Tang and Yu Wan do their best to help you have children sooner.”

“And now?” Zhao Xuanyou asked.

“Now that you and Cui Yichu have divorced, you will certainly marry again in the future. If you want to secure a good marriage, the marquis’s residence must not have any illegitimate children. Neither Feng Tang nor Yu Wan can be with child at this critical moment.”

Earlier, when Feng Tang had come to pay her respects, the old matriarch had been reminded of a very important matter.

Zhao Xuanyou had been married once before, but he and Lady Cui had no children. He was still young, favored by the emperor, and had a promising future. With the prestigious title of the Marquis of Jingyuan, it wouldn’t be difficult to find a noblewoman from a high-ranking family as his wife.

But he was currently favoring Yu Wan, and Yu Wan looked like she would be fertile. If she were to have a child out of wedlock, everything would change.

No matter how promising his future was, noble families would not easily marry their precious daughters into a household where they would have to raise another woman’s child, especially a son.

chapters.title: Bestowing Medicine
chapters.content:
"Grandmother means...?"

"Before you marry, you must give Yu Wan the contraceptive medicine."

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent.

From the perspective of the Marquis's residence, Grandmother's words were not wrong.

In the capital, almost all the young masters had a concubine before marriage to teach them about intimacy, but every family would give the concubine contraceptive medicine.

If any family had illegitimate children before marriage, they would certainly not be able to secure a good marriage.

Especially in noble families, there were precedents for titles to be passed to legitimate sons or the eldest sons. No mistress would want to make a wedding dress for someone else.

"Are you feeling sorry for her?" Old Lady Ye asked.

Zhao Xuanyou couldn't express his feelings.

He hadn't been back in the capital for long, and the time he had spent with Yu Wan was also short. Although they were intimate and affectionate, he hadn't yet considered the matter of children.

It was only when Grandmother mentioned it that he realized this issue.

If he were to marry in the future, for the peace of the household, it would be best if his lawful wife could give birth to a legitimate eldest son.

"Grandmother has considered everything thoroughly. This grandson hasn't thought about these things."

"You've been leading troops for years. How could you have thought so much about the affairs of the inner quarters?"

"Grandmother, there's no need to rush the matter of marriage."

Old Lady Ye knew that he was once bitten, twice shy, and didn't want to marry for a while. She went along with his words: "There's no need to rush. We can talk about it in a year or two. However, the matter of the contraceptive medicine cannot be delayed. What if you meet a woman you like in the future, and she sees that you already have illegitimate children at home? She wouldn't be willing to marry you, and it would delay a good marriage."

A woman he likes...

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's indecision, Old Lady Ye said: "Now I am still the mistress of the Marquis's residence. I make the decisions regarding the women's quarters. Tell me about the palace affairs. What did His Majesty say to you?"

Zhao Xuanyou temporarily set aside Yu Wan's matters. After a pause, he solemnly said: "His Majesty asked about my divorce."

"Could it be that His Majesty also knows about the ugly affairs of the Cui family?"

"Probably not. During our conversation, His Majesty never mentioned her. He only said he envied me for being able to divorce. Grandmother, I have been away from the capital for a long time, and Father told me to stay away from the palace struggles. I didn't know that the Emperor and Empress were not on good terms."

"Our Jingyuan Marquis's residence is loyal to the Emperor and the country. We have always stayed away from palace struggles. Your grandfather was like this, your father was like this, and they hope you will be the same."

The Jingyuan Marquis's residence was part of the imperial clan, with a hereditary title and military power. They didn't need to seek power and influence by currying favor with the Emperor. The best course of action was to be prudent and preserve themselves.

"His Majesty has tested me several times. I'm afraid I cannot extricate myself from this situation. I beg Grandmother for guidance."

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou did not want to be an outsider.

Going to the frontier could indeed help him preserve himself, but how could he deal with those petty people?

He didn't provoke trouble, but he was never afraid of it.

Old Lady Ye saw Zhao Xuanyou's thoughts. Her grandson was not meant to be confined to a small pond. Letting him guard a single city was indeed a waste of his talent.

Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will win every battle. This trip to Lichuan will inevitably involve him in the whirlpool. She should explain the palace affairs more clearly.

"The current Emperor was the Prince of Yong before ascending the throne, but the Princess of Yong was not the current Empress. The late Emperor, when he passed away, passed the throne to his young son. The Emperor Dowager and the regents took control of the court. A nine-year-old child became Emperor. How could his adult brothers accept this? Not long after, the nine-year-old Emperor Hongjing died in the palace with blood flowing from his seven orifices. His several royal brothers each declared themselves Emperor and started fighting. Originally, each had their own fiefs and were evenly matched, but the current Empress's father, the old Duke of Zhen Guo, was a formidable strategist. He won over the Emperor Dowager and the regents, claiming that Emperor Hongjing had left a verbal decree for the Prince of Yong to succeed him."

"With the verbal decree personally conveyed by the Emperor Dowager, the Prince of Yong became the legitimate heir."

"That's right. The Prince of Yong already had a good reputation. With legitimacy and public support, the court officials naturally respected him. The other three princes suffered setbacks one after another. Some died in battle, and some were demoted to commoners."

Zhao Xuanyou, of course, knew about this past, but he didn't know that the old Duke of Zhen Guo had played such a significant role in it.

"What happened to the Princess of Yong?"

"After the Emperor ascended the throne, he made the legitimate daughter of the Duke of Zhen Guo the Noble Consort. The Princess of Yong naturally became the Empress. During the Empress's coronation ceremony, she was already pregnant. I also went to the palace to pay my respects at that time. She had a very good pregnancy glow and complexion. Sure enough, after ten months, she gave birth to a prince."

This was His Majesty's eldest son.

However, the eldest son died young, and the original Empress... Zhao Xuanyou had never even seen her.

"They, mother and son, were unfortunate. Within two or three years, they both passed away. The Noble Consort gave birth to the second prince and naturally became the Empress."

"And her son became the Crown Prince."

"That's right," Old Lady Ye sighed. "After the Emperor ascended the throne, the power of the Duke of Zhen Guo's family reached its peak. Think about it: the Duke's daughter is the Empress, his son controls the largest of the three camps in the capital region, and his grandson is the Crown Prince."

Not to mention that their family members were in both the previous dynasty and the current palace. Even the heir to the empire carried their family's blood. How glorious and powerful they were.

"Everything in excess is a fault; going too far is as bad as not going far enough," Zhao Xuanyou sneered.

The old Duke of Zhen Guo was infallible in his calculations. If he could help the Emperor plot the throne back then, he could certainly help his own daughter plot the position of Empress.

The original Empress and the eldest son died under suspicious circumstances. The Emperor must have had his doubts.

"Xuanyou, no matter what the Emperor thinks, since you are not on the side of the Duke of Zhen Guo's family, they will be on guard against you. Now, with the Cui family's affairs, they might target you. This trip to Lichuan, you must be careful," Old Lady Ye was angry. The Jingyuan Marquis's residence had done nothing, yet they were schemed against by the Cui family and ended up on bad terms with the Crown Prince. It was truly infuriating.

"Grandmother, rest assured. This grandson will be careful."

If it were before, Zhao Xuanyou indeed wouldn't have thought so much.

But after hearing Grandmother's account of these past events, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly understood many doubts.

Why were there constant impeachments and accusations against the Crown Prince by court officials? The officials were all scholars who had come through the imperial examinations. Each was a clever person who must have long since sensed the discord between the Emperor and Empress and started to put in effort.

This was indeed good news for Zhao Xuanyou.

Of course, the people he took to Lichuan couldn't just be Yuan Zhen, Yuan Qing, and Yu Wan.

To deal with them, he had to make thorough preparations.

"Be cautious in all things. It's best to preserve yourself. If they provoke trouble, you only need to remember that the Jingyuan Marquis's residence is loyal only to the person on the dragon throne."

"This grandson understands."

Leaving the Leshou Hall, Zhao Xuanyou returned to his courtyard and started practicing with his sword.

He enjoyed martial arts, and at times like this, his mind was often particularly clear.

Thinking about the Prince of Xingguo's residence and Cui Yichu, the Emperor and Empress, and the Crown Prince and Prince Ping.

Unknowingly, a long time passed. Just as he was about to sheathe his sword, he caught a glimpse of Yu Wan happily carrying a large pile of things towards the Honghui Hall.

The summer sunlight was bright, and her smile was even more charming.

Her skirt swayed, and her glance was radiant.

Zhao Xuanyou's worries unconsciously lightened a few points. He threw the sword to Yuan Zhen and stood in the courtyard, watching her walk towards him step by step.

Yu Wan, of course, saw him.

Thanks to him, she had received so many good things, and she was happy.

However, before she could enter the Honghui Hall, Mama Xing blocked her path.

---

chapters.title: Jealousy Emerges
chapters.content:
"Mama Xing, what's the matter?" Yu Wan asked.

Mama Xing had served Old Lady Ye all her life. She was old and wise, and nothing in the inner quarters could surprise her.

She kindly said: "You have served the heir for some days now. The old lady asked me to come and remind you of some rules."

"Rules? Please enlighten me, Mama Xing."

Because Mama Xing mentioned Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Wan subconsciously looked towards the Honghui Hall.

Zhao Xuanyou was wearing his martial arts attire, his eyes deep and bright, and he was also looking at her.

Yu Wan suddenly realized that Zhao Xuanyou knew Mama Xing was coming to find her.

Mama Xing did not rush to speak. A maid beside her, holding a tray, walked over.

Only then did Mama Xing say: "In high-ranking families, concubines are always given medicine. Previously, it was due to special circumstances. Now that there is no mistress in the residence, everything must be done according to the rules."

Yu Wan understood immediately.

So, it was about giving her contraceptive medicine.

Zhao Xuanyou would surely marry again. If he had illegitimate children before remarrying, noble ladies from equivalent families would be unwilling to marry into the household.

"Yes."

Mama Xing also consoled her: "The old lady still cares for you. Otherwise, she wouldn't have sent me to deliver the medicine."

"The old lady's kind intentions, this servant understands."

Yingxue saw the commotion in the courtyard and came forward. She took the tray from the maid's hands and followed Yu Wan towards the Honghui Hall.

When they passed Zhao Xuanyou, both of them bowed to him.

"Did you find everything?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"Yes," Yu Wan respectfully replied. "Apart from clothes and jewelry, there are other things that might be needed. Manager Song also helped this servant pack them."

Zhao Xuanyou slightly nodded, shifting his gaze from Yu Wan to the bowl of medicine in Yingxue's hands.

When Grandmother mentioned it, he hadn't thought too much about it. But just now, when Yu Wan looked at him, her gaze seemed to be seeking his opinion or help, which touched him somewhat.

At that moment, he suddenly made a decision.

If she spoke up, she wouldn't have to drink the medicine.

"The old lady gave you the medicine. If you don't want to drink it, then don't."

Yu Wan was taken aback. She hadn't expected him to say that.

Could it be that he was worried she wouldn't drink the medicine?

Yu Wan didn't show any emotion on her face. She simply said: "This servant has no intention of not drinking it. It's just that I was carrying things earlier and couldn't free my hands to take it."

With that, she picked up the bowl of contraceptive medicine from the table and drank it all in one go.

Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat surprised to see her drink it so decisively.

Yu Wan saw that the sweat on his face was about to drip down. She quickly took a handkerchief and wiped his face, softly saying: "You're so hot, Master. You should rinse off. This servant will have someone draw water."

She took the empty bowl from the tray and walked out.

Zhao Xuanyou stood alone in the side room, his expression somewhat gloomy.

Yu Wan had readily drunk the medicine, which should have satisfied Grandmother. There was nothing he should find fault with, but for some reason, he felt uncomfortable.

Why?

Was it because she drank the medicine too quickly and too readily?

Did she not want to have a child with him at all?

Zhao Xuanyou suppressed the emotions in his heart and dragged his sweat-drenched body to bathe.

Yu Wan had a busy day.

She had never prepared for a long trip before. In the past, when she was with her mother, the farthest they went was the town's market, and they could return to the village within half a day. There was no need to pack anything.

As for the journey from the village to the capital, she had come with the village people's cargo bullock cart. She had no possessions, only a little silver left from selling their fields.

Yu Wan packed her clothes, checked her jewelry, and also packed combs, rouge, and other items.

Soon, it grew dark. After Zhao Xuanyou washed his feet, Yu Wan brought clean nightclothes to serve him.

Zhao Xuanyou stood there expressionlessly, allowing her to help him dress.

Having served him for so many days, Yu Wan could read his mood from his eyes.

Especially since, usually, by the time the candles were extinguished, he couldn't help but get handsy with her. Tonight, however, he was unusually calm.

What was he annoyed about? Could it be that he didn't want to see her?

After thinking for a moment, she had to tactfully step aside.

Zhao Xuanyou sat on the edge of the couch and glanced at her: "Why are you standing so far away?"

Yu Wan's eyelashes trembled. Hearing him say this, she obediently walked to the edge of the couch to sit with him.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head to look at her. She tilted her face up and smiled at him, her eyes full of tenderness and charm.

He actually liked this face very much. Whether she was happy or sad, smiling or pouting, it all made him feel at ease.

Looking into each other's eyes, he couldn't help but raise his hand to pinch her face. The calloused tips of his fingers rubbed against her lips. Her skin was soft and smooth, like jade.

"What are you thinking about, Master?"

Zhao Xuanyou stared into her eyes. The pads of his fingers suddenly applied a bit more pressure as the two of them slowly leaned closer.

"Did this servant do something wrong?" Yu Wan looked at him aggrievedly, pleading: "Master, please tell me. Don't let this servant guess."

They were too close, and for a moment, their breaths intertwined. Zhao Xuanyou's gaze became a bit blurred.

After a moment of silence, he finally spoke.

"Today, that bowl of medicine... I said you could choose not to drink it. Why did you drink it so readily?"

chapters.title: Taking Control
chapters.content:
Yu Wan's smile stiffened slightly.

Was he angry because she had taken the contraceptive medicine?

That shouldn't be the case. Zhao Xuanyou was currently enjoying a successful official career and the emperor's favor. If he had no illegitimate children, he could marry a noblewoman from a high-ranking family just like his first marriage.

Wasn't she taking the medicine to ease his burden? Why was he still angry?

Moreover, he clearly knew that the Old Grandmother was going to bestow the contraceptive medicine. If he was unwilling, why didn't he refuse?

When Madame Xing came, he didn't seem surprised at all.

Yu Wan couldn't figure out the reason for his bad mood. Feeling helpless, she carefully asked, "Does Master think this servant should not have taken it?"

At first, Zhao Xuanyou didn't care much whether she took it or not.

Matters within the inner quarters were decided by his grandmother. If she wanted Yu Wan to take the contraceptive medicine, then so be it.

But why did the image of her lifting the bowl and drinking the medicine in one gulp linger in his mind, tormenting him for half a day and still bothering him even as night fell?

She drank it so decisively. Could it be that in her heart, she had never considered bearing children for him?

Was she so indifferent about this matter?

The candlelight in the room was dim. Facing her delicate, beautiful face, Zhao Xuanyou's expression turned cold as he withdrew his hand.

"I am the one asking you, yet you turn it around to ask me. It seems I have been too lenient with you."

Lenient?

Yu Wan didn't feel that he had been lenient with her at all.

Whether it was his daily life or their intimate moments, hadn't she served him wholeheartedly according to his wishes?

How could he say she was being lenient?

Yu Wan was just a servant concubine. She could only stick to her duties as a servant and meekly accept his reprimands without talking back.

Moreover, her mother was still staying at the Taoran Inn, and the villains of the Xingguo Duke's mansion were threatening their lives. She had to cling to him tightly, using his influence to protect her mother.

"That medicine looked too bitter. If one must drink it, it's better to drink it quickly." Yu Wan looked at him innocently. "Master just said that this servant drank it too readily. Could it be that Master thinks this servant enjoys drinking it?"

"Do you not want to drink it?" Her expression didn't look like she didn't want to drink it.

"Of course. Who would enjoy drinking medicine?"

Zhao Xuanyou frowned. She seemed to be answering, yet she didn't really answer anything.

Having commanded troops on the frontier for seven or eight years, he had experienced countless storms and dangers, yet today was the first time he tasted the flavor of entanglement and hesitation.

"Didn't I say that you could drink the contraceptive medicine if you wanted to, and not drink it if you didn't? Why did you have to drink it?"

Zhao Xuanyou's clear questioning made Yu Wan inexplicably uneasy.

Her heartbeat quickened, and she lowered her eyes nervously. Softly, she said, "The medicine was bestowed by the Old Grandmother. Of course, this servant had to drink it."

Seeing that the dark look in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes had not faded, Yu Wan added coquettishly, "Master is the most filial to the Old Grandmother. This servant would not dare to disobey the Old Grandmother's orders."

So she drank it without hesitation because she prioritized his grandmother's wishes?

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze flickered as he looked at her cautious appearance, and suddenly, an idea struck him.

He leaned down and kissed her forehead.

"The Old Grandmother just suddenly thought of this. If you didn't want to drink the medicine, I could have said something. It's not a big deal."

So he really hoped that she wouldn't take the medicine... Did he want children soon?

That couldn't be. He wasn't that old. Was he in such a hurry for an heir?

Yu Wan's mind was filled with confusion, but now that she had confirmed his thoughts, she could only go along with what he said. "I understand."

The room was quiet.

Yu Wan calmed down and quickly thought of a better excuse. She softly added, "When this servant drank that bowl of contraceptive soup today, I was indeed willing."

The man's gaze suddenly sharpened.

Yu Wan pouted, "Master said that you would take this servant to the Lichuan Imperial Palace to stay for two months. If this servant were with child, wouldn't it be inconvenient to serve you there? I've heard that Lichuan has beautiful scenery and magnificent palaces. This servant... really wants to stay by Master's side. Would Master laugh at this servant for being unambitious?"

"Why would I laugh at you? Not to mention you, many officials in the court wish they could follow His Majesty to Lichuan to escape the summer heat."

Zhao Xuanyou was indeed convinced by this reason.

If Yu Wan were with child, it would indeed be inconvenient to stay there, and she would have to be sent back to the capital early.

How could he bear that?

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's expression soften bit by bit, Yu Wan stood up, intending to extinguish the nearby candles. Before she could steady herself, she was pulled onto the bed by the man.

"There's no need to put them out." He said hoarsely.

After imitating the act in the study the day before, Zhao Xuanyou had experienced a different kind of pleasure.

Darkness had its advantages, but so did the light.

With Yu Wan in his arms, her hair half undone, her posture graceful, and her eyes full of affection... it was better not to extinguish the candles.

---

Two days later, at noon, the imperial carriage departed from the capital on schedule.

Yu Wan had followed Zhao Xuanyou in the Houfu carriage to the city gate early in the morning to wait.

Apart from the accompanying officials, the two prime ministers led the civil and military officials to see off the imperial carriage at the city gate. The city gate had long been cleared by the military and the Brocade Guards, and not a single commoner was in sight. The civil and military officials lined both sides of the official road according to their ranks.

The Houfu carriage was far from the city gate, and Yu Wan was bored sitting alone in the carriage.

She quietly lifted the carriage curtain and saw that the surrounding carriages were of similar specifications to the Houfu carriage. It seemed that they were carrying the families of the emperor's close officials.

Soon, the various prince's carriages arrived at the city gate, followed by the carriages of the imperial concubines and princesses.

By noon, the imperial carriage finally set off from the palace.

The coachman outside reminded Yu Wan to get out of the carriage, and she hurriedly did so.

The families of the officials around her also got out of their carriages to welcome the imperial carriage. There were noble and dignified madams, as well as young and beautiful women. Like everyone else, Yu Wan knelt down and kowtowed to the imperial carriage as it slowly passed through the city gate, shouting "Long live the Emperor."

The sight was filled with imperial yellow, and the procession was grand.

It was not until the Feathered Forest Guard escorted the imperial carriage far away that Yu Wan finally raised her head again.

They said that accompanying the emperor was like accompanying a tiger. Yu Wan already found it difficult to serve Zhao Xuanyou, and this time, just accompanying the emperor from afar, her neck and knees were already suffering.

Although Zhao Xuanyou was cold, serving him also required a lot of effort. At least she didn't have to kneel all the time.

Yu Wan rubbed her sore neck and got back into the carriage.

The order of departure was the reverse of the order of arrival. After the imperial carriage, came the concubines, then the princes and princesses, followed by the officials in order of their ranks.

Although Zhao Xuanyou was the heir of the Houfu, he was a fourth-rank official, the lowest among the officials accompanying the emperor, so he followed at the end of the procession.

The imperial carriage did not travel fast. Normally, a carriage could reach the Lichuan Imperial Palace in three days, but they would take four.

This bit of travel was nothing to Yu Wan.

She was immersed in the joy of leaving the capital, and most of the time, she opened the carriage curtain to enjoy the scenery along the way.

Currently, Zhao Xuanyou was in favor, and the emperor allowed him and a few princes to ride horses around the imperial carriage. During the day, he was busy attending to the emperor, so Yu Wan did not need to serve him. She had the Houfu carriage to herself and was quite leisurely.

Since it was an imperial tour, the local governments and post stations along the way had long been prepared. Yu Wan not only enjoyed the scenery but also tasted the local delicacies, truly having a good time.

She was not afraid of the slight bumps of the carriage and even wished the journey would be slower.

"Madam, try this osmanthus cake. It tastes different from the ones in the capital."

"How is it different?"

"The osmanthus used is different. Madam will know after trying it."

That day, when Yu Wan got out of the carriage to eat, the gentleman next to her was introducing the food to his wife.

His voice was pleasant, and Yu Wan unconsciously looked in his direction.

chapters.title: The Handsome Man
chapters.content:
Yu Wan was mesmerized by what she saw.

Not only did the man have a pleasant voice, but his appearance was also outstanding. The dappled light and shadows of the forest shone on his handsome face, making him look even cleaner and more refreshing.

To be honest, in terms of appearance, he and Zhao Xuanyou each had their own merits.

However, the man's eyes were particularly clear, and his demeanor was otherworldly. He seemed as if he had been cleansed by the purest ice, snow, and rain, untouched by the slightest dust.

Yu Wan stared at him quietly, and from the corner of her eye, she saw the man's wife smile at her.

This was too embarrassing.

Yu Wan hastily averted her gaze and bowed to the wife.

The wife was very gentle and said to Yu Wan with a smile, "My husband says that the osmanthus cake here is more delicious than the ones in the capital. Would you like to try some together?"

Every time they stopped to rest, the families in the carriages would get out to eat and rest.

The news of Zhao Xuanyou's separation from Cui Yichu and Li had also caused a stir in the noble circles of the capital. Everyone around knew that the person in the Houfu carriage was not the worldly son's wife. Seeing Yu Wan's outstanding appearance, they guessed that she was Zhao Xuanyou's concubine.

Everyone had different statuses, and there was no need for small talk.

Yu Wan knew this and didn't mind.

In this life, she lived only for revenge and to save her mother. Whether these noblewomen acknowledged her or not didn't matter.

Moreover, by keeping Zhao Xuanyou happy, she could have a place to stay and receive gold, silver, and clothes as rewards. What good would talking to these madams do? Would they give her a piece of gold or help her kill Cui Yichu?

However, it was Yu Wan who had been rude first, and the other party had not borne a grudge and invited her to eat. It would be unreasonable to refuse now.

"Yu Wan greets the master and madam." Yu Wan stepped forward and bowed.

Looking at the handsome master's clothes, he was, like Zhao Xuanyou, a fourth-rank official. No wonder the two families' carriages were close.

"Are you a maid from the Jingyuan Houfu?" the madam asked gently.

"Yes, this servant attends to the worldly son in the mansion."

These past two days, people had been saying that the Jingyuan Hou's worldly son had brought a beautiful concubine with him. They hadn't expected her to be a maid.

However, this maid was indeed beautiful, with an outstanding face and figure. She was probably not an ordinary maid but a servant concubine in the mansion.

"Miss Yu Wan, please try some." The handsome master who Yu Wan had been staring at said gently.

Not only was he handsome, but his voice was also pleasant, like a musical instrument, richer than when he spoke.

Yu Wan didn't dare to look at him anymore. She lowered her eyes, took a piece of osmanthus cake, and under their gaze, took a bite. Looking up, she smiled and said, "It is indeed delicious. Thank you."

"In that case, I should try some too."

The three of them ate the osmanthus cake and chatted about their experiences since leaving the capital. When the guards urged them to get back in the carriages, Yu Wan bid them farewell.

After returning to the carriage, they soon continued on their way.

Yu Wan sat in silence for a while before lifting the carriage curtain and sitting next to Yuan Qi and Yuan Qing.

"Why aren't you sitting in the carriage?" Yuan Qing asked.

"Driving the carriage is boring. I came out to chat with you for a while."

Yuan Qing nodded repeatedly. "It's indeed boring to travel all day."

Yuan Qi, however, didn't believe that Yu Wan had come out just to chat with them. For the past two days, she had been eating pastries, drinking tea, and enjoying the scenery inside the carriage, living a leisurely and comfortable life.

"What do you want to ask?" Yuan Qi got straight to the point.

Yu Wan smiled and said, "Earlier, when we were resting, I spoke with the master and madam from the carriage behind us. Do you know which family they belong to?"

Yuan Qing rarely went out and naturally didn't know.

Yuan Qi said, "That is Pei Ta, the Deputy Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and his wife. Director Pei is a famous handsome man in the capital. In the past, there were even noble girls who tried to kill themselves to marry him."

Compared to Cui Yichu, this beautiful man, Director Pei's appearance was indeed deserving of his reputation.

The Deputy Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices was a fourth-rank civil official, which explained why the two families' carriages were next to each other.

Yu Wan thought of the gentle and thin wife next to Pei Ta and curiously asked, "Does Director Pei only have feelings for his wife?"

"Who knows? His wife is Sun Qianran, the only daughter of Prime Minister Sun." Yuan Qi said in a low voice.

No wonder the madam was elegant and well-spoken. She came from the prime minister's family.

From what Yuan Qi implied, Pei Ta married her because of her family background. However, Yu Wan had just met them, and their conversation seemed very harmonious. It was clear that they were a perfect couple.

"Are you saying that Director Pei is a social climber?"

Yuan Qi narrowed her eyes. "You wouldn't have been captivated by Director Pei's appearance, would you?"

Yu Wan felt a pang of guilt at Yuan Qi's counterquestion and quickly said, "Don't talk nonsense. I just think they are a good match."

"It's not that they don't match, but Madam Pei has been a sickly person since she was a child. If he went to propose marriage, wasn't it to climb up to Prime Minister Sun? What other reason could there be?"

Was Madam Pei in poor health?

Earlier, her complexion seemed fine, but her lips were indeed paler than most people's.

Yu Wan said, "You are just guessing."

"I am guessing, but my guess might not be wrong," Yuan Qi said righteously. "He is about the same age as our master. Our master is the heir of the Houfu, but he also had to fight on the frontier for seven or eight years to rise to the fourth rank."

"Master is a military general, while Director Pei is a civil official. It's different."

"He was the top scholar two years ago and has been an official for only two years, yet he has already become a fourth-rank official. If it wasn't for his father-in-law, who would believe he could rise so quickly?"

Yu Wan didn't understand court affairs, but as Yuan Qi put it, Director Pei had indeed risen very quickly.

Yuan Qing, who had been silent all this time, finally understood who they were talking about when he heard the phrase "handsome man."

"That's the number one handsome man in the capital?" Yuan Qing said disdainfully. "Compared to Master, he has no masculinity at all. Are the people in the capital all fools or blind?"

Yu Wan blinked.

Zhao Xuanyou was indeed handsome, but Director Pei was also strikingly beautiful.

"No wonder Master keeps you by his side. I didn't expect you to be so good at flattering at such a young age." Yu Wan couldn't help but smile.

Yuan Qing, however, "Hmphed" and said righteously, "It's the truth. That kind of pretty boy can't even withstand one move from Master. How can he compare to Master? Do you think Master is worse than him?"

This kid had actually turned the tables on her.

Yu Wan said, "Who said Master is worse than him? I didn't compare them. I just think Director Pei and Madam Pei look very loving. It's not that they are as you said. We really don't see eye to eye. I'm too lazy to talk to you."

Having asked what she wanted to know, Yu Wan simply returned to the carriage.

The large procession arrived at the post station before dark.

From the capital to Lichuan, the emperor and the royal family had imperial villas to stay in along the way, while the officials and their families stayed at the post stations.

Yu Wan got out of the carriage and saw Madam Pei talking to a few other madams about going to enjoy the scenery nearby before it got completely dark.

Of course, Yu Wan wouldn't be so presumptuous as to follow them. She simply took Zhao Xuanyou's personal belongings from the carriage and went to tidy up the room.

Just as she had finished arranging everything and was about to go out to eat, she opened the door and saw Pei Ta, dressed in a green robe, standing in the corridor. His features were delicate and gentle, and his bone structure was refined and handsome. Yet, there was not a trace of arrogance in him. His every movement exuded the scholarly demeanor of a gentle and refined man.

He also saw her and said with a slight smile, "Miss Yu Wan, so you live next door."

chapters.title: Covering Her Mouth
chapters.content:
It wasn't a coincidence. The accompanying officials were all arranged in lodging and meals according to their ranks. Pei Tao and Zhao Xuanyou were both fourth-rank officials, so whether it was the carriage or the room, they were arranged very close to each other.

It was just that the first two nights weren't as close as tonight, with their doors adjacent.

"Lord Pei." Yu Wan respectfully bowed.

"Did you see my wife when you entered the post station?" Pei Tao asked.

"Yes, I did. A few ladies I didn't recognize invited her to appreciate the lotuses by the pond, and they went there together."

As soon as Yu Wan finished speaking, she clearly saw Pei Tao's handsome eyebrows furrow.

"Thank you." After saying this, he hurried away.

Was it because Lady Pei was in poor health, and he was worried about her going to see the scenery alone?

Being so concerned about Lady Pei, it probably wasn't just for the sake of marrying into power.

Yu Wan watched Pei Tao's departing figure, and suddenly, her earlobe was lightly flicked by someone.

"Ah!" It hurt so much. Yu Wan covered her ear and turned around, only to meet Zhao Xuanyou's dark, unclear gaze.

"What are you looking at?"

Yu Wan endured the burning pain in her earlobe and softly said, "Just now, Lord Pei's wife went missing, and this servant is worried something happened."

When she mentioned Lord Pei, Zhao Xuanyou naturally knew who she was talking about.

Pei Tao was the number one scholar personally selected by His Majesty in the Golden Hall. He had always been highly regarded by His Majesty. While in the Hanlin Academy, he often attended to duties in the imperial study. Later, when there was a vacancy in the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, he was promoted to Assistant Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

On this trip to Lichuan, among the accompanying officials, the lowest in rank were him and Zhao Xuanyou.

However, one was the heir of the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion, and the other was the esteemed son-in-law of Prime Minister Sun. No one dared to look down on them.

"How do you know him?"

"I don't know him," Yu Wan naturally wouldn't say the wrong thing at this moment. "Previously, Lady Pei invited this servant to eat osmanthus cakes, and Lord Pei was there at the time. He couldn't find Lady Pei, so when he saw this servant, he asked a question. I heard that Lady Pei is in poor health, so this servant is also worried something happened to her."

Although it was the height of summer, the closer they got to Lichuan, the cooler it felt.

As soon as night fell, the wind turned cold. If Lady Pei was indeed a frail person as Yuan Yi had said, perhaps she really shouldn't have gone out to catch a cold wind.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her, said nothing, and went straight into the room.

Yu Wan stuck out her tongue, went to the kitchen to fetch dinner, and as she passed by the neighboring room, she faintly heard people talking inside.

It seemed Lady Pei had already returned.

"Master, dinner is served."

The post station chef's skills couldn't compare to those of the Marquis's mansion. The color, fragrance, and taste were all inferior. However, Zhao Xuanyou didn't care much about these things. After finishing his meal, he quickly changed into his nightclothes.

It wasn't yet time to sleep, so Yu Wan went to wash some fruit and brought it to him.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't move, just opened his mouth.

Yu Wan smiled, took a silver pick, and fed him.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't want fruit. After eating a piece casually, he reached out and pulled Yu Wan into his arms.

"Master, wait."

Yu Wan was afraid the porcelain bowl in her hand would fall, so she wanted to put it on the nearby table.

The post station wasn't like the Marquis's mansion. There was only herself by his side. Yuan Qing and Yuan Yi were staying with other servants elsewhere. If something broke, she would have to clean it up.

Zhao Xuanyou, of course, didn't care. His large hand explored under the edge of her summer garment.

Touching her tofu-like skin, the color in his eyes deepened.

Seeing his growing greed, Yu Wan held her breath, suddenly jumped forward, and steadily placed the porcelain bowl down.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her like this, curled the corner of his mouth, and pulled her back.

"Master, let's rest early tonight."

Tonight's post station was older than the ones from the previous two nights. Just now, when passing by Pei Tao's room, she could faintly hear them talking. If they continued as usual, they might be heard by others.

"Hmm?" Zhao Xuanyou raised his eyes, showing a displeased expression.

Yu Wan pitifully explained, "The walls of this post station seem a bit thin. This servant isn't afraid of anything, but the people around are all Master's colleagues..."

"Is that so?"

Yu Wan thought he was going to give up, but unexpectedly, he lifted her undershirt and threw it at her face.

"Is this small matter something I need to teach you?"

Zhao Xuanyou lightly hummed.

Yu Wan had no choice but to cover her mouth with the undershirt.

---

Yu Wan dozed off, leaning against his arm.

In the quiet late night, a sudden bout of severe coughing broke the silence.

The coughing continued for a long time, completely dispelling Yu Wan's sleepiness.

Was that Lady Pei?

She had gone to the lotus pond to catch a cold wind and was coughing so badly? No wonder Lord Pei had frowned at that time.

She really didn't take good care of herself. Clearly, she was frail, yet she still went to see the scenery.

Yu Wan tried her best to fall back asleep, but her mind became clearer and clearer.

"Are you awake?" The man beside her suddenly asked.

Lady Pei was coughing so violently that probably everyone around had been woken up.

"Master, were you also disturbed?"

Zhao Xuanyou still had his eyes closed: "Probably everyone in the entire building is awake."

Yu Wan sighed softly, believing Yuan Yi's words a little more.

Previously, when it was said that Lady Pei was a medicine pot, she had only thought she was a bit frail. Coughing like this, it seemed she was seriously ill.

"When you can't sleep, close your eyes first. You can still rest a little." Zhao Xuanyou slowly said.

Yu Wan listened to him, her eyelashes trembling slightly, and softly asked, "When Master is on a military campaign, do you rest like this when it's noisy?"

"Mmm."

Yu Wan looked at him meditating with his eyes closed, curved the corner of her mouth, and lay back down on his arm.

The next morning, Yu Wan served Zhao Xuanyou as he got up and left. Only then did she take her things to the post station entrance to wait for the carriage.

Many ladies around had dark circles under their eyes, presumably they hadn't slept well last night.

Yu Wan looked around but didn't see the Pei couple.

Soon, Yuan Qing and Yuan Yi drove the carriage over, and she got in.

Today's journey was only half a day. Yu Wan hadn't slept well last night and dozed off in the carriage. She only got off when Yuan Qing loudly reminded her.

The Lichuan Travel Palace was located in a river valley between two mountains. Water flowed on three sides, and the mountains on both sides were steep. It was said to have excellent feng shui.

The Travel Palace consisted of seven palaces. Outside the palace walls, many unique courtyards were built. The royal family members lived inside the palace, while the accompanying officials and their families lived in these courtyards.

However, because there were many people, it wasn't possible to have one courtyard per family. Two or three households lived together.

Since the Marquis's mansion had no mistress, after the eunuchs had arranged the other ministers' wives, someone finally came forward and said in a high-pitched voice, "Are you from the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion? Bring your things and follow me."

"Thank you, Your Honor." Yu Wan saw a eunuch for the first time. Although she was curious, she remembered the incident yesterday where she had stared at Pei Tao and been impolite. She lowered her head and followed with the luggage.

After passing seven or eight courtyards, the eunuch finally stopped. "This is it. These three rooms on the left are for the heir."

"Yes."

The eunuch glanced at Yu Wan, not expecting a maid to give him a reward. Just as he was thinking he was unlucky, Yuan Yi and Yuan Qing came from behind, carrying boxes.

Yuan Yi wasn't seeing a eunuch for the first time and was prepared. He warmly handed over a red envelope, which finally made the eunuch smile.

"You may not think much of this courtyard because it's a bit far, but this place has the best scenery and only two families live here. It's spacious."

"Thank you, Your Honor."

After seeing the eunuch off, Yu Wan pushed open the door to the courtyard. Seeing the familiar person standing in the courtyard, she realized who the other family was.

"Miss Yu Wan, we are neighbors again."

"Lady Pei." Yu Wan quickly stepped forward to greet her.

Sun Qianran's complexion was worse than when she had seen her the day before.

Her lips were originally very pale. To look better, she had applied bright lip rouge, which only made her skin look more sickly.

She apologetically said to Yu Wan, "Last night, I coughed so badly. I'm afraid I disturbed you and the heir. Since we are assigned to the same courtyard, I'm afraid you won't be able to sleep peacefully at night in the future."

Yu Wan was somewhat surprised.

She had thought that Lady Sun Qianran had gone out to catch a cold wind, which was why she was coughing. It turned out her health was so poor that she coughed every night.

"How could that be? Lady, you have been so kind to this servant. Being able to live in the same courtyard as Lady makes this servant very happy."

Yu Wan meant what she said.

At the Travel Palace, the eunuchs and palace maids were in charge of food and daily life, so Yu Wan didn't need to worry.

Zhao Xuanyou had to accompany His Majesty during the day and had no time to pay attention to her.

Even if she was kept awake at night, she could make up for it during the day.

Sun Qianran and Pei Tao both seemed very easygoing, unlike those nobles who liked to put on airs.

Whether they were sincere or not, at least they treated her, a concubine who served with her looks, kindly.

Compared to being looked down upon every day, living in the same courtyard as them was much better.

Sun Qianran gratefully smiled at her.

Yu Wan said, "The Lichuan Travel Palace is in a river valley, and the wind is strong. Lady, don't stand in the courtyard for too long."

"Mmm." Sun Qianran nodded, and her maid beside her helped her into the house.

Yu Wan moved her things into the house. Yuan Qing helped beside her, but Yuan Yi didn't know where he had gone off to.

Today was the first day the Emperor and Empress arrived at the Travel Palace. The ministers were all feasting in the main hall of the Travel Palace.

While tidying up, Yuan Yi came in, looking troubled.

"What happened?" Yu Wan asked.

Yuan Yi said bitterly, "I just found out why Master was assigned to this courtyard. The Lady Pei in the main house coughed badly yesterday. Originally, the people who were supposed to share this courtyard with the Pei family had used money to bribe the eunuchs, so those dog eunuchs assigned Master here."

"How dare they bully the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion?"

"They are all money-grubbing people. Relying on serving the Emperor, they aren't afraid of offending anyone."

Yu Wan understood that the men were all at the banquet. The mistresses of each family had probably gone to bribe the eunuchs. Only the Marquis's mansion had no mistress, so they thought they could take advantage.

She didn't mind.

"Last night's post station was already small, and the walls were thin. This is the Travel Palace, and we are separated from the main house by a few rooms. The noise from next door won't disturb us here."

Yuan Yi went out and chatted with other families' servants for a while. After finding out about the courtyard assignment, he came back to complain to them and express his dissatisfaction on behalf of Master.

However, having followed Zhao Xuanyou on military campaigns for many years, they naturally understood that he would never care about such living arrangements.

Especially since this was the Travel Palace, Zhao Xuanyou would never cause trouble with others here.

The three of them chatted and laughed as they finished tidying up. Yu Wan wandered around the small courtyard by herself.

The courtyard was square in layout, with three main rooms in the center and three side rooms on each side, almost the same size as the main rooms.

Behind the right side room, there was a small kitchen. Families who brought their own chefs could cook here.

As Yu Wan walked past, she happened to see a cook washing dishes and pots.

Sun Qianran was frail and sickly, so she needed a separate kitchen for her meals.

Because of this, Yu Wan thought of another advantage of living here.

Zhao Xuanyou wasn't particular about food. All three meals were delivered from the Travel Palace's kitchen. But other families would definitely bring their own chefs. With three families sharing one kitchen, it would be busy from morning to night, and there would be no peace.

In August, the capital was so hot that one would sweat every day. In comparison, the climate of the Lichuan Travel Palace, warm like spring, was really comfortable.

Yu Wan wanted to go out and take a look, but since she was new here, she was afraid of causing trouble by wandering around, so she gave up.

Back in the room, she wrote a letter to Chen Da Niu, explaining that she was traveling with the heir. If anything urgent came up, he could go to the Marquis's mansion to find Yingxue. Or if there was any change in her mother's condition, he could write to inform her.

Chen Da Niu was illiterate, so the letter was directly addressed to the innkeeper of Taoran Inn. When the time came, the innkeeper would naturally read it to Chen Da Niu.

After writing the letter, she entrusted Yuan Yi to send it to the capital, then lay down on the bed to rest.

Perhaps it was because Sun Qianran was in good condition during the day, or perhaps the walls of the Travel Palace's side courtyard were thick. Yu Wan didn't hear a single cough and quickly fell asleep.

---

While Yu Wan was napping, Zhao Xuanyou was accompanying His Majesty at the Travel Palace.

Many royal family members had come to the Travel Palace this time. The Emperor and Empress brought three concubines, and three princesses also came. Among the sons, apart from Prince Ping, who was left to guard the capital, Prince Jing Zhao Lin, who had taken over as the Deputy Commander of the Mingmi Guard, had gone to Yuzhou. The Crown Prince Zhao Zun, the Sixth Prince Zhao Yu, and the Seventh Prince Zhao Qi all came.

After the grand noon banquet, the Emperor kept the princes and ministers to talk.

Although he had traveled to the Travel Palace, he was not neglecting state affairs.

Memorials from the court were sent daily, first decided by the two Prime Ministers and Prince Ping. Urgent matters were sent to Lichuan by fast horses.

After briefly discussing the backlog of memorials from the past four days of travel, the Emperor said, "Now that my son Lin has gone to Yuzhou for training, and everything is going smoothly, the only thing that worries me is the studies of my sixth and seventh sons."

The Crown Prince Zhao Zun said, "The Sixth Brother has always been diligent in his studies and has been praised by the scholars of the Hanlin Academy many times. On the other hand, the Seventh Brother is still as mischievous as before, frequently causing trouble in the palace. Last month, he even talked back to the Empress. In my opinion, he should indeed be seriously educated."

Immediately, some ministers stood up to praise the Crown Prince.

After all, the Sixth Prince Zhao Yu had been under his tutelage for the past two years.

The Emperor slightly nodded, "I have the same intention. The seventh child is also smart, but in the past, I was busy with government affairs and neglected him, which led to his flawed character."

"Father, I am willing to educate the Seventh Brother."

As soon as the Crown Prince finished speaking, the Emperor raised his hand to signal him not to say more.

"It seems Father already has a good plan." The Crown Prince paused, then smiled again.

The Emperor said, "The Seventh Prince has been studying under great scholars for these years without much progress. I don't think he is suited for academic pursuits. It might be better for him to learn martial arts."

The Crown Prince's eyes moved slightly, scanning the hall.

Among the more than a dozen ministers, Zhao Xuanyou was the only military officer.

At this moment, the Emperor mentioned letting the Seventh Prince learn martial arts. It was evident that he wanted Zhao Xuanyou to teach the Seventh Prince martial skills.

The Crown Prince, of course, also knew about Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu's divorce.

People below had reported that it was because Cui Yichu was unfilial to the old lady of the Marquis's mansion, so both families agreed to the divorce.

But how could he believe such words?

The only explanation was that Zhao Xuanyou knew about Cui Yichu's loss of chastity and her past with him.

He would divorce Cui Yichu, clearly not wanting to live a life of turning a blind eye.

At this point, trying to win over Zhao Xuanyou was impossible.

The Crown Prince's gaze was fixed tightly on Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou noticed someone looking at him and calmly raised his head.

When their eyes met, it was as if thousands of troops were silently galloping.

chapters.content:

Compared to being looked down upon every day, living in the same courtyard as them was much better.

Sun Qianran gratefully smiled at her.

Yu Wan said, "The Lichuan Travel Palace is in a river valley, and the wind is strong. Lady, don't stand in the courtyard for too long."

"Mmm." Sun Qianran nodded, and her maid beside her helped her into the house.

Yu Wan moved her things into the house. Yuan Qing helped beside her, but Yuan Yi didn't know where he had gone off to.

Today was the first day the Emperor and Empress arrived at the Travel Palace. The ministers were all feasting in the main hall of the Travel Palace.

While tidying up, Yuan Yi came in, looking troubled.

"What happened?" Yu Wan asked.

Yuan Yi said bitterly, "I just found out why Master was assigned to this courtyard. The Lady Pei in the main house coughed badly yesterday. Originally, the people who were supposed to share this courtyard with the Pei family had used money to bribe the eunuchs, so those dog eunuchs assigned Master here."

"How dare they bully the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion?"

"They are all money-grubbing people. Relying on serving the Emperor, they aren't afraid of offending anyone."

Yu Wan understood that the men were all at the banquet. The mistresses of each family had probably gone to bribe the eunuchs. Only the Marquis's mansion had no mistress, so they thought they could take advantage.

She didn't mind.

"Last night's post station was already small, and the walls were thin. This is the Travel Palace, and we are separated from the main house by a few rooms. The noise from next door won't disturb us here."

Yuan Yi went out and chatted with other families' servants for a while. After finding out about the courtyard assignment, he came back to complain to them and express his dissatisfaction on behalf of Master.

However, having followed Zhao Xuanyou on military campaigns for many years, they naturally understood that he would never care about such living arrangements.

The three of them chatted and laughed as they finished tidying up. Yu Wan wandered around the small courtyard by herself.

The courtyard was square in layout, with three main rooms in the center and three side rooms on each side, almost the same size as the main rooms.

Behind the right side room, there was a small kitchen. Families who brought their own chefs could cook here.
