In fact, I should not have removed the Marquis of Jingyuan from the imperial clan registry in the first place. I intend to formally reinstate Xuanyou into the Zhao imperial lineage."

chapters.title: Brother and Sister Status
chapters.content:
If the Zhao family were recorded in the imperial registry of the Ministry of Clan Affairs, Zhao Xuanyou would be a genuine cousin to Princess Yi'an, making marriage between them absolutely impossible.

"Father Emperor..." Princess Yi'an instinctively wanted to refute, but she came to her senses before the words left her mouth. "This would be a great honor for the Jingyuan Marquis's residence. They say rewards are given based on merit, but recently, they haven't accomplished anything noteworthy. Why the sudden reward?"

The Emperor maintained a dignified and imposing demeanor, but his gaze toward Princess Yi'an revealed a touch of affection.

"I have always been troubled by Qi'er's studies. These past few years, I've worried endlessly, and even your mother finds it thorny. She said Qi'er should be sent out to temper and refine himself. Now, Xuanyou has transformed Qi'er completely in just half a month. Wouldn't you say that's a great achievement?"

"Father Emperor speaks truly." With the Emperor having said this much, Princess Yi'an dared not say more.

The Crown Prince's expression subtly tensed.

Zhao Xuanyou was determined to oppose him, and now, with the Emperor's favor, even he could not easily act against Zhao Xuanyou.

The Crown Prince exchanged a glance with the Empress. After a moment's thought, the Empress slowly spoke, "Rewards should indeed be given, but our ancestors did not include the Jingyuan Marquis's residence in the imperial registry for a reason. Your Majesty, perhaps another form of reward would be more appropriate."

The Emperor still wore a smile, but his tone deepened slightly.

"The Empress usually manages the harem. Why does she concern herself with clan matters today?"

The Empress hastily replied, "This concubine is terrified and asks for Your Majesty's forgiveness."

"This matter is decided. I am merely informing you all; there is no need for further discussion."

"Yes."

Among those present, Zhao Yu and Zhao Qi were indifferent. The Empress, the Crown Prince, and Princess Yi'an opposed the matter, while Princess Yiningsaw it as a welcome development.

She was dissatisfied with her own marriage prospects, and seeing Princess Yi'an also unable to get her way made her feel much more at ease.

Soon, the family banquet ended, and everyone respectfully withdrew from the Mingde Hall.

The Emperor did not retain any concubines; only his close attendant, Liu Quan, assisted him into the bedchamber.

"Look at this. A casual decision from me, and yet it causes such a big reaction."

Liu Quan respectfully replied, "The matter came suddenly, and Her Majesty the Empress hasn't had time to recover her senses."

"Hmph," the Emperor coldly laughed. "Let's not talk about the Empress. Did you see the reactions of the Crown Prince and Yi'an?"

"I did, Your Majesty."

"I truly did not expect Yi'an to actually harbor the idea of marrying Xuanyou." The Emperor sighed heavily.

Liu Quan said, "Master Zhao is both literate and martial, with a dignified appearance. It's not surprising that Princess Yi'an has taken a fancy to him."

"If Yi'an were not so close to the Empress and the Crown Prince, perhaps I would have agreed."

A few days ago, the Emperor had summoned Zhao Xuanyou to discuss Zhao Qi's studies and asked what reward he desired. Zhao Xuanyou, usually modest, requested to be included in the imperial registry of the Ministry of Clan Affairs.

The Emperor was no fool. The Jingyuan Marquis's residence already had a hereditary title and was supported by the court for generations. Being included in the registry would bring no substantial benefits.

Lately, Princess Yi'an had frequently mentioned Zhao Xuanyou to the Emperor and insisted on having him escort her wherever she went.

Previously, the Emperor hadn't thought much of it, but as soon as Zhao Xuanyou made his request, the Emperor connected the two matters.

Including the Jingyuan Marquis's residence in the imperial registry would make Zhao Xuanyou a cousin to Princess Yi'an. Marrying her would then be a violation of ethics and heavenly principles.

Zhao Xuanyou was a man of both literary and martial talents, brave and resourceful. The Emperor genuinely liked him.

Even though he had been married once before, the Emperor would still be willing to have him as a royal son-in-law.

Unfortunately, he was short of capable people.

Zhao Xuanyou was a rare blade the Emperor had painstakingly chosen. How could he hand him over to the Empress?

"Your Majesty is wise. Princess Yi'an may be heartbroken for now, but she will understand Your Majesty's good intentions in the future."

"It is also my neglect of her, my lack of guidance, that has allowed her to develop the Empress's temper. After all, she is my daughter. I must pull her back, but I do not know if she will make me proud."

"Has Your Majesty decided on Princess Yi'an's marriage?"

The Emperor nodded solemnly, saying no more.

Princess Yi'an was too covetous of power. All the Emperor could do was arrange a marriage for her far from the center of power, ensuring her a lifetime of safety, smooth sailing, and leisurely wealth.

---

When the Emperor's decree reached the separate courtyard, the expressions of those present were equally varied.

As shrewd as Sun Qianran was, she immediately understood that this was a strategy to counter Princess Yi'an.

Though this move could repel the enemy, it also came at a cost.

Princess Yi'an must hate him deeply... Not just him. Sun Qianran thought of the hatred Princess Yi'an had shown toward Yu Wan that day, and her gaze unconsciously shifted to Yu Wan.

She was a noble-born but petty person. Unable to touch Zhao Xuanyou, she could easily vent her anger on a maid.

In the imperial villa, Princess Yi'an, as the mistress, could easily find fault and accuse Yu Wan of disrespect, and have her beaten to death on the spot without anyone daring to say a word.

Yu Wan, however, was unaware of these thoughts. She simply thought Zhao Xuanyou had received another great reward.

Seeing Sun Qianran looking at her with a strange expression, she felt inexplicably confused and simply gave Sun Qianran a polite smile.

After following Zhao Xuanyou into the house, Yu Wan curiously asked, "Master, today's decree must be a great fortune, right?"

"Indeed."

Zhao Xuanyou had originally asked tentatively, not expecting the Emperor to agree so readily. It had surprised him.

But surprise aside, as long as he didn't have to marry Princess Yi'an, anything was acceptable. He could even teach Zhao Qi for a lifetime.

"Slave wishes Young Master good fortune."

Seeing Yu Wan's smiling face, Zhao Xuanyou's lips curved slightly.

He should indeed celebrate, not just for himself, but for Yu Wan as well.

If he had truly married that one, how could he have tolerated Yu Wan's presence?

Yu Wan, unaware of his thoughts, served fragrant tea before withdrawing.

In the courtyard, Sun Qianran was lounging on a bamboo cooling chair, sunbathing.

The chair was positioned perfectly. Sun Qianran lay there with her shoulders hidden in the shade, only her body exposed to the sunlight.

Noticing Yu Wan coming out of the house, her gaze involuntarily lingered on Yu Wan again.

"Madame Pei."

Thinking that she had been staring at her, perhaps with something to say, Yu Wan approached and curtsied.

"Has slave gotten something on her face?"

Sun Qianran realized she had been staring too much, which was impolite. She apologized, "No, nothing. It's just that every time I see you, I want to ask about your calligraphy practice. Last time, I told you to use scrap paper for writing, but I myself have never used it. I was afraid I might have led you astray."

"That method is quite good, especially economical and convenient," Yu Wan said gratefully to Sun Qianran. "Yesterday, slave dipped ink and wrote for Master to see. He said slave wrote well and even rewarded slave with a calligraphy copybook."

"Whose calligraphy copybook?"

"Zhao Meng..."

"Zhao Mengfu?"

"Yes," Yu Wan said somewhat embarrassedly. "Please forgive slave's ignorance, but slave doesn't recognize that character."

"His characters are rounded and forceful. I also practiced his works when I was young."

"In that case, slave will practice diligently." Seeing that Sun Qianran had no more to say, Yu Wan said, "Madame Pei, slave will go to the kitchen to work now."

"Go ahead." Sun Qianran watched Yu Wan's relaxed expression, and as soon as the words left her mouth, she couldn't bear it anymore and called out again, "Yu Wan."

"Does Madame have any other orders?"

After a moment of hesitation, Sun Qianran softly said, "You... should be more cautious in your actions in the imperial villa from now on."

---

chapters.title: Daytime Indulgence
chapters.content:
Be cautious in her actions?

Had she done something to offend Sun Qianran?

Probably not. She had always been respectful to the Pei couple. How could she have offended her?

Yu Wan looked at Sun Qianran inquiringly. Seeing that she had no intention of saying more, Yu Wan, as a maid, could only comply, "Thank you for your guidance, Madame. Slave will be more careful in the future."

---

Meanwhile, in her palace, Princess Yi'an was deep in thought.

The Emperor's formal decree to include the Jingyuan Marquis's residence in the imperial genealogy meant she and Zhao Xuanyou were completely incompatible.

At the family banquet that day, when the Emperor mentioned this, Princess Yi'an hadn't reacted in time. Now, having calmed down, she saw the truth.

Being recorded in the imperial genealogy of the Ministry of Clan Affairs, apart from being a distant relative of the imperial family, brought no substantial benefits.

Why would Father Emperor, who favored Zhao Xuanyou, bestow such a useless title?

The only explanation was that the reward was not for Zhao Xuanyou, but aimed at her.

This move was precisely to sever any possibility between her and Zhao Xuanyou.

Father Emperor would not do this without reason. Someone must have specifically mentioned it to him.

Zhao Xuanyou...

Princess Yi'an had initially taken a fancy to him not because he was foolish, but because she found him intelligent, highly skilled in martial arts, and capable, ensuring he would hold a high position in the court in the future.

Such an intelligent man, after several interactions with her, could not fail to understand her intentions.

He did not want to marry her!

At this thought, Princess Yi'an was almost enraged.

He did not want to marry her, but only wanted to be lovey-dovey with that lowly concubine maid.

This was truly unbearable for Princess Yi'an.

She could not let them get away with this.

But she could not act personally.

Princess Yinings's marriage had already been decided. As the elder sister, her marriage would be arranged before Princess Yinings's.

At this critical juncture, she could not act recklessly.

If only someone could act on her behalf... Princess Yi'an clenched her fists, and in her anger, suddenly thought of someone in the imperial villa who, like her, hated Zhao Xuanyou and despised that lowly concubine.

Moreover, that person held far more power than her. If he were willing to act, he could certainly accomplish it.

Princess Yi'an suddenly stood up.

"Princess, please calm down." The palace maid, knowing Princess Yi'an's thoughts, saw her strong reaction. After sitting and sulking for a long time, she suddenly stood up, fearing she might go to Mingde Hall to cause a scene. She hurriedly advised, "The decree has been issued. This matter is already settled. Princess, please do not act impulsively."

"Rest assured, I am not going to see Father Emperor." Princess Yi'an's eyes held a trace of strange smile.

"Then where does the Princess intend to go?"

Princess Yi'an answered evasively, coldly glancing at her, "What about the Western Region grapes sent by the Imperial Household Department today?"

"They have been ordered to be washed and are currently being chilled with ice wheels. If the Princess wishes to eat them, this slave will present them immediately."

"There's no need to present them. Find a unique basket to pack them nicely. I want to visit the Crown Prince at Chonghua Hall. He loves Western Region grapes, and the ones allocated to him by the Imperial Household Department might not be enough."

The palace maid did not know what she was planning. She wanted to advise her not to act impulsively, as the Crown Prince had a bad temper. If she provoked him, she would only end up upset.

But Princess Yi'an had made up her mind. The palace maid dared not say more and could only go to fetch the grapes.

Princess Yi'an walked out of the palace with a cheerful face, lightly swinging her round fan. She soon arrived at Chonghua Hall and ordered the attendants to announce her.

Before long, someone from inside led her in.

The Crown Prince was currently reviewing memorials.

The Emperor had come to the Lichuan Imperial Villa to cultivate his mind and body. Memorials sent from the capital were first reviewed and marked by the Crown Prince before the Emperor would casually look them over.

"What wind brings you here?" The Crown Prince, hearing the footsteps, did not lift his head or stop writing with the vermilion brush.

Yi'an bowed to him.

"Early this morning, the Imperial Household Department sent Western Region grapes. Knowing that Elder Brother Crown Prince loves to eat them, I specially brought some to Chonghua Hall."

The Crown Prince indifferently said, "Keep them for yourself."

Although he indeed loved Western Region grapes, as the Crown Prince, how could he be pleased by a bunch of grapes and be controlled by others?

"Since I've brought them, I don't want to carry them back."

Seeing that she was unwilling to leave, the Crown Prince put down the vermilion brush, his eyes darkening.

"I warned you long ago that Father Emperor would not favor this marriage. You and Zhao Xuanyou are impossible. Back then, I would not help you, and now that the decree has been issued, neither I nor the Empress can help you."

Princess Yi'an listened to these cold words, feeling bitterness in her heart, but the smile on her face grew even wider.

"Does Elder Brother Crown Prince think I came here for that matter? I was indeed a little sad during the family banquet that day, but I know the die is cast. Being sad won't change anything, and I no longer care."

No longer cared?

The Crown Prince knew his sister's temperament well. Without a reason, she would never come to Chonghua Hall to make a fool of herself.

Princess Yi'an let out a light sigh, looking quite helpless. "Actually, the words of advice Elder Brother Crown Prince gave me that day, I have taken them to heart. It's just that at the time, I was too stubborn and afraid of losing face in front of you, so I wouldn't admit it."

"Really taken them to heart?"

She had seemed completely unresponsive that day.

"Of course. Otherwise, how could I be smiling here in front of Elder Brother Crown Prince?" Princess Yi'an said. "These past few days, I've thought a lot. Zhao Xuanyou dotes on that concubine maid Yu Wan so much that it's clear he still can't forget Yichu. Even if he reluctantly became my husband, I'm afraid his heart would still be entirely on that maid."

As Princess Yi'an spoke, she carefully observed the Crown Prince's expression.

Sure enough, at the mention of Yu Wan's name, the Crown Prince's eyes clearly flickered.

"He dotes on Yu Wan very much?"

Yu Wan?

Did he know that stinking girl? He called her name so affectionately.

Princess Yi'an suppressed her displeasure and pretended to be sad. "Of course. That day, Zhao Xuanyou escorted me and Yinings to Cangxi Town. On the way back, we encountered Yu Wan. He, without regard for royal decorum, had her ride on the horse with him in full view of everyone, returning to the imperial villa together with us."

"On the day you went to Cangxi Town?" the Crown Prince asked.

"Yes, I remember Elder Brother Crown Prince was there that day too. That day, Zhao Xuanyou was supposed to escort Yinings and me, but Seventh Brother took Yu Wan along as well. That Yu Wan truly has some fox-like charm. Even a troublemaker like Seventh Brother is completely tamed by her, even taking her out in plain clothes."

The Crown Prince had indeed seen her with Zhao Qi's guards outside the theater that day.

"She does have some skill."

Seeing that the Crown Prince was already swayed, Princess Yi'an added fuel to the fire. "Actually, that's not the worst. What truly made me give up hope was something my close palace maid discovered."

The Crown Prince glanced at her indifferently. "What did she find out?"

Princess Yi'an lowered her gaze, feigning difficulty in speaking.

But before the Crown Prince could ask, she softly said, "I heard that Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan live together with others in the separate courtyard. They don't know how to restrain themselves and often, in broad daylight, close the door to do that kind of thing. People outside can hear everything clearly."

This, of course, was a lie.

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan had always behaved properly in the imperial villa, never indulging in daytime affairs.

But if Princess Yi'an didn't say this, how could she make the Crown Prince frown?

"They are so bold?"

Princess Yi'an said, "Zhao Xuanyou, unable to win Yichu's heart or body, probably vents all his frustrations on Yu Wan. To be honest, just looking at Yu Wan's face makes me feel sick. I wonder if Zhao Xuanyou, while holding her, calls out Yichu's name."

chapters.title: Provoking Him to Act
chapters.content:
If the previous words had barely elicited a reaction from the Crown Prince, this statement made Princess Yi’an clearly sense his expression darken.

She knew the Crown Prince had been moved, so she pretended not to notice his reaction and continued speaking.

"In my opinion, Zhao XuanYou is really something. If he likes YiChu’s appearance so much, why did he divorce her? And if he wanted a divorce, why did he have to find a maid who looks like YiChu and shower her with favor? Isn’t this just humiliating YiChu?"

"How does his humiliation of YiChu concern you?" the Crown Prince said coldly.

Princess Yi’an met his indifferent gaze and sighed deeply. "I used to not like YiChu much. I always felt that as my study companion, she was better than me in every way, which made me uncomfortable. It’s no wonder you misunderstood me, Crown Prince Brother. When YiChu was banished from the palace by the Empress, I wasn’t sad; I even felt a bit pleased. But later, without her company, and having to exchange barbs with YiNing every day, I began to miss her kindness."

The Crown Prince, upon hearing this, no longer looked at Yi’an. He simply stared at the memorials on his desk, lost in thought.

Yi’an secretly rejoiced.

Sure enough, the Crown Prince had been indifferent when YiChu left, but now that she was truly gone, he began to miss her.

After all, YiChu’s beauty far surpassed that of the current Crown Princess.

"Seeing Zhao XuanYou with that concubine makes me truly indignant for YiChu. That Yu Wan is clearly just a stand-in. After the divorce, YiChu never left her home, yet this woman flaunts herself in LiChuan, and I’ve even heard she attends classes with the Seventh Prince. Crown Prince Brother, isn’t it ridiculous? A mere concubine maid actually attends Master Pei Tuo’s lectures. It seems she’s determined to become YiChu; not just in appearance, but even in talent."

"YiChu’s talent is not something she can simply imitate. Her quatrain about snow is still praised by scholars to this day."

"Of course, I don’t think she can truly compare, but Zhao XuanYou might not see it that way. To be honest, Crown Prince Brother, seeing this impostor trying to mimic YiChu makes me so angry I could tear her apart." Princess Yi’an grew more agitated as she spoke, her eyes nearly red with fury by the end.

The Crown Prince glanced at her, and Yi’an quickly composed herself, lowering her gaze slightly.

"Today, I lost my temper and came to ZhongHua Hall to rant. It’s just that Zhao XuanYou and Yu Wan, that despicable pair, have gone too far. I couldn’t bear it anymore and had to speak out. Since it concerns YiChu, the only person in the entire palace I can say these things to is you, Crown Prince Brother."

The Crown Prince’s expression returned to its usual cold arrogance, but this time, he did not mock Princess Yi’an. Instead, he nodded and said, "Zhao XuanYou is indeed despicable. If he truly disliked YiChu, that would be one thing, but to keep a maid who looks like her by his side is going too far."

"It’s just that he’s currently in the Emperor’s favor. Apart from the Emperor, I’m afraid no one else dares to offend him. For now, there’s nothing we can do about him."

"What is he? I certainly don’t hold him in high regard. It’s just not worth the trouble."

The Crown Prince pressed his thin lips together.

Even as the Crown Prince, he wasn’t exactly afraid of Zhao XuanYou.

If he truly wanted to deal with him, he had ways, but his primary target was Prince Ping. It wouldn’t be worth causing such a commotion over a mere official like Zhao XuanYou.

"It was a moment of impulsiveness, and I misspoke," Princess Yi’an said, seeing that her provocation had worked. "The Emperor still favors him, so it’s best not to act for now. However, that impostor Yu Wan can be dealt with first, to vent YiChu’s grievances."

After finishing her words, Princess Yi’an cautiously glanced at the Crown Prince, but he remained silent, and she couldn’t tell what he was thinking.

She had said all she needed to say. Saying more would only seem excessive.

So, Yi’an let out a long sigh and smiled at the Crown Prince. "I came here in a fluster and said so much. Now, I finally feel better."

The Crown Prince lightly hummed in response.

"The Crown Prince is busy with state affairs. Yi’an takes her leave." She curtsied to the Crown Prince before respectfully retreating.

After Yi’an left, the Crown Prince remained seated, no longer reviewing the memorials.

A hot breeze blew through the window gauze, cooled by the ice basin in the room, turning into a gentle cool wind.

After a long while, the Crown Prince suddenly spoke in a low voice.

"Wen Huo."

The window moved slightly, and a gray shadow drifted in from outside, kneeling before the Crown Prince.

This was his personally trained assassin, who obeyed no one’s orders but his, not even the Emperor’s or the Empress’s.

Before the Crown Prince’s eyes appeared the graceful figure he had encountered at the theater entrance that day.

Her features did resemble YiChu’s, but for some reason, he could clearly remember her appearance and demeanor.

Did Zhao XuanYou really see her as a replacement for YiChu?

The Crown Prince’s eyes darkened. Regardless, he could not let Zhao XuanYou have everything his way.

---

Since she started practicing calligraphy, Yu Wan’s days had become even busier.

Every morning, after helping Zhao XuanYou dress and dine, she would go to the kitchen to prepare pastries and sweet soups for Zhao Qi. Once Zhao Qi arrived to start his horse stance practice, she would not just stand by idly. Instead, she would practice calligraphy in the courtyard with grass paper dipped in water.

The calligraphy manual Zhao XuanYou had given her; she copied one page every day, and each page required ten or more sheets.

As a result, the grass paper didn’t have time to dry.

Fortunately, grass paper was worthless in the summer palace. When the eunuch in charge of the separate courtyard heard she needed some, he sent her a thick stack, more than she could ever use.

Zhao Qi practiced his horse stance for two hours, and Yu Wan practiced calligraphy for two hours.

At first, Zhao Qi had been disdainful of Yu Wan’s calligraphy practice, thinking this maid was always coming up with new ideas; first wanting to attend classes, then practicing calligraphy, as if she really considered herself a scholar.

But after half a month, though Yu Wan still hadn’t captured the essence of Zhao MengFu’s style, her characters had become neater, and occasionally, a stroke would carry a sharp edge.

Zhao Qi still mocked her verbally, but deep down, he was rather impressed with Yu Wan.

After nearly a month of practicing the horse stance, he was starting to feel a little weary.

Practicing calligraphy was just as tedious as the horse stance, yet Yu Wan practiced with great enthusiasm every day, which also rejuvenated Zhao Qi’s spirit.

Seeing his perseverance, Zhao XuanYou agreed to spar with him for a few moves each day.

That day, Pei Tuo, considering that Zhao Qi had attended classes for over ten consecutive days and had written decent essays, granted him a half-day off.

Zhao Qi then pestered Zhao XuanYou until he agreed to let him take Yu Wan out for some fun.

Zhao XuanYou, thinking that Yu Wan did indeed work hard every day, softened and agreed to Zhao Qi’s request.

As soon as they left the summer palace, Zhao Qi bolted out like a wild horse. But after running a short distance, he turned back.

"I almost forgot. You can’t ride a horse!"

Yu Wan nodded. "Your Highness, you should go and have fun by yourself."

Being cooped up in the small courtyard every day was indeed stifling, but since Yu Wan couldn’t ride, she couldn’t go out with Zhao Qi.

Zhao Qi frowned, then suddenly had an idea. "The hunting grounds are empty today. Let’s just go there; I’ll teach you how to ride."

Yu Wan had only mild interest in going out, but at the mention of learning to ride, her spirits lifted.

"Wouldn’t that trouble Your Highness?" She was just a maid. How could she impose on Zhao Qi?

"Not at all. It’s not like I’m teaching you," Zhao Qi said nonchalantly.

"Then who will teach me?"

"The eunuchs at the hunting grounds are excellent horsemen. They can pick a gentle old horse for you. You’ll learn in no time."

Having known Yu Wan for over a month, Zhao Qi was aware that she was clever and strong. Riding would not be difficult for her.

"Thank you, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi led the way to the hunting grounds on horseback. Soon after, Yin Ping arrived with a carriage to take Yu Wan there.

But shortly after their departure, a gray shadow drifted out from the wall of the summer palace, following them.

---

chapters.title: Kidnapping Yu Wan
chapters.content:
The hunting grounds were not far from the summer palace; just a narrow valley away.

Yu Wan had kept the carriage curtains lifted, watching as the carriage passed through the narrow valley entrance. In the next moment, her vision opened up, revealing a vast expanse of lush green grassland.

So this was the royal hunting grounds.

Yu Wan’s eyes were opened once again, and she couldn’t help but lean out to take it all in.

The grass in the hunting grounds was meticulously maintained, without a single weed, resembling a giant green carpet.

No wonder the summer retreat palace was built in LiChuan; it truly was a treasure trove.

Before long, the carriage came to a stop. Yu Wan stepped out, but Zhao Qi had already disappeared, having led his guards deeper into the hunting grounds to chase game.

"Are you Yu Wan?"

As soon as her feet touched the ground, a handsome eunuch approached her.

He looked to be in his early twenties, tall and sturdy, clearly a trained man.

"Yes, I am Yu Wan. May I ask your name?" After staying in the separate courtyard for over a month, Yu Wan had learned how to interact with the palace staff.

"Just call me Xiao Linzi. His Highness ordered me to teach you riding today, so let’s not stand on ceremony. Come in and pick a horse and change clothes."

Yu Wan knew about picking a horse; Zhao Qi had said she needed a gentle old one.

But change clothes...?

"What kind of clothes?"

"This dress is beautiful, but the sleeves and skirt are too long. If you could already ride, it wouldn’t matter, but since you can’t, this outfit would be troublesome. The stable has riding attire for women. You can change into one."

This was the royal hunting grounds. The riding attire here must have been prepared for princesses and concubines.

Recalling Sun QianRan’s warning to be cautious, Yu Wan asked, "Would it be against the rules for me to wear them?"

Seeing her caution, Xiao Linzi smiled. "Don’t worry. We wouldn’t dare let you wear the mistresses’ clothes."

Yin Ping, hearing this, feared that Yu Wan would take too long choosing clothes and then a horse, so he said, "Yu Wan, you should go with Xiao Linzi to change first. I’ll go to the stable to see if there’s a suitable horse for you."

"Thank you for the trouble."

Yin Ping was a master even Zhao XuanYou acknowledged. The horse he picked would certainly be better than anything Yu Wan could choose herself.

Xiao Linzi led Yu Wan into the stable area, turning left after entering the gate, while Yin Ping went right toward the stables.

After passing the first two main halls, Xiao Linzi pointed to a side room. "This room is full of riding attire for palace maids. They’re all wearable. Go in and pick one you like to change into."

The nobles enjoyed bringing their servants along when riding, forming large groups to chase game, so attire was prepared for the maids as well.

"Thank you."

Yu Wan pushed the door open and entered, while Xiao Linzi waited outside.

Though he was a eunuch, Yu Wan still left the door slightly ajar as she prepared to change.

The room was filled with riding outfits, red, green, pink, white, all looking brand new.

Yu Wan didn’t dare pick anything too flashy, so she chose a simple apricot-colored set.

Just as she was about to change, she suddenly heard a faint creak from the door.

She thought it might be Xiao Linzi coming in, so she turned toward the door, but it remained closed.

Had she imagined it?

It shouldn’t be. The sound had been very soft, but Yu Wan was sure she had heard it.

"Xiao Linzi?" Yu Wan called out.

No one answered from outside.

Yu Wan’s heart began to race. She felt as if some danger was approaching.

She looked around the room. There was nothing but clothes; nothing she could use to defend herself.

Yu Wan hung the apricot riding outfit back up and, turning her back, pulled the jade hairpin from her hair, gripping it in her hand. She raised her voice and called again, "Xiao Linzi?"

"I’m here. Didn’t you find a dress you like?"

Hearing Xiao Linzi’s voice, the huge rock weighing on Yu Wan’s heart finally fell.

She let out a soft sigh and reinserted the hairpin into her hair.

"Nothing’s wrong. I’ll be done changing soon."

Yu Wan reached for the clothes again, but before she could touch them, a gray shadow descended from the beam above, appearing behind her.

A strange fragrance filled the air. Instinctively, Yu Wan tried to cover her nose and mouth, but a rough, calloused hand clamped around her throat.

The next moment, Yu Wan lost consciousness.

---

Yin Ping had circled the stable once and selected an older mare, leading her to the edge of the training grounds.

Not seeing Yu Wan or Xiao Linzi, Yin Ping thought to himself that women were troublesome; even picking a riding outfit took this long. It was just learning to ride, not performing equestrian skills. As long as it fit, it should be fine.

But then, a girl as pretty as Yu Wan would naturally enjoy dressing up.

Yin Ping waited patiently at the edge of the field for a while longer. Feeling that too much time had passed, he tied the horse’s reins to the railing and hurried toward the changing area.

Before he arrived, he ran into Xiao Linzi, who was rushing over in a panic.

Yin Ping immediately became alert.

"Where is Yu Wan?"

Xiao Linzi was completely confused. "She was clearly inside, talking to me just now. She said she’d be done changing soon. I waited and waited outside, but she never came out. When I went in to check, guess what? There was no one inside..."

Before Xiao Linzi could finish, Yin Ping pushed him aside and dashed toward the changing room.

Just as Xiao Linzi had said, the room was empty, surrounded by rows of colorful riding outfits.

The clothes were all neatly hung, and the floor was spotless, as if no one had ever been there.

Something was wrong...

A faint scent lingered in the air. Yin Ping took a deep breath and felt his head grow slightly dizzy.

A sedative?

But the scent was too faint. The wind blowing in from the doorway quickly dispersed it.

"See? There’s really no one here. Who knows where Yu Wan went. She shouldn’t be running around the hunting grounds."

Xiao Linzi still had no idea what had happened and continued to chatter.

"After Yu Wan entered the room, where were you?" Yin Ping asked coldly.

"Me?" Xiao Linzi looked bewildered. "I was waiting outside, wasn’t I?"

"Waiting the whole time?"

"Of course."

"Didn’t leave at all?"

"No."

"Impossible."

Hearing Yin Ping’s decisive tone, Xiao Linzi scratched his chin. "Well, I did go next door for a sip of water."

Yin Ping looked around. Apart from the main door, all the windows were tightly shut. One window, however, was unlatched.

He looked up at the beam above, then suddenly leapt up, carefully inspecting it. He found a spot free of dust.

This was it. The kidnapper had been hiding here before abducting Yu Wan.

Yu Wan’s decision to learn riding had been a last-minute idea from Zhao XuanYou just a quarter of an hour ago. The kidnapper couldn’t have predicted her actions and ambushed her here. He must have followed them to the hunting grounds, slipped in when Xiao Linzi left the doorway, drugged Yu Wan, and taken her out through the window.

Who was he? And why did he take Yu Wan?

And how... was he supposed to explain this to Zhao XuanYou?

chapters.title: Who Would Kidnap Her?
chapters.content:
When Yu Yuan regained consciousness, everything before her was a hazy gray.

Was she... dead again?

Her mouth was gagged, her eyes blindfolded. Her entire body felt weak and sore, and her head was as heavy as if it were filled with a stone. The only thing she could sense was a faint, sweet fragrance at the tip of her nose.

The scent was wonderfully pleasant; subtly sweet, yet neither floral nor fruity. Just a whiff of it seemed to restore some of her strength.

Instinctively, she took a deep breath, and indeed, her mind cleared a little.

Driven by the will to survive, she tried to stand up, but her strength failed her, and she collapsed heavily; only to land on soft bedding, as if falling into cotton. It didn’t hurt at all.

Had she been tied to a couch?

The memories before she passed out flashed through her mind. She was certain that the person had been standing behind her, using some kind of knockout drug.

Was that person... a lecher?

Though she couldn’t see, Yu Yuan could feel the fine, soft satin of the bedding against her cheeks. It seemed even softer and more delicate than Zhao Xuanyou’s.

How could someone who used such precious materials kidnap her?

Yu Yuan’s heart was filled with anxious speculation. She desperately tried to calm herself. Don’t be afraid. She had died once before, and if heaven had given her a second chance at life, how could she die so easily?

Moreover, her mother was still waiting for her. She had to live. She must live!

At the thought of her mother, Yu Yuan’s resolve suddenly firmed, and she regained some composure.

Since the kidnapper hadn’t killed her immediately but instead tied her up and left her here, it was clear they had some other motive. For now, her life was not in immediate danger.

But she was just a maidservant. What could they possibly want from her?

The image of Cui Yichu flashed through her mind. The person who wanted to capture her the most in this world was Cui Yichu.

But...

It probably wasn’t her.

Yu Yuan had spent some time in Cui Yichu’s room, and the fragrance lingering around her now was not the kind Cui Yichu usually used.

Moreover, if Cui Yichu had sent someone to capture her, they wouldn’t have left her tied up on a couch.

Yu Yuan was extremely reluctant to admit it, but deep down, she knew that the person who would tie her up and leave her on a couch was likely a man.

The fear of the unknown was always the most terrifying. At this moment, Yu Yuan was even more nervous than when she had first been reborn.

By now, had Yin Ping and Xiao Linzi discovered her disappearance? Xiao Linzi had no connection to her and wouldn’t care about her life or death. But Yin Ping, under Zhao Qi’s orders, had been with her and should be concerned about her whereabouts.

She didn’t know how long she had been unconscious. Did Zhao Xuanyou know about this? Would he try to save her?

He did have some affection for her, but how much of it was genuine and how much was just physical desire? Yu Yuan didn’t dare to assume.

If she had gotten into trouble outside, he might have sent someone to look for her.

But Yu Yuan had been kidnapped inside the royal hunting grounds. Would Zhao Xuanyou cause a commotion among the nobles for a mere maidservant?

After serving Zhao Xuanyou for so long, Yu Yuan knew his temperament well.

He was a man of both literary and martial arts, with a deep and calculating mind. He knew how to conduct himself properly before the emperor, neither too humble nor too arrogant, which was why he had earned the emperor’s favor.

He was a man who knew his limits.

He would never make a scene in the imperial palace to search for her. In short, it wasn’t worth risking his future for a maidservant.

At the moment, Yu Yuan’s only hope lay with Zhao Qi.

He was a prince. If he cared about her disappearance, the people at the hunting grounds should give an explanation.

But Zhao Qi had only known her for a month, and his affection for her was even fainter than Zhao Xuanyou’s. How long his interest in investigating would last was uncertain.

As Yu Yuan was lost in these tangled thoughts, she suddenly heard footsteps approaching from afar.

Her heart... leapt into her throat.

---

“What did you say? She’s gone?”

Zhao Xuanyou stood in the courtyard, listening to Yin Ping’s account before frowning. “She’s disappeared?”

Yin Ping nodded with difficulty. “Yes, Miss Yu Yuan is missing.”

“How can a living person just disappear?” Zhao Xuanyou’s tone was calm, showing no emotion, but every word made Yin Ping feel increasingly tense. “You’re a martial artist. You should understand that if she’s alive, we must find her, and if she’s dead, we must find her body.”

“Lord Zhao.” Yin Ping cupped his hands toward Zhao Xuanyou. “It was my incompetence that led to Miss Yu Yuan’s disappearance.”

The commotion in the courtyard had drawn the attention of the Pei couple inside the main house.

Pei Ta, holding Sun Qianran’s hand, walked out. Upon hearing Yin Ping’s words, his expression turned grave.

“What happened? Yu Yuan is missing?” Pei Ta asked. “Wasn’t she with the Seventh Prince? Could there have been assassins?”

Yin Ping, feeling guilty, didn’t hide the truth, knowing that the Pei couple had always been kind to Yu Yuan. “The prince was not assassinated. After leaving the palace, the prince saw that Yu Yuan couldn’t ride a horse, so he ordered me to take her to the stables to have a eunuch teach her. While I was at the stables picking a horse, Xiao Linzi took Yu Yuan to change into riding clothes...”

“She disappeared while changing clothes?” Zhao Xuanyou suddenly interrupted.

Yin Ping was slightly taken aback. He hadn’t expected Zhao Xuanyou to guess so accurately. Ashamed, he lowered his head.

If something had happened to Yu Yuan, he was to blame.

Neither Xiao Linzi nor Yu Yuan knew martial arts. They hadn’t noticed someone following them.

If he had gone with Yu Yuan and stood guard at the door, she wouldn’t have been in danger.

“Lord Zhao is correct. Xiao Linzi was waiting outside for Yu Yuan to change. In the middle, he went to get a drink of water. When he returned, he spoke to Yu Yuan for a moment. He thought she was still changing inside, but after waiting and waiting, she never came out. That’s when he realized something was wrong.”

“Did you investigate how it was done?” Zhao Xuanyou asked.

“I did. While Xiao Linzi was away, someone sneaked into the room and hid on the beam. Their qinggong must be extraordinary. Yu Yuan didn’t notice before being knocked out and taken away through the window.”

Zhao Xuanyou listened thoughtfully but said nothing.

Yin Ping cupped his hands toward Zhao Xuanyou. “Lord Zhao, rest assured. I have already pledged my military honor to the prince. I will definitely find Yu Yuan. Right now, the prince is also having the hunting grounds searched.”

“There’s no need to search.” Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

Yin Ping looked at him in shock, unable to believe his words. “N-no... not search?”

Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly. “She’s just a maidservant. Making such a big fuss to find her might actually be to her detriment. Go back to the hunting grounds and bring the prince back.”

“But...”

“There’s no but,” Zhao Xuanyou interrupted Yin Ping calmly. “Tell the prince that if he wants Yu Yuan to come back alive, he should pretend that nothing happened today.”

“I understand.” Yin Ping didn’t truly understand Zhao Xuanyou’s intentions, but since Zhao Xuanyou was Yu Yuan’s master, he had to obey.

He cupped his hands toward Zhao Xuanyou and the Pei couple, then lowered his head and left.

Pei Ta, standing beside them, looked at Zhao Xuanyou and asked tentatively, “Lord Zhao, with such arrangements, you must have some leads, right?”

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t even furrow his brow. His gaze swept past Pei Ta and settled firmly on Sun Qianran.

“I don’t have any leads, but I think Madam Pei already does.”

---

chapters.title: Three Zhuges
chapters.content:
Upon hearing this, Pei Ta first looked at Zhao Xuanyou in shock, then turned to Sun Qianran.

A gentle breeze blew through the courtyard, but the atmosphere was tense.

After a moment of hesitation, he didn’t ask Sun Qianran. Instead, he stepped in front of her, looking at Zhao Xuanyou with slight vigilance.

“Lord Zhao, we are also very concerned about Miss Yu Yuan’s disappearance. But what do you mean by this? Do you think my wife is involved in this matter?”

“Of course not.” Zhao Xuanyou looked directly at Sun Qianran. “I know Madam Pei has always been kind to Yu Yuan. It’s just that when you two came out of the house, I could see that Lord Pei had just learned of this, but Madam Pei already knew.”

“Lord Zhao, if you’ve already told the Seventh Prince not to search for Miss Yu Yuan, why must you pressure an unrelated person like this?”

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression didn’t change. He only said in a deep voice, “This is an urgent matter. I’m not pressuring Madam Pei. I only hope she will share what she knows.”

Sun Qianran placed her hand on Pei Ta’s arm and gave him a slight nod.

Pei Ta understood. He signaled to Xiang Xu, who immediately called all the Pei family servants out of the courtyard. Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhi, seeing this, also retreated outside, closing the courtyard gate behind them.

“Madam, do you really know something?”

Sun Qianran shook her head. “I truly had no idea about today’s kidnapping. However... something happened before that made me worry Yu Yuan might be in danger.”

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, his eyes fixed intently on Sun Qianran.

“Princess Yi’an once came to my courtyard to deliver ginseng, saying it was a gift from Her Majesty the Empress. I accepted the ginseng and expressed my gratitude, but the princess lingered and wouldn’t leave. Instead, she brought up Yu Yuan.”

“Princess Yi’an mentioned Yu Yuan?” Pei Ta was quite surprised.

He was well aware of Princess Yi’an’s interest in Zhao Xuanyou. But their failed engagement was due to Zhao Xuanyou’s unwillingness. It was absurd that a princess would involve a mere maidservant like Yu Yuan in this.

“Yes. When the princess mentioned Yu Yuan, her emotions were unstable, and she spoke poorly of her.”

It made some sense that Princess Yi’an would vent her anger on Yu Yuan because of Zhao Xuanyou.

But Sun Qianran had nothing to do with this. Why would Princess Yi’an confide in her?

They weren’t even friends.

“Why would she speak ill of Yu Yuan in front of you?”

Sun Qianran gave a faint smile, looking at Pei Ta’s unparalleled handsome face, a slight bitterness rising in her heart.

“She knew that Yu Yuan accompanies the Seventh Prince to his lessons every day. She wanted to provoke my jealousy, to make me think that Yu Yuan was deliberately seducing my husband, and to force me to take action against her.”

“What?” Pei Ta couldn’t help but laugh.

He found the idea that Yu Yuan was deliberately seducing him ridiculous, and the notion that Princess Yi’an thought Sun Qianran would act against Yu Yuan because of it even more absurd.

As the couple spoke, Zhao Xuanyou fell into deep thought beside them.

Sun Qianran’s mention of Princess Yi’an didn’t surprise him.

But there were many doubts in her words.

After a moment, Zhao Xuanyou slowly asked, “If she wanted to provoke Madam Pei into acting against Yu Yuan, it means that, given her character, she wouldn’t act directly against Yu Yuan herself.”

Sun Qianran nodded in approval. “That’s right. Although Princess Yi’an is the most favored in the palace, she is not the empress’s daughter. She is cautious by nature. With her marriage still undecided, she would never act recklessly.”

“So she provoked someone else?” Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes.

Pei Ta listened to their conversation, deep in thought. “This person is also in Liaochuan and has some connection to Yu Yuan. Princess Yi’an provoked them, convincing them to act against Yu Yuan?”

Yes, that was it...

Sun Qianran’s eyes flickered slightly. She continued in a low voice, “This person’s status is far above mine. If I were to act against Yu Yuan, I could only do so within this small courtyard. I certainly wouldn’t have the ability to act in the hunting grounds.”

In other words, the people staying on the other side of the creek didn’t have the means to kidnap someone in the hunting grounds.

Pei Ta thought for a moment, then shook his head firmly. “Among the people staying on the other side of the stream, the only one connected to Yu Yuan is the Seventh Prince. But he wouldn’t be the one to act.”

That was true.

Sun Qianran frowned slightly. Her peripheral vision suddenly caught Zhao Xuanyou, whose eyes were deep in thought, his brows tightly knitted, as if he had just realized something.

Kidnapping Yu Yuan didn’t necessarily mean killing her. Maybe there was another motive.

What could it be?

Yu Yuan was young and beautiful, but beauty wasn’t that valuable to the people in the palace.

A maidservant certainly didn’t have any wealth.

The only thing Yu Yuan had that was valuable... was Zhao Xuanyou’s favor.

Sun Qianran suddenly realized, “Actually... that person may not have any connection to Yu Yuan at all. Maybe... they’re connected to Lord Zhao?”

As soon as she said this, the veins on Zhao Xuanyou’s forehead twitched violently.

He cupped his hands toward the Pei couple and bowed.

“Thank you both.”

With that, he pushed open the courtyard gate and strode out.

---

“Awake?”

The arrogant voice was even colder than Zhao Xuanyou’s.

So it was a man.

Yu Yuan’s anxiety was mixed with a glimmer of hope.

If he really wanted her for her beauty, then at least she had a chance to survive.

She had already given herself to Zhao Xuanyou. She was no longer a virgin. If he wanted her body, she would do her best to please him, to win his favor, and maybe he would spare her life.

She only wanted to survive and return to her mother.

Yu Yuan’s mouth was gagged, so she couldn’t speak. She only nodded desperately.

In the deadly silence, a hand grasped her slender waist and pulled her up.

Even though she had resolved to use her beauty to save her life, Yu Yuan’s body still trembled violently.

The man, of course, noticed her trembling. He let out a cold laugh.

“Scared?”

His voice seemed to come from the heavens, carrying a sense of condescending arrogance. The casualness in his tone made Yu Yuan even more afraid.

She knew that in his eyes, killing her was no different from crushing an ant.

She nodded heavily.

The man looked at her reaction and let out a cold snort.

Before Yu Yuan could react, he used his finger to remove the silk cloth covering her eyes.

By now, it was night. A bronze branch lamp, shaped like a flowering tree, lit up the room brightly.

The man before her wore a plain red brocade robe, exuding an air of nobility.

His features were gentle and refined, but his eyes were cold and indifferent. At the moment, he was staring at her intently.

Yu Yuan had seen this face before. That day at the theater entrance in Cangxi Town, he had looked at her just like this, making her feel uncomfortable all over.

While blindfolded, Yu Yuan had many guesses about her kidnapper. Now that she saw him with her own eyes, her heart still sank heavily.

It was the Crown Prince who had kidnapped her!

The Crown Prince had sent someone to kidnap her in the hunting grounds.

She could count on her fingers the two people who might save her: Zhao Qi and Zhao Xuanyou. But even combined, their influence was not enough to resist the man before her.

Even if they had a conscience and wanted to save her, they would be powerless to do so.

She was doomed.

chapters.title: Enchanting Beauty
chapters.content:
Yu Ying glanced at the Crown Prince, then quickly lowered her head, not daring to meet his gaze.

He seemed quite pleased with her reaction. After a moment of hesitation, he slowly said, "I can let you speak, but you must not say anything improper. Do you understand?"

Understand? Of course Yu Ying understood.

There were silent experts around him who could abduct people without a sound. Not to mention speaking, Yu Ying didn’t even dare to move her eyes.

She kept her gaze lowered and nodded slightly.

The Crown Prince extended a finger, gently pulling out the wad of cloth stuffed in her mouth and tossing it to the ground. It turned out to be an exquisitely embroidered handkerchief.

Yu Ying couldn’t help but take a deep breath.

The faint, refreshing fragrance filled her nose, clearing her mind. She took several deep breaths in succession.

Seeing her actions, he twitched the corner of his lips and asked indifferently, "Does it smell good?"

Yu Ying still didn’t dare to meet his gaze, fearing her behavior might invite disaster. She also didn’t dare to breathe deeply again, only nodding.

"Too afraid to speak?" His voice carried little emotion, making it hard to discern his mood.

Recalling her experience serving Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Ying decided to tell the truth.

"It smells very good."

The Crown Prince gave a slight nod. "This is dragon’s saliva incense. Apart from my Chonghua Hall, only the Mingde Hall uses it."

Chonghua Hall?

So she was in Chonghua Hall.

If that was the case, she had been abducted and was only a stream away from Zhao Xuanyou. Yet, that small stream, which could be crossed barefoot, seemed like an impassable abyss, blocking her path back.

"So that’s how it is."

The Crown Prince’s gaze swept over Yu Ying uninhibitedly. Because Yu Ying was shrinking back like a startled bird, he felt somewhat displeased and coldly ordered, "Lift your head."

Yu Ying stiffly raised her face.

The Crown Prince was still unsatisfied. He reached out, pinching her chin, and forcibly lifted her face.

Her features did indeed bear some resemblance to Yichu, but their temperaments were vastly different. She was timid and shrinking, far from refined.

"Are you very afraid of me?"

"Your Highness is too noble. This servant is indeed... indeed somewhat terrified."

"Smile." The Crown Prince said expressionlessly.

Yu Ying’s hands trembled slightly. Fearing she might shake too much, she tightly clenched her hands together.

She looked at the Crown Prince and forced the gentlest smile she could manage, softly calling, "Your Highness."

The candles in the hall burned brightly, illuminating Yu Ying’s beautiful and delicate face. Her skin appeared even more flawless, her graceful and alluring figure more captivating. With a slight curve of her eyebrows, she looked as enchanting as a blooming peony.

The Crown Prince had only glanced at her casually, but upon seeing this smile, the hand pinching her chin froze in mid-air.

He must have misjudged her.

This little girl could serve as Yichu’s stand-in precisely because she had her own captivating charm. No wonder Zhao Xuanyou liked her.

Yu Ying looked at the supremely noble man before her, feeling her heart beat rapidly.

Her life was in his hands. If this smile failed to satisfy him, tonight would bode ill for her.

"You need not be afraid." The Crown Prince said, releasing her chin.

Yu Ying saw him sitting motionless by the couch, as if deep in thought. She didn’t dare to speak, only kneeling on the couch.

After a long while, there was a knock at the door. It sounded like a eunuch speaking.

"Your Highness, the Crown Princess has ordered the imperial kitchen to prepare crab meat buns and invites Your Highness to taste them."

The Crown Prince’s eyes quickly darkened. He said in a low voice, "Who would eat crab at this time of year? What do you think?"

Yu Ying saw that he was addressing her and could only softly agree, "Crab should be eaten in autumn when they are the fattest and most delicious."

"Look at that, even a maid from the Marquis’s residence knows this, yet the Crown Princess doesn’t."

Yu Ying said, "This servant has only heard about it. I’ve never eaten crab meat buns. Perhaps crab in summer also has its own unique flavor when made into buns."

The Crown Prince silently watched Yu Ying. Suddenly, he raised his hand and lightly brushed her lips.

"Indeed, you have a clever and pleasing mouth."

But as soon as the words left his mouth, the Crown Prince’s expression made Yu Ying’s heart clench.

If speaking to please him was the goal, why did he seem even angrier?

Fortunately, he didn’t say anything to Yu Ying. He simply stood up, took a few steps forward, and then said to Yu Ying, "Stay here obediently."

"Yes."

Watching the Crown Prince walk around the purple sandalwood carved screen, Yu Ying finally let out a sigh of relief. The delayed fear made her feel weak, and she collapsed back onto the couch.

Her hands and feet were bound. Apart from shouting, there was nothing else she could do.

But how could she shout?

She wasn’t someone from Chonghua Hall. If she shouted in the Crown Prince’s bedchamber, she would likely be taken for an assassin and killed on the spot.

The Crown Prince didn’t seem like he would kill her.

This was good news. She had to calm down and engage with him, seeking a way to survive.

Yu Ying lay on the couch, quietly gazing at the magnificent and exquisite canopy above her. The surrounding thin curtains hung long, and perhaps due to the burning dragon’s saliva incense in the hall, she felt her mind becoming clearer. All her scattered thoughts surged forth.

Cui Yichu had always used the fact that she had climbed into his bed to threaten and use her. If he knew that she had now even climbed into the Crown Prince’s bed, she wondered what expression he would have.

At this thought, Yu Ying smiled somewhat helplessly.

Even in such a situation, she still had the mood to joke.

At the moment, she seemed to be out of immediate danger, but in reality, her life hung by a thread.

If he had brought her here for his pleasure, what would happen after he was done with her? She was neither a concubine nor someone sent to Chonghua Hall for his favor. She had been silently abducted.

Once the Crown Prince was done with her, once he grew tired of her, he would silently discard her.

She, a little maid who had seen the Crown Prince’s dark side, would certainly not be left alive.

In that case, the idea she had upon waking, using her beauty to seduce him to preserve her life, would not work at all.

Once he had her, he would lose all interest in her.

No matter what the Crown Prince’s true intentions were in abducting her, taking the initiative to seduce him was not a good strategy.

Yu Ying stared at the intricate embroidery on the canopy, waiting quietly for a while before she finally heard footsteps again. It sounded like several people.

She struggled to sit up from the couch and looked over nervously, only to see the Crown Prince walking at the front with a detached expression, followed by two small eunuchs carrying trays.

The aroma of the food wafted over with their steps.

Yu Ying’s stomach let out a soft growl. Only then did she realize she was ravenously hungry.

She had no idea how long she had been unconscious...

The Crown Prince remained silent as the two eunuchs placed the bowls and dishes from the trays onto the table. They seemed not to notice Yu Ying at all and silently retreated.

"You lay down again?" the Crown Prince asked.

Earlier, he had ordered Yu Ying to smile, and now, when Yu Ying spoke to him again, she tried her best to be as respectful and attentive as she usually was when serving Zhao Xuanyou.

"Your Highness, forgive this servant. My hands and feet are a bit sore, so I lazily lay down."

The Crown Prince was indeed very pleased with this attitude.

He gave Yu Ying a deep glance and slowly said, "I can untie you, but you must behave. Do you understand?"

---

chapters.title: Eat You?
chapters.content:
"I understand, Your Highness. I won’t make you angry."

Yu Ying did her best to act normally, and this ordinary demeanor indeed softened the Crown Prince’s expression slightly.

He reached out and pulled Yu Ying into his embrace, personally untying the bonds on her wrists. He glanced at the ropes on her feet and said indifferently, "Untie them yourself."

"Yes." Yu Ying’s wrists had been tied with hemp rope for a long time, and now that they were untied, the red marks left by the rope were visible.

Yu Ying endured the stinging pain and quickly untied the ropes around her ankles.

Seeing the Crown Prince silently watching her, she asked softly, "May this servant serve you your meal, Your Highness?"

The Crown Prince was somewhat surprised by Yu Ying’s thoughtfulness but also very pleased.

"Do you usually serve Zhao Xuanyou like this?"

Yu Ying heard the strange tone in his voice when he mentioned Zhao Xuanyou. She suddenly thought, maybe he had kidnapped her not because she looked like Cui Yichu, but because of Zhao Xuanyou.

Did he dislike Zhao Xuanyou?

Why?

He had cuckolded Zhao Xuanyou, so why would he dislike Zhao Xuanyou?

"Your Highness jokes. This servant is just a maid. I only know how to serve my master and have no other skills."

Thinking of the earlier unpleasant encounter with the Crown Princess, the Crown Prince knitted his brows and said in a displeased tone, "Being able to do one’s duty is already a considerable skill."

"Thank you for your kindness, Your Highness."

Yu Ying bowed to the Crown Prince.

The Crown Prince frowned. "I didn’t reward you. What are you thanking me for?"

"This servant is of lowly status. To receive praise from Your Highness is an honor sufficient for a lifetime. Naturally, I must express my gratitude."

No one in the world disliked flattery. Even if they knew it wasn’t sincere, as long as the flattery struck the right chord, it would bring comfort to the heart and mind.

Moreover, the person flattering him had a face as beautiful as a hibiscus. Listening to her flattery was both pleasing to the ear and the eye.

The Crown Prince pretended not to care and said, "Sit down and eat something."

"This servant? This servant can sit and eat?" Yu Ying looked at the Crown Prince uneasily, her large, watery eyes appearing particularly pitiful.

"Do I need to say it a second time?"

"Yes." Yu Ying quickly sat down beside him.

"You’ve been unconscious for a day and a half. You must be starving. Eat quickly."

So she had been unconscious for more than a day...

"Thank you, Your Highness."

Yu Ying picked up her chopsticks. Noticing the wine cup and flask beside her, she put down the chopsticks, poured wine for the Crown Prince, and then picked up her bowl again.

The Crown Prince sat silently beside her, coldly taking the wine cup and sipping before putting it down.

The table was laden with a variety of dishes: fragrant and soft meat porridge, cold chicken shreds in chili oil, steamed fresh fish, crispy goose pieces, several refreshing side dishes, and a plate of crab meat buns.

Yu Ying first took a sip of the porridge and found that it contained not only diced pork but also a faint medicinal flavor. She didn’t know what precious medicine was added, but it smelled very comforting.

Hungry as she was, facing the table full of delicacies, her eyes couldn’t help but reveal a hint of longing.

She suddenly remembered Zhao Xuanyou’s usual words: porridge and vegetables weren’t filling; a martial artist must eat more meat.

Having gone without food for so long, Yu Ying’s strength was nearly depleted.

She deliberately avoided the meat porridge and bamboo shoots she usually liked, focusing instead on the meat dishes. Only when she had eaten most of them did she try a crab meat bun.

"Is it good?" the Crown Prince, who had been silently watching, asked.

Yu Ying quickly put down her chopsticks, swallowed the bun in a hurry, and cautiously said, "It’s delicious."

"Earlier, you said that crabs are fattest and best in autumn."

Ah, so the crab was a gift from the Crown Princess.

Yu Ying said, "For Your Highness, it naturally isn’t good enough. But for this servant, it’s already the finest delicacy I’ve ever had in my life."

"Aren’t you afraid of choking from eating so much meat?"

"This servant has been rude." Yu Ying said timidly.

Yu Ying’s red lips were stained with oil.

If it were someone else in this state, the Crown Prince would certainly find it disgusting and rude. But at this moment, he was calm, taking out his own handkerchief from his sleeve and handing it to Yu Ying.

"Wipe your mouth."

Yu Ying had no handkerchief of her own. Hearing his order, she didn’t hesitate, taking the handkerchief to wipe her mouth.

Under the Crown Prince’s scrutinizing gaze, Yu Ying grew nervous.

Night had deepened; it was time to rest.

Chonghua Hall was where the Crown Prince and Crown Princess rested. This room belonged to the Crown Prince, so the other room naturally belonged to the Crown Princess.

Tonight, the Crown Princess had ordered the imperial kitchen to prepare a midnight snack and invited the Crown Prince to taste the crab meat buns.

The Crown Prince had not stayed overnight at the Crown Princess’s place, clearly intending to stay in this room.

Watching Yu Ying’s uneasy expression, the Crown Prince felt a slight amusement in his heart.

Initially, when he heard Yian’s suggestion, he had indeed found Zhao Xuanyou detestable and immediately ordered someone to kidnap Yu Ying.

Originally, he had intended to kill this imposter to anger Zhao Xuanyou and avenge Yichu. But recalling the glance he had caught of her at the theater entrance, he suddenly changed his mind and had her brought here.

He just wanted to see for himself how much this girl resembled Yichu, enough to enchant Zhao Xuanyou so thoroughly.

When he saw Yu Ying tonight, he felt they looked similar, yet not quite.

Cui Yichu was cold and aloof. Even after their secret affair, she still carried a hint of pride when interacting with him. Such a woman made him feel a desire to conquer.

Yu Ying was different.

She was a maid, maintaining an extremely low posture, obedient in every way, with just the right amount of admiration in her eyes.

Cui Yichu was like the icy water in a cold pool; mysterious and deep blue, tempting to touch, but once touched, the curiosity would vanish.

Yu Ying, however, was like the hot water in a hot spring pool, making one unable to resist immersing in it, washing away all fatigue.

The Crown Prince suddenly realized that the Crown Princess was like a wooden block; neither beautiful nor interesting. The few beauties in the Eastern Palace were all chosen by the Empress Dowager. Beautiful they might be, but they were dull.

He... was in need of a clever and considerate woman like Yu Ying by his side.

That boy Zhao Xuanyou sure knew how to pick them.

Yu Ying nervously clutched the handkerchief in her hand, not daring to return it to the Crown Prince, only holding onto it herself.

Feeling the heat in the Crown Prince’s gaze, Yu Ying felt as if she were sitting on pins and needles.

"Your Highness, this servant... this servant..."

"Hmm?" The Crown Prince leaned a bit closer, lowering his voice to ask, "You should know how to serve a man, right?"

It had come to this, as expected.

Yu Ying tried her best to look surprised: "Your Highness means... this servant doesn’t dare."

The Crown Prince’s brows were already tinged with coldness, but his words were ambiguous.

"Afraid I’ll eat you?"

"My servant is of lowly birth, raised working in the fields. My hands are calloused. I am too coarse to serve Your Highness."

"Oh?" The Crown Prince, upon hearing this, took one of Yu Ying’s hands, gently rubbing her palm and the pads of her fingers, quickly feeling the thin calluses on her fingertips and knuckles.

The beauties in the Eastern Palace all had fingers as slender as spring onions, fair and tender. The Crown Prince had indeed never held a hand like this.

Under normal circumstances, he would have found it disgusting and thrown it away. But at this moment, the candlelight illuminated Yu Ying’s stunning face, making her cheeks appear as white as snow, her eyes full of charm.

Her face alone was captivating enough. Coupled with her full and ample figure, it was even more alluring.

Even with calluses on her fingertips, in his eyes, it added a different kind of appeal.

"Yu Ying..."

"Zhao Zun! Zhao Zun!"

Just as the Crown Prince was deeply immersed, the voice he least wanted to hear suddenly came from outside the room.

chapters.title: The Important Person
chapters.content:
"Seventh Prince, you must not make a noise in Chonghua Hall!" the eunuch outside reprimanded.

Yu Ying, of course, recognized that it was Zhao Qi's voice. A wave of joy surged in her heart, but she knew this was not the time to celebrate. She did not dare show the slightest hint of joy, only timidly glancing at the Crown Prince.

"Zhao Zun! Come out here!"

Accompanied by Zhao Qi's shouts, the noise outside grew louder and louder.

The Crown Prince's eyes darkened further, and he slammed his clenched fist heavily on the table.

"Your Highness, please calm down," Yu Ying said softly.

"Zhao Qi might have come for you. You must be very happy."

Yu Ying bit her lip and whispered, "This servant is just a maid. No matter where I serve, the work is the same."

These words were quite pleasing to the Crown Prince, and his expression softened slightly.

"I will go out and take a look. You stay here."

"Yes."

Yu Ying watched as the Crown Prince strode out, her body trembling uncontrollably.

Although both Zhao Zun and Zhao Qi were sons of the Emperor, Zhao Zun was the Crown Prince, the heir to the throne. In front of him, Zhao Qi was a subject. For a subject to loudly disturb the heir at his door was an act of insubordination.

Could Zhao Qi really rescue her?

When the Crown Prince arrived at Chonghua Hall, Zhao Qi had already barged onto the steps and was recklessly trying to rush into the hall, only to be blocked by the guards and eunuchs.

"Zhao Qi! Stop this insolence!"

Upon seeing the Crown Prince emerge, Zhao Qi's face changed to a smile. He slowly said to Zhao Qi, "Brother, I have been waiting at the door for so long, and only now do you come out to meet me. You have truly hurt my feelings."

Before the Crown Prince came out, Zhao Qi had been shouting his name loudly. Now, facing him directly, Zhao Qi's attitude had improved significantly.

"What are you shouting about at Chonghua Hall?" the Crown Prince asked with a dark gaze, knowing that Zhao Qi had come for Yu Ying but not believing Zhao Qi would dare to be so bold here. "I am the Crown Prince. Addressing me directly by my name is a serious crime."

"You are indeed the Crown Prince. But Father always says that family need not stand on ceremony. If a younger brother calls your name a few times and it is considered a crime, how will your reputation as a virtuous Crown Prince fare when this spreads?"

Listening to Zhao Qi's shameless words, the Crown Prince's expression worsened.

The Emperor had always doted on Zhao Qi, and that doting was the source of Zhao Qi's reckless confidence.

"You forced your way into Chonghua Hall. What do you intend to do?"

"Brother, do not speak nonsense. I did not force my way in. I am still standing on the steps. How can that be forcing my way in?"

"If there is nothing, then leave at once." The Crown Prince said impatiently.

"Brother, please wait." Zhao Qi shook off the guard's hand and walked up to the Crown Prince, bowing respectfully. "Brother, I came to disturb you so late at night because I have no choice. I need your help."

"Hmph," the Crown Prince sneered. "You always go to Father for whatever you want. Why come to me?"

Zhao Qi smiled. "I should indeed ask Father, but Father has summoned Consort Qin to his chambers tonight. She has already entered Mingde Hall. How can I disturb them? This is an urgent matter, so I came to you first, Brother. If you refuse, I will go to Father first thing in the morning."

"What is it exactly?" the Crown Prince asked, emphasizing each word.

He could guess that Zhao Qi's sudden appearance was related to Yu Ying. And since Zhao Qi kept mentioning the Emperor, he truly wanted to know what trick Zhao Qi was playing.

"It's like this, Brother. As you know, I have been learning martial arts from Minister Zhao of the Jingyuan Marquis's residence. Yesterday, I went horseback riding at the hunting grounds, and a maid from the Marquis's residence followed to attend to me. But she mysteriously disappeared at the hunting grounds. I sent people to search all day but couldn't find her. Brother, you command the Feathered Forest Guard. Could you send a few dozen men to help me search again?"

As expected, it was about Yu Ying.

The Crown Prince's expression did not change. He said indifferently, "She is just a maid from the Marquis's residence. It's not worth making such a fuss."

"Yu Ying is indeed just a maid, but she was under my care. Whether she is alive or dead, I must give the Jingyuan Marquis's residence an explanation."

"You are a prince. If the Jingyuan Marquis's residence knows what's good for them, they won't dare ask you for any explanation."

The royal family was the ruler, and the Marquis's residence was the subject. The Crown Prince was well aware that as long as Zhao Qi did not stir up trouble, Zhao Xuanyou would not dare to look for her. She was just a maid. Would he dare to cause a disturbance at the imperial palace?

"So... Brother, you mean you won't help?"

"It's late at night. Do not make any more noise and disturb Father and Mother. You cannot afford that."

"Yes." To everyone's surprise, Zhao Qi respectfully agreed.

The Crown Prince was somewhat surprised by his reaction but did not say anything. He turned and walked back into the hall.

Zhao Qi on the steps also turned around and muttered, "Forget it. I will go to Father in the morning. He always says he wants me to be a responsible person. He will surely agree."

Although his voice was not loud, the night was quiet, and every word reached the Crown Prince's ears, making him frown.

The Crown Prince subtly turned his head and saw Zhao Qi walking straight towards his and Zhao Yu's bedchamber. A hint of worry arose in his heart.

The Emperor had always indulged Zhao Qi. Who knew if he would really send men to help Zhao Qi search for the person tomorrow.

Tempering one's skills was one thing, but even the best martial arts would leave traces. The people the Emperor had trained were not idle. They might be able to find out.

The Crown Prince entered the palace chamber with a dark expression. The Crown Princess Consort, who had already lain down, put on her clothes and came out, concerned. "Your Highness, what happened? Why was Seventh Brother making a noise outside?"

"He always acts recklessly. There is no need to make a big deal out of it."

With that, the Crown Prince strode into the inner hall.

Yu Ying was restless in the room. After the Crown Prince went out, Zhao Qi did not make any more noise, and she could not hear any movement outside.

Seeing the Crown Prince enter with a dark face, she quickly stood up and greeted him, "Your Highness."

The Crown Prince sat down without a word, his gaze steadily fixed on Yu Ying.

Tonight was supposed to be a night of passion, but it had been ruined by that bastard Zhao Qi.

Under his scrutiny, Yu Ying did not dare to avoid his gaze. She only eagerly poured him a cup of wine.

The Crown Prince's reaction made her understand that Zhao Qi had been dismissed by him.

She feared she could not escape tonight.

"This servant will attend to Your Highness's rest," Yu Ying tentatively said, stepping forward to support the Crown Prince.

As soon as her hand touched his arm, he grabbed Yu Ying's hand.

"Your Highness, spare my life. It was this servant... who was presumptuous."

"I am not blaming you." The Crown Prince quietly watched Yu Ying. Compared to the unease and fear when she first woke up, she now looked much more at ease, with a lively and spirited demeanor between her brows. "Let me ask you, are you willing to stay by my side and serve me?"

"This servant is naturally willing."

"Why?"

Yu Ying slightly lowered her head, avoiding his gaze. "Will Your Highness laugh at this servant if I tell the truth?"

"Speak honestly."

Hearing the Crown Prince's response, Yu Ying seemed to have gained some encouragement. She gathered her courage and said, "Your Highness is the Crown Prince. Your status alone is unmatched by anyone. Your Highness... Your Highness is handsome and distinguished. Not to mention this servant, but any woman in the world would be willing to serve by Your Highness's side. What's more, this servant is just a maid."

The Crown Prince knitted his brows and examined Yu Ying. After a moment, he lifted his chin and softly called, "Wen Ji."

---

chapters.title: Ambush
chapters.content:
Yu Ying did not know whom he was calling. But when she heard the sound of the window moving, she instinctively shivered.

Soon, a gray shadow floated in and knelt before the Crown Prince.

Yu Ying's heart beat wildly.

It was this person who had kidnapped her after knocking her unconscious at the hunting ground that day.

Was the Crown Prince dissatisfied with her previous answer? Did he call this person in to kill her and dump her body in the wilderness?

No!

She did not want to die! She could not die yet.

The Crown Prince was about to speak when he caught sight of Yu Ying trembling beside him out of the corner of his eye. He gently patted her hand with a tender expression.

"Your Highness, this servant only..."

Overwhelmed by intense fear, Yu Ying's eyes were filled with tears, like a startled deer.

Her eyes were already beautiful, and looking at the Crown Prince with such a watery gaze naturally aroused his pity. Disregarding the person kneeling in the room, he pulled her into his embrace.

"Do not be afraid. I only asked him to take you somewhere else."

"Somewhere else?" Yu Ying asked, then carefully added, "What about Your Highness?"

The Crown Prince, who had always been indifferent, curved his lips slightly. "I will leave the palace in a few days to attend to some matters. Wen Ji will take you there first. It won't be long."

"Mmm." Yu Ying nodded obediently, trying to calm herself down as her thoughts gradually cleared.

Sending her away tonight was actually a good thing.

The Crown Prince was likely a heartless man.

Cui Yichu had been his childhood sweetheart, yet he had abandoned her after obtaining her.

At the moment, he had some desire for her. For a man like him, he would not let go until he had gotten what he wanted.

"This servant will obey Your Highness in everything."

The Crown Prince's hand lightly held Yu Ying's slender waist, which seemed ready to snap, and he simply could not let go.

But Zhao Qi was looking for Yu Ying, and Zhao Xuanyou might be looking for her too. They did not dare to search Chonghua Hall, but the Emperor would.

Keeping Yu Ying in Chonghua Hall was too dangerous.

"Take her away." The Crown Prince finally made up his mind.

While the Feathered Forest Guard patrolling the palace tonight were still his men, he had to send Yu Ying away.

"Yes." The gray shadow kneeling on the ground responded softly.

Yu Ying finally broke free from his embrace but looked at him with tears in her eyes, reluctantly. She bowed to him.

"Be gentle. Do not hurt her."

"Yes."

As soon as the gray shadow finished speaking, Yu Ying suddenly felt a heavy poke on her back, which hurt terribly. She wanted to cry out in pain but could not make a sound.

While she was wondering what had happened, she suddenly felt the world spin, and she was hoisted into the air.

Yu Ying instinctively wanted to scream, but she was as mute as a dumb person, making no sound. She felt the wind rushing past her ears as the person flew through the air with her.

The wind howled in her ears. When Yu Ying came to her senses, she had already left the palace and was riding on a horse with the gray shadow.

The horse's galloping made Yu Ying feel her occiput hit something hard, causing her head to ache. She turned her head with difficulty and saw that the gray shadow looked gray all over not only because he was wearing gray clothes but also because he wore a gray mask.

"You... your name is Wen Ji?" Yu Ying asked.

The other person did not want to talk to Yu Ying, not even a simple "mm."

Yu Ying, seeing this, did not give up and asked again, "Yesterday at the hunting ground, was it you who kidnapped me?"

The other person still did not speak.

Yu Ying had no choice but to say, "It's fine if you don't speak. Anyway, when I see His Highness the Crown Prince again, I will say you molested me on the horse!"

"I was only following orders."

Hearing him speak, Yu Ying slightly relaxed.

The Crown Prince said he would leave the palace to attend to some matters but did not say where he was going.

Yu Ying had to find a way to know where they were going so she could send a message to Zhao Xuanyou.

The night was as thick as ink.

Yu Ying was jostled terribly.

The last time she rode a horse, she had shared the ride with Zhao Xuanyou. She did not know why, but the horse that day had felt particularly steady, unlike tonight, which jolted her so much that her internal organs seemed to be in chaos.

"So you admit that you kidnapped me?"

"Following orders." The gray shadow still said indifferently.

Yu Ying did not dare to ask him directly where they were going. She carefully guessed, "Are you His Highness's secret guard?"

Having stayed in the palace for a long time, Yu Ying had heard a lot of gossip from the palace servants. For example, important figures in the palace all had secret guards hidden around them to protect their safety.

"I only follow orders."

No matter how she asked, it was the same answer. It seemed difficult to get anything out of him tonight.

After some thought, Yu Ying decided to ask something that did not involve the Crown Prince to lower his guard.
