"Just now, you poked my back in Chonghua Hall, and I couldn't speak. What was that about?"

"I pressed your mute acupoint."

"Mute acupoint? There is such an acupoint?"

As soon as Yu Ying finished speaking, she felt the person behind her take a heavy breath. It was obvious that he regretted lifting her mute acupoint after leaving the palace.

"Why... why are you wearing a mask?" Yu Ying asked again.

The other person remained silent.

Yu Ying chattered on, "Is it because all secret guards have to wear masks, or is it because you are ugly?"

As soon as she finished speaking, Yu Ying clearly felt the hand holding her arm tighten.

Had she actually guessed right? Was he really ugly?

Yu Ying did not feel any joy at having guessed correctly. At a time like this, offending him would clearly lead to her own suffering.

While she was hesitating over what to say next to make amends, the horse suddenly let out a miserable neigh. The man behind her grabbed her shoulder like an eagle's claw and lifted her into the air.

"Ah…" Yu Ying screamed in fright as she was lifted into the air with him and then set back down.

When she stood steady, she saw that the horse they had been riding had been shot by an arrow at some point and was lying on the ground, whinnying in pain.

An attack?

No, a rescue?

Yu Ying suddenly felt her eyes well up with tears. She looked around but saw only a pitch-black night.

The man beside her picked Yu Ying up again and quickly ran toward a mountain not far away.

The mountain was densely covered with trees. As long as he took Yu Ying and hid in there, it would be difficult for others to find them with his lightness skills.

Yu Ying had never known that a person could run so fast.

As they got closer and closer to the forest, the despair in Yu Ying's heart grew stronger and stronger.

Zhao Xuanyou's arrow had already arrived, and his men should not be far away. But once they entered the forest, how would he find her?

Amid her racing thoughts, the gray shadow carried her into the forest and hid their figures in a tree seven or eight zhang high.

Hearing the heavy breathing behind the mask, much heavier than when they were on the horse, Yu Ying guessed that carrying a living person and running all the way had probably exhausted him.

After a moment's thought, Yu Ying looked at the gray mask and softly said, "How about you let me go now?"

chapters.title: Sharing a Ride
chapters.content:
The other party remained silent, but the gaze behind the mask was somewhat chilling.

Yu Wan did not wait for his answer, but saw a short sword appear in his hand.

She was startled.

No matter what, she had to preserve her life.

"His Highness did not order you to kill me. Since you are acting on his command, you cannot harm my life." As she spoke, the faint sound of horse hooves approached.

It must be the person who shot the arrow earlier.

Yu Wan managed to steady her mind slightly. Without time to deliberate further, she said to the gray shadow, "Even if your martial arts are strong, you can't escape with me from their hands. It would be better for you to leave me here. They will have to stop to rescue me, which will buy you time to escape."

The eyes behind the mask flickered noticeably, clearly surprised.

Yu Wan, on the other hand, was much calmer.

Indeed, even ants strive to survive; a death-defying warrior would not want to die needlessly.

"You are ambushed now. If you don't escape, you will perish here. Why not run first and find another chance to capture me later?" Yu Wan paused, then softly persuaded, "Zhao Xuanyou kills mercilessly on the battlefield. He is ruthless. If you fall into his hands, you will surely suffer."

"Do you think I'm afraid?"

"Not being afraid of death is one thing, but there's no need to die unnecessarily." Yu Wan's words came from the heart. Of course, it wasn't just for the gray shadow's sake; it was more to remind herself to live well. "Both you and I are servants. In the eyes of those masters, we are as insignificant as weeds. They don't care about our lives, but we do."

As the sound of horse hooves grew louder, Yu Wan's heart tightened.

As the saying goes, a cornered dog will jump over a wall. When he was surrounded, who knew if he would take her as a hostage?

If she could persuade him to escape quickly, Yu Wan would be in less danger.

"You should leave quickly. As long as the green mountain remains, there will be no shortage of firewood."

As soon as she finished speaking, the gaze behind the mask clearly trembled.

While Yu Wan was thinking about what else she could say to persuade him, she suddenly felt a gray shadow flicker before her eyes. The person who had been crouching on the tree trunk a moment ago had disappeared.

She only heard the sound of leaves rustling in the forest, but when she looked up, she saw nothing.

He had really left.

Yu Wan's chest heaved slightly, feeling a sense of relief after a narrow escape. However, the sound of horse hooves became clearer, and she still did not dare to relax her vigilance.

She tightly grasped the branch beside her, pressing herself closer to the tree trunk, and instinctively concealed her figure. If the pursuers were not Zhao Xuanyou, she had to hide herself well.

After a moment, seven or eight horses galloped into the forest.

The moonlight was still bright, but it was the height of summer, and the trees were lush with branches and leaves, shading the forest pitch black.

Yu Wan looked carefully and saw one person with a tall and straight figure, very familiar. Even on horseback, his broad shoulders and narrow waist were evident. Suddenly, her eyes welled up with tears.

"Worldly Son!" Yu Wan tightly grabbed the branch and shouted loudly at the man.

She was extremely familiar with Zhao Xuanyou's figure; she couldn't be mistaken.

He had actually brought people to rescue her!

Seeing that the person under the tree did not react, as if they hadn't heard her.

"Worldly Son! Zhao Xuanyou! Zhao Xuanyou! I am Yu Wan, I am here!"

As Yu Wan exerted all her strength to shout at the people below, she suddenly felt a gust of wind, and a dark figure stood beside her.

Before she could speak, he reached out and pulled her up.

Feeling the familiar aura from him, joy and surprise simultaneously surged in Yu Wan's heart.

She had finally survived.

She had finally found a way to live.

Tears welled up in her eyes as the strength in her body gradually dissipated, and she softly collapsed into his arms.

The night wind was strong, blowing their robes wildly.

Zhao Xuanyou listened to her sobs mixed with the wind, holding her tightly. He felt a mix of heartache and anger, his gaze darker than ever.

Zhao Zun...

The old hatred had not been resolved, and now a heavy new grudge had been added.

When Cui Yichu was involved with him, she had not yet been connected to Zhao Xuanyou. Later, when she married into the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion, it was not his doing either.

But he knew that Yu Wan was his personal maid and still wanted to take her away, which was clearly an act of humiliation against him.

If a scholar can endure this, what cannot be endured?

Yu Wan, still in shock, threw herself into Zhao Xuanyou's arms, feeling his emotions also fluctuating.

She did not speak, only silently leaned on his shoulder.

After a long time, Zhao Xuanyou finally asked in his usual calm voice, "Are you alright?"

"I'm fine, this servant is fine."

Zhao Xuanyou slightly loosened his hold on her and saw that she was still wearing the same clothes she had on when she left the courtyard the day before, confirming that she was unharmed.

"What were you shouting about in the tree earlier?"

"Ah?" Yu Wan saw that he was starting to hold her accountable, and a smile appeared at the corner of her lips. She looked at him ingratiatingly, "This servant was in a moment of urgency, afraid that Master would not hear my voice, so I... called out Master's name directly."

This was the first time Zhao Xuanyou had heard her call his name.

It was against the rules, but for some reason, it sounded quite pleasant to him, and he wanted to hear her call him that a few more times.

"You're getting bolder."

"This servant knows her mistake, Master should not mention it anymore."

Her slender and graceful figure was soft and warm in his arms.

"You didn't do anything wrong, so why admit a mistake?"

"Master is not angry?"

Zhao Xuanyou casually hummed in response, then said to Yu Wan, "Hold on tight, we're going down."

Yu Wan could only hold onto him, so she wrapped her arms around his shoulders as instructed. He lifted her up, and Yu Wan instinctively hooked her legs around the tree like a vine.

Zhao Xuanyou's Adam's apple moved, and he tightened his grip on her slender waist, taking her down from the tree in one leap and landing on the horse below.

Seeing that Yu Wan was safe and sound, the surrounding attendants all breathed a sigh of relief. However, the intimate actions of the two made the others look away, not daring to watch.

Among the seven people who had followed Zhao Xuanyou, only Yuan Zi was familiar; the rest were new faces.

"Where are they?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's inquiry, one of the unfamiliar men replied, "They have gone to pursue."

Pursue?

Just how many people had Zhao Xuanyou brought? Besides these in front of him, he could still spare people to chase after that gray shadow?

Yu Wan saw that Zhao Xuanyou's face was as dark as ink, afraid that he did not want her to ask too many questions.

"Let's go." With one command, Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Wan out of the forest on horseback.

The wind rustled in her ears, and Yu Wan nestled in Zhao Xuanyou's arms, preventing the wind from blowing into her neck.

The last time they rode a horse back to the traveling palace from Cangxi Town, her face was facing forward, and Zhao Xuanyou held her from behind.

This time, however, she was sitting facing him, which was a bit awkward, but it had to be said that riding like this was not as cold as the last time.

After a long while, Yu Wan softly asked, "Master, are we returning to the traveling palace?"

Zhao Xuanyou's brows were tightly knit.

Yu Wan had been targeted by Zhao Zun; she was no longer suitable to stay in the courtyard. According to the original plan, when they reached the next fork in the road, he would have his attendants take Yu Wan back to the capital overnight.

But with the two of them sitting so intimately on the horse, how could he bear to let go of her and send her away?

---

chapters.title: A Lecher
chapters.content:
"Mmm, back to the traveling palace." Zhao Xuanyou said through gritted teeth.

He would send her back to the capital after tonight...

Just one night...

"Oh." Yu Wan felt quite uneasy in her heart.

Zhao Zun had secretly captured her, and Zhao Xuanyou had secretly taken her away. After such an incident, could she still live peacefully in the courtyard?

Zhao Xuanyou said this, and Yu Wan had no doubts.

First, he was the master, and she was the maid. Second, life in the courtyard was like the Peach Blossom Spring described in books, with scenery like an immortal realm. She could read, write, and temporarily forget her status as a maid, doing things that only noble ladies could do... She was actually quite attached to it.

Once she returned to the capital, she would be reduced to her original status.

The horses galloped swiftly, and they were soon approaching the traveling palace. The six attendants, excluding Yuan Zi, went their separate ways.

Returning to the familiar small courtyard, the main house's lights were already out, with only a dim yellow lamp hanging under the eaves, swaying gently in the night breeze.

After Zhao Xuanyou brought Yu Wan inside, Yuan Qing rushed forward with a worried face. Seeing Yu Wan safe and sound following Zhao Xuanyou, he let out a long sigh of relief.

Knowing that someone was concerned about her safety, Yu Wan felt touched and gave Yuan Qing a grateful smile.

"You may leave. Remember to report to the Seventh Prince." Zhao Xuanyou said.

"Yes."

Yuan Qing and Yuan Zi respectfully retreated, leaving only Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan in the room.

Earlier, in the dark tree, she couldn't see clearly. Now, inside the house, she saw that Yu Wan's hair bun was half undone, with many strands of hair hanging down her forehead and temples. It was clear that she had not had an easy time during the day and a half she had been missing.

Zhao Xuanyou's anger resurfaced.

Yu Wan saw him staring at her hair and raised her hand to smooth it down slightly. The sleeves piled up and fell, revealing her fair arms.

"Master, this servant will go wash up first."

As she spoke, she turned and walked towards the inner room.

Zhao Xuanyou's breathing became heavier, and he reached up to remove the jade crown from his head, casually placing it on the table before following her.

The side room already had two buckets of water prepared, though it was a bit cool.

Fortunately, in the summer, slightly cooler water was not a problem.

Yu Wan undid her hair bun and was about to rinse it when the man approached her from behind.

"I'll help you."

His tone left no room for doubt as he grabbed Yu Wan's hand and pushed her against the wall.

Yu Wan leaned against the wall, her cheek pressing against the cold surface, but her heart felt a different kind of warmth.

After all she had been through, she was tired, exhausted, and a little scared.

Being by his side was indeed safer than anywhere else.

Yu Wan gently closed her eyes.

The floor of the inner room was soon soaked. After a long time, Zhao Xuanyou finally picked her up, wrapped in a towel, and carried her out.

When they returned to the bed, feeling that her hair was not completely dry, Yu Wan simply sat leaning against the wall.

Zhao Xuanyou lay on the other side of the bed and, seeing that she was still awake late at night, couldn't help but feel a pang of sympathy.

"Are you still afraid?"

"A little... this is what they call... lingering fear." Yu Wan said, letting out a long sigh.

Looking at her pitiful figure sitting alone against the wall, Zhao Xuanyou got up and sat beside her.

He was strong and healthy, and even in the middle of the night without a blanket, he was like a warm stove.

Yu Wan had just escaped a disaster, and with him by her side now, she greedily absorbed the warmth from his body.

"Thank you." Yu Wan said softly.

"You are my person. He dared to take you, so naturally I had to take you back."

Zhao Xuanyou said it lightly, but Yu Wan understood that tonight's matter was not easily accomplished.

Moreover, the crown prince himself had taken a fancy to a maid from a minister's family. If it were someone else, would they not have handed her over without hesitation?

"Master," Yu Wan looked up at him, "how did you know that this servant was taken by His Highness the Crown Prince?"

"It wasn't hard to figure out. After all, there are only a few lechers in the traveling palace."

A lecher?

Thinking of the way Zhao Zun had looked at her before she left Chonghua Hall, Zhao Xuanyou was not wronging him.

It was truly unexpected that the crown prince himself, upon seeing a woman by the roadside, would have the idea to kidnap her and take her into the palace for his own pleasure.

Everyone wanted to climb high and attach themselves to power, but such a vicious dragon, if one climbed onto him, would only meet a tragic end.

Cui Yichu was a living example.

Yu Wan wanted wealth and honor, but she wanted to live even more.

Thinking of Zhao Zun's lustful gaze, Yu Wan felt both fortunate to have escaped the tiger's den and uneasy about the future.

In this new life, she had originally only wanted to avenge Cui Yichu. Now, she had become entangled with Zhao Xuanyou and also with Zhao Zun.

A marquis's son was already extremely difficult to control, let alone the crown prince himself?

He had failed to get his hands on her this time. Would he really give up just like that?

Yu Wan was not overestimating her appeal to the crown prince. She had just coincidentally become involved in the struggle between the crown prince and Zhao Xuanyou.

The two of them were of high status and power. Even if one of them lost in the struggle, they would not suffer much.

But she was just a maid. Could she really come out of their struggle unscathed?

Cui Yichu had the vast Xingguo Duke's mansion to rely on, and yet she ended up divorced and sent home. What could she use to protect herself?

Zhao Xuanyou noticed her worried expression and reached out to pinch her cheek.

"What are you thinking about again?"

"Nothing," Yu Wan sighed softly, suppressing the thoughts she had just had. "This servant just didn't expect such a thing to happen to me."

Hearing her refer to herself as "this servant," Zhao Xuanyou's heart stirred, and he recalled the scene in the forest where she had loudly called out his name.

"Yu Wan."

"Hmm?" After a while, when she did not receive a response from Zhao Xuanyou, she asked, "Does Master have any orders?"

"When there are no others around in the future, you can... not be so formal."

Yu Wan looked at him in confusion, her tone a bit aggrieved. "What does Master mean? Don't wrongly accuse this servant. When have I not been formal?"

"Were you very formal in the forest?" Zhao Xuanyou countered.

Was he talking about her calling his name again?

Yu Wan was confused and, after thinking for a moment, looked at him tentatively. "Does Master mean that when there are no other people around in the future, this servant can call Master by your name directly?"

Zhao Xuanyou neither confirmed nor denied, just looking at her leisurely.

Yu Wan took the affirmation from his eyes and smiled. "If Master doesn't speak, then that's what you mean. Then in the future, I will call you that."

"You've done plenty of things without proper etiquette; one more won't hurt." Zhao Xuanyou lightly huffed.

Yu Wan giggled, hugged his arm, and gently shook it, calling out, "Zhao Xuanyou."

Her voice was very soft, and when it reached his ears, it tickled his heart.

"Zhao Xuanyou." Yu Wan repeated a bit louder, "Zhao Xuanyou, Zhao Xuanyou."

Hearing her call his name, Zhao Xuanyou's gaze burned intensely. Suddenly, he tightened his arm and kissed her cheek.

Yu Wan affectionately curled up next to him. In the dim, red silk mosquito net, the two of them whispered to each other. Although the canopy was dim, it was much more comfortable than the Crown Prince's gold and jade-filled Chonghua Hall.

chapters.title: Sour
chapters.content:
The two sat in each other's arms for a long time. Zhao Xuanyou noticed that Yu Wan's palm was slightly cold, so he pulled the brocade quilt to cover them both.

"I have to get up early tomorrow to teach the Seventh Prince, so let's sleep."

Zhao Xuanyou reached out and touched her long, dark hair that hung over her shoulders. "Your hair is already dry. You should sleep too."

Yu Wan sighed softly and said honestly, "This servant cannot sleep."

Perhaps it was because she had been in a deep slumber for too long after being drugged, and then she had gone through a harrowing night. Now, she had no sleepiness at all.

Zhao Xuanyou softly hummed in response, still holding her. After a moment of thought, he pulled the pillow over to cushion their backs.

"Are you not sleeping either, my lord?" Yu Wan looked up at him, her eyes and brows filled with tenderness.

Zhao Xuanyou suppressed the emotions in his eyes and asked softly, "Tell me about what happened yesterday?"

Perhaps speaking about it would make her feel better.

Being in his arms, Yu Wan's emotions had already calmed down a lot.

"Yesterday, before I could even change into my riding clothes, I was drugged and taken away by that man. I only woke up this evening."

"That man?" Zhao Xuanyou frowned.

Yu Wan said, "I don't know who he is either. I only know that he is the Crown Prince's subordinate. The person who captured me yesterday and the one who took me away tonight were both him."

Zhao Xuanyou pondered and asked slowly, "When you woke up, were you already in Chonghua Palace?"

Yu Wan nodded slightly.

"Not long after I woke up, the Crown Prince came in. He untied me and asked me some questions. Later, the Crown Princess invited him to eat, and when he returned, he had the eunuchs bring food. While I was eating, the Seventh Prince arrived at Chonghua Palace."

At first, Zhao Xuanyou's emotions were relatively calm, but when Yu Wan mentioned the Crown Prince, the rise and fall of his chest became noticeably faster, clearly angered once more.

"What did he ask you?"

Yu Wan knew very well that if she repeated exactly what the Crown Prince had said to her, it would only pour oil on Zhao Xuanyou's fire.

But he was pressing her for answers, so she couldn't be vague.

She cautiously glanced at him. "He... just asked me if I was willing to serve him."

Zhao Xuanyou's hands suddenly clenched into fists. If he had been holding something, it would have been crushed to pieces by now.

Seeing his reaction, Yu Wan dared not say more.

If he knew that she had woken up lying on the Crown Prince's bed, she didn't know how angry he would be.

Speaking of which, Yu Wan felt a lingering fear.

Fortunately, although the Crown Prince was lustful, he wasn't a complete beast. He hadn't taken advantage of her while she was unconscious.

If he had been that shameless, even if Zhao Xuanyou had rescued her, he might not have kept her in the Marquis's mansion.

She knew that one day she would leave the Marquis's mansion, but now was not the time.

"How did you answer?"

Hearing his persistent questioning, Yu Wan felt a bit helpless.

Did he expect her to answer by cursing the Crown Prince as a toad trying to eat swan meat, or to slap him in the face?

Meeting Yu Wan's gaze, Zhao Xuanyou understood her answer and was so angry that his teeth itched.

"Looks like I shouldn't have rescued you."

Seeing him on the verge of exploding with anger, Yu Wan cupped his face and patiently said, "We had to save our lives first. I could only pretend to be affectionate towards him."

"Really just pretending? He is the Crown Prince after all. Wouldn't it be better for you to follow him than to stay in the Marquis's mansion?"

"What's better about it?" Yu Wan sighed. "I'm just a servant girl, not someone from the palace. If I were inexplicably taken away and ruined, I would just be thrown out. My lord, I am grateful that you saved me."

As she spoke, Yu Wan tilted her face up and kissed his chin.

Feeling her unusual initiative, Zhao Xuanyou felt a slight sense of pride.

Tonight, she was different.

Although Yu Wan had always been respectful and obedient to him, giving whatever he asked for, they had been entangled together night after night, and each other's little actions and thoughts were perceptible.

Compared to his enthusiasm for intimate matters, Yu Wan was much more indifferent.

It wasn't as serious as pretending, but most of the time it was him taking and her giving. Occasionally, the look in her eyes would reveal a hint of resistance.

Zhao Xuanyou was naturally a very perceptive person. He had noticed this long ago but had never shown it.

First, he thought that women were naturally much shyer than men, so Yu Wan's resistance was a sign of shyness. Second, he thought it wasn't very important.

Yu Wan was not his wife. Their bodies had come together before they knew each other.

She had been forced by Cui Yichu to serve him. If she hadn't been forced, and if he had asked her if she wanted to be a concubine, she might not have taken this path.

Zhao Xuanyou understood in his heart that he treated Yu Wan as a concubine, and Yu Wan only saw him as her master.

Wanting more from Yu Wan might be asking too much.

But tonight, when he followed Yu Wan to bathe, he clearly felt that she was different from before.

She was accommodating him and inviting him. This feeling was much better than his previous one-sided advances.

"I know, I was just teasing you." Zhao Xuanyou pulled her a little tighter. "But, the person who captured you should be Zhao Zun's death knight. We hadn't even arrived yet. How did he abandon you and run away?"

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou directly address the Crown Prince by his given name, Yu Wan pretended not to notice.

"After our horse was shot, he took me into the forest and hid in the tree where you found me. When I heard the sound of approaching hooves, I advised him to escape quickly."

"You advised him to escape?" Thinking of Yu Wan riding with that death knight, Zhao Xuanyou felt a dark hatred in his heart. Apart from Zhao Zun, that death knight was also doomed.

Yu Wan, unaware of Zhao Xuanyou's thoughts, simply nodded.

Zhao Xuanyou found it hard to believe. "And he listened to your advice?"

The death knights by the Crown Prince's side were all forged through countless trials and had long since disregarded life and death. They were merely tools for the Crown Prince to carry out his tasks. How could they possibly listen to advice and escape?

Men looked at men differently than women did.

Zhao Xuanyou thought of the horse riding and felt that the death knight might have also had lustful intentions towards Yu Wan.

"Just that one sentence?"

"Of course not just that. I told him that with so many pursuers coming, he wouldn't be able to run fast with me. Anyway, the Crown Prince's order was to send me to another place. If he died, he wouldn't be able to complete the task. If he lived, he could secretly come back and capture me again."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a light "tch." "Your crooked reasoning does sound pretty good."

"How is it crooked reasoning? It's the truth."

As long as the green mountains remained, there would be firewood to burn. Yu Wan had always thought this way.

Especially after dying once, no matter how difficult the situation was, as long as she could survive, it wasn't a big deal.

"He wouldn't have been a problem even if he didn't leave. It wouldn't have cost me much effort." Zhao Xuanyou put on an arrogant demeanor.

That death knight was just exceptionally good at qinggong.

When it came to actual combat, there was no one under heaven that Zhao Xuanyou considered worthy.

Yu Wan looked at his confident appearance and thought to herself: Of course you're not afraid. He couldn't kill you, but he could kill me! What if he decided to take me down with him? Then I would be doomed.

Of course, she wouldn't say these words aloud. She just smiled and said, "At that time, I just wanted him to leave quickly so I could escape danger sooner. But now I'm worried, will he really come back to capture me again?"

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her and reached out to gently tap her nose.

"Now you're feeling afraid?"

---

chapters.title: A Restless Night
chapters.content:
"With you by my side, of course I'm not afraid." Yu Wan said, resting her head on Zhao Xuanyou's shoulder again. "I'm just afraid that he will really come back and cause trouble for you, my lord."

"Rest assured, he is no longer a trouble for me."

"Hmm?" Yu Wan asked in confusion. "Do you mean, my lord, that when he returns, the Crown Prince won't spare him?"

"Not to that extent. A death knight who can serve the Crown Prince so closely is not easy to cultivate. It's not so easy to execute him."

"Then..."

"He would be fine if he returned, but the problem is, he can't return."

"He can't return?" Thinking of the six or seven attendants Zhao Xuanyou had brought, Yu Wan suddenly realized. "Did the people who came with you, my lord, go to chase him?"

The manpower was something Zhao Xuanyou had gathered earlier, not for Yu Wan, but for what Pei Tao had mentioned.

Unexpectedly, before he could send them to investigate the collusion between the Duke of Xingguo's mansion and corrupt officials regarding the embezzlement of tribute pearls, Yu Wan had been kidnapped by the Crown Prince.

"They have other tasks to attend to."

"Then who did you mean, my lord?" Yu Wan was completely at a loss.

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled lightly. "You're so clever. Can't you guess?"

Yu Wan shook her head in confusion.

"From whose watch was that death knight able to kidnap you?"

Whose watch?

The little forest?

He was an imperial eunuch. How would he manage such things?

"Yin Ping?"

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. "Yin Ping has suffered a setback this time, so naturally, she needs to regain her reputation. When I took you down from the tree, Yin Ping and her people had already gone to chase that death knight."

"Can they catch him? That man really runs very fast." Recalling his qinggong, it was as if he had wings.

When he carried Yu Wan, climbing trees was a matter of a blink.

"No matter how fast he runs, he will get tired eventually. Yin Ping and her people are all experts. There should be good news tomorrow."

Yu Wan responded with a vague "Oh," still leaning against Zhao Xuanyou. Looking at the exquisite lotus flowers on the canopy, she slightly narrowed her eyes and couldn't help but yawn.

After talking to Zhao Xuanyou for so long, the initial unease and anxiety in her heart had indeed dissipated.

She seemed to be getting sleepy.

Seeing the drowsiness on her face, Zhao Xuanyou pursed his lips, rearranged the pillow, and held her as they lay down together.

Outside, the night was deep, and the two embracing in the brocade canopy slept peacefully.

---

The courtyard was quiet and peaceful, but the tranquility of Chonghua Palace was shattered by a crisp cracking sound.

Zhao Zun sat by the bed, his eyes wide open as he looked at the kneeling eunuch, and angrily said, "What did you say? The people sent to receive him didn't see Wen Jiang?"

"Yes." The eunuch had served him for a long time and knew that he had a terrible temper in private, so he didn't dare to say more.

Zhao Zun's eyes tightened.

Wen Jiang was the most obedient and reliable death knight by his side. He had never made a single mistake. His only flaw was that he liked to act alone.

Now, Wen Jiang had disappeared with Yu Wan, which likely meant he had encountered trouble.

Wen Jiang's qinggong was unparalleled, and his martial arts were excellent, but he was not invincible. If it was Zhao Xuanyou, it was indeed possible...

But how did Zhao Xuanyou know Wen Jiang's whereabouts... As he thought, Zhao Zun suddenly had a vein pop.

It was Zhao Qi!

He knew it. Zhao Qi wouldn't have come over for no reason.

Zhao Qi had specifically come to tell him that he needed to report to the Emperor, forcing him to send Yu Wan away tonight.

He had fallen for the trick!

As soon as Wen Jiang left the imperial palace, he had already been followed by their people.

Zhao Xuanyou! Zhao Qi!

He had not only lost Yu Wan but also lost his most capable death knight.

"Your Highness, are you alright?" The Crown Princess's concerned voice came from outside. "This concubine heard a loud noise and came over to see."

The little eunuch kneeling on the ground saw the Crown Prince's face, which was so dark it could drip water, and quickly spoke up. "In response to Your Highness, when this slave was assisting Your Highness to the toilet just now, he accidentally bumped into Your Highness's jade pillow, causing such a big commotion and disturbing Your Highness. It is truly a crime. Please forgive this slave, Your Highness."

How could the Crown Princess blame the Crown Prince's close attendants?

"It's good that Your Highness is fine. This concubine will take her leave and not disturb Your Highness's rest any longer."

"Consider yourself lucky for being quick-witted. Get out."

"Yes." The eunuch quickly picked up the jade pillow that the Crown Prince had thrown on the ground and placed a new one for him.

The Crown Prince lay down, still angry and unable to sleep.

Zhao Xuanyou, Zhao Qi, each and every one of these traitorous ministers, didn't put him in their eyes at all.

Damn it! Damn them!

He would never let them off!

---

The next day, the sky was clear and the wind was warm.

Zhao Xuanyou thought that Yu Wan had been frightened and wanted to let her sleep a little longer. As soon as he got up, Yu Wan opened her eyes as well.

While the two were having breakfast, they heard the servants in the courtyard shout in unison, "Seventh Prince!"

Before they could put down their chopsticks to greet him, Zhao Qi burst into the room.

"Your Highness."

Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Wan to stand up and bowed to Zhao Qi.

Zhao Qi stared blankly at Yu Wan, feeling inexplicably a little dazed.

It was he who had taken Yu Wan to the riding ground. Yu Wan's disappearance was partly his fault.

Looking at Yu Wan smiling at him, Zhao Qi's anger suddenly surged.

"This bastard Zhao Zun! Come on, Yu Wan, I'll take you to the Emperor. Let's expose his beastly nature!"

"Your Highness!" Yu Wan quickly tried to stop him, but Zhao Qi was not someone she could stop.

Zhao Xuanyou could have held onto Yu Wan, but he knew Zhao Qi was strong and if he were to pull Yu Wan, he might hurt her.

This stinking brat!

Zhao Xuanyou suppressed his emotions and coldly shouted.

"Your Highness, do not act impulsively!"

Startled by his shout, Zhao Qi finally stopped pulling Yu Wan, but he looked at Zhao Xuanyou unwillingly. "What's there to be afraid of? Yu Wan is the witness. The Emperor is the most fair. If he knows that Zhao Zun did such a thing as forcibly seizing a commoner's daughter, he will surely be enraged."

His voice was not small, and the Pei couple outside the courtyard also heard it. They quickly ordered Xiang Xu to close the courtyard gate.

The couple walked to the corridor and saw that Yu Wan was safe and sound, so they both let out a sigh of relief.

Pei Tao said to Zhao Qi, "Although Yu Wan is a witness, she is the only one, and there is no physical evidence. If the Crown Prince flatly denies it, the Emperor can only punish Yu Wan for falsely accusing the Crown Prince."

"The Emperor isn't that muddle-headed!"

"His Majesty is indeed wise, but accusing the Crown Prince is no small matter."

As soon as Zhao Xuanyou spoke, Pei Tao also said, "Your Highness, think carefully. How many memorials accusing the Crown Prince are there in the court? Which of the charges is not more serious than forcibly seizing a commoner's daughter? Why is the Crown Prince still safe and sound to this day?"

Zhao Qi opened and closed his mouth, and the defiance in his brows and eyes gradually dissipated. In the end, he stomped his foot hard.

Sun Qianran stepped forward and took Yu Wan's hand, then looked at the disheartened Zhao Qi.

"Yu Wan's safe return is already a great joy. Your Highness need not be disheartened."

"That's it? Just bring her back?"

Sun Qianran softly said, "Yu Wan is not an ordinary commoner's daughter. If the news that the Crown Prince has taken a fancy to a servant girl from the Marquis's mansion spreads to the Emperor and the Empress, the situation will only become more unfavorable."

At present, it was fashionable among noble families to exchange concubines. If the Crown Prince himself took a liking to a servant girl from the Marquis's mansion, according to custom, the Marquis's mansion should respectfully present the girl to him. There was no reason to make a fuss about it.

chapters.title: Escort
chapters.content:
"How can this be? Nothing works!" Zhao Qi could not swallow this bitter pill.

Seeing his low spirits, Sun Qianran knew that further persuasion might only anger Zhao Qi more. She turned to Yu Wan instead. "You've been wronged."

"Thank you, Madame Pei. With your blessings, this servant is unharmed."

Noticing Sun Qianran's slightly furrowed brows, Yu Wan recalled her earlier warning to be cautious. Could Sun Qianran have already guessed what the Crown Prince would do?

But that didn't make sense. Sun Qianran rarely left this small courtyard. As a minister's wife, how could she have seen the Crown Prince?

Regardless, Sun Qianran had warned her out of kindness.

Pei Tao patted Zhao Qi on the shoulder. Seeing that he had fallen silent, Pei Tao turned to Zhao Xuanyou. "Minister Zhao, although Yu Wan has returned safely, in my opinion, it would be best to send her back to the capital as soon as possible."

After all, the Crown Prince was still the Crown Prince.

For him, kidnapping Yu Wan was more about humiliating and provoking Zhao Xuanyou.

Given his noble status, if he had simply asked, Zhao Xuanyou would have had no way to refuse.

Zhao Xuanyou naturally understood this. He had originally planned to send someone to escort Yu Wan back to the capital last night, but...

He gave a slight nod and turned to Yu Wan. "Last time, His Majesty bestowed many fine teas upon me. I was thinking of sending some back to the capital for my grandmother to try. Yu Wan."

"Yes, master."

"Tomorrow morning, you and Yuan Qing will take the tea leaves and return to the capital first."

"Yuan Qing and Yu Wan together?" Zhao Qi looked at Yuan Qing, who was about the same age as him, and muttered, "What if Zhao Zun tries to kidnap someone again? How could he stop him?"

Zhao Xuanyou couldn't openly mention that he had other men waiting near the imperial palace. He simply said, "Your Highness need not worry. This official has a foolproof plan."

Of course, Zhao Qi didn't believe he had any foolproof plan.

"This time, Yu Wan got into trouble because she went out with me. I will send someone to escort her back."

"Your Highness," Yu Wan knew very well that this matter was not Zhao Qi's fault at all. Seeing him, a prince, feeling guilty over this, she felt uneasy instead. "This would be against the rules."

"What's against the rules?" Zhao Qi suddenly had an idea. "In a few days, it will be my uncle's birthday. I'll go ask my father the Emperor right now. I want to return to the capital to celebrate my uncle's birthday."

Before Zhao Xuanyou and the others could retort, Zhao Qi dashed out and seriously started practicing his horse stance in the courtyard.

"Your Highness is truly impatient." Pei Tao couldn't help but laugh.

Sun Qianran softly said, "His Highness is concerned about Yu Wan's safety. If she can travel with him, the journey back to the capital will certainly be smooth."

Zhao Xuanyou thought the same.

As a court official, he had been ordered to accompany the Emperor to Lichuan and naturally couldn't return to the capital on his own.

Zhao Zun was narrow-minded. Even if he had started the trouble, he would still feel like he had been wronged.

With Zhao Qi's many guards, and Zhao Xuanyou arranging a few more people to follow secretly, with both overt and covert protection, there would be no mishaps.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, Yu Wan understood that he also thought this was a good idea.

Thinking that Zhao Qi would soon want snacks and sweet drinks, Yu Wan bowed to the three people in the room and then headed to the kitchen.

Zhao Xuanyou cupped his hands in a bow to the Pei couple.

"This time, we were able to successfully rescue Yu Wan thanks to your assistance. In the future, if there is anything I can help with, please do not hesitate to ask."

Pei Tao's brow twitched slightly, but he said nothing.

Sun Qianran glanced at him and smiled at Zhao Xuanyou. "Minister Zhao is an open-minded man. Helping each other is only natural."

She stopped there, and Zhao Xuanyou naturally understood that she was speaking on Pei Tao's behalf.

He nodded and smiled at the couple before heading to the courtyard.

Yu Wan busied herself in the kitchen for a while, steaming honey date cakes and simmering a pot of apricot soup. Returning to the courtyard, she spread out the coarse paper as usual and began practicing her calligraphy.

After writing only a couple of lines, she couldn't help but space out.

"This character '鲜' (fresh) doesn't look good. The '鱼' (fish) and '羊' (sheep) parts should be aligned at the top. The last stroke of '鱼' should be level with the last horizontal stroke of '羊', and this vertical stroke should be longer for the character to stand steady."

Yu Wan was pulled back to her thoughts. She looked up to see Sun Qianran standing beside her. Looking at her own writing of "鲜", she took Sun Qianran's advice and rewrote it. Indeed, it looked much better.

"Thank you, Madame Pei."

Sun Qianran smiled and sat down on the other side of the stone table. "Do you mind if I sit here? Will it disturb your writing?"

"How could it?" Yu Wan was writing in the courtyard to keep Zhao Qi company as he practiced martial arts. She was always ready to wipe his sweat or give him water. Moreover, with so many people coming and going around, it wasn't exactly a disturbance-free environment. "I can never figure out what's wrong with my writing, but Madame Pei spotted the problem at a glance."

"You've only been practicing for a short time. Being able to write like this already shows exceptional intelligence."

"Madame Pei flatters me."

Sun Qianran quietly observed Yu Wan.

In the morning light, everything was radiant. Yu Wan wore a light and elegant apricot-colored dress, with bright eyes and white teeth, and features as delicate as a painting.

The fabric of her clothes was clearly of high quality, but as a maidservant, her dress didn't have much embroidery, only a little decoration at the cuffs and hem. Yet, she was still striking. The thin and smooth blouse she wore outlined her figure in the wind, unable to conceal the pleasing curves of her chest.

No wonder the Crown Prince couldn't resist and did something as shameless as kidnapping her.

"Madame Pei, how does this character look?"

Yu Wan copied another character from the calligraphy book and pushed it in front of Sun Qianran for her to critique.

Sun Qianran quickly withdrew her gaze and seriously commented.

Yu Wan listened and nodded, then rewrote it. Indeed, it looked much better.

"No wonder everyone who seeks knowledge wants to study under a famous teacher. Listening to Madame's few words is more helpful than me practicing blindly for several hours."

Sun Qianran smiled faintly. "As long as you don't mind my unsolicited advice."

"How could I? Madame Pei's talents must be the best among the ladies of the capital. It's a waste of your talents to teach me."

Although they were only casual acquaintances, Yu Wan could sense that Sun Qianran was extraordinary.

Even Cui Yichu was a famous talented woman in the capital, but Sun Qianran was likely superior to her.

"Speaking of talents, the former lady of your marquis's estate was truly the best. Not only was she skilled in music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, but she could also write poetry."

Poetry?

Yu Wan had never read Cui Yichu's poetry and assumed it wasn't any good. It was just as well she hadn't read it.

"This servant only wants to learn to read and write. Being able to understand poetry is good enough. I wouldn't dare think of anything else."

Noticing the change in Yu Wan's expression at the mention of Cui Yichu, Sun Qianran couldn't help but feel curious. A unlikely thought crossed her mind.

Could the reason Marquis Zhao divorced Cui Yichu have something to do with Yu Wan?

Why would Zhao Xuanyou keep a maidservant who looked similar to Cui Yichu by his side?

No matter how clever Sun Qianran was, she couldn't possibly guess the ugly truth that Cui Yichu had an affair with the Crown Prince.

Her curiosity piqued, she softly asked, "Yu Wan, when you were at the marquis's estate, whose servant were you?"

chapters.title: Departure Thoughts
chapters.content:
Sensing the inquiry in her tone, Yu Wan respectfully replied, "This servant worked in the flower room, tending to flowers and plants after entering the marquis's estate. I never worked in the main courtyard of the lady's residence."

"You worked in the marquis's estate flower room?"

Yu Wan nodded. "The young master returned to the capital not long before taking up an official position. This servant went to the young master's study to manage the courtyard, and later, when the room was short-staffed, I began serving the young master."

She spoke simply, without mentioning Cui Yichu at all.

"In that case, it's fate that brought you and Minister Zhao together." Sun Qianran had momentarily failed to resist her curiosity and asked one more question. Now, hearing Yu Wan's reluctance to elaborate, she realized she had misspoken.

Zhao Xuanyou was still nearby, instructing Zhao Qi in his practice. If she continued to question Yu Wan, it might displease him.

"I'm just a servant. It's already a blessing from my past life to be able to serve the young master. I wouldn't dare think about fate or anything like that."

"Meeting is fate. It takes ten years of cultivation to cross paths on the same boat. Our meeting in Lichuan is also fate."

"It's this servant who is presumptuous."

Coming to the Lichuan imperial palace for over a month, although each day was busy, Yu Wan had experienced days she had never imagined.

Accompanying the prince to listen to the top scholar's lectures, sitting in the courtyard practicing calligraphy, and even almost learning to ride a horse... Before all this happened, these were things Yu Wan wouldn't have dared to dream of, yet they had actually come true.

But... tomorrow she would return to the capital, and this dream would finally come to an end.

Just now, when Yu Wan held her brush and spaced out, she had been thinking about this and felt a pang of regret.

"Meeting by chance, there's no such thing as presumptuous." Sun Qianran thought for a moment and softly said, "Perhaps after returning to the capital, we'll have the chance to meet again."

Would they meet again in the capital?

Lichuan was a different place. Outside the imperial family, everyone was a subject. The high-ranking officials living in the separate courtyards didn't put on as many airs.

Once back in the capital, the imperial palace was isolated above the common people. How could a servant like Yu Wan still have any interaction with a noble lady like Sun Qianran?

"You don't believe me?"

"It's not that... I just think..."

"My mother and your marquis's estate's old lady are relatives. When the old lady celebrated her birthday before, my mother even went to congratulate her in person." Sun Qianran had also received an invitation from Cui Yichu, but due to her poor health, she had only sent a gift and did not attend in person. "Since I've met you, if there are any banquets at the marquis's estate in the future, I will definitely attend."

Yu Wan was still very grateful to the Pei couple.

Whether their kindness was genuine or not, they had never looked down on her openly. They had always been polite to her.

If she had encountered not them in Lichuan, but those arrogant nobles, Yu Wan would not have had such a pleasant month.

"Madame, since you've been living in Lichuan these days, your complexion has improved a lot, and you don't cough as much."

The air in Lichuan was fresh, indeed much more comfortable than in the capital.

But Sun Qianran's illness was worst in winter. Last year, she had almost coughed to death on New Year's Eve. She didn't know if she would survive this winter.

But such inauspicious words, she didn't even say to Pei Tao, let alone an outsider like Yu Wan.

Since it was her last day in Lichuan, whether practicing calligraphy or listening to lectures, Yu Wan was especially attentive.

Before going to bed that night, she was still sorting through her stack of coarse paper.

Zhao Xuanyou, having changed into his nightclothes, sat on the edge of the bed. After waiting for a long time and seeing that she was still tidying up, he couldn't help but go over and throw the stack of paper aside.

"Master?" Yu Wan looked at him with a confused expression.

Without any reason, why did he throw her things away?

Zhao Xuanyou, being looked at like that, felt even more displeased.

Previously, when he had mentioned the high cost of paper, he had just been teasing her, wanting her to act coy and ask for his help. Who would have thought she would actually take Pei Tao's advice and get a stack of coarse paper to practice calligraphy every day?

It was fine to practice here in the separate courtyard, but she wanted to take it back to the capital?

She didn't need to live so frugally by his side.

"What's the point of bringing these useless things back?" Zhao Xuanyou pulled her towards the bed and said in a muffled voice, "From now on, you can use any paper in my study."

"That would be too wasteful."

"You write well enough now. It's not a waste."

Zhao Xuanyou had a cold expression on his face, his brows slightly furrowed, looking like he was about to lose his temper. Yet, he was actually complimenting her. Yu Wan realized this and smiled at him.

"Thank you, young master."

The soft red lips curved into a beautiful arc, making Zhao Xuanyou's throat tighten. He pulled her onto the bed.

Tomorrow morning, she would return to the capital. After tonight, if he wanted to be with her again, it would be at least one or two months.

The last bit of clarity in Zhao Xuanyou's mind was shattered by her fragrance, plunging into chaos. His usually calm eyes revealed a hint of ferocity.

Tonight, he had to leave a deep impression on her.

---

The faint morning light filtered through the window lattice, but the two people in the brocade canopy had not yet opened their eyes.

Yuan Qing hesitated at the door for a moment before knocking.

"Master, the Seventh Prince has sent someone to urge us."

The Seventh Prince was impatient. This time, he had sent someone to urge them. If the master and Yu Wan still didn't get up, the Seventh Prince might come in person, which would be bad.

"I know." Finally, Zhao Xuanyou's response came from inside.

In the room, Yu Wan also got up.

Last night, Zhao Xuanyou had been terrifyingly fierce. The two of them had only fallen asleep an hour ago. Yu Wan hadn't slept well, and there were faint dark circles under her eyes.

The dark circles were nothing.

Yu Wan's chest and back were covered with red marks of varying depths, all from his bites. It was almost like when she had first started serving him.

"Why are you sulking?"

In the quiet morning, Zhao Xuanyou lay on the pillow and teased her.

Yu Wan's clear eyes looked back at him.

This man... Even though neither of them had slept much, she was exhausted, yet he acted as if nothing was wrong and even mocked her!

"I'm not sulking. I just look like this."

After saying this, Yu Wan quickly tied her belt and went to wash her face.

The bundle to take back to the capital had been packed last night. Yu Wan didn't need to dress up. She moved quickly, simply washing up before using a hairpin to secure her bun and heading out.

But before she could open the door, a pair of iron-like arms wrapped around her waist from behind.

Yu Wan's body was still sore, and being hugged like this, she couldn't help but hiss.

"Does it hurt?" This soft exclamation naturally aroused his pity.

Yu Wan turned her head to look at him, aggrieved. "Master should know better than me."

Of course, he knew, but Zhao Xuanyou wouldn't admit it.

"Sleep more on the carriage later."

Starting tonight, she would be able to sleep peacefully every night. It should be him who deserved pity.

Yu Wan heard his frustration and remembered how fiercely he had treated her last night. Suddenly, a mischievous thought crossed her mind, and she rubbed against him.

Zhao Xuanyou had already seen the red marks he had left on her neck. He was already distracted.

Now, with her teasing him like this, the string in his mind easily snapped. He lifted her up and carried her back.

---

chapters.title: Someone is by His Side
chapters.content:
Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou was about to succeed, Yu Wan bent her eyebrows and shouted towards the outside.

"Yuan Qing, my luggage is too heavy. Come in and help me carry it."

"Oh."

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened fiercely.

If it were Yuan Shan outside, even if he heard this, he wouldn't rashly barge in. But Yuan Qing, that simpleton... In his hesitation, Yuan Qing's footsteps were already getting closer and closer.

At the moment he pushed the door open, Zhao Xuanyou let go of Yu Wan.

The Pei family had brought many servants, and there were quite a few people in the courtyard at this moment. With Yuan Qing pushing the door open so loudly, the people outside could naturally see the situation inside the room clearly.

Yuan Qing pushed the door open and saw Zhao Xuanyou's face as dark as iron. He felt that something was wrong and was caught in a dilemma.

"Master..."

"Help me carry this."

Yu Wan smiled and handed the bundle on the ground to Yuan Qing. Yuan Qing took it and felt that it wasn't heavy at all. Yu Wan had considerable strength, so how could she not carry it?

"Master, this servant takes her leave."

Yu Wan turned around, bowed to him, and deliberately looked at him. She couldn't help but wink at him. Then she quickly jumped into the courtyard.

She was going back to the capital. As for the anger on Zhao Xuanyou, he would have to find a way to extinguish it himself.

"Yu Wan, are you leaving?" Xiang Xu came forward and handed over a food box. "This is what the cook and I prepared this morning. Take it with you for the journey."

"Ever since we met, I have received so much care from you. I really don't know how to thank you."

It was true that Yu Wan had injured her waist from moving the table, and Xiang Xu had taken care of her for several days. Although it was done under orders, she had done her best.

Xiang Xu smiled, "It was just a small effort. There's no need for thanks. Didn't you bring me good food when you went out?"

"If we meet in the capital in the future, I will treat you to something else."

"Then it's settled."

Yuan Qing stood at the door with the bundle, and seeing that people from Zhao Qi's side were coming this way again, he hurriedly shouted to Yu Wan, "Hurry up and leave! Seventh Prince has sent people to chase you again."

Yu Wan looked around but didn't see the Pei Tuo couple. She nodded to Xiang Xu and then followed Yuan Qing out.

This time, the person who came to urge them was Mu Di. Seeing that Yu Wan and Yuan Qing had finally come out, he sighed softly. "You should walk faster. This is the first time the prince has waited for someone like this."

In the entire world, aside from the Emperor and the Duke of Ning, the Seventh Prince would not wait for anyone.

Soon, they arrived at the entrance of the courtyard. Yu Wan saw two tall and luxurious canopied carriages parked there, surrounded by dozens of mounted guards.

"Miss Yu Wan, please get in the carriage."

"And the prince?"

"He is in the carriage."

Yu Wan took the food box and boarded the carriage. Zhao Qi heard the sound and glared over with a face full of anger. When he saw the food box, he asked, "You were blabbering on just to prepare a food box?"

Seeing that he was impatient, Yu Wan had to take credit for the cook and Xiang Xu's work and nodded to Zhao Qi.

"Would Your Highness like to try some now?"

"I just had breakfast. Later." Because of Yu Wan's arrival, Zhao Qi ordered his attendants to set off.

Zhao Qi was a prince, and his carriage was more spacious and stable than the one used by the marquis's mansion.

Yu Wan saw that there were also tea sets prepared in the carriage. She poured tea for Zhao Qi and then set out four tea snacks.

Seeing that the food box contained Zhao Qi's favorite eight treasure cakes, Yu Wan took one out to offer.

"Is the carriage behind carrying Your Highness's luggage?"

Earlier, Zhao Qi had said he was returning to the capital to celebrate his uncle's birthday and would take everything back to the capital. Could it be that he was not returning to the imperial palace?

Zhao Qi glanced at her leisurely and chuckled, "Some are specialties from Lichuan prepared for my uncle, and some... are prepared for you."

Prepared for her?

Yu Wan was confused and saw that Zhao Qi was deliberately keeping her in suspense, so she simply didn't ask.

---

In the Crystal Palace, the Empress and the Crown Princess Consort were adorned in pearls and jade, exuding an aura of nobility. They were sipping tea while looking at the rippling stream outside the window.

The Crown Princess Consort, Jiang Nian Shuang, was the legitimate daughter of the Duke of Zhen Guo. Her father was the Empress's elder brother, making her bloodline close to the Empress. The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law were extremely close.

"I heard that during your stay in Lichuan, you and Zun have been sleeping in separate rooms?"

"Yes." The Crown Princess Consort's eyes dimmed slightly at the mention of their marital affairs.

"Foolish!" The Empress lightly reprimanded, "It's not easy to come to Lichuan. Away from those vixens in the Eastern Palace, you should take the opportunity to get closer to Zun."

Get closer?

How could the Crown Princess Consort not want to be closer to Zhao Zun?

She was born into a noble family and had been able to enter and exit the palace since she was young. Although she had not served as a princess's companion reader, the honors she received far surpassed those of other noble girls.

The Crown Prince was her cousin and had always treated her with kindness and gentleness.

At that time, she didn't understand love, but she secretly enjoyed being close to this noble cousin.

Later, as she grew up and understood love, her cousin still treated her the same, but she could see that he quite enjoyed talking to Cui Yichu.

Cui Yichu was born with a graceful and elegant beauty. Even in the palace filled with beauties, her beauty was still impressive.

Moreover, she was well-versed in poetry and literature, and even the Emperor had praised her poems.

Jiang Rushuang had never thought she could compete with Cui Yichu. When she had no hope, the Empress, her aunt, told her that the Crown Princess Consort would be her, not anyone else.

She was initially overjoyed, but after the joy, there was only worry.

The Crown Prince liked Cui Yichu. Even if she became the Crown Princess Consort, as long as Cui Yichu entered the Eastern Palace, with the Crown Prince's favor and her distinguished family background, how could she suppress her?

She begged the Empress, her aunt, not to let Cui Yichu enter the Eastern Palace.

The Empress agreed and, for some reason, removed Cui Yichu from her position as the princess's companion reader, expelling her from the palace.

During that period, the Crown Prince seemed a bit depressed, but soon the Emperor approved their marriage, and she became the Crown Princess Consort as she wished.

It was also from the day they became husband and wife that her previously kind and gentle cousin suddenly became cold and distant.

He would rather bestow favors on the palace maids sent by the Jing Shi Room than set foot in her bedchamber.

If not for the Empress's coercion, he wouldn't visit her even once a month.

"Your Highness... Your Highness does not like your daughter-in-law. I really have no way."

"Useless!" The Empress looked at her dejected appearance and lightly tapped the table. "You are the Crown Princess Consort. For you, a legitimate son is worth more than ten thousand things. What you should seek is a legitimate son, not Zun's favor."

"But if Your Highness does not come, how can I... how can I have a legitimate son?"

"This time, I agreed to let that rebellious son of Ping Wang stay in the capital to oversee the government so that Zun and you could have a quiet time in Lichuan. I expected good news upon your return to the capital. But look at you, you can't even get into Zun's bed."

"Please calm down, Aunt!" Seeing that the Empress was angry, the Crown Princess Consort quickly changed her address and stood up to massage the Empress's legs.

The Empress saw her pitiful appearance and sighed in her heart.

How could she not know her own son's temperament?

He liked beautiful women, but Jiang Rushuang was plain in appearance.

There were other outstanding girls in the Duke of Zhen Guo's family, but only Jiang Rushuang was of the same age as the Crown Prince.

After some thought, the Empress suppressed her impatience and carefully advised, "Zun is at the age of vigor. It won't be long. You've been in Lichuan for a month. He needs someone to accompany him. You are not bad either. Dress up for me and be clever at night."

The Crown Princess Consort listened to the Empress's words and silently bit her lip.

"Aunt, Your Highness... he has found a new woman in Lichuan."

chapters.title: Which Witch
chapters.content:
"Where did this new woman come from in the imperial palace?" The Empress's eyes tightened slightly as she thought carefully and felt that something was not right.

The palace maids serving in the Chonghua Hall were all arranged by her. None of them would have the audacity to seduce the Crown Prince.

As for the daughters of the officials who accompanied the Emperor on this trip, there were three girls of the same age as the Crown Prince, but their appearances were not outstanding and were unlikely to catch the Crown Prince's eye.

"Whom has he bestowed favors upon?"

"I do not know."

The Empress's phoenix eyes sank. "Then why are you talking nonsense?"

"I am not talking nonsense," the Crown Princess Consort tightened her fingers, her eyes filled with worry. "In recent days, Your Highness has hidden a beauty in his room. I personally heard them talking in the room and also heard Your Highness order his close eunuch to prepare women's clothing and accessories."

"Has Zun really hidden a woman in Chonghua Hall?"

The Crown Princess Consort nodded affirmatively.

"Not a palace maid of Chonghua Hall?"

"I am sure she is not a palace maid." When Zhao Zun was in the Eastern Palace, he often summoned those beauties to serve him, but the Crown Princess Consort could see that Zhao Zun did not particularly like them.

This time was different. Zhao Zun seemed either full of joy or lost in thought, and even smashed things in his room late at night.

She did not know what kind of breathtaking beauty was hidden in the room to affect his emotions so much.

"Nonsense!" The Empress knew that this daughter-in-law, although not beautiful, was not foolish. If she spoke with such certainty, it must be a done deal.

The Empress suddenly looked up at the female official beside her.

"Go and bring Zhao Zun to me."

"Yes." The female official complied and left.

The mother-in-law and daughter-in-law sat in the tea room in silence, no longer in the mood for idle chat.

After waiting for about the time it takes for a stick of incense to burn, the female official led the Crown Prince over.

The Crown Prince caught a glimpse of the Empress's gloomy eyes and then saw the aggrieved Crown Princess Consort beside her. He understood seven or eight tenths of the situation.

His cousin had come to complain to the Empress again.

His disgust grew even stronger. He only greeted the Empress, "This son was just keeping Father company in the Mingde Hall. I only learned of Mother's summons when I came out. Please forgive me, Mother."

The Empress looked up solemnly, her eyes full of displeasure. After dismissing the attendants, she asked, "Shuang says you have hidden a woman in Chonghua Hall. Is this true?"

The Crown Prince coldly glanced at Jiang Rushuang, who knew he was blaming her and only lowered her eyes without speaking.

"I am asking you, why are you looking at her!" The Empress raised her voice. "Did you hide a woman or not?"

Listening to the Empress's interrogation, the anger from being schemed against by Zhao Qi and Zhao Xuanyou these past few days rushed to the Crown Prince's head, causing a dull ache.

"Mother, I am the Crown Prince. Do I need to report to Mother even if I like a woman?"

The Empress held her tea cup and quietly observed him.

The Crown Prince was dressed in the dignified attire of the heir apparent, and his young and handsome eyes were filled with anger. It was clear that his emotions had risen.

Afraid that he would lose his temper and cause a commotion, the Empress slightly lowered her voice.

"I only forbid you from taking a concubine. When have I ever stopped you from bestowing favors on women? Are not those beauties in the Eastern Palace chosen by you yourself?"

"Is that so?" The Crown Prince coldly retorted, his eyes filled with suppressed anger.

"Zun, although you are the heir, you still have several younger brothers. Ping Wang has always been eyeing your position as the heir. You must not make any mistakes that would displease your father, the Emperor."

The Crown Prince indifferently said, "Mother, rest assured. She is no longer in Chonghua Hall and will not cause any more trouble."

"Really?"

"If Mother does not believe me, you can take your good daughter-in-law to search Chonghua Hall."

She was no longer there?

The Empress slightly let out a breath of relief, but seeing the Crown Prince's attitude, it seemed similar to when she had exposed his private affair with Cui Yichu in the past.

She suddenly became curious. What kind of woman could make the Crown Prince so concerned?

"Who is that woman?"

"A woman who has nothing to do with Ping Wang or the position of heir. Mother need not worry."

The Empress listened to these words and her expression subtly changed. "Zhao Zun, listen to yourself. For a woman, you actually speak to me in this tone!"

The Crystal Palace fell into a deathly silence. The Crown Prince did not speak, but his eyes were still turbulent.

Looking at his appearance, the Empress could not bear it.

He should have been the most noble person in the world. It was a bit heart-wrenching to let him suffer for the sake of her maiden family.

The Empress thought for a moment and then signaled to the Crown Princess Consort. The Crown Princess Consort quickly poured a cup of tea and handed it to the Crown Prince, but he refused to drink.

"I asked who she is, not to deal with her. The Eastern Palace is large enough to accommodate as many women as you like. Since you have taken a fancy to her, I can issue an imperial decree to let her enter the Eastern Palace."

"There is no need. She is no longer in the imperial palace."

Looking at the Crown Prince's dejected appearance, the Empress became even more curious.

"Just who is this extraordinary person that can make you so gloomy?"

Looking at the lifeless Crystal Palace, and recalling the gentle words Yu Wan had said to him that night, the Crown Prince's mind was filled with her delicate and charming face. He missed her even more.

He glanced at the Crown Princess Consort, who was shrinking in the corner, and then looked at the Empress. He frankly said, "The one this son likes is Zhao Xuanyou's concubine."

"Nonsense!" The Empress's voice suddenly rose as she loudly reprimanded, "What is your status? How can a lowly maid from a marquis's mansion make you concerned?"

Lowly?

Yu Wan's birth should be low, but she knew how to speak to his heart and make him happy.

The two people sitting in the Crystal Palace, one was his mother and the other was his wife. They only forced him to do things he did not want to do.

Zhao Zun did not want to stay here for a moment longer.

"Mother, rest assured. Zhao Xuanyou has already sent her back to the capital. Besides missing her, there is nothing I can do."

With that, Zhao Zun left without looking back.

"Stop!"

The Empress knocked on the table, almost slamming it in anger. The Crown Prince seemed not to hear and quickly disappeared.

"It is all this daughter-in-law's fault. I should not have told Mother about these things."

The Empress glared at her.

Husband and wife are like birds in the same forest. No husband would like to bring in outsiders to suppress his wife.

From the beginning, the Crown Princess Consort had taken the wrong path.

The Empress knew in her heart that Zhao Zun would never fall in love with the Crown Princess Consort. This couple was destined to be separated in spirit despite their union.

For the Empress, who had presided over the harem for decades, this was nothing at all.

What was marital affection?

Hmph, men's hearts were the most unreliable. Even if they were genuinely in love for a day, two days, a year, or two years, there would always come a time when they would change their minds.

Favor was intangible, but the position of Empress and the position of heir were real.

"After returning to the capital, remember to apologize to Zun. Do not try to figure out whom he likes. Give birth to a legitimate son, and everything you should have will be yours."

The Jiang family's daughter did not have the fate for romantic entanglements. She could not force it.

As long as she bound the Jiang family and the royal family tightly together with blood ties, the Jiang family's daughter would live better than anyone else.

"I understand." But the Crown Princess Consort still had some lingering concerns. "That day, His Highness did bring someone back. If it is Zhao Xuanyou's concubine, won't it cause trouble?"

"A mere maid cannot stir up much trouble," the Empress frowned, pondered for a moment, and then sighed. "Originally, I wanted to win over Zhao Xuanyou, but it seems he has already set himself against Zun. The Emperor is determined to promote him, which will be somewhat thorny in the future."

chapters.title: Agreement
chapters.content:
The carriage rolled steadily along the official road.

After eating some pastries, Zhao Qi dozed off out of boredom. When he opened his eyes again, he saw Yu Wan sitting by the window, flipping through a book.

He rubbed his eyes and sat down beside her. Seeing that she was reading the articles Pei Ta had given him before his departure, he frowned and asked, "Why do you always like reading these?"

"These articles... I can't even recognize all the characters, so how can I like them?" Yu Wan put down the papers, poured a cup of water for Zhao Qi, and handed it to him to moisten his throat.

Zhao Qi drank the water and looked at her in confusion. "Then why do you still read them?"

The articles Pei Ta had given Zhao Qi covered topics like agriculture, which Yu Wan could somewhat understand, but the rest; construction, household administration, taxation, and official systems; were completely beyond her.

It was after reading these articles that Yu Wan realized Pei Ta had been trying his best to accommodate her during lessons.

When he explained the same content, she could understand most of it, but when she read the articles herself, she was completely lost.

Fortunately, she wasn’t discouraged.

"I understand one sentence at a time. Besides, there’s nothing else to do in the carriage. Moreover, others write such beautiful characters; even if I don’t understand, I can still appreciate the calligraphy."

Listening to Yu Wan’s gentle explanation, Zhao Qi couldn’t help but ask a question that had been on his mind for a while.

"Why do you study so hard? What’s the point?"

"No particular reason." Yu Wan met Zhao Qi’s confused gaze and asked, "Does Your Highness dislike reading articles?"

"Of course I do. Who would want to read their pretentious eight-part essays? If it weren’t for Father Emperor forcing me, I wouldn’t study at all."

"What does Your Highness want to learn?" Yu Wan asked curiously.

Zhao Qi thought for a moment. "Martial arts would be good."

He could never forget the way Zhao Xuanyou had shown off in front of him that day.

He was determined to train hard and regain his dignity from Zhao Xuanyou in the future.

"That makes sense. Your Highness has tried everything and studied everything, so you know what you like. I haven’t learned anything and understand nothing, so I’m curious about everything."

"But you won’t have any use for these things."

"Your Highness is right."

Yu Wan sat by the window, the wind from outside the carriage blowing in and stirring the hair by her ears, making her appear even softer.

He recalled the rumors he had heard from Yin Ping and the others, that Yu Wan was Zhao Xuanyou’s concubine-servant.

Looking at Yu Wan, he suddenly asked, "Are you Zhao Xuanyou’s concubine-servant?"

"Yes." Yu Wan cautiously glanced at Zhao Qi.

He was young; perhaps the palace hadn’t arranged any bedchamber attendants for him yet, so he probably didn’t understand what a concubine-servant did.

"What’s the difference between a concubine-servant and a concubine?"

He really didn’t know.

"A concubine-servant is still a servant, similar to your Xiao Dezi. She does personal attendances," Yu Wan explained gently. "A concubine is considered half a mistress of the household. She only needs to serve the heir and the madam, unlike me, who has to do all the odd jobs."

Zhao Qi slightly furrowed his brows.

With only him and Yu Wan in the carriage, it was indeed a good time to ask questions he wouldn’t normally ask.

"I used to think Zhao Xuanyou didn’t like you, so he made you a servant. But when you got into trouble, I saw how anxious he was. If he cares about you, why does he still make you a servant?"

Yu Wan said, "After the Young Master separated from Lady Cui, there was no mistress in the household. He will eventually marry, and if there were concubines in the household, the noble ladies outside would have to consider it carefully."

"And with a concubine-servant, those noble ladies don’t have to consider it?"

"A concubine-servant is just a servant. Whether to keep or sell her is up to the master’s word. She won’t cause trouble for the future madam."

Zhao Qi was surprised. "Are you saying that when Zhao Xuanyou marries, he will sell you?"

"Who knows what will happen in the future."

Though she said that, Yu Wan had already made up her mind. Once her mother’s illness improved, she would take her and leave the capital.

She had indeed wanted to kill Cui Yichu for revenge, but over these days, she had gradually come to terms with reality.

The House of the Duke of Xingguo was powerful. Even Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta found it difficult to deal with, let alone her?

Now that her mother’s condition had taken a turn for the better, Yu Wan’s hatred had lessened compared to her past life.

As long as her mother could wake up, she could let go of everything, take her mother away, find a good place to buy land and a house, and live out the rest of their days in peace.

"If Zhao Xuanyou really sells you, then come work in my prince’s residence," Zhao Qi suddenly said.

Yu Wan’s thoughts were interrupted by his words. Listening to his slightly childish tone, she couldn’t help but laugh. "Your Highness hasn’t established his own residence yet. Those who serve you must be from the palace."

"We haven’t established it yet, but we will in the future. If Zhao Xuanyou sells you before I’m enfeoffed, then you can..." Zhao Qi racked his brain and suddenly had an idea. "You can go work in the Duke of Ningguo’s residence. My maternal grandfather and uncle dote on me the most. As long as I ask, they’ll agree to anything."

"Thank you for your concern, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi saw her indifferent expression, as if she didn’t take his words to heart, and immediately became anxious. "I’m serious."

Seeing his stubborn look, Yu Wan said, "This servant knows Your Highness never jokes, but the future is uncertain. I dare not rashly agree."

Zhao Qi really enjoyed being with Yu Wan.

If she weren’t Zhao Xuanyou’s servant but someone from another household, he would have directly asked for her.

But the other party was Zhao Xuanyou... Zhao Qi was afraid of him.

"What’s so hard about agreeing? As long as you leave the Marquis of Jingyuan’s residence, come work in mine."

Yu Wan, pressed into a corner, had no choice but to nod. "This servant obeys."

Only when he heard the word "obeys" did Zhao Qi finally smile.

"Your Highness."

"What? Have you changed your mind?"

Yu Wan couldn’t help but smile.

He was indeed a young prince carefully raised by the Emperor and the Duke of Ningguo. Though only two years younger than her, he was still so childish.

"I haven’t changed my mind. It’s just that I’m a little hungry. I want to take out the food box. Would Your Highness like to eat with me?"

"Mm."

The imperial palace attendants had also prepared food. Yu Wan took everything out and sat with Zhao Qi by the window, appreciating the scenery while eating the delicacies.

The days she had spent in Lichuan had been comfortable. She had lived a peach blossom spring-like life there, and unexpectedly, she had even traveled back with the prince.

This beautiful dream had a proper beginning and end.

The return journey was faster than the trip there. On the third day, before sunset, the carriage entered the city gates.

"Let me send you back to the marquis’s residence first," Zhao Qi said.

"That won’t do." Yu Wan quickly declined. "Yuan Qing and I can get off at the city gate. We didn’t bring much, so we can just hire a carriage."

Yu Wan had a small plan in mind.

After getting off the carriage, she wouldn’t return to the marquis’s residence immediately. Instead, she would take Yuan Qing to the Taoran Inn to stay with her mother for one night and return to the marquis’s residence early the next morning.

"How can that be? The carriage behind has things from the marquis’s residence. You two can’t carry them."

Zhao Qi insisted, so Yu Wan could only sigh softly and give up on going to the Taoran Inn.

When the carriage stopped in front of the marquis’s residence, Yu Wan was about to bid farewell when she suddenly caught sight of Yin Ping directing the guards to carry a large wooden box down from the rear carriage.

---

chapters.title: Whipping
chapters.content:
"Is this the Young Master’s thing?" Yu Wan saw the guards struggling to carry the box and couldn’t guess what was inside.

Before Zhao Qi could answer, there were two muffled thuds from inside the box, as if there was something alive in there.

Yu Wan was startled and looked at Zhao Qi.

"Is... is this the game the Young Master caught in the hunting ground?"

But that didn’t make sense. Whether it was a deer or a wolf, they would be kept in a cage, not a box.

Zhao Qi glared fiercely at the box. "It is indeed game. When we enter the marquis’s residence, you can whip it hard a few times to vent your anger!"

Vent her anger?

Before Yu Wan could figure it out, Yuan Qing had already directed the marquis’s residence servants to carry the box inside.

It seemed Zhao Xuanyou had already instructed him.

"Yes." Yu Wan bowed respectfully to Zhao Qi. "This servant respectsfully sees Your Highness off."

After staying in the Lichuan imperial palace for more than a month, Yu Wan had learned many palace rules and could conduct herself as properly as any palace maid.

Zhao Qi casually responded with an "mm" and thought about how, in the future, when he practiced martial arts and attended lectures, Yu Wan wouldn’t be by his side. He felt a pang of disappointment.

"Don’t forget what you promised me."

Yu Wan was slightly taken aback, remembering what he had said in the carriage. She smiled and replied, "This servant would not dare forget Your Highness’s orders."

Only then did Zhao Qi turn and board the carriage.

He was a prince, and the servants at the marquis’s residence gate knelt on the ground, watching as he departed.

It wasn’t until the large procession had left the street that Yu Wan finally stood up.

When she had first met Zhao Qi, she had suffered many setbacks at his hands. But after spending more time with him, Yu Wan realized that, despite his youthful nature, among that group of imperial relatives and nobles, he was already one of the kinder ones.

Given the difference in their statuses, she probably wouldn’t see this young prince again.

Yu Wan was about to enter the residence when she looked up and saw Fengchang supporting Old Lady Ye toward the gate.
