Zhao Qi was still unaware of the situation, but he had been very helpful in the previous rescue of Yu Wan, even going to the extent of creating a diversion in the Cheng Hua Hall. As long as he was informed of the current situation, he would surely not object.

After reaching an agreement, the two went their separate ways; one heading out of the traveling palace, the other returning to find Zhao Qi.

As Pei Ta had expected, upon hearing that Yu Wan had been kidnapped again by the Crown Prince, Zhao Qi was furious. It took Pei Ta a great deal of persuasion to calm him down.

Knowing that they already had a plan, Zhao Qi had no choice but to order his people to pack up.

Two hours later, a large contingent of soldiers gathered at the gate of the traveling palace, preparing to depart for Heishui County.

However, shortly after leaving the traveling palace, Zhao Xuanyou exchanged clothes with Yin Ping, whose build was the closest to his.

Zhao Qi looked at Yin Ping in the general's armor and couldn't help but say, "Don't tell me, even I can't recognize the difference at first glance."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression was grave, not in the mood for jokes. He cupped his hands. "I am grateful to Your Highness and Lord Pei."

"Can you really rescue Yu Wan by yourself?" Zhao Qi didn't want to go to Heishui County; he wanted to go back to the capital with Zhao Xuanyou to rescue the person. But he knew Zhao Xuanyou would not agree.

To avoid exposing any flaws, Zhao Xuanyou would not take Yuan Xie and Yuan Qing with him, leaving them with Yin Ping.

"Your Highness, rest assured. I still have people I can rely on."

Zhao Qi, of course, did not doubt the capabilities of the Jingyuan Marquis's household.

After a moment's thought, he added, "Take Mu Di with you back to the capital. When you reach the capital, go to the Ningguo Duke's residence."

"Do you have a message for me to deliver, Your Highness?"

"No." Zhao Qi lowered his head and pondered for a while, a sharp glint appearing in his eyes. "My maternal grandfather has always suspected that my mother's death was unusual. Over the years, he has been investigating and knows several hideouts of that poisonous woman and Zhao Zun in the capital. Since Yu Wan hasn't been taken to the Eastern Palace yet, she is likely hiding in one of those hideouts."

This would save a lot of trouble.

"Thank you, Your Highness."

As Mu Di rode forward, Zhao Xuanyou turned his horse around.

The sky gradually darkened, and his robes were stirred by the cold night wind, fluttering like waves. His expression was as deep as an abyss.

He cupped his hands to Zhao Qi and Pei Ta, then, under their gaze, urged his horse and left.

---

chapters.title: Heart-to-Heart
chapters.content:
Yu Wan held a tree branch, dipped it in water, and wrote characters on the bluestone slabs in the courtyard.

It had been a full five days since she was brought here by Wen Jiao.

Wen Jiao had not tied her up, so she moved freely within the courtyard, but she was bored out of her mind and decided to practice her writing with the branch.

Though her hand was writing, her mind was racing, unable to calm down.

According to Wen Jiao, they should receive the Crown Prince's secret orders within the next day or two.

All the messages were being sent from Lichuan. Presumably, Zhao Xuanyou had received the news by now...

That day, she had asked Wen Jiao to send money to the Taoran Inn, precisely to inform Zhao Xuanyou that she was still in the capital.

Would the innkeeper understand her intention?

Would Zhao Xuanyou come to rescue her?

She was just a maidservant. He had already rescued her once. Would he do it a second time? Going against the Eastern Palace was a risky endeavor.

"Eat something." Wen Jiao brought over a bowl of noodles.

Had half a day passed already? It seemed there would be no news today either.

Yu Wan sighed and put down the branch. She washed her hands in the basin and then took the bowl of noodles, sitting on a small stool under the corridor to eat.

She had been nagging every day to eat meat, claiming that when she was in the Marquis's mansion dungeon, she had never mistreated Wen Jiao and had always provided both meat and vegetables for his meals. Wen Jiao had acknowledged her reasoning and finally stewed a chicken.

After eating chicken for two days straight, Yu Wan couldn't take it anymore and started complaining again. So, Wen Jiao used the chicken broth to cook noodles.

Though she was tired of the chicken broth smell, the noodles themselves were not bad.

Yu Wan finished the noodles but left the broth untouched and handed the bowl back.

After eating, Yu Wan was too lazy to move. She watched Wen Jiao sitting there in silence, her gaze drifting toward him.

"Wen Jiao, you're so skilled in martial arts, and you can even cook. You're really impressive."

"My martial arts are not that good."

"You can leap across rooftops in the traveling palace, and you say your martial arts are not good? That's being too modest."

Wen Jiao said, "I'm just good at qinggong. My martial arts are not that good."

He couldn't defeat the Seventh Prince's guards in a direct confrontation.

"I see. So leaping across rooftops is qinggong, and the skill to fight and kill is martial arts."

Not exactly. Martial arts included qinggong.

But Yu Wan wouldn't understand, so Wen Jiao didn't need to explain further.

"More or less."

Yu Wan saw that he didn't want to engage with her, but she continued to make conversation.

"Actually, I really don't understand. If you're so skilled, why do you still work for the Crown Prince?"

Wen Jiao listened to Yu Wan's words, his tone carrying a hint of surprise. "Is there a reason I can't work for the Crown Prince? It's because of my qinggong that I can stay by his side."

"If I were as skilled as you, I would go wherever I wanted and do whatever I wanted."

Wen Jiao remained silent.

With his qinggong, he could indeed go anywhere he wanted; even into the depths of the imperial palace. But it wasn't true that he could do whatever he wanted.

After a long while, he muttered, "I don't have that much ability."

Yu Wan sighed.

After witnessing Wen Jiao's qinggong, she truly envied him.

"Do you get a lot of silver from working for the Crown Prince? You don't seem like the type to be greedy for money," Yu Wan said, looking around the small courtyard.

According to Wen Jiao, this was his residence in the capital. When he wasn't on duty, he lived here.

There were only three rooms in total, one kitchen, no flowers or plants, and the only persimmon tree was crooked.

The furnishings inside were extremely simple, even more modest than those of ordinary commoners.

Moreover, Wen Jiao seemed to have no particular demands for food. If it weren't for Yu Wan's daily complaints, he would have been fine eating steamed buns every meal.

Living such a life and working for the Crown Prince, it was impossible that he was doing it for the money.

"The Crown Prince gives a lot of silver."

"But you don't care about the silver. So why must you stay in the Eastern Palace?"

Why indeed?

Wen Jiao earnestly thought for a moment. "My master took me in. He worked for Her Majesty the Empress, so I work for His Highness the Crown Prince."

"Your master worked for Her Majesty the Empress?"

Master?

This was the first time Yu Wan had heard Wen Jiao mention anything about himself.

"He used to, but not anymore."

"Why did he stop working for her?"

"He messed up an assignment for Her Majesty the Empress. She was very angry, so she stopped using him."

Yu Wan's eyes flickered, sensing there was more to the story. "They say serving the ruler is like serving a tiger. If he messed up an assignment, wouldn't Her Majesty the Empress have killed him?"

They were dark guards, handling covert missions. Would the Empress let him live after a failure?

"I don't know," Wen Jiao said indifferently.

Yu Wan heard the coldness in his tone and couldn't help but ask, "He was your master. Don't you care about his life or death?"

Wen Jiao shook his head.

He didn't care about his master's life or death. After all, his master had never cared about his.

"What about your family? Do you remember them?"

Wen Jiao shook his head again.

Yu Wan had glimpsed Wen Jiao's true face in the dungeon. Half of his face was covered by a red birthmark, so he was probably abandoned at birth as an ill omen.

"Do you think I'm pitiful?" Wen Jiao suddenly asked.

Yu Wan's eyes slightly furrowed as she quickly collected her thoughts and seriously replied, "How could I? You were indeed pitiful as a child, but now you have remarkable martial arts and extraordinary qinggong. You're very impressive, not pitiful at all."

As she said this, Yu Wan sighed. "The pitiful one is me. My life hangs by a thread, and I don't know if I'll live or die."

Wen Jiao was somewhat surprised by Yu Wan's words.

She had seen his true face and now knew about his past.

In the past, everyone who knew these two things about him had only one reaction: Look, what a pitiful creature.

"If I had your abilities, all my troubles would be solved with ease."

She could sneak into the Xingguo Duke's residence like a bird, easily kill her enemy from both lives, Cui Yichu, and also take away the wealth that the Cui family had plundered from the pearl-diving households.

Then she wouldn't have to toil as a servant in the Marquis's household, earning silver coin by coin.

"Is your trouble your mother's illness?" Wen Jiao asked.

Yu Wan nodded.

"My mother fell from a mountain and has been in a coma ever since. After seeing many doctors, we found out she has a blood clot in her brain. She needs acupuncture to disperse the clot to wake up, and each acupuncture session costs five taels of silver." As she said this, Yu Wan smiled at Wen Jiao. "If I had your skills, I wouldn't have to work hard in the Marquis's household to earn monthly wages. I could get as much silver as I wanted."

The black eyes behind the mask flickered, and his tone was somewhat helpless. "I have never stolen anything."

His master had said he had a rare physique, a genius for learning qinggong. Later, his qinggong indeed became unparalleled, not inferior to the imperial guards.

But learning qinggong was not for the purpose of stealing.

"I'm not saying you do," Yu Wan coughed twice and continued boldly, "But if I were you, I definitely wouldn't work for that dog of a Crown Prince. With my skills, why would I listen to his orders?"

"What would you do then?"

"First, I would cure my mother's illness. Once she's better, I would travel the world with her, roaming far and wide. If we needed money, I would take it from the homes of corrupt officials. And it wouldn't just be for the two of us. If we met poor people like us on the road, we would share some of the money with them. So, this wouldn't be stealing; it would be robbing the rich to help the poor."

Wen Jiao seemed to laugh softly behind his mask.

No matter what Yu Wan said, it somehow made sense.

He was about to speak when he suddenly sensed something unusual in their surroundings.

chapters.title: She Has Lost Weight
chapters.content:
In the clear early autumn days, the sky was high and the clouds light.

When Yu Yuan saw Wen Ji suddenly stand up, she felt a sense of foreboding.

Before she could look around, Wen Ji's hand, like an eagle's claw, had already clamped onto her shoulder, pulling her in front of him, his fingers pressing against her throat.

However, he did not apply much force, merely pressing lightly, so Yu Yuan's breathing was not obstructed.

"Come out." Wen Ji said coldly.

Someone was here?

Yu Yuan felt a moment of confusion, followed by a surge of wild joy.

The only person who could make Wen Ji so on guard was one person.

But shouldn't he be accompanying the Emperor at the temporary palace right now?

It was impossible for him to be in the capital.

But... perhaps it was he who had sent Yuan Qian and others to rescue her. That must be it.

As Yu Yuan was lost in thought, she heard a "bang" as the courtyard door was kicked open, and a figure flew in.

In that instant, Yu Yuan saw the figure she had not seen for several days. Joy and surprise intertwined, making her emotions complex.

Zhao Xuanyou's expression was one of gloom she had never seen before, his dark eyes fixed firmly on Wen Ji.

"Let go of her."

Yu Yuan clearly felt the fingers around her neck tighten slightly. Recalling her recent interactions with Wen Ji, she quickly whispered, "The Crown Prince is neither your kin nor your friend. Why risk your life for him? Since Zhao Xuanyou has found you here, there must be people stationed outside the courtyard. You won't escape."

"I won't be captured alive." Wen Ji replied calmly.

Yu Yuan's heart jolted.

If he couldn't win and refused to be captured, did he intend to take her down with him?

No, absolutely not!

"Don't be impulsive. Zhao Xuanyou dotes on me the most. If you let me go, I can persuade him to let you off. We can both come out of this unscathed." Yu Yuan said urgently.

Before Wen Ji could respond, Yu Yuan looked up at Zhao Xuanyou in the courtyard and said loudly, "Young Master, he won't kill me. But can you let him go? He was only following orders."

Hearing her words, Zhao Xuanyou felt a surge of anger.

Wen Ji had captured her twice, yet she was still pleading for him. Did she not know how to look out for herself?

However, Yu Yuan was still in someone else's grasp, so Zhao Xuanyou had to consider her safety.

He said coldly, "I'll give you one chance to live. I'll count to three. If you don't let go, don't blame me for being merciless with my sword."

Outside the courtyard, he had arranged crossbowmen who could strike at his command at any moment.

Yu Yuan knew Zhao Xuanyou's character well; he would never yield to threats.

When he said he would count to three, he might not even wait that long before taking action.

In her urgency, she quickly said to Wen Ji, "Don't be foolish. Those who treat our lives as insignificant, but we must not belittle ourselves. Survival is what matters."

"One, two..."

Feeling that Wen Ji had no intention of letting go, Yu Yuan suddenly grabbed the hand he had around her throat.

The eyes behind the mask looked at her with surprise. Yu Yuan resolutely moved his hand away.

He had not applied much force, and at the moment Zhao Xuanyou said "three," Yu Yuan successfully broke free.

However, she did not immediately run to Zhao Xuanyou. Instead, she stood in front of Wen Ji.

"Young Master, he has let me go. Please let him leave."

Seeing Yu Yuan protecting Wen Ji, Zhao Xuanyou's worry turned entirely into anger, and his eyes darkened further.

"Come here."

Yu Yuan had spent a lot of time with Zhao Xuanyou and naturally could see his displeasure. She had done all she could for Wen Ji. Now, preserving her own life was more important.

She glanced at Wen Ji and saw him standing still with no intention of making a move. She then turned her gaze back and quickly walked towards Zhao Xuanyou.

Her dress fluttered gently in the wind, like a dancing butterfly.

Zhao Xuanyou watched her graceful figure rushing towards him. Finally, a slight smile appeared on his lips as he pulled her into his embrace.

Yu Yuan had often slept in his arms, so she was already accustomed to his embrace.

At this moment, as he held her, Zhao Xuanyou clearly felt that she had lost some weight.

He held her a little tighter, and when he looked up again, his eyes were filled with killing intent.

"Master, how did you return from Lichuan? Did His Majesty agree?" Yu Yuan nestled in his arms, wrapping her arms around his waist, clinging to him like a vine.

Hearing her soft words, the anger in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes finally dissipated somewhat.

The guards beside him were surprised to see the general, who was usually cold and stern on the battlefield, showing such tenderness.

Someone lightly coughed, and Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently, "Let's go." This was his way of sparing Wen Ji's life.

He lifted Yu Yuan horizontally and carried her out of the small courtyard.

It was only now that Yu Yuan noticed there were more than a dozen people standing outside the courtyard. If Wen Ji had insisted on harming her, he would have been riddled with arrows long ago.

A carriage was waiting in the alley. As soon as they got in, the guards drove away.

Inside the carriage, only the two of them were present, so Zhao Xuanyou did not need to restrain himself. He had Yu Yuan sit on his lap.

Yu Yuan leaned against his shoulder, still feeling lingering fear.

Zhao Xuanyou slowly rubbed her hand, his voice gentler than usual.

"Have you been staying here all these days?"

"Mmm, how did Master find this place?" Yu Yuan asked curiously.

Wen Ji was highly skilled in qinggong, and his movements were elusive. From his tone, it seemed that few people knew about this small courtyard. How had Zhao Xuanyou found her so quickly?

"I asked someone to help me investigate." Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

As soon as he returned to the capital, he had asked Mu Di to take him to visit the Duke of Ningguo.

Although the old duke was surprised that Zhao Qi had revealed the family's secrets to Zhao Xuanyou, he respected Zhao Qi's decision and told Zhao Xuanyou about a secret base of the Crown Prince that he had previously discovered.

Zhao Xuanyou immediately took his men to the brothel and tied up everyone inside, interrogating them one by one under torture.

Although the secret guards were well-trained and unafraid of death or torture, there were always exceptions. With enough people captured, there would always be one or two who could not endure the pain.

After a whole night of interrogation, someone finally revealed Wen Ji's whereabouts. Zhao Xuanyou immediately arranged for his men to surround the courtyard.

Yu Yuan saw that he was being vague and knew he would not say more. She silently admired his methods.

"Master, now that you have taken me back, will the Crown Prince be furious?"

"Don't worry, I know what I'm doing."

He had already had two secret conflicts with the Crown Prince over his own affairs, and this was still considered knowing what he was doing?

Yu Yuan felt a mix of joy and worry.

She was joyful that Zhao Xuanyou had indeed saved her again, and that she held some weight in his heart.

But she was worried that repeatedly offending the Crown Prince would not end well. The Crown Prince would not let this go easily.

He might not be able to do anything to Zhao Xuanyou for the time being, but what about her, a mere maid? Could she really come out of this unscathed?

Zhao Xuanyou did not hear her response. He looked down at her and saw her delicate little face looking worn and tired, with worry hidden in her beautiful eyes. He said indifferently, "If I dared to come, I naturally am not afraid of him."

Of course, you're not afraid.

Yu Yuan grumbled softly in her heart.

Seeing her lack of energy, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly said, "There's good news. Do you want to hear it?"

---

chapters.title: Warmth
chapters.content:
"What good news?" Yu Yuan perked up at his words, smiling at him. "I don't believe there's any news better than Master coming to save me."

"Is that so?" Even after being locked up for five or six days, her mouth was still as sweet as honey.

Zhao Xuanyou pinched her chin and passionately kissed her soft lips until she was almost out of breath before letting go.

"The Taoran Inn sent word that your mother opened her eyes yesterday."

Her mother opened her eyes?

Yu Yuan almost jumped out of Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

"My mother woke up?"

Seeing Yu Yuan's uncontainable excitement, Zhao Xuanyou humphed lightly. "Didn't you say there's no news better than me coming to save you?"

Yu Yuan was rendered speechless by his retort. She opened her mouth, then closed it, and snuggled back against him.

"They're both good news. My mother's safety is important, and my rescue is important too."

Zhao Xuanyou curved his lips slightly and said softly, "She hasn't fully woken up yet. She only opened her eyes for a while in her coma. Chen Da Niu has already called a doctor to see her. He said it's a good sign. Before long, your mother will wake up completely."

The last time Yu Yuan went to Taoran Inn, her mother had only moved her fingers. This time, she could open her eyes, which was indeed better than before.

Unfortunately, the first person her mother saw when she opened her eyes was not her.

If only she could have been by her mother's side all along.

Yu Yuan's eyes could not help but fill with tears.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze fell on her downcast eyes. He hugged her and patted her arm.

His birth mother had passed away early, so he naturally understood Yu Yuan's feelings.

Zhao Xuanyou's embrace was warm and solid. Yu Yuan took the opportunity to plead, "Master, can I go to Taoran Inn now? I want to visit my mother. Maybe she will open her eyes again today."

"No."

Hearing his refusal, Yu Yuan could not help but be surprised.

"I can't be seen in the capital. We must leave immediately."

"Did Master sneak out of Lichuan?" Yu Yuan was even more surprised. "What if someone finds out? Won't Master be in trouble?"

Zhao Xuanyou had actually taken such a big risk for her. It was truly hard for Yu Yuan to believe.

"I left Lichuan openly and honestly. It's just that I shouldn't be in the capital right now. I should be in Heishui County."

"Heishui County?"

Seeing Yu Yuan's curiosity, Zhao Xuanyou told her about how he and Pei Ta had received an imperial decree to go to Heishui County to suppress a rebellion.

"That's a flawless plan. It's impressive that Director Pei could come up with such a brilliant strategy."

Hearing Yu Yuan's praise for Pei Ta, Zhao Xuanyou felt somewhat displeased.

Even if Pei Ta had not helped, he would have come up with a strategy himself.

Yu Yuan, unaware of his thoughts, asked again, "So Master is going to Heishui County now?"

"Mmm." Yin Ping was currently impersonating him. With Zhao Qi and Pei Ta covering for him, he should not be exposed.

But the Crown Prince was now his sworn enemy. Everything had to be done carefully to avoid giving the Crown Prince a handle. The sooner he returned to Heishui County, the better.

"And me? Should I return to the Marquis's residence?"

"Why would you return there? The Marquis's residence is in chaos now. Come with me to Heishui County."

In chaos?

At Zhao Xuanyou's mention, Yu Yuan finally remembered her life-and-death struggle with the mad Baozhen in the dungeon.

After being away for so many days, Baozhen's body should have been discovered by now.

Seeing Yu Yuan's troubled expression, Zhao Xuanyou asked with interest, "What guilty thing did you do?"

"Master knows about Baozhen already..."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

He had already heard about it. Over the past few days, while busy searching for Yu Yuan, he had only sent someone back to the residence to assist the Old Madame in handling Baozhen's body.

Old Madame Ye knew that the dungeon of the Marquis's residence could not be made public. At that time, she only allowed Madame Xing to go and check. Although Madame Xing was shocked to see Baozhen's body, she did not spread the news and only reported it to Old Madame Ye.

Therefore, within the Marquis's residence, only Old Madame Ye, Madame Xing, and Manager Song knew about Baozhen's death.

To prevent complications, Zhao Xuanyou ordered that the body in the dungeon be disposed of quietly. It was announced to the outside that Baozhen had become a fugitive slave, thus ending the matter.

"People said Baozhen was holding an axe. Although you are stronger, can your bare hands stop an axe?"

"Of course not." Yu Yuan had fought for her life against Baozhen that night and had almost died in the dungeon. Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's mocking tone, she said with lingering fear, "I almost died under her axe. At that time, Wen Ji wanted to escape and stretched out his hand to block Baozhen's axe with the iron chain. Only then did I have the chance to knock Baozhen down. I was so scared. When I came to my senses, she was already dead."

Strangling Baozhen was less about revenge and more about the instinct for survival.

Yu Yuan dared to kill chickens and ducks, but when it came to killing a person with her own hands, she simply could not do it.

She let out a long sigh and leaned back into Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

"I never thought I would kill someone..."

"Are you afraid?"

Yu Yuan shook her head.

"It's not fear, just a strange feeling."

Yu Yuan clearly remembered Baozhen's expression as she died.

She had stared at her intently. At first, there was anger, then fear, and then her gaze gradually scattered until no emotion could be discerned.

In her previous life, it was Baozhen who had killed Yu Yuan.

She had soaked a cotton quilt in water and smothered Yu Yuan to death with it.

Through the quilt, she could not see Yu Yuan's face.

Perhaps, at that time, the Yu Yuan under the quilt had the same expression as Baozhen.

This was karma, the cycle of cause and effect.

But... unlike the joy she felt when she learned about the deaths of Madame Zhou and Baozhu, Yu Yuan's feelings were complicated.

(Note: The current chapter is not yet complete. Please click on the next page to continue reading the following exciting content.)

"Baozhen was an evil person. Her death was well-deserved. Dying in the dungeon was already letting her off easy. You need not feel guilty."

Guilty?

Yu Yuan did not feel guilty.

Taking someone's life with her own hands, even if that person was the enemy who had caused her tragic death in her past life, was not something she could easily let go.

Cui Yichu, Madame Zhou, Baozhen, and Baozhu were all evil people who took lives wantonly. They did evil without remorse, and for their own desires, they easily took the lives of others.

The fact that she felt heavy-hearted did not mean she was weak. It meant she was not like them; evil people who did countless evils.

She was different from them. She should not be sad; she should be happy.

"Hmm?" Seeing that Yu Yuan was still in a daze, Zhao Xuanyou gently shook her a couple of times.

Yu Yuan turned her head and looked up at him with a smile.

Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched slightly.

After being locked up for several days, her face was worn and tired, and without any makeup, she looked truly pitiful. But when she smiled, her worn-out little face came to life.

Even Zhao Xuanyou, with his heart of stone, could not help but be moved.

"One moment you're crying, the next you're laughing. I don't know what you're going through."

"I don't want to go through anything," Yu Yuan laughed lazily, leaning against his broad shoulder and closing her eyes to doze off peacefully. "I don't want to live in fear anymore."

Seeing her exhausted appearance, Zhao Xuanyou understood that her days in captivity must have been sleepless.

"Are you not afraid now?"

"With Master here, what do I have to be afraid of?" Yu Yuan yawned and wrapped her arms around Zhao Xuanyou's neck.

He had come to save her. She no longer had to live in constant tension day and night.

The bustling streets of the capital, the sounds of vendors and conversations, light and heavy, were like the melodious tunes her mother used to sing. They lulled Yu Yuan into a drowsy state.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at the sleeping Yu Yuan in his arms and fell into deep thought.

chapters.title: Welcoming Banquet
chapters.content:
With Baochuan’s corpse destroyed, the turmoil seemed to have subsided on the surface, but doubts lingered beneath.

The underground prison behind Honghui Hall was a secret place in the Marquis’s estate. Apart from Zhao Xuanyou and his trusted guards, only Grandmother Ye and Steward Song knew of its existence.

Before Yuan Qing left, he had instructed Yu Ying to deliver meals to Wen Shang in the prison; a highly confidential matter.

Yet neither Grandmother Ye nor Steward Song knew how Baochuan had found out.

That night, Baochuan had appeared in the prison with an axe in hand, clearly not by chance but with the intent to harm Yu Ying.

Unless Baochuan had been hiding near Honghui Hall every day, secretly monitoring Yu Ying and following her all the way to the prison… but this assumption was unreasonable.

Everyone in the Marquis’s estate recognized Baochuan and knew she had been punished to do the lowest menial labor. With her current status, if she lingered near Honghui Hall daily, how could no one have noticed?

After a moment’s contemplation, Zhao Xuanyou had reached a conclusion; someone had been secretly watching Yu Ying, reporting her movements to Baochuan, and instigating her to commit violence in the prison. Who could that person be?

There were few in the world who wished Yu Ying dead. Counting them, only Cui Yichu came to mind.

Cui Yichu’s attendants in the Marquis’s estate had already been dismissed by Zhao Xuanyou, leaving only Baochuan behind. But Cui Yichu had been the Worldly Prince’s wife for a year; perhaps there were still those in the estate she had promoted. At this thought, a cold glint flickered in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes.

He had already shown great mercy by allowing her to divorce and return home, yet she still refused to behave. Not only had she sent people to Yunshui Nunnery to find Yu Ying’s mother, but she had also extended her reach into the Marquis’s estate.

This, he would not tolerate.

Unfortunately, Zhao Zun was causing trouble for him, so he needed to take Yu Ying to Heishui Town as soon as possible.

The task of investigating the true culprit would have to be left to Steward Song.

After passing through the city gates, Zhao Xuanyou abandoned the carriage.

Yu Ying awoke in his arms, rubbing her sleepy eyes before steadying herself on the ground with his help, though her legs felt weak.

Seeing several fine horses outside the city, she asked in surprise, “Master, are we to travel by horse?”

Zhao Xuanyou gave a faint “mm” in response, mounting the horse before stretching out his long arm to lift Yu Ying onto its back.

Having traveled to Lichuan together before, Yu Ying was already familiar with finding a comfortable riding position.

However, she failed to notice how the man behind her swallowed slightly as she adjusted her posture.

“Are you seated comfortably?” Zhao Xuanyou asked in a low voice, his tone slightly hoarse.

Hearing the unusual note in his voice, Yu Ying, exhausted from the past few days, didn’t dwell on it and simply replied obediently, “Yes, I’m seated comfortably.”

Zhao Xuanyou did his best to suppress the restlessness she had stirred in him, ordering most of the guards to return to the capital to assist Steward Song in uncovering the traitor in the estate. He took only two guards with him.

His stand-in, Yin Ping, was far away in Heishui County. This journey required secrecy, so he couldn’t bring too many people.

As dusk approached, Zhao Xuanyou gripped the reins tightly and led the way toward Heishui County. The journey was a hundred miles farther than to Lichuan, and even with day-and-night travel, it took six days and six nights to reach the city’s outskirts. Upon arrival, the fine horse Zhao Xuanyou rode was so exhausted it collapsed. He ordered his attendants to enter the city first to send word, while he and Yu Ying led the horse to the river to drink.

Before long, Yin Ping arrived at the riverside with the Marquis’s guards.

Seeing Yu Ying, smiling and radiant, beside Zhao Xuanyou, Yin Ping knew the journey had been successful. He cupped his fists and said, “Miss Yu Ying’s safe return is a joyous occasion. The Worldly Prince has worked hard.”

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod and asked, “Has Heishui been peaceful these past few days? Has anyone suspected your identity?”

Yin Ping replied respectfully, “The Worldly Prince need not worry. After arriving in Heishui County, I immediately feigned illness and stayed indoors. The bandit suppression and pacification efforts were all handled by Seventh Prince and Minister Pei. No one has seen my true appearance.”

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. “You’ve done well.”

Yin Ping had already changed back into his guard’s attire and no longer needed to disguise himself.

After briefly inquiring about the situation in Heishui County, Zhao Xuanyou took Yu Ying to the county yamen.

The Heishui County uprising had begun when the common people revolted, surrounding the yamen with weapons. The county magistrate, who had long been tyrannical and corrupt, had fled in such a panic that he abandoned even his wives, concubines, and children.

The enraged villagers killed his family, and knowing that storming the yamen was a serious crime, they looted its wealth and grain before occupying the mountains as bandits. Zhao Qi and Pei Ta had been ordered to eliminate these very bandits.

“Where are Seventh Prince and Minister Pei at the moment?” Zhao Xuanyou asked upon entering the yamen.

Yin Ping replied, “Upon learning of Master Zhao and Miss Yu Ying’s return, Seventh Prince and Minister Pei are currently in the back kitchen preparing a feast. Please follow me.”

“Preparing a feast? That’s too much trouble!” Yu Ying said, feeling honored yet uneasy. She turned to Zhao Xuanyou and, seeing his calm expression, said no more and obediently followed.

Though Heishui County was far from the capital and not rich in resources, the yamen was built with considerable grandeur.

After passing through several halls and courtyards, they finally reached the inner residence.

“Yu Ying!” Before she could see anyone, Yu Ying heard Zhao Qi’s voice.

Entering the warm pavilion, she saw Zhao Qi sitting upright in a black martial robe.

Though they were reunited, Yu Ying did not forget propriety and respectfully greeted him, “This servant greets Your Highness.”

Zhao Qi, seeing Yu Ying’s worn face and slender figure, yet with eyes brighter than before, couldn’t help but sigh. “You’re truly remarkable. Captured twice by the Eastern Palace and escaped both times! No one in the world has such skill.”

Yu Ying, embarrassed, said, “This servant has no skill. It was only thanks to Your Highness and the Worldly Prince’s blessings that I escaped twice.”

“Was it the same person who captured you both times?” Zhao Qi asked, as if remembering something.

Yu Ying nodded.

Zhao Qi said angrily, “If I had known this would happen, I should have killed him when we caught him! Didn’t I say we needed to uproot the problem entirely? A moment of soft-heartedness nearly let that bastard Zhao Zun succeed!”

He cursed freely, but Zhao Xuanyou gave a light cough, his gaze turning cold. The Crown Prince was still the Crown Prince; speaking his name so loudly and directly was disrespectful. Even as a prince, Zhao Qi could be charged with a serious offense if overheard.

“What’s wrong with cursing a little?”

“Disaster comes from the mouth. Some things need not be shouted all the time.”

“Fine, I won’t say it anymore.” Zhao Qi stopped awkwardly and walked out.

Yu Ying, confused by his sudden departure, looked at Yin Ping in bewilderment. “Why did His Highness leave?”

Yin Ping smiled. “When we arrived, the yamen was empty. Minister Pei went into town to hire two women to cook and clean, but their skills were poor. Minister Pei, thinking of Master Zhao and Miss Yu Ying’s arrival, personally went into the kitchen to prepare a meal to welcome you both.”

Yu Ying couldn’t help but smile.

She wasn’t surprised that Pei Ta could cook, but Zhao Qi? Could he cook?

Yin Ping seemed to notice her confusion and smiled. “His Highness is indeed not good at cooking, but he said he would be in charge of stoking the fire tonight.”

“His Highness is stoking the fire?” Yu Ying rolled up her sleeves. “Let me go take a look. Maybe I can help so we can eat sooner.”

Zhao Xuanyou had just sat down to drink tea when he saw Yu Ying dash out of the pavilion. His sword-like brows furrowed slightly, and a flicker of displeasure crossed his eyes.

Exiting the warm pavilion and walking about ten steps to the left, they reached the kitchen.

When Yin Ping had led them past earlier, Yu Ying hadn’t expected Pei Ta to be busy inside.

Before even stepping in, she saw a slender figure standing by the stove from the doorway.

It had been many days since she last saw him, but Pei Ta still had the same refined and jade-like appearance.

He wore a light blue long robe, his hair tied with a jade crown, his demeanor elegant and graceful.

Yet in his hand was not a brush or book, but a spatula.

He stood before the stove, stirring the dish with the spatula.

Though the kitchen was filled with smoke, his movements exuded a scholarly elegance, as if he were painting with a brush rather than cooking.

“Your Highness, Minister Pei,” Yu Ying said with a smile as she entered the kitchen. “Is there anything left unwashed or uncut? Let this servant help.”

Pei Ta, hearing her voice, looked up and paused on her for a moment. Seeing she was unharmed, he gave a slight nod.

“Miss Yu Ying, you’ve traveled a long way and must be tired. Go to the warm pavilion for some tea and rest.”

“Then let me help set the bowls.” Yu Ying looked around for dishes and chopsticks. Seeing Zhao Qi sitting by the stove, his eyebrows knitted from the smoke, she hurried over and pulled him up. “Has Your Highness’s eyes been irritated by the smoke? Go outside for some fresh air. This servant will tend the fire.”

“I… I’m fine.”

Zhao Qi refused to admit it.

He had carelessly let the smoke irritate his eyes, and tears had streamed down.

Yu Ying saw his reddened eyes and knew he had been affected. She quickly fetched clean water and wiped his eyes for him.

“Your Highness, are you alright?” Yu Ying asked with concern.

Zhao Qi didn’t want to appear weak in front of Pei Ta and Yu Ying, but his eyes really couldn’t stay open. He had to admit in a low voice, “I… I’m a little tired. I’ll rest at the door for a while.”

“Alright.” Yu Ying didn’t expose him. She helped him sit on a small stool at the door and handed him a damp handkerchief to cover his eyes and ease the pain.

With Zhao Qi unable to tend the fire, Pei Ta no longer objected to Yu Ying’s help.

“I had intended to welcome you with a feast, but now I’ve made you dirty,” Pei Ta said gently.

Yu Ying laughed. “Actually, tending the fire isn’t tiring at all. When I was a child, I loved tending the fire the most.”

The village houses were simple, unlike the Marquis’s estate with its heated floors and warm pots. In winter, sitting by the stove was the warmest place.

Whenever her mother cooked, she would call Yu Ying to sit by the stove to warm herself and watch the fire.

Seeing Pei Ta cooking, Yu Ying added a few pieces of firewood to the stove to make the fire burn more strongly.

“Was everything smooth in the capital? Was anyone injured?” Pei Ta asked.

“Minister Pei, rest assured. Everything went smoothly. No one was injured, and no one died. Even the Eastern Palace’s shadow guard is still alive,” Yu Ying replied.

“Oh?” Pei Ta was slightly surprised. “You mean the shadow guard who captured you is still alive?”

Yu Ying nodded.

Pei Ta was quite astonished.

In Lichuan, he had personally witnessed the intense killing intent and hatred in Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes.

Yet after finding Yu Ying, he had not killed the shadow guard to vent his anger. This restraint was beyond Pei Ta’s expectations.

“He is the Crown Prince’s man. Even if captured, we might not get anything out of him,” Pei Ta mused.

“Worldly Prince didn’t capture him,” Yu Ying’s next words surprised Pei Ta even more.

“Didn’t capture him?”

“He let me go, so Worldly Prince let him go too.”

So that was how it was.

Zhao Xuanyou’s depth was truly unfathomable.

He had twice snatched Yu Ying back from the Crown Prince’s hands, yet had not harmed a single soldier or officer of the Crown Prince. His actions were flawless and silent.

The Crown Prince had suffered two setbacks, yet his reputation remained unharmed, preventing an immediate confrontation.

“Minister Pei, the meat in the pot is burning!” Yu Ying had stoked the fire too strongly, and Pei Ta, lost in thought, had stopped stirring, causing a burnt smell to rise from the pot.

At this moment, Zhao Qi, whose eyes were no longer stinging, walked in with a pained expression and asked impatiently, “How many more dishes are left?”

“The stir-fry is done. I’ll go check on the last soup,” Pei Ta replied.

Zhao Qi sniffed and also smelled the burnt scent. “What is that? It smells terrible!”

Yu Ying found his exaggerated reaction both amusing and helpless.

This young prince had probably never eaten burnt food before.

No, not just never eaten; he had probably never even seen it.

“The vinegar-stirred pork slices are a bit burnt. Your Highness, be careful when eating,” Yu Ying gently reminded him.

Zhao Qi still didn’t quite understand what “burnt” meant, but seeing Yu Ying’s smiling expression, he vaguely realized he had made a fool of himself and stopped dwelling on the smell.

“The stir-fry is done, so I’ll take it over first.” Zhao Qi volunteered to carry the dish.

Yu Ying saw that Pei Ta was no longer cooking, so she reduced the firewood in the stove.

“Minister Pei, is there anything else that needs help?”

“The soup should be almost done. Could you chop some green onions?”

“Alright.” Yu Ying quickly picked some green onions, washed them, and sliced them into strips before bringing them to Pei Ta.

Pei Ta had already ladled out the soup; a chicken soup made with fresh mushrooms, fragrant and inviting.

He glanced at the green onions in Yu Ying’s hand and pinched a few strands into the soup bowl.

For some reason, the distinct green and white onions in the soup made it look even more appetizing, as if they were the final touch to a painting.

“Minister Pei, you’re truly amazing,” Yu Ying sincerely praised.

“Amazing in what way?” Pei Ta turned to look at her.

“Your handwriting is beautiful, and the food you make looks just as beautiful.” Yu Ying even felt as if he were painting with the green onions in the soup.

Hearing her mention the calligraphy, Pei Ta’s eyes flickered. “Is that calligraphy book still useful?”

“Yes, I practice from it every day. Unfortunately, I only managed half a month before all those things happened,” Yu Ying said, a hint of regret in her voice.

“It’s fine. With your talent, wasting a little time doesn’t matter.”

“My talent is nothing compared to Minister Pei’s.”

He was, after all, the top scholar, the cleverest man under heaven.

“How could that be?” Pei Ta smiled. “Yu Ying, your aptitude is extraordinary. My wife, who is usually proud and aloof, holds you in high regard.”

“Does Madame Pei think I’m clever?” A flicker of joy passed through Yu Ying’s eyes.

Pei Ta nodded.

Sun Qianran had also praised Yu Ying before, but her tone was always indifferent, so Yu Ying had assumed it was just a polite remark. But hearing Pei Ta say this, she believed it and couldn’t help but smile.

“Then I will definitely practice hard and not let Madame Pei down.”

The two were standing very close, and for the first time, Yu Ying examined Pei Ta from such a near distance.

His features were perfectly refined, from his forehead, brow bones, eyes, nose, lips, to his chin, every part was flawlessly proportioned.

Every time she stood before him, Yu Ying couldn’t help but feel a little inferior.

How could there truly be such a perfect man in this mundane world?

Recalling how he and Sun Qianran had looked as a loving couple in the imperial palace, Yu Ying couldn’t help but think that it was cruel of heaven to make Madame Pei’s body so frail.

Yu Ying secretly resolved that the next time she went to the temple, she would pray for Minister Pei and Madame Pei, wishing them a long and happy life together, and that Minister Pei’s life would be smooth and fulfilling.

“Are there any more dishes to bring out?” Zhao Qi burst in again.

“There’s still one soup,” Yu Ying had just spoken when she saw Zhao Xuanyou, his face as cold as water, following behind Zhao Qi.

chapters.title: Drunk
chapters.content:
Yu Wan saw Zhao Xuanyou also entering the kitchen and thought he was hungry, so she quickly took the chicken soup from the stove.

"Your Highness, please take a seat first. I'll fetch the bowls and chopsticks," Pei Ta said, turning to get the bowls and chopsticks from the nearby cabinet.

Zhao Xuanyou followed Yu Wan, then suddenly asked, "What were you two talking about just now?"

You two?

Yu Wan was taken aback, then realized he was asking about her conversation with Pei Ta.

"Lord Pei was asking about things in the capital," Yu Wan replied.

"What did you say?"

"Everything went smoothly, no one was injured."

Zhao Xuanyou wanted to ask more, but Zhao Qi rushed over, running ahead of them and sitting down first.

Zhao Xuanyou said no more and sat down next to Zhao Qi.

Yu Wan stood by, and seeing the wine pot on the table, she poured wine for them.

Zhao Qi glanced at her, snatched the wine pot from her hand, and said, "Why are you standing here? Today is to welcome you, so sit down quickly."

"Should I sit down too?" Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou, and seeing no reaction from him, she sat down beside him.

Eating at the same table as Zhao Xuanyou was common, but eating with people from another residence was a first.

Soon, Pei Ta brought in bowls and chopsticks and distributed them to everyone.

"It's been a long time since I cooked, my skills are rusty, and I've delayed the meal. I hope you can forgive me."

Zhao Xuanyou indifferently said, "Lord Pei has good intentions."

The table was set with home-cooked dishes: braised tofu, fried dried tofu with meat, glutinous rice meatballs, and the overcooked sweet and sour pork slices along with the chicken soup Yu Wan had brought.

"Much better than the food cooked by those two old women," Zhao Qi, who had been busy in the kitchen for a long time and had his eyes smoked, was already starving.

Without further ado, he picked up his bowl and started eating.

Zhao Xuanyou was unusually silent tonight, only moving his chopsticks without saying a word, so Yu Wan naturally ate in silence as well.

Perhaps it was because she had been traveling day and night, or perhaps Pei Ta's cooking was indeed excellent. Apart from the overcooked sweet and sour pork slices, the other dishes were quite delicious. She ate two bowls of rice and couldn't help but drink a bowl of chicken soup.

Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta remained silent. It wasn't until Zhao Qi had eaten his fill and put down his chopsticks to talk to Yu Wan that the atmosphere at the table gradually became harmonious.

Zhao Qi, with the heart of a young man, after eating and drinking his fill, told Yu Wan about a tavern on the street that had excellent rice wine, and also mentioned that the lamb skewers next to it were delicious, wanting to take her to buy some.

"Go ahead, rice wine is a specialty of Heishui County, I'd like to try it too," Zhao Xuanyou said.

Yu Wan responded with a "Yes" and left with Zhao Qi. With Yin Ping and Mu Di following, it was fine.

Only Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta remained in the warm hall.

Night fell, and outside was a dark sky with a few scattered stars.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Pei Ta beside him and asked in a deep voice, "With Lord Pei's abilities, I suppose the troubles in Heishui County have been mostly handled."

Counting the days, Pei Ta and Zhao Qi had been in Heishui for ten days.

"The mountain bandits are nothing to fear. The Seventh Prince personally led troops there and broke their gate in a day, capturing all of them," Pei Ta replied.

Although this trip was to temper Zhao Qi, considering it was his first official mission, the emperor had assigned him elite soldiers.

The mountain bandits were not originally vicious; they were just common people forced up the mountain. How could they be a match for the imperial army? They were all captured in a day.

"All of them were captured?"

"A dozen or so leaders were captured, the rest were locked up in the stronghold."

The county magistrate had long since fled, and the runners who could escape had all scattered. The remaining ones were killed by angry villagers. If they were to bring all the people into the city, it would only cause chaos.

Zhao Xuanyou naturally approved of Pei Ta's approach and asked again, "I suppose Lord Pei has already interrogated the leaders?"

Pei Ta's gaze flickered slightly.

Seeing his reaction, Zhao Xuanyou knew he had found some clues: "Could there be more to it?"

"The situation is not much different from what we thought before coming. Heishui County is not rich in resources, and there have been droughts for several years. Although the court has reduced taxes, that Magistrate Lin not only did not reduce them but also ordered the people to pay double taxes."

Zhao Xuanyou looked directly at Pei Ta, hitting the nail on the head: "So, what is it that troubles Lord Pei?"

"Yesterday, the Seventh Prince sent people to thoroughly search the mountain stronghold and found some gold, silver, and jade artifacts. I interrogated the bandit leaders and learned that when they raided the county office, they found these treasures in the magistrate's storage room."

"What's special about them?"

"Among them were four brocade boxes, bearing the emblem of the Zhen Guo Duke's residence."

The Zhen Guo Duke's residence?

Zhao Xuanyou was slightly surprised.

He had thought that the matters in Heishui County were just ordinary official business. After dealing with the corrupt official, calming the people's anger, and punishing the main culprits who raided the county office and killed the innocent, it would be settled.

Who would have thought that this small Heishui County magistrate was connected to the Zhen Guo Duke's residence?

That was the maternal home of the Empress and the Crown Princess.

"How does Lord Pei plan to handle this?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a deep voice.

"Since the items have been found, we naturally cannot pretend nothing happened. Moreover, the items are in the Seventh Prince's hands. Even if you and I have objections, our words won't count."

On the day they parted in Lichuan, Pei Ta and Zhao Xuanyou learned that Zhao Qi suspected the Empress had killed his birth mother. The Ningguo Duke's residence had long been enemies with the Zhen Guo Duke's residence.

Now that they had such a handle, Zhao Qi would certainly not let it go.

"Has Magistrate Lin been found?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

A hint of disdain flashed in Pei Ta's eyes: "He abandoned his wife and children and fled quickly. He is already in Weizhou."

Weizhou was more than thirty miles away from Heishui County; he had indeed escaped quickly.

Zhao Xuanyou pondered for a moment, then slowly said, "Those boxes with emblems can barely be considered evidence, but to deal with the Zhen Guo Duke's residence, we need a witness."

Pei Ta immediately understood: "I will send someone to capture him immediately."

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou's words made Pei Ta's gaze flicker, and then he realized.

"This person is very important. If we send an official document to Weizhou to arrest him, it will alert the enemy. The Zhen Guo Duke's residence might silence him."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded: "Instead, send someone to deliver a message saying that the mountain bandits have been eliminated and we will be leaving soon. As he is still the magistrate of Heishui County, he should return quickly to manage affairs."

"Good."

"Tomorrow, I will go to the mountain stronghold to see if there are any overlooked clues."

"With Lord Zhao personally going, it will naturally be foolproof."

The two men drank a few cups of wine under the cover of night and chatted about the customs and people of Heishui County. As the effects of the alcohol grew stronger, Zhao Qi and Yu Wan finally returned to the county office.

"Worldly Son, Lord Pei, we've bought the rice wine. Would you like to try some?" Yu Wan asked.

Zhao Xuanyou slightly furrowed his brows: "Why did it take so long?"

Yu Wan felt a little embarrassed.

Originally, they only planned to buy rice wine, but they encountered a street performer on the market street, and Zhao Qi pulled her to watch for a long time.

"Lord Zhao and Yu Wan have traveled day and night; you should rest early tonight. Yuan Zhen, take them to their room."

"Yes."

Yuan Zhen respectfully stepped forward and led them to a spacious courtyard.

The night was deep, and it was quiet all around, with occasional bird calls carried by the wind from afar.

Before entering the house, Zhao Xuanyou dismissed Yuan Zhen, then with one hand around Yu Wan's waist and the other closing the door.

His fingertip inadvertently touched Yu Wan's cheek, which was quite hot.

Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but frown: "Are you drunk?"

---

chapters.title: Who is Good-Looking
chapters.content:
"Drunk?" Yu Wan felt quite sober and argued, "Impossible, I only had two bowls of rice wine."

The people of Heishui County were simple and honest. Seeing that Yu Wan wanted to buy rice wine, the shopkeeper scooped two full bowls for her to try, saying the taste was different and needed to be savored.

Coincidentally, Yu Wan had not drunk any water after finishing her meal and was a bit thirsty, so she drank both bowls clean.

Under the orange-yellow candlelight in the room, Zhao Xuanyou clearly saw the faint blush on Yu Wan's face, her eyes somewhat misty and confused, looking even more pitiful than usual.

Zhao Xuanyou patiently carried her behind the screen.

"Are you stupid? Rice wine tastes sweet, but it's stronger than ordinary wine."

"Really?" Yu Wan had never drunk rice wine before. It tasted like rice soup, cool and refreshing, with a sweet and sour flavor. It didn't burn the throat like strong liquor, but it had a strong kick?

Yu Wan didn't believe it.

"Master, I'm going to fetch water." Yu Wan struggled out of his arms.

After traveling for several days, Yu Wan had been thinking that once she arrived in Heishui County, she would take a good bath.

Zhao Xuanyou touched her increasingly hot cheek and, seeing her trying to be strong, simply let go of her.

Yu Wan hadn't taken two steps when she felt dizzy and lightheaded, stumbling to the side.

"Hmph."

Zhao Xuanyou had never seen her drunk before. He coldly watched from the side, and just as Yu Wan's head was about to hit the screen, he swiftly pulled her back into his arms.

"Like a drunkard."

He said that, but Zhao Xuanyou didn't let her fall.

"Why can't I stand steadily all of a sudden?" Yu Wan asked in confusion, clearly feeling quite sober.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her with disdain: "You're this drunk, go to sleep early."

"I haven't bathed yet," Yu Wan mumbled, her nose letting out a soft hum.

"Fine, then wash."

There was a large bathtub in the room, which seemed spacious enough for both of them.

Zhao Xuanyou called Yuan Zhen to fetch water, then carried Yu Wan to the beauty couch by the window and began to undo her outer garments.

Yu Wan's face was rosy, like she had applied rouge.

If they were at the Marquis's residence, Zhao Xuanyou would certainly have someone bring her a bowl of sobering soup. But here in Heishui County, where even meals had to be cooked themselves, there were no such conditions.

He touched Yu Wan's cheek, which was slightly hot but soft and tender, making him reluctant to let go.

Yu Wan let him pinch her face, her beautiful, drunk eyes looking at him sideways.

"Is Master going to bathe tonight too?"

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm."

Both of them had been traveling day and night, and indeed, they were both quite dirty.

He thought about it; the two of them had never bathed together in a tub before. It would have been a good opportunity to enjoy, but unfortunately, Yu Wan was so drunk that if she soaked in the tub for too long, she might pass out.

Soon, Yuan Zhen had drawn the water and discreetly exited.

Zhao Xuanyou carried Yu Wan to the bathtub. Since she was drunk and unaware, he simply washed her and carried her back to the couch.

By the time Zhao Xuanyou had finished washing himself and sat back down on the couch, a pair of dark eyes were staring at him from inside the mosquito net.

"Thought you were asleep? Not sleepy?"

Yu Wan, drunk, looked particularly obedient. Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's question, she pursed her lips and smiled but did not speak.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze lingered on her face, quietly appreciating her for a moment before lifting the blanket and lying down beside her. A long-lost feeling suddenly arose.

Ever since the Crown Prince had taken a fancy to Yu Wan, the peaceful days between Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan had been disrupted. It had been a long time since they had such a quiet moment lying together.

Yu Wan had left, and every night in Lichuan was difficult to sleep through.

To be honest, it wasn't a bad thing that Yu Wan had been taken away by Wen Qiao. If Yu Wan had been safely staying at the Marquis's residence, when the Eastern Palace attendants came to take her, his grandmother would have handed Yu Wan over.

He wasn't afraid of Zhao Zun playing dirty, but he was afraid of him playing openly.

If she really entered the Eastern Palace, he would have no way to get Yu Wan out.

It was a blessing in disguise that Wen Qiao had helped greatly.

He took a deep breath, forcefully pushing these worries out of his mind.

On such a peaceful night, just thinking about him was a mood killer.

Seeing him lost in thought, Yu Wan stretched out her dazzlingly white arm from the blanket, her fingers gently landing on his brow, as if trying to smooth it out.

Her eyes were still misty, her hair spread out on the pillow, with only a strand resting on her shoulder, making her collarbone appear even more white and delicate.

Although Zhao Xuanyou wasn't drunk, he had also drunk a lot tonight. Seeing her charming appearance, he felt the blood in his body heating up, and he reached out to hold her.

He couldn't be without her every night, yet they had been forcefully separated for so long.

Yu Wan, with her drunk eyes, only recognized that he was Zhao Xuanyou. Falling into his burning embrace, her heartbeat became even more chaotic.

She furrowed her delicate brows, and when he finally let go of her, she softly called out, "Worldly Son."

After traveling for several days and then exerting himself with her, Zhao Xuanyou didn't plan to do much tonight.

"Go to sleep, it's late."

For some reason, Yu Wan, who was clearly drunk, seemed quite energetic now.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou ignoring her, she propped herself up and lay on her side, staring at him.

Zhao Xuanyou closed his eyes for a while, feeling the movement beside him, and opened them again.

Seeing her staring at him as if he were a stranger, he couldn't help but ask, "What? Don't recognize me when you're drunk?"

Yu Wan gave him a silly smile, reaching out to touch his brow.

"Worldly Son, your face is really good-looking."

Yu Wan had always been obedient in front of him, like a flower that understood human speech, only saying things that pleased him.

But Zhao Xuanyou knew that her obedient demeanor carried some element of forced compliance.

She flattered him only because he was the Worldly Son, and she was a concubine.

But now... she was drunk.

At this moment, Yu Wan was showing a side of herself that she rarely revealed.

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly felt a stir in his heart. The drowsiness that had been building up instantly vanished, and he became wide awake.

"Where do I look good?"

Hearing his words, Yu Wan still smiled silly, tilting her head to stare at him.

After a moment, she stretched out her slender, onion-like fingers and pointed at his forehead, nose, cheeks, thin lips, and chin, murmuring, "Here, here, here, here..."

Zhao Xuanyou was naturally very pleased, but the scene of her and Pei Ta standing side by side in the kitchen at dinner time came to his mind.

From a distance, he saw Yu Wan looking up at Pei Ta with admiration in her eyes.

"Do you think Pei Ta is good-looking?" he asked.

Hearing his words, Yu Wan paused for a moment, then grinned, "Good-looking."

This unhesitating answer instantly ignited Zhao Xuanyou's anger.

However, he had long since cultivated the ability to hide his emotions. Even though his heart was surging with waves, his face remained calm.

Yu Wan, tired from lying on her side, flipped over and lay on the pillow, slightly narrowing her eyes.

Zhao Xuanyou's throat felt dry. After a moment, he turned his head, his gaze fixed on Yu Wan beside him, his tone casual.

"Is it me who is good-looking, or is it Pei Ta?"

---

chapters.title: Can't Figure Her Out
chapters.content:
Yu Wan listened to Zhao Xuanyou's words, her gaze blankly fixed on him.

Zhao Xuanyou, seeing that she wasn't answering, began to suspect whether she was truly drunk or just pretending.

But when he reached out to touch her cheek, it was still hot and soft, and her breath carried the scent of alcohol, clearly indicating she was genuinely drunk.

"Can't think of it?" Zhao Xuanyou asked again in that casual tone, but his eyes were fixed tightly on Yu Wan.

Seeing her look distressed, Zhao Xuanyou's heart suddenly sank.

But Yu Wan had already forgotten what he had asked. Feeling her eyelids grow heavy, she looked at Zhao Xuanyou, blinked a few times, and finally couldn't keep her eyes open.

Asleep?

Zhao Xuanyou felt as if his heart had been cut by a blunt knife. She had actually fallen asleep at this moment?

He felt anxious and raised his hand to shake her awake.

But Yu Wan was holding his arm, her sleeping face extremely obedient, like a small cat that used to be kept in the Marquis's residence, always curled up on a large rock in the backyard sunbathing.

The hand Zhao Xuanyou had raised ultimately couldn't bear to shake her. He simply tucked the blanket around her, covering her back.

Originally, Zhao Xuanyou had been as sleepy as Yu Wan, but now her drunken words had left him wide awake.

In his more than twenty years of life, Zhao Xuanyou had never worried about his appearance.

Of course, he neither took pride in it nor felt inferior; he simply didn't care.

At most, when he first joined the army at around ten years old, because of his fair skin, he was called a "pretty boy from the capital" by the old soldiers in the military camp.

He deliberately exposed himself to the wind and sun, but unfortunately, it had little effect. Among the men, he was the one with skin as white as jade.

Later, he established his position in the army with the sword in his hand, and naturally, no one dared to call him a pretty boy again.

But at this moment, he suddenly realized that Pei Ta seemed to have a fairer complexion than him.

Why should he care about such things?

Zhao Xuanyou became increasingly irritable. Wanting to vent his emotions, the woman beside him slept soundly.

Listening to her steady breathing, Zhao Xuanyou ultimately couldn't bear to wake her. He simply held her slender waist, suppressing all his anger in his heart.

---

The next morning, Yu Wan woke up with a slight headache from her hangover.

She vaguely remembered Zhao Xuanyou saying she was drunk, but she couldn't believe that two bowls of rice wine could have such a strong aftereffect.

She rubbed her head hard, feeling a bit more awake, and then realized she was lying in Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

His chest was firm and warm, and leaning against it felt very reassuring.

It was also at this moment that Yu Wan noticed he was wearing nightclothes, but she was not.

Yu Wan's face grew hot, and she tried to slip out of his arms to get dressed. As soon as she moved, the man beside her opened his eyes, looking at her with a displeased gaze.

Being looked at with that accusatory gaze, Yu Wan was taken aback and guessed that something had happened last night. She looked at him pitifully: "Master, was I drunk last night?"

"Mmm." Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched slightly, clearly very angry.

"Did I make a scene last night?"

Yu Wan had only been drunk twice in her life.

The first time was when Zhao Xuanyou had just returned to the capital. She had been persuaded by Baozhu to drink a few cups, after which she lost consciousness.

Cui Yichu and the others had put something in the wine. Strictly speaking, the rice wine she drank yesterday was the first time

chapters.title: Drunk
chapters.content:
Yu Ying really didn't know what she would do when she got drunk.

"I didn't make a scene."

Yu Ying let out a long sigh of relief. As long as she didn't embarrass herself, it was fine.

She was just feeling relieved when Zhao Xuanyou suddenly said, "You were awake, and you told me a lot."

Told him what?

Yu Ying didn't remember talking to Zhao Xuanyou last night.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's dark eyes, Yu Ying knew he wouldn't let this go, so she forced a smile and asked, "What did we talk about? I don't remember anything."

"You said that Pei Ta is very handsome," Zhao Xuanyou said.

As soon as Zhao Xuanyou finished speaking, he clearly saw Yu Ying's fair face quickly turn red.

He had always known that Yu Ying was shy. After being with him for so long, she still couldn't take a joke. If he said something improper to her on the bed, she wouldn't even dare to respond.

But now, when Pei Ta was mentioned, seeing her blush, Zhao Xuanyou felt a pang of jealousy in his heart.

"Ah?" Yu Ying couldn't hide her shock.

She did think that Lord Pei had an outstanding appearance, unparalleled in the world, but how could she possibly say that to Zhao Xuanyou?

Could it be that the saying was true, that alcohol gives cowards courage, and when she was drunk, she didn't know her place?

"That can't be," Yu Ying still refused to admit, "My lord, you must be joking. Why would I suddenly talk about Lord Pei with you?"

Her guess was not far off.

Last night, she had been praising Zhao Xuanyou, but Zhao Xuanyou had brought up Pei Ta himself.

"Are you saying I'm lying to you?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yu Ying forced a smile, looking at Zhao Xuanyou's angry expression, she moved a little closer to him.

"I just think it's unlikely that I would suddenly praise Lord Pei."

"Why?" Zhao Xuanyou still had a stern face.

Seeing his attitude soften slightly, Yu Ying felt more and more that he was lying to her.

If she had really been that bold, he would have pushed her off the bed last night.

How could he still hold her and sleep with her all night, only to settle the score at dawn?

"Lord Pei's appearance is indeed outstanding, but it can't compare to the Young Master. I might praise him when he's not around, but I would never praise him in front of you."

Zhao Xuanyou had been trying to make things difficult for her, but hearing this sentence, he was easily moved by her.

Fortunately, he was good at hiding his emotions, and at the moment, he was still calm, deliberately slow in speech, "Everyone praises Pei Ta for his elegant demeanor and handsome appearance like Pan An, how could he not be as good as me?"

"Elegant demeanor and handsome appearance like Pan An is indeed true, Lord Pei deserves such praise."

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou about to darken his face again, Yu Ying changed the subject, "But that's all he has. He is a top scholar, but the Young Master is both literary and martial, with the prestige of a general and the refinement of a scholar. Compared to the Young Master, Lord Pei is elegant but lacks presence."

"Oh?" Zhao Xuanyou slightly raised his eyebrows.

Yu Ying glanced at his slightly relaxed expression and knew she had guessed right.

He was just trying to get her to talk, she had never said that Lord Pei was better looking than him.

With the reassurance, Yu Ying became bolder.

She reached out and gently caressed the muscles on Zhao Xuanyou's abdomen, then climbed up and lay on his chest, speaking softly, "The Young Master is taller than Lord Pei, with a more graceful figure. Moreover, the Young Master has some advantages that others don't know about, but I do."

That was true.

Pei Ta only had his face to show off, what else could he compare with him?

Just as Zhao Xuanyou was feeling refreshed, his gaze shifted to Yu Ying.

She was smiling at him, her eyes full of admiration, and the slightly upturned corners of her eyes revealed a touch of charm.

Although what she said made sense, her flawless words made Zhao Xuanyou suspicious.

He couldn't tell which parts of her words were true and which were false.

He suddenly regretted not being softer last night.

If it had been her last night, she would have told the truth.

He held military power, deciding the life and death of others at will, and could see through the complexities of the court, but he couldn't figure out what she was thinking.

---

chapters.title: Addicted
chapters.content:
Yu Ying didn't hear from him for a long time and assumed his anger had subsided, so she propped herself up and sat up.

The thin blanket slipped from her body, and Zhao Xuanyou's distracting thoughts instantly disappeared.

Taking the opportunity while she raised her hand to tidy her hair, his hand stuck to her, unscrupulous and unrestrained.

Yu Ying bit her lip and didn't make a sound. After fixing her hair, she climbed over him and got off the bed, going to the cabinet next to her to find a set of clothes.

Heishui County was not like other places; the clothes in the cabinet were all ordinary styles. Yu Ying didn't mind and put them on properly before going out.

Zhao Qi and Pei Ta both found the local women's cooking unpalatable, so she would probably have to prepare breakfast.

However, as soon as she entered the kitchen, she saw Yin Ping busy inside.

"Miss Yu Ying." Yin Ping greeted politely.

Seeing a steaming basket of buns in his hands, Yu Ying asked in surprise, "You made breakfast?"

"I'm not a good cook. Breakfast is bought from the street. Lord Pei has already eaten. Our prince just got up, and I'm taking this to him. There's more warming on the stove. Miss Yu Ying, please take some to Lord Zhao."

Pei Ta woke up early, Zhao Qi woke up late. The guards went to the market every morning to buy food and brought it back to warm on the stove.

"Thank you."

Yu Ying was not a diligent person, so having breakfast taken care of was a good thing.

After Yin Ping left, Yu Ying took a plate of steamed buns and a plate of buns from the stove and carried them back.

At this time, Zhao Xuanyou had also gotten up and was exercising in the courtyard.

The marquis's breakfast usually came with congee and side dishes, but here there were only steamed buns and buns. Afraid that it would be too dry, Yu Ying boiled water and made a pot of tea.

Just as she finished setting the table, she saw Zhao Qi entering the courtyard.

He was originally sleepy, but as soon as he saw Zhao Xuanyou practicing sword in the courtyard, he became energetic and shouted that he wanted to practice with Zhao Xuanyou.

"Have you slacked off in your practice since coming to Heishui?"

"Not at all." Zhao Qi answered confidently, "Except for the day we went out of the city to eliminate the mountain bandits, I've practiced horseback and footwork for two hours every day, and even sparred with Yin Ping."

Hearing Zhao Qi's response, Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly, "Then let's see the prince's progress."

Zhao Qi got permission and immediately took the sword from Yin Ping's hand, starting to spar with Zhao Xuanyou.

The courtyard was soon filled with flying sword flowers and clanging sword sounds.

While the two of them were engrossed in their practice, Yu Ying's stomach growled with hunger.

If she had known they would practice for so long, she should have eaten a bun in the kitchen first.

The two practiced in the courtyard for about two incense sticks' time before stopping.

Zhao Qi sheathed his sword and looked at Zhao Xuanyou triumphantly, "How was that?"

Zhao Xuanyou slowly said, "You have some strength now, not as soft and weak as before."

"You..." Zhao Qi was provoked into a rage by that one sentence but couldn't do anything about it since he couldn't beat him.

Seeing him furious, Zhao Xuanyou added, "It's only been a little over two months. If the prince can keep practicing for a year, everyone will be impressed."

When dealing with Zhao Qi, who was a tough nut to crack, it was best to use a carrot-and-stick approach.

"Let's talk about that later." Zhao Qi said sullenly.

Seeing that Yu Ying had set the table, Zhao Qi sat down at the table and drank the tea in one go.

"Does the prince want some more?" Yu Ying had only brought two sets of bowls and chopsticks. If Zhao Qi wanted to eat, she would have to make another trip to the kitchen.

Zhao Qi had just been choked by Zhao Xuanyou's words and was feeling frustrated. Seeing Yu Ying's reluctant expression, he became even more annoyed.

They were just buns and steamed buns. Who would care?

"You two, master and servant, can't even say a nice word."

Yu Ying opened her mouth but was at a loss for words.

Hadn't Zhao Qi just eaten? Could he eat more? Yin Ping had taken a full plate of buns from the kitchen.

"Hurry up and eat. I still have to go to the mountain stronghold later." Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

"Yes." Yu Ying didn't know what was at the mountain stronghold, but Zhao Xuanyou's words relieved her. She quickly picked up a bun.

She was really hungry.

Zhao Qi didn't know about Zhao Xuanyou's conversation with Pei Ta the day before. Hearing this, he looked at Zhao Xuanyou, "You're going to the mountain stronghold?"

"I heard that the prince found some clues at the mountain stronghold. I want to go and take a look. Maybe I can find something more."

"Did Pei Ta tell you?" Zhao Qi asked.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. After swallowing the food in his mouth, he glanced at Zhao Qi, "Those things are extremely important. The prince must be careful to keep them safe."

"Rest assured." Since it involved the Empress's maternal family, the Zhen Guo Duke's residence, Zhao Qi's eyes burned with fierce fire, "I will take good care of such important things."

Zhao Xuanyou didn't know the cause of Hui Guifei's death, but given the Empress's usual behavior, he believed that Hui Guifei's death was related to the Empress.

After all, Hui Guifei came from the Ningguo Duke's residence, which held military power. She was young and beautiful, talented in both literature and martial arts, and had given birth to a prince, posing a great threat to the Empress and the Crown Prince.

The Empress wasn't even willing to give the Crown Princess consort position to anyone else, let alone the positions of Empress and Crown Prince.

Thinking of this, Zhao Xuanyou said, "What I mean is, the prince should hide those things well and not let others know of their existence."

"But those are important evidence. I will hand them over to the Emperor when I return."

"No." Zhao Xuanyou said firmly.

Zhao Qi clearly didn't agree and remained silent with a stubborn look.

Yu Ying didn't know what they were talking about and just silently lowered her head to eat the second bun.

Zhao Xuanyou drank a cup of tea and said softly, "A few boxes alone won't be enough to convict them. They can easily come up with an excuse to cover it up. If you hastily hand over the boxes, it will only alert them and put the prince on guard. The prince must keep the secret of the boxes and not tip them off."

In the eyes of the Empress and the Crown Prince, Zhao Qi had long been spoiled and was not worth worrying about.

Maintaining the status quo and letting them lower their guard was the best strategy.

"Then how long do we have to wait?" Zhao Qi said indignantly.

Every day he spent in the palace seeing the Empress and the Crown Prince was torture for Zhao Qi.

He really didn't want to call that poisonous woman "Mother" anymore.

He wanted to expose her true face to the Emperor as soon as possible and avenge his birth mother.

"The prince can rest assured. It won't be too long. I'm going to the mountain stronghold today to see if there are any more clues."

Zhao Xuanyou dared to oppose Zhao Zun, so Zhao Qi trusted him.

"Then I'm going too." Zhao Qi said.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded in agreement.

Zhao Qi finally showed a smile. Just as he was about to say something, he glanced at Yu Ying beside him.

"Is Yu Ying going?"

"Me?" Yu Ying thought that going to the mountain stronghold to search probably didn't require her help, so she said, "I'll stay at the residence. When I was at the other courtyard, I learned a few dishes from the cook of the Pei residence. Today is a good opportunity to make them for you to try."

Zhao Qi was about to say okay when Zhao Xuanyou spoke, "No need. On the way back, we can just find any restaurant, and it will be better than what you make."

He actually despised her cooking so much?

Although Yu Ying was not good at needlework, she was decent at cooking. Zhao Qi liked the pastries she made, which was proof.

However, cooking for so many people was indeed troublesome.

Since he didn't want to eat it, Yu Ying could save herself the trouble.

"Yes." Yu Ying obediently replied.

Looking at Yu Ying's delicate and flawless face, Zhao Xuanyou picked up his tea and drank it in one go.

Zhao Zun had his eyes on her, so he had to keep her by his side at all times to feel at ease.

Moreover, there was also a Pei Ta at the county office. He would never leave Yu Ying here.

chapters.title: Not Taking It to Heart
chapters.content:
After finishing breakfast, Zhao Xuanyou went into the room to change his clothes and then led Yuhan out.

Halfway there, Yuhan suddenly remembered something.

"Master, you are going to ride horses today, right?"

Yuhan's words reminded Zhao Xuanyou that she couldn't ride a horse.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou remain silent, Yuhan said, "Otherwise, I should stay at the residence."

"It's fine, you can ride with me."

"But what will others..."

"It's fine, I said it's fine."

The guards following him all knew that Yuhan was his woman. As for the soldiers Zhao Qi brought, they probably wouldn't gossip about him either.

He spoke with certainty, so Yuhan didn't dare to argue further and obediently followed him out of the residence.

However, when they reached the gate of the residence, they saw Yin Ping had harnessed a carriage and was waiting there.

Zhao Qi was already on his horse. Seeing the two of them, he impatiently said, "Hurry up and set off, I've been waiting for a long time."

Yuhan didn't expect him to be so considerate. Zhao Xuanyou hadn't even noticed, but he had thought of it and had someone prepare a carriage in advance.

She bowed to Zhao Qi.

"Thank you, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi acted as if it was nothing, hummed lightly, and then turned his horse around to leave.

Yuhan looked at Zhao Xuanyou, waiting for him to mount his horse before she got into the carriage.

Compared to the royal carriage and the marquis's carriage she had ridden before, this temporary green-canopied carriage was bumpy and unstable.

But Yuhan didn't mind. Compared to the ox cart she had taken when she first went to the capital, this was nothing.

She still sat by the carriage window, greedily taking in the sights of the streets outside.

Heishui County was larger and more populous than Cangxi Town, but perhaps because it was remote and had few resources, the streets looked messy, and the wine flags and shop signs were somewhat dirty.

Although there were many pedestrians on both sides, their clothing and appearance were not as good as those in Cangxi Town.

Yuhan sighed softly in her heart.

It was indeed the corrupt official who had exploited the people of Heishui County severely.

The mountain stronghold where the bandits were based was quite far away. Normally, it would take an hour to get there on a fast horse, but with the carriage, it would take an additional half hour.
