So Zhao Xuanyou first led a small team of men to the mountain stronghold, leaving Zhao Qi and Yuhan to follow slowly.

By the time Yuhan got out of the carriage, it was already noon.

"Your Highness, have you been here several times before?"

Zhao Qi tilted his head and counted, "I've been here two more times than you."

Once was to attack the mountain stronghold, and the other time was when his subordinates reported finding items from the Prince of Zhen Guo's residence.

He spent most of his days practicing martial arts, and most of the matters were handled by Pei Tao.

Seeing Yuhan's interest in the mountain stronghold, Zhao Qi told her about the bandits' defenses on the way up the mountain; where the sentinels were, where the traps were, and where the defensive lines were.

Listening to Zhao Qi speak so knowledgeably, Yuhan couldn't help but look at him in a new light.

"Your Highness is truly impressive. Those military books were not read in vain."

Hearing her praise, Zhao Qi felt pleased but didn't show it. He merely said, "It's just a mere mountain stronghold, naturally not a problem."

As they spoke, they arrived at the entrance of the stronghold. The guard, seeing that it was Zhao Qi, quickly opened the gate and welcomed them in.

"Where is Lord Zhao?"

The guard respectfully replied, "Lord Zhao is inspecting the storeroom. Does Your Highness want to go over?"

Zhao Qi had already seen the storeroom before, and there was nothing of interest to him. He turned to Yuhan, "Do you want to go?"

"Master Zhao is handling official business. This servant shouldn't disturb him."

In the Honghui Hall, Zhao Xuanyou had many rules, and Yuhan didn't dare to break them casually.

Thinking that it was almost time for lunch, Yuhan said, "This servant will go and see where the kitchen is, to prepare lunch for Your Highness and Master."

"The kitchen..." Zhao Qi instinctively wanted to say he would take her to the kitchen, but he didn't know where it was.

Yin Ping, who was beside them, reacted quickly, "This subordinate will take Your Highness and Miss Yuhan there."

The kitchen in the mountain stronghold was not as clean and spacious as the one in the county government office. However, as the saying goes, "live off the land." The guards stationed here had fresh mountain goods and game to eat every day.

As soon as Yuhan entered, she saw the wild chickens and hares they had hunted that day, as well as a basket of bamboo shoots dug up that morning.

She loved eating bamboo shoots the most.

Without delay, she divided the work, having Yin Ping and Mu Di prepare the wild chickens and hares while she peeled the bamboo shoots.

Zhao Qi wanted to help, but seeing the fine, dense fuzz on the bamboo shoot shells, he felt a bit apprehensive. So he stood by the stove with his hands behind his back, watching her busy herself.

Yuhan peeled the bamboo shoots with practiced ease, quickly removing the black, hairy shells.

Zhao Qi looked at the white, tender bamboo shoots and couldn't help but ask, "Doesn't the fuzz on them prick you?"

"This servant has calluses on her hands, so she's not afraid of being pricked."

Zhao Qi glanced at her, then stretched out a finger to poke the fine fuzz on the bamboo shoot shell. As soon as he touched it, he felt uncomfortable all over and quickly pulled his hand back.

Watching his amusing expression, Yuhan held back her laughter, "Your Highness doesn't need to help. This servant will finish peeling them soon."

Zhao Qi nodded without speaking.

Yuhan quickly peeled a basin of bamboo shoots, cutting half into shreds and the other half into slices.

By the time Yin Ping brought over the wild chicken, she put the chicken into the pot to stew.

As for the hare, it would naturally taste better roasted.

She gathered some firewood nearby to make a fire, then hung the salted hare above it to roast.

Before long, the hare's skin sizzled with oil, and the aroma made Zhao Qi's appetite stir.

He moved a stool to sit beside Yuhan, helping to add firewood to the fire.

"You said you were a maid in the flower room, so how do you know how to roast meat?"

"This servant only learned to take care of flowers and plants after entering the marquis's residence. Back in the countryside, besides sewing and embroidering, this servant could do everything else."

Clothes and shoes were all made by her mother, so she didn't have to worry about them.

"How long have you been in the marquis's residence?"

"Not very long, almost two years."

Zhao Qi looked at her lively and expressive eyes and said, "No wonder."

"No wonder what?" Yuhan asked curiously.

Zhao Qi said with a bad temper, "No wonder you have so much strength, a wild temperament, and dare to talk back to your master."

Of course, this was not what Zhao Qi truly thought.

Yuhan was different from the women he usually came into contact with.

She was neither as respectful and timid as those maids nor as dull and boring as those noblewomen.

She always did things that surprised him, and her smile always seemed pure and sincere.

She was no worse than any other servant in her work; in fact, she could be considered a meticulous and thoughtful good servant, but she always made people look at her in a new light.

"Ah? When did this servant talk back to Your Highness? She didn't." Even when Zhao Qi first came to pick on her, she had obediently let him do as he pleased.

Zhao Qi said with a straight face, "You are doing it now."

"Then this servant won't speak anymore."

Zhao Qi glanced at her and saw her concentrating on turning the hare, her expression free of any sorrow or restraint, lively and agile.

She was like this; saying she knew her mistake but not taking his words to heart at all.

---

chapters.title: Understanding Him
chapters.content:
Yuhan focused on roasting the hare for a while and was about to get up to check on the chicken soup at the stove when she saw Zhao Qi sitting to the side with a furrowed brow, looking troubled.

Recalling their earlier conversation, Yuhan softly said, "Your Highness, please don't be angry. It was this servant who spoke out of turn. She won't talk back in the future."

Hearing her coaxing tone, as if speaking to a child, Zhao Qi felt even more displeased.

"You just know how to annoy me!"

Yuhan had thought he was venting his frustration due to some personal troubles, but hearing his words, she realized he was truly upset by her earlier response.

"Would Your Highness like this servant to serve you a bowl of chicken soup to calm down?"

Zhao Qi gave her a white-eyed look.

Yuhan became even more confused.

Zhao Qi had been much more approachable lately, so why was he suddenly causing trouble today?

She had no choice but to ask again, "If Your Highness wants to eat something else, this servant can prepare it. There's still a large piece of pork in the kitchen. Cutting half of it to roast would be good, and the other half can be stir-fried with fresh bamboo shoots."

"You're not my maid, why are you bothering with me?"

Indeed, she wasn't his maid, but he was a prince. What could she say?

Yuhan thought this to herself but didn't dare to voice it.

Moreover, to be fair, Zhao Qi had treated her quite well these days, saving her life and personally sending her back to the capital.

"Your Highness saved this servant's life, so this servant should naturally serve you wholeheartedly."

That was a reasonable statement.

Zhao Qi curled his lip, not claiming credit, "It was nothing. Last time, it was Yin Ping who lost you, so it was only right to find you again."

"It's not just that one time," Yuhan said gently. "On the way to Heishui County, this servant heard Master say that if not for Your Highness's help, he wouldn't have been able to find this servant so quickly in the capital. Thank you, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi's earlier anger had been baseless and not truly directed at Yuhan.

After being soothed by her gentle words for a while, his annoyance gradually dissipated.

He was about to say something when Yuhan raised her hand and used her own handkerchief to wipe the sweat from his forehead.

It was early autumn, and the heat had not yet subsided. Sitting by the fire, with the hare sizzling with oil, both of them had broken out in a sweat.

"The kitchen is too hot. Your Highness might as well find a shady place to sit. When lunch is ready, this servant will come to invite you."

Zhao Qi was used to sweating from his daily martial arts practice and didn't mind it.

"It's not that hot. I can still sit here."

Yuhan's cheeks were flushed from the heat, and a thin layer of sweat had formed on her forehead. Zhao Qi was in the same state. Was this not hot?

Assuming Zhao Qi would be bored sitting alone, Yuhan didn't say more. She got up and went to the kitchen to bring him a bowl of water.

The chicken soup on the stove was bubbling with heat. She had Yin Ping remove some of the firewood from the stove.

After the chicken soup boiled, it needed to simmer on low heat to make the meat tender and the soup flavorful.

Turning back, she saw Zhao Qi still sitting by the fire, turning the hare as she had done earlier.

"Your Highness is truly impressive. You learned how to roast it just by watching once."

Zhao Qi curled his lip and didn't say a word.

Yuhan looked at the sizzling hare, then examined Zhao Qi, who was sulking.

His brows and eyes held both the boldness of a young man and the noble pride of a prince, though at fourteen, his features and demeanor still had a touch of youthfulness.

"Your Highness."

"Hmm?"

"Because of this servant's matter, will you get into trouble with the Eastern Palace?"

She was Zhao Xuanyou's maid. The Crown Prince had tried to take her twice, clearly not holding Zhao Xuanyou in regard.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't want to be his enemy but had no choice.

But Zhao Qi was different.

This matter originally had nothing to do with him. Even if he and the Crown Prince were not on good terms, they had never directly conflicted.

"What trouble? Besides, if I act like a cowardly turtle, would he let me off?" Zhao Qi sneered, his tone filled with disdain.

Yuhan was somewhat surprised by his words.

Previously, she had witnessed the verbal sparring between Princess Yi'an and Princess Yi'ning, thinking that the royal siblings simply had distant feelings for each other. But hearing Zhao Qi's words, it seemed he and the Crown Prince had long-standing deep grudges.

"Didn't Zhao Xuanyou ever tell you?" Seeing her confused expression, Zhao Qi couldn't help but ask.

In his mind, Zhao Xuanyou and Yuhan were close, so if Zhao Xuanyou had told her, she should know.

Of course, anything that could be said to Zhao Xuanyou, he wasn't afraid of Yuhan knowing.

In fact, if he were to speak to Yuhan, he might say even more.

"Tell what?"

"He is indeed not one to talk carelessly." Zhao Qi remarked lightly.

Yuhan didn't know what he was referring to, but she felt that royal family matters were not for her to inquire about.

So she said, "Master Zhao didn't mention it, probably because it's not convenient to tell this servant. In any case, this servant hopes that Your Highness won't get into trouble because of her. Otherwise, this servant will..."

"Will what?" Zhao Qi urgently asked before Yuhan could finish.

Facing Zhao Qi's direct gaze, Yuhan frankly said, "Otherwise, this servant will feel deeply guilty. After all, this servant is just a maid. If this servant causes trouble for Your Highness and is powerless to resolve it, no matter what happens, this servant can only watch helplessly as Your Highness worries."

Zhao Qi looked up at Yuhan and suddenly smiled.

"That's good. In the future, speak like this. Do you understand?"

She said she was powerless, but he said it was good.

Yuhan looked at Zhao Qi's expression, and her heart also rippled.

When she first met Zhao Qi, she thought he was an unreasonable master, a spoiled little prince who, apart from his noble status, was utterly useless.

Later, after being tamed by Zhao Xuanyou, he obediently practiced martial arts every day. Although he often barked orders at Yuhan, he never truly made things difficult for her.

Yuhan served him wholeheartedly to be able to stay by his side and listen to Pei Tao's lectures.

Later, when the Crown Prince set his sights on her, Zhao Qi intervened twice to help Zhao Xuanyou rescue her. Only then did Yuhan realize that this mischievous prince also had a sense of humanity.

"Yes." Yuhan respectfully replied.

She answered quickly, but Zhao Qi was somewhat skeptical.

"Do you really understand?"

"I understand." Yuhan met his doubting gaze and seriously said, "In the future, whatever Your Highness asks, this servant will answer properly and will never again speak as if to a child."

In fact, during those dozen or so days she spent with Zhao Qi at the Ningguo Duke's residence, Yuhan had noticed some clues.

Everyone at the Ningguo Duke's residence treated Zhao Qi like a treasure, but Zhao Qi was not close to anyone except the Duke of Ningguo.

The reason was simple: everyone treated him like a child.

Even Shen Tangyun saw Zhao Qi as a greedy child.

Zhao Qi felt annoyed when he heard such tones and was even less willing to speak nicely.

He had been willing to submit to Zhao Xuanyou because Zhao Xuanyou had defeated him as if he were an equal opponent.

Zhao Xuanyou had provoked him and mocked him, never showing mercy just because he was young.

And Yuhan, though just a maid, had been with him for only a little over a month, yet she already understood his intentions.

It was the hottest time of day, and sitting by the fire made it even hotter. Yuhan's beautiful almond-shaped eyes seemed soaked in water, filled with a misty sheen.

Her handkerchief had been used by Zhao Qi, so she used her sleeve to wipe her sweat.

"You..." Zhao Qi's gaze was fixed on her, his expression somewhat strange. After a moment, he hummed lightly, "You are indeed smarter than others."

chapters.title: Just Kidding
chapters.content:
"Your Highness flatters me."

Yu Ying softly replied, and seeing the sweat beading on his forehead, she advised him once more to rest in the shade.

Zhao Qi was indeed suffering from the heat. Thinking it would be embarrassing to keep sweating, he finally obeyed and went to the shade to cool off.

Yu Ying let out a soft sigh and wiped the sweat from her own face.

He refused to admit his childish nature, but in the end, he still had the temper of a child.

She focused on turning the roasted rabbit, and when the skin was golden and crisp, she took it off the rack.

Mao Di, skilled with a knife, took over the task of slicing the meat.

The chicken soup on the stove had simmered into a rich fragrance. Seeing it was almost done, Yu Ying added the sliced bamboo shoots and a pinch of salt.

Then she cut the pork on the chopping block into shreds and stir-fried them with the remaining bamboo shoots.

Soon, a fragrant dish of bamboo shoot and pork shreds was ready, along with the chicken soup and roasted rabbit.

Yin Ping and Mao Di helped carry the dishes to the dining room. The cooks in the camp also sent over several dishes, and the square table was soon laden with food.

Not long after the meal was prepared, Zhao Xuanyou and Zhao Qi arrived together.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's slightly furrowed brows, Yu Ying guessed he must have found some clues.

"Your Highness, Prince, this roasted rabbit is best eaten hot. Please try my cooking."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression relaxed slightly. He looked up at Yu Ying. "You made this?"

Yu Ying mimicked his usual gesture of raising an eyebrow, lifting her own delicately, and nodded proudly at him.

Zhao Xuanyou took in her charming and innocent demeanor, but showed no reaction in front of others. He picked up his chopsticks, took a piece of rabbit meat, and found it crispy on the outside and tender inside, with perfect seasoning and cooking.

"How is it?" Yu Ying looked at him expectantly.

"Not bad." Zhao Xuanyou said slowly.

Hearing this, Zhao Qi quickly took a piece of rabbit meat, tasted it, and echoed Zhao Xuanyou, "Indeed, not bad."

But before he finished speaking, he quickly took another piece.

They were all talk.

Yu Ying was silently criticizing them when Zhao Xuanyou glanced at her, "Aren't you going to sit down and eat?"

"Yes." Yu Ying sat down beside him.

After working for so long, Yu Ying was both hungry and thirsty. She first drank half a bowl of chicken soup before starting to eat.

The mountain delicacies were fresh, and even simple seasoning left a lasting aftertaste.

The three of them ate this meal with great relish.

After putting down their chopsticks, Zhao Qi looked at Zhao Xuanyou. "You've been busy in the mountain stronghold for so long. Did you find anything?"

"Nothing."

Nothing?

Yu Ying cautiously glanced at him and quickly lowered her head to drink soup.

He had looked so serious when he came in. How could he have found nothing?

Unless he was serious because he found nothing? No, that was not Zhao Xuanyou's character.

"Then shall we head back after the meal?"

Zhao Xuanyou said, "Since we're already here, I'll take another look around to avoid any oversights."

Zhao Qi snorted, as if he understood everything. "What oversights could there be? I had people search for five or six days. We've practically turned this mountain upside down. Any evidence that could be found has already been found."

"What Your Highness says is true," Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently, then suddenly added, "Didn't you forget to practice your martial arts today?"

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou said, "If Your Highness isn't in a hurry to return to the city, you can find a shady place to practice your horse stance after the meal. I'll look around a bit more."

Since there was nothing else to do, it was indeed time to practice.

Zhao Qi finally nodded.

Seeing that neither of them was eating anymore, Yu Ying stood up and collected the bowls. Then, as she had done before, she accompanied Zhao Qi in his practice.

It was not until the sun began to set that Zhao Xuanyou returned with Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing, saying they could return to the city.

"Did you find anything?" Zhao Qi asked triumphantly.

"Nothing."

"I told you so. You just didn't believe me. My subordinates are not incompetent."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression remained calm. "Naturally."

Yu Ying felt that Zhao Xuanyou was acting strangely, but she dared not interfere in court matters.

Moreover, even if she did, Zhao Xuanyou would not pay her any mind.

By the time the large group returned to the county government office, night had completely fallen. The streets were desolate, with no pedestrians in sight.

Originally, they had planned to go to a restaurant for dinner, but everyone looked tired, so they had a servant cook a large pot of noodles, and each person had a bowl.

As they were eating the noodles, Pei Ta, dressed in a dark purple robe, entered from outside.

"Did Your Highness and Lord Zhao make any progress at the mountain stronghold today?"

Zhao Qi quickly interjected, "We've already searched it thoroughly. He found nothing today."

"In that case," Pei Ta said, glancing at Zhao Xuanyou, who remained composed. After a moment's thought, he added, "I've sent someone to bring the magistrate back. With haste, he should arrive by the day after tomorrow at the latest."

Zhao Qi was unaware of their plans and asked suspiciously, "Isn't he a corrupt official? Why bring him back? I could send someone to Weizhou to execute him there."

"Investigating a case requires both witnesses and evidence. The victim's testimony, the bandits' confessions, and the official's testimony are all indispensable."

"But there's no need to bring him back, is there?"

"He hasn't been convicted yet and is still an imperial official. Leaving him some dignity is not unreasonable. Perhaps there's more to this case."

"What more could there be..."

"He has accomplices. If we arrest him rashly, we might alert them, and they could destroy the evidence. In short, we'll know everything after the trial. Once we have the confession, the signatures, and the evidence, we can take it back to the capital as irrefutable proof."

Pei Ta spoke with conviction, and Zhao Qi naturally couldn't refute him. He fell silent in frustration.

"I'm sorry for the trouble, Lord Pei. I have a headache today, so I'll retire to my room first."

"You've been on the road for days, Lord Zhao. You should rest early."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded and stood up to leave. Yu Ying quickly stood up as well, curtsied to Zhao Qi and Pei Ta, and hurried to catch up with Zhao Xuanyou.

Back in the small courtyard, Zhao Xuanyou entered the house and removed his outer robe.

Outside, the wind rustled the treetops, and occasionally, a bird could be heard chirping.

Zhao Xuanyou sat on the edge of the couch, still frowning deeply in thought. Yu Ying first brought water for him to wash his face.

"Are you really having a headache, my lord?"

In the dim yellow candlelight, Yu Ying's face appeared even more delicate, her skin as fine as white porcelain, soft and radiant.

Zhao Xuanyou cast her a dark, inscrutable glance but said nothing.

"Then let me help you relax your muscles and bones." She took off her shoes and climbed onto the couch, first kneading his shoulders, then pressing his temples, and finally pounding his back with all her strength.

Zhao Xuanyou's body was solid and muscular, so massaging his shoulders and back was no easy task.

Even with Yu Ying's strength, after a full session, her fingers and wrists ached terribly.

"Do you feel better now, my lord?"

Hearing Yu Ying's slightly breathless voice, Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes, suppressing the smile at the corner of his lips. "Who told you to stop?"

"Do you still want a shoulder massage, my lord?"

Seeing Yu Ying's pained expression, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but laugh. He gently pinched her nose and then flipped over to lie down on the couch.

"Just kidding."

Seeing him lying down so early, which was rare, Yu Ying asked, "Are you sleepy, my lord?"

Not exactly sleepy, but many things had happened recently, and he needed to think quietly for a while.

He didn't speak, but reached out and pulled Yu Ying into his embrace.

Yu Ying, caught off guard, fell onto his chest.

Even though she had landed on him, his chest was so solid that he showed no reaction, but Yu Ying's arms hurt from the fall.

She silently cursed under her breath and shifted to the side, lying down with her head on his arm.

Zhao Xuanyou was not sleepy and did not make any advances on her. His deep, dark eyes under his handsome brows were lost in thought, pondering something.

Watching his expression, Yu Ying's heart stirred, and she boldly asked, "Did you discover something at the mountain stronghold today, Prince?"

---

chapters.title: Punch His Chest
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched slightly, and his gaze fell on her.

"What did you discover?"

"I didn't discover anything. Today, I was either busy in the kitchen or practicing martial arts with His Highness the Seventh Prince. How could I have discovered anything?" Yu Ying leaned closer to his shoulder, her voice soft. "I just noticed that you have something on your mind, so I rashly spoke out of turn."

Zhao Xuanyou neither agreed nor disagreed, tacitly acknowledging her words.

Yu Ying let out a soft sigh.

"Why sigh for no reason?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"Too many things have happened recently. I feel uneasy."

"Are you still worried about the Eastern Palace?"

Yu Ying blinked, pursed her lips, and smiled softly. "With you by my side, I'm not worried. It's just that I've grown used to a peaceful life. Suddenly, there's the Crown Prince, corrupt officials, and we're in Lichuan one moment and Heishui the next. I was kidnapped and nearly lost my life under an axe. Experiencing so much in less than a month, even though I'm safe now, my heart still feels suspended. Just now, seeing you troubled, I felt even more uneasy, so I spoke out of turn."

Zhao Xuanyou slid his fingers into her hair, gently playing with her black strands. His eyes were much softer than usual, clearly not minding her words.

"Once that corrupt official returns, things will be more or less resolved. When we return to the Marquis's residence, we can go back to the peaceful life we had before."

"Don't you and Lord Pei have to return to Lichuan to report back?"

"Normally, we would, but the imperial palace sent word that Consort Qin is with child, so His Majesty decided to return to the capital early. After finishing things here, the Seventh Prince and I will go directly back to the capital from Heishui."

"And will Lord Pei stay here to handle the case?"

Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently, "His wife is in poor health. Naturally, he will go to Lichuan to meet her."

Sun Qianran was indeed frail. Without Pei Ta's careful attention, she might not be able to endure the journey.

"That's good." Yu Ying breathed a sigh of relief. "Once we're back at the Marquis's residence, there will be nothing to fear."

The days in Lichuan had been wonderful, but leaving had been embarrassing.

Yu Ying never wanted to be carried around like a chick again.

A slight smile appeared at the corner of Zhao Xuanyou's lips.

"There are still some minor troubles at the Marquis's residence. We'll deal with them all when we return."

Yu Ying couldn't help but feel confused, her big eyes innocent and lively. "What troubles are there at the Marquis's residence?"

"Can't you really guess?" Zhao Xuanyou reached out and gently pinched her cheek. "How do you think Baochuan was able to block you in the dungeon? Don't you find it strange?"

It was indeed strange.

That night, Baochuan had suddenly appeared behind her, and Yu Ying had been very puzzled.

But at that time, her life had been hanging by a thread, and she had been fighting for her life against Baochuan, with no time to think deeply.

Later, when Wen Kuo escaped from the dungeon, Yu Ying was captured again, and her mind had been filled with thoughts of escape, leaving no room to consider these things.

"I go to deliver meals from Honghui Hall at fixed times every day. Either someone in Honghui Hall leaked my whereabouts, or someone outside Honghui Hall was secretly watching me."

Her analysis was logical.

Zhao Xuanyou had long known she was intelligent and was not surprised. He asked again, "Which one do you think it is?"

"I wait until Yingxue and Ziyan leave before I go out every day. The only ones who know my whereabouts are the guards at the gate, but they are your trusted aides and would never betray me. So... it must be that someone in the Marquis's residence is watching me, but it's not Baochuan."

Baochuan had offended too many people in the past, and everyone had kicked her when she was down.

She had endless chores every day. Even after cleaning all the chamber pots, she still had to go to the firewood room to chop wood. How would she have time to stake out Honghui Hall?

Moreover, everyone in the residence knew Baochuan. It was impossible for her to stake out Honghui Hall without being noticed.

"Have you thought of who it might be?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a deep voice.

Yu Ying gently shook her head.

She didn't know many people in the Marquis's residence. Most of the people in Lingfang Hall had been sent to the farm by Zhao Xuanyou. Counting on her fingers, the only person in the Marquis's residence who wanted her dead was Baochuan.

Outside the residence, there was also Cui Yichu.

Yu Ying looked at Zhao Xuanyou. "Last time, the Cui family of Xingguo Duke's residence sent someone to Yunshui Nunnery to find my mother, but they failed. They definitely won't let it go. This matter is probably related to them."

Yu Ying had had quite a few encounters with Baochuan. Baochuan was indeed vicious, but she was also a coward who feared death.

She did all the dirty and tiring work in the Marquis's residence, which was better than being sent to the farm.

When she had rushed into the dungeon that day, Baochuan had seemed determined to die with her, but that was clearly not her true intention.

If there was a chance to live, Baochuan would definitely choose to live.

The only person who didn't care about Baochuan's life and only wanted Yu Ying dead was Cui Yichu.

"But she couldn't have known about the dungeon."

"My lord, does the Cui family have an accomplice in the Marquis's residence?"

"Who could it be?"

Zhao Xuanyou's voice was calm, and Yu Ying couldn't tell if he was genuinely asking or just making a casual remark.

After thinking for a moment, Yu Ying said seriously, "The only person in the Marquis's residence who hates me to the bone is Baochuan. As for those who dislike me..."

"Who dislikes you?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yu Ying looked at him and pursed her lips. "If I say, my lord must not blame me for falsely accusing others."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a light hum, which served as his agreement.

Yu Ying said, "After Madam Feng entered the residence, she has been unable to serve you, my lord. She is unhappy and has caused trouble for me a few times."

"Is that so?" Zhao Xuanyou's eyes flickered. "I wasn't aware."

Yu Ying reached out and gently traced his jawline, her voice soft. "My lord is so handsome and dignified, yet I have monopolized you. It's only natural that Madam Feng is unhappy."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a cold laugh and pulled Yu Ying even closer into his embrace.

"So, you think Feng Xiang might harm you."

"Whether she would or not, I don't know. I only know that she dislikes me."

Yu Ying hadn't had much interaction with Feng Xiang and didn't know much about her character. Maybe Feng Xiang was a good person with a sharp tongue but a soft heart.

But Feng Xiang's dislike for her was obvious. If she had to pick an enemy in the Marquis's residence besides Baochuan, it would be her.

At this thought, Yu Ying suddenly considered another layer.

If someone in the Marquis's residence was leaking information to Baochuan, Feng Xiang could indeed do that.

Old Lady Ye was elderly. On the surface, Feng Xiang and Manager Song managed the affairs together, but Manager Song had always only managed the front courtyard and rarely interfered with the inner courtyard.

Although Feng Xiang was a concubine, she practically managed all the inner courtyard affairs and had many people under her command.

Her influence didn't extend into Honghui Hall, but arranging someone to stake out Honghui Hall was easy.

She could have a servant sweep the path in front of Honghui Hall or have a maid trim the branches, and no one would suspect a thing.

And Baochuan, who was in charge of cleaning the chamber pots, was also under Feng Xiang's supervision.

She could both monitor Yu Ying and secretly control Baochuan. In the Marquis's residence, no one else could do this except her.

Yu Ying's heart began to race.

She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, who was also watching her.

"Thought of something?"

Yu Ying nervously fiddled with her fingers, trying to gauge his intentions through his eyes.

After a moment, Yu Ying suddenly realized and punched his chest.

"You already figured it out, didn't you, my lord?"

chapters.title: The Hidden Truth
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou shook his head.

"I don’t know how far the investigation at the manor has gone. I just thought about it in my free time. Grandmother was uneasy about the East Palace’s demand for someone, so I stopped her from pursuing the matter."

"Someone from the East Palace?" Yu Wan suddenly sat up, looking at Zhao Xuanyou in surprise. "Do you mean, the East Palace sent someone to the Marquis’s mansion to take a person?"

"Mmm. The day you were taken, a eunuch from the East Palace came and demanded my concubine."

"How could the Crown Prince…"

A cold smile curled on Zhao Xuanyou’s lips. "It wasn’t his idea. It was the Crown Princess’s."

The Crown Princess?

Yu Wan hadn’t expected this matter to involve more and more people. She looked at Zhao Xuanyou uneasily.

If the Crown Prince secretly took someone, Zhao Xuanyou could still secretly take them back.

But if the Crown Princess openly demanded someone, could Zhao Xuanyou refuse?

Seeing Yu Wan’s worried gaze, Zhao Xuanyou reached out and rubbed her head, pulling her back into his embrace. "No need to worry. The matter is already over."

"Did the Old Dowager tell the people from the East Palace that I had gone missing, and they let it go?"

Yu Wan had indeed gone missing, but if such words were spread, others would only treat it as a flimsy excuse. How could they truly believe it?

"They wanted my concubine. Apart from you, there was another person in the mansion."

"Did the Old Dowager send Huaiyue to the East Palace?" Yu Wan was somewhat taken aback.

She and Zhuang Huaiyue had little interaction. One stayed in Honghui Hall, the other in Leshou Hall. Occasionally, when they met in the mansion, it was only because of Zhao Xuanyou, and their exchanges were brief and polite. She never expected her own affairs to implicate Zhuang Huaiyue.

"No need to worry. She went to the East Palace of her own accord."

"You mean, Huaiyue requested to go to the East Palace herself?"

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement. "If you had been in the mansion, with Grandmother’s personality, she would have handed you over naturally. But since you were truly missing, Grandmother, though reluctant to defy the Crown Princess’s order, could only answer truthfully. The East Palace wanted you. If anyone else went, it would only bring misfortune."

"Huaiyue must have done it for her family’s sake, to take the risk of going to the East Palace."

"You knew?"

A faint sense of melancholy washed over Yu Wan. "Previously, when I was in Honghui Hall, Ziyan mentioned it. She said Huaiyue had always believed her father was wronged and wanted to clear the Zhuang family’s name. The time she... acted rashly in front of you, it was also out of desperation."

Zhao Xuanyou said, "Minister Zhuang was indeed a good official, but the case was not a miscarriage of justice. He was implicated by his subordinates and, in a moment of weakness, left behind evidence. The proof was irrefutable. I truly couldn’t help overturn his case. If she wants to restore the Zhuang family’s status, going to the East Palace is indeed the only way. If she can gain the Crown Prince’s favor and bear him a child, when she is granted a title, her family can be openly and rightfully pardoned."

"So that’s how it is. I hope she gets her wish."

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Yu Wan.

It was rare for her to be by his side again. He didn’t want to dwell on others’ matters.

Recalling the situation at the mountain stronghold yesterday, an idea struck Zhao Xuanyou. He asked, "Do you want to learn horseback riding?"

Yu Wan’s eyes lit up at the words, and she barely managed to restrain herself from jumping in excitement.

Ever since she started following him out, she had watched them all ride freely and envied it greatly.

"I do want to, but the last time I wanted to learn, I was taken by the people from the East Palace. I’m still a little scared."

"What’s there to be afraid of? I’ll teach you."

Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou in surprise. "Won’t you be busy with official duties, my lord?"

"The matters here are almost settled by them. There’s nothing left for me to worry about. I might as well teach you horseback riding to pass the time."

Although Zhao Xuanyou disliked Pei Ta, he had to admit that Pei Ta was quite capable. The affairs of Heishui County were trivial for him, so there was no need for Zhao Xuanyou to interfere.

"Then thank you, Young Master." For some reason, Yu Wan felt that Zhao Xuanyou had discovered something at the mountain stronghold but didn’t want others to know.

Anyway, he would handle the court matters himself.

"Is that all the thanks I get?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a low, husky voice, leaning closer.

Earlier, he had sat coldly by the couch, and Yu Wan had thought he wasn’t in the mood today...

But that was impossible.

In all the time she had known him, when had he ever not been in the mood at night?

Feeling his hand resting on her waist, Yu Wan slowly closed her eyes.

The night wind gently rustled the branches, startling a magpie into sudden flight.

---

The next morning, Zhao Xuanyou opened his eyes before Yu Wan.

He glanced at the sleeping woman beside him on the pillow, reached out, and gently pinched her cheek before getting up to change his clothes.

As soon as he stepped out, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing were already waiting outside the door.

Zhao Xuanyou’s face was stern as he asked in a deep voice, "Is everything taken care of?"

"Rest assured, my lord. All the weapons in the mountain stronghold have been inventoried and recorded," Yuan Zhen replied in a low voice.

"Did it attract any attention?"

Zhao Xuanyou was naturally referring to Zhao Qi and Pei Ta’s subordinates.

"We only said we were inventorying evidence. They didn’t suspect a thing."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod without speaking.

Yesterday, Zhao Xuanyou had inspected the mountain stronghold and indeed made a discovery.

The weapons used by the bandits were not the kind typically used by county yamen runners. They were more like military equipment.

After separately interrogating one of the bandits, he learned that the weapons in the stronghold had been found in a storage room at the county yamen.

Originally, they had thought it was a treasury, but it turned out to be full of weapons.

Impressed by the quality of the weapons, they had transported them back to the stronghold.

Private forging of weapons; now that was interesting.

"Did you find that storage room he mentioned?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Yuan Qing replied, "This subordinate searched the county yamen all night and finally found the entrance the bandit described behind the fake mountain in the back garden."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyebrows twitched.

Yuan Qing immediately understood and replied in a low voice, "Rest assured, my lord. This subordinate has already re-concealed the entrance. No one will discover it."

"As for those bandits I questioned yesterday, find a way to get them out and send them back to the capital first."

Yuan Zhen hesitated. "The guards left at the mountain stronghold are all Prince Qi’s men. If we take the prisoners, we might alert His Highness."

"It’s fine. Even if he finds out, he won’t mind much."

They weren’t taking the bandit leader, so Zhao Qi wouldn’t think too much of it even if he knew.

After a moment’s thought, Zhao Xuanyou added, "Don’t let Pei Ta know."

Zhao Qi was still naive, but Pei Ta was different. If he found out that Zhao Xuanyou was secretly taking people away, he would definitely grow suspicious.

"But..."

As the saying went, first come, first served. Pei Ta had arrived in Heishui County ten days earlier than them. Everywhere was filled with his people. Taking a few living prisoners from the mountain stronghold without Pei Ta’s knowledge would be extremely difficult.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yuan Zhen’s troubled expression and gave him a cold glance. "Tomorrow, the new county magistrate will arrive in Heishui. Pei Ta will have his hands full. Take that opportunity to retrieve the prisoners."

"Yes."

He swallowed slightly, about to give more instructions, when suddenly, he frowned, pushed open the door, and saw Yu Wan standing by the table, pouring tea.

---

chapters.title: A Gathering of Four
chapters.content:
"My lord, would you like some tea?" Yu Wan saw him suddenly open the door and knew he had noticed her. She had no choice but to harden her resolve and speak.

She hadn’t intended to eavesdrop.

When Zhao Xuanyou got up, she had woken up too. She wanted to lie down a bit longer but couldn’t fall back asleep, so she got up.

She had just reached the middle of the room when she heard their master and servants talking outside. She found herself in a dilemma.

Just as she was thinking of drinking some water to soothe her throat, Zhao Xuanyou pushed open the door.

"It’s not good to drink cold tea in the morning. Make a pot of hot tea and bring it over."

"Yes."

Yu Wan let out a small sigh of relief and took the teapot out.

By the time she returned with the hot tea, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing had already left. Only Zhao Xuanyou remained seated at the table.

She approached to pour him tea. Seeing his calm expression, she felt a quiet unease in her heart.

Zhao Xuanyou was always sharp. He wouldn’t truly believe she had accidentally overheard, would he?

"My lord," Yu Wan said carefully.

Zhao Xuanyou took a sip of tea, not even lifting his eyelids as he responded with a hum.

"I wasn’t eavesdropping just now."

Zhao Xuanyou suppressed the smile at the corner of his lips. "What did you hear?"

"I only heard something about taking people away and not letting Magistrate Pei find out..."

The three of them had spoken in low voices, so Yu Wan hadn’t caught the full conversation.

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in acknowledgment.

He had stood at the door to give instructions to Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhen, naturally anticipating that Yu Wan might overhear.

He did it because, in his mind, it didn’t matter.

She was his woman, after all. Whether she heard or not made no difference.

After finishing his tea, Zhao Xuanyou felt much more refreshed. He stood up and said, "Let’s go out for breakfast today. We can’t eat steamed buns every day."

Zhao Xuanyou had stayed in the northwest for a long time and was used to eating noodles in the morning.

"Yes." Yu Wan responded respectfully, then added, "Then I’ll redo my hair."

She had gotten up in a hurry earlier and had only hastily tied her hair into a bun after a quick wash. Since they were going out, she naturally couldn’t be so casual.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly but still nodded in agreement.

Yu Wan was naturally beautiful, and she quickly redid her hair. Not only did she fix her own appearance, but she also re-tied Zhao Xuanyou’s hair with a jade hairpin.

The two of them walked out of the county yamen together. Halfway there, they encountered Zhao Qi.

"Where are you two going today?" Zhao Qi asked.

To be honest, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want to see him right now and remained silent with a stern expression.

Yu Wan smiled and said, "The Young Master and I are going to the market for breakfast. Has Your Highness eaten yet?"

Of course he had.

Yin Ping had already prepared breakfast for Zhao Qi early in the morning.

"I ate a little, but I’m still not full. I’ll go eat some more then."

"Does Your Highness not need to practice today?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Zhao Qi might be naive, but he wasn’t stupid. He could clearly see that Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want him to come along.

If Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want him there, he would insist on going.

"I do need to practice, but I won’t have the energy if I don’t eat. I’ll practice after eating."

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression grew darker, but there was nothing he could do.

After all, no matter how he justified it, he couldn’t stop Zhao Qi from eating his fill.

The three of them walked toward the exit of the county yamen. Just as they were about to leave, they ran into Pei Ta.

Zhao Qi knew Zhao Xuanyou was displeased and deliberately stirred the pot by inviting Pei Ta along.

Pei Ta had been busy with official duties all morning and indeed hadn’t had a chance to eat yet.

Before Pei Ta could respond, Zhao Xuanyou spoke in a deep voice, "Magistrate Pei has county affairs to attend to. When we return, we’ll bring back a portion of breakfast for you."

"It’s just a small county yamen. How much work could there be? It’s just a meal. It won’t take much time. Let’s go, Magistrate Pei."

The person sent to Weizhou hadn’t returned with the county magistrate yet, so Pei Ta truly didn’t have much to do at the moment.

Seeing Zhao Qi’s enthusiastic invitation and glancing at Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan standing together, Pei Ta assumed Zhao Qi was afraid of being left out and readily agreed.

"I’ve heard that the Shui Ji Noodle House on this street is very good. Why not give it a try?"

"Alright, I’ve also heard Shui Ji is good. Let’s eat there."

As Pei Ta and Zhao Qi spoke, they walked ahead.

Yu Wan stood in place, glancing at the man beside her whose expression was growing increasingly rigid. She couldn’t help but feel a little confused.

Whether it was Zhao Qi or Pei Ta, they were all people they saw every day at the county yamen. Was it really such a big deal that they were eating together today? Why was he acting so petty this morning?

"My lord," Yu Wan gently tugged at his sleeve.

At the sight of Yu Wan’s bright, lively eyes, much of Zhao Xuanyou’s anger dissipated.

He reached out and wrapped his arm around Yu Wan’s waist, leading her forward.

The Shui Ji Noodle House was neither too close nor too far from the county yamen. The four of them walked for two streets before arriving.

For the common people, it was already past the time for breakfast, so the restaurant wasn’t very crowded.

After the four of them were seated, they each ordered a bowl of the signature noodles and an extra two catties of mutton.

Zhao Qi had refined tastes, quite different from Zhao Xuanyou’s. Although he joined in and ordered noodles, he also had Yin Ping buy silver thread rolls and soup dumplings from the nearby restaurant.

Unfortunately, he had already eaten steamed buns, so he could only take small bites of each dish. Soon, he was left with nothing to do but watch the other three eat.

Seeing that none of them were speaking, the atmosphere was a little awkward. Yu Wan put down her chopsticks and said, "This noodle soup is fragrant but not greasy. The owner must have a secret recipe."

"Is it good?" Zhao Qi asked.

Yu Wan nodded.

Zhao Qi wanted to try the soup but found there was no spoon. After looking around, he had no choice but to imitate the other diners and lift the bowl to his mouth for a sip.

He had never drunk soup from such a large bowl before. He took too big a sip and nearly choked.

Yu Wan quickly stood up, patted his back to help him catch his breath, and wiped his mouth with a handkerchief.

Zhao Qi was about to comment on the soup’s taste when he met Zhao Xuanyou’s sharp gaze.

He met it with indifference, and only after Zhao Xuanyou turned back to his food with a darkened expression did Zhao Qi turn to Yu Wan and say, "It is indeed good. How about we come here every morning for noodles? I’m tired of steamed buns anyway."

Yu Wan didn’t mind. She glanced at Zhao Xuanyou and softly said, "Even the best food can’t be eaten every day. Let’s find something else tomorrow."

"Then what? You pick, and I’ll follow."

Zhao Qi felt a small sense of satisfaction in his heart.

The more Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want him to get close to Yu Wan, the more he would stick to her.

Pei Ta had been silently eating his noodles. Now that he was almost done, he put down his chopsticks and joined the conversation with a gentle tone.

"There’s also a famous fresh meat shaomai shop on this street."

Zhao Qi looked steadily at Yu Wan. "What do you think?"

Zhao Xuanyou had been silent the whole time. Though his expression was only slightly dark, Yu Wan knew that Zhao Qi had already provoked him. He just didn’t have an excuse to lose his temper yet.

"Fresh meat shaomai can be bought by Yuan Qing and Yuan Zhen. There’s no need to come all this way to eat. Tomorrow, I’ll have them buy some extra and send it to Your Highness and Magistrate Pei early in the morning."

As soon as she finished speaking, Yu Wan clearly felt Zhao Xuanyou’s mood lighten considerably.

"That’s true. We can buy some to take back. After I finish practicing, we can eat together."

Yu Wan saw his enthusiasm and hesitated for a moment before speaking softly, "I’m afraid I won’t be able to keep Your Highness company for practice today."

"What are you going to do?"

"The weather is nice today. The Young Master wants to teach me horseback riding." Yu Wan spoke cautiously, afraid that any wrong word might upset Zhao Qi.

To her surprise, Zhao Qi agreed readily. "The weather is indeed perfect for riding. Heishui County doesn’t have a riding ground, but coincidentally, Magistrate Pei and I discovered a place where horses can run. We can take you there."

chapters.title: Lakeside Absurdity
chapters.content:
Pei Tao followed them all the way from the county yamen, and by now, he understood that Zhao Xuanyou and Zhao Qi were in a silent contest of wills.

Realizing this, he naturally didn’t want to get involved.

So he smiled and said, "Five li east of the city gate, there’s a lake. Though it’s not large, the grass along its shore is lush and green, the scenery is pleasant, and there are few visitors; perfect for horseback riding."

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Pei Tao, finding him quite considerate, and his brows twitched slightly. He murmured, "Thank you for the information."

"You’re welcome, Young Master," Pei Tao said slowly. "There’s also a wooden walkway built along the lake. You can stroll around it or climb the steps up the mountain. It’s rare to have a free day; you might as well enjoy yourself a little longer."

Before Zhao Xuanyou could respond, Zhao Qi interjected, "Yes, and later we can buy some steamed buns and bring them over to eat."

"Your Highness hasn’t practiced your martial arts today," Zhao Xuanyou reminded him in a deep voice.

"I… can’t I just practice when I get back tonight?"

"No. Morning is the best time for training. Your skills are important; you can’t afford to neglect them."

Zhao Qi looked dejected but couldn’t find a reason to argue.

Seeing his disheartened expression, Yu Wan gently comforted him, "Your Highness, go back and practice first. If we’re not back by noon, you can come find us after your meal, and we’ll all go hiking together in the afternoon."

Hearing Yu Wan’s words, Zhao Qi’s mood finally improved a little.

After settling the bill at the noodle shop, the four of them parted ways on the street; Zhao Qi and Pei Tao returned to the yamen, while Zhao Xuanyou took Yu Wan out of the city to find the lake.

As they passed by the shops along the way, Yu Wan bought a lot of snacks.

"So many?" Zhao Xuanyou frowned at the dozen or so oil-paper packages in Yu Wan’s arms.

Yu Wan, clutching the pile of food, couldn’t help but laugh. "I accidentally bought too many. It doesn’t feel like we’re going to learn horseback riding; it feels more like we’re going on a spring outing."

Seeing Yu Wan’s delighted expression, the frost on Zhao Xuanyou’s brows unconsciously melted a little. He led her forward.

The city of Heishui wasn’t large, and after passing through another street, they reached the city gate.

Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing each led two horses, waiting outside the gate. When they saw Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan come out, they stepped forward and respectfully greeted them with a "Young Master."

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t speak, his gaze flicking to the horses behind them.

Yuan Zhen quickly pointed to one of the brown mares and said, "This mare is already thirteen years old. I rode her around outside the city gate for a while; she’s indeed gentle and very suitable for beginners."

"Try touching her mane."

"Okay."

Although Yu Wan didn’t know how to ride, she had grown up in a village and had often interacted with animals, even helping Chen Da Niu feed cattle. Touching a horse was nothing to her.

She walked up to the mare and gently stroked its mane, as if combing its hair.

The mare swayed its head slightly but didn’t react strongly.

"Let’s go. We’ll ride when we get to the lake."

This horse was indeed gentle, and Zhao Xuanyou found it quite suitable.

"Young Master, should I ride now?"

"Of course not," Zhao Xuanyou mounted his own horse first, then lifted Yu Wan onto his lap in front of him. They would still ride together.

Yu Wan turned to look and saw that Yuan Qing had also mounted his horse, holding the reins in one hand and leading the brown mare with the other.

Zhao Xuanyou said in a low voice, "We’ll go ahead first. They’ll catch up later."

"Okay."

Zhao Xuanyou’s mount was a famous Ferghana horse. Though not the legendary Heavenly Horse, it was still quite rare.

With a gentle "Hya," the horse galloped forward as if it understood human intentions.

Yu Wan had ridden with Zhao Xuanyou many times before and was already quite accustomed to it.

She turned her head slightly, leaning against Zhao Xuanyou’s shoulder to prevent the wind from rushing into her nose and mouth.

Five li wasn’t far, and soon, the two of them saw the lake.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t dismount. Instead, he took Yu Wan along the lake at a slow pace.

The lake wasn’t large, but its water was clear, like a piece of blue-green jade set among the mountains.

As Pei Tao had said, there wasn’t a single person around, and the surroundings were peaceful and quiet.

Yu Wan was admiring the scenery when she suddenly felt something was off.

Having served Zhao Xuanyou for some time, she had become keenly attuned to his emotions and reactions.

The moment he acted strangely, she noticed.

But… could he really be aroused at a time like this?

Yu Wan’s heart began to race.

"Young Master, let’s dismount." In broad daylight, with no cover around, just the open grassland, Yu Wan felt her face burning at the mere thought.

"Don’t move."

Zhao Xuanyou held the reins with both hands, keeping Yu Wan firmly in his arms.

He wouldn’t let go, so naturally, she couldn’t dismount. Moreover, his horse was exceptionally tall; even if he let go, she wouldn’t dare jump down on her own.

She couldn’t figure out what Zhao Xuanyou was thinking.

If he wanted to do something wild outdoors, Yu Wan wouldn’t find it strange.

But on horseback?

Yu Wan endured it, the shame in her heart growing stronger.

Before she could think of what to say, Zhao Xuanyou lightly nudged the stirrup, and the horse started galloping again.

Yu Wan swayed on the horse and quickly hugged his arm.

That scorching, iron-like sensation became even more pronounced.

Yu Wan bit her lip, trying her best to ignore it.

The horse ran faster and faster, and both of them bounced with its gallop.

And in that moment, Yu Wan suddenly felt that burning iron shift from behind her to beneath her.

Her heart pounded wildly, almost more erratically than the galloping horse.

"I want to get off! Young Master, I want to get off!" Yu Wan shouted in alarm.

Zhao Xuanyou clearly didn’t take her protest to heart. He said in a deep voice, "Just hold onto my arm."

"No! I won’t hold on!" Yu Wan suddenly forgot her place and shouted at him.

Normally, she obeyed him in everything, but this was the first time she dared to defy Zhao Xuanyou, which took him by surprise.

But this was a scenario he had long fantasized about. Now that he finally had the chance, how could he let it go so easily?

"You’ve grown bold, daring to talk back. But this isn’t up to you." Zhao Xuanyou’s voice carried an unyielding ferocity.

Yu Wan gritted her teeth. She knew this man always did as he pleased. After a moment’s thought, she said, "Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing will be here soon. Aren’t you afraid they’ll see?"

"If they see, they won’t dare come over."

"You’re a master. If your subordinates see you acting so absurdly, how will you maintain your authority to command them in the future?"

"So what? At worst, I’ll drive them away."

Drive them away?

Yu Wan said in a huff, "Then drive me away too and find another servant to attend to you."

"Why would I drive you away?" Zhao Xuanyou’s voice grew even hoarser. Seeing that Yu Wan still refused, he softened his tone and coaxed her, "If you’re scared, just close your eyes. Leave the rest to me."

"That sounds like you’ve done this before. It seems you’re quite familiar with the process!"

Zhao Xuanyou gave a light cough. "This is my first time."

First time?

It didn’t sound like it.

Yu Wan secretly gathered her strength and suddenly elbowed backward.

"Doing such absurd things on horseback. Aren’t you afraid of breaking yourself?"

---

chapters.title: Broken
chapters.content:
Broken?

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes widened at her words.

"Break what? Don’t talk nonsense. Are you hoping for it?"

"I’m not talking nonsense! The horse is running so fast. If something goes wrong… anyway, it won’t be me who breaks! If you insist on doing this, I don’t care."

Zhao Xuanyou had only seen illustrations; he truly didn’t know how it would work in practice.

Hearing Yu Wan repeatedly curse him with breaking, he realized she was strongly opposed.

His long-awaited fantasy was ruined. Zhao Xuanyou sighed deeply and pulled on the reins, slowing the horse to a stop.

While he sighed, Yu Wan secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Finally, he’s given up on that absurd idea!

"Young Master, I’m hungry. Let’s dismount and eat something."

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened, and he casually hummed in response.

He dismounted with Yu Wan in his arms. The moment her feet touched the ground, she quickly wriggled free from his hold, putting distance between herself and that burning iron.

"The steamed buns are still warm. Do you want some?"

"No."

If he didn’t want any, then so be it.

Yu Wan thought for a moment, then opened an oil-paper package and started eating.

She deliberately ate in a way that got oil on her fingers and lips.

She didn’t believe he could still feel desire while watching her eat like this.

Zhao Xuanyou patted the horse’s neck, and the horse trotted toward the lake on its own to drink water and graze.

Seeing him silent and frowning, Yu Wan pretended not to notice and continued eating.

After an awkward silence, Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing finally arrived at the lake.

The brown mare was gentle, but compared to their horses, it naturally couldn’t run as fast, so leading it over had taken a lot of time.

"Mount up." Zhao Xuanyou’s expression was still dark, but at least he was speaking again.

He took the brown mare’s reins from Yuan Zhen and led it to Yu Wan.

"Can you get on by yourself?"

"I’ll try."

Zhao Xuanyou usually mounted his horse by jumping on directly; something Yu Wan couldn’t replicate.

She pinched her fingers, deep in thought, but had no idea how to proceed. Zhao Xuanyou finally spoke.

"Put one foot in the stirrup, hold the saddle with one hand, and push yourself up to sit."

It didn’t sound too difficult.

Yu Wan took a deep breath, placed one hand on the saddle, and put one foot in the stirrup.

Fortunately, the brown mare was indeed gentle. Even as Yu Wan fumbled with the saddle, it stood steady without moving.

After getting one foot in, Yu Wan felt a little more at ease. She took a deep breath, gripped the saddle, and exerted all her strength to pull herself up.

The sudden movement startled the mare, which shifted slightly in place.

"Ah…" Yu Wan couldn’t help but cry out.

Zhao Xuanyou, standing beside her, narrowed his eyes and reached out to grab her arm, pulling her down.

Yu Wan safely settled into the saddle.

"Thank you, Young Master."

"Move forward and backward a bit. See if you’re sitting in the lowest part of the saddle."

"Okay." Yu Wan was always a good student. Following Zhao Xuanyou’s instructions, she shifted back and forth until she adjusted properly. "It does feel steadier now."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded, then glanced at Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing.

Yuan Qing was completely oblivious to his hint, enthusiastically watching Yu Wan learn to ride. Yuan Zhen suddenly tugged at Yuan Qing’s arm and said respectfully to Zhao Xuanyou, "There’s still business at the yamen. Yuan Qing and I will head back first."

"Ah? Oh." Yuan Qing hesitated for a moment before realizing, then followed Yuan Zhen, cupping his fists in a bow before leaving.

Yu Wan, sitting on the horse, cautiously glanced at Zhao Xuanyou.

Was he in such a hurry to send Yuan Zhen and Yuan Qing away because he still had that absurd idea in mind?

Sensing Yu Wan’s scrutiny, Zhao Xuanyou coldly looked at her. "What are you looking at?"

He was truly frustrated.

What was that look in her eyes? Wary and distant, as if he were some kind of lust-crazed demon.

Yes, today’s idea was sudden, but it wasn’t as if he did this with just anyone.

No matter how alluring the fantasy, it was only ever with her.

Sensing the man’s annoyance, Yu Wan quickly averted her gaze and softly said, "Nothing. It’s just… you’re too handsome, and I couldn’t help but admire you."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes flashed with menace.

Earlier, she had been shouting on the horse as if he were forcing her to do something unspeakable, and now she was sweet-talking him.

Clearly, she was getting bolder.

"You, a woman, have learned to be so slick-tongued."

"I’m only speaking the truth."

"Enough nonsense. Do you still want to learn to ride?" Zhao Xuanyou’s tone grew sharper.

"Yes, yes," Yu Wan replied with a forced smile. "What should I do now?"

Zhao Xuanyou let out more rein, glanced at Yu Wan’s legs, and said, "Pull your feet back a little. Just the balls of your feet on the stirrups will do."

"Okay." Yu Wan followed his instructions.

Zhao Xuanyou then led the horse along the lake at a slow walk.

Yu Wan had ridden with him several times before. Though this was her first time actually sitting on a horse, the brown mare was so gentle that the ride wasn’t bumpy at all.

Seeing that Yu Wan moved naturally with the horse’s rhythm, her body relaxed, Zhao Xuanyou gradually picked up the pace after walking a while.

The horse’s movements became slightly faster. After a brief moment of worry, Yu Wan quickly adapted to the new rhythm.

This girl was indeed clever.

Seeing how quickly she learned, Zhao Xuanyou let go of the reins entirely, allowing her to ride slowly along the lake on her own while he followed on his horse.

After circling the lake a few times, Yu Wan became even more comfortable.

Seeing her natural talent, Zhao Xuanyou taught her how to make the horse trot.

The brown mare was obedient, and Yu Wan grew bolder, urging the horse into a light trot along the lake.

Though there were a couple of times when the horse suddenly started, nearly throwing her off, with Zhao Xuanyou riding beside her, Yu Wan wasn’t afraid.

After several attempts, she truly managed to ride the horse in a small trot around the lake.

"Young Master, does this count as having learned?" Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou with hopeful eyes, eager for his approval.

Zhao Xuanyou said, "You can ride this horse, at least."

Most horses weren’t as docile and quiet as the one Yu Wan was riding today. If she wanted to handle those, she’d need more practice.

"But having a horse I can ride is enough." Yu Wan smiled. "At the very least, next time I go out with you on business, I won’t have to ride in a carriage."

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in response, then reached out and lifted her down.

"Let’s eat something."

Yu Wan had been riding enthusiastically by the lake for several hours, and neither of them had remembered to eat lunch. They were indeed starving.

The food they’d bought in the city that morning was all laid out on the wooden walkway. Though wrapped in oil paper, it had long since gone cold.

But at this point, they didn’t care.

"Young Master, this rice cake is better cold. Try some."

Zhao Xuanyou disliked sweet and sticky foods the most, but seeing her lift her hand to feed him, her eyes sparkling, he couldn’t refuse. He opened his mouth and took a bite.

"Not bad." Zhao Xuanyou savored the rice cake and indeed found it tastier than he remembered.

It was early autumn, and the leaves on the mountains hadn’t turned yellow yet. The surroundings were serene and elegant. Yu Wan, in her thin green dress, laughing in the wind, outshone even the most beautiful mountain scenery.

After Zhao Xuanyou had his taste, Yu Wan ate the remaining half of the rice cake. It was sweet and soft, and after finishing it, she licked her fingertips with lingering satisfaction.

Just as she was thinking of having another piece, Zhao Xuanyou reached out and pulled her into his arms.

His warm, soft lips suddenly pressed against her forehead.

chapters.title: Peeping
chapters.content:
At the foot of the mountain by the lake, the scenery was beautiful.

Yu Yuan was held tightly in Zhao Xuanyou's arms, everything she saw and touched was him.

Seeing that he had closed his eyes at some point, Yu Yuan stared at his handsome brow for a moment before closing her eyes as well.

The mountain breeze blew gently, stirring ripples on the lake's surface.

Yu Yuan felt she was running out of breath, so she raised her hand to hold his chin, separating him from her slightly.

"Master, are you still angry?" Yu Yuan asked softly.

She was referring to what had happened on the horse.

Zhao Xuanyou said in a deep voice, "Angry about what?"

At this moment, with her soft and fragrant body in his arms, any anger Zhao Xuanyou had would have dissipated.

Moreover, he wasn't really angry.

At that time, her reaction was so intense that he naturally wouldn't force her, but he harbored a small hope that he could persuade her.

Seeing that he refused to acknowledge what had happened earlier, Yu Yuan raised her chin and said tactfully, "I didn't mean to make you angry, master, it's just..."

"Too shy?"

Shyness was part of it, but more importantly, his idea was simply beyond Yu Yuan's imagination.

In broad daylight, to do such a thing while riding a horse was simply indecent.

"The horse was running so fast, I was really worried about getting hurt."

Yu Yuan didn't resist the idea itself; in fact, over time, it had become a source of pleasure for her.

But when she was lost in pleasure, her mind would go blank, and if she accidentally fell off the horse, wouldn't that be fatal?

"Do you not trust my riding skills?"

Of course, she trusted his riding skills.

But Yu Yuan had also seen him lying on the pillow, lost in ecstasy. Could he really stay alert at such times?

If they both fell off the horse, he would be fine with his martial arts, but Yu Yuan couldn't survive the fall.

"Of course I trust you, master, it's just..." Seeing that she couldn't persuade him, Yu Yuan had to use her trump card. She grabbed his arm and shook it hard. "Master, please don't think about this anymore, okay?"

Zhao Xuanyou loved riding horses, and now, he also loved Yu Yuan.

When he saw the scene of riding and pleasure in the "Avoiding Fire Diagram," it was etched deeply into his mind like a brand.

Hearing Yu Yuan ask him to abandon this idea forever, Zhao Xuanyou felt quite helpless.

"Master?" Not getting a response from Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Yuan softly pleaded again, "If you agree to this, I can agree to something else for you."

"What can you agree to?" Zhao Xuanyou still felt reluctant.

The mountain breeze gently rustled Yu Yuan's clothes. She turned her face away, and the loose collar revealed her fair collarbone.

Her cheeks were slightly red, and her voice carried a nasal tone of embarrassment.

"When we return to the house tonight, whatever you want me to agree to, I will agree."

Zhao Xuanyou looked at the shimmering waves in her eyes, his gaze gradually deepening.

"Anything?"

"Only inside the house." Yu Yuan quickly repeated her condition. Seeing that he was somewhat moved, she tilted her face up close to his chin and rubbed her smooth forehead against his chin.

Zhao Xuanyou looked down at her and finally relented, "You said that."

"You agreed?"

Yu Yuan was overjoyed to see that he had finally given up that absurd idea and kissed him lightly on the lips.

Just as she was about to pull back, her waist was once again held by Zhao Xuanyou, and her heartbeat immediately lost its rhythm.

The distant sky was a deep blue, the grass by the water was like waves, the scenery was beautiful, and the lake's surface rippled with sparkling waves.

On the other side of the lake, where the trees were denser, a young man in a jade crown and brocade robe was about to ride his horse out of the woods when he caught a glimpse of the scene on the opposite shore. His eyes were fixed on the couple embracing and kissing passionately.

Yin Ping and Mu Di, who were riding beside him, naturally saw it clearly as well.

Seeing that Zhao Qi was staring without saying a word, the two guards exchanged a glance. Yin Ping respectfully said, "Your Highness, the people by the lake seem to be Lord Zhao and Miss Yu Yuan. In my opinion, it would be better if Your Highness doesn't go over there now."

"Yeah," Mu Di also whispered in agreement, "Lord Zhao and Miss Yu Yuan are in a romantic moment. It would be a bit of a mood killer if we go over."

Yin Ping glared at Mu Di, who quickly added, "I didn't mean that Your Highness is the mood killer... What I meant was, if Your Highness wants to ride, the scenery is better if we go up the mountain."

Zhao Qi's gaze remained firmly fixed on the two people, as if he hadn't heard Yin Ping and Mu Di speaking.

Yin Ping shook her head at Mu Di, signaling him not to say more, and quietly accompanied Zhao Qi.

The couple on the opposite shore embraced for a long time before finally separating. Then, they held hands and walked along the wooden path by the lake.

They were too far away for Zhao Qi to see their expressions clearly. He only saw the wind moving their clothes as they stood by the water, looking like a perfect couple.

Seeing this, Yin Ping tentatively said, "Your Highness, how about we ride over there now? Miss Yu Yuan has been practicing for half a day; she should be able to ride a horse by now."

"No need to go over."

Zhao Qi's face showed no particular expression. Yin Ping and Mu Di couldn't guess his thoughts; they only knew that he no longer had the enthusiasm he had when he left earlier. They could only ask cautiously, "Your Highness, then we..."

"Let's return to the county yamen." Zhao Qi tightened the reins, turned his horse around, and quickly rode back along the original path out of the forest.

Yu Yuan and Zhao Xuanyou walked by the lake for a while, feeling that they had digested their food, then they rode their horses around the lake a few more times. Compared to the restraint she had felt in the morning, Yu Yuan was much more at ease in the afternoon.

Seeing that the sun was setting in the west, Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Yuan rode back to the city together. Yu Yuan's horse was not fast, unlike the swift ride they had taken earlier.

Zhao Xuanyou accommodated her pace all the way, and they returned to the county yamen before dark.

A month passed in a flash, and Yu Yuan lived quite leisurely in the county yamen.

She had originally come to Heishui County to avoid the Eastern Palace, but unexpectedly, she learned to ride a horse here. Whenever Zhao Xuanyou had time, he would take her out of the city to ride.

In the past, at the Marquis's residence, there were many rules, and the rules at the imperial palace were even stricter. Eunuchs and maids controlled everything, and most of the time, she was confined to a small courtyard.

The Heishui County yamen was different.

Originally, the people in the yamen had either been killed or had fled, leaving no trace. The large yamen now housed only a few of them.

The corrupt official, upon returning to Heishui County, had been imprisoned by Pei Tao and Zhao Xuanyou and was being interrogated daily.

Yu Yuan only needed to arrange meals for a few people.

There were several good restaurants in the city, and Yu Yuan was too lazy to cook, so she changed restaurants every day.

The restaurants, knowing that high-ranking officials were now staying at the yamen, were more than willing to deliver meals to the yamen, saving Yu Yuan a lot of trouble.

The only strange thing was that Zhao Qi suddenly stopped acknowledging her.

Not only did he stay in his own courtyard for daily practice and martial arts, but he also had Yin Ping bring his meals back to eat, rarely showing his face.

One day, Yu Yuan made some pastries and sent them over, but he only let her put them down without saying a word.

Yu Yuan really didn't know what she had done wrong to offend the young prince.

But Zhao Qi was not her master after all, and if he didn't acknowledge her, she didn't have to seek his approval.

With her days free, she simply bought paper, brushes, and calligraphy books, and started practicing her calligraphy again.

---

chapters.title: Making Other Plans
chapters.content:
"Your son greets the Empress Dowager."

At noon, Crown Prince Zhao Zun entered the Liu Li Palace and cupped his hands in greeting to the empress, who sat in the tea room with a gloomy expression.

The empress had always loved luxury, and even the tea room was adorned with hanging curtains, gilded and inlaid with jade.

Looking at the crown prince who respectfully bowed before her, the empress glanced at the nearby female official, who understood her meaning. The official led the attendants out of the hall and closed the door to the tea room.

The moment the door was closed, the crown prince, seeing the empress's gloomy face, slightly furrowed his brows.

"Are you still summoning me because of the Crown Princess's matter? These days, I have been sharing a bed with the Crown Princess and have not gone against your wishes, Mother."

If he hadn't brought it up, it would have been fine, but mentioning it made the empress even angrier.

Since the incident with the concubine from the Marquis's residence, Zhao Zun had indeed softened and no longer lived separately from the Crown Princess.

But there were many of the empress's trusted palace maids in the Zhonghua Hall. Over time, the empress found out that even though they shared a room, it was no different from living separately.

After more than a month, they hadn't even called for water at night, which clearly meant the crown prince hadn't touched the Crown Princess at all during this time.

"Really not going against my wishes?" the empress asked with a furious gaze.

The crown prince remained silent.

Seeing his expression, the empress suppressed her dissatisfaction and waved her hand at him.

"Let's set this matter aside for now. I called you here today for something else. Sit down first."

Something else?

Hearing that the empress wasn't going to discuss him and the Crown Princess, Zhao Zun's brows and eyes relaxed slightly, and he sat down beside the empress.

Seeing that the usually composed empress had a very solemn expression, he realized that something significant must have happened.

The crown prince asked with concern, "Mother, why did you call me here? What instructions do you have?"

"There's been a problem with your uncle's side."

The crown prince's maternal grandfather was the meritorious official who had helped the current emperor ascend to the throne. After the emperor took the throne, he personally bestowed the title of Duke of Zhen Guo upon him.

After the duke passed away, the empress's elder brother inherited the title.

Although he was not as powerful as the Duke of Ningguo or the Marquis of Jingyuan, who dominated their regions, he still controlled a large imperial camp near the capital. Because of its proximity to the capital, his influence was not to be underestimated.

For Zhao Zun, his uncle's title and military power were important chips to secure his position as the heir to the throne.

However, his uncle was not as capable as his grandfather, and in the past two years, he had made many mistakes. The crown prince had often stepped in to help.

To cover up those scandals, he naturally had to do some underhanded things.

More than half of the memorials impeaching the crown prince in the court were related to his uncle.

Over the years, Zhao Zun's attitude towards this uncle had also changed.

His resistance to the Crown Princess was not entirely unrelated to his uncle's actions.

"What happened again?" Hearing that it was about the Duke of Zhen Guo's family, Zhao Zun immediately frowned.

The empress naturally noticed his attitude, but the matter was urgent, and she didn't have time to lecture Zhao Zun about the principle of "lips and teeth depend on each other, share glory and share disaster."

She had received a secret letter from her brother today, and knowing the gravity of the situation, she had waited for Zhao Zun to finish at the emperor's Mingde Hall before summoning him to the Liu Li Palace to discuss countermeasures.

Seeing the crown prince's displeasure, the empress didn't care whether he was willing or not and got straight to the point: "Do you know about the situation in Heishui County?"

Heishui County?

Wasn't that the place where Pei Tao, Zhao Xuanyou, and Zhao Qi went together? Why would Mother suddenly bring it up?

The crown prince was somewhat surprised and really didn't know why the empress was asking about this.

"I know, Mother. Two months ago, a group of rebellious commoners in Heishui County rioted, boldly attacked the county yamen, killed the county magistrate's family and the yamen runners, looted the yamen's property, and then occupied the mountain to become bandits. Zhao Qi was ordered by Father Emperor to go and suppress them. Pei Tao and Zhao Xuanyou were also there. It's been over a month now. The matter should be almost resolved. What does this have to do with Uncle?"

"Greatly related."

"I don't quite understand what Mother means."

Seeing the crown prince's indifferent attitude, the empress suddenly raised her voice: "That county magistrate of Heishui is your uncle's man."

"That Heishui County is more than a hundred miles away from the capital. How can the county magistrate be Uncle's man?"

"Don't ask how it happened. The urgent matter now is that he is your uncle's man!"

The crown prince's expression darkened as he heard the empress's almost scolding tone, and he said coldly, "I have read the memorials. Zhao Qi captured the mountain stronghold not long after arriving, and all the rebellious commoners were captured. Originally, they were to be executed on the spot, but Pei Tao said that the Heishui County magistrate was a corrupt official who had intensified tax collection during a famine, making the local people suffer greatly. Father Emperor has already approved for him to stay in Heishui County to investigate thoroughly. This matter happened so long ago. If Uncle wanted to save the man, he should have spoken up earlier. It's too late now."

The empress had already been informed of these matters in the secret letter from the Duke of Zhen Guo.

The empress sighed, "Zun, all the things you mentioned, I understand. I also think that my brother was wrong not to warn us earlier. But now that the incident has already happened, I called you here to think of a way to remedy it."

"What other ways are there? If we had known earlier, I would naturally have sent my own people to Heishui to suppress the bandits. Now that it's in Zhao Qi's hands, with Pei Tao and Zhao Xuanyou beside him, I really can't do anything. It's just a county magistrate; if he falls, he falls."

After the crown prince's breathing steadied somewhat, the empress continued in a gentle voice, "A mere seventh-rank minor official falling is naturally no problem. But he has been secretly working for your uncle, and this matter must never be discovered."

The crown prince suppressed his anger and asked, "Did all the silver that county magistrate extorted from the people go into Uncle's vault?"

"Shut up!" the empress reprimanded in a low voice, slamming her hand on the table with force, her expression dark. "Everything your uncle did was for you!"

"For me?" The crown prince laughed in extreme anger. "My food, clothing, and daily necessities are all obtained according to the rules from the Imperial Household Department on time, without any excess. Even if I like to eat Western grapes, I absolutely do not allow them to send more."
