And since she was a companion reader to Princess Yi'an, those in the court familiar with the royal family would not find it difficult to guess who her lover was, which would inevitably provoke the Empress and the Crown Prince.

As the young master of the Marquis's residence and a legitimate member of the clan, he couldn't act entirely as he pleased; he always had to consider a way out for the entire clan.

But now, everything was different.

Thinking about how Cui Yichu had ordered Bao Chan to kill Yu Wan while he was away from the capital, Zhao Xuanyou felt a storm brewing in his heart.

How much did they underestimate the Marquis of Jingyuan? First, they tried to deceive him with a non-virgin, and after being expelled from the Marquis's residence, they still tried to harm his woman!

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly felt that he still wasn't ruthless enough.

Otherwise, they wouldn't dare to be so arrogant.

"Master," Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou with some concern.

Zhao Xuanyou concealed the anger in his heart, his expression calm. "What's wrong?"

Yu Wan leaned against his shoulder, her voice weak. "I'm so tired. One wave after another, the matter with the Prince of Xingguo's residence isn't resolved, and now I've provoked the Eastern Palace. I'm afraid there will be a lot more trouble ahead."

"It's fine. We'll deal with each problem as it comes. You just live peacefully in the Marquis's residence and need not worry about the rest."

Yu Wan softly hummed in agreement.

After a moment of silence, Zhao Xuanyou said, "When we return to the residence today, we will first clean out the pests and cockroaches in the house."

Yu Wan's eyes flickered as she recalled their conversation that night when he said he would deal with the accomplices involved in Bao Chan's attempt to kill her.

Could it really be Feng Tang?

Yu Wan had no evidence, but apart from Feng Tang, it was indeed hard to imagine who else could have known her whereabouts.

But Feng Tang was a beauty sent by Prince Ping... Well, Zhao Xuanyou now didn't even fear the Crown Prince, so dealing with a concubine from the Prince's residence should be no problem.

But why had he suddenly stopped fearing the Crown Prince and Prince Ping? Had he found a greater backer? The Emperor?

As her thoughts raced, the carriage slowly came to a halt.

Yu Wan followed Zhao Xuanyou out of the carriage and saw Feng Tang, dressed in blue, coming out to greet them.

---

chapters.title: Doomed
chapters.content:
"Greetings, Young Master."

Although Feng Tang was dressed brightly and prettily, Yu Wan could see that she had lost a lot of weight and looked somewhat haggard.

Zhao Xuanyou ignored her and led Yu Wan straight into the residence.

After the long journey, Zhao Xuanyou returned to Honghui Hall, first sending someone to report his safe return to Lady Ye, then carefully washing up and changing into a dark green casual robe before heading to Leshou Hall.

Though he was a military officer, his upbringing in the Marquis's residence had instilled in him a love for literature, and without his armor, he exuded a refined and elegant demeanor.

"You will come with me to pay respects to Grandmother."

Recalling what he had said in the carriage, Yu Wan guessed what he intended to do at Leshou Hall.

"Master, you want to handle such a big matter as soon as you return? Won't Grandmother..."

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled lightly. "Grandmother has lived through two dynasties. Such a small matter is nothing in her eyes."

"Yes."

After more than a month of freedom in Heishui County, Yu Wan had changed back into the attire of a maidservant of the Marquis's residence and followed Zhao Xuanyou.

At Leshou Hall, Lady Ye, missing her grandson dearly, had already prepared a lavish feast in the warm pavilion.

Feng Jiarou, dressed in fine clothes, was seated next to Zhao Xuanyou by Lady Ye's arrangement. Strangely, Feng Tang, the only concubine in the residence, was not present.

After the meal, Feng Jiarou could see that they had things to discuss, so she excused herself to return to her room for embroidery.

Zhao Xuanyou sipped some tea to moisten his throat, then briefly recounted the official business in Lichuan and Heishui.

Lady Ye, of course, wasn't concerned about these matters.

Yu Wan's disappearance, Bao Chan's sudden death, and Zhuang Huaiyue being taken by the Eastern Palace; thinking that Zhao Xuanyou had now fallen out with the Crown Prince, she was naturally worried, and even chanting scriptures and praying couldn't calm her mind.

Recently, she had been sleeping less, and the scent of sedative incense permeated Leshou Hall inside and out.

"Grandmother need not worry about me. All troubles have been resolved."

"Truly resolved?" Lady Ye glanced at Yu Wan standing beside her and gave Zhao Xuanyou a meaningful look.

Zhao Xuanyou understood; Grandmother was still worried about the Eastern Palace matter.

Initially, the Eastern Palace had wanted Yu Wan, but the Marquis's residence had sent Huaiyue instead.

Yu Wan had returned safely, so Grandmother naturally wanted to send Yu Wan to the Eastern Palace to appease the Crown Prince's anger and let bygones be bygones.

Zhao Xuanyou, of course, would not send Yu Wan away. After a moment of thought, he softly reassured, "When the Crown Prince went to Heishui County, Yu Wan was also at the county yamen. We all traveled together from Heishui back to the capital. If His Highness truly still had intentions, there would have been plenty of opportunities to take Yu Wan away."

That was true.

After all, he was the Crown Prince. If he truly wanted Yu Wan that much, he could have simply asked, and as subjects, they couldn't refuse.

Lady Ye finally believed Zhao Xuanyou's words.

"It's best if it's over. But poor Huaiyue, I don't know how she is faring in the Eastern Palace."

Zhuang Huaiyue had her own reasons for willing to enter the Eastern Palace.

Previously, both the Crown Prince and the Crown Princess were in Lichuan, so she should be safe.

"Today, the Crown Prince returned to the court, but the Crown Princess did not follow. Perhaps she has a chance."

Zhuang Huaiyue was quite beautiful, and Zhao Zhen was fond of beauty; it was very possible he would be captivated.

However, being favored once was not difficult, but to secure the Zhuang family's pardon, she would need to maintain that favor indefinitely.

The Marquis of Jingyuan's residence had already done what it could to help. The rest was Zhuang Huaiyue's own chosen path, and she would have to rely on herself.

Zhao Xuanyou advised, "Grandmother, the Zhuang family has fallen on hard times, and we did not kick them while they were down. We also helped Zhuang Huaiyue. Now, she has chosen to enter the Eastern Palace for the sake of her family. It is her own choice."

"You're right. Everyone has their own path. I hope she fares well in the Eastern Palace." After sighing, Lady Ye looked at Zhao Xuanyou again. "These days, Manager Song has been investigating the residence as you instructed. Since you're back, quickly settle this matter. Let everyone in the residence work in peace and not live in fear."

Lady Ye knew in her heart.

Manager Song had already investigated almost everything. Zhao Xuanyou hadn't let her deal with it because he wanted to wait until he returned to let Yu Wan vent her anger in person.

Seeing how much he cared for Yu Wan, Lady Ye was naturally displeased.

"Grandson understands. This matter will be settled today."

There were only a few people in the residence. Feng Jiarou was a simple-minded young girl, and Lady Ye could guess who the accomplice was.

"After all this talk, I'm tired. Later, have Mama Xing bring the person over, and you deal with it."

Zhao Xuanyou saw that Lady Ye was tired and personally helped her back to her room to rest.

While Yu Wan waited outside, Mama Xing brought her another bowl of contraceptive soup.

Compared to dealing with Feng Tang, the old lady indeed cared more about Zhao Xuanyou.

Yu Wan, as usual, picked up the bowl and drank it all in one go.

Anyway, she had been taking it herself while away, and having Mama Xing prepare it back at the residence would save her the trouble.

Just as she was wiping her mouth with a handkerchief, Zhao Xuanyou came out from the inner room, frowning as he asked, "What is that smell?"

Yu Wan hadn't expected him to come out so quickly. She smiled slightly and whispered, "If the old lady has already rested, won't Master talking here wake her up?"

"It's fine." Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly but didn't pursue the matter. He turned to Mama Xing. "Take the person to the courtyard."

"Yes." Mama Xing exited.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head, his gaze falling back on Yu Wan.

Feeling his scrutiny, Yu Wan asked curiously, "Master, what's wrong?"

"What did you just eat? The smell is so strong."

"It's the medicine the old lady rewarded me with."

Zhao Xuanyou's expression tightened slightly upon hearing this. "Didn't I say you don't need to drink it anymore?"

"Master hasn't married yet. It's safer to continue drinking it."

Zhao Xuanyou was about to say something more when Mama Xing called from outside, "Young Master, the person is here."

He temporarily suppressed his annoyance and turned to walk outside.

Yu Wan watched his retreating figure with a frown, somewhat puzzled.

Why was he suddenly angry? Could it be that he was anxious for an heir?

In the capital, many nobles of weak crown age already had children. The Marquis of Jingyuan's residence had few descendants, so perhaps he was truly anxious.

The future mistress of the residence was still unknown, and Yu Wan had no desire to become pregnant.

In the courtyard, Feng Tang and her personal maid stood together, their faces pale, looking in terror at Zhao Xuanyou under the corridor.

After Yu Wan and Bao Chan's disappearance, on the fifth day, the old lady had said that the chaos in the residence was due to Feng Tang's poor management and stripped her of her authority as assistant manager of the household.

Since then, whenever Feng Tang came to Leshou Hall to pay her respects, the old lady refused to see her. Feng Tang had already sensed that something was amiss.

But with Yu Wan missing without a trace, they couldn't just blame her for no reason, could they?

Over the past month, she had been unable to eat or sleep well and had lost so much weight that she was almost unrecognizable.

Today, upon hearing that Zhao Xuanyou had returned to the residence, she had dressed carefully and gone to the front gate to welcome him, hoping to seize one last chance.

But the moment she saw Yu Wan, alive and well, standing next to Zhao Xuanyou, she knew she was doomed.

chapters.title: Vulgar Charm
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, his gaze lingering on Feng Tang for a moment before shifting to the maid beside her.

The maid was named Jin Que. She didn’t dare meet Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes. Overwhelmed by his presence, she couldn’t even stand steadily and knelt on the ground, kowtowing frantically.

"Worldly Prince, spare my life! Spare my life!"

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes slightly, sitting in the master’s chair on the veranda, and said in a deep voice, "Speak. What have you done that requires begging for mercy?"

Upon hearing this, Jin Que immediately confessed everything she knew, as if beans were spilling from a bamboo tube.

It turned out that when Cui Yichu was still the mistress of the Marquis’s mansion, she had noticed Feng Tang’s dissatisfaction with Yu Wan’s favor.

Even after Cui Yichu’s divorce, she still held a grudge against Yu Wan and wanted to eliminate her.

During her year as mistress, apart from her own companions, she had also purchased some people, so she still had accomplices in the Marquis’s mansion.

Upon learning that Zhao Xuanyou had never touched Feng Tang, Cui Yichu had an idea. She sent her accomplice to deliver a message to Feng Tang, ordering her to contact Baochuan and ensure Yu Wan was eliminated.

As Jin Que confessed, Feng Tang’s heart turned to ash, and she looked at Zhao Xuanyou helplessly.

She had never intended to kill Yu Wan.

She only agreed to cooperate because Cui Yichu’s persuasion was too tempting.

Zhao Xuanyou was not in the capital, once he left, Old Madam Ye stopped managing affairs, and even half of the guards at Honghui Hall were taken away.

With Yu Wan dead and Baochuan taking the blame, the plan would be flawless.

But who could have predicted that Yu Wan would escape unscathed from Baochuan’s axe?

Now, Zhao Xuanyou had returned to the capital with Yu Wan, and the first thing he did was to settle the score with her. Did she still have any hope of survival?

"Jin Que is your personal maid. Do you admit to what she has said?"

"Does the Worldly Prince still want to hear my defense?"

"You only need to answer: do you admit it or not?"

Feng Tang heard the emotionless question and knew there was no use in stubbornly resisting.

"It was I who went to find Baochuan. I told her that her family was in Cui Yichu’s hands. If she did not obey, her mother and her sister would not live."

Yu Wan heard this and confirmed her earlier suspicions.

When Baochuan was alive, Yu Wan did not want Zhao Xuanyou to think she was ruthless, so she had never troubled Baochuan.

Baochuan certainly resented her, but she was someone who feared death. After enduring so much dirty and exhausting work in the Marquis’s mansion for so long, why would she suddenly go mad and seek mutual destruction with Yu Wan?

Yu Wan had suspected that Baochuan was instigated by Cui Yichu or Feng Tang, but she had not expected that Cui Yichu had threatened Baochuan with her family’s lives.

Cui Yichu was not only cruel to Yu Wan but also to others.

She wondered if Baochuan had regretted her loyalty to such a mistress before her death.

"Since you admit it, then it’s simple. Xing Mama."

"Slave is here."

"Take her to the front courtyard. Have Manager Song send her and her maid to the authorities."

Feng Tang was a concubine sent by Prince Ping. It would be convenient for Zhao Xuanyou to handle her himself, but he was too lazy to explain to Prince Ping, so it was better to send her to the authorities for a clean resolution.

"Yes." Xing Mama immediately ordered the servants beside her to tie up the mistress and maid.

Feng Tang knew her fate was sealed and did not struggle, but Jin Que beside her wailed incessantly.

"Worldly Prince, slave really tried to persuade Mistress Feng! Slave did not want to help her harm others, but slave had no choice!"

Zhao Xuanyou shot her a fierce glance. "In such a large Marquis’s mansion, with so many masters, you truly had no choice?"

Yu Wan looked at Jin Que’s desperate and helpless appearance and suddenly felt a pang of pity.

What choices did a maid have?

It was Feng Tang who resented Yu Wan, and it was Feng Tang who had the intention to kill. Yu Wan would not show mercy to Feng Tang, but this maid, Jin Que, truly did not deserve to die.

Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou and said softly, "Worldly Prince, since she has honestly confessed, perhaps..."

Hearing Yu Wan speak up for her, Jin Que struggled free from the servant’s grasp, knelt on the ground, and kowtowed to Yu Wan.

"Miss Yu Wan, please save my life! Slave truly had no choice! Please save slave’s life, and slave will never dare again!"

Zhao Xuanyou saw her speak and narrowed his eyes. "You want me to spare her?"

"She is indeed at fault, but she is only an accomplice. She has exposed Cui’s and Mistress Feng’s crimes and also revealed the accomplices Cui left in the mansion. She has at least redeemed herself somewhat."

Having listened to Pei Ta’s lectures in Lichuan, she had indeed made progress.

"You are quite a fair and just magistrate."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou’s teasing words, Yu Wan smiled and asked, "Does the Young Master agree?"

Zhao Xuanyou neither confirmed nor denied, only saying to Xing Mama, "Take Feng Tang to the authorities. As for Jin Que... send her to a distant estate. Have someone keep a close eye on her. If she dares to offend again, punish her severely."

Being sent to the authorities, she would not die but would suffer greatly.

Life on the estate might be hard, but at least she would be safe.

"Thank you, Worldly Prince. Thank you, Miss Yu Wan." Jin Que kowtowed repeatedly in gratitude.

"Take them away." After dealing with Feng Tang, Zhao Xuanyou called Manager Song over. Apart from the few people Jin Que had implicated, who were to be sent to the authorities, all other maids and servants purchased by Cui Yichu during her time as mistress were to be sold off.

The Jingyuan Marquis’s mansion could not tolerate worms. It was best to clean them all out at once.

---

"Your Highness, the hot spring bath is ready."

In the Eastern Palace, an inner attendant respectfully approached.

The Crown Prince was flipping through the Blackwater case files organized by the Grand Secretary, his face filled with exhaustion.

The Blackwater case involved many people, and the files needed to be flawless. This was also the reason why the Empress had insisted he take over the case.

Private forging of weapons was a serious matter. Even the officials willing to follow him might not be willing to share the blame for a crime punishable by the extermination of nine clans.

After carefully reviewing, he still felt the explanation for the tax revenue’s whereabouts was unclear.

How could filling the gambling debts of a spendthrift son cost so much silver?

He would have to produce some antiques and paintings from the previous dynasty and claim the magistrate had a hobby of collecting rare artifacts. He needed to sign and seal the documents before the man died.

"Your Highness, please take care of your health." The inner attendant, seeing his concentration, advised concernedly.

"Mmm." Ever since learning about the private forging of weapons, the Crown Prince had been restless. Now that he had finally returned to the capital, he should indeed relax a little.

The Eastern Palace had a natural hot spring bath built, which was most effective for relieving fatigue.

The inner attendant helped the Crown Prince change clothes, then said, "Shall Your Highness have Concubine Liang come to attend to you?"

"No need."

"What about Concubine Xie?"

The Crown Prince felt inexplicably irritated and coldly glanced at the inner attendant. "Just common powdered faces."

The women in the Eastern Palace were all selected by the Empress Dowager. They were somewhat beautiful but held little attraction for the Crown Prince; either dull or vulgar.

None were as elegantly aloof as Cui Yichu, nor as charming and considerate as Yu Wan.

"You’ve seen Yu Wan. Are there any palace maids in the Eastern Palace like her, both enchanting and pleasing?"

Palace maids?

The inner attendant looked troubled.

The palace maids in the Eastern Palace were the best from the Shanggong Bureau, which meant they were beautiful but not seductive enough, gentle and dignified but not bold enough.

If Yu Wan were a palace maid, her figure alone would not meet the standards of the Empress and the Crown Princess. She would never be allowed to serve in the Eastern Palace.

Seeing the inner attendant’s long silence, the Crown Prince angrily said, "Useless! In such a large Eastern Palace, you can’t even find a decent woman! I, the Crown Prince, am not as free as Zhao Xuanyou!"

The inner attendant bowed his head and endured the scolding. Hearing the mention of Zhao Xuanyou, he suddenly remembered something.

"Your Highness, there is actually a maid from the Marquis’s mansion in the Eastern Palace."

---

chapters.title: Climbing the Dragon
chapters.content:
Hearing the inner attendant say this, the Crown Prince did indeed recall.

Earlier, when Wen Ji reported that Yu Wan had been captured again, the Crown Princess also informed him that the person had been taken to the Eastern Palace. After questioning both sides, he learned that another maid from the Marquis’s mansion had been sent to the Eastern Palace.

Since he knew Yu Wan was indeed not in the Marquis’s mansion, he did not pursue the matter of the wrong person and did not have the maid punished.

But after that, Yu Wan escaped again, his hideout in the capital was raided by Zhao Xuanyou, and then there was the Blackwater County incident; nothing good happened.

Now, hearing the inner attendant mention it again, his anger flared. "A woman who has been with Zhao Xuanyou, would I want her?"

Seeing his great anger, the inner attendant could only lower his head, but in his heart, he grumbled: Wasn’t Yu Wan also Zhao Xuanyou’s woman, and yet you still wanted to take her?

"The slave naturally does not mean that. When that maid entered the Eastern Palace, the matrons examined her and confirmed she was still a virgin, untouched by Zhao Xuanyou." The inner attendant said with a forced smile.

"Whether she is or not, I don’t care." The Crown Prince coldly replied.

"The slave mentions it because Your Highness has seen her before."

The Crown Prince frowned slightly. "A lowly maid, how would I have seen her?"

"That maid is not from a common family. She is the daughter of the former Minister of Works, Zhuo Lingkang; Zhuo the Minister. Does Your Highness remember?"

Of course he did. Zhuo Lingkang was a second-rank official. The confiscation of his property was a major event, so the Crown Prince naturally remembered.

"You mean, the Marquis’s mansion sent Zhuo... what month to the Eastern Palace?"

"Huaiyue, her name is Zhuo Huaiyue."

The Crown Prince certainly remembered her.

Before his marriage to Prince Ping, the Empress Dowager often hosted palace banquets, inviting the daughters of noble families in the capital to the palace to appreciate flowers and drink tea.

Although his choice had already been decided, the Empress Dowager always had to put on a show for the Emperor.

At that time, Zhuo Huaiyue, as the daughter of a second-rank official, naturally attended the banquet.

She was younger than Cui Yichu, and not yet fully grown, so the Crown Prince had no particular interest in her.

But she had a delicate and weak appearance, with a pair of black eyes that seemed misty, which had indeed left an impression on the Crown Prince.

"How did she end up in the Marquis’s mansion?" The Crown Prince asked curiously.

The inner attendant replied, "After Minister Zhuo’s family was confiscated, the women of the family were not sent to the Ministry of Rites to become official servants. It seems the Marquis’s mansion had old ties with the Zhuo family, so they took Zhuo Huaiyue in. I heard she had been serving the old madam of the Marquis’s mansion."

The Crown Prince said nothing more. He removed his clothes and entered the steaming hot spring.

Immersed in the warm water, his fatigue truly melted away.

Seeing the Crown Prince closing his eyes to rest, the inner attendant, while massaging his shoulders, softly said, "If this Zhuo Huaiyue is useless, the slave will still send her away."

Zhuo Huaiyue was not an officially registered palace servant. If the Crown Prince did not give the word, she could not stay in the Eastern Palace to serve.

"Bring her over."

"Yes."

After a moment, the inner attendant led Zhuo Huaiyue to the edge of the hot spring.

Looking at the cold and stern man in the spring, Zhuo Huaiyue was naturally terrified.

The last time, she had tried to use her beauty to serve Zhao Xuanyou but was humiliatingly driven out of Honghui Hall. This time was her last chance, and she could not afford to fail.

"Slave greets Your Highness, the Crown Prince."

"Lift your head." The Crown Prince coldly ordered.

Zhuo Huaiyue had attended a few palace banquets but had never spoken to the Crown Prince, only exchanging glances twice in the imperial garden.

At that time, she was young, and her status was not prominent. She had entered the palace to accompany others, so naturally, she did not approach the Crown Prince.

Times had changed. She was no longer the daughter of a minister but a fallen woman. To climb out of the abyss, she had to desperately seek his favor.

Remembering that the Crown Prince also liked Yu Wan, Zhuo Huaiyue tried to imitate Yu Wan’s coquettish demeanor and lifted her head to smile at the Crown Prince.

The Crown Prince’s gaze lingered on her.

In his memory, the girl had her hair loose, tied into a single bun with a jade hairpin, wearing a crimson palace dress like the other palace maids, with a sash tightly cinching her waist, making her appear even more slender.

Now, her smiling face was beautiful, but it clearly held an intent to please.

However... the Crown Prince could see that her face was bare, without any powder or rouge, naturally beautiful.

It seemed she had not expected to be summoned by the Crown Prince and had not had time to dress up.

"Actually, you look better when you are not smiling."

Zhuo Huaiyue was slightly stunned, unsure what expression she should make. In her panic, she could only lower her head.

"Slave understands."

The Crown Prince took in her nervousness and fluster, his mood slightly improving. He said indifferently, "This dress does not suit you. Discard it."

Discard it?

Zhuo Huaiyue looked at the Crown Prince inquiringly and received an affirmative glance from his eyes.

Finally... finally, she would not be humiliatingly driven out again.

She took a deep breath and, as instructed, discarded her clothes. Step by step, she entered the hot spring.

---

"Huaiyue has gained favor in the Eastern Palace?"

When Yuan Zhen reported to Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Wan couldn’t help but interject.

"Yes. His Highness the Crown Prince has already bestowed the title of Zhaoxun upon her. I heard that since returning to the capital half a month ago, he has been favoring her continuously, neglecting the other concubines."

"It’s good that she has finally gotten what she wanted."

Zhao Xuanyou, originally disinterested, glanced at Yu Wan upon hearing this.

"What’s good about it? Are you jealous?"

Yu Wan saw his sudden coldness and didn’t dare to retort, only saying, "You misunderstand, Young Master. Huaiyue ended up in the Eastern Palace because of me. Without the Crown Prince’s favor, she would have no place to stand. I am happy for her. Whether I want to climb the social ladder or not, you should be clear about. You really wrong me."

What was there for her to be jealous of?

If she wanted to attach herself to the Crown Prince, she could have taken the opportunity in Blackwater County to ingratiate herself. Would she still be here in Honghui Hall polishing vases for him?

Zhao Xuanyou cleared his throat and said no more.

Yu Wan was filled with unjustified anger but couldn’t vent it. She put down her handkerchief. "You promised today was a day off. I should go out."

"Mmm." Zhao Xuanyou knew he was in the wrong and nodded. Pointing at Yuan Qing, he said, "You, harness the carriage and send Yu Wan to the Taoran Inn."

At least he had some conscience.

Yu Wan curtsied to him and left the mansion with Yuan Qing.

Riding in the Marquis’s carriage was convenient, and soon they arrived at the inn’s entrance.

Yu Wan carried her packages into the inn. The innkeeper, seeing her, hurriedly led her to the upper room.

"When I heard that the Young Master had returned to the capital, I knew Miss Yu Wan would come to the inn."

"Innkeeper Li, how has my mother been these days?"

Chen Da Niu was often confused, and Liu Da Nian only knew how to work, so these two couldn’t clearly explain her mother’s condition.

"Physician Feng said that the blood clot in her head has completely dispersed."

"My mother has woken up?"

Innkeeper Li looked troubled, hesitated for a moment, and slowly said, "She should have woken up, but after opening her eyes once, there has been no further movement. Physician Feng also cannot explain why."

Yu Wan’s hands suddenly clenched together as if struck by lightning.

Wasn’t it said that once the blood clot in the brain dispersed, she would wake up? Why was her mother still unconscious? What other physicians could they consult? What other methods could they try?

All along, no matter what kind of predicament or dead end she faced, Yu Wan had been fearless because she had to live to wait for her mother to wake up.

But... but...

Innkeeper Li saw Yu Wan’s grief and the tears quickly filling her eyes. He didn’t know how to comfort her. After Yu Wan entered the upper room, he took Chen Da Niu and Liu Da Nian out.

"Mother, what should your daughter do? Mother, please wake up!"

Yu Wan dropped her things and threw herself onto the woman on the bed, weeping bitterly.

Outside, Yuan Qing and the others heard her sobs and were all pained.

At the same time, a frail hand rested on Yu Wan’s shoulder.

chapters.title: Escape
chapters.content:
Yu Wan suddenly lifted her head, meeting a pair of eyes filled with both joy and worry.

"Mother..."

"Shh, don't speak." The woman on the bed struggled to speak, her voice hoarse and unpleasant from disuse.

Yet to Yu Wan, this voice was like heavenly music.

Mother was awake?

Mother was speaking to her?

Yu Wan had grown accustomed to her mother lying motionless on the bed, unconscious for so long. Now, seeing her finally open her eyes and look at her, Yu Wan couldn't stop the tears from falling.

Her mother watched Yu Wan’s reaction, lifting her hand with difficulty to stroke her head.

"Child, give me some water."

"Okay." Yu Wan snapped back to reality, raising her hand to wipe the tears from her face, but no matter how she tried, she couldn’t clear them away.

She had no choice but to stand up with a face full of tear stains, fetch the teapot from the side, pour a cup of water, and carefully feed it to her mother.

After one cup, she paused, then fed her another.

"You just woke up, Mother. You can't drink too much water or eat too much food. You need to take it slow."

"Mmm, help me sit up."

Yu Wan quickly took two pillows from the cabinet and propped her mother’s back up.

Though she was awake, her body was extremely weak. She didn’t even have the strength to sit up properly, so she could only recline against the pillows.

"Is this comfortable? Should I go get another quilt?"

Her mother shook her head, only gripping Yu Wan’s hand.

Yu Wan’s eyes welled up with hot tears.

She had been longing for her mother to wake up every day. Now that her mother was truly awake, she had countless words to say but didn’t know where to begin.

She wanted to throw herself into her mother’s arms like she did when she was little, but her mother was too frail. She could only restrain her emotions, tightly holding her mother’s thin hand.

"Are you hungry? I’ll go downstairs and get some food."

"No, stay and talk with me."

"Okay."

Though her mother was weak and pale, she could speak and move, and there was a spark of life in her.

Looking at her, Yu Wan’s tears fell uncontrollably again.

"Child, you’ve had a hard time these days." Seeing Yu Wan crying so much, her mother also felt heartbroken and raised her hand to wipe her tears.

"Mother, did you just wake up?" Yu Wan sniffled, curiously asking.

Her mother shook her head.

"You were awake, but you pretended not to be?"

"Yes."

Yu Wan was astonished. "Why? Even if you don’t recognize others, you should at least recognize Chen Da Niu."

Her mother rubbed Yu Wan’s hand. "When I regained consciousness, I heard them say this was the capital. So I dared not wake up. Child, seeing you today, I finally feel at ease."

Yu Wan was even more confused. "What’s wrong with the capital?"

She had asked casually, but unexpectedly, her mother’s bony hand suddenly gripped hers tightly. "I was never supposed to return to the capital in this lifetime."

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered as many past doubts resurfaced.

For example, her mother said they were farmers, but not only could she read, she could also recite poetry.

Another example: her mother said they were relatives of the village chief, but the village chief’s other relatives in the village didn’t associate with them.

Moreover, after seeing many noble ladies in the capital, Yu Wan suddenly realized that her mother spoke like them; refined, gentle, and articulate...

"Mother, what is your real identity? Your daughter has grown up now. I can handle things. If there’s any problem, I can help you solve it and shield you from trouble."

Hearing this, her mother reached out and touched Yu Wan’s head, nodding slightly.

It had been two years since they last saw each other. Yu Wan had indeed grown a lot.

Yu Wan had brought her to the capital alone to seek medical treatment, let her stay in such a room, and hired the best doctors for her. She could imagine how difficult the journey must have been for Yu Wan.

"Mother..." Her mother’s voice was choked with emotion.

Yu Wan, seeing this, quickly patted her back to help her breathe.

After a moment, her mother spoke in a hoarse whisper, "I am not an ordinary commoner. I am a palace maid who escaped from the palace. If I am discovered, it will be the end for me."

Mother was a palace maid?

Yu Wan’s heart pounded wildly.

Some things made sense now, but others didn’t.

Thinking of her mother’s identity, Yu Wan couldn’t help but doubt her own origins. "Then who is my father? Who is he?"

As soon as the words left her mouth, her mother’s face turned pale. She tightly grabbed Yu Wan’s hand. "Don’t mention him again. He has nothing to do with us."

Yu Wan was no longer the naive country girl she once was. Seeing her mother’s painful expression, she could roughly guess the truth.

Her mother must have escaped from the palace because of her biological father.

They had lived alone in the village for so many years. That father must be a heartless man.

"Daughter understands. I won’t mention him again."

Yu Wan said this, then poured another cup of water for her mother. After her mother drank it, she slowly added, "Mother, you don’t need to worry. Everyone in this inn is trustworthy. You don’t need to pretend to be sick. Just focus on recovering."

While her mother was unconscious, aside from medicine, she could only drink a little congee to survive.

Although, thanks to Zhao Xuanyou’s care, the inn’s kitchen made nourishing congee like chicken porridge, her mother was so weak that she needed more medicinal meals to recover quickly.

"Child, I must leave the capital as soon as possible. Our household registrations are fake. It might have been passable in the village, but in the capital, it won’t stand up to official inspection."

"Mother, you’re too weak to leave the capital now. Just stay here and rest. The officials won’t come to Taoran Inn to cause trouble, nor will they check your identity. If you’re worried, just stay in this room and don’t go out. If you need anything, you can ask Chen Da Niu and Liu Daniang to handle it."

Her mother, having truly come from the palace, immediately asked the key question, "Who is the owner of this inn?"

"This Taoran Inn is the property of the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence. I currently work at the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence."

During the days she pretended to be sick, her mother had overheard Chen Da Niu and Liu Daniang chatting and knew that Yu Wan worked in a noble household, so she wasn’t surprised.

However, now that she was finally sitting up, she looked around and found that the room where she was recovering was spacious and bright, with an inner and outer room, clearly a high-end room.

"Did you rent this room from your master’s family? How much does it cost to stay in such a big room for one night?"

"Don’t worry about the money, Mother. Right now, you just need to recover. Once you’re better, we’ll leave the capital. We’ve already sold the fields and the house, so it’s best if we don’t go back. Wherever you want to go, we’ll go. I’ve saved up a lot of money, enough for us to settle down again."

Back in Lichuan, Yu Wan had received over a hundred taels of silver as a reward from Zhao Xuanyou.

This time in Heishui County, Zhao Qi and Pei Ta had also let Yu Wan manage the internal affairs of the county yamen, giving her money to take care of everyone’s food and lodging.

Yu Wan hadn’t embezzled any money, but those two were not short of funds, especially Zhao Qi, who was quite generous. After a month and a half, she had saved another fifty taels. Not counting the jewelry Zhao Xuanyou had given her, she was quite well-off.

Yu Wan smiled brightly, but her mother listened with growing suspicion.

She knew the monthly wages of servants in noble households.

Yu Wan had worked at the marquis’s residence for at most two years. How could she have so much money?

Looking at Yu Wan’s rosy cheeks and plump figure, her mother’s voice trembled slightly. "Child, what kind of work do you do at the marquis’s residence?"

---

chapters.title: True Name
chapters.content:
Her mother was not a foolish woman, and Yu Wan had no intention of hiding the truth.

She candidly replied, "I currently work by the side of the marquis’s heir. I am his concubine servant."

"Ah?!" Her mother’s already pale face turned even whiter. "It’s all my fault! It’s all my fault! If I had been more careful that day on the mountain, we mother and daughter could have lived peaceful lives, and you wouldn’t have had to suffer so much!"

"Mother, I’m fine." Yu Wan smiled calmly. After experiencing so much, her mindset was very different from before. "I miss the days when we lived in the village, but life now isn’t bad either. I’ve seen and experienced many things I never could have before."

"Do you like staying at the marquis’s residence?"

"After the heir and his wife separated, life at the marquis’s residence has been much quieter. It’s indeed not bad."

Not to mention the time in Lichuan and Heishui, since returning to the capital half a month ago, aside from helping Manager Song with some affairs, Yu Wan mostly spent her time practicing calligraphy. It was indeed peaceful and leisurely.

Her mother looked at Yu Wan’s serene face and couldn’t help but sigh softly. "Does the heir treat you well?"

Compared to ordinary masters and servants, Zhao Xuanyou naturally treated her very well.

But Yu Wan stayed at the marquis’s residence not because she was infatuated with him.

Yu Wan sensed her mother’s unease and softly said, "Mother, I stay at the marquis’s residence not because I have feelings for the heir, but because the monthly salary and rewards are high. You’re not well, and we no longer have a house or fields. If I leave the marquis’s residence, I truly don’t know how to make a living."

"So you don’t want to leave?"

"No, that’s not it." Yu Wan held her mother’s hand and squeezed it. "It’s not that I’m unwilling to leave. It’s just that your body is still weak and can’t endure the hardships of travel. Since we still need to stay in the capital for a while to recover, it’s better for me to stay at the marquis’s residence for now, find a way to save more money, so that when we leave the capital in the future, we’ll be more secure."

"The methods of these noble families are cruel and ruthless. Child, a hundred taels of silver is enough for us. Don’t take risks for money."

Yu Wan smiled. "Don’t worry, I know what I’m doing. I won’t take money recklessly."

"Child, you’re still young..."

"I’m not that young anymore. Besides, if I can bring you to the capital for treatment and provide for us, can I still be a fool?"

Hearing these words, how could a mother feel at ease?

Thinking that everything in this room was obtained because her daughter served the heir, she felt as if her heart was being torn apart.

Not only had she failed to protect her daughter, but she had also let her daughter’s future happiness be ruined because of her.

"Mother, didn’t you always say before that as long as we, mother and daughter, are together safely, nothing else matters?"

"But that’s your..."

Yu Wan smiled. "To me, you are the most important. Don’t cry anymore, Mother. I really am living happily at the marquis’s residence. I’ve learned to write with a brush, I can write my own name, and on this trip away from the capital, I even learned to ride a horse!"

Looking at Yu Wan’s animated expression, her mother could see that there was not a trace of sorrow in her eyes. Everything she said was true.

"Since you like life in the capital, then I’ll find a place near the capital for us to settle down."

"No." Yu Wan quickly said, "Your identity is special. If we’re discovered, the consequences would be unimaginable. We can’t stay in the capital, nor can we stay near the capital. The farther we go, the better."

Having stayed in the Lichuan Imperial Palace for so long, Yu Wan knew that palace rules were strict. Escaping from the palace was a serious crime, and discovery would mean death.

Unless pardoned by the emperor or empress, there was no way out.

"But you..."

"I’ll handle these matters myself. You don’t need to worry about anything. Just stay here and recover. But don’t pretend to be sick anymore. You need to eat more, take your medicine on time, and recover quickly so we can leave together."

"Mmm." Listening to Yu Wan’s clear and logical words, her mother’s heart finally settled a little.

"Yu Wan! Yu Wan!" Yuan Qing knocked loudly on the door from outside.

Yu Wan turned her head toward the door and called out, "What is it?"

"I went to the street and bought some pastries, all your favorites. Want to try some?"

Earlier, when Yu Wan entered the room, she had been crying heavily. Yuan Qing didn’t know how to comfort her, so he went to the pastry shop next to Taoran Inn and bought some of Yu Wan’s usual favorite snacks.

Seeing her mother looking a bit nervous, Yu Wan drew the curtain and went to open the door for Yuan Qing.

Yuan Qing saw that although her eyes were red from crying, her spirits seemed okay. After handing her the things, he advised, "Earlier, your mother had opened her eyes. I think she’ll wake up completely soon. Don’t worry too much."

"I think her complexion is much better than before. She must be getting better."

"That’s the best way to think about it. Anyway, the heir didn’t ask us to return early, so you can stay at the inn a little longer. I’ll go downstairs for some tea and listen to the storyteller."

"Okay."

After Yuan Qing left, Yu Wan closed the door and carried the oil-paper packages inside.

She took a pack of red bean cakes and sat back down by the bed.

"Mother, try this red bean cake. It’s still warm."

The red bean cake was sweet and soft, easy to eat, perfect for her mother.

"Who was that person just now?"

"He also works by the heir’s side. Today, when I went out, the heir ordered him to drive the carriage for me."

Her mother’s gaze flickered slightly, her emotions complex.

Yu Wan said the heir treated her well. Now, with no one in the heir’s room, and Yu Wan being so beautiful, it was natural for him to favor her. But when the time came...

"Mother, what’s wrong?"

Seeing her mother tearing up again, Yu Wan asked with concern.

"I’m fine. It’s just that thinking of you having to bear so much makes me feel extremely guilty."

"When I was little, didn’t you take care of everything for me? Now that I have money and you’re getting better, the hardest times are behind us. There’s no need to be so gloomy anymore."

Her mother nodded, but her smile was weak.

Yu Wan was already the heir’s concubine servant. The die was cast. They could only look forward.

No matter what, both mother and daughter were still alive, and they weren’t completely without resources.

"What did that person call you just now?"

"Yu Wan." Yu Wan said, writing the two characters in her mother’s palm.

Her mother smiled. "You wrote it well. You’ve really become skilled."

"That’s only natural. Your daughter has been taught by a famous master."

"Then I’ll call you Yu Wan from now on."

Years ago, her mother, pregnant and alone, had nowhere to settle. She had spent money to ask someone for help with the household registration. That person had found a pair of deceased husband and wife in the morgue of a charity burial ground.

She had taken the identity of the deceased wife, transforming into Li, the widow of a boatman. Yu Wan, naturally, was the posthumous child.

To avoid suspicion, she hadn’t dared to give Yu Wan a proper name. Seeing that the villagers called their daughters "Big Girl" or "Second Girl," she simply called Yu Wan "Child."

"Okay." The name Yu Wan had been used for a long time, and she herself had grown accustomed to it.

Since the previous names were all fake, there was nothing to be sentimental about.

However, Yu Wan’s eyes flickered, and she looked back at the person on the bed. "Then what about you, Mother? What was your original name?"

chapters.title: Betrothal
chapters.content:
Looking at Yu Wan’s curious gaze, the woman on the couch had a bitter expression in her eyes.

From the moment she fled the palace, she had discarded her past identity, never to look back.

She had lived under the widowed identity of "Li," and it had been a long time since she had thought of her former name.

Seeing her mother’s distracted appearance, Yu Wan realized her question was inappropriate.

The past memories were painful for her mother, and she did not want to bring them up.

"When we leave the capital in the future, Mother can tell me then."

"It’s fine."

She truly did not want to recall the past, but Yu Wan was her daughter, her treasure. If Yu Wan was curious, she was naturally willing to tell her.

Moreover, whether she liked it or not, they had already returned to the capital. In case of any unforeseen events, it was better for her daughter to be prepared.

"My original surname was Ding. The... the master gave me the name Wen Xi."

As she spoke, she spread out Yu Wan’s palm and, like Yu Wan had done before, wrote her name in her daughter’s hand.

"Mother’s name is so beautiful." After more than a decade as mother and daughter, it was only today that she learned her mother’s true name. Yu Wan smiled, her lips curling. "So I’m surnamed Ding. This surname is also nice."

Seeing Yu Wan’s joyful expression, Ding Wenxi felt a pang of sorrow in her heart.

"It’s Mother’s fault for not giving you a proper name."

"It’s not too late to do it now."

Hearing Yu Wan say this, Ding Wenxi frowned in thought for a moment. "The name Yu Wan is actually quite good."

"This name was given by the most talented woman in the capital for her daughter."

Ding Wenxi was still unaware of the tragic events Yu Wan had endured. Seeing the strange smile on her face, she instinctively patted her shoulder.

"The character 萦 (Wan) comes from 糸 (silk), which implies entanglement and attachment. For me, it carries a very good meaning. You are my daughter, my attachment, and my concern. The character 玉 (Yu) also has a good meaning, though it’s a bit common. If we were to rename you... let me think again."

"No need to rush," Yu Wan saw how seriously her mother was considering it and feared she would overthink. She hurriedly said, "There’s plenty of time in the future. Wait until Mother has recovered before deciding."

Seeing how considerate her daughter was, Ding Wenxi became even more worried for her.

Her clever and lively daughter now spoke and acted with such thoroughness. She didn’t know what kind of two years she had gone through.

"Mmm, don’t worry. I will rest well."

After thinking for a moment, Yu Wan added, "Now that Mother is awake, there are many things missing in the room. It’s rare that I’m out of the residence today, so I should quickly go buy them."

Ding Wenxi instinctively grabbed Yu Wan’s hand. "You’re going out?"

Yu Wan saw her mother’s anxious face and held her hands with both of her own. "I’ll be back soon, Mother. Don’t be afraid."

"I’m not afraid, it’s just..."

Yu Wan understood. Her mother had been in a coma for so long, and now that she had suddenly woken up and returned to the capital, she was constantly worried about her identity being exposed and could not rest easy.

"The Taoran Inn is in a convenient location, and there are all kinds of shops nearby. I’ll go and come back quickly. I’ll tell them that you need to rest and cannot be disturbed. From now on, only Chen Da Niu and Liu Da Nian will be allowed in this room."

"You’ve gone to a lot of trouble."

Hearing Yu Wan’s words, Ding Wenxi realized she had caused more trouble for her daughter.

But she was extremely uneasy. The fewer people who knew of her existence, the better.

"You’re my mother. Saying such things will bring me bad luck."

"Alright, I won’t say it anymore."

After gently comforting her mother, Yu Wan finally pushed the door open and left to make her purchases.

---

Hou Residence, Honghui Hall.

Zhao Xuanyou sat quietly at his desk, gazing out the window at the few purple bamboos in the courtyard.

That day in Honghui Hall, he had smelled a medicinal scent on Yu Wan. At the time, he hadn’t thought much of it, but later, he recalled that he had smelled the same scent on her when they were in Lichuan and Heishui.

He had asked the residence’s physician. Contraceptive medicines were generally made from ingredients like safflower, white peony root, and prepared rehmannia root. They were mostly similar, so their scents should be alike.

Zhao Xuanyou had sharp senses, and his nose was particularly keen. The scent he had smelled could not be wrong.

Yu Wan had not only drunk the medicine given by her grandmother, but she had also taken it herself in Lichuan and Heishui...

"Master." Yuan Zhen stood at the study door and respectfully called out.

Zhao Xuanyou withdrew his thoughts and calmly asked, "What is it?"

"The chrysanthemum wine brewed in the Old Madam’s courtyard is ready. She invites you to taste it."

Old Lady Ye did not like drinking alcohol, but she enjoyed brewing it. She had found many ancient recipes and brewed seasonal wines according to the time.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded and, after taking a few steps out, asked, "They haven’t returned yet?"

Yuan Zhen understood he was asking about Yu Wan and Yuan Qing. He quickly replied, "Not yet. Should we send someone to urge them?"

"No need."

Zhao Xuanyou arrived at Leshou Hall. Old Lady Ye had already prepared wine and food in the warm pavilion.

"Sit down, try this year’s chrysanthemum wine."

Zhao Xuanyou took a seat as bid and picked up the cup to take a sip. "It has the bitterness of chrysanthemum, but it smells very fragrant."

Old Lady Ye could see he didn’t like it and didn’t force him.

"Ever since you divorced Cui Yichu, many things have happened in the residence one after another."

Hearing the implication in Old Lady Ye’s words, Zhao Xuanyou respectfully asked, "What are Grandmother’s orders?"

Old Lady Ye sighed slightly. "This time, you’ve been away with Yu Wan for two months. I can see that you’ve grown even more fond of her. Xuanyou, you’ve grown up. There are some things I originally didn’t want to say, but Yu Wan is just a maid. If you favor her too much, and in the future your new wife is overshadowed by her, the residence will surely be in chaos. Fengchang is a lesson!"

Hearing his grandmother bring up Yu Wan, Zhao Xuanyou said, "Grandmother, rest assured. I know what I’m doing."

"Do you really? I’ve heard that today, since she was resting, you sent Yuan Qing to harness the carriage and take her out early in the morning. Is that true?"

Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t expected his grandmother to know this in such detail. He didn’t deny it and just nodded.

"She went out not to run errands for the Hou Residence. How is it appropriate for a maid to go out in a carriage, and even have Yuan Qing escort her?"

"Previously, she was kidnapped. I’m just a little uneasy about her going out alone, so I had Yuan Qing go with her."

Old Lady Ye listened to his excuse and frowned even more displeased.

It would have been better if he hadn’t mentioned it. As soon as she thought about how he had directly clashed with the Crown Prince over Yu Wan, disregarding the safety of the Jingyuan Hou Residence, Old Lady Ye sighed repeatedly.

"I originally thought Yu Wan was a steady person, and it would be good to keep her by your side. But so many things have happened, and it even involved the palace. Keeping her in the residence is really not appropriate. In my opinion, it’s best to marry her off and send her away as soon as possible."

"No!" Zhao Xuanyou didn’t hesitate for a moment and firmly refused.

Old Lady Ye had originally been testing him, but seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s firmness, she knew he had already set his heart on Yu Wan.

"I don’t mean to go against Grandmother. Yu Wan has been by my side for some time, and she truly suits me. I have no intention of sending her away."

"Then you can’t ruin the rules of the Hou Residence for her!" Old Lady Ye lightly tapped the table. "If you won’t send her away, then you must get married as soon as possible."

---

chapters.title: Probe
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou could see that his grandmother was already angry, but even so, he still refused to yield.

Not to mention his feelings for Yu Wan, but just regarding marriage, he was unwilling to rush into it.

"Grandmother may not approve of Yu Wan, but others may not be as good as her. Since there has been a previous lesson, I don’t want to marry in haste again."

"You! In the end, you’re still blaming me! If it weren’t for marrying that troublemaker Cui Yichu, the inner residence wouldn’t be in such chaos."

"I have no intention of blaming Grandmother. If there’s anyone to blame, it’s the Xingguo Public for their cunning schemes." Zhao Xuanyou made his stance clear and then soothed his grandmother with a gentle tone. "Recently, the residence has been short-staffed. Yu Wan has indeed taken on more responsibilities. Since she hasn’t been in the Hou Residence for long, it’s hard for her to gain everyone’s respect. From now on, let her just manage Honghui Hall. As for the residence’s affairs, let Manager Song handle them."

He understood that his grandmother was displeased with Yu Wan’s favor, so it was not advisable to let Yu Wan stand out any further.

Old Lady Ye sighed. "Manager Song is indeed capable, but he’s a servant. How can he be in charge of everything?"

She was old and didn’t have the energy to manage household affairs. Originally, she had let Fengchang assist, but that was out of necessity.

Urging Zhao Xuanyou to get married was not to suppress Yu Wan, but because the Hou Residence truly needed a mistress.

"From now on, I’ll manage more of the residence’s trivial matters. Grandmother doesn’t need to worry about this."

"You’ve only been back in the capital for a short time, and you’ve already made an enemy of the Crown Prince. Do you have the energy to manage household affairs?"

Zhao Xuanyou replied lightly, "Right now, his enemy isn’t just me. I’ve grown up, Grandmother. You can enjoy your later years in peace."

Old Lady Ye also knew that he had risen in rank and that his ambitions had grown with it.

However, while she could ignore court matters, she couldn’t ignore his marriage.

"When you weren’t in the capital, the second madam of the Ningguo Residence came over for tea with several young ladies from her residence. Her family’s young ladies are all very well-educated. The eldest has been betrothed, but the second and third are still unmarried."

Zhao Xuanyou understood the implication in his grandmother’s words and simply said, "The Ningguo Public treasures these granddaughters. How could they be willing to marry them off as a concubine?"

"The Ningguo Public is indeed prestigious, but the second and third branches of the public do not inherit titles. If they marry into our family, they would be the wife of the heir, so it’s not impossible."

Seeing that his grandmother was serious, Zhao Xuanyou thought for a moment and then said, "I remember their eldest daughter is betrothed to the Xingguo Public. I don’t want to be related to the Cui family by marriage."

"Betrothed to the Xingguo Public?" Old Lady Ye rarely left the residence and wasn’t familiar with many things in the capital. She thought back to her conversation with Shen Tongyun that day and sighed. "No wonder she only said she was betrothed but didn’t mention which family. So it’s the Xingguo Public. Naturally, that won’t do."

No one wanted to be related to the Xingguo Public by marriage!

"Grandmother, from now on, I will pay attention to this matter. There will definitely be good news within the next year or two."

"Will you really pay attention to it yourself?"

Old Lady Ye didn’t dislike Yu Wan. On the contrary, she thought Yu Wan was a very clever and sensible maid.

It was just that Yu Wan was too beautiful and too clever. Zhao Xuanyou was at the age where he should be cultivating affection and harmony with his wife, but all his attention was on Yu Wan.

It was clear that the two of them were growing increasingly affectionate. In the future, if Zhao Xuanyou married, he might not have the same leisure and elegance.

In the end, it was all Cui Yichu’s fault!

If it weren’t for marrying her, the Hou Residence wouldn’t have had so many troubles.

Seeing that his grandmother wasn’t urging him anymore, Zhao Xuanyou stayed and chatted with her for a while before heading to Honghui Hall as the sky began to darken.

At this moment, the corridor of Honghui Hall was lit with lanterns.

Zhao Xuanyou entered the courtyard and saw Yingxue sitting under the corridor boiling water. The room was empty, and his expression darkened.

"Still not back?"

Yuan Zhen was about to answer when he suddenly heard footsteps behind him. He quickly said, "They’re back."

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head and saw Yu Wan and Yuan Qing walking side by side from outside, their faces full of joy, as if they had encountered something good.

"Master?"

Yu Wan hadn’t expected to run into Zhao Xuanyou in the courtyard.

Seeing his deep, water-like gaze, she knew he was displeased.

But at this moment, Yu Wan couldn’t suppress the smile on her lips. She could only lower her head slightly and bow to him.

"Did you pick up some money on the street?"

Yu Wan heard the sarcasm in his voice and didn’t dare to speak. Yuan Qing, however, was a straightforward young man and blurted out, "It would be good if she had picked up money."

He was about to continue when he saw Yuan Zhen desperately making eye signals at him.

Although he didn’t know why Yuan Zhen was making those signals, he still stopped talking.

"Oh?" Zhao Xuanyou stared at Yu Wan. "Then what treasure did you pick up?"

"I didn’t pick up any treasure. My mother woke up."

Zhao Xuanyou’s gloomy expression eased slightly.

So she was late returning because her mother had woken up. The spark of anger that had just risen in his heart immediately dissipated.

"In that case, it’s a joyous occasion."

"Today, we returned to the residence very late. This servant knows her mistake." Yu Wan said carefully.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t say a word and walked straight into the room.

Because the master had returned, Honghui Hall was soon brightly lit with candles.

Zhao Xuanyou had already eaten quite a bit at Leshou Hall, so he didn’t order a meal when he returned.

Fortunately, Yu Wan had eaten some pastries while keeping her mother company, so she didn’t feel hungry either.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou wanted to handle official business, Yu Wan added a warm, yellow candle stand to the study.

Zhao Xuanyou’s mind wasn’t on his work at all. After flipping through a couple of pages, he looked at Yu Wan. "What did the doctor say?"

Yu Wan hadn’t expected him to ask about her mother’s condition. She respectfully replied, "I didn’t call for a doctor today. Previously, the doctor said the blood clots in my mother’s head had dispersed, so I suppose she won’t need acupuncture in the future."

Under the candlelight, Yu Wan’s eyebrows and eyes were even more captivating. As she spoke, her eyelashes trembled slightly, and the corners of her eyes and brows were full of charm.

Zhao Xuanyou caught a faint, delicate fragrance from her. He originally disliked strong scents, and there were no flowers in the room or courtyard, nor did he wear any sachets himself.

But this fragrance came from her, and he didn’t find it unpleasant. Instead, he took a deep breath.

"Are you wearing a sachet?"

Yu Wan knew he disliked strong scents. There were no flowers in the room or courtyard, and he didn’t wear any sachets.

"No. My mother likes flowers. Thinking that she was awake, I bought a pot of daffodils at the market. I must have picked up the scent in the room."

Her mother’s identity was special. Although Yu Wan had let her stay at the Taoran Inn to recover, she still didn’t dare to be careless.

Afraid that her mother would be bored in the room, she had specially bought daffodils and some popular storybooks in the capital.

She lifted her sleeve and smelled it. Indeed, there was a hint of floral fragrance.

She was about to take a step back to distance herself from Zhao Xuanyou, but he reached out and pulled Yu Wan into his embrace.

Yu Wan sat in his lap and saw the dark color gathering in his eyes. She reached out and touched his chin.

"Master, have you been drinking?"

"I had a few cups of chrysanthemum wine brewed by Grandmother at Leshou Hall," Zhao Xuanyou said lightly. Then, changing the subject, he asked, "Now that your mother is awake, what are your plans for the future?"

There were indeed plans.

But how could Yu Wan tell him?

She pretended to be confused and shook her head, looking troubled. "Although I’ve always hoped that my mother would wake up, I didn’t have a plan. Today, I was just happy. If Master hadn’t mentioned it, I wouldn’t have thought that far ahead. In the future... in the future... the fields and houses in the village have already been sold, so I’m afraid we can’t go back."

Zhao Xuanyou stared into Yu Wan’s eyes. "Your family only has you and your mother. Even if the fields and houses hadn’t been sold, as a daughter working in the capital, would you want your mother to go back alone?"

chapters.title: A Pleasant Surprise
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes were profound and deep. Even though his tone was calm, when Yu Wan met his gaze, she could still feel a hint of tension.

Had he discovered something?

It was rare for him to have Yuan Qing eavesdrop outside the door.

Probably not. Yuan Qing had indeed spent the whole day in the restaurant listening to storytelling and ballads, and on the way back, he couldn’t stop talking about them.

Moreover, they had just returned, and Yuan Qing hadn’t had the chance to report to him secretly.

Yu Wan said, "If we could stay in the capital, that would naturally be the best. But the capital is the most prosperous place in the world, and my mother and I have no foothold here. How could we stay just because we want to?"

There was nothing wrong with her words. Zhao Xuanyou furrowed his brows and pondered for a moment before saying, "Your mother has suffered such a serious injury. She probably can’t do any work. There’s no need to return to the village."

"Master." Yu Wan called out softly, her gaze flowing as she displayed a tender and charming demeanor.

"Hmm?" Zhao Xuanyou saw that she had a request, but instead of feeling annoyed, he rather enjoyed it, lowering his gaze to stare into her eyes.

Yu Wan’s large almond-shaped eyes sparkled with a smile. "Could my mother stay at the Taoran Inn for a few more days? The houses in the capital are too expensive, and I can’t afford them. Also, I’m worried about the people from Xingguo Duke’s Mansion..."

"It won’t be long before Xingguo Duke’s Mansion is no longer a problem."

The Cui family’s various crimes in Qingsha Town were all supported by evidence and witnesses. It wouldn’t be long before they could be reported to the court.

Not to mention the matter of them framing Pei Ta’s father years ago, the fact that they had been embezzling tribute pearls for years was enough to bring them down.

"Thank you, Young Master."

Only when Xingguo Duke’s Mansion fell would Cui Yichu truly be in trouble.

After so long, Yu Wan actually wasn’t in a hurry to see her die.

Cui Yichu had always considered herself a noble daughter of a duke’s mansion. When she became the relative of a convicted official, Yu Wan really wanted to see her expression.

"Why thank me? The Cui family is our common enemy."

The night was deep, and the wine was strong. The candlelight on the table flickered gently.

As their breaths intertwined, Zhao Xuanyou lowered his head and kissed her eyes.

He had drunk wine tonight, and Yu Wan could feel the slight warmth of his lips. Her body unconsciously stiffened a little.

Zhao Xuanyou liked her in this tender and innocent state, so he kissed her lips as well.

---

"Yu Wan."

Yu Wan was practicing calligraphy in the warm pavilion when Yuan Qing rushed in excitedly from outside.

"What’s the matter that you’re so happy?" Yu Wan put down the brush and asked curiously.

"It’s not my happy news, it’s yours."

"What good news?"

Yuan Qing smiled. "A guest has come to the Marquis’s Mansion, and they’re here to see you."

"To see me?"

Yu Wan was somewhat confused. If it were Chen Da Niu coming to see her, it wouldn’t count as a guest to the Marquis’s Mansion. Since Yuan Qing said that, it must be...

"Has the Seventh Prince come?"

"No."

"Then who could it be?" Yu Wan frowned and thought for a moment. The people who had a relationship with her and could visit the Marquis’s Mansion could be counted on one hand.

Pei Daren was refined and courteous; it was impossible for him to come to the Marquis’s Mansion to see her.

As for Madame Pei, it was possible, but Yu Wan felt that compared to Pei Daren, Madame Pei was even less likely to come see her.

Although she treated her very kindly, Yu Wan understood that she treated everyone the same way.

"It’s the eldest daughter of Ningguo Duke’s Mansion."

So it was Shen Tongyun.

"Where is Miss Shen?"

"She’s currently in Leshou Hall keeping Old Madam company. Earlier, someone from Leshou Hall came to deliver a message, saying that later you should accompany Miss Shen on a tour of the Marquis’s Mansion’s garden."

"Then I’ll go to Leshou Hall to wait."

Yu Wan quickly tidied up the table, then went back inside to redo her hairstyle and change her clothes before hurrying to Leshou Hall.

The last time Zhao Xuanyou had instructed her to keep a low profile in the Marquis’s Mansion, so Yu Wan didn’t have the servants announce her arrival and simply stood obediently outside the courtyard waiting.

After waiting for a while, she finally saw Shen Tongyun and Feng Jichou come out of the house.

"Miss Shen, Cousin." Yu Wan quickly stepped forward to greet them.

Feng Jichou smiled. "So Yu Wan arrived early. Why didn’t you come in? I was just saying I’d take Miss Tongyun to Honghui Hall."

She was a simple-minded girl. Although she and Yu Wan had no interaction, every time they met, they were polite to each other.

"Miss Shen came to pay a visit to Old Madam. This servant didn’t dare to go in and disturb."

When Yu Wan was in Heishui County, Shen Tongyun had already visited the Marquis’s Mansion with her aunt to pay respects to Old Madam. She knew that Feng Jichou was to be betrothed to Zhao Xuanyou. Seeing Yu Wan speak so carefully, she secretly admired her resilience.

"Old Madam said that the chrysanthemums in the Marquis’s Mansion’s garden are in full bloom. You can take me to see them."

Since Shen Tongyun had spoken, Feng Jichou tactfully smiled and said, "I’m not interested in flowers and plants. I’ll go back to my room first."

After Feng Jichou left, Yu Wan led Shen Tongyun towards the garden.

In the autumn, all flowers had withered except for the chrysanthemums, which were vibrant and beautiful.

Moreover, since Old Madam Feng wanted to pick chrysanthemums to brew wine, the chrysanthemums in the Marquis’s Mansion were indeed blooming luxuriantly. The petals were layered yet relaxed, and the light purple and elegant yellow each had their own charm.

Shen Tongyun listened to Yu Wan’s vivid description, her eyes full of admiration.

"You know so much?"

"You flatter me, Miss. This servant used to work in the flower room, so I know a little more."

The two walked around the garden path and finally sat down in the pavilion.

Yu Wan understood that Shen Tongyun wouldn’t come without a reason. After pouring her a cup of tea, she took the initiative to ask, "How is the Seventh Prince’s injury?"

"He had bruises on his wrists and ankles. After the Imperial Physician applied the best trauma medicine, he was fine a long time ago. Yesterday, when I went to the palace to see him, he had already started practicing martial arts."

"That’s good." Then, Yu Wan lowered her voice and asked, "Has the Crown Prince been making things difficult for him?"

Shen Tongyun’s smile faded a little, and a hint of mockery appeared in her elegant and generous eyes.

"There are so many eyes in the palace. How dare he still act arrogantly like he does outside? Naturally, he pretends to be brotherly and harmonious, sending medicine and tonics to Xiyuan every few days."

"The tonics sent by the Eastern Palace, the Seventh Prince probably won’t eat them." Yu Wan said helplessly with a smile.

She had been present when Zhao Qi and the Crown Prince had a conflict. His words and actions were indeed a bit excessive, and it couldn’t be entirely blamed on the Crown Prince.

Teacher Pei had said in class that being too rigid leads to breaking.

The Crown Prince was indeed Zhao Qi’s nemesis, but he didn’t need to clash head-on with the Crown Prince at this time, making himself suffer for no reason.

Perhaps, as Zhao Xuanyou said, it was because he had found evidence in Heishui County but was still powerless that he was making things difficult for himself.

"Indeed." Shen Tongyun couldn’t help but laugh along when she heard this. "He originally wanted to throw them all away, but yesterday when I went, he said your mother was sick, so I thought maybe you could use those tonics and medicines, so I brought them out of the palace."

So Shen Tongyun had come to bring her tonics.

Her mother had just recovered from a serious illness and indeed urgently needed tonics and medicines.

The storage room of the Marquis’s Mansion was already full of precious items that couldn’t be bought from outside pharmacies, but Yu Wan could only look at them longingly without daring to touch them.

Although the Crown Prince was lustful, Yu Wan knew he cared about face. What he could openly send to Zhao Qi must be rare treasures.

Yu Wan was overjoyed and quickly stood up to bow to Shen Tongyun. "Thank you, Seventh Prince. Thank you, Miss Shen."

"Don’t be in a hurry to thank me. There’s more." Shen Tongyun’s eyes curved into a smile, and she softly said, "There’s another thing that he specifically asked me to bring to you."

---

chapters.title: He Put Thought Into It
chapters.content:
"More things?" Yu Wan asked in surprise.

The medicines and tonics were already a timely help. She couldn’t even repay these, so how could she accept more?

"Look over there."

Shen Tongyun pointed to the maids outside the pavilion. Each of the two maids was holding a small box, which seemed to be for Yu Wan.

"Miss Shen, this is too much."

"No need to be polite. It’s useless in his hands anyway. Just take them."

Were they also tonics?

Yu Wan was overwhelmed by the favor. Thinking that these things were indeed precious but might not mean much to Zhao Qi and the others, she didn’t refuse.

Right now, nothing was more important than her mother’s health.

Moreover, it was just a small favor from her.

Zhao Qi knew she was a poor servant girl, so when he bestowed these things, he probably didn’t expect her to reciprocate.

"Thank you, Miss Shen, for delivering my gratitude to the Seventh Prince."

"When I get married, he will definitely come to the Duke’s Mansion. At that time, you can come to the Duke’s Mansion to play and thank him in person."

The last time they met at Ningguo Duke’s Mansion, Shen Tongyun had said her wedding date was in three months, which should be about a month away now.

"I remember Miss Shen’s wedding is next month."

Shen Tongyun’s face turned slightly red, and she smiled lightly. "The last time I saw you, the date was still more than a month away. Not long after, the two families discussed and changed the date to five days later."

Five days later?

That was too soon.

Yu Wan looked at Shen Tongyun, feeling a slight pang in her heart.

Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta were about to join forces to take down Xingguo Duke’s Mansion. If the wedding date was a month later, once the crime of embezzling tribute pearls was exposed, the Shen family would definitely not let their daughter get married.

But now that the wedding date had been changed, even if Zhao Xuanyou and the others acted quickly, they couldn’t do it in five days.

By the time Shen Tongyun married into Xingguo Duke’s Mansion in a grand manner, it wouldn’t be long before Xingguo Duke’s Mansion fell.

Embezzling tribute items and exploiting the people were serious crimes. If Shen Tongyun became the Cui family’s daughter-in-law, she might be implicated and punished.

"Can the wedding date be changed?" Yu Wan couldn’t help but ask. "Isn’t it a bit too hasty?"

"The two families have already exchanged marriage contracts. It won’t change this time." Shen Tongyun understood the worry in Yu Wan’s eyes and gently patted the back of her hand. "I know that everyone in the Marquis’s Mansion has opinions about Xingguo Duke’s Mansion. In fact, I don’t like Yichu much either. She has always thought highly of herself, and apart from the princess, she doesn’t acknowledge anyone else. She has indeed been spoiled by the Duke and the Duchess. However, he is not like that."

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered. Hearing Shen Tongyun’s last words, she instantly understood a lot.

Shen Tongyun and Cui Zaizhou were not marrying blindly; they had seen each other beforehand.

"Actually, my father’s first choice for a son-in-law wasn’t him either, but I spoke up for him..." Shen Tongyun’s face turned even redder, and she said in a low voice.

"So Miss Shen and Young Master Cui are childhood sweethearts with mutual affection."

"It’s not exactly childhood sweethearts. We’ve just met a few times."

Ningguo Duke’s Mansion and Xingguo Duke’s Mansion were of equal status. Shen Tongyun had met Cui Zaizhou a long time ago, and they were originally just acquaintances. Two years ago, on the Lantern Festival in the capital, Shen Tongyun got separated from her sisters. On the way, she encountered Cui Zaizhou, who sent her back to the Duke’s Mansion.

They had a pleasant conversation along the way, and both developed feelings for each other.

Yu Wan had only seen Cui Zaizhou once at the Marquis’s Mansion. Setting aside his strong defense of Cui Yichu, his appearance, speech, and demeanor were indeed good, so it wasn’t strange that Shen Tongyun had fallen for him.

Since the other party had said this much, Yu Wan understood that even if she directly exposed the evil deeds of Xingguo Duke’s Mansion, it wouldn’t change Shen Tongyun’s marriage.

Without evidence, how could anyone believe her just based on her words?

Moreover, if she told Shen Tongyun about the embezzlement of tribute pearls, and it somehow reached the Cui family’s ears, it would alert them, ruining Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta’s plans.

"Come to the Duke’s Mansion to play the day before I get married. Let’s settle it like this."

Before a woman’s marriage, her relatives and friends would go to add to her dowry. However, the only female in the Marquis’s Mansion was Old Madam Ye, who was old and frail and probably wouldn’t go out to visit.

"Don’t worry. Earlier, I already told Old Madam in Leshou Hall. The day after tomorrow, you and Miss Feng can come to the Duke’s Mansion to play. She has already agreed."

"Thank you, Miss Shen."

Zhao Xuanyou had instructed Yu Wan not to be too high-profile in her actions, which made it difficult for her to find an excuse to leave the mansion to visit her mother.

For Yu Wan, as long as she could leave the mansion, it was a good thing.

Seeing that her main business was done, Shen Tongyun stood up to take her leave.

Yu Wan knew she was about to get married and had many things to do at home. If it weren’t for Zhao Qi asking for her help, she wouldn’t have come to the Marquis’s Mansion. Therefore, she didn’t keep her any longer and saw her out of the Marquis’s Mansion.

When Yu Wan returned to Honghui Hall, she finally had the chance to open the two small boxes Shen Tongyun had brought.

One box contained tonics and medicines.

Yu Wan had already expected that the things from the Eastern Palace wouldn’t be bad, but when she saw the ginseng, as thick as a finger and as big as a radish, along with the high-quality lingzhi, bird’s nest, and goji berries as large as a fingernail, she was still amazed.

That day, when she had told Zhao Qi about her family matters, it was to advise him, but she didn’t expect him to remember and send so many things.

Yu Wan then opened the other box that Shen Tongyun had been mysterious about.

When she saw the few books inside, Yu Wan was stunned.

They were the Four Books and Five Classics that Pei Ta had given to Zhao Qi during their last return to the capital, filled with Pei Ta’s own annotations.

Zhao Qi had actually given them to Yu Wan?

He was a prince. Since childhood, he had been taught the Four Books and Five Classics by learned scholars, so these books were naturally not precious to him.

But he actually knew that she wanted them?

That time at Ningguo Duke’s Mansion, when he gave her Pei Ta’s calligraphy, he must have seen that she wanted other books.

A complex feeling surged in Yu Wan’s heart.

All along, her attitude toward Zhao Qi had only been that of a servant’s respect for a prince.

Although she knew Zhao Qi was not the arrogant and unruly young man others thought he was, she didn’t know he was so thoughtful.

The medicines might have been casually given away because of the Eastern Palace, but these books were different. He had put thought into these.

He had been so good to her, and Yu Wan didn’t know how to repay such a huge favor.

"Master."

Hearing the servant’s announcement in the courtyard, Yu Wan quickly closed both boxes.

But Zhao Xuanyou was tall and walked quickly. Before Yu Wan could carry the boxes back to her small partition, he entered the room.

"What’s that smell? It doesn’t seem like floral fragrance."

Yu Wan said, "Today, Miss Shen from Ningguo Duke’s Mansion came over. She said the Seventh Prince had rewarded me with many medicines. Miss Shen just left, and I had just opened the box. I didn’t expect the medicinal smell to be so strong."

It was indeed the fragrance of medicines.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t mind this kind of fragrance, but he was slightly surprised. "The Seventh Prince bestowed medicines upon you?"

"Previously, I had mentioned to the Seventh Prince that my mother was sick. While the Seventh Prince was recovering in the palace, the Crown Prince sent many good things over. The Seventh Prince didn’t want to take them, and since the medicines were of good quality, he had Miss Shen bring them out for me."

chapters.title: How to Endure?
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou listened to her words but said nothing, walking straight to the study.

Yu Ying placed the box in her small partition, then came out again, fetched some hot water, and headed to the study.

After a moment of hesitation, Yu Ying still spoke, "Miss Yun will be getting married in five days."

Zhao Xuanyou seemed indifferent to others' affairs, lightly humming in response. He lifted his gaze to Yu Ying, as if asking why she brought this up.
