Yu Ying understood that after all his planning, he wouldn’t give up on bringing down the Xingguo Duke’s mansion at this point. She simply said, "She invited my cousin and me to the duke’s mansion to join the festivities."

"Go ahead. Don’t worry about the dowry gifts; Manager Song will prepare them according to the marquis’s rules."

Seeing Yu Ying’s expression turn slightly tense, Zhao Xuanyou asked, "Have you gone soft?"

"Not at all," Yu Ying replied honestly. "Madame Cui has never let me or my mother off the hook. If the Xingguo Duke’s mansion isn’t taken down, the two of us will never live in peace. I wish you would act sooner rather than later."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded, then asked, "So?"

"Seventh Prince has been kind to me. Miss Yun is his cousin. Today, she specially came to bring me gifts. Thinking about how she will be implicated by the Xingguo Duke’s mansion in the future, I can’t help but feel a little emotional."

Just a little emotional.

"Don’t worry. With the Ningguo Duke’s mansion backing her and Seventh Prince looking after her, this is nothing."

That was true. Besides, Yu Ying couldn’t change anything. Thinking so, her mood lightened a bit.

Seeing her deep in thought, Zhao Xuanyou tried to cheer her up. Softly, he said, "The Xingguo Duke’s mansion has already paid the dowry they owed to the marquis’s mansion."

Yu Ying hesitated for a moment, "Congratulations, my lord."

Cui Yi’s dowry had all been left in the marquis’s mansion, and an additional portion had been paid. Setting aside the humiliation Zhao Xuanyou had suffered, from a financial perspective, the marquis’s mansion had made a huge profit. It was worth congratulating.

"You played a part in this."

Yu Ying was just pouring hot water for him when her face lit up with joy.

"Will you reward me for my contributions, my lord?"

Zhao Xuanyou gave another light hum. But seeing her face brighten so radiantly, his tone unconsciously lightened as well.

"What kind of reward?"

Thinking about how she had received so many precious medicines from Zhao Qi today, she probably couldn’t be happier. So he decided to tease her a bit.

"Wait. I’ll tell you when the time is right."

Yu Ying hadn’t expected him to play a guessing game. But since she had no clue, she could only say, "Then I won’t thank you yet. I’ll wait until I receive the reward."

---

Soon, it was the day before Shen Tongyun’s wedding.

Since today was the day Feng Jirour and Yu Ying were going out together, Manager Song had prepared a carriage for them early.

Feng Jirour had been in the capital for a few months, but this was her first time visiting another mansion. She was quite nervous.

Yu Ying comforted her from the side, "The people at the Ningguo Duke’s mansion are very kind. Cousin, you don’t need to worry."

"I’m afraid I’ll be rude and embarrass the marquis’s mansion."

"How could that be? Besides, today we’re all here to congratulate Miss Yun. Everyone will be focused on her, and no one will pay attention to anything else."

"That’s true." Although Feng Jirour had never visited a noble mansion before, she had met the second madam and a few young ladies of the Ningguo Duke’s mansion at the marquis’s mansion. They weren’t complete strangers. Listening to Yu Ying’s reassurance, she quickly calmed down.

Before long, the carriage stopped in front of the Ningguo Duke’s mansion.

Yu Ying and Feng Jirour got out of the carriage. Seeing that they were female guests, the second and third madams of the duke’s mansion immediately came to welcome them.

The Ningguo Duke’s mansion was prosperous, with many relatives in the capital alone. All of them had come to contribute to Shen Tongyun’s dowry.

In addition, there were commoners who had come to collect wedding cakes and fruits. The entrance of the mansion was truly packed.

The second madam was already acquainted with the two of them. She led them into the mansion and called for the third young lady.

"The young ladies are all in the flower hall drinking tea. Miss Feng, come with me."

Yu Ying had stayed at the Ningguo Duke’s mansion for more than ten days and was familiar with everyone there.

However, there was a distinction between master and servant. At this moment, she could only silently follow Feng Jirour and go to the flower hall with them.

But halfway there, someone blocked Yu Ying’s path. Upon closer inspection, it was an inner attendant from Zhao Qi’s side.

"Miss Yu Ying, please come this way."

Yu Ying had brought some ginseng and bird’s nest with her today, intending to slip out of the mansion. Seeing this, she was overjoyed. She said a word to Feng Jirour and followed the inner attendant.

The Ningguo Duke’s mansion was decorated with lanterns and streamers, bustling with noise and excitement. Only the courtyard where Zhao Qi lived was elegant and quiet, as if separated from everything around it.

Entering the small courtyard, she saw Zhao Qi sitting in the yard, staring blankly at a chessboard. Yu Ying walked up and respectfully greeted, "Your Highness."

Zhao Qi seemed lost in thought, not noticing her entering the courtyard until he heard her voice. Only then did he come back to his senses, but the chess piece in his hand had already fallen to the ground.

When he looked up, Yu Ying was already standing beside him, like a sea tang tree, slender as a willow.

Yu Ying bent down to pick up the chess piece, blew on it twice, wiped it clean with a handkerchief, and then handed it back to him.

Curiously, she asked, "Can Your Highness play chess alone?"

"Playing alone is no fun." Zhao Qi averted his gaze, muttering, "Last time I was playing chess, that bastard Zhao Zun ruined the mood. I was just trying to remember what the chessboard looked like that day. I couldn’t recall some of the pieces. It’s good that you’re here. Help me take a look."

That day’s chessboard?

Yu Ying was stunned for a moment before remembering that Zhao Qi was referring to the time they played chess in Heishui County and were interrupted by the crown prince.

She had only learned the rules of Go from Zhao Qi that day. Her moves were random, without any strategy or method. How could she remember what the chessboard looked like?

"I don’t remember." Seeing the disappointment in Zhao Qi’s eyes, Yu Ying said, "How about we start a new game?"

The original intention wasn’t to recall that game.

Zhao Qi nodded, "Alright."

Yu Ying helped him pick up the chess pieces one by one and put them back in the box. As she did so, she said, "I still haven’t properly thanked Your Highness for giving me so many things."

"It’s not like I need them. Giving them to you is the same as throwing them away."

Zhao Qi’s tone was cold, but Yu Ying knew his temperament. She raised her eyebrows slightly and smiled, "So these are things Seventh Prince doesn’t want. Then I won’t owe you a favor. That’s great. After all, I’m just a poor girl who can’t afford to return the gift."

"Tch," Zhao Qi’s expression was indifferent, as if he couldn’t be bothered to respond to her.

"Miss Yun said that Your Highness’s injuries have healed?"

"Mmm."

"That’s great. In the future, don’t deliberately get injured anymore."

Zhao Qi casually said, "Who would deliberately get injured? I’m not an idiot. I was harmed by that villain."

"Even if you know it’s that villain, Your Highness should endure it in the future."

Zhao Qi looked up at her, said nothing, then lowered his head again.

That lecher Zhao Zun clearly still had lustful intentions. How could he endure it when she even wanted to take him to some cool pavilion?

Yu Ying saw that he wasn’t speaking and knew that as an outsider, she shouldn’t lecture him too much. She decided to stop there and focus on the game.

After a series of haphazard moves, just as she was about to lose badly, her pieces suddenly came back to life, and she could continue the battle.

"Are you letting me win, Your Highness?"

Zhao Qi, seeing that she had seen through him, impatiently said, "You play so poorly. If I don’t let you win a little, how can we play?"

That was true.

Yu Ying smirked and continued to make her moves. Her chess skills were indeed poor. Before long, Zhao Qi had no way to turn the game around.

"I lost."

"You lost and you’re still so smug?"

Yu Ying glanced at the courtyard gate and whispered, "Your Highness, can I go out for a while?"

---

chapters.title: Outsider
chapters.content:
"Where to?" Zhao Qi thought for a moment, then added, "You don’t need to go to Cousin Yun’s place. Her courtyard is full of people. Even if you go, you won’t be able to talk to her."

As for Shen Tongyun’s marriage, Zhao Qi didn’t feel much about it.

After all, they were both in the capital. Wouldn’t they be able to see each other whenever they wanted?

"I’m not going to disturb Miss Yun. It’s rare for me to leave the mansion. I want to visit my mother. Last time, Your Highness gave me some medicinal materials. I brought some with me and want to take them to her."

Zhao Qi glanced at her but didn’t see her carrying anything.

"Where are the things?"

"In the marquis’s carriage."

Yu Ying stood up as she spoke, "I’ll be back soon. Our mansion’s cousin probably won’t come looking for me. If she does, please help me cover for me, Your Highness."

"Who said I’d help you cover?" Zhao Qi saw her about to leave and put down the chess piece.

"Are you going out too, Your Highness?"

"That’s right. The duke’s mansion is too noisy. I don’t want to stay a moment longer."

Thinking about her mother’s nervousness and worry, Yu Ying hesitated, "Your Highness, my mother is a country bumpkin who hasn’t seen much of the world. She’ll be scared if she sees you."

"Do I look that scary? Just tell her I’m a young servant from the marquis’s mansion."

Yu Ying looked at his elaborately embroidered robe and didn’t know what to say for a moment.

What kind of servant dressed like that?

Even if her mother was truly a country bumpkin, she had escaped from the palace. She might recognize the fabric as something only found in the palace.

Seeing that Zhao Qi was determined to go, Yu Ying said, "My mother is resting at the Taoran Inn. The first floor of the inn is quite lively, with singers and storytellers. If Your Highness wants to go, you could order some food and drink and sit there for a while."

Zhao Qi just wanted to have fun with Yu Ying. But hearing her say this, he immediately became contrary.

"Can’t I visit your mother with you? I won’t cause any trouble."

Yu Ying pressed her hands together in a pleading gesture, "My mother is really timid... She’s been in a coma for two years, and her body is very weak. She doesn’t want to see outsiders."

Outsider...

He remembered that the Taoran Inn was Zhao Xuanyou’s property. Her mother living at the Taoran Inn clearly meant that Zhao Xuanyou was an "insider."

"I understand." Zhao Qi responded with a stiff face.

Yu Ying had received so many precious medicines and tonics from Zhao Qi. He was practically her benefactor. Seeing that her benefactor was unhappy, Yu Ying quickly tried to soothe him, "Today, I’m just delivering medicine to my mother. I’ll stay for a while and then come back down to play with you."

Zhao Qi still sulked silently. Yu Ying had no choice but to walk out first.

The inn wasn’t far from the Ningguo Duke’s mansion. After leaving the mansion, Yu Ying returned to the carriage to get the things, then headed to the inn.

Once they left the street where the Ningguo Duke’s mansion was, it was finally less crowded.

"Young master, would you like some candied hawthorn?" Yu Ying saw a group of children buying candied hawthorn and asked Zhao Qi with a smile.

"That’s for fooling little kids. I don’t want it."

"I do."

Yu Ying pushed her way in and bought three strings, first giving one to Yinpao. She held up the other two and swung them.

"Really don’t want any?"

Zhao Qi coldly snatched one from her hand. Eating the sweet and sour candied hawthorn, his expression finally improved a bit.

After walking a bit further, Yu Ying wanted to try some fried cakes, but Zhao Qi stopped her.

"This place isn’t good. The one further ahead fries them crispier. Let’s go there."

Zhao Qi took the things Yu Ying was holding and threw them to Yinpao. He pulled Yu Ying along the street, buying a bag of fried cakes from a roadside stall.

Yu Ying tried one and found it indeed crispy.

"Your Highness, are you familiar with the streets?"

The emperor had arranged many lessons for Zhao Qi. But considering his young age and the loss of his mother, he was allowed to stay at the Ningguo Duke’s mansion from time to time.

When he was bored, Zhao Qi liked to wander around the capital.

Zhao Qi didn’t answer. He only said, "Walk a bit further ahead. There’s a dessert shop. The hawthorn candy and leather candy are very good."

"Alright, I’ll buy some to take to my mother."

The two chatted and strolled along the way. By the time they reached the Taoran Inn, Yinpao’s hands were already full.

Manager Li saw Yu Ying bring in a finely dressed young master and came forward to greet them.

"This is the young master from the Ningguo Duke’s mansion. Manager Li, please find him a good seat."

"Certainly." The manager could naturally see that Zhao Qi’s attire was extraordinary, and his status was by no means lower than Zhao Xuanyou’s. He quickly respectfully led Zhao Qi away.

Yu Ying took the things from Yinpao’s hands. Seeing that Zhao Qi was seated, she went upstairs.

Inside the room, Chen Da Niu and Liu Daniang were both present.

Yu Ying placed the tonics on the table and instructed them to ask Doctor Feng the next time he came how to use the medicine properly.

As they were talking, someone suddenly pushed the door open.

Yu Ying felt as if her head was about to explode. Helplessly, she said, "Young master, why did you come up?"

"Just looking around." Zhao Qi said, glancing into the inner room. His gaze happened to meet Ding Wenxi’s on the couch.

Ding Wenxi didn’t know who he was. Her eyes were full of detachment and vigilance.

Zhao Qi was taken aback by that gaze. He realized he had barged in and made her unhappy. He quickly lowered his head and walked over to Yu Ying.

"Yu Ying, since you have a guest, we’ll go out first."

Yu Ying nodded. After Chen Da Niu and the others had left, she looked at Zhao Qi and whispered, "Since you’re here, go say hello."

Seeing that Yu Ying wasn’t unhappy and even wanted to take him in to greet her mother, Zhao Qi nodded. The corner of his mouth unconsciously curved up.

"Mother." Yu Ying led Zhao Qi into the inner room, first getting a chair for Zhao Qi, then sitting down by the couch herself.

By now, Ding Wenxi had also noticed Zhao Qi’s luxurious clothing. The jade pendant hanging from him was a pure Hetian treasure with no impurities. She couldn’t help but feel nervous.

She looked at Yu Ying uneasily.

"This is the seventh young master of the Ningguo Duke’s mansion. He heard that you’re unwell and sent some tonics over."

Ding Wenxi had just heard Yu Ying mention ginseng and bird’s nest outside. To give so many medicines to a stranger like her, this seventh young master must be doing it for Yu Ying’s sake.

But he was still young, with a face full of childishness.

Zhao Qi felt uncomfortable being scrutinized by Ding Wenxi. He looked at Yu Ying, but she wasn’t looking at him. So he stood up and went to the outer room by himself.

Yu Ying only looked at Ding Wenxi on the couch, "Mother, did Doctor Feng come by a few days ago?"

"He did."

"What did he say?"

Ding Wenxi replied, "He said that since I’ve woken up, there’s no major issue. I just need to recover slowly. He prescribed some medicine and said a monthly check-up would be fine."

Although it was more or less what Yu Ying had expected, hearing the doctor say there was no major problem finally put her suspended heart at ease.

But Ding Wenxi looked worried.

"Good, good. How come you’re not serving at the marquis’s mansion but going out with the young master of the Ningguo Duke’s mansion?"

"It’s a long story. Tomorrow is the day the eldest young lady of the Ningguo Duke’s mansion gets married. The old madam of the marquis’s mansion is unwell, so I’m accompanying my cousin to the duke’s mansion to contribute to the dowry. Coincidentally, the seventh young master wanted to go out, so we went to the street together."

"Are the Ningguo Duke’s mansion and your marquis’s mansion very close?"

The two families weren’t close. They had only started interacting because of the recent events.

"Since the duke’s mansion has a joyous occasion, you should quickly send the seventh young master back. Don’t delay his business."

Yu Ying really wanted to stay with her mother a little longer. But with Zhao Qi there, how could she stay long?

She held her mother’s hand, reluctant to leave. Zhao Qi in the outer room heard Ding Wenxi’s words and realized that as an "outsider," he was preventing them from having a mother-daughter reunion. He felt unpleasant.

"Yu Ying, there’s nothing for us at the mansion. You stay and talk with your mother. I’ll go downstairs to listen to the music."

"I’ll go with you."

"I’ll go by myself! This afternoon, someone from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion will come by. You don’t want to see them, do you?"

Yu Ying hadn’t spoken yet, but her mother’s face turned pale in an instant.

chapters.title: The Last Decree
chapters.content:
Yu Wan noticed her mother’s hands trembling slightly but did not ask immediately.

She suppressed the unease in her heart and turned to Zhao Qi with a smile. "Thank you, young master. Then this servant will stay with my mother a little longer."

After Zhao Qi left the room, Yu Wan looked at Ding Wenxi and comforted her, "Mother, don’t worry. The seventh young master is young and straightforward, without any ulterior motives. He won’t cause trouble."

Ding Wenxi was lost in thought, as if she hadn’t heard Yu Wan’s words.

Seeing this, Yu Wan went to fetch the snacks she had bought. "I bought some mung bean cakes on the street. They’re still warm. Would you like to try some?"

"Do you know anyone from Xingguo Duke’s mansion?"

Yu Wan didn’t quite understand why her mother was asking about the Xingguo Duke’s mansion.

Her mother was frail and easily frightened. How could she dare mention the things about Cui Yichu?

If her mother knew that the Xingguo Duke’s mansion was scheming to eliminate them, she would have to settle her mother in Zhao Xuanyou’s territory. But her mother would probably be unable to sleep or eat in peace.

It would be better to wait until Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta had dealt with the Xingguo Duke’s mansion.

"I have seen them, but while I know them, they don’t know me. The Xingguo Duke’s mansion and the Ningguo Duke’s mansion are related by marriage. This engagement is their business and has nothing to do with the Hou mansion."

Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Wan, her face filled with worry.

Yu Wan had always been quick-witted. She could see that her mother was very concerned about the Xingguo Duke’s mansion and couldn’t help but ask, "Mother, do you have any grudges with the Xingguo Duke’s mansion?"

Ding Wenxi turned her face away, as if she had countless sorrows.

After a moment of silence, she choked out, "There’s no grudge. In the future, you must not have any dealings with their family."

"Mother, your daughter is already grown up." Yu Wan held her hand and softly persuaded, "I know you worry about me, but if you don’t tell the truth, I won’t know how to respond if I really encounter someone from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion in the future. After all, I still work at the Hou mansion. Sometimes, I can’t avoid them even if I want to. Tell me so I can be prepared."

Yu Wan’s words were reasonable, but Ding Wenxi couldn’t say a word, and tears fell continuously.

Her daughter was her everything, the only pillar supporting her to continue living in this world.

From the time her daughter was a child and lost her baby fat, she could see that her daughter’s facial features did not resemble hers.

Ding Wenxi had been in a coma for more than two years. When she woke up again, the naive young girl had grown into a graceful and elegant young lady, and she looked even more like her real father.

"Mother." Seeing her mother’s tears falling like a string of beads, Yu Wan’s heart became even more uneasy.

To cry like this, it was obvious that her mother had a deep connection with the Xingguo Duke’s mansion.

Given her mother’s age and having hidden in the village for more than a decade, she wouldn’t have had any dealings with the Cui siblings. It could only be with the Xingguo Duke or his wife.

Between them...

In a daze, Yu Wan was transported back to the day two years ago when she first entered the Hou mansion.

She was led to the Hou mansion by a human trafficker and stood in the courtyard with a line of maids.

Cui Yichu stood on the veranda with a detached gaze, looking down at them. She uneasily looked up.

At the moment their eyes met, both of them froze.

Yu Wan let go of her mother’s hand, not letting her notice that her own fingers were trembling slightly.

"Some people say that my appearance is similar to the young lady of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion."

Ding Wenxi’s tears surged out. She grabbed Yu Wan’s shoulders and pulled her into her arms.

"Child, it’s mother’s fault."

Yu Wan was stunned and stood stiffly in her mother’s embrace.

She and Cui Yichu were actually blood sisters?

In her past life, she had been killed by her own sister?

Not only that, in this life, her "relatives" were still trying to kill her and her mother...

Yu Wan understood most of it in her heart, but she didn’t dare to show any sign of the shock she felt inside. She tried her best to remain calm.

It didn’t matter.

None of this was important.

What was important was that she was alive, her mother was alive, and they still had a long life ahead of them.

Listening to her mother crying uncontrollably, Yu Wan softly comforted her, "Mother, don’t worry. In the future, I will avoid people from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. Before we leave the capital, I will go out less to avoid others noticing my appearance."

Ding Wenxi listened to Yu Wan’s words and looked at her in surprise, loosening her grip.

Seeing that Yu Wan’s eyes were slightly red, but her smile was as warm as ever and her spirit was still vibrant, she asked incredulously, "Child, you know you are of the duke’s bloodline. Don’t you..."

"It is surprising, but I have already told mother before. I came to the capital to earn money to cure your illness. Now that you are awake, my biggest wish has been fulfilled. Everything else is irrelevant to me. I do want to know what happened back then, but if mother doesn’t want to say much, then don’t."

Having experienced life and death, other matters were indeed not as important to Yu Wan.

"You..." Ding Wenxi felt that Yu Wan was forcing herself to be strong and felt even more guilty, deeply regretting her own cowardice.

After crying for a long time, Ding Wenxi finally calmed down.

She took a deep breath and looked at Yu Wan. "Go and see if there’s anyone outside."

Yu Wan did as she was told and went out. Seeing that the corridor was empty, and knowing that her mother was about to reveal a huge secret, she closed both the outer and inner doors tightly before sitting back down by the bed.

"After Emperor Hongjing ascended the throne, his three elder brothers were all dissatisfied, and the palace was in turmoil."

"Mother was just a palace maid. Was she involved in that?"

Pei Ta had also mentioned the events before the emperor’s ascension while teaching Zhao Qi in Lichuan.

Emperor Hongjing was the emperor’s youngest brother. Because his birth mother was greatly favored by the previous emperor, the previous emperor, on his deathbed, insisted on letting the nine-year-old Hongjing inherit the throne.

However, Emperor Hongjing did not sit on the dragon throne for long before he died suddenly. His three elder brothers then fought for the throne.

In the end, it was the Zhen Guo Duke who entered the palace as an envoy for Prince Yong, asking the empress dowager to come forward and announce Emperor Hongjing’s last decree, which specified that Prince Yong should inherit the throne.

Although Emperor Hongjing was young and died early, he was the legitimate emperor.

With the empress dowager’s announcement of this decree, Prince Yong became the legitimate heir, gaining the support of the court officials and the people, and smoothly ascended the throne, becoming the current emperor.

Recalling what her mother had said before, Yu Wan asked, "Mother, was the mistress you served in the palace the empress dowager?"

Ding Wenxi nodded.

"The empress dowager was very beautiful and gentle. She said I looked like her sister and personally taught me music, chess, calligraphy, and painting. After Emperor Hongjing’s death, she was forced to make a deal with the Zhen Guo Duke to help Prince Yong ascend the throne."

Yu Wan was startled. "The last decree was fake?"

Thinking of the past, Ding Wenxi sighed. "Emperor Hongjing died of poisoning. How could he have had time to make a last decree?"

Yes, after Emperor Hongjing’s death, if the empress dowager could help Prince Yong ascend the throne, she would have the merit of enthronement, and her situation would certainly be better.

"What happened later? How did mother leave the palace?"

"After Prince Yong ascended the throne, the empress dowager wanted to request to leave the palace and spend the rest of her life in a temple, but her request was not granted."

"Why?"

Ding Wenxi gave a bitter smile. "That decree was fake. Without a legitimate decree of abdication, it shouldn’t have been his turn to inherit the throne based on seniority. The empress dowager held this secret, so of course he couldn’t let her leave."

Yu Wan’s body trembled slightly.

At this point, Yu Wan finally understood why her mother was so eager to leave the capital.

The empress dowager had long since passed away, and the palace attendants around her were probably all eliminated.

The only living person, her mother, was the only witness.

"Mother..." Yu Wan had not expected that her mother was involved in the succession of the throne and was at a loss for a moment.

Ding Wenxi continued, "I served the empress dowager for many years and originally planned to follow her in life and death. But the empress dowager knew I had a loved one and couldn’t bear to let me be trapped in the palace, so she arranged a way out for me and helped me escape from the palace."

Hearing this, Yu Wan’s eyebrows furrowed.

"Mother’s loved one was the Xingguo Duke?"

---

chapters.title: Lingering Attachment
chapters.content:
Yu Wan had seen the Xingguo Duke before.

Although he was already in his forties, he was steady and dignified, with a natural and refined scholarly demeanor.

The young masters and ladies of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion were all exceptionally handsome and elegant. It was not hard to imagine how impressive the Xingguo Duke must have been in his youth.

Ding Wenxi’s smile was bitter as she slowly said, "After leaving the palace, I went to find him first."

"By then, he should have already been married, right?" Yu Wan asked softly.

Cui Yichu was older than Yu Wan, and he had an elder brother. By then, he must have already married Tao Shi.

"My status was not something that could be revealed. I went to find him only to ask for his help in leaving the capital."

"And then?" Yu Wan pressed.

"He personally drove a carriage to take me to a manor on the outskirts of the capital. He told me to stay there peacefully and said he would arrange a new identity for me and send me away from the capital."

"Did he go back on his word?" Yu Wan frowned slightly.

Ding Wenxi lowered her gaze and said in a low voice, "At that time, I was alone and helpless. He would come to visit me every few days. Finally, one day, he said he couldn’t bear to part with me and begged me not to leave him. He looked so moved that I softened my heart. He said he would take care of me for the rest of my life. The manor was full of servants from the duke’s mansion, and no one would reveal my whereabouts. With him taking care of me, it would be better than me going out alone to make a living."

Her mother was so beautiful that it was natural for the Xingguo Duke to not want to let her go.

And since her mother had feelings for him and was alone outside the palace with a special status, agreeing to be his secret lover was inevitable.

However, the manor her mother mentioned... For some reason, Yu Wan felt a little concerned.

"Later, why did mother leave? Did he abandon you?" Yu Wan asked softly.

Ding Wenxi gently shook her head. "I lived in that manor for a full two years. He would come and stay for a few days every month. The people in the manor knew I was his woman and were very polite to me. In my free time, I learned from the farmers how to plant vegetables and pick fruits, which was quite enjoyable."

"It sounds like mother was planning to live there for the rest of her life." Yu Wan sighed.

"Yes, if he ever stopped coming, I could still work in the manor to support myself." Ding Wenxi’s tone was calm, as if she were talking about the most ordinary thing.

"So what happened later?" Yu Wan pressed.

"He was ordered to leave the capital on official business. Not long after, his wife came to the manor." Ding Wenxi’s voice paused slightly.

Yu Wan had not witnessed Tao Shi’s methods, but she knew Cui Yichu and Zhou Mama. These two were raised by Tao Shi, so Tao Shi would only be more vicious than them.

"Did she humiliate mother?" Yu Wan knitted her brows.

Ding Wenxi gave a faint smile. "She didn’t know my identity. She put on the air of a duke’s wife and spoke politely. She even said she wanted to take me into the mansion and give me the status of a concubine. Of course, I couldn’t enter the mansion. Moreover, I could see that her intention to take me into the mansion was just to trap me like a turtle in a jar."

Indeed, it was a common trick used by Cui Yichu and his mother.

"So mother left?"

"She wanted to have someone forcibly take me away. I took a pair of scissors and threatened to kill myself. She was probably afraid that my death would anger Cui Lingyuan, so she left in a huff. I knew she wouldn’t let it go, and I was more afraid that exposing my identity would implicate the empress dowager. So that night, I packed my things and left quietly."

Although Ding Wenxi had been living in the manor for a long time, over the past two years, she had frequently interacted with farmers and servants, so she was no longer as fearful of the outside world as when she first left the palace.

This time, she did not rely on anyone. She used her money to buy a fake identity. When she found a suitable village, she bribed the village chief to recognize her as a relative, and established herself in the village as the widow of a boatman.

The only unexpected thing was that she was pregnant with Yu Wan.

"Child." Seeing Yu Wan’s solemn expression, Ding Wenxi said softly, "If you want to..."

"I don’t want to." Yu Wan blurted out.

Ding Wenxi looked at her in surprise. "You are a daughter from an unofficial marriage, but you are still a young lady of the duke’s mansion. You look like him. Without me saying anything, he will recognize you."

The hatred between Yu Wan and Cui Yichu was complicated and involved two lifetimes. Yu Wan couldn’t explain it, nor could she.

"What about mother?" Yu Wan asked.

"I naturally cannot stay in the capital." Ding Wenxi’s tone was firm.

Yu Wan smiled back and asked, "If mother is leaving, why should I stay?"

Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Wan and painfully caressed her cheek.

"You have grown up and will eventually have to live your own life. Last time, you didn’t say much to me, but I heard a lot from Chen Da Niu. I can guess that the Hou mansion’s young master treats you very well. Although you are a daughter from an unofficial marriage, he has divorced once before and is fond of you. He should be willing to marry you as his next wife."

"Wherever mother is, I will be." Yu Wan’s tone was firm.

Not to mention that Zhao Xuanyou was about to take action against the Xingguo Duke’s mansion. Even if he didn’t, given the feud between him and the Xingguo Duke’s mansion, how could he possibly marry the illegitimate daughter of the Xingguo Duke as his next wife?

Even if he had some affection for Yu Wan, he couldn’t defy Lady Ye.

Moreover, Yu Wan had lived a second life. Her greatest wish was to live a peaceful life with her mother. Now that she was about to achieve this wish, she wouldn’t give it up.

"Mother cannot stay with you forever. You will eventually have to get married. You have already..." Thinking of how Yu Wan had lost her innocence to save her, Ding Wenxi felt as if her heart was being twisted. "If he truly cares for you, you can live a stable life in the Hou mansion."

Yu Wan softly said, "No one can stay with anyone forever. Back then, the Xingguo Duke also said he would take care of mother for life, but soon after, his wife came looking for her. I only want to be with mother. Nothing else matters."

"Are you really willing to leave the Hou mansion?" Ding Wenxi asked doubtfully.

Previously, Yu Wan had indeed been somewhat hesitant.

Although her mother had escaped from the palace, nearly twenty years had passed. Perhaps the palace had already forgotten about this. As long as she was careful, she might not be noticed.

But now it was different.

Her mother was not just someone who had escaped from the palace. Her mother knew the secret of the current emperor’s ascension to the throne. Once her identity was exposed, no one could save her mother.

Not her, not Zhao Xuanyou.

"I now know mother’s situation. Once mother’s health improves, we will leave the capital immediately." Yu Wan’s tone was firm.

Ding Wenxi was still somewhat worried. "Will the young master let you leave?"

An image of Zhao Xuanyou appeared in Yu Wan’s mind. After a moment of rapid thought, she looked up and smiled. "Whether he lets me or not, I must leave."

"Do you really have no lingering feelings for him?" Ding Wenxi asked.

Yu Wan slowly shook her head.

Of course, there were lingering feelings.

When she was taken away by the crown prince, Zhao Xuanyou had disregarded the difference in their status and brought her back.

At the moment she fell into his arms, Yu Wan had also thought of never leaving him for the rest of her life.

But was she truly irreplaceable to Zhao Xuanyou?

Zhao Xuanyou would eventually marry a wife. There was also a cousin waiting to be his concubine in the mansion. Given his status, there would never be a shortage of women around him.

Ding Wenxi didn’t know what her daughter had experienced over the past two years. She just looked at Yu Wan’s response, and her brows suddenly tightened.

How many hardships did one have to endure to develop such a calm demeanor?

Ding Wenxi knew she couldn’t do it. Among the people she knew, only the empress dowager had such a bearing.

After a moment of silence, she said in a low voice, "I understand. After leaving the capital, we mother and daughter will live a good life together."

"I have money. Our life won’t be hard in the future." Yu Wan smiled.

Ding Wenxi felt a mix of emotions and knew that her daughter had made up her mind. She nodded. "That young master is still waiting for you downstairs. You should go back early to avoid gossip."

"I know." Yu Wan served her mother some warm water to soothe her throat and tucked the blanket around her before heading out.

After taking a few steps, she turned her head and asked casually, "Mother lived happily in that manor. The scenery there must have been beautiful."

At the mention of the beautiful scenery, Ding Wenxi’s voice carried a touch of nostalgia.

"Yes, it was indeed beautiful. There was a large orchard in the manor, and a small river flowed through the woods. In the spring, the river was filled with fallen petals."

chapters.title: Heartache
chapters.content:
"So be it." Yu Wan smiled gently. "Mother, please rest well. Only when your body recovers can we have a long future together."

Though she was the daughter, she was the one giving the reminders.

Ding Wenxi looked at her sensible daughter, her heart filled with sorrow. But the more upset she was, the more worried her daughter would become.

She did her best to suppress her worries and nodded. "These days, I have been taking my medicine on time, eating well, and walking around the house with Aunt Liu every day. I won't waste the tonics you brought today."

"Then your daughter can rest assured."

After leaving the room, Yu Wan closed the door, and the smile on her face froze in an instant.

She took a deep breath and forced herself to cheer up as she walked downstairs to the inn.

Aunt Liu saw her coming down, greeted her, and went upstairs to take care of Ding Wenxi.

Yu Wan walked out with her head down. Zhao Qi saw her leaving and hurried after her, but Yu Wan walked so fast that he couldn't keep up.

"Yu Wan, wait for me."

"I still need to buy some things for my mother. Your Highness, please wait here for a moment. I'll be right back."

There was nothing wrong with what she said.

But Zhao Qi felt something was off. Yu Wan had always treated him with respect and gentleness, always looking into his eyes when speaking, never turning her back on him like this.

Upon closer thought, he realized her voice just now seemed to have a slight nasal tone.

Watching Yu Wan's hurried steps, Zhao Qi quickly caught up, grabbed her arm, and turned her around.

Yu Wan's eyes were red-rimmed, and though there were no tear stains on her face, her eyes were filled with mist.

Zhao Qi panicked, his thin lips moved slightly, and he asked softly, "Why are you crying?"

After learning about her origins from her mother, Yu Wan had been doing her best to control her emotions. She had planned to find a secluded place to vent after leaving the inn, but she hadn't expected Zhao Qi to catch up.

Hearing Zhao Qi's question, Yu Wan's suppressed emotions surged instantly.

"What does it matter if I cry? What does it have to do with you?"

But as soon as the words left her mouth, reason took over again.

She took a deep breath and restrained her sobs. "Your Highness, please forgive me. This servant is not feeling well. Please return to the inn first."

Zhao Qi was used to seeing Yu Wan with a smile in her eyes, bright and unrestrained. This was the first time he had seen her sad and in tears, and he couldn't help but feel a pang of sympathy.

"You can throw a tantrum if you want. I won't be angry."

Yu Wan could hear his good intentions, but her emotions had already reached their limit, and she couldn't say anything more to him.

She nodded, lowered her head, and walked away quickly.

The autumn wind blew, lifting the hem of her dress.

Zhao Qi stood in place for a moment, then, when Yu Wan was more than ten steps away, he chased after her.

After leaving the street, Yu Wan turned into a narrow alley. She hid behind a tree, facing the gray wall, and at this moment, the tears finally gushed out.

Yu Wan did not cling to the status of a noble lady.

Whether it was honor or kinship, none of it belonged to her.

That noble mansion was filled with wolves and tigers. Setting aside Tao Shi and Cui Yichu, was the Duke really so deeply in love with her mother?

Her mother had left alone. With the power of the Xingguo Duke's mansion, if they had wanted to find her back then, it would have been impossible not to.

They didn't search because her mother had already accompanied him for two years. Losing her was not a pity; instead, it was getting rid of a hidden danger.

But why did heaven have to mock her like this?

In her previous life, the person who killed her was her own elder sister, and the manor where she died was the very place where her mother had carried her. How ironic was that?

Yu Wan had never done evil, yet she was connected by blood to those evil people.

She leaned against the tree and wept for a long time. When her emotions finally calmed down, footsteps were heard behind her.

"I'm not here to rush you." Zhao Qi did not approach Yu Wan but stood on the other side of the tree, facing away. "I had Silver Bottle and the others guard the alley. No one will see you crying."

No wonder she had been crying here for so long without a single passerby.

"Thank you, Your Highness."

"What for." Hearing her choked voice, Zhao Qi felt as if his heart was being twisted forcefully.

He was not usually a gentle person, but at this moment, there was none of the usual arrogance and coldness in his eyes.

"Are you worried about your mother's illness?"

"No."

"Then what is it?"

Yu Wan sighed. "Heartache."

Zhao Qi was confused and muttered, "You usually don't seem like someone with heartache."

Before Yu Wan could answer, he slightly turned his head, glancing at her reddened eyes from crying. Afraid she would get angry, he quickly averted his gaze and, like her, leaned against the tree trunk, looking up at the clouds in the sky.

The autumn sky was clear, but from this narrow alley, even the sky seemed cramped.

But no matter how cramped it was, at least it was quiet here, with only the two of them.

"Are you unhappy at the Marquis's mansion?" Zhao Qi asked.

"It has nothing to do with the Marquis's mansion," Yu Wan said softly. "It's just my own troubles."

"How can it have nothing to do with it?" Zhao Qi was slightly indignant. "You are Zhao Xuanyou's... maid. If you encounter trouble, he should naturally step in to resolve it."

"It's not that simple."

Hearing Yu Wan's words, Zhao Qi frowned. "Is it really big trouble?"

"More or less." Yu Wan's reply was somewhat weak.

"Does Zhao Xuanyou know?"

"Why should I tell him about my troubles?"

After a moment of silence, Zhao Qi asked again, "You don't want to tell him? Or is it that he can't solve it either."

"Both. I don't want to tell him, and he can't solve it."

"Then what about me?" Zhao Qi paused after speaking, then curled his lips with a hint of self-mockery. "I mean, can I solve it?"

Yu Wan remained silent.

This chapter is not yet complete. Please click on the next page to continue reading the following exciting content!

She wouldn't even tell Zhao Xuanyou, so how could she tell him?

Zhao Qi had enough self-awareness to know that.

Yu Wan said nothing.

"Can't I solve it either?" Zhao Qi asked in surprise. "Is it Zhao Zun causing trouble for you again? Don't worry, the Emperor will return to the capital soon. He won't dare to act recklessly in the capital."

"It's not him."

After crying so much and talking with Zhao Qi for so long, Yu Wan felt much lighter. Though her eyes were still red, her expression had returned to normal.

Seeing Zhao Qi trying his best to comfort her, Yu Wan said, "Why would I be troubled by someone like him?"

Hearing the light, teasing tone in Yu Wan's voice, Zhao Qi knew she was fine, but his heart was still in turmoil.

If she wouldn't be troubled by someone like Zhao Zun, then who would trouble her?

Zhao Xuanyou?

"You're fine now, that's good."

"Indeed, I'm fine. Earlier, I cried because my mother is unwell, but I can't always be by her side to attend to her. That's all." Yu Wan realized her reaction had been too abnormal, and now that her emotions had settled, she naturally came up with a suitable excuse.

"Doesn't the Marquis's mansion allow you to go out?"

"There are rules in the mansion. I can only go out once a month. Today, I was able to come thanks to Your Highness and Miss Yun." She couldn't reveal anything about her family to outsiders. Yu Wan took a step forward, walking around to face Zhao Qi. "We've been out for a long time. We should return to the Ningguo Duke's mansion. I haven't congratulated Miss Yun yet."

Zhao Qi couldn't focus on a single word.

He looked into those eyes, clear as autumn water, and his gaze gradually deepened.

"If you want to spend more time with your mother, why not leave the Marquis's mansion?"

---

chapters.title: Cousin
chapters.content:
Yu Wan's eyes flickered for a moment, then her smile returned to normal.

"The Marquis's mansion pays well, and the master is kind. If I leave, how will I support my mother?"

Zhao Qi's expression appeared indifferent, but upon hearing Yu Wan's words, he stiffened his neck and said, "There's more than one noble family in the capital. Which one would shortchange your wages?"

Yu Wan pursed her lips. "I know Your Highness can arrange for me to work at the Ningguo Duke's mansion. Thank you, Your Highness."

"There's more than just the Ningguo Duke's mansion in the capital. Who else would be short on money?"

"You're right, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi heard her casual response and knew she hadn't taken his words to heart at all. Suddenly annoyed, he strode out, forcing Yu Wan to follow him out of the alley.

Silver Bottle saw them come out and only then allowed the guards to let the people waiting outside pass through.

Yu Wan hadn't expected her momentary loss of control to inconvenience others, and she felt somewhat guilty.

But those blocked outside were not residents of the alley but a few idle men.

Seeing Yu Wan's beauty and Zhao Qi's handsome appearance, they lingered, openly speculating about their identities.

Seeing them staring at Yu Wan without restraint, Zhao Qi fiercely shouted, "Scram!"

As soon as he spoke, the guards beside him drew their swords, scaring the idle men away like birds and beasts.

"Your Highness, let's return to the Ningguo Duke's mansion."

Zhao Qi didn't respond.

Yu Wan guessed that her earlier response had upset him, but she didn't know how to make amends.

She couldn't very well tell him that she did want to work at the Ningguo Duke's mansion, could she?

The group returned to the gate of the Ningguo Duke's mansion. Since the day's celebratory cakes and fruits had already been distributed, most of the commoners gathered at the gate had dispersed.

"Yu Wan."

Just as she was about to enter the mansion, someone called her name.

The voice was familiar. Yu Wan looked up and saw Yuan Xi standing at the gate, waving to her.

He usually followed Zhao Xuanyou, so his presence at the Ningguo Duke's mansion meant Zhao Xuanyou had also come.

Yu Wan quickly climbed the steps. "Has Master arrived?"

Wasn't she trying to avoid any connection with the Xingguo Duke?

Yuan Xi nodded slightly, then smiled meaningfully. "He came but didn't see you. He's not happy. Hurry inside."

Yu Wan nodded and followed Yuan Xi a few steps inside. Suddenly remembering Zhao Qi, she turned to look at the gate. Zhao Qi was already out of sight.

She withdrew her gaze and followed Yuan Xi inside.

At this moment, Zhao Xuanyou was seated in the main hall of the Ningguo Duke's mansion. The guests here were all close family friends of the Ningguo Duke. Zhao Xuanyou had been stationed at the border for a long time and wasn't very familiar with them.

But since everyone knew he had gained the Emperor's favor as soon as he returned to the capital, they all came forward to exchange pleasantries.

Though he responded politely, his mind was secretly annoyed. When he saw Yu Wan standing outside the main hall, that irritation suddenly dissipated.

After exchanging a few more words, he found an excuse to leave the main hall.

"Master." Yu Wan curtsied respectfully.

"Did you go visit your mother?"

"Yes, I took some of the medicinal materials Miss Yun gave me last time."

She wished she could visit every day, but Zhao Xuanyou had told her not to rely on favoritism and to follow the Marquis's mansion rules. It had been many days since she last went out.

"From now on, if you need to send anything to the Taoran Inn, just tell Yuan Xi."

Zhao Qi had given her many things, and she had only brought a small portion today. With Yuan Xi's help, it would be much easier.

"Thank you, Master."

"Let's go."

Zhao Xuanyou had no intention of congratulating the Ningguo Duke's mansion for their union with the Xingguo Duke. He had only come to pick up Yu Wan on the way.

"Master, my cousin is still here. I should go invite her."

At Yu Wan's words, Zhao Xuanyou remembered Feng Jirou.

If he was taking Yu Wan, he naturally couldn't leave Feng Jirou alone here.

"Go call her. I'll wait for you both at the gate."

Yu Wan knew the young ladies were playing in the flower hall. She went there, but as she passed Shen Tongyun's courtyard, she glanced inside.

The courtyard was bustling with servants. Through the window, she saw Shen Tongyun speaking with the female elders of her family.

Shen Tongyun listened attentively, her eyes downcast, her shy demeanor suggesting they were discussing instructions for tomorrow's wedding night.

Yu Wan and Shen Tongyun were not in the same social circle. Though they had met a few times, Shen Tongyun had always been kind to her.

The Xingguo Duke's mansion would soon face misfortune. No matter what, Yu Wan hoped Shen Tongyun could remain unscathed.

She didn't enter to disturb them but went straight to the flower hall, found Feng Jirou, and led her out of the Ningguo Duke's mansion.

Yuan Xi had driven the carriage to the gate. Yu Wan first helped Feng Jirou into the carriage. After getting in, she looked at Zhao Xuanyou and Feng Jirou inside and, knowing better, did not join them. She sat outside with Yuan Xi.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze focused, and just as he was about to call her in, Feng Jirou beside him said, "Yu Wan, it's getting late, and the wind is strong outside. You should come in as well."

Yu Wan turned her head and saw Zhao Xuanyou's displeased expression. She had no choice but to sit inside the carriage.

"Thank you, Cousin."

"You are someone close to my cousin. We shouldn't be so formal."

Though Feng Jirou had rarely disturbed Zhao Xuanyou since arriving at the Marquis's mansion, how could she not know about Yu Wan's favored status after living there for three or four months?

Yu Wan was currently a concubine, but she would eventually become her cousin's mistress.

Feng Jirou knew that her family had fallen on hard times, and the only person she could rely on was Zhao Xuanyou's affection for his late mother. She was careful with her words and actions.

"This servant is just a maid. Cousin is too kind."

Feng Jirou glanced at Zhao Xuanyou's expression and saw his darkened brows, feeling a little tense.

The atmosphere in the carriage was eerily quiet.

Listening to the noise outside, Zhao Xuanyou turned to Feng Jirou and asked, "Have you been comfortable living at the Marquis's mansion these days?"

Feng Jirou had been in the capital for some time, but Zhao Xuanyou had been away from the mansion for most of it, so they hadn't spoken much.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou taking the initiative to care for her, Feng Jirou lowered her eyes and said, "Everything is fine at the Marquis's mansion."

This was the truth.

Even though she was a distant relative staying at the Marquis's mansion, Old Madam Ye had only one grandson, Zhao Xuanyou, and she doted on Feng Jirou. Her food, clothing, and daily needs were all arranged according to the standards of a young lady of the Marquis's mansion.

At home, Feng Jirou had shared two rooms with her three sisters, but at the Marquis's mansion, she had her own spacious courtyard, with fruit trees in front and a fish pond and swing in the back. It was extremely comfortable.

"If there's anything you want to eat or play with, just tell Manager Song. If he can't arrange it, come to me."

Feng Jirou's cheeks turned slightly red. "Thank you, Cousin. I lack for nothing at the Marquis's mansion."

"Have you gone out to have fun?"

"Old Madam Ye had Mama Xing take me to the temple fair once. It was much livelier than back home."

"Do you like living in the capital?" Zhao Xuanyou suddenly asked.

Feng Jirou couldn't gauge Zhao Xuanyou's intentions. Thinking about the arrangement made by their elders, she blushed and said, "Of course, I do."

Yu Wan listened to their back-and-forth conversation and silently watched the scenery outside.

Soon, the carriage stopped in front of the Marquis's mansion. Zhao Xuanyou helped Feng Jirou out first.

Yu Wan watched their backs as they entered the mansion and let out a soft sigh.

This was for the best.

chapters.title: Know Her Well
chapters.content:
Back at Honghui Hall, Yuhan packed up the remaining medicinal herbs and tonics, and Lao Yuanhe took the opportunity to deliver them to Taoran Inn.

After instructing Yingxue about dinner, Yuhan carried tea into the study.

She arranged the teacups and snacks one by one, and just as she was about to leave, Zhao Xuanyou called out to her.

"How is your mother?"

Yuhan turned back and walked to the desk.

"Much better than last time, but she still can't walk on her own."

"After sleeping for more than two years, her body must be very weak. She can only recover slowly. The things Seventh Prince took out must be of the finest quality. Have the inn's chef prepare medicinal meals with them."

"Yes." Yuhan nodded.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the teacup and moistened his throat, then looked up at Yuhan.

At the prime of her youth, the woman stood with a slender waist in her pink dress, her graceful figure accentuated by the faint whiteness beneath her delicate collarbone. She stood still, radiating beauty.

But at this moment, her soft red lips were slightly pursed, her eyes fixed on the teacup on the desk, avoiding his gaze, as if lost in thought.

Zhao Xuanyou, ever observant, naturally understood her concerns.

"Good news. Want to hear it?"

"The reward the Prince mentioned last time?"

Zhao Xuanyou did not answer, but said calmly, "I plan to move to the Houfu's separate courtyard for a few days. Everyone from Honghui Hall will go with me."

"What kind of reward is this?"

Wasn't it just serving him in a different place?

Seeing Yuhan hanging her head indifferently, Zhao Xuanyou raised his sword-like eyebrows slightly, helplessly saying, "At the separate courtyard, you can go out whenever you want."

"Really? Without following the Houfu's rules?" Yuhan indeed wanted to visit Taoran Inn more often.

She had just recovered from a serious illness, both physically and mentally exhausted. Yuhan was truly worried about her staying alone at the inn.

Moreover, if they were to leave the capital, they needed to make preparations. Staying in Houfu all day long would accomplish nothing.

"But why does the Prince suddenly want to stay at the separate courtyard? Leaving the Old Lady alone in the mansion might not be appropriate."

Of course, Zhao Xuanyou was not acting on a whim.

The people sent to investigate the old case in Qingsha Town had all returned. Zhao Xuanyou needed to discuss with Pei Tao the matter of bringing down the Xingguo Duke's mansion.

The Houfu was in a prominent location, too conspicuous, with many people watching. It would be inconvenient for Pei Tao to enter and exit the Houfu.

After much consideration, Zhao Xuanyou decided to stay outside the mansion for a while to avoid attention.

Coincidentally, the separate courtyard was very close to Pei Tao's residence, making it much more convenient for their activities.

"It's only for ten days or half a month. When I have time, I will return to the mansion to pay my respects. Grandmother is used to quietness and won't mind."

This was indeed good news.

"When will you move there?"

"In the next few days."

"I see. Then I will start packing tomorrow."

Zhao Xuanyou lightly hummed in agreement, then got up, "I will have dinner at Leshou Hall tonight."

"Ah? I already instructed the kitchen to make fennel-stirred mutton." This was Zhao Xuanyou's favorite dish.

He reached out and pinched Yuhan's soft cheek, whispering, "You should eat more."

Zhao Xuanyou strolled to Leshou Hall, where Old Lady Ye was currently directing the maids to pick chrysanthemums and wash the petals.

"Be careful. Don't pick the yellow ones or the flower centers to avoid bitterness."

"Grandmother."

Old Lady Ye saw him and pulled him to sit with her under the corridor.

The chrysanthemums in Leshou Hall were well-maintained, with vibrant colors and layers upon layers of blossoms, rivaling the beauty of spring in full bloom.

"Just now, Jiurou came back and said you went to Ningguo Duke's mansion to pick her up?"

Grandmother was a seasoned old hand, knowing full well he didn't go to pick up Feng Jiurou, but deliberately asked this way, clearly displeased with him again.

"After all, Ningguo Duke's mansion sent an invitation. It wouldn't be good if no one from the Houfu went to congratulate them."

Feng Jiurou was just a cousin, and Yuhan was a maid. Neither of them could represent the Houfu.

"So, this mansion needs a mistress."

Zhao Xuanyou seemed to smile, not picking up on Old Lady Ye's hint, but instead asked, "What does Grandmother think of my cousin?"

"Jiurou is a sincere and honest child. Previously, when Fenghuang was causing trouble in the Houfu, she never got involved and just managed her own affairs." Old Lady Ye glanced at Zhao Xuanyou, "What are you planning now? She has lived in the Houfu for so long. If you want to send her back, your uncle and aunt will not agree!"

"Who said I want to send her back?" Zhao Xuanyou's eyes flickered, "Grandmother has been urging me to get married. After much thought, Jiurou is the best choice."

Old Lady Ye was surprised, "You want to marry Jiurou?"

"When my mother was alive, she hoped I would marry Jiurou. It was only when my uncle brought up the marriage that I had already married the Cui family. I had no choice but to say I would take Jiurou as a concubine. She has lived in the mansion for so long. Grandmother knows she is steady and wise. Marrying her will ensure the Houfu remains peaceful in the future."

It wasn't impossible.

There wasn't much fuss about remarrying.

Feng Jiurou was a known quantity. Marrying her would certainly not cause any problems in the future.

"Do you really want to marry Jiurou?" Old Lady Ye asked doubtfully.

In the past, Old Lady Ye thought her grandson deserved the most noble and beautiful girl in the world. After the experience with Cui Yichu, she increasingly agreed with the old saying, "Marry a wife, marry a virtuous one."

The Feng family had once been prominent, but had since declined. The two families were already related by marriage, so a closer union was acceptable.

The Jingyuan Houfu did not lack money, but a capable mistress to manage the household and bear children.

Feng Jiurou might not match Cui Yichu in talent, family background, or appearance, but she was cheerful, healthy, knowledgeable, and a known quantity. In this light, she was indeed suitable.

But after much thought, Old Lady Ye still felt something was off.

She looked at Zhao Xuanyou and repeated, "Really?"

"Of course." Zhao Xuanyou answered calmly, "Marriage is a big deal. I have thought it through carefully before making this decision."

Thought it through carefully?

Old Lady Ye pondered Zhao Xuanyou's words, her expression subtly shifting, a thin anger appearing on her face.

"Are you doing this for Yuhan after careful consideration?"

Zhao Xuanyou had no children. Given his current position in the court, it would not be easy to marry a legitimate daughter from a ducal family, but there were plenty of choices from the collateral branches of noble families. For example, the daughters from the second or third branches of the Ningguo Duke's family would be more than willing to become the wife of the heir.

But high-ranking families had their own rules. The larger the family, the more they would expect the groom's family to clean house before marriage.

He had taken Yuhan to the Lichuan Summer Palace, and everyone knew he had a favored beautiful concubine. How could they tolerate that?

The Feng family was different.

The Feng family had previously agreed to let Feng Jiurou be a concubine. Now that Zhao Xuanyou wanted to marry Feng Jiurou, she would be overjoyed.

She had lived in the Houfu for so long and knew Zhao Xuanyou favored Yuhan. She would never send Yuhan away to displease Zhao Xuanyou.

Most importantly, the Feng family was not in the capital and had weak influence. Feng Jiurou had no grounds to bargain with Zhao Xuanyou.

"Taking care of Yuhan so thoughtfully and carefully, you have really gone out of your way."

Seeing that his grandmother had seen through his thoughts, Zhao Xuanyou remained composed.

"In that case, everyone is happy."

---

chapters.title: Guilty Conscience
chapters.content:
Leaf Old Lady did not think this was a happy ending for everyone.

Yuhan was intelligent and quick-witted, deeply loved by Zhao Xuanyou. Once she became a concubine, her influence in the mansion would undoubtedly be significant.

Although she was steady and rule-abiding now, people were never satisfied with what they had.

Without in-laws to suppress her in the Houfu, if Yuhan were to have a child first, with Feng Jiurou's easy-going nature, it would eventually lead to a situation where the concubine overshadowed the wife.

But Leaf Old Lady knew that Zhao Xuanyou would never send Yuhan away.

If she did not agree to marry Feng Jiurou, Zhao Xuanyou would continue to delay marriage.

Her grandson was grown up. How could she, an old woman, control him?

"If everyone is happy, then it's good," Leaf Old Lady sighed heavily, "Jiurou is your cousin. If you mistreat her in the future, when I go to the afterlife, I will have no face to see my daughter-in-law."

Hearing her grandmother speak so seriously, Zhao Xuanyou took her hand and said solemnly, "Grandmother, rest assured. I promised my mother to take care of the Feng family and have never forgotten. I will not mistreat Jiurou."

"You have grown up and have your own ways of doing things. I can't control you, but I can nag a bit. Your mother passed away early. The Houfu has only been home to the two of us for years. You don't know the twists and turns of noble families. After you married the Cui family, so many women came to the mansion, and so much trouble and even lives were lost in the past year. This is all because the mistress was not virtuous, and the mansion's rules were disrupted."

"Grandmother's teachings are correct."

Seeing him in a compliant posture, Leaf Old Lady couldn't help but nag some more: "Yuhan is clever and obedient now, but everything will change once she has a child. She may not fight for herself, but she will for her child. If you continue to indulge her then, disasters and troubles will follow one after another."

"I will keep all this in mind."

She had said what needed to be said, but Leaf Old Lady was unsure how much he would actually do.

Zhao Xuanyou's temperament was like his father's. Back then, the Jingyuan Marquis was so stubbornly devoted to Zhao Xuanyou's mother that he refused to take a concubine for a long time, leaving the Houfu with only Zhao Xuanyou as the sole heir.

Back then, she couldn't persuade the Jingyuan Marquis, and now she couldn't control Zhao Xuanyou.

Seeing other families with many children and grandchildren, Leaf Old Lady was filled with sorrow.

She ate vegetarian and prayed every day, hoping for blessings for the Houfu, hoping that Zhao Xuanyou would have more children to carry on the family line.

Speaking of which, Yuhan had a rosy complexion and a well-proportioned figure, clearly fertile. If she stayed with Zhao Xuanyou and had more children, it would be a good thing. After all, they would all be her great-grandchildren.

As long as Zhao Xuanyou did not do something like favoring a concubine over his wife, it wouldn't be a big deal.

Leaf Old Lady felt slightly relieved.

"Grandson has one more thing to report to Grandmother."

"What is it?"

"Recently, I need to handle a big matter. Living in the Houfu is inconvenient for coming and going, so I want to stay at the courtyard in Xinghua Alley for a while."

Leaf Old Lady frowned slightly, "Why stay in Xinghua Alley? That place hasn't been visited by anyone from the mansion for many years since your mother passed away. The courtyard might be overgrown."

The house in Xinghua Alley was part of Zhao Xuanyou's mother's dowry and not a property of the Houfu. It had always been registered under Zhao Xuanyou's name.

Zhao Xuanyou had been away from the capital for a long time, so that place had probably been unmanaged for years.

"It's precisely because it hasn't been visited for a long time that it's good for concealing our movements. Although it's not as good as other places, it's not in ruins." Zhao Xuanyou smiled lightly, "I have already ordered people to clean and arrange it. Staying there for a short while won't be a problem."

Leaf Old Lady didn't mind these small matters.

Thinking about what Zhao Xuanyou had said earlier, she worried, "You just returned to the capital. Be careful with your actions and don't let others find a handle on you."

"I understand."

After finishing their business, the grandmother and grandson chatted idly. Zhao Xuanyou accompanied the old lady through dinner before heading to Honghui Hall.

The night sky was filled with thick clouds, not a trace of moonlight visible. A servant held a lantern to light his way.

Entering Honghui Hall, he immediately saw Yuhan standing in the courtyard talking to Ziyan.

She turned her head and saw Zhao Xuanyou returning, so she walked up and curtsied to him.

Zhao Xuanyou raised his hand and half-embraced her in his arms.

The people in Honghui Hall were used to their closeness and didn't find it strange, each turning back to their tasks.

"Master?"

His action came suddenly, surprising Yuhan. She smelled the faint chrysanthemum fragrance on him, knowing he had drunk the chrysanthemum wine brewed by the Old Lady. She didn't move, letting him hold her all the way into the house.

"Do you want some hangover soup?"

Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but laugh, "This little bit of alcohol, what's there to sober up?"

"Then I'll prepare water."

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement. Yuhan went out to give instructions, and Yingxue and Yuan Qing quickly prepared the water.

He was unusually efficient today, carrying the water bucket himself for a refreshing wash, roughly drying his hair before changing into his nightclothes.

Yuhan had already changed into a thin silk nightgown and had just finished making the bed when he approached from behind, pressing against her as they both lay on the bed.

"You're so heavy." Yuhan couldn't help but complain.

His gaze darkened, and he finally let go of her, rolling back onto the pillow.

Yuhan sat up, loosened the silver hook on the canopy, and sat by his side.

"You seem distracted today."

Had she?

Yuhan thought she had hidden it well, but she hadn't realized it escaped his notice.

Her mother's identity was special, and she would inevitably have to leave the capital.

Today, when her mother asked at the inn, "Will the Prince let her leave?" she had not answered, only evading the question.

But this was clearly a big problem.

The candlelight in the room was dim, casting dappled shadows on Zhao Xuanyou's face through the canopy.

At this moment, with his hair down and in his nightclothes, his eyes misty, he looked extremely approachable.

But Yuhan knew in her heart that this man had been trained in martial arts since childhood, had marched through blood in the military, and had navigated the treacherous waters of the court. He had always been a man of his word, decisive and unyielding.

He now favored her, even defying the Crown Prince to keep her. How could he possibly let her leave easily?

To leave the Houfu, she would have to sneak away without his knowledge.

"What's wrong?"

Zhao Xuanyou saw her sitting dumbly on the bed, reached out to tug her arm, pulling her into his embrace, and squinted as he examined her expression.

"What are you thinking about?"

Facing his deep and penetrating gaze, Yuhan showed a rare hesitation, "Thinking about the future."

"Your mother? Or you?"

"Naturally, both." Yuhan spoke with a guilty conscience, not daring to meet his eyes. She lowered her head and nestled into his arms, "Mother can't stay at Taoran Inn forever. We need to find a place to settle her."

"The inn is indeed noisy and not suitable for a patient to rest."

"I'm not saying the inn is bad. My mother is used to living in the countryside and keeps asking to go back home."

"Didn't you sell your house in the countryside? What's the point of going back?"

Through the thin nightclothes, Yuhan could feel the warmth and solidity of his chest, stirring strange emotions within her.

She gently clutched the corner of his clothes and softly said, "That's why I'm worried."

chapters.title: Private Residence
chapters.content:
"No need to worry." Zhao Xuanyou gently patted Yu Wan's head, his words simple.

Yu Wan, however, fell into silence.

After such intimate contact for so long, she was not entirely without feelings for Zhao Xuanyou.

But the matters of this world were not all solvable by feelings alone.

She knew Zhao Xuanyou was a man she could entrust her life to, but she had no right to entrust her life to him.

Yu Wan had once impersonated Cui Yichu to stay by his side.

She understood better than anyone that his promises, his responsibilities, would only be given to his wife.

Seeing that Yu Wan still did not respond, Zhao Xuanyou said, "Go to sleep early."

Marrying Feng Jiyou was a decision he had made today. He had intended to tell Yu Wan tonight, but seeing her lost in thought, he found it hard to bring it up.

He would wait until the matter with the Xingguo Duke's mansion was resolved.

That night, the two still embraced as they slept, but each was lost in their own thoughts.

The next day was Shen Tongyun's wedding, a joyous occasion. The Jingyuan Marquis's mansion and the Xingguo Duke's mansion had long been at odds, so there was no need to join in the festivities.

Early in the morning, Zhao Xuanyou went to the yamen as usual, while Yu Wan stayed in the room to tidy up.

As she busied herself, Yuan Zi approached: "Before leaving, the master instructed me to take you to the courtyard to have a look and see what's missing, so we can prepare in advance."

"You didn't go with the master?" Yu Wan asked curiously.

Normally, it was Yuan Qing who stayed at the mansion while Yuan Zi accompanied him outside.

"Yuan Qing wouldn't be able to handle the shopping; it's better for me to take care of it."

"Alright."

This time, they would be staying at the courtyard for a longer period, so everything needed to be arranged properly.

Fortunately, it was in the capital, so shopping would be easy.

The courtyard was not far from the Marquis's mansion, but its scale was incomparable to the Marquis's mansion. The grayish facade did not look grand enough; it resembled the residence of a common wealthy family rather than an official's mansion.

Once inside, however, it was a completely different scene.

Although there were only two main courtyards, the place was lush with plants and trees, and rugged rock formations. The corridors and houses were all painted with red lacquer and green pillars, splendid and colorful. Every pavilion and building was exquisitely crafted.

Yu Wan asked in surprise, "Didn't you say this courtyard hasn't been lived in for a long time?"

"The masters indeed haven't lived here for a long time. The Marquis has been away from the capital for ten years, and the young master has also been away for a long time."

"Then why is it so luxurious?"

"This courtyard was part of the Marquis's wife's dowry. The plum tree in the main courtyard was planted the year the Marquis's wife was born. She liked this place very much when she was alive, so the Marquis spent a lot of money to renovate it. Now, this residence is under the young master's name, and he has always sent people to take care of the courtyard."

"I see."

Although the residence was small, it was complete in every aspect. In addition to the two neat courtyards, there was also a pond in the back garden.

Yuan Zi led Yu Wan on a tour before returning to the main courtyard. In the center of the courtyard stood a plum tree with considerable character.

Yu Wan paused for a moment before Yuan Zi said, "Let's go inside and have a look."

"Alright."

Inside the house, Yu Wan could see that it had indeed been uninhabited for a long time.

Although someone had done a simple cleaning, the furniture was sparse, with no curtains, ornaments, or decorations.

"The master only wants to stay here for half a month, so we don't need to bring too many things. We can just pick some things from the mansion's storeroom."

Yuan Zi said, "This is the master's private residence, not part of the Marquis's mansion's property. You can see what needs to be added and make a list for me."

Weren't there only Lady Ye and Zhao Xuanyou in the mansion?

Did they still need to separate public and private property?

Yu Wan was somewhat confused and asked curiously, "Does the master want to add a lot or a little?"

"Well... just see what's missing and add it. The master has plenty of money."

"Oh."

"The flowers and plants in the courtyard, if you want to uproot and replant them, you can change them all."

"The master doesn't like flowers, so we should dig them all up."

The flowers and plants in the courtyard had been growing for more than ten years; it would be a pity to remove them all.

Yuan Zi listened to Yu Wan's words and coughed dryly: "If you think they look good, you don't have to dig them up. The late Marquis's wife liked flowers very much. The master is so filial; he must want this place to still be as flourishing as when the Marquis's wife was alive. Anyway, the master doesn't live here often. For a courtyard, it's best to be elegant and quiet."

It was already splendid and colorful inside and out; it would be difficult to make it elegant and quiet.

"I understand."

Yuan Zi watched Yu Wan look around and slightly let out a breath. This task was really difficult.

They couldn't alert Lady Ye, so they absolutely couldn't use the Marquis's mansion's storeroom.

That was fine, but they also had to hide it from Yu Wan.

The master was really something; if he wanted to give a house, he should just give it directly. If it weren't for his cleverness, Yu Wan would have turned this place into another Honghui Hall.

After walking around for a while, Yu Wan had a plan in mind. Returning to Honghui Hall, she made a list and handed it to Yuan Zi.

Yuan Zi was efficient, and in just three days, the courtyard was redecorated according to Yu Wan's ideas.

After reporting to Zhao Xuanyou, he moved to the courtyard with his servants that very evening.

With Ziyan and Yingxue accompanying them, Yu Wan didn't need to tidy up; she only accompanied Zhao Xuanyou as they slowly walked around the residence.

When they reached the pond, the two sat down in the pavilion.

"Not bad."

Hearing his praise, Yu Wan said, "If the master likes flowers, the main courtyard could be arranged even better."

"Aren't there enough flowers?"

"The main courtyard should add a basin of lotus, plant a few orchids behind the house, and grow some banana trees outside the windows. In the morning, you can see the banana leaves as soon as you push open the window."

Zhao Xuanyou listened to Yu Wan's enthusiastic description, the corners of his mouth slightly curving.

"This place is not bad."

It was just a bit small, but in the future, Yu Wan's mother could live here alone.

Not far from the Marquis's mansion, it would be convenient for Yu Wan to return to her "maiden home."

Once the matter with the Xingguo Duke's mansion was resolved, he and Yu Wan would return to the Marquis's mansion, and then he would have someone move Yu Wan's mother here.

She was always so happy with a little money or rewards; who knew what she would look like then.

Yu Wan was unaware of Zhao Xuanyou's thoughts and simply agreed, "The Marquis's wife liked this residence, so it must be good."

The autumn night was windy, and sitting in the pavilion was too cold.

"Will the master return to the room?" Yu Wan shrank her neck.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up the teacup and poured himself a cup, then said softly, "There is a guest tonight."

"Meeting a guest here?" Without waiting for Zhao Xuanyou's answer, Yu Wan said, "Then I'll go back to the room and bring a few sheer curtains over."

"Have the cook prepare a few dishes."

"Yes."

Yu Wan returned to the main house and, together with Yingxue, found a few sheer curtains and hung them around the pavilion, which indeed blocked a lot of wind.

The cook in the residence was hired separately by Yuan Zi and was quite efficient. Before long, a table of snacks was prepared.

Yuan Zi hurriedly came to report: "Master, the guest has arrived."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. Yu Wan and Yingxue tactfully retreated to the main courtyard.

As they passed through the moon gate, they saw Yuan Qing leading a tall, thin man toward them.

Looking up, it was Pei Ta.

Pei Ta also saw Yu Wan, and a warm, shallow smile appeared on his lips: "Miss Yu Wan, long time no see."

"Lord Pei." Yu Wan quickly greeted him.

Zhao Xuanyou had always said he had important matters to attend to recently, and Yu Wan had not asked much, only vaguely guessing it was about bringing down the Xingguo Duke's mansion.

Seeing Pei Ta coming late at night, it must be to discuss this matter.

Her guess was finally confirmed; her great revenge was about to be achieved. Yu Wan felt a surge of emotion, her beautiful eyes lingering on him.

---

chapters.title: Secret Meeting
chapters.content:
Feeling Yu Wan's gaze, Pei Ta asked in confusion, "Did something happy happen today?"

Happy event, of course, a great joy.

For herself, and even more for her mother.

Cui Yichu had harmed her, and Cui Lingyuan had betrayed her mother. Their entire family deserved retribution.

With her own strength alone, Yu Wan could never bring down the Xingguo Duke's mansion. But now, someone capable of doing so had taken action.

If Yu Wan could witness this before leaving the capital, she would have no regrets.

But these words could not be spoken aloud.

Yu Wan slightly restrained the joy in her brows and cupped her hands to Pei Ta: "Lord Pei's wish is about to come true; this servant is happy for Lord Pei."

Pei Ta smiled, but there was still worry in his brows: "I don't know if it can be achieved in one strike."

Yu Wan said, "Lord Pei and our young master are the smartest people in the world. With you working together, you are sure to succeed swiftly and triumphantly."

"Pei is ashamed; it's all thanks to the young master's efforts." Remembering how he had once asked Yu Wan to act as a messenger, Pei Ta also cupped his hands to her. "Back then, I received a lot of help from Miss Yu Wan. If this succeeds, I will definitely send you a thank-you gift."

"This servant has already received many good things from Lord Pei; please, Lord Pei, do not be so polite."

Pei Ta had given her calligraphy copies, which she practiced every day.

The few books of the Four Books and Five Classics that Zhao Qi had given her, though Yu Wan read them slowly, with Pei Ta's annotations, she no longer found them as incomprehensible as before.

Seeing Yu Wan's grateful gaze, Pei Ta understood what she was referring to.

"Books are not worth much; they only become treasures in the hands of the right person. There's no need to be polite."

"I won't disturb Lord Pei's business any longer." With that, Yu Wan and Yingxue retreated to the side.

After Pei Ta and Yuan Qing had walked far away, Yingxue whispered, "That lord is too handsome, isn't he?"
