"Life in the military is monotonous and harsh. Every day is repetitive drills."

"I am not afraid."

If it were before, Zhao Qi would not have wanted to leave the capital. But if he stayed in the capital, he would never be able to compare to Zhao Xuanyou.

Father Emperor wanted to use Pei Tao, so he arranged for Pei Tao to leave the capital for training.

If he wanted to be useful, leaving the palace was a necessary path.

Moreover, Father Emperor was growing older day by day and could not protect him forever. He could not stay in the palace forever either.

One day, when Zhao Zun ascended the throne, what would he have to rival Zhao Zun with?

Even though he was reluctant to leave Father Emperor, leaving was inevitable.

"Please grant my request, Father Emperor."

The wind stirred the red windows. The emperor looked at Zhao Qi kneeling before him, and his fingers trembled slightly.

Everyone said he doted on his youngest son, and indeed, he was not as strict with Zhao Qi as he was with his other sons.

After all, the crown prince was already chosen, and Zhao Qi had endured the pain of losing his mother. It would be fine for him to live the rest of his life as a carefree and wealthy idle man.

But since he had considered abolishing the crown prince, then the other sons would have opportunities.

If Zhao Qi had such ambition, perhaps he could stand on his own in the future.

"Very well," after a long while, the emperor finally nodded. "Since you are so insistent, I will not stop you. But there is one thing I must make clear in advance."

"Father Emperor, please speak. Your son will certainly obey."

"The southeast is where you want to go. If you return after just ten days or half a month, you will be a deserter. I will order your uncle to punish you according to military law, without mercy."

A deserter?

He would never desert!

"If your son truly becomes a deserter, then punish him according to military law."

The emperor nodded slightly. "The Duke of Ningguo's family celebrations are over. Your uncle will return to the southeast in a few days. You will go with him."

"Ah?" A few days ago, at the Duke of Ningguo's residence, his uncle had said he would return to the military in ten days. If what Father Emperor said was true, then wouldn't he only have a few days left in the capital? "Father Emperor, is this not too hasty?"

It was indeed hasty.

But from the capital to the southeast was hundreds of miles. If Zhao Qi were to go alone, how could the emperor be at ease?

Naturally, it was best for him to go with his uncle.

"Are you reluctant to leave the capital?" the emperor asked in return.

"Of course not." When he returned from Heishui, Zhao Qi had already made up his mind to go to the military for training. Now that he had finally persuaded the emperor to agree, how could he give up?

But his uncle was leaving in a few days. If he went with his uncle, wouldn't he be unable to see Yu Wan before he left?

"Then it is settled. You may withdraw."

The emperor finished speaking and picked up the memorial in his hand again.

"Your son takes his leave."

Even though Zhao Qi had gotten his wish, his steps were not light.

Fifth Brother had gone to the Mingchui Guard and would not be able to return to the capital for nearly two years. If he went to the southeast, wouldn't he also be unable to see her for years?

Whatever, he was leaving anyway!

---

chapters.title: Holding Hands
chapters.content:
"The things on the table were brought over by Chen Da Niu. He said they were from your friend."

As soon as Yu Wan entered the room, Ding Wenxi spoke.

Sensing that her mother's gaze was somewhat strange, Yu Wan did not respond. She only smiled and said, "Mother, all the things you asked for have been bought. See if anything is missing."

Ding Wenxi had been resting for nearly a month. Although she still could not walk on her own, her spirits had improved a lot.

Seeing that she was deep in thought, Yu Wan asked if she wanted to read some storybooks to pass the time.

Ding Wenxi found sitting idly on the bed indeed boring, so she asked Yu Wan to buy some paper and brushes.

"You have bought so much. There must be nothing missing."

Yu Wan put the things down. Seeing Ding Wenxi staring at her, she had to look at the brocade box on the table.

Such a fine box did not seem like something Chen Da Niu would have.

Opening the box, Yu Wan was first stunned, then overjoyed.

Inside the brocade box were actually the architectural drawings of the Xingguo Duke's residence.

The ink on the drawings was fresh, clearly newly drawn by Pei Tao.

He had really done it!

That night, although he had agreed, Yu Wan had not held much hope.

First, he had drunk too much and was very drunk. It was possible he would forget after sobering up.

Second, Pei Tao was different from Zhao Xuanyou. He was a man of integrity and always did things by the book. Yu Wan's request was rather improper for him.

But unexpectedly, he had kept his word and sent the architectural drawings.

Yu Wan happily flipped through the drawings in the brocade box, almost able to imagine Pei Tao frowning as he drew them.

"Girl, what do you want with these?" Ding Wenxi's voice pulled Yu Wan back from her thoughts. She composed herself and closed the brocade box.

"Mother, you have seen them?"

"I did not mean to pry into your things. It was just that when Chen Da Niu brought the box over, he could not explain who gave it to you. I was worried there might be a problem, so I took a look."

Ding Wenxi did not understand architectural drawings, but she recognized the prominent characters "Xingguo Duke's Residence" on the drawings.

Yu Wan already knew her own identity. Obtaining these was clearly not without purpose.

"What are you thinking?" Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Wan in confusion. "Last time, you said you did not want to acknowledge your ancestry, didn't you?"

"I do not want to acknowledge my ancestry," Yu Wan realized her mother had misunderstood and quickly sat down by the bed. "These drawings are not for me. They are for the Heir."

Ding Wenxi was clearly not easily fooled.

"If they are for the Heir, why would someone deliver them to Chen Da Niu?"

"Because the Heir does not want others to know he has them. He wants to keep it secret. Mother, I cannot even understand architectural drawings. Why would I want such things?"

That was true.

Earlier, Ding Wenxi had flipped through them and indeed could not understand much.

Although Yu Wan was clever, she had only learned to recognize some characters from her. How could she possibly understand construction?

However, since the Heir had secretly obtained these drawings, the matter was more complicated.

"Does the Jingyuan Marquis's residence have dealings with the Xingguo Duke's residence?"

Seeing that her mother was so perceptive, Yu Wan said, "In the capital, these noble families are all connected by marriage. Naturally, there are dealings. Mother, do not worry. I am just a maidservant. I will not be involved in these matters."

"You truly do not want the identity of a young lady from your own duke's residence? If you reclaim your identity, you will not have to serve as a maidservant in the marquis's residence."

Although a child born out of wedlock was not as precious as a daughter raised in the residence, as long as the duke's residence acknowledged her and recorded her in the family genealogy, she would still be a legitimate young lady.

"Daughter has said it many times. I do not care. Besides, being a maidservant is only temporary. When we leave the capital in the future..."

Yu Wan's words were cut short as a commotion came from the corridor. It seemed Chen Da Niu was trying to stop someone.

Amid the noise, someone was loudly calling out, "Yu Wan."

Yu Wan tucked the blanket around Ding Wenxi and was about to get up when the room door was pushed open. Zhao Qi came rushing in.

"Prince... Seventh Young Master, why have you come?" Yu Wan knew Zhao Qi's temperament. When he was stubborn, he could not be stopped. She said to Chen Da Niu with a sigh, "Take Yinpao downstairs for tea."

After they left, Yu Wan brought him inside.

Finally seeing Yu Wan, Zhao Qi's emotions calmed down a lot. Noticing Ding Wenxi looking at him, he politely greeted her, "Madam."

"I am not any madam. I am just a commoner. There is no need for such courtesy, Young Master."

Ding Wenxi said this, but her gaze fell on the jade pendant hanging from Zhao Qi's waist, and her complexion suddenly turned pale.

If Zhao Qi's fine brocade robe could be a royal bestowal, the jade pendant, in terms of both quality and size, was definitely not something a commoner could possess.

Thinking this, she took another look at Zhao Qi's plain-looking cyan robe. The collar and cuffs were embroidered with intricate patterns in the same color, a masterpiece only the needlework artisans of the imperial workshop could produce.

Was Zhao Qi from the palace?

Such attire suggested he was a prince.

Ding Wenxi's face changed greatly, and she looked at Yu Wan in shock.

Yu Wan knew her mother had guessed the truth. She could only vaguely comfort her, "Mother, please rest assured. Do not overthink. I will take the Seventh Young Master downstairs to sit for a while."

Seeing that her mother was emotionally unstable, Yu Wan quickly took Zhao Qi's hand and pulled him out.

Zhao Qi had actually noticed Ding Wenxi's strange gaze. Normally, he would have asked for clarification, but the cold hand was suddenly held by Yu Wan's warm palm. He felt a moment of daze.

Her hand was not large, but it was warm and soft. Being held by such a hand made him feel at ease.

Of course, there was also a hint of nervousness and tension.

"You... why are you running..." Zhao Qi asked dryly, clearly feeling his cheeks heating up.

Yu Wan did not answer. She simply held his hand and kept walking.

When they finally stopped, they were already standing in the backyard of the Taoran Inn.

Yu Wan let go of his hand and said with some exasperation, "Your Highness, why did you suddenly come running over?"

"Ah? I... I..." Zhao Qi's fair face flushed slightly, as if he had run too fast and was out of breath. He coughed lightly a few times, turned his face away, and only when he felt his emotions had settled did he look back at Yu Wan. "I passed by, so I came up to take a look. Is that not allowed?"

"It is not that it is not allowed. Your Highness saw for yourself. My mother is easily frightened and cannot see outsiders."

Ding Wenxi's complexion had indeed been very poor just now. Zhao Qi said, "She has seen me before. Is she that afraid of me?"

"She is recovering from a serious illness and often has nightmares. If Your Highness comes again next time, please inform me first."

Hearing this, Zhao Qi snapped out of his earlier thoughts and remembered the purpose of his visit today.

He glanced at Yu Wan and said sullenly, "There will not be a next time."

chapters.title: Extraordinary Measures
chapters.content:
Yu Ying noticed his expression was somewhat odd, as if there was more to his words.

But she had no time to ask now, so she vaguely replied, "I'm not unhappy that Your Highness came. I'll go tell my mother and come back later."

Zhao Qi pouted and reluctantly nodded. Yu Ying turned and headed toward the inn's inner room.

Once inside, she indeed saw Ding Wenxi sitting tensely on the couch.

"Mother," Yu Ying closed the door and walked to Ding Wenxi’s side, softly saying, "The person who just came isn’t the seventh young master of Ningguo Duke’s mansion, but the seventh prince from the palace. I didn’t mean to hide it from you; I was just afraid you’d worry."

"I’m not blaming you for hiding it, but he’s from the palace, and I…"

"I know, I know. But he’s still young. He doesn’t know you, and probably doesn’t recognize the former empress either," Yu Ying held Ding Wenxi’s hand, gently comforting her. "There won’t be any trouble. I know what I’m doing."

"I’m just afraid I’ll drag you down."

"Don’t talk nonsense. Without you, where would I be?"

Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Ying, a trace of sorrow rising in her eyes. "Actually, if you regained your identity as a Cui family girl, it might not be impossible with the heir. Yu Ying, wouldn’t you want to try?"

Cui Lingyuan was a man who valued family ties. If he knew Yu Ying was his own flesh and blood, he would surely acknowledge her.

As long as Yu Ying lived well, even if mother and daughter could never meet again in this life, Ding Wenxi would have no regrets.

"How could I let you leave alone? We agreed on this. Don’t bring it up again."

Ding Wenxi had no choice but to drop the subject of the Cui family and instead asked, "You work at the marquis’s mansion. How did the seventh prince become so familiar with you?"

"His Highness the heir is unmatched in martial arts. The emperor ordered him to instruct the seventh prince in combat. Before, he used to come see the heir every day. Over time, I just got to know him."

Ding Wenxi had seen Zhao Qi twice. Though they hadn’t exchanged many words, she had glimpsed Zhao Qi’s attitude toward Yu Ying.

Looking at Yu Ying’s graceful and charming features, Ding Wenxi said, "I see he treats you very well. Do you have any idea what this means?"

It wasn’t just that he was good to Yu Ying; even she had benefited from his generosity, receiving so many precious tonics.

Yu Ying understood her implication. "What idea? Mother, you’re overthinking. The seventh prince is still just a child."

"You’re still a child too."

"Yes, yes," Yu Ying laughed, throwing herself into Ding Wenxi’s arms and coyly saying, "In front of you, I’ll always be a child."

Ding Wenxi gently stroked Yu Ying’s head, her heart growing heavier.

It was a pity that as a mother, she was useless; her daughter had to worry and arrange everything.

"You’ve grown more independent now. There are many things I can’t help you with. Just… be careful in what you do."

Mother and daughter enjoyed a brief moment of familial warmth before Yu Ying lifted her head and asked, "Mother, do you really think the seventh prince treats me differently?"

Seeing the clear, thoughtful look in Yu Ying’s eyes, Ding Wenxi said, "In this world, no one is inexplicably kind to someone else, especially a man to a woman."

Ding Wenxi was also a great beauty and understood how far a man would go to please a woman.

The marquis’s heir had given her a place to stay because he liked Yu Ying.

And the seventh prince, who had lowered himself to come here and respectfully address her as "Madame," was naturally doing it for Yu Ying’s sake.

"He is indeed young, but the way he treats you doesn’t seem like a master to a servant."

"Originally, he wasn’t my master."

Though Yu Ying said this, her heart was stirred.

She had always been respectful to Zhao Qi, of course, because of his royal status.

But thinking back, a prince like him coming to seek out a mere servant girl from the marquis’s mansion clearly didn’t treat her like anyone else.

But did Zhao Qi like her?

Not necessarily in a romantic way.

But… as her thoughts raced, Yu Ying took a deep breath and smiled at Ding Wenxi. "Your Highness is still waiting for me at the inn. Let me go see what he wants."

"Go on then. Bring those storybooks over for me."

"Mmm. Mother, read for now. If I don’t come back today, I’ll see you first thing tomorrow morning."

"You have your duties. Don’t worry about me."

Yu Ying did as she was told, bringing the storybooks over and arranging some snacks by the couch before heading downstairs to find Zhao Qi.

Zhao Qi was still standing where they had parted, but his expression was heavy, lost in thought.

"Your Highness." Yu Ying walked up to him, shaking the oil-paper package in her hand.

On her way back upstairs, she had remembered buying Zhao Qi’s favorite pine pollen cakes today and brought them over.

Zhao Qi looked at the steaming pastries, his gaze softening as he picked one up and ate it silently.

Yu Ying smiled as she watched him.

The young man was handsome and elegant, with a touch of youthful innocence, making him all the more pure and guileless.

Yu Ying couldn’t help but recall the incident at the Heishui County yamen. At that time, he had thought the crown prince was harassing her and had flown into a rage at the crown prince.

Back then, Yu Ying had thought he was like Zhao Xuanyou; simply unable to tolerate the crown prince’s behavior, which was why he repeatedly offended him.

Now, thinking back, his impulsive actions might have had something to do with her.

Yu Ying, of course, had no romantic feelings for Zhao Qi.

But with Pei Ta and Zhao Xuanyou’s plans having failed, she needed to take extraordinary measures to exact her revenge before leaving the capital.

Zhao Qi was young, but he was a prince. Not only did he have the emperor’s favor and the support of the Duke of Ningguo, but he also had dozens of experts like Yin Ping and Mu Di under his command. Even the crown prince had to show him some restraint.

If she could borrow Zhao Qi’s power…

Yu Ying made up her mind in an instant and smiled at Zhao Qi. "Is it good?"

This chapter is not yet finished. Please click to the next page to continue reading the following exciting content!

"It’s alright, I guess." Zhao Qi feigned indifference as usual.

"If Your Highness isn’t angry anymore, will you still come find me to play in the future?"

At the mention of this, Zhao Qi lowered his gaze again.

"What I said earlier wasn’t just in anger."

Not in anger?

Yu Ying looked at him in confusion. "Then…"

Zhao Qi pressed his lips together, hesitated for a moment, then looked at Yu Ying.

"Father Emperor has ordered me to follow my uncle to the military for training. In four days, I’ll have to set off with him."

"Your Highness is leaving the capital?" Yu Ying was indeed surprised. "Leaving in just four days? That’s too sudden."

They were standing close, and Zhao Qi could see the slight tremble of her long lashes. The corners of her eyes and brows seemed to carry a spring breeze, gentle and moving, charming and touching.

He had known Yu Ying for a while, but this was the first time he clearly realized how beautiful she was.

Zhao Qi couldn’t bear to look away, and the thought of leaving the capital became even more unbearable.

"It is a bit sudden, but Father Emperor has already decided. I can’t disobey."

"So… Your Highness came today to say goodbye?"

More or less.

Zhao Qi hummed in agreement, his demeanor a far cry from his usual arrogant and unrestrained self.

He felt like he had a lot of words bottled up in his chest, unable to express them, which weighed heavily on him.

"Since Your Highness is leaving the capital, how about I accompany you for a good tour of the city today?" Yu Ying looked up and smiled.

"Really?" Zhao Qi’s heart began to race, looking at her with some uncertainty. "Won’t you need to take care of your mother? Or return to the mansion for your duties?"

Originally, he had rushed to the inn just to say goodbye to her.

Yu Ying raised her hand to smooth the braid hanging over her shoulder and tilted her head with a smile.

"Of course."

---

chapters.title: On the City Wall
chapters.content:
Yu Ying and Zhao Qi left the inn and walked along the street, buying whatever caught their interest and stopping at teahouses to rest when they grew tired. Though they didn’t indulge in the reckless abandon of drunken revelry, they still managed to steal half a day of leisure.

By the time evening fell, Yu Ying’s legs were growing weak.

"Your Highness, I can’t walk anymore."

"Do you want to go back then?" Thinking of his impending departure from the capital, Zhao Qi felt a pang of sadness.

After a day of touring the city, he was tired too.

But he truly didn’t want to part ways.

Yu Ying softly asked, "Is there anywhere else Your Highness would like to go? If it’s not too far, I’ll go with you."

Zhao Qi didn’t have anywhere specific in mind. He just didn’t want the day to end.

"I… is there anywhere you’d like to go? I’ll take you."

"I do have a place in mind." Following Zhao Qi’s words, Yu Ying thought seriously for a moment. "Last time when we returned to the capital together, I stood in front of the palace gates looking at the majestic imperial palace, wondering what it looked like inside. Although I’ve been to the temporary palace, I’ve never been to the imperial palace. I don’t know if I’ll ever get the chance to go in and see it."

"It’s too late today; entering the palace probably won’t work. Let me think… tomorrow won’t work either. I have to go inspect the troops with my uncle the day after tomorrow…"

By now, the palace gates were almost locked. Forget taking Yu Ying into the palace; even Zhao Qi himself wouldn’t be able to enter much later.

"Your Highness, don’t worry. I was just saying it in passing. There are many places in the capital I haven’t been to."

Zhao Qi considered her words. "Actually, standing on the palace gate and looking down is similar to standing on the city wall. Though we can’t enter the palace now, I can take you to the city wall."

"The city wall?" Yu Ying was genuinely interested. "Can I go?"

"Of course."

Though he couldn’t freely take Yu Ying in and out of the imperial palace, as a prince, taking her to the city wall for a short visit posed no problem.

With that decided, the two headed toward the nearest city gate tower.

As expected, once Zhao Qi revealed his identity, the guards immediately let them pass, escorting them up to the city wall.

Upon hearing that the seventh prince had arrived, the commander of the city guard soon hurried over. Zhao Qi, unwilling to engage, dismissed him with a few words and remained with Yu Ying.

Outside the city wall was the moat, and inside was the sea of lights from the capital’s countless homes.

Yu Ying stood at the battlement, gazing at the dazzling streets below, unconsciously entranced.

"Standing high up, the view is indeed different."

Zhao Qi followed her gaze outward, but after a moment, he turned to look at her back.

"If you like it, then in the future, I… when I return to the capital, I can bring you here often. Every Lantern Festival, you can even see fireworks from here."

As he said this, Zhao Qi’s voice trembled slightly.

This wasn’t his usual tone, nor was it something he would normally say.

If Yu Ying hadn’t been facing away from him, he wouldn’t have been able to say these words no matter what.

Yu Ying heard him and her gaze flickered slightly.

She turned around, leaning against the city wall, and smiled. "That must be very beautiful."

"It… is very beautiful." Zhao Qi’s eyes were fixed firmly on her face.

Behind her was the entire capital, glowing with light, the interplay of shadows and lanterns. The night breeze stirred her hair, and her face, illuminated by the splendid night scene, was truly more captivating than any Lantern Festival fireworks Zhao Qi had ever seen.

"I wonder if I’ll be lucky enough to see it." Yu Ying softly sighed.

"Of course you will." Zhao Qi quickly replied. "It’ll just take two or three years."

He had just pledged to the emperor to go to the southeast and couldn’t abandon the mission halfway.

"Then I’ll wait to enjoy that privilege through Your Highness." Yu Ying said, turning back around and leaning on the battlement to overlook the capital’s night view.

Zhao Qi didn’t know what to say. Imitating her, he leaned beside her on the city wall.

"You see, that’s the imperial palace."

The imperial palace was located in the center of the capital. The towering imperial city was the most prominent and easiest to recognize.

"I wonder where the marquis’s mansion is?"

Zhao Qi pondered for a moment, then pointed east. "It should be over there. Further back is the Duke of Ningguo’s mansion."

"Oh."

Zhao Qi couldn’t help but turn his head to look at her again.

"Are you happy at the marquis’s mansion? I mean, does Zhao Xuanyou treat you well?"

"I’m just working there. As long as I get my monthly pay, there’s nothing to be happy or unhappy about."

"Then… if you left the marquis’s mansion, you wouldn’t be unhappy, right?" Zhao Qi probed.

Leaving the marquis’s mansion… Yu Ying did want to leave.

But before she left, she had to take her revenge.

She stole a glance at Zhao Qi, her eyes holding a hint of reluctance.

If her mother’s earlier words had only made her suspicious, everything Zhao Qi had said to her tonight had confirmed her mother’s guess.

Zhao Qi must have some feelings for her.

Yu Ying was too weak. With her strength alone, she was no match for the Duke of Xingguo’s mansion. To take revenge, she had to borrow strength.

She didn’t want to deceive Zhao Qi’s feelings; she only wanted to borrow a little of his power.

"I do want to leave the marquis’s mansion, but…"

"Really?" Zhao Qi, hearing the first part of her sentence, suddenly grabbed Yu Ying’s hand. "You want to leave the marquis’s mansion?"

Yu Ying winced from his grip and softly said, "The marquis’s mansion was never my home. I was always going to leave eventually. It’s just that I can’t right now."

"Is Zhao Xuanyou not letting you go?" Zhao Qi pressed.

"Not exactly."

This answer truly surprised Zhao Qi.

"You mean, even after you wanted to leave, Zhao Xuanyou was willing to let you go? Then why… why haven’t you left?"

"Back then, when Cui Shi was at the marquis’s mansion, she did many evil things. She couldn’t stand me and hated me deeply."

Zhao Qi frowned. "You mean Cui Yichu? She hates you?"

Yu Ying nodded, her clear eyes showing a hint of sorrow.

"Doesn’t Your Highness think that Cui Yichu and I look somewhat alike?"

"You do look a bit alike, but after knowing you for a while, I don’t think so anymore. Didn’t she and Zhao Xuanyou separate? What does that have to do with you?"

Yu Ying and Cui Yichu had completely different temperaments and auras. When he was with Yu Ying, he never thought they were related in any way.

"A servant girl who looks like her mistress would naturally displease the mistress. I just didn’t expect her to hate me so much that even after leaving the marquis’s mansion, she still wants to kill me."

"What? She wants to kill you? When did this happen?" Zhao Qi was almost enraged.

"Right after Your Highness and I returned from Lichuan. Her accomplice in the marquis’s mansion attacked me with an axe. Though His Highness the heir removed all her pieces in the mansion, Cui Yichu is still alive. Now, my mother is confined to the inn to avoid trouble, and if I leave the protection of the marquis’s mansion, she will surely strike again."

"Don’t be afraid. I’ll find a way to make sure she can’t hurt you again."

Yu Ying sighed softly. "But isn’t Your Highness leaving the capital soon?"

"I… I’ll find a way to get rid of that wicked woman first."

"No," Yu Ying looked steadily at Zhao Qi, her eyes flickering slightly. "I want Your Highness to help me with something."

chapters.title: I Promise You
chapters.content:
"I promise."

Before Yu Yuan could even ask for his help, Zhao Qi had already agreed without hesitation.

After all, the young man was full of sincerity, and Yu Yuan naturally believed in his intentions.

"Your Highness, can you leave a guard behind in the capital to protect me?"

Yu Yuan didn’t doubt his sincerity, but she couldn’t possibly let Zhao Qi kill Cui Yichu.

If he wanted to kill, he could certainly do it, but if it were that simple, Zhao Xuanyou would have already taken action.

Although the Gongzhu case had implicated Tao Cheng, the brother-in-law of the Duke of Xingguo, the Duke of Xingguo’s family remained unscathed and still held considerable power. Moreover, they were colluding with powerful officials like Sun Congdao. If a daughter suddenly died at home, how could they not investigate?

This was the capital, right under the Emperor’s nose. Even the slightest disturbance would alert him.

Furthermore, the Court of Judicial Review, the Ministry of Justice, and the Brocade Guards were filled with talented and extraordinary individuals. Someone would inevitably uncover the clues.

The Duke of Ningguo and the Duke of Xingguo were still related by marriage. Once Zhao Qi calmed down, he would never act so recklessly.

"Protect you?" Zhao Qi was somewhat surprised.

What Yu Yuan asked of him was not difficult.

He had more than twenty guards under his command, each with skills comparable to Yin Ping and Mu Di. Since he was going to the military for training, he couldn’t take all of them with him.

But...

"I can leave several for you. But if my guards follow you to the Marquis’s residence, would Zhao Xuanyou agree?"

"They don’t need to enter the Marquis’s residence." Yu Yuan had already decided to leave with her mother. Since she was asking for Zhao Qi’s help, she naturally couldn’t keep everything hidden. She could even reveal a bit more. "I was already planning to leave. As long as they stay in the capital to help me, it will be fine."

"Leave?" Zhao Qi’s heart began to race wildly, and he looked at Yu Yuan in shock, urgently asking, "You want to leave Zhao Xuanyou? Really? You’re not lying to me?"

The night wind on the city wall was fierce, tousling Yu Yuan’s hair.

She casually smoothed her loose strands and calmly said, "Of course I’m not lying to you."

"But... Zhao Xuanyou treats you..." After hesitating for a moment, Zhao Qi still asked, "...isn’t he treating you well?"

Yu Yuan didn’t answer whether Zhao Xuanyou treated her well or not. She only said, "Although the blood clot in my mother’s head has been removed, I don’t know why her mind remains unstable. She is always frightened, anxious, and uneasy."

Zhao Qi had visited Taoran Inn twice and had seen Ding Wenxi twice.

Every time, before he could even speak, Ding Wenxi would look as if she had seen a ghost, her expression changing drastically.

"So what do you plan to do?"

"My mother is used to living in the village. She doesn’t want to stay in the capital for even a day longer. I can only take her away as soon as possible."

Zhao Qi stared at her intently. "Where will you go?"

"I haven’t decided yet. But we’ll find a quiet and beautiful place."

"Will Zhao Xuanyou let you go?" Zhao Qi’s mind flashed back to the scene by the lake where he had seen Zhao Xuanyou holding her, kissing her so fiercely, as if he wanted to devour her. How could he possibly agree to let her leave?

Yu Yuan’s smile was faint.

From what she knew of Zhao Xuanyou, he naturally wouldn’t let her go.

"I know he won’t agree, so we have to do it without his knowledge. If I don’t have help by my side, I won’t be able to leave quietly."

"But he won’t bear to part with you. Can you?"

"Eventually, the Young Master will marry and take concubines. Once there are new people by his side, there naturally won’t be a place for a little maid like me."

Zhao Qi frowned slightly. "What’s wrong with being a maid? Even a maid can be an important person."

"Is Your Highness advising me to stay in the Marquis’s residence?" Yu Yuan blinked.

"Of course not." Zhao Qi was just speaking from his heart. Hearing that Yu Yuan wanted to leave Zhao Xuanyou, his heart was about to leap out of his chest with joy. He eagerly said to Yu Yuan, "I understand. I’ll have Yin Ping and Mu Di stay in the capital to help you."

"No. Those two are your right-hand men. Since you’re going to the military, it’s better for them to stay by your side."

Moreover, everyone knew that Yin Ping and Mu Di were Zhao Qi’s trusted aides. If they stayed in the capital after Zhao Qi left, they would surely attract attention.

"Then I’ll think about it."

Yu Yuan nodded and gratefully smiled at Zhao Qi. "That’s fine. Someone with skills like Yin Ping would be enough. Also..."

Seeing that Yu Yuan was hesitating, Zhao Qi asked, "What else?"

"Regardless of what I order them to do, they must obey? Can that be arranged?" Yu Yuan looked at Zhao Qi cautiously.

After saying so much, this was her true intention.

Yu Yuan wanted Zhao Qi’s men not just for self-protection.

She had the construction plans of the Duke of Xingguo’s residence, but having just the plans wasn’t enough.

She didn’t have the ability to scale walls and walk on rooftops.

Faced with her pitiful pleading gaze, Zhao Qi’s heart softened, and he naturally said, "Of course."

But after agreeing, Zhao Qi became a little unsure. "Besides leaving the capital, what else do you want to do?"

"Of course, to deal with Cui Yichu." Yu Yuan smiled. "But don’t worry, I won’t have them kill anyone."

"That kind of poisonous woman deserves to die." Just thinking about how Cui Yichu had sent someone to harm Yu Yuan made Zhao Qi furious.

"I’ll be careful. The Duke of Xingguo and the Duke of Ningguo are related by marriage. I won’t cause trouble for Your Highness."

Zhao Qi hadn’t thought of this before. Hearing Yu Yuan say this, he remembered that his cousin Shen Tongyun had just married the eldest son of the Duke of Xingguo.

"I don’t care, as long as it doesn’t harm my cousin." Zhao Qi thought for a moment and softly said, "Bingyun and Yangquan; you’ve seen them both at Heishui. They can stay in the capital to assist you."

Yu Yuan had indeed seen them. Although she wasn’t as familiar with them as she was with Yin Ping and Mu Di, she recognized them.

"There’s also a Yunlai Inn next to Taoran Inn. Your Highness can have them stay there, and I’ll go find them when I need something."

"Mmm." Hearing that Yu Yuan had already thought about how to contact his men, Zhao Qi realized that her idea of leaving the Marquis’s residence was not a spur-of-the-moment decision but something she had been planning for a long time. His mood became even lighter.

She didn’t like Zhao Xuanyou.

"Thank you, Your Highness."

Yu Yuan curved her lips, and her beautiful eyes sparkled with a soft, enchanting light.

That gaze was more intoxicating than wine.

Zhao Qi didn’t dare to look directly into her eyes, afraid he might change his mind and stay in the capital. He could only stare intently at the distant, bustling streets.

"Have you already decided where to take your mother?"

"I want to go south. Jiangnan is the place most beloved by scholars and poets throughout the ages. I want to take my mother to see it, to walk through the bluestone alleys and ride on a black-awning boat."

"I’ve been to Yangzhou. The scenery there is indeed beautiful. How about you go to Yangzhou first?"

This time, Zhao Qi was going to the southeast. Although it was still some distance from Yangzhou, it was much closer than the capital.

If he had free time, perhaps he could even visit Yangzhou.

He also wanted to walk through the bluestone alleys with her and ride on a black-awning boat together.

His father, the Emperor, had said he would bestow a principality on him next year. His father had always doted on him, so perhaps he could petition his father to include Yangzhou in his fief.

The more Zhao Qi thought about it, the more feasible it seemed. He immediately made a decision.

"When I pass through Yangzhou this time, I’ll find a place for you to stay. When you leave the capital, you can go to Yangzhou."

---

chapters.title: A Sticky Plaster
chapters.content:
"Yangzhou?" Yu Yuan had never considered going to Yangzhou, but seeing Zhao Qi so enthusiastic, she simply said, "I’ll think about it. If I really go to Yangzhou, I’ll have Bingyun and the others inform Your Highness."

She couldn’t dampen his spirits now, but she also didn’t want to lie to him, so she spoke vaguely.

"Mmm, if you prefer Suzhou or Hangzhou, you can go there too. Although I haven’t been, I imagine they’re also very nice."

Zhao Qi didn’t notice the hesitation in Yu Yuan’s tone at all. He just looked at her with pure joy.

Originally, he had come to see Yu Yuan because their parting was near, and he felt a pang of sadness.

Who would have thought that Yu Yuan would tell him such big news?

Thinking that she had come to him for help in leaving Zhao Xuanyou, Zhao Qi felt as if he were in a dream.

"Do whatever you need to do. They’ll do it. Don’t worry about anything. If you run into trouble, have them send me a message."

"Your Highness is too loyal." Yu Yuan glanced at Zhao Qi and softly said, "I seem like someone who only takes advantage of friends and never gives anything in return."

Zhao Qi’s gaze darkened slightly when he heard the words "loyalty."

It wasn’t surprising.

He knew Yu Yuan had always treated him like a child, like a friend. In her heart, he didn’t even have the qualifications to compare with Zhao Xuanyou.

But it was fine. After all, she was going to leave Zhao Xuanyou. By the time he returned from his training in the southeast, he wouldn’t be a child anymore.

"Who said you have to return the favor? Just remember that you have me as a friend."

"How could I forget Your Highness?"

At a time when Yu Yuan needed help the most, Zhao Qi was willing to give her two of his men. It was like receiving charcoal in the snow.

If she were alone, Yu Yuan would have no way to escape from under Zhao Xuanyou’s nose with her mother.

I won’t forget you either.

Zhao Qi looked at her, his eyes filled with deep emotion, but he didn’t have the courage to say those words aloud.

The autumn night wind was particularly cold. Yu Yuan couldn’t help but sneeze.

"Are you cold?"

Yu Yuan rubbed her hands. "Your Highness, it’s too late now. Let’s go back."

When she left Taoran Inn, Yu Yuan had the manager, Li, send a message to Zhao Xuanyou saying she would be back late.

But now it was already very late.

If she didn’t return soon, who knew what kind of face Zhao Xuanyou would show.

"Alright."

It was indeed late. Even though Zhao Qi was reluctant, he had to nod.

After descending from the city wall, Yin Ping had already prepared the carriage.

"Will Your Highness stay at the Duke of Ningguo’s residence tonight?"

"Mmm, I’ll take you back to the Marquis’s residence first." The palace gates had long been locked, so Zhao Qi could only go to the Duke of Ningguo’s residence.

Yu Yuan said, "The Young Master has been staying at the separate courtyard these days. Your Highness, return to the Duke of Ningguo’s residence first, then have Yin Ping take me back."

Zhao Qi naturally refused, and Yu Yuan had no choice but to let him have his way.

As they neared the separate courtyard, Yu Yuan reminded him, "What we talked about tonight, Your Highness must not tell a third person."

"Who could I tell?"

Yu Yuan was afraid he wouldn’t be careful enough, so she made it clear, "The people in the palace, the people in the Duke of Ningguo’s residence, and my Young Master."

"I know."

Zhao Xuanyou aside, if his father, the Emperor, and his maternal grandfather knew about Yu Yuan’s existence, they probably wouldn’t be happy. He certainly wouldn’t let them know and have them meddle in her affairs.

Anyway, she was going to leave Zhao Xuanyou.

In a couple of years... after he was enfeoffed, he could move to his fief. Far from the Emperor’s reach, his father couldn’t control him, and his grandfather even less so.

"I understand."

The carriage soon stopped at the gate of the separate courtyard. Yu Yuan got out, and someone quickly opened the door for her.

Only after watching her enter the residence did Zhao Qi order Yin Ping to drive away.

"You’ve returned quite late today." Yuan Qian had been ordered to wait for Yu Yuan at the gate. He truly hadn’t expected her to come back at this hour.

Yu Yuan said, "There was a reason."

"You can explain it to the Young Master yourself."

"Has the Young Master already retired for the night?"

Yuan Qian gave Yu Yuan a look, letting her figure it out for herself.

As they neared the main courtyard, Yuan Qian suddenly said, "Today, the Young Lady from the maternal side came over. She even had dinner at the separate courtyard before leaving."

Yu Yuan felt there was more to Yuan Qian’s words, but when she tried to get him to say more, he refused.

The main courtyard was lit with lamps. Yu Yuan entered the room, and Zhao Xuanyou, who was sitting by the desk, looked up at her.

"Young Master." Yu Yuan respectfully walked over to him.

The candlelight on the desk flickered gently in the breeze. Zhao Xuanyou put down the book in his hand and looked at her with raised eyebrows.

"Who is the master of this house?"

He was being sarcastic.

Yu Yuan pretended not to understand and smiled. "Naturally, it’s you."

Zhao Xuanyou coldly "hmphed" and looked at her with a very dark expression. "Whose maid runs out every day?"

Normally, although Yu Yuan went to Taoran Inn every day, she only did so after finishing her tasks in the courtyard and always returned before Zhao Xuanyou finished his duties.

But now it was already the Hai hour (around 9-11 PM), which was indeed very late.

Yu Yuan had no choice but to explain, "The Seventh Prince said he would soon be going to the southeast for training with the Duke of Ningguo’s heir, so he asked me to spend the day with him in the capital, which is why I was delayed."

"Is he a prince? Does he lack people to keep him company?" Zhao Xuanyou’s expression stiffened, and he coldly laughed.

Previously, he hadn’t noticed anything, but now that he thought about it, Zhao Qi was sticking to Yu Yuan a bit too much.

Even though he was still a boy, the way he chased after Yu Yuan every day was clearly problematic.

Zhao Xuanyou felt a surge of frustration.

Originally, he hadn’t wanted to teach Zhao Qi martial arts, but Zhao Qi had clung to Yu Yuan like a sticky plaster.

Yu Yuan was afraid Zhao Xuanyou would see through her, so she shifted the blame to Zhao Qi. "I’m just a maid. If he comes to find me, I can’t exactly chase him away."

Zhao Xuanyou’s sword-like eyebrows knitted slightly. "Is it that you can’t, or you don’t want to?"

Yu Yuan walked behind Zhao Xuanyou and, in a flattering manner, began to massage his shoulders. "It won’t happen again. The Seventh Prince is about to leave the capital. This is the only time."

Zhao Xuanyou, however, knitted his brows.

That morning, when he had encountered Zhao Qi at the imperial study, Zhao Qi had looked completely indifferent. How come he suddenly decided to go to the military for training?

But he also knew that Yu Yuan wouldn’t lie to him.

In any case, Zhao Qi would be leaving soon, so it wasn’t worth worrying about.

Seeing that he wasn’t speaking anymore, Yu Yuan knew she had gotten through the day and continued to diligently massage his shoulders.

But accidentally, her fingers touched his neck.

"Why are your hands so cold?" Zhao Xuanyou frowned and raised his hand to grab her wrist, pulling her into his embrace.

This way, he realized that not only were her fingers cold, but her face and neck were as well.

"Where have you been?"

After standing on the city wall and being blown by the cold wind all evening, his embrace was indeed warm.

Yu Yuan couldn’t help but snuggle into his arms, but she could only lie to him. "We were just strolling through the streets and bought a lot of things. But once night fell, it got really cold on the streets."

As she spoke, she actually sneezed.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her coldly, as if mocking her for bringing this upon herself.

Yu Yuan smiled and reached for the handkerchief at his waist.

But before she could use it, she noticed that the handkerchief wasn’t his usual one.

Upon unfolding it, she saw that the embroidery of bamboo on the handkerchief was exquisite, but it wasn’t made by Yingxue.

Her gaze flickered, and she softly asked, "When did you get this new handkerchief?"

chapters.title: She Cares
chapters.content:
Warm and soft in his embrace, Zhao Xuanyou's heart was in turmoil.

"From my cousin."

Since it was something Feng Jirou had given him, Yu Ying naturally wouldn't use it.

She folded the handkerchief neatly and carefully placed it on the desk.

"So Cousin Feng was here today."

Zhao Xuanyou lightly hummed in agreement. "Today, the estate sent fresh produce to the Marquis's residence, and she brought some over."

Yu Ying detected his intention to explain, a faint smile in her eyes, but she said nothing.

She was just a concubine; what right did she have to inquire about Zhao Xuanyou and Feng Jirou's affairs?

"It's already so late. I'll go check on the hot water and help you wash up and rest early."

As she spoke, she tried to get up from his embrace, but the moment she moved, Zhao Xuanyou stood up as well, pulling her back into his arms from behind.

"I've already bathed."

"Oh. Then I'll go make the bed."

Yu Ying tried to break free, but he showed no sign of letting go; instead, he held her even tighter.

Warm breath swept over her ear from behind.

It was late autumn, and the weather was chilly. She wore thick clothes, which concealed her slender waist, but her curves were still striking.

Zhao Xuanyou had always admired her fair, snow-like skin. Normally, he would have been lost in touching her, but today, he merely gently caressed her.

Yu Ying noticed something was different. She softly called out, "My lord."

"There's something."

Zhao Xuanyou said those three words but didn’t continue.

Yu Ying shrank back slightly, turning her head to look at him. "What is it that my lord wants to say?"

"I plan to marry my cousin."

He was going to marry Feng Jirou?

That wasn’t bad.

Feng Jirou was a gentle and refined young lady, well-educated, and conducted herself with propriety. She was favored by Lady Ye, and she and Zhao Xuanyou shared the bond of cousins.

The Feng family had once been wealthy and was a scholarly family. Though they had fallen on hard times now, Zhao Xuanyou was not short of money. Moreover, he had gained two dowries from the Marquis's residence, so there was no need to insist on marrying a noblewoman from the capital.

As a servant, Yu Ying naturally said, "Congratulations, Young Master."

"What do you think?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"Of course it's a good thing. Miss Feng is your cousin. If you marry her, it will be joy upon joy, kinship upon kinship. I remember that when the Marchioness was alive, she also hoped the two families could be united by marriage."

Yu Ying pressed her lips into a smile, her voice light, and apart from joy, no other emotions could be detected.

Zhao Xuanyou held her with one arm and, with the other, removed the jade hairpin that held her bun.

Her long black hair cascaded down, making the skin at her collarbone appear even more tender and smooth, like fine jade.

"Jirou is indeed gentle and obedient. Life in the Marquis's residence will continue to be as peaceful as it is now."

Would it truly be as peaceful as it was now?

Feng Jirou was currently a cousin living in the Marquis's residence, and outwardly, she was supposed to be Zhao Xuanyou's concubine, so she naturally acted cautiously.

But once she became the mistress of the Marquis's residence, her position would change, and so would her behavior.

Even if it were just to secure her own place in the Marquis's residence, she would have to establish her authority.

Of course, this had nothing to do with Yu Ying.

Yu Ying smiled and asked, "When does my lord plan to hold the wedding?"

"Not in a hurry. Next year will do."

"Miss Feng has already been staying at the Marquis's residence for a while. Since my lord has decided to marry her, it would be better to hold the wedding sooner. That way, Miss Feng can feel at ease, and Lady Ye can soon hold her great-grandchild. She has been longing for four generations under one roof."

Everything she said made sense, but Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly as he listened.

He turned her around to face him, holding her shoulders, and noticed that although she had been smiling the whole time she spoke, there was no joy in her eyes.

At the moment their eyes met, Zhao Xuanyou finally felt a slight sense of relief.

So, she wasn’t truly that happy.

"We can hold the wedding sooner," Zhao Xuanyou said, looking at Yu Ying, his voice deep. "After my cousin moves in, I’ll give you a proper status."

He wanted to give her a status?

Yu Ying’s feelings were actually quite complicated.

She was his woman, but she couldn’t be his only woman.

From the very beginning, when she was forced to have intimate relations with him, Yu Ying had been very clear about Zhao Xuanyou’s attitude toward his official wife.

Back then, when she had taken Cui Yichu’s place to serve him at night, and they exchanged a few casual words, he would take them to heart.

Lady Ye didn’t like how much he doted on her, and though he did as he pleased, Yu Ying knew that deep down, he agreed with Lady Ye.

Once he married Feng Jirou, he would give Feng Jirou everything she deserved: his respect, his affection, his body...

A touch of helplessness arose in Yu Ying’s heart.

After being so close to Zhao Xuanyou for so long, even if she had been emotionless at first, she had developed some feelings for him.

With feelings came other desires.

In the past, she had only wanted to stay by his side, using his power and money to cure her mother.

Now that she had some weight in his eyes, she wanted more.

Although leaving the capital was to keep her mother’s secret, Yu Ying was well aware that she no longer wanted to stay in the Marquis’s residence as his concubine.

It wasn’t that she had no feelings for him; it was that she didn’t want to share him with others in such a pitiful manner.

"Nothing will change in the future. I promise you that," Zhao Xuanyou said, pulling Yu Ying back into his arms and whispering in her ear.

Hearing that he was trying to comfort her, Yu Ying took a few deep breaths, and as her gaze shifted, her emotions settled slightly.

"Is my lord teasing me?"

"Not teasing."

"Once I become a concubine, won’t I have to move out of Honghui Hall?"

Of course she would have to move.

Zhao Xuanyou loosened his hold on her slightly and said gently, "There are several empty courtyards in the Marquis's residence. You can pick one you like."

"But I like Honghui Hall."

Zhao Xuanyou would naturally prefer her to stay in Honghui Hall, where they could be together day and night without having to go back and forth.

But once she became a concubine in the Marquis's residence, living in Honghui Hall would be against the rules.

"Are there really no courtyards in the Marquis's residence that you like?"

Yu Ying thought for a moment and then said, "What about Liu Fang Guan?"

Liu Fang Guan was the best courtyard in the inner residence of the Marquis's residence. It was in a prime location, and both the front and back gardens were spacious, even more comfortable than Leshou Hall.

After Cui Yichu married into the Marquis's residence, she had always lived in Liu Fang Guan.

In everyone’s mind, Liu Fang Guan was a place reserved for the mistress of the Marquis's residence.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Yu Ying, slightly raising his chin. "Picking a fight on purpose?"

Yu Ying looked up at him and retorted, "What fight? It was my lord who told me to pick any, and now that I have, my lord says I’m picking a fight. Since everything I say is wrong, my lord might as well send me away before the wedding, with a good sum of money."

She said these words with a smile, but beneath the jest, there was sincerity.

The moment the words left her mouth, her gaze fixed firmly on Zhao Xuanyou.

However, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression didn’t change. Clearly, he didn’t take her words to heart and thought she was just joking.

"If you really like Liu Fang Guan, then move in."

He agreed?

Yu Ying asked, "If I live in Liu Fang Guan, then what about Miss Feng? Where will the future Young Master’s wife live?"

"Listening to the Rain Pavilion is also nice. My cousin likes flowers, birds, fish, and insects; that place would suit her better."

After Yu Ying had set fire to the side room in Liu Fang Guan, Cui Yichu had moved to Listening to the Rain Pavilion. That place was adjacent to the large garden and built by the water, indeed elegant.

"I was just joking with my lord. Once there is a Young Master’s wife in the residence, it’s only right that she chooses first. It’s not my turn."

Zhao Xuanyou lightly twirled her hair with his fingers and said indifferently, "It’s good that you think that way."

In fact, Zhao Xuanyou was glad she was teasing him.

If she teased him, it meant she cared.

---

chapters.title: Farewell
chapters.content:
Of course, he wouldn’t treat her poorly.

"As for where to live in the Marquis's residence, we can discuss it after my cousin moves in. This courtyard can be given to you first."

Yu Ying looked up in surprise. "My lord is giving me this courtyard?"

"Do you like it?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"But this courtyard was left to you by the Marchioness. How can I accept it?"

Zhao Xuanyou said calmly, "My mother often said that no matter how good a house is, if it’s left empty, it’s just a private residence. A place with people living in it has a lively atmosphere. Although this courtyard isn’t spacious, it’s enough for your mother. From now on, this will be your maternal home in the capital."

Of course, that was only one of the reasons.

Lady Ye didn’t particularly like how much he favored Yu Ying. If he took things from the residence to give to her, it would surely reach Lady Ye’s ears.

This courtyard was Zhao Xuanyou’s private property and wouldn’t alarm anyone in the Marquis's residence.

"My maternal home?" Yu Ying pondered the words he had said.

Earlier, when Yuan Zai had taken her to see the house, he had kept asking her how she wanted to decorate it and what she wanted to add. It seemed Zhao Xuanyou had already decided to give this place to her back then.

"Is this the reward my lord mentioned before?"

More or less.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t answer. Instead, he asked, "Do you like it?"

"Of course I do." Yu Ying leaned against his shoulder and said softly, "My mother and I no longer have a home. To have a maternal home in the capital makes me very happy."

She spoke carefully. Zhao Xuanyou held her, inhaling the faint fragrance from her hair, and said, "The inn is crowded and noisy. Once you’ve tidied up the adjacent courtyard, have someone move your mother over."

Move her here?

This place was indeed closer to the city gate than the Taoran Inn, but Yu Ying had already instructed Zhao Qi to arrange their people in the Yunlai Inn near the Taoran Inn. If her mother moved here, it would be inconvenient for her to meet with them.

"My mother is used to living in the village. She has always said she wants to rent a small farmhouse in the suburbs to live quietly. She probably won’t want to move here."

Zhao Xuanyou frowned. "You live in the capital. It wouldn’t be appropriate for her, a frail and sickly woman, to move to the suburbs. If she likes farming, we can clear out the flower garden and plant vegetables."

"That would be great. I’ll talk to her about it another day. Besides, my lord is still living here. It wouldn’t be convenient for my mother to move in yet, so there’s no rush."

"Are you trying to drive me away?"

"Can’t I? You said yourself that this is my maternal home now. It has nothing to do with you anymore."

The dimness in her eyes caused by his marriage plans finally brightened again. Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze slowly traced her face, his breath growing warmer.

"Are you so quick to tear down the bridge after crossing it? Aren’t you afraid I’ll retaliate?"

"Of course I’m afraid. I haven’t even received the deed yet. How dare I tear down the bridge?"

Yu Ying stretched out her arms and hooked them around his neck, giving him a sweet smile.

Her figure was alluring, and her features were actually more delicate and pretty, but the flickering candlelight in the room made her eyes even more bewitching, tempting one to lose themselves in them.

Being looked at like that made Zhao Xuanyou feel his throat go dry.

He couldn’t help but kiss her forehead.

"Don’t be afraid."

She had followed him, and naturally, he would take care of and protect her.

"Mmm." Yu Ying softly replied, "With my lord here, of course I’m not afraid of anything."

Zhao Xuanyou’s lips finally moved from her forehead to her red lips, his arms tightening around her.

They had talked about too many things tonight. It was already late, and it was indeed not the time to say more.

---

Soon came the day Zhao Qi left the capital.

Although Zhao Xuanyou had been greatly annoyed by Zhao Qi’s clinginess to Yu Ying, since a message had been delivered from the palace, he, as Zhao Qi’s half-hearted teacher, naturally had to go to the city gate to see him off.

After much hesitation, he decided to take Yu Ying with him.

It was already late autumn, and the cold wind outside the city gate was bone-chilling.

Yu Ying hadn’t expected the wind outside the city to be so strong. Not only was her face blown ice-cold, but her hands and feet were also trembling slightly.

Seeing her pitiful state, Zhao Xuanyou was about to take off his own cloak when a gentle voice came from beside them: "Miss Yu Ying, I happen to have brought an extra cloak. You should put it on quickly to avoid catching a cold."

Today, Zhao Qi was leaving with the Ningguo Public’s Young Master, and many court officials had come to see them off. If Yu Ying were to wear Zhao Xuanyou’s cloak, it would indeed draw attention.

But as Yu Ying turned her head, she saw that behind Shen Tongyun stood her husband, Cui Zaizhou. She hesitated and didn’t take the cloak.

"Lady Cui means well. Put it on." Zhao Xuanyou seemed not to have noticed Cui Zaizhou at all and merely nodded lightly at Shen Tongyun in greeting.

After Shen Tongyun married into the Xingguo Public’s residence, although she still didn’t know the real reason behind Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu’s divorce, after a few interactions with Cui Yichu, she indeed found her difficult to get along with and thus didn’t think the divorce was Zhao Xuanyou’s fault.

In any case, she and the Marquis of Jingyuan’s residence had no feud, so she treated her just as she had when they were both young ladies in the Ningguo Public’s residence.

"Feeling warmer now?"

The cloak Shen Tongyun had draped over Yu Ying was a light gray color embroidered with plum blossoms, elegant in color. The hood was trimmed with a circle of white rabbit fur that swayed with the wind, very cute.

"Thank you, Lady Cui."

"No need to be polite."

Before long, someone announced that the Seventh Prince had arrived. Zhao Xuanyou, along with the other officials, walked forward, while Yu Ying, supported by Shen Tongyun, stood at the back of the crowd.

However, it wasn’t just Zhao Qi who came out of the city gate.

"The Crown Prince has arrived."

After the announcement, everyone at the city gate knelt to the ground in yellow robes to greet the Crown Prince.

No wonder Zhao Qi had always said the Crown Prince was hypocritical and liked to put on a show.

Even after what had happened in Heishui, with Zhao Qi leaving the capital, the Crown Prince had actually come to see him off. In the eyes of others, wouldn’t they praise the Crown Prince for his fraternal love and magnanimous demeanor?

"Rise. There is no need for such formalities, everyone."

After Yu Ying stood up with the crowd, she looked toward the Crown Prince.

At this moment, the Crown Prince was elegant and dignified, quoting classics to encourage Zhao Qi to work hard and not be arrogant or impatient after joining the army.

Compared to him, Zhao Qi’s expression was clearly much more sincere.

His eyes darted around, clearly not taking the Crown Prince’s words to heart at all.

"This is the time to at least pretend," Shen Tongyun whispered.

"If he pretends, then he wouldn’t be the Seventh Prince."

Shen Tongyun sighed helplessly. "I just hope that when he returns from the southeast, he will be a bit more steady."

"He’s very intelligent. Since he’s determined to endure hardships, when he returns, he will surely be transformed."

"I should think like you, but I still can’t help but worry."

"With the Ningguo Public’s Young Master there, nothing will go wrong."

"I originally thought he would be unhappy about leaving the capital, but who knew he’s been in high spirits these past few days. I heard from my father that when they went to the palace yesterday to bid farewell to His Majesty, the Emperor was quite moved and very reluctant to let him go. But he just kept grinning, almost provoking the Emperor’s anger."

Zhao Qi had been happy these past few days?

Yu Ying’s gaze flickered, and she subconsciously looked toward Zhao Qi in the distance. At that moment, their eyes met across the space.

chapters.title: Brother and Sister-in-Law
chapters.content:
Yu Yuan clearly felt Zhao Qi curve his lips in her direction from afar.

She quickly lowered her gaze, no longer looking at him.

After the Crown Prince finally finished speaking, the Ningguo Duke's heir and Zhao Qi bowed and took their leave together. As everyone watched them depart, Zhao Qi suddenly turned his horse and rode toward her.

All eyes at the city gate instantly gathered on them, including the Crown Prince’s. Yu Yuan had no choice but to lower her head even further.

Zhao Qi dismounted and walked straight to Shen Tongyun, cupping his hands in greeting.

"I’m leaving now. Take care of yourself. If you run into any trouble, have someone let me know."

His words seemed abrupt, but Yu Yuan understood; they were meant for her.

Though Shen Tongyun was her cousin, she had watched Zhao Qi grow up from a child. Thinking of his departure from the capital, he would be gone for at least two or three years, tears streamed down her face uncontrollably.

"Your Highness, take care on your journey."

This was no place for Yu Yuan to speak, and seeing that she understood his meaning, Zhao Qi mounted his horse again and left with the main group.

Shen Tongyun watched her father and cousin ride away, her tears falling even more freely.

"Sister-in-law, the world is at peace now, with no wars. His Highness and the heir will surely return safely and smoothly."

The one who came to comfort Shen Tongyun was not her husband, Cui Zaizhou, but Cui Yichu’s second elder brother, Cui Zaiting.

"Mm," Shen Tongyun took out a handkerchief to wipe her tears, forcing a smile again. "I’ve embarrassed myself in front of Second Brother. Where is your elder brother?"

"He had urgent matters at the yamen and left in a hurry. He asked me to escort you home, Sister-in-law."

As soon as Cui Zaiting finished speaking, his gaze shifted to Yu Yuan beside Shen Tongyun, and he blinked in slight surprise. "Miss Yu Yuan?"

Shen Tongyun looked at Cui Zaiting, then at Yu Yuan. "You two know each other?"

"We’ve met before. Master Cui helped me once," Yu Yuan said indifferently.

Her feelings toward Cui Zaiting were complicated.

He was Cui Yichu’s second elder brother and had always been deeply caring toward Cui Yichu, which logically made him her enemy as well.

But when Cui Zaiting learned that Cui Yichu and Lady Tao were planning to harm Ding Wenxi, he had immediately come to warn her.

If not for his warning, Yu Yuan would have forgotten that Cui Yichu knew Ding Wenxi was recuperating at Yunshui Nunnery.

Moreover, now that Yu Yuan knew her own origins, things had become even more complicated.

She had never considered acknowledging the Xingguo Duke’s family as her own, but whether she did or not, Cui Zaiting was still her elder brother by blood.

Ever since she could remember, her mother had been her only kin. Now, suddenly knowing there were so many people in the world connected to her by blood, the feeling was undeniably strange.

"Miss Yu Yuan, are your family members well?" Cui Zaiting asked with concern.

He spent most of his time at the academy preparing for next year’s imperial examinations and had only returned to the capital recently because of his elder brother’s wedding.

Thinking of how his own birth mother and younger sister were such vicious people, capable of murdering others’ parents, Cui Zaiting felt deeply pained.

"Thank you for your concern, Master Cui. All is well."

Seeing Yu Yuan’s discomfort, Shen Tongyun said to Cui Zaiting, "It’s rare for me to meet Yu Yuan. I’d like to stroll the streets with her for a while. I’ve brought maids and servants, so Second Brother need not follow us. You may go attend to your business."

"I have nothing urgent to do. Sister-in-law, you two go ahead and enjoy your shopping. Don’t mind me."

Cui Zaiting spoke, then noticed Zhao Xuanyou approaching. Sensing the moment, he tactfully stepped aside.

"Madame Cui," Zhao Xuanyou greeted politely.

Shen Tongyun smiled. "I was just saying I’d like to take Yu Yuan shopping with me. Would the heir allow it?"

Zhao Xuanyou still had to return to the yamen, and originally, Yu Yuan was supposed to go to the Taoran Inn. He simply nodded, gave Shen Tongyun a slight bow, and left.

"The heir treats you with great kindness."

Yu Yuan smiled faintly.

Compared to other maids, her life was indeed comfortable.

But all of it depended on Zhao Xuanyou’s favor. Once that favor was gone, so would the comfort and kindness.

"Madame, where would you like to go shopping?"

Yu Yuan would have preferred to go to the Taoran Inn to accompany her mother, but opportunities to interact with the Xingguo Duke’s family were rare.

Even better, Shen Tongyun and Cui Zaiting were among the more approachable members of the Xingguo Duke’s household. She should be able to gather information from them.

"There’s a stationery shop near the city gate," Shen Tongyun pondered seriously. "Let’s go take a look there, then head toward Jewelry Street."

"Alright."

Yu Yuan happily agreed, linking arms with Shen Tongyun as they walked into the city, with Cui Zaiting following at a respectful distance.

By now, the crowd at the city gate had dispersed. After entering the city and walking a few steps, they indeed arrived at the stationery shop.

Shen Tongyun was the legitimate eldest daughter of the Ningguo Duke’s family and, like Cui Yichu and Sun Tianran, had been educated from a young age.

Inside the shop, she chatted knowledgeably with the shopkeeper about the brushes, ink, paper, and inkstones produced by various workshops, clearly an expert.

Yu Yuan had only just started practicing calligraphy and used whatever was available. She had no idea which paper or brushes were good, so she could only listen silently from the side.

While Shen Tongyun was negotiating the price, Cui Zaiting, who had been waiting outside, also came in.

"Shopkeeper, you’re being unreasonable. When did Cloud Prefecture ink start selling at this price? Just two days ago, you told me five pieces for two taels of silver."

The shopkeeper had seen Shen Tongyun and Yu Yuan’s luxurious attire and tried to take advantage by charging a high price. But Shen Tongyun was also knowledgeable and had been haggling with him. Now, with Cui Zaiting exposing his old pricing, the shopkeeper had no choice but to back down. "That price is only for regular customers. Alright, alright, five pieces for two taels of silver it is."

With the ink settled, Cui Zaiting renegotiated the prices for the rest of their purchases. Only then did the three of them leave.

"Today, we really have Second Brother to thank. Otherwise, I don’t know how much longer I’d have to haggle."

"This shop is full of tricksters, but they do have the most complete selection in the capital."

After this encounter, Cui Zaiting seemed much more at ease and began talking more.

Yu Yuan found it amusing that she was now shopping with her brother and sister-in-law.

The three of them visited several more shops. When they grew tired, they found an elegant teahouse by the street to rest.

Yu Yuan and Shen Tongyun sat in a private room upstairs, while Cui Zaiting stayed downstairs to listen to a storyteller.

"Madame, please have some tea."

After the waiter arranged the tea and snacks, Yu Yuan first poured tea for Shen Tongyun before sitting down.

"No need to be so formal. You’re a friend of His Highness, so you’re naturally a friend of mine as well."

Yu Yuan said, "His Highness is young and doesn’t stand on ceremony, but I cannot be the same."

Shen Tongyun was intelligent.

Earlier, Zhao Qi had deliberately ridden over to say those words. Others might have thought they were meant for her, but she knew exactly who they were for.

Hearing Yu Yuan’s measured response, she couldn’t help but feel a surge of admiration.

Zhao Qi was still a child at heart, and she truly couldn’t be sure of his feelings toward Yu Yuan. But Yu Yuan was Zhao Xuanyou’s concubine; sooner or later, she would hold that position. It was best to keep a clear distance from Zhao Qi.

"By the time His Highness returns from the military, he’ll probably be enfeoffed as a prince and married to a princess consort."

"I wonder which noble family’s daughter will become His Highness’s princess consort," Yu Yuan softly echoed. She didn’t mind Shen Tongyun’s subtle warning at all. She had only agreed to come shopping to extract information from her.

"His marriage is decided by His Majesty. I truly can’t guess, and I won’t waste my energy worrying about it for him."

Yu Yuan’s eyes flickered slightly. She only smiled and said, "Madame looks in excellent spirits. It seems that since marrying into the Xingguo Duke’s family, everything has been going smoothly for you."

---

chapters.title: Gathering Information
chapters.content:
At the mention of her life after marriage, Shen Tongyun’s smile deepened.

The Xingguo Duke’s residence was not far from the Ningguo Duke’s, and Cui Zaizhou was her own beloved. After marrying into the Xingguo Duke’s family, her in-laws treated her kindly, and Cui Zaizhou was extremely attentive to her. Their married life was as sweet as honey.

"It has indeed been quite harmonious," Shen Tongyun said, her face slightly flushed.

Yu Yuan, seeing this, casually asked, "How is that one person doing?"

Shen Tongyun paused slightly, realizing she was asking about Cui Yichu.

"According to my husband, she was locked in the ancestral hall by my father-in-law until just before I married into the Cui family. Only then was she released and moved back to the courtyard where she lived as a young lady, though she’s still not allowed to leave the duke’s residence."

Noticing the displeasure in Shen Tongyun’s tone, Yu Yuan was somewhat surprised.

In her mind, Shen Tongyun was a dignified and gentle noblewoman who handled everything with perfect propriety.

Normally, when mentioning her sister-in-law, Shen Tongyun would be expected to say something diplomatic.

The fact that she didn’t suggested she truly had no fondness for Cui Yichu.

"Her courtyard in the marquis’s residence had gardens both front and back, very elegant. I suppose the courtyard she lived in as a young lady is just as fine."

"That’s only natural. Apart from the main courtyard, hers, the Qingyun Courtyard, is the most spacious in the duke’s residence."

Qingyun Courtyard?

Yu Yuan secretly committed the name to memory before asking, "I once tended to the flowers and plants in her courtyard. She often treated us servants harshly, and we all both respected and feared her. Could it be that even after returning to her maiden home, she’s still the same?"

"Isn’t that the case?" Shen Tongyun sighed softly.

Though she had been married into the Xingguo Duke’s family for only a short time, as the eldest daughter-in-law, her father-in-law had entrusted her with managing the household.

After Cui Yichu was moved out of the ancestral hall, Shen Tongyun had selected maids and servants for her. But Cui Yichu had a violent temper and often beat and scolded the servants in her courtyard. Shen Tongyun couldn’t bear to see it and had kindly advised her several times.

But Cui Yichu didn’t take her sister-in-law seriously at all. On several occasions, she had sarcastically mocked Shen Tongyun in front of the servants.

For the sake of family harmony, Shen Tongyun hadn’t told Cui Zaizhou about these incidents.

But she knew her mother-in-law was aware of everything; she had been at home the whole time.

Her mother-in-law hadn’t reprimanded Cui Yichu, clearly favoring her daughter over her daughter-in-law.

This was the only unsatisfactory aspect of Shen Tongyun’s married life so far.

"She even treats the Xingguo Duke’s residence servants harshly?"

"She behaves a little better when my father-in-law is at home, but otherwise, if she’s in a bad mood, she smashes things. And it’s not enough for her to just smash things; she throws them at the maids. In the short time I’ve been at the duke’s residence, she’s already injured three maids. She used to be well-regarded in the capital, so I never expected her to have such a temper. No wonder the heir sought a divorce from her."

Yu Yuan had seen Cui Yichu’s frenzied behavior before and merely gave a faint smile in response.

Noticing Shen Tongyun’s teacup was empty, she poured her more tea.

"My apologies for bringing up such an unpleasant person. It was rare for Madame to go out shopping, and I’ve ruined the mood."

"It was just idle chat." Shen Tongyun, having spoken so much, was indeed thirsty. After drinking half a cup of tea, she said lightly, "Actually, my father-in-law may very well know about these things. He just doesn’t want to interfere. If I had behaved like this before marriage in my maiden home, I fear my maternal grandfather and father would have disciplined me with family rules long ago."

Cui Yichu frequently mistreated the servants, yet her father and mother-in-law turned a blind eye. If this continued, wouldn’t the family’s reputation be ruined?

Shen Tongyun, now in charge of the household, was truly troubled by her violent sister-in-law.

"Does the Xingguo Duke not care?" Yu Yuan probed.

"My father-in-law is a gentle and kind man. Perhaps he pities her for being divorced."

Yu Yuan nodded. "After all, she is the apple of his eye."

"Not just toward Yichu; my father-in-law is good to all his children. He inquires about their studies daily. Even now, with Yichu the way she is, her food, clothing, and allowances have never been reduced, and he doesn’t allow others to mention the marquis’s residence in front of her."

Good to all his children?

Yu Yuan found the words somewhat ironic as she listened.

She wondered what expression the Xingguo Duke would have if he one day learned she was his illegitimate daughter. Shock? Disdain? Fear? Joy?

The first three were possible, but joy was unlikely.

"I’ve heard that the Xingguo Duke was as handsome as Pan An in his youth, with many romantic affairs, hence the many children in his household. Can he truly treat all his children, legitimate or not, with equal care?"

Lady Tao only had Cui Zaizhou and Cui Yichu as her own children; the rest were born to concubines and mistresses.

As the topic concerned her elders, Shen Tongyun naturally refrained from commenting. She only said, "My mother-in-law naturally distinguishes between them, but my father-in-law treats all his children equally, whether born of a concubine or not. Second Brother’s imperial examinations are coming up, and my father-in-law is very concerned about his studies. He even hired a famous scholar to tutor Second Brother, and he praises Second Brother’s essays as better than my husband’s."

"So that’s how it is." Yu Yuan smiled faintly and didn’t bring it up again.

The two women chatted a while longer, then left the restaurant and visited two more shops. As it neared lunchtime, they finally parted ways.

Yu Yuan hired a carriage directly to the Taoran Inn. After accompanying Ding Wenxi for a meal, she showed her the things she had bought that day.

"Before, the paper and brushes I bought for you were chosen at random. Today, an expert took me shopping. Mother, see if they’re any good?"

Ding Wenxi examined them carefully and smiled. "They’re indeed better than the ones you bought before. Who is this friend of yours?"

Yu Yuan’s eyes flickered slightly, but she didn’t tell Ding Wenxi that it was her sister-in-law and second brother who had taken her shopping.

Mother and daughter chatted for a while before Ding Wenxi went to take her afternoon nap.

Yu Yuan sat at the table in the outer room and opened the brocade box that Pei Tao had delivered last time. She took out the thick stack of architectural drawings, first picking out the map and the layout of Qingyun Courtyard.

The Xingguo Duke’s residence was an imperial construction, covering a vast area. The rear mansion was divided into east and west sections, with Qingyun Courtyard located in the center of the west section.

Yu Yuan could see several paths leading to Qingyun Courtyard, but beyond that, she couldn’t understand much else.

From her initial impression, unless she could sneak into the duke’s residence, there was no way to get close to Qingyun Courtyard.

Zhao Qi had left two guards for her, but she couldn’t possibly order them to sneak into the Xingguo Duke’s residence to kill Cui Yichu.

If she wanted to kill Cui Yichu, she would have to do it herself.

But how?

She didn’t have Wen Ji’s unparalleled lightness skills, nor did she have anyone inside to open the gates for her. She simply couldn’t enter the Xingguo Duke’s residence.

Set it on fire?

There were two water storage areas near Qingyun Courtyard. To set a fire, she would need to drain the water first, which would require either sneaking into the residence beforehand or having an accomplice inside.

Yu Yuan tightly clenched her fingers.

In her distress, she recalled Shen Tongyun’s words from earlier: My father-in-law treats all his children equally, whether born of a concubine or not.

Her mother had also mentioned a few times before that she should go and acknowledge her lineage. It seemed she had great confidence in Cui Lingyuan.

If she were to acknowledge Cui Lingyuan as her father, would she then have a chance to enter the Xingguo Duke’s residence?

chapters.title: Token of Love
chapters.content:
Yu Ying stared at the densely packed columns and bricks on the construction diagram, her head throbbing with pain.

It was too difficult. Seeking revenge was too difficult.

But this revenge had to be taken.

Even though Cui Yichu had been swept out of the door by Zhao Xuanyou, she still swaggered around the ducal mansion as a beloved young lady. If Yu Ying let her off, wouldn't all the suffering she endured in her past life become a joke?

As she thought this, Yu Ying's mood gradually calmed.

She compared the map of Xingguo Ducal Mansion with the blueprints of Qingyun Courtyard repeatedly. Although she still didn't understand the beams and foundations, she gradually figured out where the doors and windows were, and which parts were made of wood and which of stone.

"Girl, what are you plotting?"

Ding Wenxi's worried voice came from behind. Yu Ying turned to see that she had actually gotten out of bed, still in her outer garment.

Yu Ying put down the construction diagram and stood up to help Ding Wenxi sit down.

"Mother, weren't you taking a nap?"

"I was thirsty. I called for you twice, but you didn't hear me."

Yu Ying poured water for Ding Wenxi. After she drank, Yu Ying helped her tighten her clothes and admonished, "It's cold. Mother, don't get out of bed without proper clothes. I'll buy you a cloak later."

She had never worn a cloak before. Today, she had borrowed one from Shen Tongyun at the city gate and found it quite convenient; pull it closer when cold, loosen it when warm.

But Ding Wenxi only asked, "Didn't you say these blueprints were for the Prince?"

Yu Ying knew she couldn't evade the question anymore. She admitted frankly, "I wanted them for myself."

"What do you intend to do?"

"There is an enemy of mine in the Xingguo Ducal Mansion. I just want to cause her some trouble."

Ding Wenxi was slightly taken aback. "An enemy?"
