Yu Ying smiled faintly and said softly, "The Prince's original wife was Cui Yichu, the beloved daughter of the Duke of Xingguo."

"What?"

Before Ding Wenxi could recover, Yu Ying added, "They have already divorced."

"Because of you?"

Yu Ying shook her head. "It has nothing to do with me. Cui Yichu did too many evil things. When she couldn't do anything to the Prince, she turned all her anger toward me, forcing me to get involved."

Previously, Ding Wenxi had been seriously ill, both physically and mentally weak, so Yu Ying had hidden everything from her.

But now it was different.

To take revenge and escape with her mother, Yu Ying alone was too weak.

Her mother had survived in the palace before and raised her alone after leaving it. She was not as fragile as she seemed.

With her mother's help, many things would be much easier.

"Feud?" Ding Wenxi never expected that Yu Ying had been entangled with the Xingguo Ducal Mansion even before knowing her true identity.

The other party was the legitimate daughter of the Duke of Xingguo, which meant she was Yu Ying's own sister.

This was... too much of a cruel joke from fate.

"No wonder you were so resistant to your identity before. But how do you plan to take revenge? What can blueprints do? You can't just barge in, can you?"

"It's a huge mansion. Of course, I can't barge in alone." Yu Ying looked at Ding Wenxi and suddenly realized that today was a good opportunity to be completely honest with her mother. Her expression subtly shifted. "Mother, if one day I want to acknowledge my ancestors, what do you think I should do to make the Duke of Xingguo believe me?"

Normally, Yu Ying only shared good news with Ding Wenxi, never the bad.

Today, however, their mother-daughter conversation was full of surprises, one after another, leaving Ding Wenxi struggling to keep up.

She truly hadn't expected Yu Ying to have hidden so much.

"You want to acknowledge your relatives?"

"Of course not." Yu Ying smiled. "Cui Yichu is the Duke of Xingguo's beloved daughter. If I have to deal with the Duke of Xingguo one day, I naturally need to be prepared. Answer my question first, Mother."

Ding Wenxi pondered for a moment before slowly saying, "If I go to see him, he will naturally believe it."

"No." Yu Ying said firmly.

She was certain that Cui Lingyuan was a wicked man. Back then, her mother had been willing to be with him, so he must have deceived her.

From her mother's tone, although she didn't have any lingering feelings for Cui Lingyuan, she didn't hate him either.

If they met again and he sweet-talked her mother, the consequences would be unimaginable.

Yu Ying didn't want to acknowledge her relatives at all. She just wanted a backup plan.

In case her plan to kill Cui Yichu failed and she was caught by the Duke of Xingguo, she would still have a chance to escape.

"Years ago, he gave me many things. I sold them all one by one. Only a hairpin that he made himself have I kept... but..."

But after Ding Wenxi fell off the cliff and lost consciousness, Yu Ying had sold all the fields, houses, and jewelry.

"So there is no token."

Seeing Yu Ying frowning in deep thought, Ding Wenxi picked up the brush beside her, spread out a sheet of rice paper, and drew an exquisite hairpin.

"You draw so well, Mother." Yu Ying exclaimed in admiration.

Ding Wenxi finished drawing carefully, put down the brush, and sighed, "Life in the palace was very boring. The Empress Dowager used to make jewelry to pass the time. She would come up with designs, and I would help her draw them. I can't draw anything else."

Yu Ying picked up the drawing of the hairpin and examined it closely.

"So back then, Mother drew this hairpin, and he had it made?"

"Yes. It was my design. He said he wanted to make it and give it to me." Ding Wenxi said indifferently. "It can be considered a token between us. If he sees you and this drawing, he will naturally understand that you are my daughter."

Yu Ying's appearance already resembled her father's. With this drawing, it would be enough to convince the Duke of Xingguo.

"I see."

Ding Wenxi watched Yu Ying put away the drawing and couldn't help but worry about her again.

Meeting her concerned gaze, Yu Ying smiled and said, "Mother, don't worry. I won't do anything foolish. It's not easy to have these good days with you awake. Would I go and risk my life?"

"So what are you planning?"

Yu Ying thought for a moment and then told Ding Wenxi about Zhao Xuanyou giving her a separate courtyard.

"That place is quite peaceful. It would be perfect for Mother to move there and recover in peace."

"Me, move there?"

Yu Ying nodded. "Having you stay at the inn was a temporary measure. Now that there's a better place, we should naturally move there."

"If the Prince gives you a house, he must intend to be with you for a long time. If I move in, won't it be even harder to leave in the future?"

"How could that be? That house is very close to the city gate. If we need to leave, it would be much more convenient than from the Taoran Inn."

Ding Wenxi looked at her in surprise.

Yu Ying had even considered the distance to the city gate, showing that her thoughts were much more thorough and far-sighted than her own.

"I'll listen to you."

"That's great. Mother, you don't know how happy I am!"

With that, Yu Ying threw herself into Ding Wenxi's arms.

She had racked her brains to plan for revenge and escape, but every step was fraught with difficulties. Not to mention Zhao Xuanyou and Cui Yichu, even her mother's attitude had been uncertain.

Today, she had revealed so many secrets to her mother. Although Ding Wenxi had many doubts, she had agreed to all of Yu Ying's requests. It was a huge relief.

"Because of me?" Ding Wenxi looked at her joyful expression, thinking that she had become a burden to her, and sighed softly. She gently patted Yu Ying's back as she used to do when putting her to sleep as a child. "You are the child I carried for ten months. No matter what, I will always side with you. But remember, if anything happens to you, I won't want to live either."

"Tsk, tsk, Mother, don't say such things. I've already come up with a foolproof plan. There won't be any problems."

---

chapters.title: Begging Him
chapters.content:
Yu Ying had made big promises to Ding Wenxi, but she still felt uneasy inside.

As soon as she left the Taoran Inn, she headed to the Yunlai Inn not far away.

The layout here was similar to the Taoran Inn; dining outside, lodging inside.

However, it was clearly not as well-decorated as the Taoran Inn. The tables and chairs didn't look very clean.

Yu Ying sat at the central table, ordered a pot of tea, and after drinking for a while, she saw Yangquan appear before her.

The two of them tacitly didn't speak. Yu Ying placed the tea money on the table and followed Yangquan to the backyard.

Once inside the room, the door closed, and Bingyun, who was sitting inside, bowed to Yu Ying along with Yangquan.

These two guards were about the same age as Yin Ping, so their martial arts were presumably quite good.

"Miss Yu Ying."

"You two need not be so polite."

Bingyun said, "The Prince ordered us to stay in the capital at Miss's disposal. We wonder what Miss needs us to do."

There were many things to do, but unfortunately, many of them couldn't be entrusted to them.

"In a few days, I want to send my mother out of the capital to recover. Please go to the outskirts of the capital to find a town and rent a small courtyard for her to rest in."

"Which direction should we search in?" Yangquan asked.

"Go a bit south. It should be near the official road."

"Understood. We will leave the capital immediately to handle this."

Yu Ying nodded and took out a purse from her body. "Take this silver."

Bingyun immediately refused. "The Prince instructed us before leaving not to use Miss's money."

After a pause, Bingyun carefully added, "If Miss is short on money, the Prince has also left some."

Zhao Qi had actually thought of everything...

Yu Ying felt grateful, but although she thought more money was better, she felt indebted to Zhao Qi. She had borrowed his people, so she didn't feel right using his money.

"I know. It's not needed for now."

"How should we inform Miss once we've found a place?"

The main reason for leaving them behind was to first escort her mother out of the capital. Nothing else was needed for now.

"No need to inform me. Once you're done, return here. If I need you, I will come find you."

"Understood."

After leaving Yunlai Inn, Yu Ying hurried back to the courtyard, calculating the time.

By now, Yingxue and Ziyan were already preparing dinner for Zhao Xuanyou. Seeing Yu Ying return, Yingxue said, "We made snow pear soup this afternoon. Sister, have a bowl quickly."

Yu Ying drank the snow pear soup as advised and looked at Yingxue gratefully.

"I'm always running around outside. All the work in the courtyard has been left to you and Ziyan."

Originally, Ziyan had entered Honghui Hall to tend to the flowers and plants. Later, after Yu Ying followed Zhao Xuanyou on his travels, Yingxue had gradually become more familiar with her.

After Zhao Xuanyou returned to the capital, Yu Ying was busy taking care of her mother, and Yingxue, overwhelmed with tasks, had assigned some to Ziyan.

Yingxue smiled. "It's all work we're supposed to do anyway. These extra days don't make much difference."

The news that the Prince was going to marry Feng Jiroung had already spread throughout the Marquis's mansion.

Yingxue, who was well-informed, naturally knew as well.

"Once Miss Feng becomes the Prince's wife, the Prince will definitely promote you to a concubine."

"Let's hope so." Yu Ying smiled.

Yingxue didn't notice the helplessness in her eyes and thought she was genuinely happy. Since Ziyan had just walked out, leaving only the two of them in the room, she added a few more words. "Miss Feng is not as fierce as the previous one. The servants in the mansion will have an easier time in the future."

"I think so too."

"Speaking of Miss Feng, she's really lucky. Originally, she could only be a concubine to the Young Master, but by a stroke of luck, she's able to become the Prince's wife. Even though it's a second marriage, since the Prince has no heirs, it's not much different from a first marriage."

Yu Ying, deep in thought, only nodded absentmindedly in agreement.

Seeing that she wasn't in the mood to chat, Yingxue said a few more words before walking out. She caught sight of Zhao Xuanyou returning and respectfully called out, "Young Master."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's return, Yu Ying's spirits perked up, and she stood to greet him with a curtsy.

Yingxue silently retreated, and Yu Ying picked up the teapot to follow him into the study.

"Master, why has your official robe changed?"

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow and took off his official robe, placing it to the side.

"The Emperor has given me a new position."

"Oh? Has Master been promoted?"

"Commander of the Brocade Guard. The rank is still the fourth grade."

He had previously been a fourth-grade official in the Secretariat, and now he was the Commander of the Brocade Guard, still the fourth grade.

But there was a big difference between the two fourth grades.

The Commander of the Brocade Guard was in charge of major cases personally assigned by the Emperor and could bypass the Three Departments and Six Ministries to report directly to the Emperor.

With such power, even royal relatives would have to give way to him.

Zhao Xuanyou had tempered his cold and ruthless character through years of bloodshed on the border. With the Emperor's trust and his ability to handle court officials, this position was well within his capabilities.

Yu Ying had heard Pei Ta mention the Brocade Guard in his lectures before. She knew it was a special force that worked directly for the Emperor.

The Emperor appointing Zhao Xuanyou as the Commander of the Brocade Guard clearly showed great trust in him.

"Congratulations, Master." Yu Ying bowed to him again in congratulations.

Zhao Xuanyou was naturally in a good mood.

When the Emperor announced his appointment as the new Commander of the Brocade Guard, the Crown Prince Zhao Zun's expression had been priceless.

This was only the beginning. When Zhao Zun found out that the Emperor had appointed him to take down the Crown Prince and the Zhen Guo Duke's mansion in one fell swoop, that would be the time for him to cry.

Zhao Xuanyou let Yu Ying help him change into casual clothes, then pulled her onto the couch beside him.

After a moment of affection, Yu Ying said, "Today, I told Mother about the Prince gifting the house."

"What did she say?"

Yu Ying smiled. "What else could she say? Naturally, she was overjoyed."

"Nothing else?"

"Ever since Mother fell into a coma, we have lost our fields and houses, drifting without a home. Now, having a place to settle in the capital... Not to mention Mother, even I feel like I'm dreaming."

Zhao Xuanyou's hand wandered under her clothes. Seeing Yu Ying biting her lip and trying not to make a sound, he slowly said, "Still feel like you're dreaming?"

Yu Ying tried to pull his hand out but didn't get angry.

"I still feel like I'm dreaming. But..." Yu Ying lowered her gaze, looking at Zhao Xuanyou pitifully.

Her earlobes were adorned with two teardrop-shaped jade pendants, making her skin look as smooth as congealed fat and as white as snow.

Zhao Xuanyou slightly narrowed his eyes, seeing that she had something to say.

"What mischief are you planning now?"

"Master," Yu Ying drew out her tone, sticking to him as she called out, then carefully rested her head on his shoulder. "I've encountered a problem."

Zhao Xuanyou could tell she had a request and deliberately didn't respond.

"You're so clever. Figure it out yourself."

"I only have small cleverness. When I encounter real problems, I can only rely on Master." Yu Ying said, shaking his shoulder as she spoke.

Yu Ying had always been attentive in her service, but in private, she had always been shy and lovable, rarely taking the initiative to seduce him.

Knowing that she was only being affectionate because she needed something from him, Zhao Xuanyou still fell for it.

As she shook and swayed him, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't resist and finally asked, "What is it?"

Yu Ying softly said, "Master gave me this house so that my mother would have a place to recover in peace. I also want my mother to move in soon, but I quite like living here with Master. If my mother moves in, won't Master have to return to the Marquis's mansion?"

Yu Ying's words were vague and roundabout, but Zhao Xuanyou was exceptionally intelligent. After hearing her once, he understood her meaning, and his expression immediately darkened.

"Do you want to drive me away?"

chapters.title: Cannot Break a Promise
chapters.content:
"How dare I?" Yu Wan met Zhao Xuanyou's gaze, doing her best to make her expression look sincere and tender. "It's just that the inn is indeed noisy, and the courtyard is more suitable for my mother to recuperate."

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou remained silent, Yu Wan shook his arm again.

"Previously, you moved to the courtyard to handle the tribute pearl case. Now that the case is settled, I suppose you'll be returning to the residence soon. I'm not urging you to return, but I thought I'd ask in advance so we can prepare and tidy up."

"Is it me returning, or both of us returning?"

Yu Wan looked at him with feigned surprise, blurting out, "Wherever you are, I will naturally be there as well."

As she spoke, she tightly hugged his shoulder.

"Could it be that you're getting married and don't want to take me back to the marquis's residence?"

Though she spoke jealously, in her heart, she silently thought that if he truly sent her away before the wedding, it would save her the trouble of racking her brains.

Among the obstacles in her path, the most troublesome and hardest to deal with was Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou knew she was deliberately turning the tables on him. Unable to help himself, he reached out and pinched her cheek, giving a cold laugh. "Don't want to stay in the courtyard to take care of your mother anymore? Once we return to the marquis's residence, you won't be able to go out every day like you do now."

Yu Wan pulled his hand away from her face, her expression calm. "Am I the kind of person who is never satisfied? These days, being able to go to the inn every day to take care of my mother has already filled me with contentment. How could I dare to hope for it to last forever?"

Zhao Xuanyou stared at her for a moment, then pulled her into a tighter embrace.

The tribute pearl case had indeed been settled long ago. By rights, they should have returned to the marquis's residence. When he had gone back to pay his respects to his grandmother a few days ago, she had even mentioned it, but he had managed to change the subject.

Staying in the courtyard all this time was, of course, for Yu Wan's sake.

In the marquis's residence, he couldn't let her go out every day. The servants he had brought to the courtyard were all people he was accustomed to using; none of them would dare to question his arrangements, nor would they report his indulgence of Yu Wan to his grandmother.

Of course, he enjoyed it as well.

The place wasn't large, but it was peaceful and comfortable, and there were only the two of them.

He was infatuated with Yu Wan's softness and warmth, her skin like congealed fat, and her moments of tender affection as well as her playful coquettishness.

Compared to her cautious demeanor in the marquis's residence, he preferred the radiant smile she wore after visiting her mother every day.

But he truly couldn't stay in the courtyard forever.

His father was recuperating outside the capital. As the heir to the marquisate, managing the marquis's residence and showing filial piety to his grandmother was his duty.

A short stay to relax was fine, but how could he live outside the residence for long?

He had intended to return for some time but had not yet brought it up. Hearing that she had also considered this, he couldn't help but feel a pang of reluctance.

"Do you really want to return to the residence soon?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"It's not that I want to, but I can't stick to my mother's side every day like I did when I was a child."

At this point, the earlier hint of pique in Zhao Xuanyou had completely faded, leaving only lingering affection.

"That's true. You are already someone else's."

"Whose?" Yu Wan asked.

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes narrowed. Before he could speak, Yu Wan chuckled and leaned in, planting a kiss on his thin lips.

"You said yourself that you and I are one family. You must not go back on your word."

The moonlight cast a soft glow through the window, and Yu Wan's clear, shimmering eyes looked pitifully charming, making it truly difficult for Zhao Xuanyou to resist.

He stared at her, letting out a soft hum.

"Of course."

Yu Wan said, "I have only one request. This year is the first year my mother has recovered from her illness, and it will be her first New Year in the capital. At that time, I want to return to the courtyard to spend the New Year with her."

Her request was not unreasonable.

Zhao Xuanyou would certainly have to keep Leaf Old Madame company on New Year's Eve. With Feng Jichou now in the residence, it would be good to let her come and reunite with her mother.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm."

Yu Wan, delighted, repeatedly thanked him, "Thank you, my lord."

"When you have time, arrange the courtyard next door. We'll return to the residence at the start of winter."

"I understand."

By her calculation, there were still eight days until winter. For Yu Wan, that was more than enough time.

The next day, after Zhao Xuanyou left, Yu Wan instructed Ziyan to clean up the courtyard next door. She herself went to the Taoran Inn and told Ding Wenxi the news that Zhao Xuanyou would be returning to the marquis's residence at the start of winter.

"If I move there, will you follow the heir back to the residence?" Ding Wenxi asked.

Yu Wan nodded.

"And us?"

"Mother's health is still so weak that she can't even walk properly. There's no need to rush to leave. Stay in the courtyard for another two or three months to recuperate, and we can discuss it again at New Year."

"At New Year?"

Yu Wan smiled. "I've already talked to him. At New Year, I want to go to the courtyard to spend it with Mother."

"So that's when we leave?"

"If Mother wants to help me, these days she must eat and sleep well to recover her health so we can leave smoothly."

"And what about the Duke of Xingguo?"

"Chui Yichu has tried to harm me several times. Before I leave, I'll give her a surprise. Mother, don't worry. It won't affect our plans."

Although Ding Wenxi had never doubted Yu Wan, thinking of how she had no power or influence yet had to plan so much made her both heartbroken and worried.

"Can you handle all this by yourself?"

"Mother, rest assured. I'm not alone. Right now, I already have two helpers."

"Where did these helpers come from?"

"They are the guards left in the capital by the Seventh Prince to protect me before he left. Once Mother moves into the courtyard, I'll arrange for them to become the courtyard's guards. At that time, they will also be the ones to escort us mother and daughter out of the capital."

Ding Wenxi's eyes showed surprise. "Does the Seventh Prince know all about your plans?"

"He knows half. He has already gone to the southeast and won't affect our plans."

Zhao Qi only knew that she wanted to leave but didn't know that she still had a vendetta to settle or Ding Wenxi's secret.

"Having someone to help you is good."

With two highly skilled imperial guards assisting, Ding Wenxi felt more confident about their escape from the capital.

Yu Wan blinked but said nothing.

With Yangquan and Bingyun on their side, their chances of success were indeed much higher. But to be absolutely certain, they still needed more help.

Yu Wan's mind raced, but she merely smiled reassuringly.

"So, Mother, just focus on recovering from your illness."

She stayed at the inn with Ding Wenxi for lunch, then excused herself, saying that Zhao Xuanyou might return early, and left the Taoran Inn.

Yu Wan took a carriage from the East Market to the West Market.

Relying on her vague memory, she looked around until her legs were about to give out before finally standing in front of a small courtyard.

This was where Wen Ji had once kept her. Yu Wan had spent every day writing on the bluestone slabs in the courtyard and was very familiar with everything there. It was only after Zhao Xuanyou took her away that she roughly learned its location.

Coming to find Wen Ji was not a spur-of-the-moment decision.

Even Zhao Xuanyou had praised Wen Ji's lightness skill as unparalleled in the world. Wen Ji himself had admitted that he could even sneak into the imperial palace. If he was willing to help, the plan was sure to succeed.

Pei Tao had once told Zhao Qi that those who are good at using people can accomplish things, and those who can accomplish things are good at using people.

If there was a suitable person available, it was natural to use them.

Though she didn't know if she could persuade Wen Ji to help, if she didn't ask, how would she ever find out?

Yu Wan raised her hand and knocked heavily on the courtyard gate.

---

chapters.title: Deceiving Him
chapters.content:
The courtyard was silent, and no one came to answer the door.

Wen Ji was the Crown Prince's secret guard. Although he followed the Crown Prince every day, he had said before that when he was off duty, he would stay in this small courtyard.

Hadn't he come back yet?

Yu Wan felt a pang of disappointment but was unwilling to leave.

Zhao Xuanyou would soon take her back to the marquis's residence. Once she was back there, she wouldn't be able to move about as freely as she could now, and she wouldn't have the chance to come find Wen Ji again.

Yu Wan went to a teahouse at the entrance of the alley and ordered a pot of tea. Every so often, she would return to knock on the door.

As the sky began to darken, she had to hurry back to the courtyard, but the courtyard remained silent, with no response at all.

What should she do?

Come back tomorrow?

Yu Wan looked at the tightly closed courtyard gate and suddenly found a surge of strength. She knocked on the door while shouting inside.

"Wen Ji! Wen Ji!"

Before she could call his name a third time, the courtyard gate suddenly opened. A hand reached out, yanking her inside, and the gate slammed shut with a bang.

Yu Wan looked at the masked man in front of her and couldn't help but snap, "You were home?"

The gray mask was cold, and the man behind it gave no response.

"Were you here all day? Were you already here when I knocked earlier?"

"What do you want with me?" Wen Ji asked.

"Am I not your savior? Can't I come find you?"

Yu Wan had sat in the teahouse for a long time and had already thought about how to persuade him.

"When did you become my savior?"

"If it weren't for me pleading for you, Zhao Xuanyou would have killed you long ago. Wouldn't that be a life-saving favor?"

Yu Wan spoke with righteous indignation. Wen Ji pondered for a moment and realized that her reasoning made sense.

"Then I..."

"You didn't save me! You said it yourself; the Crown Prince ordered you to capture me alive, so not killing me doesn't count as a life-saving favor."

"In the dungeon, I blocked an axe for you."

Yu Wan remembered clearly the life-and-death struggle with Baochuan in the Marquis's underground prison. Hearing Wen Ji say this, she immediately retorted, "That was to save yourself! You used the iron chain to block the axe. Baochuan was killed by me, and it had nothing to do with you."

Wen Ji had spent a period of time with Yu Wan day and night and naturally knew that she was clever, quick-witted, and silver-tongued. Arguing with her would not get him anywhere; he would only end up losing.

"Fine, consider yourself my savior. What do you want from me?"

Seeing that Wen Ji had finally relented, Yu Wan quickly said, "Of course, I need you to repay the life-saving favor."

"How do I repay it?" Wen Ji hesitated for a moment. "You're not going to ask me to kill someone for you, are you?"

"Kill someone... How could I ask you to do that?" Yu Wan smiled.

"You've done it before."

Yu Wan saw that he was bringing up the dungeon incident again and hastily said, "That was because someone was trying to kill me, and I was just defending myself. Rest assured, I won't ask you to kill anyone."

"Then what?"

"I want you to help me capture someone. A woman."

"Capture whom?"

"Cui Yichu from the Duke of Xingguo's residence. You know her, right?"

Wen Ji had practiced martial arts since childhood and had become the Crown Prince's secret guard at an early age due to his outstanding lightness skills. He followed the Crown Prince's orders in everything and was indifferent to other matters. However, he did know Cui Yichu.

Years ago, the Crown Prince and Cui Yichu had an affair. They had exchanged secret messages and made covert moves, and Wen Ji had been fortunate enough to overhear a couple of their conversations.

"Why do you want to capture her?"

"What else could it be? Naturally, because we have a feud."

"I can't repay this favor." Wen Ji firmly refused.

"Why?" Yu Wan felt somewhat perplexed.

Faced with Yu Wan's questioning, Wen Ji also felt a sense of confusion. "I am the Crown Prince's secret guard, not some fugitive. You've come to the wrong person."

Secret guards, unlike the overt guards, operated in the shadows without revealing their faces. However, both had the same duty: to protect the Crown Prince's safety.

This reasoning might work on others, but to Yu Wan, it only sounded ironic.

"When the Crown Prince ordered you to secretly kidnap me, why didn't you tell him that you weren't some fugitive?"

This...

Wen Ji was left speechless, only tightly furrowing his brows.

Yu Wan pressed her advantage and continued, "The Crown Prince has already abandoned Cui Yichu. Helping me deal with her won't violate your loyalty to the Crown Prince; it would just be repaying my life-saving favor."

"There is a favor, but I can choose how to repay it, can't I?"

No matter how she phrased it, he still refused to act.

Yu Wan was not surprised by his answer.

A man like Wen Ji, with unparalleled skills, would naturally not easily take orders from others.

However, the Crown Prince had his own authority, and she had her own methods.

"Actually, I came to find you because I want to help you again."

Wen Ji found this somewhat amusing and countered, "If I help you capture someone, is that helping myself?"

"You should know what the Crown Prince, the Empress, and the Duke of Zhen Guo are doing behind the Emperor's back, right?" Yu Wan asked softly. "That is a serious crime."

In truth, she didn't know.

But after Zhao Xuanyou had made discoveries in Heishui, the Crown Prince had hastily rushed there and taken away all the people and evidence. Zhao Qi had even lost control and thrown a tantrum. At that time, Yu Wan had guessed that what Zhao Xuanyou had uncovered must be significant.

Wen Ji was the Crown Prince's secret guard and was always by his side. He should know many of the Crown Prince's secrets.

Yu Wan deliberately used this to deceive him. Sure enough, as soon as the words left her mouth, the eyes behind the mask sharpened abruptly.

"What do you know?"

Yu Wan smiled. "I don't know anything. However, if you help me this time, if the Crown Prince ever falls on hard times in the future, I can help you again."

Wen Ji fell into silence.

Yu Wan watched him quietly.

From their first encounter, she had advised him, "As long as the green mountains remain, there will be no shortage of firewood." Judging by his choices at that time, he was someone who valued his life.

A person who valued his life so much, even if loyal to the Crown Prince, would not easily go to his death.

After waiting for a while and sensing that he was no longer so resistant, Yu Wan said, "Rest assured, I won't ask you to do anything dangerous. I just need you to take Cui Yichu from her boudoir to the firewood room in the Duke's residence."

Sure enough, Wen Ji relented a bit. "Just that?"

Yu Wan had studied the map of the Duke of Xingguo's residence repeatedly. Cui Yichu's residence, Qingyun Courtyard, was in an excellent location, with paths on all sides. It would be extremely difficult to corner Cui Yichu there.

After much consideration, the firewood room seemed to be the most suitable.

The firewood room was already stacked with firewood, and although there were ten water jars placed nearby, as long as the water in those jars was emptied, it would be difficult to bring water from other parts of the residence in time.

Therefore, Yu Wan needed not only to enter the Duke of Xingguo's residence but also someone who could silently take Cui Yichu from Qingyun Courtyard to the firewood room. Yangquan and Bingyun had other arrangements, so Wen Ji was the best candidate to kidnap Cui Yichu.

Yu Wan nodded. "It's because I look like her. When she was at the Marquis of Jingyuan's residence, she often tormented me. The person who tried to chop me with an axe in the dungeon was her former personal maid."

Recalling that night's scene, Wen Ji understood that Yu Wan and Cui Yichu had long been like fire and water, in a life-and-death struggle.

"Are you going to kill her in the Duke of Xingguo's residence? Can you escape?"

"With your help, I can naturally escape."

Wen Ji shook his head. "If the entire residence is unguarded, I might be able to take you in and out. But if I kidnap her and someone notices, the residence's guards will take action. I won't be able to take you out safely."

"Can you escape safely by yourself?"

Wen Ji nodded.

His lightness skills were unmatched in the world. If he didn't need to take someone with him, there was nowhere that could trap him.

"That's fine." Yu Wan smiled gently. "I only need you to take the person from Qingyun Courtyard to the firewood room. After that, you can leave as quickly as possible."

"How will you manage?" Wen Ji asked, puzzled.

Yu Wan did not answer his question. Instead, she met his gaze and countered, "Do you agree?"

chapters.title: New Year's Eve Agreement
chapters.content:
For Wen Kuo, Yu Ying’s request was not unreasonable.

But he was not her subordinate and had no obligation to pay her any mind.

The only thing that could sway him was the mention of the empress and the crown prince’s treason.

After the emperor and empress returned to the capital, Wen Kuo had accidentally overheard the crown prince and his consort arguing, and only then did he learn that the empress and the Duke of Zhen Guo had long been training private soldiers and forging weapons. The crown prince’s trip to the Heishui County Yamen was to cover this up.

Although Wen Kuo had secretly helped the crown prince with many shady dealings, the news of treason truly shocked him.

Born into hardship, abandoned by his parents due to his ugly appearance, and then trained as a shadow guard because of his extraordinary bone structure, he had always been diligent in serving the crown prince. But the only time he felt at ease was in this small courtyard.

Yu Ying was right; he truly did not want to die.

“If something happens in the future, can you really help me?”

“Of course.” Yu Ying had been through much, and her lies came effortlessly. “Zhao Xuanyou is now the commander of the Brocade Guards and enjoys the emperor’s full trust. You know how he treats me.”

Zhao Xuanyou did value Yu Ying highly, going so far as to offend the crown prince twice to take her back.

Moreover, the fact that the crown prince’s treason had been revealed to Yu Ying showed just how much he trusted her.

But...

“Why not ask Zhao Xuanyou for help?”

Yu Ying’s eyes flickered slightly before she replied softly, “Cui Yichu was once his wife. He has already decided to let her go and won’t help me seek personal revenge.”

This reasoning convinced Wen Kuo.

She was right; masters never truly valued the lives of shadow guards. But Wen Kuo wanted to live.

He had no intention of betraying the crown prince, but for his own survival, forming a good connection and leaving a way out was only natural.

“You just want me to take Cui Yichu from the boudoir to the firewood shed?” he asked.

“Yes. I’ll be waiting in the firewood shed. Bring her there, and you can leave immediately.”

Wen Kuo pondered for a moment before looking up at Yu Ying. “When do you want me to act?”

“New Year’s Eve.”

“New Year’s Eve is still three months away. It seems you’ve planned everything thoroughly.”

Yu Ying’s smile was tinged with helplessness as she lightly shook her head.

Since her rebirth, she had always taken things one step at a time. How could she have a thorough plan?

If she had strong soldiers under her command like Zhao Xuanyou and Zhao Qi, she could slowly set up her plans and proceed steadily. But she had nothing, so she had to rely on strategy for thirty percent and luck for seventy percent.

“I came up with this plan only in the past couple of days. Let’s tentatively set it for now. Before taking action, I’ll send someone to inform you.”

“You still have people under you?” Wen Kuo was even more surprised this time.

Yu Ying lifted her head and smiled. “If I had no one under me, how could I have the standing to say I’ll return the favor in the future?”

Wen Kuo fell silent for a moment before saying, “Understood. On New Year’s Eve, I’ll wait for your message in the courtyard.”

Hearing his reply, the huge weight in Yu Ying’s heart finally lifted.

Wen Kuo’s willingness to help was truly a great stroke of luck for her.

“Thank you.”

Wen Kuo met her grateful gaze and turned his face away. “I’ll only help you bring the person to the firewood shed. I won’t get involved in anything else.”

“Of course.”

By now, it was already late. Yu Ying couldn’t speak with Wen Kuo any longer. She left the courtyard and immediately hired a carriage to return to the separate residence.

As expected, Zhao Xuanyou had already returned ahead of her and was dining in the warm pavilion.

Yu Ying first went to wash her face and change her clothes before joining him.

Thinking that she would be moving back to the marquis’s residence in a few days, she figured that after such a long time, a few more days wouldn’t matter. Zhao Xuanyou didn’t say anything to her.

Yu Ying secretly let out a sigh of relief and became even more attentive, serving him food and drink.

The seven days passed quickly.

On the day of the Start of Winter, as Yu Ying lifted the curtain to step out, she saw the clouds in the sky were sparse, and a cold wind hit her face.

She saw Zhao Xuanyou off at the door and then led Yingxue and Ziyan to pack up their things.

“Sister Yu Ying, when will your mother arrive?” The servants in the separate residence had been cleaning the neighboring courtyard these past few days. Although they didn’t know that Zhao Xuanyou had given this residence to Yu Ying, they knew her mother would be moving in.

“Yuan Qing has already gone to the Taoran Inn. I suppose he’ll be here in half an hour.”

Yesterday, she and Zhao Xuanyou had discussed that once Zhao Xuanyou left for his duties, she would wait for her mother at the separate residence, help her settle in, have lunch, and then return to the marquis’s residence with Yuan Qing and Yingxue to tidy up Honghui Hall before Zhao Xuanyou returned.

Sure enough, half an hour later, the gatekeeper reported that Yuan Qing had returned with the carriage.

Yu Ying hurried out and saw Chen Da Niu helping Ding Wenxi out of the carriage.

Since Liu Da Niang lived near the Taoran Inn, it was no longer convenient for her to work there.

“I’ll do it.” Seeing that Chen Da Niu was a burly man, Yingxue quickly stepped forward to take over, helping Yu Ying support Ding Wenxi as they walked inside.

Chen Da Niu, realizing he was being sidelined, scratched his head awkwardly and stood at the door.

“Yuan Qing, take Big Brother Niu to his quarters first.”

“Alright.” Yuan Qing already knew Chen Da Niu, so he led him to the servants’ quarters in the separate residence.

It was early winter, and the cold was biting. Ding Wenxi wore the cloak Yu Ying had bought for her a couple of days ago, along with a hood and a veil to conceal her face, dressing very warmly.

Although she had known that Zhao Xuanyou had bestowed a separate residence upon Yu Ying, upon entering, she saw that while the exterior was unassuming, the interior was ornately decorated with carved beams and painted rafters, and the pavilions and towers were all spacious and grand.

This was not a mere separate residence; it was a golden house.

Ding Wenxi glanced at Yu Ying, who knew what she was thinking but said nothing, simply supporting her into the courtyard.

“The young master instructed the kitchen to prepare bird’s nest congee before he left this morning. I’ll go check on it.”

Yingxue could see that mother and daughter had things to discuss, so she tactfully excused herself.

After closing the door, Ding Wenxi removed her veil and hood.

“This separate residence is a bit too luxurious.”

“This was the private property of the late marchioness. The Marquis of Jingyuan spent a fortune decorating it to please her. Now that it’s empty, the young master has bestowed it upon me.”

“Aren’t you tempted?” Ding Wenxi asked.

Yu Ying pursed her lips. “Mother couldn’t get used to living in the opulence of the imperial palace, and as your daughter, neither can I.”

Hearing her response, Ding Wenxi smiled and reached out to touch Yu Ying’s cheek.

After today, Yu Ying would return to the marquis’s residence, and mother and daughter would no longer be able to see each other every day.

Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Ying quietly, not letting her worry show too much, and softly admonished, “You must be careful in everything you do at the marquis’s residence. The young master is currently favoring you, so when trouble arises, rely on him more.”

“I know, Mother. Don’t worry, I’ll be careful.”

The marquis’s residence was currently very peaceful. Although Old Lady Ye disapproved of her being favored, the old lady was a person of principles. As long as Yu Ying didn’t break any family rules, aside from the occasional punishment, Old Lady Ye wouldn’t do anything to her. As for Feng Jirou, she hadn’t married into the family yet, so she couldn’t use the status of the young master’s wife to control her.

“By the way, after you left yesterday, a Lord Pei came to the inn looking for you.”

---

chapters.title: Gift
chapters.content:
“Lord Pei? Did he cause a stir at the inn?” Yu Ying felt a pang of tension.

After the tribute pearl case, Zhao Xuanyou despised Pei Tao to the extreme. If he found out that Pei Tao had come looking for her, it would be the least of her worries if he got angry; what was more concerning was that he might start paying closer attention to her actions.

“I don’t think so. When I saw Chen Da Niu come up holding a book, I asked about it and only then did I find out it was a gift from Lord Pei.”

Yu Ying asked curiously, “What book?”

Ding Wenxi lifted her chin and looked toward the table. “It’s in that blue bundle.”

Yu Ying walked lightly to the table and opened the blue bundle. Inside were the storybooks she had bought for her mother, but among them was a thick, heavy thread-bound book that stood out.

“Yingzao Fashi.”

Yu Ying read the title aloud and flipped through a few pages. Seeing the various architectural diagrams inside, she immediately understood Pei Tao’s intention.

He was afraid she wouldn’t understand those construction drawings, so he had sent this book to her.

Ding Wenxi sat by the couch, watching Yu Ying hold the book with a slight smile, and asked in confusion, “What is your relationship with this Lord Pei?”

Yu Ying, hearing his name, quickly composed herself.

“He’s a friend.”

“Just a friend, and he gives you such a rare book?” Ding Wenxi found Yu Ying’s earlier smile suspicious and couldn’t bring herself to believe her words.

Although she had never seen Yingzao Fashi before, she had heard of it.

This kind of book was extremely precious. Apart from the imperial study and the Ministry of Works, it was almost impossible to find in civilian circles.

“Of course. But Lord Pei is a good man. He knows I need this book, so he sent it to me.”

“He seems to care about you a lot.”

“Mmm.” Yu Ying nodded, then shook her head. “It’s not what you’re thinking, Mother. I once had the chance to attend a lecture by Lord Pei. He only sent me calligraphy copies and books because he saw that I was willing to work hard.”

Ding Wenxi had seen Yu Ying’s handwriting at the inn before. The structure was open and spacious, the strokes were fine yet powerful, and the characters were elegant, though it was unclear which master’s style they followed. “Do you practice calligraphy by copying Lord Pei’s works?”

Yu Ying nodded again. “Does it look good?”

“It does. But you and Lord Pei are so close. Won’t this draw criticism?”

“I’m just a maid. Who would have nothing better to do than criticize me? Besides, Lord Pei is upright in his conduct. No one would criticize him!”

“You seem to admire him.”

Normally, Ding Wenxi would praise the young master, and Yu Ying would rarely agree, but today she couldn’t stop praising Lord Pei.

“He is a good person, so of course I admire him.”

“Is Lord Pei married?”

“He was, but not anymore.”

Ding Wenxi observed Yu Ying’s expression, her voice pausing slightly. “What happened? Did he, like the young master, encounter an unworthy wife and divorce her?”

“It wasn’t that she was unworthy.” Thinking of Sun Qianran, Yu Ying felt a pang of emotion. “Lady Pei truly loved Lord Pei. She was a genuine noble lady.”

Although Sun Qianran was frail, Pei Tao had showered her with care, and the couple had been deeply in love, a perfect match.

Yu Ying had never expected that they would part ways one day, given how inseparable they had seemed at the Lichuan Summer Palace.

“Then why?”

“Perhaps it wasn’t meant to be.”

Ding Wenxi turned her head to meet Yu Ying’s gaze and asked softly, “And you? Do you have a connection with Lord Pei?”

“Mother.” Yu Ying sighed helplessly. “I’ve already said, Lord Pei doesn’t feel that way about me. You haven’t met Lord Pei; he’s the most handsome man in the capital, the emperor’s personally selected top scholar. Before he was married, countless noble ladies were infatuated with him. With my looks, I’m nothing special in Lord Pei’s eyes. He wouldn’t pay me any mind.”

“I see. I was just making conversation.” Ding Wenxi felt a dull ache in her heart as she said this.

In her eyes, her daughter was a celestial beauty, unmatched in the world.

If she had been born into a wealthy family, who in this world would she not be a match for?

Compared to Ding Wenxi’s dejection, Yu Ying was in a much better mood.

She carried so many secrets in her heart, and every day was like acting in a play. Even with Yingxue, with whom she had a good relationship, she could only make small talk and never discuss her own affairs.

Now that her mother had finally awoken, she could chat freely with her.

No matter what she said to her mother, her mother would listen, and the two of them would always be the closest.

“What are you smiling foolishly about?” Ding Wenxi, seeing Yu Ying smiling happily at her, unconsciously felt her own expression soften under her daughter’s influence.

Yu Ying threw herself into Ding Wenxi’s arms. “Being able to chat with you like this, Daughter feels very happy.”

“I was just talking nonsense, making all the wrong guesses, and you’re still happy?”

“Of course. Whatever Mother says, I’m happy.”

Ding Wenxi held Yu Ying, her eyes filled with both heartache and comfort.

Yu Ying had a harder life than she did, but she was also stronger.

No matter what the future held, Yu Ying would live well.

After a moment of silence, Yu Ying looked at the time and realized it was almost time to return to the marquis’s residence. She quickly discussed important matters with Ding Wenxi.

Most of the servants in the separate residence would leave today, leaving only two cleaning women, an old steward, and a cook.

Since Liu Da Niang hadn’t come to help here, Ding Wenxi still needed a little maid.

“Tomorrow, Mother can have Big Brother Niu go out and hire a maid. Don’t say it’s temporary work; say it’s a long-term position.”

Although Zhao Xuanyou had given her the separate residence, she couldn’t dismiss the original servants, or it would arouse his suspicion.

As for the newly hired people, they couldn’t be said to be temporary workers either, to avoid leaking information.

“Also, in a few days, Mother should have Big Brother Niu go to the Yunlai Inn to find someone.”

“The bodyguards left to you by the Seventh Prince?”

Yu Ying nodded. “One is called Yangquan, the other is Bingyun. Both are highly skilled in martial arts. Now that I can’t go to the Taoran Inn anymore, going to the Yunlai Inn to contact them would be inconvenient. It would be better to have them come here as guards. They can protect Mother, and it would be easier for me to meet them.”

Although Chen Da Niu was a reliable person, he was of humble origins and uneducated, so his judgment was far inferior to Ding Wenxi’s.

If she entrusted everything to Chen Da Niu alone, there might be oversights. Therefore, Yu Ying clearly explained all her arrangements to Ding Wenxi.

“I understand.” Ding Wenxi, seeing how meticulous Yu Ying was, naturally agreed to everything. “Big Brother Niu has helped us so much. When we leave, we must not treat him poorly.”

“Mother, don’t worry. I plan to leave on New Year’s Eve. Before that, I’ll have Big Brother Niu return home for the New Year and give him plenty of travel expenses.”

Before Ding Wenxi could respond, Yingxue knocked on the door from outside.

“Sister Yu Ying, the bird’s nest congee is ready.”

Yu Ying got up to open the door for Yingxue. After Yingxue entered with the congee, she waited for Yu Ying to feed Ding Wenxi and then softly reminded her, “The young master’s things have all been packed. It’s about time to return to the marquis’s residence.”

“Alright.” Yu Ying put down the bowl and, knowing her mother would be reluctant to part with her, gently reassured her, “Mother, take care of yourself. I’ll be able to visit once a month from the marquis’s residence. It won’t be long before we see each other again.”

Although there was worry in Ding Wenxi’s eyes, she still smiled at her. “Don’t worry about me. Take care of yourself and be cautious in everything at the marquis’s residence.”

The two carriages at the entrance of the separate residence were already packed and ready, waiting only for Yu Ying and Yingxue.

Yu Ying followed Yingxue out. As they neared the gate, she saw Chen Da Niu standing there, looking as if he had something to say.

“Big Brother Niu, is something the matter?”

Chen Da Niu pulled Yu Ying aside. After Yingxue had gone out and gotten into the carriage, he whispered, “Did you see the thing Lord Pei gave you?”

Yu Ying nodded.

Chen Da Niu was relieved. Seeing that Yu Ying was about to leave, he hurriedly said, “Lord Pei also had me deliver a message to you.”

chapters.title: Plucking the Plum Blossoms
chapters.content:
"What did he say?" Yu Wan pressed.

"Lord Pei said he would soon leave the capital and couldn’t help you. He told you to take care of yourself and not to... not to..." Chen Da Niu suddenly couldn’t remember what Pei Tao had said.

"Not to what?"

Chen Da Niu hesitated. "I can’t recall. It was a four-character phrase, something like 'use some trick'."

Yu Wan pondered for a moment, then softly asked, "Take a risky move in battle?"

"Oh, yes, that’s it."

"Understood. Don’t repeat this to anyone else."

Chen Da Niu nodded repeatedly. "Don’t worry, even when your mother saw that book and asked me, I didn’t say anything."

"There’s no need to hide it from Mother either. From now on, follow my mother’s arrangements at the separate courtyard."

"Alright."

Chen Da Niu was the first helper Yu Wan had found after her rebirth, and the most reliable one at that.

But he had a family. How could she let Chen Da Niu uproot his life and leave his homeland for her and her mother’s sake?

"Brother Da Niu, you’ve worked hard these days. Go home this year and have a good New Year. Buy some land, build a few more houses."

Chen Da Niu understood. Now that Yu Wan’s mother had recovered and Yu Wan had the Heir’s favor, living in such a luxurious residence, there wouldn’t be much use for him in the future.

He quickly said, "The silver you’ve given me is already more than enough. Just say the word when you no longer need my help. No need to be so polite."

"We still need people. You won’t have time to rest yet. I’m just letting you go home for a few days."

"Then I’ll go back for a trip." Chen Da Niu chuckled.

Yu Wan boarded the carriage. Yingxue saw a small bundle in her hands and curiously asked, "Did I miss something just now?"

"It’s a storybook my mother gave me."

Yingxue sighed. "Both you and your mother can read. That’s impressive."

"It’s just reading. We don’t have other knowledge, unlike Ziyan."

Ziyan, hearing this, naturally responded with modesty.

The three chatted and laughed as they rode the carriage back to the Marquis’s mansion. When the servants had moved everything from the carriage into Honghui Hall, Yu Wan placed the construction drawings and book Pei Tao had given her into her small separate room and locked them away.

Yu Wan couldn’t easily leave the Marquis’s mansion again. Though it was risky, she had to bring the items inside.

Fortunately, though the small room was next to Zhao Xuanyou’s, the other servants wouldn’t enter it without reason.

As long as she was careful, no one would discover them.

After storing her things, Yu Wan and Yingxue thoroughly cleaned Honghui Hall, which had been uninhabited for over half a month. Then, she went to the garden and cut a plum branch.

The plum blossoms hadn’t bloomed yet, only forming buds. Placing them in a vase indoors wouldn’t give off any fragrance, but it would add a touch of color.

While she was busy, Madam Xing came to deliver a message: that evening, there would be a family banquet at Leshou Hall, and Yu Wan was to attend as well.

Yingxue was happy for Yu Wan, thinking this meant she was being recognized as part of the family. But Yu Wan knew that the Old Dowager likely wanted to reprimand her again.

No matter. She was a hard rock; others could strike or beat her, but she wasn’t afraid.

In winter, the sky darkened early. By the time Zhao Xuanyou returned, the corridors of Honghui Hall were already lit with lanterns.

"Master is back."

Hearing Yingxue’s voice outside, Yu Wan quickly put down her brush and went out to greet him.

The uniform of the Jin Yi Wei commander was imposing, made of fine brocade with five-claw embroidery. A jade pendant, a gift from the emperor, hung from his waist, allowing him free entry to the palace.

Zhao Xuanyou changed into casual clothes and took Yu Wan’s ink-scented hand, sniffing it lightly.

Yu Wan smiled. "I didn’t know when you’d return, so I wrote for a while."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly. "It’s fine. In the future, practice your calligraphy more and do less chores. It won’t count as laziness."

His voice wasn’t quiet, so Yingxue, Yuan Zhen, and Yuan Qing inside all heard him clearly.

Yu Wan understood his intention and smiled as she curtsied to him.

"Then thank you, Heir. Earlier, Madam Xing came to say that dinner will be at Leshou Hall tonight."

Zhao Xuanyou had known about the winter family banquet and wasn’t surprised. He stayed in Honghui Hall for a moment, had a cup of tea, then left for Leshou Hall.

The cold wind had turned the tall trees in the Marquis’s mansion a different color. The flowers and plants along the paths had all turned yellow. Occasionally, a few early plum trees had budded, and in Yu Wan’s eyes, they held a desolate beauty, no less stunning than the lush spring and summer.

When they arrived at Leshou Hall, the food was already prepared.

After Zhao Xuanyou took his seat, Old Dowager Ye took Feng Jiyou’s hand and praised, "Today’s dishes were all arranged by Jiyou. Come, try them."

Feng Jiyou visited Leshou Hall every day to pay respects and keep company, earning the Old Dowager’s favor. She had already recognized Feng Jiyou as her future granddaughter-in-law and hoped the two would marry soon, so the Marquis’s mansion could enjoy peaceful days like other noble families.

"Thank you for your hard work, Cousin." Zhao Xuanyou said.

Feng Jiyou’s cheeks flushed slightly as she silently poured wine and served dishes for Zhao Xuanyou.

Old Dowager Ye said, "Next month, your uncle and aunt will come to the capital to discuss your marriage. I was thinking of cleaning up the separate courtyard in Ping’an Alley, the one left by your maternal grandfather, but you said you wanted to sell it. That place is small and old. I planned to have them stay there."

Zhao Xuanyou indifferently replied, "That place is too small and dilapidated. I’ve already asked a broker to find a buyer."

Indeed, the separate courtyard wasn’t large. In the past, it had only been kept because the Marquis of Jingyuan valued it.

Hearing that Zhao Xuanyou wanted to sell it, Old Dowager Ye didn’t mind. She nodded. "Then have them stay in the mansion. There are plenty of empty rooms here. Since we’re all family, living together will be livelier."

"Yes."

The family meal was very harmonious. Old Dowager Ye barely spoke to Yu Wan until Zhao Xuanyou stood to leave. Then, she mentioned that since Feng Jiyou’s parents would be staying at the mansion, it wouldn’t be appropriate for Yu Wan to stay in the small separate room.

Initially, moving into the small room had been Old Dowager Ye’s idea. Now, moving out was also her idea.

Yu Wan understood the changing circumstances and, moreover, wanted to move herself.

So she respectfully said, "This servant will move back to Xiaoyue Pavilion today."

"There’s no need to rush." Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly. "Wait until Uncle and Aunt arrive."

Old Dowager Ye glanced at them and said, "You know what to do."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded and left Leshou Hall with Yu Wan.

Night had deepened, and the cold outside grew heavier.

The two walked side by side back to Honghui Hall without speaking.

As they passed a few plum trees, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly stopped and turned to Yu Wan. "The plum branch in the room looks nice."

The plum blossoms hadn’t bloomed yet, so there was no fragrance. It was perfect for Honghui Hall.

It was thoughtful of her.

Yu Wan didn’t speak, only stopping her steps to stand beside him.

"There’s another vase in the room. Pick another good branch to take back and arrange."

He pulled Yu Wan off the path. The withered shrubs by the roadside caught on Yu Wan’s skirt. He lifted his hand to encircle her waist and lightly leapt to the base of the plum tree.

The plum tree’s branches were gnarled in the cold wind, their intertwining limbs devoid of any coquettishness, as stark and proud as halberds. Yet, on these cold and lonely branches, tiny red buds had sprouted, like a tough man’s tender heart; unique in its charm.

Yu Wan stood under the tree, silently gazing upward. Zhao Xuanyou stood beside her and softly asked, "Which branch do you want?"

"That one." Yu Wan pointed to the branch at the top of the tree.

Even Zhao Xuanyou, tall as he was, couldn’t reach it with a stretch of his hand.

He jumped onto the plum tree and stood on a branch to pluck the plum blossom.

Yu Wan watched him, knowing he was humoring her. A different emotion welled up inside her.

---

chapters.title: Treading in Snow
chapters.content:
By this time next year, the plum blossoms in the Marquis’s mansion would bud again. Perhaps Zhao Xuanyou would climb the tree to pluck plum blossoms again, but the person standing beneath the tree would be Feng Jiyou.

Across two lifetimes, Zhao Xuanyou had been the only man in her life. She had even borne him a child.

Yu Wan had once thought that after her death in her previous life, Zhao Xuanyou would surely cherish their "legitimate eldest son" dearly.

They were entangled in countless ways, yet they were fundamentally mismatched.

Ever since the night Cui Yichu had carried her, drugged, onto the bed, perhaps everything had already gone wrong.

Earlier today, she had told her mother that Pei Tao and Sun Tianran’s divorce was because they had no fate. Wasn’t her relationship with Zhao Xuanyou the same?

"What are you spacing out about?"

Lost in thought, Yu Wan was startled back to reality as Zhao Xuanyou returned with the plum branch.

He waved the branch in front of her. "If you don’t like it, I’ll pick another."

Yu Wan took the branch, her face breaking into a light, joyful smile as she quietly suppressed the turmoil in her heart.

"This one is perfect. I like it very much."

Zhao Xuanyou knew she liked flowers, but he hadn’t planted any in Honghui Hall because he disliked floral scents.

After a moment’s thought, he said, "The Ningguo Duke’s mansion has a plum garden in the outskirts of the capital. When we have time, we can ride over and take a look."

"Really?" Yu Wan looked at him with delighted surprise.

Since returning to the capital, she hadn’t had the chance to ride a horse.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

Yu Wan hugged the plum branch, thinking. "We should wait another two months. By the time it’s the twelfth lunar month, the winter plums will be in full bloom, and the weather will be even colder. Riding through the snow to seek plum blossoms would be beautiful."

Her gaze was clear and pure. Listening to her description, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly found himself looking forward to it.

"Alright, we’ll go when it snows."

Noticing that Yu Wan’s face had been reddened by the cold night wind, Zhao Xuanyou reached out to warm her cheek, then led her back to Honghui Hall.

Yu Wan had agreed to Old Dowager Ye’s request to move out, but Zhao Xuanyou had refused, so she had to give up the idea.

Life in the Marquis’s mansion was as peaceful as Yu Wan had expected.

Though Old Dowager Ye was displeased with Zhao Xuanyou’s favoritism toward her, she was advanced in years and devoted to Buddhist prayers. Apart from the occasional reprimand, she didn’t interfere much.

As for Feng Jiyou, though everyone knew she was the future Heir’s wife, she hadn’t married in yet and didn’t put on airs. Whenever she came to Honghui Hall, she was quite cordial to Yu Wan and didn’t cause trouble.

Whether her kindness was genuine or feigned, as far as Yu Wan was concerned, as long as she didn’t stir up trouble now, it was a great blessing.

Since Zhao Xuanyou had told her she didn’t need to do chores, after he left for work in the mornings, Yu Wan had more time to study the Yingzao Fashi and the construction plans of the Xingguo Duke’s mansion that Pei Tao had given her.

With the book’s explanations, the construction plans were indeed much easier to understand.

Her earlier thoughts had been correct. Lingyun Courtyard was in a good location, close to all three major water storage areas in the mansion. If they acted there, the servants would have enough time to put out the fire.

The firewood storage was different. Located in a corner of the mansion, it was already filled with flammable dry wood. If the nearest water storage jar was sabotaged, it would be impossible to put out the fire in time.

Most importantly, few people worked in the firewood storage, so setting the fire there would be less likely to harm innocents.

One day, as Yu Wan was reading in her small room, she suddenly heard Yingxue’s hurried footsteps outside.

She quickly closed the book and placed it in a box. Just as she looked up, Yingxue pushed the door open.

"Why the rush? What happened?"

Yingxue’s face was pale, her fingers trembling slightly. "Someone from the Eastern Palace has come."

Yu Wan looked at Yingxue in shock.

Since the Blackwater case had ended, the Crown Prince and Zhao Xuanyou had seemingly restored their calm on the surface. Neither had brought up the matter of competing for Yu Wan again.

Moreover, the Marquis’s mansion had sent Zhuang Huaiyue to the Eastern Palace, and she was said to be favored. Yu Wan had thought this matter was over.

She had already planned everything, arranged everything. If she were summoned to the Eastern Palace now, all her efforts would be in vain.

"What did they say?" Yu Wan did her best to steady her mind.

Yingxue shook her head and whispered, "Madam Xing just came by. She said there’s an eunuch from the Eastern Palace in Leshou Hall. The Old Dowager ordered all the maids from Honghui Hall to go to Leshou Hall to serve."

Yu Wan felt slightly more at ease.

If all the maids from Honghui Hall were called, then it wasn’t just about her. There was still room to maneuver.

"Understood. I’ll change my clothes now. Go call Ziyan."

Yingxue hurried away. Yu Wan changed her clothes in the room and waited in the courtyard for a moment before seeing Yingxue and Ziyan arrive together.

The three of them rushed to Leshou Hall. The servant at the door let them in and instructed them to wait in the courtyard.

Soon, Madam Xing came out, glanced at the three of them, and waved for them to enter.

Inside Leshou Hall, Old Dowager Ye was serving tea to the eunuch from the Eastern Palace.

This wasn’t the same eunuch who had come to take Yu Wan before. This one was said to serve at the Crown Prince’s side.

"Eunuch Wei, these three are the maids who serve in Honghui Hall. I wonder what business you have with them?"

The eunuch had been in the Marquis’s mansion for a while without stating his purpose. Hearing Old Dowager Ye’s words, he set down his teacup and let his eyes roam over the three of them.

"Which of you used to be close to Zhuang Zhaoxun?"

Zhuang Zhaoxun...

The three exchanged glances. Yu Wan was the first to recover, realizing he was referring to Zhuang Huaiyue.

Yu Wan couldn’t figure out why this eunuch had come to the Marquis’s mansion to find someone close to Huaiyue. Surely Huaiyue hadn’t caused trouble in the Eastern Palace and was now trying to implicate someone from the Marquis’s mansion?

Fortunately, even though she didn’t know if this was good or bad news, it had nothing to do with her.

Yu Wan secretly let out a breath of relief and didn’t mention Ziyan, standing silently to the side.

By now, Ziyan and Yingxue had also come to their senses. After all, only Zhuang Huaiyue from the Marquis’s mansion had entered the Eastern Palace.

Yingxue was a little afraid and spoke first. "This servant has no connection with Zhuang Zhaoxun."

"If you don’t, then be quiet." The eunuch said impatiently.

The Eastern Palace had come to the Marquis’s mansion several times to take maids, which had secretly angered Old Dowager Ye. Seeing the maids scared and pale, she spoke up sternly. "Zhuang Zhaoxun used to be close to Ziyan when she was in the Marquis’s mansion, but she didn’t stay here for long, so their friendship probably wasn’t deep."

"Which one is Ziyan?"

At this point, though Ziyan was afraid, she had to step forward. "This servant is Ziyan."

The eunuch nodded and turned to Old Dowager Ye. "Old Dowager, His Highness the Crown Prince has ordered Ziyan to enter the Eastern Palace to serve Zhuang Zhaoxun. Since we’ve found the person, I’ll take her back to report."

"This... Does the Eastern Palace lack servants? Ziyan usually tends to the flowers and plants here. She’s clumsy and might not serve Zhuang Zhaoxun well."

"His Highness wants her. No one can stop this." The eunuch stood up and bowed to the Old Dowager. "The Eastern Palace won’t take your servant for nothing. His Highness has another reward. I’ll take Ziyan with me now."

He took a step outside and, seeing Ziyan’s pale face, stretched his duck-like voice. "Don’t be afraid. This is a good thing."

chapters.title: Good News
chapters.content:
Good news?

The people in Leshou Hall exchanged puzzled glances, none daring to speak.

The eunuch who had delivered the message refused to say more, flicking his sleeve as he turned to leave.

Ziyan understood that the situation was settled; she had no choice but to go to the Eastern Palace. She bowed to Lady Ye, then turned to glance at Yingxue and Yuluan, forcing a smile before lowering her head and following the eunuch out.

Though their acquaintance had been brief, working together in Honghui Hall had fostered a bond between them.

Especially with Yingxue; during the months when Zhao Xuanyou had taken Yuluan away from the capital, she and Ziyan had spent every day together, sharing interests and growing as close as sisters.

Watching Ziyan’s retreating figure, Yingxue couldn’t help but wipe away her tears.

Yuluan gently took her hand, and Yingxue, sniffling, struggled to compose herself in front of her mistress.

Soon, a young eunuch entered, presenting a lingzhi mushroom as a tonic for Lady Ye. It was likely the reward mentioned earlier.

Lady Ye showed no joy. After expressing her gratitude, she waited for the Eastern Palace attendants to leave before letting out a heavy sigh, then began blaming herself.

If she hadn’t carelessly taken the elixir from the Xingguo Duke’s mansion all those years ago, marrying that jinx Cui Yichu, the Marquis’s residence would never have become entangled with the Eastern Palace, and troubles wouldn’t keep coming one after another.

"Return to your duties," Lady Ye said, fingering her prayer beads before heading toward the rear Buddhist hall.

She needed to continue her prayers, begging Buddha to bless the Marquis’s household with smooth sailing from now on.

Outside Leshou Hall, Yingxue asked Yuluan, "Elder Sister Yuluan, what do you think that eunuch meant by 'good news'?"

Yuluan didn’t know either.

Having spent time in the imperial palace, Yuluan understood that for the royal family, a reward from the master was good news, a punishment from the master was also good news, and even being executed by the master was the greatest good news of all.

The eunuch’s tone had been strange, neither positive nor negative, making it impossible to guess what kind of good news it was.

"It must be related to Huaiyue... I mean, Zhuo Xun."

Yingxue said, "When she was at the Marquis’s residence, I didn’t have much interaction with her. But she and Ziyan were indeed close, often talking together. She shouldn’t harm Ziyan, right?"

"I once heard the master say that after Zhuo Xun arrived at the Eastern Palace, she gained the Crown Prince’s favor. She should be fine."

"Could it be that Zhuo Xun recommended Ziyan to the Crown Prince, so she could serve in the Eastern Palace too?"

Yuluan shook her head.

Yingxue sighed. "I hope she fares well in the Eastern Palace."

At that moment, in the Eastern Palace, Zhuo Huaiyue couldn’t stop feeling nauseous. She hadn’t been able to eat for days, her complexion was terrible, her body was extremely weak, and she couldn’t even speak.

The Crown Prince stood outside, listening to her pained sounds from inside the room, his brows tightly furrowed. He glared at the imperial physician beside him. "She eats nothing but vomits everything. Don’t you have any solution?"

The physician hesitated. "Morning sickness is common among pregnant women. Some experience it mildly, others severely. It’s only natural."

"Aren’t you going to prescribe any medicine?"

"Medicine is three parts poison. Taking it might harm the child in her womb."

"And if she remains this weak, unable to even speak clearly, won’t that harm my child as well?"

The physician sealed his lips, daring not to answer.

"Useless!" The Crown Prince berated, then turned to the eunuch beside him. "Has the person from the Pacifying Marquis’s residence returned yet?"

Before the eunuch could respond, the eunuch previously sent to the Pacifying Marquis’s residence hurried in. "Your Highness, the person has been brought back."

The Crown Prince’s expression softened slightly. He looked at Ziyan behind the eunuch, noting her clear and delicate features. Though her appearance wasn’t as stunning as Zhuo Huaiyue’s, her demeanor was clean and refined.

"What’s your name?"

Ziyan hadn’t expected to be brought directly before the Crown Prince. She knelt immediately. "This servant is Ziyan. Greetings to Your Highness."

"Huaiyue has just conceived, and her morning sickness is severe. Since you were once her close friend, you will stay in the Eastern Palace to attend to her. I must go to the imperial palace to see His Majesty. Go in and keep her company."

So, Zhuo Huaiyue was pregnant, that explained why the eunuch had mentioned good news.

"As you command."

The Crown Prince left in a hurry. Ziyan rose from the ground and entered the inner chamber, where she saw Zhuo Huaiyue weakly leaning against the couch, retching dryly. A washbasin was placed beside her, as if she might vomit at any moment.

Upon seeing Ziyan, Zhuo Huaiyue feebly waved her hand at the attendants, her voice too weak to form a complete sentence. "Lea... leave..."

Ziyan was quick-witted. She turned to the palace maid beside her. "His Highness has ordered me to attend to Zhuo Xun from now on. Leave this to me."

The palace maid, knowing of the Crown Prince’s command, bowed to Zhuo Huaiyue and withdrew.

"Zhuo Xun," Ziyan began. She and Zhuo Huaiyue had met during hard times. After their families were seized and they became palace servants, they had supported each other, forming a deep bond.

Seeing Ziyan, Huaiyue’s tension eased slightly. She quickly pulled Ziyan closer, signaling her to come nearer.

Ziyan felt that Huaiyue’s grip was surprisingly strong, not as weak as she appeared.

"Shh, I’m actually not that sick," Zhuo Huaiyue whispered, noticing her confusion.

"Then..."

"Everyone around me was arranged by the Crown Princess. After the pulse diagnosis confirmed my pregnancy, I didn’t dare eat anything they brought."

"So you haven’t eaten for days?"

Zhuo Huaiyue replied, "My period hasn’t come, so I suspected. I had hidden some snacks beforehand."

Ziyan had first met Zhuo Huaiyue when she was still a delicate young lady, crying day and night, calling for her father and mother. Everyone had been annoyed by her, but Ziyan had been the one to coax her into eating.

Later, when they were fortunate enough to be sent to the Marquis’s residence, Zhuo Huaiyue had refused to listen to her advice and insisted on seducing Zhao Xuanyou, which, as expected, had ended in failure.

Then, hearing that Zhuo Huaiyue had replaced Yuluan in entering the Eastern Palace and gained the Crown Prince’s favor, Ziyan had been happy for her, thinking she had finally gotten what she wanted.

From having her family seized to becoming a Zhuo Xun, all within two years, Ziyan never expected Zhuo Huaiyue’s temperament to have changed so drastically. From an innocent noble miss, she had become a concubine who understood the ways of palace survival.

Noticing Ziyan’s surprise, Zhuo Huaiyue said, "I must protect this child. If it’s a son, then my parents and brothers will be saved. Ziyan, you must help me."

"But how can I help you? That’s the Crown Princess."

"Think of Yuluan. She’s just a maidservant, yet she still managed to outmaneuver Cui Yichu. She had nothing and still wasn’t afraid. I have the Crown Prince’s favor and a child in my womb. I won’t necessarily lose."

Ziyan had worked in Honghui Hall and knew exactly what Yuluan did there every day after seeing Zhao Xuanyou off. She practiced calligraphy, read books, and pored over the Four Books and Five Classics, even asking Ziyan for help when she didn’t understand something.

Ziyan had never seen a woman like her.

"Look at this Eastern Palace; grand and luxurious. Even if I can’t save your family, in the future, I can ask the Crown Prince to arrange a marriage for you. You won’t have to suffer as a servant anymore."

Perhaps her fate could truly change... Ziyan took a deep breath. "How does Zhuo Xun wish for this servant to help?"

---

chapters.title: Hidden Struggle
chapters.content:
Zhuo Huaiyue was overjoyed but didn’t dare show it. Lowering her voice, she said, "Others think I can’t eat anything. You can use this as an excuse to help me cook congee. Once it’s ready, bring it to feed me. Don’t leave my side for even a moment."

The Crown Prince and Crown Princess’s meals were prepared daily in the Eastern Palace kitchen, so the ingredients were safe.

Her morning sickness wasn’t severe, and her appetite wasn’t great, so she couldn’t eat much.

"Can you survive on just congee?" Ziyan asked worriedly.

"The kitchen always has chicken broth simmering. After cooking the congee, just add some chicken."

"I’ll remember."

"Actually, as long as we’re careful, there won’t be any problems. The Crown Princess may hate me, but she maintains appearances. Besides, His Highness is here."

Before Ziyan could respond, a eunuch outside announced loudly, "Her Majesty the Empress arrives!"

Zhuo Huaiyue and Ziyan exchanged a glance, slightly startled. Ziyan helped Zhuo Huaiyue up from the couch.

The sound of footsteps grew louder, and soon, the Empress and Crown Princess entered the room.

The Empress wore a noble, deep red palace gown, the peonies embroidered on the hem so lifelike they seemed ready to bloom. The phoenix hairpin with jade pendants in her coiled bun exuded regal elegance.

Compared to the Empress’s imposing presence, the Crown Princess beside her seemed rather petty.

"This concubine greets Her Majesty the Empress and Her Highness the Crown Princess," Zhuo Huaiyue said, playing her part to perfection. She leaned heavily on Ziyan, her voice weak.

The Empress looked down at her, then glanced at the washbasin placed beside the couch, her phoenix-like eyes narrowing slightly.

The attending palace servants understood. One removed the washbasin, another brought in a censer, and others carried forward a chair with a soft cushion.

After the Empress took her seat, she said softly, "Since you are with child, there’s no need for formalities in my presence. Sit and speak."

"Thank you, Your Majesty," Zhuo Huaiyue replied.

Since her pregnancy, she had indeed been eating poorly and sleeping restlessly, her face pale.

Yet her natural delicate and weak appearance made her look even more pitiful in her pallor. It was no wonder that, despite the unpleasant atmosphere in the room, the Crown Prince still doted on her.

The Empress’s gaze flickered slightly as she raised an eyebrow. "I heard you can’t eat anything?"

Zhuo Huaiyue, seated on the embroidered stool brought by a servant, began, "This concubine..." She covered her mouth after two words, paused for a moment, then softly said, "This concubine’s morning sickness is too severe."

"You are carrying two lives. Even if you can’t eat, you must force yourself. You may endure it, but my grandchild cannot."

"Yes. This concubine has already ordered a maid to cook congee in the kitchen."

The Empress and Crown Princess’s gazes immediately shifted to Ziyan.

Ziyan knew she had no right to speak, so she simply bowed respectfully to them.

"This maid looks unfamiliar," the Crown Princess, Jiang Ruoshuang, said, her eyes darkening as she gritted her teeth. "Zhuo Xun has been so pampered since her pregnancy that the palace maids and eunuchs in the Eastern Palace can’t serve her properly. She even had to request a maid from the Marquis’s residence. This will only invite ridicule from others."

"From the Pacifying Marquis’s residence?" the Empress asked.

Under the Empress’s gaze, Ziyan stepped forward. "Yes. This servant previously worked at the Pacifying Marquis’s residence."

"Since she’s here, there’s no need to drive her away," the Empress said, glancing at Zhuo Huaiyue. "But from now on, you are not allowed to act spoiled again. Otherwise, I will not let this matter rest."

"This concubine understands. I will be cautious in speech and conduct from now on."

"The Emperor heard the good news and was greatly pleased. He has bestowed tonics upon you. Focus on your pregnancy and give the Crown Prince a healthy, chubby child. I will reward you handsomely."

"Thank you, Your Majesty and Your Highness," Zhuo Huaiyue said.

Ziyan helped Zhuo Huaiyue kneel and express their gratitude. The Empress said nothing more, rising to leave.

Jiang Ruoshuang shot Huaiyue a glare, suppressing her anger as she followed the Empress out.

After the Empress and Crown Princess settled in the Eastern Palace tea room, Jiang Ruoshuang poured tea for the Empress.

"Mother, you saw how she was. She still restrains herself in front of you, but in front of His Highness, she’s even more excessive."

"You’re not unfamiliar with her. She’s always been like this."

Jiang Ruoshuang saw that the Empress’s tone was calm, seemingly not displeased with Zhuo Huaiyue, and her heart sank.

The Crown Prince had already favored Zhuo Huaiyue, and a few days ago, he had even wanted to elevate her status. If not for her invoking the Empress, Zhuo Huaiyue would no longer be just a Zhuo Xun.

Today, the Empress had suddenly come to the Eastern Palace. Jiang Ruoshuang had originally thought she would reprimand Zhuo Huaiyue, but instead, she had come to deliver the Emperor’s rewards.

Jiang Ruoshuang gently pinched her fingers, cautiously glancing at the Empress.
