Sensing Jiang Ruoshuang’s provocation, the Empress frowned. "There will always be people around the Crown Prince. If you cannot tolerate them, you’d best give up the position of Crown Princess early."

"Mother," Jiang Ruoshuang said, not expecting the Empress to speak so harshly. A touch of sorrow appeared in her expression. "It’s not that I can’t tolerate her. Since she came to the Eastern Palace, His Highness has visited her every night. I haven’t said a single harsh word. But now that she’s pregnant, what if she gives birth to a son..."

The Empress shifted her tone slightly, softening her attitude. "It’s a long time until the birth. It might not even be a son. Even if it is, you are the legitimate wife. What do you have to fear? When the enemy comes, we’ll block them. When the water comes, we’ll stop it. The Emperor has so many sons. When have I ever panicked?"

"Yes," Jiang Ruoshuang replied, lowering her head.

"The Crown Prince married before Prince Ping. Prince Ping’s residence already has a young lady, yet the Eastern Palace remains cold and quiet. Since you cannot bear children, Zhuo’s pregnancy is a good thing."

Hearing the disdain in the Empress’s tone, Jiang Ruoshuang felt even more aggrieved.

It had been two years since their marriage, yet the Crown Prince only visited her room once or twice a month. Even then, it was done hastily, unlike the way he doted on Zhuo Huaiyue; spending every night with her and even calling for water in the morning.

She hated that Zhuo Huaiyue had entered the Eastern Palace when she wasn’t in the capital, allowing that wretched woman to take advantage of the situation.

By the time she returned to the Eastern Palace, Zhuo Huaiyue had already won the Crown Prince’s heart. When she tried to have her poisoned, the Crown Prince had stopped her.

The Empress observed her expression, a hint of disdain flickering in her eyes.

"You’re not a celestial beauty, so don’t think about competing with those songbirds and swallows for favor. The Crown Prince has been married for two years without an heir. There’s already talk outside. He needs a child now, and you must not interfere. If he cannot ascend to the throne, what use are you? Do you understand my words?"

"This daughter will heed Mother’s teachings."

The Empress, having said all she needed to, rose to leave the Eastern Palace.

After stepping outside, a female official beside her whispered, "Your Majesty, if you wish to protect this child, should we send someone to attend to Zhuo Xun?"

The Empress’s brows revealed a hint of fatigue.

"If I send someone to attend to her, that girl Ruoshuang will surely inform her brother, causing unnecessary trouble."

When the old Duke of Zhen Guo was alive, he had always considered the bigger picture. Now, the duke’s residence was managed by her brother, who prioritized his own children over his sister.

Back then, to help Ruoshuang secure her position in the Eastern Palace, her brother had pressured the Empress into expelling Cui Yichu from the palace.

The Empress, to gain her brother’s support in training private troops for the Crown Prince, had no choice but to agree.

If her brother had been more farsighted and kept Cui Yichu as a concubine, even if Jiang Ruoshuang had to endure some hardship now, the Crown Prince would have the backing of two great ducal families, making his position much more secure.

Once the Crown Prince ascended the throne and held power, would he still protect outsiders?

"Your Majesty, the Crown Princess doesn’t seem like the type to endure this silently."

"Zhuo Huaiyue may appear gentle and weak, but she’s not foolish. She even knows to request a trusted person from the Marquis’s residence to serve her. If she can successfully give birth to a son, it will prove the child is destined to live, and I will naturally take care of them."

chapters.title: The Soft Persimmon
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou had been much busier since becoming the commander of the Brocade Guard than when he was in the Secretariat.

The Hou residence was in turmoil over Ziyan being taken away, yet he didn’t return to Honghui Hall until late at night.

After his bath, Yuhan handed him a soft towel to dry his hair.

"Today, an eunuch from the Eastern Palace came to the Hou residence and took Ziyan away. He said there was good news in the Eastern Palace, but I don’t know what it’s about."

Zhao Xuanyou’s sword-like brows furrowed tightly, and anger immediately clouded his face.

The Crown Prince Zhao Zun had been coming to the Hou residence every other day to pick a fight. Did he really take him for a soft persimmon to squeeze?

Yuhan asked softly, "My lord, what good news is there in the Eastern Palace?"

She was both curious and worried about Ziyan.

"Zhuang Huaiyue is with child."

"She’s been in the Eastern Palace for only two months and is already pregnant. That is indeed joyous news." Yuhan knew that Zhuang Huaiyue had always wanted to clear her father’s name, and entering the Eastern Palace was part of her plan. A flicker of understanding passed through her eyes. "Taking Ziyan to the Eastern Palace probably wasn’t the Crown Prince’s idea, but hers."

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement.

He didn’t care about Zhuang Huaiyue’s affairs, but the Crown Prince taking two maids from the Jingyuan Hou residence was going too far.

"Zhuang Zhaoxun went to the Eastern Palace alone and had no trusted aides by her side. Now that she’s pregnant, she has to be careful."

Zhao Xuanyou sneered coldly, "How can she and her mother-in-law, the Empress and Jiang Rufrost, possibly resist the pressure in the Eastern Palace?"

"Surely the Crown Prince will protect her? He has no children yet. Whether the child is a boy or a girl, it will be to his advantage."

"If he could make decisions, would Cui Yichu be causing trouble in the Hou residence?"

That was true.

The Crown Prince wasn’t deeply in love with Cui Yichu, but they had once been fond of each other. If the Crown Prince could make decisions, Cui Yichu would at least have become a concubine instead of marrying into the Jingyuan Hou residence in disgrace, which had caused so much trouble.

"It seems Zhuang Zhaoxun will have a hard time ahead."

Seeing Yuhan’s concern, Zhao Xuanyou paused for a moment before saying slowly, "If she’s smart enough to gain the Empress’s favor, she might find a way to survive."

The Empress was surnamed Jiang, but she was also the Crown Prince’s birth mother. The child in Huaiyue’s womb would call her Imperial Grandmother.

If Huaiyue could evoke the Empress’s affection for her grandchild, she might be able to give birth safely.

As they spoke, Zhao Xuanyou’s hair was already dry.

Yuhan put down the towel and turned to fetch his nightclothes. Glancing at his well-built body, she asked, "My lord, are you going to wear these?"

He had come back so late tonight. Normally, by this time, they would already be together, so there was no need for nightclothes.

Zhao Xuanyou took the nightclothes from her hand without a word and put them on by himself.

It seemed he wouldn’t be doing that tonight.

Yuhan couldn’t help but smirk.

The Brocade Guard’s affairs were indeed busy, even exhausting Zhao Xuanyou to the point of collapsing into bed.

That was fine. He left early and returned late, busy with official duties, so he had no mind to pay attention to her movements. This was greatly beneficial to her plans.

Yuhan said nothing, but Zhao Xuanyou caught a glimpse of her smile out of the corner of his eye.

"What are you smiling about?"

Yuhan quickly composed herself and softly replied, "I’m not smiling about anything."

Zhao Xuanyou had only put on half of his nightclothes, holding the pants in his hand, and stared at her with a dark expression. "You’re usually unhappy when I come more often, but now you’re unhappy when I skip a night. You’ve been pretending well."

She hastily explained, "My lord, I didn’t mean it that way. I just thought of something funny."

Before she could finish, Zhao Xuanyou threw the pants aside and pulled Yuhan into his arms.

"I’m not too tired; it’s just that I have to handle business early tomorrow morning, so I wanted to sleep early. If you really want to, we can make it quick."

This misunderstanding was huge.

Yuhan knew she couldn’t explain it clearly, so she had no choice but to close her eyes and let him have his way.

However, the next day, Zhao Xuanyou did indeed leave before dawn, and no one knew what official business he had to attend to.

Yuhan slept in, ate breakfast, and then left the residence.

After being cooped up in the Hou residence for nearly a month, she had finally gotten a day of rest.

Yuhan bought some snacks on the street, hired a carriage, and went to the separate courtyard. Soon, the gatekeeper let her in.

"Mother." As soon as Yuhan entered, she walked toward the couch, but there was no one there.

Just as she was about to call out again, she heard Ding Wenxi’s voice from the side.

"I’m over here."

Yuhan turned her head and saw Ding Wenxi sitting by the window, painting with a brush.

It had been a month since they last met, and Ding Wenxi’s complexion had improved a lot. Her once gaunt, bony face had filled out slightly.

Seeing that she was indeed recovering, Yuhan’s eyes immediately welled up with tears, and she rushed into Ding Wenxi’s arms.

"You child, be careful not to get ink on your clothes." Ding Wenxi held her with one arm while putting down the brush with the other. "You usually act so mature in speech and manner, but when you throw a tantrum, you’re just like you were as a child."

Yuhan nuzzled in Ding Wenxi’s arms for a while before lifting her head and reaching out to touch Ding Wenxi’s cheek.

In the past, when Ding Wenxi was in a coma, her face had felt like nothing but bones. Now, being able to feel the soft warmth of her face, Yuhan couldn’t help but feel a sting in her nose.

"Since moving here, I take a walk in the garden every day and eat more. That’s why I’ve recovered so quickly. You don’t need to worry about me."

"Mmm." Yuhan nodded hard, then looked at what Ding Wenxi was drawing. "This hairpin is really beautiful."

Ding Wenxi smiled. "I’ve been drawing a lot in my free time. Some of them can be made, and some can’t. When I have time in the future, I’ll try to make a few for you."

"Okay. Then you should keep these designs safe. Don’t forget to take them when we leave."

Hearing Yuhan mention "leaving," Ding Wenxi said, "You mentioned those two guards have been staying in the separate courtyard for over half a month. Do you want to see them?"

Of course. Today, Yuhan had come out not only to visit Ding Wenxi but also to meet Yangquan and Bingyun.

They had successfully entered the separate courtyard as guards, which made things much more convenient.

Yuhan immediately went out and had a maid call them over to a side room for tea.

"Miss Yuhan, the residence in the outskirts of the capital that you asked us to find has been arranged."

Yuhan’s eyes swept over the two of them before getting straight to the point. "Between the two of you, whose lightness skill is better?"

"Bingyun’s lightness skill is better," Yangquan said.

"Good. On New Year’s Eve, Yangquan, you take my mother to that courtyard to settle down early in the morning. Bingyun, you stay in the separate courtyard and follow my orders."

"Yes." Both of them answered crisply. "Does Miss have any other orders?"

" The place in the outskirts is just a temporary stop. You should also prepare a few fast horses so we can leave immediately after we meet up."

"Yes."

Of course, this was far from enough.

Yuhan had too many things to do. She needed to enter the Xingguo Duke’s residence to take revenge on Cui Yichu. She needed to escape from under Zhao Xuanyou’s nose undetected. Each of these tasks required a lot of planning.

Fortunately, there were still two months left. With Yangquan and Bingyun’s help, there was enough time to prepare.

"You remember, there are a few more things that need to be done as soon as possible."

---

chapters.title: Reluctant to Part
chapters.content:
After taking office as the commander of the Brocade Guard, Zhao Xuanyou handled two major cases in succession, earning the recognition of his subordinates and silencing the court officials who had questioned the Emperor’s favoritism toward him.

As a result, he was kept busy until the New Year.

Feng Jirou’s parents arrived in the capital in the twelfth lunar month, and the Hou residence became lively with more people around.

As soon as the future in-laws arrived in the capital, they discussed the wedding date with Old Lady Ye.

Old Lady Ye hoped that the new bride would help Zhao Xuanyou have children soon so she could have a great-grandchild. Feng Jirou’s family hoped to receive the betrothal gifts and formally become relatives with the Hou family as soon as possible. Both sides agreed without prior consultation and wanted to set the wedding date as early as possible. After consulting a fortune teller to match their horoscopes, they found an auspicious day before the Spring Equinox and set the wedding for that day.

Since this was Zhao Xuanyou’s second marriage, there was no need for a grand ceremony. With two months to prepare, it was more than enough time.

The Hou family owned many properties in the capital. Old Lady Ye had the in-laws choose one as a betrothal gift, arranged for people to clean and tidy it up, and said that after the New Year, their family could move in. Feng Jirou would then depart from there in her wedding sedan on her wedding day.

With the marriage settled, the Feng family was overjoyed. Although they knew Zhao Xuanyou had a beautiful concubine by his side, they did not show the slightest displeasure in front of Old Lady Ye. They even said that after the concubine was officially recognized, she could help Feng Jirou manage the household. However, during a casual greeting with Yuhan in the residence, they subtly hinted at their displeasure.

Yuhan had no time to pay attention to them. Coincidentally, Honghui Hall was Zhao Xuanyou’s study, and no one was allowed to enter or exit freely.

Although she knew Old Lady Ye had always wanted her to move out of Honghui Hall, Zhao Xuanyou had been so busy that his feet barely touched the ground. Yuhan pretended not to know and refused to budge.

Anyway, she was leaving on New Year’s Eve. What did it matter who was happy or not?

Outside, the cold was biting, but Honghui Hall was warm all day with heated floors. Yuhan didn’t have to do any chores. She just stayed in the room reading and practicing calligraphy, which was quite enjoyable.

Yuhan repeatedly rehearsed her plan in her mind, afraid of any oversight.

It wasn’t until Yangquan and Bingyun successively brought good news, saying that all the tasks she had assigned were completed, that she finally felt a little at ease.

However, there was still one thing weighing on Yuhan’s mind... She sat in Honghui Hall, counting the days on her fingers, waiting for the right moment. It wasn’t until the 29th of the twelfth lunar month that Zhao Xuanyou finally stayed at the residence, saying that the Emperor, considering his hard work over the past few months, had allowed him to take an early New Year break.

Old Lady Ye was delighted and suggested that Zhao Xuanyou take his uncle, aunt, and Feng Jirou out for a stroll in the capital. However, Zhao Xuanyou said he wanted to rest and would take them out during the first lunar month.

He had accompanied the elders in Leshou Hall for a while, drinking tea, before returning to Honghui Hall.

He wasn’t making excuses. He had indeed been busy for a long time and wanted to enjoy a brief moment of leisure.

Honghui Hall had idle books, hot tea, warm floors, and, of course, Yuhan.

He sat in an armchair flipping through a book while Yuhan made a pot of fragrant tea and presented a plate of hot chestnuts.

"Where did these come from?" Zhao Xuanyou glanced at them and asked.

"Yingxue and Qiuyue got a bag of chestnuts in the kitchen and roasted them in the stove in the corridor. I smelled the fragrance and snatched a handful to bring here. Would my lord like to try some?"

With Ziyan in the Eastern Palace and Yuhan about to be officially recognized as a concubine, Manager Song had selected two more maids for Honghui Hall: Qiuyue and Chun Xing. They were both learning from Yingxue.

"Chestnuts?"

Zhao Xuanyou rarely ate such small snacks, but since Yuhan had brought them specially, he condescended to pick one up.

With his great strength, he easily cracked the chestnut open with his thumb.

"My lord is truly amazing." Yuhan also loved roasted chestnuts, but she couldn’t crack them skillfully and was too embarrassed to eat the ones Yingxue and the others had painstakingly peeled. So she had to endure the craving.

"What’s so difficult about this?" Zhao Xuanyou didn’t understand Yuhan’s surprise. "Do you want to eat some?"

Yuhan nodded. "Yes, but I can’t peel them."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft laugh and cracked all the chestnuts in the plate with a series of pops.

"Thank you, Young Master." Yuhan happily picked up a chestnut kernel.

It was warm, sweet, and soft, and she didn’t have to peel it herself. It was indeed delicious.

Watching Yuhan’s satisfied expression, Zhao Xuanyou unconsciously curved the corners of his mouth and lowered his head to continue reading.

After eating a few chestnuts, Yuhan stood by the desk, quietly watching Zhao Xuanyou.

It was already the 29th of the twelfth lunar month. Tomorrow morning, she would leave the Hou residence.

When she had decided to leave, there were still three months until New Year’s Eve. Who would have thought that Zhao Xuanyou would be so busy that, in the blink of an eye, it was already the New Year, and he had only now found some free time.

Sensing Yuhan’s gaze, Zhao Xuanyou looked up. "Is there something else?"

"Earlier, my lord mentioned that the Ningguo Duke’s residence has a plum garden in the outskirts of the capital. I think the plum blossoms must be in full bloom this time of year."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyebrows twitched slightly as he recalled that he had indeed promised to take her to see the plum blossoms in the snow.

Although there was no snow today, a heavy snowfall had blanketed the capital a few days ago, so the plum garden should still be beautiful.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou didn’t respond, Yuhan asked softly, "Can we go today?"

Zhao Xuanyou had been running around nonstop for nearly three months and indeed wanted to stay in Honghui Hall longer.

Moreover, he had just declined Old Lady Ye’s suggestion to take his uncle’s family out. If he took Yuhan out now, it might displease the old lady.

Yuhan, unaware of what had happened in Leshou Hall, fixed her clear, expectant eyes on him, waiting for his answer.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yuhan’s hopeful gaze and felt a pang of cruelty. He had to look away.

"The plum garden belongs to the Ningguo Duke’s residence. It would be rude to go there uninvited. I’ll have Yuan Cui send a note to ask for permission. We can go and visit in the first lunar month."

What he said made sense.

It was someone else’s garden. They couldn’t just go and visit whenever they pleased. They had to inform the owner in advance.

But Yuhan didn’t really want to go to the plum garden.

"It’s fine if we don’t go to the plum garden. The outskirts of the capital are so vast. My lord can take me horseback riding anywhere. Doesn’t the Hou residence have several manors? It would be great if there are plum trees, but it’s fine if there aren’t."

"Why are you so eager to go out today?"

If she didn’t go out today, there would be no more chances in the future.

Although their relationship wasn’t mutual love, they had spent many nights together, sharing intimacy and affection.

No one was made of wood or stone. How could she not feel some attachment after sleeping together every night?

Zhao Xuanyou had personally taught her to ride a horse. If they could ride together today, it would be a proper farewell.

Yuhan pursed her lips. "My lord promised."

She spoke softly, her tone carrying a hint of grievance.

Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t sit still when he saw her like this. He threw down the book in his hand, stood up, and walked over to her. Lowering his head, he said, "I didn’t say we wouldn’t go. We’ll go after we get a reply from the Ningguo Duke’s residence."

"But I’m returning to the separate courtyard tomorrow."

"It won’t take me half an hour to go from the residence to pick you up."

"Once I’m at the separate courtyard, I’ll have to spend time with my mother for the New Year. I won’t be going out." Yuhan gently tugged at his clothes and said softly, "My lord is now the commander of the Brocade Guard. You leave early and return late every day. We barely get to talk."

"I don’t get to talk much with others, but I talk plenty with you."

Yuhan forced a smile. When she looked up again, her tone was clearly more aggrieved. "My lord’s marriage to Miss Feng is set for March. After the New Year, you’ll probably be busy with wedding preparations."

Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly.

Old Lady Ye was advanced in years and couldn’t handle many things.

Recently, because Zhao Xuanyou had been so busy, many matters regarding the wedding hadn’t been discussed yet.

Moreover, Old Lady Ye had previously mentioned selecting a separate courtyard for Yuhan to move into as a concubine. Although it was a good thing, it also meant she would have to leave Honghui Hall.

"Do you really want to go horseback riding?"

After saying so much and nagging for so long, he was still asking.

They truly had no fate together.

"I don’t want to go." Yuhan threw down these words harshly and turned to leave.

"Quite the temper you have."

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow, watching her back as she walked away. He suddenly grabbed her wrist.

chapters.title: No Going Back on Your Word
chapters.content:
"Father said he doesn’t want to go, so I don’t want to either. How can this be considered throwing a tantrum?" Yu Wan regained her usual coquettish demeanor, her tone calm once more.

Zhao Xuanyou pulled her into his arms and sat back down with her on the armchair.

"I didn’t say I don’t want to go, just that we’ll go in a few days. We’ll go the day it snows."

At this point, Yu Wan wouldn’t press further. She simply nodded obediently.

Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes, noticing the insincerity in her smile. He tapped the armrest of the chair twice with his fingers. "Are you going to the separate courtyard tomorrow?"

Yu Wan softly hummed in agreement, wanting to rise from his embrace.

"Father has reminded me; I still haven’t finished packing the things to bring back."

"What’s there to pack for just a few days?" Zhao Xuanyou said casually.

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered. She smiled brightly. "Who said there’s nothing? Earlier, I asked Yingxue’s mother to help buy many New Year goods from old, famous shops in the capital; food, clothes, and daily necessities. I need to sort through them all carefully."

With the New Year approaching, the various estates of the Marquis’s mansion had also sent their New Year gifts. But Zhao Xuanyou had no time to attend to them, so he left everything to Manager Song.

Naturally, for her mother’s first New Year in the capital, Yu Wan should show some gesture.

"If you bought so many New Year goods, you must have spent a lot of silver. Let me give you some to cover the costs. You and your mother should have a good New Year in the capital."

"Really?" Yu Wan looked at Zhao Xuanyou joyfully, leaning closer. "How big of a red envelope will Father give me?"

Zhao Xuanyou knew she was greedy for money. He raised an eyebrow. "How big of a red envelope do you want?"

Yu Wan said, "As the saying goes, the more skills one has, the better. Naturally, the bigger the red envelope, the better."

"You’re quite bold."

"If Father offered, and I asked for a small one, wouldn’t that be disrespectful to Father?"

At the mention of money, Yu Wan’s expression indeed lit up.

Zhao Xuanyou pressed his lips together. "The red envelope will be on the table tomorrow. You’ll see it then."

Tomorrow was New Year’s Eve. One night spans two years, and the fifth watch divides two days. The Marquis’s mansion would offer a grand sacrifice to the ancestors, and as the heir, Zhao Xuanyou would be busy from early morning. He would also have to stay up all night to welcome the New Year.

After a pause, Zhao Xuanyou said, "Since you’ve bought so many things, Yuan Zui will drive the carriage to take you back tomorrow."

"That’s wonderful." Yu Wan was delighted. She tilted her head and kissed his cheek.

Before Zhao Xuanyou could say anything else, she stood up and went to her partitioned room.

Honghui Hall was relatively quiet that day. In the depths of winter, night fell early. When Mama Xing came to Honghui Hall to invite Zhao Xuanyou for dinner, the entire mansion had already lit its lanterns.

As Zhao Xuanyou changed his clothes and stepped out, snow suddenly began to fall from the sky.

Yu Wan went inside to fetch a crane cloak for Zhao Xuanyou and draped it over him. Standing under the corridor, she couldn’t help but look up at the sky.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head to look at her. His heart softened, and he reached out to tap her nose.

"Don’t drool over it. We’ll go in a couple of days."

"It was Father who said that." Yu Wan lifted her chin, then lowered her head to remind him, "If you go back on your word again, just giving me one red envelope won’t be enough."

"Then I’ll give you two?"

Yu Wan seemed annoyed. She lightly punched his chest. "Anyway, Father is the master. You can do whatever you want. This servant has no choice."

Zhao Xuanyou listened to her words. He sighed as if in helplessness. "We will definitely go in the first month. I won’t change my mind again."

"It has to be when it’s snowing." Yu Wan emphasized, "Red plum blossoms in the snow; just thinking about it is beautiful."

Zhao Xuanyou nodded. "When it snows, we will go."

"Even if the Old Dowager forbids it, we still go?"

Hearing the teasing in Yu Wan’s tone, Zhao Xuanyou lightly coughed. "Even if the Old Dowager forbids it, we still go. No one can stop us."

Yu Wan seemed appeased by his words. She nodded along with him, but her gaze still held doubt.

"Not just this time. In the years to come, we’ll go every year. Is that okay?"

"Alright, we’ll go every year."

Yu Wan heard his reply. The corners of her lips twitched slightly, but her smile faded abruptly.

She stared at Zhao Xuanyou, gripping his crane cloak as she spoke again.

"Only take me. No one else."

The lanterns in the corridor cast a soft glow over her. Yu Wan rarely wore makeup in Honghui Hall, but even without powder or rouge, her face was still striking; bright eyes and white teeth, the picture of charm.

She stood before Zhao Xuanyou, her gaze calm, yet her eyes sparkled with countless lights.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her. It felt as if his heartbeat had skipped a beat in that instant.

Yu Wan had been by his side for a long time. She had always been accommodating and gentle, giving him whatever he wanted. Even when they bickered, she would stop after a word or two.

In Zhao Xuanyou’s mind, Yu Wan treated him with deliberate flattery.

He was the master, she was the maidservant, so she kept her posture low.

Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t say he was dissatisfied with her attitude, nor could he say he liked it.

Yu Wan was just a maidservant in the Marquis’s mansion, so naturally, she would cater to him like this.

If she served another master, she would naturally adopt the same posture.

This was the way of survival for a maidservant. Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t criticize her for it, but it did make him somewhat uncomfortable.

But now, Yu Wan had made a request of him; not only did she want him to accompany her every year to ride horses and admire the plum blossoms, but she also forbade him from bringing other women. This was a subtle difference from her previous attitude.

The snow in the sky fell heavier, rustling as it landed in the courtyard.

Accompanied by the sound of falling snow, Zhao Xuanyou was unexpectedly immersed in the moment. He reached out and pulled Yu Wan into his arms.

The servants in Honghui Hall were used to their closeness. Each one kept their eyes forward, their expressions calm. Only Mama Xing, standing at the gate of the courtyard, was shocked and averted her gaze.

Zhao Xuanyou’s emotions were still unsettled, like a string plucked by a musician, trembling ceaselessly.

"I understand," his deep voice rang in Yu Wan’s ear. "I’ll only go with you. No one else."

With his answer, a smile finally appeared in Yu Wan’s eyes.

"Father, go to Leshou Hall for dinner. Don’t keep the Old Dowager waiting. She won’t even let you out of the house during the first month."

Zhao Xuanyou heard her reminder. He restrained the surrender in his heart and regained his usual composed demeanor, releasing her.

He lightly nodded. "Tomorrow is New Year’s Eve. There are still many things to arrange in the mansion tonight. I’ll probably return late. You need to leave early tomorrow, so go to bed early tonight."

These words were considerate of Yu Wan. She said, "Thank you, Father."

Zhao Xuanyou touched her icy hands, his gaze darkening.

Earlier, when she had rushed out to hand him the crane cloak, Yu Wan hadn’t put on her padded jacket. The cold wind in the corridor had dispersed the warmth from her body, leaving her face and hands ice-cold.

"Stay inside."

With that, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t linger. His crane cloak swayed slightly as he turned and left.

Yu Wan didn’t go inside. She stood in the corridor, quietly watching Zhao Xuanyou’s departing figure. A strange feeling arose in her heart.

Zhao Xuanyou would return late tonight and be even busier tomorrow. By all rights, this moment was the last they would spend together. The words "Stay inside" were the last words they would say to each other tonight; perhaps even the last words in this life.

Facing an imminent farewell, when Zhao Xuanyou had refused to leave the capital to ride in the snow and admire the plum blossoms, Yu Wan had felt a pang of loss, but then she felt a weight lift from her shoulders.

Watching Zhao Xuanyou’s retreating figure, Yu Wan’s heart was unusually calm.

No, not calm.

Yu Wan could feel her heart beating very fast. Thinking about what would happen tomorrow, her entire body seemed to boil with excitement. Even standing in the corridor in her thin clothes, she didn’t feel the cold at all.

She looked at the heavy snowfall and let out a soft sigh.

She really hoped tomorrow would come quickly.

---

chapters.title: Playing the Full Part
chapters.content:
Yu Wan slept very soundly that night. When she woke up in the morning, Honghui Hall was indeed empty.

"Since you’re up, Sister, wash your face first." Yingxue, who was under the corridor, heard the movement and brought a basin of water into the room.

Ever since Zhao Xuanyou had ordered Yu Wan to stop working, everyone knew that Yu Wan would soon become a concubine in the mansion; and a favored one at that. Naturally, they couldn’t interact with her as they had before.

Yingxue, of course, had adjusted her attitude. She was very respectful to Yu Wan, though her words were slightly distant.

Yu Wan was leaving soon, so there was no need to dwell on these things.

She took the soft towel Yingxue handed her, wiped her face, and asked, "What time did Father leave this morning?"

"At the Mao hour, he went to the ancestral hall."

On New Year’s Eve, the Marquis’s mansion would make a grand offering. The entire clan would gather, and since the Marquis of Jingyuan was not in the capital, the heir, Zhao Xuanyou, naturally had to take on the heavy responsibility.

"Father returned late last night and got up so early this morning. Tonight, he has to stay up all night. Have someone prepare some soup to refresh his mind."

Yingxue smiled. "Sister, you’re going home for New Year today, and you’re still thinking about Father."

Yu Wan said nothing, only giving a faint smile.

Acting required full commitment. Just like last night, when she had held Zhao Xuanyou in the corridor and said those things, since she had decided to fake her death and leave, she naturally couldn’t let others see through her.

"Sister, go get dressed first. I’ll have Qiuyue go to the kitchen to bring breakfast."

Zhao Xuanyou had woken up too early. After he finished eating, the table was cleared. If Yu Wan wanted to eat, she would have to get a fresh portion from the kitchen.

Yu Wan didn’t refuse. She waited for Yingxue to leave, then glanced at the red envelope on the table.

It was the one Zhao Xuanyou had promised last night.

Yu Wan opened the red envelope. Inside was a 200-tael silver note. The corners of her lips lifted slightly.

She didn’t know how much silver she would need for this departure. The more she had on hand, the better.

She took the silver note back to the inner room, then checked the packed trunks again. When she heard Yingxue say that breakfast was ready, she walked out.

Yu Wan ate her breakfast unhurriedly. When Yuan Zui said the carriage was ready, she called for help to carry the trunks out.

Before stepping into the green-canopied carriage, Yu Wan turned back to look at the Marquis’s mansion.

In two lifetimes combined, she had spent less than a year in the Marquis of Jingyuan’s mansion. Yet her fate and circumstances were closely tied to this place.

In her past life, she had died because of Zhao Xuanyou. In this life...

Yu Wan curved her lips. Faking her death was also a way to achieve the same end.

She withdrew her thoughts and boarded the carriage directly. Half an hour later, the carriage stopped in front of the separate courtyard.

"Yu Wan, you’re back."

As soon as she stepped out of the carriage, she saw Chen Da Niu coming out to greet her, which surprised her.

She had told him to return to his hometown early for New Year. Why was he still in the capital?

With Yuan Zui beside her, Yu Wan quickly composed herself. She softly said, "Brother Da Niu, the carriage is full of New Year goods I bought. Please help carry them inside."

"Alright."

Chen Da Niu helped Yuan Zui lift the three trunks out of the carriage. When Yuan Zui was about to carry them into the mansion, Yu Wan said, "The Marquis’s mansion has so many guests today. Yuan Qing might not be able to handle it all. You should go back quickly to help Father."

Indeed, there was a lot to do at the mansion. Yuan Zui knew that Yu Wan had hired guards at the separate courtyard, so he didn’t stand on ceremony. He cupped his hands to Yu Wan. "Happy New Year. I’ll return to the mansion first. Father ordered that if there’s anything you need, send someone to the mansion to find me."

Naturally, Yuan Zui’s attitude toward Yu Wan, the soon-to-be concubine, was different.

"Happy New Year. Thank you for your trouble." Yu Wan said faintly. Yuan Zui then drove the carriage away.

After he had left, Yangquan and Bingyun came out of the house to help carry the things inside.

After walking a distance, Yu Wan asked, "Brother Da Niu, why didn’t you go back to your hometown?"

"Your mother said you’d be coming back for New Year and would need people around. She told me to finish this busy period first, then return in the spring."

It was Mother’s idea.

Yu Wan was surprised but didn’t say much. She quickly went to Ding Wenxi’s room.

At this moment, Ding Wenxi was also anxiously waiting for Yu Wan in her room. When she saw her, she hurried forward.

Seeing that Ding Wenxi’s complexion was better than when she had returned last month, Yu Wan’s worried expression relaxed slightly.

But there was no time to ask about her health now.

"Mother." Yu Wan pulled Ding Wenxi into the room and closed the door behind them. "Why did you keep Brother Da Niu here? We’re taking action today. Having him in the capital might cause trouble."

Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Wan, frowning as she shook her head.

"Child, there’s a flaw in your plan."

Yu Wan slightly furrowed her brows, looking at Ding Wenxi in confusion.

"You don’t want the heir to look for you, so you want to ‘die’ in the capital. But if you ‘die,’ and I disappear at the same time, how can he not look for me?"

"Yangquan has already found a corpse at the charity cemetery to serve as Mother’s substitute."

Ding Wenxi naturally knew about Yu Wan’s "arrangements" for her, but she still shook her head. "If something happens to you, it would make sense for me to die of rage. But the corpse Yangquan found had already been dead for several days. The timing doesn’t match at all."

This was indeed a problem. Yu Wan thought for a moment, then said, "Yangquan has already contacted the charity cemetery. She can buy another corpse that was delivered in the past two days. Then it will be foolproof."

Zhao Xuanyou had only seen Ding Wenxi once, late at night, when she was gravely ill. He probably didn’t remember her appearance clearly.

Moreover, Ding Wenxi had been resting for several months, and her complexion had long since recovered. Her face had also become fuller. She looked completely different from how she had been at Yunchui Nunnery. It should be enough to deceive everyone.

But Ding Wenxi reminded her, "Don’t forget, he is the commander of the Brocade Guards. He has the most capable investigators in the court under him. If you and I, mother and daughter, both meet with misfortune at the same time, he could casually send a Brocade Guard to investigate, and they might uncover the truth."

"Then what does Mother suggest?"

"I need to stay in the capital."

"No!" Yu Wan firmly opposed.

The whole reason for leaving the capital was to conceal her mother’s identity. After all this effort, how could she fake her death and leave, only to have her mother stay in the capital to cover for her?

Ding Wenxi patted Yu Wan’s hand. "Don’t worry. I’ve already thought it through. Since you’re going to be ‘captured’ by Cui Yichu’s men and taken to the Duke’s mansion today, naturally, there needs to be a familiar person to witness it. When you truly ‘die,’ there must be a close relative who is heartbroken to make it believable."

"But... how can I bear to leave Mother alone here?"

Seeing the concern in Yu Wan’s eyes, Ding Wenxi gently cupped her face. "Rest assured. If I could escape from the palace all those years ago, I can escape from the capital now."

Moreover, back then, she had left only to seek freedom. Now, for Yu Wan’s sake, her resolve was even stronger. Naturally, she would only allow success, not failure.

"I’ll just have to act out the part of a grieving mother in the capital. I won’t have to do anything else. I doubt the heir will make things difficult for me. Once he accepts the news of your death, I’ll leave the capital to meet up with you. With Yangquan protecting me, there won’t be any problems."

Yu Wan’s heart felt as if it were being tightly gripped, aching unbearably.

She had considered her mother’s words before. But her mother’s identity was special. She had to send her mother out of the capital first before she could be at ease.

Looking at Ding Wenxi’s worried yet determined gaze, Yu Wan took a deep breath.

"Alright, we’ll do it Mother’s way."

chapters.title: Making Dumplings
chapters.content:
When Ding Wenxi heard Yu Yuan agree, he let out a sigh of relief and said softly, "I just delayed my departure from the capital, there's nothing to worry about. It's you I'm concerned about..."

"There's nothing to worry about on my end either. Bingyun has excellent lightness skills, and I've also found another top expert to help. With the two of them accompanying me to Xingguo Duke's Mansion, nothing will go wrong."

Bingyun was Zhao Qi's subordinate, and Wen Qiao was the Crown Prince's secret guard. Both were experts who could rival the imperial guards.

How could they not even make it to Xingguo Duke's Mansion?

Because her mother wanted to change the plan, Yu Yuan had an idea.

"Mother, since you've decided to leave the capital later, why not see if we can sell this house? The deed is at the very bottom of your dowry chest."

She had spent a lot of silver recently, and with the New Year's red envelope from Zhao Xuanyou today, she still had over three hundred taels of silver.

It wasn't a small amount, but it wasn't a lot either.

Although this courtyard wasn't large, land in the capital was expensive, and it had been specially renovated by Jingyuan Marquis, with carved beams and painted buildings, exquisitely beautiful. Selling it for over a thousand taels of silver wouldn't be a problem.

In the eyes of others, the only daughter had died, and the mother, heartbroken, wanted to sell the house and leave the capital, which was reasonable.

"Alright, I'll remember that."

"You must be careful not to provoke Zhao Xuanyou."

Although the deed was in hand, the house was after all related to Jingyuan Marquis and his wife, so Zhao Xuanyou might care.

"I will act according to the situation," Ding Wenxi looked at Yu Yuan, unable to help but reach out to touch her head. "We can't spend New Year's Eve together tonight, so let's have a good lunch, just like a reunion dinner."

Ding Wenxi had been in a coma for so long, and the last time mother and daughter had a reunion dinner was three years ago.

"You go arrange tonight's matters, I'll go to the kitchen to make pork and cabbage dumplings for you. I also brewed some Tusu wine some time ago. It's not suitable to drink too much today, but a small sip should be fine."

Yu Yuan's alcohol tolerance wasn't good, so she smiled and said, "Alright, but I'll eat more dumplings. I can only have a taste of the wine."

With that, Ding Wenxi went to the kitchen.

She had done farm work in the village for more than ten years, so her physical condition was originally good.

Although she had lost a lot of vitality during her two-year coma, she had been resting peacefully in the courtyard for the past few months, nourished by various precious medicines and tonics. Although she wasn't as good as before, she had recovered about seventy to eighty percent.

Seeing her mother as efficient and capable as before, and able to advise her, Yu Yuan's eyes welled up slightly.

No matter what, she had finally survived until her mother woke up.

Once they successfully left the capital, mother and daughter could live as they used to... No, they would live even better than before.

Yu Yuan took a deep breath, suppressing her emotions, and called Bingyun and Yangquan in.

"Miss Yu Yuan." After closing the door, both of them cupped their hands together towards Yu Yuan.

"Has anything happened in the courtyard these days?" Her voice was gentle, but her gaze was firm.

Bingyun and Yangquan had initially been ordered to wait for her at Yunlai Inn. At first, they didn't think it would be a difficult task; it was just about ensuring her safety.

However, Yu Yuan's instructions, one after another, were truly beyond their expectations.

But although those instructions were bold, when strung together, they weren't far-fetched.

As they carried out each task, Bingyun and Yangquan's admiration for Yu Yuan grew.

"Miss, rest assured, nothing unusual has happened."

"I have a change of plan," Yu Yuan nodded. "Today, I temporarily changed the plan."

Changed the plan?

Bingyun and Yangquan exchanged a glance, looking at Yu Yuan in confusion.

"It's not that we're not doing it. Bingyun and I will proceed as usual at Xingguo Duke's Mansion, but my mother will not leave the capital for the time being. Yangquan, you stay in the capital to look after my mother. Put her safety first in everything, and wait until things settle down before sending her out of the city."

"And the corpse at the charity cemetery?" Yangquan asked.

"The one prepared for my mother is no longer needed." After a pause, Yu Yuan looked at Bingyun. "Tonight, I also found a lightness skill expert to help. You go out of the mansion now to find him. If he's willing to come here, that's best. If he's not willing to come with you, have him wait for us at the side gate of Xingguo Duke's Mansion near Liuye Hutong at Xu time (7-9 PM)."

Yu Yuan had studied the overall layout map of Xingguo Duke's Mansion countless times and had already come up with an excellent route for Wen Qiao.

Entering from that side gate was the closest to both Cui Yi's Yunyuan Courtyard and the mansion's firewood room, making it convenient for Wen Qiao to sneak in and out.

Hearing that Yu Yuan had found help, Bingyun said, "If Miss feels that the manpower is insufficient, we still have brothers stationed in the capital. We can have them come to help."

"No." Yu Yuan shook her head.

Zhao Xuanyou was the commander of the Brocade Guards. If she mobilized too many of Zhao Qi's people at once, it would surely attract attention.

For tonight's task at Xingguo Duke's Mansion, having Bingyun and Wen Qiao with her was already sufficient.

Seeing her determination, Bingyun and Yangquan naturally said no more.

"Bingyun, you go find the person. Yangquan, stay in the mansion and help me prepare the things we need for tonight."

"Yes."

After telling Bingyun where Wen Qiao was staying, Yu Yuan also headed to the kitchen.

To avoid drawing attention, Ding Wenxi had sent the maids who had relatives in the capital back home to celebrate the New Year the day before, leaving only a little maid and Chen Da Niu in the courtyard. They were currently helping with making dumplings.

"Mother, let me help too."

Ding Wenxi smiled, "I'm just short of someone to roll the dough. Da Niu is too slow. You come help me, and we can make them faster."

Calculating, there were six people eating lunch in the courtyard, so they needed to make at least a hundred dumplings.

Yu Yuan took the rolling pin from Chen Da Niu's hand and quickly helped roll out the dumpling wrappers.

Neither mother nor daughter spoke, focusing on coordinating to make dumplings, and in one go, they made two hundred.

"We two have no limit when we start making. Making so many, I'm afraid we won't be able to finish them in one meal."

Chen Da Niu, sitting in front of the stove to start the fire, smiled upon hearing this. "It's okay if we make too many. It snowed heavily last night, and the snow in the courtyard is thick. We can put them in a sieve in the courtyard. Not only can we eat them tonight, but also tomorrow and the day after."

"That's true."

The water in the large iron pot was already boiling. Yu Yuan carried a bamboo sieve over and started putting dumplings in. Just then, Bingyun appeared at the kitchen door.

So fast?

Yu Yuan calmly put a sieve of dumplings into the pot, then put down the sieve and walked out of the kitchen.

"The person has already come with me. He's in my room now." Bingyun said softly.

Wen Qiao was a crucial part of Yu Yuan's plan. Although he had agreed before, he wasn't as reliable as Bingyun and Yangquan and could change his mind at any time.

Yu Yuan had Bingyun bring him over early so that if Wen Qiao changed his mind, there would still be time to rearrange the plan.

"You've worked hard," Yu Yuan's tightly knit brows relaxed slightly as she smiled at Bingyun. "The dumplings in the pot are almost done. You and Yangquan should go set the table and prepare to eat."

"Yes."

Yu Yuan returned to the kitchen and saw Ding Wenxi casting a glance at her, slightly nodding towards her.

The dumplings in the pot began to float up one by one, white and plump, each one looking full and beautiful.

The first pot was cooked, and three plates were served. Soon, the second and third pots were boiled.

When all the dumplings were cooked, Yu Yuan carried the last plate of dumplings. Instead of following the others to the dining hall, she turned and walked in another direction.

---

chapters.title: Repaying Kindness
chapters.content:
"Wen Qiao." Yu Yuan stood at the door and called out.

The door opened, and a young man without a mask appeared before Yu Yuan.

He wore a plain blue robe, looking quite ordinary. His face was unfamiliar to Yu Yuan, but when their eyes met, there was a familiar feeling.

"How come you..." Yu Yuan looked at him in surprise. "No mask?"

She had seen Wen Qiao's true appearance in the Marquis's dungeon before. She remembered that Wen Qiao had a large dark red birthmark on half of his face, which was quite frightening.

Wen Qiao's gaze was not very friendly, but it flickered when he saw the large plate of steaming dumplings in Yu Yuan's hands.

"Wearing a mask during the day is too easy to attract attention, so I changed my appearance."

He didn't stand at the door but turned and went back into the room after saying that.

"I see."

Wen Qiao was naturally ugly, and Yu Yuan understood that he didn't want to talk much about his appearance. She didn't ask more about the disguise, nor did she stare at him. She just placed the dumplings on the table.

"Since we can't have New Year's Eve dinner tonight, let's eat the dumplings while we still have time."

Although there was only one plate of dumplings, Yu Yuan thoughtfully prepared a small dish of vinegar and garlic for him.

"You eat first. I'll come back to collect the bowl later."

Her mother was waiting for her to eat the reunion dinner together, so Yu Yuan didn't say more and went straight to the flower hall.

Sure enough, because she wasn't there, no one had started eating.

When Yu Yuan arrived, Ding Wenxi pulled her to sit beside her. "Everyone was waiting for you. Sit down quickly."

After everyone was seated, Ding Wenxi raised her wine cup. "Today, being able to sit together and eat dumplings is fate. Let's drink a cup together to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new."

The custom of drinking Tusu wine was different from other wines.

For other wines, the elders drank first, but for Tusu wine, it started with the youngest.

Everyone at the table drank the Tusu wine in order of age, then began to eat the dumplings lively, and the room immediately had a festive atmosphere.

After the meal, Yu Yuan helped Ding Wenxi back to their room.

"Did you cut all the window decorations in the courtyard?"

"There was nothing to do while you were away, so I cut some window decorations for decoration."

There was no floor heating in the courtyard, so mother and daughter sat by the charcoal stove. It was a rare moment of family happiness, but thinking about what was about to happen, both had heavy hearts.

"After I leave the capital, will you wait for me at the outskirts of the capital?" After a long while, Ding Wenxi asked.

Yu Yuan nodded.

"Have you decided where we will go?"

"No. We'll take it one step at a time." Yu Yuan said.

The waiting time always seemed exceptionally long. Finally, at Sheng time (3-5 PM), Yu Yuan stood up and walked out. At the door, she turned her head to look at Ding Wenxi, smiled at her, and then quickly left.

"Brother Da Niu." Yu Yuan went straight to find Chen Da Niu, saying that Ding Wenxi had been well taken care of by the nuns at Yunshui Nunnery in the past, so she had prepared many New Year goods to send to Yunshui Nunnery, allowing the nuns to have a good New Year as well.

Chen Da Niu naturally had no reason to refuse and helped to hire a carriage on the street.

Bingyun helped load the New Year goods onto the carriage. After Yu Yuan and Chen Da Niu had walked far away, he and Wen Qiao drove another carriage, following at a distance.

The courtyard was not close to Yunshui Nunnery, and it took nearly half an hour to finally arrive.

After getting off the carriage, Yu Yuan and Chen Da Niu carried the boxes of New Year goods down together.

These things were all purchased by Ding Wenxi. There were cotton quilts and padded jackets, as well as medicines and vegetarian food, all bought from old and reputable shops in the capital, costing a considerable amount.

Years ago, when mother and daughter were at their wit's end, the nuns of Yunshui Nunnery had taken in the unconscious Ding Wenxi in their charity hall and taken care of her for two years.

Although the nunnery lacked medicine, the nuns did their best to help them through the hardest times.

Even if it wasn't for escaping the capital, Yu Yuan and Ding Wenxi had the intention to repay the kindness.

These winter clothes and medicines and food might help another poor mother and daughter get through the difficult times.

Yu Yuan found a familiar nun and handed these things over to them, also giving ten taels of silver as incense money.

Seeing the nuns preparing New Year's Eve dinner for the women taking refuge there, Yu Yuan volunteered to go to the kitchen to help, and had Chen Da Niu go to a teahouse outside to wait.

She worked hard to help wash and pick vegetables. As it was getting dark, a dark shadow darted into the kitchen and silently took her away.

Outside Yunshui Nunnery, Wen Qiao, wearing a conical hat, sat on the carriage waiting.

From a distance, he saw two figures climbing over the wall of Yunshui Nunnery. He slightly furrowed his brows.

Yu Yuan had said that Bingyun's lightness skills were excellent, but with that figure, if it weren't for the dark sky and the fact that it was New Year's Eve with fewer people on the streets, they would have been noticed long ago.

Soon, Bingyun and Yu Yuan got into the carriage. Wen Qiao, expressionless, flicked the whip and drove the carriage slowly away from Yunshui Nunnery.

As soon as she entered the carriage, Yu Yuan saw the human-shaped object in the middle, tightly wrapped in hemp cloth.

"Is this the stand-in you found for me?"

"Yes."

"It smells very bad. Has it been dead for several days?"

Bingyun replied, "It was sent to the charity cemetery four days ago. Miss need not worry. Although it has started to smell, the charity cemetery only had this one corpse that matched Miss's age and height. These two are the most important. After cremation, even an old coroner won't be able to find any problems."

So that was it. Yu Yuan nodded in understanding, feeling a touch of sadness.

The girl who died at sixteen or seventeen must have met with an unnatural death. She was also pitiful.

Although Yu Yuan didn't know her name, after she escaped and ascended to heaven, she would recite the "Rebirth Sutra" several times for her, praying for a wealthy and peaceful next life.

Yu Yuan glanced at the other things in the carriage and asked, "Have you checked all the other things?"

"According to the list Miss provided, I checked them. Yangquan checked once, and I checked again."

Before long, the carriage stopped. This was a place not far from Xingguo Duke's Mansion, where carriage drivers gathered to rest. Yu Yuan had long chosen this as their parking spot.

Wen Qiao no longer needed to drive the carriage, so he also squeezed in.

Yu Yuan took out the overall layout map of Xingguo Duke's Mansion and carefully went over tonight's actions with them. Bingyun had heard this before, but it was the first time for Wen Qiao.

As Wen Qiao listened to Yu Yuan tell him where to enter the mansion, where to go to Yunyuan Courtyard, which direction to take from Yunyuan Courtyard to the firewood room, and finally how to leave from the firewood room, his originally indifferent eyes gradually showed surprise.

"You know Xingguo Duke's Mansion so well. Have you gone in to investigate?"

Wen Qiao was skilled in lightness techniques, and sneaking into places at night was something he often did.

Before other secret guards took action, Wen Qiao would usually scout ahead to find the best route for them.

Yu Yuan could plan so thoroughly only if she had scouted the place before.

Compared to Wen Qiao's surprise, Bingyun had a look of full understanding.

At first, he and Yangquan didn't think much of Yu Yuan's plan, but by now, the only word they had for Yu Yuan was "admiration."

"I figured out the route by looking at the construction map. Bingyun went to investigate, and this route is problem-free." Yu Yuan said softly. "The only trouble is that noble families have many customs. Tonight, they will definitely have New Year's Eve dinner and then stay up late. I don't know when Cui Yichu will be in his room. When you go to Yunyuan Courtyard, you can only act according to the situation."

chapters.title: Infiltration
chapters.content:
Wen Ji frowned and said, "Tonight is New Year's Eve. Cui Yichu is very likely to stay with her family all night and won't return to Qingyun Courtyard at all."

"She will return to Qingyun Courtyard, just not sure when."

Cui Yichu was known for her love of cleanliness and changed her clothes two or three times a day. After a grand family banquet like New Year's Eve, she would definitely return to her room to change.

Wen Ji glanced at the general layout map and pondered for a moment before asking, "Where will the Xingguo Duke's Mansion have their dinner?"

Yu Ying pointed to a room and said, "Here, Guanshan Hall."

The reason why the construction map was useful was that it recorded the purpose of every building in detail.

The Xingguo Duke's Mansion was slightly larger than the Jingyuan Marquis's Mansion, but the functional layout was similar. There were areas for receiving guests, dining, resting... Although Yu Ying had never been to the Xingguo Duke's Mansion, she understood the layout of the Xingguo Duke's Mansion as if she were there after walking around the Marquis's Mansion.

Wen Ji asked, "Then I'll wait for her in Qingyun Courtyard. If I can't wait for her, I'll go to Guanshan Hall to take a look. If there's no opportunity, then so be it."

"I understand." Yu Ying was not worried, "Act according to the situation, no need to take risks."

"And if we don't catch her, you'll just let it go?"

Yu Ying smiled slightly but did not answer.

As Shen Tongyun had said before, although Cui Yichu had returned to the Duke's Mansion to live as a young lady, her state of mind had already changed greatly. She often scolded the servants in Qingyun Courtyard and did not get along well with Shen Tongyun, her new sister-in-law. She only restrained herself slightly in front of the Duke of Xingguo.

Yu Ying understood why she disliked Shen Tongyun.

Both of them came from noble families and were young ladies of the same age. In the past, Cui Yichu had been the most outstanding among the noble ladies due to her beauty, talent, and status as a princess's study companion. Wherever she went, she was the center of attention.

But she failed to become the Crown Princess or even a concubine of the Crown Prince. Her dream of marrying into the Jingyuan Marquis's Mansion also fell through. Now, living in the Duke's Mansion after a peaceful separation, she naturally could not stand the sight of Shen Tongyun's smooth married life.

On New Year's Eve, the Cui family was gathered together. Cui Yichu did not dare to lose her temper in public, so she would not want to stay and would definitely return to Qingyun Courtyard early.

Looking at Yu Ying's determined eyes, Wen Ji said no more.

Bingyun brought a small vanity case from the side and said to Yu Ying, "This is what the young lady asked for."

Yu Ying nodded, sat to the side with the vanity case, let down her hair, and began to carefully apply makeup under the dim light in the carriage.

Now was a time of peace and prosperity, with a full treasury. On New Year's Eve, the emperor ordered the military police to start setting off fireworks at the four city gates from the Hai hour (9-11 PM) and continue all night, for all the people to enjoy.

When the fireworks in the entire city were set off together, the whole capital would be noisy and bustling. That would be the best time for them to take action.

While Yu Ying was applying makeup, Wen Ji and Bingyun sat quietly beside her.

Both of them were well-trained and had long been accustomed to hiding and waiting.

After a long time, there was a crisp sound of fireworks breaking through the sky, followed by crackling sounds from all directions.

The Hai hour had arrived.

Wen Ji and Bingyun's eyes lit up at the same time, both turning to look at Yu Ying.

Yu Ying was concentrating on applying flower stickers. She had naturally heard the sound of fireworks in the capital. She calmly examined her reflection in the mirror and, after confirming there were no issues, turned to face them.

Wen Ji and Bingyun were both slightly taken aback.

The first time they saw Yu Ying, they knew she was a beauty. As a servant, Yu Ying usually did not wear makeup and had a bare face. Now, with her hair piled high in a bun and adorned with gold ornaments, her long neck and tall figure were even more striking.

"Does it look like Cui Yichu?" Yu Ying asked with a smile.

Yes, it looked too much like her.

Or rather, it was not just similar; it was almost identical.

Wen Ji asked in confusion, "You're going to disguise yourself as her?"

Yu Ying smiled and said, "Just in case."

Wen Ji and Bingyun were both skilled in qinggong (a lightness skill in martial arts). If they were discovered in the mansion, they could easily escape with their skills.

But Yu Ying could not.

After much thought, she decided to disguise herself as Cui Yichu, just as she had done before.

They were biological sisters, with a fifty percent resemblance in appearance. The differences were only in the corners of the eyes, the wings of the nose, and the face shape.

After Yu Ying deliberately adjusted her makeup, the resemblance increased to eighty percent.

Now that it was dark, if she were discovered in the mansion, she could disguise her voice as she had done before to get by.

In short, it was better to be prepared.

"Wen Ji, you go into the mansion first. Remember, act according to the situation, no need to take risks."

Wen Ji nodded, and with a flicker, his figure disappeared.

Yu Ying picked up the elaborate dress prepared in advance. Bingyun understood and went out of the carriage to wait outside.

Before long, Yu Ying had changed her clothes.

This was a cotton-padded jacket that Cui Yichu had left in the Marquis's Mansion, which Yu Ying had secretly kept. Today, it finally came in handy.

Stepping out of the carriage, she looked up at the night sky.

The night was cold, but the sky was blooming with large fireworks, illuminating the entire sky with brilliant colors, dazzling and beautiful.

For some reason, Yu Ying thought of Zhao Xuanyou.

The Jingyuan Marquis's Mansion must be very lively at this moment.

"Bingyun, let's go."

"Yes." Bingyun jumped back onto the carriage and drove it quietly closer to the Xingguo Duke's Mansion, stopping in a small alley near the side gate.

The two got out of the carriage and looked around. After confirming it was safe, Yu Ying nodded slightly.

"Miss, forgive me."

Bingyun said in a low voice, reaching out to grasp Yu Ying's shoulder and lifting her up to jump over the wall together.

They landed in a flower garden.

In winter, the flowers and grasses had long withered, but there were seven or eight cypress trees planted here. The evergreen crowns formed barriers, concealing Yu Ying and Bingyun who were hiding there.

After confirming that Yu Ying was unharmed, Bingyun returned to the carriage and began moving the items hidden inside one by one.

First, the corpse, then two fire starters, and two jars of old wine.

"I'll take you to the firewood room first." Bingyun said.

Yu Ying replied, "Going back and forth too many times is not safe. You can't carry all these things in one trip, so I'll go with you. This place is close to the firewood room. Let's go there in one go."

With that, Yu Ying picked up a jar of wine.

Seeing that she was strong, Bingyun picked up the corpse and walked with her towards the firewood room.

Even though Yu Ying had never been to the Xingguo Duke's Mansion, she had already memorized the general layout of the mansion.

Most of the servants who could not return home for New Year's Eve were gathered in one place drinking. Although there were guards patrolling the mansion, they were mostly concentrated in the areas where the masters lived and would not hover around the servants.

Thus, Yu Ying and Bingyun proceeded very smoothly until they reached the door of the firewood room, where they finally heard voices inside.

Bingyun gestured to Yu Ying to quietly step aside. He put down the corpse and jumped onto the courtyard wall to take a look.

It turned out that three servants were hiding inside, eating, drinking, and gambling.

Bingyun leaped into the courtyard and knocked out the two closest people with a single strike.

The remaining two shouted loudly. Under normal circumstances, this would have alerted others in the mansion.

But tonight was New Year's Eve. Apart from the continuous fireworks in the night sky, many commoners were also setting off firecrackers. Their shouts were drowned out by the lively and festive sounds.

Helpless, the remaining two servants had to run outside.

Bingyun struck with lightning speed, subduing the remaining two before they could even run out of the courtyard. Then, he opened the door to the firewood room's courtyard.

Yu Ying entered the firewood room with the wine jar. Bingyun looked left and right at the courtyard entrance. After confirming that no one had noticed the situation in the firewood room, he quickly moved the corpse into the room.

He and Yu Ying worked together to carry the unconscious people in the courtyard to the side of the courtyard wall. Then, they went out to find the water storage location.

"There are eight large jars placed there, just as drawn on the young lady's construction map."

"We don't know when Wen Ji will arrive. Let's not rush to damage the water jars to avoid being discovered." Yu Ying said softly.

Even though she had made ample preparations for today, Yu Ying was still somewhat nervous.

Just standing there, she felt her bones and blood boiling, as if she had returned to the night she fought desperately with Baozhen in the underground dungeon.

Bingyun heard the slight tremor in her voice and tried to comfort her: "His qinggong is very skilled. As long as Cui Yichu is alone, he will definitely be able to capture her. If he hasn't arrived after half an hour, I'll go to Qingyun Courtyard to see what's going on."

Although his qinggong was not as good as Wen Ji's, it was sufficient for moving around within the Xingguo Duke's Mansion.

If Cui Yichu was not alone, Wen Ji would not make a move. If he were there, helping to take down one or two maids in the room would not be a problem.

"No need to rush. I just..." Yu Ying tried her best to steady her mind. She looked around and said, "Let's arrange the firewood in the room first."

"How does the young lady want to arrange it?"

Yu Ying had indeed thought about how to stack the firewood.

In her previous life, Cui Yichu had imprisoned her in that manor, so naturally, she wanted to return the favor and build a cage for Cui Yichu as well.

Yu Ying looked around and finally pointed to a pillar in the center of the room: "Let's arrange a circle around here."

"Okay." Bingyun moved the stored dry firewood to Yu Ying's front and watched as Yu Ying poured the wine from the jar onto the pillar.

Bingyun asked, "Later, we'll tie Cui Yichu here?"

Yu Ying nodded, looked at the firewood piled on the ground, then squatted down and started stacking the firewood piece by piece.

She stacked quickly, and before long, she had built a circular low wall around the pillar.

"It didn't collapse." Bingyun was somewhat surprised.

"When I was in the village before, there wasn't much to play with, so I liked to play with firewood."

Bingyun silently watched Yu Ying, feeling more and more that she was unfathomable.

Yu Ying's words and actions seemed to be those of a kind person, but her plan for Cui Yichu tonight was meticulous and thorough, with a fierce look as if she wanted Cui Yichu to have no place to be buried.

However, none of this was Bingyun's concern.

The Seventh Prince had said that whatever Yu Ying ordered, he would do.

He silently placed the prepared corpse next to the firewood as well.

The night sky outside the firewood room was still filled with brilliant fireworks. Yu Ying and Bingyun waited quietly inside the room, feeling that time passed exceptionally slowly.

After waiting for about half an hour, there was finally some movement in the courtyard.

Yu Ying's eyebrows twitched, and Bingyun understood. He looked out through the crack in the door and indeed saw Wen Ji carrying a woman jumping into the courtyard.

"It's him." Bingyun said in a low voice.

Had he succeeded?

Thinking that Cui Yichu had already been brought into the courtyard by Wen Ji, Yu Ying's mind wandered, and she almost lost her balance.

Bingyun opened the door and went out to help Wen Ji bring the unconscious Cui Yichu into the room.

In just a moment, Yu Ying had regained her composure.

"Tie her up."

"Yes."

While Bingyun was tying Cui Yichu to the pillar, Yu Ying walked towards Wen Ji and cupped her hands in a bow: "Thank you."

Wen Ji expressionlessly said, "I'll leave first. Don't forget what you promised me."

Yu Ying had already decided to fake her death and leave. From now on, she would never see Zhao Xuanyou again. The words she had said to Wen Ji before were just to deceive him into helping.

"I haven't forgotten. In the future, if there's anything you need my help with, I will do my best."

Wen Ji glanced at Cui Yichu, who was tied up to the pillar, and then looked at Yu Ying: "After all, she is a master. The mansion may soon notice her absence. Don't delay too long."

With that, Wen Ji left directly.

Yu Ying turned to look at Cui Yichu.

To be honest, Cui Yichu looked well.

She was the apple of the Duke of Xingguo's eye. Even if she had caused a huge disaster, she had never been punished by being made to kneel, confined, or reprimanded in a way that affected her food, clothing, or daily necessities.

Tonight, on New Year's Eve, Cui Yichu wore a silver-red cloud brocade jacket with gold sprinkles. The embroidery on the skirt was rich and magnificent, and the collar and cuffs were sewn with a circle of white fox fur, which was both beautiful and warm.

Looking at Cui Yichu's privileged appearance, Yu Ying was glad she had made her decision.

If she had not decided to fake her death, she might not have been able to bring herself to break into the Xingguo Duke's Mansion and set a fire.

"Miss, that man is right. We should act quickly and not delay."

"I understand."

Yu Ying withdrew her thoughts, picked up another jar of wine from the ground, and poured it suddenly over Cui Yichu's head.

The cold wine poured from her head, stimulating Cui Yichu to open her eyes from unconsciousness.

After the family banquet tonight, her father had praised Shen Tongyun endlessly, which made her feel a surge of anger in her heart. She had wanted to leave early, but her mother had forcibly kept her.

Later, when she really couldn't take it anymore, she said that her sleeve had been stained with oil and wanted to go back to change.

But not long after returning to her room, her head was struck by something heavy, and it still felt burning hot.

Now, not only did Cui Yichu feel a burning pain at the back of her head, but her limbs also ached terribly, as if they were being restrained by something coarse.

"You're awake?" Yu Ying asked with a smile.

Cui Yichu looked up suddenly upon hearing the voice and only then saw the person standing in front of her.

"It's you?!"

"Yes, it's me." Yu Ying slightly clenched her hand but still looked at her with a spring breeze on her face. "Long time no see. I heard that the madam has been sending people to look for me. Unexpectedly, we can meet again at the Xingguo Duke's Mansion."

The Xingguo Duke's Mansion?

At this moment, Cui Yichu realized that she was tied to a pillar. She struggled desperately but could not move at all.

"What do you want to do? You wretched woman! What on earth do you want to do?"

Cui Yichu started shouting like a madwoman. Without waiting for Yu Ying's signal, Bingyun picked up a small piece of wood from the ground and suddenly stuffed it into Cui Yichu's mouth.

"Forgive me."

"It's about time. You go and destroy those large water jars." As for Cui Yichu, there were a few parting words she wanted to say.

"Yes."

After the door of the firewood room was closed, Yu Ying held the oil lamp and took a few more steps forward.

The piece of wood in Cui Yichu's mouth had sharp edges, which had cut her mouth, and blood was dripping down from the corner of her mouth.

At this moment, Cui Yichu's eyes looked somewhat similar to her loyal servant Baozhen; full of anger and fear.

"Why be so surprised? You should know better than anyone else what I'm doing here at the Xingguo Duke's Mansion." Yu Ying sneered. "You had Baozhen try to take my life, so of course I have to return the favor, a life for a life. Am I right, Madam?"

After a pause, Yu Ying seemed to have remembered something.

"Speaking of which, we shouldn't be so estranged. I have good news to tell you, sister."

---

chapters.title: An Eye for an Eye
chapters.content:
Sensing Cui Yichu's gaze turn venomous, Yu Wan lifted her chin and chuckled lightly, "Don't you find it strange? Why do we look so much alike? I used to think it was a coincidence, but my mother recovered from her illness recently. From her, I learned that she once had a relationship with Duke Xingguo; no, with our father. We are sisters, that's why we look alike."

As soon as she finished speaking, Yu Wan clearly felt Cui Yichu's expression change.

Cui Yichu prided herself on her noble status and had always looked down on everyone, considering them beneath her.

How could someone as arrogant as her accept that the lowly Yu Wan was her half-sister, born of the same father?

"Mmm... mmm..."

With a wooden gag in her mouth, Cui Yichu could only emit muffled, furious sounds.

Yu Wan could tell she was saying, "You're lying."

"I'm not lying. My mother has a token left by our father. From what Elder Sister-in-law and Second Brother say, Father values his children the most. I'm sure he'll bring me back to the manor." Yu Wan narrowed her eyes, as if imagining the days after being acknowledged by her father, her brows and eyes filled with smiles. "Once I have the identity of a Cui family daughter, I can marry the Heir properly. Back then, you ruined his reputation before marriage, forcing the Duke Xingguo's manor to become enemies with him. Now there's a chance to mend that relationship. Father will surely be pleased to know."

At this point, Yu Wan sighed softly, "It's just a little too late. The Heir is already engaged to Feng Jiyou. Fortunately, Zhao Xuanyou likes me and is willing to take me as a secondary wife. I will definitely give birth to a legitimate son first. Sister, you must agree, otherwise, you wouldn't have taken a liking to me back then, right?"

Yu Wan's smile was gentle, meeting Cui Yichu's hatred-filled eyes without flinching. "Don't worry, Sister. If you can't tolerate me, this lowly sister can't tolerate you either."

In her past life, when Zhou Mama and others had killed her, they had done so by stabbing her heart with one thing after another.

She was merely returning the favor.

"Mmm! Mmm!"

Bound to the pillar, Cui Yichu's face turned crimson with extreme anger. The eyes that had been cold and arrogant when they first met were now filled with red bloodshot veins, as chilling as the fresh blood at the corner of her mouth.

Yu Wan looked at her appearance, feeling both relieved and heartbroken.

"Daydreaming? How could I be daydreaming?" Yu Wan patiently explained, "Sister, think about it. How could I have the ability to tie you up here? The expert just now was the Heir's subordinate. He supports me in seeking my roots and returning to the family. He's willing to take me as a secondary wife but can't accept such a vicious relative as you. So he has to get rid of you first. He is now the commander of the Brocade Guards, deeply trusted by His Majesty. Father would be eager to fawn over him, so he probably won't mind these actions."

Every word Yu Wan said was a lie, but to Cui Yichu, each word seemed believable.

Zhao Xuanyou hated her deeply, and Cui Lingyuan loved power dearly.

"Mmm..." Cui Yichu's face changed abruptly, her features twisting like a ghost.

Yu Wan raised her eyebrows and calmly watched her, though her hands in her sleeves secretly clenched tight.

"I like this dress," she gently touched her sleeve and softly said, "Sister, rest assured on your journey. I'll take everything of yours!"

The moment the last word left her mouth, Cui Yichu seemed to go mad, emitting indistinct roars from her mouth.

Looking at her turbid eyes, Yu Wan's gaze was clear.

Cui Yichu had tried to take her life multiple times. It was already too late for her to seek revenge now.

The door to the firewood room was pushed open by Bingyun, who entered panting. He nodded at Yu Wan.

Those water vats were large and deep, and when filled with water, they weighed several hundred pounds. Even though Bingyun had prepared iron rods in advance, flipping them had nearly exhausted his strength.

"Thank you for your hard work." Yu Wan said softly, then turned to look at Cui Yichu.

The water for extinguishing the fire was already gone, so there was no time to delay.

Without another word, Yu Wan decisively lit the fire starter and threw it onto the firewood.

The firewood had been soaked in alcohol, and as soon as it touched the flame, it burned rapidly, instantly shooting up several tongues of fire.

The firelight reflected in Yu Wan's eyes. She took one last look at Cui Yichu through the flames, then turned and walked out with Bingyun.

Just as they opened the door, a sudden gust of hot wind struck them from behind.

Yu Wan turned her head and saw that Cui Yichu, who had been tied to the pillar, was now lunging towards her. At this moment, her clothes and hair were already on fire, and she looked like a fireball.

She suddenly realized she had made a big mistake. Earlier, she had splashed alcohol on Cui Yichu, and some of it had soaked the hemp rope, which had quickly burned through.

Cui Yichu lunged quickly, and Bingyun reacted just as fast.

He grabbed Yu Wan's hand and pushed her out of the room, but he himself couldn't dodge in time and was tightly entangled by the crazed Cui Yichu. In an instant, he was engulfed in flames.

Yu Wan was thrown out of the firewood room and landed in the courtyard.

Before her body even hit the ground, someone caught her.

She suddenly looked up and saw that it was Wen Bo, who had returned.

Without time to think or ask questions, Yu Wan grabbed his hand, "Save Bingyun, he's still inside!"

Wen Bo put Yu Wan down, tore a piece of cloth from his body to cover his mouth and nose, and swiftly flew into the firewood room.

Yu Wan took a deep breath, waiting for her emotions to calm slightly. She picked up a firewood chopping axe from the courtyard and rushed straight into the room.

As soon as she stepped onto the platform, she saw Wen Bo carrying Bingyun out.

"He inhaled a lot of smoke." Wen Bo said briefly.

Yu Wan could see that Bingyun was in bad shape. She softly said, "Thank you. Please take him back to the carriage quickly."

"And you?" Wen Bo asked.

Bingyun was unconscious and couldn't leave the Duke Xingguo's manor on his own. Wen Bo, no matter how skilled, could only take one person away at a time.

The firewood room was filled with dry wood, and soon the entire building would be engulfed in flames. People from the manor were swarming over, and it would be impossible to escape if they stayed.

"I have my own way to escape."
