Old Lady Ye was indeed advanced in age, but she had always been in good health. How could she suddenly be at the point of needing a wedding for good luck?

Zhao Xuanyou thought for a moment, then lightly shook his head.

"Grandmother's health should be fine."

"Why?"

"Just a feeling."

Zhao Xuanyou knew his father very well. If Grandmother was truly so ill that she needed a wedding for good luck, the wording would be much more severe, and he wouldn't have glossed over her condition.

"A feeling?" Yu Wan was confused by Zhao Xuanyou's vague words, "Then do we need to rush back to the capital?"

"Of course we do. If Grandmother isn't really sick, but Father used her illness as an excuse to call me back to the capital, it must mean that something has happened in the capital."

Yu Wan's eyes flashed, and her voice trembled slightly, "You mean the empe…"

chapters.title: Backing Her Up
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou said nothing, only nodding slightly.

"In times like these, shouldn't we stay as far away as possible?"

The change of emperors had always been accompanied by intrigue and bloodshed. For the Jingyuan Marquis's residence, the safest course was to stay out of it, as the heads of the marquis's household had always done in the past.

Facing Yu Wan's worried gaze, Zhao Xuanyou reached out and pinched her cheek, his eyes carrying a hint of helplessness but no fear.

"Ever since Cui Yichu married me, I was forced into the game."

Prince Zhao Zun saw him as a thorn in his side; if he ascended the throne, he would surely turn against the Jingyuan Marquis's residence.

To ensure the future safety of the marquis's household, it was necessary to prevent Prince Zhao from ascending the throne.

The most reliable way was to have him deposed as crown prince before the emperor's passing.

"So, who do you want to support?"

Yu Wan knew that Zhao Xuanyou had a decent relationship with Prince Ping.

Back then, Prince Ping had tried to win Zhao Xuanyou over, not only by sending Feng Tang to the marquis's residence but also by arranging for Zhao Xuanyou to stay in the capital for his official duties.

"For me, as long as it's not Zhao Zun, it's fine. As for who the final winner will be, it depends on their own abilities and luck."

Hearing this, Yu Wan understood his plans.

The Jingyuan Marquis's residence would do its utmost to depose Zhao Zun, but it would not side with any other prince.

"What if His Majesty doesn't depose him?"

"There are ways to depose him, and if not, there are other ways to handle it."

This was not something to be spoken aloud.

Yu Wan cleared her throat, and the two tacitly agreed not to delve deeper into the matter.

"What are you thinking about?" After a while, seeing Yu Wan lost in thought, Zhao Xuanyou asked meaningfully, "Prince Rui?"

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou bring it up himself, Yu Wan's eyes lit up, and she smiled, asking, "Between Prince Ping and Prince Rui, who do you think has a better chance?"

So she was indeed pondering the matter of seizing the succession.

Originally, Zhao Xuanyou wanted to marry her and didn’t want her to worry about such things; he just wanted her to live peacefully as his wife.

But after going through so much, Zhao Xuanyou understood that Yu Wan was not the kind of woman content to stay in the inner quarters, tending to flowers, or playing the zither and sipping tea.

She had an adventurous spirit and enjoyed pondering such matters.

Since she was curious about this, Zhao Xuanyou answered seriously.

"Prince Ping is much older than Prince Rui and has been secretly cultivating relationships with court officials."

"So you think Prince Ping has a better chance?"

Zhao Xuanyou did not answer directly but shifted the topic: "Although Prince Ping has considerable prestige in the court, he does not dare to associate deeply with military officers. Due to the court's restrictions on princes, he only has a thousand guards under him. Prince Rui, while subject to the same restrictions, has the strong support of the Ningguo Duke's residence. The Duke of Ningguo is highly respected in the court; if Prince Rui intends to compete, he will certainly have supporters."

"So it's Prince Rui?"

"It's hard to say. The struggle for succession is always unpredictable, and pulling one thread can move the entire web. The current emperor was not favored by anyone before his ascension, yet he became the ultimate winner."

That was true.

Yu Wan's mother had witnessed that turbulent era firsthand.

"There's something I wanted to tell you when you proposed last time..."

"Hmm?" Seeing Yu Wan's hesitant expression and her mention of the proposal, Zhao Xuanyou immediately became alert. "Wasn't the proposal already settled? Once the marquis's household sends the letter, your mother and I will discuss our wedding date."

"It's not about that." Yu Wan knew he had misunderstood and quickly explained, "It's about my mother. Last time, I didn’t want to tell you, but since we're talking about it now, it's better to let you know."

Zhao Xuanyou's tense brows relaxed, clearly relieved.

"Go on, what secret does my future mother-in-law have?"

He had already called her "mother-in-law" so naturally, even though they weren't married yet.

Yu Wan didn’t correct him and simply said, "My mother used to be a palace maid."

"A palace maid?" Zhao Xuanyou was indeed surprised. He had always thought Ding Wenxi was a concubine in Cui Lingyuan's residence, driven out by Tao Shi. "If your mother was a palace maid, how did she come to know Cui Lingyuan?"

"You should be well aware of how the current emperor ascended the throne after Emperor Hongjing's passing, right?"

At that time, Zhao Xuanyou was still young; he had heard about this from the Marquis of Jingyuan after he grew up.

"I know."

"My mother served Empress Wenxiao, Emperor Hongjing's mother, in the palace. So she knew all about the deal between Empress Wenxiao and the current emperor."

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yu Wan fixedly, then realized, "So that's why your mother couldn't stay in the capital?"

"My mother said Empress Wenxiao was a beautiful and kind woman. She disliked the constant scheming in the palace and learned jewelry-making from the palace officials to pass the time."

"Did your mother learn her craft in the palace? No wonder it's so exquisite."

The palace was full of skilled craftsmen, and to please Empress Wenxiao, they would teach without reservation, which was how Ding Wenxi had acquired such excellent skills.

"My mother met Cui Lingyuan while accompanying the imperial carriage on a trip to Jiangnan. They developed feelings for each other. Later, after Emperor Hongjing's sudden passing, Empress Wenxiao knew the current emperor wouldn't tolerate her for long. Feeling sorry that my mother's youth was being wasted in the palace, she found a way to send her out."

"Then she went to Cui Lingyuan?"

Yu Wan nodded. "But Cui Lingyuan didn't truly care for her; he was only attracted to her beauty and novelty. After my mother realized this, she left Cui's estate and soon gave birth to me alone."

So that was how it happened.

"I understand." Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly. "It's been so long; His Majesty has long let go of the past. Your mother can live peacefully in Yuzhou without any problems."

"Mmm."

"When we return to the capital, I will also send more people to guard the Tangli Courtyard."

"Didn't we say we would get married in Yuzhou?"

"The letter from my father was somewhat vague, but since he said so, there must be an urgent matter. It's better for us to return to the capital as soon as possible." Zhao Xuanyou said, glancing at her. "Are you scared?"

It wasn't exactly fear.

But everyone in the marquis's household knew Yu Wan. Even if she changed her name now, they would recognize her as the former maid from Honghui Hall.

There would definitely be gossip behind her back.

Yu Wan didn't fear others' idle talk, but thinking about it still bothered her a little.

"What's there to be afraid of? From now on, you'll be the mistress of the marquis's household. If anyone speaks ill of you, we'll throw them out. If you're really worried, I can send a letter back now and have my father replace all the servants in the marquis's household before we arrive."

"How can we be so domineering before they even start gossiping?"

Yu Wan knew Zhao Xuanyou was trying to comfort her, and it worked.

"You can't bring yourself to be ruthless, but I'll back you up."

"There's no need."

After his comforting words, she did feel a bit more at ease.

"It's not that I'm afraid; it's just a bit sudden. Also, the wedding dress my mother is preparing for me isn't finished yet."

"It's fine if it's not finished. Bring all the dowry your mother prepared for you, and when we return to the capital, I'll ask the best embroideress to finish the dress." At this point, Zhao Xuanyou thought of something else. "What about Wen Jian? Your mother isn't returning to the capital, so what about him?"

"Naturally, he'll stay in Yuzhou. You know, he used to be a secret guard of the Eastern Palace. If the crown prince finds out his identity, he definitely won't let him off."

"Can't he disguise himself?"

Yu Wan detected a hint of something in Zhao Xuanyou's tone.

"Do you want Wen Jian to go back to the capital with us?"

---

chapters.title: The Sweet and Sour of Plums
chapters.content:
"Wen Jian was originally a top secret guard trained by the Eastern Palace. Now, his qinggong and hidden weapons skills are even better than before. With him guarding you, I would naturally feel more at ease."

This was Zhao Xuanyou's honest thought, but not the whole of it.

After the incident where Yu Wan was kidnapped, Zhao Xuanyou was well aware that Wen Jian prioritized Yu Wan above all else and would never betray her.

Even if Zhao Xuanyou could find someone with skills comparable to Wen Jian to protect Yu Wan, they wouldn't match Wen Jian in this regard.

The journey to the capital was fraught with danger. Even if Zhao Xuanyou didn't particularly like the relationship between Yu Wan and Wen Jian, he still had to prioritize Yu Wan's safety.

With Wen Jian protecting her, he could rest assured.

"But I've already told Wen Jian that we won't be taking him to the capital this time. I asked him to stay in Yuzhou with my mother."

Zhao Xuanyou was silent for a moment before picking up a plum from the dish on the table.

Ever since Yu Wan started helping him with military affairs in the Mingguang Hall, the desk had always been stocked with pastries and snacks.

After placing the plum in Yu Wan's mouth, Zhao Xuanyou asked softly, "Is that what he wants as well?"

Yu Wan chewed the plum without speaking.

In truth, she knew Wen Jian wanted to go back to the capital with her. But Wen Jian was, after all, a secret guard of the Eastern Palace, and returning to the capital carried risks.

Even if Zhao Xuanyou considered Zhao Zun a good-for-nothing, there were capable people in the Eastern Palace. What if someone recognized Wen Jian?

Zhao Xuanyou ate a plum himself.

He used to dislike these sour and sweet things the most, but sometimes, seeing Yu Wan enjoy them so much, he couldn't resist trying one himself.

However, as soon as the plum entered his mouth, the sourness made him frown.

He swallowed the plum whole as if it were medicine, then took a sip of tea before saying, "The capital is likely to see unrest soon. With Wen Jian by your side, I can act more freely. Moreover, he used to be Zhao Zun's secret guard and knows the Eastern Palace inside out..."

If the emperor did not intend to depose the crown prince, Zhao Xuanyou might have to take a risky move.

Assassinating the crown prince was no small matter, but with Wen Jian, who knew the Eastern Palace like the back of his hand, it would be different.

Hearing this, Yu Wan immediately interrupted him.

"Even though Wen Jian has left the Eastern Palace, he does not want to betray the crown prince and won't help you with those things."

Zhao Xuanyou indeed did not know this and slightly narrowed his eyes. "He has such loyalty to Zhao Zun?"

"It's not exactly loyalty. Wen Jian was abandoned by his family as a child, and being a secret guard was not his original wish. Although he has left the Eastern Palace, the crown prince was his former master and had never treated him badly, so he won't do anything harmful to the crown prince."

"What if the crown prince harms you?" Zhao Xuanyou countered, the corner of his lips slightly lifting.

Yu Wan opened her mouth but said nothing.

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft hum, the question was his, but after asking, he felt a pang of jealousy.

However, he knew what was more important, and right now, he needed Wen Jian to stay by Yu Wan's side, so he suppressed that jealousy.

"You don't have to worry about me going back on my word. I'll talk to him."

"You'll talk to him?"

Facing Yu Wan's incredulous gaze, Zhao Xuanyou said calmly, "Is that not allowed?"

Yu Wan smiled and coughed lightly, "You are the young master of the marquis's residence and the commander of the Mingjiao Guard. But Wen Jian may not pay any attention to you."

"Only to you?" Zhao Xuanyou inwardly scoffed again, pricking her with his words, "Or is it that you have the final say in his matters?"

On this point, Yu Wan had absolute confidence.

Wen Jian only listened to her.

Apart from her, he might listen to Ding Wenxi half the time, but if Zhao Xuanyou went to talk to him... It wasn't that Yu Wan looked down on him, but Wen Jian simply wouldn't pay him any mind.

"His matters are certainly not up to me, but it's still better if I talk to him."

"Suit yourself. After all, you are the one following me." Zhao Xuanyou spoke with certainty, but his eyes held a hint of uncertainty.

Yu Wan, however, nodded decisively.

She didn't like to drag things out. Since she had decided to marry Zhao Xuanyou, she would naturally stand with him through thick and thin.

Zhao Xuanyou wanted to return to the capital, and so would she.

And it wasn't just that.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou say that the capital might soon see great changes, she felt a hidden sense of anticipation, wanting to go to the capital soon to witness the intricate struggle for the throne among the princes.

Of course, she could adopt such a spectator's attitude toward going to the capital largely because of her trust in Zhao Xuanyou.

With him by her side, she had nothing to worry about.

"Will we get married as soon as we return to the capital?"

"Since my father mentioned in the letter that my grandmother is seriously ill, it's likely announced publicly as such. After we return to the capital, we will naturally get married immediately to bring joy to my grandmother."

Yu Wan asked again, "Then when do you want to set out?"

"I still need to arrange some matters with the Mingjiao Guard. If there are no issues on your end, we can leave the day after tomorrow."

From Yu Wan's perspective, there were no issues with Wen Jian; it was her mother who might feel reluctant.

"I'll go talk to my mother first."

"Good." Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

After reaching an agreement, Yu Wan immediately returned to the Tangli Courtyard and told Ding Wenxi about the plan to return to the capital for the wedding.

"Why do we suddenly need to return to the capital to get married?"

Yu Wan, fearing Ding Wenxi would worry, only mentioned that Old Lady Ye had fallen seriously ill, so the marquis's household wanted to hold a wedding to bring her joy.

As descendants, it was their duty to show filial piety.

Moreover, if Yu Wan was to become the legitimate young master's wife, it was proper to marry in the capital.

Although Ding Wenxi was reluctant, she didn't dwell on it too much, only sighing, "But your wedding dress is only half finished."

"Mother, don't worry. Once we return to the capital, we will hire the best embroideress to finish the dress. But no embroideress can compare to you."

"You, you just know how to make me happy."

Ding Wenxi was excellent at making jewelry, but her embroidery skills were only average.

"In my daughter's heart, you are the best."

Ding Wenxi smiled and pinched her cheek, then said, "What about Ah Jian? Will he go with you?"

"I'll ask him."

"You don't need to ask."

"Why?"

"He will definitely want to go with you." Ding Wenxi laughed. "And you don't need to worry about me. With so many guards from the marquis's household in Yuzhou, nothing will happen."

"Mmm."

After leaving the Tangli Courtyard, she went straight to find Wen Jian.

Wen Jian had set up five targets in the courtyard and was currently practicing his pellet shooting.

Yu Wan suddenly remembered Zhao Xuanyou's earlier comment that Wen Jian's qinggong and hidden weapons skills were better than before.

Zhao Xuanyou was a top expert who held his martial arts in high regard and rarely met his match. His praise for Wen Jian indicated that Wen Jian's skills had reached a level he couldn't ignore.

But Yu Wan also knew that ever since the time she and Wen Jian were both captured, Wen Jian had been training diligently.

In the past, she would often see him quietly enjoying the scenery.

Now that she thought about it, she hadn't seen Wen Jian sitting on a rooftop or tree branch, lost in thought, for a long time.

"What are you standing there for?" Wen Jian noticed her standing motionless at the courtyard gate and couldn't help but ask.

Yu Wan smiled at him and then turned to close the courtyard gate.

Wen Jian narrowed his eyes and tilted his head, sizing her up.

"Something happened?"

chapters.title: Breath Pounced Over
chapters.content:
"It's still about going to the capital." Yu Wan suppressed her emotions and smiled at Wen Jian again.

Wen Jian's eyes flickered, and he turned to sit on the bamboo cool chair in the courtyard, swaying the chair as he asked, "You changed your mind? Want me to go too."

Yu Wan nodded.

"There might be big trouble in the capital. With you there..."

"Then let's go. Why are you making that face?" Wen Jian asked, puzzled.

Last time when Yu Wan said she wanted to return to the capital, he had actually wanted to go with her, thinking she didn't want him to.

"Do you find it so troublesome to talk to me?"

"It's not just this." Yu Wan sighed and pulled over a bamboo cool chair to sit down.

Watching Yu Wan's puffed-up expression, Wen Jian didn't press further, just waited quietly for her to continue.

"Do you like your current life?"

"You mean in Yu Prefecture?"

"Not just Yu Prefecture. I mean, do you like the life after leaving Qingsha Town?"

Back in Qingsha Town, Wen Jian loved to daydream by the sea the most.

At that time, their family of three lived a quiet life in Qingsha Town, and Yu Wan was certain that Wen Jian loved that kind of life.

But after she got involved in Qiahe's disappearance case and reunited with Pei Ta, the peaceful life spiraled out of control.

Wen Jian took her and her mother, hiding and changing their names, from Qing Prefecture to Gusu, then from Gusu to Lingnan, then from Lingnan to An Prefecture, and finally was forced by Zhao Xuanyou from An Prefecture to Yu Prefecture.

Apart from the constant fleeing, Wen Jian spent his rare free time practicing martial arts, and never had time to daydream anymore.

"Why bring this up suddenly?"

"If we go to the capital, you'll have to disguise yourself and hide your tracks. You'll have to live the kind of life you didn't want to live in the Eastern Palace before. It makes me feel bad."

Yu Wan was willing to accompany Zhao Xuanyou back to the capital.

But what about Wen Jian?

When Yu Wan persuaded Wen Jian to leave the capital with her, she had promised to let him live a different life.

"I feel like I'm no different from the Crown Prince, always making you do this and that."

Hearing this, Wen Jian laughed lightly.

"Am I wrong?"

"No."

Yu Wan asked, puzzled, "Don't you like daydreaming?"

"I don't."

"Ah?" Now it was Yu Wan's turn to be stunned.

"Back then, I liked daydreaming because I couldn't go anywhere or do anything. I only had that small courtyard, and I was alone. Apart from daydreaming, there really wasn't much else to do."

"And now?"

"Yu Wan, I want to go to the capital with you. Don't leave me here."

"Of course not. Even if you stay in Yu Prefecture, I'll come back quickly."

"Then do you want me to go to the capital or not?" Now it was Wen Jian's turn to be puzzled.

"I do want you to..."

"Then that's settled. When do we leave?"

Hearing Wen Jian's relaxed tone, Yu Wan felt slightly comforted.

"We leave the day after tomorrow. We've agreed that if we encounter a life-or-death situation, we each take care of ourselves first. Always remember to preserve your own life, understand?"

"Got it. You forgot, during the sandstorm, when I couldn't find you, I also found a place to save myself." Wen Jian said naturally. Seeing Yu Wan's tense expression finally relax, he asked again, "Is something big going to happen in the capital?"

"Not yet, but it should be soon." Yu Wan said, then reminded him, "Anyway, you just need to stay by my side and guard against others harming our lives. Don't meddle in other people's business."

Wen Jian wasn't the type to meddle in others' business.

Hearing Yu Wan's special reminder and that something big was about to happen, he naturally thought of the one in the Eastern Palace.

He wasn't some loyal servant; he wouldn't risk his life for the Crown Prince.

The only thing he could do was not to betray or sell him out.

"Is the Young Master going to deal with him?"

"You know, they have long been sworn enemies."

The two had clashed before, fighting over Yu Wan, but tracing back to the root, when Cui Yichu cuckolded Zhao Xuanyou, the two were destined to be enemies.

"I might not be able to help the Young Master."

"He doesn't need your help. I've already told him we're leaving the day after tomorrow. Hurry and pack your things."

"Mmm."

After talking so much with Wen Jian, as Yu Wan walked out of the courtyard, she let out a soft sigh, feeling much better.

Wen Jian had done so much for her. When she had the ability in the future, she would definitely do more to repay him.

They were leaving the day after tomorrow, so time was indeed tight.

Yu Wan packed up all of Ding Wenxi's half-prepared dowry and had Yuan Qing seal it away.

Zhao Xuanyou was eager to return to the capital, so they would leave first, and the luggage would be transported to the capital by carriage later.

After packing all the dowry, Yu Wan also prepared the travel bags they would carry. By the early morning of the third day, she and Wen Jian each carried their own small bundles and went to the front gate of the mansion to meet up with Zhao Xuanyou.

As soon as they stepped out of the marquis's mansion, they saw Zhao Xuanyou mounted on his horse. Yu Wan walked around the horse and saw that his right leg was tied to the stirrup again.

Yu Wan immediately frowned. "You don't want this leg anymore?"

"How could that be?" Zhao Xuanyou bent down and knocked on his calf, producing a thudding sound, as if knocking on wood.

"You tied something to your leg?"

Zhao Xuanyou showed a slight hint of pride and hummed through his nose.

"Not a bad idea, huh?"

Yu Wan reached out and touched his leg. There were small wooden boards on the front and back, so no matter how much the rope moved, it wouldn't cut into his flesh. It was indeed a good idea.

"You try it first. If something's wrong, we'll switch to a carriage."

"Rest assured, I don't want to cripple this leg more than you do."

He still hoped to recover quickly and be with her...

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened, and his Adam's apple rolled involuntarily.

"Wanwan, let's go."

After Yu Wan and Wen Jian mounted their horses, Zhao Xuanyou gave the order, and they immediately set off with thirty personal guards from the marquis's mansion.

The letter from Marquis Jingyuan was full of doubts, and Zhao Xuanyou was eager to return to the capital, wishing he could get there immediately.

They rode hard for a whole day, not even dismounting to rest at noon, only stopping to eat some dry rations. By the time they stopped for the night, they were already in a small town a hundred miles away from Yu Prefecture.

The post house here was somewhat dilapidated. Zhao Xuanyou didn't want Yu Wan to suffer, so he decided to stay at the best inn in town.

Yu Wan helped him into the upper room, assisted him with a simple wash, and then supported him to sit on the couch.

"You didn't bring nightclothes?"

"Mmm."

Since they were riding hard, the lighter the luggage, the better.

"Then sleep like this."

Yu Wan finished speaking and was about to get up to return to her own room.

Before she could take a few steps, Zhao Xuanyou stretched out his arm, pulled her waist, and yanked her into his embrace, bringing her down onto the couch with him.

"Zhao Xuanyou, you..."

Before Yu Wan could finish her sentence, his breath was already on her lips.

---

chapters.title: What to Do in the Wedding Night?
chapters.content:
His kiss came urgently.

"Zhao Xuan…"

Before Yu Wan could finish, she felt the arms holding her tighten even more, as if wanting to knead her into his body.

She was kissed fiercely and urgently by him, only able to let out a few weak "mm" sounds.

The jade hairpin in her hair was knocked off by him, and her black hair scattered open, spreading all over the couch.

Their breaths intertwined closely, and in an instant, the atmosphere in the room became scorching hot.

After a long while, Zhao Xuanyou finally lifted his head and loosened his embrace.

Yu Wan took several deep breaths before she felt a bit more clear-headed.

"Why so sudden?" she muttered softly.

Hearing her sweet and soft voice, Zhao Xuanyou propped himself up again, looking down at her from above.

"Sudden?"

Yu Wan glared at him.

Being stared at like this by Yu Wan, he didn't mind at all. Instead, he pressed his head down, resting his forehead against hers.

Their eyes met, and they were too close. Yu Wan couldn't avoid his gaze even if she wanted to.

Seeing that Yu Wan wanted to escape, the smile in his eyes became even more ambiguous. In a hoarse voice, he said, "Wanwan, stay here tonight."

Stay here?

Although they had long since been intimate with each other, hearing Zhao Xuanyou say this, Yu Wan still couldn't help but blush.

"What for?!"

"What's there to be afraid of? Last time in the desert, we spent days and nights together. Are you afraid of tonight?"

"That's not the same."

Last time, when they were trapped in the yellow sand, it was forced.

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou was injured and had a fever then, so she couldn't do anything to him.

This time, although his leg wasn't healed and he couldn't walk... his spirit was fine, and his waist could still move.

"Stop messing around. We have to hurry on the road tomorrow."

"I'm not messing around." Zhao Xuanyou's eyes were dark as he stared at her fixedly.

Although his expression looked as cold and detached as usual, Yu Wan could see that the deep color in his eyes was already boiling.

She gently pushed his shoulder, her voice muffled, "Aren't we getting married in the capital soon? It won't be long."

"Haven't I waited long enough?"

He had already said it before; he always felt that way about Yu Wan.

It had been half a year since they reunited, and they had only kissed twice.

"But you're not convenient right now."

Yu Wan's soft remark made Zhao Xuanyou suddenly feel a deep sense of shame.

His right leg was indeed too important to him.

If his right leg could exert force right now, would Yu Wan still have the time to say such things?

He took a deep breath and rolled over onto the couch.

"Hmm?"

Feeling the man's frustration, Yu Wan couldn't help but smile as she sat up from the couch.

"The doctors in the capital should have more exquisite medical skills. Or you can directly invite an imperial physician to take a look. By the time we get married, you'll be better."

As soon as Yu Wan finished speaking, Zhao Xuanyou felt even more depressed.

With them traveling at such a fast pace, they could return to the capital in six or seven days. Since his father intended for them to get married to bring good luck, he had already started preparing the wedding when he wrote the letter.

Within a month, he would be able to stand firmly again, which was already quite good. It was absolutely impossible to recover completely.

Originally, Zhao Xuanyou had only wanted to tease Yu Wan a bit tonight and hadn't expected anything to happen. But after talking with her for a while, he suddenly realized a problem he hadn't considered before.

He had always wanted to marry Yu Wan as soon as possible. Now the wedding date was near, but his leg wasn't healed yet.

Although he and Yu Wan had been intimate countless times before, getting married was naturally different from the past. He should make it memorable for Yu Wan for a lifetime.

But now...

"Hey," Yu Wan looked at his gloomy face, pulled his arm and shook it a few times, "are you really worried?"

"What else?" This time it was Zhao Xuanyou's turn to speak in a bad tone. "Unless on our wedding night, we just lie in bed and chat like this?"

"That doesn't sound bad."

After Yu Wan said this, she saw the man's face darken immediately.

She found it amusing but also felt a bit sorry for him.

After thinking for a moment, she leaned down close to his ear and said, "Don't worry, I'll find a way when the time comes."

"How do you plan to do it?" Zhao Xuanyou's eyes moved, glancing at her sideways.

"You'll know when the time comes." Yu Wan chuckled, and before he could react, she sat up from the couch, quickly moving away from it. "I'm exhausted. I want to sleep early."

She ran away so quickly that Zhao Xuanyou found it hard to pull her back.

He also knew that she had been riding all day and was indeed extremely tired, so he nodded and let her return to her room to rest early.

But as soon as Yu Wan left, Zhao Xuanyou tossed and turned on the couch, unable to sleep.

There were indeed many ways to spend the wedding night, but what would Wanwan do?

She was so cunning and clever that he really couldn't guess.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't sleep well that night. The next morning, after hastily eating breakfast at the inn, he set off again with his group.

After traveling day and night for six days, they finally arrived at the north gate of the capital.

"Wanwan, why aren't you moving?"

After entering the city gate, Zhao Xuanyou noticed that Yu Wan hadn't followed, so he turned back to her side.

"Is it appropriate for me to go to the marquis's mansion now?"

Zhao Xuanyou naturally hoped she could immediately follow him back to the marquis's mansion, but Yu Wan's consideration wasn't wrong either.

He was going to marry her. It wouldn't be appropriate for her to enter the mansion with him now.

"Do you want to return to your previous courtyard house?"

That courtyard had been left to Chen Da Niu before. Although with Da Niu's personality, he probably wouldn't sell the house, but showing up unannounced might make Da Niu misunderstand that she wanted to take the house back.

Yu Wan quickly had an idea: "I'll go to the Bright Moon Tower with Ah Jian."

The Bright Moon Tower was the largest restaurant in the capital. Not only was the food and wine excellent, but the songs, dances, and plays every night were also very impressive, even attracting noblemen and scholars.

"You want to go and have fun?" Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes.

Yu Wan didn't refute.

"In the past, I always heard you say you had to socialize at the Bright Moon Tower. I've long wanted to see it for myself. Is that not allowed?"

After leaving the capital, wherever Yu Wan went, she would try the local delicacies, attractions, and sights, except for the capital.

Now that she was back in the capital, she naturally couldn't miss it.

"Then let Yuan Qing go with you. You can play in the capital for a few days. After I clean up another place, I'll send someone to pick you up."

The marquis's mansion had many properties in the capital. Since Yu Wan was to be married in the capital, she naturally needed to find a spacious "maiden's home." The mansion might not be ready yet, so he would have to send someone to prepare it.

Yu Wan heard this and didn't refuse, only nodding.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't immediately ride away. Instead, he cupped his hands towards Wen Jian: "Thank you for your trouble."

The current law and order in the capital were quite good, and Wen Jian's martial arts were excellent. With him accompanying Yu Wan, there would be no problems.

Wen Jian was stunned for a moment and returned the gesture.

After Zhao Xuanyou and his group had left, Wen Jian looked at Yu Wan and asked, puzzled, "What was he thanking me for?"

Before Yu Wan could answer, Yuan Qing chimed in, "Of course, the Young Master was thanking you for protecting his wife."

chapters.title: Encountering an Old Acquaintance
chapters.content:
Protect his wife?

Hearing these words, Wen Ji suddenly realized something he had never considered before.

Originally, Yu Wan, Ding Wenxi, and he were a family. But once Yu Wan got married, she would become Zhao Xuanyou's wife, the heir's wife. Then, she and Zhao Xuanyou would be a family?

"Why are you spacing out? Let's go to Mingyue Tower quickly."

Yu Wan and Yuan Qing walked a short distance ahead, and seeing Wen Ji still standing in place, they came back to find him.

Wen Ji snapped out of his thoughts, met Yu Wan's eyes full of smiles, and was stunned for a moment before nodding.

No matter what, Yu Wan was happy now, and that was enough.

The three of them passed through the capital city, and after half an hour, they arrived at Mingyue Tower. Yu Wan directly booked three upper rooms. After putting down their luggage, she took the two of them to have a big meal at Mingyue Tower.

After eating and drinking to their heart's content, they went to the marketplace to stroll and bought some clothes and jewelry.

Although Jiangnan was prosperous, and Lingnan and Yuzhou each had their own merits, none could compare to the bustling streets of the capital.

Having been away for four years, walking through the capital's marketplace again, Yu Wan's state of mind was naturally very different.

"Miss Yu Wan?"

As they passed by a calligraphy and painting stall, the stall owner suddenly looked at her in astonishment and called out.

Wen Ji immediately became alert and quietly moved to block Yu Wan behind him.

Yu Wan looked up and saw that the stall owner was actually Cui Zaiting.

"Mr. Cui?"

"It's really you..." Cui Zaiting looked at Yu Wan in disbelief, his lips moving slightly, his eyes almost popping out.

Previously, he had seen Yu Wan's broken jade hairpin at the scene of the fire in the public mansion's firewood room and thought she had perished.

Now, seeing Yu Wan was like seeing a ghost in broad daylight.

Yu Wan, however, didn't know about him finding the hairpin and thought he had only heard the news of her death. So she smiled faintly and said, "I'm still alive. Thank you for your concern, Mr. Cui."

Cui Zaiting was silent for a while. After his wildly fluctuating emotions calmed down, he bitterly smiled and said, "I am no longer any public mansion's young master. Miss Yu Wan, there's no need to be so polite."

Yuan Qing, hearing him keep calling her "Yu Wan," reminded him, "Our young lady's surname is Ding, and her given name is not Yu Wan. Sir, don't mistake her for someone else."

Yu Wan nodded slightly.

"Congratulations, young lady, on regaining your freedom. I was presumptuous; please forgive me, Miss Ding."

"Are all these calligraphies and paintings yours?"

Zhao Xuanyou had told Yu Wan about the Cui family's affairs.

Shen Fengyun had given birth to a posthumous child for Cui Zhou, Cui Lingyuan had gone to Yunshan Temple to become a monk, and Cui Zaiting had taken on the responsibility of supporting the family.

Yu Wan held a grudge against everyone in the Cui family, except for Cui Zaiting.

When she learned that Cui Yichu and his mother wanted to harm Ding Wenxi, Cui Zaiting had resolutely warned Yu Wan.

If it weren't for him delivering the message, Ding Wenxi, who had stayed at Yunshui Nunnery, might have...

"Yes, I painted them."

"Do you rely on selling calligraphy and paintings to make a living?"

Cui Zaiting said, "I usually work as an accountant in a pawnshop and help a bookshop edit books. When I have time, I come to the street to set up a stall and sell calligraphy and paintings."

Before the Cui family's downfall, he had just passed the imperial examination as a Juren (a successful candidate in the imperial examinations at the provincial level) not long ago and hadn't taken the metropolitan examination yet.

After the incident of embezzling tribute pearls was exposed, Cui Zaiting was naturally implicated by his father and brother, losing his qualification to take the imperial examinations.

Hearing that Cui Zaiting edited books for a bookshop, Yu Wan recalled that Pei Tao had once said that his strategy essays could earn him hundreds of taels of silver a year at the bookshop. She became curious: "With your talent, shouldn't you be able to write books for the bookshop? I had a... friend before who wrote books that sold very well. It's said he earned a lot of money."

"I don't know how to write popular fiction."

"Not popular fiction, just books related to the imperial examinations."

"Nowadays, scholars all over the world admire Pei Tao's books the most. He is the Zhuangyuan (the top scholar in the imperial examination), so everyone naturally flocks to his books. As for me, a mere Juren... even if the bookshop prints my books, they won't sell."

That was true. Pei Tao was a world-renowned Zhuangyuan.

Yu Wan glanced at the calligraphy and paintings on the stall, carefully flipped through them, and pointed to a painting of orchids: "How much is this one?"

"Two strings of coins."

"So cheap?" Yu Wan was surprised. "This amount of money isn't even enough to buy the pigments, is it?"

In the past, Yu Wan had been short on money due to practicing calligraphy and was very sensitive to the prices of brushes, ink, paper, and inkstones.

"Indeed, it's not enough. I also don't have the money to paint anymore. These are all paintings I did when I was at the academy. After our house was confiscated, my classmates sent me all the things I left at the academy. They're of no use just lying around, so I sell them for whatever I can get."

Yu Wan had also been through hard times and knew that in such situations, one could only accumulate a little at a time.

"Since it's such a good deal, I'll buy a few more."

"Yu... Miss Ding, there's really no need."

"I've just returned to the capital, and my home is in need of some calligraphy and paintings for decoration. These four paintings of plum blossoms, orchids, bamboo, and chrysanthemums are very well done. I genuinely like them. Although they are painted with light ink, the brushstrokes are as swift as the wind, perfectly capturing the demeanor of these four gentlemen."

Cui Zaiting was slightly taken aback by Yu Wan's words.

He naturally knew that Yu Wan was buying his paintings out of pity, but her brief comments were precise and insightful.

If he stubbornly refused to sell, it would make him seem affected.

"Since you understand paintings so well, I'll sell these to you."

Yu Wan promptly paid the money and then thought of Shen Fengyun.

"Miss Shen... I mean, how is your sister-in-law doing now?"

At the mention of Shen Fengyun, Cui Zaiting's gaze darkened slightly.

The reason the Cui family could still eke out a living in the capital was entirely due to the secret financial support from the Ningguo Duke's mansion to Shen Fengyun.

First, they had managed to secure a house for her, and later, they found ways to give her money.

But Shen Fengyun had always felt guilty towards her maiden family. Because she couldn't bear to let her young son be homeless, she had moved into the house provided by the Ningguo Duke's mansion. However, she refused to accept money from the mansion and usually earned a living by doing embroidery for others.

Unfortunately, the rest of the Cui family were heartless. They often went to the Ningguo Duke's mansion in Shen Fengyun's name to ask for money, but they would not give a single cent to Shen Fengyun. Instead, they would spend it all on food and drink.

Shen Fengyun had argued with them several times, only to be ganged up on by the rest of the Cui family, who accused her of being stingy despite her wealthy maiden family, forcing everyone to live in hardship.

In the past, Cui Zaiting had thought the Cui family was harmonious, but now that the tree had fallen and the monkeys had scattered, he had seen the true colors of those people.

However, there was nothing he could do about those scoundrels. He could only try to earn more money to improve the lives of his sister-in-law and nephew.

"My sister-in-law is very strong," Cui Zaiting said softly.

"She refuses to accept help from her maiden family?"

Cui Zaiting nodded.

Yu Wan wasn't surprised.

Shen Fengyun had been raised with strict family teachings and valued dignity and integrity highly.

Unlike Yu Wan, who believed that survival was more important than face, and as long as she could live a little better, she didn't care what others said.

However, she still admired Shen Fengyun deep down.

After carefully putting away the four paintings, she went to buy some other things and then returned to Cui Zaiting's stall.

"In the past, Miss Shen took good care of me. When she gave birth to her son, I wasn't in the capital. Consider these as my belated congratulatory gifts."

Since she wasn't giving them to Cui Zaiting, he naturally couldn't refuse.

Moreover, Yu Wan had only bought a few pieces of children's clothing and some food, which weren't particularly expensive gifts.

"Then I'll thank Miss Ding on behalf of my sister-in-law."

"I'll be staying in the capital for some more days. If I have time, I'll invite her for tea."

Yu Wan had originally gone out today to buy some things to visit Chen Da Niu. She hadn't expected to encounter Cui Zaiting first.

There were still many old acquaintances in the capital. It seemed that this return to the capital would not be smooth sailing.

---

chapters.title: Reunion with an Old Friend
chapters.content:
After buying the gifts, Yu Wan went to visit Chen Da Niu.

It had been four years since they last met; she didn't know if he had changed much.

Standing at the gate of the mansion, Yu Wan was filled with emotions. When she left, she had never thought she would return one day.

Seeing her hesitate, Yuan Qing smiled and stepped forward to knock on the door.

Soon, someone answered.

"Who is it?"

The gate opened halfway, and a young woman walked out.

The woman looked about the same age as Yu Wan, but her hair was styled like a married woman's, and she had a baby on her back.

"Brother Yuan Qing, is that you? You've returned to the capital!" She recognized Yuan Qing and immediately greeted him with a smile.

"Just got back yesterday," Yuan Qing said with a smile. "Sister Xiu Fang, is Brother Da Niu at home? I've brought an old friend to see him."

Hearing the words "old friend," the woman named Xiu Fang looked behind Yuan Qing and saw Yu Wan and Wen Ji. She nodded politely at them.

"He's at home, in the garden tending to the flowers. I'll take you there."

With that, Xiu Fang opened the gate wider, waiting for Yu Wan and the others to enter before closing it again.

Yu Wan was very familiar with this mansion. She guessed that Chen Da Niu wouldn't have moved into the place where Ding Wenxi used to live. She walked forward casually.

Sure enough, after passing the main courtyard, she saw Chen Da Niu trimming flower branches.

"Brother Da Niu," Yu Wan called out.

"Hmm?" Chen Da Niu turned his head at the sound of her voice. Seeing Yu Wan smiling and waving at him, he widened his eyes in shock, and the flower shears in his hand fell to the ground. "Yu... Yu Wan? You..."

He rubbed his eyes hard, unable to believe what he was seeing.

"I'm still alive, but now I've changed my name. Call me Ding Huan."

"Ding Huan?" Chen Da Niu still couldn't believe it. He stared blankly at Yu Wan for a long time before saying, "Is it really you? Are you really alive?"

Yuan Qing, standing beside them, laughed and said, "Of course it's her. A real, live person, guaranteed."

Two years ago, when Yuan Qing returned to the capital to deliver New Year's gifts to the Marquis's mansion, he had drunk with Chen Da Niu. Inevitably, they had talked about Yu Wan. Seeing how genuinely heartbroken Chen Da Niu was, Yuan Qing had subtly hinted that Yu Wan might still be alive.

However, Chen Da Niu was a straightforward man and hadn't understood Yuan Qing's hint at all.

He stared at Yu Wan, unable to believe what was in front of him.

Xiu Fang stepped forward and said, "So you're Miss Wan. Da Niu often mentions you..."

And it wasn't just mentioning. There was even a memorial tablet set up for her in the main courtyard's room.

Xiu Fang was a warm-hearted person. Seeing Chen Da Niu in a daze, she pulled Yu Wan to sit beside her.

Earlier, Yu Wan had heard Yuan Qing call her "Sister Xiu Fang," so she followed suit and called her "Sister-in-law." She then presented the prepared gifts: "Sister-in-law, just call me Wanwan. I apologize for the sudden visit. These are a small token of my appreciation."

Xiu Fang accepted the gifts and smiled, "You sit down first. I'll go make some tea."

Xiu Fang was efficient. Before Yu Wan could even ask her to put the child down before making tea, she had already walked away.

Seeing how familiar Yuan Qing was with Chen Da Niu and his wife, Yu Wan quietly asked, "When did they get married?"

"Probably a year after you left the capital."

"Judging by Sister-in-law Xiu Fang's accent, is she from the capital?"

"Yeah, her parents run a sundries shop on the street up ahead. Da Niu often went there to buy things..."

Before Yuan Qing could finish, Xiu Fang returned with tea and also opened a package of the pastries Yu Wan had brought, setting them out for everyone.

Neither she nor Chen Da Niu were particular people, and their home didn't have much to offer in the way of proper hospitality at the moment.

"Sister-in-law, there's no need to be so formal. Please, sit down with us."

Yu Wan reached out to pull Xiu Fang down, and Xiu Fang, feeling a bit awkward, looked at Chen Da Niu and also tugged at him.

Chen Da Niu had finally regained some of his senses by this point. "Yu Wan, where have you been all these years? And your mother..."

"Back then, I was forced to leave the capital. All these years, my mother has been with me. I'm sorry for keeping this from you."

"There's nothing to be sorry about," Chen Da Niu said. He had indeed been deeply saddened by Yu Wan's supposed death.

But before they left, she and her mother had left such a good mansion for him to live in. They hadn't treated him badly.

He was well aware that if it weren't for the fact that he had such a large mansion, his in-laws wouldn't have agreed to marry Xiu Fang to him, a poor country bumpkin.

"Yu Wan, the courtyard next door, Xiu Fang and I have been taking care of it. You can move in today." Since Yu Wan had returned, the mansion naturally should be returned to her. Chen Da Niu said, "Xiu Fang and I have a lot of things, so moving out might take ten days or half a month..."

Xiu Fang had previously heard from Chen Da Niu that after Yu Wan's death, her mother had been heartbroken and left the house and the deed to Chen Da Niu.

Now that Yu Wan had returned, although Xiu Fang felt reluctant, she couldn't say anything.

"Brother Da Niu, I only came today to report my safety and to see Sister-in-law and my nephew. I'm not here to take the house back." Yu Wan smiled. "I have a place to stay, so you don't need to move out for me. The courtyard next door is spacious; your family should move in there as soon as possible."

"That won't do," Chen Da Niu hurriedly said. "Don't worry about me ending up on the streets. Over these years, I've earned some money thanks to this mansion. You don't have to worry about that; just take the mansion back."

Hearing this, Yu Wan became curious and asked, "How did you earn money? Did you rent out the house?"

This mansion was so luxurious that renting it out would surely bring in a considerable income. However, besides the front hall, this mansion only had two decent courtyards. One was used as a memorial hall for Yu Wan, and the other was where Chen Da Niu's family lived. There didn't seem to be much space to rent out.

Seeing Yu Wan's interest, Chen Da Niu quickly explained, "There are so many roses, climbing roses, and monthly roses in this courtyard; all famous varieties. There are also many fragrant herbs in the back courtyard. I thought that the perfume and tea shops in the capital would be interested, so I usually pick flowers and fruits to sell. This way, I can earn some money to take care of the place."

Famous varieties of flowers and plants required careful cultivation, which was difficult for ordinary people to achieve.

Although this mansion was small, the flowers and plants were all transplanted from the Marquis's mansion.

"Brother Da Niu, I didn't expect you to have a talent for business." Yu Wan listened to Chen Da Niu's words with newfound respect.

He had wholeheartedly guarded the mansion for her, neither selling nor renting it out.

But maintaining the mansion's appearance was also a considerable expense.

Picking flowers and herbs to sell neither harmed the mansion nor earned money; it was the perfect solution.

Embarrassed by Yu Wan's praise, Chen Da Niu said, "I thought that the flowers would wither anyway, so I might as well exchange them for some money."

Chen Da Niu and Xiu Fang were both hardworking people. They didn't hire anyone and personally took care of the front and back gardens. Although it was hard work, they earned more money this way.

Over these four years, Chen Da Niu had saved up several dozen taels of silver.

"Brother Da Niu, my mother already said she would give this place to you. So it's yours now. If I take the courtyard back, it would make me seem like an unwelcome guest."

Yuan Qing, seeing the situation, interjected, "Da Niu, just listen to Miss Wan. She's going to marry our young master soon and will live in the Marquis's mansion from now on."

"You're going to marry the young master?" Chen Da Niu asked in shock, then immediately felt happy for Yu Wan. "That's great! From now on, you'll be the young master's wife."

Yu Wan heard Yuan Qing's words, and her gaze flickered slightly.

chapters.title: My Wife
chapters.content:
This was indeed the gift Zhao Xuanyou had given her.

Back when she had faked her death and left, she had thought she would have nothing to do with Zhao Xuanyou ever again. She had even discarded the name Zhao Xuanyou, so naturally, she hadn’t paid much attention to this estate.

But now things were different.

Zhao Xuanyou would soon be her husband. How could she not cherish the gifts her husband had given her in the past?

After a moment of thought, Yu Yuan had already made up her mind.

"Big Brother Da Niu, if you want to return the deed to me, that’s fine. But you and Sister-in-law don’t need to move out. Just continue living here."

"Then what about you...?"

"Don’t worry, I won’t let you live here for free. In the future, I’ll still need your help."

Hearing that Yu Yuan needed his help, Chen Da Niu didn’t ask what kind of help. He quickly nodded in agreement.

"Whatever you need, just say the word."

Even though they hadn’t seen each other for over four years, Da Niu was still this reliable.

Yu Yuan smiled. "After my mother and I left the capital, we’ve been running a jewelry shop. Currently, we have one in Yu Prefecture, and there are also shops in Jiangnan helping us distribute goods. Since I’ve returned to the capital, there’s no reason not to open a shop here as well."

"Do you want me to help you guard the shop?"

"Of course not." Yu Yuan laughed. "I want to establish Linglong Fang in the capital, and I want you and Sister-in-law Xiu Fang to manage it."

"Us?" Before Chen Da Niu could speak, Xiu Fang, who had been silent all this time, exclaimed in surprise.

"Sister-in-law Xiu Fang, your family has always been in business. You must have grown up around it and be skilled in this area. Big Brother Da Niu, even though you’ve never done business before, don’t underestimate yourself."

"Can we really do it?"

"Rest assured, there won’t be any problems. In the future, the Linglong Fang in the capital will be split into two storefronts. One will sell gold, silver, jade, and jewelry, and the other will sell rouge and cosmetics. The flowers in this courtyard can be picked and made into rouge and cosmetics, which can then be sold directly in the shop."

"Then where will the jewelry come from?"

"The Linglong Fang in Yu Prefecture is already up and running. There are six or seven master craftsmen working there, and production is fast. I will write to my mother soon and ask her not to rush the shipments to Jiangnan. Instead, I’ll have a security escort bring some goods to the capital."

As Chen Da Niu listened to Yu Yuan’s words, his eyes widened in shock.

"You... you’ve already thought everything through?"

"Yeah."

"Just now?"

Yu Yuan nodded with a smile. "Anyway, for the Linglong Fang in the capital, I’ll be in charge of the jewelry inventory. You and your wife will handle the rouge and cosmetics. You’ll manage the store, I’ll buy the storefront, and we’ll split the profits fifty-fifty."

"That’s not fair to you. I haven’t contributed anything..."

"I’m just afraid I won’t be able to manage the store well. The operations will still depend on you two. Compared to you, I’m the one getting the better deal. You’ve helped me so much before, so don’t refuse anymore."

Chen Da Niu still felt like he was getting an enormous advantage.

Seeing this, Yu Yuan didn’t bother with him anymore. She turned to Xiu Fang. "Sister-in-law, you’re familiar with the capital. Help me think. Where would be the best place to open a shop that sells both jewelry and cosmetics?"

Xiu Fang wasn’t as conflicted as Chen Da Niu.

She had helped her parents run a general store since she was little. However, as a girl, the family business was meant for her brother. When she was young, they let her run around the shop, but as she grew older, her brother and sister-in-law stopped letting her handle the business.

Hearing that Yu Yuan wanted her help in running the shop, Xiu Fang immediately became eager.

The couple might be taking advantage of Yu Yuan’s generosity, but they could manage the shop wholeheartedly and earn more money for her as repayment.

"In the capital, Qingyun Street has the most jewelry shops, and Fangcao Street has the most cosmetics shops. But these two streets are close to each other."

"Then how about we find a storefront somewhere between these two streets?"

"That sounds good." After thinking for a moment, Xiu Fang added, "Since we’re splitting the profits fifty-fifty, Da Niu and I can also contribute half the cost of buying the storefront. We have savings."

"Alright." Yu Yuan saw that Chen Da Niu didn’t want to take too much advantage, so she agreed to Xiu Fang’s suggestion. "Sister-in-law, I’ll leave the task of selecting the storefront to you. I don’t want to manage anything. I’ll just wait to enjoy the results."

"You’re about to get married, so you must be very busy. I’ll handle the storefront. If there’s anything else you need help with, just let me know."

While Chen Da Niu was still hesitating, Yu Yuan and Xiu Fang had already settled everything.

Yu Yuan chatted with Xiu Fang for a while longer, played with her little nephew, and then left with Wen Ji and Yuan Qing.

After leaving the courtyard, Yuan Qing said, "If we need to transport goods to the capital, we don’t need to hire a security escort. We can have the steward of the Hou Mansion in Yu Prefecture handle it."

The Hou Mansion had more properties in Yu Prefecture than in the capital.

Every few months, they would transport the harvest back to the capital. If Linglong Fang’s goods needed to be transported to the capital, it would be more convenient to have the Hou Mansion’s people handle it.

"Anyway, you’ll soon be the wife of the heir. Why be polite about transporting your own things?"

That was true.

After all, just two or three boxes of jewelry would last a long time in the shop and wouldn’t take up much space.

The three of them found a large restaurant on the street to eat, then strolled back to Mingyue Tower.

As Yu Yuan pushed open the door, she saw Zhao Xuanyou sitting in a chair.

"Why are you here? Where’s the wheelchair?"

Yu Yuan’s room was on the third floor of Mingyue Tower, with an excellent view, but the wheelchair couldn’t go up and down the stairs.

Zhao Xuanyou pointed to the crutch beside him without speaking.

Yu Yuan turned back and told Yuan Qing and Wen Ji to go back to their room and rest.

After closing the door, Yu Yuan leaned against it and squinted at Zhao Xuanyou. "Your expression looks like something happened. Did the Old Grandmother and the Marquis not want me to marry into the family?"

"They both can’t wait for you to marry in and quickly help the Hou family have children."

Zhao Xuanyou smiled slightly, but there was indeed a hint of hesitation between his brows.

"Did you go shopping?"

"I went to see Big Brother Da Niu and chatted with him and Sister-in-law for a while. By the way, I also admired the estate you gave me back then."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft snort. "Didn’t you give it away?"

"Big Brother Da Niu was helping me look after the estate. Now that I’m back, he returned it to me." Yu Yuan said, walking over to sit beside Zhao Xuanyou. She nudged his arm. "Since it’s the estate you gave me, I naturally have to take it back."

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t speak. He simply held her and took a deep breath of the fragrance in her hair.

"So what happened?" Sensing that the man’s mood was a bit unusual, Yu Yuan pressed.

"This time, the urgent summons back to the capital wasn’t my father’s idea."

"Then whose...?" Yu Yuan spoke the first two characters, but the last one didn’t come out. She only mouthed the word, "Emperor?"

In the capital, unlike Yu Prefecture, walls had ears. They couldn’t speak carelessly.

"More or less. Pan Xun secretly sent a message to my father, asking him to give me a proper reason to return to the capital."

Yu Yuan remembered that Pan Xun was someone Zhao Xuanyou had personally promoted in the Jin Yi Wei. After Zhao Xuanyou left the Jin Yi Wei, Pan Xun had been heavily favored by the Emperor.

"So what should we do now?"

"I’ve arranged to meet Pan Xun at Mingyue Tower. Later, Yuan Lian will bring him here."

In the evening, the high-ranking officials and nobles in the capital would all come to Mingyue Tower to drink and enjoy themselves. Whether it was Zhao Xuanyou or Pan Xun, coming here wouldn’t attract attention. It was indeed a good place for a secret meeting.

"Should I leave to avoid the meeting?"

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft snort and beckoned Yu Yuan with his finger. "You’re my wife. Why avoid anything?"

---

chapters.title: For Her
chapters.content:
"Then I’ll have the waiter prepare some wine and food."

The upper room was spacious, with a bedroom inside and a reception area outside.

Yu Yuan went out and had a waiter from Mingyue Tower send over some wine and dishes. She didn’t let him enter the room. Instead, she took the tray herself and carried it in, arranging the various exquisite small dishes one by one on the table.

"After getting used to the flavors of the northwest, these dishes seem a bit too delicate."

The patrons of Mingyue Tower were either high-ranking officials or wealthy merchants, so the cuisine at Mingyue Tower sought to be unique and exquisite.

Even hard dishes like steamed goose and crystal pig trotter looked delicate, let alone small dishes like honeyed cherries, chicken marrow bamboo shoots, and tofu with wolfberry.

"Changing the flavor is good too." Zhao Xuanyou said.

Yu Yuan had already eaten outside, so while Zhao Xuanyou was eating, she picked up a bowl of sour cream for herself. Although the cow’s milk in the north was better, when it came to making sour cream, the chefs in the capital were still more skilled.

She scooped a spoonful into her mouth and felt the creamy, rich texture, the milk fragrance lingering.

She had just finished half a bowl of sour cream when Yuan Lian knocked on the door from outside.

"Master, the guest has arrived."

Yu Yuan went forward and opened the door, seeing Yuan Lian leading a man who was about the same age as Zhao Xuanyou.

Although the man was wearing an inconspicuous robe, he still exuded an extraordinary demeanor.

She had heard Zhao Xuanyou mention Pan Xun many times, but this was the first time she had seen him in person.

"Please."

Yu Yuan said softly, waiting for Pan Xun to enter before closing the door.

"Worldly Prince, it’s been a long time."

As soon as he saw Zhao Xuanyou, Pan Xun immediately cupped his hands in greeting.

Zhao Xuanyou smiled faintly. "Director Pan, there’s no need to be so polite. Even the two Prime Ministers would have to show you respect these days."

At the beginning of the year, the former Director of the Jin Yi Wei had made a mistake while on duty. The Emperor then promoted Pan Xun, the Deputy Director, to Director.

"Worldly Prince, don’t make fun of me. Without you, there wouldn’t be my position today."

As Pan Xun spoke, his gaze flicked toward Yu Yuan.

Unlike Yu Yuan, although the two had never met, Pan Xun was very familiar with her appearance.

Back then, Pan Xun had distributed Yu Yuan’s portrait to his trusted subordinates in the Jin Yi Wei, ordering them to look for her whereabouts while handling cases.

As soon as he saw Yu Yuan, he recognized her.

"Director Pan, this is my soon-to-be wife, Ding Yuan."

"Miss Ding, a pleasure."

"Lord Zhao." Yu Yuan greeted him with a curtsy. After the pleasantries, she set out the bowls, chopsticks, and wine cups for him.

After Pan Xun took his seat, he saw Zhao Xuanyou continuing to eat, and Yu Yuan calmly eating her sour cream. For a moment, he felt uncertain.

He had come to Mingyue Tower today to meet Zhao Xuanyou about an important matter. It was a matter of great importance, if even half a word leaked out, it could cost someone their head. But... Zhao Xuanyou should have guessed. He still left Ding Yuan here, which clearly showed he trusted her.

Pan Xun didn’t know Ding Yuan, but he knew Zhao Xuanyou.

He didn’t hesitate any longer and got straight to the point. "Worldly Prince, His Majesty has encountered trouble."

Zhao Xuanyou had guessed that something big had happened in the palace, but he hadn’t expected it to be the Emperor himself. He furrowed his brows and said solemnly, "Why hasn’t there been any news outside?"

After returning to the capital yesterday, Zhao Xuanyou had a long talk with the Marquis of Jingyuan at the Hou Mansion. The Marquis had said that the capital had been calm recently, and he didn’t know why Pan Xun had insisted on Zhao Xuanyou returning to the capital as soon as possible.

Pan Xun lowered his voice. "A month ago, when the imperial physician took His Majesty’s pulse, he felt something unusual. His Majesty also said that his chest occasionally hurt. Another imperial physician diagnosed him and said that His Majesty’s pulse seemed like that of someone who had been poisoned."

"Poisoned?" Zhao Xuanyou found it hard to believe. "Have they found out what was tampered with?"

The Qianqing Palace and Yangxin Hall were not like other places. Every single thing the Emperor consumed was tested by three or four people, and every item near him was repeatedly inspected. How could he possibly be poisoned?

Yu Yuan finished her bowl of sour cream and put down the empty bowl, looking curiously at Pan Xun.

Pan Xun shook his head helplessly.

"They can’t find out?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"The sixty-five people who served in the Qianqing Palace and Yangxin Hall have all been imprisoned. Director Liu has been separately detained. The imperial kitchen, the eunuchs who delivered the meals, and the food tasters have all been replaced. There shouldn’t be any problem with the food."

"Could it have been a one-time poisoning?"

Pan Xun gave a bitter smile. "His Majesty’s poisoning wasn’t severe. The imperial physicians have been continuously detoxifying him. Normally, it would take two or three months to completely remove the poison. But ten days ago, during a pulse check, His Majesty’s poisoning suddenly worsened."

"What’s the current situation in the palace?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a deep voice. "Even though we don’t know how the poison was administered, the only one in the palace who could do such a thing to His Majesty is that person. His Majesty shouldn’t be unaware of this, right?"

The Empress had controlled the harem for more than a decade and had deep roots in the palace. The only person capable of poisoning the Emperor was her.

She was an ambitious woman. Even when Zhao Zhen’s position as Crown Prince was stable, she had secretly ordered the Prince of Zhen Guo to forge weapons.

After the Prince of Zhen Guo fell off his horse and suffered a serious injury, he had been bedridden for months before dying. For the Empress, this was a heavy blow.

She wouldn’t just sit back and wait for death.

As long as the Emperor died, no one could stop Zhao Zhen from ascending the throne.

"The strange thing is, as soon as His Majesty discovered he was poisoned, he ordered people to surround Kunning Palace. But no evidence was found. For more than a month, no one from Kunning Palace has gone out. I really can’t figure out how the poison was administered."

"His Majesty should leave the palace now."

Yu Yuan agreed with Zhao Xuanyou’s suggestion.

Pan Xun lowered his head. "His Majesty is, after all, His Majesty. He feels that being forced to leave the palace is beneath his dignity. He doesn’t want to lose to the Empress."

"You came to me. What do you want to do?" Zhao Xuanyou was not only an outsider but also a military officer. He couldn’t interfere openly in palace matters.

"The Yangxin Hall and Qianqing Palace have a new group of people, all recommended by the two Prime Ministers."

"Do the two Prime Ministers know about His Majesty’s condition?" Zhao Xuanyou narrowed his eyes.

Pan Xun nodded and continued in a low voice, "My foundation in the court is too shallow. Apart from reliable brothers in the Jin Yi Wei, there’s really no one else I can use."

Yu Yuan understood.

Pan Xun had only been promoted in the four years since she left the capital. As the Director of the Jin Yi Wei, he didn’t dare to associate with court officials and only loyally served the Emperor.

Now, because the Emperor had been poisoned, his original confidants had all been removed. The two cunning and crafty Prime Ministers had been in office for decades and naturally had close connections in the palace.

Now that they were placing their own people near the Emperor, Pan Xun naturally wanted to do the same.

Zhao Xuanyou frowned and thought for a while before saying softly, "The Hou Mansion does have some connections with eunuchs in the palace, but they may not be able to handle such a big matter."

After all, he had been on the frontier for many years. His connections in the palace were no match for the two Prime Ministers.

Pan Xun, however, said, "There’s no need to look for eunuchs. I already have a suitable candidate in mind. This time, I took the liberty of asking the Marquis to invite the Worldly Prince and Miss Ding back to the capital because I wanted..."

As he spoke, Pan Xun’s gaze turned to Yu Yuan.

Yu Yuan’s eyes flickered with surprise, but as soon as she met Pan Xun’s gaze, she realized her guess was correct.

Pan Xun wanted her to enter the palace?!

chapters.title: You Are Better Than Her
chapters.content:
"Nonsense!" Before Yu Wan could react, Zhao Xuanyou's eyes were already filled with anger.

Pan Xun knew better than anyone how much Yu Wan meant to Zhao Xuanyou, so naturally, he understood Zhao Xuanyou's feelings.

He had searched for four years to finally find the love of his life. How could he send her into the palace to face danger?

"Your Highness, please calm down. The situation in the palace is not chaotic at the moment, and Miss Ding will not be in any danger entering the palace. Moreover, I am on duty in the palace every day. If Miss Ding encounters any trouble, I will protect her with my life."

"You protect her?!" Zhao Xuanyou's expression suddenly darkened, and a gloomy smile tugged at the corner of his mouth.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's reaction, Pan Xun was slightly taken aback.

Today, he had said so much to Zhao Xuanyou at the Mingyue Tower, and even when he mentioned something as serious as the emperor being poisoned, Zhao Xuanyou had not shown the slightest emotion.

But now, as soon as Ding Wan was mentioned, he immediately got angry.

Since the words were already out, there was no taking them back. Pan Xun steeled himself and said, "Although I am in the palace every day, I am not serving the nobles closely. In the past, when Eunuch Liu was there, we could still get some information, but now I can't get any news at all. It's really quite passive."

Zhao Xuanyou did not think Pan Xun's considerations were wrong.

But at this moment, with the emperor poisoned and the empress and the crown prince eyeing the throne, how could he let Yu Wan go to the palace and risk her life?

While Zhao Xuanyou was seething with anger, Yu Wan remained calm.

She was indeed surprised by Pan Xun's proposal, but she was more curious about his specific plans.

"Minister Pan, if you want me to enter the palace, what identity would I assume? With such a big incident happening in the palace, how could someone with an unclear background like me serve a noble?"

As soon as Yu Wan finished speaking, Zhao Xuanyou's expression became even darker.

This fellow Pan Xun was talking nonsense, and Yu Wan was actually entertaining him?

But he could freely reprimand Pan Xun, yet he could not reprimand Yu Wan. He could only suppress his anger.

Compared to Zhao Xuanyou's frustration, Pan Xun suddenly felt a surge of joy.

He looked at Yu Wan and quickly said, "There is currently an excellent position that only Miss Ding is suitable for."

"Oh?"

"Although the noble consort and the empress have long been at odds, the noble consort dotes on the young prince Zhao Yi Yun, who is the son of the Eastern Palace. After the Kunning Palace was besieged, the noble consort took the young prince into the palace to live under the name of Kunning Palace. However, the young prince has a deep bond with his birth mother, Consort Zhuang, and often cries and makes a fuss because he cannot return to the Eastern Palace. The wet nurses in the palace cannot soothe him, so the noble consort, considering Consort Zhuang's usual character, wants to bring in a talented noble lady from the capital to take care of the young prince."

Zhao Yi Yun was not only the son of Zhao Zun but also the emperor's only grandson.

He was naturally clever and cute, and the emperor's affection for him even surpassed that for Zhao Qi in the past.

Even though the empress was vicious, the emperor still cared for Zhao Yi Yun deeply and did not want him to be influenced by his grandmother and father, so he directly raised him in the palace.

"So who is currently taking care of the young prince?" Yu Wan asked.

Hearing Pan Xun mention that the emperor wanted to select a talented lady from the capital's noble families, and that the two prime ministers were trying to send their own people into the palace, Yu Wan had an idea.

"It is Sun Xiangye's daughter, Sun Qianran."

As expected, it was her.

"Prime Minister Sun and his daughter Sun Qianran are quite scheming. If I enter the palace and take her position, they will definitely not let it go easily."

"Can Your Highness guess Prime Minister Sun's intentions?" Pan Xun asked in a low voice.

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow but did not speak.

Prime Minister Sun's thoughts were not to be guessed.

The emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun to the extreme. By having his own daughter take care of Zhao Yi Yun, he could then urge the poisoned emperor to bypass the princes and pass the throne to Zhao Yi Yun.

With Zhao Yi Yun being so young, Prime Minister Sun would naturally become a regent with great power, ensuring a worry-free life.

Zhao Xuanyou did not really care about these matters.

As long as Zhao Zun was dead, others could fight however they wanted.

Seeing that he was not speaking, Yu Wan also pondered for a while and slowly realized something.

"Does Prime Minister Sun think that the young prince has a chance, so he wants to use this opportunity to let Sun Qianran get close to the young prince?"

"That's right."

"Sun Qianran is clever and capable, but her health is poor, so she may not be suitable for taking care of the young prince."

"Exactly!" Pan Xun had not expected Yu Wan to know Sun Qianran so well. He was overjoyed and quickly said, "She cannot run or jump, and the young prince does not like her at all. The noble consort can naturally see this, so she wants to find someone else."

Although Pan Xun had never met Yu Wan before, he was very clear about how Yu Wan had escaped unscathed from the fire in the firewood room of the Xingguo Duke's mansion and how she had evaded the Jin Yi Wei for three years.

The situation in the palace was complex, but Yu Wan would definitely be able to handle it.

Yu Wan said indifferently, "She is a noble lady from the prime minister's family, and she has entered the palace since she was young. The emperor knows her to be gentle, dignified, and talented, so he would entrust the young prince to her. But I am different. The noble consort values the young prince and will not let me take care of him."

With that, she tactfully declined Pan Xun's request.

The palace was unpredictable. Whether it was for her own sake or for her future with Zhao Xuanyou, she had to proceed cautiously.

Moreover, Yu Wan could see that Zhao Xuanyou did not want her to get involved in this matter. How could she possibly agree?

"Your current identity may not be suitable, but you are about to marry His Highness. Once you become the wife of His Highness, your status will be more noble than Sun Qianran's, and you will naturally have the qualifications to take care of the young prince."

Seeing that Yu Wan seemed to want to refuse, Pan Xun persuaded her again, "In fact, the person the emperor trusts the most is His Highness, so he will definitely trust you."

While Yu Wan was talking to Pan Xun, Zhao Xuanyou had been quietly observing her expression.

Although she was tactfully declining Pan Xun's proposal, when Pan Xun was speaking, her eyes were clearly bright, which did not seem like she was disinterested.

At this moment, Zhao Xuanyou lightly tapped the table.

"It's getting late, Minister Pan, you should return to your residence."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's dismissal, Pan Xun looked at Yu Wan for help. He could see that Yu Wan was not completely uninterested.

Yu Wan only gave him a polite smile and did not speak.

Pan Xun had no choice but to sigh deeply, then stood up and cupped his hands towards Zhao Xuanyou. "I won't disturb Your Highness and Miss Ding any longer. I will definitely come to congratulate you both on your wedding day."

Zhao Xuanyou lightly responded with an "mm," too lazy to even be polite.

Yu Wan, however, stood up and saw Pan Xun out. When Pan Xun reached the door, he could not help but say to Yu Wan, "Miss Ding, if you can stand in the palace…"

"Get out." Zhao Xuanyou roared from inside the room.

If he had known that Pan Xun was coming for Yu Wan, Zhao Xuanyou would not have brought Yu Wan back to the capital!

After Pan Xun left, Yu Wan turned around and saw Zhao Xuanyou's dark face, and she could not help but laugh.

"He was just asking, do you have to be so angry?"

---

chapters.title: He Made a Wish
chapters.content:
"Just asking?" Zhao Xuanyou looked at her, although his voice was calm, his eyes told a different story.

Yu Wan suppressed the smile in her eyes and softly changed the subject, "Since Pan Xun's plan won't work, will we still get married in the capital?"

"Of course." Zhao Xuanyou, who was drinking, almost choked on his wine.

Facing Yu Wan's smile, Zhao Xuanyou coldly humphed, "Getting married is getting married, entering the palace is entering the palace. They are two different matters."

Marrying Yu Wan was his top priority. How could they be mentioned in the same breath?

Moreover, the news of the Old Madame's illness had already spread, and Zhao Xuanyou had brought Yu Wan back. If they did not have a wedding to bring good luck, others would naturally suspect his sudden return to the capital.

Although the capital was currently calm, this calmness was like the days before a great sandstorm.

"Father has already prepared almost everything, and he has selected several auspicious dates. You can pick one today."

"So soon?" Yu Wan blurted out, then came to her senses. She looked at him with a smile that was not quite a smile. "Oh, right. You had already prepared almost everything four years ago. Now it's just a different person entering the door, and nothing else needs to be changed."

Hearing her mention his past intention to marry Feng Jirou, Zhao Xuanyou coughed awkwardly and picked up his wine to soothe his throat.

Yu Wan knew when to stop and did not dwell on the matter. She asked instead, "Which dates has the Marquis chosen?"

"This month, the 9th, 17th, 28th, and 29th are all good."

With the wedding arranged so urgently, it was impossible to find a once-in-a-century auspicious date, but there were always a few suitable days for marriage in a month.

For Zhao Xuanyou, as long as it was marrying her, every day was auspicious.

"Today is already the 2nd, so the 9th is definitely too soon..."

"Then the 17th?" Zhao Xuanyou interrupted her.

Yu Wan understood his eagerness, but her wedding dress was only half done. She could not get married wearing an unfinished product.

She frowned and said, "My wedding dress isn't finished yet, and my mother also said that the headdress needs a few more gems."

Although she had brought all the gems needed for inlaying to the capital, finding a suitable craftsman would still take time.

"Can we hire more embroiderers?"

"More people doesn't necessarily mean better," Yu Wan said, her lips slightly pursed, her eyes shimmering. "I will figure out my own wedding dress and headdress. If you think the 17th is good, then let's set it for the 17th."

Yu Wan's voice was soft, and as Zhao Xuanyou looked at her beautiful eyes, his heartbeat became slightly erratic.

She had been away from him for too long, so long that he always felt she might leave again at any moment.

He needed to marry her as soon as possible; the sooner, the better.

"What? You don't like the 17th anymore?" Seeing that he was not speaking, Yu Wan tilted her head and looked at him.

"I do like it."

Zhao Xuanyou smiled lightly and reached out to pull her.

Yu Wan did not dodge and let him pull her into his embrace.

He said, "If we can't find suitable embroiderers, have Yuan Qing find Manager Song. The major embroidery workshops in the capital often take on work for the Marquis's residence. If Manager Song steps in, they will give face."
