In the capital, most high-ranking families had their own embroiderers, but the Jingyuan Marquis's residence usually only had the Old Madame living in the capital.

She was old and devoted to Buddhism, so simple embroidery work was done by the maids and servants in the courtyard, while larger items like clothes and quilts were outsourced to embroiderers.

"I know." Yu Wan sat in his embrace and thought for a moment before briefly telling Zhao Xuanyou about her discussion with Chen Da Niu and his wife. "Da Niu and his wife take good care of the garden. I was thinking of letting them live there for now. If our business in the capital goes well, and they save enough money to find a good house, they will definitely move out."

Of course, Yu Wan would be happy for Chen Da Niu's family to live there for a lifetime, but she understood Da Niu's character; he would definitely move out as soon as possible.

As long as Linglong Fang could make money, it would not be difficult for their family to buy their own house.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded.

He was very clear about Chen Da Niu's character. Whether Yu Wan wanted them to live there or to partner with them in business, it was worth it.

"Wanwan, do you like that house?"

"I do."

"Then, would you like to get married from there?"

Zhao Xuanyou had thought about finding another courtyard in the capital as her maternal home, but hearing that Yu Wan had taken the house back, it would be best for her to get married from there.

After all, Ding Wenxi was not in the capital, and Chen Da Niu and Wen Kuang were like Yu Wan's family in the capital.

If Yu Wan stayed at her "maternal home" for these days, having them by her side would make it livelier.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou's suggestion, Yu Wan had no objections.

Anyway, Chen Da Niu had not touched the place where Ding Wenxi used to live, so Yu Wan could just move in.

Now that she had the idea of opening a Linglong Fang branch in the capital, living with them would make it easier to discuss matters.

"Can we give that house a name?" Yu Wan suddenly had an idea.

"What do you want to name it?"

"I want you to name it," Yu Wan said, gently rubbing her nose against his. "You gave it to me, so of course you should name it."

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze lingered on her face.

With just a few simple words, she always managed to effortlessly captivate his heart and make him unconsciously indulge.

"Wanwan, do you remember when we took a boat together and passed by the Goddess Peak?"

"Of course, what about it?" Yu Wan asked curiously.

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes darkened as he hesitated for a long time before finally saying in a low voice, "At that time, you told me the legend of the Goddess Peak."

"Yeah," recalling the Goddess Peak, Yu Wan seemed to see the beautiful, mist-shrouded peak again. She recounted the legend of the Goddess Peak, "It is said that she was the daughter of the Queen Mother of the West. Because she yearned for the mortal world, she was banished to Wu Mountain and turned into the Goddess Peak. If a woman from Shu has someone in her heart, she will make a wish to the Goddess Peak, praying for mutual love. If the man breaks her heart, the clouds and mist on the peak will turn into tears, raining down and soaking the entire Wu Mountain. Why did you bring up the Goddess Peak?"

"You said at that time that you didn't believe in the legend."

"It is indeed a beautiful legend, and I indeed don't believe in it. Don't you agree?"

At that time, Yu Wan and Zhao Xuanyou were almost at each other's throats. Yu Wan was in a terrible mood and felt awful, so how could she believe in such an ethereal legend?

Zhao Xuanyou naturally felt the same.

"I..." Zhao Xuanyou, quite unusually, began to stammer.

Yu Wan looked at him in surprise, thought for a moment, and tentatively asked, "Do you want to go and tour the Twelve Peaks of Wu Gorge?"

"If there is a chance, I would naturally be willing to go with you."

However, that was not what Zhao Xuanyou wanted to say.

He looked at Yu Wan, his eyes obscure, and after a long silence, he finally made up his mind.

"That night, after you returned to the cabin, I stood alone at the bow of the ship, looking at the Goddess Peak, and then..."

"Then you dreamed of the Wu Mountain Goddess at night?"

Normally, Zhao Xuanyou loved to tease her with such ambiguous words. At this moment, he was rarely serious, and hearing Yu Wan's teasing, he could only helplessly smile bitterly.

"I stood at the bow of the ship and made a wish to the Goddess Peak."

chapters.title: Relentless Pursuit
chapters.content:
Facing Yu Yuan’s eyes brimming with laughter, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly regretted telling her about this.

"It's getting late. I should return to the marquis's residence. You can choose any name you like and have a plaque made to hang up."

Seeing the man’s expression suddenly turn stern, Yu Yuan couldn’t stop her laughter no matter what.

When she saw him push her out of his arms and even stand up to leave with his cane, Yu Yuan, rarely clingy, stuck to him, pulling his arm to stop him from leaving.

"What’s the meaning of leaving the story half-told? You promised to name that house yourself. You can’t leave until you do."

"And whatever I say goes?"

Zhao Xuanyou’s tone was harsh, but Yu Yuan still smiled brightly.

She helped him sit on the beauty couch by the window, linking her arm with his. "Come on, whatever you say goes."

"Then it’ll be called…"

"Exactly what wish did you make?" Before Zhao Xuanyou could finish, Yu Yuan impatiently pressed him.

Zhao Xuanyou awkwardly averted his gaze.

At this moment, he deeply regretted his decision.

He couldn’t understand what had come over him earlier to share his secret with her.

Yu Yuan refused to let it go, her beautiful eyebrows twitching. "If you don’t tell me, next time I tell you something, I’ll only say half of it. Don’t blame me then."

Her gaze was intense, her tone carrying a threat, much like the way Zhao Xuanyou used to interrogate criminals when he was the commander of the Brocade Guard.

Zhao Xuanyou knew he had impulsively fallen into her trap today. There was no way to change the subject, so he reluctantly said, "It was just a casual wish, and it’s related to you."

"There are many things related to me. What exactly did you wish for?" Yu Yuan scoffed, clearly not letting him off with such a vague answer.

"It’s exactly what you’re thinking." Zhao Xuanyou gritted his teeth.

Yu Yuan’s delicate chin lifted slightly, exuding a smug and triumphant air, refusing to let him off.

"I can’t think of anything. Be clearer."

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression was one of utter helplessness, yet he had no way to deal with Yu Yuan.

He had said many sappy things to Yu Yuan before and done many wild things, but this was different.

This was something Zhao Xuanyou had never done in his life, yet he did it for her.

"Zhao Xuanyou!"

Yu Yuan raised her voice, a final ultimatum.

"When I passed the Goddess Peak, I wished to reconcile with you and for our hearts to connect."

As Yu Yuan listened to his deliberate, measured words, her eyes shimmered like spring water after the thaw, rippling with vitality.

He actually made a wish...

Zhao Xuanyou actually made a wish for her at the Goddess Peak...

Even though she had been teasing and mocking him, her heartbeat couldn’t help but quicken.

The man before her still looked cold, but when her fingers touched his cheek, she could feel the burning heat of his skin.

Yu Yuan couldn’t help but lift the corners of her lips high.

"Have you ever made any other wishes to gods or Buddhas in your life?"

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou answered decisively.

He was a man who had fought his way out of battlefields. He didn’t believe in gods or Buddhas, nor in supernatural forces. He only believed in the sword in his hand.

Even when the old marchioness and Marquis Jingyuan were unwell, Zhao Xuanyou would only do his best to find famous doctors and the best medicines in the world for them. He would never burn incense or pray.

But for Yu Yuan...

At that time, Yu Yuan was about to marry someone else. There was not a trace of affection in her eyes when she looked at him. She resisted his touch and rejected his approach.

Although he had never let go, his heart was in ruins.

When passing the Goddess Peak, listening to the legends she spoke of, he truly didn’t believe them.

But after she turned away resolutely, he couldn’t help but pray to the Goddess, becoming the kind of person who sought divine help; something he had once despised.

What if...

What if there really was a Goddess in that mountain?

As long as she could change her mind, doing something foolish wouldn’t matter.

"I’m going back."

Just now, being relentlessly pursued by Yu Yuan was an embarrassment Zhao Xuanyou had never experienced in his life.

Not to mention dealing with those foreign spies in Yuzhou, even in the imperial court in the capital, he had always been dominant, effortlessly navigating even before the emperor and the crown prince.

"Didn’t mean to laugh at you." Yu Yuan was somewhat pleased, looking at his flushed face, annoyed and ashamed. She lifted her face and lightly pecked his thin lips.

He really had been teased badly. Just that light touch made Yu Yuan feel as if she had been scorched by charcoal.

"Isn’t this laughing at me?"

Normally, if Yu Yuan kissed him, no problem would be too big to solve.

But today, Zhao Xuanyou wasn’t so easily placated.

"I won’t laugh anymore. I really want to know what name to give it. We can’t call it Witch Mountain Garden or Goddess Garden, can we?"

Yu Yuan deliberately suggested two unremarkable names, and sure enough, Zhao Xuanyou frowned deeply at the sound of them.

"Hurry up and help me think."

With her soft, coquettish tone, she successfully shifted the topic, and Zhao Xuanyou finally extracted himself from his earlier embarrassment.

"Being so direct isn’t good. The Goddess Peak is always shrouded in clouds and mist. How about calling it Mist Garden?"

"Mist Garden?"

Yu Yuan softly repeated the name a few times, growing more satisfied.

"The character for mist is good. When others hear this name, they’ll know the owner of this house is as ethereal and mysterious as the clouds and mist."

Hearing that she liked the name and was proudly boasting about it, the frustration that had built up in Zhao Xuanyou’s chest finally eased.

Yu Yuan added, "Since you’re idle at the marquis’s residence anyway, why not write a plaque for me to hang at the entrance?"

"My handwriting isn’t good. I’ll find a famous calligrapher to write it for you."

"No, I want yours. Even if it’s ugly, I still want it."

Zhao Xuanyou’s handwriting was, of course, not ugly.

As a child, he had also studied under famous masters. Although he hadn’t specialized in calligraphy, his penmanship was as powerful as his swordplay, with a robust and forceful style all its own.

"Mmm."

If she wanted him to write it, how could he refuse?

Watching his slightly furrowed brows, Yu Yuan reached out and hugged his shoulder.

"Zhao Xuanyou, I’m actually very happy."

Hearing her bring up the wish again, Zhao Xuanyou’s heart tightened, afraid she would continue her relentless pursuit.

But Yu Yuan only said, "I like that you made a wish for me."

"Really?"

Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t describe his current feelings. He just stared deeply into her lively, clear, laughing eyes.

"Mmm. From now on, you’re not allowed to make wishes for anyone else."

Her tone was somewhat domineering.

Zhao Xuanyou slightly raised his eyebrows and turned to look at her.

She smiled gently and sat down in his lap. "So, do you agree or not?"

Yu Yuan always effortlessly made his heart race. He didn’t want to say anything, but he wanted to do something. He leaned in and kissed her.

After the intense passion between their lips subsided somewhat, she still wouldn’t let it go. "You still haven’t answered."

"I agree."

How could he refuse her request?

He didn’t believe in gods or Buddhas anyway. His act of praying to the Goddess Peak was just a desperate measure forced upon him by her.

Who else could push him to such lengths but her?

---

chapters.title: Wedding Preparations
chapters.content:
"Before the wedding, do I need to pay a visit to the old marchioness and the marquis?"

At a time like this, it was customary for the elders of both families to meet, but Ding Wenxi was far away in Yuzhou, and Wen Sun and Chen Da Niu weren’t in a position to help her discuss marriage matters as her maternal family.

"The old marchioness knows you so well. It doesn’t matter whether you see her or not. As for my father... we’ll talk about it after you’re married."

Marquis Jingyuan was indeed quite curious about Yu Yuan, but since the wedding was set for the 17th in half a month, a few days wouldn’t make a difference.

"Don’t worry about these things. Just focus on preparing for the wedding at Mist Garden." After a pause, Zhao Xuanyou remembered something else and instructed, "When you return to Mist Garden, make some space for the dowry."

While in Yuzhou, Ding Wenxi had helped her prepare some dowry, but since Zhao Xuanyou was in such a hurry to bring her back to "bring good luck," the prepared dowry hadn’t had time to be transported to the capital.

Since Yu Yuan was marrying into the marquis’s residence, she naturally needed a dowry to maintain appearances, and this was something Zhao Xuanyou had to handle.

Since the dowry would be carried into the marquis’s residence anyway, Yu Yuan naturally didn’t refuse.

"I know."

"There are plenty of maids and matrons in the marquis’s residence, but you can go and buy a few maids you like to bring with you to the marquis’s residence."

"Mmm." Yu Yuan responded indifferently.

Zhao Xuanyou then took out his money pouch and placed it on the low table of the beauty couch.

"The dowry prepared by Manager Song is probably nothing special. It’s just for show. Here’s two thousand taels. If you want to add anything, buy it yourself."

"I know. Zhao Xuanyou, why are you as nagging as my mother? It’s endless. I’ll handle it myself."

The night before leaving Yuzhou, Ding Wenxi had talked to her for a long time in bed, giving her many instructions. By the end, Yu Yuan had even fallen asleep.

She hadn’t expected that after coming to the capital, Zhao Xuanyou would give her another round of the same.

In front of Ding Wenxi, she had meekly pretended to listen, but in front of Zhao Xuanyou, she didn’t want to endure it.

Facing her disdainful gaze, Zhao Xuanyou felt a sudden stuffiness in his chest.

He had said so much because he was afraid she would be at a loss.

Actually, there were still several things he wanted to say, but he didn’t want to be called nagging by Yu Yuan.

He was nagging?

He, Zhao Xuanyou, had always been decisive and resolute.

He had originally thought to spend more time talking with her today, to linger here and be affectionate with her, but instead, he had been embarrassed time and time again.

"Can’t be bothered with you."

Zhao Xuanyou’s face turned cold. He pushed Yu Yuan aside with a wave of his hand and, supporting himself, tried to stand up.

"Really leaving?"

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head back, glaring at her with a stern face, refusing to say another word.

Yu Yuan stepped forward, linking her arm with his, her eyes filled with tenderness. "I’ll handle these small matters myself. Thank you for the money."

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm."

Wedding preparations were complicated, and he was worried that Yu Yuan didn’t have enough help, that many things might not be considered, and that she wouldn’t be prepared in time.

But after thinking for a moment, he had another idea.

Once he returned to the marquis’s residence, he would select a few capable old matrons to go to Mist Garden to help her.

"You know best. I’ll go back first."

It was indeed getting late. Yu Yuan had been out all day and was tired, so she didn’t keep him any longer. She helped him with his cane and saw him out of the Moon Tower.

Having decided to marry from Mist Garden, the next day Yu Yuan went to Mist Garden again.

Yu Yuan threw the ancestral tablets in the house into the stove and burned them, then did a simple cleaning.

When Chen Da Niu and his wife learned of Yu Yuan’s plans, they were naturally delighted and eagerly helped her prepare for the wedding.

After lunch, Manager Song arrived with six matrons, saying they were sent by the young master to help her prepare for the wedding.

Yu Yuan recalled Zhao Xuanyou’s stern expression from the day before when he said, "Can’t be bothered with you," and couldn’t help but smile.

She understood his intentions.

Without standing on ceremony, she assigned tasks to the matrons and handed over the unfinished headdresses and wedding dresses that Ding Wenxi had prepared to Manager Song, asking him to find reliable craftsmen and embroiderers to rush the work.

With their help, Yu Yuan’s workload was greatly reduced.

Xiu Fang accompanied her to buy two young maids, one named Pan Xia and the other Ran Dong.

Zhao Xuanyou might have been a bit nagging, but he had indeed thought of everything.

How could the young marchioness enter the residence without a single personal maid by her side?

After settling all these matters, Yu Yuan even found time to go with Xiu Fang to look at shops and quickly settled on one to buy.

By the 14th, Manager Song visited again, bringing the finished headdresses and wedding dresses, along with Zhao Xuanyou’s betrothal gifts and dowry.

Wen Sun helped Yu Yuan count the items and couldn’t help but say, "The young master has it hard too. Not only does he have to give betrothal gifts to marry a wife, but he also has to prepare the dowry himself."

Yu Yuan also found it amusing but still said, "Why are you taking his side?"

"Just saying."

"My money will eventually be used to help you marry a wife, so the more, the better."

Hearing Yu Yuan tease him again, Wen Sun turned his face away and continued counting.

Yu Yuan flipped through the items for a while, then sighed. "Mist Garden still lacks a steward and an accountant. With a steward and an accountant, we won’t have to do these things ourselves."

As they were busy, Chen Da Niu burst in excitedly. "Yu Yuan, someone is here to see you."

"Someone from the marquis’s residence?"

"Sort of," Chen Da Niu said with a smile. "It’s Miss Ziyan, who used to work with you at the marquis’s residence."

"How do you know her?"

Yu Yuan had a good relationship with Ziyan, but as far as she remembered, Chen Da Niu should only know Yingxue.

Chen Da Niu quickly explained, "After your accident, Miss Ziyan came to pay her respects once."

Pay her respects?

Yu Yuan felt a sudden embarrassment.

"Does she know I’m still alive?"

Chen Da Niu scratched his head, hesitating. "Should I not have told her you’re still alive? But I already did."

"It’s fine. There’s no need to hide it."

Returning to the capital naturally meant she would encounter old acquaintances, and Ziyan was much better than others.

Thinking of what Pan Xun had said before, Yu Yuan felt a little confused.

If Ziyan was working in the Eastern Palace, how could she come and go freely?

What was the situation in the Eastern Palace...

A hint of curiosity arose in Yu Yuan’s heart. She looked up at the maid by the door. "Pan Xia, please invite the guest in. Ran Dong, prepare tea for the guest."

Pan Xia and Ran Dong were both around fourteen or fifteen years old, similar in age to Yu Yuan when she first entered the marquis’s residence. Both were pretty and clever, but since they had never worked as maids before, they needed Yu Yuan’s instructions to know what to do.

"Yes."

Wen Sun had just put away the betrothal gifts and dowry list when Pan Xia led Ziyan in.

After more than four years, Ziyan looked much better than before. She was dressed in fine clothes and adorned with gold and jade.

As soon as she entered and saw the beautiful and charming Yu Yuan sitting in the room, her gaze froze.

"Ziyan, long time no see." Yu Yuan smiled.

Ziyan took a deep breath, suppressing the emotions in her heart, and smiled at Yu Yuan. "Yes, long time no see."

chapters.title: A Hot Potato
chapters.content:
Thinking of how Chen Da Niu mentioned that Ziyan had once come to Wu Garden to pay respects to her, Yu Wan also felt a pang of emotion.

She stepped forward, took Ziyan’s hand, and had her sit down. After pouring tea for her, she asked, "How did you know I returned to the capital?"

Ziyan replied, "Today I went out to buy some things. Passing by here, I saw the place lit up with lanterns, red 'joy' characters hanging, and Chen Gongzi busy at the entrance. I went up to ask, and didn’t expect it to be your wedding. Yu Wan, where have you been all these years?"

"Many places; Jiangnan, Lingnan, Shu, and Yu Prefecture."

Ziyan had witnessed how Yu Wan used to bury herself in books and practice calligraphy at Honghui Hall. Though her family background couldn’t compare to Zhuang Huaiyue’s, she was also literate, so Yu Wan had often sought her advice.

Hearing that Yu Wan had traveled and seen the world, Ziyan felt both happy and envious for her.

"How wonderful. All those places you once read about in poems; now you’ve seen them all."

"Well, east, west, north, south; I’ve at least made a full circle."

A glint flickered in Ziyan’s eyes as she recalled the rumors about Zhao Xuanyou. She asked, "You went to Yu Prefecture? Then what about you and the Heir?"

"We’ve already set the marriage date. On the seventeenth, I’ll marry into the Marquis’s residence."

"You’re marrying the Heir?"

Ziyan had no romantic feelings for Zhao Xuanyou, but having spent so much time at Honghui Hall, she knew full well what kind of man he was. Marrying such a man was something anyone would envy.

"You’ve truly... had it hard. I wish you and the Heir a lifetime of love and harmony."

"Thank you."

"Before, when I was still in the Eastern Palace, I heard the Crown Prince tell Zhuang Liangdi that the Heir had gone mad over a dead maid. Though he didn’t say much, Zhuang Liangdi and I guessed it was you."

Yu Wan gave a faint smile. Compared to her own affairs, she was more curious about the Eastern Palace.

"You’re no longer working in the Eastern Palace?"

Ziyan nodded. "Last December, Zhuang Liangdi asked His Highness the Crown Prince to arrange a marriage for me, so I left the Eastern Palace and got married."

"A marriage arranged by His Highness the Crown Prince. It must be a good one, right?"

Indeed, judging by Ziyan’s clothing and adornments, it wasn’t hard to guess her marriage was excellent.

"It’s a sixth-rank military officer from the Arms Bureau. He treats me well."

"With a young imperial grandson by her side, Zhuang Liangdi’s days in the Eastern Palace must be very comfortable. Why didn’t you want to stay as a palace official?"

At the mention of her past days in the Eastern Palace, Ziyan let out a heavy sigh.

"Liangdi does have the Crown Prince’s favor, but... her path hasn’t been easy either."

Especially when she was pregnant with the young imperial grandson. Apart from the times she ate with the Crown Prince, she didn’t dare relax at all; she didn’t even dare eat pastries. At that time, Ziyan was the only one by her side, and she had to check every little detail. Every day was spent in anxiety.

It wasn’t until Zhuang Huaiyue safely gave birth to Zhao Yi Yun, and the mother and child received the Empress’s care, that their days in the Eastern Palace improved.

Of course, Ziyan wouldn’t easily speak of these things.

She only vaguely said, "Zhuang Liangdi now has many attendants by her side. She doesn’t need me anymore, so I asked for her permission to leave the Eastern Palace."

Recalling what Pan Xun had said, Yu Wan felt relieved for Ziyan. The Empress had poisoned the Emperor, and though the Emperor’s life was no longer in danger, the fall of Kunning Palace and the Eastern Palace was imminent.

Ziyan was kind and gentle. Fortunately, heaven had favored her, allowing her to avoid disaster.

"It’s good that you left the Eastern Palace. Waiting on others all the time, after a few years, one would have had enough."

"Yes," Ziyan agreed.

"Is the young imperial grandson cute?" Yu Wan suddenly asked.

"Of course. His Majesty and Her Majesty both dote on him. He’s good-looking, clever, and never mischievous; quite gentle, in fact. But..."

"But what?"

"Sometimes I feel he’s a little too gentle."

"How so?"

"Once, when it was raining, I saw him frowning as he leaned against a window. When I asked what was wrong, he said that ants would drown in the rain. Tell me, at just over three years old, thinking about such things. Isn’t that too gentle?"

"He truly is a smart and perceptive child. Did you often play with him when you were in the Eastern Palace?"

"More or less. He’s Zhuang Liangdi’s lifeline; she couldn’t bear to entrust him to anyone else and always took care of him personally. Since I attended to Zhuang Liangdi, I was often by his side. Sigh... because Zhuang Liangdi valued the young imperial grandson so much, His Highness the Crown Prince has favored new consorts these past two years."

So Zhuang Huaiyue had been raising the child herself. No wonder the Emperor, after taking the child into the palace, found him unaccustomed to it.

Noticing Yu Wan’s slightly furrowed brows, Ziyan quickly said, "Yu Wan, am I disturbing your wedding preparations by talking about this now?"

With only three days until the wedding, this indeed wasn’t the time for entertaining guests.

Yu Wan didn’t keep Ziyan long. After exchanging a few more pleasantries and learning where she lived, she promised to invite her for tea another day and saw her out.

After Ziyan left, Yu Wan couldn’t help but think about the young imperial grandson.

If Ziyan were to help, perhaps she really could take good care of him.

This thought suddenly struck her, and Yu Wan immediately clutched her chest.

She shouldn’t think like this.

She was going to marry Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want her involved in palace affairs, and she knew she shouldn’t involve herself either.

If the Crown Prince fell from power, no matter which prince became the new heir, the young imperial grandson would inevitably become a hot potato.

Of course, Pan Xun’s suggestion to recommend her to the palace to care for the young imperial grandson wasn’t just to make the child happier.

Whether it was Premier Sun or Pan Xun, they wanted to use the young imperial grandson to plant an informant near the Emperor. This way, they could gain more initiative during the change in succession.

Zhao Xuanyou, or rather, the Marquis of Jingyuan’s residence, would benefit the most from this transition.

From what Ziyan said, comforting the young imperial grandson shouldn’t be difficult. Yu Wan was confident...

She couldn’t think about it anymore.

Yu Wan did her best to suppress her thoughts. Wen Geng, seeing her suddenly cover her face with both hands, her expression growing heavy, asked, "Why are you so interested in the young imperial grandson?"

"I’m not interested in him. I just..." Yu Wan sighed deeply, looking at Wen Geng with some helplessness. "Geng, what should I do? I can’t stop thinking about things I shouldn’t."

"The Eastern Palace?"

"More or less," Yu Wan said with a bitter face. "It’s just that some things, even though I know I shouldn’t think about them, I can’t help it."

She spoke in circles, and Wen Geng couldn’t understand or interject.

"Then think more about Zhao Xuanyou?"

Think about Zhao Xuanyou?

Zhao Xuanyou’s broad shoulders, narrow waist, and handsome, dignified figure suddenly appeared in Yu Wan’s mind.

Since their meeting at Mingyue Tower, she hadn’t seen him.

She didn’t know what he had been doing these past ten days... why hadn’t he sneaked over to see her?

Yu Wan lowered her gaze and bit her lip. The stray thoughts in her mind finally began to fade one by one.

---

chapters.title: Sharing Joy and Sorrow
chapters.content:
Yu Wan’s emotions settled slightly. She looked at Wen Geng and suddenly remembered something.

"Wen Geng, will you come with me to the Marquis’s residence?"

Wen Geng’s eyebrows twitched as he looked at Yu Wan. "You don’t want me to go?"

"How could that be?" Yu Wan quickly said. "The capital is different from Yu Prefecture. The Marquis’s residence has the Old Dowager and the Marquis. If you feel uncomfortable, you can stay at Wu Garden."

Wen Geng thought for a moment and still pressed for an answer. "Do you want me to go?"

Yu Wan wanted Wen Geng to always stay by her side.

With Wen Geng there, she would always feel more confident.

But the Marquis’s residence in the capital had many rules, and she was afraid he would feel out of place.

Moreover, she didn’t want to be too selfish, always keeping Wen Geng tied to her side.

"You used to either follow the Crown Prince or stay in your own small courtyard. You’ve never really traveled around. Zhao Xuanye rarely returns to the capital, so he will likely spend more time attending to his elders at the residence. After I marry, I’ll have to accompany him, so I probably won’t have time to take you out."

Seeing Wen Geng remain silent, Yu Wan said, "If you can’t decide, then come with me to the Marquis’s residence."

Wen Geng hesitated for a moment before nodding. He continued to help Yu Wan check the items.

Three days passed in a flash. Though the Marquis’s residence sent people and gifts every day, Zhao Xuanye did not appear again.

On the seventeenth, the sky was clear and warm, with soft, flowing clouds.

Wu Garden was decorated with festive red lanterns and "joy" characters, both along the corridors and on the doors and windows.

Early in the morning, a skilled old matron began styling Yu Wan’s hair.

It was said this matron had great fortune and skill; every noble family in the capital requested her services for their daughters’ weddings.

Yu Wan’s hair was piled high in the style of a noblewoman from the capital, her brows and eyes accentuated to appear even more beautiful and graceful.

Looking at herself in the mirror, her skin was as smooth as congealed fat, her cheeks like soft snow, and the corners of her eyes and brows exuded a captivating charm.

Accustomed to her plain face, Yu Wan couldn’t help but feel a hint of admiration for her own appearance. When Zhao Xuanye lifted her veil that night...

Yu Wan suppressed her self-satisfaction, took a deep breath, and let the old matron place the phoenix crown on her head.

"This phoenix crown is too beautiful. Last month, when I styled the hair of the third young lady of the Anguo Duke’s residence, their phoenix crown, though heavy with gold, had jewels far less stunning than the bride’s."

Yu Wan gently touched a large red gemstone in the center and smiled slightly.

Her mother wasn’t stingy with gold; it was just that the Marquis’s residence had many rules and ceremonies, so she intentionally had the phoenix crown made delicate, yet adorned with large red gemstones to make it both elegant and not too heavy.

Speaking of which, this large gemstone was the one Tiya had tried to sell to Yu Wan at the Hu people’s market.

After Asuohan’s downfall, Zhao Xuanye ordered a search of Tiya’s shop in the Hu market. They captured more than a dozen Uwan spies and confiscated the gemstones in the shop.

Recalling how Tiya said this large gemstone would match Yu Wan’s beauty, this particular stone was sent to Ding Wenxi, who had it set into Yu Wan’s phoenix crown.

"I’ve never seen such a large red gemstone before."

"My family does jewelry business in the Western Regions. We may not have much else, but we have good connections for buying gemstones."

These were the words the Marquis’s residence used to explain to their relatives.

Zhao Xuanye was to marry a girl named Ding Wan, whose family in Yu Prefecture ran a jade and stone business.

For a merchant’s daughter to marry into the Marquis’s residence was a great honor, and since Zhao Xuanye was not marrying for the first time and had long been in Yu Prefecture, it wasn’t strange for him to take a local wife.

"The Marquis’s residence’s welcoming party has arrived," Pan Xia announced from outside.

Wen Geng, who had been quietly sitting beside her, stepped forward and placed the red veil over Yu Wan’s head.

He crouched down and carried Yu Wan on his back toward the door.

Before they even left the room, Wen Geng whispered, "No more next time, right?"

"You should say something auspicious," Yu Wan said, exasperated by his teasing.

Wen Geng held back his laughter and carried her out.

Since Ding Wenxi was far away in Yu Prefecture, the ceremony of bidding farewell to her parents was omitted at Wu Garden.

Wen Geng carried Yu Wan out the door. Outside, firecrackers crackled, and Chen Da Niu and his wife led the servants in distributing wedding cakes and candies. The onlookers gathered around, offering their congratulations.

From the corner of her eye, through a gap in the veil, Yu Wan caught sight of Zhao Xuanye standing tall in the distance.

Today, as the groom, he naturally wasn’t in his wheelchair. Holding a short cane, dressed in a wedding robe, his tall and dignified figure had regained its former noble and outstanding presence.

Pan Xia and Ran Dong stepped forward to help Yu Wan stand steady.

Watching Zhao Xuanye slowly approach, Wen Geng suddenly said in a low voice, "I think you can have a good life with him."

Finally, an auspicious remark.

Yu Wan lightly responded with an "mm."

Before she could say more, Zhao Xuanye reached her side and took her hand.

As his hand enclosed hers, Yu Wan’s heart grew even calmer.

Zhao Xuanye helped her into the bridal sedan, then mounted his horse.

The wedding procession moved through the streets to the sound of drums and music. Yu Wan’s emotions were complex, and many past memories surfaced, bringing a warmth to the corners of her eyes.

This was the path she had chosen, and this was the person she had chosen.

Even though the future was uncertain, Yu Wan knew she did not regret it.

The sedan arrived at the gate of the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence. The bridal attendant helped Yu Wan out of the sedan and once again placed her hand in Zhao Xuanye’s.

The two entered the residence together, where the courtyard was filled with well-wishers.

After all, it was the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence holding a wedding. Even if the bride was from a merchant family, the nobles of the capital dared not be negligent, and they all came to offer their congratulations.

Zhao Xuanye and Yu Wan were surrounded by relatives and led to the main hall, where they performed the wedding bows before Old Dowager Ye and the Marquis of Jingyuan. Then, they were escorted to the bridal chamber.

The bridal chamber was the former Liu Fang Pavilion, now redecorated. Not only had the furniture and decorations been replaced, but even the plaque at the entrance of the courtyard had been taken down and replaced with a new one that read "Tangli Courtyard."

"Be careful," Zhao Xuanye gently reminded her, helping Yu Wan sit on the edge of the canopied bed.

After the bride and groom were seated, the bridal attendant brought the wedding wine.

Zhao Xuanye took a cup and handed it to Yu Wan, then picked up another for himself.

It wasn’t yet time to lift the red veil, so he couldn’t see Yu Wan’s expression; only her slender, fair hand extending from the wedding dress, nearly the same color as the white jade cup holding the wine.

He lightly pursed his lips, leaned closer to her, and together they drank the wedding wine.

The attendant beside them announced loudly, "By the mandate of heaven, the wedding wine seals the union. Sharing joy and sorrow, may your hearts be forever bound."

"One cup of wedding wine to intoxicate the seasons, from this day forward, may you grow old together in this world!" Yu Moqing, who had always been close to Zhao Xuanye, led the poetic blessing. The other relatives who had come to tease the newlyweds also chimed in with their congratulations.

"Congratulations! Congratulations!"

Yu Moqing stepped forward and pulled Zhao Xuanye. "Congratulations, big brother, on getting the beauty you desired. Today, you must drink with us brothers to your heart’s content."

"That’s right!"

The people around them clamored, pulling Zhao Xuanye away.

"Drink! Today, I’ll drink with you all to my heart’s content."

As he stood up, Zhao Xuanye’s hand secretly slipped under the red veil, gently brushing Yu Wan’s cheek as a silent farewell.

The capital was different from Yu Prefecture; the relatives outside still needed to be attended to.

Yu Wan, of course, understood.

After the people teasing the newlyweds had all left with Zhao Xuanye, she lifted the red veil herself and curiously looked around.

chapters.title: He Can’t?
chapters.content:
Although the furniture in the room had been renewed, the layout remained unchanged. Standing here, Yu Wan still felt a familiar sensation.

The main house of Liu Fang Hall had originally been Cui Yichu’s room.

However, back then, Zhao Xuanyou had not consummated his marriage with Cui Yichu here. Instead, her first time with Zhao Xuanyou had been in this very room… Yu Wan turned her head to look at the new canopy bed, her gaze subtly shifting.

She had never expected that this room would now become her and Zhao Xuanyou’s bridal chamber.

"Madam." A voice came from outside the door; Autumn Moon’s.

Both she and Spring Apricot had been promoted to senior maids when Yu Wan was still in Honghui Hall. Zhao Xuanyou, thinking she would be more comfortable with familiar faces, had arranged for them to serve her here.

"Come in."

The door opened, and indeed, Autumn Moon and Spring Apricot entered, each carrying a tray.

Years had passed, and both had become senior maids in the marquis’s residence, handling tasks with composure and speaking with consideration.

"Master feared you might be hungry, so he specially ordered us to bring some food."

The dishes Autumn Moon and Spring Apricot brought were few but all Yu Wan’s favorites: stir-fried bamboo shoots, ham with daylily, pickled shad fish, and a bowl of wontons.

Yu Wan ate a little, not daring to fill herself too much.

Tonight was their wedding night, after all. If she ate too much and made a fool of herself, Zhao Xuanyou would laugh at her for the rest of her life.

After eating, Yu Wan drank a bowl of sweet soup and strolled around the room. She noticed that the wardrobe contained not only her clothes but also Zhao Xuanyou’s.

"Has the Young Master moved all his things here too?" Yu Wan asked.

"Yes," Spring Apricot replied respectfully. "Master ordered us to move all his daily necessities to Tangli Courtyard."

"And Honghui Hall? He won’t be staying there anymore?"

"Master said Honghui Hall will only be used as a study from now on. Normally, he will stay here."

That suited him just fine.

Yu Wan pressed her lips together and sat on the edge of the couch, reminiscing with Spring Apricot and Autumn Moon for a while.

Just as the conversation was getting lively, they suddenly heard someone outside the corridor call out, "Master."

Had Zhao Xuanyou returned?

Earlier, Ye Moqing and his brothers had seemed determined to get him drunk before letting him go. It was surprising they had let him come back so early.

Puzzled as she was, Yu Wan was still delighted to hear he had returned so soon.

She sat upright on the edge of the couch and placed the red bridal veil back over her head.

Spring Apricot and Autumn Moon quickly retreated, bowing to Zhao Xuanyou in the corridor. "Master."

Zhao Xuanyou gave a slight nod, then, leaning on his cane, entered the bridal chamber.

The dragon and phoenix candles inside were burning brightly. As soon as he entered, he saw Yu Wan sitting with her hands folded on the edge of the couch.

Since their reunion, Yu Wan had rarely appeared so gentle and graceful in front of him.

She was waiting for him.

At the thought, Zhao Xuanyou felt a surge of heat in his bones.

He stepped forward to Yu Wan, too impatient to reach for the ceremonial stick beside the pillow. Instead, he lifted the veil with his hand, his gaze falling on her brows and eyes, momentarily entranced.

Sensing the admiration in his eyes, Yu Wan did not immediately look up. Instead, she lowered her gaze, a faint smile playing on her lips.

Today, she had dressed in full bridal attire; her hair piled high in a cloud-like bun, her eyebrows delicately painted; all for this moment.

"Wan."

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze darkened slightly as he softly called her name. Then, he sat down beside her and sealed her lips with his.

Yu Wan closed her eyes, feeling his kiss gradually grow from tender to passionate.

She felt a mix of anticipation and unease.

Although this wasn’t their first time being intimate, it had been over four years… Would he still be as infatuated with her as before?

Lost in her thoughts, Yu Wan suddenly felt Zhao Xuanyou pull open her wedding dress.

Her face grew even hotter, and her heart raced.

Forget it. She wouldn’t do anything, wouldn’t think anything. She would just let him take the lead.

After all, she had already married him. Even if he wasn’t as infatuated as before, it was too late for regrets!

But as she thought this, Yu Wan’s hands betrayed her, reaching out to untie his belt.

She had once been his maid, after all; undoing a belt was easy for her.

Just as she touched it, she recalled something about him…

Was it still the same as before?

Yu Wan’s heart pounded, though she also felt a flicker of anticipation.

She reached out to touch him, but the moment her fingers brushed against him, Zhao Xuanyou caught her wrist.

"Ah…" Yu Wan opened her eyes, staring blankly at Zhao Xuanyou. Her fair, delicate face flushed crimson, as if she had been caught doing something wrong.

But wait. Wasn’t tonight their wedding night? What was wrong with her reaching out?

"Zhao Xuanyou, what are you doing?" Yu Wan asked in a muffled voice.

Zhao Xuanyou loosened his grip on her slightly, struggling to suppress his boiling emotions. His voice was hoarse as he said, "Wait."

"Wait for what?" Yu Wan still didn’t understand. "Do you want to chat under the covers?"

Back when they had been trapped in the sandstorm, he had declared that he was always in the mood for that; he would never want to just chat under the covers with her.

Now that they were truly married and in their bridal chamber, had he suddenly lost the mood?

"It’s not that." Of course Zhao Xuanyou wanted her; desperately.

But tonight, he had other plans.

For the past half-month, he had been meticulously preparing for this. Now, he had to endure.

Facing Yu Wan’s suspicious gaze, Zhao Xuanyou cupped her face and gave her a quick kiss before standing up. With a slight limp, he went to the wardrobe, placed the wedding robe she had pushed aside to one side, and changed into a dark embroidered robe. Then, he took a casual outfit and returned to the couch.

"Wan, put your clothes back on."

"Put them on?" Yu Wan was currently wearing only a thin, embroidered undergarment. Yet Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t even spared it a second glance.

This was too strange.

In the past, not only when she dressed like this, but even when she leaned over the couch to tidy the bedding for him, it had been enough to arouse his interest. Yet tonight…

Yu Wan suddenly remembered the scene when she and Yuan Mo had found Zhao Xuanyou in the returning waters of Wu Gorge.

At that time, he had been on the verge of death, his lower body covered in blood.

Could it be… he was injured more severely than just his leg?

Yu Wan looked at him with a complex expression.

He… couldn’t?

This was too sudden.

"Wan?" Zhao Xuanyou had waited a long time, but Yu Wan still hadn’t put on her clothes. He glanced at the thin undergarment she wore, and another surge of heat rushed to his head.

He took a few deep breaths, suppressing the surge of desire, and draped the clothes he had just brought over onto Yu Wan.

"Zhao Xuanyou, why didn’t you tell me earlier?"

"If I had told you earlier, would it still be a surprise?"

A surprise?

He called this a surprise?

It was certainly surprising, but as for joy… where was that supposed to come from?

Though Yu Wan had never been as enthusiastic about that as he had been in the past, she was still a normal woman. Being with the man she loved was something she naturally enjoyed.

But now, he had suddenly become unable to… and he only told her on their wedding night? Such a thing was unheard of.

Yu Wan didn’t know what expression she should use to face him.

Should she tell him she didn’t mind?

But she did mind, and she feared she couldn’t pretend otherwise.

Should she tell him she would accompany him to seek medical treatment in the future?

That seemed better.

Yu Wan took a deep breath to calm herself and was about to speak when she realized the man had already dressed her.

"Zhao Xuanyou, we…"

"Let’s go. If we’re any later, the city gates will close." Without another word, Zhao Xuanyou took her hand and led her out.

---

chapters.title: Plum Trees and Fireflies
chapters.content:
"Where are we going? Be careful."

Zhao Xuanyou still held his cane, but he did not slow his pace.

Seeing that he refused to say another word, Yu Wan had no choice but to follow him out through the marquis’s residence side gate.

In the past, whenever Chen Da Niu came to the residence to see her, this was the gate Yu Wan had used.

Today, since Zhao Xuanyou was getting married, the front courtyard was filled with guests, so naturally, they couldn’t leave through the main gate.

"Master."

Yuan Mo had been waiting outside the side gate. Seeing the couple emerge, he quickly led the horse forward.

Zhao Xuanyou handed his cane to Yuan Mo, took the cloak, and put it on. After mounting the horse, he reached out his hand to Yu Wan.

"Are we really leaving the city?"

If earlier Yu Wan had been confused, now that she saw him mounting the horse, she understood a little better.

But… wasn’t the wedding night supposed to be spent in their room?

Yu Wan lowered her voice. "Does it have to be tonight?"

Zhao Xuanyou said nothing, still keeping his hand outstretched.

"Fine, have it your way."

Yu Wan sighed in resignation, took his hand, and climbed onto the horse, settling in front of him.

"Tomorrow, we might return late. Remember to inform Father."

"Yes."

After Yuan Mo respectfully agreed, Zhao Xuanyou took the reins and urged the horse through the streets, heading toward the city gate.

Yu Wan, as she had in the past, nestled in his arms. She also recalled what had happened the night before they left the capital, and her heart was touched.

Back then, she had begged Zhao Xuanyou to take her to see the plum blossoms in the snow, hoping to create one last beautiful memory before parting.

In the end, they hadn’t been able to go, and though Yu Wan had felt regret, she had forced herself to banish all thoughts of Zhao Xuanyou.

But what about Zhao Xuanyou?

During the times when she was either "dead" or in hiding, he must have thought of that night countless times, right?

Yu Wan felt a pang of sadness; not for herself, but for him.

After experiencing her tragic death in her past life, Yu Wan had thought she would never feel sorrow for others in this life. Yet now, she found herself feeling distressed.

She reached back with her hand and touched his chin.

"Are you cold?"

"Mmm."

Zhao Xuanyou let go of the reins with one hand, reaching to undo his cloak.

Sensing his movement, Yu Wan quickly said, "I don’t need the cloak. You… just hold me tighter."

She always knew just what to say to get to him.

Zhao Xuanyou lowered his head and kissed her hair, keeping one hand on the reins while the other wrapped around her waist.

He rode swiftly, exiting the city just before the gates closed.

After leaving the main road, the horse’s hooves trod over grass, passing through vast fields.

Where exactly was he taking her?

Though she guessed he wanted to make up for the regret of not having gone to see the plum blossoms in the snow, it was the transition between summer and autumn; there was no snow, nor plum blossoms. Where could they possibly go?

Zhao Xuanyou urged the horse forward, passing through the fields and onto a narrow but smooth path.

After more than half an hour, they finally saw houses ahead.

As they approached, before Zhao Xuanyou could speak, the person guarding the gate opened it.

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t stop, riding straight ahead.

Yu Wan looked at the trees on either side and softly asked, "Is this a plum grove?"

"Mmm."

It was still far from the plum blossom season, so naturally, there wasn’t a single flower to be seen.

But Yu Wan still smiled.

The plum grove was built around a mountain, with a low peak in the center. Zhao Xuanyou rode all the way to the top.

Only after dismounting did Yu Wan notice there was also an octagonal pavilion at the summit.

It wasn’t a gazebo; the doors and windows were tightly shut.

Zhao Xuanyou patted the horse’s back, sending it away, before leading Yu Wan into the pavilion.

As he opened the door, a faint plum blossom fragrance wafted through the air.

Yu Wan inhaled deeply, guessing it was a scent made from plum blossoms.

Though there were no plum blossoms now, the fact that he had thought to infuse the pavilion with plum fragrance showed his consideration.

As he turned to close the door, Yu Wan hugged him from behind.

"Zhao Xuanyou, I’m very happy."

Despite all they had been through; his marriage to another, her marriage to another, the twists and turns of their feelings; they had finally come to understand each other and were now husband and wife.

He truly cared for her.

He remembered her past wishes and was willing to go to great lengths to fulfill them.

Marrying him was indeed the best outcome for Yu Wan.

Feeling her tight embrace, Zhao Xuanyou turned around and wrapped his arms around her shoulders.

"Are we going to… consummate here?" Yu Wan whispered. "It’s dark, which is fine, but there doesn’t seem to be a bed."

The octagonal pavilion was likely built at the summit to give people a high vantage point, allowing them to take in the entire mountain of plum blossoms. Inside, there was only a round table and eight chairs.

Hearing Yu Wan’s words, Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t help but chuckle. He grabbed her chin and gave her a firm kiss.

"Don’t rush."

He whispered in her ear.

Rush?

Yu Wan bit her lip, wondering what to say, when Zhao Xuanyou took her hand and led her to the window on the other side. Suddenly, he pushed it open.

"Wan, look."

Yu Wan followed his gaze and froze.

Dozens of plum trees outside shimmered with tiny, star-like lights, as if they were in full bloom.

Though the lights were faint, they stood out clearly in the darkness of the night, creating a scene even more magnificent than the actual blossoming season.

"Do you like the plum trees with fireflies?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

"I do, of course I do…" Yu Wan’s voice trembled slightly, her eyes welling up. "What are those lights? Did you catch fireflies?"

Zhao Xuanyou embraced her from behind and said in a low voice, "At first, I tried fireflies. Catching them isn’t easy, but with enough people, we could gather enough. However, fireflies die too easily. Even if we didn’t catch them, they wouldn’t live more than a few days, let alone when hung on the trees."

"So what are those lights?"

"Later, I remembered there was a box of luminous pearls in the marquis’s storage. My father had obtained them by chance when he was in Yuzhou. I took the luminous pearls and gave it a try. They turned out beautifully."

"But where did you get so many luminous pearls?"

On a single plum tree, there were at least twenty or so glowing points. With dozens of trees, that would require hundreds of pearls.

"Time was too short. We couldn’t gather more, but fortunately, Ye Moqing married a princess. He borrowed a dozen or so from her, and the princess managed to borrow another dozen. Still, it wasn’t enough."

"So what did you do?"

"Smash them." Zhao Xuanyou exhaled lightly, rather proudly. "I had the craftsmen cut the box of pearls from the marquis’s residence in half, then hung the pieces on the trees. It looks almost the same."

Yu Wan’s breath caught.

"Cut them in half? Zhao Xuanyou, you’re far too wasteful."

"Not at all."

If cutting those luminous pearls in half and hanging them on the trees could make her happy, then that was the best use for them.

Looking at the trees adorned with glowing lights, Yu Wan was overwhelmed with emotion.

She tightened her fingers slightly, wanting to say something but not knowing where to begin.

"But I think… it’s not worth it…"

chapters.title: No Regrets
chapters.content:
"Compared to being hidden in the Marquis's mansion vault, wouldn't these luminous pearls be more valuable when placed somewhere suitable?"

Yu Ying turned around and cupped his face.

"I wasn't talking about the luminous pearls, but myself." Her breathing was slightly choked as she thought of the past, feeling immense sorrow. "It was for me that it wasn't worth it."

"Don't talk nonsense."

Zhao Xuanyou arranged everything for her, and only for her.

He lowered his head and kissed her eyes.

Feeling the slight bitterness in her eyes, he softly said, "Yingying, tonight is our wedding night. You shouldn't be crying."

When he had forcibly taken her away, seeing her red-rimmed eyes from crying, he had sworn never to let her be sad or cry again.

Hearing his words, Yu Ying felt even more distressed.

"You've done so much for me, but I can't do anything for you. Zhao Xuanyou, I don't like this."

"Feel indebted to me?" He let out a light laugh.

Yu Ying didn't speak. That was indeed what she thought.

Zhao Xuanyou suddenly sighed deeply.

"What's there to fear? We've just gotten married. There's still a long life ahead of us. It's not like we have to settle accounts tonight. If you feel indebted to me, you can make it up to me tonight, tomorrow, and in the days to come."

"You really are..." Yu Ying couldn't help but laugh through her tears at his words.

"Really what?"

"Silver-tongued. Whatever you say, you make it sound reasonable."

Tonight was a clear night.

Although there were no grand candles in the pavilion, the moonlight outside was bright, and the plum trees were adorned with glowing fireflies, making it even more magnificent than any bridal chamber.

"Have you been busy here these days?"

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm."

He had said he would give her an unforgettable wedding night.

And he had to deliver on that promise.

"Do you like it?"

She had always known that he liked her.

He liked her body, but it wasn't just that.

But Yu Ying didn't know, nor could she ask, just how much she weighed in Zhao Xuanyou's heart.

Back then, he had been willing to marry Feng Jirour, even if he didn't like Feng Jirour that much. But he would still reserve a proper place in his heart for Feng Jirour as his lawful wife.

It was at that time that Yu Ying finally understood her own feelings.

She liked Zhao Xuanyou and didn't want to share him with anyone.

If she couldn't have Zhao Xuanyou completely, she would rather not have him at all.

So she resolutely left him, banishing all traces of him from her heart.

Zhao Xuanyou wasn't irreplaceable, and neither was she.

There were so many men in the world. Apart from Zhao Xuanyou, there would always be someone who could treat her well and spend a lifetime with her.

Without Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Ying could still live her life well.

But now, looking back on everything, Yu Ying realized that this moment was what she truly wanted most.

"I like it, of course I do."

Seeing her lost in thought for a long time before coming back to her senses, Zhao Xuanyou asked, "What were you thinking about just now?"

"Many things."

"Can you tell me?"

"Do you want to hear?"

This conversation seemed familiar. Zhao Xuanyou remembered something and lightly furrowed his brows, helplessly saying, "Should I say I don't want to hear?"

Yu Ying couldn't help but laugh.

He was Zhao Xuanyou, yet he was being pushed to this point by her.

"I think..." Yu Ying pursed her lips and softly said, "You can say you want to hear."

"Then go ahead." Zhao Xuanyou felt a weight lift off his shoulders.

"I was thinking about many things and many people just now."

"Including..."

"Including the last time I got married, and the person I wanted to marry last time." Yu Ying answered frankly.

However, her frankness still seemed to prick Zhao Xuanyou a little.

His expression was noticeably darker than before.

"So?" Before Yu Ying could answer, Zhao Xuanyou fiercely said, "Yingying, today is our wedding day. You had better say something that makes me happy."

Even though Yu Ying had just said she would let him listen, he still couldn't help but remind her repeatedly.

Yu Ying let out a soft sigh, her gaze calming at this moment.

"I was going to say," she looked into Zhao Xuanyou's eyes, her gaze slightly intense, "marrying you, I have no regrets."

No regrets?

Zhao Xuanyou didn't speak, his body slightly stiffening.

After going through so much, with so many twists and turns, but now she said she had no regrets.

Zhao Xuanyou reached out and picked up Yu Ying, placing her on the windowsill.

Yu Ying steadied herself on his shoulders, her heart beating very fast.

Had this moment finally arrived?

Zhao Xuanyou untied the sash at her waist. The thin garment slipped off, revealing a thin, embroidered undergarment.

The thin fabric clung to her skin, outlining Yu Ying's figure without reservation, making her curves and slender waist all the more striking.

"Does this outfit look good?" Yu Ying asked, blushing.

This was something she had instructed the seamstress to rush-make. When the seamstress heard her instructions, her face had turned red enough to drip blood.

But seeing Zhao Xuanyou's reaction now, Yu Ying felt that the embarrassment was worth it.

"It looks good." Zhao Xuanyou raised his hand and gently rubbed the thin fabric, his gaze growing darker.

Yu Ying felt her heart sway as he touched her through the thin fabric.

"You... can you stand?" she asked nervously. "Or should we find another place?"

"Look down on me?"

Earlier, at the Marquis's mansion, Yu Ying had indeed doubted him.

But after riding here together with him, she had long felt his "unimpeded" condition, which was even more fierce than she remembered.

"I didn't mean that," Yu Ying explained softly. "I'm just worried about your leg. I've already received all the heartfelt preparations you made for tonight. I see there are guest rooms at the foot of the mountain. Why don't we go down there?"

"I can't wait any longer."

He had already endured it for more than an hour and had reached his limit. How could he endure any longer?

"Then the table?"

Given Zhao Xuanyou's current state, even a bed would be inconvenient, let alone the fact that there wasn't even a bed here.

If they had to do it in this pavilion, the only suitable place seemed to be the large round table.

"Right here," Zhao Xuanyou said firmly. "The scenery is good here."

He leaned against the wall, which was indeed not inconvenient.

Yu Ying sat on the windowsill, facing away from the plum trees outside that were glowing with fireflies. She muttered softly, "I can't see the scenery."

As soon as she finished speaking, Zhao Xuanyou picked her up and helped her turn around to lie on the windowsill.

Yu Ying exclaimed in surprise, and the man behind her pressed close.

Through the thin fabric, he gently kissed her shoulder.

"I really like this outfit, but it's a shame..."

A shame?

Before Yu Ying could ask what he found a shame, a clear sound of tearing fabric came from behind her.

Oh, so that was the shame.

Yu Ying bit her lip, feeling no regret.

This outfit was made for him in the first place.

She held onto the window frame and looked out at the spectacular sight of the fireflies glowing all over the mountain. Her vision gradually began to blur.

A moment later, Yu Ying gently closed her eyes.

The bright moon shone, the plum grove rustled, and the spring scene surpassed the glow of the fireflies.

---

chapters.title: The Beauty Awakens
chapters.content:
When Yu Ying opened her eyes, there was a moment of disorientation.

The unfamiliar bed curtains, the unfamiliar surroundings, but the familiar embrace.

She turned her head and realized she was lying in Zhao Xuanyou's arms, with a corner of the thin blanket covering her. Finally, she understood where she was.

After their wedding night in the pavilion on the mountain top, they couldn't stay there overnight after all, so they had come to a guest room at the foot of the mountain to sleep.

Since it was their wedding night, Zhao Xuanyou was naturally unwilling to go to sleep early. He held her and made merry for a long time before falling asleep just before dawn.

Yu Ying yawned softly.

Although this place was unfamiliar to her, with Zhao Xuanyou by her side, she naturally felt a sense of security, as if this place were her home.

Outside, the sky was already bright. Yu Ying rubbed her sleepy eyes and tried to sit up, despite her weak and soft body.

But as soon as she sat up, she was pulled back down by the man beside her, falling into his arms.

"It's already bright out. Let's go back to the city soon."

"What's the rush?"

The brocade curtains were fragrant, and the beauty had just awakened.

It had been too long since he had woken up to see her like this. Even if they did nothing, just lying together quietly was better than countless other things.

"It's not early anymore. I need to pay my respects to the Old Madam and the Marquis."

Zhao Xuanyou quietly admired her lazy and tender appearance, looking at the marks on her collarbone with great satisfaction.

"What Old Madam? What Marquis? Don't forget your current status."

Yu Ying was slightly taken aback, then realized that now that she was married, she was also a member of the Marquis's household and naturally had to change her form of address.

"Then we should go back even sooner. I need to serve the elders with tea to formally address them today."

Seeing Yu Ying's anxious look, Zhao Xuanyou had no choice but to lazily prop himself up.

Yu Ying was about to get up when she touched a slippery stain on the bedding. She frowned and looked at Zhao Xuanyou helplessly.

"We've made such a mess of someone else's room. Isn't this..."

It wasn't just this room. There was also the pavilion on the mountain. Last night, they had been too caught up in the moment to think about it, but now, thinking back, the pavilion must also be in disarray.

At this thought, Yu Ying couldn't help but pull up the thin blanket to cover half her face.

Seeing her shy and embarrassed look, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but reach into the blanket and pinch her cheek.

"Who told you this is someone else's place?"

Not someone else's place?

"Is this the Marquis's estate? I thought you took me..."

She had thought this was the plum garden he had mentioned before.

"It is that plum garden, but I've already bought it from the Duke of Ning. Now, this place is our home."

"You bought it?" Yu Ying sat up, looking at Zhao Xuanyou in surprise.

"What else? Did you think I would take you to someone else's place for our wedding night?"

That did make sense.

Yu Ying's emotions were still somewhat complicated. She frowned and asked, "When did you buy it?"

"Not long after you left the capital."

Zhao Xuanyou said it casually.

But those few simple words were like a small stone dropped into a calm lake, creating ripple after ripple that took a long time to settle.

Yu Ying's clear eyes looked at him, and it seemed as if a mist was gradually spreading outward.

She raised her hand and touched his chin, her fingertip gently rubbing the stubble that had just appeared.

"Yingying, if you keep doing that, I won't want to go back to the mansion."

At Zhao Xuanyou's words, Yu Ying quickly withdrew her hand.

She and Zhao Xuanyou were from mismatched backgrounds. Now that she was married into his family, how could she still be arrogant and disrespectful to her elders?

"It's fine. Father knows we were going out tonight." Seeing her so nervous, Zhao Xuanyou explained leisurely.

"You are you, and I am me. You can do as you please, but I cannot."

Moreover, Yu Ying didn't want the Old Madam and the Marquis to think she was a wayward daughter-in-law.

"Alright." Since Yu Ying thought this way, Zhao Xuanyou was naturally happy. He quickly ordered the maids outside to come in and attend to her.

He had long arranged for them to spend the wedding night here, and the servants had also made preparations.

The maids brought hot water and helped Yu Ying bathe. After her bath, they immediately presented her with clothes and jewelry.

Seeing the grand items on the tray, all of which could be worn to meet the elders, Yu Ying's heart softened even more.

When Yu Ying finished her toilet, she walked out to find Zhao Xuanyou already standing in the corridor with his cane, waiting for her.

Hearing the movement, he turned around and saw Yu Ying lift the curtain and step out.

Compared to her magnificent and enchanting appearance yesterday in the phoenix crown and wedding dress, today's attire was much more dignified and gentle.

She wore a valuable floral brocade dress, with a pale jade-colored moonlit skirt tied at the waist. The hem of the skirt was embroidered with small flowers in colored thread. The morning light shone on her, making her appear even more delicate and beautiful.

"Husband." Yu Ying called out softly.

Hearing this address, Zhao Xuanyou's gaze moved, and he reached out to pull her into his arms again.

He had just reminded her to change how she addressed the elders of the Marquis's household, but he had forgotten about himself.

"What did you say? I didn't hear clearly."

"Husband," Yu Ying repeated, following his wishes, but fearing he would make a fuss and delay their departure, she softly said, "Let's go back to the Marquis's mansion. I still need to pay my respects to Grandmother and Father."

"Mmm."

Zhao Xuanyou lowered his head and kissed the sea tang flower ornament on her forehead before letting go of her waist. However, he took her hand again, and they walked out together.

Yu Ying looked at the plum trees on both sides and couldn't help but sigh, "When winter comes and the plum blossoms are in full bloom, I wonder how beautiful the view will be from last night's pavilion."

"No need to imagine. You'll know when the time comes."

"Oh, right, what about the luminous pearls you hung on the mountain?"

"The servants will go and collect them later."

The borrowed ones would be counted and returned to the Princess's mansion as soon as possible, along with a generous gift of gratitude.

As for the ones from the Marquis's mansion that had been split in half...

Zhao Xuanyou was still considering when Yu Ying said, "Luminous pearls are too precious. Whatever you do, don't just throw them away. Later, I'll write a letter to my mother and ask if she can find a way to set them. Maybe they can be made into a beautiful ornament."

When they were in Qingsha Town, no matter how small or oddly shaped the pearls were, her mother could always find a way to turn them into beautiful jewelry. These split luminous pearls should also be able to have their strengths highlighted and weaknesses avoided, turning them into beautiful jewelry or ornaments.

"Mother is indeed skilled in this. She can turn the ordinary into the extraordinary."

Since Yu Ying had changed how she addressed the Marquis's elders, Zhao Xuanyou naturally changed his address as well.

Although he wasn't very interested in gold, silver, or jade, the phoenix crown that Ding Wenxi had made for Yu Ying was indeed beautiful and elegant, better than any he had seen before.

"When we go to pay our respects to the elders later, you do most of the talking. I'll just follow along and bow. Is that alright?"

"What are you afraid of?"

What else could she be afraid of?

Zhao Xuanyou might understand her feelings, but the elders of the Marquis's household might not.

Seeing Yu Ying's uneasy look, Zhao Xuanyou's calm eyes unconsciously held a hint of a smile.

"Don't you know Grandmother's thoughts? After all these events, all she hopes for is that I get married and settle down soon. Seeing you standing by my side, she'll be too happy to make things difficult for you."

chapters.title: Serving Tea
chapters.content:
After leaving the Plum Garden, Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan rode back to the capital.

Since it was daytime, riding together would be too conspicuous, so they each rode a separate horse.

By the time they galloped back to the side gate of the Marquis's mansion, it was almost noon.

Yuan Qing had been waiting there for a long time. As soon as he saw them approaching, he hurried forward to take the horses.

"Master," Yuan Qing glanced at Yu Wan's elaborately styled hair and immediately changed his address, "Madam."

"Has Father and Grandmother had lunch yet?"

"Not yet. Earlier, Yuan Sai came and said that the Marquis is keeping the Old Madam company in Leshou Hall. He also ordered the kitchen to prepare a feast for noon, just waiting for you and Madam to return."

Hearing Yuan Qing say this, Yu Wan's heart suddenly sank.

It was all Zhao Xuanyou's fault. On their wedding night, he had to go to such a distant place.

The Old Madam and the Marquis must think she was a very inconsiderate new bride.

Feeling Yu Wan's reproachful gaze, Zhao Xuanyou didn't mind at all.

"It's still early for lunch. Come, let's go to Leshou Hall to pay our respects to Grandmother."

He took Yu Wan's hand and led her towards Leshou Hall.

Although Yu Wan was anxious, Zhao Xuanyou relied on a cane to walk and had a slight limp. She couldn't urge him, so she had to follow him slowly to Leshou Hall.

Fortunately, Leshou Hall was not far, and soon the couple arrived at the courtyard entrance, hearing the clear bird calls from inside.

"Worldly Son, Worldly Daughter-in-law."

The maids and servants in the courtyard saw them entering and stood up to greet them.

Only then did Yu Wan notice several birdcages hanging in the corridor, containing birds like mynas and parrots.

"Has Grandmother started keeping birds?"

"I and Father were not in the capital, and she found reciting scriptures and chanting prayers quite dull. Later, Ye Moqi gave her a parrot, which seemed to spark her interest, so she got a few more."

I see.

Although the Old Madam was noble and lived in luxury, with her children and grandchildren not by her side, she must feel somewhat lonely guarding such a large Marquis's mansion.

The layout of Leshou Hall was still similar to before. Passing the zitan wood screen carved with pines and cranes symbolizing longevity at the entrance, they reached the reception area.

As they passed the screen, the room was already filled with people.

Yu Wan had thought only the Old Madam and Marquis Jingyuan were at home today, but she didn't expect the relatives of the Marquis's mansion to also be present. Her cheeks flushed slightly.

It was all Zhao Xuanyou's fault. Others wouldn't think it was Zhao Xuanyou being impolite; they would definitely say that she, as a new bride, was disrespectful to her elders and neglectful of etiquette.

Yu Wan became even more nervous and lowered her head.

"Xuanyou is here." Zhao Xuanyou's second uncle saw the couple and called out with a smile.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly and, holding Yu Wan's hand, first approached the main seat where Old Madam Ye was, respectfully saying, "Grandmother, early this morning, my leg ailment acted up again. After the mansion's physician came to give me acupuncture, he prescribed a medicine, and Wanwan boiled it for me. I had to wait until I recovered a bit, which delayed the time for paying respects."

Old Madam Ye and Marquis Jingyuan knew that the couple had just returned from outside the city and were also aware that Zhao Xuanyou had used a night pearl to set up the bridal chamber in the Plum Garden. Naturally, they wouldn't blame Yu Wan.

"It's fine as long as you're alright. We are all family; there's no need for formalities. Sit down and talk."

Yu Wan still kept her eyes downcast and helped Zhao Xuanyou to his seat.

Old Madam Ye was the most senior in the Marquis's mansion. Since she didn't mind their late arrival, the other relatives naturally wouldn't say anything either.

Zhao Xuanyou's second uncle teased, "They say it takes a hundred days to recover from a muscle or bone injury. Xuanyou, even though you're newly married, you should prioritize your health and recover first."

This remark carried a hint of teasing the newlyweds, and the other relatives in the room laughed along.

Zhao Xuanyou remained composed and calmly replied, "Thank you for the reminder, Second Uncle."

Yu Wan humphed softly in her heart, still blaming him. Otherwise, would they be teased by others?

The atmosphere in Leshou Hall was quite harmonious. Soon, the maids served tea, and Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Wan to serve tea to the elders.

Yu Wan knelt before Old Madam Ye and respectfully offered the tea.

"Grandmother, please have some tea."

It had been more than four years since Old Madam Ye had last seen Yu Wan. Now, seeing her, her feelings were quite complex.

After all, she was Zhao Xuanyou's grandmother, and her thoughts naturally revolved around Zhao Xuanyou.

Yu Wan had once faked her death and run away. Because of her, Zhao Xuanyou had lost control and beaten someone, ending up in jail and breaking off the engagement. He had refused to marry anyone else for a long time.

Even Ye Moqi's daughter, who was younger than him, already had a three-year-old child, while he still had no heirs.

Yu Wan was just a maidservant, and he had been so desperate over her. Now that she was found, he insisted on marrying her as his lawful wife.

If asked for her opinion, she would have a hundred reasons to object.

Unfortunately, Marquis Jingyuan did not side with her and insisted on supporting Zhao Xuanyou's reckless behavior.

She was old and could only manage her own small world in Leshou Hall; she couldn't control anything else.

Seeing that Old Madam Ye did not take the tea from her for a long time, Yu Wan's heart tightened.

Was the Old Madam trying to give her a warning?

Just as she was about to signal Zhao Xuanyou to intervene, Marquis Jingyuan, who had been silent all along, spoke up: "Mother, didn't you prepare many gifts for your new daughter-in-law?"

Marquis Jingyuan's voice pulled Old Madam Ye back from her thoughts.

She looked at Yu Wan, who was kneeling obediently before her, and sighed deeply.

Forget it. Since she had already entered the family, what was the point of dwelling on these things?

She only hoped that Yu Wan could live peacefully with Xuanyou and soon provide an heir for the Marquis's mansion.

Old Madam Ye took the tea cup from Yu Wan's hands, took a sip, and then gave the couple a few words of advice.

The old lady's tone was still kind, which relieved Yu Wan a little. She then served tea to Marquis Jingyuan.

After both elders had drunk the new bride's tea, the gifts were presented.

Old Madam Ye had prepared a set of gold-inlaid jade and kingfisher feather jewelry, consisting of twelve pieces, which were extremely luxurious and weighed about thirty taels.

Earlier, Yu Wan had thought Marquis Jingyuan was just casually mentioning it to remind Old Madam Ye, but she didn't expect that there really were generous gifts prepared.

"Thank you, Grandmother."

Marquis Jingyuan gave a pair of purple jade cups. Before Yu Wan could figure out their origin, the second uncle exclaimed, "Aren't these the Han Dynasty jade cups from Elder Brother's collection?"

Han Dynasty jade cups?

Although Yu Wan knew how to distinguish the quality of jade, she couldn't appraise antiques.

But hearing the second uncle's praise for the purple jade cups, she could sense their value.

Recalling that Marquis Jingyuan had just spoken up to help her out of the awkward situation, Yu Wan felt even more grateful to her new father-in-law, whom she was meeting for the first time.

"Thank you, Father."

Marquis Jingyuan had always supported Zhao Xuanyou in marrying Yu Wan, so he treated Yu Wan quite kindly.

Yu Wan finally managed to get through the ordeal of paying respects to the elders of the Marquis's mansion.

As it was almost time for lunch, Marquis Jingyuan invited everyone in Leshou Hall to go to the flower hall to dine.

Old Madam Ye was advanced in years and had been a vegetarian for many years, so she stayed in Leshou Hall.

Yu Wan was about to follow Zhao Xuanyou when Old Madam Ye suddenly said, "Wanwan, come and help me for a moment."

---

chapters.title: Tricking for a Shop
chapters.content:
"Yes." Yu Wan respectfully replied and stepped forward to help Old Madam Ye to her feet.

Seeing this, Zhao Xuanyou paused.

"I'll wait for you here."

Old Madam Ye knew he was saying this for her benefit and glared at him fiercely before taking Yu Wan into the house.

Yu Wan had already expected that the Old Madam would reprimand her a bit and wasn't too concerned.

After all, when she was a concubine maid before, she had often been reprimanded by the Old Madam.

Anyway, they would only stay in the capital for one or two months at most. Yu Wan wasn't too worried; whatever the Old Madam said, she would obediently listen.

Yu Wan helped Old Madam Ye sit down at the tea table in the inner room.

"Do you remember when you used to pour tea for me here?"

Hearing the Old Madam mention the time when she was a maid, Yu Wan calmly replied, "I remember. At that time, Grandmother even rewarded me with many gold melon seeds."

"I once told you that as long as you could bear a child for Xuanyou, that box of gold melon seeds would be yours." Recalling the past, Old Madam Ye sighed, "After all these twists and turns, that box of gold melon seeds is indeed yours."

Yu Wan didn't respond, only smiled lightly and sat beside her.

Old Madam Ye also didn't say anything more, just silently observed Yu Wan.

She knew Yu Wan was a rare beauty, and she had always known that Zhao Xuanyou was infatuated with her.

But Old Madam Ye hadn't expected Zhao Xuanyou to go so far as to refuse to marry anyone else but her.

In the capital, men his age already had children, yet he had only just married.

"Why did you leave back then? He had already agreed to make you a concubine. Weren't you satisfied with that?"

Hearing Old Madam Ye's direct and somewhat resentful words, Yu Wan thought for a moment and then spoke openly.

"At that time, I didn't want to be a concubine. I thought the constant struggle and competition were meaningless. I also didn't know he cared so much about me. I thought that after knowing I was dead, he could live peacefully with the Feng family's girl."

Old Madam Ye's previous questions had carried a hint of resentment. After hearing Yu Wan's answer, she slightly averted her gaze.

"What did you think when he found you?"

"At first, I didn't want to come back with him. After all, I had been living well these past few years apart from him. It's just..."

"He insisted on having you?"

Yu Wan lightly nodded and added, "I also liked him back then. It's just that the difference in our status was like heaven and earth; I didn't dare to hope."

Old Madam Ye could tell she was speaking the truth and felt a bit more appreciative of her.
