In the past, as a maid, Yu Wan had been charming but lacked propriety. Although she had always served Zhao Xuanyou wholeheartedly, she had done so in a way that relied on her beauty.

She had always opposed Zhao Xuanyou marrying Yu Wan, not so much because she looked down on Yu Wan's humble background, but more because she believed Yu Wan's insight and education were insufficient to handle the responsibilities of the Marquis's mistress.

After talking with Yu Wan for a while today, Old Madam Ye was pleasantly surprised.

Not only was Yu Wan graceful and exceptionally beautiful, but her speech and conduct were also poised and measured.

If she hadn't known Yu Wan had worked in the Marquis's mansion before, Old Madam Ye would have believed she was a young lady from a prominent family in Yu Province.

"Have you been doing business these past few years?"

Hearing the Old Madam's concerned voice, Yu Wan knew she had passed the test. She smiled and said, "My mother knows how to make jewelry, and my brother and I help manage the shop."

Old Madam Ye asked, "Is your shop in Yu Province?"

"It was in Qing Province before. We had always dealt with major trading firms in Jiangnan. Later, we sold the shop in Qing Province and reopened one in Yu Province."

"You did well in business. Why did you suddenly sell it? It couldn't have been because of Xuanyou, could it?"

It really was because of him.

Yu Wan smiled and said, "When we sold the shop in Qing Province, we made a lot of money. Later, in Yu Province, we found that jade and gemstones were cheaper there than in the Central Plains, making it more suitable for the jewelry business. It's also a good place to set up shop."

"Yu Province is indeed a good place to collect jade and gemstones, but to sell them at a good price, you still need to transport them to the Central Plains."

Old Madam Ye owned many properties and was well-versed in this.

Seeing her ask so carefully, Yu Wan said, "Our goods are all sold to the major trading firms in Jiangnan."

"Going through someone else's hands means you make less profit."

"That's true. So I also plan to open a shop in the capital to sell our own jewelry."

Hearing Yu Wan say this, the Old Madam's heart stirred. She said, "I happen to have a few well-located shops. In a few days, I'll have Mama Xing take you to look at them. If you find one you like, I'll give it to you."

The Old Madam was as generous as ever.

Yu Wan wanted to decline, but thinking that the Old Madam originally had some prejudices against her, constantly refusing might offend the old lady.

"Thank you, Grandmother. But I can't just take your shop for free. Once I make money, I'll at least give you thirty percent of the profits."

Old Madam Ye waved her hand, "What do I need money for at my age? You just keep it for yourself."

Yu Wan was about to persuade her further when Zhao Xuanyou said, "Wanwan is showing her filial piety to you. Just accept it. Otherwise, how can she feel comfortable taking your shop?"

He hadn't seen Yu Wan come out for a long time and was worried that Old Madam Ye might make things difficult for her. So he came in to check, just in time to hear their conversation.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou enter, Old Madam Ye narrowed her eyes, "Afraid I'll bully your wife?"

"I'm afraid Grandmother is too generous and will give all her private savings to Wanwan."

"All the money is for the family. It's all yours."

Zhao Xuanyou patted Old Madam Ye's hand, "Save some. At least leave a little for your great-grandchildren."

The words "great-grandchildren" hit a soft spot in Old Madam Ye's heart. She looked at Zhao Xuanyou and then at Yu Wan, smiling as she said, "Alright, then all my money will go to my great-grandchildren. You two don't need to worry about it."

After the jesting, Old Madam Ye completely let go of her concerns.

Yu Wan was so intelligent that she could manage the business outside; naturally, she could handle the household affairs of the Marquis's mansion.

"You two should go to the flower hall now. Don't keep your father and the relatives waiting too long."

"Yes."

Yu Wan curtsied to Old Madam Ye and followed Zhao Xuanyou out.

As soon as they left Leshou Hall, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't help but tease, "Impressive. On the first day of entering the family, you've already made Grandmother smile and tricked her into giving you a shop. I was worried for nothing."

Indeed, if even he could be coaxed around by Yu Wan, let alone Grandmother.

Yu Wan humphed softly.

"Who tricked Grandmother? I was being sincere. Grandmother was moved by my words, so she was generous."

Amidst their banter, the couple arrived at the flower hall.

Marquis Jingyuan saw them arrive and quickly ordered the feast to begin.

The flower hall was filled with people, creating a lively atmosphere.

In the afternoon, during tea, Marquis Jingyuan personally introduced Yu Wan to the relatives of the Marquis's mansion, having them get to know each other one by one.

After the evening banquet ended, Yu Wan followed Zhao Xuanyou to see each relative off.

Since they had all come to congratulate them on their wedding, she naturally perked up and did not dare to be negligent.

After the last guest left, Yu Wan couldn't help but rub her shoulders.

"Tired?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

chapters.title: Making a Scene
chapters.content:
"Mmm," Yu Ying linked his arm, leaning against him as they slowly walked back to the mansion. "It is tiring, but the feeling is also quite wonderful."

"How so?"

"You know, I've relied only on my mother since I was little. Even after learning I had a real father, I didn't feel much." Yu Ying said, resting her head on Zhao Xuanyou's shoulder. "But suddenly, I have a kind grandmother, a gentle father, uncles, aunts, cousins, sisters-in-law, nephews... it's a truly wonderful feeling."

It was the first time she had ever experienced such a large family atmosphere.

Even if the pleasantries weren't entirely sincere, it still felt different.

Zhao Xuanyou rubbed her head and said, "Having more relatives has its pros and cons. Don't take it to heart. Just take good care of your husband."

Yu Ying saw he had turned the conversation back to himself. She was about to say he was being unnecessarily jealous when she couldn't help but yawn.

Zhao Xuanyou could see she was genuinely exhausted. He sighed softly, "Shall I carry you back?"

"You?" Yu Ying instinctively countered.

But this tone clearly struck a nerve with him.

Zhao Xuanyou's face darkened, then he squatted down.

"Get on."

Yu Ying hesitated, not moving.

He was still using a cane to walk, and now he wanted to carry her?

"If I do, what if you fall..."

"How does that sound like you're worried about me, and not about yourself?"

"Can't I be worried about both?" Yu Ying quickly reached out to pull him up. "It's so late, let's go back to our room."

"Get on." Zhao Xuanyou's tone was unyielding.

Sensing his displeasure, Yu Ying sighed and bent down to climb onto his back.

Zhao Xuanyou's right leg indeed couldn't exert much strength. He supported Yu Ying with one hand and his cane with the other, gritting his teeth as he stood up.

Yu Ying was terrified, afraid his legs would give out. She could only tightly hug his shoulders.

"I knew you could carry me even when injured!" Yu Ying, fearing he would stubbornly continue carrying her forward, quickly praised him, hoping he would stop while he was ahead. "I'm not sleepy anymore. Put me down."

But Zhao Xuanyou ignored her, still carrying her forward with his cane.

"Husband! Put me down!" Since servants occasionally passed by on the road, Yu Ying couldn't shout loudly. She could only whisper in his ear, "If you use up all your strength now, what will you do when we get back to the room? Are you not planning to... tonight?"

If she hadn't said that, Zhao Xuanyou might have carried her a few more steps before putting her down.

But with those words, Zhao Xuanyou was even more unwilling to let her go.

If he put her down now, wouldn't that be admitting he was too weak to carry her for a while and then unable to perform his marital duties?

"Yingying, I only have an injury in my right leg, not a lack of stamina." Zhao Xuanyou said resentfully.

Before Yu Ying could respond, a dry cough suddenly came from beside them.

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying looked up to see Jingyuan Hou standing ahead of them.

Now, without waiting for Yu Ying to say anything, Zhao Xuanyou let go and put her down.

Yu Ying's face burned with embarrassment. She felt extremely wronged.

Clearly, it was Zhao Xuanyou who insisted on carrying her, but in the eyes of others, it would definitely seem like she had made Zhao Xuanyou, with his leg injury, carry her back to the room.

Jingyuan Hou would probably think she was a woman who made unreasonable demands on Zhao Xuanyou, and might not be as kind to her in the future.

This was such an injustice.

"Father." Yu Ying, standing next to Zhao Xuanyou, respectfully greeted him.

Jingyuan Hou looked at them with a smile, gently asking, "Have all the guests left?"

"They have all been seen out."

Jingyuan Hou had been waiting here to tell them something, but he could see the fatigue in their eyes. He simply nodded, "You two should rest early. Come to my study after breakfast tomorrow."

With that, Jingyuan Hou left.

After he had walked away, Yu Ying softly asked, "Father seemed to have something to say. Did something happen?"

"Probably nothing serious."

After all, if it were truly serious, he wouldn't wait until morning to discuss it.

Yu Ying didn't think much of it and, arm in arm with Zhao Xuanyou, returned to the Tangli Courtyard.

Although she had been exhausted from the day's socializing, Zhao Xuanyou, fearing she would look down on him, still refused to let her sleep.

That night, it was Chun Xing and Pan Xia's turn to be on duty. The two, like their masters in the room, barely slept all night. They delivered water to the room three times, and only when Qiuyue and Ran Dong came to take over in the morning did they yawn and go back to rest.

If the two maids were this exhausted, Yu Ying on the bed was even more so.

In her drowsiness, she remembered they had to go to Jingyuan Hou's study in the morning. She tried twice to force herself to get up but failed, her eyes opening for a while before falling back asleep in Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

It wasn't until the sun was high in the sky that Yu Ying finally woke up.

She lazily opened her eyes to find the man beside her propping his head up with his arm, quietly gazing at her. She didn't know how long he had been watching.

"How long have you been awake?" Yu Ying's eyes were still blurred, but his were as clear as ever.

Hearing her question, Zhao Xuanyou smugly hummed.

"I told you earlier, I'm not tired."

Indeed, he wasn't tired.

Yu Ying was truly convinced from the bottom of her heart.

She had thought that once would be enough last night, but who knew he would be as usual.

"What time is it now? Father said we should go after breakfast."

The more Yu Ying spoke, the less confident she became.

She had only been married for two days and had already been impolite twice.

"It's all your fault."

"It is my fault." Zhao Xuanyou reined in his teasing smile, leaned close to her, and kissed her forehead. "From now on, I'll let you sleep more at night and try to arrange other things during the day."

During the day?

If it was already this embarrassing at night, did he want to do it during the day too?

"Don't even think about it!" Yu Ying raised her hand to push him, but he didn't dodge, letting her hit him a few times. Instead, he held her shoulder and looked at the red marks on her body.

Those were his trophies from last night, and he needed to admire them properly.

The two had already woken up late, and after playful fighting on the bed, by the time they finished changing, it was already the third quarter of the Si hour.

At this moment, Jingyuan Hou was painting in his study, while Concubine Wei was grinding ink for him beside him.

For more than a decade since the death of the Hou's wife, it had been Concubine Wei who attended to Jingyuan Hou.

According to Zhao Xuanyou, Concubine Wei was gentle and soft-tempered, and she often took care of him when he was young.

"Worldly Son, Daughter-in-law." Seeing the couple, Concubine Wei quickly stepped forward to welcome them in.

After serving tea, she silently retreated.

Jingyuan Hou put down his brush, looked at them with a smile, not minding their late arrival, his expression full of affection.

"I called you here today to inform you of something. Xuanyou has been in charge of the Mingyuan Guard for nearly ten years. Both at home and in the military, you have shouldered everything alone. I have already submitted a memorial to the court to pass the title of Jingyuan Hou to you."

---

chapters.title: Father and Son
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou didn't show much surprise upon hearing this.

Ten years ago, when Jingyuan Hou was fighting the Wuhuan King, he was unfortunately shot in the back with a stray arrow. Although he survived, his body was ruined.

Zhao Xuanyou, at just over ten years old, took his place, leading the Mingyuan Guard to fight against the Wuhuan. In the end, at Huilang Lake, he decisively eliminated the main force of the Wuhuan, removing this major threat for the court.

Although he had always been the heir of the Hou's mansion, he had long since taken on all the responsibilities of the Hou's family.

Previously, when he married Cui Yichu, Jingyuan Hou had considered this matter, but Zhao Xuanyou had declined at the time.

In the blink of an eye, five years had passed. Zhao Xuanyou was now more steady in character and had married the woman he loved. It was the right time to inherit the title.

"Father has already submitted the memorial?" Zhao Xuanyou asked.

Jingyuan Hou slowly nodded, a smile appearing in his eyes.

"The Hou's mansion has long been under your management. Inheriting the title now is just to make it more official."

"Yes."

"The palace should respond soon. At that time, His Majesty will probably summon you and your wife to the palace for an audience." Jingyuan Hou didn't really know what was happening in the palace, but Pan Xun had urgently urged Zhao Xuanyou to return to the capital. He could guess that something big was happening. "Be cautious with your words when you enter the palace."

"What is Father worried about?"

Jingyuan Hou glanced at Yu Ying, who was standing quietly beside Zhao Xuanyou, listening to their conversation. Suddenly, an idea struck him.

Pan Xun had specifically asked them to return to the capital to get married, and it was likely not just to have Zhao Xuanyou return alone.

Seeing this, Jingyuan Hou waved his hand, waiting for the nearby servants to retreat before lowering his voice, "His Majesty might want to keep you in the capital. In these turbulent times, it's safer to stay away. As for your leg injury, I've already spread the word that it's difficult to recover. You and Yingying just need to keep this in mind."

In just a few words, Yu Ying understood Jingyuan Hou's plan.

Pan Xun was a close confidant of the Emperor, so he likely conveyed the Emperor's intentions.

Thus, Jingyuan Hou followed Pan Xun's advice and called Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying back to the capital.

But he didn't want Zhao Xuanyou involved in the matter of the imperial succession.

In Jingyuan Hou's view, as long as Zhao Xuanyou's leg injury was not healed, his martial arts would be greatly affected, and the Emperor would naturally not keep him in the capital.

"Son will act according to the circumstances."

Zhao Xuanyou did not make a definitive statement.

After inheriting the title of Hou, he would naturally prioritize the Hou's mansion. But to protect the Hou's mansion, he couldn't stand idly by and let the Empress and Zhao Zun become the winners.

However, these matters were not something his father needed to worry about; he had his own plans.

Jingyuan Hou nodded, "It was not easy for you and Yingying to become husband and wife. Return to Yuzhou early and live your own lives."

"Yes."

Yu Ying, hearing this, respectfully nodded.

"Yingying, can you still live comfortably in Yuzhou?"

"Yes, I can live and eat comfortably there. Others say that beyond the pass is desolate, but Yuzhou city is very prosperous. I love the Hu people's market and often go shopping with my mother. Although Yuzhou city is much smaller than the capital, once you leave the city, there are endless grasslands and continuous deserts. The scenery throughout the four seasons is endlessly fascinating."

Hearing Yu Ying's praise for Yuzhou, Jingyuan Hou also narrowed his eyes and smiled, "When I was in Yuzhou before, I also loved going out of the city to inspect and gallop across the grasslands. That feeling is something you can't experience in the Central Plains."

"Yes, especially when riding those good horses. It's like the wind, so fast that you can't even keep your eyes open."

"I haven't been to Yuzhou in ten years. Hearing you say this, I really miss the old days."

Hearing this, Yu Ying's heart moved, and she smiled, "Father doesn't need to miss it. This time, come back to Yuzhou with us."

Jingyuan Hou didn't expect Yu Ying to ask, and hearing her obedient "Father," he smiled gently.

Return to Yuzhou?

Jingyuan Hou's gaze shifted to Zhao Xuanyou, seeing his expressionless face and the slight retreat of the smile in his eyes.

"After Xuanyou officially inherits the title of Hou, I plan to return to Jiangnan."

Yu Ying persuaded, "Although Yuzhou's climate is not as mild as Jiangnan's, in winter, if we light the ground dragon, it's still quite warm inside the house. The Hou's mansion is spacious. It would be lively if you came."

Jingyuan Hou kept his eyes on Zhao Xuanyou, not responding to Yu Ying's words.

Sensing the subtle atmosphere between father and son, Yu Ying had to take back her words, "But staying in the house all the time is indeed boring. It would be better for Father's recovery to stay in Jiangnan."

"I have indeed grown accustomed to living in Jiangnan." Jingyuan Hou kindly said to Yu Ying, "Going to Yuzhou... let me think about it some more. You two have been busy for so long. Go back to your room and rest."

"Yes."

After Jingyuan Hou left, Yu Ying linked Zhao Xuanyou's arm and slowly walked back to the Tangli Courtyard.

Noticing Zhao Xuanyou seemed lost in thought, Yu Ying shook his arm, "Did I say something wrong just now?"

Zhao Xuanyou withdrew his thoughts and glanced at her, "A few words and you've made my father smile so happily. How could you have said anything wrong?"

"Then why was Father looking at you earlier? Don't you want him to go to Yuzhou?"

"It's not that."

"Then what is it?" Yu Ying blinked, muttering, "I thought you and Father had a good relationship."

"We do, but..."

Yu Ying could hear the hesitation in Zhao Xuanyou's tone and didn't press for an immediate answer.

The couple passed through the corridor and soon reached the entrance of the Tangli Courtyard.

Seeing their return, Pan Xia and Ran Dong came forward to greet them.

Yu Ying went to freshen up first. When she returned to the inner room, Zhao Xuanyou had already changed into his sleeping clothes and was lying down.

"Are you really mad at me?" Yu Ying sat on the edge of the bed, tilting her head to look at him.

Zhao Xuanyou reached out to pull her down beside him, smiling faintly, "Mad about what? Could I be mad that you want to be filial to my father?"

"Then what is it?"

"I just..."

"You don't want to live with Father?" Yu Ying asked again.

Zhao Xuanyou shook his head.

"So you agree with me inviting Father to Yuzhou?"

He hummed in agreement.

Yu Ying was truly confused by him.

She had thought Zhao Xuanyou and Jingyuan Hou had a close relationship, which was why she invited Jingyuan Hou to live in Yuzhou.

But she hadn't expected that when she spoke, the atmosphere between father and son would become so strange.

Just when she thought she had misunderstood, Zhao Xuanyou said he agreed with her inviting Jingyuan Hou to Yuzhou.

"Then why didn't you speak up with me earlier? If you had said something, Father would have definitely agreed immediately."

Zhao Xuanyou took a deep breath and turned his head to kiss her forehead.

"Yingying, I was just a little surprised that you so easily invited Father to go to Yuzhou with us."

Easily?

Yu Ying looked at him in confusion, pouting slightly, "Father said he missed his days in Yuzhou. I was just going along with what he said. What's so difficult about that? I always thought you and Father were very close."

Close?

Zhao Xuanyou softly said, "Father was never around when I was little. I respect and admire him, and I have always looked up to him. But our relationship... is not as intimate as you and your mother."

chapters.title: The Imperial Decree Arrives
chapters.content:
Yu Ying leaned against his shoulder, lost in thought.

"Maybe fathers and sons are just different from mothers and daughters. Like, I’ve always lived with my mother since I was little. I even had to sleep beside her at night and listen to her stories before I’d fall asleep. But you..."

At this point, Yu Ying realized that Zhao Xuanyou had lost his mother at a young age, and the Marquis of Jingyuan was far away in Yuzhou. With neither parent by his side, saying such things might upset him.

Yu Ying propped herself up and leaned down to kiss him.

"Grandmother must have doted on you a lot, right?"

Zhao Xuanyou could tell she was trying to comfort him, and the corners of his lips curled up.

"I was raised by my grandmother and Concubine Wei when I was little. They both doted on me. But since I’m my father’s only son and will inherit the family title, my grandmother didn’t dare spoil me. As far back as I can remember, I’ve always slept alone in my room."

Yu Ying pondered this. "Your father was never around, so you couldn’t even act spoiled with him."

"Pretty much. When I was little, my father was very strict with me. I never spoke to him in the tone you use with your father."

The Marquis of Jingyuan returned once a year, and during their time together, it was either to check on his studies or to teach him martial arts.

As the only son, the Marquis naturally had high expectations for Zhao Xuanyou. If he made a mistake, he would be punished according to family rules.

In their limited time together as father and son, there wasn’t much joy to be found.

"Ah?" Yu Ying felt a headache coming on. "Then when I spoke to my father like that earlier, won’t he think I’m being disrespectful?"

Zhao Xuanyou let out a soft laugh.

"How could that be? Look at his reaction; he was clearly happy."

"That’s good." Yu Ying smiled, noticing that Zhao Xuanyou was deep in thought. She didn’t say much more.

Even if there was some distance between father and son, they both cared for each other. There wasn’t a big problem, and she didn’t need to mediate.

She let out a soft yawn and nestled against Zhao Xuanyou, ready to sleep.

Sensing her movement, Zhao Xuanyou turned his head and frowned at her.

She actually wanted to sleep?

He reached out and poked her a couple of times. Yu Ying, with her eyes closed, pleaded, "Let me get a good night’s sleep tonight. We’ll talk tomorrow."

Zhao Xuanyou knew she was tired.

But they had been apart for over four years, and he had slept alone for over four years. Now that he had finally married her, he naturally wanted to make up for all the debt from the past four years.

"You sleep."

Hearing him say that, Yu Ying finally let out a sigh of relief.

Just as she was about to pull the blanket over herself, she heard him say, "I’ll do it myself."

Yu Ying closed her eyes and sighed helplessly.

Fine, let him have his way. She wasn’t going to help anyway.

...

The next morning, when Yu Ying got up, her body still felt exhausted.

Autumn Moon had already prepared hot water and helped Yu Ying to bathe.

The warm bath water finally dispelled the fatigue from her body.

By the time she had finished dressing and walked into the courtyard, Zhao Xuanyou had already been walking around the courtyard with his cane for a long time.

After returning to the capital, he had the Marquis’s physician carefully examine his right leg.

The physician said the wound had completely healed, but to recover quickly, he needed to use the wheelchair less and walk more.

Since the Marquis of Jingyuan had ordered him to keep a low profile in the capital and spread the word that his leg injury was difficult to heal, Zhao Xuanyou used a wheelchair or walked with a limp in public. Only in the early mornings did he practice walking by himself.

"How does it feel?" Yu Ying saw that he was walking more steadily than yesterday and stepped forward to wipe the sweat from his brow with her handkerchief.

"Seems a bit stronger than before."

"Looks like you didn’t practice enough in Yuzhou. Otherwise, you would have recovered sooner."

"It should heal soon," Zhao Xuanyou said, leaning closer to her. "After standing for our wedding night, it’s already much better. In the future, you can help me practice walking more."

It was early morning, and he was saying such things in the courtyard with maids standing around, yet he showed no shame.

Yu Ying didn’t bother with him and flicked her handkerchief at his face.

"Are you hungry? Let’s have breakfast."

"Alright."

The servants of the Marquis’s mansion were well aware of Zhao Xuanyou’s preferences, so the breakfast was rich, with congee, small dishes, and his favorite mutton noodle soup.

Not long after the couple finished breakfast, a eunuch from the palace arrived to announce the emperor’s decree. The emperor had approved the Marquis of Jingyuan’s petition, and from this day forward, Zhao Xuanyou would inherit the title.

After receiving the imperial decree, Zhao Xuanyou was no longer the heir of the Marquis’s mansion but the new Marquis of Jingyuan. Consequently, Yu Ying naturally became the Marchioness.

When she first heard that the Marquis of Jingyuan wanted to pass the title to Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Ying hadn’t thought much of it. But when everyone around her began addressing her as Marchioness, she finally felt the reality of it.

She had only been the heir’s wife for two days, and now she was the Marchioness?

She had hoped to enjoy a few quiet days after the wedding, but as soon as the news of Zhao Xuanyou’s inheritance spread, gifts of congratulations poured in from various noble families.

As the new mistress of the Marquis’s mansion, Yu Ying naturally couldn’t push all the matters onto Manager Song. Instead, she, along with Wen Ji, recorded all the gifts and took note of which families gave more and which gave less.

After all, reciprocity was important. When other families had their own joyous or sorrowful occasions in the future, the gifts they gave in return should be appropriate.

The next day, the newly appointed Marquis of Jingyuan and his Marchioness had to follow custom and enter the palace to express their gratitude.

Yu Ying rose early and dressed in her finest, putting on the same precious clothes as Zhao Xuanyou that were suitable for a palace audience.

The couple rode in a carriage to the palace gates and walked forward together.

The area outside the palace gates was open and spacious, and the sun in the sky was blinding. As Yu Ying walked on the thick stone bricks, she felt as if she were being roasted.

She lifted her head and looked toward the towering city gate in the distance, her heart stirring slightly.

Four years ago, when she had returned to the capital with the emperor’s procession from the Lichuan Imperial Palace, she had stood here as well.

At that time, standing here and gazing at the distant imperial palace, she had wondered what kind of wealthy and noble place it was inside.

She never expected that today she would be able to step through the palace gates and see for herself.

"It’s just entering the palace to express gratitude. There won’t be any problems." Zhao Xuanyou noticed her staring blankly at the palace and thought she might be nervous about her first audience with the emperor. He comforted her in a gentle voice, "Just stay close to me."

Yu Ying withdrew her gaze and looked at Zhao Xuanyou, nodding slightly.

After passing through the palace gates, a eunuch led them toward the Qianqing Palace.

Zhao Xuanyou glanced at the eunuch; he was indeed an unfamiliar face.

Thinking that all the people around the emperor had been replaced, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression tightened slightly.

The emperor’s poisoning case had yet to be solved, and even the most trusted Eunuch Liu had been arrested by the Brocade Guard. Various factions were restless.

No one knew the true state of the emperor in the Qianqing Palace.

Soon, the two of them arrived in front of the Qianqing Palace. The eunuch guarding the door recognized Zhao Xuanyou and, after offering his congratulations to the couple, went inside to announce their arrival.

While Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying waited outside, someone suddenly walked out of the Qianqing Palace.

Leading the way was a delicate and exquisite little child, followed by a graceful and gentle woman; none other than Sun Qianran, the former wife of Pei Ta and the daughter of the Prime Minister.

---

chapters.title: She Guessed Right
chapters.content:
Sun Qianran’s expression flickered slightly when she saw them, and she shifted her gaze to Zhao Yi Yun, who was in front.

"Royal Grandson, please walk slower."

Zhao Yi Yun didn’t respond and continued walking with his head down.

But he was so small that his steps were too big, and he stumbled down the stairs.

Zhao Xuanyou quickly reached out and caught him.

After steadying himself, Zhao Yi Yun looked up at an unfamiliar face and asked in a childish voice, "Who are you?"

"This official, Zhao Xuanyou, greets Royal Grandson."

"Are you surnamed Zhao? Then are you also my imperial uncle?"

Zhao Xuanyou was tall and handsome, and in Zhao Yi Yun’s eyes, he looked more imposing than several of his imperial uncles.

"This official is not the Royal Grandson’s imperial uncle."

Sun Qianran caught up from behind, crouched down to check on Zhao Yi Yun, and softly said, "Your Highness, this is the Marquis of Jingyuan and the Marchioness."

Yu Ying also took the opportunity to curtsy.

"Your Highness."

Zhao Yi Yun glanced at her but didn’t say anything. He simply walked forward.

He hadn’t seen his mother in a long time, and he wanted to find her.

Sun Qianran ordered the wet nurse to go after Zhao Yi Yun, then smiled at Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying. "Greetings to Lord Marquis and Lady Marquis."

"There’s no need for such formalities, Miss Sun," Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

He and Pei Ta had never gotten along well, and now there was the added resentment of Pei Ta trying to marry Yu Ying. Although it had nothing to do with Sun Qianran, he couldn’t bring himself to be pleasant to her.

Sun Qianran, of course, didn’t mind.

She wasn’t standing here for Zhao Xuanyou’s sake but for Yu Ying’s.

"Lady Marquis, it’s been a long time."

"Miss Sun."

Seeing Sun Qianran, Yu Ying couldn’t help but think of Pei Ta.

Times had changed, and before she knew it, the four people who had met at the Lichuan Imperial Palace had ended up in different circumstances and entanglements.

"Earlier, when I heard that the Marquis of Jingyuan’s mansion was preparing for a wedding, I was a bit surprised. Lord Marquis has always been devoted to you. How could he have found someone he liked in Yuzhou? But seeing you now, my confusion is cleared."

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes suddenly turned cold, filled with warning.

Sun Qianran, though often calm and composed in the palace, felt a flicker of panic under Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze. She quickly explained, "I have no disrespect for Lady Marquis. It’s just that old acquaintances meet, and I couldn’t help but exchange pleasantries. If I brought up something I shouldn’t have, I hope Lord Marquis and Lady Marquis will forgive me."

"There’s nothing that can’t be mentioned," Yu Ying said with a faint smile. She had visited the Lichuan Imperial Palace before, and many nobles in the capital had seen her. If Sun Qianran didn’t bring it up, someone else would. "The name I used in the Marquis’s mansion was given to me by others. After leaving, I naturally reverted to my maiden name."

"Lady Marquis’s family is in the business in Yuzhou?"

"Originally in Qingzhou, then later moved to Yuzhou," Yu Ying answered frankly.

Yu Ying wasn’t deliberately provoking Sun Qianran.

But the other party had come up to her and said so much, clearly intending to probe her.

Back then, Zhao Xuanyou had publicly intercepted the bridal sedan to take her away, and this incident had already caused a stir in Anzhou.

Although Anzhou was far away in Shu, such an event between two high-ranking officials would eventually spread to the capital.

Sun Qianran had never let go of Pei Ta and must have known about it long ago.

However, Yu Ying’s affairs with Pei Ta had nothing to do with Sun Qianran. Moreover, they had already ended things, so she had nothing to hide.

"Qing...zhou?"

Sun Qianran’s expression changed slightly, and for a moment, she was rendered speechless.

Just then, the eunuch who had gone to announce their arrival in the Qianqing Palace walked over and said warmly, "Lord Marquis, Lady Marquis, you’ve waited long enough. Please follow me to pay respects to His Majesty."

"Ying, let’s go." Zhao Xuanyou saw that Sun Qianran was entangling Yu Ying because of Pei Ta, and his displeasure grew. Holding his cane in one hand and Yu Ying’s hand in the other, he walked toward the Qianqing Palace.

Watching the couple walk away side by side, Sun Qianran felt a pang of heartache.

Earlier this year, she had learned from her father that Pei Ta had married a woman in Anzhou, only for Zhao Xuanyou to snatch her away in the street. At that moment, she had immediately thought of Yu Ying.

Although in the eyes of others, Yu Ying had long been dead, and although her father said the woman Pei Ta was going to marry was surnamed Song, among the women both Zhao Xuanyou and Pei Ta knew, Yu Ying was the most likely candidate.

Zhao Xuanyou’s feelings for Yu Ying were obvious; he had never hidden them, even back at the Lichuan Imperial Palace. And Pei Ta...

Back then, he had often guided Yu Ying in her studies, frequently praising her intelligence and saying that if she weren’t a maid, her reputation for talent would have spread far and wide, surpassing even Cui Yichu.

If he admired Yu Ying so much, it was indeed very possible that he had fallen for her after encountering her again following their separation.

She had been heartbroken but also relieved that Zhao Xuanyou had taken her away.

Today, seeing Yu Ying, her painful suspicion was finally confirmed.

But she hadn’t expected Yu Ying to so simply say that she had been doing business in Qingzhou before.

After faking her death and leaving the capital, had Yu Ying followed Pei Ta to Qingzhou?

So she had set her sights on Pei Ta long ago.

Pei Ta had stayed in Qingzhou for three years, and Yu Ying had spent three years with him there.

That meant the time Yu Ying had spent by his side was actually longer than hers as his wife?

And in Pei Ta’s heart, did Yu Ying hold far more weight than she did?

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying were unaware of Sun Qianran’s thoughts, and naturally, they didn’t want to know.

After entering the Qianqing Palace, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened slightly, and he hummed softly, "Why waste so many words on her? Next time you see her, don’t bother responding."

"I know."

Hearing the displeasure in his tone, Yu Ying responded with her mouth shape without making a sound.

The Qianqing Palace was grand and majestic, exuding an imposing aura.

Even though Yu Ying had been to the Lichuan Imperial Palace before, standing inside the Qianqing Palace now, she felt that this place was far beyond what the imperial palace could compare to.

The eunuch led the couple to a study in the side hall, where they waited quietly for a moment before the emperor, dressed in a bright yellow dragon robe, slowly walked over.

The emperor’s steps seemed steady, but his complexion was much worse than before.

Zhao Xuanyou’s expression tightened, and he immediately bowed with Yu Ying to greet the emperor.

Today’s visit to the palace was not an ordinary summons but to express gratitude for the inheritance of the marquis title, so the words of thanks were quite solemn.

Fortunately, Yu Ying only needed to silently follow Zhao Xuanyou’s lead and didn’t have to say anything.

The emperor looked at Zhao Xuanyou with a hint of emotion in his eyes. After accepting their bows, he allowed them to rise.

Knowing that Zhao Xuanyou’s leg injury had not yet healed, he ordered a eunuch to bring seats for them.

Yu Ying had previously thought they would have to kneel the entire time while speaking to the emperor. She hadn’t expected to be able to sit after the initial greetings, and her nervousness eased a great deal.

"Xuanyou, how is your leg injury?"

"The wound has healed, but I still can’t use much strength in it. The doctor says it might be a torn tendon that hasn’t healed properly."

"You really did it this time. You went to Shu to inspect the troops, caused so much trouble, and even ended up injuring yourself."

As the emperor said this, his eyes glanced at Yu Ying.

Yu Ying’s heart skipped a beat.

It seemed the emperor also knew about Zhao Xuanyou snatching her away in the street.

He had looked at her just now. Was he going to question her crime?

chapters.title: Targeting Him
chapters.content:
Yu Wan felt she handled others with ease.

But the man before her was the emperor, whose single word could send heads rolling; he was no ordinary person.

Yu Wan could only lower her head further, making herself appear even more timid.

Zhao Xuanyou respectfully said, "It was this subject's fault for acting recklessly. I was careless and fell into the water from the ship. I am truly unworthy."

The emperor shifted his gaze away from Yu Wan.

Four years ago, when Zhao Xuanyou was still the commander of the Brocade Guard, the emperor had known that he would abandon everything for the woman he loved, even his career. So it wasn’t surprising that he had gone to Anzhou to take a bride by force.

Of course, the reason he had summoned the couple today was not to meddle in their personal affairs.

"I am in great need of capable men right now. You’ve made yourself like this. What am I supposed to do?"

"Your Majesty, I am willing to share your burdens, even at the cost of my life."

The emperor gave a slight nod.

He had never doubted Zhao Xuanyou’s loyalty.

The reason he had called Zhao Xuanyou back to the capital was actually because of the hint he had dropped to Pan Xun.

"In your current state, what can you do for me?"

Zhao Xuanyou said in a deep voice, "Whatever I could do for Your Majesty before, I can still do now."

"Your father may not think the same."

The last time the old Marquis had entered the palace, he had described Zhao Xuanyou’s leg injury in such a pitiful manner that the emperor had guessed the old Marquis wanted to avoid the trouble of changing the crown prince and wanted Zhao Xuanyou to stay out of it.

"Since my father passed the title of Marquis Jingyuan to me, he naturally wants me to uphold the Jingyuan Marquis’s family duty of loyalty to the throne for generations. He has no other intentions."

"Good." The emperor was satisfied with the answer. His eyes regained some vigor as he ordered the eunuch to take Yu Wan to the imperial garden to appreciate the flowers.

Yu Wan stood up and bowed properly. She glanced at Zhao Xuanyou and saw him nod slightly at her. She silently followed the eunuch out of the Qianqing Palace.

She was not surprised by Zhao Xuanyou’s answer.

It was true that the old Marquis hoped they would stay away from the capital, but as long as Zhao Jun was still firmly seated as the crown prince, Zhao Xuanyou could not stand idly by.

If they were to leave, it would only be after Zhao Jun was dead.

She didn’t know what the emperor would say to Zhao Xuanyou, but Yu Wan wasn’t worried.

After all, whatever trouble arose, he would handle it himself.

Yu Wan followed the eunuch to the imperial garden. Everywhere she looked, there were clusters of flowers in full bloom, vibrant and colorful, opening her eyes to a new world.

In the past, when she was in the Marquis’s mansion, she often dealt with flowers in the greenhouse. Back then, the flower garden was filled with rare and precious flowers. But standing in the imperial garden now, the flowers she had once cultivated seemed utterly ordinary.

They would probably be uprooted by the eunuchs who tended the imperial garden.

Because of the summer heat, the eunuch went to fetch a palace fan for her to shield herself from the sun and fan herself. He then instructed her to stroll around the garden. When Zhao Xuanyou left the Qianqing Palace, he would come to take them out of the palace.

In the outside world, Yu Wan was the respected Marchioness, but within the palace, she held no significant status.

Naturally, the eunuch wouldn’t stay to accompany her the whole time.

Yu Wan didn’t mind. After expressing her thanks, she began to admire the flowers in the imperial garden by herself.

Just as she was appreciating a cluster of beautiful and charming roses, she suddenly felt something moving in the bushes.

A kitten?

Yu Wan softly mewed a couple of times.

The bushes rustled violently, and a delicate little face popped out, staring at her seriously. "I’m not a cat."

"Your Highness? Why are you here?" Yu Wan was taken aback for a moment. Seeing that it was the young imperial grandson Zhao Yi Yun, she became curious.

Wasn’t Zhao Yi Yun supposed to be with Sun Qianran?

Why was he alone, crouching in the rose bushes?

"Where is Miss Sun who is supposed to be with you? Where are your wet nurses?"

Zhao Yi Yun frowned when he heard her question and tried to crawl back into the bushes.

"Be careful." Yu Wan quickly reached out to stop him.

Roses had thorns. Even though he was the son of Zhao Jun, he was still a child. Yu Wan couldn’t just stand by and watch him get hurt.

"Don’t touch me."

Hearing Zhao Yi Yun’s soft words, Yu Wan was slightly startled.

No wonder Ziyan said he was a gentle child. Even when he was angry, his words were still this soft.

For some reason, Yu Wan suddenly thought of Zhao Qi. As a member of the imperial family, Zhao Qi’s anger was completely different from Zhao Yi Yun’s.

"Your Highness, there are no ants in there. Come out first, and I’ll take you somewhere else to look."

Zhao Yi Yun was slightly taken aback and turned his head to look at Yu Wan. "You know I’m looking for ants?"

"I heard it from someone." Yu Wan squatted down and smiled gently at Zhao Yi Yun. "Do you remember Aunt Ziyan?"

"Ah? You know Aunt Ziyan?"

Yu Wan nodded and said softly, "Aunt Ziyan and I are friends. She told me that the young imperial grandson in the Eastern Palace is very gentle and cute, and he loves watching ants the most."

"Where is Aunt Ziyan?"

"She’s still in the capital."

Zhao Yi Yun’s big eyes blinked a couple of times, looking just like a little kitten.

Yu Wan sighed secretly. No wonder the emperor doted on this grandson so much; even she found him adorable.

But suddenly, Zhao Yi Yun’s eyes filled with tears. He said sadly, "I miss Aunt Ziyan. Marchioness Yu, can you ask Aunt Ziyan to come see me?"

"Aunt Ziyan misses you too. But she has already left the palace and can’t enter freely anymore."

"Then I won’t be able to see her again?"

"How could that be? When..."

Zhao Yi Yun looked at Yu Wan expectantly. Just then, Sun Qianran, accompanied by two wet nurses, walked over from behind. When she saw Yu Wan crouching there talking to Zhao Yi Yun, she gave her a wary look before squeezing in front of Zhao Yi Yun.

"Your Highness, the wet nurse has prepared your favorite osmanthus cake. Go eat some pastries."

Zhao Yi Yun glanced at Yu Wan, then was reluctantly pulled out of the rose bushes by the wet nurse and led to the pavilion to eat pastries.

Yu Wan also stood up, intending to continue admiring the flowers nearby. But she felt Sun Qianran’s unfriendly gaze.

"You seem to get along very well with His Imperial Highness."

"I just saw His Imperial Highness crawling alone in the rose bushes with no one attending to him, so I came over to take a look."

Sun Qianran’s eyes flickered slightly. She caught the implication in Yu Wan’s words, that she was criticizing her for not taking good care of the imperial grandson, almost letting him get hurt.

And that was indeed the truth.

Although Sun Qianran tried her best to be gentle, Zhao Yi Yun had never been close to her. At every opportunity, he would run around everywhere.

He was very familiar with all parts of the palace. Although he was small, he ran very fast. Even with two wet nurses following him closely, they often lost sight of him.

"I really didn’t misjudge you before. Marchioness, you are so intelligent. It was a waste for you to be a concubine for so long."

Yu Wan didn’t mind her bringing up her past as a maid at all.

Instead, she smiled and said, "Miss Sun flatters me."

Sun Qianran hit a snag and felt stifled.

Seeing Yu Wan turning to leave, she remembered that Yu Wan had gone to great lengths to fake her death and chase after Pei Ta in Qingzhou. A surge of anger rose in Sun Qianran’s heart, and she lost all composure and dignity.

"Did you already have your sights set on Pei Ta back then?"

---

chapters.title: Retorted on the Spot
chapters.content:
Yu Wan was slightly taken aback. She hadn’t expected the usually graceful and refined Sun Qianran to say such things.

After a moment of thought, she realized that Sun Qianran must have misunderstood her earlier mention of doing business in Qingzhou.

Yu Wan was angered by her accusation and immediately retaliated.

"So it turns out I overestimated Miss Sun! Perhaps the reason Director Pei divorced you was that he saw through your true nature?"

"Shut up! You have no right to comment on my relationship with him."

Looking at Sun Qianran’s resentful eyes, Yu Wan understood that she had never let go of Pei Ta over the years.

Thinking of Pei Ta, who was far away in Anzhou, Yu Wan’s heart wavered slightly. She didn’t continue the argument but softened her tone, patiently explaining, "When I went to Qingzhou, I didn’t know Director Pei was there. I only met him last year. It wasn’t as you thought."

After leaving the Marquis’s mansion, how could a fugitive like her know about the transfers of court officials?

Leaving the capital might have opened up a vast world, but everything was unknown.

Since her mother knew how to make jewelry, she had thought of going to Qingsha Town, which was famous for its pearls.

She had been inexperienced back then.

If she had known that the ships from Lingnan went directly to foreign lands, carrying countless treasures from the South Seas, she would have taken her mother and Wen Guo straight to Lingnan. The business would have definitely thrived.

Sun Qianran heard her explanation but only gave a cold laugh.

"I originally had no obligation to explain myself to you. I only said more because I remembered that you used to be kind to me when I was a little maid. Since we don’t see eye to eye, let’s just drop it."

Seeing Yu Wan turning to leave, Sun Qianran hurriedly said, "Wait."

"If you only want to say unpleasant things, you can forget it. No matter how you curse me, I won’t care."

"Did he insist on going to Anzhou for you?"

It was indeed because of Yu Wan.

But Yu Wan’s eyes flickered slightly. After staring at Sun Qianran for a moment, she smiled lightly. "How would I know what Director Pei thinks? If you’re interested in him, you should ask him yourself, not me."

"How can I ask him?" Sun Qianran sneered.

Yu Wan said indifferently, "If he returns to the capital, won’t you be able to ask him?"

"You mean..."

"Your father may bear a grudge against Pei Ta. But you frequently enter the Qianqing Palace and have audiences with His Majesty. With your intelligence, if you really want him to return to the capital, it’s not impossible, is it?"

Yu Wan’s voice was very soft, but to Sun Qianran, it was like a clap of thunder.

She knew that the emperor had been poisoned. Since the empress was involved, the current crown prince would certainly not be able to keep his position.

Sun Chancellor had recommended her to enter the palace to take care of Zhao Yi Yun, mainly to have her pay attention to the emperor’s movements and see which prince the emperor favored as the next heir. Sun Chancellor wanted to prepare in advance so that he could become a prominent official serving two reigns.

But Yu Wan’s words clearly indicated that she knew about these inside stories.

Zhao Xuanyou had always been a favorite of the emperor, so it wasn’t strange that he knew about palace affairs. But it was surprising that he didn’t avoid discussing them with Yu Wan.

"Official transfers are not that simple. How can I, a woman, influence such matters with just a few words to His Majesty? Moreover, my father..."

Back then, when Pei Ta had insisted on divorcing her, her father had already hated him to the extreme.

If not for the emperor’s protection, her father would have long since schemed to have Pei Ta dismissed from office.

Yu Wan sighed helplessly. "If you still firmly stand on your father’s side, why are you still concerned about Pei Ta? You can’t even figure out what you want, yet you come to question me? I really misjudged you."

"Even if it were you, could you easily abandon your own father?"

"If I chose my father, I wouldn’t be entangled in my feelings for Pei Ta. If I chose Pei Ta, I would follow him wholeheartedly without any distractions. I would never be as indecisive and hesitant as you are!"

Sun Qianran was slightly taken aback and looked up at Yu Wan, her eyes filled with shock.

Earlier, when she had seen Yu Wan transform into a marchioness, she had still looked down on Yu Wan for her ambitious pursuit of status.

But after this long conversation in the imperial garden, Sun Qianran suddenly realized that Pei Ta had indeed not misjudged Yu Wan in the past.

Back then, Yu Wan had only known a few characters and had little knowledge, yet she was still clever and quick-witted.

Now, Yu Wan not only had some education but had also traveled far and wide, gaining extensive experience. When sparring with her, Yu Wan didn’t lose at all and even completely overpowered her.

Sun Qianran’s emotions were complex.

Although she appeared gentle and soft, she was actually proud and aloof.

In the past, others had praised Cui Yichu as a great talent, but she could dismiss it with a smile because she knew Cui Yichu was just a flower vase; able to write some melancholic poems but lacking in strategy.

She was different.

She was raised personally by Sun Chancellor and was not inferior to any court official in terms of strategy and scheming.

This was also why, after the incident in the palace, Sun Chancellor had immediately found a way to send her into the palace to stay by Zhao Yi Yun’s side.

But Yu Wan...

"From the looks of it, you still want to have your cake and eat it too; wanting both Pei Ta and your father." Yu Wan looked at Sun Qianran and smiled. "Don’t end up with nothing."

Sun Qianran took a deep breath and barely calmed her emotions. She somewhat regretted having said so much to Yu Wan.

"The transfer of court officials is not something a woman like me can interfere with. Marchioness, you really think too highly of me."

Yu Wan smiled. "If he can’t come back, that’s fine too. Pei Ta has always been like a free-spirited wild crane. He said that being an official outside the capital is much more relaxed than being one in the capital. Although Anzhou is remote, the scenery in Shu is not bad, and there are many beauties. I imagine it won’t be long before he finds another wife there. That would also be a good thing."

She spoke of Pei Ta’s affairs in a familiar tone, watching as Sun Qianran’s just-calmed emotions fluctuated again.

"I’ve said too much." With that, Yu Wan shook her fan and walked away.

After admiring the flowers alone for a while, the little eunuch who had initially taken her to the imperial garden finally returned. He said that Zhao Xuanyou had already left the Qianqing Palace and would now escort them out of the palace.

Yu Wan followed the eunuch forward out of the imperial garden. Soon, she saw Zhao Xuanyou standing ahead by the corridor, leaning on his cane.

When he saw Yu Wan approaching, his sharp eyes softened slightly.

The eunuch smiled. "From here, continue straight ahead to the palace gate. Marquis, you must be very familiar with this path. I won’t escort you further."

"Thank you, Your Honor."

After the eunuch had walked away, Yu Wan linked her arm with Zhao Xuanyou’s and helped him walk toward the palace exit together.

"Just now, I ran into Sun Qianran again in the imperial garden."

Zhao Xuanyou frowned slightly. "Did she cause trouble for you?"

"More or less." As soon as Yu Wan finished speaking, she clearly felt Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes fill with anger. She smiled and said, "Don’t worry. She insulted me, and I insulted her back. I didn’t let her get the better of me."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a light laugh.

After walking a short distance, Yu Wan glanced at Zhao Xuanyou’s expression, hesitated for a moment, and then spoke.

"I also talked to her about something else... about Pei Ta."

chapters.title: Honesty
chapters.content:
As soon as Zhao Xuanyou heard the name "Pei Ta," the dark clouds in his eyes, which had not yet fully dissipated, swiftly gathered again.

He glanced at Yu Ying, seeing her beautiful eyes and brows curved in a smile as she looked at him, and it felt like punching cotton.

He muttered, "What is there to say?"

Yu Ying knew that mentioning Pei Ta would make him angry.

But now they were husband and wife, so they should be honest with each other.

It was better for him to hear things from her than to find out from someone else later.

"Sun Qianran seems to still have feelings for Pei Ta, so I told her that if she can't let go of him, she might as well try to get him transferred back to the capital."

As she spoke, she kept her eyes on Zhao Xuanyou, clearly seeing his expression turn sharp; surprised, angry, and a little hurt.

"Originally, he was supposed to stay in the capital as an official. It was because of me... because of me that he ended up becoming the Inspector of the Xishu Province!"

"Who asked him to harbor ill intentions?"

If not for this, every time Zhao Xuanyou thought about how Pei Ta had tried to hide Yu Ying in Anzhou to live as husband and wife, his teeth itched with rage.

Back in Anzhou, it had been a mistake not to beat him up in the street.

Yu Ying took his hand, softly saying, "I do feel guilty about this matter. If he can return to the capital, then we can consider it even between us."

"Just that?"

"Of course. What else do you think I'm doing this for? My feelings for him..."

"What feelings?" Zhao Xuanyou's gaze tightened sharply, almost jumping up.

Yu Ying had to rephrase, saying again, "He and I are already like strangers, with no connection left. Besides, we're about to return to Yuzhou soon. If he comes back to the capital, it has nothing to do with us."

Nothing to do?

Only if Pei Ta were dead could it be nothing to do with them.

Zhao Xuanyou was furious, but he couldn't take it out on Yu Ying. He could only darken his face and walk ahead.

Before long, the couple walked out of the imperial palace.

After getting into the carriage, Zhao Xuanyou saw that Yu Ying wasn't speaking to him, and his heart panicked again. Unable to hold back, he spoke first, "Yingying, do you really feel guilty toward him?"

Hearing his tone, Yu Ying knew he was overcomplicating simple matters again.

She hadn't continued talking about it because she was afraid that before she finished, Zhao Xuanyou would be so angry he might drop dead.

"Can you let me finish before getting angry, okay?"

Hearing her sweet and soft voice pleading with him, Zhao Xuanyou had no way to refuse her and could only nod.

Yu Ying let out a slight sigh of relief, softly saying, "I do care about this matter and feel guilty. However, I don't often think of Pei Ta because of it."

"Really?"

"Of course. You know how heartless I can be," Yu Ying smiled at him, her eyes and brows full of charm.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze was firmly fixed on her eyes, letting out a cold hum but saying nothing.

Indeed, she was a heartless woman; she had left without a trace, without any lingering attachment.

Thinking this, Zhao Xuanyou unconsciously pulled her into his embrace.

Yu Ying leaned against his shoulder, continuing, "Sun Qianran kept pestering me, and I could tell she still has feelings for Pei Ta. That's why I went along with it and urged her to find a way to get Pei Ta transferred back to the capital."

"Can she do it?"

"I don't know. But now she has to take care of the little imperial grandson and sees the Emperor every day. If she can mention Pei Ta at the right time, perhaps the Emperor will take notice."

That was true.

Everyone wanted to place people close to the Emperor because sometimes a single word or action could influence his decisions.

The Emperor had originally admired Pei Ta, but since Pei Ta had been away from the capital for so long, he had gradually forgotten him.

But if someone deliberately brought him up, and the Emperor recalled his talent, a single imperial decree could bring Pei Ta back to the capital immediately.

"I won't do anything else about this matter. It ends here. Whatever Sun Qianran wants to do, she can do it herself."

"You don't want me to help?"

"No." Yu Ying raised her hand and gently poked his chin. "I just want you to know what I've done. I'm telling you."

"Really?" The gloom in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes finally began to dissipate.

"Of course. I am your wife, and I have no private feelings for Pei Ta. I tell you these things because I think there's no need to hide anything from you."

Hearing Yu Ying's words, Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat surprised and pleased.

So that was how she saw it.

"Zhao Xuanyou, if you're really angry, then from now on I'll only say things you like to hear and won't mention anything that upsets you."

"No." Zhao Xuanyou quickly interrupted her. "It's fine as it is now, Yingying. You can tell me anything. And I have nothing to hide from you either."

Yu Ying lightly hummed in agreement.

Zhao Xuanyou looked at her, unable to resist lowering his head. Their breaths intertwined, and their soft lips met.

The carriage wheels rolled on, and after a long while, Zhao Xuanyou finally let her go.

Yu Ying leaned back against his shoulder.

"I thought again about the situation in the palace. If Sun Qianran really falls for my reverse psychology today and gets Pei Ta transferred back to the capital, it could actually be beneficial for us."

Hearing her seriously discuss the palace situation, Zhao Xuanyou felt she was forcing some far-fetched reasoning just to convince him.

But he didn't dare to expose her, so he could only ask, "How would it be beneficial?"

"Last time you said that the current steward of Qianqing Palace is on good terms with Prime Minister Sun, and Sun Qianran is also in the palace taking care of the imperial grandson. So Prime Minister Sun currently holds great power. If Pei Ta returns to the capital, Sun Qianran will definitely want to reconcile with him. Since Pei Ta and Prime Minister Sun are not on good terms, maybe he can restrain Prime Minister Sun a little."

"Him?" Zhao Xuanyou looked disdainful.

Yu Ying knew he had deep prejudices against Pei Ta and didn't argue with him. She softly asked, "What did the Emperor say to you? He didn't ask you to stay in the capital, did he?"

Earlier in Qianqing Palace, the Emperor's words clearly indicated he had a task for Zhao Xuanyou.

"He just mentioned what Pan Xun talked about last time." Zhao Xuanyou paused, then asked, "Don't you want to stay in the capital?"

"Wherever you are, I will be," Yu Ying answered simply. "But I guess you don't want to leave the capital just yet."

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement.

He wouldn't leave until Zhao Zun was dead.

"And the Emperor's health?"

"The imperial physicians are slowly drawing out the poison. For now, his health is still stable." As long as the Emperor's health held, the court wouldn't fall into chaos for the time being.

Yu Ying frowned slightly. "Still no clue where the poison came from?"

Zhao Xuanyou shook his head.

After a moment of silence, he said, "The Emperor wants me to investigate this matter."

Although his time as the commander of the Jin Yi Wei had been short, during those few months, he had solved several major cases. Even after being imprisoned, he had still directed Pan Xun and others to uncover the case of the Duke of Xingguo embezzling tribute pearls.

If the Emperor hadn't thought he was too sentimental and undisciplined, even the incident of breaking into the duke's mansion and injuring someone could have been suppressed to protect him.

The person who could uncover the source of the poison in the palace was none other than Zhao Xuanyou.

---

chapters.title: Attached to Her
chapters.content:
"Did you accept this task?" Yu Ying asked.

"Do you think it's inappropriate?"

It wasn't that it was inappropriate.

"Father hopes we can return to Yuzhou as soon as possible to avoid trouble. If you take on this task, I'm afraid Father will worry."

Zhao Xuanyou remained silent for a moment before softly saying, "Earlier you mentioned having Father come with us to Yuzhou. I think if he is willing, he and Aunt Wei can go to Yuzhou first. Once things in the capital are settled, we can join them."

Since he had inherited the marquis title, no matter what upheavals occurred in the court, he had to bear the responsibility and protect the entire marquis family.

"And Grandmother?"

Zhao Xuanyou had naturally considered taking Lady Ye with them, but Lady Ye had lived in the capital her whole life. She had never followed Zhao Xuanyou's grandfather to Yuzhou even when she was younger, let alone now.

"She won't go without being asked. But there's no need to worry. With her status, no one in the capital would dare to harm her even if chaos breaks out."

"Mmm."

Before long, the carriage stopped in front of the marquis's mansion.

After entering the mansion, Zhao Xuanyou went to see his father to report on the day's events at the palace, while Yu Ying went to Honghui Hall to spend some time with Lady Ye.

Compared to the restraint of the previous day, today she felt much closer to Lady Ye.

Lady Ye told her a lot about the various relatives in the capital, which ones were close, which ones were distant, which ones were reliable, and which ones were just freeloaders; explaining everything to her in detail.

When Zhao Xuanyou saw that Yu Ying hadn't returned to the Tangli Courtyard for a long time, he came to Leshou Hall to look for her.

Since it was time for lunch, Lady Ye ordered a meal to be served in Leshou Hall and invited the couple to eat there.

The meal was enjoyable, and by the time the couple returned to Tangli Courtyard, they saw Wen Sun standing at the courtyard gate.

Since Yu Ying had married into the marquis's mansion, and with Zhao Xuanyou by her side, Wen Sun naturally didn't follow her around all the time. In fact, they hadn't spoken in two days.

"Have you eaten?"

Wen Sun nodded.

The marquis's mansion was spacious, and Zhao Xuanyou had arranged a small courtyard near the training grounds for Wen Sun. It was a bit far from Tangli Courtyard but very convenient for practicing martial arts.

Yu Ying noticed that Wen Sun had something to say. After pushing Zhao Xuanyou into the courtyard, she walked over to Wen Sun.

"Have you been bored staying in the marquis's mansion these past two days?"

"A little."

"Do you want to go back to Wuyuan?"

Wen Sun shook his head.

He didn't know how to bring it up.

Having spent a lot of time with Yu Ying and her mother, he had grown used to talking to them every day.

Now Ding Wenxi was far away in Yuzhou, Yu Ying was married, and she was often with Zhao Xuanyou. Suddenly, he felt a sense of emptiness.

"It's nothing." Wen Sun said quickly, "I just came to see how you're doing."

"Tomorrow is the third day of our marriage, and we'll go back to Wuyuan together. You can go out with Da Niu and Xiu Fang to explore the capital."

"Okay." Wen Sun finished speaking and turned to leave.

Yu Ying watched his retreating figure, her brows twitching slightly. After a moment, she turned and went back inside.

Zhao Xuanyou had already changed into his nightclothes and was lying down.

The doctor had instructed him to use his leg more, but after being bedridden for so long, half a day at the palace had left his right leg aching with fatigue.

Yu Ying approached the bed and saw him frowning as he rubbed his right leg. She asked, "Does it hurt?"

"A little sore."

"Wait, I'll get something."

Today, dressed in her finest for the palace, Yu Ying had worn a complicated outfit.

After removing her hairpiece and changing into simpler clothes, she brought over a small jade hammer and sat beside Zhao Xuanyou, massaging his right leg muscles.

"This does feel better than when I do it myself."

"Of course. I'm used to taking care of you."

Hearing the teasing in Yu Ying's voice, Zhao Xuanyou reached out and pinched her a few times.

"I can take care of you too."

Yu Ying let out a light hum, swatting his hand away without acknowledging him.

"What did Wen Sun want with you?"

"Nothing much. I think he's just a little uncomfortable staying in the marquis's mansion."

"Or uncomfortable being away from you."

As for Yu Ying's relationship with Wen Sun, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't say he was jealous, but he did feel a little uncomfortable.

After all, Wen Sun wasn't Yu Ying's real brother. He was just an adopted brother, with no blood relation.

Yu Ying valued him greatly, treating him like family.

And Wen Sun?

Zhao Xuanyou couldn't say for sure if Wen Sun's feelings for Yu Ying were purely familial, but he was certain that Wen Sun was very attached to her.

If Yu Ying asked, he would do anything for her.

Hearing the slight jealousy in Zhao Xuanyou's words, Yu Ying didn't get angry. Instead, she seriously explained, "When Wen Sun was a child, he was abandoned by his family because of his appearance. After being trained as a dark guard, he became used to taking orders. So after leaving the Eastern Palace, he came to see me as his anchor."

Zhao Xuanyou's brows twitched.

"But you're already married to me. He can't follow you forever."

Yu Ying had thought about Wen Sun's future countless times.

Wen Sun saw her as his anchor, and she herself had grown accustomed to his presence.

"I've thought about it. When we return to Yuzhou, you can arrange some work for him in the military. Would that be okay?"

Wen Sun's life had been sheltered. If he worked in the military, he might make friends and slowly open up. When the time was right, perhaps he could have a life of his own.

Yu Ying knew very well that Wen Sun was not a heartless person.

He had developed a deep bond with Bingping after spending some time with her, and even with Tiya after three days in the desert.

In the past, they had to hide and run, so Wen Sun had never been able to live a normal life.

But now it was different. Wen Sun could have a life of his own.

"You've thought quite thoroughly for him."

Looking at Zhao Xuanyou's half-smiling expression, Yu Ying continued to massage his leg, glaring at him.

"Do you think it's inappropriate? Actually, Wen Sun is quite good at business. He could help my mother manage the shops. But I just feel that with his exceptional martial arts skills, it would be a waste for him to only work in a jewelry shop."

"He's a top-tier expert. Even in the Mingchui Guard, there are few who can match him. If he's willing to join the military, I have no objections."

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou describe Wen Sun as a top-tier expert, Yu Ying couldn't help but ask, "Even you say he's a top-tier expert. Is he really that good now? Better than you?"

Seeing the amusement in Yu Ying's eyes, Zhao Xuanyou couldn't resist poking her nose.

"Can you stop boosting others' morale and undermining your own husband's prestige?"

"Who's undermining your prestige? You're of course the best. I just thought Wen Sun was an ordinary expert before since he was once captured by Yin Ping and the others."

Back then, Wen Sun was indeed just an ordinary expert. But now, his lightness skill had reached a transcendent level.

On the battlefield, Zhao Xuanyou naturally wasn't afraid of him, but if Wen Sun had the intention to assassinate, he could pose a significant threat to Zhao Xuanyou.

As Zhao Xuanyou pondered, Yu Ying suddenly thought of something.

She suddenly grabbed Zhao Xuanyou's hand. "There's something..."

chapters.title: The Red Silk Canopy
chapters.content:
Seeing the gleam in Yu Wan’s eyes, Zhao Xuanyou inexplicably felt like a lamb being led to the slaughter.

He narrowed his eyes and instinctively leaned back slightly.

"What mischief are you plotting now?"

"What mischief? I’m only thinking of good ideas."

"Not listening."

"Husband!" Yu Wan tossed the jade hammer aside, scooted over to Zhao Xuanyou, and threw herself into his arms, grumbling, "I really did think of a good idea."

Even with his heart of stone, Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t resist when her soft body pressed against his chest. After just a few wiggles from her, his gaze darkened rapidly, and he pulled her down onto the couch with him.

"Let me finish first."

Yu Wan, pinned beneath him, stretched out a hand to cover his mouth, preventing him from kissing her.

Zhao Xuanyou raised his hand, and she quickly covered her own chest.

Zhao Xuanyou furrowed his brows and sighed, finally giving a reluctant "Mmm."

"You’ve already agreed to His Majesty to enter the palace and investigate the case, so why not take Wen Kuo with you?"

"Take him into the palace?"

"You said yourself that his lightness skills and hidden weapons are exceptional. Besides, he used to work in the Eastern Palace, so he’s very familiar with everything in the palace. With the current dangers in the palace, having him by your side would be much safer."

"You just want to help him earn merit?"

It would be easy for Zhao Xuanyou to arrange a position for Wen Kuo in the Ming Chao Guard. Wen Kuo didn’t need to prove himself in front of him.

"No, Wen Kuo is my brother, and you are his brother-in-law. It’s only natural for him to help you."

In truth, Yu Wan felt the two of them were too distant.

Wen Kuo deliberately kept his distance from Zhao Xuanyou, and Zhao Xuanyou was also somewhat guarded around him.

Given their personalities, it was unlikely they’d ever share drinks and bare their hearts to each other.

Perhaps if Wen Kuo entered the palace to assist Zhao Xuanyou with this case, the two would grow more familiar, and their future interactions would become more natural.

"Do you think it’s inappropriate?"

Wen Kuo had spent a long time by Zhao Zun’s side and was indeed very familiar with everything in the imperial palace.

Additionally, Zhao Xuanyou’s leg injury hadn’t fully healed. Having Wen Kuo by his side to assist would indeed be more convenient.

"But this case involves the Crown Prince. Would he be willing?"

"He should be."

When Wen Kuo was a secret guard, he learned many of the Crown Prince’s secrets. He had never revealed a single one to Yu Wan, which proved his loyalty to the Crown Prince.

Yu Wan knew clearly that he wouldn’t willingly betray the Crown Prince, nor would he directly harm him.

But if the Crown Prince was brought down by others, that was beyond Wen Kuo’s control. He wouldn’t risk his life to interfere in the Crown Prince’s fate.

"You don’t need to worry about that. I’ll go talk to him. When you’re in the palace, feel free to order him around; just don’t ask him to assassinate the Crown Prince."

Zhao Xuanyou let out a cold snort.

"Understood."

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou agree so readily, Yu Wan finally let out a sigh of relief.

The earlier meeting between Zhao Xuanyou and Wen Kuo had been a bit awkward. Hopefully, after this, the two could get along better.

"Is that all?"

"Hmm?"

Yu Wan blinked, only then realizing what Zhao Xuanyou was referring to.

He really was... always in that mood.

Yu Wan reached for the thin blanket, intending to make him wait until evening.

But before she could turn over, the clothes on her body were already stripped off by him.

"At night," Yu Wan pleaded.

After walking so much in the palace and standing for so long, she was tired too and wanted to take a short nap.

Moreover, she didn’t want the maids to have to carry water in the middle of the day.

Seeing the blush on Yu Wan’s cheeks, Zhao Xuanyou’s heart softened even more, and he growled, "When you were asking for a favor, you weren’t saying that."

"Then..."

Yu Wan still wanted to argue, but before she could finish her sentence, the rest of her words were swallowed by him.

She could only press her lips together, grit her teeth, and muster the strength to pull the canopy down.

It was broad daylight, and the maids could come in at any moment. She didn’t want their intimacy exposed.

After their passion subsided, the two, who had originally been exhausted, found themselves wide awake instead of sleepy.

"It’s all your fault. Now I can’t even take my afternoon nap," Yu Wan complained.

Seeing the blush still on her fair, tender cheeks, Zhao Xuanyou reached for her again. "Since you’re not sleepy, let’s do it again."

"No."

Yu Wan quickly grabbed the blanket and wrapped herself up like a zongzi, rolling to the inner side.

"I’m not sleepy, but I have no energy left. Tonight, Father said we’re having a family dinner."

Zhao Xuanyou, of course, didn’t see any conflict between the two matters. He frowned and said, "So what?"

"Grandmother and Father asked me to oversee the kitchen. Tonight’s family banquet is my responsibility. I need to rest for a while and then go to the kitchen to supervise."

Yu Wan respected the elders of the Marquis’s residence so much that Zhao Xuanyou naturally couldn’t hold her back.

He sighed deeply, then gently caressed her slender waist through the thin blanket, his gaze flickering as he pondered other matters.

The two lay quietly for a while. When Yu Wan saw that he truly wasn’t moving, she finally shifted closer to him, still wrapped in the blanket.

"What are you thinking about?"

She could see that he wasn’t sleepy either, just staring deeply at the mandarin duck flowers embroidered on the canopy, lost in thought.

"Still about the Emperor’s poisoning."

"How can you figure anything out before even entering the palace to investigate?"

"The Brocade Guards aren’t useless. They’ve already searched every possible place. Even if I go, I won’t find anything more than they did."

"Not necessarily."

Back in Heishui County, Zhao Qi and Pei Ta had arrived ten days before Zhao Xuanyou, but they hadn’t noticed the illegal casting of weapons there.

Though Zhao Xuanyou was a martial general, he was meticulous and perceptive. Perhaps he really could discover something different once he entered the palace.

Hearing the certainty in Yu Wan’s voice, Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes carried a smile as he said in a deep voice, "I have thought of some things, but I’ll need to enter the palace to confirm."

"What did you think of?" Yu Wan perked up, directly flopping onto Zhao Xuanyou’s chest.

That day, when Zhao Xuanyou met Pan Xun at Mingyue Tower, Yu Wan had been there too and had heard every detail of the case.

Though she hadn’t carefully considered the case, she had thought about it briefly at Mingyue Tower and felt something was amiss.

Zhao Xuanyou let out a cold snort, giving her an annoyed look.

Just now, she had wrapped herself up like a zongzi, but now that she wanted to hear about the case, she had crawled over herself.

What did she take him for?

Was the case more attractive than him? To be summoned and dismissed at will?

"I just know that my husband is the most capable. What others can’t think of, you can."

Yu Wan saw that he was unhappy and could only resort to acting coy to smooth things over.

"Husband, just tell me."

She lightly scratched his shoulder with her fingers, half of her body leaning against him, her clear, large eyes looking at him pitifully.

With such a delicate and weak posture, how could Zhao Xuanyou stay angry?

He could only obediently reveal all the doubts he had pieced together.

"The Emperor suffered such a major incident. The Brocade Guards should have turned the imperial palace upside down. I feel that the poison isn’t in the palace."

---

chapters.title: Distinguished Guest
chapters.content:
Indeed, with the Brocade Guards’ efficiency, if there was poison hidden in the Qianqing Palace or anywhere else in the palace, they would have found it long ago. It was impossible that they had searched for over a month without any leads.

If they couldn’t find it, the most likely explanation was that it wasn’t there.

"Was there no poison in the Kunning Palace either?" Yu Wan asked curiously.

Zhao Xuanyou shook his head.

Today, during the private discussion in the Qianqing Palace, he had learned more details that Pan Xun hadn’t mentioned.

"After the Empress was placed under house arrest, all the servants in the Kunning Palace were quietly taken away for interrogation. After a round of torture from the Brocade Guards, many of the Empress’s past schemes against the concubines were confessed, but not a single person knew anything about the Emperor’s poisoning."

"So the poison really wasn’t administered by someone from the Kunning Palace. What about the Empress herself? Was she interrogated?"

"As the Empress, without evidence, Pan Xun and his men couldn’t use torture on her. The Emperor visited her twice in the Kunning Palace, and each time she wailed and cried, proclaiming her innocence."

After hearing his words, Yu Wan couldn’t help but furrow her brows in deep thought.

If the poison wasn’t in the palace, how did the Emperor get poisoned twice?

If Zhao Xuanyou’s speculation was correct...

After a moment, Yu Wan looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, suddenly realizing: "On the two days the Emperor was poisoned, someone entered the palace carrying poison and got close to him. I don’t know what method they used to make the Emperor come into contact with it."

Zhao Xuanyou raised his eyebrows slightly.

He hadn’t expected that with just one sentence, Yu Wan would guess his entire thought process.

Before he could say anything else, Yu Wan continued: "If that’s the case, finding out who administered the poison might not be so difficult. Everyone who enters the palace has to register at the gate. If we compare the records from the two days the Emperor was poisoned, we can immediately find out who was present on both days."

"It’s not that simple."

"Why not?"

"Today, you entered the imperial palace too. From the palace gate to the Qianqing Palace, there are three separate checks. Bringing poison close to the Emperor is as difficult as ascending to heaven."

Yu Wan puffed out her cheeks slightly.

That was true.
