Things brought in from outside the palace wouldn’t be eaten by the Emperor. Even if they were, the eunuchs would have inspected them first. It was impossible for only the Emperor to be poisoned.

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered slightly as the adorable image of Zhao Yi Yun and her fair, snow-like appearance came to mind.

She looked at Zhao Xuanyou. "Do you think it might be related to the little Imperial Grandson?"

The Emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun. Even after placing the Kunning Palace and the Eastern Palace under house arrest, he still kept Zhao Yi Yun by his side.

If someone used Zhao Yi Yun to poison the Emperor, it would be impossible to guard against.

"The little Imperial Grandson wouldn’t have any intention of harming the Emperor, but the people around him might."

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t think so.

"After the Emperor was poisoned the first time, he immediately suspected the Kunning Palace and the Eastern Palace, and took the little Imperial Grandson into his own care. Everyone attending to the little Imperial Grandson was replaced with people the Emperor personally arranged."

Yu Wan suddenly understood.

It was true that Zhao Yi Yun could have been a way for the Emperor to be poisoned, but he had long since been cut off from the Eastern Palace. Even if someone wanted to use him to administer poison, it would be impossible now.

The first time might have been possible, but the second time was absolutely not.

This was too complicated. She didn’t want to think about it anymore.

She let out a soft sigh and looked at Zhao Xuanyou, her eyes becoming even clearer and brighter. "Just from listening to the Emperor and Pan Xun, you’ve already thought of so much. Once you enter the palace, you’ll definitely be able to uncover the truth quickly."

Zhao Xuanyou was used to others’ praise, but the feeling of being praised by her was something no one else could compare to.

He cupped the back of her head and pressed her face down.

The expected warmth followed.

After a moment of tenderness, Yu Wan propped herself up again. "You should rest a little longer. I need to go to the kitchen."

Zhao Xuanyou’s right leg was still sore. To recover quickly, he didn’t dare to overdo it. After nodding, he added, "Since you’re preparing a feast, why not prepare a little more? Have Yuan Zhen go to the Princess’s residence and invite the Princess and Mo Huan over to join us for the meal."

"Isn’t it a bit rushed to invite them now, right before dinner?"

"If it were another family, it would be rushed, but Mo Huan is practically family. It’s fine."

Zhao Xuanyou wasn’t particularly close to his cousins, but he and Ye Mo Huan were as close as brothers.

After Ye Mo Huan married the Princess, the couple had been loving and harmonious, and they even had a clever and adorable daughter.

Since Zhao Xuanyou had already married Yu Wan, it was natural to introduce her to his brother.

"But I don’t know the Princess’s tastes. How should I prepare?"

"Mo Huan doesn’t usually have any dietary restrictions. I’m not familiar with Princess Yining either. Just prepare a variety of dishes."

Yu Wan nodded, then got up to bathe and dress. She sent Yuan Zhen to the Princess’s residence to deliver the message, while she herself went to the kitchen.

The kitchen had already prepared a quite lavish family banquet. After reviewing the menu, Yu Wan added a few more elaborate dishes.

The family banquet was originally set to be in Leshou Hall, but since the Princess was coming, to be more formal, it was moved to the Flower Hall.

Yu Wan directed the servants to remove some of the excess tables and chairs from the Flower Hall, then selected some flowers and arranged them in vases, making the space look even more elegant.

By the time evening arrived, Old Madame Ye and the Old Marquis arrived at the Flower Hall first. Seeing the refreshed look of the hall, they immediately praised Yu Wan endlessly.

Delighted by the elders’ approval, Yu Wan was also overjoyed.

After helping the Old Madame to her seat, Zhao Xuanyou soon arrived, leaning on a cane.

After the family sat and chatted for a while, a servant came to report that the Princess and the Prince Consort had entered the residence.

Ye Mo Huan was a frequent visitor to the Marquis’s residence, treating it like his own home. As soon as the gatekeeper came in to announce their arrival, Ye Mo Huan, with the Princess in tow, walked straight in.

Princess Yining was of noble status. The entire family immediately stood to greet her, escorting Princess Yining to the seat of honor.

After the pleasantries, Yu Wan ordered the servants to serve the meal.

Princess Yining seemed to be in low spirits today. Throughout the meal, only Ye Mo Huan kept the conversation going.

Yu Wan glanced at the Princess’s indifferent expression, which seemed like she was putting on airs. For a moment, she couldn’t quite figure out the other woman’s attitude.

At the Lingchuan Hunting Palace, she had only seen Princess Yining once or twice, so the Princess likely didn’t have much of an impression of her.

However, since Ye Mo Huan was so close to Zhao Xuanyou, Princess Yining must know that she used to be a maidservant in the Marquis’s residence.

As a proud daughter of heaven, perhaps she didn’t want to associate with her.

Fortunately, Yu Wan had no need to fawn over the Princess, so she focused on her meal, only exchanging a few polite words with Ye Mo Huan when he addressed her as "Sister-in-law."

After the family banquet, Old Madame Ye and the Old Marquis took their leave, allowing the four young people to chat.

Sitting in the Flower Hall had been rather stifling, so Zhao Xuanyou led the group out of the hall, around the corridor and stone path, to the pavilion in the back garden where they took their seats.

Servants quickly presented fruit and wine, then silently withdrew.

Drinking under the moonlight had a unique charm.

Ye Mo Huan, of course, knew that the Princess’s silence today had been somewhat rude. Now that the elders were gone, he got straight to the point: "Yao Yao hasn’t been feeling well lately. Yining has been worried sick. Today she’s a little better, but at the Princess’s residence, she’s been throwing tantrums every day."

chapters.title: The Sorrow of Losing a Child
chapters.content:
Princess Yinning and Ye Moqian’s daughter was named Yao Ying, with the pet name Yao Yao.

Yao Ying was a little younger than her cousin, Zhao Yi Yun. As the Emperor’s only granddaughter, she was greatly favored and had already been granted the title of County Princess at a young age.

When the topic turned to their precious daughter Yao Yao, Princess Yinning shot Ye Moqian a glare. "Yao Yao usually chattered nonstop like you, but these days she barely says two words. Do you still think she’s fine?"

Her voice carried anger, but also clear worry.

Yu Wan suddenly realized that the dullness in Princess Yinning’s eyes was not coldness, but depression.

Ye Moqian naturally cared for his daughter too, but in his view, Princess Yinning was a little too anxious.

"Yao Yao has indeed been eating less and reacting slowly lately, but the imperial physicians said it’s just the summer heat affecting her appetite."

"All quacks! Quacks! I don’t know what’s going on, but last time I asked to have the imperial physicians examine her, Father Emperor didn’t even approve."

Currently, all the physicians from the Imperial Medical Bureau were confined in the palace, working day and night in shifts to develop an antidote for the Emperor. They had no time even for the concubines in the palace, let alone to leave and treat others.

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan knew the truth but couldn’t reveal it to the couple.

"It’s just too hot in the capital. Yao Yao is too young to bear it. Tomorrow, let’s go to Lichuan to escape the heat. Alright?"

Hearing Ye Moqian’s gentle coaxing, Princess Yinning’s mood slightly settled, but she still scolded him, "And whose fault is it that we haven’t left yet? You keep dragging your feet, saying this and that. Is someone else’s wedding more important than our daughter?"

The reason Ye Moqian hadn’t taken his wife and daughter out of the capital to escape the heat was because of Zhao Xuanyou’s wedding.

Zhao Xuanyou had no brothers and had been away from the capital for a long time, so Ye Moqian naturally had to help him with the preparations.

Princess Yinning spoke so bluntly that Ye Moqian couldn’t help but feel embarrassed.

He had brought Princess Yinning here today, hoping to get better acquainted with Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan, but unexpectedly, the matter of Yao Yao had made things even more awkward.

Zhao Xuanyou, however, remained calm. He slowly said to Ye Moqian, "The physicians at Hui Chun Tang and Bao Ning Tang in the capital are quite good. If you can’t get an imperial physician for now, send someone to invite doctors from these two clinics to examine Yao Yao."

"I also think we can invite doctors from outside, but..."

Princess Yinning only trusted imperial physicians and was unwilling to let outsiders examine her daughter.

Yu Wan softly said, "The imperial physicians are indeed highly skilled, but folk doctors see hundreds of patients a day. They have extensive experience and have seen all kinds of illnesses. If County Princess Yao Yao truly isn’t just suffering from the summer heat, inviting a few more doctors might help identify the problem."

"Alright, tomorrow I’ll send someone to Hui Chun Tang and Bao Ning Tang to invite doctors." Princess Yinning agreed readily this time.

She herself was a precious princess, and it was only after having a daughter that she began learning to care for others.

The doctors at the Princess’s residence said Yao Yao had heatstroke, but Princess Yinning felt it wasn’t that simple.

These past few days, although Yao Yao had been drinking cooling soups and seemed slightly better, Princess Yinning still felt uneasy.

Tonight, Ye Moqian had insisted she come to the Marquis’s residence for a banquet, which she was very reluctant to do.

She didn’t want to leave Yao Yao alone and wanted to stay by her side.

But Ye Moqian had repeatedly explained his friendship with Zhao Xuanyou, and for his sake, she had eventually agreed to come out.

Her silence during the meal wasn’t out of disdain for Yu Wan, but because she was worried about her daughter.

Yu Wan’s words had made sense to Princess Yinning.

Since imperial physicians weren’t available now, perhaps there really were hidden talents among the folk doctors.

Princess Yinning’s mood eased slightly, and she raised the wine cup on the table.

"Marquis, Madam, I toast to you both. May you have a loving marriage and remain united forever."

"Thank you, Princess," Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan also raised their cups and drank.

Ye Moqian smiled and said, "Big brother, sister-in-law, I also toast to you both. May you have a son soon and be blessed with many children."

After this round of toasts, the atmosphere in the pavilion finally became much more harmonious.

Ye Moqian and Princess Yinning shared many amusing stories about raising their daughter, and Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan listened with great interest.

By the time the wine was strong and the excitement had faded, it was already late at night.

The couple saw the Princess and Ye Moqian off at the gate of the Marquis’s residence. As they were about to board the carriage, Princess Yinning invited Yu Wan to visit the Princess’s residence for tea another day.

After the carriage left, Zhao Xuanyou pulled Yu Wan into his arms.

"How about we have a daughter too?"

That would, of course, be wonderful.

But his words stirred up a pang of sadness in Yu Wan’s heart.

She and Zhao Xuanyou had already had a child in their past life.

In this new life, Yu Wan had avenged herself and made up for many regrets from her past life. The only thing she couldn’t make up for was the son she had left behind in her previous life.

After her death, what kind of life had her son lived in the Marquis’s residence?

Bai Yichu had taken him away, so he must have been raised to call another woman his mother.

Zhao Xuanyou had been away from the capital for years, so her son had grown up under the care of such a wicked person.

Would he turn out well?

She didn’t know what kind of life he had lived in her past life.

Child, Mother misses you so much!

If only she could see him again, talk to him, even if it was just one word.

"Wanwan, why are you crying?" Zhao Xuanyou had originally said this to discuss the idea of trying harder to have children, but he hadn’t expected that as soon as he spoke, tears would well up in Yu Wan’s eyes.

He quickly pulled her closer, examining her carefully.

"What’s wrong?"

"Nothing." Yu Wan naturally couldn’t tell him about her past life. She forced a smile and said, "I just suddenly thought of some things and felt a little sentimental."

In the glow of the lanterns along the corridor, Zhao Xuanyou could see that she was truly heartbroken at the moment.

Her gaze was fragmented, as if it could never be mended.

A thought struck him, and he remembered what Ding Wenxi had told him before he proposed.

Yu Wan had taken many contraceptive medicines while she was in the Marquis’s residence. Those medicines were harmful to the body, and perhaps Yu Wan would never be able to have children again.

She must be heartbroken because of this.

Zhao Xuanyou felt a pang of regret.

Even though his mother-in-law had repeatedly reminded him, he had still forgotten and brought up the topic of children with Yu Wan.

"Let’s just let nature take its course. Having children would be great, but even if we don’t, the two of us can still be happy."

Yu Wan didn’t know what he was thinking, but as she listened to him patiently comforting her, she simply nodded and took his arm again, walking together toward the Tangli Courtyard.

After washing up, the two lay down on the bed.

Zhao Xuanyou propped himself up on his elbow and saw that Yu Wan’s eyes were still brimming with tears. He sighed softly.

Let her sleep peacefully tonight.

He intentionally lay down a bit apart from her. Just as he closed his eyes, he felt a soft, fluffy body burrowing toward him.

He pulled her into his arms and rolled over to pin her down.

In the moonlight from outside, he could see that the person beneath him still looked aggrieved and sad.

"Wanwan... tonight I..."

"I am very sad. But when I’m sad, you’re not allowed to leave."

"I won’t leave. I’m right here."

"Not just here. I want you. I want you right now." Yu Wan sniffled, tightly hooking her arms around him and biting his ear as she said, "Don’t stop until I say so."

Only by truly feeling his presence could the buried pain in her heart be shattered piece by piece.

---

chapters.title: Wake Me Up
chapters.content:
The next day was supposed to be the day Yu Wan returned to her family home. While the couple was still having breakfast, a palace messenger arrived to summon Zhao Xuanyou to the palace.

Zhao Xuanyou felt a little helpless but had no choice but to follow the eunuch into the palace immediately.

He had originally planned for the two of them to ride out of the city together and then visit the plum garden, but since Zhao Xuanyou was called away by the Emperor, Yu Wan took Wen Qian with her to stroll through the city, heading toward Wu Garden.

Coincidentally, she encountered Cui Zaiting setting up a street stall to sell calligraphy and paintings again.

This time, Yu Wan didn’t approach him. Instead, she had Wen Qian go over and pick out a few paintings of ladies.

The jewelry and cosmetics shops were still being prepared. The flower-and-bird paintings she had bought before and the lady paintings she bought this time would be perfect for hanging in the shops, adding a touch of elegance.

Not many carriages were parked in front of Wu Garden.

The return gift was something Zhao Xuanyou had prepared long ago: ten bolts of fine silk, ten jin of Wuyi tea, ten lacquered boxes, and ten sachets, symbolizing perfection in every aspect.

When Chen Da Niu saw that Yu Wan had brought such valuable return gifts, he felt too embarrassed to accept them as her family. He firmly declined.

Yu Wan said that if he didn’t accept, it would mean he didn’t consider her as family.

After much persuasion, Chen Da Niu finally accepted the gifts, and together with Xiu Fang, they started preparing lunch.

Both of them were good cooks. Although the dishes were simple, they were very delicious.

Taking this opportunity, Yu Wan told them about the shop that Lady Dowager Ye had given her.

Manager Song had arranged for people to clean and tidy it up over the past two days. Once everything was ready, he would send someone to Wu Garden to inform them.

Xiu Fang hadn’t been idle either. She had hired two women in the capital who knew how to make rouge and had started producing it.

She didn’t know how to sell jewelry, but after selling flowers and herbs with Chen Da Niu for a while, she had become familiar with several major cosmetics shops in the capital.

She had already figured out how to decorate the shop, how many people to hire, what kind of jars to use for packaging, and how much to sell each box of rouge for.

Seeing how capable Xiu Fang was, Yu Wan let her take charge and only gave some instructions about the jewelry shop.

Xiu Fang knew that Yu Wan, as the Marchioness, didn’t have time to busy herself with the shop every day, so she took note of everything and said she would ask for advice if she had any questions.

Yu Wan spent most of the day at Wu Garden. She and Xiu Fang got along very well, and it was almost dark by the time she boarded the carriage to return to the Marquis’s residence.

She had thought Zhao Xuanyou would have returned home by now, but the Tangli Courtyard was still unlit.

Yu Wan changed her clothes and went to Leshou Hall to serve Lady Dowager Ye her calming tea.

Lady Dowager Ye hadn’t been very supportive of this marriage at first.

Zhao Xuanyou had been slow to marry and have children, and the old Marquis had allowed him his freedom. Now that he was finally getting married, what could Lady Dowager Ye say?

Yu Wan had been a maid in the residence before, so Lady Dowager Ye naturally had complicated feelings about her.

But in the three days since Yu Wan had entered the family, she had handled social interactions with relatives gracefully and had dealt with the servants appropriately. Everyone in the Marquis’s residence had nothing but praise for her.

The initial concerns about Yu Wan not being up to the task gradually faded, and the old lady treated her with increasing kindness.

"Did you go see the shop I mentioned today? Is it suitable?"

"Not yet." Yu Wan smiled softly. "Manager Song told me about the condition of the shop. The previous tenant had moved out, and he was having people clean it up. Just from his description, I know that the shop, whether in terms of location or layout, is one of the best in the capital. It would be suitable for any business."

Yu Wan’s sweet words made Lady Dowager Ye quite pleased.

Her maternal family, the Anning Marquis’s residence, had also been prosperous for a hundred years, and as the legitimate daughter of the family, she had married into the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence as the lady of the house. One could say her life had been smooth and successful.

The shop she had given to Yu Wan was part of her dowry. As Yu Wan had said, the shop was in a prime location with constant foot traffic, making it suitable for any business.

"If you like it, that’s good. I still have a few other shops in the capital. If you don’t like that one after seeing it, you can go look at the others."

Yu Wan chatted with Lady Dowager Ye for a while. When it was getting late, she returned to the Tangli Courtyard.

Zhao Xuanyou still hadn’t returned.

After washing up, Yu Wan instructed Autumn Moon that when Zhao Xuanyou returned late at night, she should remind him to wake her up before he left in the morning.

After a long day out, Yu Wan was exhausted and fell asleep soon after lying down.

The next time she regained consciousness, she felt someone pinching her nose.

She frowned and hummed a couple of times, then opened her sleepy eyes to see Zhao Xuanyou, fully dressed, sitting by the bed.

Seeing how difficult it was for her to open her eyes, Zhao Xuanyou let go of her nose.

"Did you just get back?" Yu Wan mumbled.

"I have to leave." Zhao Xuanyou leaned down and held her in his arms. "Can’t you sleep a little longer? Why do you have to make me wake you up?"

Yu Wan blinked hard a few times, feeling her mind clear a little. She hugged his face and kissed him.

"We just got married. If we can’t even exchange a few words a day, what’s the point? Besides, I can go back to sleep after you leave."

In the past, when she was about to leave the capital, Zhao Xuanyou had just been promoted to the commander of the Brocade Guard. He had been so busy that he was out from dawn till dusk, coming home late at night and leaving before sunrise. Even living under the same roof, they rarely saw each other.

Yu Wan didn’t want to live like that again.

Zhao Xuanyou hummed in agreement, then lowered his head to hold her and kissed her for a moment. Only when Yuan Qing urged him from outside did he reluctantly let her go.

"You don’t need to get up early to go to Leshou Hall. Have lunch with Grandmother later."

"I know." Yu Wan was a bit more awake now. Seeing that he was about to leave, she couldn’t help but ask, "Have you found any leads?"

"We’re investigating the people who entered and left the palace a few days before His Majesty was poisoned. There are quite a few of them, so it will take time to sort through."

The Emperor’s poisoning might not have happened on the day the imperial physicians discovered it. It could have been three or four days earlier. This meant the number of suspicious individuals increased significantly.

"I thought of something else today. Since it’s confirmed that the Empress and the Crown Prince are behind the poisoning, the person who administered the poison must also have close ties to them. We can start by investigating these people."

Zhao Xuanyou saw that her eyes were still blurred, yet she was giving him sensible advice. The corners of his lips twitched, and he kissed her again.

By the time he stood up, Yu Wan’s cheeks were already flushed from his kisses, as if she had applied rouge.

"I’m going to call Wen Qian. You go back to sleep."

Zhao Xuanyou hardened his heart and, after saying these words, left with the help of his cane.

He also remembered the previous matter of bringing Wen Qian into the palace.

Yu Wan smiled faintly. She wanted to go back to sleep, but the drowsiness had mostly faded.

She tossed and turned in bed, thinking about many things, and only fell asleep again after daybreak.

For several days in a row, Zhao Xuanyou left early and returned late, and Yu Wan insisted that he wake her up before leaving to say a few words.

When he wasn’t home, Yu Wan wasn’t idle either.

As the lady of the Marquis’s residence, she had to take over all the properties and affairs of the residence. She needed to inventory the storerooms and account books and get to know the managers of each section.

Most of the servants who stayed to work in the Marquis’s residence were born into servitude. Since Manager Song had already given them a thorough talking-to, no one dared to cause trouble in front of Yu Wan.

After three busy days, Yu Wan received an invitation from the Princess’s residence.

chapters.title: Approaching the Truth
chapters.content:
Holding the invitation card, Yu Wan was somewhat surprised.

When Princess Yining had come to the Marquis's residence for a banquet the other day, it was only out of consideration for Ye Mo Huan’s face. Moreover, since she knew Yu Wan’s background, it was already decent of her to maintain appearances. The casual remark about inviting Yu Wan to the Princess’s residence for tea before leaving was likely just a polite gesture, and Yu Wan hadn’t expected her to actually follow through.

Yet, the invitation had truly been delivered.

Yu Wan had Spring Xing put away the account books spread out on the desk, then called Autumn Yue and Pan Xia to help her dress and style her hair.

After she was ready, she had Yuan Qing prepare a carriage to take her to the Princess’s residence.

After Yuan Qing had entered the palace with Wen Ji to assist Zhao Xuanyou in investigating the case, Zhao Xuanyou had instructed Yuan Qing to stay by Yu Wan’s side to ensure her safety.

Yuan Qing was skilled in martial arts, and with four or five guards from the Marquis’s residence, it was more than enough for traveling within the capital.

The carriage didn’t take long to reach the Princess’s residence.

After presenting the invitation, the gatekeeper immediately sent someone inside to announce her arrival.

Given Yu Wan’s status as the Marchioness of Jingyuan, the gatekeeper didn’t make her wait outside. Instead, she was invited inside and seated in a small side hall to drink tea while waiting.

Before long, a maid approached and said that the Princess was currently at the pond in the back garden, fishing with the young county princess, and invited Yu Wan to join them.

Yu Wan followed the maid all the way to the back garden of the Princess’s residence.

The Emperor had only two princesses under his care: Princess Yian and Princess Yining. In the past, Princess Yian had been more favored, but after both princesses married, Princess Yian’s restless behavior, keeping male favorites and hosting elegant gatherings, gradually lost the Emperor’s favor. In contrast, Princess Yining, who lived a stable life, gained the upper hand.

The Princess’s residence was built in a magnificent and luxurious style, with red-lacquered pillars and green beams, appearing splendid and dazzling.

After passing through the front courtyard, they arrived at the pond in the back garden. Here, the rocky landscape and lush trees presented a different kind of scenery.

Princess Yining had found a shady spot by the pond. At the moment, she was holding a fishing rod, trying to catch fish while saying to the little girl beside her, “Yao Yao, look, there’s a fish coming. Yao Yao, at least look! You used to love watching fish so much.”

At this moment, her voice was extremely gentle, completely different from her usual proud and aloof demeanor in front of others.

However, the little girl beside her just sat there blankly, showing no reaction to her mother’s words.

“Princess, the Marchioness of Jingyuan has arrived,” the maid announced respectfully.

“Oh.” Princess Yining turned her head to glance at Yu Wan, then forced a smile. “Please, have a seat. Serve the Marchioness some tea.”

The maid brought over a chair for Yu Wan and soon served tea and fruit.

Yu Wan knew that Princess Yining only had eyes for her daughter and didn’t mind the Princess’s coldness. She simply sat quietly to the side, sipping her tea.

After a long while, Princess Yining still hadn’t caught any fish. She finally scattered a handful of fish food into the water, and soon many fish swam over.

The eunuch beside her quickly scooped one up with a net and placed it in a basin.

“Yao Yao, look at this beautiful carp.”

The little county princess turned her head slightly to look at the carp in the basin but still didn’t speak.

Princess Yining’s face showed a hint of disappointment she couldn’t conceal.

After coaxing her for so long, she was indeed exhausted. She threw the fishing rod aside and sat down next to Yu Wan.

The servants around them were well-trained and immediately stepped forward to wipe her hands and face.

After Princess Yining had finished her tea, Yu Wan asked at the right moment, “The other day, the Princess mentioned going to the imperial medical hall in the capital to invite a physician to see the county princess. What did the physician say? Or is the county princess still suffering from heatstroke?”

“We haven’t had the chance to see one yet. It was too hot in the capital a few days ago, so we took Yao Yao to the villa outside the city to stay for a few days.”

Ye Mo Huan had always said that Princess Yining was too anxious and confused, insisting it was just heatstroke when it might not be.

She had also forced herself to believe that her child was simply suffering from heatstroke, so she took her to the countryside to escape the heat.

But when they reached the cool mountain villa, Yao Yao’s condition hadn’t improved at all, in fact, she had become even quieter.

“I see that the county princess doesn’t like to talk much.”

“Yes, she’s just like her father, once she starts talking, she can’t stop. But as you saw earlier, I teased her for half a day, and she didn’t say a single word.” At this, Princess Yining suddenly wiped away tears. “Honestly, in the past, even if I had a slight headache or fever, I could have the imperial physicians attend to me. Now that Yao Yao is so ill, I can’t even get one imperial physician to come.”

Yu Wan hadn’t expected Princess Yining to suddenly start crying and didn’t know what to say for a moment.

In Princess Yining’s mind, Yao Yao was precious as gold, and no ordinary physician was worthy of treating her. She had always wanted an imperial physician to examine her.

Unfortunately, with the current situation in the palace, even the imperial physicians were under suspicion by the Brocade Guards and couldn’t be allowed out of the palace.

“Never mind, tomorrow I’ll take Yao Yao into the palace to pay respects to Father Emperor. I’ll make sure he has an imperial physician examine her.”

“I’ve heard that His Majesty dotes on the county princess very much,” Yu Wan could only vaguely agree. “If His Majesty knows that the county princess is unwell, he will certainly have the best imperial physicians from the Imperial Physician’s Office treat her.”

Princess Yining felt slightly comforted by Yu Wan’s words, but then she frowned again.

“Father Emperor used to dote on Yao Yao very much. Every few days, he would summon us to the palace to talk. But recently, he only wants Zhao Yi Yun by his side, showering all his favor on his grandson and forgetting about his granddaughter. But the two times Yao Yao entered the palace, Father Emperor seemed happy to see her.”

For some reason, Yu Wan’s heart stirred slightly when she heard Princess Yining’s words.

Entered the palace twice?

“When was the last time the county princess entered the palace?”

Princess Yining found Yu Wan’s question sudden and out of the blue, but since it wasn’t a matter of great importance, she casually replied, “The last time was about twenty days ago.”

Twenty days ago. That was exactly the second time the Emperor had been poisoned!

Yu Wan’s heart raced. She couldn’t help but ask, “Last time when she entered the palace, was His Majesty cold to the county princess?”

“How could that be? Father Emperor adores Yao Yao. Of course, not as much as Zhao Yi Yun, but every time Yao Yao enters the palace, Father Emperor says she looks just like me when I was little. He holds her in his arms and kisses her repeatedly.”

Kisses her repeatedly...

Yu Wan’s heart pounded wildly. Could it be like this?

But maybe not. Zhao Xuanyou had said that many people’s schedules overlapped with those two dates, and it wasn’t strange that Princess Yining and her daughter were among them.

Moreover, judging by Princess Yining’s attitude, how could she possibly use her beloved daughter to poison her own father?

The Emperor’s death would bring her no benefit.

But...

On the other hand, the Empress was Princess Yining’s birth mother. This also fit Yu Wan’s speculation.

The poisoner must be someone closely connected to the Empress and the Crown Prince.

After thinking for a moment, Yu Wan asked again, “Since His Majesty dotes on the county princess so much, I suppose Her Majesty the Empress does as well?”

“She treats her even better than she treated me.” Mentioning the Empress, Princess Yining started chattering again. “When Yao Yao was born, Mother gave her many rewards, all following the same standards as Yi Yun’s. Yi Yun had two wet nurses, so Yao Yao had two as well.”

Mentioning this, Princess Yining was quite proud. When she was a child, she had only had one wet nurse.

Yu Wan’s heart jolted, and she blurted out, “Are the county princess’s wet nurses assigned by the palace?”

---

chapters.title: Cannot Tip Off the Enemy
chapters.content:
“Yes,” seeing Yu Wan’s surprised expression, Princess Yining glanced at her, feeling that she was making a fuss over nothing. “Yao Yao is His Majesty’s first granddaughter. After her birth, His Majesty was overjoyed, so Mother specially arranged for palace wet nurses to take care of her.”

By rights, after Princess Yining moved out of the imperial palace to live independently in the Princess’s residence, apart from the attendants and guards she brought from the palace, any additional staff in the Princess’s residence had nothing to do with the imperial palace.

After Yao Yao was born, not only were the rewards from the palace generous, but the Empress also additionally assigned two wet nurses from the Shanggong Bureau to take care of Yao Yao.

This was, of course, a great honor for Yao Yao.

Princess Yining always spoke of this with pride.

Yu Wan’s gaze flickered slightly as she looked at the servants standing around. She quickly noticed two elegantly dressed and poised matrons.

“Are those two the wet nurses sent by the palace?” Yu Wan asked casually.

“Yes, ever since Yao Yao was born, Aunt Jing Xian and Aunt Qiao Hui have been taking care of her personally. Yao Yao is very attached to them.”

Yu Wan praised, “People from the palace are indeed unmatched elsewhere. No wonder the little county princess is raised to be so fair and lovely.”

Hearing Yu Wan’s praise, Jing Xian and Qiao Hui both bowed to her.

Yu Wan maintained her smile, but her heart grew increasingly anxious.

Ye Mo Huan and Princess Yining cherished Yao Yao more than their own lives. It was unlikely they would sacrifice their daughter to poison the Emperor.

But what if the Empress had deceived the couple and secretly used Yao Yao to poison the Emperor?

The two wet nurses looked to be in their early thirties and had served in the palace for many years. It was very possible they were people promoted by the Empress herself.

What should she do?

Yu Wan was both worried about her bold conjecture and concerned for Princess Yining’s family.

If her conjecture was true, could they bear to face the truth?

She forced down the thoughts in her mind and looked at little Yao Yao in the distance, feigning casualness as she asked, “How long has the county princess been like this, not liking to talk?”

“It’s been over a month. At first, she just didn’t like to talk, but in the past ten days or so...” Here, Princess Yining wiped her tears again. “Not only does she not talk, but she doesn’t react at all when I speak to her.”

A few days ago, they had gone out of the city hoping that avoiding the heat would help, but Yao Yao’s condition only worsened, so they returned to the capital in a hurry.

This morning, Princess Yining had sent someone to the palace to request an imperial physician but was refused again. Feeling distressed, and with Ye Mo Huan having returned to the Anning Marquis’s residence to visit his grandmother, she had no close friends in the capital, so she thought of Yu Wan and sent an invitation to the Jingyuan Marquis’s residence.

Seeing that Princess Yining had started crying, Aunt Jing Xian handed her a handkerchief and consoled, “Your Highness need not worry. Since the residence’s physicians have examined her, there must not be any serious problem.”

Yu Wan only pressed her lips together and said nothing.

Earlier, Zhao Xuanyou had mentioned that the poison the Emperor had ingested was strange. The imperial physicians could detect that it was poison, but they didn’t know what kind, so they could only try different antidotes slowly.

It wouldn’t be strange for these two wet nurses to lie through their teeth. Could it be that even the physicians in the Princess’s residence couldn’t detect it?

How many chess pieces had the Empress planted around Princess Yining?

“How can there be no problem? When I talk to her, she doesn’t even move her eyes.”

Yu Wan was alarmed. She stood up and walked over to the little county princess, taking her small hand. Yao Yao only slightly moved her eyelids and didn’t look at Yu Wan at all.

This was indeed not a normal reaction.

“If the Princess is so worried, why not take the county princess into the palace today?”

As Yu Wan said this, her peripheral vision kept glancing at Jing Xian and Qiao Hui. Sure enough, as soon as she finished speaking, the expressions of the two wet nurses subtly changed.

Princess Yining, hearing this, said in frustration, “It’s useless. I’ve sent people to request imperial physicians many times, but none have come.”

“Not to request imperial physicians, but to go directly into the palace.”

This was a serious matter, and Yu Wan didn’t dare to rashly voice her suspicions.

First, take the county princess into the palace. If Yu Wan’s guess was correct, the antidote prepared by the Imperial Physician’s Office for the Emperor could be given to the county princess immediately.

If her guess was wrong, it would be a false alarm, but at least Princess Yining wouldn’t have to worry about her daughter anymore.

“Into the palace? Didn’t you hear what I said?”

Of course, Princess Yining wanted to take Yao Yao into the palace so that an imperial physician could examine her as soon as possible.

But she had personally gone to the imperial palace and hadn’t been able to see the Emperor or request an imperial physician.

Yu Wan maintained her calm expression and softly said, “I know that the Princess has sent people into the palace several times without success. However, these past two days, my husband has been on duty in the palace. The county princess’s condition is so serious that when we arrive at the palace gates, I can first call my husband out and tell him about the county princess’s condition. Maybe he can find a way to request an imperial physician to come and see her.”

Princess Yining’s eyes darkened as she listened to Yu Wan’s words.

“You also think Yao Yao’s condition is very bad, don’t you?”

Yu Wan didn’t know how to respond.

The little county princess actually looked normal, just not speaking or moving much. It was no wonder the physicians in the Princess’s residence and Ye Mo Huan thought it was just heatstroke.

But Yu Wan knew the inside story of the Emperor’s poisoning. The timing of the little county princess’s palace visits overlapped with the Emperor’s poisoning, and there were also the Empress’s assigned wet nurses attending to her closely. It was impossible not to suspect.

Yu Wan had to stabilize Princess Yining’s emotions while also avoiding tipping off the enemy. She could only persuade, “I don’t understand medicine, so I can’t say whether it’s serious or not. The residence’s physicians and the wet nurses are all experienced, and if they say it’s nothing, then it’s probably fine. However, a mother is always more concerned about her own daughter than anyone else. Since the county princess is unwell, it’s better to have an imperial physician examine her to be at ease.”

Those two wet nurses, having received orders from the Empress to poison the Emperor, must be cunning and bold, perhaps even trained like assassins. They might even have hidden martial arts skills.

Yu Wan had to be careful with her words to avoid alerting them.

Hearing Yu Wan’s words, Princess Yining felt even more distressed and muttered, “Yao Yao really isn’t right.”

“Mm, don’t worry, Princess. Let’s go to the palace right now. Maybe we’ll be able to see an imperial physician soon.”

Princess Yining also knew that the Emperor favored Zhao Xuanyou greatly.

Since Zhao Xuanyou was in the palace investigating the case, he must be able to see the Emperor. As long as they told the Emperor about Yao Yao’s illness, and since the Emperor doted on Yao Yao so much, he would definitely send an imperial physician to examine her immediately.

Princess Yining wiped her tears and quickly stepped forward to pick up Yao Yao.

Yu Wan followed behind the mother and daughter as they walked toward the residence’s gate. She saw that Jing Xian and Qiao Hui were following them to the gate.

“Your Highness, let this slave take the county princess in the carriage at the back.”

Seeing Jing Xian reaching out to take Yao Yao, Yu Wan quickly smiled and took Yao Yao into her own arms.

“Since I came to visit today, I haven’t even held the little county princess yet. How about letting me hold her for a while?”

At this moment, letting them hold the child would be like delivering a lamb into the tiger’s mouth, handing them a hostage.

chapters.title: The Truth Comes to Light
chapters.content:
Princess Yining was in a foul mood and didn’t think much of Yu Wan’s request, merely nodding in agreement.

Yu Wan secretly let out a sigh of relief and carried the young county princess to share the carriage with the princess.

As she boarded the carriage, Yu Wan glanced at Jing Xian and Qiao Hui, who were heading to the second carriage. Seeing their tense expressions, she grew increasingly uneasy.

But since she hadn’t seen Zhao Xuanyou yet, she could only endure in silence.

"Yao Yao, would you like some pastries?"

Princess Yining opened the food box, took out a delicate osmanthus cake, and offered it to the young county princess. The child neither ate nor spoke, her eyes unmoving, as if she couldn’t hear or see anything.

"This is your favorite pastry. Try some?"

Before Yu Wan could speak, she saw Princess Yining’s eyes quickly redden.

"It’s so hot now, the young county princess probably doesn’t want pastries."

Princess Yining sighed. "Do you think she’s really alright like this?"

Of course she wasn’t alright.

Not only was she indifferent to her favorite pastries, but children her age were usually shy around strangers. Yet, the young county princess didn’t make a sound even as Yu Wan, a stranger, carried her the whole way.

At this moment, only Yu Wan and Princess Yining were in the carriage. After some thought, Yu Wan decided to reveal a little information.

"Recently, someone in the palace was poisoned with an unknown toxin. My husband, the Marquis, was ordered to investigate this case in the palace. Looking at the young county princess..."

"Do you think Yao Yao has been poisoned?"

"I’m not a doctor, and I don’t understand medicine. But once the imperial physicians examine the young county princess in the palace, we’ll know for sure."

Princess Yining found Yu Wan’s words abrupt but oddly convincing.

Although she lived in the princess’s residence, she entered the palace every ten days or so to pay respects to the emperor and empress.

Recently, the empress was said to be ill and had been resting behind closed doors for over a month.

More than twenty days ago, she had seen the emperor, who didn’t seem in good spirits either. He had only held Yao Yao, kissed her, exchanged a few words, and then sent them out of the palace.

The strangest thing was that in the past, if she had a slight headache or fever, it was easy to call an imperial physician. But this time, when Yao Yao was ill, not a single imperial physician could be summoned.

"Has the empress been poisoned?"

Of course not. She was the mastermind behind it all.

Yu Wan gave a bitter smile. "I’m not very clear on the details of the case."

"You’re not clear, yet you want me to bring Yao Yao into the palace?"

"I saw that you were worried about the young county princess’s health. Since my husband is currently on duty in the palace, I thought that with his help, we might be able to call an imperial physician from the Imperial Hospital to examine the young county princess."

Her words were reasonable, and Princess Yining didn’t argue further.

Soon, the carriage stopped outside the palace gates. Princess Yining stepped forward, and the guard respectfully said, "The emperor has not summoned the princess today. I’m afraid I cannot allow you to pass."

This was similar to the previous times Princess Yining had come. She frowned, clearly about to lose her temper.

Yu Wan, seeing this, politely addressed the guard, "I am the Marchioness of Jingyuan. Today, the Marquis of Jingyuan is on duty in the palace. Could you please pass a message for me? Say that there’s an urgent matter at home, and I request the Marquis of Jingyuan to come out and meet me."

The guard, of course, knew about the recent incidents in the palace and that the Marquis of Jingyuan was leading the Brocade Guards in the investigation.

He didn’t dare to disturb the emperor in the Hall of Imperial Purity, but passing a message to the Marquis of Jingyuan wasn’t much trouble.

After all, the Marquis of Jingyuan was a favorite of the emperor, and it wouldn’t hurt to do him a small favor.

"Madam, please wait a moment. I’ll inform my comrades inside, but I can’t say when the Marquis of Jingyuan will come out."

"That’s only natural."

Yuan Qing, having been trained by Yuan Yi, quickly handed over a red envelope after Yu Wan finished speaking. "Brothers, it’s hard work guarding the gates. A little for your trouble."

The guard smiled and accepted it, then sent someone into the palace to find Zhao Xuanyou.

The bright sun beat down on them, and the thick bricks at the palace gates radiated heat, making it feel as if they were being roasted.

Yu Wan’s forehead beaded with sweat, and she crouched down to wipe the young county princess’s forehead with a handkerchief.

After waiting about the time it takes for a stick of incense to burn, Yu Wan finally saw the tall figure enter her line of sight.

Zhao Xuanyou, though using a cane, walked swiftly.

He had also seen Yu Wan, his gaze fixed steadily on her.

Yu Wan picked up the young county princess and quickly walked toward Zhao Xuanyou.

Zhao Xuanyou saw her holding a child and frowned. "Wanwan, what’s happened?"

"It’s the young county princess," Yu Wan said in a low voice. "I suspect she’s been poisoned like the emperor. She entered the palace..."

Before Yu Wan could finish, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression had already changed.

Over the past few days, he had been investigating the people who had entered the palace when the emperor was poisoned twice. Leaf Mo and Princess Yining were on that list.

However, he knew Leaf Mo’s character well and was aware that Princess Yining and Leaf Mo were currently a loving couple with a smooth life, with no motive to poison the emperor. Therefore, he had placed them at the end of the list for investigation, prioritizing those closely connected to the Eastern Palace.

"The young county princess’s wet nurses were sent from the palace. I suspect they tampered with her."

"Where are they?"

Yu Wan didn’t turn around, only softly said to Zhao Xuanyou, "Right behind the princess."

She was worried the two might harm the young county princess, so she had deliberately carried the child some distance away.

Zhao Xuanyou’s eyes darkened, and he glanced at Jing Xian and Qiao Hui. Coldly, he said, "Arrest them." The Brocade Guards behind him lunged forward and seized the two women.

"Be careful they don’t kill themselves. Knock them out first!"

Wen Guo, having been a secret guard, naturally understood the methods suicide operatives would use to protect their master’s secrets.

At his reminder, the Brocade Guards quickly knocked the two wet nurses unconscious.

When they pried open their mouths, they indeed found hidden deadly poison inside.

If not for Wen Guo’s timely warning, they might have already died from the poison.

Princess Yining still didn’t know what was happening. Seeing the Brocade Guards arrest Yao Yao’s wet nurses, she shouted angrily, "How dare you! What are you two up to?!"

"Princess, please remain calm." Zhao Xuanyou understood that Yu Wan must have tricked Princess Yining, her daughter, and the two wet nurses into coming to the palace. Seeing the princess glaring at Yu Wan, he immediately shielded Yu Wan behind him and said in a deep voice, "A major incident has occurred in the palace, involving the wet nurses from the princess’s residence. It also involves the princess and the young county princess."

Looking at Zhao Xuanyou’s solemn expression, Princess Yining’s heart sank.

She recalled what Yu Wan had said in the carriage and asked incredulously, "What exactly happened? Could Yao Yao really have been poisoned? She and I eat and live together. I’m fine, so how could she be poisoned?"

"Please, Princess, come into the palace with me immediately. After the imperial physicians have examined her, everything will be clear."

Yu Wan still held the young county princess and followed Zhao Xuanyou a few steps before adding, "The physicians in the princess’s residence are also suspicious."

Zhao Xuanyou pondered briefly and realized the issue.

Ordinary people might confuse poisoning with heatstroke, but how could the physicians of a princess’s residence fail to notice?

"Arrest them at once."

"Yes!"

At Zhao Xuanyou’s command, the Brocade Guards immediately set out to arrest the physicians in the princess’s residence.

---

chapters.title: Poisoned
chapters.content:
Seeing that it was Zhao Xuanyou, the eunuch hurried into the Hall of Imperial Purity. A moment later, he led everyone inside.

"Father Emperor," as soon as she saw the emperor on the dragon throne, Princess Yining rushed to him, knelt down, and tearfully pleaded, "They say Yao Yao has been poisoned. I don’t believe she could be poisoned. Please, have the imperial physicians examine Yao Yao quickly."

The emperor’s expression changed abruptly as he looked at his granddaughter in Yu Wan’s arms.

Unlike Zhao Yi Yun, who was quiet and gentle, Yao Yao was naturally talkative and cheerful. Whenever she was in the emperor’s presence, the hall would be filled with her laughter.

Now, such a clever and lively child was held limply in Yu Wan’s arms, her face blank, her eyes not moving at all.

The emperor’s heart sank, and he forced himself to endure the pain as he helped Princess Yining to her feet.

"There’s no need to panic. I will summon the imperial physicians at once."

"Yes." The eunuch responded and left.

With the emperor’s assurance, Princess Yining felt slightly at ease. "Thank you, Father Emperor."

Yu Wan saw the emperor continuously looking at the young county princess and carried the child forward.

"Yao Yao?" The emperor called out, but the young county princess only tilted her head slightly without responding.

The emperor took a deep breath and looked up at Zhao Xuanyou. "What’s going on? Why was Yao Yao poisoned?"

On the way from the palace gates to the Hall of Imperial Purity, Yu Wan had already told Zhao Xuanyou everything she knew.

Zhao Xuanyou responded in a deep voice, "The two wet nurses by the young county princess’s side were sent from the palace. They used the young county princess to poison Your Majesty. Although we haven’t interrogated them yet, when the Brocade Guards arrested them just now, they found deadly poison hidden in their mouths for suicide. These two must be up to no good."

The emperor was slightly taken aback, recalling some past events.

After Princess Yining had safely given birth to Yao Yao, the emperor had been overjoyed and bestowed many gifts upon Yao Yao. The empress then suggested that, since she was the first granddaughter, they should follow the precedent set for Yi Yun and assign palace wet nurses to raise and educate her, to demonstrate the affection of her grandfather and grandmother.

The emperor had no reason to refuse and allowed the empress to make the arrangements.

He never expected that the empress had already planted her people around Yining and Yao Yao at that time.

Hearing this, Princess Yining’s legs gave out, and she collapsed to the ground, murmuring, "Father Emperor, I truly don’t understand. Who would want to harm Yao Yao? She’s so young and doesn’t understand anything."

"They weren’t trying to harm Yao Yao. They were trying to harm me."

Princess Yining’s body trembled in shock as she looked at the emperor. "Father Emperor, you were poisoned?"

At this point, the emperor saw no need to continue hiding the truth from her.

"I have been poisoned for over a month, but for now, my life is not in immediate danger."

"But, but what does this have to do with Yao Yao?"

The emperor glanced at Princess Yining, who was crying bitterly, and ordered the eunuchs to help her up and sit to the side to rest.

As they spoke, the eunuch brought three imperial physicians hurrying into the Hall of Imperial Purity.

At this moment, Princess Yining, having learned that her daughter was poisoned, was on the verge of collapse. Yu Wan alone carried Yao Yao to follow the imperial physicians to a side hall for diagnosis.

In the main hall, Zhao Xuanyou continued his report: "As far as I know, every time the county princess entered the palace, Your Majesty would hold her and play with her. The true culprit behind this must have known of Your Majesty’s affection for the county princess and thus devised such a poisonous plot."

"Hmph," the emperor gave a cold laugh, his eyes dark with fury.

"I have already sent people to the princess’s residence to arrest the physicians there. Pan Xun is currently interrogating the two wet nurses intensively. I believe we will know the details soon."

"What’s wrong with the physicians?"

"The princess and the prince consort had already noticed the young county princess’s discomfort, but the physicians insisted she was merely suffering from heatstroke."

The emperor lowered his gaze and remained silent for a long time.

"Royal Grandfather." A crisp child’s voice broke the heavy silence in the Hall of Imperial Purity.

Zhao Xuanyou turned his head and saw the youthful Zhao Yi Yun running into the hall. Following him were Sun Nianran and a wet nurse, who were stopped by the eunuchs at the entrance.

Zhao Yi Yun looked around the hall in confusion, walked up to the emperor, and tugged at his robe.

"Royal Grandfather, what’s happened? Why is Aunt Yining crying?"

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Zhao Yi Yun and couldn’t help but feel a pang of emotion.

The empress was ruthless, and the crown prince was weak and foolish, but this child was both perceptive and gentle.

The emperor looked at Zhao Yi Yun, his emotions also complex.

In his heart, this clever and sensible grandson held great importance. Because of this child, he had even refrained from taking harsh measures against the empress and the crown prince.

Who would have thought that this moment of mercy would lead to such a grave mistake.

"Take Yi Yun to the side hall."

Since the emperor had given the order, Sun Nianran, who had been stopped at the entrance, was finally allowed into the Hall of Imperial Purity. She silently took Zhao Yi Yun to the side hall.

As soon as she entered the hall, Sun Nianran saw Yu Wan holding the young county princess. Seeing the lifeless child, countless thoughts flashed through her mind.

The imperial physicians confirmed that the young county princess had been severely poisoned, and Yu Wan’s expression was also grave.

The young county princess shared no blood with her, and the princess was not close to her.

But seeing the child, dulled by poison, Yu Wan couldn’t help but think of her own child, and she felt a pang of sadness.

"Marchioness." Sun Nianran, holding Zhao Yi Yun’s hand, greeted her coolly.

Zhao Yi Yun also recognized her, but at this moment, he was more concerned about the young county princess in her arms.

"Marchioness, is my sister ill?"

Yes, poisoned by your own grandmother.

Yu Wan sighed inwardly. "In response to Your Highness, the young county princess is indeed unwell. I need to take her to report to His Majesty. Excuse me."

She adjusted her hold on Yao Yao and, along with the imperial physicians, returned to the main hall.

"How is Yao Yao?" Princess Yining saw them return, her eyes sharpening as she regained some strength. She rushed forward, snatched Yao Yao from Yu Wan’s arms, and asked urgently.

The director of the Imperial Hospital looked troubled and turned to the emperor. "The county princess has indeed been poisoned with the same toxin as Your Majesty."

Although there had been earlier suspicions, hearing it confirmed by the imperial physicians was different.

Princess Yining clutched her daughter tightly and asked repeatedly, "The same poison? Then if you’ve cured His Majesty, can’t you cure my Yao Yao too? She should be fine, right?"

"In response to the princess..." the director hesitated.

"Speak quickly." The emperor, also worried about his granddaughter, suddenly slammed his armrest.

The director dared not delay and had to speak the truth. "The young county princess is too young, and the poisoning has been going on for too long. I’m afraid the outlook is grim. Your Majesty, rest assured, we will do our utmost to detoxify the county princess."

"What do you mean by grim?" Princess Yining’s eyes turned red instantly. Holding her child with one hand, she grabbed the director’s collar with the other. "How dare you spout nonsense! Do you believe I won’t have His Majesty behead you?!"

"I wouldn’t dare to spout nonsense. Although the poison isn’t extremely potent, the county princess has been poisoned for over a month. It has already deeply penetrated her organs. We truly cannot guarantee a cure."

Princess Yining wanted to say something more, but suddenly felt dizzy and fainted, still holding her child.

Fortunately, Yu Wan was right beside her and quickly reached out to support both mother and daughter.

"First, take Yining to the side hall to rest. The Imperial Hospital will immediately begin detoxifying Yao Yao."

At this, the eunuchs took Yao Yao from the unconscious Yining’s arms and helped Yining to the side hall.

Seeing his daughter and granddaughter in such a pitiful state, the emperor’s eyes also revealed a hint of dejection.

But as the Son of Heaven, he quickly regained his composure.

"Bring Jiang Shi and Zhao Zhen here."

chapters.title: Interrogation Before the Emperor
chapters.content:
"Yes."

Zhao Xuanyou cupped his fists in response, but his gaze lingered on Yu Wan standing inside the hall.

He had hastily brought Yu Wan into the Qianqing Palace just now. Now that he had to go and arrest someone, he could only leave Yu Wan here.

Meeting his worried gaze, Yu Wan pressed her lips together slightly, signaling him to be at ease.

She had only met the Emperor twice, but she could tell that he was not a foolish ruler. Even in extreme grief and anger, he remained rational.

Staying by the side of such an Emperor was not like accompanying a tiger; there was nothing to fear.

After watching Zhao Xuanyou leave the Qianqing Palace in quick strides, Yu Wan turned to the Emperor on the dragon throne, bowed, and respectfully said, "Your Majesty, the Princess is in deep sorrow now. This concubine wishes to go to the side hall to accompany the Princess."

Her words were flawless; the Emperor would surely consent.

"Are you the wife of Zhao Xuanyou?" the Emperor asked, his gaze falling on Yu Wan.

"This concubine is Ding Wan, wife of the Pacifying Duke."

"Why did he bring you into the palace today?"

Yu Wan quickly explained, "This concubine did not follow the Duke into the palace to interfere with his duties. Today, while this concubine was visiting the Princess's residence, I heard the Princess say that the young county lady was unwell, supposedly from heatstroke, but the Princess seemed very worried."

"Do you also think it doesn't seem like heatstroke?"

"This concubine does not understand medicine, but I heard the Princess say that she had tried several times to invite imperial physicians to diagnose the young county lady but was unable to do so. Thinking that the Duke was handling matters in the palace, perhaps he could help convey the young county lady's condition."

The Emperor's expression darkened slightly. "Do you know what he is handling in the palace?"

"No."

After Yu Wan spoke, she felt a chill creeping up from her feet.

The Emperor's poisoning incident had been kept strictly confidential within the palace, completely hidden from the outside world.

He had entrusted this case to Zhao Xuanyou precisely because of his favor and trust in him.

If the Emperor found out that Zhao Xuanyou had told his pillow partner everything about the palace affairs, he would be furious, and it might even bring disaster to the Pacifying Duke's residence.

"Truly do not know?"

"This concubine would not dare deceive Your Majesty. Ever since the Duke was ordered into the palace to handle matters, he has been leaving early and returning late every day. Not to mention palace cases, this concubine hasn't even had the chance to speak with him properly at home. I beg Your Majesty to see clearly."

Just now, she had been confident she wouldn't make a mistake before the Emperor, but now Yu Wan was so nervous that her palms were sweating.

Listening to her words, the Emperor pondered for a moment and found her explanation reasonable.

Zhao Xuanyou entered the palace before dawn and left after the Zi hour (midnight). Even if he wanted to leak information, he wouldn't have had the opportunity.

"You managed to persuade Princess Yining to bring the child into the palace. That counts as a merit."

"This concubine only saw that the Princess was deeply affectionate towards her child and overly worried, so I took the liberty to advise her to come to the palace and try. I truly do not dare claim any merit."

The Emperor looked at Yu Wan, who was respectfully responding, and stared deeply at her for a moment.

Although rumors outside said that Zhao Xuanyou had married a wife who looked similar to Cui Yichu because of his lingering feelings for her, in the Emperor's view, while Yu Wan's appearance did bear some resemblance to Cui Yichu, her demeanor was entirely different.

Cui Yichu had the typical noble and aloof bearing of a high-born lady from the capital, while Yu Wan was enchantingly beautiful, with bright and lively eyes that held a hint of cunning and wildness.

Feeling the Emperor's scrutiny, Yu Wan grew extremely nervous.

Surely she hadn't misspoken anywhere?

Just as cold sweat was about to break out on her forehead, the Emperor finally spoke: "You may go and keep Princess Yining company."

"This concubine obeys."

Yu Wan, feeling as if she had been granted a great pardon, quickly retreated from the main hall and hurried to the side hall.

At this moment, Princess Yining was lying in a small room in the side hall. She had regained consciousness but looked weak and powerless.

Yu Wan stood at the doorway, took a deep breath, and entered the room only after her heartbeat had calmed somewhat.

She had known Princess Yining for a short time, but in just two meetings, she could see the Princess and the Prince Consort's deep love for their daughter.

Faced with such a blow, Yu Wan couldn't think of any words of comfort.

"Where is Yao Yao?" Princess Yining asked in a trembling voice as soon as she saw Yu Wan enter.

Seeing her in such a state, Yu Wan could only offer empty reassurances: "The imperial physician has already taken the county lady to detoxify. The Imperial Medical Office has ready-made antidotes. Once the county lady takes the medicine, she should improve."

"Didn't you hear? He said Yao Yao's chances are slim."

Yu Wan had indeed heard that.

After a moment of silence, she said, "Perhaps the young county lady's condition is not very good, but the imperial physician is just being cautious. They said they would do their best, and they didn't say it was hopeless. The young county lady must have a chance."

"Really?"

Yu Wan nodded firmly.

She knew that Princess Yining must be in complete disarray at the moment. If she didn't give the Princess some hope, she would surely collapse.

But she could only say so much.

The greater the hope, the greater the disappointment, and it would be even harder to endure in the end.

She silently stayed by Princess Yining's side. Suddenly, a considerable commotion arose from the main hall.

"What happened?" Princess Yining asked nervously. "Is it Yao Yao...?"

The eunuch guarding outside the hall quickly entered: "Princess, rest assured. The county lady is fine in the Imperial Medical Office."

"Then why is His Majesty so furious?"

The eunuch hesitated for a moment before softly saying, "The Pacifying Duke has brought Her Majesty the Empress and His Highness the Crown Prince to the Qianqing Palace. His Majesty is currently interrogating them."

"Interrogating?" Princess Yining was stunned. "What crime have Mother and the Crown Prince committed?"

Ever since she heard that her daughter had been poisoned and was in critical condition, Princess Yining's taut string in her mind had snapped. All she could feel was heartbreak; she had no time to think about anything else.

This was not something the eunuch could explain. He lowered his head and silently retreated.

"Why are you leaving? Finish what you have to say!"

Princess Yining struggled to get up from the couch. Yu Wan quickly said, "The Princess is still weak. Please rest first."

"Why does Father want to question Mother and the Crown Prince?"

Yu Wan remained silent.

Princess Yining was not a fool. At this point, if she calmed down and thought about it, she would realize what crime the Empress and the Crown Prince could have committed.

"They... they are the ones who poisoned her?" Princess Yining's heart pounded wildly. The more she thought about it, the more she realized her guess was correct.

Those two wet nurses were sent from the palace. Apart from the Empress, who else could have such influence?

"It's impossible. I have always been respectful and obedient to Mother and the Crown Prince. I have never offended them. There's no reason for them to harm my Yao Yao. Yao Yao is just His Majesty's granddaughter; she poses no threat to them at all."

The young county lady indeed posed no threat to them.

In their eyes, the young county lady was merely a tool used to poison the Emperor.

"No! I must ask them!"

Princess Yining suddenly sat up from the couch and quickly ran towards the main hall.

However, she did not barge directly into the hall. Instead, she stood by the two layers of bright yellow curtains behind the dragon throne, peering through the gap at the situation inside the hall.

As a child, when she was mischievous, she would hide here to eavesdrop on her father's discussions with court officials.

Yu Wan, who followed closely behind, saw this scene and decided not to persuade her to leave. Instead, she hid there with her.

Meanwhile, Empress Jiang, dressed in a red palace gown with golden embroidery, stood upright in the main hall, her chin slightly raised, her eyes filled with killing intent.

---

chapters.title: Turmoil in the Golden Hall
chapters.content:
Yu Wan had heard many things about the Empress from Zhao Xuanyou.

Although Empress Jiang held the highest position in the harem, she was not content with managing the harem and often extended her influence to the imperial court. She had formed alliances with court officials and secretly forged weapons.

It was only after the Prince of Zhen Guo was severely injured that the Empress seemed to restrain her ambitions. She showed care for the concubines in the harem and concern for the princes and princesses, presenting herself as a model of maternal virtue.

Who would have known that she had long since placed her pieces around Princess Yining, preparing for future use?

No, perhaps she had not only planted people around Princess Yining; the other princes and princesses likely had her people around them as well.

Hadn't someone reported back to the capital when Zhao Qi went to Yuzhou to find her?

Yu Wan looked at Empress Jiang, whose expression was dark and sinister. Even in such a dire situation, she showed no fear. Yu Wan couldn't help but feel a mix of emotions.

Empress Jiang was indeed ambitious, but she also had the means and strategies to back it up.

It was a pity that she could even target a three-year-old child; she was truly cruel.

"To the victor go the spoils. Since the matter has been exposed, there is nothing more for me to say," Empress Jiang said with a smile that was not a smile. "Whether to kill or spare, Your Majesty may do as you please. However, the Emperor has always valued his reputation. Would you really dare to reveal to the world that I tried to poison you?"

She spoke with composure and arrogance, but Crown Prince Zhao Zun beside her looked confused and shocked.

"Mother, what are you talking about? Are all those things Father just said really what you did?"

Empress Jiang looked at Zhao Zun's expression, and her originally haughty gaze dimmed slightly.

If her son had been more capable, would she, as a mother, have had to scheme to such an extent?

"So, you admit it?" the Emperor slowly asked.

"Does it matter whether I admit it or not?" Empress Jiang sneered.

Now that the plot was exposed, the husband and wife had completely torn off their masks and had nothing left to fear.

"When the Crown Prince was established, you were unwilling. It was only because Zhao Zun was the legitimate son and the eldest that you reluctantly agreed to the enthronement at the request of the court ministers. As Zhao Zun grew up, your dissatisfaction with him increased, and you longed to depose him. The only path left for me was this one; I had no choice!"

The people standing in the great hall were the Emperor's wife and eldest son. Even though the Emperor had anticipated this, hearing the Empress's words still filled him with a deep chill.

"Zhao Zun is my son, but you treated him as a tool to maintain the Jiang family's power! If I had not given Zhao Zun the opportunity, I would not have made him the Crown Prince in the first place. It is you! You stubbornly dragged Zhao Zun onto your Jiang family's pirate ship and forced him into this situation."

"Father..." Zhao Zun's lips trembled, but his heart pounded like a drum in his chest.

Mother actually tried to poison Father?

Mother actually dared to do such a thing...

"Hmph," Empress Jiang was unimpressed, her expression cold. "If you truly valued him, how could he not know? Zhao Zun may be indecisive, but he is not a fool. You know what you think in your heart, and so do I, and so does Zhao Zun."

The Emperor gently closed his eyes. When he looked at the Empress again, there was no emotion left in his gaze.

"It's a pity. I still did not die from your poison. Not only will you not get what you want, but you will also lose everything you currently have."

"If I cannot have this world, I do not care about anything else."

In the golden hall, Empress Jiang spoke with resolve.

Zhao Zun glanced at his mother beside him, his gaze fierce in a way he had never seen before.

He certainly wanted the throne, but he did not want to lose everything he had now.

"Father, your son knew nothing about what Mother did. I am a descendant of the Zhao family and have never sided with the Jiang family."

Listening to Zhao Zun's words, Empress Jiang let out a sinister laugh.

"It's useless. He has already given up on you."

The Emperor ignored Empress Jiang, glanced at Zhao Zun, and said slowly, "When selecting the Crown Princess, you knew that I would support you in marrying Cui Yichu. Why did you insist on choosing a Jiang family girl?"

"Your son... your son did not think that much. I just did not want Mother to be unhappy."

"Did not think that much..." The Emperor let out a light laugh.

As the heir apparent, residing in the Eastern Palace, every word and action required deep thought. For something as significant as establishing the Crown Princess, how could he say he did not think that much?

"Father, I have never liked Jiang Ru Shang. I can immediately depose her."

"Five years ago, when we were staying at the Lichuan Summer Palace, why did you suddenly request to go to Heishui County?"

The Emperor's voice was not loud, but as soon as he spoke, Zhao Zun's face changed instantly.

"Zhao Zun, do you also know nothing about this?"

"Your son..."

It was clear that the Empress was ambitious, yet he allowed the maternal relatives to grow powerful.

With such muddled thinking, even if he inherited the throne, he would struggle to hold onto the empire.

"I was wrong! I only wanted to please both Father and Mother. I never had any intention of harming Father. I beg Father to see clearly!"

"So you already knew." Empress Jiang's eyes also showed a hint of surprise. After a moment of contemplation, she let out a soft laugh. "The reason you have been enduring is not because you are soft-hearted, but because you simply couldn't find where those weapons were hidden? It's a pity that even as the son of heaven, you have raised a bunch of incompetent people. This time, my plan was flawless. It was just your good luck that allowed you to detect the poison early. It's truly a pity. Blame heaven for not helping me!"

"Silence!" Seeing Empress Jiang's reckless and arrogant demeanor, the Emperor roared in anger. "Take them away! The Brocade Guards are to immediately arrest everyone in Kunning Palace, the Eastern Palace, and the Prince of Zhen Guo's residence!"

The Crown Prince's eyes suddenly tightened, and he froze on the spot.

The Brocade Guards in the hall quickly stepped forward and took the Empress and her son away.

Empress Jiang, having weathered many storms, had anticipated the consequences of failure ever since she decided to poison the Emperor. Naturally, she showed no fear, only letting out a cold sneer.

"Royal Grandfather, Royal Grandfather."

A childish voice came from behind. Yu Wan turned her head and saw Zhao Yi Yun quickly running over. He rushed past the heavy curtains and ran to the Crown Prince's side.

Seeing his usually dignified and mighty father being taken away by the Brocade Guards, Zhao Yi Yun felt both fear and concern.

Sun Qianran stood not far away, quietly watching the commotion without approaching.

Yu Wan withdrew her gaze and looked back at the scene in the hall.

"Take Yi Yun away." With the Emperor's command, the eunuchs quickly stepped forward to take Zhao Yi Yun.

"Royal Grandfather, please spare my father and grandmother."

Although Zhao Yi Yun was young and did not know what crimes the Empress and the Crown Prince had committed, he knew that his Royal Grandfather had the final say in all matters under heaven. He quickly turned to beg him.

Since the eunuchs knew the Emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun, they did not dare to use force.

Zhao Yi Yun struggled with all his might, breaking free from the eunuch's grasp. He stumbled and ran to the Emperor's side, grabbing the corner of the dragon robe and kneeling down.

"Royal Grandfather, please show mercy and spare my father and grandmother."

The Emperor looked at Zhao Yi Yun with a helpless and bitter smile.

He did not speak but gave the eunuchs a look. The eunuchs immediately stepped forward and used some force to pick up Zhao Yi Yun.

"Royal Grandfather! Royal Grandfather!"

Zhao Yi Yun cried and shouted in the eunuch's arms, but no matter how hard he struggled this time, he could not escape.

Just as the eunuch carrying Zhao Yi Yun passed through the curtains and by Yu Wan's side, Princess Yining, who had been quiet all along, suddenly pulled a gold hairpin from her hair. With lightning speed, she raised the hairpin and fiercely stabbed it towards Zhao Yi Yun!

chapters.title: Not Daring to Claim Credit
chapters.content:
"Ah…"

A child's piercing scream shattered the heavy silence in the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

The eunuch holding Zhao Yi Yun was startled and fell to the ground, causing Zhao Yi Yun to tumble out of his arms as well.

Princess Yining's golden hairpin had struck Zhao Yi Yun's shoulder, but because it hit the shoulder bone, it did not penetrate deeply.

Her eyes were bloodshot as she grabbed Zhao Yi Yun with one hand and raised the hairpin with the other, preparing to strike again. Yu Yuan quickly grabbed her hand, trying to wrest the hairpin away.

"You deserve to die! Let go of me!" Princess Yining roared.

At this moment, she was a mother avenging her daughter, irrational but giving her all.

Even though Yu Yuan was strong, she could only barely hold her own against the princess.

"Your Highness, please calm down. His Majesty will surely punish the culprit severely."

"You don't understand! They killed my Yao Yao. I must kill Zhao Yi Yun to vent my hatred!"

Even if the Emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun the most, even if something happened in the Eastern Palace, he would still protect Zhao Yi Yun.

But only by killing Zhao Yi Yun could Empress Jiang experience the same pain as her.

This was her only chance!

Yu Yuan could understand Princess Yining's hatred, but no matter what, she couldn't stand by and watch a child be killed in front of her.

The Emperor, who was in the main hall, quickly rushed over upon hearing the commotion, followed closely by Zhao Xuanyou.

Seeing Yu Yuan struggling with Princess Yining over the hairpin, Zhao Xuanyou's eyes tightened. Without waiting for the Emperor's command, he swiftly moved forward and firmly gripped Princess Yining's wrist.

"Ah…" Feeling a sharp pain, Princess Yining released the hairpin and collapsed to the side.

Zhao Xuanyou turned back, and Yu Yuan quickly nodded to him, indicating she was fine.

"How is your hand?" Zhao Xuanyou asked in a low voice.

But Zhao Xuanyou didn't believe her. He took her hand and opened it, indeed seeing a red mark on her palm where the hairpin had scraped her.

"It's just a minor injury, not even bleeding," Yu Yuan glanced at him, "How is your leg?"

Just now, Zhao Xuanyou had been afraid that Yu Yuan would be stabbed by the hairpin, so he had thrown aside his crutch and rushed forward. Now, his right leg ached terribly.

But he would never admit it.

"It's fine," Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently.

While the couple checked each other's injuries, Pan Xun picked up Zhao Yi Yun, who had fallen to the ground.

Zhao Yi Yun's shoulder was covered in blood, his small face was pale, and he couldn't even cry. He looked pitiful.

After briefly examining the injury, Pan Xun quickly reported to the Emperor, "The young prince has injured his shoulder. He probably fainted from the pain, but he should be fine."

The Emperor let out a sigh of relief. "Take Yi Yun away and attend to him. Summon the imperial physicians immediately. There must be no further mishaps."

"As you command." Pan Xun accepted the order and immediately carried Zhao Yi Yun out of the Hall of Supreme Harmony.

The Emperor looked at Princess Yining, who was in a daze, his eyes filled with pity.

He crouched down, took Princess Yining's hand, and softly comforted her, "Rest assured, I will save Yao Yao. I won't let anything happen to her."

"Father," Princess Yining's face was covered in tears, "You cannot let Zhao Yi Yun go. He is young now, but when he grows up, who knows if he won't seek revenge for his father."

The Emperor cut her off, "You're exhausted. Return to the Princess's residence first. I will have the imperial physicians do their best to treat Yao Yao."

"Father! I want to stay in the palace with Yao Yao!"

Princess Yining repeatedly begged through tears, but she was still taken out of the Hall of Supreme Harmony by the eunuchs.

The Emperor stood up, took a deep breath, and looked at Yu Yuan.

"Are you injured?"
