Yu Yuan's expression turned serious, and she quickly replied, "In response to Your Majesty, this concubine is unharmed."

"Today's events deserve recognition."

"This concubine does not dare to claim credit."

The Emperor did not say more. He slightly nodded, "Xuanyou, take your wife to the Imperial Physician's Office."

"Thank you for Your Majesty's grace."

After so many events, the Emperor was also deeply affected. He could barely stand and had to be supported by a eunuch back to the dragon throne.

Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Yuan out.

Not far from the Hall of Supreme Harmony, they encountered Prince Ping and two chancellors rushing over.

After the Emperor was poisoned, it had not been announced to the public that he was ill. Every day, these three had been entering the palace to handle state affairs on the Emperor's behalf.

Upon hearing about the incident in the Hall of Supreme Harmony, they immediately dropped their memorials and rushed over from the Wenhua Hall.

"Xuanyou, what happened in the Hall of Supreme Harmony?" Prince Ping asked, "Have you found out who poisoned Father?"

Now that the Empress and the Crown Prince had completely fallen from power, the most likely person to rise to power was Prince Ping.

Zhao Xuanyou understood the current situation and did not hide anything. He truthfully said, "The Empress has already confessed."

"Really her?"

Prince Ping's eyebrows twitched, and his expression became somewhat subtle.

"I never expected Mother to poison Father. Her heart is truly despicable. This matter should have nothing to do with the Crown Prince, right?"

"The Crown Prince said he was not aware."

"Does Father believe the Crown Prince?"

Zhao Xuanyou understood his concern and explained how the Empress had used Princess Yining's daughter to poison the Emperor. He then added, "His Majesty has already ordered the Brocade Guards to imprison the Empress and the Crown Prince to thoroughly investigate the case."

Upon hearing this, not only did Prince Ping's eyes flicker, but the two chancellors also changed their expressions.

The Crown Prince being thrown into prison clearly meant he had completely lost the Emperor's trust and was doomed.

"Yao Yao is still so young, and Mother actually poisoned her. Yining must be heartbroken." In an instant, Prince Ping's expression became as warm as spring, and he looked at Zhao Xuanyou with concern. "The palace has been investigating for so long without any news, but as soon as you took over, the truth came out. It seems the Brocade Guards should indeed be handed over to you. How is your leg injury?"

"It's manageable for walking, but I still can't exert much strength."

"I have plenty of high-quality medicinal herbs in my residence. I'll send some to the Marquis's mansion another day."

"Thank you for your concern, Your Highness."

After praising Zhao Xuanyou, Prince Ping smiled at Yu Yuan, "And this is..."

"This is my wife."

"Concubine Ding Yuan, greets Prince Ping."

"Truly a talented husband and a beautiful wife. No wonder Xuanyou is so devoted to you." After a brief exchange, Prince Ping changed the subject, "Such a big event has occurred. Father must be very sad. I need to go to the Hall of Supreme Harmony quickly."

This was a perfect opportunity for him to display his filial piety while the Emperor was in distress.

With that, Prince Ping quickly walked ahead.

Zhao Xuanyou led Yu Yuan to the side and waited for Prince Ping and the two chancellors to walk far away before turning around to continue on their way.

"This Prince Ping..."

Being in the palace, Zhao Xuanyou naturally couldn't say much and only lightly hummed in response.

In an instant, Yu Yuan thought of many things, but then she realized that these matters seemed to have nothing to do with her.

"I don't want to go to the Imperial Physician's Office anymore."

"It's fine to return to the Marquis's mansion first." Zhao Xuanyou could see that she was tired.

Her hand injury indeed did not require the imperial physician's attention. It would be better to return to the mansion and rest.

"What about you?"

Zhao Xuanyou helplessly smiled, "The palace is a mess. I can't leave for a while."

"Then don't see me out of the palace. Go back to the Hall of Supreme Harmony quickly."

"Do you know the way out of the palace?"

Yu Yuan nodded, "Just keep walking straight from here to the palace gate we entered through."

---

chapters.title: Hiding Something in the Heart
chapters.content:
The round trip from the Hall of Supreme Harmony to the palace gate was not short. Just now, Zhao Xuanyou had used qinggong to save her, and his leg was probably still uncomfortable. Naturally, Yu Yuan wanted to minimize the distance he had to walk.

Before Zhao Xuanyou could say anything else, Yu Yuan let go of his hand and quickly walked ahead.

Because the sun was too strong, after walking a distance, she took shelter under a tree to rest briefly and wipe the sweat with a handkerchief.

Just as she was about to continue walking, someone suddenly rushed past her; it was Princess Yian.

Years ago, during the summer retreat at the Lichuan Summer Palace, Princess Yian had taken a liking to Zhao Xuanyou and often visited their small courtyard. Yu Yuan still recognized her face.

Presumably, she had also heard about the incident in the Hall of Supreme Harmony and came to visit the Emperor.

Yu Yuan did not look at her for long and silently lowered her eyes to the side.

Unexpectedly, after glancing at her, Princess Yian stopped in her tracks and walked toward Yu Yuan.

It wasn't that she had an extraordinary memory and remembered the maid from the Marquis's mansion from five years ago. Rather, she had grown up with Cui Yichu and was very familiar with her. Upon seeing Yu Yuan's face, she couldn't help but take a second look.

"Who are you?" Princess Yian asked.

After leaving the imperial palace, Princess Yian had a strained relationship with her husband, the Marquis. Many rumors spread, and she began hosting monthly gatherings at her princess's residence, inviting young talents from the capital to recite poetry and compose essays. The Emperor disapproved of this, but she became even more uninhibited in her actions.

Today, she wore a dress of brocade and splendor, with jingling ornaments and a golden hairpin shaped like a phoenix in her hair, exuding an air of luxury and extravagance.

"Concubine Ding Yuan, wife of the Marquis of Jingyuan."

Princess Yian had, of course, heard about Zhao Xuanyou returning to the capital to marry. However, since she and Zhao Xuanyou were no longer connected, she had not paid much attention to it.

Seeing Yu Yuan with a face that was fifty percent similar to Cui Yichu's, she couldn't help but sneer.

She remembered that there had been a maid who looked like Cui Yichu by Zhao Xuanyou's side back then. Now he had married a wife who looked similar. He truly loved deeply.

Princess Yian did not say more and walked straight ahead.

Yu Yuan sighed in relief and quickly walked toward the palace gate.

The palace was indeed different from other places. One could encounter trouble at any time. It was better to rest at the Marquis's mansion.

Fortunately, she did not encounter anyone else afterward and successfully left the palace.

Back at the Marquis's mansion, after resting briefly in the Tangli Courtyard, Yu Yuan sent someone to invite the old Marquis to the Leshou Hall and reported the events that had transpired in the Hall of Supreme Harmony to the two elders.

Upon learning that the Emperor had been poisoned, both Old Madam Ye and the old Marquis looked grave.

"According to the imperial physicians, His Majesty is not in mortal danger. The court situation should not descend into chaos for the time being." Seeing their heavy hearts, Yu Yuan carefully spoke.

The old Marquis sighed, "Since even the type of poison isn't completely clear, I'm afraid this matter is not so simple."

"You mean..."

"Your father means that the Empress is meticulous and vicious. Since she used poison, the poison itself must not be ordinary," Old Madam Ye said. Although she had never participated in palace struggles, she had lived long enough to be very clear about what happened in the imperial harem.

Hearing this, Yu Yuan understood that they were still worried about Zhao Xuanyou.

"But the Marquis cannot leave the capital. His Majesty relies heavily on him now." After some thought, Yu Yuan added, "Actually, Prince Ping has a good relationship with the Marquis. Even if... for the Marquis's mansion, there shouldn't be any major changes."

The old Marquis heard that Yu Yuan was trying to reassure them in reverse and slightly composed himself. "The Marquis of Jingyuan has for generations enjoyed the Emperor's salary and been loyal to him. I am not trying to make Xuanyou afraid of trouble. The Crown Prince's deposition is already a foregone conclusion. From now on, you and Xuanyou must be more cautious in your actions."

"Yes."

Old Madam Ye looked at Yu Yuan standing obediently to the side and suddenly remembered that she had reached out to stop the out-of-control Princess Yining in the Hall of Supreme Harmony. She asked with concern, "Did you get injured when you grabbed the hairpin?"

"No, I didn't." Yu Yuan quickly replied.

Old Madam Ye did not believe her. She took Yu Yuan's hand and opened it, seeing a red mark on her palm.

"It's good that it didn't break the skin. Be careful with your hand these next few days. Don't injure it again."

After today's events, Old Madam Ye appreciated Yu Yuan even more.

Such a big incident had occurred, yet she had remained calm and even found the presence of mind to save the young prince. In the entire capital, there were few who could handle things as well as she could.

Xuanyou's judgment was indeed much better than her own as an old woman.

After leaving Leshou Hall, Yu Yuan was starving. She returned to Tangli Courtyard and immediately ordered a meal. After eating two bowls of rice, she went to bed and slept until almost nightfall.

"Has the Marquis returned?" Yu Yuan asked.

Autumn Moon replied, "The Marquis sent a message from the palace saying he won't return to the mansion tonight. He told the madam not to wait for him."

He wasn't coming back?

Yu Yuan sighed in her heart. It wasn't entirely unexpected.

The Emperor had said in the Hall of Supreme Harmony that all the people from the Hall of Supreme Harmony, the Eastern Palace, and the Zhen Guo Duke's mansion would be arrested. There were several hundred people in total. Even if they worked through the night, they might not be able to finish.

But he still couldn't walk properly. With so much work, she didn't know if it would delay his recovery.

No matter how worried she was, Yu Yuan had no other choice but to continue waiting at the mansion.

Three days later, as she was in her room checking the account books, Ran Dong quickly entered and bowed to her.

"Madam, the young master has returned from the palace."

Uncle Wen Hao had returned?

Yu Yuan's heart leapt with joy. She quickly asked, "Did the Marquis return with him?"

"I didn't see the Marquis. The young master is outside Tangli Courtyard and says he has something to see you about."

"Quickly invite him in."

Ran Dong soon brought Wen Hao in.

As soon as the door closed, Yu Yuan couldn't wait to ask, "Why did you come back alone? Where is Zhao Xuanyou?"

"He's still in the palace. They just finished arresting everyone. The Brocade Guards are still interrogating them one by one. It will take at least half a month before they can take a breather."

Half a month without seeing each other... that was too long.

Seeing Yu Yuan's disheartened expression, Wen Hao teased, "You miss him?"

"He is my husband. Is it wrong for me to miss him?"

"Of course not. Do you know why I returned today?"

This question stumped Yu Yuan. She looked at Wen Hao suspiciously. "Why did you come back to the mansion alone? Did something happen in the palace?"

"His Majesty has ordered you to enter the palace to take care of the young prince. I came to escort you."

This news was indeed sudden.

Yu Yuan was stunned for a moment. "Why did His Majesty suddenly make this decision? What about Sun Qianran?"

"She didn't take good care of the young prince and let him run from the side hall to the main hall, almost losing his life. His Majesty was very angry and sent her out of the palace. For the past few days, the Brocade Guards have been taking care of the young prince, but they don't know how to care for a child. So His Majesty thought of you."

That day, when Princess Yining had lost control and stabbed at Zhao Yi Yun, it was Yu Yuan who had stepped forward to protect Zhao Yi Yun.

The Emperor had seen this and naturally considered Yu Yuan the best candidate.

Since it was an imperial decree, whether Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Yuan were willing was naturally unimportant.

In any case, being able to enter the palace to take care of the young prince meant that she could at least see Zhao Xuanyou every day.

"Then should I go to the palace with you now?"

As soon as Yu Yuan finished speaking, she noticed Wen Hao's eyes flickering a few times.

It was clear that Wen Hao was hiding something.

chapters.title: Weapons
chapters.content:
"You have something to say, just say it. What is there to hesitate about in front of me?"

Listening to Yu Ying's clear and confident voice, Wen Sun pursed his lips and smiled, but the next moment he lowered his eyes.

"Ying, I want to ask you for a favor, but it's a difficult one."

Difficult?

Yu Ying's delicate eyebrows twitched. Thinking of Wen Sun helping Zhao Xuanyou, she said, "Do you need Zhao Xuanyou to intervene?"

Wen Sun nodded heavily.

Seeing that he still struggled to speak, Yu Ying guessed that this matter might be related to the Eastern Palace.

"The matter of the Crown Prince is already settled. Zhao Xuanyou cannot interfere."

"It's not about the Crown Prince," Wen Sun quickly said.

Four years ago, Wen Sun already knew that the Empress and the Crown Prince had done things punishable by death. The reason he had made up his mind to leave with Yu Ying back then was not only to live a free and unfettered life but also to find a way to save himself.

The Crown Prince's abilities were far from sufficient to support his ambitions. His downfall was only a matter of time.

Wen Sun was just a secret guard. Staying would not allow him to change the course of events, and leaving the Eastern Palace would not cause much loss. He just wanted to survive.

"If it's not about the Crown Prince, then it's fine. For other matters, Zhao Xuanyou should still be able to help."

"When I was adopted by my master, there was someone I got along well with. We practiced martial arts together and later entered the Eastern Palace as secret guards."

Yu Ying asked curiously, "So you still have friends in the Eastern Palace?"

"I don't know if he can be considered a friend. He is the kind of person who is determined to achieve great things. Whether it's practicing martial arts or handling tasks, he always gives his all. He is not like me."

Yu Ying blinked and smiled, "Then why were you able to get close enough to protect the Crown Prince?"

"My lightness skill is good."

Wen Sun had a thin figure, and he was naturally gifted in lightness skills.

Even without giving his all, his lightness skills were already among the top in the secret guards.

Over the past few years, he had practiced diligently. In Zhao Xuanyou's view, his lightness skills were unparalleled in the world.

"Has he been captured?" Yu Ying asked.

Wen Sun nodded, "The day before yesterday, after the Jin Yi Wei arrested the concubines and servants of the Eastern Palace, they also found the secret guard roster and are now arresting people in the capital according to the list. Yesterday, when I went to the prison to count the number of people, I saw him. He recognized me too."

"You were in disguise, and he still recognized you?"

"We practiced martial arts together and learned disguise together. He could recognize me just by my figure."

"Did he expose your identity?"

"No," Wen Sun lowered his head, his voice growing softer, "He is actually like me, an abandoned orphan. Although we may not be friends, we did grow up together. He won't expose me."

But when Wen Sun met his gaze, he could see that the other man wanted to survive.

Just like back then, out of the twenty people adopted by the master, only eight survived in the end.

Giving their all was just for the sake of survival.

"I understand. I will go and talk to Zhao Xuanyou. However, the situation with the Jin Yi Wei is complicated, and I cannot make any promises right now."

"You agreed to plead for him?" Wen Sun asked joyfully.

Seeing his reaction, Yu Ying couldn't help but smile, "Did you think I would refuse you?"

It wasn't that he thought Yu Ying would refuse.

But Zhao Xuanyou was carrying out the Emperor's orders. Asking him to secretly release someone would be risky.

If it were Wen Sun himself, Yu Ying would definitely save him.

But for Wen Sun's friend, asking Zhao Xuanyou to take the risk, Yu Ying might not agree.

"So, in your heart, I am also a heartless woman?"

Wen Sun just smiled and said nothing.

Heartless?

In Yu Ying's heart, there was a scale. For those she cared about, she would naturally soften.

But for those she didn't care about...

Yu Ying sighed and pretended to be sad, "In that case, I should be heartless and reject your request."

"Don't." Wen Sun quickly stopped her, "I didn't mean that. You are the kindest."

After the jest, Yu Ying asked again, "What is that person's name?"

"Lin Jing."

After Wen Sun finished explaining which "Jing" it was, Yu Ying realized that their names were all weapons.

"Did your master give you these names?"

Wen Sun nodded.

The master had adopted them to turn them into the sharpest weapons in the world, to serve their master.

Wen Sun didn't know what Yu Ying was thinking. Seeing that she didn't speak, he added, "Lin Jing is very skilled in martial arts. If we were to fight head-on, I wouldn't be able to beat him. If you don't mind, we can keep him in the army to work, or he can protect you."

"How can someone who used to protect the Crown Prince become my guard?"

"Why not?" Wen Sun didn't think much of it. Apart from Yu Ying, there wasn't anyone else in this world worth protecting.

Yu Ying smiled, "I have you."

Wen Sun heard this and lowered his eyes with a smile, "Well, let's talk about it after he escapes."

"Let's go to the palace now."

Rather than staying at the Marquis's residence feeling uneasy, it was better to go to the palace.

Yu Ying then changed her clothes and, after reporting to the Old Dowager in the Leshou Hall, followed Wen Sun to the imperial palace.

Since Wen Sun had a token, there was no need for further reporting, and the guards at the palace gate let them in.

The eunuch who received them saw Yu Ying and directly led her to the West Garden. This place used to be where the underage princes lived. Now that the princes had been enfeoffed and established their own residences, the place was empty.

"Marquis's wife, the young prince is inside." The inner attendant sighed, "That day in the Qianqing Palace, he was greatly frightened. Since then, he hasn't been able to eat or sleep well and rarely speaks."

Witnessing his grandmother and father being arrested, and then being injured by his aunt, it was hard for anyone, let alone a four-year-old child, to bear.

"I'll go in and take a look."

The inner attendant opened the door for her and silently stepped aside.

Yu Ying and Wen Sun entered the room together. Looking around, they didn't see Zhao Yi Yun's figure.

With Jin Yi Wei and inner attendants guarding outside, he shouldn't be able to run away.

"On the couch." Wen Sun said softly.

Only then did Yu Ying see Zhao Yi Yun squatting in the corner, hugging his knees and looking like a small, curled-up figure.

Yu Ying gave Wen Sun a look, and he understood, retreating to the doorway.

"Your Highness, the Royal Grandson." Yu Ying sat down by the couch and called out gently.

Hearing the voice, Zhao Yi Yun looked up guardedly. Upon seeing Yu Ying's face clearly, his gaze relaxed slightly.

He recognized her as the person who had stood in front of him that day, blocking Princess Yining's hairpin for him.

However, he still didn't speak, lowering his head again.

Yu Ying took off her shoes and cautiously moved closer to him. Just as she was about to touch him, he suddenly lifted his head, his eyes red as he stared at Yu Ying.

"Do you want to drink some water?"

Yu Ying didn't approach rashly again. Instead, she sat down by the couch like him to avoid provoking him further.

Zhao Yi Yun, of course, did not answer.

Yu Ying recalled the time she had encountered Zhao Yi Yun in the Imperial Garden, where he had kept saying he missed his mother. An idea struck her, and she asked, "Your Highness, do you miss your mother?"

chapters.title: Like Three Autumns Apart
chapters.content:
Zhao Yi Yun's gaze brightened for a moment, but only for an instant.

His eyes dimmed again as he lowered his head, murmuring, "If even Father has been arrested, then Mother must also..."

The secret guards in the Eastern Palace had all been captured. As a favored concubine, Zhuang Huaiyue was naturally no exception.

Yu Ying avoided the topic and asked gently, "Do you want to see her?"

"Can I see her?" Zhao Yi Yun asked in surprise, his small eyes wide with shock as he looked at Yu Ying anxiously, "Marquis's wife, please."

This was naturally not something Yu Ying could decide. Even Zhao Xuanyou couldn't take Zhao Yi Yun to the prison to see Zhuang Huaiyue.

"I can't take you to see her, but if you eat and sleep well, you can write a letter. I will find a way to deliver it to her."

"But I can't read or write yet."

"You speak, and I will write it for you. Or, if you want to send something to your mother, I can help you find a way."

Zhao Yi Yun looked at Yu Ying, his eyes showing some hesitation and some temptation.

Looking at his gaze, Yu Ying asked gently, "You don't trust me?"

Zhao Yi Yun didn't speak, but in his mind, he recalled the day when Princess Yining had raised her hairpin to stab him, and it was Yu Ying who had stood in front of him to block it.

She had saved him, so now she was someone worthy of trust.

"I trust you."

Yu Ying let out a soft sigh of relief, "Then we have an agreement. You must eat and sleep well, and then I will help you."

"Okay."

"Does your shoulder still hurt?"

That day, Princess Yining had not struck a vital spot, but she had injured his shoulder. For a four-year-old, it was a serious injury.

"It hurts." Zhao Yi Yun said, tears welling up in his eyes.

"Let me see." Yu Ying, seeing that he was no longer on guard, moved a little closer to him, holding him in her arms and carefully pulling open his clothes.

The wound had been properly bandaged. Apart from a faint smell of blood, there was also the scent of healing medicine.

It seemed that with the Emperor's orders, the people below had not neglected him.

"Do you want something to eat?" Yu Ying asked.

Zhao Yi Yun shook his head.

"Do you want me to carry you to the garden for a walk to see if we can find any ants?"

Zhao Yi Yun looked at Yu Ying and finally nodded.

After putting on her shoes, Yu Ying carefully carried Zhao Yi Yun out.

Wen Sun, standing at the door, saw Zhao Yi Yun quietly being carried out by her without any resistance, showing no surprise.

When it came to coaxing people, who could compare to Yu Ying?

"Are we going out?" Wen Sun asked.

"Just for a walk in the garden."

The inner attendants waiting outside saw that Yu Ying had carried Zhao Yi Yun out and immediately showed joy in their eyes.

Yu Ying said, "Prepare some snacks and soups that the young prince usually likes. When he gets tired from playing, he will want to eat."

"Yes." The inner attendant responded and withdrew.

The West Garden was much more open than the Imperial Garden. Although the flowers and plants were not as lush as in the Imperial Garden, there were more trees.

Yu Ying carried Zhao Yi Yun to a crabapple tree and carefully searched the trunk for any trace of ants.

Wen Sun, not understanding, asked softly, "What are you looking for?"

"Ants."

Wen Sun's eyebrows twitched slightly, looking at Zhao Yi Yun with a hint of surprise.

He hadn't expected that the young prince would share the same hobby as him.

The three of them played in the garden for a long time. Since Wen Sun had found several ant nests in a row, Zhao Yi Yun gradually let down his guard against him.

When Zhao Xuanyou arrived at the West Garden, he saw the three of them playing happily.

He frowned and coughed lightly.

Yu Ying turned her head and saw him standing there with a stern face, unable to help but smile.

"Ying, I'll take the young prince to rest for a while."

Seeing that Yu Ying had been carrying Zhao Yi Yun for so long, Wen Sun guessed that her arms must be sore and reached out to take Zhao Yi Yun from her.

Zhao Yi Yun hesitated for a moment but did not shrink back into Yu Ying's arms. Instead, he leaned forward, allowing Wen Sun to take him.

Yu Ying reached out and tapped Zhao Yi Yun's forehead, "Go eat something first. I'll play with you again later."

Zhao Yi Yun nodded and looked at Zhao Xuanyou, then back at Yu Ying.

"Marquis's wife, do you remember what you promised me?"

Zhao Xuanyou had been in the palace for a while, and Zhao Yi Yun often entered the Qianqing Palace. Although no one had said it, he knew that the Emperor held the Marquis of Jingyuan in high regard.

He was young, but he was not confused.

The Marquis of Jingyuan could see his mother. Confirming this point, Zhao Yi Yun accepted Yu Ying's suggestion.

"Of course, I remember." Yu Ying said softly, then pointed at Zhao Xuanyou, "I will speak to him for you in a moment. However, you must also keep your word and eat properly."

Zhao Yi Yun nodded vigorously, allowing Wen Sun to carry him into the house.

Only then did Yu Ying turn around and walk to Zhao Xuanyou, who had a gloomy expression.

"Haven't seen you for a few days, and this is the face you show me?" Yu Ying hummed lightly, pretending to be annoyed.

Zhao Xuanyou pulled her into his embrace.

They had just gotten married, and after a few days apart, it felt like three autumns had passed.

"This is the palace." Yu Ying, being held by him, was momentarily stunned. After looking around, she saw that they were all familiar guards and felt relieved.

Zhao Xuanyou didn't think much of it, "So what if it's the palace? You are my wife."

"Do you miss me?" Yu Ying asked with a smile.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with a hum, his eyes darkening, "You were having so much fun with others. It seems you don't miss me."

She was ordered to take care of Zhao Yi Yun, a four-year-old child. Was he going to be jealous even of this?

Yu Ying felt helpless, but since she hadn't seen him for a few days, she couldn't bear to argue with him.

Looking at the refined and noble man in front of her, Yu Ying raised her chin and kissed his face heavily.

The wind in the garden still carried the lingering heat of summer, and the aftertaste of the kiss was long and passionate.

Zhao Xuanyou was finally satisfied, a smile appearing on his previously cold face.

Yu Ying was close to him and actually noticed that his ears were slightly red.

After being so close to Zhao Xuanyou for so long, this was the first time Yu Ying had noticed his ears turning red.

He was actually embarrassed by her kiss?

But he was such a strong and proud person. If she exposed him, he might not be able to maintain his composure.

Yu Ying pursed her lips, suppressing her smile, and pretended to be nonchalant as she leaned on his shoulder.

After a while, presumably when Zhao Xuanyou's emotions had returned to normal, he pulled her to sit on a stone bench nearby.

"Taking care of the young prince at this time is not a good task." Since everyone around was trusted, Zhao Xuanyou spoke without restraint.

However, for the sake of caution, he kept his voice lower than usual.

Yu Ying understood his meaning.

Previously, the Emperor had been poisoned, and it was kept secret.

Taking care of Zhao Yi Yun could earn the Emperor's favor. More importantly, it allowed access to the Qianqing Palace, enabling her to always be by the Emperor's side and understand the true state of his health.

But now, everyone knew that the Emperor had been poisoned, and Empress Jiang and Zhao Zun were both imprisoned. No matter how much the Emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun, to appease the anger of the royal family and the court officials, it was impossible to keep Zhao Yi Yun by his side any longer.

The royal grandson, who had been highly favored just a few days ago, had suddenly become a hot potato.

chapters.title: With Him Here
chapters.content:
Yu Ying let out a soft sigh, sounding rather helpless. "But this task wasn’t something we sought out. Even if we don’t want to do it, it’s not so easy to refuse."

"I’m still in the palace. You don’t need to be afraid."

Zhao Xuanyou said this as he placed his hand over the back of hers.

"Of course I’m not afraid."

This was both trust in Zhao Xuanyou and her own judgment of the palace’s situation.

The emperor may have been poisoned, but his life was not in danger.

He had asked Yu Ying to take care of Zhao Yi Yun, and if she completed the task, it would count as a merit in the emperor’s eyes.

"Oh, there’s something very important I want to ask your opinion on."

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow slightly, waiting for Yu Ying to continue.

She rarely spoke to him in such a tone, and he was curious about what important matter it could be.

"Wen Jue had a good friend in the Eastern Palace named Lin Jing. Now that Zhao Zun has fallen, Lin Jing has been arrested too. Wen Jue wants to ask for your help..."

"To release Lin Jing?"

Seeing that he had guessed correctly, Yu Ying continued.

"Wen Jue says Lin Jing is quite skilled in martial arts. If you don’t mind, you could keep him in Yuzhou to work for you."

"Zhao Zun’s man? Of course I mind."

Zhao Xuanyou spoke with disdain. Yu Ying knew he meant what he said, so she didn’t try to persuade him. She only asked, "Can you find a way to release him?"

"You’ve already promised Wen Jue?"

"I know this isn’t easy, but Wen Jue has helped me with many things. This is the first time he’s asked me for a favor, so naturally I’ll do my best to ask for your help. Now that he’s been arrested, can it still be done? If it’s truly impossible, then we’ll have to give up."

Of course, as Wen Jue had thought, Yu Ying had her own scales in her heart. She knew what was light and what was heavy.

She would do her best to make this happen, but if it would harm Zhao Xuanyou, then it couldn’t be done.

"You’ve already said it yourself; he’s helped you many times, and this is the first time he’s asked you for help. I can’t let you be ungrateful."

Zhao Xuanyou felt rather at ease.

He had always thought that Yu Ying and Wen Jue were too close. Although there was nothing romantic between them, that kind of bond had made him a little jealous.

Yu Ying’s words just now clearly showed that he was family, while Wen Jue was an outsider. This truly made him feel at ease, both physically and mentally.

"Won’t this give someone a handle to use against you?"

"People die in prison every day. To the emperor, to Prince Ping, to those who care about the Eastern Palace’s succession, Lin Jing is just an insignificant person. No one will pay attention."

"Who died in prison?" Yu Ying asked casually.

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow. "There were two pregnant concubines in the Eastern Palace. They both died yesterday."

"Who... who did it? It can’t be the emperor, right?"

Given the emperor’s favor toward Zhao Yi Yun, Yu Ying could tell that he valued his descendants highly. It was unlikely that he would take action to eliminate his own bloodline.

"Who knows?"

Yu Ying frowned and leaned closer to him, doubt flickering in her eyes. "The incident happened right under your nose, and you don’t know?"

"I arrested the people, but I didn’t assign the guards for the prison. However, I do have my suspicions. Guess. Who do you think is most afraid of Zhao Zun leaving behind descendants?"

"Prince Ping?" Yu Ying didn’t make a sound, only forming the two words with her lips.

Zhao Xuanyou nodded slightly, confirming her guess.

"He’s too hasty, isn’t he? It’s only been a few days."

"Before the children are born, the emperor hasn’t had time to show concern. It’s better to eliminate potential threats early."

"Isn’t he afraid of the emperor’s anger?"

"The emperor hasn’t fully recovered from the poison yet. How can he pay attention to so many things? Two low-ranking concubines died in the Eastern Palace. As long as no one mentions they were pregnant, who would investigate further? Pan Xun only found out they were the pregnant ones when he sent someone to collect the bodies."

As Yu Ying listened to him, she felt her breath tighten.

The struggle for the throne was treacherous, and lives were as insignificant as weeds.

Zhao Zun’s children were Prince Ping’s nephews, but he showed no hesitation in killing them.

"Didn’t Pan Xun report this to the emperor?"

Zhao Xuanyou’s voice deepened slightly. "Think about it again."

With the Eastern Palace fallen, Prince Ping was currently the most likely to win.

Although the emperor was not in mortal danger, he was old and poisoned. Prince Ping might ascend to the throne in a few years.

Pan Xun was still young. For the sake of his own future, he naturally wouldn’t stick his neck out to offend Prince Ping at this time.

Yu Ying didn’t say anything, but judging by her expression, Zhao Xuanyou knew she had figured it out herself.

"Then... will Prince Ping harm the young prince?"

"Not while the emperor is still alive."

Zhao Yi Yun had been the emperor’s beloved for four years. He was the apple of his eye, not comparable to unborn bloodlines.

Hearing Zhao Xuanyou say this, Yu Ying’s tense expression eased slightly. Then she remembered something else.

"Earlier, to coax the young prince into eating, I promised to help him write a letter to Consort Zhuang and send it to the prison. Can this... still be done?"

"No problem. If you really write it, give it to me."

"Won’t this offend Prince Ping?"

"He can’t take Zhao Yi Yun’s life now. These minor matters aren’t worth worrying about. You just need to do your duty and take good care of the young prince. Leave the rest to me."

With him by her side, Yu Ying indeed had nothing to worry about.

It was also because he was in the palace that Yu Ying dared to accept this task.

"Today I entered the palace in such a hurry. I don’t even know the arrangements here. Will I be staying in the Western Garden to take care of the young prince from now on?"

Zhao Xuanyou responded with a soft "mm."

"And you?"

"If you’re staying here, I’ll naturally stay here too."

Yu Ying was delighted to hear this.

"Really?"

"You and I are husband and wife. It’s only natural for us to live together."

Of course, the most important thing was that the princes were already grown up. The Western Garden was quite empty, and it wasn’t difficult for Zhao Xuanyou to obtain permission to stay here.

"Which room will you be in?"

"Right next door, in Qingfen Pavilion. Remember to come over tonight."

Looking at the deep color in his eyes, Yu Ying knew what he was thinking.

"I can’t."

Zhao Xuanyou was taken aback, not understanding what Yu Ying meant. "What’s inconvenient? The emperor asked you to take care of the young prince, not to be his wet nurse. Once he’s asleep, you can come over."

"It’s not that I can’t come over... it’s that my body isn’t feeling well. We can’t... do that."

Last night, Yu Ying had started her period, so naturally, they couldn’t engage in marital relations.

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze flickered, somewhat unexpectedly, but he couldn’t say he was disappointed.

"Alright, we won’t. But you should still come over early."

As he spoke, Zhao Xuanyou gave her slender hand a firm squeeze.

He had come to find her to give her some instructions after learning she had entered the palace. There were still many matters in the palace waiting for him to handle, so he couldn’t linger in the Western Garden for too long.

After Yu Ying agreed, he finally left, leaning on his cane.

Yu Ying returned to the room. By this time, Zhao Yi Yun had already finished eating the pastries, and Wen Jue was wiping his hands.

"You’re surprisingly good with children."

Seeing that Yu Ying was teasing him, Wen Jue didn’t take offense. He just looked at her nervously. "Did you talk to him?"

Releasing Lin Jing wasn’t something Yu Ying could decide. It was entirely up to Zhao Xuanyou.

"I already talked to him. Don’t worry, it shouldn’t be a problem."

---

chapters.title: Brother-in-Law
chapters.content:
With Yu Ying’s assurance, Wen Jue finally felt at ease.

Yu Ying pursed her lips. "Don’t forget he’s your brother-in-law. If you have a problem, how could he not help?"

Brother-in-law?

Although Yu Ying had already married Zhao Xuanyou, Wen Jue had never addressed him as such.

He and Yu Ying weren’t blood-related siblings, and besides, he wasn’t very familiar with Zhao Xuanyou. Calling him that always made him feel like he was overstepping.

Yu Ying tilted her head to look at him, then asked, "Don’t want to call him that?"

"No."

Zhao Xuanyou was, after all, a high-ranking and powerful heir. How could he bring himself to claim such a connection?

Wen Jue hesitated. "I’m afraid he wouldn’t want to hear it."

"If you call him that, he’ll naturally want to hear it."

Yu Ying had insisted on having Wen Jue accompany Zhao Xuanyou into the palace to handle official business precisely to bring the two of them closer.

Wen Jue was Yu Ying’s brother, and Yu Ying was Zhao Xuanyou’s wife. That made Wen Jue Zhao Xuanyou’s legitimate brother-in-law.

Starting with the address, they could gradually build a familial relationship.

"Are you sure?"

Yu Ying nodded confidently.

Normally, when she mentioned Wen Jue to Zhao Xuanyou, she could clearly sense the man’s inexplicable jealousy.

She had never explained it because she felt it was unnecessary.

If Wen Jue called Zhao Xuanyou "brother-in-law," Zhao Xuanyou would certainly be overjoyed.

"Alright."

Wen Jue obediently agreed. After Yu Ying sat down, she saw Zhao Yi Yun also looking at her expectantly.

When Yu Ying’s gaze finally fell on him, Zhao Yi Yun quickly said, "Madame Hou, I’ve done everything I promised you. I ate a lot; osmanthus cake, mung bean cake, and rose dew."

"I know." Yu Ying smiled at him and lightly tapped his forehead. "Don’t worry, your matter can be handled too."

"Really?" Zhao Yi Yun was overjoyed. He stood up from his seat in excitement. "Then can you write the letter to my mother now? Thank you, Madame Hou, thank you!"

"Alright, let’s write it now."

Yu Ying stood up. To avoid touching Zhao Yi Yun’s injured shoulder, she deliberately took his other hand.

At the desk, Yu Ying spread out the paper and picked up the brush, waiting for Zhao Yi Yun to think about what he wanted to write.

Zhao Yi Yun tilted his head in thought, but soon his eyes filled with sadness again.

"Your Highness, what’s wrong?"

"I want to see my mother. I want her to come to the palace to take me away. I don’t want to stay here alone."

This was something Zhuang Huaiyue couldn’t do.

Yu Ying understood this, and so did Zhao Yi Yun.

If even the empress dowager and the prince had been arrested, how could his mother possibly take him away?

"Then write something else?"

"What should I write?"

"Write that you’re doing well in the palace, that the emperor dotes on you, that you’re staying in the Western Garden, that you just watched ants in the garden, and that you ate osmanthus cake, mung bean cake, and rose dew."

Zhao Yi Yun looked up at Yu Ying with wide eyes. After listening to her, he softly asked, "Will my mother be happy to hear all this?"

"Of course. You’re the child she carried for ten months. The person she worries about most in this world is you. As long as you’re safe and sound, that’s the best news for her."

Yu Ying spoke calmly, but Wen Jue felt something was different.

He looked up at Yu Ying, as if he saw something shiny in her eyes.

Was she crying?

Wen Jue thought she shouldn’t be.

Zhao Yi Yun was indeed pitiful, but he still had the emperor’s favor. No matter what, he could temporarily stay safe in this storm.

Why was Yu Ying so heartbroken for him?

"Then I’ll listen to you. Let’s write it like that." Zhao Yi Yun said.

He didn’t understand what crime his father had committed, but he knew the emperor was very angry. No amount of pleading would help. Even if he asked his mother to come take him away, she couldn’t do it.

He didn’t want to make his mother sad.

So, as Madame Hou said, the best thing was to let his mother know not to worry about him.

Looking at Zhao Yi Yun, Yu Ying was indeed reminded of her child from her past life.

Cui Yichu had taken the child, and of course, he wouldn’t cherish him. He would only use the child as a tool to secure his position. The child must have longed for his mother’s love too.

As Yu Ying’s emotions surged, Wen Jue reached out and patted her arm.

She was slightly startled and looked up at Wen Jue. Quickly suppressing her chaotic thoughts, she took a deep breath and wrote a short letter.

"Your Highness, think about whether you want to draw something or write something so that Consort Zhuang will recognize it as your letter at a glance."

"The emperor taught me how to write my own name."

"You’re so capable, Your Highness."

Yu Ying praised him and then lifted Zhao Yi Yun onto the chair, steadying his small body.

Zhao Yi Yun grabbed the brush and wrote the characters "Yi Yun" at the end of the letter.

He hadn’t started learning to read yet. It would be more accurate to say he had drawn the characters rather than written them. They were crooked, uneven, and he had even made a mistake in one of the strokes for the character "Yi."

Yu Ying didn’t correct him. After he put down the brush, she lifted him down.

"Your Highness, think about whether you want to send some things to Consort Zhuang, like food or daily necessities."

"Can we send them?"

Since the Jin Yi Wei went to the prison to interrogate the prisoners every day, if they could send a letter, it shouldn’t be difficult to send some things along.

Hearing this, Wen Jue went outside and had an inner attendant bring in a basket.

Yu Ying took Zhao Yi Yun to put some fruits and pastries into the basket. Zhao Yi Yun even took a book from the bookshelf.

"Does Consort Zhuang like reading?"

Zhao Yi Yun nodded. "My mother likes reading. She often tells me stories."

At this, Zhao Yi Yun’s eyes reddened again.

It had been too long since he had seen his mother, too long since he had heard her tell stories.

Yu Ying, seeing this, was filled with sympathy and pulled Zhao Yi Yun into her arms.

Zhao Yi Yun sobbed softly in her embrace.

Yu Ying held him and gently patted his back. After a long while, Zhao Yi Yun lifted his head and carefully asked, "Madame Hou, can you tell me a story tonight?"

"You want me to tell you a story?"

Zhao Yi Yun nodded.

"But I haven’t read as many books as your mother. I don’t know that many stories."

"Ah."

Facing Zhao Yi Yun’s disappointed expression, Yu Ying curved her lips into a smile. "How about you tell me a story instead, Your Highness?"

"Me tell you?"

"Mm."

"But..."

"Your Highness, the stories you’ve heard from Consort Zhuang must all be very interesting."

Those stories his mother told were indeed very interesting. After a moment of hesitation, Zhao Yi Yun still nodded.

The first day in the palace passed smoothly. Even though both husband and wife had entered the palace, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t return to the Western Garden until nearly the hour of Zi.

Wen Jue had been standing guard at the door. Hearing the footsteps, he turned and stood in front of the door.

Seeing that it was Zhao Xuanyou returning, he instinctively wanted to step aside but then remembered Yu Ying’s instructions and felt conflicted.

Zhao Xuanyou saw him blocking the door without moving and couldn’t figure out what he was trying to do.

Just as he was about to speak, he heard Wen Jue stammer, "Sis... sister-in-law."

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow. Although Wen Jue had been following him into the palace for several days, he had always addressed him as "Lord Zhao" like the others. This was the first time he had called him "brother-in-law."

Since the other party was making an effort to get closer, Zhao Xuanyou naturally wouldn’t dampen his spirits. He responded, "Where’s your sister?"

chapters.title: Ice and Snow Melt
chapters.content:
"My sister..."

Wen Shuo was not only unaccustomed to calling Zhao Xuanyou "brother-in-law," but he was also not very used to calling Yu Wan "elder sister."

But with the atmosphere built up to this point, he naturally couldn’t take it back.

"She’s still in the room. The little imperial grandson has already fallen asleep, probably because she was telling him a story."

Zhao Xuanyou sighed helplessly, "She certainly has the leisure to tell others stories."

His tone was tinged with bitterness.

Zhao Xuanyou had lost his mother at a young age. No one had ever told him stories to coax him to sleep.

Yu Wan had the mood to coax someone else’s son, but she might as well coax him instead.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou had misunderstood, Wen Shuo hesitated for a moment before explaining, "It wasn’t Yu Wan telling the story to His Highness. It was His Highness telling her a story."

What?

Zhao Xuanyou chuckled softly, "That does sound like something she would do."

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou’s reaction, Wen Shuo couldn’t help but curve his lips into a smile as well. "Isn’t she always like this? Her actions are always unexpected."

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow, and the two shared a knowing smile.

They had known each other for quite some time. Over the past few days, while working in the palace, Zhao Xuanyou had followed Yu Wan’s instructions to keep Wen Shuo by his side at all times.

Although they spent day and night together, they didn’t speak much to each other. Their relationship wasn’t like that of superiors and subordinates, nor like relatives; there was always a layer of distance between them.

But with those few simple words just now, the solid ice between them seemed to melt silently.

"His Highness the Imperial Grandson should be asleep by now. Brother-in-law, go in and take a look."

Wen Shuo stepped aside.

Zhao Xuanyou responded with an "mm" and reached out to push the door. Just then, Wen Shuo added, "Earlier, when she was with His Highness, I don’t know what she was thinking about, but she suddenly started tearing up."

"She cried?" Zhao Xuanyou frowned.

"Not exactly crying, just that her eyes seemed to glisten with tears. I didn’t ask her about it."

"Thank you." Zhao Xuanyou pushed the door and entered the room.

Afraid of waking Zhao Yi Yun, he left his cane by the door and limped inside.

The inner room was dimly lit by a single weak candle. Zhao Xuanyou walked around the screen and saw Yu Wan sitting by the couch, quietly watching Zhao Yi Yun’s sleeping face. As Wen Shuo had said, her eyes indeed seemed to shimmer with unshed tears.

"Wanwan."

Zhao Xuanyou called her name softly.

Yu Wan snapped back to reality and quickly lowered her head, seemingly wiping her tears.

But soon, she lifted her head again and smiled at him before walking over.

"Where’s your cane?" Yu Wan asked softly.

"Afraid of waking the child, I left it by the door. Is he asleep?"

Yu Wan nodded and helped Zhao Xuanyou walk out.

Seeing them come out, Wen Shuo stood up again.

"Ah Shuo, you stay here tonight and guard this place. Apart from the two eunuchs who attend closely to His Highness, don’t let anyone else in."

"Understood."

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan returned to Qingfen Pavilion. After a brief wash, they lay down on the bed.

Yu Wan had started her period today, and after taking care of Zhao Yi Yun for so long, she was indeed exhausted. As soon as she lay down, she closed her eyes.

Zhao Xuanyou lay beside her and wrapped his arms around her from behind.

"Wanwan, if you don’t want to do this, I can go to His Majesty and decline the task for you."

There were so many concubines in the palace. Logically, it was their duty to take care of Zhao Yi Yun.

Initially, it was because Chancellor Sun wanted to plant eyes in the Qianqing Palace that Sun Qianran was pushed into the role.

"I don’t mind doing it."

"You don’t have to force yourself." Zhao Xuanyou said gently.

"I’m not forcing myself. His Highness is a very cute and gentle child. Being with him isn’t hard; it’s actually quite enjoyable."

"Really?" Zhao Xuanyou thought of how she had looked sitting by the couch, her expression sorrowful. Naturally, he didn’t believe her. "Then why were you sad earlier?"

Yu Wan’s body stiffened slightly.

So Zhao Xuanyou had seen her crying.

She didn’t turn to look at him, allowing him to hold her from behind. She evaded vaguely, "I was thinking that His Highness will soon be a child without a father or mother. I just felt sorry for him."

If someone else had said this, Zhao Xuanyou might have believed it. But coming from Yu Wan, he clearly didn’t.

However, he could see that Yu Wan didn’t want to talk about it, so he didn’t press further. Instead, he gently rubbed her stomach from behind.

"Does it hurt?"

Yu Wan was quite robust among women. Even on her period, she wasn’t delicate. Not to mention now that she was the mistress; even when she was a servant, she could still work as usual.

"It doesn’t hurt, just a little bloated."

She lay on her side facing away from him, her dark hair spread like silk on the pillow.

Zhao Xuanyou rubbed his cheek gently against her hair, recalling how she used to be during her period in the past.

She had also said it didn’t hurt, but he remembered she would feel cold and would burrow into his arms while sleeping.

Summer was coming to an end. Although the sun was still fierce during the day, the nights already carried a hint of autumn chill.

Zhao Xuanyou reached back and felt her hand; it was indeed a little cold. He couldn’t help but hold her slender hand in his.

He had a warm constitution, and with him holding her tightly, it was like leaning against a warm stove. At times like this, it was indeed much more comfortable.

The light in the bed curtains was dim, his embrace warm and solid, making Yu Wan linger in the comfort.

Feeling Yu Wan snuggling closer, Zhao Xuanyou let out a slight sigh of relief.

"Stop overthinking. Go to sleep early."

Yu Wan had already opened her eyes. After lying quietly in his arms for a while, she softly said, "Earlier, while I was watching His Highness, I was indeed overthinking."

"What’s wrong?"

"If we also had a son as cute as him, I would definitely stay by his side, tell him stories, coax him to sleep, and watch him grow up little by little."

Zhao Xuanyou froze for a moment before tightening his hold on her.

"Soon, we will."

Yu Wan moved her lips silently, saying without a sound, "We already have."

Zhao Xuanyou waited for a long time without hearing her speak. He propped himself up to look at her.

In the darkness, Yu Wan’s eyes were half-open, looking as if she was both exhausted and unable to sleep.

"Stop overthinking. Our son won’t suffer such a fate. Both you and I will be by his side, watching him grow up slowly."

His tone was solemn, not just empty reassurance, but a promise to her and their child.

Yu Wan took a deep breath, and reason finally prevailed.

Every time her period came, her emotions were always prone to overflow. It was truly troublesome.

"I’m fine now. Let’s sleep."

After saying that, Yu Wan turned over and, as usual, fell asleep nestled in the crook of his neck.

Seeing her take this posture, Zhao Xuanyou understood that her emotions had passed. He also felt at ease and lay back down.

"Today, I helped His Highness write a letter to Huaiyue and prepared some things. Can they be sent to the prison cell tomorrow?"

"Yes."

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou agree so easily, Yu Wan thought for a moment before finishing her words.

"Do you think it’s possible to let His Highness the Imperial Grandson see Huaiyue one more time?"

Huaiyue seemed destined to die.

Yu Wan didn’t have much of a relationship with her, but she deeply empathized with the heartbreak of a mother and child being separated by life and death. So she wanted to do a little more for them.

---

chapters.title: Bearing the Consequences
chapters.content:
"I can’t promise you this, but I promise that if there’s an opportunity, I will mention it to His Majesty."

Zhao Xuanyou could see that Yu Wan was particularly concerned about Zhao Yi Yun. Combined with what Wen Shuo had said, it wasn’t hard to guess that Yu Wan’s earlier tears were also because of Zhao Yi Yun.

Zhao Yi Yun was Zhao Zun’s son, and Zhao Xuanyou didn’t have good feelings toward him.

Although he had no intention of harming Zhao Yi Yun, he absolutely didn’t want to take care of him.

From the very beginning, Zhao Xuanyou didn’t want Yu Wan to get involved in the affairs of the Eastern Palace. He was also quite angry at Pan Xun for deceiving them into returning to the capital.

Who would have thought that, by a twist of fate, Yu Wan had still taken on this hot potato.

Originally, he thought that once the chaos in the palace subsided a little, he would find an excuse to help Yu Wan resign from this task. But who knew that after just one day together, Yu Wan would already care so much for the child.

"Really?" Yu Wan, unaware of Zhao Xuanyou’s troubles, heard his words and her eyelashes trembled lightly. She leaned in and kissed him.

Seeing her look at him like this, Zhao Xuanyou should have felt pleased, but since her joy was for Zhao Yi Yun’s sake, his feelings were complicated.

"I can only promise to act when the opportunity arises. I can’t guarantee anything else."

"I know, I know." Yu Wan looked up, her eyes full of smiles. "I won’t make you do difficult things."

As she spoke in a soft, coquettish voice, Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t help but lift his hand to cup her cheek.

His fingertips brushed against her lips a few times before he finally suppressed his emotions.

Since she wasn’t feeling well today, he would let her sleep peacefully. He could analyze the pros and cons with her another day.

"By the way," Yu Wan suddenly remembered something, "how is the young county mistress from Princess Yinning’s family doing?"

"The Imperial Physicians have prepared an antidote for her. It was sent back to the princess’s residence yesterday."

"Can she be cured?"

"The physicians don’t dare say for sure. It seems the situation isn’t very good."

The young county mistress had been poisoned at almost the same time as the emperor. A few days later, the imperial physicians discovered that the emperor had been poisoned and immediately began preparing an antidote for him.

When the emperor was poisoned a second time, the young county mistress was also poisoned again.

Thanks to the efforts of the entire Imperial Physicians’ Office, the emperor’s life was no longer in danger. But the young county mistress was only a little over three years old. After dragging on for more than a month, it was truly too long.

"Have those two wet nurses who administered the poison confessed?"

"They have."

The empress and the crown prince were already in prison, their defeat inevitable. The wet nurses had no reason not to confess. The Brocade Guards didn’t even need to use torture; they spilled everything like beans from a pod.

It was more or less as they had previously suspected.

The empress, seeing how the emperor doted on his grandchildren, often holding Zhao Yi Yun and Yao Yao on his lap to play with them, and seeing their innocent and adorable expressions, couldn’t help but come up with this clever plan.

As the empress, it was easy for her to plant her people around the imperial children.

Someone as cautious as the Prince of Ping would naturally not use palace personnel, but Princess Yinning didn’t guard against the empress. Instead, she was pleased that Yao Yao had palace wet nurses to teach her, which gave the empress an opportunity.

The empress ordered the two wet nurses to mix the poison into a fragrant ointment, which they would apply to Yao Yao’s hair and face whenever she entered the palace.

No matter how strict the palace inspections were, they only checked what items were brought in.

Moreover, Yao Yao was the emperor’s only granddaughter and was only three years old. The guards and eunuchs wouldn’t inspect her too thoroughly, so she successfully carried the poison in and out of the palace.

After listening to Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Wan couldn’t help but shake her head. "Sure enough, only someone close to His Majesty could come up with such a poisonous scheme. Fortunately, His Majesty is safe, but it’s a pity for Yao Yao."

"Yesterday, Mo Han came to the palace to take Yao Yao. Since I’ve known him, I’ve never seen him look so lost and distraught."

In Zhao Xuanyou’s memory, Ye Mo Sun was born with a smile, always amiable. As long as he was around, one would never feel cold or lonely.

"In such matters, no one else’s comfort would help."

Zhao Xuanyou said, "That’s not entirely true."

"How so?"

"His Majesty has already issued a decree to hand those two wet nurses over to them for punishment."

"His Majesty’s decree?"

"Princess Yinning is nearly broken over this, and Mo Han isn’t doing well either. If they aren’t allowed to vent their emotions, it would be hard for them to get through this."

"Adults commit crimes, yet the children bear the consequences."

Seeing Yu Wan grow sad again, Zhao Xuanyou kissed her forehead.

"Don’t overthink. I won’t let anyone harm you or our child."

Yu Wan met his serious and candid gaze, and her own eyes cleared.

"I know. I was just lamenting for them, not worrying about myself."

Really not about herself?

She had cried twice today while watching Zhao Yi Yun. No matter how she looked at it, it didn’t seem like it was only for Zhao Yi Yun.

"Wanwan, go to sleep."

Yu Wan responded with an "mm" and shifted her soft body a little closer to Zhao Xuanyou.

Smelling the faint fragrance on her, Zhao Xuanyou restrained his desire for her, only holding her a little tighter without any further actions.

As their gentle breaths intertwined, both of them closed their eyes.

The next morning, when Yu Wan woke up, Zhao Xuanyou had already gotten up and left.

After she finished breakfast and went to see Zhao Yi Yun, Wen Shuo had already taken Zhao Yi Yun to play pitch-pot in the garden.

"Marquess’s wife." Upon seeing Yu Wan, Zhao Yi Yun called out to her in his childish voice, looking much better than the day before.

Yu Wan smiled and walked over, bending down to ask, "Did His Highness have a good breakfast today?"

"Yes." Zhao Yi Yun answered obediently, his long eyelashes fluttering twice as he stared straight at Yu Wan. "Marquess’s wife, the letter you helped me write yesterday..."

Zhao Xuanyou had agreed, but Yu Wan wasn’t sure if he had taken it to the prison.

She didn’t want to lie to Zhao Yi Yun, so she said, "I already told the marquis about it yesterday. His Highness can rest assured. He keeps his word."

"Your Highness, do you want to continue playing?" Wen Shuo asked.

"Yes."

Zhao Yi Yun, having received Yu Wan’s assurance, turned his head with a relieved expression and continued the pitch-pot game with Wen Shuo.

Seeing that he was willing to let Wen Shuo take him to play, Yu Wan let out a slight sigh of relief.

Although she didn’t suffer from stomachaches during her period, her stomach was always bloated, and her body felt a little lazy.

Seeing the two of them playing happily, Yu Wan had a eunuch bring over a chair. She sat under the shade of a tree, watching them play.

As Wen Shuo had said before, the crown prince liked having him by his side. Now it seemed that like father, like son; Zhao Yi Yun also quite liked Wen Shuo.

The imperial palace and the court were in turmoil due to the empress and the crown prince both being imprisoned. However, the Western Garden, under the emperor’s protection, remained quite peaceful.

Apart from Zhao Xuanyou, no one else could enter or leave the Western Garden.

Yu Wan had been staying in the Western Garden with Zhao Yi Yun for over a month. During this time, with Zhao Xuanyou’s help, she had sent many foods and clothes to Zhuang Huaiyue in prison. Although they never managed to arrange a meeting between mother and son, Zhao Yi Yun’s mood gradually settled.

One day, while Yu Wan was in the study with Zhao Yi Yun, drawing pictures, a eunuch suddenly came to report.

"Marquess’s wife, someone from the Qianqing Palace has arrived."

chapters.title: Reuniting with Prince Rui
chapters.content:
"Did they say what it was about?" Yu Wan asked.

The eunuch replied, "His Majesty misses the Imperial Grandson and has ordered the Marchioness to bring the Imperial Grandson to the Hall of Heavenly Purity for a talk."

Having lived in the Western Garden for over a month, the Hall of Heavenly Purity had sent many toys and delicacies, but the Emperor had never summoned Zhao Yi Yun.

"I... I don't want to go," Zhao Yi Yun suddenly said, afraid.

The Emperor summoning Zhao Yi Yun was a good thing; it showed he still cared for his grandson.

But Yu Wan was not surprised by Zhao Yi Yun's reaction.

Zhao Yi Yun had witnessed the Emperor order the Jin Yi Wei to arrest his grandmother and father, and knew even his own mother had been captured. Naturally, he feared this grandfather who had once doted on him.

Yu Wan said to the eunuch, "The Imperial Grandson needs to change his clothes. Go inform the Hall of Heavenly Purity that we will be there shortly."

"Yes."

After the eunuch respectfully retreated, Yu Wan pulled Zhao Yi Yun into her arms and softly asked, "Are you afraid of the Emperor?"

Zhao Yi Yun nodded slightly.

"Do you want to see Consort Zhuang?"

"Yes. Of course."

Yu Wan sighed lightly and rubbed Zhao Yi Yun's little head. "Your Emperor Grandfather is the Son of Heaven; all matters under the sky are decided by him. If you want to see your mother, you must go see him."

"The Emperor won't agree," Zhao Yi Yun recalled that day, his eyes quickly reddening. "I begged him so much, but he still arrested the Empress Dowager and Father."

"They did wrong, so His Majesty could not forgive them. But your mother did nothing wrong. When we get to the Hall of Heavenly Purity, don't plead for your grandmother and father again. Just tell the Emperor that you haven't seen your mother in a long time and miss her."

"Will the Emperor agree then?"

Zhuang Huaiyue was a Consort of the Eastern Palace, but she indeed had not participated in the Empress's and Crown Prince's schemes. The Emperor was aware of this.

It wasn't as if they were asking the Emperor to pardon Zhuang Huaiyue; they only wanted a meeting between mother and son. As long as the Emperor still cared for Zhao Yi Yun, he should agree.

"The Emperor's mind is hard to fathom; I cannot guarantee it. But if the Prince does not try..."

Zhao Yi Yun, hearing this, tightly grabbed Yu Wan's arm. "Then I will never see my mother again?"

"Of course not."

He was still too young; many things couldn't be said too bluntly.

Yu Wan thought for a moment and changed her approach. "Maybe this time His Majesty won't agree, but next time, the Prince can try again. The other day when we were reading, there was a saying: 'Nothing in the world is difficult for one who sets his mind to it.' The Prince wants to see Consort Zhuang. As long as you don't give up, you will see her eventually, right?"

"Mmm." Zhao Yi Yun, encouraged by Yu Wan, nodded heavily.

Seeing that he had been persuaded, Yu Wan slightly relaxed. She quickly changed him into more formal clothes and, along with Wen Bo, left the Western Garden, following the eunuch to the Hall of Heavenly Purity.

The road from the Western Garden to the Hall of Heavenly Purity was not short, and along the way, they encountered many guards and palace servants.

Zhao Yi Yun had once been favored and often ran and played throughout the palace. Almost everyone in the palace knew him.

Now, as they passed, people bowed to him in respect.

However, after they passed, those people would point and whisper about Zhao Yi Yun.

Zhao Yi Yun was a sensitive child. After encountering this a few times, he naturally noticed and his eyes quickly dimmed.

"Marchioness, I don't want to go to the Hall of Heavenly Purity anymore."

"Why?"

Zhao Yi Yun lowered his head. "They look at me so strangely. I don't want to be looked at like that. I want to go back to the Western Garden."

"Don't you want to see Consort Zhuang anymore?"

He did, of course.

This situation was indeed too complex for a four-year-old child.

Yu Wan looked at his downcast and sad expression, bent down, and picked him up.

"Don't worry, I'm with you. If anyone dares to look at you like that again, I'll scold them."

"Really?"

"Let's pinky promise." Yu Wan smiled and nodded.

The group continued forward and indeed encountered more pointing and whispering palace servants.

Yu Wan kept her word and scolded them sharply.

Given her status, she naturally had no right to reprimand people in the palace. However, Zhao Yi Yun was still the Imperial Grandson, and their disrespect towards him was an act of insubordination.

Being in the wrong, they immediately knelt and apologized to Zhao Yi Yun.

The eunuchs of the Hall of Heavenly Purity saw Yu Wan standing up for Zhao Yi Yun and ordered the offenders to go to the managing eunuch for punishment.

Zhao Yi Yun tightly hugged Yu Wan's neck, his cheek pressed against her hair.

He didn't understand many grand principles, but he knew that Yu Wan had saved his life from Princess Yining, and today she prevented him from being mocked by the palace servants.

"It's alright. Anyone who disrespects you will be punished."

Yu Wan gently patted Zhao Yi Yun's back, softly comforting him.

Zhao Yi Yun nodded slightly. With the Marchioness by his side, he indeed felt less afraid.

Yu Wan carried Zhao Yi Yun and continued forward.

As they neared the Hall of Heavenly Purity, the eunuch beside them suddenly knelt and greeted, "Your Highness."

Yu Wan followed the sound and looked up, her gaze meeting the person opposite. Both were somewhat surprised.

"Uncle Seven." Zhao Yi Yun turned his head and, seeing that the newcomer was Zhao Qi, blurted out.

"Your servant greets Prince Rui."

Zhao Qi must have also returned to the capital upon learning of the Emperor's indisposition.

"You need not be so courteous, Marchioness."

Prince Rui had been back in the capital for several days and had met Zhao Xuanyou in the palace a couple of times. He knew she was now the Marchioness of Jingyuan.

Dressed in a crimson brocade robe with intricate embroidery on the chest and collar, and a jade belt of excellent quality around his waist, he exuded an air of nobility.

He was eighteen this year, his face still bearing the vigor of youth, but his eyes were softer than before, especially in front of Yu Wan.

However, he didn't dare to linger his gaze on Yu Wan, turning instead to Zhao Yi Yun and asking in a deep voice, "Yi Yun, I heard you were injured. Are you better now?"

"It's healed."

When Princess Yining had tried to stab Zhao Yi Yun with a golden hairpin, she had used all her strength. Fortunately, he was lucky, and the first strike had only hit his shoulder.

After more than a month of recovery, the wound had healed, though the bone still ached slightly.

"Are you also going to the Hall of Heavenly Purity?" Zhao Qi asked again.

This time, Yu Wan answered, "Yes, His Majesty has summoned the Imperial Grandson."

"I am also going to the Hall of Heavenly Purity. Yi Yun, let your seventh uncle carry you." Zhao Qi reached out to Zhao Yi Yun.

Although the Crown Prince and Zhao Qi had always had a poor relationship, Zhao Yi Yun inexplicably liked this young uncle and was always willing to be close to him in the palace.

However, after so many things had happened, even the Emperor, who had doted on him the most, had arrested his father and mother. Princess Yining had even tried to kill him with a hairpin. Zhao Yi Yun was now a bit afraid of his former relatives.

"It's just ahead to the Hall of Heavenly Purity. There's no need to trouble Your Highness; I can carry the Prince."

Zhao Qi saw that Zhao Yi Yun was afraid and did not insist, merely nodding as he walked with them toward the Hall of Heavenly Purity.

"Did Your Highness also receive an imperial decree to enter the palace?" Yu Wan couldn't help but ask.

Rarely hearing Yu Wan initiate conversation with him, Zhao Qi turned to look at her and said, "Yes."

Yu Wan, however, did not look at him, only slightly furrowing her brows.

It was unlikely to be a coincidence that they were both going to the Hall of Heavenly Purity at the same time.

Could it be that the Emperor's summons for Zhao Yi Yun was not as simple as just having a talk?

---

chapters.title: Cutting the Weeds and Eliminating the Roots
chapters.content:
Yu Wan looked up ahead, gazing at the magnificent palace halls and layered eaves in the distance, and couldn't help but feel a little nervous.

Once inside the Hall of Heavenly Purity, Zhao Yi Yun's fate would be entirely in the Emperor's hands; it was beyond her control.

She followed Zhao Qi forward, neither of them speaking.

The eunuchs guarding the door saw their arrival but did not announce them, directly leading them inside.

Inside the Hall of Heavenly Purity, the Emperor was currently wearing a bright yellow casual robe, sipping tea from a cup.

There were many people standing in the hall at the moment, all surrounded by pearls and jade, radiant and resplendent.

Yu Wan glanced and only recognized Prince Ping and Princess Yian.

She didn't dare to look further, quickly lowering her gaze as she carried Zhao Yi Yun forward, following Zhao Qi in bowing to the Emperor.

The Emperor had doted on Zhao Yi Yun for over four years, and the bond between grandfather and grandson was deep.

After such a huge incident, having not seen each other for over a month, the Emperor missed his little grandson. However, times had changed, and he could no longer disregard others' feelings by picking up Zhao Yi Yun for a hug and kiss.

"Everyone, take a seat."

Seeing that Yu Wan was still holding Zhao Yi Yun, the Emperor bestowed special favor by granting seats to everyone in the hall.

Yu Wan glanced at the clothing of the people in the hall. Seeing that Prince Ping was closest to the Emperor and Zhao Qi was at the far end, she knew the two in the middle must be Prince Jing and Prince Qing.

On the other side, sitting with Princess Yian, was a beautiful woman in a crimson palace dress, exuding elegance and nobility. Her age was similar to the Emperor's, so she was likely Consort Li, Prince Ping's mother.

Zhao Xuanyou had mentioned to Yu Wan that Consort Li came from a humble background but had served the Emperor for a long time. Although she was not particularly favored, her status in the palace was not low because she had given birth to Prince Ping.

After Empress Jiang was imprisoned, the Emperor entrusted the responsibility of managing the harem to Consort Li.

The surroundings were the same as the last time Yu Wan had been here, but the hall was now filled with luxurious attire, and the atmosphere was entirely different.

Especially Consort Li and Prince Ping, whose expressions were relaxed and content.

With Empress Jiang and Zhao Zhen left with only the path of death, and with the virtuous and gentle Consort Li in the harem, along with Prince Ping, who assisted in managing court affairs, the mother and son's future was bound to be immeasurably noble.

"Father Emperor still favors his grandson. Earlier, you made your son and brothers stand while speaking, but now that Yi Yun is here, we get to sit as well."

Princess Yian had not had a smooth life after marriage and had become increasingly uninhibited in her speech and actions.

The Emperor glanced at her, but the smile in her eyes did not diminish in the slightest, though she did not continue speaking.

"Yi Yun, does your injury still hurt?" the Emperor asked gently.

However, hearing the Emperor speak to him, Zhao Yi Yun still instinctively trembled.

"Don't be afraid," Yu Wan whispered in Zhao Yi Yun's ear without moving her lips.

Zhao Yi Yun quietly looked up at the Emperor and softly said, "It doesn't hurt anymore."

"Princess Yining was really something. How could she bear to strike Yi Yun so heavily?" Consort Li knew the Emperor doted on Zhao Yi Yun and, seeing the Emperor's gentle gaze, added, "This concubine sees that Yi Yun is not as lively as before. It seems keeping him confined in the Western Garden is not good."

"What else can we do if we don't confine him?" Princess Yian glanced at Zhao Yi Yun, her expression somewhat complex.

In the imperial family, the feelings between brothers and sisters were naturally not pure.

Both Yian and Yining were the Emperor's daughters, pampered princesses with fine clothes and food. But for the long-term, they had always carefully tried to gain the favor of the Empress and the Crown Prince.

However, they had not expected the Empress to use Yining's daughter to poison the Emperor.

She had visited Yining's residence with a hint of schadenfreude, but seeing Yao Yao's poisoned, foolish state had touched a sore spot.

After currying favor with the Empress for so long, if one day the Empress needed to poison her to contend for the throne, she feared the Empress would not hesitate for a moment.

"Father Emperor, everyone in the Eastern Palace has been imprisoned and interrogated. Yi Yun is the Crown Prince's only son. How can he be an exception?"

Princess Yian's words clearly carried some resentment.

Her relationship with Princess Yining had always been somewhat delicate; both inseparable and mutually competitive.

But thinking of Yao Yao's dull expression and her stupid sister daring to try to kill someone with a hairpin, Princess Yian also had the idea of seeking justice for her and Yao Yao.

The Empress had been so cruel, showing no regard for years of filial piety, treating them sisters like weeds. How could the bloodline left by the Empress be spared?

"Do you want to lock Yi Yun up?" the Emperor asked, displeased.

Princess Yian's gaze did not waver in the slightest.

"Isn't that what Father Emperor is thinking?"

Prince Ping looked at Princess Yian, his eyebrows twitching slightly, feeling quite pleased internally.

Of course, he wished Zhao Yi Yun would be locked up with Zhao Zhen.

To cut the weeds, one must eliminate the roots; otherwise, they would grow back with the spring wind.

However, he was not the Crown Prince after all. He was the closest to the throne but had not yet obtained it.

If the Emperor favored Zhao Yi Yun and wanted to protect him, he could endure for the greater good, allowing Zhao Yi Yun to live a little longer, until the Emperor's passing.

He had originally planned to put on a show of an uncle caring for his nephew in front of the Emperor but had not expected Princess Yian to jump out and do what he truly wanted to accomplish.

He lightly coughed, doing his best to suppress his inner joy, and hypocritically advised in a slow voice, "Yi Yun is Father Emperor's only grandson. He is only four years old and innocent. What crime has he committed?"

Princess Yian sneered, "If he is innocent, then what about Yao Yao from Princess Yining's family? She is even younger than him by a year."

"But Yi Yun indeed did not participate in the plot to harm Father Emperor," Prince Jing Zhao Lin couldn't help but interject.

He didn't have much ambition to contest for the throne but felt that it was unnecessary to completely exterminate the imperial descendants for their mistakes.

"Then what about the eunuchs and palace maids in the Eastern Palace who cooked and served meals? Did they participate in the plot to harm Father Emperor? If we are to pardon the innocent, then we should release them all as well."

Prince Ping had not expected that his sister, who usually only knew how to gather scholars and literati for drinking and composing poetry, would have such excellent debating skills.

He pretended to be unable to counter Princess Yian's argument, frowning as if troubled. "What Royal Sister says makes sense. Jiang and Zhao Zhen attempted to regicide, and the people of the Prince of Zhen Nation's Mansion and the Eastern Palace are indeed guilty by association. However, Yi Yun is Zhao Zhen's son and has survived. If this spreads, it may indeed invite criticism of Father Emperor."

"Criticism of what?" The Emperor's eyes darkened, clearly displeased.

"Father Emperor, your son does not agree with Royal Sister's words. Yi Yun is young and of imperial blood. How can he be compared to those servants? However..." Prince Ping paused before continuing, "Father Emperor has already issued a decree to depose Jiang and Zhao Zhen. It is indeed inappropriate for Yi Yun to remain in the palace as the Imperial Grandson."

chapters.title: The Path Forward
chapters.content:
"Indeed." Princess Yi'an spoke again, "If Father Emperor continues to let Yi'Yun live a life of luxury in the palace as an imperial grandson, Yi'ning will not accept it, and neither will I!"

"Silence!" The Emperor, seeing Yi'an pressing step by step, was also angered.

Consort Li saw this and quickly stood up, walking to the side of the dragon throne, gently patting the Emperor's back to soothe him. "Your Majesty, please calm down. Yi'an is only speaking recklessly because of her deep sisterly bond with Yi'ning."

"I am not speaking recklessly." Princess Yi'an said, suddenly turning around to look at Zhao Yi'Yun, her eyes filled with severity. But she turned back to the Emperor, "Father Emperor, I know that in your heart, Yi'ning and I will never compare to my brothers, and even Yao Yao, your granddaughter, cannot compare to Zhao Yi'Yun, your grandson. I can endure it, and Yi'ning can too. But what about Yao Yao? She has already been poisoned into foolishness! You promised to seek justice for her, but then you let the son of the culprit continue to live in the palace as an imperial grandson. What kind of justice is this?"

Princess Yi'an's voice was filled with anger, and the majestic Qianqing Palace fell into a moment of silence.

Feeling Zhao Yi'Yun trembling in fear in her arms, Yu Wan could only hold him tighter.

In this situation, she had no right to speak. Apart from holding Zhao Yi'Yun, she could do nothing but wait and see.

After a moment, the Emperor said softly, "Jiang and Zhao Zun violated the national law, and the Three Courts will determine their crimes. The servants of Kunning Palace, the Eastern Palace, and the Zhen Guo Duke's residence will also be dealt with according to their crimes. But Yi'Yun is of Zhao's bloodline. Today, I have gathered you all here to discuss together how to arrange for Yi'Yun in the future."

"I have already said what needed to be said." Princess Yi'an finished speaking and sat back down on her chair, coldly staring at the Emperor.

The Emperor did not say anything more to her, shifting his gaze to Prince Ping, Prince Jing, Prince Qing, and Prince Rui.
