Prince Ping met the Emperor's gaze without flinching and respectfully said, "Yi'Yun is young and should not be implicated in Jiang and Zhao Zun's crimes. However, I believe that Yi'Yun is indeed not suitable to be raised in the palace. He should be demoted to a commoner and expelled from the royal palace as a form of punishment."

"If Yi'Yun were fourteen instead of four, I would agree with you. But at his age now, if we send him out of the palace, would he even survive until tomorrow?" Consort Li now also understood her son's intentions.

The Emperor's feelings for Zhao Yi'Yun were too deep. If he were to stay in the palace and the Emperor remained healthy, who knew what would happen in the future. Even if they couldn't kill Zhao Yi'Yun now, they had to send him away as soon as possible so that the Emperor could never see him again.

"Your Majesty speaks truly. Yi'Yun is too young and needs someone to take care of him. However, his grandmother and father are both heinous criminals. Even if we keep him in the palace, he will be criticized in the future. It would be better to..." Consort Li said.

"Better to what?" The Emperor looked at Consort Li with a cold expression.

Consort Li was somewhat afraid of his gaze and quickly lowered her head. "This concubine was thinking, perhaps we could send Yi'Yun to the White Horse Temple to be under the care of Master Xuan Jing. Not only would he be influenced by Buddhist teachings, but the monks would also take care of him. And when Your Majesty goes to the White Horse Temple to burn incense, you can still visit him."

"No! I don't want to go!" Zhao Yi'Yun had been listening to his relatives in the hall arguing, and his heart was already filled with fear. Now, hearing Consort Li suggest sending him to the temple, he was so scared that he shouted at the Emperor, his voice trembling. "Imperial Grandfather, I don't want to go to the temple. I'm afraid of those Buddha statues."

"Silly child, Buddha saves all beings. What is there to be afraid of?" Consort Li softly laughed at Zhao Yi'Yun, then lowered her head and whispered to the Emperor, "This child has been with Jiang for too long and may have been led astray. He is even disrespectful to Buddha. It's best to send him to Master Xuan Jing as soon as possible to resolve the resentment in his heart."

Yu Wan's heart sank as she glanced at Consort Li. She suddenly understood why Empress Jiang was so cruel and domineering, yet Consort Li had managed to survive in the palace for twenty years, not only raising her son safely but also holding the position of a noble consort.

She appeared gentle and modest, but she was actually hiding a sharp edge, subtly manipulating people's hearts.

Would His Majesty send Yi'Yun to the temple?

Yu Wan felt anxious but had no solution.

The Emperor had gathered the princes and princesses in the Qianqing Palace today, clearly seriously considering Zhao Yi'Yun's future.

He didn't want to keep Zhao Yi'Yun in the palace either.

"Father Emperor." Zhao Qi, who had been silent, suddenly spoke.

"Qi'er, what do you think?" The Emperor asked.

Zhao Qi stood up. "Is the reason we want to send Yi'Yun out of the palace just because he is Zhao Zun's son?"

"What else could it be?" Before the Emperor could speak, Princess Yi'an interjected, "Jiang and Zhao Zun plotted to harm Father Emperor, a heinous crime. But Zhao Yi'Yun may not think they are guilty. If we let him go, when he grows up, who knows if he won't seek to avenge them and cause trouble? The future consequences would be endless!"

Prince Ping's eyebrows twitched, silently agreeing with Princess Yi'an's words, though naturally, what he said was different.

"Yi'Yun is still young. There is still a chance to correct him. Mother Consort's suggestion to send him to White Horse Temple is well-considered."

Princes Jing and Qing did not insist on implicating Zhao Yi'Yun like Princess Yi'an, but they also did not think Zhao Yi'Yun should continue to be an imperial grandson in the palace. Hearing Consort Li and Prince Ping's words, they also felt that sending him to White Horse Temple was a good suggestion.

"Father Emperor, I think Third Brother's suggestion is good."

"I agree."

White Horse Temple was a place outside the secular world. If Zhao Yi'Yun went there, it would be acceptable to no longer pursue his worldly crimes.

The Emperor did not respond to their words, only looking at Zhao Qi.

"Qi'er, what do you want to say?"

"If Yi'Yun is guilty only because he is Zhao Zun's son, then I am willing to adopt Yi'Yun as my own son."

"Zhao Qi, have you gone mad?" Princess Yi'an said in astonishment, looking at Zhao Qi. "Have you forgotten how Jiang and Zhao Zun treated you?"

They were the two people Zhao Qi hated the most. Their downfall made Zhao Qi happier than anyone else.

But Zhao Qi couldn't explain why he wanted to stand up for Yi'Yun.

Perhaps it was because he had never directed his anger at Yi'Yun, or perhaps it was because Yi'Yun always called him Seventh Uncle in a childish voice, or maybe it was because he saw the anxiety in Yu Wan's expression...

Yu Wan also looked at Zhao Qi in astonishment.

He actually wanted to adopt Zhao Yi'Yun?

"This is probably not appropriate." Consort Li, seeing Zhao Qi wanting to adopt Zhao Yi'Yun, also became somewhat anxious. If Zhao Qi took him to the Prince Rui's residence, it would be difficult to deal with Zhao Yi'Yun in the future.

Moreover, Zhao Qi was already favored by the Emperor. Now he was forcefully protecting Zhao Yi'Yun, perhaps it was another means to please the Emperor without regard for consequences.

"Why does Consort think it is inappropriate?" Zhao Qi raised his eyebrows and asked.

Consort Li quickly composed herself, restoring her gentle and dignified demeanor, and softly said, "You are only eighteen years old and have not yet married. You are still a child yourself. How can you take care of a child?"

chapters.title: A Perfect Solution
chapters.content:
Mentioning marriage, Zhao Qi's eyes flickered for a moment before quickly returning to normal. He seriously said, "Although I have not yet married, Father Emperor has already arranged a marriage for me, and I will soon be able to marry. At that time, the Princess Consort can also help me raise Yi'Yun."

"Silly child," Consort Li looked at Zhao Qi with a concerned expression, "You do not even have your own son yet. If Yi'Yun is adopted by you, he will become your eldest son and inherit your prince title in the future."

Although she had ill intentions, her words were indeed reasonable.

Zhao Yi'Yun was the eldest imperial grandson. If he were adopted by Zhao Qi, not only would he inherit Zhao Qi's title, but he would also be the eldest son in any of the other three princes' residences.

Prince Ping need not be mentioned. Even Princes Jing and Qing would not adopt Zhao Yi'Yun into their own families out of sympathy.

Zhao Qi frowned and was about to speak when he saw the Emperor wave his hand. "Consort Li speaks reason. There is no need to discuss this further."

Jiang and Zhao Zun's attempt to usurp the throne was a fact. Although Zhao Yi'Yun carried the royal bloodline, he indeed could not be adopted as the eldest son of any prince's residence.

What the Emperor sought was only to let him live out his life in peace.

Yu Wan listened to their words and suddenly had an idea.

Adopting him to Zhao Qi was indeed inappropriate, but listening to the conversation in the hall, Yu Wan suddenly thought of a more appropriate solution.

However, her status did not allow her to speak in this situation.

She desperately looked at Zhao Qi. Zhao Qi felt her gaze and was somewhat puzzled.

How could she tell him?

Yu Wan felt distressed.

She and Zhao Qi were too far apart to communicate directly.

However, she was holding Zhao Yi'Yun in her arms. Maybe she could use his small body as a cover to gesture.

In any case, Yu Wan decided to try.

She stared straight at Zhao Qi, desperately winking at him. But Zhao Qi didn't know what was wrong with him. His gaze wandered everywhere but never landed on her.

Yu Wan felt helpless but could only silently watch him.

Princess Yi'an was still persuading the Emperor to lock Zhao Yi'Yun up in prison. Prince Ping was coldly making sarcastic remarks.

Zhao Qi had long known that in this palace, apart from Father Emperor, no one would care about kinship.

Everyone present was dressed in fine silks and adorned with gold and jade, but each had a cold and ruthless heart; except for her.

Zhao Qi couldn't help but look at Yu Wan again. This time, their eyes met.

Yu Wan blinked at him repeatedly, clearly having something to say, but this was not the place to speak.

Zhao Qi remained silent, only looking at her blankly.

Yu Wan's expression remained calm as she subtly pointed at Zhao Qi.

Zhao Qi saw her quietly gesturing and looked up, pretending to listen to the Emperor while using his peripheral vision to watch her.

Yu Wan then gestured the number "seven."

He was the seventh prince. Zhao Qi lightly blinked, indicating that he understood.

Yu Wan then gestured the number "four" and pointed at Zhao Yi'Yun before quickly clenching her fist to hide her hand, afraid that someone would notice her actions.

Four?

Zhao Yi'Yun was the eldest imperial grandson. How could he be four?

Who else in the palace was related to the number four?

Zhao Qi's fourth brother had passed away at the age of seven. He... Zhao Qi suddenly realized. She wanted Yi'Yun to be adopted by his deceased fourth brother.

This was feasible.

Zhao Qi pondered for a moment, made up his mind, and stood up again.

"Father Emperor, I have thought of a perfect solution that can both save Yi'Yun's life and avoid criticism."

The Emperor knew that Zhao Zun and Zhao Qi had been at odds in the past, each wanting the other dead. Seeing Zhao Qi repeatedly speaking up for Zhao Yi'Yun today made him feel greatly relieved.

The child he valued was kind after all.

"Qi'er, let's hear it."

"My fourth brother passed away at the age of seven. Consort Feng has never recovered from her grief. If we adopt Yi'Yun under my fourth brother's name and have Consort Feng raise him, it would both continue my fourth brother's lineage and bring some comfort to Consort Feng."

"This..." The Emperor slightly furrowed his brows, falling into deep thought.

Adopting him under the name of the deceased fourth prince and having Consort Feng raise him would allow Zhao Yi'Yun to live in the palace with a legitimate reason.

Zhao Qi's suggestion was something the Emperor had not considered.

Consort Li spoke softly, "Although Yi'Yun is a naive child, he is after all the descendant of a traitor. Adopting him out to inherit a prince title may not be appropriate."

"My fourth brother was not granted a prince title and had no fiefdom or prince residence for Yi'Yun to inherit. Adopting Yi'Yun under my fourth brother's name would only be a nominal gesture. For now, while he is still young, imperial grace can allow him to stay in the palace with Consort Feng. When he is older and can take care of himself, he can be sent out of the palace to make his own way."

As long as the Emperor lived, the palace would be the safest place in the world for Zhao Yi'Yun.

Regardless of whether Consort Feng would raise him well, they needed a reason for Zhao Yi'Yun to stay in the palace now.

He had specifically gathered the imperial family in the Qianqing Palace to come up with a solution.

Zhao Qi's suggestion was obviously better than what the Emperor had expected.

His expression softened a lot, and when he looked at his children again, his gaze was also gentle.

"Huan'er, what do you think?" The Emperor asked Prince Ping.

Prince Ping naturally did not agree, but he was only one step away from the position of crown prince and would not risk losing everything over a small matter like Zhao Yi'Yun.

Since the Emperor had asked him, he immediately put on the demeanor of an elder brother and said with a smile, "I think Seventh Brother's idea is perfect."

Seeing Prince Ping say this, Consort Li understood her son's intentions and did not speak further, only adding, "Consort Feng has been in poor health since losing her son. Taking care of Yi'Yun may be too much for her."

"This is a minor matter. There are so many people in Consort Feng's palace. She won't be burdened. Moreover, the Princess Consort of Jingyuan Hou is there to help."

As soon as the Emperor finished speaking, everyone in the hall turned their gaze to Yu Wan again.

Yu Wan kept her eyes forward, holding Zhao Yi'Yun and sitting upright.

"You have taken care of Yi'Yun for more than a month. He is also familiar with you. Suddenly sending him to Consort Feng may be difficult for him. You can go to Jingyang Palace with him for a while. After he becomes familiar with Consort Feng, you can leave the palace."

"I will do my best to assist Your Majesty and Consort Feng." Yu Wan held Zhao Yi'Yun and bowed.

Princess Yi'an looked at Yu Wan with a cold smile, but since the Emperor had made his decision, she did not dare to be presumptuous.

"All of you may leave. I need to finish drinking my medicine."

After speaking for so long, the Emperor was already tired.

The poison given to him by the Empress was actually very potent. Fortunately, the director of the Imperial Physicians discovered it early, otherwise, he would have ended up like Princess Yi'ning's daughter, foolish and silly.

However, he was old, and after this ordeal, his vitality was greatly weakened, and his energy was far less than before.

Consort Li saw this and respectfully stood up to support the Emperor towards the inner hall.

"All of you may leave. Do not disturb Father Emperor's rest."

The Emperor had entrusted all state affairs to Prince Ping and the two prime ministers. The siblings understood that Prince Ping had already gained power and did not dare to interact as they had before, looking to him for guidance in everything.

Yu Wan held Zhao Yi'Yun and followed behind them as they exited the Qianqing Palace.

Just as they descended the steps, Princess Yi'an, who was walking ahead, suddenly stopped and turned to look at Yu Wan with a proud smile.

"I remember who you are now.

chapters.title: Public Confession
chapters.content:
Princess Yi'an's voice was not low, and as soon as she spoke, everyone present showed surprise, all looking towards Yu Yuan.

Zhao Qi knew that Princess Yi'an had met Yu Yuan before and saw that she was causing trouble for Yu Yuan, so he slightly raised his eyebrows.

"This is the Qianqing Palace. Royal Sister, please do not make a scene here."

"Huh? Seventh Brother, you used to follow Zhao Xuanyou everywhere back then. You should be very clear about her background, right?"

Prince Ping only knew that Zhao Xuanyou had gone through a lot of trouble to marry his current wife. Since he had the intention to befriend Zhao Xuanyou, upon hearing Princess Yi'an's words, he also spoke to stop her.

"Father Emperor is unwell. If there's anything to say, do it outside the palace."

"If you want to leave, you can leave quickly. I haven't finished speaking yet."

Seeing that Princess Yi'an had no intention of backing down and was staring at her intently, Yu Yuan remained calm.

"May I ask what instructions the Princess has?"

"Aren't you the maid who followed Zhao Xuanyou to the Lichuan Summer Palace years ago? After a few years apart, you've become a merchant's daughter, transforming from a concubine maid to a marchioness, entering the Qianqing Palace. Do you know this is a crime of deceiving the Emperor?"

Upon hearing this, Zhao Qi immediately angrily said, "What crime of deceiving the Emperor! It's broad daylight, Royal Sister, don't go mad in the palace!"

"Hmph, back then you were already fooled by a maid, and now she's become a marchioness. You wouldn't still be thinking of marrying her as your princess consort, would you?"

"Please do not speak nonsense." Before Zhao Qi could say more, Yu Yuan spoke first, neither servile nor overbearing. "This subject's wife was indeed a concubine maid of the Marquis in the past and did follow the Marquis to the Lichuan Summer Palace. Later, this subject's wife redeemed herself and left the Marquis's mansion, following her mother and younger brother to engage in trade in Jiangnan and Yuzhou. After reuniting with the Marquis in Yuzhou, we decided to marry. These are not shameful matters. Even if we were before the Emperor, this subject's wife would answer the same way."

Yu Yuan's voice was gentle, and there was a faint smile on her face. She did not change color even when mentioning the words "concubine maid."

Prince Ping slightly raised his eyebrows and looked at Yu Yuan with newfound respect.

Initially, he knew that Zhao Xuanyou had even disregarded his future for a woman. Now, seeing this side of Yu Yuan, he somewhat understood.

This woman was indeed extraordinary.

Prince Ping was about to speak when he suddenly caught sight of a black figure quickly approaching from the side, with robes fluttering like a flying hawk.

He inwardly sneered. He had arrived quickly.

"If the Princess has any doubts, feel free to direct them at this subject. There is no need to harass this subject's wife."

Zhao Xuanyou's figure flew over and stood beside Yu Yuan, putting one arm around her waist.

Although his words were still respectful, his tone was quite heavy.

Princess Yi'an heard him say that she was harassing Yu Yuan and immediately felt angry. But when she met Zhao Xuanyou's dark and gloomy gaze, she suddenly felt a chill run down her spine.

Zhao Xuanyou was a military general who had personally killed countless enemies on the battlefield. The killing intent around him was very strong.

Princess Yi'an had been pampered and accustomed to luxury. Being stared at like that by him, she almost shivered.

She took a few deep breaths, barely steadying her mind, and angrily said, "Zhao Xuanyou, you are being presumptuous! This Princess is just curious about how a concubine maid could transform into a marchioness. What harassment? Nonsense!"

"Since the Princess is so curious, this subject can only tell the truth," Zhao Xuanyou pulled Yu Yuan closer to him and said with a frown, "This subject has admired Yuan for a long time and is devoted to her alone. In this life, I only have eyes for her. Even if she was a maid, in this subject's heart, she is worth a hundred times more than others. I will not marry anyone but her."

Zhao Xuanyou spoke with conviction, and for a moment, everyone around him was stunned.

Yu Yuan was no exception.

Yu Yuan had never doubted Zhao Xuanyou's feelings for her.

But this was the imperial palace, the front of the Qianqing Palace. These were not just guards and palace servants; even the few people in front of them were members of the imperial family.

Zhao Xuanyou had actually said such things in front of them!

This was truly beyond Yu Yuan's expectations.

Just now, when Princess Yi'an had shouted that she was a concubine maid, Yu Yuan had not been afraid. But now, after hearing Zhao Xuanyou's words, Yu Yuan felt a bit embarrassed.

She did not dare to look at the people around her, feeling her ears burning, and instinctively lowered her head.

"Marquis, just now Aunt Yi'an bullied the Marchioness."

Zhao Yi Yun softly said to Zhao Xuanyou.

"I know." Zhao Xuanyou finished speaking, and anger reignited in his eyes. He coldly looked at Princess Yi'an. "Yuan is my wife and has the Emperor's decree. The Princess should treat her with respect. If there is any more verbal abuse or unreasonable trouble, this subject will not fear the crime of a subordinate offending a superior!"

If it was said that Zhao Xuanyou's tone had been angry but his words still restrained before, now his words were filled with threats!

"You dare threaten me? Zhao Xuanyou, what do you think you are..."

"Enough!" Seeing that Princess Yi'an's face had turned pale with anger, Prince Ping spoke before the situation escalated further. "Yi'an, today it was indeed you who spoke disrespectfully to the Marchioness."

"I am a princess. What can't I say? Besides, she used to be..."

Zhao Qi had just been immersed in the shock of Zhao Xuanyou's bold declaration to Yu Yuan in public.

He had not expected that Zhao Xuanyou, of all people, would publicly declare his feelings for Yu Yuan in front of everyone.

Seeing that Princess Yi'an still would not let it go, Zhao Qi collected his thoughts and coldly said, "I heard that every time the Princess holds a gathering at her mansion, there are at least four or five scholars and literati staying overnight, for as short as two or three days, or as long as a month or two. Since the Princess likes to gossip so much, why doesn't she tell us what she does with these outsiders in her mansion?"

As soon as he finished speaking, Prince Jing and Prince Qing could not help but laugh.

It was already an open secret in the capital that Princess Yi'an kept male favorites. However, as her younger brothers, they had never had the chance to confront her directly.

Watching Zhao Qi expose Princess Yi'an's actions in public, making her so angry that her hairpin trembled, they were happy to watch the show.

"Xuanyou, aren't you still investigating a case over there? Take the Marchioness and leave first." Seeing the situation, Prince Ping did not try to persuade Princess Yi'an anymore but instead advised Zhao Xuanyou to leave first.

This was the Qianqing Palace after all. Zhao Xuanyou clearly did not take Princess Yi'an seriously, which was obviously his fault.

Zhao Xuanyou also understood Prince Ping's intention and immediately turned around with Yu Yuan.

However, after walking a few steps forward, Zhao Xuanyou stopped again, turning his head to look at Princess Yi'an with a cold expression.

"Yuan is my wife. If anyone dares to bully her again, I will not let it go!"

With that, Zhao Xuanyou did not stay any longer and left with Yu Yuan and Zhao Yi Yun towards the West Garden.

Princess Yi'an looked at Prince Ping: "Royal Brother, are you just going to let others bully me like this?"

"It's your own doing." Zhao Qi coldly turned and left quickly.

Prince Ping, of course, felt that Zhao Xuanyou's last words were a bit excessive. However, since the Emperor had kept Zhao Xuanyou and his wife in the palace, they were more useful to Prince Ping than Princess Yi'an.

He indifferently said, "Xuanyou is a member of the imperial clan. By seniority, he is your elder brother. We are all descendants of the Zhao clan. There is no question of a subordinate offending a superior. In the future, do not be rude to your sister-in-law again."

With that, Prince Ping also left with his two younger brothers.

The front of the Qianqing Palace returned to silence.

Princess Yi'an stood frozen in place, her expression stiff and cold.

She was a princess. For more than twenty years, she had always been the center of attention, basking in glory and favor.

Even when she caused trouble after marriage, the Emperor had never spoken harshly to her.

But today, in front of the Qianqing Palace, she had been treated this way by Zhao Xuanyou. Her own brothers not only stood by but also spoke harshly to her.

This was... a great humiliation.

---

chapters.title: Backing
chapters.content:
The first time Yu Yuan stood in front of the palace gate, looking at the majestic and grand city walls and the gilded and resplendent halls, she felt both reverence and longing for this place of wealth and honor.

When she heard Zhao Qi express his disdain for being part of the imperial family, she also felt that Zhao Qi was ungrateful for his good fortune.

But today, after witnessing the imperial family's affection in the Qianqing Palace, she felt a mix of emotions.

"What's with that expression?"

After they had walked far enough from the Qianqing Palace, Zhao Xuanyou finally slowed his pace.

He turned his head and saw Yu Yuan's complex expression, unable to help but smile lightly.

Seeing him so calm, Yu Yuan could not help but say, "You can still smile?"

Yu Yuan was not blaming him.

Not only had he come forward to defend her, but he had also declared his feelings for her in front of so many people. She was actually very happy.

But Yu Yuan could see that the Emperor was someone who valued his descendants greatly. Zhao Xuanyou had scolded and threatened Princess Yi'an in front of the Qianqing Palace. The Emperor would definitely find out.

Zhao Xuanyou was indeed a favored subject, but how could a subject be compared to the Emperor's own daughter?

"I know my limits. Nothing will happen." Noticing her worry, Zhao Xuanyou said gently.

"I don't see you knowing your limits. Princess Yi'an's face was pale with anger. She definitely won't let this go."

Zhao Xuanyou bent the corner of his lips indifferently. "If she took my words to heart just now, then I won't pursue the matter further. But if she dares to provoke you again..."

After all, they were in the palace. Zhao Xuanyou did not finish the last part of his sentence, but Yu Yuan naturally understood his meaning.

However, Yu Yuan did not say anything more. She smiled and responded with an "mm."

He had gone to such lengths for her. How could she blame him in return?

Yu Yuan had always known that she was absolutely safe by his side. What happened today only confirmed her guess.

"Are you tired from holding him?" Zhao Xuanyou noticed that she had been holding Zhao Yi Yun all along and could not help but ask.

"His Highness is not heavy. It's fine."

Wen Guo, who had been silently following behind, spoke up at this moment. "Let me hold the Royal Grandson."

He had not followed Yu Yuan into the Qianqing Palace, so he did not know what had happened inside. But he had seen how Princess Yi'an had humiliated Yu Yuan.

He secretly noted Princess Yi'an's actions, thinking of finding an opportunity to avenge Yu Yuan. Then Zhao Xuanyou appeared.

Against everyone's expectations, Zhao Xuanyou not only publicly humiliated Princess Yi'an but also declared his feelings for Yu Yuan in front of everyone.

Such a man was indeed worthy of Yu Yuan.

It was no wonder that Yu Yuan had chosen Zhao Xuanyou in the end.

Wen Guo could not help Yu Yuan much, but he could at least help by holding the young Royal Grandson.

Yu Yuan had been holding Zhao Yi Yun for a long time, and her wrists were indeed a bit sore.

However, she did not directly hand Zhao Yi Yun to Wen Guo. Instead, she softly asked, "Can Uncle Guo hold you?"

"Okay."

There were still tears welling up in Zhao Yi Yun's eyes. The events that had taken place in the Qianqing Palace today had been just as shocking to him as the previous incident.

In that incident, his grandmother and father had been arrested on the spot, and his aunt had tried to stab him with a hairpin.

This time, his Imperial Grandfather would not allow him to be the son of his father anymore. Another aunt wanted his Imperial Grandfather to lock him up in prison. Apart from Seventh Uncle, the other three uncles all wanted to send him to a temple.

Although in the end, his Imperial Grandfather had not driven him out of the palace, he did not want to be the grandson of Consort Feng.

Yu Yuan saw his expression and knew that this was not the place to talk, so she did not say more and simply handed him to Wen Guo.

After returning to the West Garden, Wen Guo first took Zhao Yi Yun back to his room. Yu Yuan followed Zhao Xuanyou to the Qingfen Pavilion and told him everything that had happened in the Qianqing Palace.

"Adopting him under the name of the late Fourth Prince is indeed a good idea. At least, Yi Yun is no longer the son of a criminal." Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yu Yuan, his eyes full of admiration. "You were quick-witted to come up with such an idea. You are truly amazing."

Yu Yuan had only had a sudden inspiration after hearing Zhao Xuanyou talk about the situation in the palace before entering.

"I can see that Prince Ping does not really want to let Yi Yun go. Who knows what he will do in the future?"

Now that Prince Ping had the upper hand, how long Yi Yun could stay in the palace depended entirely on how long the Emperor lived.

Thinking of this, Yu Yuan could not help but worry for him.

Zhao Xuanyou guessed Yu Yuan's thoughts and sighed lightly.

"Yuan, you have done your best. He is, after all, Zhao Zhen's son."

Yu Yuan's eyes moved slightly, understanding Zhao Xuanyou's implied meaning.

She was also very clear that seeing Zhao Yi Yun so helpless, she had transferred all the love she had for her son in her previous life onto Zhao Yi Yun.

"You're right."

"Yuan, do whatever you like, but he is Zhao Zhen's son. Zhao Zhen committed treason, and he should have been demoted to a commoner and banished from the palace. This is his fate. Even the Emperor can only barely preserve his life. You don't need to torment yourself over this."

"Just consider it a moment of weakness on my part. I can only care for him for this short time in the palace. When we return to Yuzhou, I will put all this behind me."

This was her explanation to him.

Zhao Xuanyou reached out and gently pressed her brow with his fingertip.

"From Prince Ping's perspective, wanting him dead is not wrong."

He knew these words were very cruel, and he knew Yu Yuan pitied Zhao Yi Yun, but after a moment of hesitation, he still told the truth.

"What if the winner is not Prince Ping?"

"Others would be about the same."

About the same?

Prince Qing and Prince Jing might want to eliminate Zhao Yi Yun completely, but Zhao Qi would definitely not.

Although he was unrestrained in his actions, he was kind at heart.

His repeated pleas for Zhao Yi Yun today were proof of that.

Thinking of Zhao Qi, Yu Yuan recalled what Consort Li had said earlier in the Qianqing Palace about him not being married yet. She looked curiously at Zhao Xuanyou.

"Earlier, you said that the Emperor has already arranged a marriage for Prince Rui. Why does it sound like there is still no Princess Consort in Prince Rui's mansion?"

"It is true that a marriage was arranged. Originally, it was said that Prince Rui would marry in September. Later, I don't know what methods Prince Rui used, but he postponed the wedding date again. It should be next month."

Yu Yuan knew more or less why Zhao Qi did not want to get married and did not continue the topic.

"I heard that the Liang family girl is not only beautiful but also has a good temperament. I imagine they will be a good match after marriage."

Zhao Xuanyou had seen Liang Miaofeng once from a distance when he went out for social engagements.

Others spoke highly of her as the future Princess Consort of Prince Rui.

"The Emperor has always doted on Prince Rui. The girl he chose for Prince Rui is naturally excellent."

Zhao Qi had feelings for Yu Yuan after all, and it was uncertain whether he had given up. So Zhao Xuanyou did not want to continue this topic.

"A lot has happened today. You must be tired. Lie down and rest for a while before getting up to eat."

Yu Yuan had been tense the entire time in the Qianqing Palace. Now, by Zhao Xuanyou's side, she finally completely relaxed.

She lazily responded and, after changing her clothes, peacefully dozed off.

chapters.title: The Imperial Garden
chapters.content:
After witnessing the shocking scene in the Hall of Heavenly Purity, Zhao Yi Yun remained dispirited for several days. He also stopped mentioning to Yu Yuan his wish to see Zhuang Huaiyue.

He was clever and quick-witted.

He knew that the Emperor no longer doted on him as he once had.

Both of his aunts wanted him dead, and several of his uncles were indifferent to him.

He didn’t know how much longer he could stay in the Western Palace. Perhaps tomorrow, the Emperor would send someone to take him to Consort Feng.

He didn’t want to go, but no one would ask what he wanted.

The Emperor was the Emperor. Once he made a decision, no one could change it.

Not even Seventh Uncle or Madame Hou.

No matter how much he cried or made a fuss, it would only cause trouble for the kind Madame Hou.

Yu Yuan saw all this but could do nothing.

Zhao Xuanyou had made it clear: Zhao Zun was convicted of treason, and Zhao Yi Yun’s life was bound to be turned upside down. The fact that he was still alive was already the best possible outcome.

All she could do was ensure Zhao Yi Yun’s daily meals and current safety.

One day, while Zhao Yi Yun was crouched on the ground silently watching ants, a eunuch entered to announce that Consort Li had invited Yu Yuan to the Imperial Garden to appreciate the flowers.

“Does Her Grace the Consort only want me? Is there no need to bring His Highness the Imperial Grandson?”

“Only the madam has been invited,” the eunuch respectfully replied. “Without His Majesty’s order, His Highness the Imperial Grandson cannot leave the Western Palace.”

“I understand.”

Yu Yuan returned to her room to change clothes, but her mind was filled with doubts.

Prince Ping was eager to win over Zhao Xuanyou. As his birth mother, Consort Li should have no ill will toward her. Inviting her to appreciate the flowers was likely a gesture to give Zhao Xuanyou face.

But the problem was, she didn’t know if Princess Yian would be there.

Yu Yuan wasn’t afraid of Princess Yian causing trouble over her status as a concubine; she just found it bothersome.

Still, since Consort Li had sent someone to invite her, Yu Yuan couldn’t refuse.

Prince Ping was likely to be the next emperor. For Zhao Xuanyou’s sake, she shouldn’t offend him or his mother at this time.

After changing her clothes, Yu Yuan redid her hair.

Seeing that she was about to leave, Wen Guo naturally wanted to follow. However, Zhao Yi Yun reached out and grabbed the sleeve of his robe.

Yu Yuan smiled and said, “You stay here and keep His Highness company.”

“And you?”

“I’m going to the Imperial Garden. Nothing will happen to me. Besides, Zhao Xuanyou is still in the palace. What do I have to fear?”

Recalling how quickly Zhao Xuanyou had come to her aid the last time Princess Yian had bullied her, she indeed had nothing to worry about.

However, after Yu Yuan had taken only a few steps, Wen Guo, having soothed Zhao Yi Yun, caught up with her.

“Brother-in-law said that wherever you go, I must follow.”

Moreover, after Princess Yian had been publicly reprimanded by Zhao Xuanyou, she must be harboring resentment.

Wen Guo had been by Zhao Zun’s side for a long time and was well aware of Princess Yian’s character.

When it came to doing bad things, Princess Yian surpassed Zhao Zun a hundredfold.

Hearing this, Yu Yuan didn’t insist. She only said to Zhao Yi Yun, “Your Highness, play with Eunuch Xiao Linzi for a while. I’ll go to the Imperial Garden and come back soon.”

“Okay.” Although Zhao Yi Yun was reluctant to let Yu Yuan go, he nodded obediently.

Yu Yuan didn’t intend to stay long in the Imperial Garden. She had the imperial decree to care for the Imperial Grandson. She only needed to pay her respects to Consort Li, express her gratitude, and then she could leave.

She and Wen Guo quickly left the Western Palace and followed the eunuch who had delivered the decree to the Imperial Garden.

At this moment, the Imperial Garden was filled with the delightful colors of autumn, and the people coming and going were laughing and chatting.

Although such a major event had occurred in the palace; the Emperor had been poisoned, and both the harem and the Eastern Palace were left vacant; the harem was managed by Consort Li, and the front court was handled by Prince Ping. Everything remained orderly.

The flattery that had once surrounded Consort Jiang now all shifted to Consort Li.

However, neither Consort Li nor Prince Ping put on airs because of this. Their treatment of others remained the same as before.

When the palace attendants announced the arrival of the Lady of Jingyuan Hou, she stopped her conversation with the nearby concubines, looked up, and smiled. “Please invite her over quickly.”

Wen Guo stayed outside the pavilion, and Yu Yuan bowed as she approached to pay her respects.

“There’s no need for such formalities, Lady Hou,” Consort Li said softly. “Be seated.”

The nearby palace attendants immediately brought over an embroidered stool.

After expressing her gratitude, Yu Yuan took her seat.

“Having been in the palace for so long, have you visited the Imperial Garden before?”

“I have once, but the last time was in a hurry, and the scenery in the garden wasn’t as beautiful as it is today.”

Today was the first time Consort Li had gathered everyone to appreciate the flowers since taking charge of the harem. Naturally, her subordinates had put great effort into the arrangements.

But Yu Yuan’s words, apart from praising the scenery, were also a way to flatter the new mistress of the harem.

“Lady Hou is so beautiful and knows how to speak so well. It’s no wonder Jingyuan Hou is so devoted to her.”

“Isn’t that true? There aren’t many people in this palace who dare to stand up to Princess Yian.”

“She truly is a beauty who could captivate a nation.”

“I find that Lady Hou resembles a certain old acquaintance.”

The incident where Zhao Xuanyou had stood up for Yu Yuan at the gate of the Hall of Heavenly Purity had long since spread throughout the imperial palace.

Consort Li had invited Yu Yuan to appreciate the flowers to win her over, and the others, upon hearing that Consort Li had invited her, were all eager to see the beauty who had made Jingyuan Hou so angry on her behalf.

Upon seeing her face, which resembled Cui Yichu’s, everyone believed the rumors circulating in the capital.

Jingyuan Hou must be unable to forget the late Cui Yichu, which was why he insisted on marrying a concubine who looked like her.

Listening to the concubines’ chatter, Consort Li slightly furrowed her brows.

She had invited Yu Yuan to build a relationship, not to let these idle women humiliate her.

So, Consort Li said, “As the poem says, ‘If I can have your heart, we’ll stay together till our hair turns white.’ Lady Hou is fortunate to have Jingyuan Hou’s devotion. With such a good husband protecting her, her future will surely be smooth and worry-free. Which woman wouldn’t envy her?”

Zhao Xuanyou had thoroughly investigated the Emperor’s poisoning case, interacting with every palace and department. The concubines had naturally all seen him and were deeply impressed.

A high-ranking and decisive general, yet also a man of both literary and martial arts, with an extraordinary bearing and appearance.

Such a man was devoted to only one woman, openly showing his affection and not allowing her to suffer the slightest grievance.

Although they were the Emperor’s women, life in the palace had brought them countless hardships.

Even the now successful Consort Li had endured twenty years of hardship under Consort Jiang’s intimidation before rising to her current position.

“Your Grace speaks truly,” the concubines in the pavilion thought, losing their interest in gossip.

The Emperor had been poisoned, and his spirit was far from what it once was. Consort Li had finally risen to prominence. What about them?

Seeing that they had all fallen silent, Consort Li smiled faintly and then asked with concern about Zhao Yi Yun’s situation. She said that Consort Feng had been unwell lately, so she couldn’t take Zhao Yi Yun in yet. Yu Yuan would have to continue taking care of him for a while longer.

As they were speaking, a eunuch entered to announce the arrival of the young ladies from the Liang family.

The Liang family?

Had Zhao Qi’s fiancée arrived?

---

chapters.title: An Unexpected Conversation
chapters.content:
Yu Yuan turned her head to look outside the pavilion and saw two young girls in elegant dresses.

Both had bright eyes and white teeth, with outstanding appearances. Their skin was particularly fair and tender, as if glowing like pearls.

“Please invite them in,” Consort Li said.

After they had greeted Consort Li, she granted them seats as well.

Yu Yuan glanced at the two sisters. They were close in age; Liang Miaofeng was the elder, and Liang Miaotong was the younger.

Consort Li looked at them with approval in her eyes.

“Minister Liang is truly fortunate. His family has raised two daughters as beautiful as fairies. If I had a daughter like this, I wouldn’t know how happy I’d be.”

“Your Grace flatters us,” Liang Miaofeng said demurely.

Her nature was quiet and gentle, while her younger sister was livelier. Even in the palace, she was not restrained and looked up at Consort Li with a smile. “Father and Mother often complain at home that my sister and I are too noisy and want to marry us off quickly.”

“Tong’er,” Liang Miaofeng blushed and tugged at her sister’s sleeve.

The concubines in the pavilion laughed along.

“Prince Rui and your good news are approaching. On the day you truly marry, your parents won’t want to let you go.”

Liang Miaotong said, “I won’t want to let my sister go either. Once she’s married, there will be no one to play with me.”

The two sisters were not only beautiful but also had pleasant personalities. After they entered the pavilion, the atmosphere was filled with laughter and chatter.

Yu Yuan silently sat to the side, watching Liang Miaofeng’s gentle and obedient demeanor, and thought she and Zhao Qi would make a good match.

She had only come to the Imperial Garden to avoid offending Consort Li. Now that the pavilion was getting more crowded, and Consort Li was constantly talking to others, she couldn’t bring herself to ask to leave.

After some thought, Yu Yuan stood up and said, “Your Grace, this subject has noticed that the chrysanthemum varieties in the garden are ones I’ve never seen before. I’d like to go out and admire them.”

The flowers in the Imperial Garden were indeed carefully cultivated by the palace florists and couldn’t be seen outside.

Consort Li had originally invited Yu Yuan to appreciate the flowers, so upon hearing this, she naturally agreed with a smile.

Yu Yuan left the pavilion and let out a light sigh.

Although Consort Li was very kind to her, Yu Yuan could sense that the other concubines still looked down on her for being a concubine.

She wasn’t sad, nor did she bother to pretend otherwise. She might as well look at the flowers for a while and then return.

Yu Yuan led Wen Guo around the garden. Occasionally, she could hear people around her whispering and pointing.

“That’s the Lady of Jingyuan Hou.”

“She is indeed beautiful. No wonder Jingyuan Hou would quarrel with Princess Yian over her.”

“They say Jingyuan Hou cherishes her as much as his own eyeballs.”

“She’s just a concubine. If she didn’t resemble that famous beauty from the capital, how would Jingyuan Hou be devoted to her?”

“What’s wrong with being a concubine? In the imperial palace, you should know very well that where there is favor, there is status. What does birth matter?”

“That’s true. Isn’t the current winning family also from a dancer?”

Consort Li had once been a dancer from the Southern Mansion. During the Lantern Festival, she had performed a dance before the Emperor, caught his eye, and was kept by his side after being favored.

A cautious one whispered, “Shh, be careful with your words.”

Yu Yuan listened to these words, her mood growing even more indifferent.

Consort Li was now at the height of her power, yet there were still people talking behind her back. What about her?

She had no time to listen to such idle gossip. She focused solely on appreciating the flowers. Finally, she stopped in front of a pot of golden chrysanthemums with curled petals and gently touched the upward-curving arc of the petals.

“Does Lady Hou also like this pot of flowers?”

A clear and melodious voice came from behind her. Yu Yuan turned around and saw the Liang sisters standing behind her.

Seeing Yu Yuan look over, Liang Miaofeng seemed a little embarrassed and curtsied to Yu Yuan. “My sister’s words were out of line. She disturbed your elegant mood of flower appreciation.”

Liang Miaotong frowned, dissatisfied. “I only asked because I saw that Lady Hou and I both like this pot of flowers. How is that disturbing?”

“Yes, appreciating flowers is more enjoyable when you meet someone with the same taste,” Yu Yuan said with a smile.

Most people in the Imperial Garden were admiring a pot of blooming black chrysanthemums. Few came to look at this pot of golden flowers.

Liang Miaofeng saw that Yu Yuan was so gentle and smiled. “I don’t see what’s so special about this pot of flowers.”

Yu Yuan said, “This is a variety grafted by the palace florists using famous breeds. It can’t be seen outside.”

“I see.”

Thanks to this small episode, the three of them began to admire the flowers together in the garden.

The Liang sisters had very pleasant personalities, and Yu Yuan found it very easy to get along with them.

After walking around the Imperial Garden, Yu Yuan returned to the pavilion to take her leave from Consort Li.

She had the imperial decree to care for Zhao Yi Yun. Coming to the Imperial Garden to appreciate the flowers was already a gesture of deference to Consort Li.

After all, Zhao Xuanyou had a good relationship with Prince Ping. As Prince Ping and Consort Li’s influence grew, Yu Yuan, as Zhao Xuanyou’s wife, naturally had to follow suit.

In the Imperial Garden, Liang Miaofeng watched Yu Yuan’s retreating figure. The gentle and calm look in her eyes suddenly dimmed.

“Sister, I think Lady Hou is a very good person. She doesn’t seem like what the princess described,” Liang Miaotong said.

Just now, they had deliberately gone to talk to Yu Yuan under the pretense of appreciating flowers. It wasn’t a coincidence.

“Yes, if she weren’t a very good person, how could His Highness like her?”

At the beginning of the year, when she had watched the fireworks with Zhao Qi in the imperial city, Liang Miaofeng had sensed that he had no romantic feelings for her.

She had thought that Zhao Qi would reject this marriage, but unexpectedly, the Emperor suddenly issued an edict bestowing the marriage.

Her mother had comforted her, saying that Prince Rui had always been the Emperor’s favored youngest son, naive and straightforward, and probably didn’t understand love. That was why he was so indifferent to her.

Her father had also said that after inquiring, Prince Rui didn’t even have a bedchamber attendant. After marrying into the prince’s mansion, her days would be peaceful and quiet.

With such reassurances from her parents, Liang Miaofeng had set aside her concerns and began preparing for her marriage at home.

She had never expected that two days ago, when she went to another family’s banquet, she would encounter Princess Yian.

The usually haughty Princess Yian had actually pulled her aside to drink tea and told her a secret.

She said that the Lady of Jingyuan Hou was a vixen who had bewitched Jingyuan Hou, and even Zhao Qi had fallen for her beauty, which was why he had never married; he couldn’t get over the Lady of Jingyuan Hou.

Liang Miaofeng had cried for a long time in her room the previous day, and Liang Miaotong had tried in vain to console her.

Today, after Yu Yuan had gone out to appreciate the flowers, the sisters had followed. The bolder and more straightforward younger sister had gone up to speak to Yu Yuan.

They had originally wanted to find out some information, but instead, they were captivated by Yu Yuan’s conversation.

Yu Yuan was so knowledgeable about flowers that the sisters were completely absorbed. After walking around, they had completely forgotten to inquire about Zhao Qi.

Liang Miaotong tilted her head and thought for a moment, then whispered, “It’s not like we didn’t gain anything. Previously, the princess said that Lady Hou was the kind of woman who flirts with men, but today we saw that Lady Hou is dignified and generous, not like that at all. Maybe... the princess’s other words are also false?”

Could they be false?

Thinking of Zhao Qi’s indifferent gaze, Liang Miaofeng’s heart couldn’t help but feel a pang of disappointment.

chapters.title: An Eye for an Eye
chapters.content:
When she returned to the Western Garden, Zhao Xuanyou was actually playing with Zhao Yi Yun in the garden.

Yu Ying looked at the two of them in surprise and laughed, "You two? What are you playing?"

"I'm playing riddles with the Marquis," Zhao Yi Yun said quickly when he saw Yu Ying return.

Yu Ying rubbed his head, "What kind of riddles?"

"There's an ant nest in that tree. I pick a leaf, and the Marquis guesses how many ants are on the leaf."

What a good game to pass the time.

"Who wins more?"

"The Marquis."

Yu Ying exchanged a few words with Zhao Yi Yun and had Wen Shuo take him back to wash his hands and eat something.

Turning around, she saw Zhao Xuanyou's gaze fixed firmly on her, so she linked her arm with his and walked towards Qingfen Pavilion.

"Did you come back to check on me because you heard I went to the Imperial Garden?"

The case of the Eastern Palace had not yet been concluded, and Jiang's hidden pieces in the palace had not all been unearthed. Zhao Xuanyou was actually quite busy.

His return to the Western Garden at this time was clearly for Yu Ying.

"Something like that." Zhao Xuanyou did not deny it.

The intentions of the Prince of Ping and his son were obvious. Zhao Xuanyou knew that they would not only not make things difficult for Yu Ying but would also treat her with courtesy, so he did not directly barge into the Imperial Garden.

However, the palace was full of people with loose tongues, and he was still worried that someone might not know the limits and try to make trouble for Yu Ying, so he returned to the Western Garden early to wait for her.

"Princess Yi'an didn't come, so no one made trouble today."

"Hmph." Zhao Xuanyou sneered, "If she doesn't come to make trouble, I will go to her."

"What's wrong?" Yu Ying asked in confusion.

Before Zhao Xuanyou could answer, Yu Ying advised, "She is a princess after all. We can't openly fall out with her."

"We naturally won't fall out openly."

"And in secret?"

"Do you know what she has done in secret?"

Yu Ying was taken aback and subconsciously asked, "What has she done?"

The imperial palace was full of intrigue, but life in the Western Garden was peaceful as if it were a utopia. Yu Ying indeed did not know what was happening outside.

"Previously, when we returned to the capital, we always told the outside world that your family had been merchants for generations. These days, rumors have been spreading in the capital that you are my concubine and that you schemed to seduce me to become the Marchioness."

"Are you sure it's her? There were many people outside the Qianqing Palace that day. Maybe others are spreading it too."

A cold glint passed through Zhao Xuanyou's eyes.

Who else would add fuel to the fire and smear Yu Ying like this besides Princess Yi'an?

"I will handle these matters. You just need to be aware." Zhao Xuanyou was only worried that others would cause trouble for Yu Ying and make her unhappy. "Did anyone insult you with words today?"

"No. Today in the Imperial Garden, I learned that Concubine Li was once a dancer. Even the most prominent woman in the palace didn't have a good background. How dare others humiliate me with my background in the Imperial Garden?"

That was true.

As they spoke, the couple entered Qingfen Pavilion.

Although it was autumn, the late summer heat was as strong as the peak of summer.

Yu Ying had walked around the Imperial Garden without eating or drinking and was already thirsty. She drank two cups of tea as soon as she entered the house.

After moistening her throat, she looked curiously at Zhao Xuanyou, "You just said you would handle it? How will you handle it? Tell me."

"Of course, an eye for an eye."

"Are you going to have someone spread rumors about Yi'an?"

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow and said seriously, "Am I the kind of person who spreads rumors about others behind their backs?"

"Aren't you?"

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yu Ying's teasing expression, pulled her over, and kissed her hard, "When have I ever said bad things about others?"

"Then what method is 'an eye for an eye'?"

"I don't need to fabricate news at all. I just need to have someone spread the word about Yi'an and her husband's amorous affairs. It won't take a few days before the whole city is talking about it."

People loved scandalous stories the most. After marriage, Yi'an and her husband lived in harmony in appearance but were estranged in reality. One kept male favorites, and the other kept household singers. They both played wildly.

Although the Emperor had reprimanded Yi'an many times before, to maintain the royal family's reputation, he did not allow these things to be spread outside.

So, the common people of the capital, although they knew that Yi'an often gathered young scholars at her residence for elegant gatherings, only had vague guesses and did not know much more.

If Yi'an dared to spread rumors in the capital to damage Yu Ying's reputation, Zhao Xuanyou would naturally counterattack.

On the one hand, it was to vent for Yu Ying, and on the other hand, it was to quickly make others stop talking about Yu Ying.

The fastest way to dispel a rumor was not to cover people's mouths but to make everyone spontaneously discuss another rumor.

What could be more attractive to the idle people in the marketplace and the gossiping women than the amorous affairs of a current princess?

"Won't this alarm His Majesty?"

"The palace is already in chaos. Who has the time to care about these things?"

Zhao Xuanyou said lightly.

The Emperor's lingering poison had not been cleared, and there were so many troubles in the front and back courts. Not to mention that he did not care about these things, but the people around him would not even report such trivial matters to him.

Moreover, Zhao Xuanyou had kept his hands clean.

The words were spread by the people around the Princess's husband. Even if someone intentionally investigated, they would not be able to trace it back to him.

Seeing his confident appearance, Yu Ying did not ask further.

"Today in the Imperial Garden, I met the young lady from the Liang family."

The Liang family?

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow, remembering who she was talking about, "Did she cause trouble for you?"

Yu Ying said indignantly, "Am I so dislikable that everyone wants to cause trouble for me?"

Zhao Xuanyou coughed dryly and met her feigned angry look. He said gently, "A tree that stands out in the forest is sure to be destroyed by the wind. It is because you are too good that those petty people will try to cause trouble."

"Miss Liang is not a petty person."

"You two chatted?"

"We appreciated the flowers together in the Imperial Garden. I don't know how the Liang family raises their daughters. The two young ladies have different personalities but are both very likable."

Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched, but he did not speak.

If heaven were to bless them with a daughter, they would raise her to be even more likable.

Yu Ying did not know what he was thinking. Seeing that he was silent, she said again, "I heard from Concubine Li that the marriage between Prince Rui and Miss Miaofeng is approaching."

"Yes, it shouldn't be delayed anymore."

"Has the Marquis's residence prepared the congratulatory gifts?"

Zhao Xuanyou was busy with palace affairs and had no time to attend to such trivial matters.

"Steward Song will handle it."

The old Marquis and Zhao Xuanyou were not in the capital, so social interactions were mostly handled by Steward Song.

Prince Rui's marriage had been decided long ago, so Steward Song should have been prepared.

"My mother has transported jewelry from Yu Prefecture. Help me pass a message to Steward Song to select a few fine pieces from them and send them to the Prince's residence as a congratulatory gift."

The fine jewelry from Linglong Workshop was personally designed by Ding Wenxi. Although they were not considered precious for a princess consort, they were unique.

Knowing that Yu Ying had not encountered any unpleasantness in the Imperial Garden and had even gotten along well with the Liang family's young lady, Zhao Xuanyou naturally agreed.

Yu Ying was the Marchioness of Jingyuan. Sooner or later, she would have to interact with the noble circles of the capital.

With the rumor of her being a concubine spreading throughout the capital, those noble ladies might distance themselves from Yu Ying due to their self-perceived status. If she could have more interactions with Concubine Li and Princess Rui, it would be beneficial for Yu Ying.

Thinking of this, Zhao Xuanyou suddenly said, "There is something you should be prepared for."

---

chapters.title: Chaoyun Palace
chapters.content:
Seeing Zhao Xuanyou's somewhat solemn expression, Yu Ying guessed that what he was about to say was not something she would like to hear. She pouted, "Is there some bad news?"

Zhao Xuanyou's eyebrows twitched slightly. After a pause, he said, "Today, His Majesty summoned Consort Feng to the Qianqing Palace. Consort Feng is very pleased about the adoption matter. I expect that in a few days, she will take the young master to her place."

So that was it.

Originally, it was Yu Ying's idea to have Zhao Yi Yun adopted under the name of the late Fourth Prince. It was not surprising that Consort Feng would take Zhao Yi Yun with her.

A hint of reluctance flashed through Yu Ying's heart. She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, seeing the concern in his eyes, and could not help but curve her lips into a smile.

"What kind of expression is this? Are you worried that I will be reluctant?"

"Isn't that the case?"

Yu Ying's concern for Zhao Yi Yun had long surpassed the scope of following orders.

The incense burner in the room emitted a faint, sweet smoke.

"I have indeed grown very fond of Yi Yun over these days. But I am very clear that he is Zhao Zun's son and has nothing to do with us. Now that His Majesty has arranged a good place for him, I am happy for him."

Zhao Yi Yun was cute and had a sweet and sensible temperament. When he missed his mother, it always reminded Yu Ying of her own child from the past.

But Yu Ying was very clear that Zhao Yi Yun was not her child.

She had already helped him in every way she could. From now on, he would have to walk his own path.

"Mmm."

Zhao Xuanyou pulled her into his arms. The couple chatted casually for a while before he left.

Yu Ying lay down in the room for a while. After resting properly, she went to Zhao Yi Yun.

After playing with him for a while, Zhao Yi Yun asked again about when he could see Zhuang Huaiyue. Yu Ying could not help but say, "Yi Yun, do you remember what His Majesty said a few days ago in the Qianqing Palace?"

Zhao Yi Yun knew that Yu Ying rarely spoke to him in such a serious tone. Hearing this, he suddenly lowered his head and refused to speak.

Seeing his reaction, Yu Ying knew he was afraid. But he would have to live with Consort Feng sooner or later. It was better to tell him early so he could be prepared. Otherwise, when the imperial decree arrived, he might not be able to accept it.

"I don't want to hear it." Zhao Yi Yun muttered.

"His Majesty wants to keep you in the palace and by his side to take care of you. That's why he came up with the idea of having Consort Feng raise you."

Zhao Yi Yun subconsciously grabbed Yu Ying's clothes and looked at her pitifully, "What about you?"

"I am neither a palace person nor your relative." Yu Ying reached out and rubbed his little head. "I know you are afraid of His Majesty because of some things, but His Majesty is your grandfather. He is the person who cares most about you and is most able to protect you. Staying in the palace is the best arrangement for you."

Zhao Yi Yun lowered his head and said nothing.

So many things had happened during this period. The uncles, aunts, and others who had been kind to him before all wanted to take his life or send him to a temple.

And the grandfather who loved him the most neither saw him nor spoke to him.

For Zhao Yi Yun, the sky had fallen.

Only when he hid in the Western Garden and stayed by the Marchioness's side could he feel a little peace.

"If it weren't for His Majesty's compassion for you, why would he have me take care of you?"

Zhao Yi Yun was slightly stunned and looked at Yu Ying in surprise.

He was still young and only felt that his imperial grandfather was cruel for arresting his parents. But hearing Yu Ying say this, he naturally thought of many things he had not considered before.

"That day in the Qianqing Palace, some people said they wanted to put you in prison, and others said they wanted to send you to a temple. Although the proposal to adopt you to your Fourth Uncle was suggested by Prince Rui, His Majesty immediately agreed when he heard that you could stay in the palace."

"Does Imperial Grandfather really still care about me? But my father..."

"Your father did something wrong. Although Consort Zhuang did nothing, she is your father's woman, so she was implicated. But His Majesty tried his best to protect you."

Looking at Yi Yun's frowning and troubled expression, Yu Ying knew that there were many things he could not understand now.

"Your Highness, you must not blame His Majesty for what your parents did. When you grow up, you will understand what I said today. You only need to remember that the only reliable and trustworthy person in this palace is His Majesty. If you trust me, you must trust His Majesty. Do you understand?"

Zhao Yi Yun listened to Yu Ying's words silently, and his eyes gradually filled with tears.

Yu Ying had said everything she needed to say and did not speak any further.

Zhao Yi Yun was still young and did not understand many rights and wrongs. If he could remember the four words "trust His Majesty," it would be enough for him to survive in the palace.

Three peaceful days passed, and the imperial decree finally arrived. Zhao Yi Yun was to be adopted under the name of the Fourth Prince and officially taken to Consort Feng's palace.

Because she had to raise Zhao Yi Yun, the Emperor specially moved Consort Feng to Chaoyun Palace on the north side of the imperial palace.

This place was quieter, but not far from the Yangxin Palace where the Emperor often stayed, showing the Emperor's careful consideration.

Yu Ying led Zhao Yi Yun to the outside of Chaoyun Palace. She originally thought that after the eunuchs announced their arrival, they would enter to pay their respects to Consort Feng. Unexpectedly, Consort Feng personally came out to welcome them.

"Yi Yun, you've come."

Consort Feng was a beautiful and delicate woman with a somewhat haggard face, but Yu Ying could see that the joy in her eyes was genuine.

"Greetings to Consort Feng."

Zhao Yi Yun, having been reminded by Yu Ying before leaving, respectfully saluted Consort Feng.

"Good child, from now on, we will depend on each other. You need not be constrained with me."

Consort Feng said this and tried to pick up Zhao Yi Yun, but she was too delicate to lift him and could only pull him into her embrace.

She had entered the palace to receive favor at a very young age and soon became pregnant and gave birth to the Fourth Prince.

Originally, she had been at the peak of her glory, but unfortunately, the Fourth Prince fell seriously ill and passed away at the age of seven. Consort Feng had never recovered from the loss of her son and gradually fell out of favor.

More than ten years had passed since then, and Consort Feng was not yet forty, but Yu Ying clearly saw that she already had premature gray hair.

"Marchioness, thank you for taking care of Yi Yun all these days." Consort Feng said gently.

"It was my duty. Now that the young master can be adopted under Consort Feng's care, I am also happy for the young master."

Consort Feng wanted to take Zhao Yi Yun into the palace, but Zhao Yi Yun turned to look at Yu Ying, hesitating to move forward.

Seeing this, Yu Ying took his other hand, and together with Consort Feng, they led him into Chaoyun Palace.

As soon as they entered Chaoyun Palace, Zhao Yi Yun was slightly startled.

"Do you like it, Yi Yun?" Consort Feng asked with a smile. "His Majesty specially ordered people to decorate this place to resemble your former palace."

"Is it really His Majesty's decree?"

"Of course." Consort Feng took Zhao Yi Yun around to inspect the place.

Not only was the layout of Chaoyun Palace similar to Zhao Yi Yun's former residence, but many of the items were old belongings that the Emperor had ordered to be brought over from the Eastern Palace.

Consort Feng was originally a gentle person. After spending some time with Zhao Yi Yun, the distance between them melted away.

Yu Ying watched them chatting happily and felt relieved. She quietly left Chaoyun Palace.

chapters.title: Joyous Occasion at the Prince's Mansion
chapters.content:
Yu Ying and Wen Shu returned to the Western Garden, both feeling a touch of melancholy.

For Yu Ying, she had transferred her longing for the child from her past life onto Zhao Yi Yun.

For Wen Shu, Zhao Yi Yun was the son of his former master, and being around the boy inevitably stirred memories of the past.

However, neither of them were the type to dwell on such emotions. After sitting in the garden and talking for a while, their moods returned to normal.

After bathing in the Qingfen Pavilion, Yu Ying lay down on the couch.

In the middle of the night, she heard movement behind her and sat up.

"Did I wake you?"

Zhao Xuanyou's voice was deep and rich.

Yu Ying didn't answer. She reached out in the dark and found his shoulder, then threw herself into his arms.

Zhao Xuanyou pulled her into his embrace and rolled onto the couch. After a passionate encounter, Yu Ying quietly rested her head on his arm.

"Was everything alright at Chaoyun Palace today?"

"Yi Yun already knew Feng Zhao Yi. They just weren't close before, so he wasn't afraid when he saw her."

"Did he not feel sad when you left?"

"How much could he have grown attached in such a short time?" Even as she said this, Yu Ying added, "I left quietly. Maybe he'll cry when he realizes I'm gone."

Zhao Xuanyou agreed with a low "Mmm."

"The Emperor really cares for him. He even moved all the things Yi Yun used in the Eastern Palace to Chaoyun Palace."

"Yes, Feng Zhao Yi has been preparing Chaoyun Palace these past few days, which is why Yi Yun was only taken there today."

"I think Feng Zhao Yi has a kind and gentle face. I'm sure she'll get along well with Yi Yun in the future."

Zhao Xuanyou responded in agreement.

In truth, whether Zhao Yi Yun could live well depended entirely on how much longer the Emperor lived.

Once the Emperor passed, not even Feng Zhao Yi could protect him.

But Yu Ying was in high spirits at the moment, so Zhao Xuanyou naturally didn't voice these thoughts.

He was the son of Zhao Zun. He and his wife had already done more than enough for the boy.

"I entered the palace to take care of the imperial grandson. Now that the imperial grandson has gone to Chaoyun Palace, do I have to leave the palace?"

According to palace rules, the Imperial Household Department would have sent Yu Ying out of the palace today. It was only because Zhao Xuanyou had spoken to the chief steward that Yu Ying was allowed to stay a few more days in the Western Garden.

The case in the Eastern Palace would take at least another month to resolve. If Yu Ying were sent away, who knew how long it would be before he could hold her in his arms again.

The next morning, after Zhao Xuanyou accompanied Yu Ying for breakfast in the Western Garden, a eunuch indeed came to escort Yu Ying out of the palace.

Although there was no empress, Consort Li managed palace affairs with exceptional diligence, and order had long been restored in the palace.

In gratitude for Yu Ying's care of Zhao Yi Yun, the Emperor bestowed many rewards upon her. Consort Li, considering herself the acting empress, also generously added to Yu Ying's rewards.

Yu Ying had entered the palace in haste with Wen Shu, but she was leaving laden with gifts.

After Wen Shu escorted her back to the Marquis's mansion, he returned to the palace.

Yu Ying had the steward, Song, register the palace rewards into the inventory before going to Leshou Hall to pay her respects to Old Madam Ye.

Seeing her return, Old Madam Ye and the Old Marquis naturally inquired after her well-being. They also expressed indignation at the rumors that had previously circulated in the capital about her. This protective attitude left Yu Ying feeling both surprised and touched.

She had only ever felt familial love from her mother and Wen Shu.

Before marrying into the Marquis's family, she knew she wasn't the kind of daughter-in-law they wanted. She had planned to keep her distance from her grandmother-in-law and father-in-law, maintaining a superficial peace.

But she truly hadn't expected them to care for her so much.

Yu Ying then briefly recounted the events in the palace, omitting the part where Princess Yi'an had humiliated her.

"It's good that you're safe. The palace is a place to avoid as much as possible," Old Madam Ye said with a heavy sigh. "Such a grand and luxurious place, full of heartless people. For the sake of power and favor, they won't even spare a child as young as Yao Yao."

The Old Marquis and Zhao Xuanyou were often away from home, so it was usually Ye Mo Xuan, a nephew from her maternal family, who kept Old Madam Ye company at the Marquis's mansion.

Ye Mo Xuan and Princess Yingning had a daughter, and Old Madam Ye had sent many gifts and red envelopes to Yao Yao, treating her like her own granddaughter.

When such a big incident occurred in Ye Mo Xuan's family, Old Madam Ye, despite her old age, had gone to the Princess's mansion to visit. Seeing Yao Yao's dull and confused state, Old Madam Ye had been moved to tears and couldn't eat for several days after returning home.

Seeing Old Madam Ye in tears, the Old Marquis said, "The palace has sent two imperial physicians to treat Yao Yao. There will surely be a turn for the better."

"I hope so. These past few days, I've been reciting scriptures every day, praying that Buddha will show mercy to Yao Yao."

Yu Ying handed Old Madam Ye a handkerchief to wipe her tears and offered a few words of comfort.

Old Madam Ye patted Yu Ying's hand. "Children are precious. When you and Xuanyou have children in the future, you must take good care of them."

"Grandmother, rest assured. We will be careful."

This was not an empty promise but Yu Ying's vow to her future children.

She would protect them and not let them suffer the slightest harm.

The Old Marquis had spent many days at home comforting Old Madam Ye. Seeing her tears well up again today, he looked at Yu Ying and changed the subject. "You've returned at just the right time."

"Is there something happening in the mansion?" Yu Ying asked.

"Tomorrow is the day Prince Rui gets married. I don't want to go out, but not going would be a loss of face for the Prince's mansion."

"Do you want me to go?"

"You are already the Marchioness. It's time for you to go out and meet people, let others get to know you. But if you..."

Yu Ying knew her father-in-law was worried about the rumors in the capital. She quickly said, "Prince Rui has helped me and the Marquis before. I've also met Princess Rui, and we get along quite well. It's only right that I go to offer my congratulations."

"You are the lawfully wedded wife of Xuanyou. Pay no mind to those idle rumors. Go and offer your congratulations with confidence."

Even so, Old Madam Ye was still worried that the noblewomen might not easily accept Yu Ying.

After some thought, she sent a message to her maiden home, the Anning Marquis's mansion, asking the Marchioness of Anning to take Yu Ying along.

The Marchioness of Anning was well-respected in the circle of noblewomen in the capital. With her taking Yu Ying, those with any sense wouldn't cause trouble.

After leaving Leshou Hall, Yu Ying had Steward Song present the list of gifts. She reselected a few pieces of jewelry for Liang Miaofeng before attending to other matters.

The next morning, a carriage from the Anning Marquis's mansion arrived.

Yao Yao was the granddaughter of the Anning Marquis's family, and such a big incident had occurred. The Marchioness of Anning was also deeply saddened.

But as the mistress of the Marquis's mansion, there were many matters she had to attend to personally.

Today, going to the Prince Rui's mansion to offer congratulations, aside from delivering gifts on behalf of the Anning Marquis's mansion, she also had to deliver a portion from the Princess's mansion.

Before long, the carriage stopped in front of Prince Rui's mansion.

The wedding at the Prince's mansion was grand and solemn. The local authorities had blocked off the entire street to prevent congestion.

The Marchioness of Anning and Yu Ying alighted from the carriage and waited for the guards at the street entrance to check their invitations before walking past the red cloth barriers toward the Prince's mansion.

---

chapters.title: An Unexpected Encounter
chapters.content:
Behind the cloth barriers, servants of the Prince's mansion were waiting to guide the guests.

Seeing female guests arrive, a maid came forward to lead them into the mansion.

"Has the Prince already left to fetch the bride?" the Marchioness of Anning asked.

"Yes, the wedding procession left about the time it takes to burn a stick of incense. The Liang family is not far from here, so the Prince should be back with the Princess Consort soon."

The mansion was already filled with well-wishers. The maid led them through the front courtyard toward the garden where the women were gathered.

The Marchioness of Anning was highly respected and well-liked in the circle of noblewomen. Upon her arrival, the ladies and young noblewomen in the garden came forward to greet her.

After exchanging pleasantries with a smile, she introduced Yu Ying to everyone.

Upon hearing that she was the Marchioness of Jingyuan, all eyes turned to Yu Ying.

The conflict between Zhao Xuanyou and Princess Yi'an to defend Yu Ying's honor had spread like wildfire within the palace but had not reached beyond its walls.

However, Princess Yi'an, in an attempt to make life difficult for Yu Ying in the noble circles of the capital, had spread the rumor that Yu Ying had once been a concubine's maid. Although the capital had recently been abuzz with gossip about Princess Yi'an's own scandalous affairs, the noblewomen present were still curious to see what a woman who had risen from a maid to a marchioness looked like.

"So this is the Marchioness of Jingyuan," said a woman who was on good terms with the Marchioness of Anning, breaking the awkward silence.

"Yingying, this is Madame Yin, the wife of Minister Yin."

"Madame Yin."

"During the Marquis of Jingyuan's wedding, I came to offer my congratulations, but unfortunately, I didn't get to see the Marchioness's true appearance that day."

With Madame Yin leading the way, several other kind-faced ladies struck up conversations.

"The other day, my mother celebrated her birthday. We had planned to invite you to join the festivities, but then we heard you had been commanded to enter the palace to take care of the young imperial grandson."

Even though the Eastern Palace had fallen, for the nobles, serving in the palace was still a great honor.

Cui Yichu had always taken pride in her status as a princess's study companion.

Many people, despite their disdain for Yu Ying's past as a concubine's maid, were impressed to hear that she had entered the palace to care for the imperial grandson.

"You entered the palace?"

"Yes," the Marchioness of Anning replied. "Xuanyou was ordered to investigate a case in the palace, and Yingying took care of the young imperial grandson for over a month. Both of them have earned the Emperor's favor. They are people of both virtue and talent."

Although Zhao Yi Yun was the descendant of an enemy to the Anning Marquis's family, since the Emperor was determined to protect him, the Anning Marquis's family, as subjects, dared not express their true feelings as openly as Princess Yingning.

Moreover, the Anning Marquis's family and the Jingyuan Marquis's family had been on good terms for generations and were even related by marriage. The Marchioness of Anning would never redirect her anger toward Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying.

"She actually stayed in the palace for over a month. Every time I enter the palace, I'm in such a hurry that I just pay my respects and leave. I've never even properly visited the Imperial Garden."

"I've been to the Imperial Garden several times, but I didn't dare to wander around. I've never properly explored it either."

As the ladies chatted and laughed, Yu Ying said, "I also stayed with His Highness the Imperial Grandson in the Western Garden and didn't dare to move around the palace freely."

Madame Yin started to say something but stopped abruptly.

After all, today was the Prince's wedding, and with so many people around, it wouldn't be appropriate to discuss palace matters.

Yu Ying guessed what she was going to say and replied, "Nowadays, the harem is managed by Consort Li, and everything is in order."

Consort Li and Prince Ping had the upper hand, and they had repeatedly shown goodwill toward the Jingyuan Marquis's family. Yu Ying's words were both a natural response and a way to help Madame Yin save face.

Madame Yin looked at Yu Ying with gratitude.

As they were talking, someone nearby asked with a smile, "I've heard that the Marchioness's family has been in the merchant business for generations. May I ask what kind of business you do?"

The news of Yu Ying's past as a concubine's maid had already spread throughout the capital. The noblewoman's question about Yu Ying's previously claimed merchant background was clearly intended to embarrass her and make her lose face.

The Marchioness of Anning frowned slightly, about to intervene, but Yu Ying said, "My family runs a jewelry shop. My family is in Yuzhou, but our jewelry is also sold in major shops like Shunxing, Baotong, and Xiangyun in Jiangnan."

The noble families in the capital lived extravagant lives, and to maintain such a lifestyle, relying solely on the court's salary was far from enough. Therefore, each family had its own businesses.

Some relied on land, some on rent from shops, and others on banks, restaurants, or various other ventures.

The names of these major shops in Jiangnan were familiar to the noblewomen.

Madame Yin noticed the exquisite butterfly hairpin adorned with rubies on Yu Ying's head. The butterfly's wings trembled slightly with her movements, and the pairs of rubies embedded in the wings sparkled brilliantly.

"That hairpin is quite unique. Was it made by your family's shop?"

"Yes, it was part of my mother's dowry," Yu Ying said with pride.

Butterfly hairpins were a popular style, and they could be found in almost every jewelry shop.

However, Ding Wenxi had come up with the idea of using pairs of rubies to create the patterns on the butterfly's wings, which was a novelty even for the well-traveled noblewomen of the capital.

"It's a shame your shop is in Yuzhou. Otherwise, I'd like to buy one for my daughters."

Yu Ying smiled. "Coincidentally, my family is preparing to open a branch in the capital next month."

"Oh? What will it be called?"

"It will be called Linglong Workshop. We'll sell not only jewelry but also rouge and powder. We'll have to invite all of you to visit when the time comes."
