"I don’t want to make things difficult for you, Your Highness."

Zhao Qi, smelling the faint fragrance from her, sighed deeply.

"Before His Majesty bestowed our marriage, I was indeed in a difficult position. But from the day you entered this house, I made up my mind to live a good life with you."

"Really?" Liang Miaofeng was extremely surprised. She hadn’t expected Zhao Qi to say such things. "When you wanted to stay before, was it because of this?"

"Mmm."

"You don’t dislike me, Your Highness?"

"You are my wife. Why would I dislike you? Yu Wan has her life, and you and I have ours to live."

So many unexpected things had happened tonight.

Zhao Qi had admitted to liking Yu Wan, but he also said he wanted to live a good life with her.

Liang Miaofeng’s heart began to race.

Gathering her courage once more, she propped herself up and quickly kissed Zhao Qi on the lips. Before he could react, she quickly retreated back under the quilt.

The kiss came so suddenly that by the time Zhao Qi regained his senses, Liang Miaofeng had already covered herself completely with the quilt, head and all.

His mind was in turmoil, and a strange, unfamiliar feeling arose within him.

He stiffly lay back down in his own quilt, feeling dazed.

"Your Highness, let me continue telling you about today’s events." Liang Miaofeng had stolen a kiss from him and felt extremely guilty. After calming her emotions under the quilt, she quickly changed the subject. "We told Consort Li about the assassin, but Consort Li insisted it was an accident and acted as if nothing happened."

"Of course she wants to act as if nothing happened." Zhao Qi’s breathing was still a bit ragged.

"The Marchioness said she knows who the mastermind is, and it doesn’t matter if we don’t investigate."

"Who?"

"She didn’t say. Maybe she was afraid of causing trouble for Tong’er and me. But we thought about it at home and felt that Sister Yi’an has hostility towards her. Today, she also said some nonsense in front of Consort Li."

Zhao Qi heard this and wasn’t surprised, only giving a cold laugh. "She’s courting death."

"But Consort Li said not to investigate. Could this still implicate Royal Sister?"

"Let’s wait and see. Zhao Xuanyou won’t let her off."

---

chapters.title: Daring to Pierce the Heavens
chapters.content:
In the Princess’s residence, Princess Yi’an changed into her nightclothes and sat on the edge of the bed, having a servant massage her feet.

Her mood was not particularly good at the moment.

Originally, she had planned to use an "accident" to make Yu Wan fall off the mountain, but unexpectedly, Yu Wan had left Yuzhao Garden unscathed, and for some inexplicable reason, Liang Miaotong had fallen instead.

What was even more bizarre was that the eunuch she had arranged to collide with Yu Wan had disappeared.

He had fallen down the mountain with Liang Miaotong, and since Liang Miaotong was injured, he should have been seriously injured as well. It was impossible for him to have run away on his own.

Had he been captured?

By Zhao Xuanyou?

Impossible. Even if Zhao Xuanyou was capable, he couldn’t have predicted that she would try to harm Yu Wan at Yuzhao Garden.

Even if he had three heads and six arms, he couldn’t have arrived at Yuzhao Garden faster than the Imperial Guards.

But compared to what had already happened, what came next worried Yi’an even more.

Yu Wan had returned to the Marquis’s residence and would certainly tell Zhao Xuanyou about what had happened today. Then Zhao Xuanyou...

Yi’an’s feelings towards Zhao Xuanyou had always been complicated.

The first time she had seen Zhao Xuanyou at the Imperial Palace’s Internal Affairs Department, she had actually taken a liking to him. At that time, Zhao Xuanyou was the husband of Cui Yichu, and no matter how domineering she was, she couldn’t take someone else’s husband.

Later, when Zhao Xuanyou divorced Cui Yichu, Yi’an was overjoyed and frequently created opportunities to spend time with him at the Lichuan Summer Palace.

Given her noble status as a princess, marrying Zhao Xuanyou as his second wife would have been a slight demotion, but she liked him.

But Zhao Xuanyou didn’t appreciate it at all. To avoid the marriage, he even went to His Majesty to obtain imperial clan status, completely cutting off her hopes.

She was both angry and heartbroken, but there was nothing she could do about it.

In the blink of an eye, several years had passed. Zhao Xuanyou, who had refused to marry her, had instead married a lowly concubine, making that concubine the noble Marchioness, who now moved in and out of the imperial court, putting on airs.

Yi’an had only verbally humiliated that lowly woman a few times, and Zhao Xuanyou had dared to publicly retaliate in front of the Qianqing Palace.

How could Yi’an swallow this insult?

She had carefully arranged the accident, but it had all been for nothing.

Although Consort Li had suppressed the matter, Yi’an couldn’t help but feel a lingering fear when she thought of the murderous aura Zhao Xuanyou had displayed in front of the Qianqing Palace that day.

As soon as she returned to the capital, Princess Yi’an went to Prince Ping’s residence to explain the situation.

Although their sibling relationship was mediocre, Prince Ping was still her imperial brother. Moreover, today’s plum blossom banquet had been hosted by Consort Li. Although Prince Ping had angrily scolded her a few times, he had still agreed to go and appease Zhao Xuanyou.

Prince Ping was at the height of his power. With him stepping in, Zhao Xuanyou shouldn’t dare to cause trouble.

But for some reason, after returning to the Princess’s residence, Yi’an still felt uneasy.

She ordered a servant to bring her a bowl of calming soup and added more calming incense to the censer. After these arrangements, she soon felt drowsy and went to bed after extinguishing the candles.

At first, she slept quite peacefully, but soon she felt like she couldn’t breathe, as if a hand was tightly gripping her throat.

Yi’an suddenly opened her eyes and saw a demon standing at the edge of her bed in the darkness.

She instinctively wanted to scream, but her throat was tightly choked, and she couldn’t make a sound.

"She’s awake." The "demon" said in a low voice.

Feeling the grip on her throat loosen slightly, Yi’an finally got a chance to breathe.

Had she been having a nightmare?

After catching her breath, Yi’an saw a face even more terrifying than the demon’s.

Zhao Xuanyou?!

How could he be here?

Yi’an’s face suddenly paled, and she was filled with terror.

It was at this moment that Yi’an realized that the "demon" by the bed was just a person wearing a Zhong Kui mask.

"Let go of her."

Zhao Xuanyou’s gaze was as sharp as a sword, and his tone was icy.

The person wearing the Zhong Kui mask, Wen Bo, released his grip and turned to press a finger heavily on Yi’an’s acupoint.

The force was so strong that Yi’an felt like her body was about to be punctured. As a pampered princess, she had never endured such pain before. The Emperor had never hit her, and rarely even spoken harshly to her.

But this was only the beginning. After being pressed on the acupoint, she felt as if a huge rock was pressing down on her, every bone and muscle aching. She couldn’t even muster the strength to sit up.

"Zhao Xuanyou, how dare you!"

At this point, Princess Yi’an was fully awake.

This was no nightmare. Zhao Xuanyou had truly come to her residence to seek revenge.

Enduring the discomfort in her body, Yi’an did her best to suppress the panic in her heart and shouted, "Someone! Come here!"

"There’s no need to shout. Your two dark guards are already dead."

Facing Zhao Xuanyou’s icy gaze, Yi’an was suddenly stunned.

Her two dark guards had been personally bestowed by His Majesty and had exceptional martial arts skills. But the person who had broken into the Princess’s residence was Zhao Xuanyou...

"Zhao Xuanyou, you’ve broken into the Princess’s residence and even dared to kill my dark guards. Tomorrow, I will definitely report this to His Majesty."

"Do you think you’ll live to see tomorrow?" Zhao Xuanyou’s voice was low, but the anger in his tone was not concealed.

"Hmph? Do you dare to kill me? What do you take yourself for? If you kill me in the Princess’s residence, His Majesty will definitely have your entire family executed!"

Listening to Princess Yi’an’s threats, Zhao Xuanyou’s expression darkened.

"I wouldn’t dare kill you, of course. Besides, I already promised Prince Ping that I wouldn’t harm you."

Hearing this, Yi’an’s panicked heart finally calmed down a bit.

As expected, there was a difference between ruler and subject. How dare he harm her?!

He had broken in tonight only to vent his anger with harsh words. She just needed to stabilize the situation, and tomorrow she would immediately go to the palace to report this.

No matter how much His Majesty favored him, he would never tolerate such a disregard for the royal family’s dignity.

But before Yi’an could speak, Zhao Xuanyou coldly said, "I came tonight to give the Princess a generous gift."

He gestured to the person beside him, and soon someone dragged in a bloodied man.

Zhao Xuanyou grabbed the man’s hair and slowly said, "This man is the one you sent today to attack Wan. Since he worked so hard for you, you should at least see him off on his final journey."

Princess Yi’an was confused and looked at Zhao Xuanyou, but was met with the cold light in his eyes, which made her shiver.

"You... what do you want to do?"

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t say another word. The person beside him quickly tied the half-dead eunuch with a rope and hung him from the top of Yi’an’s bed canopy.

The eunuch was still alive but had his tongue cut out, his mouth full of blood, looking like a ghost.

What was even more terrifying was that the blood dripped from the corner of his mouth onto Yi’an’s face, one drop at a time.

"Ah…"

Yi’an let out a piercing scream, but before the sound could spread, someone stuffed a cloth into her mouth.

But this wasn’t the end.

Wen Bo placed the corpses of the two dark guards on either side of her. No matter how she moved, she would see a horrifying face.

At this point, a hint of a smile finally appeared on Zhao Xuanyou’s face.

"If you’re not mad by tomorrow morning, whether you choose to go to the palace to report this or let the matter drop is up to you." Zhao Xuanyou’s voice remained calm. Looking at the terrified Yi’an on the bed, he said word by word, "Don’t ever think about harming my wife again. When I go mad, I dare to pierce the heavens. Let alone you!"

chapters.title: Follow You
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou returned to the Tangli Courtyard in the middle of the night. Yu Wan was fast asleep.

Although it was the dead of winter, the heated brick floors in the room were burning strongly, and the thick bedding made it quite warm on the bed.

Yu Wan lay on her side, with only half of the cotton quilt covering her, her dark hair loosely draped over the edge of the pillow.

He quietly watched her sleeping face for a while, then reached out to touch her belly.

Thinking that there was a little one resting here, all the murderous aura in his body dissipated.

After standing still for a moment, Zhao Xuanyou changed into his nightclothes. As he tiptoed toward the bed, the person on it opened her eyes.

"Did I wake you?"

Yu Wan curved her lips. "I slept for a long time this afternoon, so I wasn't sleepy to begin with."

As she spoke, she sat up. Zhao Xuanyou reached out to hold her and sat down beside her.

"What were you doing?"

Zhao Xuanyou didn't respond. With one arm around her, he gently rubbed her belly with the other.

At four months pregnant, her winter clothes concealed the pregnancy completely during the day. Only someone as familiar with her body as him could notice that her waist was slightly thicker than before.

"Has your stomach been hurting?"

"No," Yu Wan indeed had no discomfort. She just looked at Zhao Xuanyou. "Hurry up and tell me, what were you doing?"

"Someone had ill intentions toward you. I went to give her a little warning."

So he had indeed gone to cause trouble for Princess Yi'an.

Today, Yi'an had schemed to make Yu Wan lose the baby. This not only touched Zhao Xuanyou's reverse scale but also crossed Yu Wan's bottom line.

If it were any other matter, Yu Wan would advise Zhao Xuanyou to endure it, but not this one.

"Will this alarm His Majesty?"

"Not likely. But Wanwan, the Ministry of War might soon order me back to Yuzhou."

He was a second-rank General of the Cavalry, but also the commander of the Mingmi Guard.

Previously, he had hurried back to the capital under the pretense of his grandmother's critical illness. Later, he was entrusted with investigating the treason case involving the deposed empress and the deposed crown prince, which was why he had stayed in the capital for so long.

Now that the case had been handed over, he naturally had no reason to stay in the capital any longer.

"Is this related to what happened today?"

"Mmm."

The emperor's health was still very weak. The specific affairs of the court were still managed by Prince Ping and the two prime ministers.

Although Zhao Xuanyou had not killed Princess Yi'an, he had not given up on revenge.

Tomorrow, when Prince Ping learned of the news from the Princess's mansion, he would surely be angry, thinking that Zhao Xuanyou had not given him face.

"Will Prince Ping report this to His Majesty?"

"He has nothing to report." Zhao Xuanyou said indifferently. "The matter at Yuzhao Garden was suppressed by Consort Li. There is no evidence in the Princess's mansion that can implicate me. If he wants to investigate, he should first investigate Consort Li and Yuzhao Garden."

Consort Li wanted to become the empress. That way, Prince Ping would be the legitimate eldest son, and establishing him as the crown prince would be a matter of course.

Yi'an could use Consort Li to have Prince Ping suppress Zhao Xuanyou, and Zhao Xuanyou could also use Consort Li to have Prince Ping suppress Yi'an.

That was the logic, but "What if Yi'an goes to report this herself?"

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow. "I hope she can still go to report it tomorrow morning."

Even if someone really told the emperor, the emperor would have the Brocade Guard investigate. What could they do?

Yu Wan looked at his composed expression and thought of his earlier "little warning." She became curious. "How exactly did you warn her?"

"I won't tell you."

"Are you afraid of scaring me?" Yu Wan said dissatisfied.

"You, of course, cannot be scared."

Yu Wan dared to break into the Xingguo Duke's mansion to set a fire for revenge. She could survive in the desperate situation of a sandstorm. How could the little commotion he made at the Princess's mansion scare Yu Wan?

However... it was different for Princess Yi'an.

Princess Yi'an regarded other people's lives as grass. When it came to herself, even a pinprick would make her jump to the sky.

Tonight's lesson would be enough for her to digest for a long time.

"What are you thinking about?" Yu Wan asked.

A smile appeared in Zhao Xuanyou's eyes. "It's not that I'm afraid of scaring you, but I'm afraid of scaring the child."

Yu Wan was amused by his words. She also placed her hand on her belly and teased, "Our child, could they be that timid?"

"She's still young. We need to give her time to grow up."

Because of today's events, Zhao Xuanyou had some other emotions.

Ever since Yu Wan became pregnant, he often thought about what it would be like if it were a son or a daughter.

If it were a son, naturally, he would be raised by his side from a young age, practicing martial arts and gaining experience.

If it were a daughter, of course, she would be carefully protected and cherished.

But Princess Yi'an was raised by the emperor with great favor. She was of noble birth and had lived a life of luxury and fine food all her life. However, she had taken a life for her own mood, which was heartless and inhumane.

Thinking about this, raising a daughter was not a simple matter.

He had to ensure that his daughter lived a safe and happy life, free to be bold and unconstrained, but also that she understood the hardships of the world and had compassion for others.

Zhao Xuanyou was thinking about the long-term plan for raising the child, but Yu Wan was worried about the immediate situation.

"If you return to Yuzhou, I will go back with you. I just don't know if the child can handle the journey."

Whether it was the capital or Yuzhou, she wanted to be with Zhao Xuanyou.

But she was pregnant and could not return to Yuzhou with Zhao Xuanyou as quickly as they had come to the capital.

Seeing Yu Wan's worried expression, Zhao Xuanyou lowered his head and kissed her slightly swollen cheek.

How could he bear to leave her and the child in the capital?

"I'll find a way. Alright?"

With his promise, Yu Wan finally smiled.

"You said it!"

"I said it." Zhao Xuanyou said, then yawned. After being busy for half the night, he was indeed tired. "Let's go to sleep."

Yu Wan made room for him on the inside and lay down beside him.

Ever since Yu Wan became pregnant, the two of them had not engaged in marital relations.

At first, Zhao Xuanyou was somewhat unaccustomed and always wanted to seek some affection from Yu Wan. But thinking that there was a little one in the bed besides them, this new feeling truly fascinated Zhao Xuanyou.

He held Yu Wan and soon fell asleep.

The couple spent a few peaceful days in the Marquis's mansion. One day, while Zhao Xuanyou was teaching Yu Wan how to play Go, Yuan Qing rushed in from outside and said that someone from Prince Ping's mansion had come and asked Zhao Xuanyou to go to the prince's mansion.

This was within Zhao Xuanyou's expectations. He immediately changed his clothes and went to the prince's mansion.

Yu Wan couldn't play Go alone. Thinking that the weather was nice today, she decided to visit Liang Miaotong at the Liang mansion.

A few days ago, she had sent many tonics over, but since Liang Miaotong had saved her and the child that day, she should personally visit to express her gratitude.

She ordered Qiuyue to go to the storeroom and get some high-quality tonics, and then sent someone to call Wen Kuo over.

Wen Kuo usually stayed in his own room when they were at the Marquis's mansion, with Zhao Xuanyou guarding Yu Wan.

Yu Wan changed her clothes and waited for Wen Kuo to arrive. However, Pei Xia said that Wen Kuo was not in his room.

Not at home?

Normally, when Yu Wan asked Wen Kuo to go out more, he refused and just stayed in the courtyard practicing his skills. Was the sun rising from the west today?

Because Wen Kuo was not there, Yu Wan had Pei Xia call Yuan Qing over.

To visit the Liang mansion, with Yuan Qing and a few capable guards, it would be enough.

Really, who knew where that guy Wen Kuo had gone.

---

chapters.title: Your Mask?
chapters.content:
The Liang mansion was a bit far from the Marquis's mansion.

Mr. Liang was not from the capital. His entire family had moved to the capital only a year ago. Because his family was a noble and scholarly one, the location of their residence was somewhat off to the side in the capital.

The Marquis's mansion's carriage passed through the city. Yu Wan held a hand warmer, sitting in the carriage with her eyes closed to rest. Suddenly, she heard Yuan Qing outside the carriage shout, "Young Master Kuo!"

Yu Wan perked up and lifted the carriage curtain. Sure enough, she saw Wen Kuo standing by the street, looking at her in surprise.

Wen Kuo didn't say anything. He quickly jumped into the carriage and sat down next to Yu Wan, then helped himself to a piece of pastry and started eating.

Yu Wan ordered the coachman to continue to the Liang mansion.

Wen Kuo was still gnawing on the pastry. Hearing this, he looked up at Yu Wan and then lowered his head to continue eating.

"It's so cold today. What are you doing wandering the streets?"

"I'm not afraid of the cold." After saying this, Wen Kuo asked, "Why did my brother-in-law let you go out alone?"

"He went to see Prince Ping. I thought that since there was nothing to do today, it would be a good time to visit Miss Miaotong at the Liang mansion."

Wen Kuo muttered, "Didn't you send medicine over before?"

"She is my savior. Of course, I need to thank her in person." Yu Wan felt that Wen Kuo's expression was a bit strange but didn't think much of it.

"Then I'll wait for you in the carriage later."

"Mmm."

When the carriage arrived at the Liang mansion, Yuan Qing went to the gatehouse to announce their arrival. Before long, Madame Liang came out to greet them personally.

"Madame Hou."

Yu Wan, supported by Pei Xia, got out of the carriage and stepped forward to exchange greetings.

Knowing that Yu Wan was pregnant, Madame Liang was afraid that the cold wind outside would be bad for her. Without much conversation, she welcomed Yu Wan into the mansion.

"How is Miss Miaotong's body?"

"It's nothing serious. It's just that it takes a hundred days to recover from a sprain. She'll have to lie down for two or three months."

Yu Wan wasn't sure how much Liang Miaotong had told her family. She carefully said, "That day, when Miaotong fell, I was right next to her. If she hadn't pulled me, I would have been the one to fall."

"Madame Hou, there's no need to feel guilty. My daughter Feng'er told me about that day's events. The human heart is hard to fathom, and hidden arrows are hard to guard against. I have always scolded Tong'er for being too reckless. This time, she reacted quickly. It seems she has grown up."

After Yu Wan offered some words of comfort, she ordered Yuan Qing to present the gifts and said she wanted to visit Liang Miaotong.

Madame Liang then led Yu Wan to the courtyard where Liang Miaotong lived.

The Liang mansion was far less spacious than the Marquis's mansion. After passing the main hall and going around a corridor, they reached the area where the young ladies lived.

According to Madame Liang, before Liang Miaofeng got married, both sisters lived here.

As soon as they entered the courtyard, they saw a grape trellis and two swings. It was not hard to imagine how pleasant it was for the sisters to spend time here.

Seeing Yu Wan looking at the swings, Madame Liang smiled. "Before Feng'er got married, the two sisters loved to sit on the swings and chat."

As they spoke, they entered the room. Surprisingly, Liang Miaotong was not lying on the bed resting but sitting on a beauty couch by the window reading a book.

"Mother." Liang Miaotong looked up and saw Yu Wan, surprised. "Madame Hou? Why are you here?"

"Today's weather is nice. I thought I'd bring you some good food and fun things."

Indeed, Yu Wan had brought many things today. Besides tonics and medicine, there were boxes full of pastries and some clever toys from the Marquis's mansion's storeroom.

"Do you like them?"

"I've never played with a Kongming lock like this before."

"I thought that since you can't move around these days, some toys might help pass the time."

"Madame Hou, you are so thoughtful, unlike my mother. I asked her to buy me some storybooks from the street, and she wouldn't."

Hearing Liang Miaotong's words, Madame Liang said, "Your father said that those storybooks on the street are the delusional works of poor scholars. A young lady like you should read less of those."

"If she won't buy them, then she won't. Anyway, my sister will buy them for me." Liang Miaotong said proudly with a smile.

Yu Wan saw that although Liang Miaotong was injured, her mood was not affected. She felt a little relieved.

"Madame Hou, please sit here for a while. I'll go to the kitchen and take a look. Our family's cook isn't very skilled, but she makes decent pastries from our hometown. Since you've come all this way, you should try some."

Madame Liang was so enthusiastic that Yu Wan couldn't refuse.

Moreover, she had originally wanted to speak to Liang Miaotong alone today.

After thanking her, Yu Wan waited for Madame Liang to leave the room before looking at Liang Miaotong.

"Miaotong, that day in Yuzhao Garden, did you see my guard?"

"I did. Madame, rest assured. I haven't even told my parents."

"Thank you." Yu Wan was relieved and explained to Liang Miaotong, "It's because I've offended someone in the capital, so I had my guard follow me secretly. I didn't expect something to happen."

Liang Miaotong listened quietly to Yu Wan and then smiled at her. "Madame Hou's guard is really amazing. He can come and go without a trace in Yuzhao Garden."

"He is indeed very capable." Thinking that Wen Kuo had been seen by Liang Miaotong, and Wen Kuo was always sensitive about this, Yu Wan couldn't help but sigh softly. "It's just that his appearance is marred, so when he goes out, he either disguises himself or wears a mask."

"But he doesn't look ugly." Liang Miaotong subconsciously said.

Yu Wan smiled and nodded, then felt something was off.

She thought that Wen Kuo's mask falling off was a fleeting moment. With Wen Kuo's usual character, he would have quickly hidden.

How could Liang Miaotong have seen his appearance clearly?

"He's not ugly," Yu Wan continued along her line of thought. "He has clear eyebrows and bright eyes. If it weren't for that birthmark, he would probably be quite liked by girls."

This was not a topic that an unmarried girl should discuss.

Liang Miaotong lightly coughed, picked up her tea, and lowered her head to drink.

Yu Wan had intended to probe, so she watched Liang Miaotong's reaction. She also recalled encountering Wen Kuo on the street not far from the Liang mansion and felt that something was amiss.

Because Liang Miaotong had avoided her gaze, Yu Wan casually turned her face away and looked around the room.

As she did, Yu Wan noticed something.

Behind the desk, on the wall, there were no paintings hung as decorations. Instead, sixteen masks of various shapes were neatly hung. There were chubby baby masks with innocent expressions, stern door god masks, smiling masks of the South Pole Immortal, and at the very bottom hung a pure white mask, which happened to resemble the one Wen Kuo had worn that day in Yuzhao Garden.

"Are those masks something you collected every year during the Lantern Festival? They look nice, don't they?" Noticing that Yu Wan was looking at the masks on the wall, Liang Miaotong explained.

"They are nice. Did you buy them all yourself?"

Liang Miaotong nodded firmly.

Yu Wan smiled and didn't say anything more. She asked Liang Miaotong what storybook she was reading, changing the subject.

Before long, Madame Liang brought over some pastries. Yu Wan tried them, sat for a while, and then got up to take her leave, saying she would come to visit Liang Miaotong again in a few days.

Back in the carriage, Yu Wan saw Wen Kuo sitting in the corner and didn't say anything.

When they entered the Tangli Courtyard, Yu Wan had the maids withdraw. As soon as the door was closed, Wen Kuo became a little restless.

Yu Wan took a sip of tea and raised her eyebrows to look at him.

"Speak. What were you doing out today?"

chapters.title: What About Me?
chapters.content:
"Just walking around the streets, didn't you tell me to go out more?"

Wen Ji said this as he poured himself a cup of tea and drank it with his head lowered.

In Yu Wan's eyes, he was clearly acting guilty, avoiding her gaze.

"I did tell you to go out more, but I didn't tell you to go to the Liang residence."

"I... didn't. Why would I go to the Liang residence?"

The white mask Wen Ji wore had previously fallen to the ground, and its right side had been stained with a bit of mud.

When Yu Wan was at the Liang residence, she had specifically checked the mask hanging on the wall, and sure enough, the right side of that mask was also stained brown; exactly like Wen Ji's.

Seeing how stubborn Wen Ji was being, Yu Wan decided to cut to the chase: "Then the mask in Miss Miaotong's room isn't yours."

Upon realizing that Yu Wan knew about the mask, Wen Ji simply fell silent.

His expression was rather amusing, and Yu Wan held back her laughter before asking, "Did you two talk that day in Yuzhao Garden?"

"Didn't you tell me to go save her?"

"You went down the mountain to save her, and then?"

At that time, Liang Miaotong had rolled down the mountain and should have been injured. How did they have the chance to talk?

"I chased after her, but she had already hit a tree trunk. I saw that her leg was injured, so I wanted to help her by sealing her acupoints to relieve the pain. But..."

Yu Wan looked at Wen Ji curiously, waiting for him to continue.

"She said she was born with a dull sense of pain. Even if she broke her leg, she wouldn't cry."

Yu Wan now understood why, when she visited the Liang residence today, Liang Miaotong wasn't lying in bed recovering but was instead sitting by the window, cheerfully eating snacks and reading a storybook.

Leg injuries were troublesome to recover from. After Zhao Xuanyou had fallen into the river, although he had never cried out in pain, Yu Wan could tell he wasn't unaffected; he had simply endured it silently.

Liang Miaotong had been carried back from Yuzhao Garden, and by all accounts, her wounds hadn't even swollen yet. Yet, her spirits seemed completely unaffected.

So, she had a dull sense of pain.

"That day, I told her my mask had been caught on a tree branch and fallen. She had picked it up. I was afraid the guards would catch up, so I didn't dare linger in the plum forest. I only told her I was your guard and asked her to hide the mask well before leaving with the eunuch." As if afraid Yu Wan wouldn't believe him, Wen Ji added, "Today, I just wanted to secretly retrieve my mask."

"In broad daylight?"

If he hadn't added that, Yu Wan might have believed him.

With Wen Ji's qinggong skills, sneaking into the Liang residence at night to retrieve the mask wouldn't be difficult. But doing it in broad daylight; even if he could fly, someone would see him.

"I wanted to see where the mask was during the day. She's a noble miss; I couldn't very well sneak into her room at night to search."

Seeing Wen Ji explain himself to this extent, Yu Wan knew she had almost backed him into a corner. So she said, "Miaotong likes collecting masks. She hung your white mask on the wall of her boudoir. If you want to retrieve it, bring her a nice one to hang in its place. Otherwise, there'll be an empty spot."

Wen Ji had thought Yu Wan would continue teasing him. Hearing her say this, he paused for a moment before responding with an "mm."

"We'll eat at Tangli Courtyard tonight."

"Has your appetite recovered?"

"I can eat three steamed buns in the morning now. The imperial physician even told me to restrain myself a little and not eat too much."

"Do you want to eat the food I make?" Previously, when Yu Wan had morning sickness and lost her appetite, the cooks in the mansion had racked their brains to make food for her. Wen Ji had also tried making some of her favorite dishes, but unfortunately, she couldn't eat any of them.

Hearing this, Yu Wan was overjoyed: "Yes."

Ever since arriving in Yuzhou, she hadn't eaten any of Wen Ji's cooking.

"Then I'll cook tonight."

"Good. I told Zhao Xuanyou about your cooking skills before, and he didn't believe me! Tonight, let him see for himself."

Seeing Yu Wan so happy, Wen Ji smiled slightly before heading to the kitchen.

After Wen Ji left, Yu Wan rested her chin on the table, lost in thought. When Zhao Xuanyou entered, he saw her in this absent-minded state.

"What are you daydreaming about?"

Hearing his voice, Yu Wan smiled and looked up, quickly getting up and walking toward him, draping her arm over his shoulder.

A beauty throwing herself into his arms; such a pleasant thing.

Zhao Xuanyou lifted her up, but frowned as he carried her back to the edge of the beauty's couch by the window and gently set her down.

"Don't always rush around like this. Be gentler and slower."

"I know."

He had just returned from outside, and his brocade robe still carried the chill of the wind, feeling cold to the touch.

"I'll go change my clothes."

But Yu Wan clutched his belt, refusing to let go. She untied his belt for him and slipped her hand inside his robe.

Zhao Xuanyou had practiced martial arts for years, and his waist and abdomen were well-defined, lean, and firm.

Feeling her fingers tracing the contours, Zhao Xuanyou's expression stiffened slightly.

Yu Wan's morning sickness had just passed, and now she had taken to a new habit; she particularly enjoyed touching him.

Normally, this would be to Zhao Xuanyou's liking, but with her pregnant, how could he allow such behavior?

Zhao Xuanyou could only let her have her way while tightly pressing his lips together, trying to maintain his composure.

Seeing that Yu Wan had no intention of stopping, he cleared his throat and changed the subject.

"Today, Prince Ping urged me to leave the capital."

This statement indeed caught Yu Wan's attention. She looked up at Zhao Xuanyou and asked repeatedly, "Urged you to leave? How urgent is it? What about Princess Yi'an?"

"The news sent from Princess Yi'an's residence was intercepted by Consort Li. It wasn't reported to the Qianqing Palace. Instead, an imperial physician was sent to treat Princess Yi'an."

"What's wrong with her?"

"Nightmare disorder."

"Nightmares?"

"Mm. I heard she had a nightmare, and after waking up, she refused to eat, drink, or speak."

Yu Wan paused for a long moment before softly asking, "Did you scare her?"

"She has a guilty conscience; she's scaring herself."

Since Zhao Xuanyou had personally handled the matter, Yu Wan was naturally at ease. After thinking for a moment, she sensed something unusual: "Are the affairs of the palace being handled by Consort Li and Prince Ping?"

"It hasn't come to that. His Majesty's health has not yet recovered, but he no longer attends to the complicated affairs of state."

Pan Xun had officially been promoted to the commander of the Brocade Guard, so Zhao Xuanyou was well-informed about the palace situation.

"So, currently, only Consort Li and Prince Ping can see His Majesty?"

"Not exactly. The two prime ministers and Pan Xun visit the Qianqing Palace daily to report to His Majesty." Zhao Xuanyou said this while subtly removing Yu Wan's hand from his robe. He added, "His Majesty has recently asked Prince Jing, Prince Qing, and Prince Rui to help manage state affairs. It seems he wants to counterbalance Prince Ping's influence."

Hearing this, Yu Wan suddenly realized that His Majesty might not actually favor Prince Ping as the heir to the throne.

No wonder His Majesty had been so slow to depose Zhao Zun; perhaps in His Majesty's heart, Prince Ping was no better than Zhao Zun.

Now that the other three princes were all married and established, it was hard to say whom the emperor favored.

Seeing Yu Wan lost in thought again, Zhao Xuanyou took the opportunity to pull his belt away from her hand and went to change into casual clothes.

When he returned to the beauty's couch, Yu Wan's eyes were wide as she looked at him: "When are we returning to Yuzhou?"

"I have to leave in ten days."

Yu Wan noticed the subtle difference in their questions and immediately urged, "What about me?"

---

chapters.title: A Sudden Joy
chapters.content:
"I'll discuss it with the imperial physician."

Yu Wan was pregnant, and although Zhao Xuanyou wanted to be with her every day, all plans had to prioritize her and the child.

"Has the Ministry of War notified you yet?"

"Not yet, but I expect the news tomorrow."

Yu Wan reached out and grabbed Zhao Xuanyou, feeling a pang of distress.

Even when he was working in the palace, coming and going early and late, Yu Wan had already found it hard to bear.

At least then, they could see each other in the mornings and evenings. If she couldn't go back to Yuzhou with Zhao Xuanyou, by the time she gave birth and finished her confinement, wouldn't it be a whole year before she saw him again?

She wanted to be a virtuous wife who understood the bigger picture, but the thought of being apart for so long made her nose tingle.

Wen Ji entered the room and saw the couple sitting together by the window. He retreated back out.

"Wen Ji, come in." Yu Wan said, straightening up.

Wen Ji re-entered the room, greeted Zhao Xuanyou as "brother-in-law," and sat across from the couple.

"As I told you before, Wen Ji is an excellent cook. Tonight, he's cooking, so you're in for a treat."

Soon, Autumn Moon and Spring Xing set out the cups, plates, and dishes before withdrawing.

After the three of them were seated, they stopped talking about court matters and focused on the meal.

Wen Ji had prepared simple home-style dishes: steamed fish, stir-fried lamb, salted pork with bamboo shoots, and a ginseng chicken soup; perfect for a family meal.

With delicious food and family by her side, Yu Wan's distress gradually subsided.

It had been a long time since Yu Wan had eaten with Wen Ji, so she didn't let him leave after the meal. After the maids cleared the dishes, they brought out fruit wine and sweet soup.

As they chatted idly, Yuan Zhe came forward and announced that a letter from Shen Yao, the deputy commander of the Mingjian Guard, had arrived for Zhao Xuanyou.

During the time Zhao Xuanyou had been in the capital, military affairs had been handled by Shen Yao.

Without avoiding Yu Wan and Wen Ji, Zhao Xuanyou opened the letter directly.

While Zhao Xuanyou read the letter, Yu Wan reached her chopsticks into his cup, wanting to dip them in the fruit wine to taste it.

Before the chopsticks could touch the cup, they were intercepted by another pair of chopsticks.

Yu Wan suddenly looked up, glaring fiercely at Wen Ji.

Wen Ji showed no fear. Instead, he looked at Yu Wan, resolutely refusing to let her dip the chopsticks.

Yu Wan had no choice but to withdraw her chopsticks.

She didn't like drinking, had a low tolerance for alcohol, and didn't know why, after the first three months of pregnancy, she had suddenly developed cravings; even for alcohol, which she had never touched before.

Unfortunately, she had been caught by Wen Ji.

Yu Wan pouted and put down her chopsticks, then looked up at Zhao Xuanyou, only to see his expression was quite strange.

Had he seen her trying to taste the wine?

No, he was reading the letter.

Could it be that enemies were invading Yuzhou? As the commander, Zhao Xuanyou would naturally be responsible.

"Husband, has something happened in Yuzhou?"

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yu Wan with a complex gaze, then at Wen Ji, but said nothing.

Yu Wan could sense surprise in his eyes, but his reaction didn't seem like an enemy invasion.

"You take a look." Zhao Xuanyou actually handed the letter to Wen Ji.

Wen Ji was a little surprised. He hadn't expected Zhao Xuanyou to ignore Yu Wan's question and hand the letter to him instead.

He took the letter, and as soon as he saw its contents, he looked up in shock, first at Zhao Xuanyou, then at Yu Wan, unsure how to react.

Seeing their reactions, Yu Wan stood up to snatch the letter from Wen Ji's hands.

Since she stood up too quickly, Zhao Xuanyou, afraid she might bump into something, hurriedly steadied her and pulled her to his side.

"Shen Yao wrote in the letter that he wants to..."

Zhao Xuanyou stammered and didn't finish. Wen Ji also looked away, his eyes darting around.

Yu Wan was about to go mad with curiosity and almost slammed the table. She angrily demanded, "Speak!"

Zhao Xuanyou gave Wen Ji a look.

Wen Ji had no choice but to steel himself and say, "General Shen wrote in the letter that he wants to ask for your mother's hand in marriage."

"Who? Who wants to marry my mother?"

Yu Wan now wore the same expression as the two of them had moments before.

Zhao Xuanyou cleared his throat. "Shen Yao, the deputy commander of the Mingjian Guard. You've met him before."

When Yu Wan was in the study helping him with military affairs, Shen Yao often came to report to Zhao Xuanyou. Yu Wan had seen him a few times, so of course, she recognized him.

If he had kept quiet, it would have been fine, but now that he had spoken, Yu Wan's gaze turned fierce: "Did you know he had feelings for my mother all along?"

"How would I know?"

Zhao Xuanyou's feelings were indescribably complicated.

Yu Wan had always been very filial. When they left Yuzhou, she had wanted Wen Ji to stay behind to protect Ding Wenxi. But Zhao Xuanyou had felt that the capital was more dangerous, so he had Wen Ji accompany them back.

To reassure Yu Wan, Zhao Xuanyou had specifically instructed Shen Yao to take good care of Ding Wenxi, who was left alone in Yuzhou.

Who would have thought that Shen Yao would end up wanting to marry her?

Shen Yao was ten years older than Zhao Xuanyou. He was a soldier brought up by the old marquis, and to Zhao Xuanyou, he was less like a subordinate and more like an older brother. That was why Zhao Xuanyou had trusted him to help.

But after half a year of care, Shen Yao had developed feelings for his mother-in-law. How was this any different from being robbed by one of his own men?

If Shen Yao were in front of him right now, Zhao Xuanyou might have the urge to stab him to death.

Unfortunately, Shen Yao was thousands of miles away, and the person next to him was ready to stab him instead.

Wen Ji, also lost in shock, suddenly spoke up: "Does Mother also like him?"

At this, Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan both fell silent.

From what they knew of Shen Yao, it was clear he wasn't the kind of man to force himself on someone.

Since he had written to propose marriage, Ding Wenxi must know about it.

Wen Ji had intended to help Zhao Xuanyou out of the awkward situation, but his words only made the atmosphere in the room more awkward.

Ran Dong entered with a bowl of swallow's nest soup and immediately sensed the strange atmosphere.

She placed the bowl in front of Yu Wan and carefully said, "Just now, the old marquis sent someone to deliver a message. He invites the marquis to have breakfast with him early tomorrow morning."

Zhao Xuanyou waved his hand, signaling Ran Dong to leave.

Ran Dong, frightened by the atmosphere in the room, lowered her head and quickly retreated.

Zhao Xuanyou had been called to Prince Ping's residence today, so his father must have known about it and wanted to discuss the matter with him.

Compared to court affairs, the matter of his mother-in-law was clearly more troublesome for Zhao Xuanyou.

After a long silence, Wen Ji finally spoke slowly: "General Shen is handsome, skilled in martial arts, and has a good character. Maybe it truly is mutual affection."

Yu Wan's beautiful eyes shot him a cold glance, and Wen Ji's expression froze. He didn't dare say more.

Zhao Xuanyou knew Wen Ji was trying to help and chimed in: "Wen Ji is right. I bet Mother-in-law has taken a liking to Shen Yao."

"You've seen Cui Lingyuan. My mother likes handsome men."

Zhao Xuanyou had never seen Cui Lingyuan in his youth, but looking at Yu Wan's face, it wasn't hard to imagine how handsome Cui Lingyuan must have been twenty years ago.

Young Cui Lingyuan standing next to Pei Tao probably wouldn't have paled in comparison, which was why his mother-in-law had been willing to fall for him.

Even if Shen Yao was handsome, he certainly couldn't compare to Cui Lingyuan.

But Zhao Xuanyou thought Wen Ji's guess made sense: "Maybe after falling for a handsome man and getting hurt, she now knows that character is what truly matters."

Yu Wan let out a cold humph: "My mother has told me many times that she likes scholars, not warriors."

Zhao Xuanyou had been about to argue, but suddenly realized that his mother-in-law's words were directed at him. He felt a pang of frustration.

It wasn't hard to guess that his mother-in-law had said this while commenting on him and Pei Tao to Yu Wan.

"Talking about me?" Zhao Xuanyou asked sourly.

"What else could it be?"

Wen Ji saw the couple's conversation veering further off track and fell silent, regretting that he hadn't worn his mask today.

chapters.title: A Needless Worry
chapters.content:
Seeing the two of them talking one after another, Wen Mo hesitated for a long time before finally speaking up, "Mother did say that. Back then, you were arguing with her. You said that your brother-in-law is both literate and martial, not only is his kung fu impressive, but his knowledge is even better than those scholars."

Upon hearing this, Zhao Xuanyou glanced at Yu Wan with a sidelong look. Seeing her puffed-up cheeks and aggrieved expression, he immediately felt a sense of satisfaction.

"Don't worry, I will definitely get to the bottom of this. If Shen Jiao took advantage of your mother when she was alone, I will absolutely not let him off."

He only said half of what he meant, but Yu Wan and Wen Mo understood the other half.

If Ding Wenxi truly liked Shen Jiao and they were mutually in love, then as their juniors, they naturally had no reason to oppose.

"I'll go back to my room first." Wen Mo, seeing the situation, let out a slight sigh of relief and took the opportunity to slip away.

Left alone in the room with just the couple,

Zhao Xuanyou looked at Yu Wan and gently patted her head, "Don't worry, let me first find out what's going on."

Yu Wan remained silent.

Zhao Xuanyou picked up a honey-glazed cherry that she liked and put it into her mouth. Seeing that she was still sulking, he carried her back to the inner chamber, had the maids attend to her washing up, and then went to the study to write a letter to Shen Jiao.

When he returned, Yu Wan had already lain down.

The candlelight in the room swayed gently. Zhao Xuanyou leaned closer to Yu Wan, and a faint fragrance wafted over.

After becoming pregnant, Yu Wan had stopped using rouge and powder, and the room was rarely filled with incense. Only a small amount of sleep-aiding herbs were tucked under her pillow.

In Zhao Xuanyou's eyes, she was extremely beautiful even without any makeup, with a charming allure in every glance and gesture.

He looked at her and smiled, then raised his hand to gather her loose hair that was scattered on the pillow, and then lay down beside her.

Before he could figure out how to comfort her, Yu Wan burrowed into his arms and sighed softly, "I know General Shen is a good person, it's just that it's too sudden."

Ever since Yu Wan could remember, it had always been just her and her mother relying on each other.

Suddenly hearing that her mother was going to remarry made her feel as if they would no longer be a family.

"I can't bear to be separated from my mother."

Before marrying Zhao Xuanyou, she had thought that when she entered the Marquis's residence, her mother and Wen Mo would also move in, and the family would be together.

If her mother got married, she would definitely have to move out.

"Let me first find out what's going on." Zhao Xuanyou held Yu Wan, gently patting her shoulder as if coaxing a child, "If your mother really agrees to the marriage, then let Shen Jiao buy the house next to the Marquis's residence, and we can connect them with a door."

Yu Wan was coaxed into laughter by him, and her tense voice finally softened.

"Mother had a bad experience in the past and married the wrong person. If she really finds a reliable person, I should be happy for her."

During the two years her mother was with Cui Lingyuan, they had not spent much time together and had never experienced the true life of a married couple.

Later, she lived alone with Yu Wan, and in the village, there wasn't even one person she could talk to.

Thinking about it this way, her mother's life had been quite lonely.

"If they are mutually in love, it is indeed a good thing." Seeing that Yu Wan had calmed down, Zhao Xuanyou also spoke his mind, "You have me now, and we have a child. Our days ahead will be fulfilling and happy. Your mother now has her own business to manage. If she has someone to rely on, her future days will also be as fulfilling and happy as ours."

"Mmm." Yu Wan reached out to touch her stomach, her eyes shining faintly.

After becoming pregnant, her mind and body had indeed prioritized the child, even over Zhao Xuanyou.

Knowing that her mother's days in Yuzhou were going well was indeed something to be happy about.

"General Shen is several years younger than my mother. To be honest, I still find it a bit hard to believe."

As a son-in-law, Zhao Xuanyou was not in a good position to comment on his mother-in-law. However, seeing Yu Wan so distressed, he still said, "With your mother's appearance, it's not just Shen Jiao. She could find someone even younger."

Yu Wan's appearance took more after the Cui family, but Ding Wenxi's beauty was also extraordinary.

Now that she was older and usually dressed plainly, but her every movement exuded a cold and beautiful light, easily attracting others' attention.

"Oh?"

Seeing Yu Wan narrow her eyes, Zhao Xuanyou coughed dryly and said, "It's only because you asked that I said it."

Looking at his cautious appearance, Yu Wan couldn't help but smile, tilting her chin up and going over to give him a peck on the cheek.

"I know." After a pause, Yu Wan asked again, "I know General Shen has a daughter but no wife. What happened to his wife?"

"They divorced by mutual agreement."

Shen Jiao was originally from the capital, and although he was not of noble birth, his family was quite well-off.

He had joined the army under the old Marquis, thinking that after a few years of training in Yuzhou, he would return to the capital to seek an official position. At that time, the war with the Wuhuan was intense, and the old Marquis was seriously injured. How could he leave?

His wife felt that he had not kept his promise and, heartbroken, asked for a divorce by mutual agreement.

After Shen Jiao returned to the capital and divorced his wife, he took his daughter to Yuzhou. With no ties left in the capital, he had been stationed in Yuzhou ever since.

"So that's how it is."

In such matters, no one was at fault. In the end, it could only be said that their fate had come to an end.

Seeing that Yu Wan had been silent for a long time, Zhao Xuanyou asked, "Do you still feel that something is not right?"

"No." Yu Wan sighed softly, "I have you, and my mother has General Shen. What about our Wen Mo?"

Zhao Xuanyou used to dislike how affectionate Yu Wan was with Wen Mo, but now that they had been together for a long time, he had grown fond of his little brother-in-law.

Hearing Yu Wan say this, he keenly sensed something.

"Does Ah Mo have something going on?"

"I don't know if it counts." Yu Wan then recounted her visit to the Liang residence that day, and after finishing, she asked Zhao Xuanyou, "Do you not approve?"

"If Miss Miaotong has seen Ah Mo's true appearance, then his looks are not a problem. However, Minister Liang probably won't agree to this marriage."

Yu Wan, of course, understood this, but Zhao Xuanyou had said it out loud.

Minister Liang was a literati official who had risen through the imperial examinations. Although he did not place as much emphasis on family background as the noble families, Minister Liang had a good reputation, and the Liang family had produced a princess consort. With Miss Miaotong's character and appearance, there would definitely be many families in the capital who would want to form a marriage alliance with the Liang family.

Even if Wen Mo had the title of being Zhao Xuanyou's brother-in-law, it would still be difficult for the Liang family to accept him.

Zhao Xuanyou pondered for a while and felt that there was no immediate solution, so he advised, "Maybe we're worrying needlessly. The two of them might not have those feelings."

This made sense.

After interacting with Liang Miaotong a few times, she found her to be quite clever and playful. Maybe she just found it amusing and left the mask behind.

After talking so much, Yu Wan also felt sleepy. Before long, she fell asleep in Zhao Xuanyou's arms.

The next morning, Zhao Xuanyou went to have breakfast with the old Marquis.

Yu Wan sat down to eat her porridge. Pei Xia came in and said that the old Marquis had asked her to go to Leshou Hall.

She put down her porridge bowl and had Pei Xia fetch her clothes and cloak, feeling a sense of disappointment.

Her grandmother must have known that Zhao Xuanyou was going to leave the capital and probably wouldn't let her go with him.

---

chapters.title: The Old Marquis Steps In
chapters.content:
Not long after, Yu Wan arrived at Leshou Hall.

To her surprise, not only were her father-in-law and Zhao Xuanyou there, but Wen Mo had also been called over.

"Wanwan is here."

Old Lady Ye was wearing a dress with a floral pattern in the color of autumn fragrance, and on her head, she wore a plain-colored forehead band to keep warm.

This forehead band was made by Yu Wan herself. Since she was not skilled in embroidery, she had not embroidered any flowers on it. It looked plain, but Old Lady Ye liked it very much and often wore it.

Seeing Yu Wan enter, she warmly called her over to sit beside her.

"I heard that Xuanyou will have to return to Yuzhou soon. Your grandfather and I have discussed it," Old Lady Ye patted Yu Wan's hand, her voice sincere and earnest, "It's freezing outside, and the roads to Yuzhou are all icy. Not to mention you traveling, even Xuanyou makes me worry. It's best if both of you wait until after the New Year to depart."

Yu Wan understood that her grandmother was right, but she simply did not want to be separated from Zhao Xuanyou.

For a moment, she did not know how to respond and could only remain silent.

"At this time, carriages and horses indeed have difficulty traveling. Even if Xuanyou returns to Yuzhou, it would be more appropriate to wait until spring when the ice and snow have melted." The old Marquis knew that Yu Wan had misunderstood Old Lady Ye's intention and gently said, "Today, I will go to pay a visit to Minister Xu to see if I can mediate."

Minister Xu was a senior and respected official, and his words carried considerable weight with the emperor.

In the court, Minister Sun had already shown signs of siding with Prince Ping. Prince Ping also needed to win over the highly respected Minister Xu. If Minister Xu were to speak up, it was likely that Prince Ping would not object.

So, her grandmother and grandfather had called her to Leshou Hall just to discuss this matter.

"Thank you, Father." Yu Wan was overjoyed.

"I have some connection with Minister Xu. He should be willing to help."

Zhao Xuanyou, seeing the smile in Yu Wan's eyes, could not help but smile as well.

The old Marquis stayed in Leshou Hall for a while before leaving to visit Minister Xu. Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan stayed and chatted with Old Lady Ye for a long time.

Old Lady Ye had not interacted much with Wen Mo before. During the idle chat, she learned that Wen Mo was not yet married and mentioned that she wanted to arrange a marriage for him.

Before Yu Wan could speak, Zhao Xuanyou said that Wen Mo would also join the military in the future, thus changing the subject.

After sitting in Leshou Hall for half a day and having lunch, they returned to the Tangli Courtyard.

The couple was just about to take a nap when Yuan Qing came to report that the old Marquis had returned. He said that they could rest assured and spend the New Year in the capital.

This meant that Minister Xu had agreed to help.

Yu Wan's suspended heart finally settled, and her sleepiness vanished. She pulled Zhao Xuanyou to discuss spending the New Year in the capital.

Soon, a directive came from the Ministry of War. Instead of ordering Zhao Xuanyou to return to Yuzhou immediately, it asked him to temporarily take over the affairs of the Central Army Command. It turned out that someone had reported that the Grand Duke had close ties with the deposed Crown Prince. The Brocade Guards were still investigating, and the court would discuss the selection of the new Grand Duke after the case was resolved.

Zhao Xuanyou now had a proper reason to stay in the capital. After being busy for a while, he planned to take Yu Wan to stay in Mei Hua Wu for a few days. However, the Princess's residence sent someone with an invitation.

During their last meeting at Yuzhao Garden, Princess Yining had mentioned that she wanted to invite them to her hot spring villa.

This villa was bestowed by the emperor and was very close to the capital. The official road leading to it was wide and smooth. The area around the hot spring was warm due to the geothermal heat, making it as comfortable as spring even in winter, with flowers blooming all year round.

Since Yu Wan had never soaked in a hot spring before, Zhao Xuanyou accepted the invitation.

Yu Wan was pregnant and could not travel quickly. Taking advantage of the clear weather, she ordered the carriage to be prepared early, and they set off when the city gates opened, finally arriving at the hot spring villa before lunch.

Even before entering, Yu Wan could feel the warmth around her.

"Big Brother, Sister-in-law."

Ye Mo Yuan stood at the entrance and welcomed them in. After walking a short distance inside, they saw Princess Yining with her daughter picking flowers.

"Princess Yining." Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan greeted her together.

Princess Yining saw them and told them not to stand on ceremony here.

Yu Wan went over to exchange pleasantries with the princess and then softly greeted Yao Yao.

No matter what Yu Wan said, Yao Yao just looked at her blankly and answered irrelevant things.

Seeing such a young child harmed by power struggles, Yu Wan felt distressed and just patted her little head without saying anything else.

In any case, Yao Yao recognized Ye Mo Yuan and Princess Yining and could speak, which was an improvement from before.

"Don't stand here talking. Lunch is ready. Let's go eat first." Ye Mo Yuan said, picking up his daughter and leading Zhao Xuanyou forward.

Princess Yining, holding the freshly picked flowers, walked behind with Yu Wan.

"Let's arrange these flowers in a vase later. Otherwise, they will wilt if left for too long."

"Okay."

Yu Wan used to work in a flower room and had some knowledge of flower arrangement. She quickly picked and chose, soon arranging the flowers in a vase.

Zhao Xuanyou watched her arranging the flowers and suddenly remembered the first time he "saw" her, she was holding a large bunch of flowers standing in front of him.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou staring at Yu Wan, Ye Mo Yuan teased, "Big Brother, your feelings for Sister-in-law are too deep. Even when she's just arranging flowers over there, you're staring so intently."

Yu Wan looked over at the sound of his voice and met Zhao Xuanyou's gaze, smiling before continuing to arrange the flowers.

Zhao Xuanyou pretended not to notice Ye Mo Yuan's teasing, a smile flashing in his eyes.

After spending so much time together, he could tell that whenever Yu Wan met girls of similar age, her mood would be very good, her expression relaxed and free, with a unique charm of a young girl.

She had not had many opportunities to make friends along the way. Now that her life was stable, she had finally been able to make up for this.

"Let's eat first. Don't arrange flowers anymore." Ye Mo Yuan saw that they were chatting enthusiastically and urged them to eat first.

It wasn't that he was afraid the food would get cold, but both of them were expecting, and it wouldn't be good if they got hungry.

Yu Wan and Princess Yining put down the vase and, as advised, returned to the dining table.

After lunch, Yu Wan wanted to go back to her room to rest.

Although the carriage had traveled slowly, sitting for the whole journey was still tiring. She didn't dare to overdo it and wanted to rest to regain her energy before enjoying the scenery.

Ye Mo Yuan had already prepared a room for them and personally led them there to rest.

Before they arrived, they saw a maid leading a young man in a green robe coming from the front.

Yu Wan looked at the man's appearance and was slightly startled.

It was Cui Zaiting.

Cui Zaiting was also a bit surprised to see them and cupped his hands in greeting.

Ye Mo Yuan knew that Zhao Xuanyou had a feud with the Cui family and quickly explained, "I invited Mr. Cui to paint a portrait of Yao Yao. The princess liked it very much and said to paint the whole family, so I invited Mr. Cui over."

Ye Mo Yuan had a wide circle of friends in the capital and had interactions with several young masters of the Cui family.

After the Marquis of Xingguo was seized and his family was confiscated, Ye Mo Yuan had encountered Cui Zaiting selling calligraphy and paintings on the street.

Previously, the imperial physician had said that Yao Yao would not live long. Princess Yining had asked the palace painters to paint several portraits of Yao Yao, but she was not satisfied with any of them. Ye Mo Yuan then found Cui Zaiting, and after trying him out, he indeed painted better.

When Yao Yao's condition improved, Princess Yining wanted to paint a portrait of the whole family and thus invited Cui Zaiting directly to the villa.

Originally, they would not have met Zhao Xuanyou and his wife, but a few days ago, it had snowed. Ye Mo Yuan was afraid of slipping on the icy roads and asked Cui Zaiting to stay a few more days, which led to this encounter.

chapters.title: Acknowledging Family
chapters.content:
"Master Cui." Seeing the hesitation in Ye Moqian's eyes, Yu Wan also returned the greeting to Cui Zaiting.

Ye Moqian secretly let out a sigh of relief. After exchanging a few pleasantries with Cui Zaiting, he had a maid lead him to the studio to clear away all the paintings.

The three of them continued walking forward, but before they had gone far, Cui Zaiting suddenly spoke up.

"Madame Hou."

Yu Wan stopped in her tracks and turned to look at Cui Zaiting.

Cui Zaiting's eyes flickered, seemingly quite uneasy. After being stared at by the three of them for a moment, he still said, "Madame Hou, may I have a word with you in private?"

"This might be..." This remark would sound rude to others. Ye Moqian was about to speak up to stop him, but saw Zhao Xuanyou giving him a wink.

Yu Wan, surprisingly, nodded her head and, supported by the maid, walked over to Cui Zaiting.

"Big brother?" Ye Moqian said softly.

"It's fine."

Ye Moqian set his mind at ease and stood in place with Zhao Xuanyou to wait for Yu Wan.

"Master Cui, what is it?"

Cui Zaiting glanced at the maid beside him and frowned without speaking.

Yu Wan vaguely guessed what he wanted to say and signaled the maid to step back a bit.

Before Cui Zaiting could speak, Yu Wan got straight to the point and asked, "You know?"

Cui Zaiting had complicated feelings towards Yu Wan.

He clearly knew of Cui Yichu's hatred towards Yu Wan, and he also clearly knew of the grudges between the Jingyuan Marquis Estate and the Xingguo Duke Estate. His highly respected elder brother had been beaten half to death by Zhao Xuanyou and had eventually died of illness before the execution.

But what he had never expected was that, beyond all these grudges, he and Yu Wan were actually related by blood.

The beautifully dressed woman before him was actually his sister.

Cui Zaiting took a deep breath and nodded with difficulty. "When I went to Yunshan Temple to visit Father, he told me."

"He has already become a monk, why does he still care about these mundane matters?"

Cui Zaiting remained silent.

Although the Xingguo Duke Estate had been confiscated, his father still hoped to make a comeback one day.

He didn't know where his father had heard that Yu Wan was now the Madame of the Marquis Estate, and had urged Cui Zaiting to acknowledge his kinship with Yu Wan and seek an opportunity to obtain an official position.

Of course, Cui Zaiting didn't have the face to ask Yu Wan to acknowledge their kinship, but he hadn't expected to encounter her here today.

"Father is not resigned to his fate. I have advised him many times, but it was all in vain."

Seeing Yu Wan's indifferent expression, Cui Zaiting couldn't help but say, "You can rest assured, I don't intend to pester you. I just feel that it's quite fateful. I still remember the first time I saw you at the Marquis Estate, you pitied me and brought me a cup of water. I was very grateful to you at that time. I never expected that you were my..."

He didn't have the courage to say the word "sister."

Yu Wan curved the corner of her lips slightly and understood his meaning.

Just like how she had relied on her mother for survival since she was young, and then found out that Cui Yichu was her biological sister, a group of unfamiliar relatives had suddenly appeared in her life, as if fate was playing a trick on her.

As she pondered, Yu Wan's gaze fell on Cui Zaiting.

"You warned me before that Cui Yichu wanted to harm my mother. I remember this kindness. If you have any difficulties, feel free to speak up."

Yu Wan had always been clear about gratitude and revenge.

She hated Cui Yichu because, in both her past and present lives, the other party had tried to kill her. She had taken Cui Yichu's life as revenge.

As for Cui Lingyuan's heartlessness towards her mother, Yu Wan had returned it with equal coldness, pretending that she didn't have this biological father.

She had never thought of taking out her anger on the rest of the Cui family.

Cui Zaiting had shown her kindness. Even if he wasn't her brother, Yu Wan would still repay his kindness.

"I don't have any difficulties," Cui Zaiting understood Yu Wan's position.

She had ended up as a servant in the Marquis Estate, which showed that she and her mother had not had an easy life before.

Now that the Xingguo Duke Estate had fallen, and she had become the glorious Madame of the Marquis Estate, it would be quite embarrassing for him to come and acknowledge their kinship.

Seeing Cui Zaiting's embarrassed look, Yu Wan understood that he had no other intentions. She added, "If you encounter any difficulties in the future... or if you want to leave the capital, you can come find me in Yuzhou. However, this only applies to you. I don't acknowledge the rest of the Cui family."

Cui Zaiting was slightly taken aback. Looking into Yu Wan's clear black and white eyes, he also smiled and nodded.

He cupped his hands again towards Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian in the distance, then followed the maid to the studio.

Seeing this, Ye Moqian led the couple to continue walking forward.

The houses in the villa were all built around the hot spring, with occasional pavilions and towers. Before long, they arrived at the entrance of a small courtyard.

The courtyard was built in a refined and elegant style, surrounded by a bamboo fence.

After thanking Ye Moqian, Yu Wan and Zhao Xuanyou entered the house.

Yu Wan was truly exhausted. After changing her clothes, she went to sleep and slept for a full hour before feeling a bit more energetic.

"Would you like some bird's nest soup?"

Zhao Xuanyou walked over with a bowl of soup.

Yu Wan nodded and let him feed her half a bowl of bird's nest soup.

"What did he want to talk to you about?"

"He knows that I am his sister. Cui Lingyuan told him."

Zhao Xuanyou's eyes narrowed slightly, thinking the same as Yu Wan. "Even though he is in Yunshan Temple, his information is quite up-to-date."

"He still wants to make a grand comeback as the Duke one day."

"Did Cui Zaiting say that?"

"He didn't say it directly, but I could tell. Cui Zaiting is a man who values his reputation. He wouldn't say such things."

"Cui Lingyuan hopes that after Cui Zaiting acknowledges his kinship with you, I will help Cui Zaiting out of consideration for our family ties. Wanwan, do you want me to help him?" Zhao Xuanyou asked with great interest.

As for Cui Zaiting alone, Yu Wan naturally didn't mind, but behind Cui Zaiting stood Cui Lingyuan.

Even after being confiscated, he was still hiding in the temple causing trouble. Who knew what he would do if he saw a glimmer of hope for a comeback?

Yu Wan shook her head.

"I consider myself without this biological father. Don't you try to fulfill my filial piety for me."

Zhao Xuanyou raised his eyebrows and nodded.

After a moment of silence, he said, "There's something you should be mentally prepared for. Cui Lingyuan might very well make a comeback."

"Why?"

"Currently, the position of Crown Prince is vacant. Several princes have already established their own families. Although Prince Ping has the upper hand, Prince Rui has the Emperor's favor and the support of the Ningguo Duke. It seems that both have a chance, but in the end, it might be the unexpected Prince Jing or Prince Qing who carve out a new path and rise suddenly."

Zhao Xuanyou naturally had ambitions to influence the court, but after careful consideration, none of the four princes had a guaranteed chance of victory, which made him lose interest in placing his bets.

For now, it was best to go with the flow.

The house was near the hot spring, so even in winter, without heated floors or charcoal braziers, it still felt warm.

In such a warm place, after talking for a long time, Yu Wan soon fell asleep.

She had only intended to take a short nap, but the journey had been so tiring that when she woke up, it was almost time for dinner.

Yu Wan saw that the space beside her was empty and knew that Zhao Xuanyou had gotten up earlier. She called for a maid to help her up.

Before she could ask where Zhao Xuanyou had gone, she heard the sound of splashing water.

"Madame, the Princess's husband invited the Marquis to soak in the hot spring. He specifically instructed the servants not to wake you and to have you go directly when you woke up."

Yu Wan changed her clothes and was about to go out when Pan Xia led her in another direction.

As she pushed open the door, she saw Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian soaking in the largest pool in the center, while Princess Yining was sitting alone at a stone table nearby, eating snacks.

Earlier, she had only known that all the houses were built around the hot spring pools. Now, Yu Wan realized that each courtyard had two doors, one leading to the garden and the other opening directly to the hot spring.

Seeing Yu Wan come out, Princess Yining walked over to her.

"Are you well-rested?"

"Thank you for your concern, Princess. I feel much better after sleeping."

"When you're with me, there's no need for so much formality. Come, let's soak our feet for a while."

The palace servants brought soft cushions and placed them by the small pool at the entrance, carefully helping Yining and Yu Wan to sit down.

Yu Wan glanced at Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian in the distance, hesitated for a moment, then took off her shoes and socks, and put her feet into the hot spring pool.

The pool water had a faint smell of sulfur, and the palace servants had scattered flower petals into it, which floated beautifully on the water.

Princess Yining saw this and quickly ordered the servants to bring a screen to place in front of the small pool, explaining to Yu Wan, "After the Emperor bestowed this villa upon me, I have never invited outsiders to come and play. Usually, only our family is here, so I didn't have these pools separated."

"It's best not to separate them when it's a place for family to enjoy. Before coming here, I even told the Marquis that I had never soaked in a hot spring before and that this trip was to see the world. I didn't expect to be the first guest invited here. It's such an honor."

She spoke sincerely, and hearing this, Princess Yining didn't feel that Yu Wan was some unsophisticated country bumpkin; instead, she found her interesting.

"I remember you were quite close with Sun Qianran?"

During their stay at the Lichuan Summer Palace, Yining had followed Yian to their small courtyard a few times and remembered that Yu Wan and Sun Qianran had been very close.

Yining didn't know about her own departure from the capital and the matter with Pei Ta, so Yu Wan naturally couldn't say much.

She simply said, "When we were at the Summer Palace, Miss Sun treated me very kindly. We haven't been in contact since then."

Princess Yining let out an "oh" and relaxed a bit. "Do you remember her husband at that time, Pei Ta?"

"I do."

"They divorced a few years ago. There are rumors that Sun Qianran still can't forget him. In the past, I didn't think much of it, but the other day in the palace, when Consort Li mentioned wanting to arrange a marriage for Pei Ta, Sun Qianran actually stood up and confronted Consort Li. It seems she is indeed as deeply in love as the rumors suggest."

After Yu Wan agreed with her, she shifted the conversation to pregnancy.

The two of them sat by the pool and soaked their feet for a while. Then, the maids came forward to remind them that it was time to get up and helped them dry their feet and put on their shoes and socks.

By this time, Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian had gotten up and changed into clean clothes. They all sat at the stone tables by the hot spring pool and had a leg of lamb roasted, along with some mild and nourishing food suitable for pregnant women.

Yu Wan had originally planned to stay at the villa for two or three days before returning, but the climate here was as warm as spring. After returning to the capital, Zhao Xuanyou would definitely have to go to work, so she was happy to stay here with company.

As for Zhao Xuanyou, he was always busy, and Ye Moqian loved to chat, ensuring that wherever he was, there would be lively conversation. Princess Yining occasionally put on airs, but she was very kind to Yu Wan.

The days spent at the hot spring villa were the most relaxed since Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan had returned to the capital. Yu Wan and Yining, accompanied by Yao Yao, picked flowers and waded through the water, sharing the hardships and joys of pregnancy. Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian rode horses and swam, reminiscing about their childhood mischief and antics. Each had their own enjoyment.

It wasn't until ten days later, when the Marquis Estate sent someone to urge them to return to handle the New Year's affairs, that the couple bade farewell to the Princess and the Prince Consort and returned to the capital by carriage.

Zhao Xuanyou had rested for several more days, but after returning to the capital, a lot of official business had piled up, and he resumed his days of leaving early and returning late.

Yu Wan, under the guidance of the Old Madame, took on the responsibilities of the Madame of the Marquis Estate. She had to account for the harvests from the fields and shops, arrange the items needed for the New Year celebrations at the Marquis Estate, and prepare New Year gifts for the various relatives and friends.

Fortunately, she was a new bride and pregnant, so although the Old Madame was teaching her, she also had her father-in-law and Concubine Wei help manage the account room affairs, with Wen Tao assisting from the side. Yu Wan also took this opportunity to put her four personal maids to use.

Even so, Yu Wan had no more opportunities to go out.

No matter how others helped, as the mistress of the Marquis Estate, she had to be informed about all matters to have a clear understanding and handle things with ease.

Although it was hard work, the New Year at the Jingyuan Marquis Estate was very lively.

The Old Madame was in good health, Zhao Xuanyou was an official of the second rank, and the Marquis Estate had three generations living together in harmony. Next year, there would even be four generations under one roof, which was something to look forward to.

The whole family accompanied the Old Madame in staying up late on New Year's Eve. After the old year passed and the new year began, the couple set off firecrackers at the entrance of the Marquis Estate before heading to the Tangli Courtyard.

At this moment, the capital was filled with a joyful and festive atmosphere, and the sound of firecrackers could be heard from far and near.

Yu Wan, holding Zhao Xuanyou's hand as they walked forward, suddenly felt a bit distracted.

As she was lost in thought, her feet suddenly left the ground as Zhao Xuanyou picked her up horizontally.

"It's snowing," Zhao Xuanyou said softly.

There was a light dusting of snow on the ground, and he was worried about Yu Wan slipping, so he decided to carry her back.

Yu Wan held onto his shoulder with one hand and opened the other, and soon a cold snowflake drifted into her palm.

It was small, but its shape was still beautiful.

"What are you thinking about?" he asked.

Yu Wan smiled slightly and kissed him on the chin.

"Some old memories."

That New Year's Eve, Zhao Xuanyou had stayed at the Marquis Estate to celebrate the New Year with his grandmother, while she, along with Wen Tao, Bingyun, and Yangquan, had quietly sneaked into the Xingguo Duke Estate, beginning an adventure.

She spoke vaguely, but since it was the New Year, Zhao Xuanyou easily guessed what old memories she was referring to.

In the past, when reading poetry, he would come across the line "Year after year, the flowers are the same, but the people are different," and always feel a sense of sadness. Fortunately, when it came to him and Yu Wan, each year was better than the last.

---

chapters.title: Snowflakes in the Palm
chapters.content:

The current Emperor had not been favored by anyone before his ascension, yet he ended up being the final winner.

"Did you rest well?"

"Thank you for your concern, Princess. I feel much better after sleeping."

"When you're with me, there's no need for so much formality. Come, let's soak our feet for a while."

The palace servants brought soft cushions and placed them by the small pool at the entrance, carefully helping Yining and Yu Wan to sit down.

Yu Wan glanced at Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian in the distance, hesitated for a moment, then took off her shoes and socks, and put her feet into the hot spring pool.

The pool water had a faint smell of sulfur, and the palace servants had scattered flower petals into it, which floated beautifully on the water.

Princess Yining saw this and quickly ordered the servants to bring a screen to place in front of the small pool, explaining to Yu Wan, "After the Emperor bestowed this villa upon me, I have never invited outsiders to come and play. Usually, only our family is here, so I didn't have these pools separated."

"It's best not to separate them when it's a place for family to enjoy. Before coming here, I even told the Marquis that I had never soaked in a hot spring before and that this trip was to see the world. I didn't expect to be the first guest invited here. It's such an honor."

She spoke sincerely, and hearing this, Princess Yining didn't feel that Yu Wan was some unsophisticated country bumpkin; instead, she found her interesting.

The days spent at the hot spring villa were the most relaxed since Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan had returned to the capital. Yu Wan and Yining, accompanied by Yao Yao, picked flowers and waded through the water, sharing the hardships and joys of pregnancy. Zhao Xuanyou and Ye Moqian rode horses and swam, reminiscing about their childhood mischief and antics. Each had their own enjoyment.

It wasn't until ten days later, when the Marquis Estate sent someone to urge them to return to handle the New Year's affairs, that the couple bade farewell to the Princess and the Prince Consort and returned to the capital by carriage.
