Wen Jian was silent for a moment before shaking his head, "She doesn't know what kind of person I am."

"Then go to Yingzhou and tell her about your past. Let her decide whether to accept you." Yu Wan looked at Wen Jian, a soft color appearing in her eyes. "Ah Jian, she is an unmarried girl at the age of marriage arrangement. Leaving home like this will surely invite criticism. She is taking a great risk. If you don't respond, her heart will surely be broken. Can you bear that?"

Wen Jian's gaze trembled, and he finally nodded slightly.

"I will go to Yingzhou to find her."

Yu Wan finally persuaded him, and a smile appeared on her lips.

When she thought about it, she had spent more time with Wen Jian than with Zhao Xuanyou. Wen Jian had long become her family and reliance.

Thinking that he would leave Yuzhou, and she didn't know when he would return, Yu Wan felt a little reluctant.

However, the next time he returned to Yuzhou, he would not be alone.

"If you can't return for a while, remember to write to me and your mother."

"I know."

The sunlight was warm, making Yu Wan's mood very pleasant.

After making up his mind, Wen Jian set off for Yingzhou soon after.

After meeting Liang Miaotong, he told her all about his past. As Yu Wan had expected, Liang Miaotong did not mind these things at all. From the moment he appeared in Yingzhou, she had already chosen the man in front of her.

The two clarified their feelings but did not privately decide their marriage. Instead, they became sworn siblings and traveled together, enjoying the scenery and relaxing their minds.

It wasn't until five years later, when Zhao Xuanyou was ordered back to the capital by the emperor and came to Yuzhou to find Wen Jian, that they were brought back to the capital.

Lord Liang and Lady Liang, seeing their daughter whom they had not seen for several years, were both heartbroken and angry.

Yu Wan naturally wanted to immediately arrange their marriage, but the emperor was seriously ill, and she and Zhao Xuanyou had more important matters to attend to, so they had to postpone the marriage.

Not long after, the adopted son of the Marquis of Jingyuan, Zhao Yi Yun, ascended the throne as emperor, honoring the Marquis and his wife as the Grand Emperor and Grand Empress. Wen Jian was also granted the title of Marquis of Ping'an.

This time, Yu Wan did not ask a matchmaker to propose the marriage. The emperor personally bestowed the marriage.

On the day of the wedding, the Grand Emperor, Grand Empress, and the Emperor personally visited the Marquis of Ping'an's residence to offer their congratulations. The capital had never seen such a lively and grand wedding, and it became a much-talked-about event for a time.

Not long after, another joyous news spread from the palace.

---

chapters.title: Extra – Ah Ning 1
chapters.content:
The spring was coming to an end, and the warm wind rippled the water of Taiye Pool.

The flower trees by the pool were in full bloom. Yu Wan sat under a flower tree, quietly watching Ah Ning learning to swim in the lake not far away.

These days, the water in the pool had warmed up, and Zhao Xuanyou was teaching his son and daughter to swim. For some reason, Zhao Mianze was not very serious about anything, but he learned everything quickly.

Seeing Ah Ning's disheartened look, Yu Wan felt extremely distressed and found a palace maid who knew how to swim to teach Ah Ning.

Liang Miaotong arrived with the palace servants just in time to see this scene.

"Your Majesty, the Empress Dowager."

Although Yu Wan was the Empress Dowager, she usually did not like to wear palace attire, only wearing a loose spring dress with simple colors. However, the embroidery on the hem and cuffs was intricate and exquisite, adding a touch of grace to her.

"No need for formalities. Please, sit down and talk."

Liang Miaotong stood up and sat down, smiling as she asked, "Your Majesty, are you still experiencing morning sickness?"

Not long after the wedding at the Marquis of Ping'an's residence, the imperial physician diagnosed Yu Wan with a joyful pulse. She had severe morning sickness and could not eat much. Wen Jian and Liang Miaotong often came to the palace to visit her.

"It was severe for a while, but these past few days, I only have no appetite in the mornings."

After some small talk, Ah Ning also got tired from swimming and was carried ashore by the palace maid. After bathing and dressing, she was brought to Yu Wan.

"Mother, Aunt."

Ah Ning had grown a bit taller recently. When she walked, her skirt swayed, and she was beginning to show the makings of a beauty.

She had inherited Ding Wenxi's beauty, with delicate features and clear, watery eyes that were both beautiful and pure.

Liang Miaotong couldn't help but sigh, "When our Ah Ning grows up, all the flowers in the imperial garden won't be able to compare to her."

Ah Ning, hearing the praise, slightly pouted, her eyes showing a hint of loss.

Yu Wan saw this and laughed, "Recently, she has suffered setbacks and doesn't like to hear people praise her beauty."

This sentence brought back Ah Ning's sad memories, and she said aggrieved, "What's the use of being beautiful? I still learn everything slowly."

Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan did not separate their son and daughter in their education. The two children were taught together. Ah Ning had always been serious, but for some reason, Zhao Mianze learned everything particularly quickly, which indeed made Ah Ning somewhat disheartened.

Liang Miaotong put her arm around her shoulder and softly comforted her, "It's okay to learn slowly. The key in learning is precision, not speed. I think your paintings are better than Mianze's."

"Really?" Ah Ning knew that her aunt could paint and was happy to hear this, but she was also worried that her aunt was just trying to comfort her.

Yu Wan saw this and encouraged her, "Your swimming posture is better than your second brother's. The weather is getting warmer day by day. From now on, Mother will accompany you to practice every day."

When Emperor Zhao Yi Yun first ascended the throne, Yu Wan had devoted almost all her time and energy to him.

Now that the palace affairs were in order, she and Zhao Xuanyou could spare some attention for their younger son and daughter.

"Come to think of it, I don't know how to swim either."

"Really?" Ah Ning asked curiously.

Ah Ning, having parents like Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan, had lived a carefree life, doing whatever she wanted. Whatever her brothers did, she did too, and her parents never restricted her.

She naturally did not know about the various constraints placed on women in the boudoir.

Not to mention someone like Liang Miaotong, a young lady from a noble family, even Yu Wan had only learned from Zhao Xuanyou when they were in Yuzhou.

"Ah Jian is very good at swimming. Let him teach you," Yu Wan said with a smile.

Liang Miaotong's face turned slightly red, and she did not speak.

Ah Ning leaned against her mother, eating something. Since she was not interested in the topics her mother and aunt were discussing, she stayed by Taiye Pool for a while before heading to Qianqing Palace.

"Princess," the eunuch at the gate of Qianqing Palace saw her coming and quickly bowed to her.

"Is Emperor Brother still discussing state affairs with the officials?"

Her mother had told her that she must not disturb Emperor Brother when he was handling government affairs.

The eunuch respectfully replied, "Prime Minister and the various Shangshu have already left the palace. At this moment, His Majesty is speaking with Master Cui."

Master Cui was Cui Zaiting.

He had achieved top honors in the imperial examination and, because of his teacher-student relationship with Zhao Yi Yun, was naturally appointed as the Grand Tutor.

However, Yu Wan had no intention of acknowledging her ancestry, so outsiders did not know that Cui Zaiting was actually the children's maternal uncle.

Hearing that it was her uncle inside, Ah Ning confidently entered Qianqing Palace.

Zhao Yi Yun had long ordered the inner attendants that Ah Ning did not need to be announced when she came, so the attendants did not stop her.

Ah Ning entered the imperial study without obstruction and saw Zhao Yi Yun and Cui Zaiting drinking tea, seemingly chatting about family matters.

"Uncle, I haven't seen you for a long time."

Cui Zaiting gently patted Ah Ning's head and spoke to her kindly. After a short while, he stood up to take his leave.

"Uncle, stay and have dinner in the palace today," Ah Ning liked both of her uncles. After returning to the capital, Wen Jian often came to the palace to play with her. Cui Zaiting, to avoid revealing Yu Wan's background, had not visited the inner palace much and usually only gave lessons to Zhao Yi Yun.

"I have something to attend to today. Next time, I will definitely stay and have dinner with Ah Ning in the palace."

"Then it's settled." Although Ah Ning was still reluctant, she was well-behaved and would not force others.

"Of course." Cui Zaiting softly said, "I bought a few exquisite cricket cages in the marketplace. I'll bring them for Ah Ning next time."

"Thank you, Uncle."

After Cui Zaiting left, only Zhao Yi Yun and Ah Ning remained in Qianqing Palace.

Zhao Yi Yun sat back at the imperial desk and continued to review the memorials. As he wrote, he asked, "Do you know what Uncle is going to do?"

Ah Ning was drinking sweet soup and blinked her eyes upon hearing this.

After moving into the imperial palace, her mother told her that she should not call Cui Zaiting "Uncle" in front of others. Later, she learned many things from her father.

Her maternal grandfather was still alive, but he was not a good person. He had never taken care of her grandmother and mother, so they did not want to have any connection with him.

But her uncle was different. He, out of fatherly affection, would often visit the temple to see him.

"Uncle is going to visit Maternal Grandfather today," Ah Ning realized.

"Mmm."

After Cui Zaiting became the Grand Tutor, Cui Lingyuan, who was hiding in the temple for cultivation, had other ideas. He instigated the officials who had previously associated with him to submit memorials, demanding recognition for Cui Zaiting's contributions and the restoration of the Xingguo Duke's family status.

Upon receiving the memorials, Zhao Yi Yun naturally first consulted with Yu Wan.

Yu Wan's grudges with the Xingguo Duke's family had long been resolved, and she did not mind bestowing the title of Xingguo Duke upon Cui Zaiting. Today, Zhao Yi Yun had kept Cui Zaiting to discuss this matter.

Of course, Cui Zaiting did not want to accept.

The Cui family originally had a crime to their name. Zhao Yi Yun had already shown great royal grace by pardoning him and allowing him to participate in the imperial examination. How could he rely on his blood relationship with Yu Wan to demand a title?

He planned to immediately go to Yunshan Temple to advise Cui Lingyuan to abandon his ambitions and truly devote himself to Buddhism.

"Sigh." Ah Ning tilted her head and sighed.

Zhao Yi Yun heard this and raised his eyebrows to look at his sister, softly asking, "Why the long face?"

"I was thinking, what kind of person is Maternal Grandfather?"

All the relatives around her were so kind that Ah Ning simply could not believe her maternal grandfather was a bad person.

Before Zhao Yi Yun could speak, Ah Ning suddenly said, "I really want to meet him."

chapters.title: Extra - Aning 2
chapters.content:
Zhao Yi Yun understood her curiosity.

After ascending the throne, Zhao Yi Yun also summoned the living relatives of his birth mother, Zhuang Huaiyue, but to him, these people were no different from strangers. After meeting them, there was little to say, and after bestowing gifts, he sent them all back.

"Mother will be unhappy," Zhao Yi Yun reminded her.

That was true.

Aning didn’t want to upset her mother, so she puffed out her cheeks and nodded, giving up the idea.

Zhao Yi Yun approved three memorials, then looked up to see Aning still looking dispirited. Helpless, he set down his brush.

"Do you really want to see him?"

Aning’s eyes lit up, and she quickly walked to Zhao Yi Yun’s side, acting coy: "I’ll just take a look, I won’t talk to him, so Grandmother and Mother won’t be sad."

Lady Ye and the old Marquis were still living in Jingyuan Hou’s residence, and Shen Jiao and Ding Wenxi had also settled in the capital. The three children often went out of the palace to play, so finding an opportunity to visit Yunshan Temple was not difficult.

Zhao Yi Yun gently poked Aning’s cheek. "If Mother finds out and scolds you, I won’t help you."

"Brother, come with me."

She said that, but Aning didn’t believe it. From childhood to now, no matter what trouble she got into, her brother had never ignored her.

"Fine, I’ll go out of the city with you, but I won’t see him. I’ll wait for you outside the temple."

Zhao Yi Yun had never interacted with Cui Lingyuan, but he trusted Yu Wan and Cui Zaiting’s judgment.

Aning was just a little girl, and going to the temple out of curiosity to see her maternal grandfather was not a big deal. But Zhao Yi Yun was the emperor. If he went to see Cui Lingyuan, things would be different.

"Deal. This is a secret, only we two know."

At her age, Aning was curious about everything. Knowing she had another relative, she really wanted to see him.

Zhao Yi Yun couldn’t bear to refuse her request, so he nodded in agreement.

The next day, after court, Zhao Yi Yun sent an inner attendant to inform Yu Wan that the spring scenery was beautiful and he wanted to take Aning to the outskirts for a spring outing.

After becoming emperor, Zhao Yi Yun had always been diligent, never slacking in handling state affairs, reading, or martial arts. Yu Wan pitied him and didn’t control him too strictly, often allowing him to take his younger siblings out in plain clothes to tour the capital.

Today, Yu Wan didn’t think much of it. She ordered Ran Dong to prepare a fine food box for them and reminded them not to play too much and to return to the palace early.

Zhao Yi Yun and Aning took a carriage out of the capital and went straight to Yunshan Temple.

At the temple gate, Zhao Yi Yun had two guards accompany Aning into the temple and ordered them to bring Aning out after a quarter of an hour, whether or not they found Cui Lingyuan.

Aning got out of the carriage, turned back, and waved to Zhao Yi Yun in the carriage before skipping toward the temple gate.

The guard showed his token to the guest monk at the temple gate, who immediately led them into the temple.

The scenery behind Yunshan Temple was beautiful, with a small stream flowing through the lush green grass. Aning walked to the stream, looked down, and saw that the water was shallow, with many smooth pebbles at the bottom, and small fish darting around.

She really should have let Emperor Brother come over to catch fish.

"Little benefactor, Master Cui has arrived."

Cui Lingyuan was a layman at Yunshan Temple and had not taken monastic vows, so the monks in the temple called him a layman.

Aning was slightly startled, turned around, and saw a middle-aged man in plain robes standing a few steps away.

Although it was their first meeting, they both recognized each other’s identities at a glance.

Aning saw the shadow of her mother in Cui Lingyuan’s face, and Cui Lingyuan also saw Ding Wenxi’s appearance in Aning.

"You are my..." Aning blinked, momentarily stunned.

Cui Lingyuan gently said, "Are you Aning?"

He was originally handsome, and although he had aged now, he still had a kind and amiable appearance.

He had offered incense at Yunshan Temple for many years and had a good relationship with the abbot. After the Xingguo Duke’s residence was confiscated, he had lived comfortably in the temple these years.

After Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Wan entered the palace with Zhao Yi Yun, he began to pay attention to the situation at court again.

But Cui Lingyuan understood that Yu Wan had no father-daughter affection for him and would not take care of him, so he had not made any moves.

It was not until Cui Zaiting returned to the capital to participate in the imperial examination that he learned that Cui Zaiting had been staying in Yu Prefecture all these years, not only recognizing Yu Wan as his sister but also becoming Zhao Yi Yun’s teacher.

This reignited his ambition.

It didn’t matter if Yu Wan ignored him. Cui Zaiting was a child he had raised himself. Now that he had become a grand tutor, as long as he could persuade Zhao Yi Yun, he could restore the Xingguo Duke’s family name.

He just didn’t expect that Cui Zaiting wouldn’t appear, but his little granddaughter would come to see him.

Because he resembled Yu Wan, Aning naturally took a liking to him.

Seeing him looking at her affectionately, Aning obediently nodded: "I am Aning. Do you know me?"

"Of course," Cui Lingyuan took two steps forward, looked down at Aning, and gently said, "You are my granddaughter, right?"

Aning pursed her lips, not knowing whether she should call him grandfather.

She came to Yunshan Temple originally just to take a look at this relative she had never met. She didn’t expect the guest monk to bring him over directly.

Mother said that her maternal grandfather was a bad person. Reasonably, she shouldn’t call him that.

Cui Lingyuan was well-experienced and saw the retreat in Aning’s eyes at a glance. He didn’t urge her further but softly asked, "Would you like to see the vegetable garden I planted?"

"You can plant vegetables?" Aning asked curiously.

Cui Lingyuan smiled and nodded, leading Aning forward. In a moment, they reached a vegetable patch.

A gentle breeze blew through the vegetable patch, carrying the scent of green leaves and soil. Aning asked in surprise, "Did you plant all these vegetables?"

"Yes, not only these vegetables, but there are also many fruit trees on the mountain. When autumn comes and the fruits are ripe, I’ll pick them and have your uncle bring them for you to taste."

"Okay."

Seeing Aning’s happy agreement, Cui Lingyuan softly introduced the various vegetables growing in the patch.

Aning knew a lot about flowers but little about vegetables, so she listened very carefully.

Before long, the quarter of an hour was up, and the guard came forward to remind Aning that it was time to leave.

Aning hadn’t played enough, but she remembered Zhao Yi Yun’s reminder, so she said goodbye to Cui Lingyuan.

Back in the carriage, Zhao Yi Yun ordered the guard to drive back to the city.

Seeing that his sister’s face was filled with smiles, he softly asked, "Did you see him?"

"He looks a lot like Mother. I recognized him at a glance."

"Do you like him?" Zhao Yi Yun asked.

Aning felt a little guilty when asked this.

Mother said that her maternal grandfather was a bad person, so he must be a bad person. But today, when she saw him, she indeed liked him. Yu Wan didn’t look much like Ding Wenxi, so Zhao Yi Yun wasn’t surprised by this.

"What did you talk about?"

In such a short quarter of an hour, Cui Lingyuan seemed to have become quite close to Aning.

Zhao Yi Yun was very curious about what they had talked about.

"He took me to see the vegetables he planted. There are also many fruit trees on the mountain." Aning excitedly told Zhao Yi Yun about what had just happened. "He also said that when autumn comes and the fruit trees bear fruit, he would have Uncle bring them to the palace for me to taste."

chapters.title: Extra - Aning 3
chapters.content:
As Aning spoke, her face was filled with bright smiles, but Zhao Yi Yun frowned slightly.

Cui Lingyuan knew Aning’s nickname, so he must have inquired about her.

Zhao Yi Yun suddenly felt a pang of regret for bringing Aning to Yunshan Temple.

"Brother, did I make you wait too long?"

As she spoke, Aning noticed Zhao Yi Yun’s expression and asked worriedly.

Zhao Yi Yun withdrew his thoughts and smiled. "I was thinking about court matters."

"Oh."

"Before we left the palace, we agreed that we would only come to take a look. In the future, I won’t bring you here again, so as not to upset Mother."

Aning had spent some time with Cui Lingyuan and had developed a liking for this grandfather. Hearing Zhao Yi Yun’s words, she indeed felt a little unhappy.

She had indeed said that, and she couldn’t go back on her word, so she could only nod.

"I know."

Zhao Yi Yun gently flicked her nose and was about to order the guards to start back to the palace when he suddenly heard her shout, "Wait."

"What’s wrong?"

"If we’re not coming back in the future, I want to go in and say goodbye."

She had promised her grandfather that she would taste the fruits he grew and that she would come back to Yunshan Temple to visit him. She couldn’t break her promise and leave him hoping in vain.

Aning looked at Zhao Yi Yun with her beautiful eyes full of pitiful pleading. He couldn’t refuse her, so he agreed.

The carriage was still outside Yunshan Temple, so it was fine for her to go in again.

Aning made her way back to the vegetable patch, where Cui Lingyuan was still weeding.

Seeing Aning return, he put down the hoe and walked to the shade of a tree.

"Aning, why are you back?"

Aning felt a little embarrassed as she said, "I won’t be able to come here in the future, and you don’t need to send fruit for me to eat."

Cui Lingyuan was slightly startled and understood that someone was waiting for Aning outside the temple.

Yu Wan wouldn’t bring Aning to Yunshan Temple, nor would Zhao Xuanyou.

Aning’s visit to Yunshan Temple was entirely out of curiosity about him. Since she didn’t come alone, the only one who could allow her to leave the palace was Zhao Yi Yun.

Zhao Yi Yun really valued this little girl.

"Alright." Cui Lingyuan didn’t say anything else.

His straightforward answer surprised Aning.

Before she could think of any words of comfort, Cui Lingyuan spoke again: "When Aning grows up and moves out of the palace, come back to Yunshan Temple to visit your grandfather."

Aning blinked in confusion. "Why would I move out of the palace?"

Father and Mother had said that the palace would be their home from now on. She certainly wouldn’t move out.

"Girls grow up and get married, and after marriage, they have to leave the palace."

Get married?

Aning didn’t understand the matters of love and marriage between men and women, but she had heard her parents discussing the selection of an empress for Emperor Brother. At that time, she had asked what an empress was. Father said that the empress was Emperor Brother’s wife, just like Father and Mother were husband and wife. They were going to select a beautiful and talented woman from the noble families in the capital, and after Emperor Brother took personal control of the government, they would officially hold the grand wedding.

By then, Father and Mother would move to Cining Palace and leave Kunning Palace for the empress to live in.

So, getting married meant going to live in someone else’s home.

"I won’t get married then." Aning said sullenly. Father, Mother, and her brothers all doted on her, so they would definitely agree.

"You’re still young. When you grow up, they will arrange a marriage for you." Cui Lingyuan said gently. "However, Grandfather also has a way for you to not move out of the palace and live here forever."

"What way?"

"You become the empress."

Aning shook her head and seriously explained, "That’s not right. The empress is Emperor Brother’s wife. I am his sister."

"He’s not your real brother. Besides, you are surnamed Ding. You are a girl from the Ping’an Marquis’s family, not a princess."

Aning seemed to understand but not quite.

Mother had told her that when she was born, her health was poor. It was only after being adopted out, as advised by a master, that she grew up safely.

But how did this relate to becoming empress?

"Mother has already selected several sisters for Emperor Brother. They are all very beautiful, and Mother says they are very talented and have good temperaments."

"Hmph, no matter how beautiful they are, can they be as beautiful as Aning?" Cui Lingyuan lightly scoffed, patting Aning’s shoulder. "Your mother doesn’t want to compete, but you must. Only by becoming the empress can you not be an outsider and live in the palace forever."

"Really?" Aning indeed didn’t want to move out of the palace alone.

"Of course." Cui Lingyuan said earnestly, "When you grow up, you will know that your grandfather is the one who truly cares for you. At that time, you must remember your grandfather."

Aning felt that this statement was wrong. She was her parents’ daughter, so of course, they cared for her the most.

She didn’t want to talk about it anymore, so she waved to Cui Lingyuan and left.

Zhao Yi Yun saw Aning return with puffed cheeks and thought she had been wronged by Cui Lingyuan. He frowned and asked, "What happened?"

"Nothing, just a little annoyed."

"Do you still want to go to Yunshan Temple to visit him?"

"Not this matter."

Aning wasn’t that unreasonable. Today, her brother had taken her out to satisfy her curiosity, which was enough. She didn’t want to do anything that would upset Mother.

"Then what’s wrong?"

"Grandfather said that when I grow up, I will get married, and then I’ll have to move out of the palace."

Zhao Yi Yun hadn’t expected Cui Lingyuan to say this to Aning and didn’t know what to say for a moment.

"Brother, is this true?" Aning had hoped to find some comfort from her eldest brother, but his reaction made her even more worried.

Seeing that Aning was about to cry, Zhao Yi Yun quickly composed himself and gently said, "When you grow up, you’ll know that getting married isn’t scary. Mother married our father, and they live happily every day."

That was true...

But Aning was still unhappy. "You all live in the palace, but I’m the only one who has to move out."

"The palace will always be your home. You can come whenever you want," Zhao Yi Yun said, seeing the tears in Aning’s eyes. He couldn’t think of better words to comfort his sister, so after a moment, he asked, "Did Grandfather say anything else?"

Aning nodded, pouting as she said, "He said that only by becoming the empress can I live in the palace forever. Brother, can I become the empress?"

Zhao Yi Yun looked at Aning in astonishment, and many thoughts flashed through his mind.

After a brief moment of panic, Zhao Yi Yun looked down and asked, "Aning, do you know what it means to be the empress?"

Feeling her brother’s gaze change, Aning became inexplicably nervous.

Her brother wasn’t angry with her, but this look was completely different from usual.

"Hmm?" Zhao Yi Yun waited for her answer.

"The empress is Brother’s wife."

"So, you want to be my wife?"

Aning became even more flustered, but her father often taught her that the more things happened, the calmer she should be.

She blinked and said softly, "Grandfather said I’m not your real sister, so I can be your empress."

"Do you want this?" Zhao Yi Yun still asked.

Aning began to think seriously.

Being Emperor Brother’s sister meant she would have to marry and leave the palace, but being Emperor Brother’s wife meant she could live in the palace forever, so she wouldn’t have to be separated from her parents and two brothers.

However, being Emperor Brother’s wife would mean living in the same room as him, like their parents...

The young man in front of her was fair and handsome, with a delicate yet sharp face, and an air of nobility. But most importantly, since Aning could remember, he had always been the gentlest person to her in the world.

"I want to be with Brother forever."

Zhao Yi Yun looked at Aning, and after a moment of silence, he took Aning’s hand. "I promise you, but this is a secret between us. You can’t tell anyone."

"Will Brother tell them?"

"Mmm." Zhao Yi Yun knew that the palace had already started selecting an empress for him. Aning was still young, and this matter needed careful planning.

"I know." Aning smiled mischievously. "Then this is our second secret."

Knowing that she wouldn’t have to move out of the palace and could always be with her family, Aning was overjoyed.

Today’s trip to Yunshan Temple was their first secret, and her becoming empress would be their second secret.

Zhao Yi Yun nodded.

This was the second secret, and in the future, they would have more secrets that belonged only to the two of them.

Looking at Aning, he felt an inexplicable joy rise in his heart.

"Aning, we’ve agreed on this. No backing out, alright?"

"No backing out. Let’s pull hooks."

Aning extended her little finger, and Zhao Yi Yun also hooked his finger with hers.

Aning was originally a girl from the Ping’an Marquis’s family, so becoming empress was perfectly reasonable.

But Aning was five years younger than him. To get married, they would have to wait at least seven or eight years. When she grew up, who knew how she would feel about today’s events.

Zhao Yi Yun thought about this, and his expression became serious. "Aning, I can promise you anything. However, when you grow up, if you change your mind, I absolutely won’t indulge you, understand?"

"I know, I know. Pull hooks, a hundred years without changing."

chapters.title: Extra – Cui Zaiting 1
chapters.content:
"Aning went to Yunshan Temple?" In the Imperial Garden, Yu Wan was eating watermelon when she heard Cui Zaiting say this, and she was momentarily stunned.

Cui Zaiting had originally intended to go to Yunshan Temple to persuade his father to give up on restoring the Xingguo Duke's family reputation. Unexpectedly, he learned from the guest monk that Aning had gone to see Cui Lingyuan.

He didn’t intend to report Aning, but he thought that Aning must have left the palace without Yu Wan’s knowledge. After all, she was still young, and leaving the palace without permission could have hidden dangers. He wanted Yu Wan to be aware.

"She stayed in the temple for a quarter of an hour, just talked for a while. I thought you should look into how Aning managed to leave the palace."

Yu Wan, of course, didn’t need to investigate this.

Aning had left the palace with Zhao Yi Yun that day, so naturally, Zhao Yi Yun had taken her.

"Thank you for your concern, Brother. I’ll remind her later."

Yu Wan said this, but she was still worried.

Aning was full of ideas, and upon learning that her maternal grandfather was still alive, she must have been extremely curious. That curiosity wasn’t wrong.

Zhao Yi Yun was neither too old nor too young, and now he was the emperor. He couldn’t be casually reprimanded.

Moreover, he had no interest in Cui Lingyuan at all. It was just that Aning wanted to go, so he indulged her.

Aning leaving the palace wasn’t a big deal, and meeting Cui Lingyuan wasn’t a mistake.

She was just afraid that if Zhao Yi Yun continued to indulge her like this, she might become lawless and unruly in the future.

Yu Wan couldn’t help but feel a headache coming on. She would have to discuss this matter with Zhao Xuanyou properly.

Cui Zaiting didn’t ask too much about how Yu Wan would discipline the child. He wanted to make it clear to her about Cui Lingyuan’s situation today.

"I told Father that I declined the title of Duke of Xingguo and asked him not to harbor any more delusions about causing trouble in the court. He should live a quiet life in retirement at Yunshan Temple."

Originally, Cui Zaiting had thought about setting up a farmhouse in the suburbs of the capital for his father to enjoy his old age, but after this incident, he abandoned that idea. It was better to let Cui Lingyuan continue to stay at Yunshan Temple.

He had become an official, increased the offerings to Yunshan Temple, and arranged for a servant to take care of Cui Lingyuan. His father could definitely enjoy his old age in peace.

"Actually, Yi Yun and we all wanted to bestow the title of Duke of Xingguo upon you, Brother," Yu Wan sincerely advised.

"One should not accept rewards without merit. I only taught Yi Yun for a few years in Yuzhou. Being able to serve as the Grand Tutor is already a great imperial favor. When I truly have achievements worthy of being enfeoffed as a marquis or appointed as a minister, I will not refuse."

But this was only part of the reason.

Zhao Yi Yun was the new emperor. Back then, to make his adoptive parents the Emperor Emeritus and Empress Dowager, he had defied public opinion. Although the officials had eventually been unable to argue against him on the grounds of propriety, many still believed that Zhao Yi Yun’s rewards were excessive.

Cui Zaiting neither thought he deserved the title of duke nor wanted to give the court officials more reason to gossip because of this matter.

Seeing his brother’s firm attitude, Yu Wan said no more.

She had great confidence in Cui Zaiting. With his talents, after a few more years in office, he would eventually be enfeoffed as a marquis or appointed as a minister.

"Brother, can I ask you a question?"

Since she had already said this, Cui Zaiting couldn’t stop her. He smiled and nodded.

Yu Wan said, "Previously in Yuzhou, I arranged several marriage proposals for you, but you weren’t interested. I thought you must have someone in mind in the capital. Now that you’ve returned to the capital and become the Grand Tutor, any noble lady from a high-ranking family would be a good match for you. If you’re too shy to speak up, I can help you arrange it."

Cui Zaiting was originally a young master of the Xingguo Duke’s family. Even as a concubine-born son, he was still of noble birth. The girl he liked must be of high status.

"There’s no need to trouble you."

Yu Wan blinked, her eyes flickering as her smile deepened. "So Brother really does have someone in mind in the capital."

Cui Zaiting’s handsome face suddenly turned red, but his eyes were somewhat complicated.

Thinking that Cui Zaiting was already quite old and had spent so many years in Yuzhou, Yu Wan guessed that the girl he liked might have already married.

This was indeed a difficult situation.

Even if she was the Empress Dowager, she couldn’t help her brother take someone else’s wife.

"Brother, did you suddenly come to Yuzhou back then because of this girl?"

Listening to Yu Wan’s genuine concern, Cui Zaiting was silent for a moment before finally nodding.

When they were in Yuzhou, Yu Wan had hinted around several times, but Cui Zaiting had always changed the subject. Today, he was responding to this matter, which surprised Yu Wan and gave her a glimmer of hope.

"Which family’s girl is it? Do I know her?"

"Yes, you do."

Yu Wan looked at him in shock, racking her brain to think of the noble ladies she and Cui Zaiting both knew. Suddenly, she remembered something. When Zhao Qi had left the capital to train in the military, she had gone to the city gate to see him off.

That day, Cui Zaiting had been there, and so had Shen Tongyun.

"Is your sweetheart Sister Tongyun?"

Cui Zaiting didn’t answer, but his expression said it all.

He gave a bitter laugh. "I’ve never told anyone about this, and I originally didn’t plan to tell anyone. But I think, if I tell you, maybe you won’t think I’m ridiculous or pitiful."

Shen Tongyun was his widowed sister-in-law. In the eyes of others, this feeling was unacceptable.

"Of course not." Yu Wan sighed. "I just think you told me too late. If you had told me earlier, I would have sent someone to bring Sister Tongyun to Yuzhou."

Every time he thought about this, Cui Zaiting’s heart felt as heavy as a rock. Hearing Yu Wan’s casual tone, his mood lightened as well.

But...

"She wouldn’t have come to Yuzhou."

"Brother, you just said you’ve never told anyone about this. Does that include Sister Tongyun? Does she know your feelings?"

"I haven’t told her."

After the Xingguo Duke’s mansion was confiscated, the Cui family moved to a small house supported by Shen Tongyun’s maiden family. At that time, Cui Zaiting had come to realize the coldness and selfishness of his family, but he had also seen Shen Tongyun’s resilience and kindness.

He had helped her support the broken family, and in the process, he had slowly fallen in love with her.

Because of Cui Lingyuan’s crime, his path to the imperial examinations was ruined, and he became a useless scholar with no money or power. He had no confidence to confess his feelings to her, fearing that it would add to her troubles and subject her to gossip.

"You didn’t even confess to Sister Tongyun before running off to Yuzhou?"

Cui Zaiting looked down. "She was the one who ran away first."

"What happened exactly?" Yu Wan pressed.

"Well," Cui Zaiting nodded, and blurted out everything he had been holding in his heart. "She had always refused to accept her maiden family’s support. It was because she knew my feelings. To avoid me, she asked the Duke of Ningguo to buy her a house in Jiangnan, and she even hid the date of her departure from me."

By the time Cui Zaiting found out, she had already left the capital with her son.

He went to the Duke of Ningguo’s mansion to inquire, but they only said that Shen Tongyun had gone to Jiangnan, and he couldn’t find out anything else.

"No wonder you suddenly came to Yuzhou." Yu Wan suddenly realized.

"It was all my one-sided wishful thinking. I wanted to forget everything and start anew, but no matter what, I couldn’t forget her."

Yu Wan’s eyes flickered, and she smiled lightly. "How could it be one-sided?"

"It’s impossible," Cui Zaiting said firmly, but he absolutely trusted Yu Wan’s intelligence. If Yu Wan said so, it reignited a glimmer of hope in him. "Wanwan, do you really think she... she has feelings for me?"

"If she didn’t have feelings for you, she wouldn’t have run away from you in the first place."

Afraid that Cui Zaiting was too close to the situation to see clearly, Yu Wan made it a bit clearer. "Sister Tongyun went to such extremes not only to break your feelings but also to break her own."

chapters.title: Extra – Cui Zaiting 2
chapters.content:
"You mean..." Cui Zaiting understood the implication in Yu Wan’s words, but there was still hesitation in his brows.

Yu Wan didn’t press him further, waiting quietly for him to figure it out himself.

At this time of year, the Imperial Garden was in full bloom, with rare flowers shimmering and lush trees flourishing. Yu Wan came here every day to sit, read, admire the flowers, and enjoy the leisure of solitude.

"Wanwan, should I really go find her?"

"If you can’t let go, then go find her."

Cui Zaiting gave a self-deprecating laugh but nodded solemnly.

"Is Sister Tongyun in Jiangnan?"

"Yes, but when I went to the Duke of Ningguo’s mansion to ask a few times, they refused to tell me exactly where she is."

After thinking for a moment, Yu Wan said, "Since you’ve set your mind on Sister Tongyun, why not pay a visit to the old Duke and confide your feelings to him? With his blessing, Sister Tongyun’s concerns will be much less."

Back then, because of Zhao Qi, Yu Wan had frequently visited the Duke of Ningguo’s mansion for a period of time. The deepest impression she had was that the old Duke was extremely protective of his children.

Shen Tongyun had been a widow for many years. Even with the support of the Duke’s mansion, she lived without worries about food and clothing, but raising a child alone in Jiangnan must have been difficult. The old man must have been very heartbroken.

As long as Cui Zaiting showed enough sincerity, she believed the old man would support him.

It was common for widows to remarry, but Cui Zaiting was, after all, Shen Tongyun’s brother-in-law. If they were together, there would inevitably be gossip.

The Duke of Ningguo was the head of the Shen family. With his support, no one would dare to criticize them openly, and Shen Tongyun’s burden would be lighter.

"I understand. You think more thoroughly than I do."

"Don’t be so polite with family. Once you bring Sister-in-law back, the palace will be livelier." Yu Wan didn’t have many friends. Usually, only Princess Yining, Yingxue, and Liang Miaotong came to the palace to visit. "Speaking of which, Ah Biao and Tong’er are planning to spend the summer in Jiangnan. If you act quickly, Brother, you might be able to go to Jiangnan with them and return together."

"In that case."

While the siblings were talking, Zhao Xuanyou also arrived at the Imperial Garden.

After exchanging greetings, Cui Zaiting stood up to take his leave.

His romantic affairs were fine to discuss with his sister, but he would be too embarrassed to talk about them with Zhao Xuanyou.

After Cui Zaiting left, Zhao Xuanyou sat down next to Yu Wan and reached out to smooth her hair, which had been scattered by the wind.

"What are you so happy about?"

Yu Wan’s lips curled up uncontrollably. Leaning on his arm, she smiled and said, "Big Brother’s good news is coming soon. I’m happy for him."

"Oh? Which family’s girl?"

Zhao Xuanyou hadn’t discussed private matters with Cui Zaiting, but since Cui Zaiting was already in his mid-twenties and still unmarried, there must be some story.

"You know her. It’s Sister Tongyun from the Duke of Ningguo’s mansion."

Zhao Xuanyou raised an eyebrow slightly and looked at Yu Wan. "Isn’t she his..."

"That was six or seven years ago. Sister Tongyun has been living as a widow all these years. Brother has always had a soft spot for her and has never forgotten her. Now that he has finally settled down, it’s a case of good things coming after hard times."

"That makes sense."

Seeing Yu Wan’s joyful expression, Zhao Xuanyou’s cold, hard features softened a bit.

He didn’t care about other people’s business, but as long as Yu Wan was happy, it was a good thing.

However, Yu Wan’s smile didn’t last long. Before Zhao Xuanyou could say anything else, her delicate eyebrows furrowed.

"There’s something I wanted to discuss with you."

"Oh?"

Yu Wan then told him about Zhao Yi Yun taking Aning out of the city.

Zhao Xuanyou thought for a moment. "If you’re worried that the man at Yunshan Temple will cause trouble, why not move him to a place farther from the capital?"

"I’m not worried about him causing trouble. I’m worried about Aning."

Cui Lingyuan was old, and the number of court officials who were on good terms with him was decreasing. Yu Wan didn’t think he could stir up any waves.

Yu Wan’s thoughts were only on her daughter.

"Aning was just curious. I’ll talk to her later. It’s not a big mistake."

Yu Wan had expected Zhao Xuanyou to say this and sighed softly.

Zhao Xuanyou grunted. "Should I scold her?"

"Do you have the heart to?"

The children had grown up, and Zhao Mianze had been scolded by his father many times for his studies, and Zhao Yi Yun had also been reprimanded for practicing martial arts. Only their daughter had never heard a harsh word.

Zhao Xuanyou coughed lightly a few times and defended himself. "Aning has always been well-behaved. There’s nothing to scold her for."

"I don’t want you to scold her. I’m just worried about her future."

"What’s wrong?"

"When Aning was born, she was very frail. We pitied her and have always spoiled her. Since she can remember, she has never seen the hardships of the world. If she were just the daughter of a duke, it would be fine, but now she’s being raised in the palace like a princess. I’m afraid that being too pampered will make her grow up spoiled."

Princess Yi’an, due to the former emperor’s indulgence, had become lawless and even tried to take Yu Wan’s life out of jealousy.

Moreover, Yi Yun had always doted on Aning, and the honors she would receive in the future would definitely not be less than those of Princess Yi’an.

Yu Wan wasn’t afraid of Aning meeting Cui Lingyuan. She was afraid that Aning would become even more arrogant and willful than Princess Yi’an.

"Shall we take Aning out to see the world and experience its hardships?"

Yu Wan worriedly rubbed her stomach.

If it weren’t for the little one in her belly, she would have long since left the capital to relax. She wouldn’t have stayed in the Imperial Garden every day.

She looked at Zhao Xuanyou reproachfully. "Do you think I’m not worried enough already?"

"Aning is still young. There’s no need to rush this year." Zhao Xuanyou also placed his hand on her stomach and said gently, "After you give birth to our fourth child, we’ll go out together. Wanwan, I’ve long wanted to travel with you."

When Zhao Xuanyou was young, he had followed the old marquis all over the place, traveling through the mountains and rivers of the east, west, south, and north. Yu Wan had also traveled far and wide and seen the wonders of the world.

But strictly speaking, the two of them had never traveled together to enjoy the scenery, which was indeed a regret.

When Yu Wan had just reunited with Zhao Xuanyou, every time he saw Wen Biao, he would be jealous and admire that he could accompany Yu Wan on her travels.

"I want to as well."

After moving into the palace, Yu Wan and Zhao Xuanyou had indeed gained honor and status.

The palace was magnificent and resplendent, but after all, it was surrounded by high walls.

Yu Wan often missed the days in Yuzhou when she and Zhao Xuanyou went riding and shooting on the grasslands together, truly free and unrestrained.

But thinking about it, Yu Wan knew that it would be difficult to make the trip next year.

If they took Aning out of the capital for a trip, Zhao Mianze would definitely not be willing to stay behind and would insist on going with them. But if both Zhao Mianze and Aning went with them, and only Zhao Yi Yun was left in the palace, he would feel left out.

Moreover, Yu Wan was currently focused on relaxing, but with the fourth child just born and still an infant in swaddling clothes, she couldn’t possibly leave the child at home and go out to play.

"Let Aning go to Jiangnan with Tong’er and the others first."

Zhao Xuanyou was stunned. "Let them take her out?"

"Do you not trust them?"

Zhao Xuanyou didn’t distrust Wen Biao and Liang Miaotong. He just wasn’t willing to let his daughter leave his side.

After thinking for a moment, he thought of a reason to refuse.

"They’re newlyweds. It’s not convenient for Aning to be with them."

The two of them were indeed newly married, but they had traveled together for several years before getting married. Letting them take a child once wouldn’t affect their marital relationship.

"Ah Biao is Aning’s nominal father. It’s only natural for a father to take his daughter."

"You also said it’s nominal. They two don’t know how to take care of children."

Yu Wan knew that Zhao Xuanyou couldn’t bear to part with his daughter. She gently persuaded him, "They may not have taken care of children before, but they will definitely take good care of Aning."

Wen Biao and Liang Miaotong traveled without attendants, and they did everything themselves. This was also the reason why Yu Wan wanted Aning to go out with them to try.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou was still silent, Yu Wan grabbed his sleeve and shook it hard.

"You were six years old when you followed Father from the capital to Yuzhou. Like father, like daughter. Let me ask her first. If she’s not afraid herself, then you shouldn’t be either. Give her a chance to grow."

chapters.title: Extra - Cui Zaiting 3
chapters.content:
Zhao Xuanyou finally nodded in agreement.

However, he was worried about Aning's safety and insisted on arranging a female secret guard to follow her.

Yu Wan intended to temper Aning's character, not to put her in real danger, so she naturally agreed.

The two sat in the imperial garden and talked for a while. Estimating that the children should have finished school, they returned to the Qianqing Palace.

Before long, the three children returned together.

Ran Dong had already prepared snacks, all of which were the children's favorites.

Yu Wan sat on the noble concubine's couch, quietly watching them eat. After Aning wiped her hands, Yu Wan softly called her over and told her the plan.

Upon learning she could travel to Jiangnan, Aning was naturally delighted. But when she heard that her parents and brother would not be going, her mind buzzed. Remembering what Cui Lingyuan had said about her not belonging in the palace, she anxiously asked, "Mother, does this mean I can no longer live in the palace and have to move to the Prince An's residence?"

"How could that be?" Yu Wan didn't know where Aning got such an idea and quickly reassured her, "It's just a two-month trip to Jiangnan with your uncle and aunt. If you don't want to go now, we can take you out when you're older."

"But why isn't Second Brother going?" Aning was still uneasy after her mother's explanation.

"Because if you and Mianze go, only Yi Yun will be left in the palace. He would be so lonely."

Seeing Aning still hesitating, Yu Wan's heart softened again.

"If you're afraid, then forget it. Let your second brother go with your uncle and the others to gain some experience. In the future, you can travel with your father and me."

Hearing this, Zhao Mianze, who was beside them, smiled and said, "Alright, I'll go with Uncle Wen to have some fun."

Having been reborn in this life, he had always stayed close to Yu Wan. Back in Yuzhou, he had been relatively free, but after moving to the palace, he had grown weary of the confinement.

Apart from his own family, Zhao Mianze liked his Uncle Wen Jian the most, so he was naturally happy to go to Jiangnan for a couple of months.

Aning didn't want to miss out on the fun; she just couldn't bear to part with her parents and brother.

After hearing Zhao Mianze's words, Aning made up her mind: "Mother, I want to go."

"Alright." Yu Wan gently pinched Aning's little face. Fearful that her son might feel she was being unfair, she comforted him, "Your uncle travels out of the capital every year. This year, your sister is going with him; next year, it will be your turn."

Zhao Mianze knew that his mother was pregnant with their fourth child and wouldn't be traveling far in the next two or three years. Naturally, he wouldn't truly compete with his sister over this and add to his mother's worries.

Beside them, Zhao Yi Yun's gaze flickered, somewhat surprised.

Aning was only seven years old; how could his mother think of sending her out of the capital to travel?

He vaguely felt that this matter was related to their trip to Yunshan Temple, but since his mother didn't mention it, neither did he.

After all, after making that agreement with Aning, he felt a bit guilty facing his parents.

"If both I and Second Brother can leave the capital, what about Emperor Brother?"

"The Emperor Brother has his duties and cannot leave the capital at will. We'll talk about it again when the court is more stable."

Upon hearing this, Aning suddenly felt a bit sorry for Emperor Brother and quickly comforted him, "When I return to the capital, I'll bring back the most fun things from Jiangnan for you, Brother."

"Alright." Looking at Aning's smiling eyes, Zhao Yi Yun's gaze softened.

Zhao Mianze, who was closest to him, narrowed his eyes and looked at him carefully.

Over the past year as emperor, Zhao Yi Yun had grown taller rapidly, and most of his childishness had faded, making him appear even more elegant and refined, like a graceful and outstanding young man.

Zhao Mianze glanced at his sister beside him.

Aning had a fair and delicate face, clear and bright eyes, and wore luxurious clothes and exquisite bead ornaments, looking like a little fairy sculpted from ice and snow.

At this moment, the little fairy looked up at Zhao Yi Yun, her smile bright and charming, exuding a coquettish demeanor.

Aning was innocent, but Zhao Yi Yun was different. Could it be that he had developed some feelings?

Zhao Mianze helplessly rubbed his forehead.

Well, no matter how you looked at it, they weren't siblings by blood. If he really had feelings, it wasn't a big deal. As long as Zhao Yi Yun didn't do anything out of line, he would turn a blind eye.

Yu Wan didn't pay attention to the children's movements. After getting Aning's confirmation, she informed Wen Jian and Miaotong.

Miaotong had always liked Aning, and Wen Jian was also very close to her, so they naturally agreed without hesitation.

After settling this matter, Yu Wan began teaching Aning how to take care of herself, such as dressing, combing her hair, and washing her face, so she wouldn't trouble her uncle and aunt.

Aning wasn't spoiled and diligently learned to take care of herself.

A few days later, Cui Zaiting also sent good news. After expressing his feelings for Shen Fengyun to the Duke of Ningguo and his heir, he obtained Shen Fengyun and his son's address in Jiangnan.

Since the palace had already made preparations, the group set off immediately.

Although this was Yu Wan's idea, when she saw her daughter leaving, she couldn't help but shed tears.

Aning had never been separated from her for seven years.

"If you can't bear it, we can still call her back now."

Previously, Zhao Xuanyou had been against letting Aning travel far, but he spent less time with the children than Yu Wan did. Seeing his daughter's carriage moving further and further away, he was much calmer than Yu Wan.

"Since Aning has the courage to go forward, how can I call her back?" Yu Wan wiped her tears and sighed, "This is just a trip out of the city. When she gets married and moves to someone else's home in the future, it will be even harder."

Zhao Xuanyou naturally understood Yu Wan's feelings and didn't notice the different expressions on his two sons' faces.

Zhao Yi Yun appeared calm, with a hint of a smile in his eyes, while Zhao Mianze also smiled, but it was a cold smirk directed at Zhao Yi Yun.

Only when the carriage disappeared from sight did the family turn back to the palace.

Inside the carriage, Aning was also wiping her tears. However, as the scenery outside the carriage gradually became unfamiliar, her mood changed as well.

Uncle Wen Jian and Aunt Miaotong knew that Aning missed her family, so they told her about the places they passed along the way; the names of the mountains, the names of the rivers, and the local specialties of the villages.

Aning was at the most curious age and had inherited Yu Wan's adventurous nature, so she was naturally interested in these things. Soon, she stopped crying and started smiling.

After two days of traveling by carriage, the four of them switched to a boat heading south. With favorable winds and currents, they arrived in Yangzhou half a month later.

Over the years, Shen Fengyun had been living with her son in a manor on the outskirts of Yangzhou.

Cui Zaiting had originally planned to have the three of them continue south, but when Aning heard Aunt Miaotong mention that Uncle Zai Ting would soon have an aunt, she immediately refused to leave, insisting on meeting this new aunt.

Cui Zaiting had always doted on Aning and couldn't refuse her, so he took them all to the Duke of Ningguo's manor.

After reporting their names to the gatekeeper, there was no response from the manor.

The four of them waited outside the gate for a long time before someone finally came to invite them in.

Cui Zaiting felt a bit relieved that he had brought Aning and the others with him. If it had been just him alone, Shen Fengyun might have continued to avoid him and refused to see him.

As the saying goes, "The closer to home, the more apprehensive one feels." On the way to Jiangnan, Cui Zaiting had been eager to arrive quickly each day. But now that he was actually sitting here waiting, he felt extremely anxious.

After years of separation, his feelings had not changed, but what about hers? Would she feel the same as him?

Would there be someone else by her side?

---

chapters.title: Extra - Cui Zaiting 4
chapters.content:
Amid his unease, Cui Zaiting turned around and saw the figure he had been dreaming of.

In the courtyard, with lush trees and flowers, Shen Fengyun stood with her son among the dense foliage.

Years of separation had made her appear much thinner, but her demeanor was clearly more composed than before.

Meeting Cui Zaiting's gaze, Shen Fengyun did not look away but her smile faded slightly.

"Er Di." Shen Fengyun spoke first.

Hearing her address him as "Er Di" (second younger brother), Wen Jian and Liang Miaotong both felt a sinking feeling in their hearts. Shen Fengyun was clearly drawing a line.

They didn't know Shen Fengyun, but when they saw her approach,

Cui Zaiting was not surprised by her reaction. After all, she had always avoided his feelings in the past.

He cupped his hands in greeting to her but did not call her "Sao Zi" (sister-in-law).

"Chengzhang, come greet your second uncle." Shen Fengyun said.

The young man beside Shen Fengyun was about the same age as Zhao Yi Yun. He had a handsome appearance, but his gaze was somewhat timid as he looked at the crowd.

Cui Zaiting gently said, "Chengzhang, don't you recognize me?"

Cui Chengzhang had been cared for by Cui Zaiting many times when he was young, but that was before he was three years old. After living in Jiangnan for seven or eight years, his memories of the capital had long faded.

"Second Uncle." Following his mother's instructions, he respectfully greeted Cui Zaiting.

Things seemed to be going poorly, but Cui Zaiting was not discouraged.

He looked at Shen Fengyun and warmly introduced Wen Jian, Liang Miaotong, and Aning to her one by one.

"Today, I have taken the liberty to visit because there are some words I have long wanted to say to you, and they have become a burden on my heart."

Shen Fengyun looked at him in surprise, not expecting him to say such things in front of so many people.

Liang Miaotong, on the other hand, felt a sense of relief.

Every beginning is difficult. Shen Fengyun's distant attitude just now was clearly meant to make Cui Zaiting give up. But now that Cui Zaiting had spoken, there was no turning back, and the situation had taken a turn for the better.

She gently shook Aning's arm and softly said, "Aning, would you like to stroll around the garden for a while?"

"Yes, but this isn't my home, so I can't just wander around."

Liang Miaotong had already prepared a speech for Aning when they entered the manor, and now was the perfect time to use it.

Aning was the most clever and naturally remembered every word. After speaking, she walked up to Cui Chengzhang and asked with a smile, "Brother, can you take us around the garden?"

Without waiting for Cui Chengzhang to respond, Aning took his sleeve and walked forward.

Seeing this, Liang Miaotong also pulled Wen Jian along, "You two talk first. We'll go with the children."

The four of them left in a line, leaving only Cui Zaiting and Shen Fengyun in the garden.

Shen Fengyun met Cui Zaiting's gaze and sighed softly.

"Why did you have to come to Yangzhou?"

"I had to come here to get your answer."

His voice was low, and his expression was full of tender care.

Shen Fengyun, of course, knew his feelings.

As Yu Wan had said, if she didn't know his feelings, how could she have run so far away?

"I and Chengzhang have been living peacefully here. We have grown accustomed to this peaceful life and really do not want any changes." Shen Fengyun said truthfully, "I have long forgotten everything about the capital."

"I only ask you one thing: have you developed feelings for me?"

Shen Fengyun was startled again. She truly hadn't expected the usually calm and restrained Cui Zaiting to ask her so directly.

After the Xingguo Duke's mansion was confiscated, the Cui family fell into hard times. Those once polite and kind servants suddenly changed, each becoming despicable.

During that period, if it hadn't been for Cui Zaiting by her side, she wouldn't have been able to endure.

His feelings, his kindness, she naturally understood.

But he was Cui Zaizhou's younger brother, Chengzhang's second uncle. Such feelings were certainly not acceptable to conventional society. She had stayed far away to preserve her and Cui Zaiting's reputation, not wanting to put her caring relatives in a difficult position.

"I have said all that needs to be said. I will not speak of anything else."

Shen Fengyun took a deep breath and dropped this sentence before turning to leave.

However, Cui Zaiting stepped forward and grabbed her hand.

"Let go!" Shen Fengyun exclaimed.

Cui Zaiting tightly held her hand, his gentle eyes tinged with pain.

She had rejected and avoided him with every word, but from her eyes, he could confirm her feelings.

She did like him, but she didn't dare face the eyes of the world.

Now that he knew her feelings, Cui Zaiting naturally wouldn't let go.

He was no longer the useless scholar he once was. He could shelter her and Chengzhang from the wind and rain and take care of them both.

If she wanted to run, he would never agree.

This time, no matter how she tried to drive him away, he would never leave.

---

On the other side of the garden was a babbling brook that had been diverted from outside the manor.

Aning was used to the vast and rippling Taiye Pool in the palace, but this was the first time she had seen such a beautiful stream.

The meandering brook flowed slowly through the garden, so clear that one could see the colorful pebbles at the bottom from the bank.

"This place looks so much fun."

Aning let go of Cui Chengzhang's clothes and hopped to the edge of the stream. She crouched down and splashed water with her hands.

The cool touch of the stream water on her fingertips was incredibly amusing.

If it weren't her first time here, Aning would have wanted to take off her shoes and socks to wade in the water.

"There are fish in the stream too!"

Cui Chengzhang was meeting Aning for the first time and found her lively and cute. He didn't dare to talk to the adults but felt at ease with Aning.

Seeing Aning speak, he said, "This stream is diverted from outside and has many fish in it."

In Jiangnan, waterways crisscrossed, and almost every household had a stream passing by their door.

"Brother, do you know how to fish?"

Cui Chengzhang shook his head. "I usually study at home and don't have time to play in the garden."

His mother was usually very strict about his studies, so even though the stream was right there in the manor, he had never had the time to go fishing.

"It's alright. When we return to the capital, I'll have my eldest brother teach you how to fish. He's the best at it." As she said this, Aning missed Zhao Yi Yun in the capital a little.

If he were here, he would definitely take her to catch fish in the stream.

Cui Chengzhang wasn't thinking about fishing at the moment; he had only caught the words "return to the capital."

"Return to the capital?"

"Yes, didn't you know?" Aning looked at him in surprise. "Uncle came to Jiangnan specifically to pick you up."

Cui Chengzhang shook his head. "The uncle you mentioned, is he my second uncle?"

Aning was about to say yes, but then she thought again. The uncle wanted to marry this young brother's mother, so he should be the young brother's father. But the young brother also called the uncle "Second Uncle"... Hmm, what should he be called then?

"Aunt Miao." Aning looked at Liang Miaotong for help.

Liang Miaotong was also at a loss for words at the moment, and Wen Jian was even more so.

Unable to get help, Aning thought carefully for a moment and then seriously said to Cui Chengzhang, "Uncle likes your mother and wants to marry her. When we go back to the capital together, you won't have to call him Second Uncle anymore; you can call him Father."

"You shouldn't talk nonsense."

"I'm not talking nonsense," Aning had eavesdropped on her parents before. Seeing that she had upset the young brother, she imitated her mother's tone and said, "If you are a filial child, you should want your mother to be happy."

"I am filial, but I can't just acknowledge someone as my father."

"It's not random. My uncle truly likes your mother and will marry her. He will take care of her and make her happy forever."

Aning's rapid-fire words left Cui Chengzhang stunned.

Liang Miaotong wanted to stop her, but upon careful consideration, Aning's words made sense.

Without Cui Chengzhang's approval, Cui Zaiting would not be able to take Shen Fengyun back to the capital.

Aning's voice was crisp and pleasant, but every word she said sounded like thunder to Cui Chengzhang.

"Did Second Uncle come to propose to my mother?"

"Yes," thinking of her uncle's kindness, Aning proudly said, "My uncle is the Grand Tutor and the Emperor Brother's teacher. He is very capable. When we go to the capital, your mother won't have to work so hard anymore."

Hard?

Cui Chengzhang naturally knew that it was hard for his mother to raise him alone, but... Second Uncle and Mother... Cui Chengzhang still found it hard to accept.

"But my mother and I don't want to leave here."

Aning continued, "Brother, you study hard every day and don't even have time to fish. It must be for the imperial examinations. Anyway, we have to go to the capital eventually. Brother, let's go back to the capital with us now."

Aning often visited the Qianqing Palace, and whenever Zhao Yi Yun and her parents reviewed memorials, she would quietly sit beside them.

Through constant exposure, her understanding far surpassed that of an ordinary eight-year-old, and she could even discuss court affairs coherently.

"My mother..." Cui Chengzhang instinctively wanted to refute, but thinking of his mother's constant exhortations to study hard and pass the imperial examinations, it was clear that his mother wanted to return to the capital.

Seeing the two children talking to this extent, Liang Miaotong thought for a moment and then took Aning's hand.

This matter was too sudden for Cui Chengzhang, and it was impossible for him to accept it in such a short time.

Moreover, they didn't even know Shen Fengyun's feelings yet. Persuading Cui Chengzhang was still too early.

"Chengzhang, have you forgotten what the capital looks like?"

On the way to Yangzhou, Cui Zaiting had told them many things about the past. After some consideration, Liang Miaotong also spoke up.

"I've forgotten what it was like to live in the capital," Cui Chengzhang said softly.

"Do you want to go to the capital to see it?"

Cui Chengzhang was silent for a moment before saying, "My mother said that my maternal grandfather's family all live in the capital."

Naturally, he was curious about the capital.

"In that case, you can return to the capital with us. Your maternal grandfather misses you very much."

After saying so much, Cui Chengzhang now understood that they were speaking on behalf of his second uncle.

In fact, all their words were in vain.

Cui Chengzhang had always been obedient and filial. Whatever his mother decided, he would not oppose.

So, the pretty little sister had wasted her effort.

To motivate Cui Chengzhang to study, his mother had told him about the past of the Xingguo Duke's mansion. Cui Chengzhang wanted to pass the imperial examinations, rise in the world, and earn a title for his mother.

The teachers at the Imperial College were all great scholars. If he could study there, it would definitely be helpful.

"If my mother is willing to return to the capital, then I am naturally willing as well."

Wen Jian gently nudged Liang Miaotong's sleeve, signaling her to stop talking.

Liang Miaotong naturally agreed. She took the two children for a walk along the stream. After estimating that enough time had passed, they returned to where Cui Zaiting and Shen Fengyun were talking.

They saw Cui Zaiting and Shen Fengyun standing side by side under the shade of a tree. The summer wind blew, one in a brocade robe, the other with her skirt swaying. As they talked, their eyebrows and eyes were filled with smiles.

Wen Jian and Liang Miaotong exchanged a glance and smiled knowingly.

This trip hadn't been in vain. The journey back to the capital would be lively.

chapters.title: Extra - New Life 1
chapters.content:
When Aning returned to the capital, Yu Wan was already nearing her due date.

Originally, Wen Xiao and his group had planned to travel around Jiangnan for a month after leaving Yangzhou by boat before returning to the capital. But after arriving in Hangzhou, Liang Miaotong fell seriously ill and had to stay in the city to recuperate, delaying their return by over a month.

Fortunately, the journey back to the capital went smoothly, and they managed to arrive just in time before Yu Wan gave birth.

Wen Xiao and Liang Miaotong had promised Yu Wan before leaving the capital that they would bring Aning back within two months, but the delay left them feeling somewhat guilty, knowing she must have missed her daughter dearly.

Yu Wan, of course, held no resentment toward them.

As Aning excitedly recounted her various experiences in Jiangnan and all the things she had done on her own after leaving her parents' care, Yu Wan felt nothing but gratitude toward them.

Apart from her blood relatives, they were the only ones Yu Wan trusted enough to entrust her child to.

"Is Tong'er feeling better now? I'll have the imperial physician take a look at you."

Liang Miaotong replied with a hint of shame, "It's nothing serious. It was my own fault for being greedy and eating too much street food. I don't know which one went bad, but I had diarrhea for days."

As she spoke, Liang Miaotong couldn't help but feel relieved. "That day, Aning ate a lot with me too. Thank goodness she didn’t eat the spoiled food."

If Aning had also fallen ill, she would have been overwhelmed with guilt.

Yu Wan understood her thoughts and consoled her, "When traveling, such things are unavoidable. Just be more careful with food in the future."

After saying this, she looked up at Shen Tongyun and Cui Chengzhang, mother and son.

Strictly speaking, among those in the Cining Palace at the moment, apart from Zhao Mianze and Aning, Cui Chengzhang was the one most closely related to her by blood.

Yu Wan had previously discussed this with Wen Xiao and Tong'er, and they both agreed that Cui Chengzhang had been well-educated by Shen Tongyun. However, having grown up with his widowed mother, his temperament was somewhat reserved.

"Sister-in-law, you haven't been back to the capital for a long time. Are you still adjusting?" Yu Wan addressed Shen Tongyun as such, since Cui Zaiting and Shen Tongyun had not yet married.

Shen Tongyun's cheeks flushed slightly, and she felt a bit embarrassed.

No wonder, after reuniting, Cui Zaiting was no longer as restrained as before but instead openly expressed his feelings to her.

In Yuzhou these past few years, he must have been greatly influenced by his sister, Yu Wan.

"I grew up in the capital since I was little, so there's nothing I'm not used to. It's just that Chengzhang's appetite hasn't been as good as before."

Cui Chengzhang was born in the capital but raised in Jiangnan, so he was bound to have some trouble adjusting to the local food and water.

Yu Wan said, "The Houfu has an excellent Jiangnan chef. Since there aren't many people at home who eat Jiangnan cuisine, I'll send him to Wu Garden. In the future, he can serve at my brother's residence."

The late Marquis's wife was from Jiangnan, so the old Marquis had hired many Jiangnan chefs for her. After her early passing, most were dismissed, and only one remained.

Although Shen Tongyun was now with Cui Zaiting, she still worried about causing trouble for the Ningguo Duke's household. So, she only visited her elders with her son and had not moved back into the Duke's residence.

Wu Garden had been vacant for years, and Yu Wan had arranged for them to stay there temporarily until Shen Tongyun married Cui Zaiting and moved into the Cui residence.

"Thank you, Your Majesty."

Cui Chengzhang indeed struggled with the capital's cuisine. At his age, he needed proper nutrition, and Shen Tongyun was concerned about him.

As the Empress Dowager, Yu Wan certainly had access to chefs, so there was no need for Shen Tongyun to refuse.

Cui Chengzhang stood up and bowed, "Thank you for your grace, Your Majesty."

"Among family, there's no need for such formalities."

As they were talking, Zhao Xuanxu walked over. Everyone stood up to greet him, except for Aning, who, like a joyful little bird, flew to Zhao Xuanxu's side.

Zhao Xuanxu could only repeat what Yu Wan had said before: "We are family; there's no need for formalities."

After chatting for a while, Liang Miaotong mentioned she had matters to attend to at her residence and took her leave, followed by the others.

The couple then arranged for the children to have dinner together. After the children returned to their respective palaces, Zhao Xuanxu helped Yu Wan back to her couch.

Since becoming pregnant, Yu Wan had refrained from using makeup, and with a basin nearby, she had even removed all her golden hairpins and jade rings. In Zhao Xuanxu's eyes...

"When is Brother planning to get married?" Zhao Xuanxu asked.

"He needs to settle Chengzhang first before preparing for the wedding," Yu Wan said with a sigh. "But Brother is too soft-hearted. In my opinion, he should get married first. Only then can a father properly take care of his son."

Cui Chengzhang had not opposed Cui Zaiting's marriage to Shen Tongyun. Cui Zaiting knew that his son felt uncomfortable about it.

"He has already waited so many years. Waiting another year or so shouldn't be a problem."

"No," Yu Wan narrowed her eyes. "They say good things take time, but I think good things should happen as soon as possible. If you wait too long, the golden flower will wither."

Upon hearing this, Zhao Xuanxu knew Yu Wan was planning to meddle again.

"What do you intend to do?"

"I originally thought Brother wanted to send Chengzhang to the Imperial College, but in my opinion, it would be better for him to study in the palace."

Traditionally, the emperor and princes' study companions were often selected from among their relatives.

Currently, Zhao Yi'yun and Zhao Mianze's companions came from the Jingyuan and Anning Marquis' households. Adding Cui Chengzhang wouldn't be an issue.

As Cui Chengzhang was Yu Wan's own nephew, having him study in the palace as a companion would be better than having an outsider.

Listening to Yu Wan's delighted plans, Zhao Xuanxu's deep eyes softened.

"You're always worrying about these things. Aren't you tired?"

Yu Wan reached out to massage his shoulders. "Unlike you, I don't have to deal with military and state affairs every day. Confined to the Kunning Palace, if I don't find things to worry about, I wouldn't know what to do."

Zhao Xuanxu raised an eyebrow. "If Yi'yun can marry and take charge of the government soon, I'll be able to spend more time with you."

The Ministry of Rites had been arranging candidates for the empress, but Yi'yun hadn't taken a liking to any of them.

At the mention of this, Yu Wan also felt somewhat helpless.

"I've met those young ladies several times. They all have their own charms, but he hasn't taken a fancy to any of them. I don't know what kind of girl he actually likes."

Zhao Xuanxu clicked his tongue. "Perhaps none of them caught his eye."

"The longer he delays marriage, the further he is from taking charge of the government."

After a young emperor ascended the throne, it was usually the appointed regents who managed state affairs until the emperor married and began his personal rule.

Zhao Xuanxu had no intention of interfering in politics, but to counterbalance Prime Minister Xu, he often had to step in on many court matters, leaving little free time for Yu Wan and their family.

Yu Wan pinched his chin and softly said, "I want to move to Cining Palace."

Previously, they had lived in Kunning Palace because Zhao Yi'yun was still young, and living nearby made it easier to care for him.

Moving to Cining Palace now would also subtly remind Zhao Yi'yun that the imperial palace should have a mistress.

Zhao Xuanxu understood Yu Wan's intentions, but he frowned slightly and said softly, "I always feel that Yi'yun is hiding something."

"Do you mean regarding his marriage?"

"Mmm," Zhao Xuanxu had mentioned this to Zhao Yi'yun several times before, and Yi'yun's attitude had made him suspicious. "Perhaps Yi'yun already has someone in mind?"

Someone in mind?

Zhao Xuanxu was busy, and Zhao Yi'yun was also busy with learning to handle court affairs and his studies and martial arts. He probably didn't have many opportunities to meet young ladies his age.

After pondering for a moment, Yu Wan thought of something.

"Huaiyue's elder brother's family has a cousin who is two years younger than Yi'yun. Previously, I had considered her as a candidate, but after the Zhuo family's decline, the children were not well-educated. I saw that the girl was unlearned and impolite, so I didn't consider her. Maybe Yi'yun has taken a liking to her."

Yi'yun missed his birth mother, Zhuo Huaiyue, and had always intended to help the Zhuo family. However, the younger generation of the Zhuo family had no outstanding talents, and Huaiyue's elder brother had only been given a minor sixth-rank idle position.

Before Zhao Xuanxu could speak, Yu Wan had already figured it out.

A young girl's lack of education wasn't a big problem. As long as she had a good character, everything else could be taught gradually.

Yu Wan herself had only started learning to read and write at the age of sixteen or seventeen.

"Tomorrow, when Yi'yun comes to pay his respects, I'll ask him about it."

---

chapters.title: Extra - New Life 2
chapters.content:
After the morning court session, Zhao Yi'yun returned to the palace, changed into his casual clothes, and went straight to Kunning Palace.

In the past, Yu Wan would go to Qianqing Palace to wait for Zhao Yi'yun after court. But since Yu Wan became pregnant, Zhao Yi'yun had been coming to Kunning Palace every day after court to pay his respects.

At this moment, Zhao Mianze and Aning were still in class, and Zhao Xuanxu was discussing state affairs with Prime Minister Xu. Only Yu Wan and Zhao Yi'yun were present in Kunning Palace.

The imperial physician had said that the due date was in the next day or two. Yu Wan, with her bulky figure, leaned against the soft cushions on the noble consort's couch.

"Yi'yun, today I had the imperial kitchen make your favorite silver thread rolls. Try them while they're hot."

"Okay."

Zhao Yi'yun ate two silver thread rolls and then asked about Yu Wan's condition.

Even without makeup, Yu Wan's hair was as black as ink, and her skin was fair with bright eyes, resembling the image of his mother in his memory.

There were rumors in the court that Zhao Xuanxu and Ding Wan (Yu Wan) controlled him, making him a puppet. But only he knew that he genuinely regarded them as his parents.

"Mother, do you want to redecorate Kunning Palace?"

Seeing Ran Dong and Pan Xia leading the palace servants in tidying up, Zhao Yi'yun asked curiously.

"I'm moving to Cining Palace today."

"But you're about to give birth. Why the rush?"

Yu Wan smiled. "Cining Palace has already been prepared. Today, we just need to move some daily essentials over. Yi'yun, you've grown up. Soon, you'll be getting married. This Kunning Palace will be for your wife."

Zhao Yi'yun's eyes flickered slightly, and he lowered his gaze. "I've already discussed this with Father. I have no one in mind, so this matter should be postponed."

This response was identical to what Zhao Xuanxu had mentioned. Seeing this, Yu Wan pulled Zhao Yi'yun to sit beside her.

"Yi'yun, tell Mother the truth. Do you have someone in mind?"

"No."
