Zhao Yi'yun naturally denied it, but he knew that Yu Wan was not asking casually today. She wanted a serious conversation with him, and a simple "no" would not convince her.

After thinking for a moment, Zhao Yi'yun said, "Mother and Father need not worry about me. I simply have no plans to marry yet."

"How can you, as the ruler of a nation, have no plans to marry?"

"I want to wait until I'm seventeen or eighteen to discuss marriage."

Aning was too young now. If he said he wanted to marry Aning, Mother would definitely be angry.

When he turned seventeen, Aning would also be of the age when noble ladies in the capital were considered for marriage. Then, bringing up the marriage proposal wouldn't seem so abrupt to his parents.

Yu Wan saw that he was indeed avoiding the topic and got straight to the point. "Are you afraid that Father and I won't like the person you have in mind? Actually, as long as you like them, we won't object."

She herself came from a humble background. How could she look down on a girl from the Zhuo family?

No matter how much the Zhuo family had declined, it was still better than being a servant girl.

Zhao Yi'yun was slightly taken aback.

Yu Wan's tone suggested she had guessed his intended person, but her words didn't quite match.

Aning was the apple of Father and Mother's eye. How could they not like her?

"Mother, who do you think is the person I have in mind?"

"Is it the cousin from your maternal uncle Zhuo's family?"

"Of course not."

Zhao Yi'yun denied it immediately, but he answered too quickly. Yu Wan instantly saw through him; he indeed had someone in mind.

"Then who is it?" Yu Wan pressed.

Facing Yu Wan's clear and bright eyes, Zhao Yi'yun realized he had already given himself away.

If he were to make up a name to brush her off, Mother would surely not believe him.

Of course, if she did believe him, that would be even worse.

Yu Wan watched Zhao Yi'yun's gradually pensive gaze and realized the matter was not that simple.

She stopped pressing and picked up the chicken soup beside her.

After finishing most of the soup, Yu Wan softly said, "Yi'yun, no matter what you're thinking, you can share it with Father and me. Whether it succeeds or not, we can always help you make a decision."

Zhao Yi'yun remained silent for a long time before looking up at Yu Wan.

Years ago, when he arrived at the Marquis's residence, he was a despised traitor's orphan. Apart from his royal grandfather, all his relatives wished he were dead.

But Zhao Xuanxu and Yu Wan treated him like their own son.

Of course, he regarded them as his true parents, and Zhao Mianze and Aning as his siblings.

If he told Mother that he wanted to marry Aning, what would her reaction be?

After a year as emperor, Zhao Yi'yun had long since developed an imperial demeanor, handling any situation with composure. But now, he felt a bit apprehensive.

He didn't know how Yu Wan would react. He was afraid she would be angry, afraid she would be disappointed in him.

"Yi'yun, what's wrong?"

Seeing Zhao Yi'yun's expression, Yu Wan felt increasingly uneasy, her heart hanging in suspense.

After a moment of silence, Zhao Yi'yun slowly raised his eyebrows.

"Mother, no matter what I say, please don't be angry with me, okay?"

"Would being angry solve anything?" Yu Wan lightly laughed and patted Zhao Yi'yun's shoulder. "You are my son. No matter what you do wrong or say wrong, I will only work with you to find a solution."

Zhao Yi'yun nodded and, looking into Yu Wan's eyes, said in a low voice, "I want to marry Aning."

Even though Yu Wan had mentally prepared herself and expected Zhao Yi'yun to say something shocking, the five short words still left her stunned.

"Aning is your sister."

Hearing that Yu Wan's tone was full of shock and no blame, Zhao Yi'yun felt slightly at ease.

"Mother, no matter what, Aning is not my sister."

Zhao Yi'yun was the son of Zhao Zun and Zhuo Huaiyue, while Aning was the biological daughter of Zhao Xuanxu and Yu Wan.

Currently, Zhao Yi'yun had become the adopted son of Zhao Xuanxu and Yu Wan, and Aning had long been adopted into the Ping'an Marquis's family.

There was no blood relation between them, nor were they siblings by law.

"Aning is too young..."

Zhao Yi'yun took Yu Wan's hand and pleaded, "I don't plan to marry now. I can wait for Aning to grow up."

Yu Wan tried her best to calm her emotions.

She understood Zhao Yi'yun and saw that he was determined.

"Mother, I understand your concerns. This matter is too sudden for you and Father. If you can't accept it, I won't blame you." Zhao Yi'yun's gaze was also very sincere. "But please don't make me marry someone else, okay?"

"I and your father have already decided not to interfere in Aning's marriage. Whoever she wants to marry is up to her."

"Then let's wait for Aning to grow up and decide for herself."

"Are you really willing to wait?"

Aning was the apple of Zhao Xuanxu and Yu Wan's eye. They had already decided that she would not marry until she was seventeen or eighteen.

Zhao Yi'yun was five years older than Aning and was the emperor. If he was willing to wait ten years to establish his empress, he might be willing, but the court officials would not.

After thinking, Yu Wan gently reminded him, "Yi'yun, your father and I both hope that Aning's husband will be devoted only to her, that they will be a couple for life."

An emperor had three palaces and six courts, with thousands of beauties. Yu Wan did not want Aning to live a life of vying for favor.

Zhao Yi'yun remembered that his birth father, Zhao Zun, had many concubines. Although his mother, Zhuo Huaiyue, held the title of a high-ranking concubine, she often suffered at the hands of the Crown Princess and even some lower-ranking but favored concubines.

He did not want Aning to endure such humiliation.

Moreover, at the Ping'an Marquis's residence, he had experienced the warmth of a true family and hoped to have a relationship like Zhao Xuanxu and Yu Wan's; exclusive and devoted.

chapters.title: Extra - New Life 3
chapters.content:
"Mother, if I marry Aning, she will be the only one in the harem, and I will never let her suffer."

Zhao Yi Yun's eyes were clear, and his tone was sincere.

Yu Ying did not doubt his sincerity, but they were both too young.

Not to mention the innocent and naive Aning, even Zhao Yi Yun himself might not understand love.

"I promise you, I will delay your marriage. If after a few years you still want to marry Aning..." Yu Ying said gently, "it depends on Aning's wishes."

She and Zhao Xuanyou had already made up their minds not to interfere in their children's marriages.

When Aning grew up, if she had someone she liked, they would send her off in a grand wedding. If she didn't have anyone in mind, they would support her for life.

"I understand. I will ask for Aning's wishes when she reaches the age to discuss marriage."

"Yi Yun, I must remind you, since you regard Aning as a young lady of the Ping'an Marquis's residence, you must not treat her like a sister from now on."

Zhao Yi Yun was slightly startled and asked in surprise, "Does Mother want Aning to move to the Ping'an Marquis's residence?"

"Of course not," Yu Ying said, "I mean, you and Aning can no longer be as intimate as before."

Zhao Yi Yun and Aning had been as close as siblings before. Since he no longer considered Aning as a sister, he must follow the rule that boys and girls should not sit together after the age of seven.

"Yes, from now on, I will treat Aning like a cousin." Zhao Yi Yun solemnly promised Yu Ying.

He had lied to Yu Ying.

He had already decided to marry Aning. If Aning truly changed her mind, he would fight for her until the end.

Afraid that Yu Ying would notice his strange behavior, he lowered his gaze. "There is something else I want to report to Mother."

"Go on."

"The Cining Palace has been uninhabited for a long time and should be renovated. Even if Mother wants to move out of the Kunning Palace, there is no need to go there. I want to build a new palace for Father and Mother."

"You have just ascended the throne. Large-scale construction will invite criticism from court officials. Although the Cining Palace is a bit old, its layout is spacious, and the garden is large. It is comfortable to live there."

The Cining Palace garden was only slightly smaller than the imperial garden. It was more comfortable to live there than in the Kunning Palace, which was surrounded by hard stone railings.

"Mother, please leave this matter to me. I will not marry for the next few years, so there is no need to vacate the Kunning Palace. Father and Mother can live here peacefully. In the future, when it's time to move, I will arrange it."

Zhao Yi Yun did not allow Yu Ying to refuse. He ordered the palace servants not to pack any more things and said he should go to the imperial study to attend his lessons.

Yu Ying and Zhao Xuanyou would never contradict Zhao Yi Yun in front of court officials and servants. They did not say much, only reminding him to study hard and come to the Kunning Palace for dinner in the evening.

After Zhao Yi Yun left, Yu Ying sighed deeply.

She looked calm, but the shock she received today was not small.

Yi Yun actually wanted to marry Aning...

While she was worried and confused, Zhao Xuanyou returned to the Kunning Palace.

Seeing that the items packed in the morning were all put back in their original places, he guessed that Yu Ying would not move to the Cining Palace today. However, Yu Ying's expression was truly inscrutable.

"What did Yi Yun say?"

Yi Yun treated Yu Ying more like a mother than himself. He could not say things to Zhao Xuanyou that he could say to Yu Ying.

Looking at Yu Ying's distracted appearance, Zhao Xuanyou knew that the matter was not simple.

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Ying's emotions became even more complicated.

Yi Yun and Aning were children they had raised themselves, but Aning was the only girl. Zhao Xuanyou had always treated Aning like the apple of his eye. Hearing this news, he would probably be angry with Yi Yun.

In an instant, Yu Ying's slight anger towards Zhao Yi Yun vanished.

"Yi Yun said he wants to delay marriage for a few years."

"Is that all?"

Yu Ying did not answer immediately. She took his large hand and placed it on her swollen belly.

The baby was about to be born. Even when he was not moving, she could easily see the baby's movements.

"Yi Yun wants to marry Aning."

After Yu Ying spoke softly, Zhao Xuanyou's eyes flickered, and a hint of anger appeared in his brows.

If his hand were not still on Yu Ying's stomach, he might have clenched it into a fist.

"I have talked to him. Since he has this idea, he should treat Aning as a young lady of the Ping'an Marquis's residence. From now on, he cannot act like siblings with her." Yu Ying was not entirely accepting of this matter and still patiently advised, "Aning's marriage is up to her. If she is willing to marry Yi Yun five years later, then so be it."

"He has been good to Aning since he was a child, and now he has such thoughts."

Yu Ying also sighed softly. After thinking for a moment, she continued to speak for Zhao Yi Yun.

"He is a little older than Aning and is still a child. How could he understand love? Maybe in five years, he won't want to marry her anymore."

Zhao Xuanyou coldly huffed.

Aning was so lovely that everyone adored her. In the future, there would be countless people who wanted to marry her. How could Zhao Yi Yun give up once he had set his mind on her?

Yu Ying, however, could not help but smile.

When criticizing Zhao Mianze, Zhao Xuanyou could find countless faults, but when it came to Aning, she was perfect in his eyes, without a single flaw.

She tilted her head slightly and let out a breath.

"Just now, while I was sitting here, I thought of a benefit of Aning marrying Yi Yun."

"There is a benefit?"

Yu Ying nodded, leaning against Zhao Xuanyou's shoulder with her arm around his.

"In the past, when we talked about the children's future, we said we would let Aning stay at home for a few more years and not rush into marriage. If Aning marries Yi Yun, she won't have to marry into another family or serve her in-laws and worry about their moods."

It was indeed a great benefit.

Zhao Xuanyou, as the heir of a marquis, knew many secrets of the high-ranking families in the capital. Almost every family had troubles.

Yi Yun's family was the Jingyuan Marquis's residence. Marrying him would mean not having to worry about these family troubles.

The frown between Zhao Xuanyou's brows gradually faded, but he soon thought of another problem. Yi Yun was the emperor and had no troublesome relatives, but he would have a harem of three thousand beauties.

"Aning's temperament would not allow her to live a life of competing for favor."

Yu Ying said, "In the high-ranking families of the capital, the number of men who do not take concubines can be counted on one hand. Marrying outside the palace does not necessarily mean finding a satisfactory husband. Yi Yun has promised he will not have a large harem, and compared to others, I trust him more. However, whether it succeeds or not depends on Aning's wishes in the future."

Zhao Xuanyou furrowed his brows and pondered for a while before agreeing with Yu Ying.

Marrying Zhao Yi Yun was indeed better than marrying an outsider.

However, Aning was still young. Zhao Xuanyou would not allow Aning to be alone with Zhao Yi Yun. He would have to keep a close eye on that boy and not allow him any opportunity to overstep.

"Ah…"

While Zhao Xuanyou was deep in thought, Yu Ying beside him suddenly exclaimed.

"Ying!"

Seeing Zhao Xuanyou so nervous, Yu Ying softly said, "I think I'm about to give birth."

Zhao Xuanyou was slightly startled. Seeing that Yu Ying's skirt was wet, he knew she had broken her water.

Yu Ying had given birth to a son and a daughter for him eight years ago. The familiar tension returned.

"Send for the imperial physicians and midwives."

The Kunning Palace had long been prepared for Yu Ying's childbirth. A group of people went to the Imperial Medical Bureau, and another group prepared water.

Zhao Xuanyou carried Yu Ying into the house and then waited outside.

Zhao Yi Yun, Zhao Mianze, and Aning soon arrived after hearing the news and waited with Zhao Xuanyou.

The three children were experiencing this situation for the first time. Hearing Yu Ying's painful cries, they were all anxious but refused to leave.

Their mother was going through the most difficult time, and she was not afraid. How could they stay away?

Just as they silently prayed for their mother to suffer less, a baby's cry finally came from the inner hall.

---

chapters.title: Extra - Blessings Flow On 1
chapters.content:
"Mother, Mianyu knocked over my inkstone."

Aning wore a light pink spring dress with delicate peach blossom embroidery on the skirt. As she moved, it seemed as if she were walking through a peach forest with fluttering petals, making her already beautiful features even more charming.

However, at this moment, Aning looked angry.

Aning was twelve years old. Her every movement exuded the grace of a young lady, but she still showed her childish side in front of Zhao Xuanyou and Yu Ying.

Zhao Mianyu was the son Yu Ying had given birth to five years ago. Mianyu was naturally mischievous and truly gave Yu Ying a headache.

Normally, raising three children would have made Yu Ying experienced, but with Mianyu, she realized it was not that she was good at raising children, but that the first three children had been easy to raise.

Zhao Yi Yun was not to be mentioned. He had suffered hardships in his childhood, which made him steady, quiet, and considerate of his family's emotions. He had the demeanor of an eldest son. Aning was lively but not naughty, the most considerate little cotton-padded jacket for her parents. Even Zhao Mianze, who gave Yu Ying and Zhao Xuanyou the most headaches, never caused trouble. He was just indifferent to everything.

With Mianyu, Yu Ying finally realized that it was not that she was good at raising children, but that the first three children had been well-behaved.

"Mianyu is too naughty. Later, I will have Father spank him hard." Yu Ying held her daughter in her arms and softly asked, "Where is the calligraphy you wrote? Show it to Mother."

If she hadn't mentioned it, it would have been fine, but now that she had, Aning became even more disheartened.

"Mianyu spilled ink all over the Buddhist scriptures I was copying for the Great Grandmother's birthday. I have to rewrite those pages."

"This is unacceptable!" Yu Ying was truly angry.

Aning had been preparing a gift for Lady Ye's birthday for several months. She wanted to personally copy a volume of Buddhist scriptures to give to the old lady.

Normally, Zhao Mianyu's mischief was tolerable, but this time he had ruined Aning's carefully copied scriptures.

"Qiansu, bring Mianyu here."

Before Qiansu could speak, Aning said, "After he knocked over the inkstone, he ran to the imperial garden. He said I was no fun and that he wanted to find his brother."

"Mother will take you to the imperial garden and have Mianyu apologize to you."

It was one thing to be a little naughty while playing, but bullying his sister was another matter entirely. This could not be tolerated.

Yu Ying took Aning's hand and went to the imperial garden together.

The imperial garden was lively today. Ladies from noble families in the capital had brought their daughters to enjoy the flowers. Yu Ying had chatted with them for a while before returning to the palace to rest.

This flower gathering was originally organized to select a consort for Zhao Yi Yun, but since Zhao Yi Yun never attended, Yu Ying had stopped looking at girls. However, the imperial garden was vibrant with flowers in spring, and a group of young girls enjoying tea and flowers was a pleasant sight. Yu Ying continued to host the spring flower banquets year after year.

Although Zhao Yi Yun did not select a consort, the ladies from noble families brought their daughters to socialize at the flower banquets, and several marriages had indeed been arranged.

"Did Yi Yun and Mianze go to the imperial garden?"

Halfway there, Yu Ying suddenly had a doubt.

Yi Yun had never attended the flower banquets in previous years, and Mianze, now older, no longer followed Yu Ying there.

Yu Ying had returned to the palace to rest, so who would be in the imperial garden now?

Aning also slightly lowered her gaze.

As she grew older, she finally understood what her previous agreement with Brother Yi Yun meant.

She was naturally happy about it.

Hearing Yu Ying's words, she was also a little curious. Could Brother Yi Yun be in the imperial garden?

There were so many beautiful sisters in the garden. Could it be that he had taken a fancy to someone?

Yu Ying saw her daughter lowering her gaze and not speaking, so she did not say more. She took Aning's hand and continued walking.

Soon, the mother and daughter arrived at the imperial garden. After exchanging greetings with the ladies, Yu Ying called a palace servant forward: "Is Mianyu here?"

"Yes, His Highness the Prince took Mianyu and the young master to play at the rockery."

When Zhao Yi Yun ascended the throne, he conferred the title of Prince on Zhao Mianze. This title was naturally higher than that of a marquis.

However, the old marquis and Zhao Xuanyou always believed that the Jingyuan Marquis's residence and the Mingji Guard needed to be inherited. They had once considered letting Aning inherit the title when she grew up, but Aning preferred calligraphy to martial arts, and Zhao Yi Yun said he wanted to marry Aning, so this matter was dropped.

After Zhao Mianyu was born, his boundless energy gave Yu Ying a headache, but the old marquis was overjoyed. He immediately requested an imperial decree to establish Zhao Mianyu as the heir of the Jingyuan Marquis's residence.

"Is Mianze in the imperial garden?" Yu Ying asked.

"Yes."

Yu Ying waved her hand to dismiss the palace servant. She was about to call Aning to go find them, but she saw Aning looking down and smiling.

"What are you smiling about?"

Aning quickly composed herself, and her fair cheeks turned slightly red.

"I was thinking about how Mother would scold Mianyu, and I found it funny."

Really?

Yu Ying did not believe her. One moment she was frowning, the next she was smiling secretly. There was clearly something going on.

However, it was normal for a girl her age to have her own little secrets. There was no need to pry too deeply.

"Mother, let's go to the rockery quickly."

Aning was also afraid that her mother would ask, so she quickly took her hand and walked away.

Brother Yi Yun had instructed her not to tell their parents about their agreement.

The mother and daughter climbed the rockery and saw Zhao Mianze taking Zhao Mianyu to sit in the pavilion at the top of the hill. However, besides the two of them, there was also a young girl in a pink-purple dress in the pavilion.

The young girl was about the same age as Zhao Mianze. She had a round, oval face, beautiful features, and a scholarly elegance in her brows and eyes. However, there was a hint of wariness in her eyes when she looked at Zhao Mianze.

No one knew what they were talking about, but the young girl stood up to leave, only to be pulled back by Zhao Mianze.

Was this boy bullying her?

"Zhao Mianze!" Yu Ying raised her voice, and the three people in the pavilion all looked in her direction.

Zhao Mianyu looked confused and did not react much, but Zhao Mianze was surprised and immediately let go of the girl's hand.

The young girl was shocked when she saw Yu Ying. She thought she had caused a great disaster in the palace and immediately knelt down with tears in her eyes.

"Your Majesty the Empress Dowager, this humble..."

"Don't be afraid, get up quickly."

Seeing that the young girl was so scared, Yu Ying gave Aning a look. Aning hurried over, helped the young girl up, and comforted her: "Sister, don't cry. My mother is the kindest person and won't punish you."

"What is your name? Which family are you from?"

"In response to Your Majesty the Empress Dowager, this humble one is Qi Luan, the daughter of... the Minister of Revenue, Qi Jun."

Qi Luan looked at Yu Ying with tears in her eyes. This was her first time entering the palace. Earlier, while appreciating the flowers with other noble girls of the same age, she had been pulled away by Zhao Mianyu.

Because Zhao Mianyu was of noble status and only five years old, the ladies and palace maids nearby did not dare to stop him.

Qi Luan, on her first visit to the palace, did not dare to act presumptuously. She could only follow Zhao Mianyu to the rockery. Unexpectedly, she encountered Zhao Mianze in the pavilion.

She did not recognize Zhao Mianze, but she could guess from his attire that he was the prince brother that Zhao Mianyu had mentioned.

Zhao Mianze asked her to sit and talk, and Qi Luan reluctantly took a seat, but she still felt it was improper.

After a moment of discomfort, she still wanted to get up and leave, but she was stopped by Zhao Mianze. She did not expect this scene to be seen by the Empress Dowager.

"So it's the young girl from the Qi family. Don't be afraid. What happened just now was Mianze's fault. I won't blame you," Yu Ying softly comforted the young girl and then said, "Aning, take Miss Qi back to continue enjoying the flowers."

"Yes." Aning glanced at Zhao Mianze and Zhao Mianyu, the two troublemakers, and took Qi Luan's hand to the rockery.

After they left, Yu Ying's expression darkened.

Zhao Mianyu was naughty and ignorant, but Zhao Mianze had actually dared to touch a young girl in the imperial garden. This was a serious matter.

Zhao Mianze felt a lump in his throat when he met his mother's gaze.

What should he do?

He was in deep trouble this time.

chapters.title: Extra - Blessings Flow On 2
chapters.content:
"Speak, what happened?"

Yu Yuan entered the pavilion, and Zhao Mianze helped her sit down before standing to the side with his head bowed.

Luan Luan was his wife from his past life.

Upon learning that she had entered the palace today, he immediately came to the imperial garden.

Originally, he just wanted to catch a glimpse of her from afar, to see what Luan Luan looked like as a child.

But after several glances, the sweet memories of their past life together surged like a tide, and he couldn't resist asking his younger brother to bring Luan Luan over for a few words.

Before he could even speak, Luan Luan wanted to leave.

He instinctively reached out to stop her, only to be caught red-handed by his mother.

"I just wanted to talk to her."

"Does talking require Mianru to bring Miss Qi here?" Yu Yuan's face darkened, her tone unusually severe.

In Zhao Mianze's memory, his mother had never spoken to him in such a harsh tone.

Today's matter must have greatly angered her.

"Mother, I really just wanted to talk."

Zhao Mianze spoke sincerely. He truly just wanted to see Qi Luan at this age and had no ill intentions.

But to Yu Yuan, his words clearly sounded like he had taken a fancy to the girl, used his brother to deceive her into coming here, and then laid hands on her when she refused to engage.

"Does that sound reasonable?"

Given Qi Luan's personality, today's events would likely weigh heavily on her mind.

But Zhao Mianze also felt wronged.

He had spent a lifetime with Qi Luan; seeing her face, he instinctively reached for her hand.

Zhao Mianze frowned and pursed his lips, saying nothing. Yu Yuan assumed he was unrepentant and ordered him to stay and reflect, then took Zhao Mianru and left.

The imperial garden was still lively; Aning and Qi Luan surprisingly got along well.

Seeing that Qi Luan's spirits had recovered and she was laughing and chatting, Yu Yuan set her mind at ease and left the imperial garden with Zhao Mianru, heading towards the Yaoguang Palace.

Compared to Zhao Mianze, Zhao Mianru's mischief was trivial, but he still couldn't go unpunished.

At the beginning of the year, Yu Yuan and Zhao Xuanyou moved from the Qianqing Palace to the Yaoguang Palace.

Zhao Yi Yun did not undertake grand construction but instead renovated the existing palace rooms by the Taiye Pool.

In terms of appearance and regulations, the Yaoguang Palace did not surpass the Qianqing Palace or the Kunning Palace. However, after renovation and decoration, the Yaoguang Palace became the most magnificent place in the imperial palace.

The steps were made of snow-white jade, and the walls were coated with pepper mud, exuding a faint fragrance without the need for incense.

The jade artifacts, antiques, and jewelry used for decoration were the finest treasures in the palace. The entire Yaoguang Palace was adorned with gold lacquer and paintings, exuding luxury and splendor everywhere.

Moreover, the Yaoguang Palace was located by the Taiye Pool. Opening the window, one could see the rippling waves of the Taiye Pool, with qiong flowers and yaocao grass planted along the shore, presenting a beautiful and charming scenery of clear water and beautiful flowers.

Yu Yuan ordered Zhao Mianru to carry a basin of water and carefully scrub the golden brick floor of the Yaoguang Palace.

Zhao Mianru, though young and mischievous, was very perceptive. He knew his mother was angry at Mianze, so he didn't dare to act wildly while she was upset. He silently wrung out the cloth and started scrubbing the floor.

Yu Yuan stood by the window, the spring wind from the Taiye Pool brushing against her face, and the sound of birds chirping in her ears, but she still couldn't calm her emotions.

After a while of sulking, Ran Dong entered to report that the flower-appreciation banquet had ended.

After a moment of thought, Yu Yuan ordered someone to send rewards to the Qi residence.

In the imperial garden, she had been greatly angered by Zhao Mianze, and her expression and tone had been very severe.

She was angry at Zhao Mianze, but there was a distinction between monarch and subject. The young girl Qi Luan might have been frightened, so sending some rewards would prevent her from worrying about causing trouble in the palace after returning home.

When Zhao Xuanyou returned to the palace and learned that Zhao Mianru had ruined Aning's birthday gift for Lady Ye, he flew into a rage, grabbed Zhao Mianru, and went to administer family punishment.

"Has someone checked on Mianze?" Yu Yuan asked.

"Xiao Anzi is accompanying His Highness in the imperial garden for reflection. He just sent someone to report back." Ran Dong felt that her expression had softened slightly and thought she had calmed down. He softly advised, "His Highness has been standing in the pavilion for more than an hour. It's getting dark now, and the wind on the artificial hill is strong. Why not let His Highness return and have dinner?"

"One missed meal won't starve him."

Ran Dong didn't dare to advise further and silently served tea.

Yu Yuan picked up the teacup but didn't take a sip. Instead, she walked out.

After the flower banquet ended, the imperial garden returned to its usual tranquility.

Yu Yuan climbed the artificial hill and indeed saw Zhao Mianze still standing in the pavilion, reflecting on his actions.

He was at the age where he was growing taller, but he was very thin, looking somewhat frail as he stood there.

Yu Yuan couldn't help but feel a pang of heartache.

"Your Majesty, the Empress Dowager." Xiao Anzi, who was guarding nearby, saw Yu Yuan approaching and quickly knelt to pay his respects.

Zhao Mianze turned his head and silently greeted Yu Yuan.

Yu Yuan entered the pavilion and sat down, waving for Xiao Anzi to leave.

She looked up at Zhao Mianze and sighed, "Sit down and talk."

Zhao Mianze did not sit down. Instead, he stood by Yu Yuan's side and explained with downcast eyes, "Mother, I didn't mean to disrespect Miss Qi today."

"Why did you want to see her alone? To talk to her?"

"I just... just wanted to make friends with her." Zhao Mianze said this with very little confidence.

He certainly wasn't attracted to her appearance, but he did like Qi Luan, and he couldn't deny it even if his mother didn't believe him.

"Mother, I promise you, this will never happen again."

"You liked Miss Qi at first sight?"

Zhao Mianze hesitated for a moment before nodding, "Yes."

Zhao Yi Yun and Aning were already discussing marriage, so it wasn't a big deal for him to like Qi Luan.

In the capital, high-ranking families often arranged marriages early. His marriage to Luan Luan in his past life was arranged by Lady Ye.

If his mother knew about his feelings for Luan Luan earlier, she could help arrange their marriage, preventing others from coveting Luan Luan.

Yu Yuan looked at Zhao Mianze's response and felt a mix of emotions.

Yi Yun had grown up, and Mianze and Aning had also grown up.

"Even if you like her, you shouldn't do such things privately." Yu Yuan hoped that her son and daughter could find their beloved and spend their lives together. But since it was the first time Zhao Mianze and Qi Luan had met, his actions might have made Qi Luan dislike him. "The more you value someone, the more you should treat them with respect to show your appreciation."

"Yes, I was reckless today. Mother, please don't be angry anymore."

"If you do it again next time, I will have your father administer family punishment." Yu Yuan raised her voice, but her tone softened.

She pulled Zhao Mianze to sit down, and Ran Dong took out some pastries and sweet soup from the food box.

"You've been standing for so long; eat something."

Zhao Mianze nodded and picked up the sweet soup as instructed.

He had inherited Yu Yuan's looks, with fair and handsome features, delicate yet sharp, and his black gold-embroidered robe exuded nobility and dignity.

Looking at Zhao Mianze, Yu Yuan suddenly felt a pang of guilt.

When Zhao Mianze and Aning were born, Zhao Yi Yun was sent to the Marquis's residence, and suddenly, the Marquis's residence had three more children.

Zhao Yi Yun's background was complicated and involved great responsibilities. Aning was born weak and sickly, so naturally, Yu Yuan devoted more attention to them.

Zhao Mianze, who should have been the most attended-to eldest son, had unknowingly become the most easily overlooked second son.

He made a mistake, but Yu Yuan didn't blame him; instead, she blamed herself.

She had indeed paid too little attention to Zhao Mianze.

After finishing the sweet soup, Zhao Mianze looked up at Yu Yuan and was suddenly startled.

"Mother, why are you crying?"

---

chapters.title: Extra - Blessings Flow On 3
chapters.content:
"I'm fine."

Yu Yuan didn't want to cry in front of her son, so she turned her face away from the pavilion.

After feeling the moisture in the corners of her eyes dispersed by the wind, Yu Yuan turned back and softly explained to her son, "Mianze, I just... remembered some things and felt a little sad."

Zhao Mianze saw Yu Yuan's hesitation and thought she was still angry with him, "If Mother is still angry, then scold me some more."

He was thick-skinned and didn't mind being scolded, as long as it would make his mother feel better.

Yu Yuan remained silent, and Zhao Mianze gave a self-deprecating smile, "Come to think of it, this is the first time I've been scolded by Mother."

When Zhao Mianze had just reincarnated, he was very clingy to Yu Yuan, following her wherever she went.

Whenever Yu Yuan's hands were free, he would reach out to be held.

Because of these actions, he was often scolded by his father but never by his mother.

But over time, Zhao Mianze could see the difficulties Yu Yuan faced in raising three children and managing the Marquis's residence.

His mother worked so hard, so naturally, he took a step back, not competing for her attention with Yi Yun and Aning, and took care of his own affairs to avoid causing trouble for the family.

Moreover, in the past, he couldn't compete with Yi Yun and Aning, and now with the addition of a younger brother, Zhao Mianru, it was even harder.

Yu Yuan felt even more distressed.

"Over the years, I have not given you enough attention, and you have grown up so quietly."

Hearing Yu Yuan say this suddenly, Zhao Mianze quickly replied, "I am the eldest brother; it's my duty to help Father and Mother take care of my younger siblings."

Yu Yuan was naturally pleased to hear her son say such thoughtful words, but looking at Zhao Mianze, she couldn't help but have other thoughts.

Actually, Zhao Mianze had always been very sensible. Ever since he was a child...

"Mother, did I say something wrong?"

Yu Yuan reached out and touched Zhao Mianze's head, sighing, "You said everything right. It's just that I feel like I often can't understand you."

Zhao Mianze was slightly taken aback and subconsciously asked, "Why does Mother say that?"

Yu Yuan smiled, "You children were all raised by me. With Yi Yun, Aning, and Mianru, I can guess seven or eight out of ten times what they are thinking just by looking at them. But with you, Mianze, I can't see through your thoughts. I don't know what you like or what you want. Today, with Miss Qi, it's the first time I've heard you say you like someone."

Apart from being clingy to Yu Yuan as a child, Zhao Mianze had always been a very sensible child.

He never caused his parents any worry with his studies or martial arts. Although he wasn't particularly diligent, he excelled in everything.

Whether it was Yi Yun's troubles or Aning's illnesses, he would always silently help Yu Yuan solve her worries.

Zhao Mianru had been mischievous since he was young, and even Yi Yun and Aning, with their good tempers, were often annoyed by him.

Yu Yuan found her youngest son very troublesome, but Mianru always listened to Mianze, and Mianze often played with Mianru, helping Yu Yuan a lot.

"I really don't have any particular hobbies," Zhao Mianze said, never picky about food, clothing, shelter, or other matters. He didn't care about anything else. A rare hint of sadness, beyond his years, appeared on his face. "As long as Mother is happy, I am happy."

Yu Yuan was taken aback by his words.

Mianze was mature for his age and indifferent to many things, but he had always treated Yu Yuan differently.

Zhao Xuanyou's scoldings or beatings didn't seem to affect him, but a single glance from Yu Yuan could make him lower his head in submission.

It wasn't unusual for a son to be attached to his mother, but hearing Mianze say this directly still made Yu Yuan ask, "What about your father? Your brothers and sisters? Don't you care about them?"

"I do care about them, but Mother is different."

Zhao Mianze's gaze was clear and bright, his expression rarely so determined.

Yu Yuan, however, was even more confused.

She, of course, cared about Zhao Mianze too, but if she had to distinguish between closeness and distance among her family, she couldn't do it.

Why was Mianze so sure to put her first?

"Why?"

Zhao Mianze smiled slightly and slowly lowered his head.

"Mianze?" Seeing her son like this, Yu Yuan didn't want to force him and said, "It's fine if you don't want to say. It's getting late; let's return to the palace."

Yu Yuan took Zhao Mianze's hand and left the pavilion. After only a few steps, Zhao Mianze suddenly stopped.

"It's not that I can't say it; I'm just afraid that if I do, Mother won't believe me."

"How could that be?" Yu Yuan looked at Zhao Mianze in surprise, thinking he didn't trust her. She softly said, "Of course, Mother believes you."

Zhao Mianze looked up and met Yu Yuan's gaze, his heart stirring slightly.

He had been born in the Marquis's residence with a secret, and he had always hidden it well.

Could he tell his mother?

Zhao Mianze instinctively felt he couldn't, but looking at his mother, he hesitated.

His mother had probably noticed his condition long ago but had never asked.

They mother and son rarely had such private conversations. If he didn't speak today, his mother would certainly not ask.

But...

Zhao Mianze was willing to share his secret with his mother; his only concern was that he might scare her.

"If I say something shocking, Mother must not tell anyone else, and must not send me to see a doctor."

"Not even your father?"

"No."

"Alright, everything you say tonight will stay here. Not a word will leave."

Zhao Mianze pondered for a moment, and when his emotions had calmed somewhat, he said in a low voice, "Mother, I am your son, but I do not belong here."

To anyone else, these words would be confusing, and they wouldn't understand what Zhao Mianze meant.

But Yu Yuan was different.

She immediately thought of her own experiences and was suddenly startled, looking at Zhao Mianze in astonishment.

"Mianze, do you mean... you... came from..."

Zhao Mianze had originally thought that if he told the truth, his mother would dismiss it as a joke.

But his mother's reaction clearly showed that she was taking him seriously.

Since he had started speaking, Zhao Mianze decided to be straightforward, "I can't explain clearly where I came from or how I got here. But after I died in that world, I opened my eyes and was born in the Yuzhou Marquis's residence."

"After you died, you came here?"

Yu Yuan's voice trembled slightly.

She never would have imagined that Zhao Mianze was, like her, someone who had been reborn after death.

"Then, what was your name before... before this?"

"Zhao Mianze, of course. Mother, I said it before: I am your son, both in the past and now," Zhao Mianze sighed deeply here, with a mix of helplessness and regret. "In my past life, I was the same as I am now. It was our great-grandmother who gave me the name, and our grandfather and father chose Mianze. My past life was good, but it didn't have you. Mother, so now I only hope that you are happy, and that's what I care about most."

At first, Yu Yuan was just shocked that her son was also a reborn person.

But after hearing her son's following words, Yu Yuan felt as if she had been struck by lightning.

"My past life was good, but it didn't have you."

Mianze... was Mianze her son from her past life?

He had died and was reborn in this life to continue their mother-son relationship.

chapters.title: Extra – Blessings Flowing On 4
chapters.content:
"You were called Zhao Mianze in your past life? The young master of the Jingyuan Marquis's mansion?"

"Yes." Zhao Mianze watched Yu Wan not doubt his words at all, and a hint of confusion arose in his heart. However, he did not rush to ask, but seriously answered Yu Wan, "I am also your son, but many things are different."

Still her son... but without her.

Yu Wan held onto these words, feeling as if an invisible hand had grabbed her heart, causing her unbearable pain, leaving her speechless.

In her past life, didn't she die tragically right after giving birth to her son?

Then the Mianze in front of her was her son from her past life?

Yu Wan's legs suddenly went weak, and she fell towards the ground.

Zhao Mianze quickly caught her and helped her sit back in the pavilion.

"Mother, did what I say scare you too much?"

Yu Wan shook her head, wanting to say something, but tears welled up first.

"Mianze, in your memory, how did I die in my past life?"

"You were killed by Father's original wife, Lady Cui."

Cui Yichu...

Yu Wan's hand, resting on Zhao Mianze's wrist, suddenly tightened. Zhao Mianze had practiced martial arts since childhood and didn't feel the pain, but he could sense his mother's emotional turmoil.

Mother's reaction... didn't seem like she doubted his words?

But how could she believe such shocking words so quickly?

A bold conjecture slowly emerged in Zhao Mianze's mind.

"Have you seen Lady Cui?"

"No." Zhao Mianze suppressed his emotions and shook his head. "I heard from Great Grandmother that when I was just born, Lady Cui took care of me for a year. Later, when Father returned, he discovered that Lady Cui was not my birth mother. After that, Lady Cui was sent to the countryside."

He found out?!

Zhao Xuanyou found out?!

Yu Wan's eyes burned, and tears uncontrollably streamed down her face.

No matter how happy this life was, the events of her past life had always been a scar in Yu Wan's heart that she dared not touch.

She didn't dare to imagine what happened after her death, didn't dare to think about how Zhao Xuanyou would deal with Cui Yichu, didn't dare to think about how her son would treat Cui Yichu.

Of course, what she dared not think about even more was, what if Cui Yichu had other children, how would they treat her own son.

Hearing her son personally say Cui Yichu's fate in the past life, the deep scar in Yu Wan's heart finally healed.

So, Cui Yichu did not get her wish to grow old with Zhao Xuanyou, and her son did not mistake the enemy for his mother.

That's right.

That was Zhao Xuanyou, after all. How could Cui Yichu's tricks deceive him?

After the intense emotional turmoil, Yu Wan's mood slightly calmed. "Did your father divorce his wife later?"

"No, I heard that Lady Cui died of illness in the countryside not long after she was sent there."

At that time, Zhao Mianze was still young, and the people of the Marquis's mansion naturally didn't tell him the details about Lady Cui. He only knew that Lady Cui was the murderer who killed his birth mother.

Thinking of this, Zhao Mianze couldn't help but say indignantly, "She died too early. I couldn't avenge you, which was a stroke of luck for her."

"Mianze, as far as you know, how did I die in my past life?"

"Great Grandmother said that after you gave birth to me, Lady Cui killed you and wanted to take me as her own son."

Hearing this, Yu Wan was certain that Mianze was her son from her past life.

She could no longer suppress the excitement in her heart and pulled Zhao Mianze into her arms.

"Mianze, did you live well in your past life?"

To be honest, Zhao Mianze had lived quite well in his past life.

The family of the Marquis's mansion all cared for him deeply. After growing up, he married his beloved Luan Luan, and they had a pair of adorable children.

He hesitated, wondering if saying this would hurt his mother's feelings, but when he looked up, he met Yu Wan's concerned gaze.

He suddenly felt at ease.

How could his mother bear a grudge against him for living well? She would only hope that he lived well.

"I lived quite well before. It wasn't as glorious as being a prince now, but being the heir of the Marquis's mansion wasn't bad either. Luan Luan was my wife in the past life. We grew old together and died of old age."

"That's good," Yu Wan said. Confirming that her son had also lived well in his past life, the heart that had been hanging since her rebirth finally settled. She tightly hugged her son and softly said, "Mianze, Mother missed you very much, every day."

Yu Wan's words connected with Zhao Mianze's earlier conjecture, striking him deeply.

"Mother, why do you believe my words so much? Could it be that you..."

Yu Wan's face was covered in tears. "I am the same as you. After being killed by Cui Yichu in my past life, I was reborn into this life."

Reborn?

Just like him?

Was the mother in this life the same as his mother from his past life?

Yu Wan was crying, but Zhao Mianze was overjoyed.

"Really? Mother, is this true?"

Seeing her son so happy, Yu Wan's tears flowed even more, but this time they were tears of joy.

Heaven had truly been kind to her. Not only had it given her a chance to live again, but it had also restored the mother-son bond she had lost in her past life.

"It's true, it's really true."

"So good! So good! Mother, I've never been this happy before!"

"What's so happy?"

Zhao Xuanyou's voice came from outside the pavilion. Yu Wan and Zhao Mianze both turned their heads.

"Ah Ning said that Second Brother did something wrong and was being punished. I didn't expect you two to be hiding here, secretly having fun."

Although Zhao Xuanyou was teasing Yu Wan, he also saw the tear stains on her face.

Seeing that she was still hugging her son, Zhao Xuanyou reached out to wipe her tears.

"At first, I thought he had done something wrong, but after talking, it's already resolved." Yu Wan tried her best to calm down, but the joy in her heart couldn't be concealed. "Why did you come here?"

"It's good that nothing happened. I was worried you might have been upset."

Zhao Xuanyou had learned about Zhao Mianze's trouble from Ah Ning. Seeing that the mother and son hadn't returned to the Yaoguang Palace for a long time, he thought Zhao Mianze might be disobedient, so he came to check.

"Let's go back to the palace."

In front of Zhao Xuanyou, Yu Wan naturally couldn't ask her son about his past life anymore. She tried to calm her emotions and let go of Zhao Mianze.

Back at the Yaoguang Palace, the whole family ate together. After the children all went to sleep, Zhao Xuanyou took Yu Wan's hand and entered the bedroom.

The red silk soft canopy hung low, and the pillows and quilts were fragrant and soft. The couple sat on the bed, their faces only a few inches apart.

Zhao Xuanyou's gaze deepened slightly. As he was about to kiss her, Yu Wan looked into his eyes and suddenly realized something.

She slightly leaned back and softly asked, "Earlier, when you were in the imperial garden, didn't you hear what Mianze and I were talking about?"

Zhao Xuanyou's affectionate gesture paused. Hearing her words, he slightly raised his eyebrows.

"I heard Mianze saying something happy."

"Only that?"

Earlier, Yu Wan was immersed in the joy of recognizing her son, and many things didn't have time to think through.

Now that she had calmed down, she suddenly felt that Zhao Xuanyou's timing was too coincidental.

How could he just happen to appear right after she and her son had finished saying the most important things?

Zhao Xuanyou had excellent lightness skills and strong hearing.

Could it be that he had already arrived at the fake mountain long ago and quietly stood by, listening to their entire conversation?

Yu Wan's heart suddenly sank.

chapters.title: Extra – Rainy Night Boat Ride on the Lake
chapters.content:
"So serious? What did you two talk about?" Zhao Xuanyou teased.

Yu Wan tilted her head and stared at him, smiling gently. "Our mother-son secrets can't be told to you."

"Not even me?"

Zhao Xuanyou asked softly, with a tender smile hidden in the depths of his profound eyes.

No.

Her and Mianze's secret, she didn't want to tell anyone, not even Zhao Xuanyou.

But... if he had heard it himself, then it was fine. After all, he was Zhao Xuanyou.

After thinking, Yu Wan skipped the details. "Our son has a crush."

"Oh?" Zhao Xuanyou indeed became interested. "Did he take a fancy to someone at the imperial garden today?"

Yu Wan stretched lazily. She was indeed tired after a whole day of busyness.

Seeing that Zhao Xuanyou still wasn't sleepy, Yu Wan leaned against his shoulder.

"Yes."

"The flower banquet was originally held for Yi Yun to choose a consort. Unexpectedly, Mianze stumbled upon his luck. Which family's girl has Mianze set his eyes on?"

"Daughter of Minister Qi from the Ministry of Revenue, named Qi Luan."

"So it's settled?"

"They are still young. There's no need to rush. We should at least wait until Yi Yun gets married before making preparations." Thinking of Mianze's persistence towards Qi Luan, Yu Wan added, "Another day, when you meet Minister Qi, you can mention it to him, so he doesn't arrange other marriages for his daughter."

"Understood." Zhao Xuanyou pondered for a moment, then softly said, "Yi Yun hasn't married yet, and many court officials have some complaints. His marriage to Ah Ning will probably have to be announced to the world this year to settle people's minds."

Yi Yun was the emperor, and every move he made was watched by countless eyes.

The 17-year-old emperor still had no empress or concubines, and there were indeed many rumors outside.

"Let Ah Ning get married now?"

"Not get married now, just announce the marriage to the world."

Zhao Xuanyou was reluctant to let his daughter get married early, even if it was just moving to the Kunning Palace.

Yi Yun's feelings had never changed, and although Yu Wan had never asked Ah Ning, Zhao Xuanyou could see his daughter's intentions.

It was good to settle the marriage.

"That's true. We can't let others criticize Yi Yun." At this point, Yu Wan lightly sighed. "Once the marriage is settled, can Yi Yun start ruling personally?"

Zhao Xuanyou let out a low laugh.

Outsiders said that they controlled the puppet emperor Yi Yun and ruled in his place, but in reality, they had always been looking forward to Yi Yun ruling on his own.

"Yi Yun is smart. He has been able to handle things on his own for a long time."

"Isn't that right." Yu Wan muttered, pulling Zhao Xuanyou to lie down, her thoughts flying back to the days when they traveled everywhere, north and south.

She blinked and sighed softly, "We can't go out and blame Yi Yun. It's all because of that boy, Mian Yan."

Both families' elders were old, and they couldn't leave the responsibility of taking care of Mian Yan to the elders. Wen Biao and Miaotong took Ah Ning on a long trip every year, which was hard enough.

"Yes, there must be adults in the palace to keep an eye on things. We can't leave a group of children to cause trouble."

Yu Wan heard this and suddenly had an idea.

Adults... wasn't Mianze an adult?

But she couldn't say this directly.

"They are not young anymore. Not to mention Yi Yun, Mianze is also steady in his actions. Ah Ning is even more sensible. The only headache is Mian Yan. But Mian Yan usually listens to Mianze the most. Even if we leave the palace, Mianze can take care of his younger brother."

"Are you serious?"

Yu Wan's face was full of smiles. "Of course, I'm serious. We've always said that Yi Yun should rule personally. We might as well let him try once. As for the matters in the harem, they will eventually have to be entrusted to Ah Ning. It's time for her to gain experience."

Yi Yun could indeed handle court affairs by himself, but Ah Ning...

"Suddenly letting Ah Ning manage the harem affairs, can she handle it?"

"There are not many concubines in the palace. With Mianze assisting her, she can manage. Our daughter is capable."

"You seem to have suddenly gained a lot of confidence in Mianze." Zhao Xuanyou teased.

Yu Wan smiled. "I have always had confidence in Mianze. It's you who have been too strict with him."

"If you are so confident, then let's leave the palace and travel freely for two or three months."

Zhao Xuanyou had long known that Yu Wan was bored in the royal palace and naturally agreed.

The next day, they called all four children to the Yaoguang Palace and told them about their plan to travel incognito.

The children knew their parents' hardships and had long known their intention to travel, so they were naturally happy with their decision.

With the children's support, the couple quickly packed their bags and left the palace incognito.

They did not bring any attendants with them but instead hired a boat from the capital to Jiangnan.

Yu Wan first took Zhao Xuanyou to Qingsha Town.

Although the Shuyu Pavilion had changed owners, the reputation built by Ding Wenxi and Yu Wan when they managed the shop remained, and the shop's signboard was unchanged. Most of the seamstresses were still there.

Yu Wan told Zhao Xuanyou in detail about the old days when she hid and managed the shop, pulling him to look at the pearls of various shapes on the dock, and leading him to sit by the sea to feel the damp wind.

After staying in Qingsha Town for half a month, the two went to Taihu Lake and hired a pleasure boat to tour the lake.

That night, a light rain began to fall on the lake. The couple sat in the pleasure boat with candles, eating fruit wine and pastries, enjoying a rainy night boat ride.

While talking, the pleasure boat suddenly shook, as it had collided with another boat.

Zhao Xuanyou had Yu Wan stay in the cabin while he took an umbrella and went out to check. Unexpectedly, he encountered an old acquaintance.

"Minister Pei, long time no see."

On the deck of the other pleasure boat, Pei Tao stood with a dignified and refined demeanor in his loose clothes.

Beside him stood a woman in a green dress, a new style of embroidered skirt popular in Jiangnan.

The woman held an oil-paper umbrella behind Pei Tao, shielding him from the rain.

Zhao Xuanyou had previously heard that Pei Tao had gotten married and sent a congratulatory gift, but it was today that he finally saw Madame Pei.

"It has indeed been a long time."

Pei Tao's expression was calm, and he did not address Zhao Xuanyou, only cupping his hands in greeting.

Zhao Xuanyou was here incognito and did not want to draw attention.

"Has Minister Pei been away from the capital for two years?"

"Almost two years, three months short."

When Yi Yun had just ascended the throne, Pei Tao did not side with Prime Minister Xu. Thus, Yi Yun relied heavily on him, letting him preside over two imperial examinations in a row, selecting many civil officials for the court, preventing the court officials from being dominated by Prime Minister Xu.

Many people said that Yi Yun would definitely appoint Pei Tao as prime minister once he ruled personally, and Yi Yun indeed had that intention.

But last year, there was a vacancy for the position of governor in Jiangnan. Pei Tao took the initiative to request a decree to go to Jiangnan.

Yi Yun had intended to retain him, but Pei Tao was determined, so he eventually went to Jiangnan to become the governor.

"Wan is also here. Would you like to come over for a drink?"

This was the first time Zhao Xuanyou had invited Pei Tao for a drink.

Pei Tao glanced at the cabin behind Zhao Xuanyou. Through the window, he saw the orange candlelight inside and imagined that Yu Wan was waiting for Zhao Xuanyou in that soft glow. He smiled faintly. "The night is deep and the rain is heavy. I won't disturb your elegant mood."

The phoenix perches on the wutong tree, and the mandarin ducks share deep affection. Zhao Xuanyou was Yu Wan's best destination.

As for him and Yu Wan, they had long since completely severed their past.

Pei Tao cupped his hands to Zhao Xuanyou once more, took the umbrella from his wife's hands, and with his arm around her, they returned to their cabin.

Zhao Xuanyou stood on the deck, watching Pei Tao and his wife's pleasure boat drift away. Then he turned and went back with the umbrella.

He had been gone for a long time, and Yu Wan, bored, was playing with the candle wick with a pair of scissors.

"Why did you take so long? Is the boat okay?"

"It's fine."

Zhao Xuanyou sat down beside Yu Wan and picked up the fruit wine on the table to toast with her.

Outside, the rain was drizzling, and inside, the candlelight was warm.
